description: Big, rich and off-dry, this is powered by intense spiciness and rounded texture. Lychees dominate the fruit profile, giving an opulent feel to the aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2012 Lieu-dit Harth Cuvée Caroline Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Big, rich and off-dry, this is powered by intense spiciness and rounded texture. Lychees dominate the fruit profile, giving an opulent feel to the aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2012 Lieu-dit Harth Cuvée Caroline Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A dry style of Pinot Gris, this is crisp with some acidity. It also has weight and a solid, powerful core of spice and baked apple flavors. With its structure still developing, the wine needs to age. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2012 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Well-drained gravel soil gives this wine its crisp and dry character. It is ripe and fruity, although the spice is subdued in favor of a more serious structure. This is a wine to age for a couple of years, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Gresser 2013 Kritt Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: While it's rich, this beautiful dry wine also offers considerable freshness. Acidity cuts easily through the ripe white fruit, pear and red apples, allowing room for spice that provides a contrasting aftertaste.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2013 Seppi Landmann Vallée Noble Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Initially quite muted, this wine slowly develops impressive richness and spice. It's not sweet, more medium dry, with the spice forming a core of dryness that contrasts with the honeyed texture. It can develop more, so wait to drink until 2016.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2013 Domaine Saint-Rémy Herrenweg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The granite soil of the Brand Grand Cru vineyard has produced a strongly structured wine that also has richness and ripe fruits. Off dry, it has a hint of honey as well as yellow fruits and pears. The aftertaste brings out the acidity and freshness that balance the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2010 Brand Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Hugely spicy this rich wine is described as sweet. In fact, the spice gives it a drier edge, adding pepper and cinnamon as well as a mineral character from the granite soil. The wine could age, so drink from 2016.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2012 Holder Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A blend from several premier cru vineyards in Pommard, here is a wine that exhibits just the right firm but dusty tannins of the appellation. But because it is 2005, the natural exuberance of the fruit is also there, lively red berries under the dry structure. It needs some aging, but already the richness is there, along with a smoky aftertaste.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2005 Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A blend from several premier cru vineyards in Pommard, here is a wine that exhibits just the right firm but dusty tannins of the appellation. But because it is 2005, the natural exuberance of the fruit is also there, lively red berries under the dry structure. It needs some aging, but already the richness is there, along with a smoky aftertaste.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2005 Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A powerful, chunky wine, packed with solid tannins that promise good aging. It has a sense of drama in its spice, dark tannins and spacious fruit. This is going to develop well over 5–10 years.
title: Henri de Villamont 2005  Grands-Echezeaux

description: This full-bodied, lush white is mainly Grenache Blanc (70%), so I'd opt for drinking it over the next few years. Marshmallow and peach notes combine easily, then finish long and honeyed.
title: Château Maucoil 2014 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A fine value for a northern Rhône of this quality, this bottling from the Tain cooperative is full bodied and ripe, but with enough acidity for balance. Modest pear and melon flavors evolve on the palate into bolder honey and bergamot notes on the long finish. Drink now.
title: Cave de Tain 2015 Grand Classique Marsanne (Saint-Péray)

description: A fine value for a northern Rhône of this quality, this bottling from the Tain cooperative is full bodied and ripe, but with enough acidity for balance. Modest pear and melon flavors evolve on the palate into bolder honey and bergamot notes on the long finish. Drink now.
title: Cave de Tain 2015 Grand Classique Marsanne (Saint-Péray)

description: Despite its proximity to Bordeaux, the Marmandais has managed to retain Abouriou as its own grape variety. As part of its conservatory of some of the more obscure grape varieties, this producer has made this fine and fruity wine. It is smoky with attractive tannins and swathes of juicy black fruits. It's a fine wine to drink now.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2014 Abouriou (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Saint-Péray is an tiny and underappreciated source of northern Rhône whites, mainly Marsanne, with some Roussanne in the mix. This barrel-fermented version is rich and full-bodied, boasting melon and pineapple fruit flavors that take on hints of creamed corn and citrus on the finish. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2015 La Belle de Mai Roussanne-Marsanne (Saint-Péray)

description: Saint-Péray is an tiny and underappreciated source of northern Rhône whites, mainly Marsanne, with some Roussanne in the mix. This barrel-fermented version is rich and full-bodied, boasting melon and pineapple fruit flavors that take on hints of creamed corn and citrus on the finish. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2015 La Belle de Mai Roussanne-Marsanne (Saint-Péray)

description: This is a delicious, ripe and fruity wine that comes from the south of Beaujolais. It has ripe red-berry fruits and soft tannins allied to a juicy acidity that keeps it all fresh. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Terres Dorées 2015 L'Ancien  (Beaujolais)

description: The Gelin family has produced a rich style of wine, full of red-berry and cherry fruit. The wine is concentrated and full-bodied, giving a deliciously ripe character. The tannins are there adding support and extra density. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: The middle wine in the trilogy of wines from the Molinié family at Ponzac, this is a ripe wine that has density, some firm tannins and rich black-plum fruit flavors. It is concentrated and firm at first and then fills out with the richness. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Château Ponzac 2014 Patiemment Malbec (Cahors)

description: A reticent nose on this wine tells only of earth and faint citrus at this point. The uncompromisingly dry palate however, is perfumed with conifer and citrus zest around a fluid, concentrated center. The tart, super-clean lemon finish tingles enticingly.
title: Boeckel 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Notes of herb and stone color the subdued fruit of the nose on this wine. The medium-sweet palate reveals a more honeyed nature, hemmed in by a pithy, almost earthy bitterness of citrus peel, giving both balance and texture. The long finish is concentrated.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2013 Cuvée Saint Jacques Riesling (Alsace)

description: Although initially austere, this wine then opens out well, giving a firm and structured character. There are spice, solid dry tannins and a fine layer of berry fruits, finishing off with lively acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2006  Médoc

description: Delicate aromas of stone fruits and gardenia open this pretty little wine. The palate is not intense, but has genuinely appealing apricot notes and zesty acidity which carry through to the mineral-tinged finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2007 Réserve Spéciale Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Delicate aromas of stone fruits and gardenia open this pretty little wine. The palate is not intense, but has genuinely appealing apricot notes and zesty acidity which carry through to the mineral-tinged finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2007 Réserve Spéciale Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A fresh, juicy wine, with attractive acidity, red berry flavors and a layer of well balanced tannins. Very perfumed, with hints of mineral and final acidity.
title: Camille Giroud 2008  Côte de Beaune-Villages

description: Aromas of ripe yellow fruits announce a wine that has rich fruit flavors of apricots touched by pineapple. It does have the attractive, nervy texture of 2008, along with an important layer of toast.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2008  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Concentrated, with dark tannins to go with the ripe fruit. There is a tough edge to the wine, although it is more accessible than some Nuits-Saint-Georges at this stage.
title: Louis Latour 2009 Les Damodes  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Soft, ripe and rich, this is very easy on the palate. The wine does have good depth of flavor from the rounded black cherry flavors, the fruit almost sweet in its openness. It is already delicious.
title: Louis Latour 2009 En Chevret  (Volnay)

description: Pure, ripe strawberry flavors are pierced with acidity. The texture is soft, with a dry side. The raspberry acidity cuts right to the end.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Chambolle-Musigny

description: Crisp sparkling Burgundy, laced with taut acidity and hints of nuts and toast. This is a wine under tension, with a strong mineral element, cool and fresh, best with food.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2007  Crémant de Bourgogne

description: Crisp sparkling Burgundy, laced with taut acidity and hints of nuts and toast. This is a wine under tension, with a strong mineral element, cool and fresh, best with food.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2007  Crémant de Bourgogne

description: A tight, tannic wine, showing considerable acidity as well as fresh red fruits. The wine is densely packed with dry tannins, then a fruity character develops, sparked by acidity.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2008 Les Borniques  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: Soft, round and perfumed, this has rich red fruits that are laced with youthful acids and tannins. With its texture, it has good aging potential; give it 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2010  Volnay

description: Intense, rich and creamy, this effortlessly balances the wood influence with the apricot and white peach flavors. It demonstrates the opulence of the year while remaining structured. Developing well, this is almost ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2010  Montagny

description: This has a firm edge of tannins along with dense red fruits. It's structured and balanced, with the texture and acidity that suggest its aging potential. Give this 3–4 years.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2010 Les Puillets Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: This has a firm edge of tannins along with dense red fruits. It's structured and balanced, with the texture and acidity that suggest its aging potential. Give this 3–4 years.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2010 Les Puillets Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: This is wood laden, with sweet fruit that compensates for the toastiness. The oak element should integrate well in the next 2–3 years, making for a wine that's soft and sweetly fruity, with smoky acidity.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010 Hauts Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This is wood laden, with sweet fruit that compensates for the toastiness. The oak element should integrate well in the next 2–3 years, making for a wine that's soft and sweetly fruity, with smoky acidity.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010 Hauts Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Close to the beach of Pampelonne, this is a ancient vineyard. It has produced a 2013 that is full of fruit, dense red flavors and fresh acidity. The wine is rich and lightly textured.
title: Mas de Pampelonne 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Soft and ripe, it is gently fruity with light acidity. Plenty of red berry flavors are cut with a textured edge. Light and stylish, it is a fine apéritif style.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a barely pink rosé, perfect to reflect the Mediterranean sea. Fresh and fruity, it carries just the lightest tang of lemon zest and is ready to drink.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2013 Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is a fruity, lightly mineral and fresh wine. With pure and crisp apple and lemon flavors, it's already a pleasure to drink now.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2012 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a fruity, lightly mineral and fresh wine. With pure and crisp apple and lemon flavors, it's already a pleasure to drink now.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2012 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Balancing fruit and ripe spice, it merits a place at the table rather than just serving as an apéritif. It has peach, lychee and a just off-dry character that allows for acidity. Drink now
title: Gustave Lorentz 2012 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Crisp and fruity, this mature-tasting wine has a fine toasty element in the background. Ripe and full with a creamy texture and warming aftertaste, it's ready to drink.
title: Castelnau NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Crisp and fruity, this mature-tasting wine has a fine toasty element in the background. Ripe and full with a creamy texture and warming aftertaste, it's ready to drink.
title: Castelnau NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: In order to maintain freshness and crispness in his Champagnes, this producer blocks malolactic fermentation. That results in a wine that is fruity yet on the dry side of Brut. Citrus and green apple flavors dominate the tight and textured palate. Drink now.
title: Bruno Gobillard NV Domaine Vieilles Vignes Brut  (Champagne)

description: Here's a bright and aromatic selection, with forward aromas of red plum, cherry and raspberry. Mouthwatering and inviting, ripe and juicy fruit flavors flood the palate. This is fresh, lively and extremely approachable now.
title: Domaine Mirabau 2011 Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: Dominated by tannins, this is a firm, solid and chunky wine. Black plum skins, juicy blackberries are layered over a dry, dark core. There is a hint of the 12 months' wood aging, but the wine is more about the rich fruit. Drink from 2014.
title: Domaine les Hauts de Riquets 2011 Le Mignon Red (Côtes de Duras)

description: Soft, fragrant wine, layering raspberry and red currant fruit with elegant tannins and acidity. The wood aging shows lightly, giving a wine that is fruity and ripe. Drink from 2014.
title: René Muré 2011 Côte de Rouffach Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A level portion of this premier cru, called Les Plateaux, is the origin of this wine. As befits a wine from Nuits Saint-Georges, it is dark with tannins as well as fruit. It has a good structure, with dense blackberry and plum flavors that are developing. Give this wine until 2022.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A level portion of this premier cru, called Les Plateaux, is the origin of this wine. As befits a wine from Nuits Saint-Georges, it is dark with tannins as well as fruit. It has a good structure, with dense blackberry and plum flavors that are developing. Give this wine until 2022.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: With spice and layers of wood aging over the black-cherry fruit, this is a wine in progress. It has the bright character of the vintage, full of acidity and with the potential of great fruitiness. From the Vergennes sub-section of the Corton Grand Cru, it has a good future. Drink from 2021.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Corton Vergennes

description: With spice and layers of wood aging over the black-cherry fruit, this is a wine in progress. It has the bright character of the vintage, full of acidity and with the potential of great fruitiness. From the Vergennes sub-section of the Corton Grand Cru, it has a good future. Drink from 2021.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Corton Vergennes

description: Classically powerful and rich, this is a concentrated wine. With spice from the wood aging prominent, it is still young. That spice is balanced by the ripe yellow and baked-apple fruits. The aftertaste has delicious flavors of honey and lemon. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This will be a delicious, ripe and full wine. Already the red fruits and acidity are filling out the generous space left by the spicy wood. It has dark, smoky tannins and a rich character. Drink from 2019.
title: Jaffelin 2014 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This will be a delicious, ripe and full wine. Already the red fruits and acidity are filling out the generous space left by the spicy wood. It has dark, smoky tannins and a rich character. Drink from 2019.
title: Jaffelin 2014 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: A perfumed wine with red fruits, this offers dry tannins and a dense texture. With all these elements in place, the wine will develop slowly and well. Drink from 2021.
title: Tollot Beaut et Fils 2014 Les Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: As dense as Muscadet gets, this is a full, concentrated wine in its white fruit flavors. Its broad, rounded character is pierced by lemon and lime acidity. Age for six months.
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2010 Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A complex style of Muscadet, this starts with crisp citrus flavors and a tight structure. It has density and a fine, nervy edge that offers a delicate perfumed character as well as the possibility of aging. Drink from 2014. Screwcap.
designation: Les Frères Couillaud Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie
title: Château de la Ragotiere 2012 Les Frères Couillaud Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A complex style of Muscadet, this starts with crisp citrus flavors and a tight structure. It has density and a fine, nervy edge that offers a delicate perfumed character as well as the possibility of aging. Drink from 2014. Screwcap.
designation: Les Frères Couillaud Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie
title: Château de la Ragotiere 2012 Les Frères Couillaud Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This medium-sized négociant is making an effort at upgrading its wines, and this is a solid example. Thyme and bay leaf notes mark the black cherry fruit, picking up hints of black tea that turn dusty and dry on the finish. A bit stern for the vintage, it should be consumed over the next couple of years before the fruit fades.
title: Lavau 2011 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A perennially attention-worthy wine, the Jaume family's Grande Garrigue Vacqueyras combines bold black cherry fruit with spicy notes suggestive of licorice root and bay leaf. It's full bodied and round in the mouth, but the fruit remains fresh, ending on a mouthwatering note of acidity. Drink now–2018.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2011 Grand Garrigue Red (Vacqueyras)

description: Very rich and packed with yellow and tropical fruits, this is a complex, wood-aged wine. It has a strong toasty edge that gives burnt spice that is balanced by the rich fruitiness. Acidity follows, making an appearance in the fresh finish. Drink from 2014.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2011 Moulin des Dames White (Bergerac Sec)

description: This is a powerhouse of ripe fruits, strong tannins and dark acidity. It burst out of the glass with its bold, firm flavors and solid structure. It is already balanced, the fruit complementing the dense texture. But it will certainly develop more and age very well. Drink in 2016 and until 2022.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2011 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is pretty pale for a Tavel, with a coppery tinge to its pink color. Notes of lime zest, wet stone and modest cherry-berry notes finish on a bright citrus note.
title: Prieuré de Montézargues 2014  Tavel

description: This is pretty pale for a Tavel, with a coppery tinge to its pink color. Notes of lime zest, wet stone and modest cherry-berry notes finish on a bright citrus note.
title: Prieuré de Montézargues 2014  Tavel

description: This ripe and full-bodied wine has weight as well as fine fruits. It is juicy, still fresh with its acidity and still structured. Aging for 12 months in large barrels has given an extra richness as well as broadening the fruitiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul Balland 2014  Sancerre

description: This ripe and full-bodied wine has weight as well as fine fruits. It is juicy, still fresh with its acidity and still structured. Aging for 12 months in large barrels has given an extra richness as well as broadening the fruitiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul Balland 2014  Sancerre

description: The picturesque name of the wine, the vineyard where God sits, comes from a monopole—a walled property in the hills behind Beaune, wholly owned by the Château de Santenay. Ripe and smooth with an attractive, crisp texture, the wine is ready to drink. A touch of toast gives extra interest.
title: Château de Santenay 2012 Clos de la Chaise Dieu  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune)

description: Produced from the rare Romorantin grape, this wine is honeyed as well as crisp and fragrantly fruity. The 50-year-old vines give extra concentration to this lightly wood-aged wine that is ripe while also light and poised. Drink now, although it would be better to keep it until 2017.
title: Benoît Daridan 2014 Vieilles Vignes Romorantin (Cour-Cheverny)

description: From one of the few estates in Saint-Julien that is not a classified growth, this wine represents a bargain. The wine is rich, perfumed and beautifully structured. It has a velvety consistency with its ripe black currants and generous tannins. The estate is named after the mill belonging to Abbot Bridane in the Middle Ages. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Moulin de la Bridane 2015  Saint-Julien

description: The second wine of this Premier Grand Cru Classé estate is very fine. With its rich tannins, generous acidity and black fruits, it is solid and dense while having such attractive fruitiness. The wine will age well, full of ripe fruit and with excellent concentration. Drink from 2021.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2015 Dame Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The second wine of this Premier Grand Cru Classé estate is very fine. With its rich tannins, generous acidity and black fruits, it is solid and dense while having such attractive fruitiness. The wine will age well, full of ripe fruit and with excellent concentration. Drink from 2021.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2015 Dame Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This very lemony wine is crisp and cool from the mountain vineyards of Savoy. It has a bright, creamy texture and baked-apple and pear flavors accented with a shot of citrusy acidity. It's a wine to drink now.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2012  Roussette de Savoie

description: This very lemony wine is crisp and cool from the mountain vineyards of Savoy. It has a bright, creamy texture and baked-apple and pear flavors accented with a shot of citrusy acidity. It's a wine to drink now.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2012  Roussette de Savoie

description: Soft and light, this is a fresh, fragrant wine, full of bright, lemony acidity and fruitiness. It's the perfect apéritif with its lively texture and bouncy, crisp feel.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2012 Cruet Jacquère (Savoie)

description: The aromas are of new wood and toast as much as fruit, and this follows on the palate. It has strong burnt-toast flavors along with a full textured palate. Blackberry fruits are under this weight of wood, and need several years to emerge, although the wine will always have a strong wood component. Drink from 2017
title: Château Roquetaillade la Grange 2009  Graves

description: The Lelarge family has been on the northern slopes of the Montagne de Reims since the 18th century. The family's non-vintage Champagne is soft, rounded and creamy. It has fresh citrus and tangy orange zest fruits that are tight, crisp and with a direct line of acidity. It's totally ready to drink.
title: Lelarge-Pugeot NV Premier Cru Brut Tradition  (Champagne)

description: This is a powerful, big-hearted Malbec, full of rich fruits and perfume. Flavors of black-plum skin and licorice are encased in firm tannins and juicy acidity that lingers on the finish. A wine with concentration meant for hearty meat dishes.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Pont du Diable Malbec (Vin de France)

description: This is a powerful, big-hearted Malbec, full of rich fruits and perfume. Flavors of black-plum skin and licorice are encased in firm tannins and juicy acidity that lingers on the finish. A wine with concentration meant for hearty meat dishes.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Pont du Diable Malbec (Vin de France)

description: This delicious, opulent Blanc de Blancs emphasizes rich fruit as much as minerality. Full of ripe apple flavor, along with hints of lemon juice and apricot, this has a fine depth of flavor and delivers a fragrant, refreshing finish.
title: Drappier NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: New wood aromas are still strongly evident in this young and fruity wine. It has ripe tannins, a juicy character and attractive, forward fruitiness. The aftertaste has delicious acidity and freshness.
title: Château Vieux Cardinal Lafaurie 2011  Lalande de Pomerol

description: New wood aromas are still strongly evident in this young and fruity wine. It has ripe tannins, a juicy character and attractive, forward fruitiness. The aftertaste has delicious acidity and freshness.
title: Château Vieux Cardinal Lafaurie 2011  Lalande de Pomerol

description: The wine develops slowly in the glass, closed at first and then bringing on ripe fruits and firm tannins. There is a definite dryness here, solid, textured and darkly structured. It is meant for aging, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Château Tour Saint-Germain 2010 Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Wood flavors and bright fruits are combining well in this wine. It is a rich wine, bright and fruity at the same time. The structure is settling in to give a wine that has a good future. Producer Jacques-Henri Bravard identified 21 parcels (of different soils). All vines are certified organic. Drink from 2019.
title: Xavier Flouret 2014 Château Haut-Meneau Quai Lumière  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Most rosé Champagnes get their color by the addition of red wine. This wine gets its hue from the skins of red grapes macerating before fermentation. It has a deep pink color and a lightly tannic character, making for a rich wine flavored with red currants and finished with acidity.
title: Vollereaux NV Brut Rosé de Saignée Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: From a producer in the same family since 1834, this rosé is crisp and poised. Attractive red fruits are sharpened by orange zest and filled out with an edge of tannin from the addition of red wine to give color. The wine is young, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Boizel NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A pink-colored wine, this is ripe in red fruits. It is soft and creamy, with a touch of toast as well as fruitiness. On the dry side of Brut, it has a tight, mineral texture finished with crisp acidity.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Brut le Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A very fruity nose teases with the scent of ripe, yellow mirabelle plums. The palate is equally sprightly and full of primary fresh fruit, but here it is greengage and white currant rather than mirabelle. Wonderfully light-footed. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann NV Bonheur Festif Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This wine is ripe and immediately drinkable. It has a rich feel, the yellow and white stone-fruit flavors giving a full character that is soft and creamy. It is very ready to drink.
title: Joseph Perrier NV Cuvée Royale Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fruity wine, this is crisp with red currants and refreshingly tangy. The aftertaste continues the fresh style. Lively, bright and young, it makes a great apéritif.
title: Joseph Perrier NV Cuvée Brut Royale Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Strawberry compote on the nose leads to a berry-fruited palate with slightly more tartness: cranberry and red currant come to mind. The flavours are ultrafresh and invigorating, made even more so by the lively frothy fizz. This is joyful, fresh and generous. Drink soon.
title: Joseph Cattin NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The merest hint of pineapple hovers above the glass. This leads onto a full-fruited generous and fizzy palate of ripe mirabelle plum. It is exuberant with big bubbles of joy. Freshness is evident in the lemony tartness which provides a welcomed balance.
title: Joseph Cattin NV Brut Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: The merest hint of pineapple hovers above the glass. This leads onto a full-fruited generous and fizzy palate of ripe mirabelle plum. It is exuberant with big bubbles of joy. Freshness is evident in the lemony tartness which provides a welcomed balance.
title: Joseph Cattin NV Brut Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This Pinot Meunier-dominated wine makes great use of the grape's natural fruitiness and softness. It is ripe with swathes of acidity that have been tempered by the three years of reserve wines in this nonvintage blend. It is ready to drink.
title: Mondet NV Brut Grande Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Fresh tart apples provide the chief flavor on nose and palate. This is light bodied and crisp, refreshing and dry. The bubbles are frothy and provide lively, easy refreshment and a clean finish.
title: Domaine Jean-Luc Mader NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fresh tart apples provide the chief flavor on nose and palate. This is light bodied and crisp, refreshing and dry. The bubbles are frothy and provide lively, easy refreshment and a clean finish.
title: Domaine Jean-Luc Mader NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fortified dessert wines made from Malbec follow a tradition going back to the Middle Ages. This has a tawny-Port like quality, but is more structured and concentrated with a palate full of raisins and black-fruit flavors.
title: Château de Chambert NV Rogomme Malbec (Vin de Liqueur)

description: The aroma of this wine shows strong signs of the wood aging, although red fruits do show as well. There is a minty character from the new wood, berry fruit flavors and the juicy acidity of the vintage. The wine is going to age well over the medium term, so drink from 2015.
title: Château Croix de Mission 2011  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: Alain Thiénot's non vintage is ripe, rich and full-bodied—a departure from typical house style. It has signifcant weight on the palate with yellow- and citrus-fruit flavors, and a soft, generous feel. The finish is crisp, exhibiting acidity laced with lime.
title: Thiénot NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: Alain Thiénot's non vintage is ripe, rich and full-bodied—a departure from typical house style. It has signifcant weight on the palate with yellow- and citrus-fruit flavors, and a soft, generous feel. The finish is crisp, exhibiting acidity laced with lime.
title: Thiénot NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a crisp, dry wine that exibits delicious acidity, along with fresh citrus and green-apple flavors. It's bright and fruity, but has a textured undertow that promises good bottle aging. Ready to drink now, but could also benefit by cellaring for a year.
title: Philippe Fontaine NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Bitter black cherries are the hallmark of this rather hard-edged wine. It shows dark tannins and fruit that misses full richness. Maybe it is restrained power, maybe it will age, but the balance is not there now.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Les Peuillets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Bitter black cherries are the hallmark of this rather hard-edged wine. It shows dark tannins and fruit that misses full richness. Maybe it is restrained power, maybe it will age, but the balance is not there now.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Les Peuillets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This is a taut wine that's full of zest, acidity and delicate wild strawberry fruit. It has a hint of orange and almond, with a great crisp feeling.
title: Domaine de la Courtade 2011 L'Alycastre Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a taut wine that's full of zest, acidity and delicate wild strawberry fruit. It has a hint of orange and almond, with a great crisp feeling.
title: Domaine de la Courtade 2011 L'Alycastre Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a textured wine that's rich and round. Its citrus and red berry fruits are balanced with a spice and caramel character.
title: Château la Tour de l'Evêque 2011 Pétale de Rose Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The entry-level wine from Château d'Esclans, this is red fruited, with fine acidity. It has weight and a smooth texture, with a finish that's rounded and ripe.
title: Château d'Esclans 2011 Whispering Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The entry-level wine from Château d'Esclans, this is red fruited, with fine acidity. It has weight and a smooth texture, with a finish that's rounded and ripe.
title: Château d'Esclans 2011 Whispering Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Citrus acidity and raspberry fruit combine in this ripe, sun-drenched wine. It has a fine balance of crispness, with rich fruits and a delicate lemon note on the finish.
title: Château de Saint-Martin 2011 Eternelle Favorite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Citrus acidity and raspberry fruit combine in this ripe, sun-drenched wine. It has a fine balance of crispness, with rich fruits and a delicate lemon note on the finish.
title: Château de Saint-Martin 2011 Eternelle Favorite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Ripe black cherry fruit is underlain by hints of game in this medium-bodied Crozes from one of the world's biggest producers of Syrah. It's a clean, crisp wine with a faintly dusty texture to its finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Cave de Tain 2009 L'Esprit du Fief  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: Open, generous wine, the fruits showing round, white peach flavors dominant, with a crispening of lemon zest.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2008 Les Grands Cheneaux  (Mâcon-Verze)

description: Showing tightly crisp grapefruit and citrus flavors, with an intense dryness and acidity, this is classic Muscadet, fresh, very bright and green.
title: Domaine de Beauregard 2009  Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

description: Showing tightly crisp grapefruit and citrus flavors, with an intense dryness and acidity, this is classic Muscadet, fresh, very bright and green.
title: Domaine de Beauregard 2009  Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

description: Crisp, fresh sparkling wine, lightly creamy but more going towards green fruits, tight acidity. It doesn't need any bottle aging and really should be drunk in the next year to keep its essential freshness.
title: Manuel Olivier NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Crisp, fresh sparkling wine, lightly creamy but more going towards green fruits, tight acidity. It doesn't need any bottle aging and really should be drunk in the next year to keep its essential freshness.
title: Manuel Olivier NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Laurent Miquel has built a solid reputation making clean wines at a superb value, and this one doesn't disappoint. Fresh and lively notes of sweet pea and honeysuckle mingle with ripe tropical fruit and clementine citrus. Drink now.
title: Laurent Miquel 2010 Père et Fils Chardonnay-Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Honeysuckle and fresh grass mingle with aromas of nectarine and apricot pit on the bouquet, while the mouth offers vibrant flavors of sweet citrus and juicy fresh peach slices. Balanced and easy to drink with a kiss of toast on the close. Drink now.
title: Laurent Miquel 2009 Nord Sud Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Full and soft, this is a ripe and creamy wine, with generous melon and rich apple fruits. It is already delicious, though simple.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2009  Saint-Véran

description: This Blanquette (made with 90% Mauzac) offers a bouquet full of bright crisp red apple and melon core. The texture is creamy with fine bubbles and medium acidity, and the palate is loaded with satisfying sweet citrus rind and toasty brioche flavors. Drink now.
title: Château Rives-Blanques 2008 Brut Sparkling (Blanquette de Limoux)

description: A soft, buttery wine, full and fat, that shows rich fruit flavors. Warm spice and toast wrap around apricot and pear fruits, light acidity well integrated. To drink now.
title: Maison Champy 2009  Rully

description: Fresh apple, green grass, dandelion and a touch of soft smoke emanate from the glass, transitioning to flavors of gingered peach and spicy orange on the palate. Medium weight and well structured with nice complexity and evolution. Drink now.
title: Les Jamelles 2009 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Fresh apple, green grass, dandelion and a touch of soft smoke emanate from the glass, transitioning to flavors of gingered peach and spicy orange on the palate. Medium weight and well structured with nice complexity and evolution. Drink now.
title: Les Jamelles 2009 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Named after Léonie  Duchêne, one of the founders of this producer, this wine is soft, although with a drier character than in the past. It has apple fruitiness that is enhanced by almonds and a touch of spice. Drink now.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: Named after Léonie  Duchêne, one of the founders of this producer, this wine is soft, although with a drier character than in the past. It has apple fruitiness that is enhanced by almonds and a touch of spice. Drink now.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: A finely balanced wine, this is ripe with red fruits and also shot through with acidity and a crisp texture. Together they make for a refreshing, fruity wine. The current release also seems to have just the right bottle age. Drink now.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Brut Le Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The nose of those wine is fruit driven, with red apple and a riper notions of melon and strawberry. The same appetizing fruit plays on the light dry palate where some yeasty, brioche-like autolytic notes provide a sonorous counterpoint. The finish is dry, fresh and lasting.
title: Domaine G. Metz NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The nose of those wine is fruit driven, with red apple and a riper notions of melon and strawberry. The same appetizing fruit plays on the light dry palate where some yeasty, brioche-like autolytic notes provide a sonorous counterpoint. The finish is dry, fresh and lasting.
title: Domaine G. Metz NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Lovely notes of ripe mirabelle plum and yellow apple play on the nose. The palate adds a lot more citrus lightness and brightness to this and a finely fizzing mousse that heightens the impression of weightless freshness even more. This is a lovely, dry and invigorating apéritif.
title: Domaine Ehrhart NV Brut Prestige Domaine Saint Remy Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Ripe, soft and very drinkable, this has a generous structure that cushions the tannins with rounded black fruits. The acidity and the warm, generous character of the 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc blend net a fine representation of the fruity 2012s. This is Bordeaux consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt's home turf. Wooden fermenters and 16 months in barrel (40% new) necessitate time, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'A 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Ripe, soft and very drinkable, this has a generous structure that cushions the tannins with rounded black fruits. The acidity and the warm, generous character of the 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc blend net a fine representation of the fruity 2012s. This is Bordeaux consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt's home turf. Wooden fermenters and 16 months in barrel (40% new) necessitate time, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'A 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Hand-sorting and 18 months of aging is the key here. This 80% Merlot blend with 15% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Cabernet Franc offers a generously proportioned balance of tannins and black fruits. It has full-bodied character, packed with berry fruits and rich acidity. With all these elements, it will develop well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Frédignac 2012 Cuvée Terroir  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: There is a lovely, poised balance between fresh, crisp fruitiness and peppered spice in this wine made from the increasingly rare Chasselas. It is light, flavored with apple and quince, very attractive and ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2012 Vieilles Vignes Chasselas (Alsace)

description: Ripe and full in the mouth, this is a yellow fruit and citrus flavored wine. Tangy, salty and textured, it also has a rich feel with its peach and kiwi accents. It's a wine for aging, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Loew 2012 Bruderbach Clos des Frères Riesling (Alsace)

description: Rich, spicy and perfumed, this delicious wine is developing well and also has aging potential. It is packed with berry and plum fruits that parade with acidity and tannins that act as a support. It's still dense and the balanced fruit and tannins will allow it to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Ambe Tour Pourret 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine is rich, full in the mouth and delicious. With its creamy texture, baked apple flavors and sprinkling of spice, it's a dense and ripe wine that could be drunk now, but which will be better in 2016.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2013 Réserve Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Very spicy, yes, but also subtle, marrying exotic bergamot flavors with a structured, mineral texture. It is rich, cut with pepper as well as nutmeg, allowing room for some fresher acidity at the end. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Gérard Neumeyer 2012 Les Deux M Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Still tight and closed up, this wine has potential, offering ripe citrus and white fruits and nervy, tangy texture. Concentrated and dense, it's a wine for the long term; drink from 2020. Olivier is a large medieval hunting estate that, since the 19th century, has belonged to the Bethmann family. The 148 acres of vines and forests are managed environmentally.
title: Château Olivier 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Powerful and dense, this wine has great potential. With full-bodied blackberry fruits and acidity that push through the dark tannins, it shows a rich character that is impressive for the year. Drink from 2020. The property has been owned since 1999 by Sophie Lurton of neighboring Château Bouscaut.
title: Château Lamothe Bouscaut 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Ripe and tropical, this full-bodied wine conveys mango, quince and ripe white peach that accompany a rich texture. It's going to develop relatively quickly, so drink from 2018. Winemaker Stephan Carrier returned from Napa to take over winemaking after Irish businessman Lochlann Quinn bought the property in 2001. A new winery and barrel cellar opened in 2011. Hubert de Boüard of Château Angelus consults with Carrier. Fieuzal's newsletter is an accurate report on harvests.
title: Château de Fieuzal 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: True to the estate's signature style, this is a powerful, luscious wine. It's ripe with plum and berry fruits,layered with dark, firm tannins. There is a juicy element as well as black-coffee flavors from the enthusiastic use of wood. Give it time to integrate properly and drink from 2022.
title: Château Troplong Mondot 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Ripe and structured, this has black plum and ripe berry flavors that are lifted by the acidity typical of the vintage. Tannins are solid and dense, packed around the fruit, and show that the wine is still young. Drink this solid while fruity wine from 2020.
title: Château la Fleur-Pétrus 2013  Pomerol

description: Benefiting from the ripe 2009 fruit, this shows the attractive character of many value Bordeaux wines in this year. It has red plum fruits, touched with raisins along with toast, acidity and a balance of tannins.
title: Château des Combes 2009  Bordeaux

description: With plenty of acidity and tannins, this wine is almost trying to be a young red. Drink it like that with food and it will be worth it. The aftertaste has pepper and attractive spice.
title: Château de Marsan 2016  Bordeaux Clairet

description: Firmly structured, the wine is dry and with dark tannins. Its fruit is currently masked. Give it until late 2017.
title: Maison Hebrard 2015 Château des Trois Tours  (Bordeaux)

description: This is still a young wine, firm with tannins. The enthusiastic wood aging shows strongly in the smoky toasty flavor. It's hard to find the fruit.
title: Château Roc de Minvielle 2015 Cuvée Les Tourelles  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: I continue to be perplexed by the Pagan white Cuvée Lône. Like previous vintages, the 2016 is tight and lean, marked by underripe melon and citrus notes. The blend is 40% Clairette, 30% Bourboulenc, 20% Grenache Blanc and 10% Ugni Blanc.
title: Château Pégau 2016 Cuvée Lône White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The wine is rich and packed with superripe blackberry fruits. While there is acidity to keep the wine crisp, it does have a heavy feel to it from the high alcohol that also brings a pepper edge. Drink from 2018.
title: Chateau Malbat 2015  Bordeaux

description: This soft and creamy wine has a really bubbly rosé mousse. It has fruit and a crisp clean edge. The strawberry fruits give this wine a sweet character, certainly off dry. It is ready to drink.
title: Jaillance NV Cuvée de l'Abbaye Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bordeaux)

description: Layered tannins and wood flavors have tended to smother the fruit in this wine. That gives a dry, tough character not promising much for the future.
title: Château Laville 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Layered tannins and wood flavors have tended to smother the fruit in this wine. That gives a dry, tough character not promising much for the future.
title: Château Laville 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Firm with tannins, this is a dry wine. Its tough structure dominates the berry fruit, needing time to balance out. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Guitar 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a light- to medium-bodied rosé made exclusively from Syrah grown in the northern reaches of the Rhône Valley. The cooler climate gives it a lighter bearing and redder fruit flavors than many other Rhône rosés: this one resembles red plum and pineapple. Drink now.
title: Cave de Tain 2016 Première Note Rosé de Syrah (Collines Rhôdaniennes)

description: Made in a more savory style, this shows hints of nutty, putty-like aromas alongside cantaloupe and citrus. It's medium in body, with a dry, earthy finish.
title: Louis Bernard 2016 Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Situated in the heart of the heart of the Entre-deux-Mers, this estate has a long history dating back to the Middle Ages. With its stalky black currant fruit and acidity, this is fruity with a cool edge and a crisp edge. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Pey de Faure 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The tannins and high toast flavors have taken over this wine. The fruit has been submerged. It is difficult to see this completely balancing out.
title: Château Malbat 2015 C'est la Vie!  (Bordeaux)

description: A generous use of wood aging has given this wine a caramel flavor that lies awkwardly alongside the berry fruits. The aftertaste is dry.
title: Château Lamothe Castera 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine has too much wood. Tannins and spice as well as toast are present, but not enough fruit.
title: Château Grand Pascaud 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine has too much wood. Tannins and spice as well as toast are present, but not enough fruit.
title: Château Grand Pascaud 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: There's a medicinal cherry hint to the nose of this Syrah-based rosé, with additional notes of ripe peach and melon. It's fleshy and full-fruited on the palate, with just enough acidity to keep the ripeness in check.
title: Les Costières de Pomerols 2016 Beau Vignac Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This is a blend of Sémillon and Cabernet Franc. With its creamy texture and bright citrus flavors, it is an attractively fruity wine. Its crisp fruitiness makes it dry, although there is a soft side to the wine that blunts the acidity. Drink now.
title: Jaillance NV Cuvée de l'Abbaye Brut  (Crémant de Bordeaux)

description: 90-92 A ripe wine, keeping great swathes of freshness and offering the most delicioys acidity. Such a fresh wine, full of great blackberry fruist, very fresh as well as dense.
title: Château Potensac 2010 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 90-92 Severe in character, the acidity driving dry tannins. A wine for aging, although the juicy aftertaste is delicious now.
title: Château Moulin Saint-Georges 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 A wine that is smoky from the wood, while the tannins are firm and structured. It has a dark character, dominated by final new wood flavors.
title: Château Marquis d'Alesme 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92 A wine that is smoky from the wood, while the tannins are firm and structured. It has a dark character, dominated by final new wood flavors.
title: Château Marquis d'Alesme 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92 Structured, the second wine of Léoville las Cases, has solid tannins, chunky while melding into ripe black fruits. A fine second wine, ready to drink in 4-5 years.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2010 Barrel sample Le Petit Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 Structured, the second wine of Léoville las Cases, has solid tannins, chunky while melding into ripe black fruits. A fine second wine, ready to drink in 4-5 years.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2010 Barrel sample Le Petit Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 Densely tannic wine, with beautiful perfumes. It is ripe, concentrated, while retaining great charm
title: Château le Prieuré 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 So stylish, with its ripe, jammy berry fruits already a pleasure to appreciate. It does have structure to go with the new wood character. Probably not for the long-term.
title: Château Dassault 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Packed with new wood that dominates the fruit. The style does have some elegance, while the new wood will need to calm down.
title: Château Cos Labory 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92 Great swathes of sweet tannins and ripe berry fruits, the wine is delicious, ripe, concentrated and intense without losing charm.
title: Château Clarke 2010 Barrel sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Great swathes of sweet tannins and ripe berry fruits, the wine is delicious, ripe, concentrated and intense without losing charm.
title: Château Clarke 2010 Barrel sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Attractive floral perfumes, a wine that is soft initially then shows a fine herbaceous edge. Crisp, textured with hints of wood.
title: Château Brown 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Densely characterized wine, with its dark tannins, and powerful structure. Spice, juicy pepper, final acidity.
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 90-92 The wine has rich citrus and pear flavors, with weight, an oily texture and balanced wood spice to finish. Well structured.
title: Château Rahoul 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 90-92 Firm in character, with tannins that dominate. There is a good weight behind the tannins, with black fruits likely to come through well.
title: Château Rahoul 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 90-92 Delicious acidity, fresh in character, layering gentle tannins with black currant fruit and tight, nervy acidity. A juicy, fruity aftertaste. Well integrated.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Delicious acidity, fresh in character, layering gentle tannins with black currant fruit and tight, nervy acidity. A juicy, fruity aftertaste. Well integrated.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Beautifully perfumed wine, the tannins relatively gentle. It has packed weight, as well as ripe berry fruits.
title: Château Lafon-Rochet 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92 Firm and tannic, while there are also sweet berry fruits and black currant flavors. The acidity is important.
designation: Barrel sample La Chapelle de la Mission Haut-Brion
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2010 Barrel sample La Chapelle de la Mission Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Firm, concentrated, dry wine. It seems to be all structure, until the sweet juicy plum fruits show through.
title: Château Fourcas Dupré 2010 Barrel sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 91-93 The wine is tight, densely textured, very firm in character. It has considerable weight to go with the sweet fruit, very powerful.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 91-93 Very powerful spicy wine with rounded fruit despite the dense tannins. It has juicy acidity, finishing with a dark, dry aftertaste.
title: Château Quinault L'Enclos 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91-93 Very powerful spicy wine with rounded fruit despite the dense tannins. It has juicy acidity, finishing with a dark, dry aftertaste.
title: Château Quinault L'Enclos 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91-93 Firm while also rounded, very rich Merlot spice and blackberry character. There are hugely dense, extracted tannins, with a final dark fruit character.
title: Château le Bon Pasteur 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91-93 Fresh, citrus and spicy pear flavors, a wine laced with acidity, a crisp texture and elegant bright aftertaste.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93 Fresh, citrus and spicy pear flavors, a wine laced with acidity, a crisp texture and elegant bright aftertaste.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93 Rich, the structure all a part of the ripe blackberry fruits, very dark in style. The wine is very ripe, still retaining elegance
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 91-93 Finely structured, richly juicy fruit, packed with ripe tannins and great swathes of rich blackberry. It is intense, as well as well integrated.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91-93 Rich more than dry, the palate a very spicy character, the texture full, unctuous, but more than just sweet.
title: Château d'Arche 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 91-93 This is no longer a second wine, but a wine with its own portion of Ducru-Beaucaillou's vineyard. It is juicy, rich, without being overpowering. The acidity at the end is both very ripe and very fresh.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 91-93 Delicious initial fruit is followed by dense swathes of tannin. Concentrated wine that has all the weight without any sign of bitterness. The aftertaste brings back the delicious opening.
title: Château Marquis de Terme 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 91-93 Ripe, soft fruit and tannins that come from fruit rather than wood. The acidity is a dominant factor, with great wafts of bright black currant fruits and final tannins.
title: Château Les Carmes Haut-Brion 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93 Smoky acidity and juicy, very fresh fruit. The wine certainly has dry tannins, along with this delicious waft of black berry fruit juice.
designation: Barrel sample Le Clarence de Haut-Brion
title: Château Haut-Brion 2010 Barrel sample Le Clarence de Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93 There is a certain toughness her. The dense and firm character gives a solid, textured wine, packed with acidity. Foursquare and chunky.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: Crisp and fresh, this is a soft style of Sauvignon Blanc that brings out pineapple and apricot flavors as much as herbaceousness. A streak of lemon and pink grapefruit acidity is well integrated into the riper fruits. The aftertaste adds bright acidity to the mix.
title: Vignobles Berthier 2013 Domaine de Montbenoit Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: The wine tastes richer and more full-bodied than its light alcohol would suggest. That's good, with plenty of fresh fruits that also have a creamy texture and bright acidity that is fully integrated with the mineral texture and crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Marquis de Goulaine 2013 Cuvée du Millénaire Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Millet's Bué vines are in one of the classic chalk terroirs of Sancerre, and this wine revels in the richness of the fruit and brightness of the acidity. It does have some grassy herbaceousness, although this is broadened by the warm fruitiness. Drink now.
title: François Millet 2013  Sancerre

description: A truly herbaceous, juicy wine from the cool climate of Touraine. It has bright, crisp, pure lemon flavors, light and fruity. A light minerality gives texture. A wine to drink now.
title: Domaine Joël Delaunay 2013 Domaine Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This blend of Cabernet Franc and Gamay concentrates on fruit and soft acidity. It has some smokiness and rounded tannins, fresh and full of red fruits. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Joël Delaunay 2012 Domaine de la Brossette Red (Touraine)

description: This is made using a selection of fruit that's sourced from both banks of the Serein River. It's a properly crisp Chardonnay, and it offers a white fruit flavor and a bright, lively finish.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Les Deux Rives  (Chablis)

description: This is made using a selection of fruit that's sourced from both banks of the Serein River. It's a properly crisp Chardonnay, and it offers a white fruit flavor and a bright, lively finish.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Les Deux Rives  (Chablis)

description: A textured and minerally wine, this is wine has plenty of citrus flavor. It is fruity and crisp, and it offers a touch of vanilla and lively acidity on the finish.
title: Maison Champy 2010  Saint-Romain

description: Mature winter apple, oatmeal and the intricate aromas of dark pine honey give a complex, rich nose to this crémant. The honeyed notes become more pronounced with air and create a thrilling counterpoint to the streak of lemony freshness that pervades the palate. The mousse is integrated, fine and soft while the autolysis lends layers of brioche, oatmeal, earth and yeast. It has backbone, character and a beautifully long finish.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl NV Paul-Edouard Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Mature winter apple, oatmeal and the intricate aromas of dark pine honey give a complex, rich nose to this crémant. The honeyed notes become more pronounced with air and create a thrilling counterpoint to the streak of lemony freshness that pervades the palate. The mousse is integrated, fine and soft while the autolysis lends layers of brioche, oatmeal, earth and yeast. It has backbone, character and a beautifully long finish.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl NV Paul-Edouard Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Ripe and exquisitely pure notes of yellow apple perfume the nose and palate, against a bready, biscuity, rich and complex canvas of autolytic development. Freshness pervades and the very fine, pin-prick of mousse makes these flavors unite and sing. The dryness accentuates both purity and precision of this wine. Real class and pedigree shine brightly and are even more evident in the lingering finish.
title: Clément Klur NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: There is an attractive hint of toastiness here, since the bottle was disgorged in February 2014. That brings a roundness and a complexity to this classic Blanc de Blancs. As its name indicates the grapes come from the village of Cramant on the Côte des Blancs, and there are suggestions of the chalk terroir in the tight minerality and crisp apple that come through in the aftertaste.
designation: Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: G. H. Mumm NV Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: There is an attractive hint of toastiness here, since the bottle was disgorged in February 2014. That brings a roundness and a complexity to this classic Blanc de Blancs. As its name indicates the grapes come from the village of Cramant on the Côte des Blancs, and there are suggestions of the chalk terroir in the tight minerality and crisp apple that come through in the aftertaste.
designation: Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: G. H. Mumm NV Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This prestige cuvée from Collet, with its hand-blown bottle and blend mainly of Premier and Grand Cru vineyards, is elegant and stylish—just like the fashion industry it celebrates. It is balanced, soft and ripe, filled with pear and apricot fruits that are cut with steely acidity. The wine has touches of maturity and this bottling is ready to drink.
title: Collet NV Esprit Couture Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is all structure at the moment. Dense, dry tannins are masking the fruit that is waiting to develop. Great acidity is pushing forward to give a more juicy character. This impressive wine just needs time, so drink from 2017.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2014 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: This wine is all structure at the moment. Dense, dry tannins are masking the fruit that is waiting to develop. Great acidity is pushing forward to give a more juicy character. This impressive wine just needs time, so drink from 2017.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2014 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: Aged for at least five years in the Lanson cellars before disgorgement, this is a blend of Grand Cru wines from the Côte des Blancs. It has signs of maturity in the hints of toast and almonds while showing a crisp, tightly mineral texture. It's a great food wine, very fresh with good depth of flavor. The acidity at the end is bright and refreshing.
designation: Extra Age Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Lanson NV Extra Age Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Aged for at least five years in the Lanson cellars before disgorgement, this is a blend of Grand Cru wines from the Côte des Blancs. It has signs of maturity in the hints of toast and almonds while showing a crisp, tightly mineral texture. It's a great food wine, very fresh with good depth of flavor. The acidity at the end is bright and refreshing.
designation: Extra Age Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Lanson NV Extra Age Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a fine wine from a great vintage. Still young, it is already showing great swathes of apple and tight citrus fruit cut with lemon zest. It has a crisp character, packed with acidity that will soften while always there. Drink this wine from 2018.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Chouilly Brut
title: A.R. Lenoble  2008 Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Chouilly Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fresh notes of juicy orange are the chief charm of this dry, fresh wine. The palate has an earthy aspect but comes with lip-smacking freshness. The finish is clean and dry.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Fresh notes of juicy orange are the chief charm of this dry, fresh wine. The palate has an earthy aspect but comes with lip-smacking freshness. The finish is clean and dry.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: The slightest hint of passion fruit highlights the rose-petal notes on the nose. The palate is fresh and friendly, poised with fruit and blossom and defined by a clean streak of lemon freshness that makes it both appetizing and moreish.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Affenberg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The slightest hint of passion fruit highlights the rose-petal notes on the nose. The palate is fresh and friendly, poised with fruit and blossom and defined by a clean streak of lemon freshness that makes it both appetizing and moreish.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Affenberg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is young, bold and fruity. It has black-cherry fruit that bursts from the glass giving a spicy character to the tannins and juicy acidity. The wine is ripe, full of delicious fruit and likely to be ready to drink from early 2017.
title: Domaine Dubost 2015 Cuvée Monthieux  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Producer Jacky Gauthier has made a ripe wine that is full of black-cherry fruit. It has structure and acidity both suggesting the wine should age another few months to bring out its potential richness. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Colette 2015 Coteaux de Colette  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc, with a touch of perfume from Muscadelle give a wine that, while still young, is ripe and shows a touch of spice from wood aging. It is a rounded wine that has pepper as well as just enough acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2015 Cuvée des Conti White (Bergerac Sec)

description: The wine is intensely rich and fresh at the same time. Still young and from super-ripe almost shriveled grapes, this is a wine to age. It needs time to develop, so wait until 2019.
title: Château Jolys 2014  Jurançon

description: Régnié, is the newest of the Beaujolais cru village appellations. The grapes come from vines owned by the chateau, giving a wine that is all about ripe fruit and some firm tannins. It is still developing and will be better from 2017.
title: Château de Pizay 2015  Régnié

description: An aromatic, herbal wine with crisp acidity and delicate raspberry flavors coming from vineyards near Saint-Tropez. The wine is tangy and textured giving a tight mineral aftertaste. Its weight shows it is certainly a food rosé. Drink now.
title: Château de Garcinières 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A blend of 70% Marsanne and 30% Roussanne, this is unusually aromatic for a white Hermitage, with perfumed notes of pineapple and melon underscored by hints of graphite. It's plump on the midpalate and custardy-rich in texture, yet focused and long on the finish. Drink now, or sometime after 2017.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2009 White (Hermitage)

description: The wine still tastes young, with ripe yellow fruits and bright acidity. Chardonnay dominates the blend, allowing hints of minerality to come through the lime and lemon crispness. Still developing its more toasty character, it will be better from 2017.
title: Charles Ellner 2006 Brut Prestige  (Champagne)

description: With three years aging in bottle before release, this is rich and full on the palate. Hints of toast show how well it is developing to give a ripe, complex wine that could still age further. To experience it at its best, drink from 2017.
title: Goutorbe-Bouillot NV Louise B. Cuvée Prestige Brut  (Champagne)

description: A slightly rubbery note on the nose is really the only quibble with this wine, but a quick decanting should help clear it up. Beyond that, it displays cocoa and coffee notes layered over a core of black cherry fruit. It's medium to full in body, with a slightly creamy texture and a long, softly dusty finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Louis Bernard 2010 Red (Vacqueyras)

description: Lucien Lardy takes the risk of not using sulfur during fermentation, giving a wine that retains its great fruitiness. It's bright, full of red cherry fruits and lively acidity. Tannins are a hint in the background, enough to give structure but not to suggest long aging. Drink until 2018.
title: Lucien Lardy 2012 Les Roches  (Fleurie)

description: Lucien Lardy takes the risk of not using sulfur during fermentation, giving a wine that retains its great fruitiness. It's bright, full of red cherry fruits and lively acidity. Tannins are a hint in the background, enough to give structure but not to suggest long aging. Drink until 2018.
title: Lucien Lardy 2012 Les Roches  (Fleurie)

description: This is a dark, earthy wine. Clove and leather notes accent modest black-cherry fruit, but the texture is plush and silky, making it approachable now.
title: Andrieux & Fils 2010 Cuvée Jean Vieilles Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A really crisp wine, loaded with apple and citrus, with light flavors of almonds that bring out the intensity of the wine. This is delicious and refreshing, with bright acidity on the close.
title: Domaine Pichot 2012 Coteau de la Biche  (Vouvray)

description: A wine that has firm extraction, giving licorice, smoky wood and bitter chocolate flavors. It does have weight, and there is a powerful sense of fruit. For the moment, it shows extreme minerality and structure that need several years to round out and bring on the fruit potential. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Gaudou 2011 Grande Lignée Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This wine's name translates to “cherry,” and cherries are in its aroma along with spice. The palate shows a juicy, forward fruity character, a tang of acidity and soft tannins. It's a fine wine, but not for long-term aging so drink now and over the next few months.
title: Pascal Aufranc 2012 Les Cerisiers Vieilles  Vignes  (Juliénas)

description: This supple yet mouthfilling wine boasts intense notes of garrigue--that Provençal blend of wild thyme, bay leaf and lavender--layered over hints of pepper and a base of cherry fruit. A hint of cocoa emerges on the short but pleasant finish. Drink it now and over the next couple of years.
title: Les Trois Couronnes 2011 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This supple yet mouthfilling wine boasts intense notes of garrigue--that Provençal blend of wild thyme, bay leaf and lavender--layered over hints of pepper and a base of cherry fruit. A hint of cocoa emerges on the short but pleasant finish. Drink it now and over the next couple of years.
title: Les Trois Couronnes 2011 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Smoky wood makes its presence known. This wine has a soft, rounded texture and a warm, rich feel. There's attractive citrus and apricot fruit to go with the wood spice.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2010 Cuvée Madeleine Chardonnay (Côtes du Tarn)

description: This is the entry-level wine from Château Eugénie, and it is delicious. The Malbec is softened with some Merlot, rounding out the wine. It does still preserve the solid structure of Cahors with its dense black fruits and firm tannins.
title: Château Eugénie 2009 Tradition Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This typical Provence blend with bubbles has a spicy, pepper-like edge as well as crisp fruit. Bright acidity and a creamy mousse give it an attractive, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Château de Brigue NV Bulles de Brigue Brut Nature Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: Named after one of the Three Musketeers, this is a simple, rounded but dense wine, with hints of dry fruit topped by rounded, soft, black flavors. A great value, it has open flavors with spice and a juicy, smoky aftertaste.
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Château d'Aydie 2006 Aramis Tannat Cabernet Red (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: Named after one of the Three Musketeers, this is a simple, rounded but dense wine, with hints of dry fruit topped by rounded, soft, black flavors. A great value, it has open flavors with spice and a juicy, smoky aftertaste.
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Château d'Aydie 2006 Aramis Tannat Cabernet Red (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: At the eastern end of Saint-Emilion, this vineyard is close to Castillon. The wine has structure and density, with powerful tannins that are still filling out. Delicious, juicy black plum and damson flavors are going to be full and generous, while remaining fruity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Chapelle aux Moines 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: At the eastern end of Saint-Emilion, this vineyard is close to Castillon. The wine has structure and density, with powerful tannins that are still filling out. Delicious, juicy black plum and damson flavors are going to be full and generous, while remaining fruity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Chapelle aux Moines 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: This second wine of Château Durfort-Vivens is ripe, firm and well structured. Beautiful ripe black currant and berry fruits are cut with intense acidity. From the great 2010 vintage, it is solid, dense and full of fruitiness as well as tannins. It still does need to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Durfort-Vivens 2010 Vivens  (Margaux)

description: The wine is soft and warmly ripe with simple raspberry fruitiness. It has a touch of crisp acidity to keep it in order and to help its refreshing character. Drink now.
title: Maison Belle Claire 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: It's good to see a wine in that increasingly rare sight: a Provence skittle-shaped bottle. This is a light and fruity wine from vineyards on the Massif des Maures, close to the sea. It has a bright crisp aftertaste with plenty of acidity to keep it all very crisp. Skittles is the precursor to lawn and indoor bowling.
title: Vignobles Ravel 2016 Château Montaud Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pale in color, this is a light-tasting wine. It does have just enough fruit to give some red-fruit flavors. Everything though is light—a crisp reflection of the light of Saint-Tropez. Drink now.
title: Vignobles de Saint-Tropez 2016 Chevalier Torpez Saint-T. Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a really light wine with bright fruit and a crisp texture. It has a breezy feel—all crisp fruit and lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Thomas Carteron 2016 Le Bonheur de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From the small Coteaux Varois, a hilly region in central Provence, this is a crisp mineral-textured wine. It has lively acidity, citrus zest and a touch of red currants. It's a real food rosé. Ready now.
title: Estandon 2016 Terres de Saint-Louis Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a fruity crisp blend of classic Gascony grapes. It has a clean bright texture with just a touch of honey as well as plenty of lemon and tangy orange. Intensely fruity, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2016 Classic White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Light, fruity and with attractive red fruits, this is a crisp wine. It has cool tannins and bold acidity. With a juicy aftertaste, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Laballe 2015 Les Terres Basses Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Made from selected parcels, this wine is structured and firm while not losing sight of rich red berry and cherry flavors. It's a dense wine, the tannins still developing and filling out to balance the fruits. Drink from 2017.
title: Robert Perroud 2014 Pollen  (Brouilly)

description: Made from selected parcels, this wine is structured and firm while not losing sight of rich red berry and cherry flavors. It's a dense wine, the tannins still developing and filling out to balance the fruits. Drink from 2017.
title: Robert Perroud 2014 Pollen  (Brouilly)

description: With its strongly Pinot Noir character, this dry Champagne is crisp and with enough fruit to give a full character that is fruity and textured at the same time. The wine is perfumed and structured with a light tannin and mineral touch.
title: Nicolas Maillart NV Platine Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: With its strongly Pinot Noir character, this dry Champagne is crisp and with enough fruit to give a full character that is fruity and textured at the same time. The wine is perfumed and structured with a light tannin and mineral touch.
title: Nicolas Maillart NV Platine Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine is mature both in its orange-pink color and toasty flavors. It has fresh acidity, although that is less important than the almond and spice secondary flavors. Ripe and full in the mouth, this is a rich rosé with a soft, ready-to-drink aftertaste.
title: Moët & Chandon 2006 Grand Vintage Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This limited-production wine shows great structure appropriate for a wine that can age. It has a solid texture, full of rich cherry and black-plum fruits and a fresh line of acidity. The tannins give shape to the wine, which will certainly age. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Pral 2014 Les Charmes  (Morgon)

description: This is an attractive, perfumed wine that has good wood aging, firm tannins and a solid structure. Dark berry fruits show through the texture, lending a ripe and juicy aftertaste. Drink from 2015.
title: Château de Beaupré 2010 Collection du Château Cabernet-Syrah (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is an attractive, perfumed wine that has good wood aging, firm tannins and a solid structure. Dark berry fruits show through the texture, lending a ripe and juicy aftertaste. Drink from 2015.
title: Château de Beaupré 2010 Collection du Château Cabernet-Syrah (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: A serious, considered wine with its full, ripe and soft flavors tempered with a complex structure. It will not age as impressively as other Pol Roger vintages, and already the yeast and toast element is creeping in. But the weight of Pinot Noir is there, leaving a powerful, creamy mousse finish.
title: Pol Roger 2000 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: With all the signature acidity of the 1996 vintage, this shows plenty of aging potential. The wine is thirst-quenchingly fresh, with the flavor of just-squeezed lime juice, but also has a depth of complex tannins and texture. Drink now but age for five years or more.
title: Bruno Paillard 1996 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: With all the signature acidity of the 1996 vintage, this shows plenty of aging potential. The wine is thirst-quenchingly fresh, with the flavor of just-squeezed lime juice, but also has a depth of complex tannins and texture. Drink now but age for five years or more.
title: Bruno Paillard 1996 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A beautifully fine, elegant wine, the acidity like a shaft of light through the tight apple and grapefruit flavors. The texture is taut, steely, with vivid tannins. It is still young, although showing brilliant fruit. Worth aging for 5–6 years.
title: Deutz 1999 Cuvée William Deutz Brut  (Champagne)

description: Each year, the Jacquesson blended nonvintage is identified by a new cuvée number, meaning the vintage basis of the blend and the composition has changed.
