description: This wine has a jammy character with acidity that is unbalanced. Wine is made in cement tanks and aged in cement tanks and new and up to three-year-old French oak barrels.
title: Château Dina 2013  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Red cherry aromas lead to a wine that is curiously structured with firm tannins and jammy fruit that is not in balance. “Natur” means the winemaker did not add sulfites during wine production.
title: Château Penin 2013 Natur  (Bordeaux)

description: You need to work hard to find the fruit in this 100% Merlot. It is tough, only hinting at acidity and black currant flavors.
title: Château Queyssard 2013  Bordeaux

description: The new wood and spice flavors still show in this wine. A dry, woody character is still keeping the fruit back. Black coffee flavors show that there was heavy extraction. This 20-acre property is one of four in the greater Saint-Émilion area owned by the Lannoye family.
title: Château Moulin de  Clotte 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is dry, firm with chocolate and bitter extraction flavors. It's likely to remain dry.
title: Château Lacombe Cadiot 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine is dry, firm with chocolate and bitter extraction flavors. It's likely to remain dry.
title: Château Lacombe Cadiot 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has too much tannin for its own good. It's tough and bitter, showing wood and extraction. In this difficult Bordeaux vintage, the vineyard produced less than half what is normal.
title: Château Frédignac 2013 La Favorite  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine has too much tannin for its own good. It's tough and bitter, showing wood and extraction. In this difficult Bordeaux vintage, the vineyard produced less than half what is normal.
title: Château Frédignac 2013 La Favorite  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: High levels of acidity give this wine a tight, eye-watering character. The fruit was probably not ripe.
title: Château Bellevue Peycharneau 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: High levels of acidity give this wine a tight, eye-watering character. The fruit was probably not ripe.
title: Château Bellevue Peycharneau 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Toast aromas precede layers of wood flavors that give the wine a tough, dry, spicy character that masks the fruit.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2013 Heritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A jammy character to this wine jars with the dry tannins. It is extracted, with a firm, bitter character. A Châteaux Solidaires wine.
title: Château Haut Cabut 2013  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Tannins mask the light fruitiness in this blend of 45% Merlot, 45% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc. It seems extracted, with the producer attempting to get too much out of the fruit in a lean year.
title: Château Bellevue la Randée 2013  Bordeaux

description: This lean wine, all acidity and tannins, has a severe character that is not likely to go away. The estate has been handed down from mother to daughter for seven generations and now owned by enologist Marie Laure Latorre. It was named for the Merlot plot planted on 08/11/99, the date of the last total solar eclipse seen in France.
title: Château le Sanctuaire 2012 L'Eclipse  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This lean wine, all acidity and tannins, has a severe character that is not likely to go away. The estate has been handed down from mother to daughter for seven generations and now owned by enologist Marie Laure Latorre. It was named for the Merlot plot planted on 08/11/99, the date of the last total solar eclipse seen in France.
title: Château le Sanctuaire 2012 L'Eclipse  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This sweet rosé is light, with some attractive ripe strawberry flavors. Grapefruit acidity gives it a fresher side, lifting the bright, fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Alliance Loire 2014 Demoiselle Bleue  (Cabernet d'Anjou)

description: This sweet rosé is light, with some attractive ripe strawberry flavors. Grapefruit acidity gives it a fresher side, lifting the bright, fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Alliance Loire 2014 Demoiselle Bleue  (Cabernet d'Anjou)

description: Fruity with enough tannins to give support, this ripe wine has filled out well. Black currant and spice from wood dominate, leaving juicy acidity as the attractive aftertaste. François Bouquier bought this property in 1939. Grandson François now runs the property: 60% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc on 40 acres.
title: Domaine de Grandmaison 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Smooth and balanced, this wine brings together generous red fruits and fresh acidity. Underneath, attractive, dry tannins give shape to this otherwise ready-to-drink, fruity wine. It's is a generous blend of 60% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cabernet Franc and 5% Malbec.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2014 Tradition  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: Lightly wood aged, this wine is soft while still keeping some fruitiness. Spice and touches of toast are still integrating with the apple and lime flavors. The tangy, zesty aftertaste needs to calm down. Drink from late 2016.
title: Cheval Quancard 2014 Cuvée Clémence  (Entre-Deux-Mers)

description: In the southern section of the Haut-Médoc, close to Margaux, this estate has produced a fresh, fruity wine. A high proportion (11%) of Petit Verdot gives it color and also a ripe juicy character. Blackberries and young tannins dominate at the moment. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Meyre 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: There is a strong, spicy wood character in this wine, which is showing its fruit acidity as an afterthought at this stage. The juicy background has potential and will allow the wine to fill out. Drink from 2019. Once owned by monks, then a shipbuilder, Philippe and Chantel Miecase arrived in 2006 and renovated vineyards, château, chapel, winery and added a restaurant and B&B.
title: Château Léognan 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: There is a strong, spicy wood character in this wine, which is showing its fruit acidity as an afterthought at this stage. The juicy background has potential and will allow the wine to fill out. Drink from 2019. Once owned by monks, then a shipbuilder, Philippe and Chantel Miecase arrived in 2006 and renovated vineyards, château, chapel, winery and added a restaurant and B&B.
title: Château Léognan 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: While almost bone-dry, this Champagne has intense apple and citrus fruitiness along with a fine texture that's stylish and crisp. Extra bottle age will improve this tight, steely wine and bring out the quality of the fruit. Drink from 2014.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV L'Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: There is an animal, undergrowth character to this wine, along with a foursquare, solid structure. The wine has power and is developing slowly, with the dry outer skin concealing the fruit potential underneath. Drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2010 Les Murgers Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Spicy and aromatic, this is a wine with great acidity and structure to complement delicious red fruits. The palate has weight, richness and a firm texture, with hints of the wood aging that will need to integrate before drinking. Drink from 2016.
title: Henri de Villamont 2010 Clos de Verger  (Pommard)

description: Fresh wild-strawberry flavor dominates this bright and youthful wine. It is dry and crisp, yet has a mouthfilling weight. Definitely a food Champagne and one that benefits from a few minutes aeration.
title: Vincent Couche NV Rosé Désir Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: A ripe and fruity wine that has rich tannins and a soft, full structure. It has jammy black currant fruit flavors that are already developing well with spice from wood aging. There is a dry core that, with the acidity, will allow the wine to age well. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Vray Houchat 2010  Fronsac

description: Dusty aromas and spice notes introduce this robustly tannic wine with red-berry and currant flavors. A touch of acidity adds freshness to the fruitiness on the finish. It's a wine with potential, so drink from 2016.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2011 Les Puillets Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Dusty aromas and spice notes introduce this robustly tannic wine with red-berry and currant flavors. A touch of acidity adds freshness to the fruitiness on the finish. It's a wine with potential, so drink from 2016.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2011 Les Puillets Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Obviously wood aged, this is still a richly fruity wine. The two elements are still coming together, the spice and toast on the one hand, the ripe blackberry on the other. Give the wine time and it will be a good expression of the structure of the vintage. Drink from 2016.
title: Château le Calvaire 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The richest and most generous hints of dried pear and fruit loaf rise from the glass. The palate continues in the same, generous vein with plenty of pear, shimmering and scintillating with juicy, mellow and just off-dry ripeness. This is countered by fresh lemon zestiness and leaves a totally balanced and very lasting impression. There are pleasant highlights of bitterness and that pervasive sense of pear fruit just lasts and lasts.
designation: Brand Grand Cru Clos de la Treille
title: François Baur 2014 Brand Grand Cru Clos de la Treille Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: There is not just a notion of ripeness but almost of overripeness of pear fruit on the nose, accompanied by hints of honeysuckle. There also are hints of sandalwood and gentle vanilla. The palate is cushioned with mellow residual sweetness, making the rich flavors even more rich and generous. A vein of citrus freshness counters this, but this is in the generous, medium-sweet spectrum, oozing fruit and generosity. The finish, nonetheless, is precise and fresh. A great example of mature Pinot Gris.
title: Domaine Michel Fonne 2010 Marckrain Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Made from a separate parcel of the Valandraud estate, this is a fruity, ripe wine. Dark tannins and flavors of dark chocolate combine with great fruit and acidity. It is still packed with tannins and will take plenty of time to come round. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Valandraud 2014 Virginie de Valandraud  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The wine is powerful with fine tannins and concentrated black fruits. The dense texture is lifted by the acidity and beautiful fruit of the vintage. The tannins are dusty, tight and surrounded by beautiful fruit and acidity. This, the second wine of Montrose, will develop surely over the next several years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Montrose 2014 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This second wine of whites from both Haut-Brion and La Mission Haut-Brion is both rich and intensely crisp. It has a fine blend between great acidity and grapefruit fruit and a more tropical element. The tangy texture is taut with a mineral edge. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2014 La Clarté de Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: This second wine of whites from both Haut-Brion and La Mission Haut-Brion is both rich and intensely crisp. It has a fine blend between great acidity and grapefruit fruit and a more tropical element. The tangy texture is taut with a mineral edge. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2014 La Clarté de Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: The second wine of Cos d'Estournel is powerfully packed with tannins and dark ripe fruit. It is enormously rich and intense while keeping a fine smooth texture. There is a dark core that is going to allow the wine to develop over many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2014 Les Pagodes de Cos  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: The second wine of Cos d'Estournel is powerfully packed with tannins and dark ripe fruit. It is enormously rich and intense while keeping a fine smooth texture. There is a dark core that is going to allow the wine to develop over many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2014 Les Pagodes de Cos  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This second wine of Calon Ségur is beautifully proportioned. It is fruity with rich tannins. At the same time, the crisp fruit of the vintage gives a lift to the deep concentration. Let the wine develop over several years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2014 Le Marquis de Calon Ségur  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This is a structured wine that also has great layers of rich black fruits. They give the wine weight and intensity that is lifted by acidity. It is a powerful complex wine, concentrated and ripe. Drink from 2025.
title: Château Bouscaut 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a structured wine that also has great layers of rich black fruits. They give the wine weight and intensity that is lifted by acidity. It is a powerful complex wine, concentrated and ripe. Drink from 2025.
title: Château Bouscaut 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a warm and ripe wine with a smooth caramel texture. That lies over the ripe red-berry fruits and balanced acidity. The result is a rounded wine that is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2016 Pigmentum Malbec Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: A classic blend from Gascony, this wine combines all the right crisp and herbal flavors. It is tangy with lemon juice and delicious acidity. The fine fruitiness is right up front, ready to be drunk now.
title: Domaine la Taste 2016 White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a caramel-flavored blend of Merlot, Tannat, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Syrah and Malbec. That's a range, but the result is an attractive fruity and soft wine. It is bright at the end with plenty of acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Pellehaut 2016 Harmonie de Gascogne Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a blend of the unusual Egiodola (a disease-resistant cross of native vines) and Syrah. This rosé version of two naturally tannic grapes turns out to be fruity and juicy. It is lively with crisp acidity and a lightly turned texture. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Millet 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a blend of the unusual Egiodola (a disease-resistant cross of native vines) and Syrah. This rosé version of two naturally tannic grapes turns out to be fruity and juicy. It is lively with crisp acidity and a lightly turned texture. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Millet 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The wine is soft with a warm caramel and spice character. That contrasts easily with the red-currant fruits and lemon zest acidity. It is a clean fruity wine, ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de Bendel 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is soft with a warm caramel and spice character. That contrasts easily with the red-currant fruits and lemon zest acidity. It is a clean fruity wine, ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de Bendel 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This refreshing aromatic wine will appeal to the sailors with its nautical theme. It is light and fruity, just touched by spice and with lemon and red-currant fruitiness. The wine is lively and bright at the end.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Nautiqa Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In its classic Provence skittle bottle, this is a wine for quaffing at a patio or restaurant table. Pale in color but packed with red fruit, it is an immediately attractive fruity and lively wine. Drink now.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2016 Soleillades Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: In its classic Provence skittle bottle, this is a wine for quaffing at a patio or restaurant table. Pale in color but packed with red fruit, it is an immediately attractive fruity and lively wine. Drink now.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2016 Soleillades Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is simple, light and fruity wine. Blending two naturally herbal grapes, it is tangy, zesty and has light final acidity. Drink this lively wine now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2016 Echo Indigo Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is simple, light and fruity wine. Blending two naturally herbal grapes, it is tangy, zesty and has light final acidity. Drink this lively wine now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2016 Echo Indigo Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Really candied pink in color, this is an attractive, open and fruity wine. Easy to drink and bright with acidity, it is given a backbone by the Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend. Drink now.
title: Moncigale 2016 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This dry Champagne forms a good contrast with the Brut Nature Rosé from the same producer. There is more weight to this wine, more richness and, in the case of this bottling, more bottle age. With its flavors of white fruit and toast, this wine is very ready to drink, with a rich aftertaste.
title: Drappier NV Brut Nature Zero Dosage Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: As befits a 100% Pinot Noir wine, this is a rich Champagne, poised between ripe apricot and pear fruits and more mineral acidity. Just a touch of tannin adds structure to this ready-to-drink wine.
title: Devaux NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: From a single parcel in this estate, this wine is a rich Merlot-dominated wine. It has dark tannins and plenty of juicy blackberry fruits that are deeply spiced by the wood aging. It is a full wine, ripe although with a fine streak of finishing acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tour Bayard 2014 L'Angelot  (Montagne-Saint-Émilion)

description: This is a fine wine, with wood and fruit both rich and concentrated. It has spice, juicy black fruits and ripe tannins. It is developing slowly and surely and will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Lamothe de Haux 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: With vines situated on the slopes above the Garonne River, this Terra Vitis bottling is rich and spicy, full of blackberry fruits and still young acidity. Sixty percent Merlot gives it its smooth character although it is the Cabernet Franc that adds its subtle perfumes. The wine will need time and should be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château la Grange Clinet 2014 Grande Réserve  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: With vines situated on the slopes above the Garonne River, this Terra Vitis bottling is rich and spicy, full of blackberry fruits and still young acidity. Sixty percent Merlot gives it its smooth character although it is the Cabernet Franc that adds its subtle perfumes. The wine will need time and should be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château la Grange Clinet 2014 Grande Réserve  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The base of this wine is Chardonnay with some Pinot Noir added to give color (standard practice in Champagne). The result is a pale-colored wine that's ripe and full of fruit. It has a rich character lifted by the tight, mineral acidity in the aftertaste.
title: A.R. Lenoble  NV Terroirs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The base of this wine is Chardonnay with some Pinot Noir added to give color (standard practice in Champagne). The result is a pale-colored wine that's ripe and full of fruit. It has a rich character lifted by the tight, mineral acidity in the aftertaste.
title: A.R. Lenoble  NV Terroirs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, this wine has great fruit and a soft texture. The flavors of ripe bitter orange and apples are now moving towards maturity, with the toastiness coming through. Drink now.
title: A. D. Coutelas 2008 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: A blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, this wine has great fruit and a soft texture. The flavors of ripe bitter orange and apples are now moving towards maturity, with the toastiness coming through. Drink now.
title: A. D. Coutelas 2008 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: Produced from Grand and Premier Cru vines in the Côte des Blancs, this crisp, mineral-driven wine has intense acidity, citrus flavors and a tight, steely texture. Still young, it needs to age and will be best from 2018.
title: Jacquart 2009 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Produced from Grand and Premier Cru vines in the Côte des Blancs, this crisp, mineral-driven wine has intense acidity, citrus flavors and a tight, steely texture. Still young, it needs to age and will be best from 2018.
title: Jacquart 2009 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: One of a range of top cuvées from this cooperative in the grand cru village of Mailly, this is a Pinot Noir-dominated wine, fashionably pale in color with a good balance between crisp red fruits and tight, nervy acidity. A touch of tannin gives structure to this elegant wine. Drink now.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2009 L'Intemporelle Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: One of a range of top cuvées from this cooperative in the grand cru village of Mailly, this is a Pinot Noir-dominated wine, fashionably pale in color with a good balance between crisp red fruits and tight, nervy acidity. A touch of tannin gives structure to this elegant wine. Drink now.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2009 L'Intemporelle Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The minerality of this pure Chardonnay shows how close the Côte des Bar is to the vineyards of Chablis. It has a chalky texture as well as ripeness, a crisp and structured wine. This bottling is a little young and will repay waiting few months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Château de Bligny NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Based at the eastern end of the Montagne de Reims, this cooperative only uses grapes grown in the grand cru vineyards of Mailly. This nonvintage wine is no exception, giving a rich blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay that is ripe and driven both by minerality and white-fruit flavors. The bottling is ready to drink.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: The blend of delightfully crisp wine is based around three years of reserve wines. It is creamy, with just a hint of toastiness. The acidity and ripe apple combine well with this touch of bottle age to give a wine that is ready to drink.
title: Vollereaux NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Still young, it's fruity but closed up. A tight, steely character gives a strong texture that is still dominating the fruit. Wait until 2015 for the citrus and white fruits to come through.
title: Bouchié-Chatelier 2012 Premier Millésimé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: While herbaceous, this wine also has ripe tropical fruits that bring out a richer, early drinking side. It's bone-dry and crisp, the apricot fruits balanced by intense citrus. Concentrated and very fruity, it can be drunk now.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2013 Les Baronnes  (Sancerre)

description: The wine is rich and still shows firm tannins, along with full-bodied blackberry fruitiness and a tight, crisp texture. It's solid and concentrated, full of juiciness at the end. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Fongalan 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: The blend of 70% Malbec and 30% Merlot is produced in the vineyard around this 12th-century castle. This is an impressive wine with its balanced structure and dark tannins. Concentrated and powered by its black plum fruits and acidity, it will age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Saint-Didier-Parnac 2015 Château de Grézels Prestige Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Partly wood aged, this wine is conceived as the essence of Malbec. With its concentrated black fruits and firm tannins, it is dense and needs to age. There is a core that is firmly structured—rich and still surrounded by youthful fruitiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Lamartine 2014 Prestige du Malbec (Cahors)

description: From a selection of bunches that were left on the vines to gather noble rot, this wine is rich and wonderfully concentrated and with layers of botrytis and ripe fruits. Apricots and honey are balanced by the drier edge of the noble rot. It's a young wine still and will be even better from 2019.
title: Château Bélingard 2014 Ortus de Château Bélingard  (Monbazillac)

description: This Côtes du Rhône, from a plot of vines located just outside Châteauneuf-du-Pape, is a terrific achievement in a challenging vintage. Hints of garrigue, black olive and cocoa add nuance to the ample black cherry fruit, while the finish of this full-bodied wine shows enough grip and astringency to warrant short-term cellaring. Drink 2019–2025.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Domaine Grand Veneur Les Champauvins Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This wine is a perennial overachiever, but the 2015 is even more so than usual. The aromas are bold and ripe, offering notes of cherries, ample garrigue and hints of tar. The wine is rich and velvety on the palate, folding in notes of chocolate, baking spices, plum and dried herbs. Drink now–2025.
title: Mas des Bressades 2015 Cuvée Tradition Syrah-Grenache (Costières de Nîmes)

description: From the village just west of Puligny-Montrachet, this is ripe, round and creamy. A good value for white Burgundy, it shows a touch of wood and a generous character. Its acidity and fruit are already well in balance. Drink from late 2017.
designation: Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru
title: Maison Champy 2015 Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: With grapes from long contracted growers, this wine represents the structure as well as the ripe fruit of the appellation. It imparts a smoky character from wood aging as well as a tense layer of tannins that give it a dry edge. Drink from 2021.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: A sweet cherry aroma sets the scene for this fruity, firmly structured wine. The juicy red-berry fruit is balanced by a smoky tannic character. This will be a pleasure to drink in a year, and it can also age longer.
title: Roche de Bellene 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Volnay)

description: This is a wood-aged style of Chablis, but the toast has been applied discreetly. Rich, full bodied and structured, this wine is full of ripe yellow-fruit, spice and red apple flavors. Its acidity makes this a juicy expression.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a wood-aged style of Chablis, but the toast has been applied discreetly. Rich, full bodied and structured, this wine is full of ripe yellow-fruit, spice and red apple flavors. Its acidity makes this a juicy expression.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: A rich, spicy wine, this shows flavors of new wood and ripe yellow fruit. The concentrated palate reveals juicy pear and peach juice flavors and a tight, minerally structure. Dense vineyard planting and 35-year-old vines bring out extra intensity and complexity.
title: Roche de Bellene 2010 Les Chenevottes Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is a round, rich and soft style of Chardonnay. It feels generous, and its yellow fruit flavor pushes through the acidity. It slowly opens to reveal complex tropical-fruit notes, and it will develop further, so give it another four years.
designation: Le Clos Blanc Grèves Premier Cru
title: Louis Jadot 2010 Le Clos Blanc Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: From 80-year-old vines, this wine is named after current winemaker Fabien Moreau's grandfather. It's a concentrated, dense wine that is very well structured. Tight, almost shocking acidity is supported by the strong fruit character as well as the fragrant, perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
designation: Vaillons Premier Cru Cuvée Guy Moreau
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2013 Vaillons Premier Cru Cuvée Guy Moreau  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: From 80-year-old vines, this wine is named after current winemaker Fabien Moreau's grandfather. It's a concentrated, dense wine that is very well structured. Tight, almost shocking acidity is supported by the strong fruit character as well as the fragrant, perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
designation: Vaillons Premier Cru Cuvée Guy Moreau
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2013 Vaillons Premier Cru Cuvée Guy Moreau  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: Ripe and rounded, this has rich acidity balanced by a touch of yellow fruit. Still young, it has a flinty character that will soften and fill out. Intense, pure and with great fruitiness, it will be best from 2017.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2013 Drouhin-Vaudon Mont-de-Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Round and ripe, this is a wine with generous, opulent fruits and touches of spice from wood aging. Plenty of yellow fruit and sliced apple flavors mingle with the mineral texture and fragrant acidity. With its power and richness still to develop, it's a wine to age, needing at least until 2018.
title: Henri de Villamont 2013  Corton-Charlemagne

description: La Chablisienne owns the major part of the Grenouilles Grand Cru, centered on a winery called Château Grenouilles. This wine is powerful and still very young. It has weight and structure along with ripe, generous fruits that are typical of this vineyard. Touched by vanilla from wood aging, it is balancing out now. Drink from 2018.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 Grenouilles Grand Cru Château Grenouilles  (Chablis)

description: From this premier cru that is furthest down the slope of Puligny and close to the village, this ripe and generous wine sums up 2013 whites in Burgundy. With just a touch of honey, it has a rich character with yellow fruit flavors, cut with lemon and lime freshness. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Alex Gambal 2013 Les Enseignères Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: From a mix of purchased grapes and the Laroche domaine, here is a ripe wine with swathes of yellow fruit, very approachable and warm. Rich and full in the mouth, it has a dense texture that supports the generous fruits. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Laroche 2012 Mont de Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a delicious, crisp wine full of minerality, acidity and a zesty texture. Tight and lively, it offers citrus and green-plum fruitiness with a hint of spice. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Maison Stéphane Brocard 2015 Closerie des Alisiers  (Mâcon-Milly Lamartine)

description: Firmly tannic and structured this is a young wine that will need time to soften. It has the foursquare character that is often found in Nuits Saint-Georges. The fruit weight is there, promising a ripe red-fruit future. The wine should be ready from 2020.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Laurent Dufouleur  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: The wine comes from a new appellation at the southern end of the Côte de Beaune. It is a blend of different premier cru vineyards to give a juicy raspberry flavored. Tannins show a solid dry background to the attractive perfumed fruitiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Premier Cru  (Maranges)

description: Citrus aromas reveal this wine's essentially crisp character. Plenty of acidity balances the rich white fruits while the mineral texture adds bite to this well-made wine. It will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine de la Garenne  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wood-aged wine comes from a single vineyard in Mercurey. It is lightly toasty with touches of apricot, a crisper edge of citrus and a mineral aftertaste. Drink the wine from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2015 Le Closeau  (Mercurey)

description: A selection from a single plot of 40- to 70-year-old vines, this full-bodied wine is juicy with a tight texture that comes from the terroir. It offers a crisp edge as well as bright acidity, the apple fruits lifted further by a lemon streak. Drink from 2019.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2016 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: This is a smoky, obviously wood-aged wine. The fruit is dominated by the high toast flavors needing time to integrate into the blueberry fruit flavor. That will happen, allowing this crisp, balanced wine to shine. Drink from 2020.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Clos Jus Premier Cru  (Givry)

description: This is a smoky, obviously wood-aged wine. The fruit is dominated by the high toast flavors needing time to integrate into the blueberry fruit flavor. That will happen, allowing this crisp, balanced wine to shine. Drink from 2020.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Clos Jus Premier Cru  (Givry)

description: Hints of honeysuckle are very restrained on the nose. The palate is dry and shaped by rounded lemony freshness and hints of zesty spice. This is wonderfully light and deeply aromatic, but not obviously so. A wonderfully subtle expression of Muscat.
title: Allimant-Laugner 2015 Muscat (Alsace)

description: Faint and restrained notes of rose petal and orange peel make for an inviting scent. On the dry and very slender, almost weightless, palate the power of lemon freshness pervades all and highlights notions of honeysuckle and rose. It's a gentle, fresh, and aromatic wine.
title: Hugel 2014 Classic Muscat (Alsace)

description: A lovely, clean and aromatic lift of ripe red cherries is instantly appetizing. The palate is full of juicy fruit but structured with slightly rustic but smoothed-out tannins and a bright lively freshness. This is honest fresh-faced fruit-driven Pinot Noir without any pretentiousness that is a joy to drink.
title: Hugel 2013 Classic Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A lovely, clean and aromatic lift of ripe red cherries is instantly appetizing. The palate is full of juicy fruit but structured with slightly rustic but smoothed-out tannins and a bright lively freshness. This is honest fresh-faced fruit-driven Pinot Noir without any pretentiousness that is a joy to drink.
title: Hugel 2013 Classic Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: An earthy hint accompanies the scent of ripe pear on the nose. The palate is diffuse with fruity pear and fresh lemon resulting in a very refreshing, textured wine with some concentration. The finish is lasting and dry.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2014 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a succulent wine, with juicy red fruits and a fine structure that gives the wine its texture. Balanced and ready to drink, the wine (which is made in tiny quantities) is a fine mature Bordeaux.
title: Domaine Roses Camille 2008  Pomerol

description: Generous notions of ripe pear on the nose acquire an earthier, rounder aspect on the fresh palate. This is generous with fruit, yet fresh and somehow weightless. The finish is long and lasting.
title: Domaine Gérard Neumeyer 2015 la Tulipe Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Generous notions of ripe pear on the nose acquire an earthier, rounder aspect on the fresh palate. This is generous with fruit, yet fresh and somehow weightless. The finish is long and lasting.
title: Domaine Gérard Neumeyer 2015 la Tulipe Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This is a big, bold wine with superripe fruit. It is saved from great excess by its tannins and acidity. It does have some bitterness from the high toast wood aging. The wine should soften out to leave a rich fruity wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Valade 2014 L'Etendard de Château Valade  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This is a big, bold wine with superripe fruit. It is saved from great excess by its tannins and acidity. It does have some bitterness from the high toast wood aging. The wine should soften out to leave a rich fruity wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Valade 2014 L'Etendard de Château Valade  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A smooth wine that is ripe with rich berry and dark-plum fruits. With its soft tannins and juicy crisp acidity, the wine is warm, rounded and likely to develop quickly. Drink this already attractive smoky wine from 2020.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2014  Pomerol

description: There are fine ripe tannins here that go with the smoky fruitiness. The wine is lightly structured—enough to allow it to age. At the same time with its fine fruits, it is rich and open. Drink the wine from 2021.
title: Château de Fonbel 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: Unusually for the Médoc, this wine has a significant percentage (14.5%) of Cabernet Franc as well as 12.5% Petit Verdot. These two grapes give the wine its perfume and its dark color. They add to the rich tannins and juicy black currants that pack the wine. Drink this fine wine from 2020.
title: Château Charmail 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: With vines close to Pauillac, the estate offers an unusual blend with 50% Petit Verdot. Great butts and intense black fruits as well as an almost black color are the result. The wine is solid, structured and likely to need time to be ready to drink. Keep until 2021.
title: Château Balac 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: Very ripe fruit is discernible on nose and palate and gives a sense of generosity with even a touch of spice. Lemony freshness provides a wonderful counterpoint to this generosity and makes for a very appetizing moreish finish.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2015 Collection Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Very ripe fruit is discernible on nose and palate and gives a sense of generosity with even a touch of spice. Lemony freshness provides a wonderful counterpoint to this generosity and makes for a very appetizing moreish finish.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2015 Collection Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a full-bodied wine. It has a light tannic character over intense acidity. A caramel underlay cuts down on the freshness and adds some richness. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Ballade 2014 Ballade Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The wine is all structure and solid tannins, with a dry core and an earthy character that mask the red fruits. Let the wine develop a few months for this youthful excess to blow off. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Saint-Didier-Parnac 2013 Oltesse Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: The wine is all structure and solid tannins, with a dry core and an earthy character that mask the red fruits. Let the wine develop a few months for this youthful excess to blow off. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Saint-Didier-Parnac 2013 Oltesse Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This is billed as the only Chardonnay planted in the coastal Landes region (not a difficult claim). It is soft, ripe and easygoing in character with a hint of citrus and acidity. Drink now.
title: Laudet 2014 Laballe Le Chardonnay des Landes Chardonnay (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is pure Sauvignon Blanc, fresh, crisp and lightly herbaceous. It has attractive lemon flavors, a touch of saltiness and a bright, fruity texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2014 Ferran Pradets Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: A fresh-faced rosé, with a rose-grey color, this has red fruit acidity and an attractive, creamy character to go with the crisp finish.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2011 VieVité Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a gloriously juicy wine, full of melon, apricot and the brightest citrus flavors. This fruit salad is given structure by the wood and the tangy, zesty edge. It drinks well now, still young and fresh, but will be better aged. Drink from 2016.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012 Rabourcé Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: This is a gloriously juicy wine, full of melon, apricot and the brightest citrus flavors. This fruit salad is given structure by the wood and the tangy, zesty edge. It drinks well now, still young and fresh, but will be better aged. Drink from 2016.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012 Rabourcé Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: This full-bodied wine has swathes of ripe yellow fruits and juicy wood and acidity. Under this opulent surface, a more steely character gives the wine structure that will allow it to age. It will be ready to drink by 2016.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012  Meursault

description: A Blanc de Noirs made exclusively from Pinot Noir always has a feeling of weight and richness. This is no exception, full-bodied in character, with rich pink grapefruit and green plum flavors. The bottling is still young and will benefit from bottle aging until 2016.
title: Boizel NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: A Blanc de Noirs made exclusively from Pinot Noir always has a feeling of weight and richness. This is no exception, full-bodied in character, with rich pink grapefruit and green plum flavors. The bottling is still young and will benefit from bottle aging until 2016.
title: Boizel NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Full and ripe, this is dominated by rich apple flavors that are cut with taut lemon zest. The wine is crisp, showing great acidity and a creamy aftertaste. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Charles Baur NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is deliciously fresh and full. Red fruits are laced with intense acidity and a crisp, clean texture. It gives instant fruity pleasure and a light and bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine Charles Baur NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a structured wine, firmly tannic and with considerable wood flavors at this stage. Plenty of rich fruit lies in the background, giving promise for the future. With those red berry flavors and fine acidity in place, this will be a solid, dense wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine A. Machard de Gramont 2012 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Firm and powerful, this tannic wine has dense black-fruit flavors, with enough fruitiness to balance the structure. The finish shows a smoky character, a bitter cherry flavor and bright acidity.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010 Collection Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: While this wine has the crispness of Chablis, it also has weight and concentration. The bright green-apple flavor is underpinned by a sense of minerality. Nervy, tense yet fruity, this can age for 2–3 years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: An elegant yet ripe wine, this comes laced with citrus acidity, and the yellow fruit and melon flavors give it a sense of richness. It's lively and crisp, and it has a toasty base. Age it for 3–4 years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Clos Saint-Marc Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Smooth and round, this wine is made from grapes that were sourced from the southernmost vineyards of the Côte d'Or. It has a soft, rich and fruity character that shows citrus and white peach flavors, plus a pineapple hint. As it opens, it becomes opulent and full bodied.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2010 Les Charmes Dessus  (Santenay)

description: An elegant wine, this is full of ripe black-fruit flavors, and it has a rich, velvety texture. The acidity and minerality give this wine a sense of structure that promises good aging potential.
title: Domaine Champy 2010 Les Taillepieds Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: A pure-tasting wine, this has a mineral character, tight, balanced acidity and lemon and white-fruit flavors. One of the rare white wines from the Côte de Nuits, this has power and a toasty element.
title: Domaine Bruno Clair 2010 En la rue de Vergy  (Morey-Saint-Denis)

description: Forward and fruity, this allies fresh, upfront apple and citrus fruits with acidity. Light, bright and crisp, it offers pleasurable drinkability.
title: Sylvain Dussort 2010 Cuvée des Ormes  (Bourgogne)

description: Soft and open, this has ripe fruits that are lightly textured and gently attractive. The acidity that shows on the finish gives the wine definition, but its softness is likely to be the dominant character.
title: Domaine George 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Chablis)

description: Soft and fruity, this has apple and citrus flavors, with a touch of vanilla. It is light, fragrant and crisp; ready to drink.
title: André Guichot 2010  Bourgogne

description: This is a juicy, red-currant-flavored wine. With its round feel and soft, smoky tannins, it has an initial smoothness that is given some bite by the red-berry acidity on the finish.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010  Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: On the lean side, this taut and crisp red-currant-flavored wine is dominated by acidity and dry tannins. It seems to miss out on generosity.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2010 Les Mondes Rondes  (Côte de Beaune)

description: While it doesn't have huge power, this wine does have many great attributes. It is smoothly ripe, its open structure a fine reflection of the elegant style, edged with minerality. The acidity is pure, not too dominant, but lifting the generous fruit and final dry character.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2006  Pessac-Léognan

description: While it doesn't have huge power, this wine does have many great attributes. It is smoothly ripe, its open structure a fine reflection of the elegant style, edged with minerality. The acidity is pure, not too dominant, but lifting the generous fruit and final dry character.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2006  Pessac-Léognan

description: Earthy and rustic, this Pinot Noir is lightweight, with a hint of red cherry. There is an unpleasant bitter aftertaste.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2009 Pinot Noir (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: Fragrant and soft, this has a touch of spice that adds interest to the fresh lemon and bright apple fruitiness. With a gentle texture, it is ready to drink.
title: Doudet Naudin 2013  Saint-Véran

description: Crisp and tight, this offers bright acidity over a lightly smoky flavor. A green fruit and herb element adds to the general freshness of the wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine Paquet et Fils 2013  Mâcon Chaintré

description: The plateau vineyards that are the source of this wine give a cool, crisp and light character. It's fragrant, pure fruitiness, with a light minerality and citrus at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Laroche 2014  Petit Chablis

description: The plateau vineyards that are the source of this wine give a cool, crisp and light character. It's fragrant, pure fruitiness, with a light minerality and citrus at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Laroche 2014  Petit Chablis

description: Intensely crisp with a strong lemon and orange zest character, this is a ripe, tight wine with hints of honey and a steely, mineral aftertaste. It will be better from the end of 2015.
title: Bailly-Lapierre 2014  Saint-Bris

description: A fresh rosé, so crisp, bright and lively. This is real pleasure, the red berry fruits bursting out of the glass, lifted by delicious acidity. Very crisp, pure in taste.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2009 Vieilles Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Off-dry Vouvray, with hints of honey, light on acidity and feeling soft. The wine needs to be drunk over the next year.
title: Bougrier 2010 Doulce France V  (Vouvray)

description: Off-dry Vouvray, with hints of honey, light on acidity and feeling soft. The wine needs to be drunk over the next year.
title: Bougrier 2010 Doulce France V  (Vouvray)

description: Very lightweight wine, with some attenuated fruit and a dry character. The attraction is the fresh acidity that does offer some compensation for the overoaked flavor.
title: Louis Chevallier 2009  Bourgogne

description: Very lightweight wine, with some attenuated fruit and a dry character. The attraction is the fresh acidity that does offer some compensation for the overoaked flavor.
title: Louis Chevallier 2009  Bourgogne

description: This is ripe and soft, with its red fruits well integrated into the rounded texture. There is a crisp edge to the wine, with spice, lemon and apple skin flavors.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2011 Cuvée Lampe de Méduse Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The tart fruitfulness of ripe, red apples rises from the glass. Chock-full of appetizing apple notes, this brings more flavor than your average Pinot Blanc. Drink soon while aromas abound.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2014 Pfaff Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: The tart fruitfulness of ripe, red apples rises from the glass. Chock-full of appetizing apple notes, this brings more flavor than your average Pinot Blanc. Drink soon while aromas abound.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2014 Pfaff Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: Soft, gentle and generous cherry notes color the nose and light palate. This is pliable and has pleasant edges of peppery, tingling spice and freshness.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2013 Trois Chateaux Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Fresh green-pear notes appear everywhere and round out the slender palate. Lemon and lime freshness provide extra structure. Drink soon.
title: François Baur 2015 Herrenweg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A real evocation of fresh, crisp and crunchy apple delivers freshness and punch on the easy-drinking but fresh, clean and joyful palate. Drink this soon, if possible at a summer party where this slender wine will come into its refreshing own.
title: Famille Hauller 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Aromatic red berries signal tart pleasure: redcurrant and raspberry. The very easy and smooth body fully plays into that with light-bodied charm. Drink while the aromas still sing.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2014 Rosenberg Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A subdued nose of crushed oak leaf whispers with the slightest hint of red berry. The palate is oak-spiced and gentle: think tart red plum with cinnamon. This is fresh and light bodied for a red, but has ample charm.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2014 Bonheur Convivial Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This perfumed, fruit-forward wine is ripe with red berries and sweet tannins. The aftertaste brings in the freshness of the year.
title: Domaine Jean Fournier 2014 Trois Terres  (Marsannay)

description: Full and soft, this wine is a rounded style of rosé. Ripe strawberry flavors are cut with crisper raspberries. The wine, produced at the Pessac-Léognan estate of Domaine de Chevalier, has attractive, refreshing acidity to complete a harmonious package. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2015 Rosé de Chevalier Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a rich, densely tannic wine with dark-hued blackberry fruits and ripe acidity. It is concentrated, still very firm while just beginning to show its full-bodied character. Wait until 2018.
title: Château la Tour de By 2011  Médoc

description: This is a big, bold and fruity wine, packed with ripe Merlot fruit. Juicy blackberry flavors have a fine shot of acidity and soft tannins. It's a warm wine that will age well over the medium-term. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Patache 2012  Pomerol

description: Without any dosage, this bone-dry wine has shocking initial acidity that then opens up to allow the attractive white fruits and mineral character to shine. It is six years old, but it still tastes young and should be kept until 2017.
title: Vincent Couche 2009 ADN Montgueux  (Champagne)

description: Soft and ripe, a wine that is wide open. With its light and crisp character and attractive yellow fruits, this will develop quickly.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2008 Beaune du Château Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This plump, medium-bodied rosé is a blend of two-thirds Syrah and one-third Mourvèdre. It's a fruit-driven style, driven by hints of peach, cantaloupe and bubble gum, that should have broad appeal.
region: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2014 Cape Bleue Rosé (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: As crisp and light as the mountain air of Savoie, this citrus and apple-bright wine offers great fruitiness and a tangy, orange-zest aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Philippe Viallet 2014 Les Cantates Chignin Jacquère (Vin de Savoie)

description: This is a clean, refreshing rosé from the generally higher altitudes of Luberon. In the modern, cold-fermented style, it's a bit confectionary in fruity esters—somewhat reminiscent of bubble gum or cotton candy—yet dry on the finish.
title: Marrenon 2014 Classique Rosé (Luberon)

description: This is a clean, refreshing rosé from the generally higher altitudes of Luberon. In the modern, cold-fermented style, it's a bit confectionary in fruity esters—somewhat reminiscent of bubble gum or cotton candy—yet dry on the finish.
title: Marrenon 2014 Classique Rosé (Luberon)

description: This light Chablis is fresh and packed with attractive young fruitiness. It comes from the plateau above the Serein valley and shows its provenance in the cool-climate crispness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2014  Petit Chablis

description: Light, bright and fresh, this wine is ready to drink. Crisp apple and lemon flavors are lifted by tangy acidity. Juicy and very fruity it has a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Domaine Daniel Reverdy et Fils 2014  Sancerre

description: Light, bright and fresh, this wine is ready to drink. Crisp apple and lemon flavors are lifted by tangy acidity. Juicy and very fruity it has a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Domaine Daniel Reverdy et Fils 2014  Sancerre

description: This is round, ripe and full of rich fruitiness. It has a tannic structure that gives the wine concentration and a tight texture. The fruit is less obvious making this much more a rosé for food. Drink now.
designation: Domaine des Brosses Secrets des Tronbochards
title: Alain Girard et Fils 2014 Domaine des Brosses Secrets des Tronbochards Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This is round, ripe and full of rich fruitiness. It has a tannic structure that gives the wine concentration and a tight texture. The fruit is less obvious making this much more a rosé for food. Drink now.
designation: Domaine des Brosses Secrets des Tronbochards
title: Alain Girard et Fils 2014 Domaine des Brosses Secrets des Tronbochards Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This progressive domaine in Tavel reaches into neighboring Lirac for this wine, which is a high 70% Cinsault (the balance is Grenache). It's fresh and citrusy despite having ample weight, ending on a zesty note.
title: Domaine Maby 2014 La Fermade Rosé (Lirac)

description: This progressive domaine in Tavel reaches into neighboring Lirac for this wine, which is a high 70% Cinsault (the balance is Grenache). It's fresh and citrusy despite having ample weight, ending on a zesty note.
title: Domaine Maby 2014 La Fermade Rosé (Lirac)

description: Ripe and fruity, this is a rich style of rosé. It has forward succulent strawberry flavors that are gently lifted by acidity. There is also a young, almost bitter character that, unusually, suggests this rosé needs to age. Drink summer 2016.
title: Pierre Prieur et Fils 2014 Domaine de Saint-Pierre Rosé (Sancerre)

description: One of a range of wines under the Homage to Heritage import label, this fruit-driven wine has apple and green plum fruits, sustained by great acidity and a crisp, mineral texture. Drink from 2016.
title: Trenel Fils 2014 Homage to Heritage  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: An attractive wine. The Chardonnay is fresh, lightly mineral, with flavors of red apples, lemon zest and crisp acidity. A great party wine.
title: Barton & Guestier NV Cuvée Réservée Brut Chardonnay (Vin Mousseux)

description: Just touched by honey and with a light spritz, this is a crisp, lemon and lime zest-flavored wine. It has great acidity with a yeasty character.
title: Pierre Boniface 2009 Les Rocailles White (Apremont)

description: Just touched by honey and with a light spritz, this is a crisp, lemon and lime zest-flavored wine. It has great acidity with a yeasty character.
title: Pierre Boniface 2009 Les Rocailles White (Apremont)

description: With its sunset pink color, this is an open, soft, full wine that edges towards dryness, but equally picks out red berry fruits, lifted by forward light acidity. It's young, fruity, with hints of minerality.
title: Deutz 2004 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: An already mature, toasty Champagne, with yeast, dry toast and almond flavors. The grapefruit edge from primary fruits is there, but this wine is filling out, becoming deliciously open and certainly entering maturity. Enjoy as a food Champagne.
title: Delamotte 1999 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A smooth and velvet-textured wine, where the wood, while dominant, is also there to give an opulence to the ripe fruits. So pear and peach flavors go with spice and there is a fine, apple streak of acidity. With its final concentration of rich flavors this is developing well, giving a caramel and lime acidity finish.
title: Château Bel Air Perponcher 2006  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This may be a nonvintage wine, but it's obvious from the yellow straw color that the wine is very ready to drink. The taste confirms this with a smooth palate with yellow fruit flavors and acidity that is well integrated. It's a delicious wine, fruity and generous at the end.
title: Piot-Sévillano NV Brut Prestige  (Champagne)

description: A wine with soft fruitiness, red berry flavors and a touch of toast. Ripe, full and not quite dry, it is an easy, accessible rosé sparkler, fine for apéritifs.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A wine with soft fruitiness, red berry flavors and a touch of toast. Ripe, full and not quite dry, it is an easy, accessible rosé sparkler, fine for apéritifs.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Tannins and strong smoky wood flavors dominate this wine.Very dark and dry in texture, its fruitiness hides behind all this hard structure and dense character.
title: Louis Sipp 2009 Nature'S Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Tannins and strong smoky wood flavors dominate this wine.Very dark and dry in texture, its fruitiness hides behind all this hard structure and dense character.
title: Louis Sipp 2009 Nature'S Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A fresh, fragrant Sauvignon Blanc. It's bone dry, full of citrus flavors and a fine swathe of acidity. Herbaceous, crisp and ready to drink now. Screwcap.
title: Domaine de Bellecours 2012  Sancerre

description: Dry, yes, but this wine is also soft and ripe. It has an attractive toasty character giving power to the midpalate. It's in the finish that the real acidity and dryness show most.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Dry, yes, but this wine is also soft and ripe. It has an attractive toasty character giving power to the midpalate. It's in the finish that the real acidity and dryness show most.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine is seriously structured for the vintage: that means a wine that is full of tannins, dark and firm. It has concentration and black fruits, shot through with acidity. Drink this dense wine from 2018.
title: Maison Givas 2014 Vin No 1  (Montagne-Saint-Émilion)

description: The wine is seriously structured for the vintage: that means a wine that is full of tannins, dark and firm. It has concentration and black fruits, shot through with acidity. Drink this dense wine from 2018.
title: Maison Givas 2014 Vin No 1  (Montagne-Saint-Émilion)

description: Full of jammy Merlot fruits, this is a smooth ripe wine. Dried fruits and tannins give the wine its varietal character. They are freshened by the acidity and black-currant fruitiness. The aftertaste allows the firm tannins to shine. Drink from 2017.
title: Maison Givas 2014 Vin No. 09  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Full of jammy Merlot fruits, this is a smooth ripe wine. Dried fruits and tannins give the wine its varietal character. They are freshened by the acidity and black-currant fruitiness. The aftertaste allows the firm tannins to shine. Drink from 2017.
title: Maison Givas 2014 Vin No. 09  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: This rich, wood-aged wine has ripe plum fruits and dark tannins. It's still young, but it has a concentrated profile that's full bodied and dense. The fruity aftertaste is well integrated with the tannins. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2012 L'Enclos de Ramage  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This is totally fruit-driven wine. With very fresh citrus acidity, it is as crisp as possible while not losing sight of the potential of its white fruits. There is a delicious steely edge as well as great acidity at the end. The wine is a blend from vineyards planted with 60% Sauvignon blanc, 30% Sémillon and 10% Muscadelle. The estate has been in the Le Grix de la Salle family for 100 years.
title: Chateau le Grand Verdus 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Full and textured, this wine has a strong tangy, zesty character. Offering orange peel and red apple flavors, it's in the food-friendly category. It will be better in few months, so drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château de Brigue 2014 Rosé Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Full and textured, this wine has a strong tangy, zesty character. Offering orange peel and red apple flavors, it's in the food-friendly category. It will be better in few months, so drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château de Brigue 2014 Rosé Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wood-aged wine is crisp and displays a great balance between acidity and rich fruits. The wine is still young, although you can see the good acidity, mineral texture and refined toastiness. The elements are coming together to give a wine that will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Chassagne-Montrachet 2011  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This wood-aged wine is crisp and displays a great balance between acidity and rich fruits. The wine is still young, although you can see the good acidity, mineral texture and refined toastiness. The elements are coming together to give a wine that will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Chassagne-Montrachet 2011  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This is rich with fruit as well as a mineral, tangy texture. A ripe character comes from the delicious raspberry fruit and acidity (60% Grenache, 40% Cinsault). The aftertaste is fresh, while remaining textured and ready for food.
title: Château de Calavon 2014 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This wine is so well balanced with its acidity, crisp white and citrus fruit and tangy texture. A strong spice and pepper character gives the wine a bite, while the final acidity is deliciously refreshing.
title: Château Barbeiranne 2014 Réserve Robert Pascal Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A light, easy Pinot Blanc, rounded, creamy and with just the right balance of fresh acidity. It's simple, attractive now, ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2011 Bouquet de Printemps Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A light, easy Pinot Blanc, rounded, creamy and with just the right balance of fresh acidity. It's simple, attractive now, ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2011 Bouquet de Printemps Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Hints of garrigue herbs and bramble add depth to the bright red-berry and strawberry aromas on the nose of this wine. Juicy fruit flavors continue on to the balanced and accessible palate, alongside soft tannins and a clean, mouthwatering finish.
title: François Lurton 2009 Mas Janeil Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages)

description: Rounded and rich, this Blanc de Blancs has both a smooth texture, delicious white fruits and an intense line of acidity. It's clean, fragrant, very fresh.
designation: Perle d'Ivoire Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Louis Bouillot NV Perle d'Ivoire Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is a seriously sweet, gorgeously opulent wine made from late-harvest fruit. Spice notes fringe flavors of honey and fresh fruit. It's a wine to drink now, although it will age well until 2020.
title: Willm 2008 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a seriously sweet, gorgeously opulent wine made from late-harvest fruit. Spice notes fringe flavors of honey and fresh fruit. It's a wine to drink now, although it will age well until 2020.
title: Willm 2008 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Perfumed, and still quite youthful, this is a wine with potential both from its texture and its acidity. There is a strongly chalky, mineral element that lends structure to the aromatic, crisp white fruits. On the finish, the wine has a cool, elegant character.
title: Joseph Cattin 2011 Hatschbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Spicy, new wood aromas dominate this firm and structured wine. It has weight and a density that comes both from the wood and ripe fruits. Big and solid, it has a fine red berry aftertaste.
title: Mas de la Rouvière 2009 Red (Bandol)

description: Spicy, new wood aromas dominate this firm and structured wine. It has weight and a density that comes both from the wood and ripe fruits. Big and solid, it has a fine red berry aftertaste.
title: Mas de la Rouvière 2009 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a rich, finely structured wine. It is highly perfumed, packed with black fruits and has a dark, firm texture. At the same time, the acidity is intense and the structure tight, suggesting a wine to age. Beautifully endowed with great fruit, it will take time to develop. Drink from 2026.
title: Vieux Château Certan 2014  Pomerol

description: This is a very fine wine showing a new level of quality at Montrose. With its almost velvet tannins inside the intense black fruits, the wine is rich, smooth and generous. Blackberry and black-plum fruits are to the fore along with the fine acidity and great structure. A wine to age for decades, it will be ready to drink from 2027.
title: Château Montrose 2014  Saint-Estèphe

description: There is a sense of pure juicy black-currant fruit that shoots through this great wine. With tannins that are firm while not a jot too much, the wine is crisp, packed with fruit and set for many years of aging. It is beautiful, fruity and intensely structured. Drink from 2027.
title: Château Margaux 2014  Margaux

description: The classic blend for Figeac with its 32% of Cabernet Sauvignon and 28% Cabernet Franc gives a beautifully dense wine with great tannins. The wine is perfumed while the complex tannins are finely cushioned by the generous black fruits and acidity. It is a wine for long-term aging. Drink from 2026.
title: Château Figeac 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: This is an immensely dense wine that is going to be a classic. The dark tannins are still lined with wood aging but that will go because the fruit underneath is also just as dense and intense. Blackberry, black plum and damson plum give power and sweetness. This is a great wine with huge potential. Drink from 2028.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2014  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a structured wine with its tight acidity and concentrated white and citrus fruits. Produced from a small parcel on the Chevalier estate, it is complex with its mineral texture, its touch of pepper and its fine herbal acidity. It is a wine for long-term aging. Drink from 2023.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a structured wine with its tight acidity and concentrated white and citrus fruits. Produced from a small parcel on the Chevalier estate, it is complex with its mineral texture, its touch of pepper and its fine herbal acidity. It is a wine for long-term aging. Drink from 2023.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: Dense and beautifully ripe, this is a rounded rich wine. It focuses on the tropical yellow-fruit spectrum. That gives a full wine with wood-spice hints and just the right amount of citrus acidity to give it a lift. Drink this finely structured wine from 2023.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: It's easy to call this a beautiful wine—it's dense and lush, with great layers of black fruit and acidity. The first fully biodynamic vintage from this estate has certainly yielded impressive ripe fruit, with structured tannins and dark berry flavors that linger long. It has enormous potential, certainly not be ready to drink before 2027.
title: Château Palmer 2014  Margaux

description: This grand wine is stylish and elegant. It is also powerful and dense with dark tannins and great concentration. It is a very fine wine, packed with black plum and berry fruits and balanced richness. Don't let the great fruit deceive: this is a wine for the serious long term. Drink from 2028.
title: Château Ausone 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: Full of ripe fruit, opulent and concentrated, this is a fabulous and impressive wine. It has a beautiful line of acidity balanced with ripe fruits. The wood aging is subtle, just a hint of smokiness and toast. This is one of those wines, from a great white wine vintage, that will age many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: This premier cru vineyard with its steep slopes, is close to the village of Saint-Aubin. It has produced a wine that is toasty, showing strong wood flavors as well as ripe pear and peach fruitiness. Drink this rich wine from 2018.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2014 Les Frionnes Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: This premier cru vineyard with its steep slopes, is close to the village of Saint-Aubin. It has produced a wine that is toasty, showing strong wood flavors as well as ripe pear and peach fruitiness. Drink this rich wine from 2018.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2014 Les Frionnes Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: This is the first vintage at this Fleurie property by new owner Alexandra de Vazeilles. It is rich, full of red fruits with considerable acidity. Hints of the 12 months wood aging show in the spice and smoothness at the end. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château des Bachelards 2014 Grand Vin Gamay

description: This is the first vintage at this Fleurie property by new owner Alexandra de Vazeilles. It is rich, full of red fruits with considerable acidity. Hints of the 12 months wood aging show in the spice and smoothness at the end. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château des Bachelards 2014 Grand Vin Gamay

description: From a single parcel on the Vrignaud domaine, the wine has 30% wood aging. That gives a ripe full character which emphasizes the rich vintage. Toast mingles with rich apples and touches of citrus. Drink this refreshing wine from 2017.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2015 La Champréaux  (Chablis)

description: From a single parcel on the Vrignaud domaine, the wine has 30% wood aging. That gives a ripe full character which emphasizes the rich vintage. Toast mingles with rich apples and touches of citrus. Drink this refreshing wine from 2017.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2015 La Champréaux  (Chablis)

description: The vineyards of Vendômois lie in the Loir valley and north of the Loire proper. That gives them an extra tang of coolness as well as intensity. This crisp, baked-apple and spice-flavored wine is delicious, fruity while also well structured. Drink this perfumed wine now.
title: Domaine Patrice Colin 2014 Vieilles Vignes Chenin Blanc (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: The vineyards of Vendômois lie in the Loir valley and north of the Loire proper. That gives them an extra tang of coolness as well as intensity. This crisp, baked-apple and spice-flavored wine is delicious, fruity while also well structured. Drink this perfumed wine now.
title: Domaine Patrice Colin 2014 Vieilles Vignes Chenin Blanc (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: The appellation is good at producing soft early drinking wines like this. It is fruity with good acidity and red-currant fruitiness. The tannins are in the background, allowing the wine to age for a few years. Drink this ripe wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Maillard 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: A year's maturation and wood aging have produced this smooth, rich wine. The tannins are integrated into the red fruits that burst out of the glass. Aromatic and spicy, the wine is still full of young fruitiness and will be better from late 2017.
title: Domaine Chancelle 2014  Saumur-Champigny

description: A tinge of copper to this white's hue suggests a bit of skin contact, and there's a decided textural element and tannic grip on the palate as well. Pear and melon flavors finish refreshing and mouthwatering in spite of the wine's richness. Drink now.
title: Brotte 2016 Les Hauts de Barville White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: One in a series of small cuvées from the Right and Left banks, this pure Cabernet Sauvignon (from the great 2010 vintage) is still young. It does have impressively concentrated fruit and powerful tannins to allow it to develop well. Drink this impressive wine from 2019.
title: Belliard Vins Selections 2010 Excellence de Belliard  (Margaux)

description: A hint of honey gives this wine richness while keeping every bit of freshness. It has tangy acidity, a mineral character and apricot and mango fruit flavors. Drink now, although the wine will be better from early 2016.
title: Laudet 2014 La Demoiselle de Laballe Gros Manseng (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Ripe and wood aged, this is rich with ginger and tropical fruit flavors. Dense and concentrated, it is a full-in-the-mouth wine—powerful and very ageworthy. Give this five years.
title: Château de Fuissé 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is powerful, ripe and creamily smooth, bearing yellow fruits that dominate the wood aging. It's a rich medley of apricot and yellow peach flavors, laced with citrusy acidity. Full, complex and generous, this is worth aging for over four years.
title: Château de Fuissé 2010 Les Brûlés  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A signature wine for Girardin, this is powerful and rich, with apricot, quince and green plum fruits that are layered within the taut texture. A toast note rounds out this complex, ageworthy wine.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: A signature wine for Girardin, this is powerful and rich, with apricot, quince and green plum fruits that are layered within the taut texture. A toast note rounds out this complex, ageworthy wine.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: With wood-based aromas, this is currently a closed, taut wine. It has green fruits and minerality; it's nervy and under tension. The acidity is crisp while very light in character. This is for aging.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2010 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: In this vintage, Echézeaux reveals an extra edge of really ripe, full fruits. They are balanced by the firm wood- and spice-laden structure, with the tannins and intense acids adding the final touches. Age this over 7–8 years.
title: Jean-Claude Boisset 2009  Echézeaux

description: Using grapes sourced from a steep slope in the Blanchot Vineyard, this powerful wine shows richness as well as concentrated fruitiness. Its smooth, mineral texture is punctuated acidity and flavors of apricot and melon fruit. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Blanchot Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Nervy and textured, this is a wine under tension. It is crisp with acidity, with lots of bright green-fruit and citrus flavors. This is complex and age worthy, bringing out the intense texture from the vineyard.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Perrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Soft and rich, with ripe fruit flavors, this is warm and opulent. Packed with notes of spice and toast, the ripe peach flavor is layered into the fine, elegant structure. Aging will make it even more delicious.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Genevrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Soft and rich, with ripe fruit flavors, this is warm and opulent. Packed with notes of spice and toast, the ripe peach flavor is layered into the fine, elegant structure. Aging will make it even more delicious.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Genevrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: This medium-sweet wine is rich, with all the tropical fruit flavors expected from Gewurztraminer. It's perfumed, full-bodied and ripe, while conserving some acidity. It needs a few months, so drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine Zinck 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This aromatic, fruity wine has a crisp and steely backbone. It's laced with citrus and crisp pear flavors, fresh and with a bright, clean aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2013 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: A medium-sweet style of Gewurztraminer this is is soft, spicy and rounded with tropical fruits and lychees. The aftertaste continues the smooth character of the wine, easy to drink and ready now.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2012 Collection Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This fresh and fruity wine is soft with gentle spice. It has a crisp side as well, making for an easy, ready-to-drink wine that is well balanced.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2013 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This medium-dry wine offers a drier core of spice and pepper. Around this, yellow fruits and creamed pears come to the fore. The wine is ready to drink now, although it will be worth waiting until 2016.
title: Charles Sparr 2013 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This medium-dry wine offers a drier core of spice and pepper. Around this, yellow fruits and creamed pears come to the fore. The wine is ready to drink now, although it will be worth waiting until 2016.
title: Charles Sparr 2013 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This soft, fruity, light wine has great white fruits and a cut of attractive acidity. It's crisp, spiced with nutmeg and given freshness by the sliced green apple.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg 2013 Anne de K Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The wine is all spice and ripe lychees, conveying a simple, fruity character that is rounded and medium sweet in character. It's ready to drink.
title: Boeckel 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This spicy, apple-fresh wine has spice, crisp acidity and great fruitiness. It's a perfect apéritif style with its lightness and freshness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Loew 2013 Cormier Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Made from organic grapes, this is a lightly spicy wine with balanced acidity. It has fresh apricots, grated nutmeg and a crisp, tangy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2013 Cuvée de l'Ours Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Made from organic grapes, this is a lightly spicy wine with balanced acidity. It has fresh apricots, grated nutmeg and a crisp, tangy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2013 Cuvée de l'Ours Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: On the sweet side, this light and fresh wine hails from a single vineyard. It has spice and attractive apple acidity, plus a crisp side at the end. This is a bright wine to drink now.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2013 Pfleck Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Structured and dense, with layered tannins and an austere edge. At the same time, the fruit packs concentrated strawberry flavors, acidity and complexities from textured wood.
