description: This smoky wine is showing its wood, with spice and toasty flavors over the red fruits. The wine will balance out to become open and fruity. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Belissand Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This smoky wine is showing its wood, with spice and toasty flavors over the red fruits. The wine will balance out to become open and fruity. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Belissand Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: An attractive orange-pink wine, this offers ripe red berry and currant fruits. It is full in the mouth with a touch of tannin and bitterness from the recent bottling. It is tight at the end, crisp and needing some bottle age. Drink after 2015.
title: Charles Ellner NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Intensely fruity, this has great acidity, fresh red fruits and delicious orange-zest tang. Pale in color, it is poised and elegant, leaving a crisp, refreshing aftertaste.
designation: Les Folies par Marquis de Chasse
title: Ginestet 2014 Les Folies par Marquis de Chasse Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Dominated by Pinot Meunier, this is a soft and ripe wine despite its low dosage. It is aromatic with summer flowers and quince fruit flavors, while the aftertaste brings out a drier character. Vincelles village, home of the producer, is right at the western limit of Champagne production
title: Piot-Sévillano NV Tradition Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Boasting weight and some richness, the wine shows that the northern Beaujolais crus are the most successful in 2010. The cherry and sweet plum flavors are laced with ripe acidity as well as a mineral edge.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Sélection  (Saint-Amour)

description: Boasting weight and some richness, the wine shows that the northern Beaujolais crus are the most successful in 2010. The cherry and sweet plum flavors are laced with ripe acidity as well as a mineral edge.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Sélection  (Saint-Amour)

description: A wine with considerable structure, balanced by a good dollop of sweet fruits. The wine has weight, a tight final acidity and a finish that hints at some aging potential.
title: Henry Fessy 2010  Brouilly

description: In Beaujolais, 2010 was a firm and structured year, and this is very evident in this darkly tannic wine. It is packed with juicy acidity and red berry fruits, while it is also in need of several months' aging.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Sélection  (Juliénas)

description: Some richness and smoky flavors, although the acidity is also very present. Flavors of red cherry and pepper are balanced by a core of tannins.
title: Robert Perroud 2010 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: Ripe and fruity, this is a delicious and juicy wine. With plenty of red fruits, bright cherries and a soft texture, it is rounded and approachable now.
title: Domaine Dupré 2013 Haute Ronze  (Régnié)

description: The old vines from this estate that has been run by the same family for 10 generations have produced a firm wine, with structure and tannins that still need to soften. It is rich and juicy with black fruits and wood aging toastiness. The wine, named after the 1780 Royal Edict that established this small appellation on the banks of the Garonne river between Bordeaux and Toulouse is worth aging longer, so wait to drink until 2018.
title: Château Labastide Orliac 2008 1780 Royal Heritage Red (Brulhois)

description: This Roederer nonvintage seems to be getting drier, bringing out more of the green fruits and less creamy character. It works well here because the wine has some bottle age, giving a beautifully balanced wine that has great class and elegance.
title: Louis Roederer NV Brut Premier  (Champagne)

description: Crisp raspberries and red currants here, with a refreshing, lively acidity. If there is any intensity in this finely balanced wine, it is in the relationship between the fruit and the clean structure. But this is not for aging—drink now.
title: Henriot 2002 Rosé Millésimé  (Champagne)

description: This is certainly rich, packed with youthful green- and white-fruit flavors, but it still has that seductive elegance that is the hallmark of Deutz. Here is a wine that definitely needs aging. It has richness but there is still a raw edge.
title: Deutz 2000 Brut  (Champagne)

description: As it ages in bottle, this Champagne is showing real class. It remains as delicate as when reviewed last year, but it is now showing much more mature toastiness and bread flavors, and less of the green fruits. Elegance is still the main character; a fine, pure wine.
title: Pommery 1998 Cuvée Louise Brut  (Champagne)

description: As it ages in bottle, this Champagne is showing real class. It remains as delicate as when reviewed last year, but it is now showing much more mature toastiness and bread flavors, and less of the green fruits. Elegance is still the main character; a fine, pure wine.
title: Pommery 1998 Cuvée Louise Brut  (Champagne)

description: Cuis is among the first villages on the Côte des Blancs after leaving Epernay. While it doesn't have the reputation of the Grand Cru villages further along the slope, it can produce delicious wines. This fine, lightly creamy, white currant-flavored Champagne, shows a good mineral texture, a crispness and a refreshing aftertaste.
designation: Cuis Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils NV Cuis Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fragrant and crisp, this is a lively blend in which the Aligoté gives a great cut of acidity. The wine does have some weight as well, rounded at the end with the bright aftertaste.
title: Manuel Olivier NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: While Brouilly is one of the lighter of the Beaujolais crus, it still is a step up from Villages, as this ripe wine shows. With weight and some tannins, it promises moderate aging while also offering a delicious cherry profile drinking now.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2011 Château la Perrière  (Brouilly)

description: Ripe, with jammy red fruits, this is an attractively fruity wine. It has maraschino cherry flavors, intertwined with acidity to give structure, a fresh character and soft tannins. Drink this year.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2011 Château de Nervers  (Brouilly)

description: One of the smallest crus, Saint-Amour produces firm and structured wines. This Sélection shows both rich black fruit and solid tannins that are typical. Over the next six months, it's likely the fruitiness will become more dominant.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Sélection  (Saint-Amour)

description: One of the smallest crus, Saint-Amour produces firm and structured wines. This Sélection shows both rich black fruit and solid tannins that are typical. Over the next six months, it's likely the fruitiness will become more dominant.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Sélection  (Saint-Amour)

description: This is a light, bright white-flower-perfumed wine, and it offers fresh, apple-like acidity, a crisp texture and an edge of lemon zest. For drinking soon.
title: Château de Pizay 2011  Bourgogne

description: Warm and round, this Mâcon has ripe melon and peach flavors that come with a citrusy edge. It has an attractive floral character that brings out the light minerality and acidity on the finish.
title: Barton & Guestier 2011  Mâcon-Villages

description: Ripe yellow-fruit flavors and a soft texture are the hallmarks of this wine. Full in the mouth, this has a warm southern Burgundy feel. It offers touches of spice and green herbs, and it has orange-zest-like acidity on the finish.
title: Antonin Rodet 2011  Mâcon-Villages

description: Soft, light and fruity, this wine is already approachable. It is an apple- and apricot-flavored Chardonnay, with just a tang of lemon zest that lends the finish some bite.
title: Antonin Rodet 2011 A. Rodet  (Bourgogne)

description: In this smooth wine, toasty flavors mingle easily with the ripe yellow fruits. It offers minerality as well as juicy citrus flavors, making for a rich wine that needs to age. Drink from 2021.
designation: Les Clos des Mouches Premier Cru
title: Seguin-Manuel 2015 Les Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: In this smooth wine, toasty flavors mingle easily with the ripe yellow fruits. It offers minerality as well as juicy citrus flavors, making for a rich wine that needs to age. Drink from 2021.
designation: Les Clos des Mouches Premier Cru
title: Seguin-Manuel 2015 Les Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Rich, fruity and with a full texture, this smooth, creamy wine has great fruit, deliciously cut with acidity. The wine is smooth, hinting at toast, with a tighter, more textured aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2015 Les Corton Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Rounded and warm, this wine shows ripe yellow fruits and spice from the wood aging. It's richly endowed, full of toast and with a generous texture. The minerality and acidity are a hint in this rounded wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Latour 2015 Les Referts Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Rounded and warm, this wine shows ripe yellow fruits and spice from the wood aging. It's richly endowed, full of toast and with a generous texture. The minerality and acidity are a hint in this rounded wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Latour 2015 Les Referts Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This is firm, in the Pommard style. But because this is a 2015 vintage, the wine is also generously rich and with great red berry fruits. The acidity is in the back of this wine with its bold flavors and concentrated texture. Drink from 2023.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Les Arvelets Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: While there are wood aromas and wood flavors, the wine is equally about ripe fruit and generous tannins. It has spice, red-berry fruits and a rounded structure. It will age well, giving a rich wine from 2022.
title: Henri de Villamont 2015 Clos des Guettes Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Light and fruity, this is a strawberry flavored wine that is soft, open, ready to drink. It has attractive acidity, gentle tannins and a rounded finish.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2011  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: Beautifully fruity wine, bright, citrus and yellow fruit dominated. Packed with crisp acidity, light floral flavors and a steely texture. It's for drinking now. Screwcap.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2012 Classic White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Beautifully fruity wine, bright, citrus and yellow fruit dominated. Packed with crisp acidity, light floral flavors and a steely texture. It's for drinking now. Screwcap.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2012 Classic White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A rounded wine, benefiting from the fruitiness of the year to give soft tannins, ripe strawberry fruits and an attractive acidity. The wine is ready to drink, although could age a few months.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2011 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: A rounded wine, benefiting from the fruitiness of the year to give soft tannins, ripe strawberry fruits and an attractive acidity. The wine is ready to drink, although could age a few months.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2011 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: The warmth of the year brings out rich fruits as well as the cool structure of a wine from the Hautes Côtes in the hills behind Beaune. There is acidity, of course, coupled with red berries and an underlying ripeness.
title: Antonin Rodet 2010 Château de Mercey  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune)

description: Fruity wine, packed with red berries, lightweight tannins and a stalky black currant fruit character. It's not for aging, it is a wine that has friendly acidity and an open, generous nature. Drink now.
title: Château de Chambert 2011 Les Loges de Carlat Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Fruity wine, packed with red berries, lightweight tannins and a stalky black currant fruit character. It's not for aging, it is a wine that has friendly acidity and an open, generous nature. Drink now.
title: Château de Chambert 2011 Les Loges de Carlat Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Intensely peppery as well as fruity, this is a tight, crisp wine. It has creamy acidity as well as a more nervy, mineral character that shows a tangy texture at the end.
title: Boeckel 2012 Vieilles Vignes Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: Very toasty aromas materialize into a wine that has way too much wood aging. There is no sign of fruit here, only wood plank flavors.
title: Château Beaulieu Comtes de Tastes 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A fruity, open wine, this has bright acidity, crisp green fruits, a touch of lemon and a light texture. Ready to drink.
title: Jean Médeville et Fils 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Bitter extraction hinders this wine. It does have some attractive fruitiness in the background, but it's lost amidst all the toughness. The rigid edge will soften, although the wine's fruitiness may well never materialize.
title: Château de Seguin 2011 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This is a concentrated, extracted wine that's firm and hard-edged. It has some bitterness while the fruit is missing.
title: Château Argadens 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine is too toasty for its own good. It has dark tannins, high spice and bitter toastiness. There is a soapy aftertaste that only just hints at fruit.
title: Château de Camarsac 2011 Prince Noir  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This wine is too toasty for its own good. It has dark tannins, high spice and bitter toastiness. There is a soapy aftertaste that only just hints at fruit.
title: Château de Camarsac 2011 Prince Noir  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This wine is too jammy for its own good with a texture that's soft and squishy. Notes of overripe strawberries are dominant, redeemed slightly by red-currant acidity. This wine is not for aging.
designation: Le Bord'eaux du Clos des Moiselles
title: Clos des Moiselles 2011 Le Bord'eaux du Clos des Moiselles  (Bordeaux)

description: Very ripe notes of yellow pear appear on the nose. A touch of earthiness adds texture and interest to the palate, as does the merest smidgen of residual sweetness, boosting the fruit flavors. A zesty freshness pulls all into focus. The finish is dry and lasting.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2015 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The nose gives appetizing glimpses of pure ripe juicy pear. These flavors blossom fully on the palate and leave a most harmonious picture of ample, dry, but well-expressed pear fruit with lovely freshness. Everything here happens with ease. The finish is pure and fresh.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2015 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Honeysuckle richness and lemon freshness vie for attention on the nose. The palate comes in with lots of concentration and very pithy, almost bitter texture as well as residual sweetness. Together they create balance and a very intense tangy finish and leave a lasting impression.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2015 Lieu-Dit Harth - Cuvée Carolin Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Ripeness and generosity of pure pear flavors characterize nose and palate. There is concentration on the palate and both juicy ripeness and zesty freshness, creating a lively fruit-driven wine. The finish is long and appetizing.
title: Paul Blanck 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Inviting notes of ripe juicy pear have an earthy pithy tint. The palate shows the same contrast of rich beguiling fruit and earthier pithier elements of bitterness. They work well together and create a harmonious textured picture. The palate is generous, concentrated and finishes off dry.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2015 Trois Châteaux Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Light fruit with soft tannins give this wine freshness and a soft texture. It offers black-currant flavors and intense, juicy acidity. It's not for aging, drink from 2017.
title: Château Nenin 2013 Fugue de Nenin  (Pomerol)

description: This wine is ripe with black-currant flavors and a stalky texture. The dominant Merlot gives it rich character, while Cabernet Franc adds a perfumed, smoky flavor. Still structured, it will be ready from late 2016.
title: Château Macalan 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine is ripe with black-currant flavors and a stalky texture. The dominant Merlot gives it rich character, while Cabernet Franc adds a perfumed, smoky flavor. Still structured, it will be ready from late 2016.
title: Château Macalan 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: From one of the estates belonging to the Lapalu family, this wine is structured with dusty tannins and a dry core. There is fruit, fresh with black-currant acidity and spice. It needs time to lose the edge of toasty wood-aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lieujean 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This smooth Sauvignon Blanc-dominated wine is soft, lightly spicy and ready to drink. It is ripe with only light acidity. Lemon and crisp apples show strongly at the end. Third-generation Lafarge owner Jean-Pierre Leymarie was born on the estate.
title: Château Lafargue 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Produced in one of the estates belonging to the Lapalu family, this wine is soft, rounded and ready to drink now. Gentle tannins give shape and structure to the black currant-fruits that finish on a fresh, crisp note.
title: Château Lacombe Noaillac 2013  Médoc

description: Almost ready to drink now, this is a rounded, smooth wine with only light tannins but plenty of fruitiness. It's not a big wine, balanced and juicy with attractive fruits. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Haut Barrail 2013  Médoc

description: This wine is fresh with acidity, rather than fruit. The dry core shows up in wood flavors that still need to integrate with fruit. Give this wine a few years and it will come together while always being on the lean side. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Hannetot 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Heavy extraction has given the wine a dark, bitter-chocolate character along with a serious amount of toast flavors. The result is a wine that is tough and only hinting at the fruit. It will probably soften as it develops although that firm wood character will likely remain. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Faizeau 2013  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: Structured and also rich, this wine is full of dark berry fruits as well as tannins. It's dense with ripe Merlot and delicately perfumed by the Cabernet Franc, offering a delicious, juicy black-fruit aftertaste. The vineyard is on the flat plain of Saint-Émilion that leads to the river Dordogne. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Parc 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Green fruits and an herbal character give this wine brightness and freshness, balanced by riper tropical fruits that come in with their softer edge. Still young, the wine is ready to drink now although is likely to be better from summer 2016.
title: Château Rousset-Caillau 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: Green fruits and an herbal character give this wine brightness and freshness, balanced by riper tropical fruits that come in with their softer edge. Still young, the wine is ready to drink now although is likely to be better from summer 2016.
title: Château Rousset-Caillau 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: A ripe while herbal wine, this is crisp and full of grapefruit and gooseberry fruits. Tangy with lively acidity, it is aromatic with white flowers and has a fresh, fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Sauvion 2015 Loire Valley  (Sancerre)

description: This crisp, clean, lightly herbal wine has apple and grapefruit flavors that come through intense acidity. Bright with ripe fruit, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Rémy-Pannier 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This attractive blend of Grenache and Cinsault is fruity with lively acidity and a crisp, tangy texture. Raspberry and orange zest hang happily together. Drink now.
title: Domaine Grand St Paul 2015 Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: This attractive blend of Grenache and Cinsault is fruity with lively acidity and a crisp, tangy texture. Raspberry and orange zest hang happily together. Drink now.
title: Domaine Grand St Paul 2015 Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: A pale rose-colored wine, this is attractive, crisp and fresh. Lime and raspberry fruits are cut by tight, lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Terra Vecchia 2015 Niellucciu-Syrah Cuvée Armonia Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: A pale rose-colored wine, this is attractive, crisp and fresh. Lime and raspberry fruits are cut by tight, lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Terra Vecchia 2015 Niellucciu-Syrah Cuvée Armonia Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: This attractively pale-colored rosé has ripe red fruits and crisp acidity in just the right proportions. It is soft, fruity with a lightly crisp texture and a bright, lively aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2015 Les Belles Vignes Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This attractively pale-colored rosé has ripe red fruits and crisp acidity in just the right proportions. It is soft, fruity with a lightly crisp texture and a bright, lively aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2015 Les Belles Vignes Rosé (Sancerre)

description: The vineyard of this estate, on the first slope above the River Loire, has produced a dry while honeyed wine. Fresh pear contrasts with lemon acidity and a light texture. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Petit Coteau NV  Vouvray

description: Light tannins and attractive red-berry fruits give this wine its instant appeal. It is soft, fruity, with a juicy, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014 Les Maladières  (Bourgogne)

description: Light tannins and attractive red-berry fruits give this wine its instant appeal. It is soft, fruity, with a juicy, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014 Les Maladières  (Bourgogne)

description: Made from 100% Pineau d'Aunis (a local grape that originated in Saumur in the 11th century) this is a soft wine. With attractive acidity, red-berry fruits and a gentle texture, the wine is ripe while keeping a backbone of mineral texture. Drink now.
title: Cave Cooperative du Vendômois 2015 Lieu-dit Cocagne Rosé (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: Chignin is one of the cru villages of Savoie. This wine is crisp, mineral and tight, with delicate layers of lemon and grapefruit acidity. Lively and bursting with fruit, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine les Fils de René Quénard 2015 Les Cantates Chignin Jacquère (Savoie)
winery: Domaine les Fils de René Quénard

description: Chignin is one of the cru villages of Savoie. This wine is crisp, mineral and tight, with delicate layers of lemon and grapefruit acidity. Lively and bursting with fruit, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine les Fils de René Quénard 2015 Les Cantates Chignin Jacquère (Savoie)
winery: Domaine les Fils de René Quénard

description: This is a crisp, medium-bodied example of Saint-Joseph. Aromas of creosote, black olives and roasting meat receive an infusion of brighter, fruitier flavors on the palate, adding cherries to the savory mix. Drink this mouthwatering wine over the next few years.
title: Duvernay 2010  Saint-Joseph

description: This is a crisp, medium-bodied example of Saint-Joseph. Aromas of creosote, black olives and roasting meat receive an infusion of brighter, fruitier flavors on the palate, adding cherries to the savory mix. Drink this mouthwatering wine over the next few years.
title: Duvernay 2010  Saint-Joseph

description: Very buttery aromas lead to a wine that is ripe, rounded and full in the mouth. The acidity is masked by the richness, leaving apricot rather than citrus as the dominant character.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2012 La Roche  (Mâcon-Vergisson)

description: Fruity and citrusy, with a steely, mineral edge, this wine is mainly sourced from Meursault. It's crisp, lemony and very bright on the end.
title: Domaine Jean-Philippe Fichet 2011  Bourgogne

description: This fresh wine is vinified in tanks rather than wood to retain the bright strawberry fruit flavors. It is elegant, light and has good acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Chantal Lescure 2011 Le Clos des Topes Bizot  (Côte de Beaune)

description: This fresh wine is vinified in tanks rather than wood to retain the bright strawberry fruit flavors. It is elegant, light and has good acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Chantal Lescure 2011 Le Clos des Topes Bizot  (Côte de Beaune)

description: Crisp with apples and citrus, it's also laced with a more mineral character. It's full in the mouth, very bright with acidity and grapefruit. Drink now.
title: Francis Blanchet 2012 Cuvée Silice  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A concentrated wine, it's packed with both dark fruits and tannins. A dense structure contrasts with the fresher black currant fruitiness. Ripe and full-bodied, the wine needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Métairie Neuve 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: It balances a crisp texture against ripe fruitiness. Finely structured, it's very fresh with herbaceous fruits and lively acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Château le Sartre 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: An aromatic wine, it has a rounded texture, a spicy character and only light acidity. Very forward and fruity, it's going to be ready to drink by 2015.
title: Château de Cruzeau 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: This rich wine boasts perfumed acidity as well as a juicy white-fruit flavor. It feels full in the mouth, weighty, although a more steely edge is never far away.
title: Bott Frères 2010 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Apple and peach flavors are mixed with a tangy character, leavened with notes of almond and toast. With its attractive maturity, it is ready to drink.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2009 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Confected and spicy, this is a wine that shows the indulgent side of Gewürztraminer. It has a spice note, with a fresh fruit-salad flavor. Screwcap.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2011 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Deliciously fruity, this has great flavors of pear and green plum. It is so fresh and lightly aromatic, with a smooth, creamy texture that's highlighted by lemony acidity.
title: Vignoble des 2 Lunes 2009 Apogée Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A rounded wine that exudes a flavor of warm yellow fruit. With its weight, the fruitiness comes through strongly, leaving an attractive tang of acidity on the finish.
title: Louis Max 2010  Saint-Véran

description: The Louis Max style seems to be of wines that open slowly and have a firm structure. That's the case here: It has plenty of acidity, with a red currant flavor and a dry, dense character.
title: Louis Max 2009  Chambolle-Musigny

description: This is ripe and jammy, with soft fruit and attractive acidity. It is warm, with a hint of wood aging. Ready to drink.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2009 Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Pale salmon and orange in color, this is a wine that brings together almonds, red fruits and a yeasty character. It is full-bodied, the ripe fruits like fruit candy, a bitter edge never far away.
title: Gratien et Meyer NV Cuvée Flamme Brut Rosé  (Saumur)

description: Richly satisfying this offers powerful tannins and equally powerful, juicy fruits. It has a great sense of structure, density and potential. Ripe berry and black plum fruits push through the impressive tannins to produce a wine that is developing well, although it will need several more years. Drink from 2018.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château Léret Monpezat Malbec (Cahors)

description: Richly satisfying this offers powerful tannins and equally powerful, juicy fruits. It has a great sense of structure, density and potential. Ripe berry and black plum fruits push through the impressive tannins to produce a wine that is developing well, although it will need several more years. Drink from 2018.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château Léret Monpezat Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is part of the range of three wines from different soils. Marne, or clay and chalk soil, is relatively heavy and produces a rich style of Sauvignon Blanc. This brings out the more tropical fruits and ripe pineapple that dominate the youthful acidity that cuts through the texture. Drink from 2016.
title: Vignobles Berthier 2013 Terre de Marne Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: Like many of Denis Pommier's wines, this comes from old vines, and the concentration is testament to that. The texture is rich, touched by honeyed wood, with peaches in syrup ripeness. As a contrast, there is also a fresh, red apple acidity, which gives a lift to the aftertaste.
title: Domaine Pommier 2007 Croix aux Moines  (Chablis)

description: A light, crisp, fresh wine, with attractive lemon grass and orange zest flavors. It is juicy, the green fruits full of intensity. There is good minerality as well, underlined by toast from wood aging.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2007 Domaine Béranger  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A light, crisp, fresh wine, with attractive lemon grass and orange zest flavors. It is juicy, the green fruits full of intensity. There is good minerality as well, underlined by toast from wood aging.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2007 Domaine Béranger  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Rich and powerful, this is a spicy wine flavored with caramel and apricot. There is a layer of high toast that is out of balance with the fruit, and needs time to calm down. Wait 6–9 months.
title: Faiveley 2007  Mâcon-Villages

description: Rich and powerful, this is a spicy wine flavored with caramel and apricot. There is a layer of high toast that is out of balance with the fruit, and needs time to calm down. Wait 6–9 months.
title: Faiveley 2007  Mâcon-Villages

description: Hardly dry, this wine has an edge of bitterness and seems unbalanced. The citrus and red apple fruits are not in alignment with the nut and white plum-skin tanginess, leaving a sharp aftertaste.
title: Demarjory NV Cuvée Céleste Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine misses fruit, although it does have a firm structure and tannins. A fresher character at the end gives a lift of acidity.
title: Château Turcaud 2014  Bordeaux Clairet

description: The wine misses fruit, although it does have a firm structure and tannins. A fresher character at the end gives a lift of acidity.
title: Château Turcaud 2014  Bordeaux Clairet

description: Lightly herbaceous, this is a fresh, obviously youthful wine. It is only lightly textured, the main character coming from yellow fruits and pear juice flavors. Drink now, although it will age and improve until 2016.
title: Château Moulin de Vignolle 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a perfumed wine, fresh with floral character. An attractive crisp edge makes it ready to drink now.
title: Château la Caderie 2014 Esprit  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: An orange tang gives acidity as well as fruit. Contrasted with this, the wine has a smoother, yeast and caramel side that doesn't balance.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light colored and light flavored, this has just hints of fruitiness along with the acidity. It is a crisp wine, very dry in character, bright and tangy at the end.
title: Château Haut Bessac 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light and fruity, this is a crisp, fresh wine. Hints of red apples and yellow fruits are cut with lemon zest. The wine is perfumed and ready to drink.
title: Château Grand Jean 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: With its extra-dark rosé color, Clairet is an unusual style. This wine is juicy with some acidity alongside fresh raspberry fruits. At the end, the wine seems heavy.
title: Château de Piote 2013 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: With its extra-dark rosé color, Clairet is an unusual style. This wine is juicy with some acidity alongside fresh raspberry fruits. At the end, the wine seems heavy.
title: Château de Piote 2013 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: Light in color, this gently fruity wine offers a touch of caramel as well as red currants. It's made to drink young and fresh now.
title: Château de Belcier 2014 Fleurs de Belcier Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light in color, this gently fruity wine offers a touch of caramel as well as red currants. It's made to drink young and fresh now.
title: Château de Belcier 2014 Fleurs de Belcier Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Dry and crisp, this is a fruity, red currant-flavored wine. Bright acidity and a light texture give a final bite of structure to an otherwise soft and ready to drink release.
title: Cave de Rauzan 2014 Duprais Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is lightly herbaceous, with a crisp while creamy texture that emphasizes perfumed green fruits and refreshing acidity. It is light, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Ginestet 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is soft, ripe and fruity. It is made to be drunk young with only hints of tannins and sweet black fruits. It's an easy, barbecue-style red wine that is rounded and ready.
title: Ginestet 2014  Bordeaux

description: Heavy and fat, this dark-colored rosé has a bitter character along with vanilla and spice flavors. The almost-sweet texture is round and soft at the end.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a tight woody wine that is hard and over-extracted. Some fruit may come through but it is hard to imagine.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a tight woody wine that is hard and over-extracted. Some fruit may come through but it is hard to imagine.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2014  Bordeaux

description: The wine, with its dry tannins, is dense while unfocussed. It will remain tannin dominated.
title: Château Les Petits 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is dry, firm and initially tough. With its dry wood core, the fruit is not getting a chance.
title: Château Haut Mondain 2014 Grande Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: The wine suffers from over-ripe fruit that give it a red-jelly flavor. The tannins and acidity make an odd contrast.
title: Château Clos Chaumont 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is dominated by extracted wood flavors. It is likely to soften, but not enough to allow the fruit to sing.
title: Château Bellevue Peycharneau 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine smells of over-ripe fruit and this sensation continues through the palate. The fruit and the tannins don't coincide.
title: Château Metairie Neuve 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine smells of over-ripe fruit and this sensation continues through the palate. The fruit and the tannins don't coincide.
title: Château Metairie Neuve 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Smoky and with a burnt toast aroma, this is a tough wine to like. It is young and there is fruit behind this bitterness so it could balance out. Wait until 2018.
title: Château Maison Noble Saint Martin 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine is smoky and toasty. It is extracted with bitter coffee flavors that dominate the fruit. Too much burnt wood will leave little room for fruitiness.
title: Château Fleur Haut Gaussens 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Firm with tannins, this is a dry wine that will probably remain that way. Dark coffee flavors hint at the hard extraction while there is little sign of fruit.
title: Château Nénine 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is soft, full in the mouth while not having much focus.
title: Château de Sours 2014 La Source  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Pale in color, this blend of every possible Provençal grape variety (including some whites) is classic, easygoing Provence rosé. It has wild raspberry fruit and crisp acidity. A tangy, tight mineral texture adds to its refreshing nature.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine Vallon des Cigales Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pale in color, this blend of every possible Provençal grape variety (including some whites) is classic, easygoing Provence rosé. It has wild raspberry fruit and crisp acidity. A tangy, tight mineral texture adds to its refreshing nature.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine Vallon des Cigales Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There's a rich character to this blend of 50% Grenache, 40% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre. It offers heady aromas of black cherry, boysenberry and raspberry that are laced with hints of vanilla, pepper and pencil shavings. It's well balanced and approachable, with a pleasant licorice kick to the finish.
title: Maison de la Villette 2014 Grenache-Syrah-Mourvèdre Red (Vin de France)

description: This classic, fresh wine has citrus flavors and a light herbal touch. It is fruity, with a light tannic edge that adds to the attractiveness of the wine.
title: Domaine Sainte Lucie 2015 MiP Made in Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This classic, fresh wine has citrus flavors and a light herbal touch. It is fruity, with a light tannic edge that adds to the attractiveness of the wine.
title: Domaine Sainte Lucie 2015 MiP Made in Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This lively, bouncing wine comes straight at you with its fruit and light, easy texture. Juicy red currant and pineapple flavors give it a clean, clear character. It's a fine apéritif style.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2015 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With an extra year's age, this wine is rounded, full in the mouth and rich. It has plenty of the classic Muscadet acidity and mineral texture, although both are now well integrated into the apple and pear flavors. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Julien Braud 2012 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: With an extra year's age, this wine is rounded, full in the mouth and rich. It has plenty of the classic Muscadet acidity and mineral texture, although both are now well integrated into the apple and pear flavors. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Julien Braud 2012 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This soft wine has fresh acidity that lifts the peppered pear flavors. It's ready to drink, very fruity while keeping its mineral and chalky texture. The aftertaste is ripe and also fresh.
title: Alexandre Monmousseau NV Vigneau Brut  (Vouvray)

description: This is a beautiful, ripe wine, flavored with quince, pear and apricots. It is above all the zesty texture that gives this wine its character and attraction. Fruity, structured and likely to age well, the wine should be drunk from 2015.
title: Domaine Daniel Dugois 2012 Chardonnay (Arbois)

description: With attractive, juicy fruit, this wine has as much freshness as it does structure. The palate is warm and open with blackberry fruits that are rounded and soft. Spice and some tannins show through on the finish. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Talbot 2011  Saint-Julien

description: This rounded, full wine is densely packed with fruit, but also tannins that add balance. Blackberry flavors come through the dry structure to give both richness and freshness. The aftertaste is ripe, juicy and delicious. Drink now, but best from 2015.
title: Château le Doyenne 2011  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: At this stage, the wine is showing way too much wood aging. It is toasty and spicy with the fruit obscured beneath. It should integrate in a few years, although the wood is always likely to be prominent. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lascombes 2011  Margaux

description: At this stage, the wine is showing way too much wood aging. It is toasty and spicy with the fruit obscured beneath. It should integrate in a few years, although the wood is always likely to be prominent. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lascombes 2011  Margaux

description: This is a powerfully woody wine that shows more wood than fruit at this stage. Structured, austere and powerful, it needs time to flesh out. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2011  Saint-Julien

description: This is a powerfully woody wine that shows more wood than fruit at this stage. Structured, austere and powerful, it needs time to flesh out. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Dense and textured, this is a powerful, complex wine. It's layered with honey and botrytis, and a concentrated fruitiness with flavors of apricots and creamed pears. There is a great sense of freshness on the finish.
title: Château de Myrat 2010  Barsac

description: While it is certainly rich, this wine has a drying core of botrytis that dominates at the moment. There's remarkable weight and concentration on the palate, but brisk lemon flavors add vibrancy and cut. It is obviously a wine to age, so don't drink before 2018.
title: Château de Malle 2010  Sauternes

description: Firmly structured, this is a significant improvement on 2007, with the wood kept in play but not dominant. That's because the fruit is so bright, with juicy berries bubbling along, leaving refreshing acidity at the end.
title: Mähler-Besse 2008 Château Cheval Noir  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Soft and ripe wine, with gentle tannins and fresh acidity. There is an edge of bitterness that comes between the fruit and the structure.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Vignes Franches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Soft and ripe wine, with gentle tannins and fresh acidity. There is an edge of bitterness that comes between the fruit and the structure.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Vignes Franches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Attractive wine, hinting at the elegance of Chambolle, packed with strawberry-fruit flavors and sweet tannins. There is some final firmness, the acidity mingling with a solid structure.
title: Louis Latour 2008  Chambolle-Musigny

description: A soft wine, its tannins firmly embedded in the sweet black fruit. This is classic young Bordeaux, tannic and dry, of course, but suffused with a fresh, berry fruit character, lightened by acidity.
title: Château Lestage Simon 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: A soft wine, its tannins firmly embedded in the sweet black fruit. This is classic young Bordeaux, tannic and dry, of course, but suffused with a fresh, berry fruit character, lightened by acidity.
title: Château Lestage Simon 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: Dark in color, with a series of herbal aromas, this is dense and rich, with fine layers of berry fruits and solid tannins. It has a definite fresh character, with juicy fruit and acidity playing against the dry texture.
title: Mähler-Besse 2008 Château la Couronne  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Dark in color, with a series of herbal aromas, this is dense and rich, with fine layers of berry fruits and solid tannins. It has a definite fresh character, with juicy fruit and acidity playing against the dry texture.
title: Mähler-Besse 2008 Château la Couronne  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The year 2009 seems to have been a tannic one in Fleurie, producing wines that will benefit from some aging. This fits that bill well, a mineral and austere black fruit flavored wine, with a smoky aftertaste to go with tight acidity.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 La Madone  (Fleurie)

description: Produced by the winemaking team of Château Giscours in Margaux, this is finely ripe blend of Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc. With rich tropical fruits and lime flavors, it is balanced and already delicious. Drink now.
title: Petite Sirène 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Produced by the winemaking team of Château Giscours in Margaux, this is finely ripe blend of Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc. With rich tropical fruits and lime flavors, it is balanced and already delicious. Drink now.
title: Petite Sirène 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Hints of superripe, yellow pear and candied pear make for an enticing nose. The palate is more diffuse but light and fresh. Drink soon while aromas are at their peak.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Trois Châteaux Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: Hints of superripe, yellow pear and candied pear make for an enticing nose. The palate is more diffuse but light and fresh. Drink soon while aromas are at their peak.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Trois Châteaux Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: This wine comes from the north of the Gascony region in Southwest France. It has some herbal character as well as a delicious cool feel. Riper fruit flavors such as peach and pineapple give a warmer, soft aftertaste.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2014 La Réserve Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This refreshing wine has lively acidity followed by red fruits and a soft texture. It is a round wine, hinting at sweetness because of the ripeness.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2015 Domaine Valfont Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Capitalizing on the fashion for Malbec, this wine is closer to Argentina than Cahors. It has soft tannins and a ripe and juicy flavor of red-berry fruits. Acidity and a soft aftertaste reinforce this New World feel.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Malbec (Vin de France)

description: Ripe peach and nectarine aromas and flavors are at the forefront of this friendly, approachable Moscato, with touches of melon, pear and sweet orange to round it out. The palate is bright and balanced, with solid stone-fruit and pear flavors that finish fresh and easy.
title: Le Pépin 2015 Moscato (Vin de France)

description: Ripe peach and nectarine aromas and flavors are at the forefront of this friendly, approachable Moscato, with touches of melon, pear and sweet orange to round it out. The palate is bright and balanced, with solid stone-fruit and pear flavors that finish fresh and easy.
title: Le Pépin 2015 Moscato (Vin de France)

description: This is a gentle and easy-going Chardonnay. It is soft, lightly buttery and conveys apricot and ripe pear flavors. The aftertaste just touches on acidity.
title: Café du Midi 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: There is only the faintest of aromas on this soft, lightly juicy wine. It is a warm-climate wine, rounded, soft and gentle. The freshness comes at the end, bright and with a citrus touch.
title: Bougrier 2015 Alain de la Treille Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: There is only the faintest of aromas on this soft, lightly juicy wine. It is a warm-climate wine, rounded, soft and gentle. The freshness comes at the end, bright and with a citrus touch.
title: Bougrier 2015 Alain de la Treille Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine is light and perfumed, with crisp red currants and a tangy orange-zest texture. It dances from the glass, refreshing and poised to finish.
title: François Lurton 2015 Les Fumées Blanches Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This organically grown wine celebrates lavender, used for perfumes and other famous products from Provence. Soft and gently fruity with attractive strawberry flavors plus a touch of spice, the wine is immediately drinkable as an apéritif.
title: Domaines Pierre Chavin 2015 Lavandelle Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With its tannins, this is initially a firm wine, but then ripe berry fruits emerge, followed by great acidity and freshness.
title: Louis Latour 2009  Aloxe-Corton

description: Light and fruity, with cherry notes and touches of clay-like earthiness. Simple and clean, and priced accordingly.
title: Clerget 2007 Pont du Rhône Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Less successful than some previous bottlings under this label, the 2008 seems earthier and less fruit-forward, with coffee and tree bark notes dominating this medium-bodied wine. The blend is 55% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 15% Mourvèdre.
title: Vignobles Boudinaud 2008 Côté Jardin Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Made solely from old-vine Carignan, this wine does stand out as being unique among a flight of Costières de Nîme wines. It's slightly pruny, marked by dried fruit, leather and clove, turning a touch metallic on the finish.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2008 Qu'es Aquo Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: On the lighter side of the Côtes du Rhône spectrum, with a slightly briary note to the cherry fruit. Turns more olivaceous on the silky-textured finish. Drink now.
title: Michel Picard 2007 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This is a relatively lightweight Costières de Nîmes, despite being 100% Syrah. Modest cherry and black pepper notes are pretty enough, just lack intensity and fade a bit quickly on the finish.
title: Château de la Tuilerie 2008 Syrah (Costières de Nîmes)

description: An intensely black-colored wine, with dark, smoky tannins to match. It does have a juicy, ripe sweet berry fruit element, laying under the surface tannins. With this power, it needs several years to develop.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2008 Château de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: Tasted from a half bottle, the rich and complex flavors of Brut La Française show just that extra touch of maturity. The wine has peach and almond flavors that contrast well with the taut, nervy edge. It's full in the mouth and ripe, and works well both as an apéritif and a food Champagne.
title: Taittinger NV La Française Brut  (Champagne)

description: Lovely notes of crisp apples make for a very friendly nose. The palate comes in with immense freshness that is nonetheless tempered by a balm-like rounded texture that couches Riesling's freshness in seamless fluidity. The palate remains dry and is colored with red and green apple, lemon and tangerine. The finish is dry and wonderfully lip smacking.
title: Paul Blanck 2012 Wineck-Schlossberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The lift of heady aroma precedes the pear-fruited and herbal tisane-scented nose. The palate is gentle and has that same herbal softness. The fruit is rich with residual sweetness and characterized as ripe pear. This is balanced by zesty, pleasantly bitter citrus. The effect is of harmonious, gentle and generous balance. This mature Pinot Gris is now perfectly à point. Its flavors linger long and pleasantly.
title: Dopff & Irion 2009 Vorbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: There almost is the slightest touch of lovely Poire William spirit on the nose. This is a lovely pear-scented, dry wine of immense fruitfulness. A homely earthiness counteracts this and makes for a concentrated, medium-dry but mellow palate. The finish is off dry, lasting and mouthfilling. There is something immensely satisfying about this.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2012 Spiegel Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A breezy zingy nose of lemon makes for a very refreshing proposition. The palate does not disappoint and continues in the same tart-but-ripe citrus fashion. The sharp freshness on the dry palate makes the citrus notes shine even more. This is utterly refreshing and totally moreish.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2015 Zinnkoepfle Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: A breezy zingy nose of lemon makes for a very refreshing proposition. The palate does not disappoint and continues in the same tart-but-ripe citrus fashion. The sharp freshness on the dry palate makes the citrus notes shine even more. This is utterly refreshing and totally moreish.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2015 Zinnkoepfle Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: Showing beautifully, with intense lemon and lime fruit and a luxurious texture. The chalky, minerally palate is saved from austerity by a touch of sweetness. A very nice package.
title: Domaine Seilly 2006 Veilles Vignes Schenkenberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: The multi-dimensional, hedonistic nose of honey and exotic spices promises big things to come. The palate could have a bit more complexity but overall we have few complaints. A crisp finish keeps the slight residual sugar from seeming cloying.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2006 Im Berg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Complexing notes of botrytis are interspersed with an unusual pine aroma. The palate is bit simple but gives way to a very long finish with focused flavors of petrol and lemon.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2004 Altenberg de Bergheim Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Honey, lemon and spice open this slightly blowsy Pinot Gris. The unctuous palate shows intense notes of orange peel and clove. Slightly astringent finish.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2004 Spiegel Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Honey, lemon and spice open this slightly blowsy Pinot Gris. The unctuous palate shows intense notes of orange peel and clove. Slightly astringent finish.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2004 Spiegel Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Bready aromas from sur-lie aging are layered with notes of summer desserts—strawberry-rhubarb crumble, peach compote and lemon-meringue pie. A slight sweetness adds to the hedonistic impression. The lingering finish is hunger-inspiring.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2006 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Delicious freshness here, with crisp fruits, citrus and apple and a touch of caramel. Very fresh, great acidity, hints of mineral and flint.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008 Domaine Drouhin-Vaudon Réserve de Vaudon  (Chablis)

description: A wine that seems designed for some aging, with youthful green fruits, a vibrant texture of apple juice and good depth of flavor.
title: Nicolas Maillet 2008  Mâcon-Villages

description: Rich and round, the wine boasts ripe toast and creamy pear and peach fruit. The lemon touches give point to this full wine, adding attractive freshness.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2008 Les Trois Pêcheurs  (Saint-Véran)

description: Beautifully textured wine, very creamy, the toast and butter from wood smoothing out the tight fruit texture. A fine, polished wine.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2008 Le Bouchon  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Tangy and mineral, this is a crisp apple- and citrus-driven wine, full of fruitiness while also having a tight texture. Its acidity just adds to the generally ripe character of the wine. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Réserve Personnelle  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: From its privileged position right next to the grand cru of La Tâche, Aux Malconsorts has produced a heady, perfumed wine, relatively delicate, relying on its succulent red fruits to give body. It is on the sweet side of Pinot Noir, jammy with red berry flavors, and already delicious.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006 Aux Malconsorts Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Smoky, delicious, ripe fruit dominates this luscious wine. It sings of rich strawberries, given structure with minerality and sweet tannins. Immediately appealing, the structure does promise some aging.
title: Maison Champy 2006 Taillepieds Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: A lively, fresh wine that gives joy, with its delicious sweet red fruits. It fills the mouth with freshness, as well as showing some tense tannins. The aftertaste continues this vibrant theme, with sweet acidity and ripe fruit.
title: Maison Champy 2006 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This shows the proper attention to structure that is the inheritance of any Nuits-Saint-Georges. But around that structure, Gilles Jayer builds a velvet curtain of ripe black fruits, touched with spice and leavened with acidity. It's a wine that is delicious now, but certainly should be aged.
title: Domaine Jayer-Gilles 2006 Les Hauts Poirets  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: From parcels in the southern portion of Clos Vougeot, Bichot produces a ripe, relatively soft style of wine. It is, of course, also rich and powerful, but the tannins are sweet, subdued into ripe red plum and raspberry fruits, the acidity giving the wine a fresh, lively character to finish.
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Clos Frantin  (Clos de Vougeot)

description: From parcels in the southern portion of Clos Vougeot, Bichot produces a ripe, relatively soft style of wine. It is, of course, also rich and powerful, but the tannins are sweet, subdued into ripe red plum and raspberry fruits, the acidity giving the wine a fresh, lively character to finish.
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Clos Frantin  (Clos de Vougeot)

description: A finely perfumed wine, but one with a tight initial structure. Ripe wild strawberries and mulberries appear with dry tannins and spice from wood. The finish underlines that this is a wine for aging, with its structure and firmness. Keep for 4–5 years.
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Clos des Maréchaudes  (Corton)

description: In its early stages of evolution, this wine offers mainly stoniness, firm acidity and a hard- edged structure. Of course it will soften, but this will likely remain a tannic wine, the fruit always edged with acidity, for many years. It is potentially a great wine that just needs patience.
title: Maison Champy 2006  Corton

description: In its early stages of evolution, this wine offers mainly stoniness, firm acidity and a hard- edged structure. Of course it will soften, but this will likely remain a tannic wine, the fruit always edged with acidity, for many years. It is potentially a great wine that just needs patience.
title: Maison Champy 2006  Corton

description: Dense, concentrated, solid, this wine shows the stern side of Nuits-Saint-Georges. The tannins are dry, very firm and rough at the edges. The fruit is just as edgy, with black, juicy plums surrounded by smoky wood and tobacco. The wine needs to age, although it will always have a solid, structured character.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Les Boudots Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Firm and tense, this is a wine on the high wire. The tannins are stretched with acidity, the berry fruits and red cherry flavors vividly standing out against this structure. The aftertaste is fine, poised, mineral. This is developing into an important wine.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006 Marconnets Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Rich fruit, layered with acidity, stars in a wine that is dense, very much a product of the powerful 2005 vintage. With the concentrated tannins, this is showing that it needs to age, but already the sweet fruits are opulent and soft.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: This dark, extracted wine is firm in character. It has bitter coffee and licorice flavors, which rather elbow aside the fruit.
title: Château Croix de Gentis 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This dark, extracted wine is firm in character. It has bitter coffee and licorice flavors, which rather elbow aside the fruit.
title: Château Croix de Gentis 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has ripe black fruits, fresh acidity and black-plum flavors. It is rich while still showing plenty of bright fruity acidity. With a light sense of structure, the wine is more about fresh fruits that are also jammy. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: This wine has all the right elements with structure, tannins and ripe berry fruits. It's full of blackberry and plum flavors that are underlined with a firm structure and layers of toast. Drink from 2019. Third-generation owner Jean-Pierre Leymarie was born on the estate. It has grown from five acres in 1983 to 45 acres.
title: Château Lafargue 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is the second wine from Premier Grand Cru Classé estate La Gaffelière, made from a selection of vines and barrels. It is rich and very ripe with bold black-fruit flavors and a dark, firm structure. The wine is already in balance, showing that it will develop quickly and attractively. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2013 Clos la Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: One of several châteaux in Saint-Estèphe that come from the plateau of Pez, this is a lightly structured wine, with already-forward black currant fruitiness and acidity. It's developing quickly and will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château de Pez 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: With great freshness, this is an attractive, fruity wine with final ripe berry flavors that are delicately leavened and given weight by tannins. There is already a drinkable balance from the fruit, although the wine needs more time to be in harmony. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2013  Pauillac

description: This is a ripe wine, with attractive red-berry flavors and acidity. It has a good sense of structure, solid with balanced tannins and ample acidity. The wine is developing well and should be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a ripe wine, with attractive red-berry flavors and acidity. It has a good sense of structure, solid with balanced tannins and ample acidity. The wine is developing well and should be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Almost entirely Merlot, this is a rich and fruity wine. Dusty tannins hang in suspension alongside the ripe blackberry fruits. The wine is juicy, fresh with acidity and likely to develop quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Cheval Blanc 2013 Le Petit Cheval  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Consultant Denis Dubourdieu has made the most of the difficult vintage, bringing out the fruit and ripe black-currant flavors. This balanced wine will develop attractively and quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Batailley 2013  Pauillac

description: An attractive pale-salmon color, this 100% Cinsault rosé opens with soft scents of strawberry, pear, melon rind and earthy spice. The palate is lush, with fleshy fruit flavors that are balanced by ample acidity and a soft tannic astringency on the close.
title: Mont Gravet 2015 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft notes of apple compote perfume the nose. The palate has the same soft but distinct freshness of ripe, juicy apple. The friendly aromas could do with more definition on the palate, but this is a simple, clean wine.
title: Vieil Armand 2014 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A fine, slightly mineral wine, packed with tight tannins, but also with the rich fruits of the vintage. It is well balanced, the acidity sitting easily with the sweet, jammy fruit flavors. Dryness and some austerity mark this wine as a fine partner for food.
title: Christian Moueix 2005  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A firm, rather lean, stalky wine, dominated by black currant flavors. The tannins are dry, dense. This will show best with food, its firmness and tannic character cutting well with rich meat.
title: Bernard Magrez 2004 Château Tour Blanche  (Médoc)

description: Big, powerful, dominated by dark tannins and dense fruit. The alcohol is apparent in the burnt rubber edge, although the richness of the fruit, with its bitter chocolate edge, does help to mask it. The acidity at the end gives freshness.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2005 Héritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Big, powerful, dominated by dark tannins and dense fruit. The alcohol is apparent in the burnt rubber edge, although the richness of the fruit, with its bitter chocolate edge, does help to mask it. The acidity at the end gives freshness.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2005 Héritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Mint and toast aromas suggest—and the palate confirms—that this is all about new wood, polished black plum fruits and dense, dusty tannins. A New World style of wine, the finish is dominated by cinnamon and wood tannins.
title: Château Fougas 2005 Maldoror  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: With its appealing toast and fruit aromas, this is a rich wine. It does keep plenty of steely texture while allowing the yellow fruits, ripe pear and toast to shine. In style it hovers halfway between the ripe, buttery Meursault of the past and the crisper style of today, a fine compromise and ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013  Meursault

description: With its appealing toast and fruit aromas, this is a rich wine. It does keep plenty of steely texture while allowing the yellow fruits, ripe pear and toast to shine. In style it hovers halfway between the ripe, buttery Meursault of the past and the crisper style of today, a fine compromise and ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013  Meursault

description: A full-bodied wine, structured and textured. It lacks acidity and crispness,  instead giving honey and ripe yellow fruits. It is so rich, there are hints even of late harvest grapes here. The finish is spoiled by pepper.
title: Audrey et Christine Binner 2004 Schlossberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a full-bodied, rich rosé from the walled Clos des Muraires, ripe with red berry fruits and the warm sunshine. Fruity and with a mineral texture, it can age until mid-2015, although it is delicious now.
title: Bernard Magrez 2013 Château des Muraires Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: On the rich side, this is a ripe and fruity wine. Its mineral texture is comfortably cushioned within an aromatic white fruit character that adds juicy acidity to the mix. It's a delicious wine that could age a few months more.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2012 Domaine Saint-Rémy Herrenweg Riesling (Alsace)

description: On the rich side, this is a ripe and fruity wine. Its mineral texture is comfortably cushioned within an aromatic white fruit character that adds juicy acidity to the mix. It's a delicious wine that could age a few months more.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2012 Domaine Saint-Rémy Herrenweg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Named after the patron saint of wine producers, this wine is properly balanced, structured and dense. It is not a wine for long aging with its soft tannins and juicy black-fruit acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos Saint-Vincent 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Named after the patron saint of wine producers, this wine is properly balanced, structured and dense. It is not a wine for long aging with its soft tannins and juicy black-fruit acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos Saint-Vincent 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: It's a shame so much high-toast wood was used in aging this wine. Under those flavors of smoky wood, some black fruit wants to come out. The wine does have the weight, and it will be worth waiting until 2018 before drinking.
title: Château Tour Saint Vincent 2013  Médoc

description: While this wine has plenty of tannins, the generous blackberry fruits dominate. It is balanced with a fresh character that brings out just the right amount of acidity. The dry core will allow the wine to develop. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Tour des Termes 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: While this wine has plenty of tannins, the generous blackberry fruits dominate. It is balanced with a fresh character that brings out just the right amount of acidity. The dry core will allow the wine to develop. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Tour des Termes 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: This ripe, rich and Merlot-dominated wine comes from the western section of Lalande de Pomerol. Juicy black-fruit flavors are lifted by acidity and given structure by the firm wood-aging texture. The wood needs to integrate with the fruit, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Sergant 2013  Lalande de Pomerol

description: This fruity, black-currant-flavored wine comes from a blend of Merlot and Cabernets Sauvignon and Franc. A strong, smoky tannin character lies under the fruit and makes the wine both structured and fresh, with blackberry acidity at the end. This promises some aging; drink from 2017. An Alliance Bourg member.
title: Château Saint-Urban 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This fruity, black-currant-flavored wine comes from a blend of Merlot and Cabernets Sauvignon and Franc. A strong, smoky tannin character lies under the fruit and makes the wine both structured and fresh, with blackberry acidity at the end. This promises some aging; drink from 2017. An Alliance Bourg member.
title: Château Saint-Urban 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Half and half Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine has ripe berry fruits that are layered with firm tannins. The structure shows the toast from wood-aging, which does not detract from the fruitiness that is developing. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Ramafort 2013  Médoc

description: This wine is ripe with dense blackberry fruits and some firm, dry smoky tannins. It has the fruitiness and acidity typical of the vintage, along with some depth of flavor and a smooth aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Patache d'Aux 2013  Médoc

description: Well made and balanced, this wine is full of red-currant and berry fruits plus layers of tannins. Structured and with a smoky character, it is fresh, fruity and will develop quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Moulin de Canhaut 2013  Médoc

description: Well made and balanced, this wine is full of red-currant and berry fruits plus layers of tannins. Structured and with a smoky character, it is fresh, fruity and will develop quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Moulin de Canhaut 2013  Médoc

description: One of the properties owned by the Fontana family, this estate has produced a firm, tannic wine with flavors of ripe black fruits, spice and dark chocolate. It is still young and showing its stalky, fruity side. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château le Breton 2014 Grande Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: One of the properties owned by the Fontana family, this estate has produced a firm, tannic wine with flavors of ripe black fruits, spice and dark chocolate. It is still young and showing its stalky, fruity side. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château le Breton 2014 Grande Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine has structure, with firm tannins and black-currant fruit. That contrasts with a stalky, almost rustic character that gives dry, rough edges to the wine. Drink from 2018,
title: Château Ducluzeau 2013  Listrac-Médoc

description: Brightly colored, this wine is full both of fruit and smoky tannins. It is structured now, firm with its dry core. Around it, fresh blackberry and red-berry fruits are beginning to show well. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Château du Cartillon 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This is still a young wine, with its youthful structure of dark, stalky tannins still in place. It offers juicy black-currant flavors as well as fresh acidity and a dry aftertaste. The wine comes from a vineyard named after the 17th-century French philosopher Montesquieu. Drink from 2017.
title: Château des Fougères 2012 Clos Montesquieu  (Graves)

description: Just like this wine has lost its initial red color, so too has its flavor changed. Now maturing fast, it conveys flavors of leather and acidity along with a dry edge that may be a sign of age. It's delicious, but drink the wine now.
title: Château des Annereaux 2008  Lalande de Pomerol

description: Just like this wine has lost its initial red color, so too has its flavor changed. Now maturing fast, it conveys flavors of leather and acidity along with a dry edge that may be a sign of age. It's delicious, but drink the wine now.
title: Château des Annereaux 2008  Lalande de Pomerol

description: Quince, toast and ripe apricots combine easily in this full, rich wine. It has attractive spice, juicy apricot juice and a rounded, textured aftertaste conveying nutmeg as well as fresh acidity. Laurent and Sophie Cisneros bought Rouillac with a focus: eliminate chemical pesticides and herbicides. They built a barrel cellar to environmental European standards. Eric Boissenot consults.
title: Château de Rouillac 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Quince, toast and ripe apricots combine easily in this full, rich wine. It has attractive spice, juicy apricot juice and a rounded, textured aftertaste conveying nutmeg as well as fresh acidity. Laurent and Sophie Cisneros bought Rouillac with a focus: eliminate chemical pesticides and herbicides. They built a barrel cellar to environmental European standards. Eric Boissenot consults.
title: Château de Rouillac 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine is all about herbaceous fruitiness. Made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc, it offers gooseberry, grapefruit and other crisp citrus flavors along with a tight, tangy texture. Fresh, crisp and fruity, it is ready to drink.
title: Prince de Tabourg 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Made from 30-year-old vines, this dense wine has considerable acidity that gives a fresh edge along with spice and a juicy black-currant character. It will age quickly, so drink from 2017.
title: Les Hauts de Tousquiron 2013 Cuvée Lucie  (Médoc)

description: This structured wine is bold with its tannins and dry cherry-pit flavor. It is dense, its stalky acidity and red-plum flavors backed by a dry core. It's a concentrated wine that needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Vignoble de la Jarnoterie 2013 Quintessence  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: This structured wine is bold with its tannins and dry cherry-pit flavor. It is dense, its stalky acidity and red-plum flavors backed by a dry core. It's a concentrated wine that needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Vignoble de la Jarnoterie 2013 Quintessence  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: Just a hint of spritz gives this wine lift and brings out the ripe apple and quince flavors. This single-vineyard wine is full of freshness, a ripe slice of minerality and a spicy, peppery aftertaste. Drink now.
designation: Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2013 Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The partly volcanic nature of amphibolite soil gives this wine a natural ripe fruitiness. Apple skin and fresh Rocha pears convey a fruit-forward character, bright and crisp. It's a young wine, although it can be drunk now for its exuberant outward-looking character.
title: Domaines Landron 2013 Amphibolite Nature  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The partly volcanic nature of amphibolite soil gives this wine a natural ripe fruitiness. Apple skin and fresh Rocha pears convey a fruit-forward character, bright and crisp. It's a young wine, although it can be drunk now for its exuberant outward-looking character.
title: Domaines Landron 2013 Amphibolite Nature  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a rich wine, intensely full of yellow fruits and soft, generous acidity. The wine has honey, apricots and ripe fruitiness. Delicious and approachable, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaines Landron 2012 Le Fief du Breil  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This ripe and full wine is balanced and textured. A mineral background gives a crisp character to the ripe yellow and pear fruit flavors. With long aging on lees, the wine has weight and richness. It should be aged further and drunk from 2016.
title: Château Moncontour 2013 Cuvée Prédilection Brut  (Vouvray)

description: Dominated by intensely herbaceous Colombard, this is a light, fresh and aromatic wine. Acidity combines with a fruit drop character that suggests some sweetness in the blend. Screwcap.
title: Domaine de Maubet 2012 Blanc Sec White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A very fruity, red berry flavored wine. It has a slight tannic structure giving shape to this simple, accessible rosé.
title: Dopff & Irion 2012 Rosé (Alsace)

description: A blend of Malbec and Merlot, this is a rich, fruity wine. It has a tannic firmness and a stalky black currant juiciness, along with intense acidity. There is a rough, rustic aftertaste that spoils the general fruitiness.
title: Domaine les Hauts de Riquets 2012 Diablerie Red (Côtes de Duras)

description: A blend of Malbec and Merlot, this is a rich, fruity wine. It has a tannic firmness and a stalky black currant juiciness, along with intense acidity. There is a rough, rustic aftertaste that spoils the general fruitiness.
title: Domaine les Hauts de Riquets 2012 Diablerie Red (Côtes de Duras)

description: This is a wine that seems to veer between sweetness and dryness. It has spice and a dry, peppery edge, as well as an underlying character that's marked by rich, sweet, honeyed fruit. At this stage, it should be showing more balance.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2009 Kaefferkopf Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is fresh and fruity, with hints of spice and pear, plus an attractive layer of crisp acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Jean Becker 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is fresh and fruity, with hints of spice and pear, plus an attractive layer of crisp acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Jean Becker 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Soft and rounded, this has stewed pear and red apple flavors that give it an attractive, fruity feel. The acidity brings out a bright, crisp finish.
title: Jean Becker 2010 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: The name of this wine playfully refers to the fact that storks still nest in the chimneys of Alsace. It is rich, full, soft, with notes of pepper and dried apricot, plus ample sweetness. The acidity helps to cut the richness, making it food friendly.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2009 Special Delivery Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: One of the top Vouvray sparkling wines, this 2012 is still young. That gives it almond, quince and pear flavors along with intense bright acidity. It is still missing the richer, toasty character that will come with age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Moncontour 2012 Cuvée Prédilection Brut  (Vouvray)

description: The heady and concentrated bouquet of this wine leads with forward scents of blackberry liquor, black plum, bramble, cocoa nib and crushed violet. Medium weight and creamy on the palate, the texture is like crushed velvet and the flavors recall black-fruit preserves, mulled blackberries, black tea and licorice root. Drink now–2018.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2010 Le Viala Red (Minervois La Liviniere)

description: This wine, named after a swarm of bees, comes from a small region in the center of the larger Côtes de Provence. From high-altitude vineyards in a state park, it is cool while keeping plenty of richness. The acidity and the red-currant fruits dominate this attractive, ready-to-drink wine.
title: Château Thuerry 2016 Les Abeillons Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: From one of the old Provence estates, this is a concentrated herbal wine. It has plenty of spice as well as full red fruits and balanced acidity. This is a fine wine, packed with taste. Drink now.
title: Château Saint-Maur 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Owned by Champagne producer Bruno Paillard, this wine is as crisp as a rosé Champagne. It is light and fruity with just a touch of mineral texture. The red-berry flavors lift and enhance the concentration of this attractive wine. Drink now.
title: Château des Sarrins 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The golden color suggests evolution and the nose does not disappoint, presenting lifted notes of petrol, saffron, candied lemon and mandarin. Rich sweetness on the palate pairs with 2010's laser-sharp acidity, becoming more honeyed with each moment. This acidity still rings with greengage and lime freshness, providing lift. In the middle of its evolution, the wine is developed but still has potential. Drink now–2026.
title: Domaine Bernhard & Reibel 2010 Vendanges Tardives Riesling (Alsace)

description: Both the golden color and the advanced nose signal a mature wine.
