description: Intense and concentrated, this shows dense tannins and layers of red- and black-fruit flavors, with the acidity cutting through. It's likely to age well over 4–5 years.
title: Manuel Olivier 2009  Aloxe-Corton

description: Rounded and sweet, this is a rich Gewurztraminer that's full of spice and textured with coconut. It is full in the mouth—a wine for rich sauces and pâtés.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2009 Les Princes Abbés Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Full and round, this is a rich wine, with a fine, tangy texture. There is a core of lime and other citrus flavors, with tight acidity. Age this for several more months before drinking.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2010 Les Comtes de Ribeauvillé Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is mouthfilling but not overly weighty, with a wonderful blend of herbs and spices rounded out by cherries and plums. Intense garrigue notes pick up hints of anise on the long, softly dusty finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Fontaine du Clos 2014 Confidences Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This is a tight, textured and fruity wine. With a great mineral texture and steely structure, it is a wine for some aging. Lemon and pink grapefruit flavors sheer through the texture, still waiting to balance. From 2017 it will be a fine wine.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul Balland 2014  Sancerre

description: This may not be as potent or complex as Colombier's Cuvée Gaby, but it comes close, which makes it an excellent value. Meaty, savory notes are ideally suited for accompanying autumn game or winter stews, yet the tannins are supple, making it approachable already.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2013  Crozes-Hermitage

description: Grilled yellow plum and anise aromas set the stage for this blend of 47% Roussanne, 40% Grenache Blanc and 13% Clairette. It's full and plump on the palate, with smoky notes that accent the plum and melon flavors on the lengthy finish.
title: Domaine de Nalys 2012 Eicelènci White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This huge, rich wine has weight and density. What make it still recognizably Bordeaux are the black currant fruits, acidity and the stylish tannins. Everything else is larger than life, with power and concentration. Drink from 2018. Owners Mallet Frères use parcel selection for this 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon blend.
title: Château Haut-Macô 2010 Cuvée Jean Bernard  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: A ripe and honeyed wine, this is dry and with acidity along with fresh fruitiness. It's crisply textured, refreshingly perfumed and with delicious, pure apple flavors and acidity. It's a wine to drink now, although better to age until 2017.
title: Château de Brézé 2013 Clos du Midi  (Saumur)

description: A ripe and honeyed wine, this is dry and with acidity along with fresh fruitiness. It's crisply textured, refreshingly perfumed and with delicious, pure apple flavors and acidity. It's a wine to drink now, although better to age until 2017.
title: Château de Brézé 2013 Clos du Midi  (Saumur)

description: This is a smooth and apple-fruited wine, with acidity that's tempered by a soft texture and a touch of toast. It's balanced, lightly crisp and ready to drink.
title: Nicolas Potel 2010  Mâcon-Villages

description: This is initially round and ripe, with a hint of vanilla, before showing a more structured, steely side. It shows fine balance between its intense texture and fruitiness, promising 2–3 years of aging.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 La Pierrelée  (Chablis)

description: Rich and soft, this is full of pear and quince flavors that pack a punch of acidity. The fruitiness is offset by a yeasty character that adds notes of almond and spice.
title: William Fèvre 2010  Chablis

description: This is ripe and finely balanced, with its wood-aging character showing well with the yellow fruit flavor. It has weight and a fine sheen of brightness, while the finish shows a crisper side.
title: Bzikot Père et Fils 2010  Bourgogne

description: This demonstrates a fine balance between the crisp white and peach fruits and the nervy texture that keeps this feeling taut and sharp. Beneath the fruity surface there is structure and a mineral character. Age for another 2–3 years.
title: Domaine L. Chatelain 2010 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Close to the village of Aloxe-Corton, this vineyard is one of the smallest of the Corton grand crus. This wine, still fresh while also closed up with tannins, is dark, structured and has the potential to age many years. Intense red-berry acidity and a tight, dry core still convey youthfulness. Drink this impressive wine from 2022.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2013 Clos des Fietres  (Corton)

description: In hommage to the man who pioneered the use of oak to ferment Sauvignon Blanc, this wood-fermented and matured wine is only produced in the best years. It is rich and just toasty, but equally about the structured mineral texture and ripe citrus. It is a wine to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2013 Etienne Henri  (Sancerre)

description: Dried spices, cracked pepper and roasted meat notes scream of Syrah and the Northern Rhône. It's medium to full in body, but with fine tannins and bright acidity, making it remarkably easy to drink. Approachable now, it should still be drinking well through 2030.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2011 Terres Brulées  (Cornas)

description: Dried spices, cracked pepper and roasted meat notes scream of Syrah and the Northern Rhône. It's medium to full in body, but with fine tannins and bright acidity, making it remarkably easy to drink. Approachable now, it should still be drinking well through 2030.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2011 Terres Brulées  (Cornas)

description: Grown on two parcels of 60- and 80-year-old vines, this is a dense, impressively concentrated wine. It has rich white fruits cut with citrus, as well as a firmer, more mineral character that sets the wine on the road to aging. This structured wine will be best from 2019.
title: Michel Vattan 2014 Les L-O  (Sancerre)

description: This wine is young, surprisingly fruity at this stage for this normally textured, structured Grand Cru. A pure line of sliced apple and green-plum flavors are shot through with tangy acidity. The fruitiness and intense acidity will pass soon and the wine will develop the proper steely, tight and mineral character. It will drink at its best from 2020.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2014 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This wine is young, surprisingly fruity at this stage for this normally textured, structured Grand Cru. A pure line of sliced apple and green-plum flavors are shot through with tangy acidity. The fruitiness and intense acidity will pass soon and the wine will develop the proper steely, tight and mineral character. It will drink at its best from 2020.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2014 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This lightly fruity wine hints at strawberry fruits laced with soft acidity. There is a bitterness in the background that is not pleasant.
title: Charles de Fère NV Réserve Rosé Dry Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This ripe wine offers swathes of red fruits and soft tannins. The structure is well embedded in the juicy red-cherry flavors that are further lifted by acidity. It's an attractive, smooth wine that will be ready from 2017.
designation: Domaine Adélie Le Champs-Martin Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine Adélie Le Champs-Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Named after a pioneer of wood-aged Sauvignon Blanc, this wine has toast as well as rounded fruit. The subtle wood focuses on enriching the fruit and bringing out its steel and citrus character. The wine can certainly age, drink until 2020.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Etienne Henri  (Sancerre)

description: Named after a pioneer of wood-aged Sauvignon Blanc, this wine has toast as well as rounded fruit. The subtle wood focuses on enriching the fruit and bringing out its steel and citrus character. The wine can certainly age, drink until 2020.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Etienne Henri  (Sancerre)

description: Fruity and fragrant, this rich and complex wine also has a strong sense of acidity. Putting it all together, the wine has weight, aging potential and a fine, zesty, tight texture. It needs to age, so drink this fascinating wine from 2016.
title: Domaine Labet 2011 Fleurs Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: Château la Varière produces powerful reds, and this concentrated blend is no exception. It has some licorice flavors, intense black currant acidity and a touch of smokiness from the wood aging. It is a wine to age for several years; don't drink before 2016.
title: Château la Varière 2011 La Grande Chevalerie Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: Fitou, a small region entirely surrounded by Corbières, is very dry in the summer. In 2004, when little rain fell, the grapes became extra concentrated, as shown here. There's a powerful burst of fruit, with black cherries, coffee and plenty of spice from the 50% Syrah. Only to finish are the tannins at all apparent.
title: J. & F. Lurton 2004 Château des Erles Red (Fitou)

description: Intense aromas of cassis, black plum, licorice and espresso grinds fill the bouquet of this 65%   Merlot, 35% Cabernet Sauvignon blend. Firm and tight in the mouth with prominent tannins and assertive dark fruit flavors. A touch of soft spice unfolds on the end.
region: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: O'Vineyards 2007 Trah Lah Lah Merlot-Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: Intense aromas of cassis, black plum, licorice and espresso grinds fill the bouquet of this 65%   Merlot, 35% Cabernet Sauvignon blend. Firm and tight in the mouth with prominent tannins and assertive dark fruit flavors. A touch of soft spice unfolds on the end.
region: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: O'Vineyards 2007 Trah Lah Lah Merlot-Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: Faury has crafted a wonderfully quaffable Old World Syrah in '05, with scents of violets, cracked pepper and ripe blackberries, modest tannins and a crisp, clean finish. Drink now-2012. Imported by Kermit Lynch Wine Merchant.
title: Domaine Philippe Faury 2005  Saint-Joseph

description: Loaded up with toast and vanilla, as you might expect from Tardieu Laurent, but the wine shows plenty of weight and concentration under the wood, and some underlying pear and melon fruit ultimately finds its way out. It's a rich, succulent mouthful of oak and fruit for near-term drinking.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2007 Guy Louis White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Bright, round wine, with a layer of firm mineral tannins, but more about black berry and plum fruits, jammy acidity and a finishing dry structure. This second wine of Vray Croix de Gay will be ready in 2–3 years.
designation: L'Enchanteur de Vray Croix de Gay
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2007 L'Enchanteur de Vray Croix de Gay  (Pomerol)

description: Shows some slightly rustic but authentically Rhônish qualities, ranging from grilled cherries to hints of leather and cured meats. The tannins are supple, turning elegant on the finish. Drink now-2015.
title: Domaine Jérôme Gradassi 2005 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Shows some slightly rustic but authentically Rhônish qualities, ranging from grilled cherries to hints of leather and cured meats. The tannins are supple, turning elegant on the finish. Drink now-2015.
title: Domaine Jérôme Gradassi 2005 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: The continuing improvement at classed growth Camensac under the ownership of the Merlaut family (Chasse-Spleen, Citran, etc) is apparent even in the lesser vintage of 2007. The structure hangs well with the stalky but solid black berry fruit, the acidity a pure streak through it. Age over 4–5 years.
title: Château de Camensac 2007  Haut-Médoc

description: This is a structured wine that will shortly balance its blackberry fruit and tannins. It has fine acidity, and a core of dryness that will soften. Drink from 2019.
title: Château le Bourdieu Vertheuil 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: A fruity wine with soft tannins that reflects the crispness of the vintage. The wine, full of blackberry fruit and balanced acidity comes from an estate in the heart of the Entre-deux-Mers region of Bordeaux. Drink now.
title: Château les Terrasses de Bouey 2014  Bordeaux

description: On an eminence above the river Garonne, this estate is in the Entre-deux-Mers. The wine ,with its juicy red fruits, has just a touch of tannins along with crisp acidity and a mineral aftertaste. Produced from organically grown grapes, this is clean, bright and will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Lauretan 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: On an eminence above the river Garonne, this estate is in the Entre-deux-Mers. The wine ,with its juicy red fruits, has just a touch of tannins along with crisp acidity and a mineral aftertaste. Produced from organically grown grapes, this is clean, bright and will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Lauretan 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This blend of 75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Sauvignon is light, bright and crisp. It has red fruits and perfumed acidity along with a softly tannic aftertaste. It is not a wine for aging long so drink from 2018.
title: Château la Fleur Bellevue 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This blend of 75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Sauvignon is light, bright and crisp. It has red fruits and perfumed acidity along with a softly tannic aftertaste. It is not a wine for aging long so drink from 2018.
title: Château la Fleur Bellevue 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Owned by the Francisco family since 1870, this wine is juicy and just lightly stalky, with fine crisp acidity. Needing to develop and soften its firm texture, it will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château de la Croix 2014  Médoc

description: The 65% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend has produced a wine that is tight with as much acidity as fruit. It does have a juicy edge that is attractive although overall the wine seems thin and dry.
title: Château Aney 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: Named after Roman emperor Probus, who allowed the replanting of vines in France, this finely mature wine is smooth, with a dry core. That structure supports secondary flavors and spice, which add to its juicy acidity and overall richness. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: Named after Roman emperor Probus, who allowed the replanting of vines in France, this finely mature wine is smooth, with a dry core. That structure supports secondary flavors and spice, which add to its juicy acidity and overall richness. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: The natural late harvest richness of Petit Manseng makes this wine so rich and sweet. Its mango and honey sweetness is balanced by the intense acidity that also comes from this grape. It's beautiful, ripe and delicious now but will be better from late 2018.
title: Famille Laplace 2016 Château Aydie  (Pacherenc du Vic Bilh)

description: The natural late harvest richness of Petit Manseng makes this wine so rich and sweet. Its mango and honey sweetness is balanced by the intense acidity that also comes from this grape. It's beautiful, ripe and delicious now but will be better from late 2018.
title: Famille Laplace 2016 Château Aydie  (Pacherenc du Vic Bilh)

description: The third generation of the Laplace family has produced a black-colored, juicy and richly balanced wine. Its black plum and damson fruit is enclosed in young, firm tannins that will gradually soften. It's a dark, dense wine that will be ready to drink by 2020.
title: Famille Laplace 2014 Odé d'Aydie Tannat (Madiran)

description: This is already a beautiful wine. An intense flavor of dried apricot fruit is balanced by a serious core of botrytis. With its underlying acidity, this is concentrated, ripe and sure to age well. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Suduiraut 2014 Castelnau de Suduiraut  (Sauternes)

description: This is already a beautiful wine. An intense flavor of dried apricot fruit is balanced by a serious core of botrytis. With its underlying acidity, this is concentrated, ripe and sure to age well. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Suduiraut 2014 Castelnau de Suduiraut  (Sauternes)

description: Illogically, there are two second wines at this estate. This is the richer of the two (the other is Lions). It has intensity, spice, ripe apricot fruit and a smooth, dense texture. Its honey and botrytis notes are just right while the thread of acidity keeps it all in place. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Suduiraut 2011 Castelnau de Suduiraut  (Sauternes)

description: This serious, ageworthy wine is the top in the series of three wines from the Moinié estate. It's powerful and perfumed, with rich dark chocolate and superripe black plum and berry flavors. The tannins are still firm, showing its considerable potential. Wait until at least 2021 before drinking.
title: Château Ponzac 2015 Eternellement Malbec (Cahors)

description: This rich wine is dominated by concentrated botrytis tones, yet its acidity and lemon flavors are still very much at the fore. With its firm structure, spice notes and crisp lemon fruit still coming together, it suggests a fine future. Drink from 2023.
title: Château Lamothe Despujols 2014  Sauternes

description: Wood aged and serious, this is a finely balanced wine. Its spice and toast notes are beginning to come together with its young, exuberant fruit and acidity. Black currant flavors dominate, giving it a crisp, juicy edge. Drink this impressive wine from 2021.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2014 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: This comes from a producer based in the Marne Valley, so it is not unusual to find a 100% Pinot Meunier wine. It gives great fruitiness, apples and crisp pears as well as bright, ready-to-drink acidity.
title: Poissinet NV Constance Brut Pinot Meunier (Champagne)

description: Ripe green and white fruits give a fresh while warm character to this wine. An herbaceous element brings in a more tangy character. It is fresh at the end, very fruity while still young. Drink from late 2015. Produced by Grands Chais de France.
title: Mademoiselle Comédie 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Ripe green and white fruits give a fresh while warm character to this wine. An herbaceous element brings in a more tangy character. It is fresh at the end, very fruity while still young. Drink from late 2015. Produced by Grands Chais de France.
title: Mademoiselle Comédie 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Produced at Domaine la Gemière in Sancerre, this ripe full-fruited wine is perfect to drink young. Packed with citrus fruits with a strong mineral edge, the wine is rich and floral. Drink now.
title: Xavier Flouret 2016 French Blonde  (Sancerre)

description: This fruity wine is ripe with crisp red apples. It has acidity as well as a touch of pepper, although the main thrust of the wine is the rich fruitiness and rounded texture at the end. Drink now.
designation: Château de la Gravelle Sur Lie
title: Véronique Günther-Chereau 2016 Château de la Gravelle Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Although it is dry, this wine with its gentle mousse has a light touch of honey to go with the ripe pear and cantaloupe flavors. It has a crisp edge, lightly toasty, dry and with tight acidity at the end.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2014 Cuvée T Brut  (Vouvray)

description: This attractive herbal and spicy wine is the entry-level wine at this showcase estate. The wine is rich, generous with a character that reveals both crisp fruit and ripeness. That makes it rich and very drinkable young.
title: Château de Tracy 2016 Madamoiselle de T  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A blend of 80% of the two red Pinot grapes and 20% Chardonnay, this is lightly tannic and structured. At the same time, the red-berry fruits shine through to produce a wine that is dry, crisp and attractively fruity. Ready to drink now.
title: Forget-Brimont NV Brut Rosé Premier Cru  (Champagne)

description: Bright and crisp with an edge of tannins and plenty of red-currant fruitiness, this is an attractive wine. It is perfumed with a mineral edge and lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Faniel et Fils NV Pérlane Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Bright and crisp with an edge of tannins and plenty of red-currant fruitiness, this is an attractive wine. It is perfumed with a mineral edge and lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Faniel et Fils NV Pérlane Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This mildly aromatic blend of Grenache Blanc, Roussanne and Vermentino marries apple and lime flavors into a fresh, citrusy white that persists nicely on the finish. Drink now.
title: Chateau Mourgues du Gres 2010 Les Galets Dorés White (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This blend of Roussanne, Marsanne, Clairette and Grenache Blanc shows some plumpness on the midpalate thanks to lees contact rather than oak. Aromas are of struck flint and passion fruit, but the flavors are riper, skewing toward melon and nectarine yet remaining crisp and focused on the finish. Drink now.
title: Château la Canorgue 2010 White (Luberon)

description: Although this is aimed at a slightly higher target than Beaubois's entry-level Expression cuvée, it comes across as just slightly more tannic, with a fine balance of blackberries, olives and earth on the midpalate but a touch of coarseness to the finish. 80% Syrah, 20% Grenache. Drink 2012–2015.
title: Château Beaubois 2009 Elegance Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: From organically grown vineyards, this is a medium-bodied blend of Grenache, Carignan and Syrah, with crisply defined fruit notes of black cherries and hints of coffee, sage and baking spices. Drink it over the next 9–12 months.
title: Mas du Fadan 2010 Rouge Red (Ventoux)

description: From organically grown vineyards, this is a medium-bodied blend of Grenache, Carignan and Syrah, with crisply defined fruit notes of black cherries and hints of coffee, sage and baking spices. Drink it over the next 9–12 months.
title: Mas du Fadan 2010 Rouge Red (Ventoux)

description: Marrenon's luxury cuvée aged in oak is 90% Grenache and 10% Syrah and is full-bodied without being tough or overly muscular. Cherry preserves are wrapped in a coat of coffee- and chocolate-tinged oak. Drink now and over the next couple of years.
title: Marrenon 2008 Orca Red (Ventoux)

description: Fits the fashion for very pale rosé, with delicate pink color and aromas of struck flint and passion fruit. In the mouth, it's mouthwatering and plump, with peachy notes and a bit of lime zest to finish. Drink now.
title: Château la Canorgue 2010 Rosé (Luberon)

description: Spiced, baked apple constitutes the main aroma on nose and palate: ripe but tart baked fruit scented with edges of cinnamon and citrus. This brims with fruit and lemony brightness on a citrus-focussed, dry palate of concentration and earthy poise. Lasting and delicious. Drink 2016–2020.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2013 Praelatenberg de Kintzheim Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Spiced, baked apple constitutes the main aroma on nose and palate: ripe but tart baked fruit scented with edges of cinnamon and citrus. This brims with fruit and lemony brightness on a citrus-focussed, dry palate of concentration and earthy poise. Lasting and delicious. Drink 2016–2020.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2013 Praelatenberg de Kintzheim Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: While the wine is very young, the potential is there. It has rich tannins and berry fruits that are packed with youthful acidity. The structure and the depth of flavor are there with a hint of the juicy fruits as well as the minerality that are both developing. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014 Maxime Cuvée Silex  (Sancerre)

description: Stony, peachy notes are evident on the nose. The palate confirms these and majors on that stony, structural framework. Pervaded as it is by ripe stone fruit flavor of yellow plum and peach, there is a pleasant bitter edge, reminiscent of honey. This is an exciting tightrope walk between the slightest smidgeon of residual sweetness and electric acidity, finishing dry. Ready now, will drink well until 2018.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2012 Hengst Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: While the nose gives little away, the palate has a shy but very seductive nature: floral borders of honeysuckle adorn the edges of tart, fresh apple fruit and are highlighted by lemony acidity. The body is light and dry and shows playfulness and charm against a more serious, stony background. A very charming, subtle wine.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Sommerberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: While the nose gives little away, the palate has a shy but very seductive nature: floral borders of honeysuckle adorn the edges of tart, fresh apple fruit and are highlighted by lemony acidity. The body is light and dry and shows playfulness and charm against a more serious, stony background. A very charming, subtle wine.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Sommerberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: There is a whiff of flint before the tangy nose reveals itself with orange and lemon zest. This has a sprightly, lively feel and a textured, dry palate where orange zest, lemon juice and tangerine freshness play against a fruit-drenched backdrop of chalky stone. This is chock-full of fruit and joy but also really fresh. Drink 2016–2025.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Rosacker Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a very fine, medium dry wine. It is superbly balanced between honeyed ripeness and tight, bright acidity. Crisp apples dominate the fruit profile of this young wine. That makes it delicious now but the wine is set to age well into a mature wine with great complexity. If you can wait, it will be more mature from 2019.
title: Alexandre Monmousseau 2014 Clos le Vigneau  (Vouvray)

description: This is a very fine, medium dry wine. It is superbly balanced between honeyed ripeness and tight, bright acidity. Crisp apples dominate the fruit profile of this young wine. That makes it delicious now but the wine is set to age well into a mature wine with great complexity. If you can wait, it will be more mature from 2019.
title: Alexandre Monmousseau 2014 Clos le Vigneau  (Vouvray)

description: This has tannins, black currant fruit and a solid structure. It should soften in two years, resulting in an attractive, juicy and fruity wine.
title: Château Tuilerie Pagès 2010  Bordeaux

description: Produced from Cabernet Sauvignon, this aromatic, crisp rosé has refreshing red-currant acidity and a light, lively character. Screwcap.
title: Château Suau 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: On the lean side, this is a tannic and structured wine. The fruit is stalky, with a black currant note and tight acidity, creating a wine that needs 1–2 years to really soften.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Médoc)

description: Taut and herbaceous, this has a refreshing line of perfumed pear and lime flavors. It's crisp, tangy and drinkable now with a clean, bright finish.
title: Alpha Loire 2011 Domaine de la Croix Bouqure Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Round and fruity, this is cleanly made, with its soft character coming from the ripe strawberry fruit. It's a good candidate to pair with a fruit dessert or to serve as an apéritif.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: Lean and rather severe, this is now showing maturity. It has a leathery texture, with just a hint of juicy fruit in the background.
title: Château Plaisance 2007  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This has apricot and pear flavors, plus a nutmeg hint and intense, refreshing acidity.
designation: Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay
title: Antonin Rodet 2011 Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay  (Rully)

description: This has apricot and pear flavors, plus a nutmeg hint and intense, refreshing acidity.
designation: Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay
title: Antonin Rodet 2011 Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay  (Rully)

description: Made from fruit sourced from a parcel in Fourchaume, this fruity wine offers green fruit flavors that are cut by the minerally texture. It is crisp, taut and nervy, and it needs a few years to show its best.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2011 Les Vaupulans Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Made from fruit sourced from a parcel in Fourchaume, this fruity wine offers green fruit flavors that are cut by the minerally texture. It is crisp, taut and nervy, and it needs a few years to show its best.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2011 Les Vaupulans Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a rich, fruity wine that has a definite minerally character. The chalky texture is laced with lemon and apricot flavors, leading to a crisp, tight finish.
title: Bret Brothers 2010 Climat en Combe  (Saint-Véran)

description: This is a smoky, fragrant wine that offers dense fruit and firm tannins. It has the structure of a fine Gevrey and the concentration of the vintage. This is classic and worth aging for 4–5 years.
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Clos Prieur  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Situated on the northern slopes of the Montagne de Reims, this producer is well situated to make a tightly defined Chardonnay Blanc de Blancs. This wine is textured, crisp and with intense acidity. The low dosage emphasizes the nervy mineral character of this wine. Drink this bottling from 2018.
designation: Brut Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru
title: Forget-Brimont NV Brut Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Rich, with a hint of toast, this floral wine, with its almond blossom aromas, is drier than many other bottlings from this producer. It has a crisp, tight texture, with a mineral edge as well as a firm structure that suggests it is still young, so drink from 2018.
designation: Charles VII Grande Cuvée le Victorieux Brut
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Charles VII Grande Cuvée le Victorieux Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a creamy wine with a soft bubbly mousse. The wine is crisp with a strong mineral character that gives the wine a distinct zesty apple-skin flavor. It is dry, fruity and ready to drink.
designation: Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Crisp, dry, and packed with red currants, this mineral-textured wine is ripe while also intensely crisp. Its acidity and taut character are delicious, refreshing and well in balance. The creamy mousse and lively aftertaste add to the brightness of the wine.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Rosé de Mailly Brut  (Champagne)

description: The nonvintage blend from this producer is getting marginally drier with tight crisp fruit as well as delicious sliced apple flavors. With a touch of toastiness, this wine shows itself as having some attractive bottle age. It is ready to drink.
title: Louis Roederer NV Brut Premier  (Champagne)

description: The beautifully judged pale-orange-pink color of this delicious wine is a sign of the balance in the glass. It is crisp and towards the dry end of Brut, typical of the Lanson style. There is fine acidity and a crisp texture from the Chardonnay in the blend. Hints of red fruits come through along with a touch of tannin. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Lanson NV Rose Label Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The beautifully judged pale-orange-pink color of this delicious wine is a sign of the balance in the glass. It is crisp and towards the dry end of Brut, typical of the Lanson style. There is fine acidity and a crisp texture from the Chardonnay in the blend. Hints of red fruits come through along with a touch of tannin. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Lanson NV Rose Label Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Finely balanced wine, layering tannins, red juicy fruits and plenty of delicious, sweet acidity. Like so many Gaillac wines, it has an attractive, earthy edge, which gives character and will blow away as the wine ages. The tannins come back at the end, so the aging potential is good.
title: Domaine Rotier 2005 Les Gravels Red (Gaillac)

description: A crisp wine with intriguing herbal and green fruit flavors that are edged with tannins, and a toasty, mineral finish. Delicious.
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Clos Triguedina NV Le Sec du Clos Chardonnay-Viognier (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: With its spice, white pear and nutmeg flavors, this is a rich wine, round, full-bodied, packed with apple skin tannins, and a welcome and balancing freshness. The alcohol does show, however, in the pepper feel to the aftertaste.
title: Alain Brumont 2006 Le Jardin Philosophique  (Pacherenc du Vic Bilh)

description: With its spice, white pear and nutmeg flavors, this is a rich wine, round, full-bodied, packed with apple skin tannins, and a welcome and balancing freshness. The alcohol does show, however, in the pepper feel to the aftertaste.
title: Alain Brumont 2006 Le Jardin Philosophique  (Pacherenc du Vic Bilh)

description: The Chéreau family has long been proponents of wood-aging for some Muscadets. Also, so it appears, of long aging. The toasty aromas and flavors that still dominate the wine give it a Chardonnay feel, replacing the crispness of melon with a round creamy flavor. There is spice, but also some oxidation.
designation: Elevé en Fûts de Chêne Neufs
title: Château du Coing de Saint-Fiacre 1999 Elevé en Fûts de Chêne Neufs  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Eight months on lees before bottling give this wine its rich, concentrated character. Melon and green-plum fruits are poised and stylish, pointed up by a touch of pepper. It is ripe, full bodied, ready to drink in 2017.
title: Clos Venturi 2015 Vermentino (Corse)

description: Eight months on lees before bottling give this wine its rich, concentrated character. Melon and green-plum fruits are poised and stylish, pointed up by a touch of pepper. It is ripe, full bodied, ready to drink in 2017.
title: Clos Venturi 2015 Vermentino (Corse)

description: More deeply colored than the current fashion for pale rosés, this wine also has plenty of flavor. It offers juicy red-berry fruits, orange juice, and a crisp, direct texture. It is meant to go with food.
title: Clos Venturi 2015 Rosé (Corse)

description: This widely found local grape has produced a crisp, wine full complex berry and black fruits that are balanced with tannins. Richly structured, the wine is held together by the tannins and by the bright acidity typical of the grape. Drink now.
title: Clos Venturi 2013 Pur Sciaccarellu Sciaccerellu (Corse)

description: This bottling is a blend comprised of wines from the 2011–2013 vintages, hence the nonvintage Vin de France labeling. Aromas of leather, clove and cinnamon come with a hint of adhesive bandage. The tannins are firm, so pair this with rare beef or lamb to bring forward the long, mouthwatering finish.
title: Laurence Féraud NV Plan Pégau Red (Vin de France)

description: Made from a selection of grapes dominated by Syrah, this is the more structured of the two rosés produced at the estate. Rpe red and citrus fruits are filled out with touches of apricot juice. Very much a wine for food, it has a dry, spicy aftertaste.
title: Domaine du Dragon 2015 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a rounded, ripe and fruity wine named after a red star in the Cetus constellation. It is immediately drinkable with attractive red-currant fruit flavors along with perfumed acidity and just a touch of orange zest. The wine is refreshing and very ready to drink.
title: Château Ferry Lacombe 2015 Mira Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Equal proportions of the three main Champagne grapes give this wine a fine balance. It is ripe with pear and melon fruitiness as well as almonds and toast that suggest some bottle age. Drink now.
title: Eric Taillet NV Egali't Brut  (Champagne)

description: Equal proportions of the three main Champagne grapes give this wine a fine balance. It is ripe with pear and melon fruitiness as well as almonds and toast that suggest some bottle age. Drink now.
title: Eric Taillet NV Egali't Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a soft wine with young apple and creamy pear flavors. Its acidity and tangy texture are behind the smooth surface, although taste further back. There is plenty of acidity. Drink this fruity wine now.
designation: Le Fresnay Grande Réserve Sur Lie
title: Véronique Günther-Chereau 2016 Le Fresnay Grande Réserve Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Lightly aromatic, this ripe full wine is beautifully balanced, poised between crisp citrus acidity and ripe apple and pear flavors. It is zingy, textured and delicious to drink now.
title: Domaine Martin 2016 Les Trois Versants Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This grower, based in Chamery on the Montagne de Reims, has produced a ripe creamy nonvintage wine. White-fruit aromas and apple-fruit flavors reinforce the richness of the wine. It has a crisp aftertaste that brings in acidity to balance. Drink now.
title: Bertrand-Delespierre NV Brut Premier Cru  (Champagne)

description: Properly dry and crisp, this is a zesty mineral-driven Champagne. It has acidity, citrus and green-fruit flavors. The texture and the direct fruitiness reveal a wine that is still young. Drink this bottling from 2018.
title: Barrat-Masson NV Fleur de Craie Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a strangely chemical wine that has overripe fruit. It misses out on initial acidity and fruitiness.
title: Domaine de Sulauze 2011 Lauze Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a strangely chemical wine that has overripe fruit. It misses out on initial acidity and fruitiness.
title: Domaine de Sulauze 2011 Lauze Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a Pinot Noir rosé that is very light and dry. The acidity is strikingly high leaving an impression of sharpness.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2012 Rosé (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: Smoky and structured, this is a dry wine with only the acidity to hint at the berry fruits to come. With this firm, toasty tannic character, the wine is likely to remain structured for a while to come. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2014 Clos du Roy  (Marsannay)

description: Situated on the east coast of Corsica, this vineyard is 50 hectares. The wine is ripe, full in the mouth and refreshingly fruity. There is a touch of spice as well as great waves of fresh acidity.
title: Domaine Alzitana 2015 Rosé (Corse)

description: Situated on the east coast of Corsica, this vineyard is 50 hectares. The wine is ripe, full in the mouth and refreshingly fruity. There is a touch of spice as well as great waves of fresh acidity.
title: Domaine Alzitana 2015 Rosé (Corse)

description: This wine is crisp and refreshingly fruity. With red currant and bright spicy acidity, it is lively, just hinting at a tannic edge. It finishes with a burst of raspberries.
title: Château des Tourtes 2015 Cuvée Classique Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is crisp and refreshingly fruity. With red currant and bright spicy acidity, it is lively, just hinting at a tannic edge. It finishes with a burst of raspberries.
title: Château des Tourtes 2015 Cuvée Classique Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: In this generous interpretation of Nuits Saint-Georges, ripe berry fruits burst through the typical dry tannins. It has plenty of red-fruit flavors, a generous texture and structure. Drink this already attractive wine from 2018.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: In this generous interpretation of Nuits Saint-Georges, ripe berry fruits burst through the typical dry tannins. It has plenty of red-fruit flavors, a generous texture and structure. Drink this already attractive wine from 2018.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: Ripe, juicy pear appears as a pristine, expressive flavor on nose and palate. Body and structure are light and just off dry. Drink soon while at its delicious peak.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This wine comes from a single vineyard in the heart of the appellation. It is soft, just hinting at the lime acidity while focused on ripe yellow and green-plum fruits. This wine can develop further and will be at its best from 2017.
title: Cave de Lugny 2013 La Carte  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: With its onion-skin color, this already shows age. The palate, with its mature reflection and beautiful rounded texture, confirms this. Rich, well balanced and gently mature, it has retained enough red fruits to keep an element of freshness. It is a food wine, rich and full in the mouth.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Réserve Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Very dry, this is a crisp, steely and structured wine, a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir that still tastes young. A blend made from nine different villages, it is so fresh and fruity with its white and citrus fruits, sliced apples and lemon juice. A zesty character at the back gives it a lively aftertaste.
title: Bruno Paillard 2004 Assemblage Brut  (Champagne)

description: Very dry, this is a crisp, steely and structured wine, a blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir that still tastes young. A blend made from nine different villages, it is so fresh and fruity with its white and citrus fruits, sliced apples and lemon juice. A zesty character at the back gives it a lively aftertaste.
title: Bruno Paillard 2004 Assemblage Brut  (Champagne)

description: A lightly orange-colored rosé that is made by macerating the grapes on the skins for 72 hours. The result is a soft wine, very dry while also showing a rounded character that gives richness. Ripe red fruits and a touch of grapefruit are sustained by a mineral texture. Drink now.
designation: Premium Rosé de Saignée Premier Cru Extra-Brut
title: J. Dumangin Fils 2008 Premium Rosé de Saignée Premier Cru Extra-Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is the best Delamotte vintage since 1996, a ripe and rich wine that brings out the chalky soil character with a strong mineral content. It has weight along with a relatively high dosage that gives softness. It is balanced, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Delamotte 2004 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A soft and round exterior hides the concentrated, structured core that sets this wine on a long road to maturity. Creamed pears, quince and tight acidity are developing to come through and fill the wine with a crisp character allied to steeliness. Drink from 2017.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2012 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: A soft and round exterior hides the concentrated, structured core that sets this wine on a long road to maturity. Creamed pears, quince and tight acidity are developing to come through and fill the wine with a crisp character allied to steeliness. Drink from 2017.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2012 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Although this wine is labeled Brut, it is in fact right at the driest end of that category. Bone dry, therefore, while full of white fruits and crisp lemon zest flavors. The texture is tight, steely and speaks strongly of the chalk of the soil. It is still young, so this vintage wine can be drunk now for its fruitiness or left until 2016 for a more rounded, toasty character.
designation: Cuvée Gastronome Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2009 Cuvée Gastronome Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Now mature and ready to drink, this is a ripe, smooth wine. It has soft tannins and a rounded texture with spice and secondary undergrowth flavors. The wine, from an estate owned by the bishops of Angers before the French Revolution, needs no more aging.
title: Vignobles Laffourcade 2011 Château Perray Jouannet Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: This is a lively, fresh and crisp wine. It has a touch of minerality and pepper that is lifted by the citrus and kiwi-fruit flavor. There is a fine tang at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaines Vinet 2012 Domaine Saint Martin  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a light blend of the two Cabernets with fresh red fruits and a touch of stalky tannin. It is made from organically grown grapes, fresh, full of red-cherry and red-currant flavors that are given an even crisper character by the acidity. The wine will be ready to drink from the end of 2016.
title: Domaine la Paonnerie 2014 La Jacquerie Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages)

description: This is a ripe, warm Gamay with black-cherry fruits that give acidity to go with the soft texture. It is juicy, fruity and will make a fine summer drink, lightly chilled. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Rin du Bois 2014 Gamay (Touraine)

description: A smooth and creamy wine that is also full of fresh fruit and crisp acidity. It has an attractive floral character along with a mineral texture that gives the wine its shape. The wine is ready to drink.
designation: Vieilles Vignes Clos de la Fontaine Sur Lie
title: Domaine de la Foliette 2015 Vieilles Vignes Clos de la Fontaine Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a crisp, really fruity wine with a light touch of wood from the six months of barrel aging. It is ripe, lightly herbal balancing citrus flavors with riper yellow fruits. Drink now.
title: Cheval Quancard 2015 Réserve Sauvignon-Sémillon  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a crisp, really fruity wine with a light touch of wood from the six months of barrel aging. It is ripe, lightly herbal balancing citrus flavors with riper yellow fruits. Drink now.
title: Cheval Quancard 2015 Réserve Sauvignon-Sémillon  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: An attractive, fruity wine full of black currants and acidity. The tannins are still dry and need to soften a little before the wine is ready to drink. It does have all the bright character of this early developing vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Terre Blanque 2014  Bordeaux

description: The wine has yeasty aromas although the fruit is all there. Red-berry flavors are cut with a tannic texture and enough acidity to balance. The wine will be better from the end of 2016.
title: Château Lamothe de Haux 2015 Red (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: The wine has yeasty aromas although the fruit is all there. Red-berry flavors are cut with a tannic texture and enough acidity to balance. The wine will be better from the end of 2016.
title: Château Lamothe de Haux 2015 Red (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: This is an attractive, soft and fruity wine. With gentle tannins and a touch of spice to balance the red fruits, it is developing into a juicy wine. Lightly smoky at the end, it will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château la Valade 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is rich Champagne, full with a lively mousse and a dominance of Pinot. The acidity and grapefruit flavors are intense, with just a hint of yeastiness. This bottling seems youthful and could age a few months.
title: Drappier NV Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: A mature, beautifully balanced wine, with great fresh raspberry and red currant flavors. It is rich, dense, balancing toast, yeast and fresh fruit. With its dry edge, think of this as a food wine.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A mature, beautifully balanced wine, with great fresh raspberry and red currant flavors. It is rich, dense, balancing toast, yeast and fresh fruit. With its dry edge, think of this as a food wine.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A soft product of a soft vintage, offering rich fruit as well as a crisp texture. The balance is just right: green apples and lime to go with yeast and acidity that lies neatly under everything. Age this excellent wine for 2–3 years.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2000 Cuvée Spéciale Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A soft product of a soft vintage, offering rich fruit as well as a crisp texture. The balance is just right: green apples and lime to go with yeast and acidity that lies neatly under everything. Age this excellent wine for 2–3 years.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2000 Cuvée Spéciale Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Literally timeless, L'Intemporelle is an elegant, almost discreet style. It downplays the rich fruit to present a stylish wine, with citrus highlights over ripe yellow fruit. This 2005 is still young; age for 3–4 years.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2005 L'Intemporelle Brut  (Champagne)

description: Literally timeless, L'Intemporelle is an elegant, almost discreet style. It downplays the rich fruit to present a stylish wine, with citrus highlights over ripe yellow fruit. This 2005 is still young; age for 3–4 years.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2005 L'Intemporelle Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a soft, lightly earthy style of wine produced from grapes from across the Loire Valley. It has a strong herbal character and a touch of grapefruit. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine is soft and creamy, with a layer of herbal fruitiness. As the name indicates, the grapes come from near two seas (mers): Sauvignon Blanc from the Atlantic and Viognier from the Mediterranean. The combination is refreshing and attractively, with a balance of crisp fruit and a soft texture.
title: Duo des Mers 2016 Sauvignon-Viognier White (Vin de France)

description: This wine is soft and creamy, with a layer of herbal fruitiness. As the name indicates, the grapes come from near two seas (mers): Sauvignon Blanc from the Atlantic and Viognier from the Mediterranean. The combination is refreshing and attractively, with a balance of crisp fruit and a soft texture.
title: Duo des Mers 2016 Sauvignon-Viognier White (Vin de France)

description: This crisp, clean and zesty wine is lightly herbal and immediately appealing. It's full of citrus and gooseberry flavors and is ready to drink.
title: Vindivin 2016 La Belle Saison Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Made from Loire Valley fruit, this has the tangy, herbal character typical of cool-climate wines. Drink now.
title: Villebois 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This light, crisp and fruity wine dances in the glass. With the acidity from Niellucciu very present, it's lively and bright, with a delicious final tang. Drink now.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2016 Terra Corsa Rosé (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: With its pale color, this looks like a Provence rosé. It's soft and fruity, with spice, juicy red currant flavors and fine acidity at the end.
title: Tussock Jumper 2016 Grenache Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Bringing out the crispness of a Touraine Sauvignon, this wine is full of herbal flavors, crisp acidity and a soft fruity character. It is immediately attractive, simple, bright and ready to drink.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2016 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc Sauvignon Blanc (Val de Loire)

description: Produced from Gamay in a small enclave of vines south of Sancerre, this is a cherry-blossom-perfumed wine, bright and crisp with red-cherry flavors. It is ready now.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2016 Les Amphores Rosé (Châteaumeillant)

description: Produced from Gamay in a small enclave of vines south of Sancerre, this is a cherry-blossom-perfumed wine, bright and crisp with red-cherry flavors. It is ready now.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2016 Les Amphores Rosé (Châteaumeillant)

description: This warm-climate Sauvignon Blanc is soft and very fruity, with the merest hint of herbal character. Its juiciness, acidity and peach flavors are refreshing.
title: Florent Descombe NV Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This warm-climate Sauvignon Blanc is soft and very fruity, with the merest hint of herbal character. Its juiciness, acidity and peach flavors are refreshing.
title: Florent Descombe NV Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This Grenache is deeply colored. Its flavor has the right spice and rounded character. Plenty of acidity keeps it crisp while a hint of pepper adds interest.
title: Florent Descombe NV Grenache (Vin de France)

description: The Savigny-lès-Beaune-based producer shows his Pinot Noir skills with this wine. It's generous, with red plum flavor, light wood-aging notes, ripe tannins and crisp acidity. It's rounded and ready to drink.
title: Doudet Naudin 2016 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This is a plump, perky little red, full of ripe, bouncy cherry fruit on the nose and palate. It's an easy quaff that falls away quickly on the finish.
title: Château Mont-Redon 2013 Réserve Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This 100% Viognier from Cairanne is broad and rich, showing proper varietal notes of apricot and ginger. It seems a bit warm and soft on the finish.
title: Domaine Brusset 2013 Les Clavelles Viognier (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Every Gascon white grape seems to have ended up in this ripe, soft blend. It offers plenty of cool-climate acidity, with lemon and pink grapefruit. It also has a steely, more mineral bite, with a more honeyed, perfumed aftertaste.
title: Laudet 2014 Le Moulin en Gascogne White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This earthy wine is full of firm and dry tannins. It has a dense and dark character, very concentrated along with its red berry fruits and acidity. At five years, it still tastes young and certainly tannic, not moving very far.
title: Château les Hauts d'Aglan 2009 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This earthy wine is full of firm and dry tannins. It has a dense and dark character, very concentrated along with its red berry fruits and acidity. At five years, it still tastes young and certainly tannic, not moving very far.
title: Château les Hauts d'Aglan 2009 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This blend of 60% Syrah, 30% Grenache and 10% Cinsault is just a bit too confected. Bubble gum, melon and stone-fruit notes are bold and forward, then finish tart and dry.
title: Château Beaubois 2014 Cuvée Expression Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This blend of 60% Syrah, 30% Grenache and 10% Cinsault is just a bit too confected. Bubble gum, melon and stone-fruit notes are bold and forward, then finish tart and dry.
title: Château Beaubois 2014 Cuvée Expression Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This bright pink-colored wine is made from Malbec. It is fruity and fresh with strawberry flavors and layers of acidity that give it a crisp, tight aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Pigmentum Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: This is a classic Burgundian version of a Champagne blend—made from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from the cool areas around Chablis. It's bright and fruity, tangy with lemon zest and a fine streak of minerality, and finishes with an attractive, creamy edge. Drink now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This full-bodied wine with its spice and creamed pear fruit flavors, feels rich and smooth. Structured and textured, the balanced acidity shows through well, giving a warm, off-dry aftertaste.
title: Domaine Seilly 2008 Vin de Pistolet d'Obernai White (Alsace)

description: Made with a high proportion of Pinot Meunier, this is elegant, fruity, with plenty of good acidity and a wonderful floral character. It is so fruity, fresh, a wine for real enjoyment.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: This is an intensely aromatic wine that follows through to a complex palate of white fruit, almond, thyme and fresh acidity. It is dry, with a steely edge, likely to age for several years.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2009 Steinert Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: Very spicy, lychee-flavored wine, rich and concentrated. It is full of this perfumed character, with pepper, sweet spice and an edge of honey.
title: Joseph Cattin 2009 Hatschbourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A great partner for rich sauced fish or pâté, this beautiful wine is relatively sweet, full of gently honeyed fruit, naturally full-bodied. The acidity is a light addition to the weighty texture.
title: Wolfberger 2009 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A great partner for rich sauced fish or pâté, this beautiful wine is relatively sweet, full of gently honeyed fruit, naturally full-bodied. The acidity is a light addition to the weighty texture.
title: Wolfberger 2009 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: While the wine has all the steely crispness you expect in a Chablis, it also offers ripe fruitiness that gives a full-bodied, round character. Acidity cuts through to give a lift to the fruit and to the tight texture of this young wine. It should age until 2015.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: To celebrate its 1843 origins, Besserat de Bellefon has released this limited-edition wood-fermented wine. It is a classic yet exceptional blend of Chardonnay/Pinot Noir/Pinot Meunier from eight cru vineyards. The taste is ripe and rich, with the wood treatment reducing the acidity while filling out the fruit. A complex wine, it will repay further bottle aging.
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée B de B Brut  (Champagne)

description: This Blanc de Blancs has shed its initial minerality and gained rich fruitiness. Apricots as well as more citrus flavors abound, bringing out a full and round character. From Grand Cru vineyards on the Côte des Blancs, this is ready to drink.
title: Ayala 2007 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Old vines give this single-parcel wine its power and concentration. Long wood aging hasn't diminished the richness of the fruit, the juicy acidity and the succulent berry flavors. It's a wine that's full and structured, likely to age well. Drink from 2018.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012 Les Damaudes  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Old vines give this single-parcel wine its power and concentration. Long wood aging hasn't diminished the richness of the fruit, the juicy acidity and the succulent berry flavors. It's a wine that's full and structured, likely to age well. Drink from 2018.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012 Les Damaudes  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This is a fruity, fragrant wine with light fruitiness and deliciously crisp acidity. Red berry flavors are lined with red apple acidity and a texture that shows a touch of minerality from the Grand Cru vineyards on the Montagne de Reims. Unusually for a rosé Champagne, this is made principally from Pinot Noir, with color coming from the skins rather than from adding red wine to the blend.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With his background in Bordeaux, François Lurton knows how to handle Sauvignon Blanc to good effect. This wine is crisp and herbal, suggesting the cooler vineyards of the southwest in its style. It is packed with citrus and spice flavors. Refreshing and delicious, this is an immediately drinkable wine.
title: François Lurton 2015 Les Fumées Blanches Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Sourced from grapes outside the family's Mas de Cadenet estate, this wine is light, fresh and immediately attractive. Its clear, open texture is ripe but refreshing with a soft fruity aftertaste. The name means “sleepless night” because the grapes are harvested at night.
title: Famille Negrel 2015 Nuit Blanche en Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A pungent wine, this has crisp acidity and tight fruits. Lightness comes from the red-currant flavors and the tangy citrus texture. It is bone-dry and will be better with food.
title: Domaine Saint Roman d'Esclans 2015 Air de Famille Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The entry-level wine at the Faulkner family's estate, this is easygoing, ripe and bright, with citrus plus cherry and strawberry flavors. With soft texture and lively acidity, it will be very drinkable on its own.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2015 Jules Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Immediately attractive, this fresh wine has crisp fruit and lively acidity. It offers a straight shot of red fruits and lemon, with a tight, mineral texture. The wine will make a fine apéritif.
title: Domaine de la Croix 2015 Eloge Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from grapes purchased from local growers, this is the entry-level wine of the Rosaline range. It is crisp, clean with an attractive ripeness from the red-berry fruits. It is in a refreshing apéritif style.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2015 Perle by Roseline Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from grapes purchased from local growers, this is the entry-level wine of the Rosaline range. It is crisp, clean with an attractive ripeness from the red-berry fruits. It is in a refreshing apéritif style.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2015 Perle by Roseline Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The entry-level wine at Roubine, this offers so much attractive, lighthearted fruit. It is crisp, packed with tight acidity and red currant flavors. It has a light, bright, deliciously perfumed aftertaste.
title: Château Roubine 2015 R de Roubine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The “83” refers to the department number of the Var, the winery's home county in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur. This open, gentle wine dances with attractive bright, fresh fruitiness. It is crisply textured, with a strong citrus element along with raspberry sweetness. It is an apéritif style.
title: Château de Brigue 2015 Rosé 83 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From a warm, south-facing vineyard, this is a sunny wine. Ripe red fruits are lifted by acidity. The background has a pepper and spice character that leaves the wine dry, almost structured. Drink now.
title: Cellier Saint-Sidoine 2015 Saint-Sidoine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an elegant and light wine. It is full of clean raspberries and red currants, lightly textured and with a bright finish that has refreshing acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2015 La Villa Barton Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This ripe, full wine has an attractive spice and toast character. Warm yellow fruits and a rich feel indicate the generous, rounded potential. The wine has a crisp side as well as a mineral touch. Drink now, but better from 2017.
title: Christophe Cordier 2014 Vielles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is a crisp, refreshing wine. With a mousse that is lively but with a creamy edge, it offers attractive apple fruitiness. A hint of toast suggests some good bottle age. The wine finishes with a mineral, tangy aftertaste.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV La Burgondie Brut Réserve  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: From a small vineyard in the north of the Côte de Nuits, this is a rare white wine in a red-wine region. Lightly toasty, it has spice, pear flavors and perfumed acidity. It's bright and crisp, ending with lively acidity.
title: Alex Gambal 2014  Fixin

description: The wood is still showing in this ripe, fruity wine. That's fine because the fruit and the perfumed acidity will fill out the wine and give it richness. Drink from 2018.
title: Tollot Beaut et Fils 2014 Les Lavières Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This is a ripe, spicy wine, with nutmeg and ginger flavors that blend with the crisp apple to give both freshness and a fragrant, aromatic character. It is delicious already, so drink now.
title: Domaine des Crets 2014  Mâcon-Chardonnay

description: This isn't sweet, but just so wonderfully rich. It's the concentration of botrytis that makes the wine. The texture is velvet, but with a spicy bite to it. Apricot, honey and marzipan all contribute to a wine that will age over decades.
title: Château d'Yquem 2005  Sauternes

description: This isn't sweet, but just so wonderfully rich. It's the concentration of botrytis that makes the wine. The texture is velvet, but with a spicy bite to it. Apricot, honey and marzipan all contribute to a wine that will age over decades.
title: Château d'Yquem 2005  Sauternes

description: A serviceable fizz but with off-beat aromas of beer nuts and pie crust. Foamy in the mouth, it ends with a quick orange note.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé NV Giersberger Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fat, simple wine that offers ripe apples, but misses out on acidity. The finish has a candied character.
title: Silver Cap NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: A fresh and juicy wine, full of red fruits as well as striking acidity. The tannins are soft, but do offer a core of firm dryness. For aging over the next two years.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2009  Côte de Beaune-Villages

description: With no dosage and no added sulfur dioxide, this wine is bright and tightly crisp, but the ripe Pinot Noir from this southern region of Champagne gives richness. With this good balance, the wine is fresh and generous at the same time. Because it is so dry, a few more months bottle age will make it even better, so wait to drink until 2017.
title: Pierre Gerbais NV L'Audace Brut Nature Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: With no dosage and no added sulfur dioxide, this wine is bright and tightly crisp, but the ripe Pinot Noir from this southern region of Champagne gives richness. With this good balance, the wine is fresh and generous at the same time. Because it is so dry, a few more months bottle age will make it even better, so wait to drink until 2017.
title: Pierre Gerbais NV L'Audace Brut Nature Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: The prestige cuvée from this producer, this has richness and a dense texture that brings out the ripe fruits. From a good, if not great, vintage, it is beautifully balanced, still young to taste and likely to age well. Drink now for the fruit or wait until 2018 for more maturity.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2006 Palmes d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: The prestige cuvée from this producer, this has richness and a dense texture that brings out the ripe fruits. From a good, if not great, vintage, it is beautifully balanced, still young to taste and likely to age well. Drink now for the fruit or wait until 2018 for more maturity.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2006 Palmes d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: Notes of fresh sourdough rye bread, crisp apples and citrus vie for attention and signal an evolved wine with beautiful notes of long autolysis. This is borne out on the exquisitely pure and fresh palate, still sprightly with lemon and green-apple freshness against a background of bread crust and crumb. Over time, the apple notes mellow and are reminiscent of spiced winter apple. This is marked by exquisite elegance and purity. Without any dosage, this shines with pure, intense and lively fruit.
title: Zusslin 2013 Brut Zéro Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This blend of 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay from the Montagne de Reims is rich and full in the mouth. It has intense acidity and a firm texture as well as ripe red currant and cherry fruits. It needs time to develop, so leave this bottling (disgorged January 2016) until 2018.
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Nature Verzenay Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: This blend of 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay from the Montagne de Reims is rich and full in the mouth. It has intense acidity and a firm texture as well as ripe red currant and cherry fruits. It needs time to develop, so leave this bottling (disgorged January 2016) until 2018.
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Nature Verzenay Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: Dominated by Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs, this mature, mineral-textured wine is both ripe and beautifully structured. With white fruits and a floral character, it is moving into spicy territory. Roast almonds are balanced with a crisp character from the low dosage. The wine is now just ready to drink.
title: Henri Abele 2007 Le Sourire de Reims Brut  (Champagne)

description: Dominated by Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs, this mature, mineral-textured wine is both ripe and beautifully structured. With white fruits and a floral character, it is moving into spicy territory. Roast almonds are balanced with a crisp character from the low dosage. The wine is now just ready to drink.
title: Henri Abele 2007 Le Sourire de Reims Brut  (Champagne)

description: This Aube-based producer has made a fine vintage from a good year. A half-and-half blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, still young and crisp, this concentrated wine brings in apricot as well as citrus fruits into a taut and mineral texture. Still full of its baby fruit, it will age well and will be best drunk from 2018.
title: Devaux 2008 D Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The second wine of this Saint-Emilion Premier Grand Cru Classé estate comes from selected parcels. Rich and with the smoothness of oak aging and ripe grapes, it is a generous wine that is developing well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2014 Dame Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The second wine of this Saint-Emilion Premier Grand Cru Classé estate comes from selected parcels. Rich and with the smoothness of oak aging and ripe grapes, it is a generous wine that is developing well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2014 Dame Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Notes of chalk, bread and stone precede the bruised apple notes on this beautiful, elegant vintage Crémant. On the palate, the apple notes become fuller and rounder and appear like mellow, baked Golden Delicious. There is purity, structure and precision in the autolytic notes which are supported by pure citrus and apple freshness, leaving the palate impressed but not weighed down. Hints of spice develop in the background while all the freshness makes for a lip-smacking, long and savory finish.
title: Boeckel 2012 Extra Brut Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Half-and-half Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay gives a sparkling wine that is both fresh and creamy. Attractive apple and almond flavors are lifted by bright acidity and a tight, very crisp aftertaste. The bottling seems a little young, so drink from 2016.
title: Alexandre Monmousseau NV Vigneau Brut Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: Half-and-half Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay gives a sparkling wine that is both fresh and creamy. Attractive apple and almond flavors are lifted by bright acidity and a tight, very crisp aftertaste. The bottling seems a little young, so drink from 2016.
title: Alexandre Monmousseau NV Vigneau Brut Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: Attractive mid-gold color. Fairly muted nose of very ripe stone fruit. Medium-bodied with moderate concentration of juicy citrus and sweet stone fruit flavors. Softish texture, smooth across the palate. Not very complex, but gentle and pleasing flavors. Medium length and fruity, honeyed finish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2008 Grand Cru Eichberg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Mid-gold color. pronounced aromas of creamy apricot custard, ruby grapefruit and enticing hints of spice, rose-water and honey. Concentrated, creamy stone fruit flavors follow through on the palate intertwined with a strong earthy minerality. Medium-bodied with a smooth, rich texture yet fresh with bright acidity. Long, layered, smooth finish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2008 Collection Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Pale lemon color with flecks of gold. Snappy citrus aromas with hints of peach and a floral note. Delightfully racy feel in the mouth with lots of juicy grapefruit, lemon and lime flavors. Light bodied and not very complex but very refreshing with a moderately long tangy finish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2008 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Attractive deep gold color. Rich, intense aromas showing some evolution. Earthy, savory, honeyed and spicy with floral notes adding lift and a touch of brown sugar. Opulent, rich texture with lots of honeyed tropical and stone fruit flavors with notes of nutmeg and mace. Bright acidity adds freshness and balances the slight sweetness. Fairly full-bodied with a long, lingering spicy finish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2007 Cuvée Caroline Vendange Tardive Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Attractive deep gold color. Rich, intense aromas showing some evolution. Earthy, savory, honeyed and spicy with floral notes adding lift and a touch of brown sugar. Opulent, rich texture with lots of honeyed tropical and stone fruit flavors with notes of nutmeg and mace. Bright acidity adds freshness and balances the slight sweetness. Fairly full-bodied with a long, lingering spicy finish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2007 Cuvée Caroline Vendange Tardive Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Deep gold in color. Complex nose, very earthy, savory, minerally aromas showing some evolution. Rich, viscous and broad across the palate with a strong savory, almost vegetal palette of flavors, some spice. Slightly lacking in freshness and fruit. Full-bodied with a warm, round finish.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2007 Herrenweg de Turckheim Muscat (Alsace)

description: A blend of 50% Grenache, 43% Syrah and 7% Cinsaut, this is very fresh and fruity--loaded with cherries--but also includes spice and earth complexities and a reasonable rich, creamy texture.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2009 Domaine Grand Veneur Réserve Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A blend of 50% Grenache, 43% Syrah and 7% Cinsaut, this is very fresh and fruity--loaded with cherries--but also includes spice and earth complexities and a reasonable rich, creamy texture.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2009 Domaine Grand Veneur Réserve Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Youthful lemony color with bright citrusy aromas and hints of smoke, honey and spice. Fresh, juicy, vibrant flavors of moderate intensity leading to a moderately long, soft finish. Good, easy drinking every-day wine.
title: Hugel 2008 Gentil White (Alsace)

description: Youthful lemony color with bright citrusy aromas and hints of smoke, honey and spice. Fresh, juicy, vibrant flavors of moderate intensity leading to a moderately long, soft finish. Good, easy drinking every-day wine.
title: Hugel 2008 Gentil White (Alsace)

description: This is a dry wine that wants to become sweet. It has that edge of honey and apricots typical of dry Jurançon along with the freshest, tangy acidity. With its bright fruit, fine texture and hint of toastiness, it will age and will be better from 2017.
title: Château Jolys 2014  Jurançon Sec

description: Beaujolais is an increasingly attractive source of inexpensive Chardonnay. This perfumed wine is warm with yellow fruits as well as crisper green plum and citrus flavors. With a touch of toastiness and caramel it is ripe and smooth, ready to drink now.
title: Château de Lavernette 2014 Les Vignes de la Roche  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Beaujolais is an increasingly attractive source of inexpensive Chardonnay. This perfumed wine is warm with yellow fruits as well as crisper green plum and citrus flavors. With a touch of toastiness and caramel it is ripe and smooth, ready to drink now.
title: Château de Lavernette 2014 Les Vignes de la Roche  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Fresh, fruity and juicy, this is a red cherry flavored wine that has brought out the best of the light 2013 vintage. It is soft with only the lightest of tannins and refreshing acidity at the end. Two of the inventors of the cinema, the Lumière brothers, lived in this castle which dates from the 19th century.
title: Château de Bellevue 2013 Les Charmes  (Morgon)

description: This balanced wine, full of ripe fruits, also has good acidity and a crisp citrus edge. It conveys a warm character, the apricot freshened by lemon flavors and given a tangy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Yves Giroux 2015 Les Raidillons  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: The wine is structured with solid tannins and a foursquare character. Ripe fruits with plenty of balancing acidity give this wine its density and its crisp edge. This is a fruity wine that will develop slowly and well. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Latour 2015  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: This premier-cru vineyard, wholly owned by the Devillard family, has produced a broad, ripe wine. It is generous, somewhat muted at this stage although promising plenty of citrus and yellow fruits and acidity as it ages. The wood aging creates a smooth hint at the back. Drink from 2021.
designation: Château de Chamirey La Mission Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Château de Chamirey La Mission Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: This premier-cru vineyard, wholly owned by the Devillard family, has produced a broad, ripe wine. It is generous, somewhat muted at this stage although promising plenty of citrus and yellow fruits and acidity as it ages. The wood aging creates a smooth hint at the back. Drink from 2021.
designation: Château de Chamirey La Mission Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Château de Chamirey La Mission Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: This wine is rounded, rich and full of ripe fruit. Its wood flavors, giving spice and vanilla, are a backdrop to the generous apricot and pear flavors and good acidity. Drink this wine from 2022.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2015 Sous Blagny Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Exotically spicy, a wine that smoothly rides over its richness and density. The ripeness adds piquance to the earthy character of the flavors, dry tannins and a spicy meatiness. The aftertaste is full of juicy blackberry.
title: Château Jean-Pierre Gaussen 2004 Longue Garde Mourvèdre (Bandol)

description: Exotically spicy, a wine that smoothly rides over its richness and density. The ripeness adds piquance to the earthy character of the flavors, dry tannins and a spicy meatiness. The aftertaste is full of juicy blackberry.
title: Château Jean-Pierre Gaussen 2004 Longue Garde Mourvèdre (Bandol)

description: Rich, full-bodied, a Muscadet that brings together crisp green fruits, intense minerality and concentration. There's a great tang of lime and pink grapefruit, smoothed out with ripe, creamy apple. Age maybe for a year.
title: Château de la Ragotiere 2007 Vieilles Vignes  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Made from old vines, this is a blend of Syrah and Négrette, with some Cabernet Sauvignon to give extra structure. It has fresh juiciness, with red plum and berry flavors, a touch of sweet chocolate, the wood aging well judged to leave the clarity of the fruit.
title: Château Bellevue la Forêt 2004 Optimum Red (Fronton)

description: Unusual, a 7-year-old white from Provence that doesn't show signs of age. Maturity yes, with almonds rather than primary fruits, but this wine is developing like an old Riesling, hinting at petrol, while still preserving some fresh pineapple flavors.
title: Domaine Gavoty 2000 White (Côtes de Provence)

description: Made from the Gros Manseng grape, this pineapple and mango flavored wine is dry, but so fruity. The acidity just floats in the mouth, while the slight fruit-skin texture adds an edge to a wine that's delicious.
title: Lapeyre 2006  Jurançon Sec
