description: A very aromatic wine, smoothly textured. Flavors of yellow fruits are spiced up by vanilla from the wood aging. The acidity is light, and almost lost in this rich wine.
title: Domaine Rotier 2009 Renaissance Sec White (Gaillac)

description: A concentrated, tannic-driven wine, with the structured black fruits as a balancing contrast. It is certainly rich, while having a solid structure that promises several years aging.
title: Domaine du Crampilh 2007 L'Originel Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: The dominance of young Sémillon in the blend gives considerable herbaceousness. The wine has a fresh, grassy character, its acidity offering freshness within the full texture.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2010 Cuvée des Conti White (Bergerac Sec)

description: Emphasizing the herbaceous nature of Gros Manseng, this is a ripe, full and fruity wine. The flavors of fresh citrus combine with herbs and broad beans to give a wine with some weight, although with taut final acidity.
title: Château Jolys 2010  Jurançon Sec

description: A herbal wine, its sweetness just an element in a series of crisp, fresh flavors. The wine has weight and concentration, with a tangy texture of lemon zest and exotic fruits.
title: Château Jolys 2009  Jurançon

description: Feathery, lifted notes of citrus, lemon zest and leaf announce a lightness of touch. Some topnotes of chamomile tisane swing alongside. The palate is fresh, taut, dry and light-footed. Deeper notions of fruit are still just hinted at, a core of fruit that still takes time before it is unlocked. Purity and elegance mark this one out.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2014 Cuvée Théo Riesling (Alsace)

description: The lifted, pure scent of damask rose after rain hits you first. It is then joined by riper notions of Mirabelle but always with fresh, airy lift. While the palate weighs this down with perceptible sweetness, the aromas rise unfettered. This is a beautiful wine singing with rose and orange aromatics that persist with a lingering perfume.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2013 Altenbourg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This wine is now in perfect condition. Just mature, it has great swathes of ripe plum and dark berry fruits that are textured with tight, spicy tannins. Balanced and rich, it shows mint and a concentrated structure. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Vignelaure 2009 Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This wine is now in perfect condition. Just mature, it has great swathes of ripe plum and dark berry fruits that are textured with tight, spicy tannins. Balanced and rich, it shows mint and a concentrated structure. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Vignelaure 2009 Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Still way too young, this is developing into a substantial and structured wine. Full of both fruit and tannins, it is dark and dense, very dry at this stage but with the most enticing perfumes. The Grand Cru, split between Chambolle-Musigny and Morey Saint-Denis, is known for its structure and this wine is a great example. Drink from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013  Bonnes-Mares

description: From a vineyard that lies just beneath the Grand Cru vineyards of Gevrey-Chambertin, this is a well-structured wine. It has a smoky character from the wood aging, giving complexity to the red fruits and dense texture. The acidity of the vintage shows strongly, giving a fruity aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Max 2013 Clos Prieur Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: From a vineyard that lies just beneath the Grand Cru vineyards of Gevrey-Chambertin, this is a well-structured wine. It has a smoky character from the wood aging, giving complexity to the red fruits and dense texture. The acidity of the vintage shows strongly, giving a fruity aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Max 2013 Clos Prieur Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: With big, ripe fruits, this powerful wine oozes rich plum and spice flavors. It is dark and intense, concentrated with both acidity and wood aging. A line of freshness gives this dense wine an impressive lift of raspberry and red currant flavors. Drink from 2021.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Petite Chapelle Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Rich, juicy and packed with both wood flavors and delicious red fruits, this concentrated and dense wine has a wonderful sense of freshness. There is a strong mineral texture, with tannins that come from ripe fruit as well as wood. The whole wine is finished with acidity, spice and a full-bodied, rich aftertaste.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Les Cazetiers Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: The wine is dominated by crisp, herbal flavors. With acidity, citrus notes and just a touch of spice, it's fruity and bright. Drink now.
title: Château Lacaussade Saint-Martin 2016 Trois Moulins  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Fruity and lightly spicy from wood aging, this wine has black fruit aromas. It's lightly tannic, with just enough structure to make it an early-drinking wine. Drink now.
title: Château Haut Peyruguet 2016  Bordeaux

description: Fruity and lightly spicy from wood aging, this wine has black fruit aromas. It's lightly tannic, with just enough structure to make it an early-drinking wine. Drink now.
title: Château Haut Peyruguet 2016  Bordeaux

description: This wine is dry, structured and heavily extracted. That leaves a bitter note behind the fruit and acidity. It could have benefited from more gentle winemaking, and although it will soften with age, it will always be tough.
title: Château Brethous 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This ripe, rich wine has solid tannins and still-young blackberry fruit. Although a basic Bordeaux, it is extra rich and extracted and, surprisingly, needs to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Calvet 2015  Bordeaux

description: This floral wine has attractive quince aromas. Its crisp acidity and bright character are upfront, bursting with fruit and freshness. Ready to drink.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2016 Cruet Jacquère (Savoie)

description: This floral wine has attractive quince aromas. Its crisp acidity and bright character are upfront, bursting with fruit and freshness. Ready to drink.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2016 Cruet Jacquère (Savoie)

description: This crisp, dry wine is full of bright red fruit and has a bite of attractive acidity. It refreshes with a lift of red currant fruit on the finish. Drink now.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2016 Tradition Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a perfumed wine with yellow fruit and baked apple flavors. Attractive and with delicious acidity, it's ready to drink now.
title: Château Les Bertrands 2016 Cuvée Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is one of a range of branded wines produced by the Alliance Bourg. It is ripe with red berry fruit and spicy tannins that are beginning to soften. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Mévret 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: This wine is smoky and juicy, with swathes of attractive black currant fruit. It's lightly structured, crisp and likely to age quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Grand Bourgeau 2016  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This shows the soft, juicy side of Malbec. No serious tannins here, just red berry fruit and fine acidity. That means it's ready to drink this winter.
title: Château du Cèdre 2016 Marcel Malbec

description: This bold, purple-colored wine is fruity and soft. Its acidity combines with black fruit and a juicy, lightly tannic texture. Drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2016 Cedrus Malbec

description: This late harvest wine is soft with delicious creamed apple and light honey flavors. It's spicy and attractive to drink as an apéritif.
title: Château de Marsan 2015 Moelleux  (Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: With no added sulfur, this ripe, young wine is broad with spice and some firm tannins. Its berry flavors are still dominated by the structure. Drink from 2018.
designation: Le Petit du Château de Lagarde
title: Château de Lagarde 2016 Le Petit du Château de Lagarde  (Bordeaux)

description: Ripe black plum and berry dominate the nose and mouth on this Merlot, with appropriate accents of coffee granules and black pepper to spice things up. Lightweight but round with a medium-length finish.
title: Delas Frères 2007 Sélection Delas Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A great selection for those seeking an affordable organically grown Merlot. Ripe red berries along with notes of mocha and spearmint unfold on the nose, while red plum and cherry take center stage in the mouth. With solid structure and good balance, this is sure to be a crowd pleaser.
designation: Originel Made with Organically Grown Grapes
title: Barton & Guestier 2008 Originel Made with Organically Grown Grapes Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Fine and fresh, this has clean fruit, a touch of caramel along with crisp white peach and creamy apple. The wine is light, soft, accessible now.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007  Saint-Véran

description: Clean, clear Sauvignon, as fresh as can be, but with some fatness to it. There are good gooseberry and green herb flavors, only the lightest of textures. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2007 La Charnivolle  (Menetou-Salon)

description: Aromas of mulberry, boysenberry, underbrush and dried lavendar lead to notes of black currant, dried herb and crushed granite on the palate. It possesses a smooth mouthfeel with succulent glycerol, balancing acidity and lightly grainy tannins. Moderate in length, with savory and mineral qualities lingering, this will evolve over the next 2–3 years and may hold longer.
region: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: Vignobles Sarrail 2011 Domaine L'Estagnère Red (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: The wine's name comes from the Adour River that flows through the Madiran region. This is dark colored, powerful and spicy, with weight and richness that should allow this to age for at least four years.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2009 Mon Adour Tannat (Madiran)

description: Morel, the general manager at M. Chapoutier, also has his own label, which includes this very attractive wine from Sign­argues, the southernmost villages appellation of the Côte du Rhône. It's full bodied and ripe without being flabby or unstructured, delivering blueberry and blackberry fruit, peppery spice and a long finish that reverberates with fruit and an espresso note.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2009 Signargues Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This selection shows pure black-cherry fruit on the nose, then it folds in hints of flowers, spices, chocolate and coffee on the palate. It's full bodied and creamy in texture without being heavy, then finishes long. Ready to drink, but should easily hold another 5–6 years.
title: Dauvergne & Ranvier 2009 Vin Rare  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: This is a wine that teeters on the edge between superripeness and overripeness. At one moment its fruit comes across as slightly herbal and raspberry-like, while the next it can seem slightly raisined, with a hint of nail polish. It's round and creamy in texture, with a long finish framed in elegant, soft tannins. Drink now–2018.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2009 Lieu-Dit Pignan Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This is a wine that teeters on the edge between superripeness and overripeness. At one moment its fruit comes across as slightly herbal and raspberry-like, while the next it can seem slightly raisined, with a hint of nail polish. It's round and creamy in texture, with a long finish framed in elegant, soft tannins. Drink now–2018.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2009 Lieu-Dit Pignan Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: If the oak integrates better and recedes more into the fruit than I suspect, this rating will look conservative. Right now, oak is front and center, arrayed in ranks of toasted cedar and vanilla. It's full bodied and chewy in texture, with a long, plushly oaky finish. Try after 2015.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2009 Domaine de Roure  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: Enticing acidity, with fresh raspberry fruit, bright in style, just touched by dried sultanas. Drink now.
title: Charles Joguet 2010 Rosé (Chinon)

description: Dominated by herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc, this cool wine is a great alternative New Zealand Sauvignon. It has nettle and gooseberry flavors with an attractive poise and fresh acidity. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Ballade 2009 Sauvignon Blanc/Colombard Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is Baumard's entry-level sparkling wine, with ripe, soft fruit, a creamy texture with some attractive weight and flavors of apples and pears.
title: Domaine des Baumard NV Carte Turquoise Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: A ripe, buttery style of wine, with yellow fruit, toast and a ripe, almost honeyed character. The finish displays some light, zesty acidity.
title: Domaine de la Feuillarde 2008  Mâcon-Prissé

description: Classic southwest France Sauvignon Blanc, bright, fresh and citrus-flavored. Great for summer drinking, clean and delicious.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Reserve Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: From fruit grown in Avize and Aÿ, this pure Chardonnay is mineral textured while also full of ripe fruit. Ripe apples contrast with zingy acidity that gives a good lift at the end. This is a delicious wine to drink now.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Lallier NV Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A beautifully ripe wine with great black fruits that burst through the classic tannins. In its richness and in its structure, it combines the best of the vintage. Dark, complex, fruity and very rich, a magnificent wine for long-term aging.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: While outwardly this wine is generous and opulent with great juicy sweetness, the core is structured and powerful. The wine is concentrated and complex, with dark tannins and a brooding, dense texture. This is a wine with a long-lived future.
title: Château Palmer 2010  Margaux

description: A beautifully dense, ripe wine, its intense acidity balanced by an opulent structure and gorgeous fruits. The texture is smooth and velvety, while never losing sight of the powerful structure. This elegant and powerful wine will age for many years.
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is an architectural wine, very classical in its structure like so many of the top wines of 2010. It's powered by ripe tannins and beautiful black currant fruits. While the wine is gorgeously ripe, it also has a powerful dark and structured character. For long-term aging.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: A beautiful, velvety smooth wine, unusually for Vieux Château Certan dominated by Merlot. It has tannin, to be sure, but these are conveyed through the ripe fruit and the sweetness of the blackberry flavors. It is opulent, although never too much, retaining its elegance. Age for many years.
title: Vieux Château Certan 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: A beautiful, velvety smooth wine, unusually for Vieux Château Certan dominated by Merlot. It has tannin, to be sure, but these are conveyed through the ripe fruit and the sweetness of the blackberry flavors. It is opulent, although never too much, retaining its elegance. Age for many years.
title: Vieux Château Certan 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: A dense, smooth and opulent wine bursting with ripe Cabernet Sauvignon flavors. It's regal and well structured, balancing the natural exuberance of Mouton with a more severe side. This is a wine with power, yet not without its charms from the fruitiness and final acidity. This great wine will age many, many years.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2010  Pauillac

description: A dense, smooth and opulent wine bursting with ripe Cabernet Sauvignon flavors. It's regal and well structured, balancing the natural exuberance of Mouton with a more severe side. This is a wine with power, yet not without its charms from the fruitiness and final acidity. This great wine will age many, many years.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2010  Pauillac

description: A firm and serious wine, complex and complicated, one of the finest wines from 2010 vintage. It has a rich undertow of black fruits, while the tannins dominate at this stage. To add to the powerful range of flavors, the wine has an edge of severity that bodes  well for its long-term future.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: A firm and serious wine, complex and complicated, one of the finest wines from 2010 vintage. It has a rich undertow of black fruits, while the tannins dominate at this stage. To add to the powerful range of flavors, the wine has an edge of severity that bodes  well for its long-term future.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: Dense, yes, but this is also a handsome wine that balances complex tannins with pure black currant fruits that shine. This biodynamic wine has a generous, full and rich feel, ripe with just a touch of restraint. The greatness of the wine shows in its purity with a deceptive simplicity that hides the final complex tannins and structure.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2010  Pauillac

description: A great wine that is just starting out. The high proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives the structured, black currant character. Dark chocolate and layers of wood are forward, revealing how young the wine is. And then the fruit, so rich and powerful, brings deliciousness to the firm, dense structure. Age for many years.
title: Château Margaux 2010  Margaux

description: Stern, almost severe initially, this great wine takes time to show its immense fruit power. Black currant and blackberry notes are packed into the wine, along with an impressive array of spices from new wood that gives a more exotic element. At the end, though, it has a fine, structured sense of proportion. Obviously for aging over decades,  so don't drink before 2022.
title: Château Latour 2010  Pauillac

description: Stern, almost severe initially, this great wine takes time to show its immense fruit power. Black currant and blackberry notes are packed into the wine, along with an impressive array of spices from new wood that gives a more exotic element. At the end, though, it has a fine, structured sense of proportion. Obviously for aging over decades,  so don't drink before 2022.
title: Château Latour 2010  Pauillac

description: A big, bold wine with unbelievable power and concentration. Low yields and a dominance of Cabernet Franc have produced an immensely concentrated wine. Still very young, this magnificent wine holds the promise of great aging.
title: Château Ausone 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: A hugely powerful wine, full of dark, brooding tannins. It's a wine for seriously long-term aging, a sculptural vision of classic Bordeaux structure with with classy, ripe blackberry fruits. It has fresh acidity and an immense full-bodied character, cut through with mineral acidity. A great wine, with great potential.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2010  Saint-Julien

description: This is the finest Cheval Blanc for many years. It is, quite simply, magnificent. The wine shows the greatness of Cabernet Franc in the vintage, with 57% of the variety in the blend. It is beautifully structured and perfumed, with velvety tannins, balanced acidity and swathes of black-currant and black-cherry fruits. It's well on course to becoming a legendary wine.
title: Château Cheval Blanc 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: Almost black in color, this stunning wine is gorgeous, rich and dense. It's grand and powerful, with a strong sense of its own importance. The beautiful tannins and the fragrant black currant fruits are palpable. It's a great wine, with huge potential.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2010  Pauillac

description: Almost black in color, this stunning wine is gorgeous, rich and dense. It's grand and powerful, with a strong sense of its own importance. The beautiful tannins and the fragrant black currant fruits are palpable. It's a great wine, with huge potential.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2010  Pauillac

description: This is the weak link in an otherwise increasingly enjoyable range of wines from Barton & Guestier. Positioned somewhere between off dry and medium sweet, it has an edge of bitter sulphur along with almond and quince fruit flavor. The final acidity jars.
title: Barton & Guestier 2011  Vouvray

description: Ripe and full-bodied, this is a forward, fruity wine. It has pear and apricot flavors, showing rich fruitiness and full floral character. Perfumes come through strongly at the end.
title: Domaine Labet 2011 Fleurs de Savagnin Savagnin (Côtes du Jura)

description: This is a delicious wine, fruity and with good depth of flavor to show both crisp acidity and riper white and yellow fruits. The aftertaste of this fine wine is soft and creamy. Drink now.
title: Domaine de la Gaverie NV Brut  (Vouvray)

description: With very herbal aromas, this wood-aged red has a green quality that detracts from the riper red fruit flavors. Acidity and firm tannins do add structure. It needs time to fully integrate, so drink from 2015.
title: François Millet 2011 Tentation Rouge  (Sancerre)

description: A smooth and ripe wine that is rich in fruit as well as tannins. It has red berry flavors, a direct line in acidity and a texture that brings out both minerality from the limestone soil and dark fruit tannins. Drink from 2014.
title: Domaine de la Perruche 2012 Clos de Chaumont  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: This beautifully balanced wine has a fine texture of steely acidity and ripe fruit tones. Like many Pouilly-Fumé wines, it needs time to mature further to bring out the great fruit and the fine structure that will make this an impressive wine. Drink from 2018
title: Domaine Tinel-Blondelet 2015 Genetin  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This beautifully balanced wine has a fine texture of steely acidity and ripe fruit tones. Like many Pouilly-Fumé wines, it needs time to mature further to bring out the great fruit and the fine structure that will make this an impressive wine. Drink from 2018
title: Domaine Tinel-Blondelet 2015 Genetin  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This is a dry wine, although still retaining those enticing honey flavors that are typical of Loire Chenin Blanc. Apple and ripe pear flavors are laced with intense acidity. Its delicate white-flower perfumes are ethereal. Drink now.
title: Clos du Gaimont 2016  Vouvray

description: Like most Sancerre producers, Roger also draws on vines across the Loire in Pouilly-Fumé. This ripe full wine shows the richness of this appellation and also its potential for aging. Its lime and green-plum fruits are shot through with acidity and balanced by a tangy rich texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2015 Cuvée les Alouettes  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Like most Sancerre producers, Roger also draws on vines across the Loire in Pouilly-Fumé. This ripe full wine shows the richness of this appellation and also its potential for aging. Its lime and green-plum fruits are shot through with acidity and balanced by a tangy rich texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2015 Cuvée les Alouettes  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: From vines planted in 1955, this is a ripe, fruit-packed and mineral-driven wine. It has succulent green fruits, laced with lemon zest and firmly textured. It needs to age for several years to reveal its full potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2012 Fourchaume Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes  (Chablis)

description: From vines on the slopes of Mont Saint-Victoire, this wine has a cool, bright feeling. Citrus fruits and attractive acidity integrate well with its more tangy texture. The wine is elegant, aromatic and ready to drink. The blend is a selection of Syrah, Rolle and Grenache parcels from vineyards at 1,000 feet.
title: Château Gassier 2014 946 Sélection Parcellaire Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: A firm, darkly structured wine. It has a hard edge of smoky wood tannins that dominate the black fruits, so it needs 2–3 years to balance out. It's always likely to be a firm, dense wine.
title: Moillard 2009 Les Saint-Georges Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: From its situation on the plain outside Beaune, Chorey is often overlooked. A wine like this, ripe and smooth, full of red fruit, offers a deliciously juicy drink and represents a great value in red Burgundy. Drink now, or keep for two years.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: One of the classic wines from Drouhin, this concentrated and ripe wine has rich tannins, certainly laced with wood. Plum and red-fruit flavors are a delicious presence to go with the firm, solid structure. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009  Côte de Beaune

description: This 2007 is nearing the end of its shelf life, but it still features a round, ample mouthfeel and pleasant honey, peach and citrus flavors. Drink up.
title: Vignobles La Coterie 2007 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: There is a touch of bitterness in this wine, giving it an edgy character. There is plenty of fruitiness with notes of apple skin and lemon flavors that are bright and fresh. It needs a few months in bottle to fully integrate.
title: Domaine Charles Baur NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Beyond the hard edge of tannins, this is an extracted wine, with dark chocolate and wood flavors. The hints of fruit bring out a more gentle black currant ripeness, although they are far from developing well.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2012  Margaux

description: Beyond the hard edge of tannins, this is an extracted wine, with dark chocolate and wood flavors. The hints of fruit bring out a more gentle black currant ripeness, although they are far from developing well.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2012  Margaux

description: This wine is crisp and packed with both acidity and lively citrus fruits, balanced between fruit and freshness. It makes a good apéritif wine, light and very much in balance. The mostly red-wine property, owned by Régis and Hervé Grandeau, sits on a slope above the Right Bank of the Garonne River only four miles from Bordeaux city.
title: Château Lauduc 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Full of acidity, this is also a really fruity 100% Sauvignon Blanc. Great citrus and green apple flavors go with a mineral edge and a final fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink from late 2015.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Fresh and juicy, with bright acidity and some solid tannins. Flavors of spice accompany an edge of green fruit. The aftertaste is tannins and wood.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2007 Les Carruades de Lafite  (Pauillac)

description: Although the varietal composition isn't typical of Châteauneuf (one-third each Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre), the flavors certainly are, combining baked fruit with dusty earth and touches of leather and spice. It's soft and round in the mouth, with a juicy, mouthwatering finish. Drink now-2015.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2005 Les Bartavelles Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Although the varietal composition isn't typical of Châteauneuf (one-third each Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre), the flavors certainly are, combining baked fruit with dusty earth and touches of leather and spice. It's soft and round in the mouth, with a juicy, mouthwatering finish. Drink now-2015.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2005 Les Bartavelles Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Aromas of fresh cantaloupe melon and apricots, are echoed in the flavors of this tropical fruit wine, which is ripe and full, with the acidity coming from nectarines and some toast.
title: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) 2005 Château Paradis Casseuil  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Lean, with acidity but not high richness, this is a light, simple wine, the fruit flavors edging towards sweet apples.
title: Château d'Arche 2004  Sauternes

description: Lean, with acidity but not high richness, this is a light, simple wine, the fruit flavors edging towards sweet apples.
title: Château d'Arche 2004  Sauternes

description: A fresh, lightly perfumed wine with a smooth, full character. It has flavors of pears, spiced apricots and sweet orange zest, finished with some almost sweet acidity.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Mirail 2007 Colombard (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is an intensely herbaceous wine; all grapefruit and hedgerow fruits with a grassy core. It is light, very fruity, clean and crisp; a typical cool climate Sauvignon Blanc.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2012 Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes du Tarn)

description: This is an intensely herbaceous wine; all grapefruit and hedgerow fruits with a grassy core. It is light, very fruity, clean and crisp; a typical cool climate Sauvignon Blanc.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2012 Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes du Tarn)

description: Firm and dry, dark and dense, this wine has intense concentration and hard tannins. It feels heavily extracted, giving a bitter, burnt edge. The aftertaste just hints at potential juiciness.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: An attractive, fruity wine with black-currant and red-berry juiciness followed by a lightly tannic character. It's a classic for the vintage—light and fruity.
title: Château la Petite Roque 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: An attractive, fruity wine with black-currant and red-berry juiciness followed by a lightly tannic character. It's a classic for the vintage—light and fruity.
title: Château la Petite Roque 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This dry, firm wine shows a hint of bitter extraction, but the core of the wine is smooth. Give it several years' aging.
title: Château des Judes 2011  Bordeaux

description: This dry, firm wine shows a hint of bitter extraction, but the core of the wine is smooth. Give it several years' aging.
title: Château des Judes 2011  Bordeaux

description: An intense and fresh wine that is packed with acidity as well as powerful red fruits. It is breathtakingly fruity at this stage, the structure still developing and giving a delicious perfumed berry character. Drink from 2015.
title: Evening Land 2011 Château de Bligny Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This is a ripe and smoothly textured wine. It is already finely balanced, rich with toast, apricot fruits and a tight, mineral character. It is enjoyable now but will age well until 2022.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2012 Quintessence  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Made from Viognier grown in the Gaillac region, this is a rich wine with tropical and yellow fruit flavors. The wood aging shows gently through the fresh fruit and attractive acidity. The wine is ready to drink, but will improve until 2018.
title: Château Lagrézette 2012 Mas des Merveilles Viognier (Côtes du Lot)

description: From a small estate, this big, ripe and fruity wine has swathes of black fruits to go with the dark, brooding tannins. Very broad and fruity, the wine is always likely to be structured. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Devise d'Ardilley 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Ayala specializes in dry Champagnes and this is their extreme example. It has the right amount of bottle age to soften the intense acidity and bring in some toastiness and fruit. It can be drunk now, but a few more months in bottle would make it even better.
title: Ayala NV Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: A ripe, wood-aged wine, it's richly smoky and fruity at the same time. The blend brings out honey, ripe apricots and peach. Acidity cuts through at the end to give a final, delicious lift. Drink now, but best wait until 2015.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Cami Salié  (Jurançon Sec)

description: This apricot and honey flavored wine is both rich and fresh. The balance between the sweetness, the botrytis and the acidity is just right. It will go well with blue cheese or pâté. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Nigri 2012 Toute une Histoire  (Jurançon)

description: This is taut and minerally, with intense acidity. The structure comes from tangy notes of lemon zest and peach skin. There is some discreet wood aging, but it remains crisp and refreshing.
title: Vincent Prunier 2010  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Soft and rounded, this has an open, fragrant character. It has ripe flavors of strawberries and red plums, with a touch of wood and delicious, fresh acidity. Only on the finish does the structured side show through.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Ile de Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Soft and rounded, this has an open, fragrant character. It has ripe flavors of strawberries and red plums, with a touch of wood and delicious, fresh acidity. Only on the finish does the structured side show through.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Ile de Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Firm from the start, the wine then shows both ripe red-berry fruit and a dense structure. There's an herbal edge that will soften in the next 2–3 years, bringing out the richness of Chambolle.
title: Louis Latour 2010  Chambolle-Musigny

description: Firm from the start, the wine then shows both ripe red-berry fruit and a dense structure. There's an herbal edge that will soften in the next 2–3 years, bringing out the richness of Chambolle.
title: Louis Latour 2010  Chambolle-Musigny

description: This is finely structured, with its ripe tannins forming a solid base for the dense red fruit and spicy wood flavors. It's soli and chunky, showing its youth through the rich texture. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Jean-Claude Boisset 2009 Les Charbonnières  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This is finely structured, with its ripe tannins forming a solid base for the dense red fruit and spicy wood flavors. It's soli and chunky, showing its youth through the rich texture. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Jean-Claude Boisset 2009 Les Charbonnières  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: While this shows the ripeness of the vintage, it remains very minerally in style, with a lemony crispness to match with its white fruit flavor, tight texture and taut finish.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: While this shows the ripeness of the vintage, it remains very minerally in style, with a lemony crispness to match with its white fruit flavor, tight texture and taut finish.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Ripely rich, this is full of soft fruit, with a dominant note of apricot. It has just a touch of spice to add piquancy, while the smooth texture is given a tight edge by a lemon juice flavor. An impressive wine that will age over the next 2–3 years.
title: Domaine Pommier 2010  Chablis

description: This is a light and fruity wine with red-currant fruit and a crisp texture. Coteaux Bourguignons is one of the Burgundy regional appellations that offers, as here, bright fruity wines that are ready to drink young.
title: Domaine Fribourg 2015  Coteaux Bourguignons

description: This pure Cabernet Franc is perfumed and crisply fruity. It has balanced acidity as well as a soft, creamy character. Red-berry fruits go well with a citrus aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Gratien et Meyer NV Brut Rosé Cabernet Franc (Crémant de Loire)

description: The wine comes from the only appellation in Burgundy to grow Sauvignon Blanc, located not far from Chablis. This is classic herbal Sauvignon that is light and fruity with tangerine and citrus flavors and a tropical fruit hint. Drink now.
title: Domaine Gueguen 2015  Saint-Bris

description: This is an off-dry wine, which is not indicated on the label. Honey and lemon flavors partner with ripe pears and lively acidity. The balance is just right, giving a wine that is ready to drink.
title: Cave des Producteurs de Vouvray 2014 Les Dîmes  (Vouvray)

description: A beautifully ripe wine, with the new wood just a hint in the background. The wine has rich red plums and black cherries, laced with the most intense acidity. It is a dense, firmly concentrated wine with a long ahead.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2009 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Juicy red fruits are the veneer on a wine that is structured and complex, full of tight tannins, intense acidity and the promise of a long-term future. The dry center of the wine holds the exuberant fruit flavors together, while the aftertaste is all freshness.
title: Pierre André 2007 Corton les Renardes Grand Cru  (Corton)

description: Juicy red fruits are the veneer on a wine that is structured and complex, full of tight tannins, intense acidity and the promise of a long-term future. The dry center of the wine holds the exuberant fruit flavors together, while the aftertaste is all freshness.
title: Pierre André 2007 Corton les Renardes Grand Cru  (Corton)

description: The top wine from this château is a solid, textured effort. It has a full-bodied feel with very ripe black fruits. With its tarry texture, firm structure and generous fruits, it merits medium-term aging, although it could be drunk now.
title: Château Petit-Freylon 2011 Cuvée Leah Grande Cuvée  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Laden with wood aromas, this is a firm, dry wine. The fruit can cope with the considerable wood flavors, suggesting a wine that will be smooth, rich and velvety. It has weight now, but needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château du Port 2011 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Almost black in color, this very dense, complex wine is tough at this young stage. It needs several years for the powerful tannins to soften, giving a chance for the ripe black plum skin and berry fruits to show. Drink from 2018.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Mon Adour Tannat (Madiran)

description: Argile is French for clay soil, and that terroir gives this wine a full-bodied feel that is ripe and rich. The Sauvignon flavors lean more to tropical, rounded and fruity. It could benefit from some aging, so wait until 2015.
title: Michel Vattan 2012 Cuvée Argile  (Sancerre)

description: Argile is French for clay soil, and that terroir gives this wine a full-bodied feel that is ripe and rich. The Sauvignon flavors lean more to tropical, rounded and fruity. It could benefit from some aging, so wait until 2015.
title: Michel Vattan 2012 Cuvée Argile  (Sancerre)

description: Herbaceous and crisp, this wine shows its steely side before it brings out the fruit. It's mineral in character along with a strongly zesty intensity and a bone-dry, very fresh aftertaste.
title: Les Vignerons des Coteaux Romanais 2013 Domaine du Haut Morlu Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This tight, young wine is shot through with steely acidity and minerality. It tastes of the flinty soil of Pouilly, full in the mouth and concentrated. Give it until 2015 before drinking.
title: Dominique Pabiot 2012 Cuvée Plaisir  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Round and soft, it offers apples, citrus and gooseberries enveloped in a full-bodied texture. An edge of steely background suggests it's a wine for some aging, so wait until 2015.
title: Domaine A. Cailbourdin 2012 Les Cris  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Firm and dry, it's packed with as much tannin as fruit. It has a dark, structured character that's shot through with mint and black currant flavors. The aftertaste is dense and solid. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Gauthier 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Smoky and toasty, this is a structured wine. It has layers of black currant fruits, fresh acidity as well as firm tannins that overlay the juicy fruitiness. It needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Chantemerle 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The name, referring to the flinty soil of the vineyard, says it all. It is a mineral wine that tastes of stony soil, flint and chalk. It has a great core of hardened steel, very firm, surrounded by intense green fruits, filled with apple juice and grapefruit flavors. For aging over 2–3 years.
title: Domaine Fouassier 2008 Les Chailloux  (Sancerre)

description: The name, referring to the flinty soil of the vineyard, says it all. It is a mineral wine that tastes of stony soil, flint and chalk. It has a great core of hardened steel, very firm, surrounded by intense green fruits, filled with apple juice and grapefruit flavors. For aging over 2–3 years.
title: Domaine Fouassier 2008 Les Chailloux  (Sancerre)

description: 89-91 Balanced wine, its acidity marking the red berry fruits. It has a dry, tough core, while the fruit rolls easily through the structure.
title: Château Sénéjac 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 A balanced wine, the fruit shining through the tannins. The wine has power, not excessive, with a jammy character and a light touch of final acidity.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 A balanced wine, the fruit shining through the tannins. The wine has power, not excessive, with a jammy character and a light touch of final acidity.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 This has weight, dark tannins, very taut and mineral. Spice comes from the wood.
title: Château Camensac 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Very structured, the wood permeating the fruit, giving a toasty, spicy character. The fruit shows in the juicy under taste. Extraction might be a problem.
title: Château Tour de Pez 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89-91 Elegant, with spice and ripe stalky fruit, acidity and firm tannins. Juicy black fruit to finish.
title: Château Rolland-Maillet 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Elegant, with spice and ripe stalky fruit, acidity and firm tannins. Juicy black fruit to finish.
title: Château Rolland-Maillet 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Both freshness and richness are well combined in this elegant Sauternes. What it misses in weight, it gains in honey and apricot flavors.
title: Château Raymond-Lafon 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 89-91 Ripe, juicy fruit laced with wood and tannins. The fruit is so black currant jam in flavors that the wine is almost approachable now.
title: Château Preuillac 2010 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 89-91 A balanced and structured wine that shows fine acidity, berry fruits and dashing acidity. With the balance already there, it is developing well in barrel, promising a stylish wine down the road.
title: Château Franc Mayne 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 A balanced and structured wine that shows fine acidity, berry fruits and dashing acidity. With the balance already there, it is developing well in barrel, promising a stylish wine down the road.
title: Château Franc Mayne 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 A wine that is lighted by its acidity. It has weight, certainly, but the dominance is freshness. Extreme final smoky juiciness.
title: Château du Tertre 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 89-91 Concentrated wood aromas, although on the palate fine, tannic black fruits show through the toast. Will be rich and juicy.
title: Château Brown 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 Smooth, ripe wine, its black plum fruits integrating well with acidity and an edge of dusty tannins. The wine has weight, density, good freshness.
title: Château Bouscaut 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Rich and fruity, a real juice bomb of a wine that has black currant and spice fruit to go with its solid, well-integrated tannins.
title: Château d'Agassac 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Toasty aromas on a wine that at this stage is dried by wood. The fruit is at a distance here, although the acidity is very present.
title: Château Carbonnieux 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 A soft, juicy wine, swollen with black currants, having the freshest character in the aftertaste.
title: Château Lalande-Borie 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 A soft, juicy wine, swollen with black currants, having the freshest character in the aftertaste.
title: Château Lalande-Borie 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 Packed with new wood, very polished wine, its tannins smooth and velvet. It has a delicious juicy red berry fruit character that shows a fine elegance.
title: Chateau La Tour Carnet 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 New wood aromas, and a tight palate, very toasty in character. Blackberry juice is under the wood, with the relief of final acidity.
title: Château Fontenil 2010 Barrel sample  (Fronsac)

description: 90-92 A firmly tannic wine, solidly based on a dry texture, the black currant fruits a major element in its texture. It is dark, dry, guarding its freshness for the end.
title: Château de Fieuzal 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Perfumed, juicy wine, fresh, with delicious acidity and blackberry fruits. A fruit bomb of a wine.
title: Château Clément-Pichon 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Structured, ripe wine, full of tight botrytis character and acidity. The wine is spicy, complex, rich.
title: Château Bastor-Lamontagne 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 90-92 All structure and tannin over the austere black fruits. The wine at this stage is powered by its texture rather than the fruit.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90-92 All structure and tannin over the austere black fruits. The wine at this stage is powered by its texture rather than the fruit.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Dominated by its acidity, the tannins firm without being too dry, finely integrated into the rich structure. A fine finish of licorice and black plum skins.
title: Château Cantemerle 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Concentrated, structure, a wine that pushes power and density. The year's acidity adds the necessary freshness. Impressive.
title: Château Broustet 2010 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 90-92 Great structure, great acidity, with the ripe fruit pierced with acidity. The tannins are hugely powerful and dry.
designation: Barrel sample La Dame de Montrose
title: Château Montrose 2010 Barrel sample La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92 Firmly structured, tough in character, a wine that has big fruit and big tannins. Dense and potentially powerful.
title: Château Duplessis 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90-92 A wine that shows acidity, a tension between fruit and richness, delicately structured, very aromatic. The texture shows potential richness.
title: Château Doisy-Védrines 2010 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 90-92 Austere, with a dark character dominated by major tannins. These push the spice character of the wine, the sweet fruit following on behind.
title: Château Tour du Pin 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Austere, with a dark character dominated by major tannins. These push the spice character of the wine, the sweet fruit following on behind.
title: Château Tour du Pin 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Half and half Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this elegant wine comes from Premier Cru vineyards. It's soft and creamy, indicating a high dosage. That is balanced by the crisp fruit and bright acidity that gives the wine a lift. It is a fresh wine, probably best drunk young and fruity.
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Premier Cru  (Champagne)

description: This delicious, crisp wine conveys a great bite of fruit and acidity. It has light tannins, tasty crushed raspberry fruits and lively acidity at the end.
title: Château la Verrière 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This delicious, crisp wine conveys a great bite of fruit and acidity. It has light tannins, tasty crushed raspberry fruits and lively acidity at the end.
title: Château la Verrière 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Bright, crisp and fruity, this is a classic white Bordeaux. It is fresh with just a touch of herbaceousness, followed by a riper orange and green plum character. The aftertaste brings in spice as well as fruity acidity. Produced by Crus et Domaines de France.
title: Château Fonfroide 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Muscadelle blend is rounded and ripe, with yellow fruit flavors to go with the fresher acidity. It shows the ripe, tropical side of the Sauvignon Blanc—rich and full in the mouth. Drink from early 2016.
title: Château Borie de Noaillan 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Muscadelle blend is rounded and ripe, with yellow fruit flavors to go with the fresher acidity. It shows the ripe, tropical side of the Sauvignon Blanc—rich and full in the mouth. Drink from early 2016.
title: Château Borie de Noaillan 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This yeasty, ripe and fruity wine is given great shape by the mineral-taut texture. It is on the dry side, crisp with well-structured apples and pears. The bready character gives extra richness and balances the tight acidity at the end.
title: Charles Ellner NV Carte Blanche Brut  (Champagne)

description: This yeasty, ripe and fruity wine is given great shape by the mineral-taut texture. It is on the dry side, crisp with well-structured apples and pears. The bready character gives extra richness and balances the tight acidity at the end.
title: Charles Ellner NV Carte Blanche Brut  (Champagne)

description: This pure Chardonnay has a tight, nervy mineral texture that gives great freshness as well as a crisp apple skin and lemon zest character. It is fruity, full of lively acidity that goes with the perfumed, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Goutorbe-Bouillot NV Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a wine with potential. For now, it is textured and tight. For the future, plenty of citrus, crisp acidity and ripe apple flavors promise a fruity, fragrant wine. The grapes, vinified in wood, are from the Graves and Entre-Deux-Mers. Drink from 2016.
title: Michel Lynch 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a wine with potential. For now, it is textured and tight. For the future, plenty of citrus, crisp acidity and ripe apple flavors promise a fruity, fragrant wine. The grapes, vinified in wood, are from the Graves and Entre-Deux-Mers. Drink from 2016.
title: Michel Lynch 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Very lightly golden in color, this perfumy wine has fine ripe tropical fruits with a touch of honey and spice. Rounded, full bodied, pepper and acidity at the end. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Zinck 2011 Portrait Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Perfumed wine, all its flavors directed towards a spice-driven lychee character. Rosehip and peppered pineapple are layered with soft, ripe texture. Screwcap.
title: Pierre Sparr 2010 Gewürztraminer (Alsace)

description: With its distinctive herbaceous edge, the wine has a grapefruit-and-citrus character that offers a bright acidity. It has density and richness, fruity and forward.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2010 Domaine Sainte Claire  (Saint-Bris)

description: Toasty aromas are followed by intense black plum fruits twisted with tannins and polished with wood. It's an impressive, powerful wine, with a complex structure. Firm at this stage, it need 4¬–5 years at least to age.
title: Château la Caminade 2008 La Commandery Malbec (Cahors)

description: A gorgeous wine, dark and complex, with assertive leather and licorice spice throughout the boysenberry and bramble character. Touches of graham cracker, tobacco leaf and spice unfold in the mouth. Lush and decadent, with a lingering chocolate-raspberry finish. Enjoyable now, it could show more balance and finesse in 2–3 years.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2007 La Forge Red (Corbières-Boutenac)

description: Built along traditional lines, this claret features soft plummy Merlot fruit accented by leafy tobacco and cassis. Its cedary leanness makes it an ideal foil for rich meat dishes.
title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild 1995 Réserve Mouton Cadet  (Médoc)

description: A solid claret, with cherry and plum fruit accented by dried herbs and a touch of vanilla. This is a basic Saint-Emilion that stays true to its appellation and doesn't try to be more than it is: a user-friendly wine that goes down easy.
title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild 1998  Saint-Émilion

description: With its bold, jammy blackberries and a hint of black pepper on the nose, this wine is all about delivering a flavor punch. Straightforward berry fruit is tinged with licorice in a bulky but satisfying package.
title: Château Val Joanis 1998 Estate Bottled Red (Côtes du Luberon)

description: Impressive dark purple in color, this powerful vin carries lots of toasted-oak aromas: menthol and cedar in particular. There's some promising dark fruit underneath it all that should emerge in a couple years' time. Less exciting than this winery's 1996, which leads to the question: could the creation of a luxury cuvée have had an effect on the quality of this wine?
title: Château Lagrézette 1997 Red (Cahors)

description: Impressive dark purple in color, this powerful vin carries lots of toasted-oak aromas: menthol and cedar in particular. There's some promising dark fruit underneath it all that should emerge in a couple years' time. Less exciting than this winery's 1996, which leads to the question: could the creation of a luxury cuvée have had an effect on the quality of this wine?
title: Château Lagrézette 1997 Red (Cahors)

description: Ripe and smooth, this is rich with red berries. A touch of pepper accompanies a zesty texture that backs up the fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château de Cornemps 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A pure citrus-flavored wine, this is refreshing and light. Its crispness will soften over the next few months, but drink now for the forward fruitiness.
title: Vignerons de Tutiac 2016 Carrelet d'Estuaire  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A light, bright and fruity wine from the Lafite stable, this is a fine apéritif style. Crisp green fruitiness comes with a hint of a more steely character. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) 2016 Légende  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Without any wood aging, the wine shows just the yeastiness from aging on the lees. That fills the palate with spice and a touch of pepper. The wine needs a little more time. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Sauvat 2015 Anthéus Chardonnay

description: The palest pink in color, this wine has a crisp texture but not much fruitiness. It is light with a touch of perfumed acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Thieuley 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a light wine from the stable of offerings from the Courselle sisters. It has a pale character, just hinting at citrus flavors and lively acidity. It is an apéritif style, light, bright and ready to drink.
title: Château Thieuley 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is tart, with considerable crisp acidity. That gives it a fruit-juice freshness, although the acidity should be calmer than it is.
title: Château Haut-Rian 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: The wine tastes sulphured, with suppressed fruit. There is some weight, with caramel and red berry fruit flavors, but it is all muted.
title: Les Vignerons de Grimaud 2010 Cuvée du Golfe de Saint-Tropez Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The estate wine at Mapliers is rich, full-bodied and rounded. It has raspberry and apricot flavors that give it richness. To balance that there is a strong mineral and spice edge along with final acidity. This powerful wine should be aged a few months, so think Thanksgiving and drink from late 2017.
title: Domaine des Mapliers 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a powerfully ripe wine. It has layers of great black fruits and firm tannins. Both indicate a wine for aging. It has a concentrated juicy character along with acidity and a dry structured core. Drink this wine from 2019.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2015 Cuvée Germain Red (Côtes du Tarn)

description: The top wine in the Sanglière range is delicious. With its finely balanced fruit and acidity, it is bright with orange and red-currant crispness as well as a warmer sunny character. With its final acidity it is a great food wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2016 Cuvée Spéciale Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pacherenc wines are the white counterpart to red Madiran, grown in the same area. This dry wine is a blend of Gros and Petit Manseng and the rare Arrufiac. It is a lightly honeyed wine with fine acidity and a really juicy fruity citrus and white-fruit-flavored aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Viella 2015  Pacherenc du Vic Bilh

description: The main estate wine from Roubine is a rich, ripe and fruity with a light edge of spice. It has a soft character, the result of the malolactic fermentation reducing the acidity. That gives a great balance between the red fruits and tangy zesty aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Roubine 2016 Premium Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is crisp and lemony, with intense acidity. It has a spicy note that gives the wine an exotic character, enhanced by lychee fruit. The wine is full in the mouth, really fruity and crisp at the end.
title: Château Roquefeuille 2016 La Combe Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Owned by the Abeille family of Château Mont-Redon in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, this wine is delicious. Crisp and clean with great red currant and citrus fruitiness, it is finely judged with acidity and a light texture balancing the fruit. Drink now.
title: Château Riotor 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wood-aged blend of Merlot and Malbec comes from the range of hills that continue from Saint-Emilion and Castillon in Bordeaux. There are similarities in the richness of this wine giving a fine balance between fruit and acidity. The tannins and the spice from wood aging are showing well, suggesting the wine will age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Laulerie 2014 Comtesse de Ségur  (Montravel)

description: With vines close to the sea, this estate has produced a strongly mineral wine with a firm edge as well as plenty of red-berry fruits. The wine is crisp and full-bodied without losing any of the balancing acidity. Drink the wine now.
title: Château des Bormettes 2016 Argentière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a finely balanced wine. It is dry with its red fruit right to the fore. The acidity and the tangy texture both promise some further aging. This is a great food-style rosé that will be good to drink from late 2017.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Brigue Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A blend dominated by Malbec, this wine comes from one of the estates managed by the Marmande cooperative. It has fine tannins and attractively juicy black fruits. The wine is balanced with plenty of fruity acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2015 Château la Vieille Eglise Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: A blend dominated by Malbec, this wine comes from one of the estates managed by the Marmande cooperative. It has fine tannins and attractively juicy black fruits. The wine is balanced with plenty of fruity acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2015 Château la Vieille Eglise Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Red fruits and a cool edge characterize this wine from the highest elevation of the Beaujolais cru villages. It has red cherry fruitiness, a crisp layer of acidity and a dry, smoky aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Florent Descombe 2016  Chiroubles

description: This is a rich style of Burgundy, broad and full of yellow fruits. These are cut by acidity, a lime-zest character that pushes the fruitiness right forward. Drink now.
title: Florent Descombe 2015  Bourgogne

description: Dark purple in color, this opens with a rich, dense bouquet of blackberry, plum, boysenberry, purple violet and cocoa nib. The plush palate boasts velvety tannins and good overall balance, with earthy, spicy tones that linger through the finish.
title: Fat Bastard 2016 Syrah (Pays d'Oc)

description: The bouquet of this red blend starts off with medium-intense aromas of dried red cherry and raspberry, but transitions into secondary accents of sweet smoke and soft spice. The medium-weight palate is balanced and straightforward. Drink now.
title: Marius 2010 Grenache-Syrah (Pays d'Oc)

description: This attractive, light-colored rosé is dry, but its richness, crushed strawberry flavor and textured acidity neatly combine to produce a crisp, yet full, wine. Ready to drink.
title: Montaudon NV Grand Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: One of the best-known Champagnes on the market, this tastes relatively dry. It isn't losing its bright, open fruitiness, but that quality now joins a structured, mineral-driven edge. This could work as an apéritif or it could be paired with food.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Cordon Rouge Brut  (Champagne)

description: A sweet wine from one of the best Grand Cru vineyards, this is full of ripe spice and is still very young. It offers layers of pepper, lychee fruits and a luscious texture that wraps around the palate. It's going to be excellent; wait until 2018.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2012 Kaefferkopf Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Produced by the same ownership as Château Giscours, this well-made wine has ripe, soft fruit packed with black-currant flavors. The tannins are gentle and the wine will develop quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Tertre 2013  Margaux

description: This wine is coming into balance with wood, acidity and fruit all present. It has a dusty tannic character that's attractive and acts as a good base for the blackberry flavors. The wine will develop quickly, so drink from 2018. Laurent and Sophie Cisneros bought Rouillac with a focus: eliminate chemical pesticides and herbicides. They built a barrel cellar to environmental European standards. The vineyard is 60 acres Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, with five acres of white grapes. Eric Boissenot consults.
title: Château de Rouillac 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine is coming into balance with wood, acidity and fruit all present. It has a dusty tannic character that's attractive and acts as a good base for the blackberry flavors. The wine will develop quickly, so drink from 2018. Laurent and Sophie Cisneros bought Rouillac with a focus: eliminate chemical pesticides and herbicides. They built a barrel cellar to environmental European standards. The vineyard is 60 acres Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, with five acres of white grapes. Eric Boissenot consults.
title: Château de Rouillac 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a finely etched wine with just the right balance between its ripe fruits and tannins. Structured while also juicy, it has a mint and black-currant freshness as well as a dry core that will allow the wine to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Cossieu Coutelin 2012  Saint-Estèphe

description: This Grand Cru Classé, with its 25% Cabernet Franc, is rich and opulently textured. It brims with ripe berry fruits, plus dense tannins that are supple and well integrated. Still developing, it's full in the mouth and is becoming a generous wine, more fruit than long-term structure. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Cap de Mourlin 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Dark in color, this wine is firm, structured and dense. Ripe blackberry fruits dominate the tannins, giving weight and impressive richness for the vintage. The wood-aging is still showing in the dry core, so the wine needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Cantin 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Dark in color, this wine is firm, structured and dense. Ripe blackberry fruits dominate the tannins, giving weight and impressive richness for the vintage. The wood-aging is still showing in the dry core, so the wine needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Cantin 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: On 15 acres on the hill above Angélus and under the same ownership, the vineyard is 100% Merlot. This wine is ripe with red fruits, with a structure that shows the chalk soil. Tannins and a dense texture will allow it to develop over the medium-term. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Bellevue 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: On 15 acres on the hill above Angélus and under the same ownership, the vineyard is 100% Merlot. This wine is ripe with red fruits, with a structure that shows the chalk soil. Tannins and a dense texture will allow it to develop over the medium-term. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Bellevue 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: This is a ripe, full wine with flavors of pineapple and apricots. Still developing, it still has a strongly mineral texture, so wait until 2018. This third-generation family estate hosts monthly musical and tasting events with estate fruit, vegetables and honey for sale.
title: Château Bardins 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: A soft and ripe wine, its Sauvignon Blanc component is well into the tropical fruit spectrum. Pineapple and white fruits give the wine its full, spicy and peppery character. There is just enough acidity to keep it crisp.
title: Château Landonnet 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a soft wine from the warm white vintage of 2015. It is a touch herbal and much more tropical and white fruits. The balance is just right, so drink now.
title: Saveur des Vins de France 2015 Les Portes de Bordeaux  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a soft wine from the warm white vintage of 2015. It is a touch herbal and much more tropical and white fruits. The balance is just right, so drink now.
title: Saveur des Vins de France 2015 Les Portes de Bordeaux  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: The wine is lean with austere tannins and plenty of structure. What is seems to be missing is the fruit potential. It will soften over time, although probably not enough.
title: Château Sémeillan Mazeau 2014  Listrac-Médoc

description: Ripe and fruity, this is already a delicious wine. It shows rich apricot and peach flavors that are balanced by good acidity. The aftertaste with its rich texture and touches of toast shows potential for aging. Drink now to 2020.
title: Domaine Labet 2011 La Bardette Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: A rounded, wood-aged wine that shows rich tropical fruits, pineapple and white peach flavors. Hints of vanilla create a warm feeling. It should be aged until at least 2016.
title: Château d'Estoublon 2011 Grenache Blanc (Vin de France)

description: With its maturity, this wine shows great balance between ripe yellow fruits and toastiness. It provides extra richness and roundness without losing that typical Jura acidity. Drink now.
title: Château d'Arlay 2009 A la Reine Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: With its maturity, this wine shows great balance between ripe yellow fruits and toastiness. It provides extra richness and roundness without losing that typical Jura acidity. Drink now.
title: Château d'Arlay 2009 A la Reine Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: The small, little-known Vaulignot premier cru has produced a juicy, while still mineral wine. Ripe red currant fruit and pineapple flavors give a rich character. It's a delicious wine to drink young like this, although the structure does promise aging until 2019.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2012 Vaulignot Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The extra dry version of Besserat's prestige cuvée is a certainly bone dry. But there is richness as well, so that it offers the hints of yellow fruits as well as crisp apple skin. It has bottle age with a toasty edge that gives further depth. All in all, an attractive, ready-to-drink Champagne that deserves food to bring out its best.
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine is structured and concentrated, showing a strong sense of minerality. Citrus and ripe apple fruits are complemented by richer apricot, always cut through with acidity and a tense texture. It needs to age, drink from 2016.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Strongly wood-aged, this is a ripe, toasty wine. The citrus and creamed apple fruits are still working their way through the wood flavors. It's going to be richly fruity wine with a round texture that is cut by acidity. Give it time and drink from 2018.
title: Louis Jadot 2012 Clos des Guettes Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Strongly wood-aged, this is a ripe, toasty wine. The citrus and creamed apple fruits are still working their way through the wood flavors. It's going to be richly fruity wine with a round texture that is cut by acidity. Give it time and drink from 2018.
title: Louis Jadot 2012 Clos des Guettes Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: With half the blend Chardonnay, this has a crisp and steely character. It also has richness and the first signs of maturity. It is full in the mouth, an elegant Champagne that would be good to drink now, but will also develop further.
title: Boizel 2004 Grand Vintage  (Champagne)

description: Soft, ripe and fruity, this has a generous texture rounded with an attractive touch of toastiness and rich pear flavors. At the end, with its steely aftertaste and acidity, the wine shows a firmer structure and density. It's very much in the rich Ruinart style.
title: Ruinart NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The style of Piper-Heidsieck's nonvintage Champagne is getting more and more refined. It is drier than in the past while also full of ripe white fruits. There is a tight structure, a hint of toast from bottle age and fresh acidity at the end. Ready to drink.
title: Piper-Heidsieck NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: Firm tannins and concentrated black fruit flavors set this wine up for long-term aging. It has a solid core that gives it dryness at this young stage. But the bold blackberry fruit and acidity will come through to produce a generous, balanced wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Vieux Château des Combes 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: Aged in wood, this smoothly textured wine is rich with spice and creamed pear and melon flavors. Its acidity cuts easily through the ripe fruitiness and oak-derived toast. At three years old, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Rotier 2014 Renaissance Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac)

description: This wine is rich and rounded, with some wood flavors and plenty of spice. Creamy with swathes of ripe pear and quince flavors, it's just now ready to drink and has a great balance between acidity and richness.
title: Domaine Dugois 2015 Terre de Marne Chardonnay (Arbois)

description: Apricot and orange flavors are still right up front in this rich wine. Its acidity and poise show a balance that is delicious now. The aftertaste is crisp, cool and stylish.
title: Château Simon 2009 Cuvée Exceptionelle  (Sauternes)

description: This young wine is packed with firm tannins and juicy black plum fruit. Its structure of tannins, both from the fruit and from wood aging, gives it a rich texture. It's spicy and ripe and needs some aging. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Nozières 2015 Amrboise de l'Her Malbec (Cahors)

description: Concentrated and smoky, this wine has plenty of black cherry and black currant fruit. Its firm tannins promise that aging that will make it a richly endowed wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Château les Petits Arnauds 2015 Excellence  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Mint aromas from new oak aging and spice and toast notes on the palate are part of this young, firm-structured wine. It 's powerful and dense, with great black fruit and acidity. A dry core of tannins indicates it will age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château le Grand Moulin 2015 Prélude No. 15  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Mint aromas from new oak aging and spice and toast notes on the palate are part of this young, firm-structured wine. It 's powerful and dense, with great black fruit and acidity. A dry core of tannins indicates it will age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château le Grand Moulin 2015 Prélude No. 15  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is juicy and fruity, with generous tannins that support its ripe black fruit and balanced acidity. It has a smoky edge and will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Le Cap 2015 Excellence  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This soft wine is still waiting for its intensity to come through. The acidity is there, as is ripe, honeyed fruit. Wait until 2022 to open it.
title: Château la Tour Blanche 2014 Charmilles  (Sauternes)

description: This is a fruity, juicy wine with swathes of black currant and berry flavors. The tannins give a smoky, spicy character and add to the sense of richness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Fredignac 2015 La Favorite  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: While this wine has obviously seen plenty of wood aging, it's also full of dark blackberry fruit. Together, those qualities give density and structure, with acidity and fruitiness to match. Drink from 2021.
title: Château de Marsan 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This serious wine is beginning to mature. Its spicy wood and mint flavors are now integrating with the rich structure. The finish is bright in a final burst of fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Barton & Guestier 2012 Thomas Barton Réserve Privée  (Médoc)

description: While there are plenty of firm tannins and weight here, the wine does feel somewhat hollow. The red fruits are there, showing slowly against the tannins. It has fine final acidity, but not the power and concentration you should expect.
title: Manuel Olivier 2008  Clos de Vougeot

description: Rounded and soft, very approachable. It has attractive raspberry fruit and lively acidity, while the structure evolves slowly to show the dry edge of tannins and smoky aftertaste. For drinking now and over 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2008 Clos Genet  (Santenay)

description: Rounded and soft, very approachable. It has attractive raspberry fruit and lively acidity, while the structure evolves slowly to show the dry edge of tannins and smoky aftertaste. For drinking now and over 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2008 Clos Genet  (Santenay)

description: There's a strong herbal presence in the bouquet of this wine (bay leaves, clover) that marries well with the red plum and dried raspberry flavors. The mouth is smooth and creamy with a touch of tobacco spice lingering on the close. Drink now–2012.
title: Château de Lancyre 2008 Coste d'Aleyrac Pic Saint-Loup Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: This entry-level wine of the Saint André de Figuière range is pretty impressive in itself. It has a rounded, smooth character that is lifted by attractive red berry acidity and a nervy, mineral texture. Balanced acidity completes the picture.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2014 Cuvée Signature Magali Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: One of the lightest rosés in color, this wine does have plenty of flavor as a contrast. It is ripely fresh, full of red fruits and delicious, refreshing acidity. It has the fruit weight of a Sainte-Victoire wine, full right to the end.
title: Domaine des Diables 2014 Bonbon Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: With 50% Mourvèdre in the blend, this is an aromatic, ripe and complex wine. It has a sense of structure, with tannins as well as zesty orange and layers of spice. The aftertaste is more floral and fresh, although there is a touch of pepper right at the end.
title: Domaine des Baguiers 2014 Rosé (Bandol)

description: Orange-pink in color, this is a ripe, full-bodied wine. It offers red fruits along with apricot and peach. Together with its lightly peppery texture and edge of caramel, it is a rich wine to go with food.
title: Château Saint-Maur 2014 M Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a selection from parcels on the Rimauresq estate. Well balanced, it has enough weight and texture to be food-friendly. Intense red fruits dominate, put easily against fresh acidity that finishes the wine with a lift.
title: Château Rimauresq 2014 R de Rimauresq Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a selection from parcels on the Rimauresq estate. Well balanced, it has enough weight and texture to be food-friendly. Intense red fruits dominate, put easily against fresh acidity that finishes the wine with a lift.
title: Château Rimauresq 2014 R de Rimauresq Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh citrus aromas follow through to the crisp, lemon and grapefruit flavors of this wine. To balance, a tangy texture, red currant fruits and intense acidity give this tasty wine all its poised presence. This blend of Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah and Mouvédre is from certified organic vineyards.
title: Château les Valentines 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The heavy bottle signals this is statement rosé. It's certainly rich, full in the mouth with spice, acidity and tangerine flavors mingling well together. The wine is deliciously textured and could do with some more aging. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château Hermitage Saint-Martin 2014 Ikon Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a pretty wine with its elegant pale color and delicious fruit. Made from organically grown Grenache (85%) and Cinsault (15%), it is crisp, full of fresh red currant fruit and has a nervy, very fresh aftertaste.
title: Château Henri Bonnaud 2014 Terre Promise Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is a pretty wine with its elegant pale color and delicious fruit. Made from organically grown Grenache (85%) and Cinsault (15%), it is crisp, full of fresh red currant fruit and has a nervy, very fresh aftertaste.
title: Château Henri Bonnaud 2014 Terre Promise Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Light, fruity and balanced, this combines acidity, red fruit and a bright feel. For drinking over this year.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2011 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a lightly sweet wine that has perfumed apricot and orange fruits. Balanced with acidity, this would be just right as an apéritif.
title: Château le Raz 2010 White (Côtes de Montravel)

description: The structure is present as is the bright black-currant fruit. It has some richness, although it is tempered with acidity and a stalky character. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2010 Cuvée Alliance Red (Bergerac)

description: The structure is present as is the bright black-currant fruit. It has some richness, although it is tempered with acidity and a stalky character. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2010 Cuvée Alliance Red (Bergerac)

description: A bulky wine with an ample mix of cherry and chocolate flavors, this Gigondas is a big, fairly rich mouthful but is slightly lacking for nuance. Give it another year or two to see if more develops.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2009  Gigondas

description: This smooth, easygoing blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah is a pleasant surprise, offering up bright raspberry fruit and a hint of chocolaty richness. Drink it over the next year or so.
