description: This lemon- and pear-flavored wine has an attractive, fresh fruitiness, tight acidity and a very crisp feeling. It is light and bright.
designation: Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2012 Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A ripe and fruity wine, the lemon flavors are complemented by rich melon and orange zest. It's a wine that has a dense texture, with the acidity well integrated into the fruitiness.
title: Bougrier 2012 Château du Jaunay Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Fruity strawberry flavor leads this ripe and soft wine. The palate has a crisp edge to it, with touches of orange zest. The aftertaste, light and delicate, is laced with minerality.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Fruity strawberry flavor leads this ripe and soft wine. The palate has a crisp edge to it, with touches of orange zest. The aftertaste, light and delicate, is laced with minerality.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With some good bottle age, this is a soft, biscuit- and almond-flavored wine. There is a crisp edge from the grapefruit flavor underneath, making this a Champagne that's full of character and ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Classic Brut  (Champagne)

description: A brilliantly strawberry-flavored rosé, this is crisp and fresh with lively acidity. There's a tight citrus texture, but the main thrust of this delicious summer rosé is fruitiness.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A dry style of wine that only slowly reveals its juicy character to bring out a warmer, richer side. It also does show considerable toast and spiciness along with firm tannins all of which still need to fully integrate. So don't drink until 2016.
title: Château d'Uza 2010  Graves

description: A dry style of wine that only slowly reveals its juicy character to bring out a warmer, richer side. It also does show considerable toast and spiciness along with firm tannins all of which still need to fully integrate. So don't drink until 2016.
title: Château d'Uza 2010  Graves

description: A rich and rounded wine whose tannins are well buried in the ripe blackberry fruits. It's a dark wine, solidly dry at the core with great swathes of juicy fruit around. It's almost ready to drink so try it out in 2014.
title: Château de Paillet-Quancard 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: An obviously wood aged wine, with burnt toast and spice dominant at this young stage. Happily, there is enough black currant fruit and fruity acidity underneath to support this overdose of wood. Give it time to fully integrate, and drink from 2016.
title: Château Bois Cardon 2011  Médoc

description: An obviously wood aged wine, with burnt toast and spice dominant at this young stage. Happily, there is enough black currant fruit and fruity acidity underneath to support this overdose of wood. Give it time to fully integrate, and drink from 2016.
title: Château Bois Cardon 2011  Médoc

description: This is soft, full of ripe white fruit flavors. The wine is broad, showing some freshness along with the forward richness. It is likely to age relatively quickly.
title: Louis Latour 2008  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This is soft, full of ripe white fruit flavors. The wine is broad, showing some freshness along with the forward richness. It is likely to age relatively quickly.
title: Louis Latour 2008  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: A wine with just the right Meursault opulence already the dominant character. The wine is fat, ripe, not losing sight of acidity or freshness, combining yellow fruits with a crisp, citrus final streak.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2007  Meursault

description: Broad and ripe, this is textured with some citric character, its acidity cutting through the green plum flavors. The aftertaste is freshly mouth watering.
title: Cave de Lugny 2008 Les Beluses  (Mâcon-Chardonnay)

description: A wonderfully balanced wine, this shows a vanilla note that harmonizes with its ripe tropical fruit and a distinct touch of minerality. Wood aging shows through on the finish.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2010 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Structured, dense and packed with black fruits, this is complex wine. Yet with all of its ripeness, it offers a great line of freshness and a smoky wood flavor, with blackberry-like acidity on the finish. Age for five years or more.
title: Domaine Drouhin-Laroze 2010 Lavaut Saint-Jacques Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This is crisp, with citrus and red apple fruits that are heightened by the taut structure. Nervy acidity adds to the tense feel while judicious layers of wood warm the finish. For long-term aging.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010 Les Chenevottes Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is dark and wood laden, with sweet, rich fruit and a firm, dense structure. It has a full feel, and its opulence is likely to develop over the next 2–3 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009 Clos des Fèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Using grapes sourced from 50-year-old vines, this is a powerful expression of rich Chardonnay. It has great depth of flavor, with concentrated, intense and ripe yellow and white fruits, spiced from having aged in the wood. Allow to age for over five years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2009 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is grandiose, with ripe apricot and peach flavors—even a note of mango—that are allied to the wood notes. As a contrast, there is fine acidity and elegance, with a lemon zest edge that gives structure to this full, superripe, powerful effort.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This is grandiose, with ripe apricot and peach flavors—even a note of mango—that are allied to the wood notes. As a contrast, there is fine acidity and elegance, with a lemon zest edge that gives structure to this full, superripe, powerful effort.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009  Corton-Charlemagne

description: A minerally textured wine, this layers tannins and a dark, brooding character over the ripe black fruits. It has considerable power and richness, with intensity of fruit and spice, and a sweet, almost soft finish.
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010 Les Beaux-Monts Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This shows a hint of mineral along with tropical fruit. This is a seductive combination that shows richness and a taut, nervy character. Age for at least six years.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2010 Montmains Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This shows a hint of mineral along with tropical fruit. This is a seductive combination that shows richness and a taut, nervy character. Age for at least six years.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2010 Montmains Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is concentrated, but it's all structure at this stage. It has rich black fruits that lie under the dense tannins, with a potentially rich powerhouse of flavor. It needs at least six years of aging.
title: Domaine Heresztyn 2010  Clos Saint-Denis

description: Wood and ripe fruit flavors drive this explosively fruity wine. Its richness is balanced by the acidity from green apple and lime fruits. Spice from the wood aging adds piquancy, leads to a final burst of textured minerality.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Les Pucelles Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This is complex and powerful, with its energy directed equally at the concentrated tannins and at the ripe damson and plum fruits. It's going to be a delicious wine—the wood element smoothing the firm edge. Age for at least five years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Epenots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: This is complex and powerful, with its energy directed equally at the concentrated tannins and at the ripe damson and plum fruits. It's going to be a delicious wine—the wood element smoothing the firm edge. Age for at least five years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Epenots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A firm, powerful wine, its tannins still very dominant. Acidity is a factor, along with deep red-plum fruit. Some sweetness will develop in the next several years, although this concentrated and complex wine will also have a solid core of dry, structured tannin. Age for at least five years.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Château Corton Grancey  (Corton)

description: A firm, powerful wine, its tannins still very dominant. Acidity is a factor, along with deep red-plum fruit. Some sweetness will develop in the next several years, although this concentrated and complex wine will also have a solid core of dry, structured tannin. Age for at least five years.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Château Corton Grancey  (Corton)

description: One of a range of single-vineyard wines from Château de Fuissé, this is powerful and complex. It's intense, with white fruit flavors that are laced with concentrated, wood-influenced notes. It has an opulent, generous feel, while remaining structured.
title: Château de Fuissé 2010 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: It's plump and juicy, yet not devoid of structure, blending Asian pear and citrus aromas and flavors with nectarine skin and bitter almond. There's a softness to the finish that causes it to lose a little definition but helps it go down easy.
title: Louis Latour 2000  Meursault

description: This wine is so typical of the area. It's defined by a stony, dry nose, citrus and tropical fruit flavors, a lean, tight finish and mouth-cleaning acids. It's hardly the deepest, most complex wine you'll find, but not all good wines have to be complicated.
title: Domaine A. Cailbourdin 2000 Le Cris  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Cleaner than the producer's Pouilly-Fumé, with gooseberry and popping citrus aromas, this wine is still a bit lean. But it does offer nice grapefruit and green apple flavors atop a very tight structure. All in all, it's crisp and easy to drink, which is what a basic Sancerre should be.
title: Lacheteau 2000 Sancerre  (Sancerre)

description: Wood and ripe fruitiness are the hallmarks of this open, rounded wine.Attractive apple and citrus flavors give a lemon zest character. At the end, the acidity comes in strongly.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2012 Mersault-Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Lively, crisp and fragrant, this offers fresh acidity and a fruit salad of flavors, along with a creamy textured mousse. With its slight spiciness, it's best as an apéritif.
title: Cave Freudenreich NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This firm wine still needs to shed its youthful structure of tannin and bring out the underlying ripe fruits. It has weight, hints of juicy acidity and a medium-term potential. The end shows some of the natural concentration from old vines.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Fresh and crisp, this is a blend of Pinot Blanc, Chardonnay and Auxerrois. It has a bright aromatic character, citrus and apple flavors and a fruity aftertaste.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Pinot Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fresh and crisp, this is a blend of Pinot Blanc, Chardonnay and Auxerrois. It has a bright aromatic character, citrus and apple flavors and a fruity aftertaste.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Pinot Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This medium-dry Champagne is attractively structured and really fruity. It does have something of the mineral texture of a drier Champagne that is contrasted with apricot and honey highlights. It is ready to drink.
title: Piper-Heidsieck NV Cuvée Sublime Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: This medium-dry Champagne is attractively structured and really fruity. It does have something of the mineral texture of a drier Champagne that is contrasted with apricot and honey highlights. It is ready to drink.
title: Piper-Heidsieck NV Cuvée Sublime Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: The aromas of this pretty, refreshing rosé are delicate and subtle at first. Faint scents of white cherry, raspberry and red-apple skin build strength and concentration on the medium-weight palate. The mouthfeel is bright, juicy and mouthwatering, while a toasty, spicy accent unfolds on the finish. Drink now.
title: Côté Mas NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Limoux)

description: The aromas of this pretty, refreshing rosé are delicate and subtle at first. Faint scents of white cherry, raspberry and red-apple skin build strength and concentration on the medium-weight palate. The mouthfeel is bright, juicy and mouthwatering, while a toasty, spicy accent unfolds on the finish. Drink now.
title: Côté Mas NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Limoux)

description: Scents of violet, brambly berry and blackcurrant leaf lead the bouquet of this earthy blend, with a light gamy character in the background. The palate is bright and lively, with attractive freshness and fine tannins that result in a clean, juicy finish.
title: Belles Vignes 2014 Grenache-Syrah-Marselan Red (Vin de France)

description: This wine is tight with the lightest hints of riper fruit in the future. It has spice, toast flavors and suggestions of yellow fruit. Wait to drink this wine until 2017.
title: Domaine des Valanges 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This wine has a creamy, smooth character. Lightly buttery and with some ripe pear flavors, it is soft, refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de l'Echelette 2015  Mâcon-Cruzille

description: Ripe yellow fruits shine through this attractive wine. It has a fresh, crisp side with lemon acidity that nicely balances the warm, rounded texture. It delivers a crisp, more mineral aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Tramier et Fils 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: The nose of this wine is all fruit—strawberry, raspberry and cherry abound. Flavor wise, the accessible palate offers more of the same, with light tannins and ample acidity to keep the mouthfeel fresh and the finish clean.
title: Kiwi Cuvée 2014 Bin 518 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This is a very aromatic wine, full of rose-petal aromas. A palate of ripe strawberries, soft acidity and a rich texture finishes on a high note of tangy lemon and raspberries.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine Fredavelle Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Crisp, light and fruity, this wine is attractively balanced between its acidity and a light touch of vanilla. In the background, fragrant red fruits give a juicy aftertaste to this delicious wine.
title: Château de Brigue 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This fresh, crisp, textured wine has pepper as well as red fruit flavors. There's a touch of spice, ripe strawberries and delicious final acidity.
title: Château Cavalier 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This fresh, crisp, textured wine has pepper as well as red fruit flavors. There's a touch of spice, ripe strawberries and delicious final acidity.
title: Château Cavalier 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Organically grown grapes give this wine a pure and fruity character that makes it instantly attractive. It is crisp, laced with lemon and lively, juicy red fruits. The aftertaste is dry and full of flavor.
title: Domaines Pierre Chavin 2014 Pierre & Paul Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This single-parcel wine gives fresh youthful acidity and bright white and citrus fruitiness. It's chalky textured, steely in its character and crisp and nervy at the end. Drink from late 2015
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2013 Les Champréaux  (Chablis)

description: There is a definite touch of stalkiness here, perhaps a consequence of the vintage. It has black currant fruits and balanced acidity, needing a few more months to be developed. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Houchart 2013 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: There is a definite touch of stalkiness here, perhaps a consequence of the vintage. It has black currant fruits and balanced acidity, needing a few more months to be developed. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Houchart 2013 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light and fresh, this is a crisp and tangy wine. Attractive acidity dominates and gives life to the bright red fruits. A slice of lemon brings a tangy dimension to this juicy, fragrant wine.
title: Château Montaud 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light and fresh, this is a crisp and tangy wine. Attractive acidity dominates and gives life to the bright red fruits. A slice of lemon brings a tangy dimension to this juicy, fragrant wine.
title: Château Montaud 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a pale-colored wine, very fruity and crisp with an impressively refreshing quality. A touch of pepper gives interest to this dry, easy-drinking wine.
title: Château de Saint-Martin 2014 Cuvée Grande Réserve Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Developed aromas of forest floor and mushrooms come as no surprise, given the deep brick color on this Alsace Pinot. The highly nuanced palate is complex and shot through with mineral notes. Cherry cola flavors dominate the long finish. An excellent foil for squab or other game birds.
title: Pierre Sparr 2003 Presitge Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A blend with mainly Rolle and some Clairette, this is light, bright and crisp. Floral aromas lead to sliced apple and lime juice flavors that offer lively acidity and a tangy, zesty aftertaste. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G White (Côtes de Provence)

description: The steep south-facing Chêne Marchand vineyard provides fruit for this very concentrated and impressive wine. Its weight doesn't come from richness, but rather a powerful structure that underpins a mineral tang and intense freshness.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2010 Le Chêne Marchand  (Sancerre)

description: This is a crisp, fresh wine with red-currant fruits and light tannins from the Alliance Bourg co-op. It is juicy and fruity, likely to develop quickly to give a light, bright wine.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine has red fruits and tannins along with acidity. The 25-year old vines have produced a rich wine that is all about fruit and acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Motte Maucourt 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine has red fruits and tannins along with acidity. The 25-year old vines have produced a rich wine that is all about fruit and acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Motte Maucourt 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: High spice and toast flavors dominate this wine. The wood use is masking the fruit, probably too enthusiastically. It should soften, although not enough.
title: Château La Bourrée 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: High spice and toast flavors dominate this wine. The wood use is masking the fruit, probably too enthusiastically. It should soften, although not enough.
title: Château La Bourrée 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Fresh and fragrant, this is a lively, bright and tangy wine. With crisp acidity and raspberry fruit that is twisted with orange peel it is ready to drink.
title: Château de Blaignac 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: While the wine is dry at this young stage, it has fine potential. Generous fruits and firm tannins give it richness and a juicy character. Drink the wine from 2018.
title: Château Séguin 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a fresh and juicy organic wine with attractive acidity and just the right balance of tannins. Drink this wine soon, certainly from 2018.
title: Château Roland-La-Garde 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is an open fruity wine with attractive red berries and concentrated tannins. It is developing well into a ripe perfumed wine that will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château Pey La Tour 2014  Bordeaux

description: This fresh Saint-Chinian rosé exhibits a beautiful, earthy, floral core, as notes of peony and baby's breath take center stage against a soft white strawberry and peach backdrop. Medium weight with good, lifting acidity and a clean, refreshing finish.
title: G. Moulinier 2010 Rosé (Saint-Chinian)

description: While the wine does have considerable tannins, it also has the ripe Merlot fruit to support it. Good acidity, black currant fruits, smoky wood, all the elements are there. It will always be firm, but should mature well.
title: Château Rocher-Bonregard 2008  Pomerol

description: Big, structured tannins lie over the ripe fruit. The wine has a dense character, the young tannins dominant. Given a year, the fine fruit will come through to give a sweeter blackberry character.
title: Château Bertinerie 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This nonvintage cuvée sums up the Gosset style in its precise texture and crisp, taut acidity. A blend of fruit from the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs, it shows some attractive maturity. Given its balanced, perfumed aftertaste and great fruitiness, this is a Champagne to drink now.
title: Gosset NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: This most recent release of vintage rosé from Deutz boasts fine acidity and crisp young fruit, marking it as a wine to age. Bright and lively with a sophisticated edge of acidity and red currant fruit, it should be cellared until 2019.
title: Deutz 2012 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this attractive wine is creamy and fruity, with delicious acidity and a smooth texture. Finely balanced with a touch of toastiness, it's crisp on the finish and drinkable now. The name means “little vines,” a reference to the small quantity produced.
title: Baron-Fuenté NV Galipettes Brut  (Champagne)

description: Pure Pinot Meunier from a select parcel of vines called La Grosse Pierre, this impressive limited-production bottling is an anomaly in Champagne. It fits Huré's crisp style yet also has rich fruitiness and generous acidity. Drink now.
title: Huré Frères NV 4 Eléments Pinot Meunier (Champagne)

description: This impressive Champagne is rich while tight and mineral-textured. Creamy and ripe, it balances the weight of Pinot Noir with the elegance of Chardonnay. The producer's location in the relatively warm Aube region gives its wines extra fullness. This one is just now ready to drink.
title: Fluteau 2008 Cuvée Symbiose Brut  (Champagne)

description: Still young, this is a ripe fruit-driven wine. It suggests green apple slices as well as warmer yellow fruits that give richness. It should be aged to bring out greater texture and character. Drink from 2017.
title: Veuve Doussot 2011 Cuvée Ernestine Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: Still young, this is a ripe fruit-driven wine. It suggests green apple slices as well as warmer yellow fruits that give richness. It should be aged to bring out greater texture and character. Drink from 2017.
title: Veuve Doussot 2011 Cuvée Ernestine Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: This complex rosé effortlessly combines hints of flowers, dried spices, garrigue and red berries. It's full-bodied yet paradoxically weightless, buoyed by a long finish of crushed stone and fresh lime juice. Drink it over the next few years.
title: Domaine Maby 2014 Prima Donna  (Tavel)

description: Coming from premier cru vineyards, this lively wine is beautifully ripe with a balanced dosage lying under the white and yellow fruitiness. The fruit gives the wine a rich character, full and creamy in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Charles Ellner NV Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Coming from premier cru vineyards, this lively wine is beautifully ripe with a balanced dosage lying under the white and yellow fruitiness. The fruit gives the wine a rich character, full and creamy in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Charles Ellner NV Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a very spicy wine with weight, great depth of flavor and concentration. Fine acidity cuts through the core, balancing sweetness and adding freshness to flavors of wild thyme-honey and orange marmalade. Drink the wine from 2017.
title: Château Coutet 2010  Barsac

description: This is a luxurious wine that's opulently rich. Ripe black fruits dominate, lending fullness to the firm structure in the backdrop. It's a wine with great potential, density and weight. Touches of chocolate and licorice combine with flavors of dark plum, toast and spice. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lynch-Bages 2011  Pauillac

description: Dense and opulent, this is a fine, ripe wine. There is great weight here, along with flavors of nutmeg and white peach. Acidity and a firm, youthful texture all promise aging. Drink this wine from 2017.
title: Château Lafaurie-Peyraguey 2010  Sauternes

description: Great swathes of fruit cross the tannic core in this impressive wine. Hints of wood aging peek out from beneath the sumptuous richness and spice. It is ripe, dense and obviously set for long aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Léoville Barton 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Great swathes of fruit cross the tannic core in this impressive wine. Hints of wood aging peek out from beneath the sumptuous richness and spice. It is ripe, dense and obviously set for long aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Léoville Barton 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Big tannins and impressive fruits are the hallmarks of this impressive wine. It is also subtle, not showing all its flavors at once, hiding beneath tannins and structure. For this fruity vintage, it shows a strong sense of direct, solid structure, only allowing the strong black plum and berry flavors to come through slowly. It is for the long haul, so don't drink before 2022, even better later.
title: Château Latour 2011  Pauillac

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. The second wine of Cheval Blanc is surprisingly soft and ripe—full of blackberry fruits—with delicious acidity and a lingering black-currant aftertaste.
title: Le Petit Cheval 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A fine, dense, opulent wine with a great sense of structure. It's dark and solid with tannins that are dense, dusty and brooding. It's likely to age well.
title: Le Carré 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A fine, dense, opulent wine with a great sense of structure. It's dark and solid with tannins that are dense, dusty and brooding. It's likely to age well.
title: Le Carré 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Surrounded by the city of Libourne, Quinault l'Enclos has produced a Merlot-dominated wine that's ripe and soft on the palate. There's a good sense of structure, balancing fresh black-currant flavors with delicious acidity.
title: Château Quinault L'Enclos 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A ripe and fruity wine, this exhibits an well-structured balance of acidity and sweet tannins. It has weight, richness, and a fine fruitiness.
title: Château Petit-Village 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A ripe and fruity wine, this exhibits an well-structured balance of acidity and sweet tannins. It has weight, richness, and a fine fruitiness.
title: Château Petit-Village 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a solid wine showing chunky richness that chimes with the black fruit of the vintage. It's full and ripe, but still shines with fresh fruit character.
title: Château Nenin 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Firm tannins guard the ripe blackberry flavors on this rich wine. Spice and sweet tannins add to the intensity.
title: Château la Pointe 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Owner Alain Moueix is a standard bearer for biodynamics in Bordeaux. This is a rich and opulent wine, boasting ripe black currants and fragrant fruits. A very pure and forward wine.
title: Château Fonroque 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Owner Alain Moueix is a standard bearer for biodynamics in Bordeaux. This is a rich and opulent wine, boasting ripe black currants and fragrant fruits. A very pure and forward wine.
title: Château Fonroque 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This solid wine is dark with tannins and a dense, extracted texture. The palate is weighty with an intensely dry core and a serious, mineral character. For long-term aging.
title: Château Dassault 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. The second wine of Château Valandraud is richly powered by spice from new wood and delicate acidity. It's smooth—showing opulent tannins—and attractive freshness.
title: Château Valandraud 2012 Virginie de Valandraud Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and smoky wine with lively acidity. It also has dense black fruits and a firmly tannic character that demands aging. Solid in texture, it's touched by notes of licorice with a bitter edge.
title: Château Providence 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. The only Grand Cru Classé on the sandy plain of Saint-Emilion, Monbousquet is producing great wines thanks to huge investments by owner Gerard Perse. This Merlot-dominated blend is ripe, spicy, rich and open.
title: Château Monbousquet 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Newly promoted to Premier Grand Cru Classé in 2012, this is a fine, concentrated wine, showing great style. It has weight and a delicious juiciness that is sustained by firm, dry tannins. Already a beautiful wine.
title: Château Larcis Ducasse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This is a fruity wine, dominated by delicious black currant flavors. It has a firm background of fine, complex tannins and a fragrant, lingering aftertaste.
title: Château Faugères 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This dense, extracted wine has dark coffee and bitter chocolate flavors that are followed by wood and tannins. The fruit is still obscured, and may need many years for its dark character to emerge.
title: Château Canon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Tight, firm and mineral in style, this wine is dark with expressive tannins cast over black fruits. As always, the wine is a complex expression of its fine terroir.
title: Les Astéries 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This concentrated wine is packed with new wood as well as dark chocolate flavors. The palate is dense with bitter, extracted coffee flavors, but balanced by lively, lingering acidity.
title: Château Grand Corbin-Despagne 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This wine has weight and tannins that offer good structure, but it's the ripe, rich fruit that dominates. It's powerful and complex, and likely to age well.
title: Château Figeac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This wine has weight and tannins that offer good structure, but it's the ripe, rich fruit that dominates. It's powerful and complex, and likely to age well.
title: Château Figeac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Black currant flavors resound on this juicy, deliciously fresh wine. It's a structured wine with a core of dry tannins and a palate that's firm and concentrated to the finish.
title: Château Villemaurine 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Solid, firm and tannic, this is a powerful success. It has equal weight of fruit and tannins and a palate that's intensely structured and complex. For long-term aging.
title: Château Beauregard 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. The diminutive neighbor of Château Pavie, Pavie Decesse's wine has its own, more mineral, tight character. It is complex but fruity, with blackberries supported by wood, acidity and dense texture.
title: Château Pavie Decesse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Very dense and rich with fine, tarry tannins that float amidst the ripe blackberry flavors. The wine is structured but full in body with a rich, opulent feel.
title: Château Fombrauge 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. An exemplary wine, this is powerful, rich and full of ripe red fruits. The palate is dark, but brightened by acidity, red fruits and a beautiful line of freshness.
title: Château le Gay 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Powerful and concentrated, this is a firmly textured wine with a dark, solid, dense character. The palate balances fine acidity and fruit with a dark, brooding structure.
title: Clos Fourtet 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Lavish with chocolate, coffee aromas, this is a finely perfumed wine. The palate is packed with ripe fruits and generous tannins that yield a deliciously rich mouth feel. Spicy, wood laden and opulent.
title: Le Dôme 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Full bodied and ripe, this wine is marked by smoky character, spiciness and full-throttle tannins. Blackberry fruits on the palate complement this serious structure. Obviously a long-term wine.
title: Château Pavie Macquin 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a very firm and concentrated wine with dark and smoky character. The palate is elegant and fine, but densely structured with dark tannins that give extra complexity.
title: Château Certan de May de Certan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)
winery: Château Certan de May de Certan

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a powerful wine with solid fruits and structure. The palate is full of beautifully ripe fruit—packed with rich and juicy blackberries. It shows how the potential of this property is being realized.
title: Château Beausejour-Duffau-Lagarrosse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a finely balanced wine that's ripe and structured at the same time. It has richness and spice, with a powerful context of wood, juicy blackberry fruits and delicious acidity. With such concentration, this is a wine with excellent ageing potential.
title: Château Beau-Séjour Bécot 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. The second wine of Château Ausone shows its 60% Cabernet Franc to great effect. It's perfumed and mineral, but with a dark intensity and acidity. A fine wine with a good future.
title: Château Ausone 2012 La Chapelle d'Ausone Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. A complex and very successful wine, this shows rich tannins, dark fruits, a powerful texture of ripe blackberry fruits and spiced acidity. It will shine with some serious aging.
title: Château La Tour Figeac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: From the hills of the Dordogne region, this is a fruity wine. It has a rustic, barnyard edge to it that spoils what is otherwise a fresh, crisp wine. Drink now.
title: Couleur d'Aquitaine 2014 L'Oie de Périgord Sauvignon Blanc (Périgord)

description: From the hills of the Dordogne region, this is a fruity wine. It has a rustic, barnyard edge to it that spoils what is otherwise a fresh, crisp wine. Drink now.
title: Couleur d'Aquitaine 2014 L'Oie de Périgord Sauvignon Blanc (Périgord)

description: This is a soft and rather rustic wine. It has herbal and citrus flavors that are fresh edged by a barnyard character. Drink now.
title: Vinovalie 2014 Tarani Sauvignon Blanc

description: This is a soft and rather rustic wine. It has herbal and citrus flavors that are fresh edged by a barnyard character. Drink now.
title: Vinovalie 2014 Tarani Sauvignon Blanc

description: This is a stalky wine, with black currant fruits and a soft texture. It is full of acidity and light fruitiness that will make it attractive if drunk lightly chilled. Drink now.
title: Vinovalie 2014 Tarani Cabernet Sauvignon

description: This is a stalky wine, with black currant fruits and a soft texture. It is full of acidity and light fruitiness that will make it attractive if drunk lightly chilled. Drink now.
title: Vinovalie 2014 Tarani Cabernet Sauvignon

description: The wine with a Polynesian family history is full of tropical fruit flavors, includig mango and pineapple, and only light acidity. It's a curious wine, slightly oxidized, grassy and super-ripe at the same time. Drink now.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2014 Varua Maohi Domaine de Saint-Sernin Chardonnay (Côtes du Lot)

description: The wine is full of stalky black currant fruits and fresh acidity. A blend of Bordeaux-style grapes with Syrah, it is made to be drunk young and slightly chilled for the summer. Drink now.
title: Domaine Chiroulet 2015 Java by Chiroulet Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A big and bold wine, showing black plum fruits, an impressive structure and a solid, foursquare feel. It is obviously a wine for aging. Give it 2–3 years.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2008 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a firm yet ripe wine that boasts ripe black-plum flavors layered with dense and dusty tannins. The wine is concentrated, with wood aging filling out the structure. It is big and bold, finishing with great ripe fruit.
title: Château Lanbersac 2009  Puisseguin Saint-Émilion

description: Densely tannic and rich, this is full of ripe chocolate and blackberry fruit. It is dark, brooding and dense—a great success for the second wine of Château du Glana.
title: Château du Glana 2009 Terre du Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: This small Pauillac property, close to Château Pontet-Canet, has produced an impressive 2006, structured with firm tannins under the black currant fruit.
title: Château Béhèré Courtin 2006  Pauillac

description: Moving toward the floral side of Sauvignon Blanc, this fruity, rounded wine has ripe acidity, a tangy citrus flavor and a full-bodied feel. It's set to age over several years.
title: Domaine Laporte 2010 Les Duchesses  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This is very aromatic, with minerality vying with fruit and tense acidity. This complex wine has an austere side, both rich and structured that will soften in a couple of years.
title: Domaine Laporte 2010 Le Rochoy  (Sancerre)

description: Moving toward the more tropical fruit spectrum of Sauvignon Blanc, this is round, with apricot and pineapple flavors. There is a fine streak of citrusy acidity that lifts the ripe fruit.
title: Domaine Landrat-Guyollot 2010 La Rambarde  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Moving toward the more tropical fruit spectrum of Sauvignon Blanc, this is round, with apricot and pineapple flavors. There is a fine streak of citrusy acidity that lifts the ripe fruit.
title: Domaine Landrat-Guyollot 2010 La Rambarde  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This is a well structured, rich wine. It has solid, ripe red-berry and black-currant fruits that dominate the firmer tannins, giving a juicy, generous feel. Well worth aging for 3–5 years.
title: Château Bellegrave du Poujeau 2009  Haut-Médoc

description: As so often with Montrose, this is a powerful, concentrated and very structured wine. Dense tannins are paired with rich black fruits, although at this stage the wine also has a sense of austerity. Power, severity and complexity all make for a wine for long aging. Wait until 2019.
title: Château Montrose 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: Rich and smooth, this is a ripe wine packed with blackberry fruits and sweet tannins that give a soft, while firm, structure. From the owner of Léoville Poyferré in Saint-Julien, it is sophisticated and elegant. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Le Crock 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is powerful and concentrated, with the high proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend standing out firmly. It is dark, rich, packed with ripe black fruits and sweet tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Figeac 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This is powerful and concentrated, with the high proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend standing out firmly. It is dark, rich, packed with ripe black fruits and sweet tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Figeac 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Powerful, very rich and very concentrated, this epitomizes the opulent style of Cos d'Estournel. A sense of extraction is overwhelmed by the huge, ripe fruit. It shows velvet texture at first, but then the tannins come on strongly, leaving a wine that will age over many years. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: Firm and very structured, it has depth plus some spice from wood aging, along with a dry core that still dominates the fragrant red berry fruits. Don't drink before 2018.
title: Château Calon 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Despite the huge weight of fruit and accompanying structure, this is a stylish wine. It's impressively dense, concentrated and solid. At the same time, the juicy black fruits give a generous, full-in-the-mouth character. Drink this very fine wine from 2022.
title: Château Ducru Beaucaillou 2011  Saint-Julien

description: A structured wine, with some tight black cherry flavors as well as firm tannins. The wine has a mineral edge, the acidity giving a juicy character to the fruit, while the texture is dry, tannic. Age for a year.
title: Gaël Martin 2009 Les Fouillouses  (Juliénas)

description: This Grenache-dominated cuvée starts off with beautiful lifted aromas of clove, allspice and cherries. On the palate, it's rich, full-bodied and savory, with plentiful tannins that balance out the ripe cherry fruit. Ambitious, and pulls it off. Drink 2012–2016.
title: Domaine du Tix 2009 Doña Maria Red (Ventoux)

description: This Grenache-dominated cuvée starts off with beautiful lifted aromas of clove, allspice and cherries. On the palate, it's rich, full-bodied and savory, with plentiful tannins that balance out the ripe cherry fruit. Ambitious, and pulls it off. Drink 2012–2016.
title: Domaine du Tix 2009 Doña Maria Red (Ventoux)

description: Pesquié's red Quintessence is a blend of 80% Syrah and 20% Grenache, aged in oak barrels. The result features plenty of spices, like clove, nutmeg and cinnamon, but also lush cassis and raspberry fruit and a velvety texture. Drink now–2016.
title: Château Pesquié 2009 Quintessence Red (Ventoux)

description: This enchanting rosé starts off slightly flinty and citrusy on the nose, but follows up on the palate with waves of creamy concentration and ripe berry fruit balanced by a bright, refreshing finish.
title: Chateau Mourgues du Gres 2010 Les Galets Rosés Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This enchanting rosé starts off slightly flinty and citrusy on the nose, but follows up on the palate with waves of creamy concentration and ripe berry fruit balanced by a bright, refreshing finish.
title: Chateau Mourgues du Gres 2010 Les Galets Rosés Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Bottled unfiltered, this is a richly ripe wine, layered with a more smoky, even mineral, texture from the volcanic soil of the vineyard. It is dense, the tannins giving hints of wood as well as a black plum skin character.
designation: Cuvée Jules de Souzy Vieilles Vignes
title: Château de la Terrière 2009 Cuvée Jules de Souzy Vieilles Vignes  (Brouilly)

description: This is a rich, powerful and wood-aged wine that shows fine balance between its ripe red fruits and solid, chunky tannins. The wood rounds out the rich texture and gives character to the full, juicy finish.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2011 Domaine des Ailes  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Ripe, smooth and balanced, this wine shows firm tannins and a solid, chunky build. With its rich black-plum fruit and opulent texture, it will be ready to drink in 2–3 years.
title: Château Ponzac 2009 Patiemment Malbec (Cahors)

description: An attractively balanced Moulin-à-Vent, this has firm tannins that contrast well with the damson flavor and tight acidity. The finish is fresh, with a hint of minerality.
title: Signé Vigneron 2011 Domane de la Passion  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Bold fruit characterizes this firm, fruity Cahors. It has the dark tannins of Malbec, which are supported by the rich black-fruit flavor and touches of licorice, black cherry and black currant. Age this for another 2–3 years.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Bold fruit characterizes this firm, fruity Cahors. It has the dark tannins of Malbec, which are supported by the rich black-fruit flavor and touches of licorice, black cherry and black currant. Age this for another 2–3 years.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Intensely juicy, this is packed with acidity and tight red-cherry fruit layered with firm tannins. It feels a little austere at the moment, and it is likely to take time to open.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2011 Côte du Py Vieilles Vignes  (Morgon)

description: Intensely juicy, this is packed with acidity and tight red-cherry fruit layered with firm tannins. It feels a little austere at the moment, and it is likely to take time to open.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2011 Côte du Py Vieilles Vignes  (Morgon)

description: A blend of Braucol and Tannat, this a dark-colored blockbuster, with firm tannins that are mitigated by the smooth, rich blackberry flavor. It has power, immense concentration and great density. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine du Moulin 2010 Le Faucon Red (Côtes du Tarn)

description: A crisp blend of Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc and Muscadelle, this is a ripe wine, showing the warmth of this vintage. It is lightly perfumed with apricot and red-apple flavors. The aftertaste is all about tangy fruit. Drink now.
title: Château du Moulin 2015  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: Balanced acidity and fruit give this Lobre wine its immediate attraction. It has a bright character, the fruit and the acidity in harmony. Drink this ripe wine now.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This refreshing wine from the Seze family of Fronsac is light, crisp and packed with fruit. Crisp with citrus flavors it is ready to drink now.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A slightly earthy note colors the apple and lemon aromas on the nose. The palate shows lots of freshness and has a tart, light and dry body. The finish is lemony and fresh. Drink while aromas are expressive.
title: Joseph Cattin 2016 Riesling (Alsace)

description: The second wine of Clos Cantenac is already accessible. With spice, black currant fruits and ripe tannins, it's both juicy and firmly structured. The wine is balanced, with great acidity at the end contrasting with the tannins. Drink now.
title: Clos Cantenac 2011 Petit Cantenac  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The second wine of Clos Cantenac is already accessible. With spice, black currant fruits and ripe tannins, it's both juicy and firmly structured. The wine is balanced, with great acidity at the end contrasting with the tannins. Drink now.
title: Clos Cantenac 2011 Petit Cantenac  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The wine is rich, full of berry fruits that are also touched by damsons. It has spice, some toast and a smooth texture. Plenty of jammy fruit indicate good potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Penin 2012 Natur  (Bordeaux)

description: Across the river Dordogne from Castillon, the vineyard of Lajarre is on the first slope. This soft and ripe wine has black currant fruitiness, fresh acidity and a judicious use of wood aging. It still shows the structure of 2010, so will be better from 2015.
title: Château Lajarre 2010 Cuvée Eléonore  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Dense and richly smooth, this displays all the fruit and generous texture of a 2009. It's now maturing well with its blackberry fruitiness, sweet tannins and light acidity. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château du Tasta 2009 Grande Réserve  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Ripe and juicy, this is perfumed, full of red berry flavor and attractively soft tannins. The wine feels broad and rich, ready to drink from 2015.
title: Château de Bel 2012 La Capitane  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Juicy black fruits give a great start, supported by the tannins that kick in. Ripe, full of flavor and generous, this is a broad, full-bodied wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Brande-Bergère 2012 Cuvée O'Byrne  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Ripe berry fruits shine through this wine. Supported by the tannins, they give a solid and rich character that is beginning to develop. With a dark aftertaste, this wine has potential and will be best from 2017.
title: Château Bois de Rolland 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Ripe berry fruits shine through this wine. Supported by the tannins, they give a solid and rich character that is beginning to develop. With a dark aftertaste, this wine has potential and will be best from 2017.
title: Château Bois de Rolland 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: The blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon has produced an attractive, fruity wine that's young and fresh. Light and bright, with delicious final acidity, its structure suggests it could age; drink from the end of 2015.
title: Barton & Guestier 2013 Passeport  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Firm and hard-edged this wine is currently tough. The fruit—black currant and berry—will bring out the potential richness. It's structured for the moment, but wait until 2017.
title: Kirkland Signature 2012 Château de Marsan  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: The top Pouilly Fumé from Joseph Mellot is a complex wine with rich, rounded fruits touched by wood aging. Yellow fruits dominate, given a further lift by apple acidity and a smoky flavor. Delicious now, it's a powerful wine that could age further, so keep until 2015.
title: Joseph Mellot 2012 La Grande Cuvée des Edvins  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This is a dense, flavorful and powerfully structured wine, brimming with notes of black cherry, plum, currant, baking spice, black pepper, crushed violet and bittersweet chocolate. It's full and chewy on the palate, with a firm structure and gripping tannins. Hints of licorice root, mocha and toasted sweet spice unfold on the finish. It's delicious now, but it should hold well through 2020.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Le Viala Red (Minervois La Liviniere)

description: This is a structured wine whose fruit is still coming through the tannins. It has a dry core, layers of acidity and juicy bitter cherry acidity. Drink from the end of 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Cuvées Classic  (Morgon)

description: Lightweight fresh fruit flavors, mostly grapefruit and clean freshness. The wine is attractively fruity in style.
title: Sauvion 2010 Loire Valley  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Here's a simple but enjoyable Cab with notes of black plum, violet and cassis. Medium weight with soft tannins and a solid finish.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2009 Réserve St. Martin Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft Chardonnay, with pear and walnut flavors, light acidity and rounded buttery flavors. There is an attractive final richness.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009 Laforet  (Bourgogne)

description: What would convince a producer to call a wine Jovly seems to be a mystery. That said, the wine is fresh, rounded with plenty of orange juice acidity, honey and a soft finish. Screwcap.
title: Caves du Val de France 2009 Jovly  (Vouvray)

description: There's a green edge to this wine that struggles with the richer dark berries and fudge cake flavors. Soft and round in the mouth with a short finish.
title: Mont Tauch 2009 Le Dog de Jean Marc Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: There's a green edge to this wine that struggles with the richer dark berries and fudge cake flavors. Soft and round in the mouth with a short finish.
title: Mont Tauch 2009 Le Dog de Jean Marc Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: An easy, fruity wine, its attractive red cherry flavors bubbling away in soft tannins and light acidity. Very drinkable, and not for aging.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2008  Bourgogne

description: A wine that is absolutely mature, showing almonds and secondary flavors:  green herbs, yeast and toast rather than fruit.
title: Domaine Chêne 2007  Mâcon-Villages

description: A wine that is absolutely mature, showing almonds and secondary flavors:  green herbs, yeast and toast rather than fruit.
title: Domaine Chêne 2007  Mâcon-Villages

description: Dry, dark-hued tannins cut through the wine, giving it a bitter feel. It is tough, firm, missing the balancing fruit.
title: Château de Virecourt 2009  Bordeaux

description: Dry, dark-hued tannins cut through the wine, giving it a bitter feel. It is tough, firm, missing the balancing fruit.
title: Château de Virecourt 2009  Bordeaux

description: Dry and light, an unfocused wine. It has tannins, only light fruit, very dry and ultimately tough.
title: Château Moulin de Canhaut 2007  Médoc

description: Quintessence is a good name for this wine that has the minerality and the structure that are the soul of the appellation. In addition it offers apricot and pear fruitiness and intense acidity. This wine is so drinkable now, although it will be much better from 2018.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2014 Quintessence  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Subtle smoky notes add complexity to this ripe, full-bodied wine (the Roussanne component is aged in barrel). Combine that with Grenache Blanc, Clairette and Bourboulenc and the results come together in a whirl of honey, pineapple and citrus that is long, crisp and mouthwatering on the finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Domaine du Vieux Lazaret 2012 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Vaillons is on the left bank of Serein river across from the slope of Grand Cru vineyards. This wine, made from organically grown grapes, is ripe while also having a tense, steely texture that will allow it to develop for several years. Apple and pink-grapefruit flavors are lifted by nervy acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2013 Vaillons Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The small village of Saint-Andelain is at the heart of Sauvignon Blanc in Pouilly Fumé. This wine is ripe with melon and peach flavors cut with intense acidity. It is well textured, full bodied and should be held until well into 2017.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2015 En Travertin  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This is a blend of several parcels throughout the appellation including some Premier Crus. It has the power of the appellation along with the elegant Leflaive house style. That makes for a fine structured wine with great acidity, apple and pineapple fruit and a strongly mineral aftertaste. Drink starting from 2019.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This is crisp and attractively citrusy, with a touch of caramel. It's bright and fruity, with apple and lemon flavors that are well integrated with the piercingly refreshing acidity. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Laroche 2011 Saint-Martin  (Chablis)

description: This shows more texture than fruit, but it has weight and richness that will come forward in the next two years. Its clean apple fruit is likely to be the dominant factor.
title: Domaine du Chardonnay 2010  Chablis

description: This shows more texture than fruit, but it has weight and richness that will come forward in the next two years. Its clean apple fruit is likely to be the dominant factor.
title: Domaine du Chardonnay 2010  Chablis

description: Soft and rounded, this has an attractive fresh-fruit character. It's warm with a yellow fruit flavor; a crisp touch of grapefruit tempers the richness.
title: Pierre André 2010 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: This is an attractive light and fruity wine. It has fresh fruit flavors, with notes of crisp citrus and green apple. A touch of vanilla and a smooth texture surface as it opens up.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2011 Le Classique  (Chablis)

description: Light, fragrant, and structured, this shows a smoky flavor and refreshing red-berry fruit. It's lively and fruity, and the tannins are in the background.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2010  Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: Initially, this tastes of only crisp acidity, but the fruitier flavors of lemon and red apple come through slowly, giving weight to this lively, bright wine. The minerally, edgy texture is prominent on the finish.
title: Domaine Jean-Claude Courtault 2010  Chablis

description: This is laden with wood, spiced with a toast note that dominates this otherwise crisp, nervy wine. The acidity is refreshing; the citrus note creates a lively streak of freshness. This needs a few months for the wood infuence to soften.
title: Domaine Hubert Lamy 2010 Les Chataigniées  (Bourgogne)

description: Firm and structured, this has strong tannins set over smoky fruit. It has concentration, although the wood flavor has an old-wood feel, seeming just a touch dirty.
title: Domaine Coquard Loison-Fleurot 2010  Vosne-Romanée

description: Soft, smooth and buttery, this is full of ripe tropical fruits and bright, citrusy acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Domaine de la Batie  (Saint-Véran)

description: This is fruity, with an apple flavor that's lifted by a lemon zest edge. It's warm with a rich, minerally tautness; a caramel note comes through on the finish.
title: Vincent 2010 JJ Bourgogne Blanc  (Bourgogne)

description: With the extra concentration from the low-yielding old vines, this is a dense wine, with its acidity contrasting the rich red fruit. It is round and smooth, with well-integrated tannins and a soft, fruity finish.
title: Manuel Olivier 2009 Vieilles Vignes  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: From a 24-acre vineyard with vines aged from five to 65 years, this is an attractively fruity wine. Ripe apple flavors gain even greater liveliness from the twist of citrus zest. It is ready to drink with all its freshness.
title: Domaine Siret-Courtaud 2014  Quincy

description: This entry-level white from the Roblins is fresh, crisp and fruity. The light texture is dominated by acidity and the bright apple and pink-grapefruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Domaine Matthias et Emile Roblin 2014 Origine  (Sancerre)

description: The entry-level wine from this domaine is light and soft, offering attractively perfumed apple fruits and balanced acidity. The wine is refreshing, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Reverdy-Ducroux 2014 Beau Roy  (Sancerre)

description: Herbal aromas give this young wine its freshness, with bright acidity and crisp texture. Green fruits are laced with a touch of minerality and freshness. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Laporte 2014 Le Grand Argentier  (Menetou-Salon)

description: Mint and herb aromas are followed by a structured and tannic palate. It has balancing acidity, with a juicy black-currant flavor and a dark, dry edge. Like nearly all of the 2010s, it needs to age.
title: Château Lousteauneuf 2010  Médoc

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is finely balanced, with juicy black-plum fruit and acidity. The Merlot gives it a smoky character and a ripe, fleshy texture. Age this for 3–4 years.
title: Château Haut Barrail 2010  Médoc

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is finely balanced, with juicy black-plum fruit and acidity. The Merlot gives it a smoky character and a ripe, fleshy texture. Age this for 3–4 years.
title: Château Haut Barrail 2010  Médoc

description: A blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Loin de l'Oeil, this is ripe, fruity and perfumed. It has an attractive floral character, with flavors of toast and hedgerow. It's ready to drink, but it could age.
title: Domaine du Moulin 2010 Blanc Sec Vieilles Vignes White (Gaillac)

description: A classic Bordeaux-style blend, but mainly Merlot, this wine has a ripe feel, with a firm, dense structure. It has weight and ripe blackberry fruit, plus a fine line of acidity. Wait for two years, although it is drinkable now.
title: Château Trolliet Lafite 2009 Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: The chalky soil yields a crisp, textured wine with yellow fruits to round it out. There is a steely edge and just a touch of wood, while the aftertaste is packed with acidity.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2011 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: The chalky soil yields a crisp, textured wine with yellow fruits to round it out. There is a steely edge and just a touch of wood, while the aftertaste is packed with acidity.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2011 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: This is a supple, medium- to full-bodied red for drinking over the next few years. The plummy flavors are a bit earthy, dark and indistinct, but pleasant enough, and the wine's silky finish features a bright burst of red fruit.
title: Château du Trignon 2009  Gigondas

description: Wood flavors initially dominate this wine. Then the more fruity character shows through to give a toast and citrus character, rounded while tightly textured. The wine has some aging potential, although it could be drunk now.
title: Bret Brothers 2012 Climat La Martine  (Mâcon-Uchizy)

description: Rounded and ripe, it has tannins nicely embedded in the red plum and strawberry flavors. It's full-bodied and already showing a delicious, seductive side. Drink from 2016.
title: Maison Ambroise 2011  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: Rounded and ripe, it has tannins nicely embedded in the red plum and strawberry flavors. It's full-bodied and already showing a delicious, seductive side. Drink from 2016.
title: Maison Ambroise 2011  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: A soft wine with attractive fruitiness and lemon and lime flavors. Fresh and rounded, it shows its northern French origins with the tight acidity at the end.
title: Joseph Faiveley 2011 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: From the good-value Fixin appellation, this full wine offers minerality but, more noticeably, a ripe, red-fruited feel, with acidity to give freshness. Hints of licorice show the wood aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2011 Crais de Chêne  (Fixin)

description: With attractive wood aromas, this is rich and bright, with touches of butteriness. It has weight and plenty of ripe fruit. The acidity at the end is fresh and crisp.
title: Domaine Ferret 2012 Les Perrières  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Light and fresh in its skittle bottle, this is rosé for the beach and picnic. Red currant fruitiness has been softened with a caramel flavor.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2013 Domaine Fontanyl Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Spicy and fruity, this is a lightweight, attractive and smooth wine. It has some undergrowth aromas, followed by red berry fruits, with fresh acidity at the end. Drink now.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2011 Cuvée Saint Grégoire Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A wine that is proof that not all powerful wines also need high alcohol, this intense 13% ABV wine is concentrated, almost black in its color, a classic Malbec. It has all the solid tannins, structure, the darkest of black plums and licorice flavors. It should age well.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2006 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: A wine that is proof that not all powerful wines also need high alcohol, this intense 13% ABV wine is concentrated, almost black in its color, a classic Malbec. It has all the solid tannins, structure, the darkest of black plums and licorice flavors. It should age well.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2006 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: This organic blend of 60% Carignan, 20% Grenache and 20% Syrah offers a good amount of herbal aromas alongside notes of ripe dark cherry and berry fruit. Rich and tasty flavors of blueberry, boysenberry and raspberry unfold in the medium-weight mouth, while accents of pepper and anise remain through the close.
title: Château Malavieille 2007 Rouge Permien Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: This organic blend of 60% Carignan, 20% Grenache and 20% Syrah offers a good amount of herbal aromas alongside notes of ripe dark cherry and berry fruit. Rich and tasty flavors of blueberry, boysenberry and raspberry unfold in the medium-weight mouth, while accents of pepper and anise remain through the close.
title: Château Malavieille 2007 Rouge Permien Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: A fresh wine, with some of the richness of the vintage showing in up-front red berry fruits. The tannins are already well integrated, allowing the wine to show a softer side. It is for medium-term aging.
title: Château Grand Tayac 2009  Margaux

description: A lifting menthol streak infuses the ripe red plum and berry aromas and flavors of this wine, with a nice minerality lingering underneath it all. Balanced with medium acidity and moderate but fine tannins, the wine's finish shows a cinnamon and nutmeg spice accent appears after swallow. Very drinkable now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2008 Red (Minervois)

description: A lifting menthol streak infuses the ripe red plum and berry aromas and flavors of this wine, with a nice minerality lingering underneath it all. Balanced with medium acidity and moderate but fine tannins, the wine's finish shows a cinnamon and nutmeg spice accent appears after swallow. Very drinkable now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2008 Red (Minervois)

description: A rich, ripe concentrated wine, packed with red plum and cherry fruits, lightly layered with tannins. The wine is immediately attractive, juicy, ready to drink.
title: Pezat 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Juicy red plum and bright berries fill the palate, while accents of savory herbs and wild animal add depth to the nose. Balanced and approachable with a satiny structure and a medium-length finish. Drink now.
title: Château Ollieux Romanis 2008 Cuvée Alice Red (Corbières)

description: Fruity while still solidly tannic, this is a ripe Merlot-dominated wine. It has a touch of bitterness, but the main flavors are of black currant, fresh berries and a strong line in acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château la Fleur Poitou 2011  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: While the wine is light, it has a good balance between its dry tannins and attractive black currant fruitiness. With good structure, it will age over the medium term, so drink from 2016.
title: Château du Perier 2011  Médoc

description: Hugely rich and in a seriously heavy bottle, this is a statement wine. Its texture is there, surrounded by superripe fruit and touches of pepper from the alcohol. This almost tropical-fruit wine needs to age a little longer, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laporte 2015 La Comtesse  (Sancerre)

description: The wine comes from a 14-acre estate owned by the producer. Its fruitiness and texture are both important elements in the wine at this young stage. They give a tightly textured wine that is still bright, crisp with lemon fruit and crispened with considerable acidity. Let the wine soften and drink from 2018.
title: Joseph Mellot 2016 Domaine des Emois  (Sancerre)

description: The wine comes from a 14-acre estate owned by the producer. Its fruitiness and texture are both important elements in the wine at this young stage. They give a tightly textured wine that is still bright, crisp with lemon fruit and crispened with considerable acidity. Let the wine soften and drink from 2018.
title: Joseph Mellot 2016 Domaine des Emois  (Sancerre)

description: The short oak aging has broadened this already ripe wine. The touch of toast is balanced by the yellow fruits and rich acidity. It is full, concentrated, mineral textured and ready to drink.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 La Grande Châtelaine  (Sancerre)

description: 84-86 Tough, only with tannins. Very hard wine, firm.
title: Château Liversan 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 85-87 A dark wine, the fruit tasting a little over-ripe. It does have structure and acidity, but feels soft and flabby.
title: Château Barreyres 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 85-87 A dark wine, the fruit tasting a little over-ripe. It does have structure and acidity, but feels soft and flabby.
title: Château Barreyres 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 85-87 The wine seems too ripe, the fruit very rich, opulent. It has weight, a jammy character, the tannins out of balance
title: Château Clauzet 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 85-87 Pushing dryness, and tannins, the wine feels extracted, hard. The fruit doesn't catch up with the structure.
title: Château Caronne Ste Gemme 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 85-87 Pushing dryness, and tannins, the wine feels extracted, hard. The fruit doesn't catch up with the structure.
title: Château Caronne Ste Gemme 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 86-88 Fine fruit, lovely black currant character, with fine acidity and great freshness. A delicious wine. There is some Carmenère in the blend.
title: Château de Fonbel 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 86-88 Sweet, soft fruit, ripe and attractive, with some spice and fresh tannins. The wine is open, already developing.
title: Château Balestard la Tonnelle 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 86-88 Intense wood aromas that are translated through to the palate. This is all smoky plank and structure.
title: Château Fonréaud 2010 Barrel sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 86-88 Firmly tannic, stalky with black currant and an edge of extracted bitterness.
title: Château La Grande Clotte 2010 Barrel sample  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: 86-88 A lean wine, with the over-ripe fruit battling with the tannins. It is hard and over extracted.
title: Château Durfort-Vivens 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 87-89 A wine that is all structure, with very little fruit. It has a hard, metallic edge.
title: Château Suau 2010 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 87-89 Firmly structured, dense tannins and wood, leaving the fruit behind. Extraction is a problem here.
title: Chateau Desmirail 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 87-89 The wine is out of focus, with fruit lost in a structure that hasn't come together. It has weight and acidity, plum fruits showing slowly.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 87-89 Smooth, poiished new wood along with sweet, soft tannins. A velvet textured, smoky wine.
title: Château la Tour de By 2010 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 87-89 Lovely weight and fruit with freshness and acidity. A very attractive wine with blackberry fruits, dusty tannins. Almost opulent.
title: Château La Serre 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 87-89 The wine tastes light, with a hard edged mineral character, the richness still a distance away.
title: Château Filhot 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 87-89 Soft wine, its acidity light. Pineapple and green apple flavors, with hints of wood.
title: Château Ferrande 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 87-89 A delicious spicy wine, keeping the freshness and acidity in a red fruit style. The spice from the wood is too defined.
title: Château Bourgneuf 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 87-89 Very cassis in character, with fruit, some weight and totally juicy acidity.
title: Château Simard 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 87-89 Very cassis in character, with fruit, some weight and totally juicy acidity.
title: Château Simard 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 87-89 Ripe and juicy, a forward fruity wine, with acidity and freshness. A wine for early drinking.
title: Château Siaurac 2010 Barrel sample Plaisir de Siaurac  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: 87-89 Ripe new wood and spice with blackberry juice flavors, very rich and concentrated. It has soft tannins, very juicy.
title: Château Reysson 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87-89 The wine seems hollow, all tannins, missing the weight of fruit. It's dark, certainly and concentrated, but one-dimensional.
title: Château la Couspaude 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 87-89 Lacking richness, the wine has acidity, some sweetness, but misses definition and density.
title: Château Lamothe 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 87-89 Solid, chunky wine, full of dense tannins, concentrated fruit. There is a powerful feel to it.
title: Château Plince 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 87-89 With intense acidity, this is a structured, firm wine. The extract is considerable, leaving an edge of bitterness. At the same time, the freshness gives point to the wood tannins.
title: Château Greysac 2010 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 87-89 With intense acidity, this is a structured, firm wine. The extract is considerable, leaving an edge of bitterness. At the same time, the freshness gives point to the wood tannins.
title: Château Greysac 2010 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 87-89 Rich, though a wine that seems to lack an inner core. It is all beautiful fruit, super-ripe, laced with acidity, missing the structure.
title: Château Beauregard 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Soft, ripe, smooth, with delicious acidity and berry fruits. Some good density.
title: Château de Lamarque 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Smoky ripe fruit, big and bold fruit with some firm tannins. The wine is packed with ripe berry fruits.
title: Château Laforge 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The producer has several parcels in Moulin-à-Vent which go into this blend. It is a firm and structured wine at this stage: dense and with both spice and black fruits. It is obviously made for some long aging, so don't drink this serious wine before 2019.
title: Richard Rottiers 2015  Moulin-à-Vent

description: The producer has several parcels in Moulin-à-Vent which go into this blend. It is a firm and structured wine at this stage: dense and with both spice and black fruits. It is obviously made for some long aging, so don't drink this serious wine before 2019.
title: Richard Rottiers 2015  Moulin-à-Vent

description: This is a concentrated wine, packed with tannins and black plum fruits. It has some of the fruity crispness of the vintage although with its dark structure and concentration it is obviously a wine that needs to soften over time. Rich and juicy at the end, it will be ready to drink from 2024.
title: Château Prieuré-Lichine 2014  Margaux

description: One of the largest estates in Margaux, Lascombes is now performing well. With this vintage the heavy over-oaking of past years has gone to be replaced with a wine that is full of black fruits as much as rich tannins. There is concentration and a good potential for aging. Drink from 2025.
title: Château Lascombes 2014  Margaux

description: Dark orange in color, this dry wine relies on its fresh red fruits to give balance. It's perfumed with a light touch of tannin from the red wine used to produce the color. This is a food-friendly wine, crisp and dry at the end.
title: Piper-Heidsieck NV Sauvage Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a structured wine, firm with tannins as well as bursting with ripe red fruits. Its acidity is well integrated into the rich fruitiness. It could well age for another few months, so drink from 2016. Jean-Yves Perraud, the fifth-generation winemaker, uses old vines on sandy granite soil for this wine.
title: Domaine de Foretal 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This is a tight, mineral-textured wine with fresh citrus and lemon-zest flavors and a steely character. It is crisp, almost cool in style and could do with some aging in bottle.
title: Charles Ellner NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: With a year's age, this wine has softened its intense fruitiness and ripened with a rich, soft texture and well-integrated acidity. A structure gives a dry edge to the red currant and cherry fruits that are rounded out with a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Les Frères Perroud 2013 Améthyste  (Brouilly)

description: With a year's age, this wine has softened its intense fruitiness and ripened with a rich, soft texture and well-integrated acidity. A structure gives a dry edge to the red currant and cherry fruits that are rounded out with a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Les Frères Perroud 2013 Améthyste  (Brouilly)

description: Apple and citrus notes signal freshness, with a seam of bright acidity pervading the palate, giving a tart aspect to the wine. The fizz is soft and the body is light, making for a simple, refreshing and very easy-drinking wine.
title: Meyer-Fonné NV Brut Extra Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Apple and citrus notes signal freshness, with a seam of bright acidity pervading the palate, giving a tart aspect to the wine. The fizz is soft and the body is light, making for a simple, refreshing and very easy-drinking wine.
title: Meyer-Fonné NV Brut Extra Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: An attractive, pale-colored rosé, this offers crisp acidity and bright red currant and raspberry fruitiness. The wine is balanced with delicate fruits, a touch of minerality and a fresh aftertaste. It is ready to drink.
title: Marion-Bosser NV Premier Cru Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With its prominent new wood, here is a wine that goes for spice, caramel and high toast flavors. It has great power, a wine that is currently all structure, leaving the fruit to gain in richness at a later stage.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2006  Pessac-Léognan

description: Very much in the food style of Bordeaux, this wine shows the freshness of the 2006 vintage, while also offering some ripe weight. Flavors of fresh black currants edged with black plum skin are supported by a firm line of tannins, finished with a sweet, juicy, fleshy aftertaste.
title: Château Preuillac 2006  Médoc

description: This is a serious wine, tight and closed up at this stage. Around the dry core, the fruit is structured, not offering richness, but with a good, solid base of black currants. It needs time to soften.
title: Château Durfort-Vivens 2006  Margaux

description: With its well-handled new wood treatment, this wine instead has gone for full-bodied richness. The wood is definitely an important element, but its ripe, smooth black plum juice and blueberry flavors share the honors of this delicious wine equally. In 2–3 years, this will be a wine for luxuriating.
title: Château Branas Grand Poujeaux 2006  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: This is an impressively complete wine, the fruit right in context with the dark, dry tannins. All the elements are in place, from the initial juicy fruit to the soft, fresh close.This is an impressively complete wine, the fruit right in context with the dark, dry tannins. All the elements are in place, from the initial juicy fruit to the soft, fresh close.
title: Château Potensac 2006  Médoc

description: The second wine of Château Montrose is at a high level. With its ripe chocolate and sweet black currant flavors, the structure comes from dark tannins, which, as so often in Saint-Estèphe, are dry, but not hard, and have delicious fresh berry fruits to envelope them. A wine that is great for aging over 4–5 years.
title: Château Montrose 2006 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)
