description: The second wine of Château Montrose is at a high level. With its ripe chocolate and sweet black currant flavors, the structure comes from dark tannins, which, as so often in Saint-Estèphe, are dry, but not hard, and have delicious fresh berry fruits to envelope them. A wine that is great for aging over 4–5 years.
title: Château Montrose 2006 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: Delicate and elegant wine, with smoky fruit, ripe but freshened with a tight layer of acidity. It has delicious black currant juice flavors, but the texture remains light and the tannins soft.
title: Château Margaux 2006 Pavillon Rouge de Château Margaux  (Margaux)

description: Smooth, ripe and immediate, this is a wine that is developing deliciously, but fast. There is a great fresh, juicy character that balances with the ripe, full tannins. Don't age, just enjoy.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2006  Pessac-Léognan

description: Guigal's luxury cuvée from Condrieu is a great success in 2008, marrying richness and power with hints of honeysuckle, toasted nuts and apricot. It's full bodied, creamy in texture and tremendously long on the finish. Drink now–2016, and possibly beyond.
title: E. Guigal 2008 La Doriane  (Condrieu)

description: A lively Champagne, initially all froth and fizz. But get through that and there is a pleasant, slightly sweet wine— perhaps more full-bodied than some. The primary red-fruit flavors have been lessened by some bottle age, leaving a wine which has a hint of maturity.
title: Heidsieck & Co Monopole NV Rosé Top  (Champagne)

description: An easy, full-bodied nonvintage Champagne, with soft white and tropical fruits, a full dosage and a well-integrated, balanced aftertaste.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte NV Réserve Particulière Brut  (Champagne)

description: An easy, full-bodied nonvintage Champagne, with soft white and tropical fruits, a full dosage and a well-integrated, balanced aftertaste.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte NV Réserve Particulière Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a complex cru wine that has ripe fruits, firm tannins and a good ageworthy structure. It has a dense texture, rich black-cherry fruits and a finish that brings out crisp acidity. Produced by this Beaujolais-based negociant, the wine will be ready to drink from the end of 2017.
title: Trenel Fils 2015  Fleurie

description: This is a complex cru wine that has ripe fruits, firm tannins and a good ageworthy structure. It has a dense texture, rich black-cherry fruits and a finish that brings out crisp acidity. Produced by this Beaujolais-based negociant, the wine will be ready to drink from the end of 2017.
title: Trenel Fils 2015  Fleurie

description: Full-bodied for a rosé (as Tavel should be), this wine boasts plenty of cherry-berry fruit, but also appealing, complex notes of fresh thyme, ground clove and aniseed. Drink this blend of 60% Grenache, 20% Cinsault, 10% Syrah and 10% Clairette (a white grape variety) over the rest of 2017.
title: Les Vignes des Prêcheurs 2015  Tavel

description: From a somewhat maligned vintage, this is a commendable effort. It's not as textural as the wine can be in better years, but it shows enough richness to easily carry the attractive leather, mocha and spice flavors. Drink now–2025.
title: Domaine de Mourchon 2014 Tradition Red

description: This taut, intense wine is a bit angular compared to many Tavels, but pull out a bottle around Thanksgiving, and it should be singing. Cherry and citrus flavors collide on the palate, but should merge into a seamless whole with a bit of bottle age.
title: Domaine Chantepierre 2016  Tavel

description: This wine from the Gonfrier family property is full of berry fruits. It's also a ripe wine that is already drinkable. It has generous tannins and balanced acidity that gives the wine its crisp edge as a contrast to the blackberry flavors. Drink now, or even better, wait until 2018.
title: Château le Gardera 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A traditional blend of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, this is a silky, medium-bodied wine. Cinnamon and cedar shadings frame bright cherry fruit and linger through the elegant finish. Drink now–2019.
title: Château la Genestière 2014 Red (Lirac)

description: A traditional blend of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, this is a silky, medium-bodied wine. Cinnamon and cedar shadings frame bright cherry fruit and linger through the elegant finish. Drink now–2019.
title: Château la Genestière 2014 Red (Lirac)

description: The second wine of La Dominique on the Saint-Emilion plateau shows the fruity side of this estate. It is packed with red fruits and with soft tannins. The acidity and the smooth texture promise early drinking for a generous wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Dominique 2014 Relais de la Dominique  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The rich fruit and structure of this impressive wine are already well integrated. With power and concentration as well as layers of dark fruits, it is showing fine aging potential. The wine, dominated by 80% Merlot, comes from vines in the east of Saint-Emilion. Drink from 2020.
title: Château la Chapelle aux Moines 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: This is the second wine of Clos Haut-Peyraguey. It comes from a fine Sauternes vintage with a great balance between acidity and rich sweetness. With botrytis, plenty of sweetness, bitter marmalade and apricot fruit and delicious acidity, the wine is almost ready to drink. Just wait until the end of 2017.
title: Château Clos Haut-Peyraguey 2013 Symphonie de Haut-Peyraguey  (Sauternes)

description: The wine is rich, complex, softly creamy, but at the same time dry. It has a wine-like weight, a full mouthfeel of puréed apples and white currants, finishing though with mineral acidity.
designation: Brut Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs
title: Soutiran NV Brut Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Pol Roger's excursion into a bone-dry Champagne brings a house style with natural weight up against an almost bony wine style. The resulting mix is certainly dry, edgy, very crisp, leaning towards austere. Extra bottle time would help the wine to gain weight and flesh out the structure.
title: Pol Roger NV Pure Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: Pol Roger's excursion into a bone-dry Champagne brings a house style with natural weight up against an almost bony wine style. The resulting mix is certainly dry, edgy, very crisp, leaning towards austere. Extra bottle time would help the wine to gain weight and flesh out the structure.
title: Pol Roger NV Pure Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: A Blanc de Noirs made from 100% Pinot Noir, this is already showing some maturity, with flavors of black truffles and mushrooms to go with the richness. There is a yeasty character that blends well with the almonds and currants. The finish is ripe and full.
title: Soutiran NV Perle Noire Brut Grand Cru Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Les Meslaines is the name of the parcel of Pinot Noir that produces this Blanc de Noirs. It has richness, a ripe character with fresh apricot flavors, a Champagne that has the weight of a wine. It could do with bottle age, but for freshness drink now.
title: Lamiable 2005 Les Meslaines Grand Cru Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: An easily accessible, easy-drinking style of Crozes-Hermitage, Ferraton's 2007 La Matinière displays a lovely balance between clean red fruit (cherries, raspberries), baking spices, cracked pepper and a faintly herbal tinge. Drink it now and over the next few years.
title: Ferraton Pere et Fils 2007 La Matinière  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: Based in the Pouilly-Fumé area, but with vines in Sancerre, this producer has made a rich wine with a line of steely acidity. The spice and touch of vanilla are balanced by the crisp lemon and gooseberry fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Patrice Moreux 2015  Sancerre

description: Based in the Pouilly-Fumé area, but with vines in Sancerre, this producer has made a rich wine with a line of steely acidity. The spice and touch of vanilla are balanced by the crisp lemon and gooseberry fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Patrice Moreux 2015  Sancerre

description: While there is a youthful stalky element to this wine, it also has plenty of ripe black-cherry fruit. That suggests a warm ripe future as the tannins soften. Drink this potentially rich, spicy wine from 2019.
title: Isabelle et Pierre Clément 2015 Tradition  (Menetou-Salon)

description: While there is a youthful stalky element to this wine, it also has plenty of ripe black-cherry fruit. That suggests a warm ripe future as the tannins soften. Drink this potentially rich, spicy wine from 2019.
title: Isabelle et Pierre Clément 2015 Tradition  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This medium-pink rosé shows some heft but is mostly about refreshment. Passion fruit and peach notes give way to citrus zest on its crisp, vibrant finish. Drink now.
title: Marrenon 2016 Les Grains Rosé de Merlot (Mediterranée)

description: There is a caramel edge to this ripe wine with its strawberry fruits. It has spice and flavors of vanilla along with the crisp aftertaste of acidity. Drink this Pinot Noir-based wine now.
title: Nicolas Millet 2016 Champ Secret Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Although this producer is based in Pouilly-sur-Loire, across the Loire, it also has vines in Sancerre. This attractive crisp wine has herbal hints and bright apple and citrus fruit. Drink now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Domaine de la Perrière  (Sancerre)

description: Although this producer is based in Pouilly-sur-Loire, across the Loire, it also has vines in Sancerre. This attractive crisp wine has herbal hints and bright apple and citrus fruit. Drink now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Domaine de la Perrière  (Sancerre)

description: This is a tight, mineral-driven wine with fresh acidity and a crisp character. Sémillon dominated, it conveys green fruits, bright acidity and a lively, tangy aftertaste. The wine is refreshing, fruity and ready to drink. Nicolas Thienpont and his brothers bought this 16-acre property in 1988.
title: Château les Charmes Godard 2014  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This 100% Sauvignon Blanc with six months in French oak is fresh with attractive fruitiness and light acidity. It has spice, a touch of toast and full yellow fruits. The aftertaste brings in a more citrus character that lets the wine finish with freshness. Drink now. Laurent Dubois is the family's ninth generation at this northern Gironde property.
title: Château Les Bertrands 2014 Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This 100% Sauvignon Blanc with six months in French oak is fresh with attractive fruitiness and light acidity. It has spice, a touch of toast and full yellow fruits. The aftertaste brings in a more citrus character that lets the wine finish with freshness. Drink now. Laurent Dubois is the family's ninth generation at this northern Gironde property.
title: Château Les Bertrands 2014 Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: An easy-drinking Côtes du Rhône, this isn't particularly intense but is harmonious from start to finish. Hints of garrigue accent black cherry and plum fruit, while the texture is silky.
title: Château des Séraphin 2014 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Deliciously fruity and fresh, this is a great blend of Chardonnay, Chenin Blanc and Cabernet Franc. It has bright apple flavors, crisp acidity and a nutty background. It's light and clean at the end.
title: Cave de Saumur NV De Chanceny Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: This attractive and fruity wine blends Niellucciu with Sciacerellu, both local Corsican grapes. The freshness is right there, crisp and hinting at red currant flavors and bright acidity. Drink now.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2014 Domaine Petroni Rosé (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: This property continues its upward trend. It is a solid wine, packed with great ripe fruit. Old vines give extra concentration and depth of flavor. The wine has great potential, with both its tannins and rich fruit playing strongly. Drink from 2023.
title: Château Clerc Milon 2014  Pauillac

description: Spicy, rich and full of ripe fruit, this wine has great potential. It is structured and dense while bringing out a stylish elegance. Blackberry fruit dominates the tannins to create a wine that has both concentration and fine fruit. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2014  Saint-Julien

description: Spicy, rich and full of ripe fruit, this wine has great potential. It is structured and dense while bringing out a stylish elegance. Blackberry fruit dominates the tannins to create a wine that has both concentration and fine fruit. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2014  Saint-Julien

description: Planted in 1935, this single vineyard wine is rich and structured. At this stage, it is dominated by firm tannins as much as by the perfumed juicy black fruits. As the wine softens with age, this generous fruitiness will comet through to give a deliciously ripe wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Michel Dupré 2015 1935 Vieilles Vignes  (Morgon)

description: Ripe scents of pineapple, peach, lychee and melon are laced with hints of honey and orange oil. The palate is lush and mouthfilling, with rich stone- and tropical-fruit flavors that transition into a subtle spice note on the close. Drink now.
designation: Domaine de Lancyre Val de Monteferrand
title: Château de Lancyre 2013 Domaine de Lancyre Val de Monteferrand Roussanne (Saint Guilhem le Désert)

description: Warm, spicy scents of brambly blackberry, spiced plum and fruit cake grace the bouquet of this 80% Syrah and 20% Carignan blend. Hints of graphite add intrigue, while soft tannins and fruit-skin flavors lend an attractive earthiness to the palate. An approachable and ready-to-drink selection.
title: Château de Cordes 2012 Syrah-Carignan (Minervois)

description: Warm, spicy scents of brambly blackberry, spiced plum and fruit cake grace the bouquet of this 80% Syrah and 20% Carignan blend. Hints of graphite add intrigue, while soft tannins and fruit-skin flavors lend an attractive earthiness to the palate. An approachable and ready-to-drink selection.
title: Château de Cordes 2012 Syrah-Carignan (Minervois)

description: Notes of candied mandarins steal their way into this fresh, fruity and blossom-scented wine—think apricot, tangerine and jasmine. The charm is easy here, and all is held on the fruity, perfumed side. This is playful, fruit-driven fun.
title: Willm 2014 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Made from selected parcels of Gamay, this structured wine offers both fruit and fresh acidity. It has a dry core, giving a solid wine with some aging potential. Aromatic and fresh red fruits complete a wine that will be better from 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Grande QV  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: More complex and richly textured than most Provençal rosés, this wine is a treat, from its mineral-laden, smoky aromas to its ripe cherry-berry flavors and layered finish. Drink now, although it has enough stuffing to suggest it might last longer than just a single summer.
title: Domaine Sorin 2007 Terra Amata Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an unusually elegant wine for Provence, from a tiny, isolated vineyard in the maritime Alps. It's a blend of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, that's gently extracted, crimson in color and filled with intricate, delicate fragrances and flavors, ranging from violets and a hint of iodine to red cherries and maybe even a touch of apricot. Drink now and over the next few years.
title: Clos Saint-Joseph 2004 Villars-sur-Var Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Like the estate's Cuvée Carolle, this has a note of volatility and sur-maturité, but it's also bigger, richer and more extracted, with lots of ripe tannins but also thick purple fruit that comes through on the finish. Try in 2010. 40% Syrah, 40% Cab Sauvignon, 10% Mourvèdre, 10% Grenache.
title: Domaine de la Sauveuse 2006 Cuvée Philippine Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: This small négociant house blends wines from 37 different villages to produce its nonvintage cuvée. The wine is balanced, fresh while also ripe with attractive acidity and grapefruit and lemon flavors. A fine orange tang at the end leaves a wine that is bright and deliciously lively.
title: Jeeper NV Brut Grand Assemblage  (Champagne)

description: This wine, with its acidity, is so crisp and bright. Touches of red fruits give the wine a riper character, although what makes it most attractive is the freshness and the delicious fruity aftertaste. Drink this bottle as a fine apéritif.
title: Henri Abelé NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Grown in the far north of Beaujolais, almost in Burgundy's Mâcon region, this full and ripe Chardonnay is full of spice and toast as well as rich yellow fruits. It is still young, with intense citrus flavors, so wait to drink until 2016.
title: Domaine du Clos du Fief 2014 Fleur de  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Grown in the far north of Beaujolais, almost in Burgundy's Mâcon region, this full and ripe Chardonnay is full of spice and toast as well as rich yellow fruits. It is still young, with intense citrus flavors, so wait to drink until 2016.
title: Domaine du Clos du Fief 2014 Fleur de  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Dry in style, this dark-hued wine comes from vines between 30 and 90 years old. With firm tannins and a dry core, it is only just showing its fruity side. Coming from a five-generation family's vineyard near Fleurie, it has the richness and potential of wines from this cru. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Roche Guillon 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Dry in style, this dark-hued wine comes from vines between 30 and 90 years old. With firm tannins and a dry core, it is only just showing its fruity side. Coming from a five-generation family's vineyard near Fleurie, it has the richness and potential of wines from this cru. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Roche Guillon 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This is a fragrant, ripe wine that while delicious to drink now really does need a few months aging. Fruity with apples, lime and green-plum flavors it also has a fine texture that gives structure and will allow the potential richness to develop. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château de Chatelard 2014 Cuvée Secret de  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: A soft style of Blanc de Blancs, rounded as much as crisp, this is an attractively ripe and fruity wine. Apple and grapefruit flavors are filled out with perfumed acidity and a lively, fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Chassenay d'Arce 2005 Blanc de Blancs Millésimé Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A pale-colored rosé, fresh and very dry, this is crisp and light. Attractive raspberry and red currant fruits are cut by acidity. The tangy texture is lively and crisp.
title: Bruno Paillard NV Première Cuvée Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Produced from Grand Cru vineyards, this pale-colored rosé is warm and ripe. An attractive blend of red fruits and crisp acidity is rounded out with a soft, full aftertaste. It could be drunk as an apéritif, although it would be better with food.
title: Lallier NV Grand Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Like its rosé counterpart, this wine is soft and fruity. With attractive apple fruits and bright lemon to give freshness, it's a rounded wine that has perfumed white fruits and a ripe, always fresh aftertaste.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne Sec  (Champagne)

description: Like its rosé counterpart, this wine is soft and fruity. With attractive apple fruits and bright lemon to give freshness, it's a rounded wine that has perfumed white fruits and a ripe, always fresh aftertaste.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne Sec  (Champagne)

description: Light and fruity, with a touch of pepper and spice, this is a immediately attractive, red-fruited wine. It has enough crisp freshness as well as richness to go with food. The aftertaste emphasizes both spice and fruit.
title: Château Thuerry 2012 Le Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light and fruity, with a touch of pepper and spice, this is a immediately attractive, red-fruited wine. It has enough crisp freshness as well as richness to go with food. The aftertaste emphasizes both spice and fruit.
title: Château Thuerry 2012 Le Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The second wine of Château Ramage la Batisse, L'Enclos is ripe and fruity. It has a sense of structure although this is played down by the rich black currant fruits. Acidity cuts through the general richness of this medium-aging wine.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2010 L'Enclose de Ramage  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Rounded wine, showing ripe tropical flavors as well as a more citrus character. The wine is full, attractively textured with a buttery edge. Spice and green herbs come through to finish. Screwcap.
title: Château Larroque 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Rich and dense, this is a ripe, wood-aged wine, now showing maturity. It has weight, red berry fruits and a firmer structure of tannins. It is ready to drink, but could age another year.
title: Château la Mascaronne 2009 La Mascaronne Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Spicy, minty, wood-aged wine that shows more wood than fruit. It does have a rich character from black plum and berry flavors so the wine will become better integrated. So wait for 2–3 years.
title: Château de Calavon 2009 La Réserve Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Spicy, minty, wood-aged wine that shows more wood than fruit. It does have a rich character from black plum and berry flavors so the wine will become better integrated. So wait for 2–3 years.
title: Château de Calavon 2009 La Réserve Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Firmly tannic yet with the potential of good black currant fruit, this is a fine reflection of the vintage, rich and fruity, layered with considerably fresh acidity. Drink now, or give it a year.
title: Grands Terroirs de France 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Zestiness amid the rounded apricot and rose-petal flavors marks this out, while a pleasant, ever-so-slightly bitter phenolic edge gives just a little bite. The aromatics are subtly expressed and the real action happens on the textured palate.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Clean, taut green apple and zesty lemon are the chief markers of this slender, dry wine. It holds lots of refreshment and has a racy core. Have this on its own when in need of refreshment, or have it with food when there is light, subtle fare.
title: Joseph Cattin 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is an obviously wood-aged wine with plenty of toast flavors. This wood aging has flattened the fruit giving a wine that is soft with few tannins. It is ready to drink.
title: Château Laffitte Laujac 2012  Médoc

description: The wine is spicy and laden with wood. It has an extracted character that produces chocolate and bitter coffee flavors. The fruit is hard to find at this stage.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a structured, firm wine that has tense tannins and acidity. It is smoky with a dry core. The fruit is just not there.
title: Château de Beauregard-Ducourt 2014  Bordeaux

description: The spicy wood is prominent here. It balances the red-berry fruits and bright acidity. That makes for a perfumed, juicy wine that will finish fresh and crisp.
title: Château du Grand Pierre 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The spicy wood is prominent here. It balances the red-berry fruits and bright acidity. That makes for a perfumed, juicy wine that will finish fresh and crisp.
title: Château du Grand Pierre 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine from Bruno Martin's 3.3-acre vineyard is going to be a fresh and fruity. Already it has a fine juicy character and plenty of red fruits. Crisp acidity at the end confirms this bright character.
title: Château Sainte-Luce Bellevue 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine has plenty of ripe fruit, raspberry flavors and light spice. With a crisp streak of acidity, it is beginning to show a good balance. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Queyssard 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a wine with light spice and perfumed red fruits. It is juicy, fresh, lightly tannic and likely to develop quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Maréchaux 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A light, fragrant Chardonnay, this wine feels cool and soft. There are attractive plum and greengage flavors, as well as a gentle touch of acidity. This is pure fruitiness, with no wood aging.
title: Domaine de l'Herré 2012 Chardonnay (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Generally regarded as one of the lighter vintages of the 21st century, the wine still has charm and attractive mature flavors like mushroom, as well as a leathery texture. The end still hints at freshness and attractive fruit.
title: Château le Raz 2002  Montravel

description: This firm wine has black-currant and red-plum fruit, nicely integrated with the dry core. Ready to drink, although capable of aging a year or two.
title: Château Grand Marchand 2011  Bordeaux

description: This still-young wine is jammy while firmly structured with dry tannins. There is a foursquare character that misses subtlety with its broad-brush approach. The wine does need to age and will be ready to drink from 2023.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection Tramier  (Corton)

description: This still-young wine is jammy while firmly structured with dry tannins. There is a foursquare character that misses subtlety with its broad-brush approach. The wine does need to age and will be ready to drink from 2023.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection Tramier  (Corton)

description: Old vines on the Aegerter Domaine in Savigny-lès-Beaune give a rounded ripe wine. It has a crisper red-cherry side to its otherwise smooth texture. The tannins support all this juicy fruit and offer a chance for the wine to age. Drink from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Old vines on the Aegerter Domaine in Savigny-lès-Beaune give a rounded ripe wine. It has a crisper red-cherry side to its otherwise smooth texture. The tannins support all this juicy fruit and offer a chance for the wine to age. Drink from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Wood aromas provide a toasty character that dominates the fruit. It will take time for the apple and pear fruit flavors to show. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Françoise André 2015 Sous Frétille Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Wood aromas provide a toasty character that dominates the fruit. It will take time for the apple and pear fruit flavors to show. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Françoise André 2015 Sous Frétille Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Perfumed spice aromas give this wine its toasty character. The wood aging dominates the fruit. The fruit is ripe and will develop. Give this wine until 2024.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2015 Clos de l'Ecu Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This wine is tangy and zesty, with a strong mineral texture that partners with the perfumed acidity, lively fruitiness and citrus flavors. It is likely to age well because of its tight texture. Drink from 2020.
title: Bouchard Aîné et Fils 2015  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: A rich, oak-laden wine that shows fine ripe fruits. There are juicy blackberry and dried fruit flavors allied to a light structure that results in a rich, open and generous wine.
title: Château de Fonbel 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: A creamy, wood-aged white that simultaneously emphasizes crisp Sauvignon Blanc fruit and minerality. Hints of pineapple and lemon go with a tight texture. A rich yet fresh wine that could age for a few years but can also be enjoyed now.
title: Le Nardian 2010  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Rich and spicy, this is a smooth, wood-aged wine. It has ripe tannins and some concentrated fruits. With its acidity and dry aftertaste, it will certainly age.
title: Château La Grange Clinet 2010  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A full, rich wine, showing red fruits at their best. It has structure and layers of bright acidity. It's not a wine for long aging, likely to be at its best in three years time.
title: Château de Laville 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A full, rich wine, showing red fruits at their best. It has structure and layers of bright acidity. It's not a wine for long aging, likely to be at its best in three years time.
title: Château de Laville 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Tense and firmly tannic, this wine is still very young. Berry and black currant fruit are still dominated by a dry character. The wine will take time toward its slow maturity.
title: Château Bourgneuf 2010  Pomerol

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a refreshing, lively rosé. It is dry with strawberry flavors and a crisp acidity on the finish. Drink now.
title: Bott Frères NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Very spicy on the nose, this sweet wine is ripe, full bodied and fruity. It has a floral character that gives complexity as well as a delicious, refreshing aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Bott Frères 2011 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a ripe wine with sugared strawberry flavor. There is ample acidity to balance this fresh wine, and a soft mousse on the finish.
title: Klipfel NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is typical Pinot Blanc—its warm, fruity and soft with just a touch of spice. The wine has an attractive line of acidity from its pear flavors, making it balanced and ready to drink.
title: Dopff & Irion 2012 Cuvée René Dopff Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Medium sweet in style, this is spicy, fragrant wine with honeyed lychee and pear flavors. It's warm and rich with nicely lifted acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2011 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Despite its recent vintage, this is a wine that is already tasting mature. The palate is layered with secondary flavors touched with floral perfume, intense acidity and a dry aftertaste. It's not for aging, so enjoy now.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2011 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a surprisingly dry wine that's all spice and lychee flavors without any hint of sweetness (not indicated on the label unfortunately). It has a light texture with notes of pepper and rosewater, along with some acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2011 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Billards is the name of a small area of Saint-Amour. The cru wine from this vineyard is richly structured and packed with juicy black fruits. There is a mineral texture from the granite subsoil that gives the wine its structure. Drink from late 2017.
title: Jean Loron 2015 Domaine des Billards  (Saint-Amour)

description: Billards is the name of a small area of Saint-Amour. The cru wine from this vineyard is richly structured and packed with juicy black fruits. There is a mineral texture from the granite subsoil that gives the wine its structure. Drink from late 2017.
title: Jean Loron 2015 Domaine des Billards  (Saint-Amour)

description: This ripe, fresh wine packs a punch of fruit. It's well structured and lightly mineral at the back. Swathes of apple, citrus and pink grapefruit occupy the foreground of this impressive wine that is ready for drinking.
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2012 Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Wood-fermented Muscadet is rare and this limited edition from 40-year-old vines is certainly unusual. The toast and spice have taken away the natural fruitiness of the Melon grape while adding a richer texture and a ripe, full-bodied ageworthy feel. Drink from 2017.
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2012 Les Perrières Monopole  (Muscadet)

description: From one of the rising stars in Beaujolais, this ripe wine has both a tense minerality and rich black fruits from vines that average 60 years. It is balanced between the very fresh acidity and a dry edge that will allow it to age. Drink from 2016. The vineyards are certified organic.
title: Richard Rottiers 2014 La Sambinerie  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A balanced wine, this shows both fresh, crisp fruit and the beginnings of toasty maturity. Its richness contrasts with a steely texture and tight, lemon-zest character that gives the wine a delicious tension.
title: J. M. Gobillard et Fils NV Grande Réserve Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Still young and fruity, this wine is totally integrated, harmoniously blending the red fruits with a tight texture and fresh acidity. Although it is drinkable now, it will benefit from bottle age, so best drink from 2017.
title: J. M. Gobillard et Fils 2010 Cuvée Prestige Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Pale in color, this fragrant wine has some bottle age that gives a toast and almond character. Ripe strawberry flavors balance between softness and a crisp, tight aftertaste. It is ready to drink.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Réserve Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Balanced and rich with apple flavors, this is tightly textured, cut with lemon zest and full of fruit. Although aged for six years, it is still so fresh and crisp, with a bright, lively aftertaste only just hinting at some toast.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: An equal blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this is a crisper than other Champagnes in the Coutelas range. It is also still young with its bright green and citrus fruits and tense texture. Lively and fresh, it should be aged and not drunk before 2017.
title: A. D. Coutelas 2006 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: This offers plenty of tannins and a dry, firm structure along with the weight of ripe plums, blackberries and a rich character. The wine is certainly going to age, with its solid texture and bold fruit aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Lucien Lardy 2014 Les Thorins  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This is a dry, mineral wine with a tight texture of lemon zest, white stone fruits and crispness. It is dry while keeping fresh fruitiness. The texture and the structure are just coming together as the wine moves towards a more mature future. A light toastiness adds complexity.
title: Gosset NV Grand Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a dry, mineral wine with a tight texture of lemon zest, white stone fruits and crispness. It is dry while keeping fresh fruitiness. The texture and the structure are just coming together as the wine moves towards a more mature future. A light toastiness adds complexity.
title: Gosset NV Grand Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: With its gold bottle designed by Adriana Karembeu, this rich wine is full of rounded fruits and ripe, juicy apples. This fruitiness is balanced by a more structured character that introduces a steely edge of minerality. The wine is mature, ripe and balanced with a bright, fresher aftertaste.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Cuvée Adriana  (Champagne)

description: From Grand Cru vineyards in the Côte des Blancs, this fresh and fruity wine is now at its peak of crispness and minerality. It has concentration and a lively texture with white fruits, citrus and a bright, tight aftertaste. It could age after purchase, although there is no need.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Extra Brut
title: Bruno Paillard NV Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Certainly dry, this Champagne is also ripe and structured, balancing the extreme dryness and acidity. It is a complex wine that has the ability to age in the bottle. The minimalist label, designed by Philip Starck, is a perfect pairing with the no-frills wine inside the bottle.
title: Louis Roederer 2006 Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: Yes, it is very dark colored, but this rich wine shows elegance as well as its dense tannins. Flavors of blackberries come through the coffee note and dry core to give a wine that will develop relatively quickly over the next 2–3 years.
designation: Clos Triguedina La Chapelle du Clos
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina La Chapelle du Clos Malbec (Cahors)

description: Yes, it is very dark colored, but this rich wine shows elegance as well as its dense tannins. Flavors of blackberries come through the coffee note and dry core to give a wine that will develop relatively quickly over the next 2–3 years.
designation: Clos Triguedina La Chapelle du Clos
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina La Chapelle du Clos Malbec (Cahors)

description: So rich that it is almost sweet. The yellow fruits give considerable ripeness to this intense, spicy wine. With its smooth, oily texture and its layers of wood, it is almost too much.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2009 Moulin des Dames White (Bergerac Sec)

description: A wine that balances considerable sweetness against the most exhilarating freshness. It has honey, yellow fruits, orange peel alongside touches of greener plums and herbs. A great aperitif wine.
title: Château de Jurque 2009 Tendresse  (Jurançon)

description: This is structured, its tannins coming through dense and dry. The blackberry fruits give a juicy character that's overlaid by wood. The wine has a firm character, while letting the fruit show well.
title: Château de Cénac 2009 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: A darkly tannic wine, with licorice and espresso coffee flavors as well as intense blackberry fruits. It is firm, the wood aging showing through strongly at this stage. Keep for 3–4 years so that the alcohol burn can blow off.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2008 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Almost black in color, this is a Syrah to rival the most concentrated wines from the Rhône. It has weight, richness and power, its dark damson fruit flavors and tannins almost lost in all this intense fruit. Age for 3–4 years or drink now.
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Château Bouissel 2009 Le Syrah de Bouissel Syrah (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: Almost black in color, this is a Syrah to rival the most concentrated wines from the Rhône. It has weight, richness and power, its dark damson fruit flavors and tannins almost lost in all this intense fruit. Age for 3–4 years or drink now.
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Château Bouissel 2009 Le Syrah de Bouissel Syrah (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: This has enough rich fruit to meld with the abundance of toasty wood. It is opulent and ripe, a powerful wine, typical of the vintage with its sweet red-berry flavor and refreshing acidity on the finish.
title: Château la Croix Saint-Georges 2009  Pomerol

description: Tough at the moment, this is a wine with impressive concentration. It's solid and chunky, with massive structure. The fragrant finish is a sign of the pleasure to come.
title: Château Grand-Puy Ducasse 2010  Pauillac

description: Rich and juicy, this features a ripe plum flavor and acidity, resulting in a wine that is fragrant, fresh and structured. It has power, and its dark concentration is at the heart of this solid effort.
title: Château Fombrauge 2008 Magrez Fombrauge  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Ripe, dense and smooth from wood aging, this is a modern view of Margaux. At the same time, it shows a beautiful black-currant flavor from the Cabernet Sauvignon, and the Petit Verdot adds great color.
title: Château du Tertre 2010  Margaux

description: This firmly tannic wine boasts solid structure and density. It has powerful concentration, due to very low yields. The fruit is ripe, driven by notes of black plum and berry. This is a wine with a long-term future.
title: Château de Pez 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: Warm, voluptuous, rich and generous, this wine has the right weight, along with firm, dark tannins and a bitter coffee flavor. The finish is warm and delicious.
title: Château de Candale 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This blend of Marsanne and Roussanne comes across as something of a hybrid between Hermitage and Burgundy. It has grilled peach, citrus and smoke notes, ample weight and a long, hazelnut-tinged finish. Drink it over the next 6–8 years.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 Domaine Mule Blanche White (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: Ripe and fruity, this is a pale pink-colored wine from Raymond family organic vineyards. In the winery, the wine is full of red berry flavors and with a crisp final texture. Refreshing and lively, it's ready to drink now.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: The nose is subdued but has a floral aspect. The palate, while fresh, slender and dry, seems to have a bitter element that gets in the way of the clean citrus notes. There is some concentration and a zesty lemony finish.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2016 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: While there is ample pear fruit on nose and palate, bitter pith notes seem to be dominant. Alcoholic heat is palpable on the midpalate. The finish is dry and returns to the fruity pear notes.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2016 Vieilles Vignes Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This soft and fruity wine has open white fruit and citrus flavors. It is light and crisp with just the right amount of acidity. Coming from a warm year, it is richer than in other vintages, smoother and riper. Drink now.
title: Chateau de l'Oiselinière 2015 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This soft and fruity wine has open white fruit and citrus flavors. It is light and crisp with just the right amount of acidity. Coming from a warm year, it is richer than in other vintages, smoother and riper. Drink now.
title: Chateau de l'Oiselinière 2015 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This intense and rich wine has also managed to keep a great sense of balance. The black fruits emerge from the firm tannins, bringing with them juicy acidity and a dusty texture. The wine is still young, but it's developing well to emerge ripe and delicious by 2016.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2012 K-or Malbec (Cahors)

description: The top cuvée from Château Famaey is a rich, new-wood-aged wine. With spice, mint and toast flavors, it's opulent, ripe and full of black fruits. Even at five years, it's still young, with tannins that are dense and concentrated. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Famaey 2009 Cuvée X Malbec (Cahors)

description: Château des Jacques, owned by Burgundy producer Louis Jadot, makes serious wines, such as this Morgon. It's powerful and rich, full of solid black cherry flavors and a strongly mineral structure from granite soil. It's a complex wine that needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012  Morgon

description: Château des Jacques, owned by Burgundy producer Louis Jadot, makes serious wines, such as this Morgon. It's powerful and rich, full of solid black cherry flavors and a strongly mineral structure from granite soil. It's a complex wine that needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012  Morgon

description: This strongly mineral and textured wine is all about terroir. It has dark tannins, dense black fruits as well as freshness. Black currants and cherries give the fruity side, but at this stage it's the structure that is important. Wait and drink from 2016.
title: Lucien Lardy 2013 Côte de Py  (Morgon)

description: This legendary Madiran is, its fruit tannins just softened by wood aging. It's smoky, brooding, very concentrated, and worth aging for 10 years.
title: Alain Brumont 2007 Château Montus Tannat-Cabernet Franc (Madiran)

description: This is a blend of the best barrels from the five Mercurey Premier Crus owned by the Devillard family. First produced in the 2010 vintage, the wine is now made in most vintages. It is a rich wine, bringing out the pure red fruitiness of a Mercurey and its beautifully integrated structure. It is concentrated and very dense, packed with vanilla, mint and dark coffee flavors as well as the fruit. Age this wine, at least until 2020.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Château de Chamirey Les Cinq  (Mercurey)

description: This Premier Cru abuts some of the grandest Grand Crus of Burgundy. It shares the same rich, age-worthy characters with this dark structure and dense tannins. The wine is still very young: its texture mineral and concentrated. The black fruits and licorice flavors will develop slowly and surely, but don't drink before 2022.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2014 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: From right at the northern end of the sweep of Corton Grand Cru vineyards, this rich and complex wine is dense with smoky flavors as well as ripe blackberry fruit. It is solid, densely structured and powered minerality from the chalk in the soil. This is going to be a fine wine, so drink from 2019.
title: Capitain-Gagnerot 2011 Les Grandes Lolières  (Corton)

description: From old vines, as are most of the wines from this producer, this is a dense and powerful wine. New wood aging has given the wine a strongly toasty character balanced with creamy apple and yellow fruits. The wine is concentrated and obviously needs to age. Drink from 2022.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: From old vines, as are most of the wines from this producer, this is a dense and powerful wine. New wood aging has given the wine a strongly toasty character balanced with creamy apple and yellow fruits. The wine is concentrated and obviously needs to age. Drink from 2022.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Structured and still very young, this is a dense and fruity wine. The tannins and the spice and licorice from wood aging show strongly, although they are just beginning to soften and integrate. Expect a rich wine, layered with fruit and ripe tannins as it develops. Drink from 2023.
title: Philippe Pacalet 2013  Echézeaux

description: This is a domaine wine, coming from one of the vineyards owned by Olivier Leflaive and worked biodynamically. It is a very fine wine from probably the most well-known premier cru in the village. With its rich acidity and white fruits, it is generous as well as crisply textured. The toast from the wood aging adds its juicy character to this impressive wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This is a domaine wine, coming from one of the vineyards owned by Olivier Leflaive and worked biodynamically. It is a very fine wine from probably the most well-known premier cru in the village. With its rich acidity and white fruits, it is generous as well as crisply textured. The toast from the wood aging adds its juicy character to this impressive wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This is a rich textured wine from the center of this Premier Cru. It has structure and concentration as well as generous white stone fruits. Densely packed with acidity, toast and a fine, creamy texture, the wine is likely to age well. It is produced from biodynamically grown grapes (as are all the Olivier Leflaive family Grand and Premier Crus). Drink from 2020.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Clos Saint-Marc Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This wine is  refreshing, its red fruit juice laced with acidity and a touch of herbs. Easy and light to drink.
title: Andrieux & Fils 2010 Cuvée Victoria Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This starts off shy, but with time allows aromas of delicate peach, cherry and orange blossom to come through in the bouquet. Pleasant ripe-fruit flavors unfold on the clean, well-balanced palate, with lingering notes of peach pit and orange peel on the finish.
title: Les Vignerons de Florensac 2016 Rosé été Rosé (Côtes de Thau)

description: Made from 40% Syrah, 30% Grenache, 20% Mourvèdre and 10% Carignan, this Roussillon rosé opens with elegant notes of green pepper and savory herbs that frame the tight red cherry and underripe melon fruits. Medium in weight and a touch plush in feel, red cherry and berry tones dominate the palate, but finish bright and with a slightly bitter, fruit skin-like edge on the close.
title: Domaine Cazes 2016 Les Clos De Paulilles Collioure Rosé (Collioure)

description: Big tannins mask the fruit in this potentially ripe and fruity wine. It is structured and dark with a dry core of tannins. It means the wine needs time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Vircoulon 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Big tannins mask the fruit in this potentially ripe and fruity wine. It is structured and dark with a dry core of tannins. It means the wine needs time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Vircoulon 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: There is a caramel edge to this wine showing the wood-aging flavors. Luckily the fruit is all there as well, giving a balanced future to this structured wine. With plenty of tannins and juicy acidity combined, it will be a fine wine from 2019.
title: Château Saint Seurin 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a bold fruity wine that just allows its tannins to build a supporting structure. The black fruits are right up front, full of acidity and with a delicious potential. Drink from 2019.
title: Château le Grand Verdus 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Rich and with good fruit, this is a structured wine that has the density to age well. The dark-chocolate flavors mingle with the black-plum fruits, finishing with just a light lift of acidity.
title: Château la Verrière 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Rich and with good fruit, this is a structured wine that has the density to age well. The dark-chocolate flavors mingle with the black-plum fruits, finishing with just a light lift of acidity.
title: Château la Verrière 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Produced in the hills above the small town of Castillon, the wine is fruity with a stalky texture and some firm tannins. It is balanced, though, with its acidity and black-currant flavors and should mature well over the next few years. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Roc 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine has firm tannins and a dense texture that promises a good aging potential. Its ripe blackberry and black-plum fruits also show a solid wine with its richness and fine fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Rouquette 2016  Bordeaux

description: The wine has firm tannins and a dense texture that promises a good aging potential. Its ripe blackberry and black-plum fruits also show a solid wine with its richness and fine fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Rouquette 2016  Bordeaux

description: While there are plenty of wood flavors here, the wine also has fine ripe blackberries. That gives potential balance and density. This fine wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château de Lionne 2015 L'Envolée de Lionne  (Bordeaux)

description: Bright cherry and cedary aromas open to a soft mouthfeel and tart blackberry flavors with black toast shadings. The dark flavors and light mouthfeel are a bit out of sync, as if the flavor range demands more weight on the palate. Tart black fruits show on the finish.
title: Abarbanel 1999 Estate Bottled Syrah (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Rich perfumes reach the nose: quince and baked apple give a seductive tone. The palate strikes with the same richness but is dry. There is concentration and earthy power against a backdrop of freshness and fruity charm.
title: Domaine Gresser 2014 Wiebelsberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Mellow, rounded and ripe notes of fresh and baked apples promise a rich wine. The palate is more sprightly and lends plenty of gingery, peppery spice to all the abundant apple fruit. This is wired and lively, dry but very fruity and unusually spicy with a fine backbone of bright, lemony freshness. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2012 Frankstein Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Mellow, rounded and ripe notes of fresh and baked apples promise a rich wine. The palate is more sprightly and lends plenty of gingery, peppery spice to all the abundant apple fruit. This is wired and lively, dry but very fruity and unusually spicy with a fine backbone of bright, lemony freshness. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2012 Frankstein Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is so fresh and crisp with an attractive mineral character that points up the crisp apple flavors. There is a fine touch of citrus acidity as well to enhance the freshness of the wine. It is delicious, bright and refreshingly light.
title: Monmousseau NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Sun ripened mirabelle notes entice the nose and continue on the palate, where they are joined by an earthy edge as well as a pervasive lemon freshness. This is slender and fresh, dry and very energetic. The finish is lip-smacking and moreish.
title: André Kientzler 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Sun ripened mirabelle notes entice the nose and continue on the palate, where they are joined by an earthy edge as well as a pervasive lemon freshness. This is slender and fresh, dry and very energetic. The finish is lip-smacking and moreish.
title: André Kientzler 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose has rich hints of dried lemon peel while the palate shows fresh lemon zest. The flavors on the slender but concentrated body are pure and very fresh. This is just dry and totally focuses on lemon flesh and zest. Wonderfully fresh and enlivening.
title: Willm 2016 Cuvée Emile Willm Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose has rich hints of dried lemon peel while the palate shows fresh lemon zest. The flavors on the slender but concentrated body are pure and very fresh. This is just dry and totally focuses on lemon flesh and zest. Wonderfully fresh and enlivening.
title: Willm 2016 Cuvée Emile Willm Riesling (Alsace)

description: The wine is candied and sherbet-flavored. Acidity gives some freshness, but it feels artificial and light.
title: Manuel Seguin 2012  Viré-Clessé

description: Very soft and dull, it offers white fruits and some acidity. Drink now.
title: Louis Latour 2012 En Paradis  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: Despite its name, this is in fact a rosé, which is light orange-pink in color. It is bone dry, mineral, taut and crisp. Red currant and lime flavors mingle with a tight acidity and totally dry aftertaste. Disgorged June 2012.
title: René Geoffroy NV Blanc de Rosé Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Despite its name, this is in fact a rosé, which is light orange-pink in color. It is bone dry, mineral, taut and crisp. Red currant and lime flavors mingle with a tight acidity and totally dry aftertaste. Disgorged June 2012.
title: René Geoffroy NV Blanc de Rosé Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: A soft, ripe rosé, this is on the sweeter side of brut. It also has a flavor of bottle maturity that blends easily with attractive crisp acidity and a fragrant rose hip character. It is ready to drink.
title: H. Blin NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Rustic, barnyard aromas with flavors of hedgerow red berries and light acidity. The style is fruity; the sweet fruits are shot through with some licorice and beetroot flavors.
title: Château du Bousquet 2005  Côtes de Bourg

description: Rustic, barnyard aromas with flavors of hedgerow red berries and light acidity. The style is fruity; the sweet fruits are shot through with some licorice and beetroot flavors.
title: Château du Bousquet 2005  Côtes de Bourg

description: There's earthy, fleshy aromas on this wine that has acidity, red fruits and soft tannins. The rough edge of rusticity is not far away, though, spoiling the fresh fruits.
title: Château Saint-Sulpice 2005  Bordeaux

description: With its few years' aging, the wine exhibits a Chenin Blanc nutty quality backed by the greater weight of Chardonnay. Full-bodied, ready to drink. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays du Jardin de la France
title: Domaine des Baumard 2006 La Calèche Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Vin de Pays du Jardin de la France)

description: A soft, open wine, kept together by its dry tannins. Good black fruits, fresh acidity and an attractive smoky character.
title: Château Monroze 2008  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A wine that offers plenty of the charm of Margaux, with its soft tannins, layers of chocolate, smooth texture and juicy fruit. The wood at this stage is prominent, and needs to settle down.
title: Barton & Guestier 2007 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Margaux)

description: Close to Fronsac, this is a Merlot-dominated wine that has soft, ripe fruit. It shows sweetness and open berry flavors touched by chocolate and licorice. To be   opened over the next 2–3 years.
title: Château Saint-Michel 2008  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Close to Fronsac, this is a Merlot-dominated wine that has soft, ripe fruit. It shows sweetness and open berry flavors touched by chocolate and licorice. To be   opened over the next 2–3 years.
title: Château Saint-Michel 2008  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A curious, dirty nose doesn't help this wine. The palate is certainly better, its fruit now mature, smooth, the acidity blending with attractive smoky flavors.
title: Château Pimpine 2005  Bordeaux Côtes de Francs

description: Tight wine, its black currant flavors layered with dry tannins. It's finely structured, although the stalky element tends to dominate. Not for aging.
title: Barton & Guestier 2008  Médoc

description: Confusingly, the wine has no connection with Château Magnol, also owned by Barton & Guestier. It's a soft Médoc wine, light and gentle in character, the tannins soft, merging with the red berry fruits.
title: Barton & Guestier 2008 Les Charmes de Magnol  (Médoc)

description: A blend of typical Gascon grapes gives a lemon and citrus wine, very fresh, tangy. There is plenty of acidity and an attractive lightness. Screwcap.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2009 Villa Beaurivage White (Vin de France)

description: A blend of typical Gascon grapes gives a lemon and citrus wine, very fresh, tangy. There is plenty of acidity and an attractive lightness. Screwcap.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2009 Villa Beaurivage White (Vin de France)

description: With layers of new wood and spice flavors, this wine is highly structured without much fruit to balance. It will develop into a dry, firm wine, showing light black fruit flavors surrounded by textured tannins.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2011  Médoc

description: With layers of new wood and spice flavors, this wine is highly structured without much fruit to balance. It will develop into a dry, firm wine, showing light black fruit flavors surrounded by textured tannins.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2011  Médoc

description: This is an enormous wine, maybe too much. With its layers of rich black fruits and dark tannins, it is a powerful, juicy, jammy and super-ripe wine. It all seems excessive and out of balance. It's fun for a moment, but not for drinking with food.
title: Château Roullet 2010  Canon-Fronsac

description: An attractive, if lightweight, wine that has good acidity and red berry fruits. It is a medium-term wine, fresh and developing quickly.
title: Château Léo de Prades 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: An attractive, if lightweight, wine that has good acidity and red berry fruits. It is a medium-term wine, fresh and developing quickly.
title: Château Léo de Prades 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a stalky, black currant and spice flavored wine. It has relatively soft tannins while showing a meaty, juicy character. The wine is for medium-term aging, so drink from 2016.
title: Château d'Escurac 2011  Médoc

description: This is a stalky, black currant and spice flavored wine. It has relatively soft tannins while showing a meaty, juicy character. The wine is for medium-term aging, so drink from 2016.
title: Château d'Escurac 2011  Médoc

description: Named after the stagecoaches that used to travel through the Médoc, this château has produced an attractive, fruity wine in 2011. It has some tannins and firm wood-aging flavors, while the fruit is light and fresh. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Patache d'Aux 2011  Médoc

description: Despite some tough tannins on the finish, this is an intriguingly complex wine that may prove even better than this rating suggests. It starts with a garrigue note and a hint of tapenade, then adds bright cherry fruit and plenty of dusty tannins. Drink 2014–2020.
title: André Brunel 2009 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Despite some tough tannins on the finish, this is an intriguingly complex wine that may prove even better than this rating suggests. It starts with a garrigue note and a hint of tapenade, then adds bright cherry fruit and plenty of dusty tannins. Drink 2014–2020.
title: André Brunel 2009 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Smoky and structured, this is a wine that has both firm tannins and balanced, juicy fruits. It's a fine wine to drink now, especially with rich meats, and it can age for a year or two.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: Smoky and structured, this is a wine that has both firm tannins and balanced, juicy fruits. It's a fine wine to drink now, especially with rich meats, and it can age for a year or two.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: Ripe plum and blackberry fruits push this wine forward, with firm tannins and smokiness. Full and juicy in feel, this is a fruity wine that is immediately accessible and friendly. It's a wine that will age over the medium term.
title: Château Thénac 2009 Fleur du Périgord Red (Bergerac)

description: A 50-50 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this smoky wine has a flavor of black currant juice and a lean, firmly tannic texture. It needs several years to mature.
title: Château la Roque de By 2010  Médoc

description: A 50-50 blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this smoky wine has a flavor of black currant juice and a lean, firmly tannic texture. It needs several years to mature.
title: Château la Roque de By 2010  Médoc

description: Using fruit sourced from a small appellation to the west of Cahors and east of Bergerac, this blend of Merlot and Malbec shows a light, approachable character. It's full of red berry fruit, with sweet tannins and juicy acids on the finish.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Pigmentum Merlot-Malbec (Buzet)

description: This is a rich, full-bodied and complex wine. It shows dense tannins and equally dense fruits that are powered by the ripe black currant fruit flavors. There is a fresher component at the end, attractive and bright. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Ormes de Pez 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a perfumed, new wood-flavored wine. It has soft tannins and attractive acidity along with a drier core. Showing a rich potential, it will round out over the next four to five years. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Meyney 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a ripe wine with spice, juicy red fruits and a feeling of opulence. Full, fruity and rich, it's a wine for medium-term aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2011  Pauillac

description: A very dry wine, it shows the traditional Saint- Estèphe hard tannins. That suggests it will develop slowly, gradually bringing out the potential of the red berry fruits and acidity as it develops into a fine, complex wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Cos Labory 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a woody, toasty wine, which seems to be the style here for the last several years. It has weight, but does need time for the wood to subside and bring out the elegant fruits.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2008  Saint-Estèphe

description: Very herbaceous, dominated by Sauvignon Blanc, this wine is powered by green fruits, citrus and layers of wood. Ripe, crisp, with a tangy finish.
title: Château Couhins 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: Only produced from Grand Cru vineyards, this ripe wine offers yellow fruit flavors cut by dry tangy citrus acidity. It's full in the mouth, with a creamy mousse and attractive freshness. The wine, with its hints of toast as well as fruit, is ready to drink.
title: Pehu-Simonet NV Face Nord Brut Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: Made from old vines and vinified in oak, this beautifully rich, very dry wine has both rounded apricots and quince plus a touch of toast. It is still young, fresh and needs to age. Drink from 2017 and the tense, youthful minerality will disappear and become richer and full.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2013 Le Peu Morier  (Vouvray)

description: Made from old vines and vinified in oak, this beautifully rich, very dry wine has both rounded apricots and quince plus a touch of toast. It is still young, fresh and needs to age. Drink from 2017 and the tense, youthful minerality will disappear and become richer and full.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2013 Le Peu Morier  (Vouvray)

description: On the right bank of the Serein river, Vaucoupin gives rich wines, showing its sunny exposition. This bottling is ripe, full in the mouth and intense with fragrant white fruits, vanilla and youthful acidity. With freshness still to the fore, it will age and will be better from 2017.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2013 Vaucoupin Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The oak aging, implicit in the name of the wine, is present in its smooth character. This bottling is in the elegant style typical of Famaey wines and also has weight and firm, concentrated black fruit with acidity and a dry core. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Famaey 2011 Fût de Chêne Malbec (Cahors)

description: The oak aging, implicit in the name of the wine, is present in its smooth character. This bottling is in the elegant style typical of Famaey wines and also has weight and firm, concentrated black fruit with acidity and a dry core. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Famaey 2011 Fût de Chêne Malbec (Cahors)

description: The Domaine des Perdrix is based at Nuits Saint-Georges, so this wine comes from the Côte de Nuits. It is richly fruity with layers of warm red fruits and soft tannins. Rounded and ripe, the wine is an instant success. Drink now.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine des Perdrix  (Bourgogne)

description: This blend from several vineyards is a soft, rounded wine. It has a good balance between acidity and ripe white and yellow fruits, shot through with acidity. A touch of toast adds spice to the mix. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Château de Chamirey  (Mercurey)

description: A mineral-driven wine, this is tangy-zesty, with a tight texture. Great fruit shines through the crispness. Balanced, ripe and with some potential, the wine will be ready from late 2018.
title: Domaine Perraud 2015  Saint-Véran

description: This wine is tight and flinty. Crisp lemon and apple flavors are textured with a steely character that needs time to broaden out. Drink this mineral wine from 2019.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2016 Vers Cras  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Behind the main vineyards of the Côte de Beaune, this village makes some delicious wines, both red and white. This village wine, full of fruit, also has wood-aging flavors and firm spicy tannins. It is coming together well and will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2015  Auxey-Duresses

description: This ripe, full-bodied wine is made from biodynamically grown grapes. Although rich, it has enough acidity to keeps it crisp and fruity. The wine is balanced and delicious, ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Guillemot-Michel 2015 Quintaine  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Full of warm fruit and light spice, this generous wine is rich with yellow fruits balanced by bright acidity and vanilla. The rounded texture and ripe fruit mean the wine is very ready to drink.
title: Clos des Rocs 2015 En Chantone  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: For this appellation, this is a soft wine, full of bright cherry flavors and attractive acidity. A jammy character brings out rich fruitiness that will allow the wine to be ready from 2018.
title: Château de Pizay 2016  Morgon

description: This wine has a firm structure as well as plenty of fruit. The wine's acidity, crisp red-currant fruit and bright character are balanced by the firm, smoky and dry tannins. Give this structure time to soften and fill out into a ripe wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Pizay 2016 Château de Saint Lager  (Brouilly)

description: This wine has a firm structure as well as plenty of fruit. The wine's acidity, crisp red-currant fruit and bright character are balanced by the firm, smoky and dry tannins. Give this structure time to soften and fill out into a ripe wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Pizay 2016 Château de Saint Lager  (Brouilly)

description: A smooth and creamy wine, this is packed with tropical fruits and spice. Acidity gives the wine its lift, bringing a crisp edge to the full-bodied character. Drink now.
title: Pascal Rollet 2015 Aux Bouthières  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: The hot, overweight 2003 vintage has not been kind to this licorice- and dark chocolate-flavored wine. It is dry, firm, while still garishly rich. If you have it, drink it now.
title: Château Fourcas Hosten 2003  Listrac-Médoc

description: This is a lively crisp wine with a creamy texture and a perfumed character. It is ripe and full with just enough acidity to give freshness.
title: Château Jeanguillon 2015  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: The wine is structured with concentrated tannins and dense fruit. It has spice, wood-aging flavors and a firm aftertaste. That means the wine needs time, so wait until 2019.
title: Château Haut Peyrefaure 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a structured wine from 96% Merlot and 4% Cabernet Sauvignon that has plenty of fruit. With some firm tannins as well as concentrated blackberry fruit, it is going to be a fine wine. It was created under the direction of consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt's team. Start drinking from 2019.
title: Château Gigault 2014 Cuvée Viva  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine is full of juicy acidity along with some attractive spice and light wood flavors. It is still developing and the fruit is too young, so give it until 2018.
title: Château Feret Lambert 2014 Costes du Château Feret Lambert  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This is a dry wine, firm with tense tannins and structured. It needs time to bring out the ripe fruits that are there. Big and concentrated, this wine inaugurated a new gravity-fed winery. Wait until 2019 to drink.
title: Château Bourron 2014 Belvedere de Château Bourron  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a dry wine, firm with tense tannins and structured. It needs time to bring out the ripe fruits that are there. Big and concentrated, this wine inaugurated a new gravity-fed winery. Wait until 2019 to drink.
title: Château Bourron 2014 Belvedere de Château Bourron  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a crisp and herbal wine that is both fruity and finely textured. With layers of acidity and green fruit flavors, it is bright, fresh and ready to drink.
title: Château Barbé 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This soft wine has strong red-berry flavors and a ripe, lightly tannic texture from the 100% Pinot Noir. It is fruity and ready to drink.
title: Jean Laurent NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This wine is ripe and potentially rich, but is firm at this stage. With its dark tannins and dense structure, it will age well. Drink from 2019.
title: Vignobles Carreau Selection 2014 Château Crusquet Sabourin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The organic wine has tight tannins and acidity. The structure is balanced by red-currant fruit flavors. The wine is vinified under the direction of Michel Rolland and one of several family wineries under Bacchus Investments. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Suau 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The organic wine has tight tannins and acidity. The structure is balanced by red-currant fruit flavors. The wine is vinified under the direction of Michel Rolland and one of several family wineries under Bacchus Investments. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Suau 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a fresh wine that has been aged in tanks, retaining its bright red fruits and lively acidity. It is still young although it will develop quickly to give a soft fruit-driven wine.
title: Château Roc de Ségur 2015  Bordeaux

description: Spice and some firm tannins mark this wine. It has a red-fruit character as well as a more earthy backdrop. With its structure it will need to sit until 2017.
title: Château Malbat 2014 Optimus  (Bordeaux)

description: Spice and some firm tannins mark this wine. It has a red-fruit character as well as a more earthy backdrop. With its structure it will need to sit until 2017.
title: Château Malbat 2014 Optimus  (Bordeaux)

description: The wine is all fruit with just the lightest tannins. It has great acidity, a lively red -ruit character and intense freshness. Drink this wine now.
title: Château les Arromans 2014  Bordeaux

description: The wine is firm and structured although with enough fruit weight to give the wine a good potential for aging. Still full of young energy, it is going to develop balance.
title: Château Lajarre 2014 Cuvée Eléonore  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Full of acidity and red-currant flavors, this is a wine that is light and fruity. It is crisp along with touches of wood. This is one of several Nicolas Thienpont properties, run by son Cyrille. Drink from 2018.
title: Château La Prade 2014  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A very flowery interpretation with gardenia, freesia and carnations on the nose that carry over to the palate where they merge with fresh orange peel. There's only moderate intensity and complexity here, but the exceptionally pretty nose and the crisp, linear finish make for a nice overall package. Serve with flounder. Should be drunk up in a year or two.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2007 Prestige Riesling (Alsace)

description: A very flowery interpretation with gardenia, freesia and carnations on the nose that carry over to the palate where they merge with fresh orange peel. There's only moderate intensity and complexity here, but the exceptionally pretty nose and the crisp, linear finish make for a nice overall package. Serve with flounder. Should be drunk up in a year or two.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2007 Prestige Riesling (Alsace)

description: The wine has aromas of pears. There is plenty of fruit here, but the freshness is missing, giving a southern, warm feel.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Domaine Long-Depaquit  (Chablis)

description: The wine has aromas of pears. There is plenty of fruit here, but the freshness is missing, giving a southern, warm feel.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Domaine Long-Depaquit  (Chablis)

description: Crisp and fresh with lively flavors of apple slices, clementine supremes, nectarine and a touch of honeysuckle. Lighter weight with good balance and a clean finish. The 2009 should be available, so drink up the '08 now.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2008 Réserve St. Martin Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: While there are certainly tannins here, this wine is essentially about fruit. Stalky black currants and berries dominate this perfumed wine with its fresh acidity and crisp, clean aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Haut-Sorillon 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Fruity and juicy, this is an attractive blend of Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc, giving a tight, mineral-driven wine. With its pink grapefruit and crisp green apple fruits, it is young and can age, although not for long. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Grand Jean 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This fragrant, spicy wine is soft and rounded. It is still developing to give a wine that will be warm and full. It misses something of the essential fruitiness.
title: Château Au Grand Paris 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This stalky, firmly tannic wine is still developing. Dominated by Merlot, it has black currant fruits in the background with acidity and crispness. Give this structured wine another few years and drink from 2016.
title: Château Andron 2010  Médoc

description: This stalky, firmly tannic wine is still developing. Dominated by Merlot, it has black currant fruits in the background with acidity and crispness. Give this structured wine another few years and drink from 2016.
title: Château Andron 2010  Médoc

description: This is a soft and ripe wine. Red fruits and caramel flavors add weight to the wine and a rich character, without forgetting the crisp, fresh acidity in the aftertaste.
designation: Le Rosé Gourmand de Maison Blanche
title: Maison Bouey 2014 Le Rosé Gourmand de Maison Blanche Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a soft and ripe wine. Red fruits and caramel flavors add weight to the wine and a rich character, without forgetting the crisp, fresh acidity in the aftertaste.
designation: Le Rosé Gourmand de Maison Blanche
title: Maison Bouey 2014 Le Rosé Gourmand de Maison Blanche Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This crisp, lemon-flavored wine has a ripe, full character. It is rich with apples, apricots and delicious acidity at the end.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This crisp, lemon-flavored wine has a ripe, full character. It is rich with apples, apricots and delicious acidity at the end.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. There is big, and serious botrytis here. With its powerful structure, its dry botrytis, here's a wine that will certainly need aging. Very powerful, intense.
title: Château Lamothe Guignard 2006 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. There is big, and serious botrytis here. With its powerful structure, its dry botrytis, here's a wine that will certainly need aging. Very powerful, intense.
title: Château Lamothe Guignard 2006 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. A dark, meaty wine, very new world in its richness and opulence. It is concentrated, packed with black fruit.—R.V.
title: Château Faugères 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. With its big, almost dry core of botrytis, this is going to be an intense wine - many years from now. For the present, the acidity gives it some freshness, while it remains concentrated.
title: Château Suau 2008 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. With its big, almost dry core of botrytis, this is going to be an intense wine - many years from now. For the present, the acidity gives it some freshness, while it remains concentrated.
title: Château Suau 2008 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. An impressive wine. It shows just the right balance of dry botrytis and sweet fruit, bringing a firm structure as well as ripe bitter orange marmalade flavors.
title: Château Filhot 2008 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. An impressive wine. It shows just the right balance of dry botrytis and sweet fruit, bringing a firm structure as well as ripe bitter orange marmalade flavors.
