title: Château Filhot 2008 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. With its gold color, this announces richness. The texture is rich, a wine that rounds in the mouth, giving sweetness, tropical flavors and big, ripe fruit. Only to finish, does the acidity arrive.
title: Château de Myrat 2008 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. With its gold color, this announces richness. The texture is rich, a wine that rounds in the mouth, giving sweetness, tropical flavors and big, ripe fruit. Only to finish, does the acidity arrive.
title: Château de Myrat 2008 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. Like many of the Sauternes in 2008, this is dominated by huge, concentrated botrytis. The fruits are dried, with orange peel coming through as a final, fresh lift.
title: Château Clos Haut-Peyraguey 2008 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. A fat, full wine, this is rich, intense, concentrated. Great layers of botrytis and apricot flavors give it attraction and power.—R.V.
title: Château Rieussec 2006 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. A fat, full wine, this is rich, intense, concentrated. Great layers of botrytis and apricot flavors give it attraction and power.—R.V.
title: Château Rieussec 2006 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. Owned by the Bécot family of Beauséjour-Bécot, this is a single vineyard parcel, producing a rich wine, powered by blackberry fruits.
title: Château la Gomerie 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. Well balanced wine, with its rich dark fruits well in harmony with its freshness and its dry tannins. Very juicy aftertaste.
title: Château Hosanna 2006 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 92—94 Barrel sample. Well balanced wine, with its rich dark fruits well in harmony with its freshness and its dry tannins. Very juicy aftertaste.
title: Château Hosanna 2006 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: This crisp, lively red shows off the herbal notes of Provence—what the French call garrigue—and tart cherry fruit. It's less ripe than many Côtes du Rhône wines, but bright and mouthwatering. Drink now–2020.
title: H to H 2014 Homage to Heritage Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Elegant and full of fruit, it has just the right steely edge. It offers richness as well, with lemon and pear fruits showing strongly. Acidity gives a bright aftertaste to this wine that will age well. Drink from 2016.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2011 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Dense tannins dominate this firm and structured wine. Behind the dry surface lies fruitiness, bringing out red currant and berry flavors along  with acidity. The wine is potentially rich and deliciously perfumed. Drink from 2017.
title: Louis Jadot 2011 Clos du Roy  (Marsannay)

description: A lightly smoky aroma shows the wood aging of this wine. It is toasty, with a mineral touch, and the ripe yellow fruits are developing well. Smooth and potentially rich, this needs a few more months to show at its best. Drink from 2015.
title: La Soufrandière 2012 Clos de Grand Père  (Mâcon-Vinzelles)

description: Honeyed but otherwise not overly aromatic, this full-bodied, corpulent Condrieu still provides enjoyable drinking. The weighty notes of honeyed citrus linger on the finish, but drink up over the next six months or so.
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2009 Les Archevêques  (Condrieu)

description: Honeyed but otherwise not overly aromatic, this full-bodied, corpulent Condrieu still provides enjoyable drinking. The weighty notes of honeyed citrus linger on the finish, but drink up over the next six months or so.
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2009 Les Archevêques  (Condrieu)

description: Dried thyme and bay leaves impart a welcome herbal element to this wine's dark fruit. Hints of espresso, roasted meat and black olive help flesh out this slightly firm, linear blend of 80% Grenache, 15% Syrah and 5% Mourvèdre. With its crisp, dusty finish and admirable concentration, it look capable of aging through 2020.
title: Domaine du Grand Montmirail 2010 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Gigondas)

description: The 2010 La Petite Chapelle is firmly structured and tannic, but presents attractive aromas of earth, roasted meat and cedar, rounded out by savory flavors of black olive and espresso. Give it another couple of years in the cellar.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 La Petite Chapelle  (Hermitage)

description: The 2010 La Petite Chapelle is firmly structured and tannic, but presents attractive aromas of earth, roasted meat and cedar, rounded out by savory flavors of black olive and espresso. Give it another couple of years in the cellar.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 La Petite Chapelle  (Hermitage)

description: This is a crisp blend, fresh with citrus and ripe with apples. Hints of the warmth of the region show with the concentration that lies in the background. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Petroni 2015 White (Corse)

description: A minerally and creamy wine, this has a green apple character that's shot through with acidity. It has a soft, fresh finish with bright citrus flavors.
title: Louis and David Luneau 2010 Château des Cléons Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a soft wine, with attractive red-currant fruit and open, smoky tannins. It's well balanced between the fruit, tannins and acidity, which lends a crisp aftertaste.
title: Château Piron 2009  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This is a fruity wine with a black currant flavor. As a contrast, the tannins offer a denser side, creating a food-friendly wine with fine dryness and a smoky flavor.
title: Château Lande de Bertin 2009  Bordeaux

description: This is a fruity wine with a black currant flavor. As a contrast, the tannins offer a denser side, creating a food-friendly wine with fine dryness and a smoky flavor.
title: Château Lande de Bertin 2009  Bordeaux

description: This has intense black-currant fruit, with stalky tannins and a bone dry, firm core. It's a finely structured wine, packed with tight fruit and acidity. Drink now.
title: Calvet 2009 Réserve de l'Estey  (Médoc)

description: Rounded, rich and full in the mouth, this is a fruity wine. It has flavors of toast, yeast, green apple skin and a burst of citrus. There is a dry, herbal finish.
title: Grandin NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: This plump, medium-bodied rosé offers hints of peach and melon fruit, then finishes long and citrusy. It's very pale salmon in color, with an attractive coppery tint.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2013 Les Cimels Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Mas des Bressades is one of the standard-bearers of Costières de Nîmes, and this rosé is a perennial favorite. Red berries and cherries lead the way, wrapped around a core of citrus acidity. It's light to medium in body, with a pleasantly silky feel to the finish.
title: Mas des Bressades 2013 Cuvée Tradition Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Made to be drunk young, this surprisingly soft Malbec is ripe and full of smooth fruit. Juicy red berries come strongly through the light tannins that are accompanied by acidity and a fresh, fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2013 Gouleyant Malbec (Cahors)

description: Drink this maturing wine over the next year or two. Leather, chocolate and cherry notes mingle easily, the texture is smooth and the finish is silky.
title: Les Galets de Sauveterre 2012 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Dominated by the local Duras grape, this spicy and fruity wine has an intriguing blend of juicy acidity and leathery tannins. It gives a wine that could benefit from aging while also being ready to drink now. Give it the benefit of the doubt and wait until 2016.
title: L'Enclos des Braves 2013 Les Gourmands Red (Gaillac)

description: Rich and lightly structured, this wine is shot through with bright acidity that offers a crisp, tight aftertaste. The red fruits flourish happily at the end.
title: Maison Saint Aix 2015 Aix Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: From a 1,350-acre family estate divided among five chateaus, this crisp wine is packed with red fruits cut with citrus acidity. Refreshing and mineral textured, it will make a fine apéritif.
title: Fabre en Provence 2015 Château de l'Aumerade Cuvée Marie-Christine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From a 1,350-acre family estate divided among five chateaus, this crisp wine is packed with red fruits cut with citrus acidity. Refreshing and mineral textured, it will make a fine apéritif.
title: Fabre en Provence 2015 Château de l'Aumerade Cuvée Marie-Christine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This ripe, earthy wine with spice delivers a lightly tannic character. Rich, it's made to go with food, full of red-berry fruits and acidity. The aftertaste has a tangy, peppery edge.
title: Château Vannières 2015 Rosé (Bandol)

description: Organic grapes grown north of the Mediterranean port city of Toulon have produced a ripe wine with an intense burst of red-currant fruits given extra dimension by perfumed wild-strawberry flavors. The wine's richness means it will be better with food than as an apéritif.
title: Château Trians 2015 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Time to rock with this new, lightly oaked cuvée from Esclans, a fresh, bright, full wine with forward fruit. Despite its alcohol, the wine has a light touch with a hint of pepper and rounded red fruits making it ideal for food. The wine will be best to drink from late 2016.
title: Château d'Esclans 2015 Rock Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With bright fruit and intense acidity, this is a crisp, perfumed rosé. Clean, fresh lines of red and citrus fruits are cut by the tight, mineral texture. It is both delicious wine and refreshing.
title: Bejot Vins et Terroirs 2015 Charles Thomas Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: A young wine, with crisp apple and grapefruit salad freshness. It is bright, glowing with vibrant fruit and a light touch of toast.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2008  Saint-Véran

description: Starts off a touch funky, but that subsides after a couple of minutes in the glass. Black plum and cassis are strong on the nose and mouth, backed by accents of vanilla, black pepper spice and roasted coffee granules. The finish is long and evolving, moving from black fruit flavors to cherry pits and ending on sweet oak flavors.
region: Vin de Pays du Val de Cesse
title: Château Cabezac 2006 Cariñu Red (Vin de Pays du Val de Cesse)

description: A crisp and fruity blend of the herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc and the creamy Loin de l'Oeil, this has apple and grapefruit flavors. It has a bright feel, with a hint of mineral on the finish.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château Baron White (Gaillac)

description: A crisp and fruity blend of the herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc and the creamy Loin de l'Oeil, this has apple and grapefruit flavors. It has a bright feel, with a hint of mineral on the finish.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château Baron White (Gaillac)

description: This is firmly tannic, with dark berry and black cherry fruits. Minerally and textured, it shows the full effect of Beaujolais's granite soil. It also has a rich feel that will evolve over the next several months.
title: Domaine Chasselay 2011 La Carrière  (Chénas)

description: This wine is named after a windmill on the Conti family property. It is rich, with a spicy new-wood flavor. While it has plenty of structure, the acidity is subdued.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2010 Moulin des Dames White (Bergerac Sec)

description: This wine is named after a windmill on the Conti family property. It is rich, with a spicy new-wood flavor. While it has plenty of structure, the acidity is subdued.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2010 Moulin des Dames White (Bergerac Sec)

description: The intense herbaceous aroma is softened on the palate by the wine's lemon-curd flavor and smooth texture. Rich with intense fruitiness, this has notes of black currant and pink grapefruit, with bright acidity on the finish.
title: Château Thénac 2011 Fleur du Périgord White (Bergerac Sec)

description: Using fruit sourced from a 20-acre vineyard in Castillon, this is dominated by Merlot, with a touch of perfumed Cabernet Franc. It has an age-worthy structure, showing good balance, firm tannins and ripe fruit.
title: Château Moulin de Clotte 2010  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A classically structured wine, this has a smoky wood flavor that's balanced by a fresh black-currant note. It has a juicy edge, a dark chocolate note and a slight bitterness that should fade. This needs to age for 4–5 years. Château Loudenne is situated by the Gironde estuary.
title: Château Loudenne 2010  Médoc

description: This is herbaceous, but it also has a ripe yellow-fruit character. It is fresh and crisp, with a great depth of flavor. Its bright acidity and tight-textured finish make this a food wine.
title: Château Laulerie 2010 Comtesse de Ségur  (Montravel)

description: Soft and already approachable, this is a red-fruited wine, with ripe, well-integrated tannins and juicy acidity. It's round, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Château du Port 2010 Tertre-Perdigous Malbec (Cahors)

description: Soft and already approachable, this is a red-fruited wine, with ripe, well-integrated tannins and juicy acidity. It's round, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Château du Port 2010 Tertre-Perdigous Malbec (Cahors)

description: From the eastern slopes of the hill of Brouilly, this attractive, open and fruity selection shows a fine red-fruit character that's laced with fresh acidity. It has a firm structure, which creates a solid base for the fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château de Pizay 2011 Château de Saint Lager  (Brouilly)

description: From the eastern slopes of the hill of Brouilly, this attractive, open and fruity selection shows a fine red-fruit character that's laced with fresh acidity. It has a firm structure, which creates a solid base for the fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château de Pizay 2011 Château de Saint Lager  (Brouilly)

description: Made using fruit sourced from vineyards on the highest terrace above the Tarn River, this fruity wine is made to be consumed young. It has a touch of minerality and some firm tannins, but the red berry fruit and flower note is already attractive. A blend of Négrette, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec.
title: Château Bouissel 2010 Classic Red (Fronton)

description: Dense and dark in color, this wine has a black currant flavor. The tannins are ripe and soft, and the texture has a fresh lilt to it from the acidity and fruitiness. Only on the finish do the youthful tannins show, promising medium-term aging.
title: Château Bessan Ségur 2010  Médoc

description: Smells a little warm with notes of stewed red berries and brandied cherries. Lightweight with medium acidity and virtually no tannins—this is an easy-to-drink option; given the Tetra-pak packaging, a great choice for concerts, camping and picnics.
title: French Rabbit 2007 Pinot Noir (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A wine with a light texture and character, this is very fresh and crisp. It has flavors of white berries, pears and red plums, with lemon zest acidity.
title: Château Montaud 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A wine with a light texture and character, this is very fresh and crisp. It has flavors of white berries, pears and red plums, with lemon zest acidity.
title: Château Montaud 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is herbal, with some flavors of green bell pepper and wild spice. The wine is light bodied and fruity, with attractive, juicy black-currant flavors and a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Château de Brigue 2010 Signature Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is light in body for a Côtes du Rhône, elegant and spicy, with silky tannins and hints of cracked pepper on the finish. Enjoy this blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah over the next few years.
title: Domaine de Givaudan 2009 Léa Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: From selected vineyards, this is a rich, tropical fruit-flavored wine. It has peach and ripe plum fruits laced with citrus. Smooth and fruity. Drink now.
title: François Lurton 2010 Fumées Blanches Réserve Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Lightly salmon-pink in color, this wine is ripe, caramel-flavored and full of red-berry fruits. A zesty orange edge gives the freshness this otherwise full, ripe wine needs.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Pleasant aromas of stone fruit, candied orange peel and white gummy bear waft from the glass and carry through to the round, fruity palate. Ample acidity keep the mouthfeel fresh and the finish clean. Drink up.
title: La Croix du Pin 2012 Cuvée Prestige Medium Sweet Muscat (Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft and fruity, this is a rounded, simple wine. It has apple and light spice and a gentle texture that is already approachable. Juicy and fresh, not a wine for aging, it is ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Les Enfants Terribles Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: The wine is so soft that only the light wood flavors give it shape. It is smooth with red plum fruits that are rounded and sweet in style. Acidity seems to be an afterthought. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: The wine is so soft that only the light wood flavors give it shape. It is smooth with red plum fruits that are rounded and sweet in style. Acidity seems to be an afterthought. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: The wine is perfumed and full. It is so soft, missing tannins, and already easy to drink. Black fruits are super-ripe and generous. Drink now.
title: Pelvillain Frères 2014 Zee Original Malbec (Côtes du Lot)

description: This wine is tightly textured, firm and with a strongly tannic element. It will be better with food.
title: Château Toutigeac 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Named after the lightning bugs (bellugues means spark) that lived in the nearby woods, this wine is all fresh fruit and soft texture. There is a hint of caramel to go with the bright acidity and red currant fruits. The wine is a great apéritif style.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine des Bellugues Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: There is a strongly caramel element to this wine. A tannic edge gives structure, though its fruit is less obvious.
title: Domaine du Claouset 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Soft, warm and smoky wine, this has a finely layered wood flavor to go with the black currant and red berry fruits. It's dry, yet warm and ripe, finishing with freshness.
title: Château Moulin de Clotte 2009  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A rich, yet finely structured wine, this is full of acidity and bright green and yellow fruits. It's delicious, mouth-filling and refreshing, touched by notes of wood and citrus, with a smooth, toasty finish.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2010 Les Champréaux  (Chablis)

description: A rich, yet finely structured wine, this is full of acidity and bright green and yellow fruits. It's delicious, mouth-filling and refreshing, touched by notes of wood and citrus, with a smooth, toasty finish.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2010 Les Champréaux  (Chablis)

description: For a Premier Cru, this is surprisingly open and ready. It has a light structure, offering delicious, forward, juicy fruit that has been rounded out by wood aging. With its ripe character, it will be ready to drink in a year.
title: Domaine A. Machard de Gramont 2010 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This shows the richness of the vintage in its ripe red fruits. It has weight as well as tannins, with a solid, firmly structured base of red plum fruit.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009  Pommard

description: Concentrated and complex, this has structure and acidity, with a black cherry flavor. It's a ripe, powerful wine that could become more generous as it ages.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: This is a rich mouthful of a wine, with ripe notes of red apple and green plum. Behind the fruit, there is a soft vanilla edge that adds depth of flavor. It's concentrated and ready to age for 2–3 years.
title: Francine et Olivier Savary 2010  Chablis

description: Rich, round and concentrated, this is developing fast. The acidity is already comfortably embedded in the ripe red-berry fruit..
title: Louis Latour 2010 En Chevret Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Rich, round and concentrated, this is developing fast. The acidity is already comfortably embedded in the ripe red-berry fruit..
title: Louis Latour 2010 En Chevret Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: While the wine seems at first rich, it then shows a tautly acidic character that gives a refreshing character to the roundness. That steely acidity is what defines the tight, crisp finish.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 Les Vénérables  (Chablis)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Lots of spiced wood, with sweet blackberry fruits. The wine is initially soft, but the tannins do kick in. The fruit finally has great freshness
title: Château Beaumont 2009 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A hugely extracted wine, very dark and tannic, solid, spicy wood.
title: Marojallia 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A hugely extracted wine, very dark and tannic, solid, spicy wood.
title: Marojallia 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Dark bitter chocolate coated wine, soft in texture, but with a good stalky chewy edge. Final flavors are of cedar, new wood and spice.
title: Château Teyssier 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Dark bitter chocolate coated wine, soft in texture, but with a good stalky chewy edge. Final flavors are of cedar, new wood and spice.
title: Château Teyssier 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Sweet vanilla aroma, fruit that is ripe, soft, fleshy. This seems to have suffered from super-mature, fruit, although a final juiciness does help.
title: Château Lafon-Rochet 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. There is a high level of new wood, toast that dominates both the aroma and the flavors. It gives the wine a hard-edged feel at this stage.
title: Château de Lamarque 2009 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Very apply wine, with light botrytis character, some spice and very fresh fruit. It is bright and almost crisp.
title: Château Bastor-Lamontagne 2009 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Very soft, rounded wine, the tannins a mere hint as the fruit rolls forward. Fine, juicy spice.
title: Château Anthonic 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Very soft, rounded wine, the tannins a mere hint as the fruit rolls forward. Fine, juicy spice.
title: Château Anthonic 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Some spice here, from the rich Merlot. The wine has ripe blackberry, sweet fruits as well as concentrated tannins.
title: Château Plince 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Some spice here, from the rich Merlot. The wine has ripe blackberry, sweet fruits as well as concentrated tannins.
title: Château Plince 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Ripe and sweet, plush fruit, balanced sufficiently with acidity and some firm tannic character. The wine is chunky, but there is balance.
title: Château Montviel 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Ripe and sweet, plush fruit, balanced sufficiently with acidity and some firm tannic character. The wine is chunky, but there is balance.
title: Château Montviel 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Packed, fruity wine, dominated by very fresh acidity. The wine is crisp as much as rich, maybe on the lean side.
title: Château Malescot Saint-Exupery 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. This is rich, with sweet fruits and delicious sweet plum flavors, good tannins, a lovely juicy character.
title: Château Haut-Simard 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. This is rich, with sweet fruits and delicious sweet plum flavors, good tannins, a lovely juicy character.
title: Château Haut-Simard 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Light, ripe, fresh with pleasant acidity and the freshest of blackcurrants.
title: Château Haut-Carles 2009 Barrel sample  (Fronsac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Very ripe fruit aromas, the fruit ripe, full of sweetness, showing signs of super maturity.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2009 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A smooth wine, almost velvet, very polished. The fruits are ripe, sweet, very soft.
title: Château Grand Barrail Lamarzelle Figeac 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A full-bodied wine that lacks some definition. It has fatness, weight, but the freshness is not all there.
title: Château Bouscaut 2009 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A solid chunky sweet wine, with lots of ripe bright fruits, and vivid blackcurrants. With this structure it will age.
title: Château Bonalgue 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Very fresh. With just a light touch of wood spice, and a great burst of citrus, grapefruit, a little lychee from Muscadelle.
title: Le Nardian 2009 Barrel sample  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Powerful, but smooth, with ripe milk chocolate and sweetness. Very velvet in texture, with just enough acidity.
title: Château Puy-Blanquet 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Sweet fruit, soft tannins, ripe wine. The structure takes a while to show with dusty, almost velvet tannins.
title: Château la Tour de Pin Figeac 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)
winery: Château la Tour de Pin Figeac

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A definite burnt character on the nose, but the fruit has proper richness, the wood perhaps showing too much high toast. The freshness should be kept and not lost in the wood.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2009 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Solid, but still fresh wine, good acidity, some sweetness, but more pure blackcurrant and berry fruits.
title: Château du Domaine de l'Eglise 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. The wine has a rustic edge, over very juicy fruit, very blackcurrant, and with a high acid content. It feels light.
title: Château d'Issan 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Owned by Jean-Luc Thunevin of Valandraud, this is an intense - maybe too intense - spicy wine, packed with new wood. There is a juicy character, but structure dominates.
title: Château Bel-Air Ouÿ 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Rich and sweet, with fresh tannins and solid fruit flavors. The wine is dark, but has vivid acidity.
title: Château Andron Blanquet 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This comes from an underrated appellation, in the shadow of the Corton-Charlemagne vineyard. It's touched lightly by wood aging, showing ripe yellow fruit and a cool streak of minerality. Still young, it's developing well and will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015  Pernand-Vergelesses

description: The flagship estate of the Vigouroux family, this medieval castle on a hill is also a hotel. The vineyard produces powerful wines like this, packed with dusty tannins and with dark berry fruits and fine concentration. It is a wine to age, drink from 2020.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Château de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: A fine blend of ripe fruit and crisp red berry flavors, this negociant wine produced by Domaine Dujac is structured and generous. The bright acidity reflects the vintage while the structure and tannins reflect the appellation. Together, they will allow the wine to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Dujac Fils & Pere 2014  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: The combination of two naturally tannic grapes has inevitably produced a tannic wine. But the ripe layer of rich black fruits acts as a foil to the density of the wine and gives it both balance and a good future. This is a serious wine that needs to age, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Lamartine 2014 Expression Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: A hard and tannic wine, with too much dryness for pleasure. It's not likely to soften enough to balance out.
title: Domaine du Claouset 2011 Réserve  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Juicy but not quite ripe, this is a green and herbal wine that is not worth aging. Drink it over the next few years.
title: Château Laride 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Juicy but not quite ripe, this is a green and herbal wine that is not worth aging. Drink it over the next few years.
title: Château Laride 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Very dry and with too much wood, this is an attenuated wine with a hard facade. It doesn't offer enough fruit for the future.
title: Château Noblet 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: A very juicy wine that shows overripe fruit and an herbal character. It's soft, fruity without great definition and likely to develop quickly.
title: Château du Retout 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: This soapy, unfocused wine has tannins and red berry fruit but little structure. The fruit shows a green streak that will not improve.
title: Château des Tourtes 2011 Classic  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Hard and extracted, this wine shows little more than tannins. The fruitiness is hard to discern and may never come through.
title: Château Penin 2011 Les Cailloux  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A balanced wine, showing attractive fruitiness, ripe black currants and soft tannins. It's likely to be ready to drink soon.
title: Vinum Natura 2011  Bordeaux

description: On the south bank of the River Serein, Sécher is one of the lesser known Premier Crus. This is a cool, crisp wine, emphasizing both green fruits and an underlying buttery touch. Beautifully integrated acidity frames the wine.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008 Domaine Drouhin-Vaudon Sécher Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: An appropriately rich wine, full, toasty and dense. The fruit is beautifully balanced with ripe acidity, just a touch of spice, citrus and an opulent, full-bodied character. It will certainly age, but is already very drinkable.
title: Maison Jessiaume 2008  Corton-Charlemagne

description: A super-rich wine, packed with peach and green plum fruits, layers of wood and an intense concentration. An impressive wine that shows weight and richness as well as style.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2007 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: While this wine is lean initially, it also shows weight and the potential of ripe fruits. Concentrated tannins still allow room for a little juicy fruit. The overall effect is of structure triumphing over fruitiness. Made by the team at Domaine de Chevalier, the wine will take time to develop. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine de la Solitude 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: This shows both the fruit of the vintage and a more structured tannic side. Black currant flavors are up front, offering a generous feeling. They are balanced by the backdrop of tannins and tight acidity. Together they make a wine that is concentrated and likely to be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Teyssier 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Big and dry, this wine shows the tannic, firm character of the vintage. It has a dark, dense core of wood tannins while the juicy black currant fruit is still developing. The wine needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Teyssier 2011  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: For the vintage, this is a ripe, bold wine. Layers of delicious black fruits are supported by firm tannins and the right amount of wood aging. Balanced and dense, it will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Pierre de Montignac 2012  Médoc

description: For the vintage, this is a ripe, bold wine. Layers of delicious black fruits are supported by firm tannins and the right amount of wood aging. Balanced and dense, it will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Pierre de Montignac 2012  Médoc

description: This wine is soft and fruity with ripe berry fruits and gentle tannins. For a major second wine, it's surprisingly easy and soft, developing fast with its berry fruits, chocolate and wood flavors at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2012 Le Petit Mouton  (Pauillac)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and fruity wine with smooth tannins within a densely-textured palate. It's weighty in the mouth with richness, elegance and a purity of character. The acidity on the finish is already delicious.
designation: Le Petit Lion de Léoville las Cases Barrel Sample
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2012 Le Petit Lion de Léoville las Cases Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a dark, extracted wine with coffee flavors and dense tannins. The palate has a bitter character to it, and a structure that's very firm and dry.
title: Château Lamarque 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This dense, structured and solidly tannic wine is balanced by dark black fruits that are juicy and ripe. The wine will always be dry, mineral and fairly severe in style.
title: Château Sérilhan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This dense, structured and solidly tannic wine is balanced by dark black fruits that are juicy and ripe. The wine will always be dry, mineral and fairly severe in style.
title: Château Sérilhan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This wine is made from property owned by the Bernard family of Domaine de Chevalier in Pessac-Léognan. It's a finely-made wine with great acidity and swathes of blackberry fruits. Well balanced and likely to age.
title: Château Peyrabon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This wine is made from property owned by the Bernard family of Domaine de Chevalier in Pessac-Léognan. It's a finely-made wine with great acidity and swathes of blackberry fruits. Well balanced and likely to age.
title: Château Peyrabon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This fruity wine is soft and open with flavors of ripe red-berry fruits and fresh acidity. It's expressive with immediately attractive tannins.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This wine is very smoky with firm tannins typical of Saint-Estèphe. Layers of fruit surround the core of dryness in the heart of the wine. Floral and fragrant, the wine finishes with good acidity.
title: Château Capbern Gasqueton 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This wine is very smoky with firm tannins typical of Saint-Estèphe. Layers of fruit surround the core of dryness in the heart of the wine. Floral and fragrant, the wine finishes with good acidity.
title: Château Capbern Gasqueton 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. There is a fine depth of flavor here, with solid tannins as well as ripe fruit. This second wine of Château Pichon Longueville is packed with the vintage's hallmark of perfumed black-currant fruit.
designation: Les Tourelles de Longueville Barrel Sample
title: Château Pichon Longueville 2012 Les Tourelles de Longueville Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a rich and soft wine made predominantly from Merlot. The wine has good depth of flavor with fresh black currants and soft tannins.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2012 Carruades de Lafite Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This wine is the second wine of Ducru-Beaucaillou, sourced from a vineyard in the heart of Saint-Julien. It's rich and dense, with plenty of firm tannins. The fruit is already delicious and ripe with black currant and berries.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This wine is the second wine of Ducru-Beaucaillou, sourced from a vineyard in the heart of Saint-Julien. It's rich and dense, with plenty of firm tannins. The fruit is already delicious and ripe with black currant and berries.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. From the same stable as Léoville Poyferré in Saint-Julien, this is a finely structured, ripe and serious wine. It has dark tannins, big blackberry fruitiness and a generous while firm character.
title: Château Le Crock 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Showing both a firm tannic structure and jammy black fruits, this is a finely ripe and full wine. It has spice, sweet fruits and a solid tannic core. A wine that is likely to age well.
title: Château Le Boscq 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Rich, smooth mint and polished tannins give this wine a ripe, opulent feel. It benefits from the fine Cabernet of Pauillac, which adds structure and juicy black currant acidity.
title: Château La Fleur Peyrabon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Rich blackberry fruits are surrounded by a dense structure on this wine. The palate is ripe, but balanced with acidity, juiciness and a solid concentrated character.
title: Château Belgrave 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. There's a dry character to this wine. It's concentrated in tannins with a bitterness that leads to a new-wood and spice character. The fruit is still in the background here.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. There's a dry character to this wine. It's concentrated in tannins with a bitterness that leads to a new-wood and spice character. The fruit is still in the background here.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a densely tannic wine with juiciness showing quite tardily through the tannins. The wine has a very dry, firm character with acidity that finishes on a bright, fresh note.
title: Château Beaumont 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Made from grapes grown in a specific parcel in the Léoville Las Cases vineyard, Clos du Marquis is a ripe wine that's also promises seriously good aging. Tannins and structure dominate the black fruits and acidity.
title: Clos du Marquis 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Wood and mint aromas yield a wine that is darkly tannic, with a distinct black-coffee flavor. It's a powerful, concentrated wine with fruit hiding behind the dense structure.
title: Chateau La Tour Carnet 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. With so much spicy fruit, intensely ripe blackberry flavors and solid tannins, all the elements of excellence are here, and powered by a firm structure. This wine has weight and a fine Cabernet concentration.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. With so much spicy fruit, intensely ripe blackberry flavors and solid tannins, all the elements of excellence are here, and powered by a firm structure. This wine has weight and a fine Cabernet concentration.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. There's great concentration here, on this powerful wine with very dry structure and dark character. The palate hints of a more perfumed character with fine fruitiness and lingering freshness on the finish.
title: Château Langoa Barton 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Solid and concentrated, this wine certainly shows great dryness as well as fruit. It has power and density, and a texture that balances new wood as well as the fruitiness.
title: Château Gloria 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. While initially severe with chocolate and dark coffee flavors, ripe fruitiness comes through on the mid palate. It's full bodied and dense in tannins, but a solid wine showing the continuing development of this property.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. While initially severe with chocolate and dark coffee flavors, ripe fruitiness comes through on the mid palate. It's full bodied and dense in tannins, but a solid wine showing the continuing development of this property.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This wine boasts big chocolate character along with ripe fruit. The palate is solid and generous with rounded Merlot flavor. It has remarkable weight with tannins surrounded by layers of delicious fruit.
designation: Les Pagodes de Cos Barrel Sample
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2012 Les Pagodes de Cos Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. With so much spicy fruit, intensely ripe blackberry flavors and solid tannins, all the elements of excellence are here, and powered by a firm structure. This wine has weight and a fine Cabernet concentration.
title: Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This wine is heavily influenced by ample new-wood aging. It's deliciously juicy with black currant and plum fruits balanced by swathes of refreshing acidity at the end.
title: Château Talbot 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This is a full and opulent wine comprised of 76% Merlot. The palate has weight, and coffee and black-plum flavors that lend richness and a smoky, spicy character.
designation: La Dame de Montrose Barrel Sample
title: Château Montrose 2012 La Dame de Montrose Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Big and densely ripe, this is an impressive wine. It has balanced weight, fine acidity and a sense of richness. Offering all the right elements, this is going to be a great wine.
title: Château Grand-Puy Ducasse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: Scented mellow notes of ripe yellow apple stream from the glass. On the palate they are displayed against an autolytic background that recalls both rye bread and short-crust pastry. The mouse is very fine and adds creamy allure to the dry light palate. This is dry, classy and rather sophisticated with a refreshing finish that leaves a lasting impression.
title: Boeckel 2014 Extra Brut Chardonnay Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Scented mellow notes of ripe yellow apple stream from the glass. On the palate they are displayed against an autolytic background that recalls both rye bread and short-crust pastry. The mouse is very fine and adds creamy allure to the dry light palate. This is dry, classy and rather sophisticated with a refreshing finish that leaves a lasting impression.
title: Boeckel 2014 Extra Brut Chardonnay Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: As part of a range of wines that are based on specific parcels of vines, this wine has also been partially wood fermented. Its richness and the touches of spice and toastiness give the wine a ripe rounded character. However, it is dry, crisply textured with a touch of tannin to give it structure. Drink now.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Blanc de Pinot Noir Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: As part of a range of wines that are based on specific parcels of vines, this wine has also been partially wood fermented. Its richness and the touches of spice and toastiness give the wine a ripe rounded character. However, it is dry, crisply textured with a touch of tannin to give it structure. Drink now.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Blanc de Pinot Noir Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This wine teeters between superripe (bold black cherries) and overripe (raisined and browning black cherries) on the nose, but comes out very good in the end. It's full bodied and richly textured, with pretty notes of lavender and thyme accenting black cherry flavors and a long velvety finish. Drink it over the next several months.
title: Les Trois Couronnes 2011  Gigondas

description: This wine teeters between superripe (bold black cherries) and overripe (raisined and browning black cherries) on the nose, but comes out very good in the end. It's full bodied and richly textured, with pretty notes of lavender and thyme accenting black cherry flavors and a long velvety finish. Drink it over the next several months.
title: Les Trois Couronnes 2011  Gigondas

description: Importer Robert Kacher has an impressive stable of rosés from the southern Rhône at terrific pricing. this one, from the undervalued right bank of the valley, features 70% Cabernet Franc. Peaches, cherries and hints of peppery spice combine easily, then end on a note of wet stones. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Cantarelles 2012 Rosé de Fayel Rosé (Vin de Pays du Gard)

description: Importer Robert Kacher has an impressive stable of rosés from the southern Rhône at terrific pricing. this one, from the undervalued right bank of the valley, features 70% Cabernet Franc. Peaches, cherries and hints of peppery spice combine easily, then end on a note of wet stones. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Cantarelles 2012 Rosé de Fayel Rosé (Vin de Pays du Gard)

description: Despite being labeled at 15% abv, this is a crisp rendering of Vacqueyras, filled with fresh herbal notes and tart, crunchy cherries. A violet-like essence emerges on the palate, providing added interest. It does turn a bit astringent on the finish, so drink it from 2015–2020, or now with some suitably rare beef or lamb.
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2010 La Sillote Red (Vacqueyras)

description: This structured, full and ripe wine shows great cherry fruits, some chewy tannins and a delicious juicy character. It is balanced and with its tannins should age. Drink now and until 2017.
title: Fabien Collonge 2012 L'Aurore des Côtes  (Chiroubles)

description: Wood aging does not help the richness of this wine. It brings out toast and covers the glorious sweet fruits. With acidity thrown in the balance is not there. Maybe several years will help, so don't drink before 2017.
title: Domaine Pichot 2009 Les Larmes de Bacchus  (Vouvray)

description: A wine that has good concentration from the very old vines along with red cherry fruits and some tight, mineral acidity. The banana character does spoil the overall ripe, full effect, so give the wine another year for this to disappear. Acidity and tannins do promise this aging.
title: Domaine Dupré 2012 Vignes de 1935  (Morgon)

description: A very perfumed wine, almost heady, with its herbal and wild flower aromas. The wine is still closed up, darkly tannic and very firm. At the same time, black fruits show the same perfumed character. This is very flavorful and structured. Drink this unusual wine from 2014.
title: Clos des Bachelards 2010  Fleurie

description: A structured wine that has berry fruits, black currants and a firm, dry core of tannins. It has the weight, texture and richness of the vintage, with a solid future as it rounds out and softens. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Trolliet Lafite 2010 Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: Clean, poised, rounded notes of ripe, red-cheeked apples play on every front. There is something joyous and bountiful here. The frothy mousse accentuates the light-hearted but generous aspect on the dry but rounded palate, which also brings ample refreshment.
title: Wolfberger NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Clean, poised, rounded notes of ripe, red-cheeked apples play on every front. There is something joyous and bountiful here. The frothy mousse accentuates the light-hearted but generous aspect on the dry but rounded palate, which also brings ample refreshment.
title: Wolfberger NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A big and dense wine, this is concentrated and mineral in character, reflecting the granite soils of the Côte de Py. It's concentrated with its black-cherry flavors cut by bright acidity and a tight texture. The fruit needs to assert itself more, so wait until 2018 before drinking.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Belairissime le Py  (Morgon)

description: With broad, ripe fruit this is a rich, generous wine. The acidity gives fresh support to the warm cherry and red plum fruits. Underneath, tannins offer a dry core to the wine, allowing it to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Grand Garant 2014 Le Vivier  (Fleurie)

description: Freshly sliced green and yellow apples are the aromatic markers of this dry, softly fizzing crémant. There is substance and body from yeasty autolysis that comes across as the golden crust of wheat bread, with the apples always peeping through. An elegant apéritif without dosage and all the purity of ripe, delicious fruit.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2012 Brut Zero Dosage Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Freshly sliced green and yellow apples are the aromatic markers of this dry, softly fizzing crémant. There is substance and body from yeasty autolysis that comes across as the golden crust of wheat bread, with the apples always peeping through. An elegant apéritif without dosage and all the purity of ripe, delicious fruit.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2012 Brut Zero Dosage Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is textured and dense with red berry fruits and red currant crispness. Rich, it also shows some minerality and a zesty edge. This is a real apéritif rosé with its soft aftertaste and lift of acidity.
title: Chassenay d'Arce NV Confidences Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is an attractive, crisp and fruity wine. Plenty of acidity gives a zingy feel to the palate, while allowing ripe apple and pear flavors to come through on the tight and textured finish.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: Aromatic notes of green, yellow and red-cheeked apples waft enticingly from the glass. The palate is equally friendly and smile-inducing, with a totally fruit-driven but exuberant character that majors on frivolous pleasure. The palate is light, frothy and dry. This is made for sparkly afternoons and evenings that last and last. Be sure to get more than one bottle.
title: Domaine Gresser 2013 Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Aromatic notes of green, yellow and red-cheeked apples waft enticingly from the glass. The palate is equally friendly and smile-inducing, with a totally fruit-driven but exuberant character that majors on frivolous pleasure. The palate is light, frothy and dry. This is made for sparkly afternoons and evenings that last and last. Be sure to get more than one bottle.
title: Domaine Gresser 2013 Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Berry fruits and dense red jelly flavors are the hallmark of this wine. It is full, although edging on stalky, its black berry flavors mixed with acidity and dry tannins.
title: Château Sainte Barbe 2008 Merlot  (Bordeaux)

description: Stalky, dry, with attractive black currant fruits and a light tannin character. Showing little sign of its potential richness.
title: Château la Fontaine de Genin 2009  Bordeaux

description: Stalky, dry, with attractive black currant fruits and a light tannin character. Showing little sign of its potential richness.
title: Château la Fontaine de Genin 2009  Bordeaux

description: Solid and firmly tannic, this is a wine with forward red-fruit flavors, a dry core and dense texture. The structure of this balanced wine along with its concentration promise aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Mas de la Dame 2011 Cuvée Gourmande Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Steinbach is a village at the extreme southern end of the Alsace vineyard, known for its Pinot Noir. This is a rich, full example—a wine that has structure and concentration, as well as ripe cherry fruitiness. It can be drunk now, or until 2022.
title: Joseph Cattin 2010 Steinbach Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The weight of the bottle seems to foretell this wine's weight, structure and judiciously layered oak influence. With ripe cherry and berry flavors, it's a wine that can age. Drink from 2015.
title: Rieflé 2011 Côte de Rouffach Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Not quite dry, this is an impressively rich wine. It has a strong mineral element that brings out the currant flavors and intense acidity. This is a wine that is still developing, offering an impressive array of flavors while still needing time. Drink from 2015.
title: Hubert Meyer 2011 Winzenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Not quite dry, this is an impressively rich wine. It has a strong mineral element that brings out the currant flavors and intense acidity. This is a wine that is still developing, offering an impressive array of flavors while still needing time. Drink from 2015.
title: Hubert Meyer 2011 Winzenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: An unusual edge of licorice clings to nose and palate of this fresh, zingy Riesling. The streamlined body is dry and pervaded by brisk, friendly lemon freshness.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2014 Lieu Dit Harth Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Notes of stone and smoke join lemon and green apple on the nose of this wine. The palate has an earthier aspect but is bracingly fresh and precise with pure lemon zestiness. Dry and slender, the wine will round out with some bottle age. Drink 2018–2023.
title: Domaine Pfister 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Creamy earthiness joins the yellow stone fruit on nose and palate, making for a toned-down but full-fruited, generously rounded Gewurztraminer. The structure provided by pithy, pleasantly bitter notes leaves a lasting, refreshing impact.
title: Domaine Gresser 2015 Kritt Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The scent of freshly cut green and red apple is followed by the spicy taste of burnt caramel and brought together with zesty citrus. The finish is dry and clean-cut.
title: Domaine de la Tour Blanche 2014 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A subdued nose has soft hints of baked apple and citrus. The palate of this wine brings in a bitter note of lemon pith on a dry, lithe body, made bright by lemon freshness. It finishes fresh and long.
title: Domaine Bernhard & Reibel 2013 Rittersberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Soft citrus notes of clementine are streaked with fresh lemon to create this fresh, fruit-driven but very appetizing wine. The body is slender, dry and totally refreshing.
title: Joseph Cattin 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Half-and-half Négrette and Syrah, this is typical blend for Fronton with its hints of the Mediterranean mixed in with a more Atlantic influence. The wine is soft and balanced with dusty tannins, red fruits and a perfumed aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Laurou 2013 Les Complices Red (Fronton)

description: Half-and-half Petit and Gros Manseng, this is a classic dry Jurançon blend. Soft and rich, it is a wine that is dry while demonstrating fine fresh fruitiness. The structure and strongly mineral texture both suggest the need for aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Jolys 2014  Jurançon Sec

description: The 16th-century chateau of Saint Lager is on the slopes of the local landmark hill of Brouilly. The wine comes from vines below. It has spice, cherry and blueberry fruits with attractive acidity. The wine, still with a strong tannic edge, will be better from 2017.
title: Château de Pizay 2015 Château de Saint Lager  (Brouilly)

description: There is an earthy note amid the off-dry, gently peachy palate. The roundness is countered by zesty citrus pith that leaves a tangy, appetizing and moreish finish.
title: Boeckel 2015 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Earthy aromas lead to a wine that is still young and tannic, firm with a dry core and dark-chocolate flavors. It will be a concentrated wine as it develops, so wait until 2017.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2013 Cuvée François Signature Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Anise, fennel seed and laurel lead the bouquet of this blend, framed by fruity tones of small red cherry and plum. Made from 70% Syrah, 20% Mourvèdre and 10% Grenache, the palate is easy and approachable, with a lightness to the body and tannins and a quick yet clean close.
title: Domaine La Borie Blanche 2012 Terroirs D'Altitude Red (Minervois La Liviniere)

description: While rich, this wine is well balanced with its fresh acidity and wild strawberry flavors. Citrus and a tangy orange texture are both attractive and give the wine a great lift. Drink now.
title: Château la Gordonne 2014 Vérité du Terroir Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A light, dainty selection, this opens with soft scents of menthol and garrigue herbs that are framed by hints of pear and white melon rind. The palate is similarly light in intensity, with subtle fruit flavors that are complemented by touches of ginger and oaky spice. Drink now.
title: Mas Gabinèle 2014 Grenache Gris (Vin de Pays de L'Herault)

description: This is soft and rounded, with attractive red plum and berry fruits that bring in acidity and a light tannic character. The wine is ripe, with a dry core surrounded by cherry flavors and fresh acidity. It is not a wine for long aging, drink from 2017.
title: Louis Latour 2012  Beaune

description: Coteaux Varois is a small area in the heart of the Provence vineyards. This wine is fresh, fruity and light in texture. With its strawberry fruits, it has a crisp side and attractive acidity. The wine, with its fresh aftertaste, is ready to drink.
title: Le Cercle des Vignerons Saint-Louis 2014 Diamarine Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Coteaux Varois is a small area in the heart of the Provence vineyards. This wine is fresh, fruity and light in texture. With its strawberry fruits, it has a crisp side and attractive acidity. The wine, with its fresh aftertaste, is ready to drink.
title: Le Cercle des Vignerons Saint-Louis 2014 Diamarine Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: The nose does not give much away but the dry palate is all about bright, luminous lemon zest and tart lemon juice. Have this on a hot summer day for ultimate refreshment.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2013 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose does not give much away but the dry palate is all about bright, luminous lemon zest and tart lemon juice. Have this on a hot summer day for ultimate refreshment.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2013 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Big and beefy, this has layers of dark tannins lying over the big black plum fruit flavors. With a solid texture that comes from this rich, dense vintage, the wine is still developing. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Trimoulet 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: With vineyards close to the Gironde, this is a well-situated château. This 2012 is one of the best from the property for several years, giving ripe tannins, balanced wood and good black currant acidity. It's not for long-term aging, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Loudenne 2012  Médoc

description: Ripe and attractively fruity, this wood-aged wine has ripe tannins that are still firm and strong. The fruit is still young, full of black currant flavors and bright acidity. These elements give a wine that has structure and needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Laffitte Laujac 2011  Médoc

description: Dry and structured, this dense wine has some austerity that comes from the dry tannins and extracted, bitter flavors. The aftertaste shows more of the tannins and dryness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château la Louvière 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Smooth, ripe and easy, this wine brings out the fruitiness of the vintage. It has some dusty tannins, although it is so approachable and generous. Ripe berry fruits and soft acidity come through at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Château La Grave à Pomerol 2012  Pomerol

description: A parcel within the Château Simard vineyard gives this wine that features plenty of fruitiness, with attractive acidity and black currant flavors. It also has structure, a touch of minerality and final, dry tannins, all of which will allow it to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Simard 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Ripe and luscious, this is full of red berry fruits and black plums. Soft tannins pulse through the rich texture, giving shape while not taking away from the open character of the wine. It will age relatively quickly, so drink from 2016.
title: Château Grivière 2012  Médoc

description: New wood and stalky fruit have combined well in this wine that is well on the way to being balanced and rich. The dry edge of tannins has smoothed well, giving a luscious wine that will develop quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Portets 2012  Graves

description: Fresh-fruited and well balanced, this has firm tannins that are already well integrated into the black currant flavors and acidity. Solid and structured, it will develop well. The aftertaste brings out the acidity.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 Château Tour Blanche  (Médoc)

description: With its dusty tannins, this is a structured wine first, a more fruity wine second. It has density, juicy acidity and hints of blueberry and black currant fruits. It's typical of 2011 at this stage, still very firm and tannic. Give it until 2017.
title: Producta Vignobles 2011 Pavillon la Tourelle  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This wine has an intense structure while not losing sight of fruit. It's a solid wine with dominant tannins. It also has intense acidity and, in the background, red berry fruits. It needs time to come together into an impressive wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Rotier 2013 Les Gravels Red (Gaillac)

description: This rich and ripe wine is full of apricot and almond flavors. It is beautifully textured with a strongly mineral character as well as an orange-zest flavor and tangy, spicy aftertaste. The wine should age, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Nigri 2013 Pierre de Lune  (Jurançon Sec)

description: Harvested at the end of October, this gently sweet wine has hints of botrytis along with ripe apricot and honey flavors. It is shot through with delicious acidity that gives the wine a great lift and final freshness.
title: Domaine Cauhapé 2013 Ballet d'Octobre  (Jurançon)

description: Big, dark tannins dominate this concentrated wine that is powerful, dry and firm. Under the structure lies a smoother layer of ripe plum and berry fruits. At 90% Malbec and 10% Merlot, it will certainly need more time to mature; drink from 2018.
title: Château Lamartine 2012 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Big, dark tannins dominate this concentrated wine that is powerful, dry and firm. Under the structure lies a smoother layer of ripe plum and berry fruits. At 90% Malbec and 10% Merlot, it will certainly need more time to mature; drink from 2018.
title: Château Lamartine 2012 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Very light mango, pineapple and banana aromas are joined by flowers and minerals. Nutty notes are brought to the fore on the dry and stony palate. Finishes broad and long, with echos of the floral and mineral notes on the nose. Now it's pretty tight; best in 2002 and beyond.
title: Domaine Laroche 1997 Les Blanchots  (Chablis)

description: This recently released 2002 is still showing its youth, with a firm, mineral edge to it. But it does have the right refreshingly crisp character, along with intense fruits, and acidity that just powers right through. Wait 3–4 years.
designation: Fleuron Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2002 Fleuron Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This recently released 2002 is still showing its youth, with a firm, mineral edge to it. But it does have the right refreshingly crisp character, along with intense fruits, and acidity that just powers right through. Wait 3–4 years.
designation: Fleuron Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2002 Fleuron Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A fine vintage, which shows some age from a relatively fast-maturing year, but is now nicely poised between the initial fresh green fruits and grapefruit flavors, and the elements of toast and yeast that are developing well. This is a great food wine, with some weight and ripeness.
title: Pommery 1998 Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: It's fading a bit at the rim, but it's a treat to know that mature releases like this are in the market. Age has mellowed its tannins to silky smoothness, while the aromas and flavors resemble thyme blossoms, cherries and leather. Hints of herbal tea and mocha linger elegantly on the finish. Drink now–2022.
title: L'Amandine 2011 Bel Air Red

description: Full bodied and opulent, yet remarkably refreshing at the same time, wines like this are why the commune of Laudun is so highly regarded as a white-wine terroir within the warm Southern Rhône. Honey, pineapple and stone fruit notes linger through the finish, balanced by hints of crushed stone and citrus. Drink now.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2014 White (Laudun)

description: Round and harmonious on the palate, this wine is a terrific value. Floral notes mark the nose, backed up by raspberry and strawberry fruit, while an undercurrent of crushed stone provides depth and backbone. The finish is berry-filled, but balanced and savory.
title: Domaine Corne-Loup 2016  Tavel

description: This wood-aged wine is rich, spicy and with a stylish combination of acidity and rich yellow and white fruits. The acidity cuts through the ripe texture and gives the wine its full-bodied character. The aftertaste shows a wine that is still young and will be best from 2018.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2014 Les Chaniots Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: This blend of Grenache and Niellucciu comes from vines that are up to 40 years old. It is a big, bold ripe and juicy wine, bursting with black plum and berry flavors. The wine is fruity enough to drink now, although it should age for at least 10 years.
title: Yves Leccia 2014 YL Rouge Red (Ile de Beauté)

description: This wine from the Côte Chalonnaise is a lighter style of Chardonnay than Leflaive's rich Côte de Beaune wines. It's a delicious lightly toasty wine that has crisp acidity and a strong and refreshing dose of lemon juice. The wine is creamy at the end. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Les Cloux Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: This domaine is now sold through the Jean-Marc Brocard family. This is a rich wine with yellow fruit as well as crisper citrus. There is a touch of pepper that lifts the fine acidity and the ripe apple and peach. At the end, the wine is crisp and clean.
title: Domaine Chenevières 2015 Les Grandes Vignes  (Chablis)

description: This wine is crisp, tight and mineral while also full of lively apple and citrus fruit. It offers concentration from old vines and a fresh, forward character that demands instant drinking.
title: Philippe Viallet 2015 Apremont Vieilles Vignes Jacquère (Savoie)

description: This blend of Pinot Noir and the rare local César grape is as light as red wine can get in Burgundy. This northern region close to Chablis produces bright fruity expressions that attractively balance red cherry flavor with racy acidity. Drink now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2014  Irancy

description: The fruitiness in this tight wine is still developing, hiding for now behind a bitter, toasty character. That should soften as the wine fills out—from 2018.
title: Nicolas Potel 2013 La Pucelle Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: Bright red cherry fruit and lively acidity give this wine an immediate burst of crispness. It has an attractive tannic character underpinning its ebullient fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Maison Charles Père et Fils 2015  Bourgogne

description: Bright red cherry fruit and lively acidity give this wine an immediate burst of crispness. It has an attractive tannic character underpinning its ebullient fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Maison Charles Père et Fils 2015  Bourgogne

description: This family-owned producer based in the Aube has made a ripe Pinot Noir-dominated wine. It's full and structured with light tannins and minerality. Its acidity and ripe currant fruit lend balanced richness. Drink now.
title: Fluteau NV Cuvée Réservée Brut  (Champagne)

description: This family-owned producer based in the Aube has made a ripe Pinot Noir-dominated wine. It's full and structured with light tannins and minerality. Its acidity and ripe currant fruit lend balanced richness. Drink now.
title: Fluteau NV Cuvée Réservée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Because its color comes from the grape skins rather than from the addition of red wine, this is a dark-hued rosé Champagne. It has a tannic edge that will soften with bottle age, allowing its red berry fruit to show better, so drink from 2018.
title: Charlier & Fils NV Rosé de Saignée Prestige Brut  (Champagne)

description: A dark and rich wood aged wine, packing the intense punch of Tannat while smoothing and rounding it with spicy wood, dark chocolate and sweet plums. Age for 3–4 years and more.
title: Domaine du Crampilh 2007 Vignes Vieilles Tannat (Madiran)

description: A dark and rich wood aged wine, packing the intense punch of Tannat while smoothing and rounding it with spicy wood, dark chocolate and sweet plums. Age for 3–4 years and more.
title: Domaine du Crampilh 2007 Vignes Vieilles Tannat (Madiran)

description: A big and powerful wine with a vibrant, rich texture. Dense black plum and ripe berry fruits push through the firm tannins. The wine is smooth and perfumed with a big spicy aftertaste. Drink now, or keep for 2–3 years.
title: Domaine de l'Hermitage 2007 L'Oratoire Mourvèdre (Bandol)

description: A warm, beautifully balanced wine, with a fine weight of black fruits, juicy acidity, all rounded with tannins and some wood. This ageworthy wine is concentrated while remaining poised and elegant.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2008 La Gloire de Mon Père Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: The Loin de l'Oeil is the local white grape of Gaillac and is very happy to produce sweet botrytized wines. This is rich, full of botrytis flavors along with fig, sultana and apricot. Age the wine for 2–3 years, but it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Rotier 2008 Renaissance Doux Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac Doux)

description: A powerful wine, very concentrated, the tannins a part of the richer fruit and dark brooding character of the wine. There is good juiciness as well, black fruits and acidity cutting through the dominant young tannins.
title: Château Peyros 2007 Vieilles Vignes Tannat (Madiran)

description: Perfumed wine, from a blend of Tannat and Cabernet Franc. Here is a powerful expression of intense terroir. Very concentrated and dense, with the tannins just beginning to soften, the wine is packed with black ripe fruits, solid and chunky.
title: Château Peyros 2006 Tannat-Cabernet Franc (Madiran)

description: With the richness of the vintage, the natural tannins of Tannat are tamed by the welter of intense black fruits, sweet berries and Arabica coffee. The structure is exhibited in the dusty tannins under all the fruit.
title: Château d'Aydie 2009 Madiran Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: With the richness of the vintage, the natural tannins of Tannat are tamed by the welter of intense black fruits, sweet berries and Arabica coffee. The structure is exhibited in the dusty tannins under all the fruit.
title: Château d'Aydie 2009 Madiran Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: This is a serious, firmly structured wine, impressively rich as well as tannic. Black fruits push through the considerable structure, offering balance as the wine ages. It is young now, with hints of mint from wood aging. Powerfully textured, give this 4–5 years.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Château Labrande Malbec (Cahors)

description: On the ripe, tropical side of Pouilly, this is a full wine, laden with attractive notes of wood, juicy yellow fruit and bitter orange zest. It is warm, rich and ready to drink later this year.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2010  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: The wine has firm, dark tannins as befits a Pommard, with underlying sumptuous black fruit. As the tannins soften, this will become a rich and juicy wine, and it will likely always remain structured.
title: Labouré-Roi 2009 Le Taillefer  (Pommard)

description: Flavors of apples, pears and lemons compose this ripe, friendly wine. It has nutmeg and wood flavors along with a warm and rounded character. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This is already mature. It has weight and demonstrates a delicious balance between a ripe white-fruit flavor and fresh acidity, with a fine note of tangy citrus. Ready to drink.
title: Willm 2009 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Full and fruity, this is already a delicious wine. A note of tangy citrus enlivens the apple and pear flavors. This has weight and an intense texture, with warm acidity and a touch of spice on the finish.
title: Cave de Beblenheim 2010 Baron de Hoen Riesling (Alsace)

description: Soft and attractively spicy, this has flavors of fresh apple, exotic mango and kiwi. Along with this fruitiness is a perfumed character that rounds out the finish. Screwcap.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2010 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A fine, mineral, structured wine with a very dry, solid core. Juicy red fruits offer a hint for its future ripeness. It has the freshness of the vintage that shows through at the end of this chunky wine. Age for 5–7 years.
title: Domaine des Croix 2011 Bressandes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: A fine, mineral, structured wine with a very dry, solid core. Juicy red fruits offer a hint for its future ripeness. It has the freshness of the vintage that shows through at the end of this chunky wine. Age for 5–7 years.
title: Domaine des Croix 2011 Bressandes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This 100% Grenache cuvée displays charming and complex aromas of garrigue and ripe cherries and raspberries. It's lush and creamy in texture despite being vinified and aged in concrete. It's a touch warm on the finish, but delicious nonetheless. Drink now–2020.
title: Château de la Font du Loup 2010 Le Puy Rolland Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)
winery: Château de la Font du Loup

description: This 100% Grenache cuvée displays charming and complex aromas of garrigue and ripe cherries and raspberries. It's lush and creamy in texture despite being vinified and aged in concrete. It's a touch warm on the finish, but delicious nonetheless. Drink now–2020.
title: Château de la Font du Loup 2010 Le Puy Rolland Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)
winery: Château de la Font du Loup

description: This wine has great fruitiness, soft tannins and generous, ripe red fruits, while finishing dry. It's a wine with the structure for aging while also packed with big red fruits. Keep for 4–6 years.
title: François Bertheau 2011 Les Amoureuses  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This wine has great fruitiness, soft tannins and generous, ripe red fruits, while finishing dry. It's a wine with the structure for aging while also packed with big red fruits. Keep for 4–6 years.
title: François Bertheau 2011 Les Amoureuses  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: A powerful wine, still closed. It has great potential with delicious acidity at the same time as depth of flavor complexity. This is a wine for the long-term, so give it at least seven years.
title: Domaine Luc et Lise Pavelot 2011  Corton-Charlemagne

description: A powerful wine, still closed. It has great potential with delicious acidity at the same time as depth of flavor complexity. This is a wine for the long-term, so give it at least seven years.
title: Domaine Luc et Lise Pavelot 2011  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Despite being aged in used barrels, this does show some oaky notes, but they're well balanced by bushels of black cherry fruit. It's lush, creamy and harmonious, with a long finish and up to 10 years of longevity.
title: Domaine Isabel Ferrando 2010 Colombis Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: The Delorme family's luxury cuvée is aged in a fair bit of small oak, which imparts a plush texture and cedary overtones to the wine. It's full-bodied and powerful, loaded with dark cherry fruit and baking spices that linger on the finish. Drink now–2020 or so.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2010 La Reine des Bois Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This soft and ripe wine is full of bright cherry flavors, with gentle tannins and just a hint of wood aging. A proper Pinot Noir acidity brings out the fruitiness of the wine. Drink now.
title: René Muré 2012 Cuvée V Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: With good concentration, this still-young Riesling has potential. It's aromatic, with hedgerow aromas, summer fruits and bright acidity. There is a juicy background along with a more textured character that is ready for that aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2012 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: This balanced wine is crisp, taut and mineral. It tastes very dry, packed with acidity and perfumed apple and lemon flavors. It's quite ready to drink, but will be better from 2016.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2012 Cuvée Charles Riesling (Alsace)

description: From Château des Landes' old vines, this is a concentrated, solid wine. Dark tannins have dark chocolate and licorice flavors, with a structure that dominates the fruit and needs to soften. New wood aging was perhaps excessive, but give the wine time. Drink from 2017.
title: Château des Landes 2011 Cuvée Prestige  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: A deliciously fruity rosé, brimming with smiling red-berry flavors and enhanced by a lime-like tang. It is just what a light summer rosé should be. Screwcap.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2011 Colombelle L'Original Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A blend of Colombard and Ugni Blanc, this is crisp and lively. It has a wonderfully fruity tang, and is packed with flavors of citrus fruit and green apple juice. Screwcap.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2011 Colombelle L'Original Blanc White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A touch of sweet spice jazzes up the nose, giving lift to the lightly baked apple and yellow peach characteristics. The round, medium-bodied palate has lively acidity and a sweet orange-oil flavored finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2010 Réserve Spéciale Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: A touch of sweet spice jazzes up the nose, giving lift to the lightly baked apple and yellow peach characteristics. The round, medium-bodied palate has lively acidity and a sweet orange-oil flavored finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2010 Réserve Spéciale Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: A structured and firmly tannic wine, with sufficient juicy blackberry fruit to make it already approachable.
