description: Made in honor of Christian Moreau's father, Guy, this is produced from 70-year-old vines that bestow serious concentration and density. It has as much yellow fruit ripeness as citrus and minerality. Put together, these elements give an ageworthy wine. Drink from 2018.
designation: Cuvée Guy Moreau Vaillon Premier Cru
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2012 Cuvée Guy Moreau Vaillon Premier Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: A perennial value, this year's edition boasts plenty of smoky blackberry aromas tinged with slight game notes. Medium-bodied—verging on full—there's loads of fruit and flavor packed into an easily accessible format. Ready to enjoy now and should continue to drink well for a few more years.
title: Domaine Borie de Maurel 1999 Syrah (Minervois)

description: One of a series of wines from vines grown on different soil types, this comes from micro-schist soil, giving a wine that is rich as well as structured. Behind the structure, the wine is spicy, ripe and full in the mouth showing the potential of yellow fruits as well as lime-juice citrus. Drink this concentrated wine from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'Ecu 2013 Gneiss  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: One of a series of wines from vines grown on different soil types, this comes from micro-schist soil, giving a wine that is rich as well as structured. Behind the structure, the wine is spicy, ripe and full in the mouth showing the potential of yellow fruits as well as lime-juice citrus. Drink this concentrated wine from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'Ecu 2013 Gneiss  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Spice and almonds lead off this ripe wine. It is off dry while also having a firm structure that brings flavors of pepper, German spice cake and, at the end, acidity. It's a wine for drinking now.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2012 Cuvée Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Spice and almonds lead off this ripe wine. It is off dry while also having a firm structure that brings flavors of pepper, German spice cake and, at the end, acidity. It's a wine for drinking now.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2012 Cuvée Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A spicy, perfume-shop aroma leads to a wine that is all about spice and some sweetness. Soft, round and rich, this wine could do with some aging to bring it fully into balance with the acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is for those who like their Gewurztraminer super-spicy, decadent even. It's total spice without much in the way of fruit, and so makes a statement. Drink now.
title: Joseph Cattin 2012 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is for those who like their Gewurztraminer super-spicy, decadent even. It's total spice without much in the way of fruit, and so makes a statement. Drink now.
title: Joseph Cattin 2012 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Light and fruity, this wine has as much perfumed fruit as honeyed sweetness. It's a delicate wine, hinting at rosewater and spice. A smooth texture and lemon juice balance the honey at the end.
title: Boeckel 2013 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Intensely fruity, this young wine bursts with energy. It is tangy, layering lemon and pink grapefruit flavors over a mineral, taut texture. It needs a few months to soften, so drink from 2016.
title: Pascal Rollet 2014 Solutré  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This fruity, very fresh wine has attractive acidity under its crisp apple and citrus flavors. It is light in texture, just tangy from lemon zest and with a bright, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Mâcon-Villages

description: This fruity, very fresh wine has attractive acidity under its crisp apple and citrus flavors. It is light in texture, just tangy from lemon zest and with a bright, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Mâcon-Villages

description: This crisp wine offers plenty of acidity as well as green fruits, pears and a totally refreshing aftertaste. It's a wine to drink as an apéritif as well as with food, with great energy.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2013 Les Clos  (Macon-Bussières)

description: Fruity and crisp, this bright wine offers flavors of lemon and fresh apple juice. A tangy lemon-zest texture gives great acidity and a refreshing aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cave des Vignerons de Mancey 2013 Domaie Touzot  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Made from 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah, this opens with attractive notes of red cherry, plum and blood orange. Rich, yet balanced by ample acidity, this ends on a slightly bitter, pithy note. Drink up.
title: Domaine La Jeanne 2014 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Sweet juicy fruit flavors dominate this concentrated wine. It is rich, soft in texture, showing heat even though well-balanced. It could age for several months given its firm texture.
title: Domaine Sorin 2009 Rosé (Bandol)

description: Bone-dry style, very crisp and with a full fruit character of red apples and peaches along with red berries. A great food wine.
title: Château Revelette 2009 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Bone-dry style, very crisp and with a full fruit character of red apples and peaches along with red berries. A great food wine.
title: Château Revelette 2009 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Zind-Humbrecht owns some great Grand Cru vineyards, perhaps none more so than the Clos Saint Urbain. This luscious, rich, sweet wine shows both power and intensity without losing any sense of structure. It's young, needing many years to show off its full potential. Drink from 2018.
designation: Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2012 Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Sélection de Grains Nobles, the ultimate in Alsace sweetness from the volcanic soil of the Rangen de Thann, is sure to create a great wine. This really young wine is going to live up to the billing with its opulent honey and mineral character spiced with rich fruits and acidity. It will need many years, so drink from 2019.
designation: Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald Sélection de Grains Nobles
title: Domaine Schoffit 2013 Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald Sélection de Grains Nobles Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a sweet, honeyed wine that's powerful and concentrated. It's full of spice, ripe tropical fruits and pleasurable sweetness. Just behind all this richness lies a great acidity that's so attractive. The wine could be drunk now, but it will be even better from 2017.
designation: Seppi Landmann Zinnkoepflé Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2012 Seppi Landmann Zinnkoepflé Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: With its evocative image of the surrounding Alps on its label, this is the crisp, ski-friendly wine par excellence. Its light apple and citrus flavors are immediately attractive and perfumed, with a touch of spice at the end. Drink now.
title: Les Rocailles 2016 Apremont Jacquère (Savoie)

description: With its evocative image of the surrounding Alps on its label, this is the crisp, ski-friendly wine par excellence. Its light apple and citrus flavors are immediately attractive and perfumed, with a touch of spice at the end. Drink now.
title: Les Rocailles 2016 Apremont Jacquère (Savoie)

description: This crisp, ripe Malbec rosé comes from vineyards in Cahors. Its red currant acidity and perfumed, fruity character make it immediately drinkable and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2016 Clos Triguedina Malbec Rosé

description: This crisp, ripe Malbec rosé comes from vineyards in Cahors. Its red currant acidity and perfumed, fruity character make it immediately drinkable and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2016 Clos Triguedina Malbec Rosé

description: This finely balanced wine is poised between spicy wood notes and black currant fruit. It's lightly structured with fine tannins and plenty of juicy acidity. Although young, it has been made to drink now.
title: Ignatus 2016  Bordeaux

description: The 100% new oak used in the aging of this wine was not a good idea. It has given too much woodiness and not enough fruit. Still young, it may soften enough to allow the generous blackberry flavors to come through.
title: Château Valade 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: From vines on the plateau to the west of the village of Saint-Émilion, this is a light, fruity wine. Its acidity and tannic structure lend a crisp texture to its black currant fruit. It will probably broaden as it matures, so drink from 2019.
title: Château Truquet 2016  Saint-Émilion

description: One of three wines from the Moinié family with different aging potentials and prices, this is the simplest. It's fruity and made to be drunk young, with plenty of blackberry flavor. With its tannins, it will benefit from a few more months of age and be ready from 2018.
title: Château Ponzac 2015 Maintenant Malbec (Cahors)

description: Red fruit aromas dominate this youthful wine. On the palate, it's still tight, with fine red berry fruit flavors interlaced with tannins. The structure and acidity suggest it will age, so drink from 2019.
title: Château Noblet 2016  Côtes de Bourg

description: Red fruit aromas dominate this youthful wine. On the palate, it's still tight, with fine red berry fruit flavors interlaced with tannins. The structure and acidity suggest it will age, so drink from 2019.
title: Château Noblet 2016  Côtes de Bourg

description: Reflecting the ripe vintage, this is a warm wine. Its black currant fruit is still dominated by spice from wood aging, although this will dissipate to leave a smooth, ripe and fruity wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château l'Orangerie 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This ripe, juicy wine will develop quickly. Its tannins are there but already well integrated with the red cherry fruit and acidity. It's bright and ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Le Cap 2015 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Soft, sweet wine with crushed strawberry flavors that show a high dosage and sweet acidity. It is full-bodied, rich, but not well balanced.
title: Drappier NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Lalande de Pomerol is the northern extension of Pomerol, so it's no surprise to find this wine dominated by Merlot. It is soft, rounded and rich. Black plums give the fruitiness while black fruit skins provide the texture. It's a full wine that needs a little aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Vieille Dynastie 2012  Lalande de Pomerol

description: Rich and round, this attractive wine has generous tannins and equally generous fruit. Black currants shine with their acidity while the texture is firm and solid. This is a wine with a future; drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2012  Bordeaux

description: Rich and round, this attractive wine has generous tannins and equally generous fruit. Black currants shine with their acidity while the texture is firm and solid. This is a wine with a future; drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2012  Bordeaux

description: This wine has dark tannins and considerable wood flavor at this stage. The structure and the weight are all there, allowing the fruit and rich texture to develop. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Bel Air Perponcher 2012 Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: While the wine has plenty of tannins, it also has juicy black fruits that more than balance the structure. It's a well-made, ripe wine that has a sweep of fruitiness. From 2018, the tannins will be fully integrated.
title: Château de la Cour d'Argent 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Just maturing, this is a rich, wood-aged wine. Its tannins have softened and melted into its ripe dark plum and black fruit flavors and concentrated structure. A serious wine, it's powered by a dry core and rich fruitiness. Drink from 2018.
title: Clos Teddi 2014 Grande Cuvée Red (Patrimonio)

description: Balanced and ripe, this is a rich wine. Its tannins and dark chocolate and wood flavors are deliciously balanced by ripe black fruit. It's concentrated and dense and will age well. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Tanesse 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Although full of fruit, this no-sulfur-added wine is structured and concentrated. Big tannins back up the ripe character and generous fruit flavors. It's likely to be ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château les Petits Arnauds 2015 Cuvée Non-Sulfité  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Although full of fruit, this no-sulfur-added wine is structured and concentrated. Big tannins back up the ripe character and generous fruit flavors. It's likely to be ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château les Petits Arnauds 2015 Cuvée Non-Sulfité  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This bold, ripe wine is full of tannins as well as great fruit. Juicy with black currant flavors, smoky from wood aging and rich with tannins, it's finely structured and ready to mature gently. Drink from 2021.
title: Château la Croix Saint-Pierre 2015 Grande Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: An unusual blend of 95% Cabernet Franc and only 5% Merlot comprises this richly perfumed and structured wine. It's generous, with dark chocolate and spice flavors as well as acidity at the end. It could still age further, so drink from 2019.
title: Château la Clide 2009 Primo du Château la Clide  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Black cherry aromas are followed by rich black fruit, plum and damson flavors in this wine. There is plenty of juicy acidity here as well, with tannins to support the richness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Peyrefaure 2015 Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: While this dense wine has plenty of firm tannins, it also has fine, ripe fruit. Rich blackberry flavors and smoky aromas dominate. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Dina 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: While this dense wine has plenty of firm tannins, it also has fine, ripe fruit. Rich blackberry flavors and smoky aromas dominate. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Dina 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Named after the 18th Century Russian tsar, Peter the Great, this wine is tannic and structured, with a fine balance of black fruit. The Merlot in the blend, which softens the Malbec, has also added a strongly rich and fruity character. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Eugénie 2015 Cuvée Tsar Pierre le Grand Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This ripe, juicy and smoky wine is rich in black fruit. It's structured and full, the fruit layered with wood. Perfumed now, it promises a good future ahead. Drink from 2021.
title: Château du Roc 2015 Libelula by Roc  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This ripe, juicy and smoky wine is rich in black fruit. It's structured and full, the fruit layered with wood. Perfumed now, it promises a good future ahead. Drink from 2021.
title: Château du Roc 2015 Libelula by Roc  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a beautiful, ripe, soft, perfumed wine. Its intense berry fruit is well to the fore, backed by firm tannins. Packed with fruit and smokiness from wood aging, it has strong aging potential. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Ricaud 2015 Grand Vin  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a beautiful, ripe, soft, perfumed wine. Its intense berry fruit is well to the fore, backed by firm tannins. Packed with fruit and smokiness from wood aging, it has strong aging potential. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Ricaud 2015 Grand Vin  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This concentrated wine is solid with tannins. The fruit is evident from the fine acidity and hints of black plum that push through the wall of tannin. Give it time and drink from 2021.
title: Château de Birot 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A crisp and fruity wine, this is fresh, full of lemon and grapefruit flavors with a warmer layer of ripe pear. It's aromatic, refreshing and full of life. The acidity gives the whole wine a lift.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2014 Cuvée Lampe de Méduse White (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pear candy and citrus peel beckon from the glass. There is a slightly candied edge to the expressive fruit, while the dryish palate shows concentration and warmth.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2013 Cuvée Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Pear candy and citrus peel beckon from the glass. There is a slightly candied edge to the expressive fruit, while the dryish palate shows concentration and warmth.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2013 Cuvée Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Already this wine is so smooth that it is quite ready to drink. With its berry fruit flavors that are lifted by acidity, it is well balanced between mineral tannins and fruitiness. The aftertaste is full and round.
title: Vignerons de Mancey 2013 Cuvée Agnès de Couëdic  (Mercurey)

description: This wine is soft and ripe, with some attractive strawberry-jam flavors and fresh acidity. The rounded texture is already attractive, although the wine will be better from 2017, when it will have filled out.
title: Henri de Villamont 2012 Le Village  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is a full-bodied rosé. It has ripe red fruits and a touch of tannin along with balanced acidity. With its up-front richness, it is a food wine, rather than an apéritif.
title: Château Barbebelle 2014 Cuvée Madeleine Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Called Earth because, claims Pommery, the bottle is lighter (meaning lower carbon footprint in transportation). The wine is a fine blend, bringing good acidity to balanced white and green fruits, the light dosage finely integrated.
title: Pommery NV POP Earth Brut  (Champagne)

description: Very herbal Sauvignon Blanc, crisp and tangy, with flavors of lime and green apple skins. Fresh as well as structured, with a final zest of acidity.
title: Château les Arromans 2010  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A solid effort, all tannins and dark texture at this stage. The acidity and dry tannins are firmly edged with black currant fruits. It will age and soften, but will always be on the dry, firm side.
title: Château le Paradis 2009  Côtes de Bourg

description: Soft apple- and honey-flavored wine that has dry botrytis and a spiced texture. With flavors of lemon curd and peach, it is more in a light Barsac style, fruity as well as sweet.
title: Château Hallet 2009  Sauternes

description: With the few years of bottle age, the wine is showing ripe fruits, the tannins well integrated. The combination of juicy acidity and ripe fruit, with the dry core, are bringing the development of the wine on well.
title: Château Franc-Cardinal 2006  Bordeaux Côtes de Francs

description: With the few years of bottle age, the wine is showing ripe fruits, the tannins well integrated. The combination of juicy acidity and ripe fruit, with the dry core, are bringing the development of the wine on well.
title: Château Franc-Cardinal 2006  Bordeaux Côtes de Francs

description: A smooth, wood-aged wine that has a rich texture, layers of toast and nutmeg from the wood and peach fruits. The wood needs time to integrate, but already shows that this is going to be a rich wine.
title: Château Bertinerie 2009 Cru Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Rich new wood and fruit combine well in this concentrated wine. Flavors go right through to give mint, blackberry and dark plum fruits. The tannins are already integrated to give a wine that will be ready to drink in two years.
title: Château Grand-Maison 2009  Côtes de Bourg

description: This light and fruity wine is fresh with lemon and light minerality. It is ready to drink, with its bright acidity and pear and apple aftertaste.
title: Tortoise Creek 2013 Le Charmel Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This light and fruity wine is fresh with lemon and light minerality. It is ready to drink, with its bright acidity and pear and apple aftertaste.
title: Tortoise Creek 2013 Le Charmel Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This New World style of Sauvignon Blanc is ripe, intense and catty in flavor. Very herbaceous, concentrated fruits are right up front. There is no complexity, just fruit.
title: Confrerie de Oisly et Thesée 2014 Les Gourmets Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This young and fruity wine has red cherries that lie over soft tannins and a stalky texture. It's all about fruit that's ready to drink, and not for aging.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier 2014 Le Grand Bouqueteau  (Chinon)

description: This young and fruity wine has red cherries that lie over soft tannins and a stalky texture. It's all about fruit that's ready to drink, and not for aging.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier 2014 Le Grand Bouqueteau  (Chinon)

description: This cru is a solid wine. It has a dense structure spearheaded by the tannins and lifted by acidity. Black plum and berry fruits are still developing behind the firm facade. It will take some time to develop, so wait until early 2019.
title: Domaine des Marrans 2015  Fleurie

description: Owner Arnaud Briday has made a firm structured cru wine. While it has the generous fruit of the year, it also has plenty of tannins that give it tension and concentration. The wine is rich with explosive berry fruits and balanced acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Chers 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Wines from this great producer have developed a tendency towards too much alcohol for a wine from Beaujolais. It is a shame because otherwise this is a generous structured cru wine that is finely balanced. With tannins and delicious acidity, the wine is ready to develop further. Drink from 2018.
title: Château des Jacques 2015  Fleurie

description: From vines planted as its name suggests on granite soil, the wine is structured and dense with rich juicy black fruits. Packed with perfumed fruitiness and acidity, the wine is developing well, ready to drink from late 2017.
title: Château de Chatelard 2015 Cuvée les Vieux Granits  (Fleurie)

description: A pleasant, if somewhat light offering, featuring bright Grenache fruit highlighted by red cherries and hints of black pepper. Finishes with a touch of stemmy astringency that adds needed grip.
title: Château de Ségriès 1999 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Another solid showing from one of importer Fran Kysela's stable of Rhône producers. This offering shows plenty of rustic leathery aromas, along with a blend of cherries and blackberries. Not overripe or heavy; the fruit and tanned-hide notes come together in a velour-textured finish.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 1998 Domaine Grand Veneur Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Attractive grapefruit and herb aromas and flavors mark the bouquet and palate of this French sparkler. There’s a touch of anise or licorice in the mouth, and a dry spice note on the foamy finish. The soft feel gives it great appeal, while the solid flavors set it apart from the sweet set.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Bordeaux)

description: Soft and pleasant, this white blend offers attractive aromas and flavors. A melange of mild fruit and spice elements makes for very easy drinking, and the mouthfeel is smooth, almost creamy.
title: Domaine de la Solitude 1998 White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Pale for a rosé, but you can pick up a trace of black cherry in the aroma, along with the usual baked bread and squeeze of lime. The baked flavor and texture persist in the mouth. It’s almost like burnt toast, and the finish is very dry and bitter. An eccentric wine for sure.
title: Jacquart NV Brut Mosaïque Rosé  (Champagne)

description: There’s a pleasing nose here with some toast and mineral notes. A dry palate follows with lime, herb and mushroom flavors, and the mouthfeel is light and positive. More of the same follows on the finish, with a tasty biscuit note. It’s a solid, straightforward sparkler with a refreshing lack of pretense. Kosher, too.
title: Abarbanel NV Cremant d'Alsace  (Alsace)

description: An effusive, unabashedly fruity wine that's loaded with grapey, black-cherry fruit. Some sweaty-leather notes on the nose bring you back to the Rhône Valley, and a dash of green peppercorns spices up the finish.
title: La Bouvaude 1999 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Not quite as impressive as the wonderful 1998, this blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah features solid black-cherry fruit and hints of smoke but seems a bit compact, with firm structure. Still, the persistent finish and reasonable depth suggest it will show better in a couple of months.
title: Château de Ségriès 1999 Cuvée Reservée Red (Lirac)

description: From the full bouquet with its dark-cherry and black-pepper notes, this wine makes its presence felt. There’s very good depth of fruit, with a characteristic brambly quality. Some complexity can be found here via earth and white-pepper elements that accent the fruit.
title: Domaine de la Solitude 1998 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: From the full bouquet with its dark-cherry and black-pepper notes, this wine makes its presence felt. There’s very good depth of fruit, with a characteristic brambly quality. Some complexity can be found here via earth and white-pepper elements that accent the fruit.
title: Domaine de la Solitude 1998 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This offering from a well-known négociant is made in a lighter style and has good flavor. The essential ripeness of the vintage shows; there is some texture to the mouthfeel and it wraps up with a clean finish of good length.
title: Barton & Guestier 1998 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This one smells like a French Prosecco, with effusive bubbles and a citrusy bouquet. Off-dry, with lots of orange flavors. It finishes with a lively, lengthy, orange-rind explosion. This is very well made, and invites a second or third glass. It rests gently on the palate, and lingers pleasantly.
region: Clairette de Die Méthode Dioise Ancestrale
title: Carod Freres NV  Clairette de Die Méthode Dioise Ancestrale

description: A powerful wine, concentrated with an edge of pepper and rich red fruits, lifted with an orange zest flavor. This is serious rosé, intense and worth aging a few months.
title: Domaine de la Sauveuse 2010 Cuvée Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Stalky smoky aromas open a wine that is spicy, smoky from wood and full of red fruits. The wine is light with acidity as well as a layer of crisp tannins. Drink this from 2018.
title: Domaine du Petit Bondieu 2015 Vendôme Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Stalky smoky aromas open a wine that is spicy, smoky from wood and full of red fruits. The wine is light with acidity as well as a layer of crisp tannins. Drink this from 2018.
title: Domaine du Petit Bondieu 2015 Vendôme Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Crisp lemon aromas follow through to an equally crisp wine. It has a touch of pepper as well as citrus and green-plum fruits. The acidity and the tangy texture are given weight by the lees aging. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2016 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Vanilla and ripe fruit aromas and a creamy texture give this wine its rounded fruity character. White fruits, caramel and light spice all come into play. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2016 Sélection Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: Produced from Pinot Noir, this is a particularly crisp example of a Sancerre rosé. It has red-currant fruitiness along with an edge of tannins. The finish is smoothed with caramel. Drink now.
title: Michel Vattan 2016 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Produced from Pinot Noir, this is a particularly crisp example of a Sancerre rosé. It has red-currant fruitiness along with an edge of tannins. The finish is smoothed with caramel. Drink now.
title: Michel Vattan 2016 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Powerful tannins dominate this serious wine. It has a complex, dense structure, full of wood and fruit tannins, along with blackberry fruits and a touch of spiced bitter cherry. This is Beaujolais for aging. Give it at least 3–5 years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine des Rosiers  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Textured, full wine, ripe in character, full of fragrant apple and quince flavors, tightly layered. It's a concentrated wine, dense in character. The flavors go right down into the heart of the wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Boeckel 2010 Wiebelsberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: From the best parcels at Haute-Serre, this prestige cuvée is big, powerful and certainly full of the ripest fruit. Strong wood aging and chocolate flavors show the firm extraction of this very concentrated wine. It needs considerable time to soften and open up. Drink from 2017.
designation: Château de Haute-Serre Cuvée Géron Dadine de Haute-Serre
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château de Haute-Serre Cuvée Géron Dadine de Haute-Serre Malbec (Cahors)

description: A blend from five of the Mercurey Premier Crus, a rich full-bodied wine, with elegant ripe fruits, red cherry flavors and spice. The wine is fresh, perfumed as well as solidly constructed with firm final tannins. Drink from 2017.
designation: Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Dark, dense and tannic wine, very firm. The youthful structure covers the red fruits and acidity, promising much though for the future. The wine has a potential of elegance, balance and richness. Drink from 2018.
designation: Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: An impressive, wood-aged wine, with great perfumes as well as structure. Rich, while very mineral, the wine has an intense, ageworthy texture that brings out dark plums, ripe berries and dark tannins. Keep this wine and drink from 2016.
title: Château Eugénie 2010 Cuvée Pierre le Grand Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This is a great wine, rounded and rich despite its power and weight. Its many elements—the ripe black fruits, the balanced acidity—are smoothed with wood aging. It also shows an elegance, giving the wine good aging potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Aydie 2010 Tannat (Madiran)

description: This is a great wine, rounded and rich despite its power and weight. Its many elements—the ripe black fruits, the balanced acidity—are smoothed with wood aging. It also shows an elegance, giving the wine good aging potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Aydie 2010 Tannat (Madiran)

description: This wine is chunky and firm, and its lively red fruit brings freshness. With its dry core and touch of toast on the finish, this could age for a couple of years.
title: Jaffelin 2010  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: Ripe and fruity, this wine has a full, rich texture, with apple and peach flavors and a toast note. On the finish, there is a citrus-like character from the refreshing acidity. Ready to drink, but it can be cellared for a year.
title: Jaffelin 2010  Meursault

description: This wine's fresh, fragrant fruit comes with a steely blade of acidity and minerality. It is just beginning to show its concentration, and the citrus and white peach flavors are starting to develop.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2011 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This wine's fresh, fragrant fruit comes with a steely blade of acidity and minerality. It is just beginning to show its concentration, and the citrus and white peach flavors are starting to develop.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2011 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Montagny produces wines that have a warm, southern feel. This full-bodied wine is packed with flavors of yellow fruits, and it offers ripe acidity and a touch of toast. The finish shows a limestone-like minerality.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: Bright, fruity and crisp, this silky-textured rosé has a refreshing finish and bold, pink bubble-gum-like (but dry) flavors. Drink now.
title: Pont du Rhône 2016 Passion Terroirs Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A pretty floral note, reminiscent of carnations, sits atop the crisp, fresh fruit tones of red cherry and watermelon on the nose and mouth of this easygoing wine. It's direct, yet clean, with a mouthwatering finish.
title: Domaine Montrose 2016 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Lightly stalky because it is still young, this wine otherwise promises rich black-currant fruitiness as it matures. It is balanced, ripe and with a gentle set of tannins in the background. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Tour Chapoux 2015  Bordeaux

description: This attractive fruity wine is full of young black-currant and red-berry fruits. The tannins mingle with spice to give a contrast to the aura of fruitiness surrounding the wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut Pasquet 2015  Bordeaux

description: This luxury cuvée combines Syrah with Vermentino in a wine that resembles Sauvignon Blanc for its lively citrus and passion fruit aromas and flavors. A bit of oiliness gives it weight on the midpalate, but it finishes zesty and refreshing.
title: Château de Campuget 2016 1753 Syrah-Vermentino Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: While this wine is firm at the moment, it does have fine black fruits. The acidity from the blackberry fruitiness is going to balance with the tannins shortly to give a ripe and fruity wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Briot 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a ripe wine with generous black fruits and crisp acidity. It is balanced—fruity with a core of tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Vircoulon 2015  Bordeaux

description: A romantic name for an easy fruity wine. Spice from wood gives the black-currant fruit richness and some complexity. With its acidity and dry core, this is a wine to keep for another year. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Venus 2014  Graves

description: This juicy, wood-aged Pierre Lurton wine has very ripe fruit. That gives it richness with black-plum fruits and a dense texture. A bitter coffee flavor shows through the fruit. It needs time, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Marjosse 2015  Bordeaux

description: This juicy, wood-aged Pierre Lurton wine has very ripe fruit. That gives it richness with black-plum fruits and a dense texture. A bitter coffee flavor shows through the fruit. It needs time, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Marjosse 2015  Bordeaux

description: Fruity and with fine tannins, this wine is already tasting good. It has juicy acidity, lots of ripe tannins and black-currant fruitiness. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Château Haut Pingat 2015  Bordeaux

description: Firmly structured, this wine will be equally packed with ripe fruit. While the toast and tannin flavors soften, wait for those rich red plum and cherry tastes to come through. Balanced and solid, this dense wine should be drunk from 2018.
title: Louis Max 2013 Les Lièvres  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Firmly structured, this wine will be equally packed with ripe fruit. While the toast and tannin flavors soften, wait for those rich red plum and cherry tastes to come through. Balanced and solid, this dense wine should be drunk from 2018.
title: Louis Max 2013 Les Lièvres  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This has a toasty edge that complements the ripe red fruit and attractive lemon and yeast character. It seems to be well on its way to maturity, retaining a fruity style while its flavors are beginning to dig deeper.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin 2004 La Grande Dame Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This has a toasty edge that complements the ripe red fruit and attractive lemon and yeast character. It seems to be well on its way to maturity, retaining a fruity style while its flavors are beginning to dig deeper.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin 2004 La Grande Dame Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A mature Champagne, this shows as much toast and cookie character as fruit, making it soft, ripe and delicious. The fruit moves toward tropical, with pineapple and peach flavors. It is not a wine to age.
title: Duval-Leroy 2000 Femme de Champagne Brut  (Champagne)

description: A mature Champagne, this shows as much toast and cookie character as fruit, making it soft, ripe and delicious. The fruit moves toward tropical, with pineapple and peach flavors. It is not a wine to age.
title: Duval-Leroy 2000 Femme de Champagne Brut  (Champagne)

description: This has smooth, rich fruit, with sweet berries, ripe tannins and strong layers of wood. The wine is powerful; the stalky and bitter chocolate edge contrasts the sweet, ripe fruit. This is meant for long-term aging.
title: Château Olivier 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Already delicious, this wine shows its wood aging with such finesse, while letting its elegant white-fruit flavor come through. It has an herbaceous edge, rounded out with a more ripe fruit character. This is meant for aging.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Already delicious, this wine shows its wood aging with such finesse, while letting its elegant white-fruit flavor come through. It has an herbaceous edge, rounded out with a more ripe fruit character. This is meant for aging.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Full of tropical fruit flavors, this is rounded, ripe and very accessible. At the same time, its structure shows through in the tang of green apple skin, judicious wood aging and taut aftertaste.
title: Château de Fieuzal 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Big, ripe and delicious, this is packed with spice and sweet apricot fruits. It's full and opulent, very much a wine of 2009, yet it retains its sense of balance and structure.
title: Château Malartic-Lagravière 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: One of the top wines from Henri Bourgeois, this is rich and ageworthy. Its green and white fruits push through a concentrated structure to give a dense wine with ripeness and great elegance.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2010 Jadis  (Sancerre)

description: One of the top wines from Henri Bourgeois, this is rich and ageworthy. Its green and white fruits push through a concentrated structure to give a dense wine with ripeness and great elegance.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2010 Jadis  (Sancerre)

description: Very dense and firm, this has powerful tannins as well as a blackberry jam flavor. The wine is complex, full of both dark tannins and the richest fruits, layered with notes of herb, spice and a concentrated structure.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: From old vines, this a wonderfully perfumed, oak-aged wine. Almond and ethereal juicy acidity complement its richness and fine ripeness, with an intense acidity on the finish. Delicious now, but can age for another 6–8 years.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2008 Le Clos  (Vouvray)

description: A wood-aged sweet wine, opulent and golden. It has sweetness, honey, white fig and quince jelly flavors, balanced by just the right acidity. A superb wine, ready for long aging. It's tempting to drink it now, but wait until 2017.
title: Domaine Rotier 2010 Renaissance Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac Doux)

description: A wood-aged sweet wine, opulent and golden. It has sweetness, honey, white fig and quince jelly flavors, balanced by just the right acidity. A superb wine, ready for long aging. It's tempting to drink it now, but wait until 2017.
title: Domaine Rotier 2010 Renaissance Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac Doux)

description: A concentrated wine that is the epitome of dark, dense Malbec. Spice, tense acidity, black fruits, dark plums and licorice are all present in this impressive, dense wine. The power in this dense wine is very evident, expressed right up front. It should age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Vincens 2009 Les Graves de Paul Malbec (Cahors)

description: A concentrated wine that is the epitome of dark, dense Malbec. Spice, tense acidity, black fruits, dark plums and licorice are all present in this impressive, dense wine. The power in this dense wine is very evident, expressed right up front. It should age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Vincens 2009 Les Graves de Paul Malbec (Cahors)

description: Great spice, honey and tropical fruits are subtly combined in this delicious, elegant sweet wine. With acidity to add its fresher character, it is balanced, full in the mouth and already a very fine wine. It is better to age it, though, so drink after 2017.
title: Château Jolys 2011 Cuvée Jean  (Jurançon)

description: An herbal and perfumed wine, its welcoming soft aromatic character comes from the Cabernet Franc in the blend. The wine has dusty tannins, rich and juicy black fruits and tamed Tannat structure, to give a ripe, full and opulent wine that will develop quickly. Drink now or, better, from 2015.
title: Château d'Aydie 2011 Aydie L'Origine Tannat-Cabernet Franc (Madiran)

description: There is no missing the power of this hugely concentrated wine. It comes from steep slopes above the Adour valley at the eastern end of the Madiran appellation. This rich wine, stlll young at five years, holds massive flavors of new wood and black fruit. Tannins march through showing no signs yet of softening as the superripe Tannat powers the wine forward. Drink from 2018.
title: Alain Brumont 2009 Château Montus Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: A limited-edition vintage that Perrier-Jouët releases for summer drinking. It has weight and richness with a soft, fruity dosage that gives touches of yeast and fragrant acidity. Ripe apple, raspberry and citrus fruits are still very present in this wine that is full and balanced. It could do with more bottle age to bring out more of the toast that is just beginning, so drink from 2016.
title: Perrier Jouët 2007 Belle Epoque Edition Première Brut  (Champagne)

description: A limited-edition vintage that Perrier-Jouët releases for summer drinking. It has weight and richness with a soft, fruity dosage that gives touches of yeast and fragrant acidity. Ripe apple, raspberry and citrus fruits are still very present in this wine that is full and balanced. It could do with more bottle age to bring out more of the toast that is just beginning, so drink from 2016.
title: Perrier Jouët 2007 Belle Epoque Edition Première Brut  (Champagne)

description: The palest of rosés, this crisp, bright and fruity wine is full of tight acidity, freshly picked raspberries and steely acidity. It could age a few more years to bring out a toastier character. The specially designed bottle has a hummingbird etched on the inside and gold on the outside.
title: Perrier Jouët 2005 Belle Epoque Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A superb wine from a great year, this is powerful and structured, with great acidity and solid, pronounced fruits. La Romanée is a small vineyard, wholly owned by Liger-Belair, next to Romanée-Conti. The wine is rich, spicy and very complex, with black fruits welling up from its depth. With great structure, it brings together opulent Pinot Noir fruits with firm, dense tannins with immense aging potential.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2010  La Romanée

description: A superb wine from a great year, this is powerful and structured, with great acidity and solid, pronounced fruits. La Romanée is a small vineyard, wholly owned by Liger-Belair, next to Romanée-Conti. The wine is rich, spicy and very complex, with black fruits welling up from its depth. With great structure, it brings together opulent Pinot Noir fruits with firm, dense tannins with immense aging potential.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2010  La Romanée

description: In this great year for white Burgundy, Bâtard-Montrachet shines out as the epitome of balance between superb fruit and intense mineral and terroir characters. Its subtle touch of wood highlights the unctuous surface texture while just hinting at the steel sharpness of the structure beneath. Age this superb wine for at least 10 years.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2010  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: A southern yet herbal-feeling wine, this is ripe—maybe overripe—and missing real structure or fruitiness.
title: Château Bellevue Favereau 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Vibrant notes of red cherry, plum and blueberry are partnered with earthy hints of forest floor and cocoa. This is a solid selection that's perfect for entertaining. It's well balanced, with light tannins, lifted acidity and a medium-length, black-pepper-kissed finish.
title: Arrogant Frog 2010 Lily Pad Noir Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: Notes of red apple rind and orange oil lead the bouquet of this straightforward quaff. The bright palate offers more intense citrus flavors, leading nicely onto the brisk, clean finish. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2010  Picpoul de Pinet

description: This soft, off-dry wine has attractive flavors of tangy orange and lemon, softened by it's fruit-forward character. This is a wine for drinking now. Screwcap.
title: Château de Montfort 2011 Demi-sec  (Vouvray)

description: The fruit isn't the star of this wine; instead, intense notes of forest floor and cola spice dominate the nose and palate. Sure, the red berry and cherry flavors are there, but they're just hanging in the background of this bright yet herbaceous selection.
title: Labouré-Roi 2010 Les Sangliers Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: The fruit isn't the star of this wine; instead, intense notes of forest floor and cola spice dominate the nose and palate. Sure, the red berry and cherry flavors are there, but they're just hanging in the background of this bright yet herbaceous selection.
title: Labouré-Roi 2010 Les Sangliers Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: Tender apple and pear notes make for a fresh, crunchy toned-down palate. The fresh fruit is highlighted by lemon freshness; likewise the almost fizzy midpalate finishes with off-dry lemon hints.
title: Willm 2015 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tender apple and pear notes make for a fresh, crunchy toned-down palate. The fresh fruit is highlighted by lemon freshness; likewise the almost fizzy midpalate finishes with off-dry lemon hints.
title: Willm 2015 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Red-berry fruits and a full-bodied texture form the hallmark of this ripe wine. It has spice, a rich character that is generous and fruity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Louis Jadot 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Red-berry fruits and a full-bodied texture form the hallmark of this ripe wine. It has spice, a rich character that is generous and fruity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Louis Jadot 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This 100% Syrah rosé is extremely pale in color and offers dainty aromas of pink peony, cherry, strawberry hull and barely ripe peach. The pristine palate offers more of the same, with additional hints of melon rind and peach skin that lend some bitterness and texture to the finish. Well balanced and refreshing; drink now.
title: La Forge Estate 2015 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Notes of ripe but tart apples and pears tumble forth. The palate is off dry, underlining the rich fruitiness of the flavors. These are balanced by lemony freshness, leaving full-fruited, apple- and pear-scented generosity on the palate.
title: Koenig 2014 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Volcanic ash over granite gives this vineyard its structured character, which carries over into this wine. Wood aged in large barrels, it has a rich firm character that will allow the wine to develop. Powered by acidity and tannins, the ripe black fruits are juicy and concentrated. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2015 Grand Cras  (Morgon)

description: Volcanic ash over granite gives this vineyard its structured character, which carries over into this wine. Wood aged in large barrels, it has a rich firm character that will allow the wine to develop. Powered by acidity and tannins, the ripe black fruits are juicy and concentrated. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2015 Grand Cras  (Morgon)

description: From vineyards on the cooler south bank of the Serein, this wine is crisp and tightly coiled despite the warmth of the 2015 vintage. It's built on a backbone of sturdy minerality, fleshed out with crisp, citrus fruit, and will be ready to drink from late 2017.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2015  Chablis
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: From vineyards on the cooler south bank of the Serein, this wine is crisp and tightly coiled despite the warmth of the 2015 vintage. It's built on a backbone of sturdy minerality, fleshed out with crisp, citrus fruit, and will be ready to drink from late 2017.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2015  Chablis
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This is Alain Gayraud's estate wine. With 90% Malbec and 10% Merlot, it certainly shows some of the tannins typical of the grape. At the same time, it has attractive berry fruits and balanced acidity. It has a light touch that will make it ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lamartine 2014 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This is not nearly as rich and plush as La Nerthe's luxury-level Cuvée des Cadettes, but remains a very good wine. Red plum and red currant fruit is medium-bodied, supported by bright acids, while some slightly ashy notes and a hint of cocoa emerge on the crisp finish.
title: Château La Nerthe 2013 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This is not nearly as rich and plush as La Nerthe's luxury-level Cuvée des Cadettes, but remains a very good wine. Red plum and red currant fruit is medium-bodied, supported by bright acids, while some slightly ashy notes and a hint of cocoa emerge on the crisp finish.
title: Château La Nerthe 2013 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Organically grown fruit, aged in new wood for 12 months, creates this rich smooth wine. With a juicy oxidative character, it is soft and round. Yellow fruits and spice come together in a wine that is now ready to drink.
title: Château Beauséjour 2013 Red (Bergerac Sec)

description: From the Bouyssou family estate, this structured wine is perfumed, ripe with black fruits and firmly based on serious tannins. It has weight and richness with spice and concentration. At the end, the acidity is crisp and juicy. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Armandière 2014 Ancestral Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is just right, balanced with plenty of crisp citrus fruit and a warmer, ripe background of green plums and even apricots. The combination gives the wine weight and even a touch of richness.
title: Domaine du Fief aux Dames 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is just right, balanced with plenty of crisp citrus fruit and a warmer, ripe background of green plums and even apricots. The combination gives the wine weight and even a touch of richness.
title: Domaine du Fief aux Dames 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Abouriou is a grape found almost exclusively in southwest France. As here, it produces a wine that balances acidity and juicy red fruits with a herbal edge. A light layer of tannin gives a structured aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2012 Just Abouriou (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: This is full, ripe and strongly mineral. Its young apricot and citrus fruits are very fresh, bright and have a sense of structure with minerality and zesty, tangy lemon peel. With its good depth of flavor, it is ready to drink.
title: Barton & Guestier 2013 Passeport  (Sancerre)

description: This perfumed and fruity wine is a new concept from Jean-Luc Baldès of Clos Triguedina. It is rich, with the Malbec tannins cushioned by ripe black fruits and mint flavors. It's ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2012 Malbec du Clos Malbec (Cahors)

description: Seemingly one dimensional, this wine is tight and packed with acidity. It has a fine texture marked with lemon-and-lime zestiness, but misses the mark in terms of depth and complexity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Buronfosse 2010 Varron Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: Firm and solid, this wine is more tannin than fruit at this stage. It does have some weight and acidity to it, showing potential for blackberry fruitiness with age.
title: Château Bois Pertuis 2011  Bordeaux

description: From the same ownership as Larose Trintaudon, this wine is firm while also having juicy red-currant fruit and intense acidity. The two characteristics are still working it out in this young wine. Wait to drink until 2018.
title: Château Larose Perganson 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: All spice, acidity and tangy herbal flavors, this rich wine is also very fresh. It's full of green fruits and lively acidity. The aftertaste is crisp but ripe. The property has been owned since 1999 by Sophie Lurton of neighbor Château Bouscaut.
title: Château Lamothe Bouscaut 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This easy, early-developing wine has balanced tannins that lift the black-currant fruitiness and the fresh acidity. It is developing fast, with its fruit right to the front and the tannins in the background. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lamothe-Bergeron 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This rich, smoky wine has an appealing streak of ripe black-plum flavors. What it is missing in all this richness is enough acidity, although the tannins will certainly allow it to age. Drink this powerful, ripe Merlot from 2017.
title: Château La Croix Chantecaille 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Named after King Henri IV, this is a powerful, ripe and still-structured wine. Big, rich tannins push the structure forward and boost the full black-plum flavors. It is complex, dense and still needing time. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Henry de France 2010  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Named after King Henri IV, this is a powerful, ripe and still-structured wine. Big, rich tannins push the structure forward and boost the full black-plum flavors. It is complex, dense and still needing time. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Henry de France 2010  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is tough and structured, while still having plenty of weight and fruit for the future. As it integrates, ripe berry flavors will balance those tannins, giving a classic, structured Bordeaux. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Hanteillan 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This wine is tough and structured, while still having plenty of weight and fruit for the future. As it integrates, ripe berry flavors will balance those tannins, giving a classic, structured Bordeaux. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Hanteillan 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: Big and fruity, this is a ripe, full wine that shows good structure and dark berry fruits. It has a fine juicy potential, fine acidity and a perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Gazin Rocquencourt 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is rich with black fruits and layers of wood. It is structured and dense while also having the attractive fruitiness of the vintage. The wine will be ready to drink by summer 2016.
title: Château Fontana 2014  Bordeaux

description: Half and half Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine is firm and tannic. It has a ripe character, benefiting from the good climatic conditions in Saint-Estèphe. Blackberry and damson flavors are lifted by youthful acidity that will calm down. Drink this from 2019.
title: Château de Côme 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: From a property owned by Château Mongravey in Margaux, this firmly structured wine is solid with dark tannins and blackberry fruits. It has the stalky texture typical of the vintage, although this will soften to leave a firm while ripe wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Braude 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This attractive, fruity wine features soft blackberry fruits that are backed up by still-young, dry tannins. A juicy character comes from the acidity typical of the vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour St Bonnet 2013  Médoc

description: This attractive, fruity wine features soft blackberry fruits that are backed up by still-young, dry tannins. A juicy character comes from the acidity typical of the vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour St Bonnet 2013  Médoc

description: This wine is full of black-currant freshness. It is already delicious, crisp while just lit up by tannins. It is developing quickly, with a refreshing character that will make it drinkable from 2017.
title: Château Teyssier 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Fruity and perfumed, this is already an attractive wine. Dusty tannins are working with the black-currant fruitiness to produce a fresh, lightly structured wine. Like many wines of the vintage, it will develop quickly, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Paveil de Luze 2013  Margaux

description: This crisp blend of Braucol and Syrah comes from a gravel terrace. While it has fine acidity, the wine also has ripe red fruits, sweet plum flavors and an attractive sprinkling of spice. Drink this wine from 2017.
title: Domaine Rotier 2014 Les Gravels Red (Gaillac)

description: Pure and friendly notes of ripe Bosc pear entice the nose. The palate shows freshness and generosity in equal measure. Balance and zip makes this wine moreish and expressive, while the pithy, citric core lends structure and balance.
title: Domaine Gresser 2015 Brandhof Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The soft, gentle lift of lemon peel sets the pure tone, with concentrated yet light-footed freshness on the palate. This wine is dry, crystalline and friendly, with a zesty finish.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2014 Cuvée Charles Riesling (Alsace)

description: The soft, gentle lift of lemon peel sets the pure tone, with concentrated yet light-footed freshness on the palate. This wine is dry, crystalline and friendly, with a zesty finish.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2014 Cuvée Charles Riesling (Alsace)

description: Notions of ripe lemon and mandarin zest play upon nose and palate of this admirably dry Riesling, which has enough concentration to carry the riot of citrus perfectly. This refreshing, clean and bracing wine could be your rescue on a hot summer day.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2014 Letzenberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: This single-parcel wine is rich and with layers of wood aging in the flavor, giving a spicy slightly toasty character. Behind that, there is a more herbal green-fruit character that is crisp with acidity and with a tangy, zesty aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2014 Anthologia Parcelle No A299 Sauvignon Blanc (Bergerac Sec)

description: The wine is all about its ripe blackberry fruits. With a small proportion of Merlot (10%) in the blend to smooth the Malbec tannins it is rich, generous, and finely structured with a good future. Drink this dense wine from 2018.
title: Château Nozières 2014 Ambroise de l'Her Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Aged in wood for 18 months, this eucalyptus-perfumed wine is solid, structured and still packed with tannins. It is made for long-term aging with its rich black fruits and dark structure. The concentration and ripe fruit both promise a fine future. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Gaudou 2013 Renaissance Malbec (Cahors)

description: A blend of 50% Bourboulenc, 30% Grenache, 10% Roussanne and 10% Marsanne, this boasts an enticing bouquet of field flowers, fresh fennel bulb, white peach and citrus zest. Unmistakable marine influences of mineral and saline notes shine throughout and become more pronounced with aging. The mouthfeel is smooth and rich, and while it is delightful now, it will mature and develop well through 2022.
title: Château d'Anglès 2015 Classique Bourboulenc-Grenache-Roussane White (La Clape)

description: The scent of fresh Bosc pear peel also conveys a sense of texture. This is confirmed on the rounded, juicy and full-fruited palate that balances the generous ripe pear with ample, off-dry freshness. Drink soon for maximum enjoyment of fruit.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2015 Collection Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A deliciously fruity wine, its bright apricot, pineapple and peach flavors open and generous. Of course, there is a more serious core of structure, lemon zest and dryness to promise aging. At the end, though, fruit and a light toastiness give immediate pleasure.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2009 Clavoillon Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This shows a fine, silky texture from a vintage that resulted in some tough-textured wines. Raspberry and garrigue combine on the nose, while the palate adds hints of sun-baked earth on the long, softly dusty finish. Drink now–2023.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 L'Andéol Red (Rasteau)

description: This is a fresh and full-bodied wine, with ripe yellow fruit and citrus tones—at once warm and with crisply edged. Still young, it shows a strong mineral side that will soften with time. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2015 Authentique  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Organic vineyards in the shadow of the Corton hill and the Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru provide the basis for this wine. It's ripe and full of apple and lime flavor, its minerality adding crisp texture. A touch of yellow fruit on the finish shows the richness of the vintage. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laleure-Piot 2015  Pernand-Vergelesses

description: Produced by Cahors negociant and vineyard owner Georges Vigouroux, this wine from vines on the slopes of the Garonne valley has just enough tannic structure to give it richness and potential aging. The tannins are balanced by the generous black fruits. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tournelles 2014 Red (Buzet)

description: This is a bold, ripe and fruity wine. It has rich black currant fruits, solid tannins and a dense texture. Very aromatic, it is powered by its dry core that is showing signs of softening and rounding out. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Poitevin 2011  Médoc

description: This is a bold, ripe and fruity wine. It has rich black currant fruits, solid tannins and a dense texture. Very aromatic, it is powered by its dry core that is showing signs of softening and rounding out. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Poitevin 2011  Médoc

description: A gently perfumed wine, it has ripe, juicy black-fruit flavors and a backing of tannins. It's balanced with the dry core surrounded by rich fruitiness and a burst of final acidity. It could be drunk now, but will be better from 2016.
title: Château Pierre de Montignac 2011  Médoc

description: A fruity and juicy wine, it also has a stalky, herbal element. That gives a fresh character to the wine while also showing lightness. The black currant fruits are strong and forward, with a hint of maturity that suggests this is for medium-term aging.
title: Château les Anguilleys 2011  Médoc

description: With a majority of Merlot in the blend, this is a smooth and ripely rich wine. It has sweet berry fruits, soft tannins and good juicy acidity. At this stage, the wood shows strongly, but the fruit will soon develop. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Haut-Bellevue 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Showing considerable wood flavor, this wine has some tough tannins to overcome before it really shows its best. The fruit is ripe, full and packed with blackberry flavors. Once fully integrated, the wine should reveal more of a luscious side. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Greysac 2011  Médoc

description: Showing considerable wood flavor, this wine has some tough tannins to overcome before it really shows its best. The fruit is ripe, full and packed with blackberry flavors. Once fully integrated, the wine should reveal more of a luscious side. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Greysac 2011  Médoc

description: Very classic in style, it has firm tannins that come before black currant fruits. Its structure is dry, lightly smoky from wood aging and with a crisper fruit character underneath. The tannins need to soften before the wine can be drunk with pleasure, so wait until 2017.
title: Château Belle-Vue 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Firmly touched by wood, this is a rich and also structured wine. It has spice as much as fruit at this stage, the juicy acidity lurking behind the toasty exterior. The wine should balance out but will need time. Drink from 2020.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine du Pavillon  (Meursault)

description: This wine is soft and rounded with attractive red-cherry fruits, ripe strawberries and touches of wood and tannin. Acidity comes along behind this richness. It is going to develop quickly and will give great pleasure. Drink from 2018.
title: Faiveley 2014 Les Charmes Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This rich, almost jammy wine is given structure by the darkly tannic character. The dry, firm, toasty structure is pulled forward by the red-berry acidity that indicates a good future for the wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2014 Les Longeroies  (Marsannay)

description: With light wood-aging flavors, this wine is both ripe and fresh. The touch of toast points up yellow fruits that are generous and rounded. Pineapple and peach are given an edge by the citrus acidity in the aftertaste. Drink from 2017. The family estate has been established since the 14th century.
title: Domaine Ninot 2014 La Barre  (Rully)

description: This is not an obvious wine, but one that creeps up slowly, takes time and impresses quietly. It delivers depth rather than power. Glints of pepper and allspice shine amid the restrained red, tart cherry fruit. The slightest of tannic grips stems from concentration rather than extraction. It's elegant Alsace Pinot, quiet but firm.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2013 Rouge Red (Alsace)

description: Pithy zesty notes rise from the glass. The palate has the same lifted, pithy, and slightly bitter edge but some residual sweetness rounds the pear apparent on the palate into fluid fruitiness. The bitter edge remains and the wine finishes dry.
title: Allimant-Laugner 2016 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Ripe peach on the nose has some earthy undertones. The palate is fresh but has the same earthy and slightly muddy aspect. Lemon freshness brightens the flavors and creates subtle balance. Drink soon.
title: André Kientzler 2015 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: With 20% Sémillon in the blend, this wine has some richness as well as plenty of herbal character. It is light, refreshing and crisp, with plenty of acidity and gooseberry flavors. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Cheval Quancard 2016 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This wine is fruity, packed with red-berry flavors. It has plenty of the acidity that marks this vintage in rosés while keeping a riper backdrop. Drink now.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2016 Les Hauts de Smith Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This attractive pink-colored wine has plenty of red-fruit flavor and acidity. It is a warm, rich wine, full of fruit with a touch of spice. Drink now.
title: Château Laville 2016 Rosé de Laville Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: An attractive pale, salmon-pink-colored wine, this is soft and ripe with strawberries and a smooth texture. Drink now.
title: Château La Gabarre 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: An attractive pale, salmon-pink-colored wine, this is soft and ripe with strawberries and a smooth texture. Drink now.
title: Château La Gabarre 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A rather subdued nose merely hints at ripe pear flavors. The palate is dry, just softly pear-fruited and balanced. There is a subtle, mature heat on the finish that is rather appetizing. Drink soon.
title: Klipfel 2014 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Densely tannic, this has edgy black currant flavor emerging between a firmly dry structure  packed with dark berry fruits and fresh acidity. This is light in fruit and heavy on tannins.
title: Château le Bonnat 2003  Graves

description: Densely tannic, this has edgy black currant flavor emerging between a firmly dry structure  packed with dark berry fruits and fresh acidity. This is light in fruit and heavy on tannins.
title: Château le Bonnat 2003  Graves

description: Ripe, fruity wine, it has sweet tannins, blackberry fruit, laced with acidity. The wine is all fruit, with only the lightest hint of wood.
title: Château Roc Meynard 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: An austere, tannic wine that will need a few years to develop. It has solid tannins that are layered over the fresh berry and currant fruits. A smoky hint gives the wine extra character.
title: Château Lagrave Paran 2008 Cuvée Géraldine  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: One of the most familiar brands of Champagne, this is a soft, finely blended wine. With its fresh fruits, touch of toast and a crisp aftertaste, it is dominated by Chardonnay, in the Taittinger style. A steely edge creeps in at the end, leaving a wine that is bright and ready to drink.
title: Taittinger NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: This is a warm and ripe Merlot-dominated wine. The chateau's position on the hill of Fronsac gives the wine structure and a mineral texture that does promise aging. With blackberry fruitiness developing well, drink from 2016.
title: Château Tessendey 2010  Fronsac

description: A big, ripe, still very young wine with black fruits that are right up front. It's jammy and juicy, with almost as much fruit as tannin. There is some aging potential, with the underlying dryness of the structure, but the wine is mostly about ripe fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Chambert 2011 Grand Vin Malbec (Cahors)

description: A big, ripe, still very young wine with black fruits that are right up front. It's jammy and juicy, with almost as much fruit as tannin. There is some aging potential, with the underlying dryness of the structure, but the wine is mostly about ripe fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Chambert 2011 Grand Vin Malbec (Cahors)

description: Showing up-front fruit, with tense acidity, this is all about freshness. There's a cool, textured feel to the wine, more plum skin than juice.
title: Paul Beaudet 2010 Domaine Romy  (Beaujolais)

description: With bright red fruits and acidity, this shows structure, piles of red cherry flavors, followed by firm tannins.
title: Mommessin 2010  Beaujolais-Villages

description: With bright red fruits and acidity, this shows structure, piles of red cherry flavors, followed by firm tannins.
title: Mommessin 2010  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Well structured wine, the red cherry fruits laced with some banana hints. The wine is deliciously fruity, the tannin edge just a light coating.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Sélection  (Régnié)

description: One of the rare white wine produced in Beaujolais from Chardonnay. This is fresh with an attractive mineral content, touches of lemon and a ripe final aftertaste.
title: Paul Beaudet 2010 Domaine Romy  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: One of the rare white wine produced in Beaujolais from Chardonnay. This is fresh with an attractive mineral content, touches of lemon and a ripe final aftertaste.
title: Paul Beaudet 2010 Domaine Romy  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Soft, lilting wine that is gentle, ripe and ready to drink. The fruits have some sweetness, the tannins are light, and the acidity is fresh and never too intrusive.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007  Monthélie

description: Soft, lilting wine that is gentle, ripe and ready to drink. The fruits have some sweetness, the tannins are light, and the acidity is fresh and never too intrusive.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007  Monthélie

description: A soft wine that hints at the richness of Meursault, with caramel flavors giving weight, and a distinct citrus and apple character giving freshness. For early drinking.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007  Meursault

description: A soft wine that hints at the richness of Meursault, with caramel flavors giving weight, and a distinct citrus and apple character giving freshness. For early drinking.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007  Meursault

description: This value-priced Chard offers a medium-intense bouquet of orange rind, Granny Smith apple and white peach pit followed by a round mouth with accents of apple skins and buttercup. Balanced with a solid finish and low alcohol.
title: Barton & Guestier 2008 B&G; Reserve Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft Chardonnay, nicely balanced between ripe white fruits and some toast. It is an open, generous wine, enjoyable and ready to drink.
title: Antonin Rodet 2007 Bourgogne A. Rodet  (Bourgogne)

description: Pale orange-pink in color, this wine is fresh, fruity and soft. It has a rounded texture given a crisp edge by the red currant and pink grapefruit freshness and acidity. It's a wine for food, with its tangy, textured aftertaste.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Mas de Pampelonne Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: The purity of the Pinot Noir in this wine is outstanding. It may not be particularly complex, but the beautiful ripe red cherry fruit is so good. Drink now, or keep until 2020.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: This is young to release a Volnay, as this wine shows in its taste. It is almost shocking in its fresh acidity and red fruits, disclosing tannins and a drier side. Some juiciness will develop as the wine matures. Wait until 2017.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2013  Volnay

description: This is young to release a Volnay, as this wine shows in its taste. It is almost shocking in its fresh acidity and red fruits, disclosing tannins and a drier side. Some juiciness will develop as the wine matures. Wait until 2017.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2013  Volnay

description: A pale gray-pink color, this is fresh, crisp and bright in the mouth, with a touch of pepper to add interest. The aftertaste is full of ripe raspberries.
title: Domaine de la Croix 2014 Eloge Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Full in the mouth, this is a soft caramel and orange zest-flavored wine. It has light acidity, although probably not enough to give a balance. The aftertaste brings pepper and spice.
title: Château Léoube 2014 Sécret de Léoube Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: While the wine is full in the mouth with ripe fruits, it also has a delicious poise and freshness that makes it ready to drink. It's a well-balanced wine, full of fruitiness and acidity in harmony.
title: Château d'Esclans 2014 Whispering Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This fresh, crisp, textured wine has pepper as well as red fruit flavors. It offers a touch of spice, ripe strawberries and delicious final acidity.
title: Château Cavalier 2014 Réserve de la Familie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This fresh, crisp, textured wine has pepper as well as red fruit flavors. It offers a touch of spice, ripe strawberries and delicious final acidity.
title: Château Cavalier 2014 Réserve de la Familie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine comes from a tiny seven-acre estate to the east of the town of Saint-Emilion. Owned by the same family since 1847, it estate is making serious wine. This is a rich wine, perfumed by Cabernet Franc although firmly based in Merlot. Black plum and berries are strengthened by the firm tannins that will allow further aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Rochebelle 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: For what is essentially a second wine, generally blended from the estate's younger vines, this is a solid effort in a not-so-easy vintage. Vanilla and cinnamon from barrel-aging play a role hedre, but there's also plenty of juicy, plum-tinged fruit. There's ample body and texture, capped off by supple tannins and a lingering finish. Drink now–2022.
title: Château La Nerthe 2014 Les Granières de la Nerthe Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Here's a new wood-aged young wine, with ripe fruit and mint aromas. The wine does have a bitter edge of extraction that detracts from the generous black fruitiness. It is certainly firm at this stage—a full-bodied wine with a dark-fruit character at the end. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Gaby 2014  Canon-Fronsac

description: The second wine of Château Glana in the prestigious Saint-Julien appellation is properly tannic with fruit in the background. The wine will develop well, but will still require some time. Its juicy black-currant fruitiness and acidity have power and concentration—enough to produce a ripe, while still elegant wine from 2020.
title: Château du Glana 2014 Terre du Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: A touch of wood helps the wine's light fruit to deepen and become richer. The wine is well balanced, with fresh acidity giving a good lift.
title: Château Grand Jean 2009 Elevé en Fûts de Chêne  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: The rustic aromas are off-putting in this wine. It has a proper density but seems to have a musty character. This could blow off over time, because the fruit is here.
title: Château Bellegrave 2008  Pauillac

description: Named after the French author who came from Provence, this wine is a bright, fruity style with pepper and caramel flavors. It has plenty of red fruits and attractive final acidity.
title: La Belle Collection 2015 Colette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Named after the French author who came from Provence, this wine is a bright, fruity style with pepper and caramel flavors. It has plenty of red fruits and attractive final acidity.
title: La Belle Collection 2015 Colette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This bold, ripe blend even contains some Muscat that gives richness and a touch of honey and spice to what is otherwise a dry rosé. The acidity acts as a balance to this attractive wine.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Jas des Vignes Rosé

description: This bold, ripe blend even contains some Muscat that gives richness and a touch of honey and spice to what is otherwise a dry rosé. The acidity acts as a balance to this attractive wine.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Jas des Vignes Rosé

description: A simple, fruity wine, this has light acidity and a touch of pepper at the end. It is a classic apéritif style of rosé.
title: Moncigale 2015 Frais et Fruité Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An off-dry blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Gros Manseng, this comes from the French southwest. Named after a sandy beach in the Basque Country, the wine has that cool feel of ocean breezes. Honey and lemon flavors are right up front to give a wine that is both fresh and beautifully fragrant.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 Villa Chambre d'Amour White (Vin de France)

description: An off-dry blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Gros Manseng, this comes from the French southwest. Named after a sandy beach in the Basque Country, the wine has that cool feel of ocean breezes. Honey and lemon flavors are right up front to give a wine that is both fresh and beautifully fragrant.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 Villa Chambre d'Amour White (Vin de France)

description: This vibrant red opens with scents of small red berries and cherries, accented by touches of vanilla bean and black pepper. The medium-weight palate is well balanced and approachable, with fruit-skin flavors that harmonize with the fine tannins. A kiss of cocoa graces the finish.
title: La Châsse 2015 Syrah (Vin de France)
