description: The wine has bold fruit and ripe tannins. There is still a strong flavor from the wood aging although this should integrate. The fruit is the dominant character of this red-berry flavored wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Plince 2014  Pomerol

description: A vivid, vibrant, red-fruited wine, bursting with crisp fruits, light acidity, and red cherry flavors. Very fresh.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2007 Château des Maladrets  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Fresh, simple, raspberry-flavored wine, this is very soft, candied and fruity. There is just enough tannin to give the wine some structure, but the crispness of 2007 shows right through.
title: Domaine Pral 2007  Beaujolais

description: Fresh, simple, raspberry-flavored wine, this is very soft, candied and fruity. There is just enough tannin to give the wine some structure, but the crispness of 2007 shows right through.
title: Domaine Pral 2007  Beaujolais

description: There are pure lemon and lime flavors on this light, crisp wine, along with quite a bite of salt and green-apple-skin tannins. Attractive and fresh, drink this summer.
title: Alexis Sauvion 2006 Estelle Sauvion  (Muscadet)

description: This Mediterranean blend of Syrah and Grenache is soft and open. It has the lightest touch of tannin, adding texture to its blackberry fruit and crisp acidity. It finishes with an attractive perfumed character.
title: Vinadeis 2016 Appetit de France Red (Vin de France)

description: This is a soft, simple, light and fruity wine. Its lively acidity is refreshing and crisp. It has a fragrant perfume and is ready to drink.
title: Saget la Perrière 2016 La Petite Perrière Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This is a soft, simple, light and fruity wine. Its lively acidity is refreshing and crisp. It has a fragrant perfume and is ready to drink.
title: Saget la Perrière 2016 La Petite Perrière Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This is a lightly honeyed wine with attractive almond and apple fruits. It comes from vines owned by the Saget family since 2002. With final crisp acidity and a tangy texture, it is ready to drink.
designation: Château de la Mulonnière M de Mulonnière
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Château de la Mulonnière M de Mulonnière Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: This is a lightly honeyed wine with attractive almond and apple fruits. It comes from vines owned by the Saget family since 2002. With final crisp acidity and a tangy texture, it is ready to drink.
designation: Château de la Mulonnière M de Mulonnière
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Château de la Mulonnière M de Mulonnière Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: With its silex soil, this vineyard is able to produce a distinctly mineral wine. This is crisp, tightly woven with acidity and herbal characteristics. That is balanced by the refreshing lemon and grapefruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Pierre Chainier 2016 Domaine Roc de Châteauvieux Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Ripe while also herbal, this is an easy fruity wine. It has an attractive spice and perfumed white-fruit character that enhances the crisp citrus fruit. Drink now.
designation: Château de la Roche Sauvignon Blanc
title: Pierre Chainier 2016 Château de la Roche Sauvignon Blanc Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This 100% Pinot Gris wine has a light-pink color. With its soft ripe red-berry fruitiness it is crisp and clean. There is a touch of spice from these pale-pink-skinned grapes which are more often used to make white wine.
title: Joseph Mellot 2016 Les Milets Rosé (Reuilly)

description: This warm style of Sauvignon Blanc has apricot and citrus flavors. Packed with fruit and with refreshing acidity, it makes a fine apéritif.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2016 La Châsse Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine comes from a large 300-acre estate on the island's east coast. It has subtle raspberry fruit and plenty of acidity. With its crisp aftertaste, filled out with a touch of caramel, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vetriccie 2016 Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: This broad wine has apple and pear flavors and a smooth texture. It's all ripe and creamy fruit, with well-balanced acidity.
title: Bougrier 2016 Alain de la Treille Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This broad wine has apple and pear flavors and a smooth texture. It's all ripe and creamy fruit, with well-balanced acidity.
title: Bougrier 2016 Alain de la Treille Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: A rather soapy, wine, it does not have enough fruitiness to sustain its tannins. It's hard edged and likely to remain that way.
title: Château La Clare 2011  Médoc

description: A rather soapy, wine, it does not have enough fruitiness to sustain its tannins. It's hard edged and likely to remain that way.
title: Château La Clare 2011  Médoc

description: This wine is all structure and dark, dry tannins. The fruit is very subdued, giving a hard wine that could well remain tough.
title: Château du Cartillon 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: With barnyard aromas, this is a rustic wine. It does have some red fruit flavors and acidity but these are compromised by the earthy texture.
title: Château Bonnin 2011 La Fleur Blanchon  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: A blend of Sémillon and Cabernet Franc, this is a smooth, soft wine. It has soft fruitiness, some fresh acidity and a light but clean aftertaste.
title: Jaillance NV Brut  (Crémant de Bordeaux)

description: Too much wood aging yields a wine that is lean and lacks fruitiness. It has intense dark, burnt wood flavors and doesn't have the weight to round out.
title: Château Moulin de Canhaut 2011  Médoc

description: From a ripe vintage, this soft, generous wine has a good balance between its acidity and its smooth, creamy character. The wine is crisp now and could probably do with some bottle age to bring out its inherent richness. Wait until 2018.
title: Taittinger 2009 Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: From a ripe vintage, this soft, generous wine has a good balance between its acidity and its smooth, creamy character. The wine is crisp now and could probably do with some bottle age to bring out its inherent richness. Wait until 2018.
title: Taittinger 2009 Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Made using Pinot Noir skins to color the wine, rather than the more usual Champagne trick of adding red wine, this is a well judged, ripe wine. With its red fruits and light tannins it still tastes young. Acidity and a balanced dosage make for a wine that will be better from 2017.
title: Pannier NV Egérie Rosé de Saignée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Still young, this blend of Pinot Noir, with a small amount of Pinot Meunier, is crisp with bright citrus and white fruits. Richness and a touch of tannin give structure. The acidity cuts through at the end, offering a zesty, tight aftertaste. Drink this vintage from 2017.
title: Pannier 2010 Blanc de Noirs Brut  (Champagne)

description: A rich, Merlot-dominated wine, this is opulent and packed with blackberry fruits. It has a great structure of tannins and ripe fruitiness. Bitter chocolate and coffee flavors give an extra complexity. The wine is still young, still full of juicy fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Lafleur du Roy 2014  Pomerol

description: A rich, Merlot-dominated wine, this is opulent and packed with blackberry fruits. It has a great structure of tannins and ripe fruitiness. Bitter chocolate and coffee flavors give an extra complexity. The wine is still young, still full of juicy fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Lafleur du Roy 2014  Pomerol

description: This ripe Champagne is deliciously balanced between the rich white fruits and good acidity. Zingy texture gives it a crisp edge. Full, fruity and with the ability to age, it is ready to drink.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Based in Avize in the Côte des Blancs, producer Michel Gonet specializes in Chardonnay-based wines. Produced from grand cru vineyards in Mesnil-sur-Oger, this mineral textured wine is ripe while keeping a proper crisp tension. White fruits go with citrus to add the bright aftertaste. Drink now. Gonet uses this label for the American market.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Charles-Gilbert de Vindé NV Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This mineral-textured wine is taut and tense. Crisp citrus and sliced-apple flavors are lifted by a touch of honey, balanced with lines of pure acidity and great poise and elegance. The bottling is young and will be better enjoyed from 2017.
designation: Cuvée des Moines Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: In its silver-coated bottle with the “Ace of Spades” logo, this is a crisp, mineral-driven wine, full of acidity and with a bright character on the dry side of brut. Young with layers of apple fruits, it will age. Drink now for the fruit or keep for maturity from 2018. This is one of five Champagnes by entrepreneur and rapper Jay Z under the Armand de Brignac Empire brand that is produced by the Cattier family, in Champagne since 1763.
title: Armand de Brignac NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe, rich red-fruit-flavored wine. It has great concentration and a dense texture that spotlights bright fruit, plus a touch of tannin from the red wine used to give color. This bottling needs to age further, so drink from 2018.
title: Alfred Gratien 2007 Cuvée Paradis Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This soft and red-fruit-driven wine has attractive acidity and a crisp aftertaste. It is dry, all about bright raspberries and red currants. The aftertaste just carries on with fruit. Drink now.
title: Villa Nissarda 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a dark and tannic wine, very firm and dense. It has weight while also allowing room for acidity. The ripe blackberry fruits are still buried beneath this tannic character, needing more time to show through. It is likely to remain a dry wine with a tough aftertaste.
title: Domaine de Gensac 2011 Piaffer Red (Gers)

description: A wine that has a light, delicate sweetness, keeping total freshness as well as baked apple and honey flavors. Floral and aromatic, it's a wine more for apéritif than food, and ready to drink.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2011 Les Deux Cèdres Gros Manseng (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A wine with mint and black fruits that has been produced to be drunk young. The tannins are light, enough to give structure to the fruits and acidity. It's a fruity, spicy wine that will be ready to drink in 2015.
title: Château de Gaudou 2013 Tradition Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Immense and perhaps too powerful, this is a mouthful of black fruits and dense tannins. It seems the producer tried to hard, with bitter extraction as well as very firm, superripe fruit. Pepper and spice show the alcohol.
title: Château de Cayx 2010 Cuvée Majesté Malbec (Cahors)

description: Immense and perhaps too powerful, this is a mouthful of black fruits and dense tannins. It seems the producer tried to hard, with bitter extraction as well as very firm, superripe fruit. Pepper and spice show the alcohol.
title: Château de Cayx 2010 Cuvée Majesté Malbec (Cahors)

description: This shows a more serious side to Gamay. Black cherry and plum fruits are sustained by firm tannins and tight, mineral acidity. It needs a few months to develop. Drink from 2015.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2013 Eté Fleuri  (Chiroubles)

description: This shows a more serious side to Gamay. Black cherry and plum fruits are sustained by firm tannins and tight, mineral acidity. It needs a few months to develop. Drink from 2015.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2013 Eté Fleuri  (Chiroubles)

description: This rich wine conveys pure fruitiness without any wood aging. That gives a ripe, black currant character, soft tannins and juicy acidity. It's wine to drink young, so start now.
title: Château du Cayrou 2011 Malbec Valley Malbec (Cahors)

description: This medium-bodied rosé is a blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah drawn from the estate's young vines. Like its big brother, the Vieilles Vignes, it's gently textured, easily balancing red berry fruit against citrusy elements. It's a clean, refreshing, but somewhat simple quaffer at a bargain price.
title: Château de Nages 2013 Buti Nages Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This medium-bodied blend of 60% Roussanne, 30% Grenche Blanc and 10% Marsanne displays moderately fruity aromas of pineapple and honeydew. Some notes reminiscent of wet stones creep in on the palate, and bright citrus notes mark the finish. Drink now and over the next few months.
title: Château de Campuget 2013 Tradition de Campuget White (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a rich, weighty red with a velvety texture and plenty of alcoholic warmth. The fruit is ripe to the point of turning chocolaty and even a bit fudge-like, lingering on the richly textured finish. Drink now.
designation: Domaine des Colombettes Les Terres du Roy
title: Cellier des Chartreux 2011 Domaine des Colombettes Les Terres du Roy Red (Lirac)

description: This is a ripe wood-aged wine. It has tannins and layers of spice and toast from the wood aging. Happily, the fruit is also there, giving well-balanced black currants and acidity. The wine will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Les Trois Manoirs 2014  Médoc

description: Equal proportions of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot give this wine a ripe character. The wood aging shows in the smoky flavors that underline the juicy black-currant fruits. The wine is attractive and will soon show its fruitiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Laujac 2014  Médoc

description: This is a smooth and soft wine that will develop quickly. It has a light tannin structure behind the easy blackberry fruit. The chateau is owned by Castel, the largest drinks producer in France. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Château Barreyres 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: This is a smooth and soft wine that will develop quickly. It has a light tannin structure behind the easy blackberry fruit. The chateau is owned by Castel, the largest drinks producer in France. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Château Barreyres 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: This soft wine shows some of the Aligoté crispness that has become creamy and smooth. There are touches of yellow fruits as well as lively acidity and a gentle aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012  Bourgogne Aligoté

description: Very crisp while also creamy, the wine has sliced apple acidity with a mineral, tight texture and a lemon aftertaste. It's young and fruity, fresh with a lively mousse. Because it is dry, it will be better with food.
title: Charles Sparr NV Brut Pinot Blanc (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Very crisp while also creamy, the wine has sliced apple acidity with a mineral, tight texture and a lemon aftertaste. It's young and fruity, fresh with a lively mousse. Because it is dry, it will be better with food.
title: Charles Sparr NV Brut Pinot Blanc (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Simple Chablis, but one that is full of ripe and creamy fruit. In the background, a more tangy, zesty and mineral texture brings out the northern cool vineyards. Otherwise it is about yellow fruits and sliced red apple. Drink now.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 La Pierrelée  (Chablis)

description: Based in the Marne Valley, Huré Frères has produced a fresh Champagne. It's full in the mouth, rounded and brimming with youthful fruitiness. Just a touch of sweetness at the end gives a soft aftertaste.
title: Huré Frères NV L'Invitation Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Fresh and creamily fruity, this well-made, balanced wine features a touch of honey and almonds as well as bright, crisp acidity. The 100% Chardonnay in the wine gives a ripe and round aftertaste.
title: Domaine du Vieil Orme NV Gabriel Brut Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: This is a beautifully perfumed wine that's fragrant with white spring blossoms and flavored with bright fruit flavors. The palate has remarkable structure with intense acidity that lends zest and zing, and a fine, lively feeling on the finish. Drink until 2020.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2010 Burg Riesling (Alsace)

description: This beautifully perfumed wine is a fine mix of herb and black-fruit flavors. It has richness, density and a fine, crisp streak of acidity. Drink after 2015.
title: Domaine la Bastide Blanche 2011 Fontanéou Red (Bandol)

description: This wine has intense acidity and a profoundly mineral character. Rich black-fruit flavors and firm tannins give it a sense of potential for the future. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine du Gros Nore 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: This wine has intense acidity and a profoundly mineral character. Rich black-fruit flavors and firm tannins give it a sense of potential for the future. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine du Gros Nore 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: While firmly tannic and structured, this wine shows youth with its concentrated fresh berry flavors and bright acidity. The dry core promises a long-term future, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Domaine de la Vallongue 2010 Garrigues Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: This is a richly honeyed wine that has flavors of spice cake and sweet fruits that are balanced with a taut, firm texture. The wine is ripe, but has a delicate touch that makes it very attractive. Drink now.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2010 Vendange Tardive Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Notes of almonds and sweet fruit combine with steely acidity in this wine. It has both a bright, fresh character and honeyed smoothness. It is still quite youthful and could age well for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2009 Vendange Tardive Riesling (Alsace)

description: Notes of almonds and sweet fruit combine with steely acidity in this wine. It has both a bright, fresh character and honeyed smoothness. It is still quite youthful and could age well for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2009 Vendange Tardive Riesling (Alsace)

description: A blend of Cabernet Franc and Pinot Noir, this pale pink rosé has really fresh acidity and crisp apple fruits. There are just hints of red-berry fruits and a touch of tannin that gives the wine an edge of dryness. The aftertaste, with the creamy mousse, is fresh and lively.
title: Monmousseau NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: The wine is typically light and fruity, although a year from the harvest it has lost its total freshness and filled out. It is fruity with apples and zingy citrus that are softening and becoming more rich. Drink now.
designation: Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie
title: Domaine Martin 2014 Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a soft, fruity wine that is already mature. It still has berry and red plum fruitiness although this is now integrated with the gentle tannic structure. The freshness comes from juicy acidity that creeps in at the end to leave a fresh aftertaste.
title: Château de Sancerre 2012  Sancerre

description: This starts off as a deceptively simple berry-cocktail sort of rosé, but then adds lime and crushed stone on the finish to provide added interest and refreshment. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Gournier 2010 Rosé (Vin de Pays des Cévennes)

description: This starts off as a deceptively simple berry-cocktail sort of rosé, but then adds lime and crushed stone on the finish to provide added interest and refreshment. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Gournier 2010 Rosé (Vin de Pays des Cévennes)

description: Light, creamed apple fruits with a bright line of fresh acidity. The wine is exuberant in its citrus character, just broadened by an underlay of green apples.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2008 Buissonnier  (Bourgogne)

description: Showing signs of toastiness, this is a ripe and full-bodied wine. Rich with apples and yellow fruits shot through with lemon, it still could age. Drink from 2016.
title: Poissinet 2008 Cuvée Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: Showing signs of toastiness, this is a ripe and full-bodied wine. Rich with apples and yellow fruits shot through with lemon, it still could age. Drink from 2016.
title: Poissinet 2008 Cuvée Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: Full and creamy, this is a ripe style of Blanc de Blancs. It may miss the style's minerality although it makes up for it with its rich, smooth texture and yellow fruit flavors. A gentle tang gives extra freshness at the end, while the aftertaste provides a reminder of the wine's generous character.
designation: Cuvée Inédite Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: Louis de Sacy NV Cuvée Inédite Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Finely structured and aromatic, this is initially dense before opening up with ripe yellow fruit, becoming balanced by orange- and tangerine-like acidity. It has a young, zesty texture that pairs with the rich concentration, promising to age over 3–4 years.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 Monte de Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The small Côte de Léchet Premier Cru offers a steely vision of Chablis—crisp and driven by apple and grapefruit flavors. It is bright and taut; like any wine from this vineyard, it needs to age for at least three years.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 Côte de Léchet Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: With its softness and medium-dry character, this is a great food wine for pâtés or blue cheese. It is finely in balance, its acidity giving a lift to the tangerine, peach and dried fruit flavors. The aftertaste is perfectly clean, creamy, lifted by acidity.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Exception Exquise Demi-Sec  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: With its softness and medium-dry character, this is a great food wine for pâtés or blue cheese. It is finely in balance, its acidity giving a lift to the tangerine, peach and dried fruit flavors. The aftertaste is perfectly clean, creamy, lifted by acidity.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Exception Exquise Demi-Sec  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is a juicy wine, stuffed with soft berry fruits and jammy black currant flavors. It has some tannins, lightly integrated into the general fruitiness of this wine. With Dural and Braucol in dominance, it holds a touch of dryness at the center that will allow it age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Rhodes 2011 Red (Gaillac)

description: Seduction may be an odd word to use for a Malbec-based wine that is dark and drily tannic. It is structured and firm, with a dry core and black currant fruits. Drink this solid wine from 2017.
title: Château Bovila 2012 Château de Rouffiac Séduction Malbec (Cahors)

description: La Guillotte is a parcel on the Bouissel estate, planted with old Négrette. This firm and structured wine is solid with black plum fruits and cherry acidity. It is still developing and will need some time to soften its tannins. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Bouissel 2013 La Guillotte Negrette (Fronton)

description: A soft, rounded wine, with spice and toast and a cushion of plump yellow fruit. Almonds and mandarin oranges fit well together with the fine acidity.
title: Labouré-Roi 2006 Les Chevaliers  (Meursault)

description: Full of mango and starfruit flavors to go with the nuts, spice and ripe texture. The wine, made from organic grapes, has richness as much as sweetness, the acidity an important element. For long-term aging.
title: Domaine du Petit Coteau 2008 L'Etoile Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: There is good density of fruit tannins here, boosted by wood. The wine has dried fruit, spice, perfumed blackberry and lively acidity. It could well age for 1–2 years.
title: Domaine du Grand Bouqueteau 2006 Réserve  (Chinon)

description: There is good density of fruit tannins here, boosted by wood. The wine has dried fruit, spice, perfumed blackberry and lively acidity. It could well age for 1–2 years.
title: Domaine du Grand Bouqueteau 2006 Réserve  (Chinon)

description: Weight and richness here, with attractive acidity, but also a ripe, creamy texture. The wine has some tight tannins, but is much more to do with opulent peaches and cream.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Weight and richness here, with attractive acidity, but also a ripe, creamy texture. The wine has some tight tannins, but is much more to do with opulent peaches and cream.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: The aroma says wood, and that's what the taste confirms. To go with the wood, there is rounded apricot and peach-flavored fruit, open and rich. The wine has a youthful taut edge, finishing with the greatest acidity.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2007  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: A piercingly delicious, apples and cream wine. It has the youthful freshness of Chenin Blanc, its texture rounded with a great bright acidity. Almonds are a glint in the background. Drink now, or age for 4–5 years.
title: Château Moncontour 2008 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This attractive, smoky wine has a soft, juicy texture that comes through the red fruits. Balanced and ripe, it finishes with acidity and is ready to drink.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2012 Les Belles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: This is a ripe and soft wine with pure apple and citrus fruit. It is crisp, juicy and bright with acidity and tangy orange zest flavors. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Les Sétilles  (Bourgogne)

description: This is a fruity, juicy and soft wine. It has plenty of red-currants that give the wine a crisper side. It comes from a vineyard just north of the Burgundian capital of Dijon, which produces the wine's cool fruity character. Drink from 2017.
title: Maison Stéphane Brocard 2015 Closerie des Alisiers  (Bourgogne)

description: Ripe and soft, it offers attractive acidity given richness by red berry fruits. It's ready to drink, with a final balanced, velvet texture.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2013 Eté Indien  (Brouilly)

description: This rounded wine adds richness to its herbaceous character. Apple and quince flavors are razor-sharp in freshness, bright and deliciously lively. Drink now.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2013 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This fruit and acidity-driven wine has bright red cherry and raspberry flavors. Young and fruity, it is best drunk now, although waiting until 2015 will soften the fresh tones.
title: Robert Perroud 2013 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: Négrette gives its typical earthy character to this spicy, fruity wine. It's full in the mouth, aromatic with black fruits bolstered by a light tannic edge. Drink now.
title: Château Bellevue la Forêt 2010 Red (Fronton)

description: The wine, from one of the five Aubert family properties, is rich and full of great fruit. With ripe tannins and blackberry generosity over the wood aging, this is still structured yet ready to drink.
title: Château de Ribebon 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The cave cooperative in Tavel is hitting on all cylinders, turning out numerous consistent, top-rated examples. Différent doesn't have the spicy nuances of the very best Tavels, but it offers a bold, ripe mouthful of raspberry and cherry fruit, ample weight and richness and a long, slightly dusty-textured finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2016 Différent  (Tavel)

description: Crisp, apple-flavored and touched by citrus, this is light and toasty. The finish is dry, fruity and fresh. Ready to drink.
designation: Grande Cuvée Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Le Grand Courtage NV Grande Cuvée Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: There's an overall dustiness to this wine, almost like a combination of talcum powder and dried, crushed plums and berries. Lean and slightly tart on the palate, it has a taut structure and a clean but short finish. Drink now.
title: Gilles Louvet 2010 O Made from Organic Grapes Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: This attractively fruity offering features floral, fruity flavors that are cut by crisp acidity. It is a bright, light and fruity sparkler, with just a touch of sweetness.
title: Marquis de Perlade NV Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This attractively fruity offering features floral, fruity flavors that are cut by crisp acidity. It is a bright, light and fruity sparkler, with just a touch of sweetness.
title: Marquis de Perlade NV Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: An intensely perfumed wine that smells of a candy shop. It has tight acidity, but that is lost in the welter of white fruit flavors, allied with sweet wood. It seems at first too sweet, but then toast and acidity come in to give the wine an edgy finale.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Hauts Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: An intensely perfumed wine that smells of a candy shop. It has tight acidity, but that is lost in the welter of white fruit flavors, allied with sweet wood. It seems at first too sweet, but then toast and acidity come in to give the wine an edgy finale.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Hauts Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Initially all lightness and crisp fruit, this wine slowly builds in richness as its botrytis and intense honey flavors develop. It shows huge potential: concentrated and opulent yet always balanced with acidity. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Romer du Hayot 2014  Sauternes

description: This is ripe and floral, with intense acidity under the sweet, honeyed surface. Its dry core of botrytis is controlled by acidity and citrus flavors. Still developing and still young, it needs to age for many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Château de Malle 2014  Sauternes

description: Already beautifully balanced, this wine is intense, rich and full of layered acidity and concentrated honey flavors. It's ripe, opulent and dense, with spice notes and acidity highlighting its rich core. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Guiraud 2014  Sauternes

description: This floral wine shows geranium and white fruit notes. These are in relief against a background of great acidity and generous honey flavors. All these elements need time to come together but show great potential. Drink from 2025.
title: Château de Myrat 2014  Barsac

description: Beautifully poised, this wine strikes a balance between crisp lemon-curd acidity and intense honey and botrytis. Along with its nutmeg and marmalade flavors, it has the potential to be a powerful, wine. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Rabaud-Promis 2014  Sauternes

description: Dark fruits like blackberry, raspberry and black plum lead the bouquet, with supporting aromas of milk chocolate and purple flower. Balanced and approachable, it has a crushed velvet texture that's complemented by the skin-driven fruit and dusty cocoa flavors on the palate.
title: M. Chapoutier 2010 Rimage  (Banyuls)

description: Dark fruits like blackberry, raspberry and black plum lead the bouquet, with supporting aromas of milk chocolate and purple flower. Balanced and approachable, it has a crushed velvet texture that's complemented by the skin-driven fruit and dusty cocoa flavors on the palate.
title: M. Chapoutier 2010 Rimage  (Banyuls)

description: Despite its description as “extra dry,” this is in fact sweeter than a brut. This is fresh and fruity, with an attractive apple-purée flavor, balanced by crisp acidity and a light, bright finish.
title: Louis Roederer NV Carte Blanche Extra Dry  (Champagne)

description: Despite its description as “extra dry,” this is in fact sweeter than a brut. This is fresh and fruity, with an attractive apple-purée flavor, balanced by crisp acidity and a light, bright finish.
title: Louis Roederer NV Carte Blanche Extra Dry  (Champagne)

description: Showing dryness in its pepper and spice characters, this is a full-bodied, weighty wine. Dried fruit and lychee combine with a toasty, almond-flavored edge. Worth aging a year.
title: André Kientzler 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Showing dryness in its pepper and spice characters, this is a full-bodied, weighty wine. Dried fruit and lychee combine with a toasty, almond-flavored edge. Worth aging a year.
title: André Kientzler 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a mature and toasty vintage, showing notes of yeast, croissant and toast flavors. The fruit is still there, with notes of quince, pear and green plum partnered with acidity. It is balanced, ripe and ready to drink now.
title: Pannier 2005 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: There's a touch of spice in this rounded, ripe wine. It's dry, with flavors of baked apple and cinnamon. Full, rich and flavorsome.
title: Domaine Ernest Burn 2010 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This perfumed wine features ripe tannins and strawberry flavors. It is structured, with good concentration and acidity. The wine is developing well with the richness as well as line of fresher acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Latour 2014  Morey-Saint-Denis

description: This perfumed wine features ripe tannins and strawberry flavors. It is structured, with good concentration and acidity. The wine is developing well with the richness as well as line of fresher acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Latour 2014  Morey-Saint-Denis

description: Ripe with tropical-fruit flavors, this wine has good acidity layered with spice and toastiness. A crisper structure behind this generous fruit will allow the wine to age, although it is drinkable now.
title: Loron et Fils 2014 Château de Mirande  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This is a spicy wine, with balanced wood, yellow-fruit flavors and acidity that cuts through the spice and ripeness. A zing of citrus finishes this attractive wine in style.
title: Marcel Couturier 2014 Vielles Vignes  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: This is a spicy wine, with balanced wood, yellow-fruit flavors and acidity that cuts through the spice and ripeness. A zing of citrus finishes this attractive wine in style.
title: Marcel Couturier 2014 Vielles Vignes  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: The fruit and juicy acidity are the focus here, supported by smoky tannins. The wine will develop relatively quickly, full of fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Maison Champy 2014 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: The fruit and juicy acidity are the focus here, supported by smoky tannins. The wine will develop relatively quickly, full of fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Maison Champy 2014 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: With its tight acidity and crisp texture, this young wine needs a little time to develop. Citrus and spice are coming together with the richer pear and apricot fruits. A refreshing wine, it will be good to drink from 2017.
title: Jean-Paul Paquet 2014 Domaine des Granges  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: With its tight acidity and crisp texture, this young wine needs a little time to develop. Citrus and spice are coming together with the richer pear and apricot fruits. A refreshing wine, it will be good to drink from 2017.
title: Jean-Paul Paquet 2014 Domaine des Granges  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: This impressively structured and rich wine is full of yellow fruits, apricot skins and yellow plum skins. It's rounded and full in the mouth with juicy while textured fruits. Drink this ageworthy wine from 2017.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2012 Vau de Vey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This perfumed, smoky wine is gently wood aged and offers layers of tannin and black cherry fruits. It is still young and dense, dark and dry, with piercing acidity. It is concentrated, firm and needs time. Drink from 2019.
title: Roche de Bellene 2012  Clos de Vougeot

description: A typical southern Rhône blend of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre mixed up behind a modern label, this is creamy and supple in texture, with colluding notes of cherry and black olive. Drink now.
title: The Rhôning Stones 2007 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A typical southern Rhône blend of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre mixed up behind a modern label, this is creamy and supple in texture, with colluding notes of cherry and black olive. Drink now.
title: The Rhôning Stones 2007 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Fresh in style, especially for the hot, dry 2007 vintage, reflecting the slightly higher elevation of the Massif d'Uchaux, this medium-bodied wine offers oodles of cherry-berry fruit. It's nothing too serious or complex, just good, quaffable pleasure to consume over the next 2–3 years.
title: Domaine de la Renjarde 2007 Massif d'Uchaux Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Fresh in style, especially for the hot, dry 2007 vintage, reflecting the slightly higher elevation of the Massif d'Uchaux, this medium-bodied wine offers oodles of cherry-berry fruit. It's nothing too serious or complex, just good, quaffable pleasure to consume over the next 2–3 years.
title: Domaine de la Renjarde 2007 Massif d'Uchaux Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is ripe concentrated Muscadet. Plenty of acidity keeps it tight and nervy while the citrus and young green-apple fruits are right up front. It has the weight and depth to age and this wine will be better from late 2018.
designation: Clos de la Motte Sur Lie
title: Véronique Günther-Chereau 2016 Clos de la Motte Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Intense and crisp, this wine with its herbal and gooseberry flavors is rich and full bodied. Spicy, with a mineral texture and youthful acidity, the wine is complex and will need to age another few months. Drink from late 2018.
title: Domaine Gérard Fiou 2016 Terroir Silex  (Sancerre)

description: From 40-year-old vines in a single vineyard, this rich wine is dense, aromatic and packed with concentrated fruit. Its citrus and crisp texture is balanced by the ripe green-plum and apple flavors. Drink this fine wine now.
title: Domaine du Haut Bourg 2016 Pavillon Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: From 40-year-old vines in a single vineyard, this rich wine is dense, aromatic and packed with concentrated fruit. Its citrus and crisp texture is balanced by the ripe green-plum and apple flavors. Drink this fine wine now.
title: Domaine du Haut Bourg 2016 Pavillon Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: Based in the Grand Cru village of Cramant, this producer has access to some fine vineyards which go into its nonvintage cuvée. It is textured, tight, fruity and with fine acidity to cut through the apple and lemon fruitiness. Drink now.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Voirin-Jumel NV Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: With its ripe texture and delicious red-fruit flavor, this wine has a tangy mineral edge and a fine balance. It offers softness (because of that balance) that veers towards dry. It is a fine apéritif style, rich and ready to drink.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: As the name of this cuvée indicates, the grapes for this bottling come from sandier parcels within the appellation. The result is a fruitier expression of Tavel, one that morphs ceaselessly between red plum, yellow peach and mixed berry flavors. Crisp and firm on the finish, this needs a little time to show its best; drink throughout 2017.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2015 Terroir des Sables  (Tavel)

description: This is a full-bodied and fruity wine. It has ripe red berry fruits as well as layers of warm citrus and fresh acidity. It's the richness that shows most strongly here, from the fruit to the texture, very much a house style of Ruinart. Drink now.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a full-bodied and fruity wine. It has ripe red berry fruits as well as layers of warm citrus and fresh acidity. It's the richness that shows most strongly here, from the fruit to the texture, very much a house style of Ruinart. Drink now.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Big, dusty tannins dominate this rich and opulent wine. With black plum and juicy red berries, it is well balanced, the acidity cutting through to point up the richness. Very ready to drink, but it will age. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Haut Selve 2009 Réserve  (Graves)

description: This is a youthful, fruity wine with crisp yellow-fruit and citrus flavors, with a toastiness from wood aging. Sourced from Saint-Aubin, it has a cool, fresh feel that complements its pristine fruitiness. It's for drinking soon, but will also improve with age through 2021.
title: Jean-Claude Boisset 2011 En Remilly Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Bright citrus-fruit flavors are rounded with warm apple and pear notes on this densely textured, fruity wine. It shows no sign of aging, with a palate that's still fresh and bright, and revealing its minerality and tight acidity slowly. Drink through 2020.
designation: Tsarine Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Chanoine 2006 Tsarine Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Even with some bottle age, this is a ripe and fruity wine. With a good edge of toastiness, it has lost its initial freshness, while gaining a round, rich character. It has great acidity and crispness on the finish.
designation: Blin's Édition Limitée Extra Brut Rosé
title: H. Blin NV Blin's Édition Limitée Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Full bodied and opulent in classic Meursault style, this ripe, yellow-fruited wine is full of ripe fruits layered in wood notes. There's a sense of power and generosity throughout. It's a wine that will develop over the medium term, so drink from 2015.
title: Patrick Javillier 2011 Clos du Cromin  (Meursault)

description: Still quite youthful, this wine is closed and tight, but full of potential. Flavors of citrus fruits, mango and pear are layered elegantly with wood. It's a ripe, while crisp wine that's tightly structured and powerful. Drink from 2016.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2011 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Still quite youthful, this wine is closed and tight, but full of potential. Flavors of citrus fruits, mango and pear are layered elegantly with wood. It's a ripe, while crisp wine that's tightly structured and powerful. Drink from 2016.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2011 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Fermented in 225-liter barrels, this is a rich, full-flavored wine touched with hints of toast and brisk acidity. The palate is weighty, but there's a crisp, dry fruit quality on the palate. Still youthful, it's not quite integrated yet, so keep until 2016.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2005 Cuvée 225 Millesimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Fermented in 225-liter barrels, this is a rich, full-flavored wine touched with hints of toast and brisk acidity. The palate is weighty, but there's a crisp, dry fruit quality on the palate. Still youthful, it's not quite integrated yet, so keep until 2016.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2005 Cuvée 225 Millesimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A full-bodied wine made from Pinot Noir, this has richness and weight, accentuated by green-plum and lime flavors, but also an intense acidity. There's a great depth of fruit and flavor, making this a food Champagne par excellence.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Black tea leaves and sweet spices season the fresh black-cherry and cassis spine of this attractive red blend. A good grip in the mouth lends structure to the fruit-forward palate and gives longevity to the dry finish.
title: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) 2010 Val de L'Ours Cabernet Sauvignon-Syrah (Pays d'Oc)

description: Lightly amylic-pear drop, resin, mineral, stone-fruit and peach-skin aromas dominate the youthful nose of this wine. Very clean and mineral-focused. The medium body and vibrant acidity give the palate a firm texture. Given its short, crisp finish, it is best consumed between now and through 2013. Good by the glass or with light fare.
title: Domaine la Croix Gratiot 2011  Picpoul de Pinet

description: Lightly amylic-pear drop, resin, mineral, stone-fruit and peach-skin aromas dominate the youthful nose of this wine. Very clean and mineral-focused. The medium body and vibrant acidity give the palate a firm texture. Given its short, crisp finish, it is best consumed between now and through 2013. Good by the glass or with light fare.
title: Domaine la Croix Gratiot 2011  Picpoul de Pinet

description: While it's firmly tannic, the fruit still shows through the structure. It has taut flavors of black plum and currant; angular now, but has some good aging potential.
title: Lannac Saint-Jean 2009 B (Si) Malbec (Cahors)

description: While it's firmly tannic, the fruit still shows through the structure. It has taut flavors of black plum and currant; angular now, but has some good aging potential.
title: Lannac Saint-Jean 2009 B (Si) Malbec (Cahors)

description: The wine seems flat. It has the red fruits and acidity, but they seem flabby and dull.
title: Bailli de Provence 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine seems flat. It has the red fruits and acidity, but they seem flabby and dull.
title: Bailli de Provence 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Caramel and soft fruits in a wine that seems to be missing the zesty, crisp element. The wine feels flat.
title: Château Montaud 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pink in color, this is a full wine that misses out on freshness. It is clean with ripe strawberry fruits, but it feels fat and heavy. Screwcap.
title: Château de Beauregard-Ducourt 2012 Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Very young, fruity wine. The tannins are already soft and there is stalky black currant acidity that gives the wine a bright freshness. It has no wood and will develop fast.
title: Château Allégret 2012  Bordeaux

description: Accents of cola spice and cardamom lend a spicy overlay to the black plum and berry core of this wine. It's surprisingly light in weight, with soft tannins and plush, sweet oak-spice tones that dominate the finish.
title: Fortant 2015 Hills Reserve Malbec (Pays d'Oc)

description: Accents of cola spice and cardamom lend a spicy overlay to the black plum and berry core of this wine. It's surprisingly light in weight, with soft tannins and plush, sweet oak-spice tones that dominate the finish.
title: Fortant 2015 Hills Reserve Malbec (Pays d'Oc)

description: Black cherry, currant and plum swirl in the bouquet, with hints of baking spice and bittersweet chocolate in the background. It's promising, but the palate comes across a bit flat, with soft tannins and a fleeting finish.
title: Domaines Pierre Chavin 2015 Iconique Cabernet Sauvignon (Pays d'Oc)

description: This wine is soft and very rich. That takes away from the fruit and leaves a broad wine, smooth and with a touch of pepper from alcohol. It is too big.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine de la Garenne  (Macon-Bussières)

description: This wine is soft and very rich. That takes away from the fruit and leaves a broad wine, smooth and with a touch of pepper from alcohol. It is too big.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine de la Garenne  (Macon-Bussières)

description: Delicate aromas of red apple and dried grass tease on the nose of this soft wine, while slightly more assertive flavors of lime and white melon rind unfold on the medium-weight mouth. Ample acidity keeps the finish fresh, but short.
title: Barton & Guestier 2016 B&G Réserve Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: Clean notes of apple, melon and lime peel unfold of the nose and carry through to the lightweight mouth. There's ample acidity to keep the palate fresh, with a short finish.
title: Sainte Marie des Crozes 2016 Le Clandestin Sauvignon Blanc (Pays d'Oc)

description: This blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault is light and fruity, with a touch of red-fruit candy. It has a soft aftertaste that suggests the wine is not bone dry. Drink now.
title: Marrenon 2016 Triniti Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This wine is fairly soft and muted, with delicate aromas of straw, apple and underripe white melon. The palate is similarly light in feel and intensity, with low acidity and a short finish.
title: Les Jamelles 2016 Viognier (Pays d'Oc)

description: This soft, gentle wine has some attractive citrus and apple fruits. Easy to drink, it offers a crisp tangy aftertaste. It is not a wine for aging, so drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Collection  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This soft, gentle wine has some attractive citrus and apple fruits. Easy to drink, it offers a crisp tangy aftertaste. It is not a wine for aging, so drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Collection  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This wine has easy flavors that are bursting with red cherry. A shot of tannin gives this open, fruity wine shape. It is ready to drink.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Beaujolais)

description: This is spicy with a strong floral character. Its red-berry fruits are shot through with acidity. The crispness and attractiveness of the wine are spoiled just by the hint of candy and caramel. Drink now.
title: Fabre en Provence 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This soft wine is open, rounded with a balance between fruit and crisp acidity. Simple and gentle, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Deux Roches 2016 Tradition  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: A meaty, gamy character graces the red-fruit core of this lightweight wine. The tannins are soft, with light acidity and a subtle cherry-cola flavor that unfolds on the close. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Brau 2016 Pure Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: A meaty, gamy character graces the red-fruit core of this lightweight wine. The tannins are soft, with light acidity and a subtle cherry-cola flavor that unfolds on the close. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Brau 2016 Pure Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: Classic, simple and fruity, this is an immediately accessible wine. With bright red fruits and a soft, juicy texture, it is crisp, lively and ready to drink.
title: Château de Pizay 2016  Beaujolais

description: This cherry-fruited wine is spicy, but a strong acid streak gives a raw aftertaste that should have softened by now. It is ready to drink.
title: Boutinot 2016 Les Violettes  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Menthol and sweet grass are upfront on the nose of this herbal rosé, supported by notes of strawberry hull and black currant. There's a slight prickle to the palate, with a pithy astringency on the finish.
title: Pierrick Harang 2016 Le Petit Balthazar Cinsault Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Menthol and sweet grass are upfront on the nose of this herbal rosé, supported by notes of strawberry hull and black currant. There's a slight prickle to the palate, with a pithy astringency on the finish.
title: Pierrick Harang 2016 Le Petit Balthazar Cinsault Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This soft, light wine has hints of citrus and acidity. It is fruity, crisp and bright with orange zest at the end. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2016 Les Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: This soft, light wine has hints of citrus and acidity. It is fruity, crisp and bright with orange zest at the end. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2016 Les Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: Château de Rully is managed by Rodet. It has produced a firm, dark and smoky wine in 2010. It's firm, solid, with an earthy, undergrowth edge. At the same time, its weight and density promise some good aging over at least five years.
designation: Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay
title: Antonin Rodet 2010 Château de Rully Cuvée R. de Ternay  (Rully)

description: Full, fat, ripe, perfumed wine that is full of rich red fruits, plums and strawberries. It also has a stylish structured with refined tannins as well as a dense texture. It's a wine for aging over at least 5–7 years.
title: Antonin Rodet 2010 Château de Mercey Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Big and solid, this is very firm in character. It has weight, density and dry tannins. At the same more juicy black fruits and acidity emerge from this mineral textured wine. Powered by its structure, it could well age for 3–5 years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Big and solid, this is very firm in character. It has weight, density and dry tannins. At the same more juicy black fruits and acidity emerge from this mineral textured wine. Powered by its structure, it could well age for 3–5 years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This is an immediately attractive and approachable wine, with direct and intense aromas and flavors of black cherry, plum and boysenberry accented by notes of sweet smoke, mocha and pepper. Firm yet approachable, this is well-balanced with structured tannins and ample acidity. Drink from 2015-2018.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Grand Terroir Tautavel Grenache-Syrah-Carignan Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages Tautavel)

description: This is a big, rich wine, with swathes of black currant fruit and ripe spice. The tannins are there too, a wall of solid texture and dark structure. With this weight and density, it's obvious that this wine needs some serious aging, so don't drink before 2018.
designation: Château la Tour Chambert Cuvée des Hauts Coteaux
title: Château de Chambert 2011 Château la Tour Chambert Cuvée des Hauts Coteaux Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: An intensely perfumed, beautifully rich wine. It has tense and mineral acidity, citrus juice contrasted with pineapple freshness. Very full, rounded and ripe, this will age beautifully; drink from 2016 on.
title: Pierre and Charles Sparr 2010 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a spicy wine, finely fruity with black-currant fruits and with some firm structured tannins. It is a concentrated wine that is likely to mature slowly. There is a sense of power behind this fine cru wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine de Côtes Rémont 2015  Juliénas

description: This is a rich, unctuous, yet refreshing example of Condrieu. Apricot and melon notes pick up hints of honey, then end with a pop of wood spice and a balanced tannic feel. Drink now.
title: Ogier 2013 La Combe de Malleval  (Condrieu)

description: This wine is packed with cheerful red fruits that are given a more serious edge by the tannic structure and acidity,. With its touch of pepper and minerality, it will age well over the next two years. The cru wine comes from a family-owned property on steep slopes.
title: Stéphane Aviron 2015 Domaine de la Madrière  (Fleurie)

description: This wine is packed with cheerful red fruits that are given a more serious edge by the tannic structure and acidity,. With its touch of pepper and minerality, it will age well over the next two years. The cru wine comes from a family-owned property on steep slopes.
title: Stéphane Aviron 2015 Domaine de la Madrière  (Fleurie)

description: Old Merlot vines from a five-acre parcel have given this powerful and dense wine. Solid with dark-plum fruits and still-dry tannins, it also has a fine texture and freshness to balance. It is juicy while also young. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lanbersac 2012 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Puisseguin Saint-Émilion)

description: A dark-colored wine, this is full of tannins as well as ripe blackberry fruits. The acidity and fruitiness give it a very fresh character, while the underlying tannins will let it age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Agassac 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: A dark-colored wine, this is full of tannins as well as ripe blackberry fruits. The acidity and fruitiness give it a very fresh character, while the underlying tannins will let it age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Agassac 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This is a blend of Syrah and Cinsault. That gives the wine structure as well as bright fruits. It is an elegant fruity wine with a creamy ripe texture along with red-currant and raspberry fruits. Drink the wine now.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2016 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a deliciously fruity wine. It has fine red-currant and citrus fruits that give it a fresh crisp texture and flavor. The attractive wine is so bright with fruit right up front. Drink now.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2016 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a blend of Grenache and Cinsault from the organic vineyard of Château Gabriel. It is a lively, crisp wine with fine acidity and refreshing red-currant fruits. It is bone dry, packed with bright acidity as well as fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Château Gabriel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is a blend of Grenache and Cinsault from the organic vineyard of Château Gabriel. It is a lively, crisp wine with fine acidity and refreshing red-currant fruits. It is bone dry, packed with bright acidity as well as fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Château Gabriel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is one of the entry-level wines from this producer. It shows the ripe, soft side of Malbec without compromising on the firm structure and mineral edge that is natural to the grape and the appellation. The wine is developing easily and quickly, with bold black fruits and acidity. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2014 Malbec du Clos Malbec (Cahors)

description: This small appellation is an enclave in the middle of Côtes de Provence. Its style is very similar and this wine, named after the owner, is a structured blend of Syrah and Grenache. The wine from organic grapes has a pepper and spice edge over the crisp acidity of the red fruits. Drink now.
title: Château la Calisse 2016 Patricia Ortelli Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a stylish wine. It has fine acidity and light poised fruity character. With plenty of orange zest and a herbal touch, this blend of Cinsault, Grenache and Syrah is a generous wine, ready to drink now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The concentration that Christian Roche produces here is immense, a wine that has dark tannins, the most bitter of chocolate flavors and peppered cherry fruits. Even after four years, this is nowhere open yet, the tannins and the heavy toast wood still dark and dry. Age for 3–4 years more.
title: Domaine l'Ancienne Cure 2005 L'Extase Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: The concentration that Christian Roche produces here is immense, a wine that has dark tannins, the most bitter of chocolate flavors and peppered cherry fruits. Even after four years, this is nowhere open yet, the tannins and the heavy toast wood still dark and dry. Age for 3–4 years more.
title: Domaine l'Ancienne Cure 2005 L'Extase Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: From selected parcels of the Bélingard vineyard, this is a firm and rich wine, with excellent concentration. The tannins are firm, dusty, broken by ripe plums and sweet acidity. The 18 months of wood aging shows in the polish of the wine. Age for another year.
title: Château Bélingard 2005 Ortus Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: It is the balance that stars with this wine. The fruit, acidity and mineral texture are held together in maturing harmony. Still young, the wine is still in the fruity spectrum and yet is very ready to drink now. The acidity and the link between the soft dosage and freshness are all in place. Drink now and until 2026.
title: Pol Roger 2006 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: For Perrier-Jouët the symbols of the Belle Epoque are the house calling card. This prestige cuvée, in its stylish flowered bottle, has been released with good maturity, offering toast as well as fruit and a crisp, tight and mineral backdrop. There is an elegant style to the wine, fresh and with poise. Drink now.
title: Perrier Jouët 2007 Belle Epoque Brut  (Champagne)

description: For Perrier-Jouët the symbols of the Belle Epoque are the house calling card. This prestige cuvée, in its stylish flowered bottle, has been released with good maturity, offering toast as well as fruit and a crisp, tight and mineral backdrop. There is an elegant style to the wine, fresh and with poise. Drink now.
title: Perrier Jouët 2007 Belle Epoque Brut  (Champagne)

description: Among the most iconic Champagnes, this wine always reflects its vintage. In this 2007, coming from a good, not great year, the wine is developing more quickly than is sometimes the case. It is now showing as a beautiful, balanced wine ripe with apples while also hinting at almonds and a yeasty character. The wine has such style, elegant with its fragrant acidity and complex structure.
title: Louis Roederer 2007 Cristal Brut  (Champagne)

description: With some age, this is a gloriously ripe and toasty wine. It has a rich character emphasized by the round texture and the creamy mousse. It also has great concentration, bringing together acidity as well as dense secondary flavors. With its rich, mature character, it is best suited for food. It is ready to drink, but will hold well through 2025.
title: Moët & Chandon 2005 Dom Pérignon Brut  (Champagne)

description: With some age, this is a gloriously ripe and toasty wine. It has a rich character emphasized by the round texture and the creamy mousse. It also has great concentration, bringing together acidity as well as dense secondary flavors. With its rich, mature character, it is best suited for food. It is ready to drink, but will hold well through 2025.
title: Moët & Chandon 2005 Dom Pérignon Brut  (Champagne)

description: Taittinger's prestige cuvée epitomizes the Chardonnay predilection of this producer. This now-mature bottling is elegant and very stylish. Toast and a soft texture combine with great complexity to reveal a wine that is poised and ready to drink. But with the acidity in the background, it could still age, so drink now and until 2022.
designation: Comtes de Champagne Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Taittinger 2006 Comtes de Champagne Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A blend of 60-40 Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this beautifully textured wine offers white fruit, citrus and crisp apple flavors. These contrast with the yeast and cookie flavors that are developing after the long aging in the Lanson cellars. This impressive wine could still develop further. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Lanson NV Extra Age Brut  (Champagne)

description: The great 2002 vintage has produced some remarkable wines and this falls into that category. Still so fresh, with swathes of mineral texture and tight acidity, it is still developing. Hints of toast point to a future where the wine will be rounder and with even more complexity. For now, the crisp apple, pear and softer yellow fruits dominate. Drink from 2017.
title: Lanson 2002 Noble Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Beautifully crisp and fresh, this is a young, tightly textured wine that is already so refreshing. Its red fruit character is just a part of the mineral and tannin texture and the pure line of fragrant acidity. Very pale in color, this sophisticated wine could do with some aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Louis Roederer 2010 Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a very fine wine with considerable bottle age. From its orange-pink color to its mature toast and almond flavors, this complex wine is much more than the fruit that has merged with the secondary flavors. Light tannins and a crisp texture are balanced by the softness that comes from the relatively high dosage. The wine, beautifully mature, is ready to drink.
title: Moët & Chandon 2004 Dom Pérignon Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This mature wine shows its toasty side. A mineral texture is now integrated with the almond, yeast and bread flavors to give a wine that's crisp while no longer bringing out its fruit. This wine is elegant with poise and great style. Drink now.
title: Bruno Paillard 2004 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This mature wine shows its toasty side. A mineral texture is now integrated with the almond, yeast and bread flavors to give a wine that's crisp while no longer bringing out its fruit. This wine is elegant with poise and great style. Drink now.
title: Bruno Paillard 2004 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Beautifully pale in color, this is the latest release of Cristal Rosé. It is ripe and full in the mouth, packed with fruit and also with intense acidity that cuts through the soft texture. There is a hint of bottle age, giving the wine a toasty complexity that brings a balance to this great wine. Drink now, although this vintage will certainly last to 2020 and beyond.
title: Louis Roederer 2007 Cristal Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The wine is ripe and perfumed. Mint and sweet eucalyptus aromas are followed on the palate by ripe tannins and strawberry fruits. This is an attractive wine that will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Auguste 2014 L'Audacieux  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Both blossom and fruit are offered on the nose: the dewy scent of ripe, yellow mirabelles is captivating. The same primary notes play on the fizzy, frothy palate, boosted further by generous dosage. This is easy and fresh, lively and exuberant. For now, yeasty autolytic notes are still in the background. This will change with a little bottle age.
title: Charles Sparr NV Hallelujah Chardonnay (Alsace)

description: The scent of very fragrant ripe apples abounds on the nose: think both Red and Golden Delicious. This fruity note carries through the entire palate: from its fresh, sprightly opening through its dry, slender body to its frothy, lively finish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The scent of very fragrant ripe apples abounds on the nose: think both Red and Golden Delicious. This fruity note carries through the entire palate: from its fresh, sprightly opening through its dry, slender body to its frothy, lively finish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A salmon-pink rosé, this wine is crisp with red cherry and raspberry flavors. Light and stylish, it offers a tangy texture that gives a bright aftertaste of acidity and crisp apples.
title: Thiénot NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A salmon-pink rosé, this wine is crisp with red cherry and raspberry flavors. Light and stylish, it offers a tangy texture that gives a bright aftertaste of acidity and crisp apples.
title: Thiénot NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The nose is rather closed but the palate displays crisp, refreshing and mellow notes of apple. All the flavors are restrained but elegant while the mousse underlines all this with soft, finely-tuned creaminess. All this results in a dry refreshing understatement.
title: Wunsch & Mann NV Cuvée Traditionelle Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The pure scent of freshly picked strawberries is as enticing on the nose as it is on the palate. The gentle flavors are supported by bright lemony freshness and a frothy fizzy mousse that accentuates the purity of these primary flavors perfectly. All of this spells lightness and ease. The finish is dry and full of strawberry notes.
title: Wolfberger NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This Malbec is soft in style, with plenty of black currant tones balanced by vibrant acidity and ripe tannins. The black fruit flavors have a succulent character that makes the wine now ready to drink.
title: Vignobles 46N118 2010 Noir 46 Malbec (Cahors)

description: The high elevation appellation of Chiroubles produces structured wine like this. It's a cool, tannin and crisp fruit flavored wine. Red currants are cut with acidity and a juicy, really fruity aftertaste. The structure will allow the wine to age a few months, so drink from the end of 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Vidame de Rocsain  (Chiroubles)

description: Produced from vines around the grand chateau, this is a crisp wine that has banana flavors and tight red-currant acidity that is crisp and lightly perfumed. It will probably be softer from early 2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Château de Plantigny  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A soft banana and cherry-flavored wine that has attractive acidity and only the lightest of tannins. It is bright, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Beaujolais

description: The wine is nothing but fresh cherries from vines grown on sandy soil. Light tannins and bright fruitiness are the wine's hallmarks, giving a crisp, lively aftertaste.
title: Louis Tête 2015 Les Sableux  (Beaujolais)

description: This is a tight wine with red-currant fruits and plenty of acidity. It is crisp and very fresh, demanding a few more months to calm down. Drink from 2017.
title: Laurent Perrachon 2015 Terre de Loyse  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Light tannins give this wine an attractive texture. It has bright cherry fruits along with glittering acidity. It's a fruity, fresh wine that is ready to drink.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2015  Beaujolais

description: A blend that includes Gros Manseng along with Colombard and Sauvignon Blanc, this wine is light as a feather—crisp and with just an edge of honey. It is lively with a herbal character that is refreshing and lightly perfumed.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2015 Haut-Marin Cuvée Marine White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The herbal aromas leap from the glass in this crisp, green-fruit and citrus-flavored wine. It is tangy, herbal and grassy in character with a zesty texture and a tight mineral aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2015 Colombard-Ugni Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Orange-pink in color, this is ripe, full rosé. It has plenty of acidity as well as a crisp texture. The weight of the wine puts its firmly in the food category of rosé.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2015 Ysé Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Orange-pink in color, this is ripe, full rosé. It has plenty of acidity as well as a crisp texture. The weight of the wine puts its firmly in the food category of rosé.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2015 Ysé Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Lively, fruity and made to be drunk young, this is a crisp red-fruit-flavored wine. It has acidity and a tangy orange peel character. Drink now.
title: Domaine Bertrand 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Made from 40% Grenache Noir, 40% Syrah and 20% Cinsault, this coppery rosé is freshly fruited and quite floral, with aromas of ripe stone fruit, strawberry and orange blossom. The palate is approachable and balanced, with ample acidity and a short but clean finish.
title: Château Viranel 2015 Tradition Rosé (Saint-Chinian)

description: Muddled strawberry and watermelon aromas and flavors are partnered with an earthy streak reminiscent of wet leaves. The palate is similarly fruit forward, with ample acidity that lifts the fruity richness and results in a short but clean finish.
title: Domaine Sainte-Eugénie 2015 Rosé (Corbières)

description: This is a ripe wine, full of cherry fruit and bright acidity. It has a dry edge that gives the wine a structure to balance the crisp, perfumed fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Duperray 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: This is a ripe wine, full of cherry fruit and bright acidity. It has a dry edge that gives the wine a structure to balance the crisp, perfumed fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Duperray 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: This soft wine is full of red fruit. It has a fine balance of acidity and gentle tannins. From the fruity 2012 vintage, it's now ready to drink.
title: Château Tour Grand Mayne 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This fine, perfumed wine is richly endowed with tannins and black fruit. It has good concentration as well: ripe and juicy, with its acidity and crisp texture in place. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Picoron 2015 Petit Picoron  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This fine, perfumed wine is richly endowed with tannins and black fruit. It has good concentration as well: ripe and juicy, with its acidity and crisp texture in place. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Picoron 2015 Petit Picoron  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is firm, with dry, smoky tannins that underscore its rich black fruit, promising good aging potential. It will develop slowly and be ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château Mayne Mazerolles 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a soft and juicy wine with black currant fruitiness. Its wood aging is nicely judged, allowing its ripe character, acidity and black fruit to show through. The wine will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château les Aubastons 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: This is a soft and juicy wine with black currant fruitiness. Its wood aging is nicely judged, allowing its ripe character, acidity and black fruit to show through. The wine will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château les Aubastons 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: This perfumed wine is ripe with exuberant black fruit and hints of wood aging. It's juicy with spice and pepper notes as well as bold red fruit. Drink from 2020.
title: Château la Croix Saint-Pierre 2015 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is still tannic and firm, with a dry core of ripe fruit. The tannins will always be present, typical of this vintage. Drink now, but decant first.
title: Château la Clide 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This big and ripe wine with dense blackberry fruit is concentrated and still young. The firm tannins under its bold fruitiness still need to soften to give a rich and fruity wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château du Caillau 2015 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This big and ripe wine with dense blackberry fruit is concentrated and still young. The firm tannins under its bold fruitiness still need to soften to give a rich and fruity wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château du Caillau 2015 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Malbec is on the list of allowed grapes in Bordeaux but is rarely found now because it used to be difficult to ripen. This rich, structured wine shows that the situation has changed. It's ripe, full of black fruit and likely to mature well. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Lagarde 2016 En Mémoire du  (Bordeaux)

description: This soft, fruity wine delivers honey and apricot aromas. With touches of botrytis, it has a dry, spicy edge. At the same time, it's full of bitter orange and yellow fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Dauphiné Rondillon 2011

description: Solid tannins mark this out as a wine that will need to age. Its structure dominates its black fruit, hiding it beneath a smoky, spicy character. Give it until 2020 before opening.
title: Château Castegens 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Solid tannins mark this out as a wine that will need to age. Its structure dominates its black fruit, hiding it beneath a smoky, spicy character. Give it until 2020 before opening.
title: Château Castegens 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: There is considerable freshness here, along with black currant, bright berries and a smoky edge. It does have a strong tannic element that gives an austere structure.
title: Château Grand Rolland 2008 Grande Cuvée  (Bordeaux)

description: Literally friends and neighbors (the guys on the label dancing and playing an accordion), this wine is a light, soft blend of Groslot and Cabernet Franc from Anjou. It is light, strawberry-juice flavored, with green acidity. Ready to drink now.
title: Domaine des Sablonnettes 2008 Les Copains d'Abord Red (Vin de Table Francais)

description: Ripe Sauvignon Blanc, bringing out pear and apple flavors, topped with cream. There is a bite from an apple skin texture, along with bright, delicate acidity.
title: Guy Saget 2008 La Petite Perrière Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays de France)

description: A lightly botrytised wine, with sweet raisins and orange zest. The wine is soft, missing acidity, but the freshness is just right.
title: Yvon Mau 2007 Seigneurs de Monbazillac  (Monbazillac)

description: The fruit in this soft wine is ripe and creamy. Green and white fruits give a balanced blend of fresh acidity and smooth texture. It is rich, generous and will be ready to drink from 2016.
title: Alex Gambal 2013  Bourgogne

description: The fruit in this soft wine is ripe and creamy. Green and white fruits give a balanced blend of fresh acidity and smooth texture. It is rich, generous and will be ready to drink from 2016.
title: Alex Gambal 2013  Bourgogne

description: A soft, ripe and smooth wine, this conveys sweet caramel as well as brighter green fruits and citrus. A smoky character gives complexity and a ripe aftertaste to go with the juicy acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: Rijckaert 2013 Verchères  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Fresh strawberry, raspberry, sweet pea, orange blossom and honeysuckle abound in the bouquet of this pretty, pale rosé. It has a bright and clean but not overly simple character, with hints of garrigue and peach pit that add interest to the palate. Enjoy this refreshing sip now.
title: Domaine Montrose 2014 Les Lezards Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Although the domaine is mainly centered on Chassagne-Montrachet, neighboring Saint-Aubin is hardly far. This ripe, yellow and citrus-fruit-flavored wine is already delicious. Touches of toast from wood aging along with balanced acidity give it both crispness and richness. Drink now.
title: Philippe Colin 2014 Le Charmois Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Opulent and ripe, this wine has fine tannins that support the rich red fruit and smoky acidity. The weight and concentration of the wine make it so attractive and indicate it will develop well. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Max 2014 Aux Fourneaux Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: With a touch of spice from the wood, this wine is full of yellow and apple fruits yet with a cool thread of acidity. It is a lively, bright wine, filled out with fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Louis Latour 2014 En Caradeux Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: An intriguing wine, that offers ripe sweetness followed by an edgy rustic acidity. Is this a stage in its evolution? Probably, because the tannins promise aging and the intensely aromatic nature of the fruit points to a potentially fine wine. Just don't drink it yet.
designation: Clos de la Mousse Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006 Clos de la Mousse Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: A rounded, mouthfilling wine. At the beginning, it seems very soft, but then it is possible to discern rich tannins through the concentrated red fruits and black plums. The acidity is there all the time, a fine counterpoint to the seductive, rich fruits and dry tannins.
title: Domaine Jayer-Gilles 2006  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: Importer and Master Sommelier Fran Kysela uses the Maison du Midi label for lots of Rhône wines he selects to bring into the U.S. This effort, from Plan de Dieu, is seriously intense, full-bodied and firmly tannic, showing the character of the vintage.
