The plummy fruit is powerful, fighting through the tannins on the finish. Try it young with rare beef, or put it away for a few years and see if the tannins soften over time.
title: Maison du Midi 2005 Plan de Dieu Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Maison Bouachon is an old négociant house based in Gigondas. It's now owned by the Skalli family who is trying to raise the level of the wines. This Côtes-du-Rhône cuvée is a promising effort, boasting plenty of black cherry fruit to go with hints of leather and game. The fruit shows a hint of sur-maturité, yet remains fresh, while the mouthfeel is round yet not unstructured. Drink now–2010, possibly longer.
title: Maison Bouachon 2006 Les Rabassières Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A solid, dense wine, its rich tannins dominating dark black fruits. The wine is ponderous, brooding, with shafts of acidity giving it a lift. But it does need a couple of years to soften that core of serious tannins.
designation: Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Murots
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Murots  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: A solid, dense wine, its rich tannins dominating dark black fruits. The wine is ponderous, brooding, with shafts of acidity giving it a lift. But it does need a couple of years to soften that core of serious tannins.
designation: Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Murots
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Murots  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: After spending 18 months in oak, this is an unusually cedary Châteauneuf-du-Pape, its stewed fruit, plum pudding and spice flavors covered by a veneer of toast and vanilla. It's full bodied, plushly textured and undeniably appealing in a rather obvious, modern style. Imported by New Castle Imports, Inc.
title: Domaine de Beaurenard 2004 Boisrenard Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This firm's top Crozes-Hermitage cuvée is the Domaine Raymond Roure, which sees plenty of new wood in its upbringing, to judge from its somewhat coarse vanilla and cedar notes. There is plenty of blackberry fruit lurking beneath, so hopefully this will come together in time. Try after 2010.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2005 Domaine Raymond Roure  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: The voluble, opinionated Jean-Luc Colombo has crafted a Cairanne that shows a lot of ripe Grenache character, offering scents akin to cherries, almond butter and almost peach or apricot. It's on the chunky side, with some dusty tannins on the finish, so you could drink it now or save it for a few years.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2005 Le Pavillion des Courtisanes Cairanne Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Very pure, this has a clean strawberry flavor, with exhilarating acidity. The wine has some structure and firm tannins, although its fruitiness is the dominant factor.
title: Domaines Devillard 2010 Domaine des Perdrix  (Bourgogne)

description: Fresh, soft and fruity, this is brightened by a jammy red-fruit flavor and light acidity. It has a juicy character, with underlying attractive, gentle tannins.
title: Domaines Devillard 2010 Château de Chamirey  (Mercurey)

description: Fresh, soft and fruity, this is brightened by a jammy red-fruit flavor and light acidity. It has a juicy character, with underlying attractive, gentle tannins.
title: Domaines Devillard 2010 Château de Chamirey  (Mercurey)

description: Showing fine acidity, this has a creamy texture and a rich, rounded feel. Full of pear and creamed-apple flavors, it has some weight and a full-bodied character without losing the crisp acidity.
title: Domaine Robert Klingenfus 2011 Signature Riesling (Alsace)

description: While ripe, this also has a firm structure, with a mix of rich yellow-fruit flavors and austere minerality. With the acidity just beginning to soften, it will turn into a full and more rounded wine.
title: Domaine de la Garenne 2009  Mâcon-Azé

description: Round and full-bodied, this has a spice note and a perfumed, floral character. The wine is bright, still rather tight, needing a few months to develop.
title: Cave de Hunawihr 2011 Riesling (Alsace)

description: From a classic Champagne vintage year, this wine is just hinting at maturity. It is poised between freshness and richness, with layers of toast under the almonds and ripe sliced apples. Stylish and elegant, it delivers a brilliant fresh aftertaste.
title: Vincent Couche 2004 Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: From a classic Champagne vintage year, this wine is just hinting at maturity. It is poised between freshness and richness, with layers of toast under the almonds and ripe sliced apples. Stylish and elegant, it delivers a brilliant fresh aftertaste.
title: Vincent Couche 2004 Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: This sophisticated wood-aged wine comes from a fine year for whites in Pessac-Léognan. Subtle wood supports the rich tropical and yellow fruits as well as the crisper acidity. The texture, with its minerality, is still developing, with good potential. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Brown 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Mainly Pinot Noir with a shot of Chardonnay, this is developing into an impressive wine. It has ripe fruit with hints of tropicality as well tighter lemon zest. The toastiness is just beginning to develop and the wine will be at its peak from 2016.
title: Liebart-Régnier 2008 Excélia Brut  (Champagne)

description: Situated high on a rock overlooking the river Lot, Château de Mercuès, now a luxury hotel, dates from the 13th century. The wine is as ripe and luxurious as the hotel. It is a dense, solid and structured Malbec, with its powerful tannins balanced by big, bold black fruits. It's a classic wine for serious aging, so wait until 2018.
designation: Château de Mercuès Grand Vin Seigneur
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château de Mercuès Grand Vin Seigneur Malbec (Cahors)

description: This and the other Icône wine from Georges Vigouroux are massive. Despite its high alcohol, this is more restrained, derived from the high elevation of Haute-Serre. Intense black fruits and powerful tannins are well integrated and give a rich rather than out-of-control character. This would be worth aging, so wait until 2018.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Château de Haute-Serre Icône Wow Malbec (Cahors)

description: Named after the Roman emperor who allowed vines to be planted in Cahors, this richly perfumed wine has huge tannins that are still controlled by the equally powerful black fruits and acidity. Wood aging is still prominent along with the dry structure. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2012 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: This beautifully crisp and fresh wine has great red-berry acidity. Tight and textured, it is dry while balancing fruit and the more steely edge. The bottling is young, so could be aged for six months from purchase, although it is also refreshing to drink immediately.
title: A.R. Lenoble  NV Terroirs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Named after the street where the winery stands, this is jammy and ripe while also structured with some firm tannins. Rich and juicy red-berry fruits have both crisp acidity and a dense texture. It should be drunk from 2017.
title: Vignobles Bulliat 2014 Cuvée du Colombier  (Morgon)

description: Impressive and dense, this wine has a dark structure, firm tannins as well as fruit. Flavors of spice and smokiness are lifted by the red-berry flavors and acidity. The wine is still young, needing more time, so drink from 2016.
title: Lucien Lardy 2014 Les Roches  (Fleurie)

description: Simple and fruity, this has tangy a tangy raspberry flavor. It's light and zesty, with a fine, fresh aftertaste.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2011 Provence One Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: A soft wine, with just a touch of sweetness. The ripe fruit lends a gentle, smooth texture, and it's balanced with attractive red-currant acidity.
title: Château de l'Escarelle 2011 iPink Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: The scent of fresh, bruised and baked apples makes for an enticing nose on this wine. Fresh and lively with lemon, the palate has a broader aspect than expected, with some graininess on the midpalate. It finishes dry and fresh.
title: Dopff & Irion 2015 Cuvée René Dopff Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tart citrus fruit and earthy aspects unite in a taut, bright clean palate with a very clean-cut, dry finish.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tart citrus fruit and earthy aspects unite in a taut, bright clean palate with a very clean-cut, dry finish.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is an aromatic blend of Colombard, Gros Manseng and Sauvignon Blanc. Fresh, crisp and fruity, it is the ideal apéritif wine with its mineral texture and bright acidity. It is a lively wine, with just a hint of yellow fruit to go with the intense citrus. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2015 Cuvée Marine White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: There is an appealing touch of honey in this medium-sweet wine. It has a fine balance between acidity and ripe apricot and peach fruit. It is attractive and crisp with an underlying perfumed character. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2015 Les Deux Cèdres Gros Manseng (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: There is an appealing touch of honey in this medium-sweet wine. It has a fine balance between acidity and ripe apricot and peach fruit. It is attractive and crisp with an underlying perfumed character. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2015 Les Deux Cèdres Gros Manseng (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Although labeled as Viognier, the wine also has a small amount of Chardonnay. But it is the perfumed Viognier, with its yellow-fruit flavor, that dominates and gives a rich, spicy and generous texture. Drink now.
title: Château Routas 2015 Viognier (Var)

description: Although labeled as Viognier, the wine also has a small amount of Chardonnay. But it is the perfumed Viognier, with its yellow-fruit flavor, that dominates and gives a rich, spicy and generous texture. Drink now.
title: Château Routas 2015 Viognier (Var)

description: This is a rich style of rosé with caramel as well as red-fruit flavors. It has enough acidity to carry its ripe character, giving the wine a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Routas 2015 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a rich style of rosé with caramel as well as red-fruit flavors. It has enough acidity to carry its ripe character, giving the wine a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Routas 2015 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: There is no hint of wood in this fruity, lightly tannic wine. It has black-currant fruit, just a touch of dryness and juicy acidity. It's a simple, delicious wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Marcel Malbec

description: This is a bright, lively blend of Ugni Blanc and Colombard. It has tangy acidity and a refreshing lemon-peel texture. With its herbal green-fruit character and refreshing aftertaste it is ready to drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Blandine le Blanc Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The wine has a tannic edge that suggests it is still young. Underneath there is some attractive red-berry fruit and acidity. It just needs a few more months to fill out, so drink from 2017.
title: Château de Pizay 2015  Beaujolais

description: This Reims-based cooperative's wine is fruity, with a nice mature character from aging. Its citrus and green plum fruit is balanced with soft acidity. The texture is creamy, ripe and ready to drink.
title: Castelnau NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: Less bright and perfumed than La Coterie's Passe Colline bottling, this is still a soft, approachable wine with ample cherry fruit. Hints of leather and white pepper give it a bit of complexity. The blend is 65% Grenache, 25% Syrah and 10% Carignan.
title: Vignobles La Coterie 2010 Pierre du Diable Red (Ventoux)

description: A light, easy-drinking blend of Grenache Blanc (56%), Clairette (37%) and Roussanne (7%), the Terre d'Ocres displays an array of fresh stone fruit, citrus and a bit of white pepper. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Tara 2010 Terres d'Ocres White (Ventoux)

description: Light and fruity, full of red cherries, sweet tannins and attractive acidity. The wine is softly attractive with some of the warmth of the year.
title: Domaine de la Combe au Loup 2009  Régnié
winery: Domaine de la Combe au Loup

description: Light and fruity, full of red cherries, sweet tannins and attractive acidity. The wine is softly attractive with some of the warmth of the year.
title: Domaine de la Combe au Loup 2009  Régnié
winery: Domaine de la Combe au Loup

description: Crisp, clean and fruit-driven, with apple and citrus notes. It's middle-of-the-road as far as weight. The pineapple-like flavors are simple but refreshing. A blend of Roussanne, Marsanne, Grenache Blanc and Clairette.
title: Domaine de la Citadelle 2010 Les Artèmes White (Luberon)

description: This mature example of Costières de Nîmes should be consumed over the next six months or so for its appealing savory characters of leather and dried fruit. It's medium bodied, with a silky finish that should make it easy to pair with anything from chicken to lamb.
title: Domaine Fincham 2007 Red Note Grenache-Syrah (Costières de Nîmes)

description: The Grand Veneur white relies on a somewhat unusual blend of Viognier, Roussanne and Clairette to yield a svelte, medium-bodied wine. Delicate aromas of pencil shavings and pear lead into a palate boasting pear, melon and tangerine flavors. There's just enough citrusy zest to prolong the finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2015 Réserve Grand Veneur White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Full bodied and rich, this is a big, toasty example of white Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Grilled mango notes lead the way, with vanilla and toast framing tropical and stone fruit on the long, oak-lined finish.
title: Famille Perrin 2014 Château de Beaucastel White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Sourced from the lieu dits of Le Méal and Les Greffieux, this is a sturdy, tannic rendering of Hermitage. It's smoky, meaty and cedary upfront, with blackberry fruit and plenty of savory notes that linger through the drying finish. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2013 Le Rouet Rouge  (Hermitage)

description: The big tannins indicate a wine with powerful potential. It has weight, richness, generous red fruits and a strong sense of structure. The freshness of the vintage comes through in the acidity at the end. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2011  Fixin

description: The chalky soil conveys a cool feeling to this wine. Tight and mineral, it has yellow fruits that show good acidity. Toasty wood gives a juicy aftertaste. It's already delicious, but the wine's cool character will develop further, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Les Caradeux Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: From granite soil, this rounded wine has a firm core of structure. Pineapple and peach fruit flavors surround this center, making it full in the mouth, rich and charming. Acidity at the end and the firm texture promise some aging. Drink from 2015.
title: Château des Rontets 2011 Pierrefolle  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This was the first vineyard bought by the Bouchard family, purchased in 1791. More than 220 years later, this 2011 has a delicate touch of wood nestled in the heart of creamy fruit flavors. Crisp lemon and tight acidity give a bright, fresh aftertaste. Drink from 2016.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Clos Saint-Landry Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Fruity and ripe, it also presents a fresh feel that cuts through the jammy red fruits and gives an edge to the weight and velvet texture. It's almost ready to drink but will be better from 2015.
title: Louis Latour 2011 Vignes Franches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Crisp acidity and citrus fruitiness combine with a riper, textured character. The wine shows the strong minerality inherent in whites from Pernand-Vergelesses, as well as a richer streak. Because of its structure, it should age. Drink from 2016.
designation: Creux de la Net Premier Cru
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Creux de la Net Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Less flamboyant than the 2010, this is still an excellent wine. It's full bodied, rich and broad on the palate, delivering layers of honeyed apricot and citrus that finish warm, with a hint of caramel. Drink it over the next couple of years.
title: E. Guigal 2011 La Doriane  (Condrieu)

description: This is a light-colored wine with warm raspberry flavors and attractive acidity. Well balanced, it has a tangy orange-zest texture along with an herbal aftertaste. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2016 Nuit Blanche en Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A richly rounded wine, impressively dense and powerful. Its ripe tropical and green fruits are integrating well with the toast from wood aging to give great swathes of complex fruit and structure. This is a wine for the long haul. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: A dense, wood-aged wine, it brings richness, intense fruit and acidity together. It's complex and concentrated, powerfully structured and full of yellow fruits as well as lemon juice, edged with toast. It's a wine for aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Malartic-Lagravière 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: From selected, sunny parcels of vines, it's powered by its citrus and pear fruits along with an intensely mineral texture and supreme concentration. It's a Sancerre to keep, still young and gawky, best drunk from 2016.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 Jadis  (Sancerre)

description: Aged in wood from Domaine de la Romanée-Conti, this rich wine has sweetness, just enough tannins and wood to give structure, and a deep red cherry fruitiness.
title: Domaine de Gry-Sablon 2006 Cuvée Tradition  (Juliénas)

description: A hint of wood is a good sign of the richness and balance of this wine. There is some dryness and tautness to go with its black cherry and plum-skin flavors. There is a big and bold fruity aftertaste.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2006 Château de la Terrière  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A ripe, rounded wine, with flavors of pear, red apple and superfresh acidity. It's lifted, vibrant and delicious to drink now.
title: Domaine de la Tourmaline 2006  Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

description: A ripe, rounded wine, with flavors of pear, red apple and superfresh acidity. It's lifted, vibrant and delicious to drink now.
title: Domaine de la Tourmaline 2006  Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

description: Plum-jam-flavored wine, this is very sweet, rich and very direct. The freshness is here, but this is more about the dense, superripe fruits.
title: Domaine Chignard 2006  Fleurie

description: While the aromas on this example are not perfectly clean, they are followed by a burst of flavor that makes up for it all. Indian spices and macadamia nuts are punctuated by apricot fruit and wrapped up in a glossy texture. Long, nutty finish. Drink now to one year.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2005 Gloeckelberg Grand Cru Grande Reserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: While the aromas on this example are not perfectly clean, they are followed by a burst of flavor that makes up for it all. Indian spices and macadamia nuts are punctuated by apricot fruit and wrapped up in a glossy texture. Long, nutty finish. Drink now to one year.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2005 Gloeckelberg Grand Cru Grande Reserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Chitry lies just outside the Chablis appellation area, giving a wine that has some of the classic steely character but is more rounded and less focused. Pleasing Chardonnay, finishes with an attractive vanilla touch.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2008 Bourgogne Chitry  (Bourgogne)

description: Simple, attractive, light Chardonnay. Green fruits and pear juice layer with acidity and a soft texture. With its lively, crisp finish, the wine is ready to drink.
designation: Château de la Tour de l'Ange
title: Maison Jean-Baptiste Béjot 2008 Château de la Tour de l'Ange  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: A great value and a good choice for barbecue or summer seafood dishes. Moderate notes of small red berries, wild strawberry and raspberry dominate the creamy mouth along with a hint of soft garrigue herbs on the finish.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2008 Réserve St. Martin Syrah Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A great value and a good choice for barbecue or summer seafood dishes. Moderate notes of small red berries, wild strawberry and raspberry dominate the creamy mouth along with a hint of soft garrigue herbs on the finish.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2008 Réserve St. Martin Syrah Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: This wine makes you work harder than many of its neighbors to find the flavor but it's worth the effort when you uncover an intriguing mélange of hay, apricot and early summer fruits. The crisp, minerally finish puts one in mind of a platter of choucroute garnie. Drink now to 2013.
title: Dopff & Irion 2007 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This poised late-harvest blend of Loin de l'Oeil and Sauvignon Blanc tastes lightly honeyed, with an edge of dry botrytis. Perhaps more prominent are the dried apricot and spice notes, along with balanced acidity. Intense and in need of more aging, it will be best from late 2018.
title: Domaine Rotier 2016 Les Gravels White (Gaillac)

description: This poised late-harvest blend of Loin de l'Oeil and Sauvignon Blanc tastes lightly honeyed, with an edge of dry botrytis. Perhaps more prominent are the dried apricot and spice notes, along with balanced acidity. Intense and in need of more aging, it will be best from late 2018.
title: Domaine Rotier 2016 Les Gravels White (Gaillac)

description: Strongly herbal while also rich, this tangy, zesty wine shows no concessions in its expression of Sauvignon Blanc. Ripe and full of green plum and gooseberry flavors, it's smooth and ready to drink now.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2015 Moulin des Dames Parcelle A296 Sauvignon Blanc (Bergerac Sec)

description: This ripe, smoky wine is structured, full of new oak flavors and dense with both fruit and tannins. Its concentrated, bold blackberry flavors and firm tannins mix with smoky wood notes and acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Roque le Mayne 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Wood aging gives this wine's aroma its eucalyptus character. That perfume follows through to the finely structured palate, where oak flavors balance its delicious black plum fruit. It's warm, ripe and stylish. Drink from 2020.
title: Château le Grand Moulin 2015 Collection Grande Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This smooth and ripe wine is full of dark berry fruit and layered with tannins that will allow it to age. Although rich with black plum flavors, it's balanced with acidity. Fine and ageworthy, it will be ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château la Fleur 2015  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This serious, solid wine has plenty of smoky flavors, juicy black fruit and a firm background of tannins. Ripe, full of fruit and with fine acidity at the end, it will be ready from 2019.
title: Château la Bastidette 2012  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This serious, solid wine has plenty of smoky flavors, juicy black fruit and a firm background of tannins. Ripe, full of fruit and with fine acidity at the end, it will be ready from 2019.
title: Château la Bastidette 2012  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This generously structured wine is rich in tannins and fine, ripe black fruit. Its structure and juicy acidity will allow it to age well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Ricaud 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This generously structured wine is rich in tannins and fine, ripe black fruit. Its structure and juicy acidity will allow it to age well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Ricaud 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Château de Cérons, which also produces sweet wines, uses the same grape varieties for this dry white. It has an almost honeyed character that fills out its crisp acidity and citrusy orange flavors. Drink from late 2018.
title: Château de Cérons 2015  Graves

description: With Merlot and Cabernet Franc dominating the blend, this wine is as perfumed as it is structured. It shows elegance through its rich blackberry fruit and firm tannins. Concentrated and ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château de Brousse 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Generous tannins and blackberry fruit, along with a smooth texture all contribute to the richness of this broad, ripe wine. The 79% Merlot in the blend lends a generous character and the likelihood it will age quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Chantemerle 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: While the bulk of this estate's wines are in prestigious Saint-Julien, this comes from a parcel in the Haut-Médoc. It's a rich and structured wine, full of black fruit and acidity. Although developing well, it still needs time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Beychevelle 2015 Le Haut-Médoc de Beychevelle  (Haut-Médoc)

description: A pale rosé in color, this light and fruity wine has a fresh raspberry flavor, with a zingy texture that gives attractive acidity. It's light and creamy, hinting at yeastiness on the finish.
title: Domaine Zinck NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This creeps up slowly, gradually revealing its rich, spicy character that's laced with creamed pear and vanilla. What it lacks in fresh acidity, it certainly makes up for in ripeness.
title: Clément Klur 2011 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This is a ripe, fruity, creamy Chardonnay-based sparkler. It has a tropical fruit flavor, with some sweetness from both the fruit and the high dosage. It's in a full-bodied, attractive apéritif style.
title: Domaine Luquet NV Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: A soft earthy character adds depth to the strawberry and rhubarb fruit aromas and flavors. The palate is clean and bright, with a cocoa-dusted red-berry fruit finish.
title: Le Grand Noir 2010 Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: With its red berry flavor and touch of citrus, this is very fruity. It's attractive, crisp and open.
title: Roland Champion NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is made in a fruity style, with attractive red-fruit flavors. It is dry and laced with acidity. It has richness, a full body and refreshing final acidity.
title: Jaffelin NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is made in a fruity style, with attractive red-fruit flavors. It is dry and laced with acidity. It has richness, a full body and refreshing final acidity.
title: Jaffelin NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: From one of the many cru estates that are run by Beaujolais merchant Georges Duboeuf, this wine is smooth, generous and juicy. It has red-cherry fruit that is surrounded by some firm tannins as well as juicy acidity. Drink from late 2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine de Javernière  (Morgon)

description: From one of the many cru estates that are run by Beaujolais merchant Georges Duboeuf, this wine is smooth, generous and juicy. It has red-cherry fruit that is surrounded by some firm tannins as well as juicy acidity. Drink from late 2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine de Javernière  (Morgon)

description: From the south facing Côte du Py, this oak-aged wine is full of ripe fruit that is given a crisp edge by the acidity. Lightly textured, the wine is tight, mineral and likely to age. Jean-Ludovic Loron is the cru property's fifth generation. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Gaudets 2015 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: From the south facing Côte du Py, this oak-aged wine is full of ripe fruit that is given a crisp edge by the acidity. Lightly textured, the wine is tight, mineral and likely to age. Jean-Ludovic Loron is the cru property's fifth generation. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Gaudets 2015 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: Fruity and juicy, this is an immediately attractive cru wine. With its ripe berry fruits and soft tannins, it has a good depth of flavor that gives it richness. The wine, with its crisp fruitiness, is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Combe au Loup 2015  Régnié
winery: Domaine de la Combe au Loup

description: This is a finely balanced wine, combining an herbaceous flavor with apricot and sweet pear. The whole is a delicious wine that brings together notes of toast and fresh fruit, with a firm, dry structure. For long-term aging.
title: Château Pape Clément 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: An impeccable wine, this is so finely balanced between its rich fruits and structure. With its seamless character, it offers both fine acidity, green and white fruit and an undertow of wood aging. This is a wine for long-term aging.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: An impeccable wine, this is so finely balanced between its rich fruits and structure. With its seamless character, it offers both fine acidity, green and white fruit and an undertow of wood aging. This is a wine for long-term aging.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: In the oxidative style that is so special to the Jura, this blend of Chardonnay and Savagnin is distinctive. With almond, apricot and yeast flavors, it is dry, a food wine although also, like a fino Sherry, good as an apéritif.
title: Domaine Rolet Père et Fils 2007 Tradition White (Arbois)

description: In the oxidative style that is so special to the Jura, this blend of Chardonnay and Savagnin is distinctive. With almond, apricot and yeast flavors, it is dry, a food wine although also, like a fino Sherry, good as an apéritif.
title: Domaine Rolet Père et Fils 2007 Tradition White (Arbois)

description: Can you guess what the S stands for? The nose is tarry and intense, full of black olives, plum and espresso. Yup, it's Syrah. Full-bodied and velvety, but with a firm core and a rich, layered finish. It's fine now, but try to hold some until 2016 and possibly as late as 2020.
title: Domaine Coudoulis 2010 Cuvée S Red (Lirac)

description: A rich wine in which the firm Tannat character dominates, giving great character, black plum flavors, a dense structure and generous tannins. All these join in a wine that's as much about elegance as power. Drink from 2017.
title: Château d'Aydie 2012 Aydie L'Origine Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: Old vines give a solid structure for this firm wine that is concentrated and dense. With wood aging and rich berry fruits, it's a complex wine with a good future. The black currant and berry fruits have a fresh character as well as great acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Richard Rottiers 2013  Moulin-à-Vent

description: This is a dark, plush Saint-Joseph, not an edgy, wiry, herb-scented version. Superripe plum and licorice notes are framed by soft tannins and hints of baking spices, but the wine' essential Syrah nature comes through on the dusty pepper-and-anise finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Delas Frères 2011 François de Tournon  (Saint-Joseph)

description: The top of the range from Château Ponzac, this is, as its alcohol suggests, pretty powerful. Almost black in color, it's a solid, chunky wine that still has its youthful tannins. Black fruits, berries and damsons are layered with wood and fruit tannins, giving a dense and concentrated character. It needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Ponzac 2012 Eternellement Malbec (Cahors)

description: A blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah, this is a full-bodied, plush example of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Cracked pepper, licorice and crushed stone fold gently into layers of plummy fruit, then finish with a lingering note of mocha. Drink now–2020 or so.
title: Château Gigognan 2010 Close du Roi Grenache-Syrah (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah, this is a full-bodied, plush example of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Cracked pepper, licorice and crushed stone fold gently into layers of plummy fruit, then finish with a lingering note of mocha. Drink now–2020 or so.
title: Château Gigognan 2010 Close du Roi Grenache-Syrah (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A parcel of old vines has yielded this concentrated wine that has great depth of flavor, very ripe berry fruits and juicy acidity. It's smoky with fresh ground coffee flavors, and a touch of licorice. Still young, it's a wine for aging, so don't drink before 2019.
title: Château de Gaudou 2011 Réserve Caillau Malbec (Cahors)

description: At the hands of Pierre Laplace, Tannat becomes smooth, rounded and shapely. It of course has tannins, but these are at the service of the rich fruit and the balanced acidity. The wine is full of character, a medley of fruit along with an elegant structure. It's going to develop well, so drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Aydie 2012 Madiran Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: This is a refreshing picnic wine with light acidity, touches of pears and some sweetness. Its low alcohol makes it great for summer sunshine.
title: Louis Perdrier NV Brut Excellence Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: Very much in the style of the light whites of Gascony, this is crisp with apple and grapefruit flavor, herbaceous and clean as a whistle. It's ready to drink, but keep a few months if you'd like a softer character. Screwcap.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2012 La Réserve Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Pascal Bouchard's entry-level Chablis is a wine that is tank fermented, preserving its great fruitiness. The wine is certainly full of lemon, pear and orange-zest flavors. With its forward fruitiness it can be drunk now, but should hold well through 2019.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2012 Le Classique  (Chablis)

description: There seems to be too much wood here which is smothering the fruit. Given that, the wine does have weight and as the wood softens, the juicy fruit flavors should come through. Wait to drink until 2016. But it will always be austere.
title: Château la Croix Margautot 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: From the far east of the Bordeaux vineyards, this is a soft wine that is already drinkable. It has red berry fruits, fresh acidity and a lightly tannic structure. Drink now and until 2016.
title: Château La Barotte 2011  Bordeaux

description: A tight, stalky wine, showing black currant and dark plum fruits, intense acidity and a dry, tannic character. It feels light, without great density, very up front and fruity.
title: Château de Cornemps 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A pale onion-skin color sets the stage for this light, fresh and fruity wine. It has red-fruit flavors, lively acidity and a soft, ready-to-drink character. Refreshing without great depths.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Authentique Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The epitome of Grand Cru Chablis, this is mineral and fruit driven—impressive both from its richness and its tense structure. The power comes from the depth of flavor that brings the texture right through the wine. Age for 5–7 years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: The epitome of Grand Cru Chablis, this is mineral and fruit driven—impressive both from its richness and its tense structure. The power comes from the depth of flavor that brings the texture right through the wine. Age for 5–7 years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Using grapes sourced from the greatest white-wine vineyard in Burgundy, this is huge, dense, very rich and complex. The balance already shows in the wine's acidity, ripe yellow fruit and round texture. Wood aging brings notes of spice and toast. This will age for many years.
title: Louis Latour 2010  Montrachet

description: Richly structured, this wine is all texture at this stage—although the rich fruit lingers underneath. Apple, pear and citrus fruits give this opulent, powerful wine its freshness. This has a great future ahead.
title: Louis Latour 2010  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Richly structured, this wine is all texture at this stage—although the rich fruit lingers underneath. Apple, pear and citrus fruits give this opulent, powerful wine its freshness. This has a great future ahead.
title: Louis Latour 2010  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Big, rich and powerful, this uses grapes sourced from a small section of the Corton hill that's close to Charlemagne. It has the ripe pineapple and apricot flavors to go with the acidity. With its enormous concentration, this is ready to age over at least 10 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010  Corton Vergennes

description: Made from grapes sourced from vines planted in 1902, this is a huge, powerful, minerally wine. It's currently tight as a drum, with solid tannins and great density that pair with ripe plum and wood flavors. The acidity that appears on the finish promises long-term aging.
designation: La Richemonne Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010 La Richemonne Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Made from grapes sourced from vines planted in 1902, this is a huge, powerful, minerally wine. It's currently tight as a drum, with solid tannins and great density that pair with ripe plum and wood flavors. The acidity that appears on the finish promises long-term aging.
designation: La Richemonne Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010 La Richemonne Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Christophe Perrot-Minot makes this wine from a parcel of the vineyard that is declassified grand cru. It's opulent and generous, yet it's also minerally and fresh. The sumptuous Chambolle feel is still to come as the wine rounds out and loses its youthful tannins. Age for at least seven years.
designation: La Combe d'Orveau Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010 La Combe d'Orveau Cuvée Ultra Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: Structured and minerally, this has citrus fruits that sit prominently over the tight acidity. A vanilla note is there to round the wine out. The crisp fruits and steely acids are intense and impressively balanced. Age for at least 5 years. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Laroche 2010 Les Blanchots Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a ripe Pinot Noir, with a firm and solid structure and a very dense character. It has concentration and a great depth of flavor; the blacks fruits and tannins cut into the heart of the wine. Age for at least seven years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009  Clos de Vougeot

description: This is a ripe Pinot Noir, with a firm and solid structure and a very dense character. It has concentration and a great depth of flavor; the blacks fruits and tannins cut into the heart of the wine. Age for at least seven years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009  Clos de Vougeot

description: Big and showy, with an ripe, opulent feel, this is all about dark fruits and firm tannins. Flavors of black cherries and plums are balanced by the acidity, all rolled together into a structure that's powerful and seriously age-worthy.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2009  Chambertin Clos de Bèze

description: This is a deeply rich, very impressive wine from a great white-wine vintage. It's concentrated with the essence of pure Chardonnay. It has tension along with a full texture. Age it for at least 10 years.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010  Chevalier-Montrachet

description: This is a deeply rich, very impressive wine from a great white-wine vintage. It's concentrated with the essence of pure Chardonnay. It has tension along with a full texture. Age it for at least 10 years.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010  Chevalier-Montrachet

description: This is taut and mineral, with hidden power. It's very closed at this stage. It's a wine with acidity and notes of green fruits and crisp apples, with just a touch of wood. This will age for many years.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2010 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Powerful and concentrated, this has an intense expression of ripe tropical fruits. The wood shows strongly at this stage, although with this amount of richness, it has the weight and the power to develop well over many years.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Rich, yet always elegant, this has a raspberry flavor and terrific acidity that creates tension, contrasting with the opulent fruit. While it's structured, it will soften and round out over the next five years.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2010  Mazis-Chambertin

description: This is big, muscular and very opulent, with its density lying over its minerality. Flavors of black stone fruits and red berries have the intensity of a powerful, age-worthy wine.
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010  Charmes-Chambertin

description: Sweet, yes, but not intensely so, more a sweet apéritif sweet wine for blue cheese or ham. The botrytis gives the wine a drier character, while the honey element leads straight into citrus.
title: Domaine Bellegarde 2008 Cuvée Tradition  (Jurançon)

description: Eighteen months in wood have dried out the fruit, and now the wine needs time to come together. The black plum weight is here, with a rich potential to bring out the sweet, juicy flavors.
title: Château Cabredon 2007 Tradition  (Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Smooth and rounded, this exhibits the opulent side of Chablis while retaining an elegant structure. It has flavors of yellow and white fruits that combine with a nutty character, a mineral texture and a refreshing, crisp finish. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Beauroy Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Tannins and severe fruit flavors are the initial impressions of this wine. Behind the mineral, austere exterior, there is a richer, fatter core—its ripe red fruits waiting to surface. Keep for at least three years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010  Pommard

description: Light colored and fruity, this is all about red fruit—its structure and firm tannins coming out slowly. This village wine demonstrates the richness of the appellation, showing a fine balance between its ripe fruit and its smoky, dry, tannic core.
title: Joseph Faiveley 2010  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: Already a delicious wine, this has ripe yellow fruits, with notes of wood and spice adding complexity. The minerally acidity brings out the flavors of this ripe, structured effort.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2010  Puligny-Montrachet

description: Already a delicious wine, this has ripe yellow fruits, with notes of wood and spice adding complexity. The minerally acidity brings out the flavors of this ripe, structured effort.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2010  Puligny-Montrachet

description: On the mineral side of Meursault, the has a very textured feel, with acidity to go with the honey note. Finely balanced, warm and ripe, this has a crisp, tight finish.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009 Les Clous  (Meursault)

description: Intense acidity combines with spice and just the right amount of fresh fruitiness to give this lively wine that's full in the mouth. It's ripe and ready to drink.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Saint-Roch-les-Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is soft, gentle, ripely fruity and immediately drinkable. Fresh raspberry flavors are cut with acidity and lemon zest. It is fresh, balanced and full of flavor.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine Carambole Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is soft, gentle, ripely fruity and immediately drinkable. Fresh raspberry flavors are cut with acidity and lemon zest. It is fresh, balanced and full of flavor.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine Carambole Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is soft and gentle, with hints of strawberry fruits and freshness. It's light, but has a crisp and spicy aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2014 Passeport Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is soft and gentle, with hints of strawberry fruits and freshness. It's light, but has a crisp and spicy aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2014 Passeport Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Reuilly has the peculiarity of having rosés from Pinot Gris, even though its reds are from Pinot Noir. This perfumed wine with its pale color brings out the slightly dusty character of the grape. That's contrasted with the intense acidity and black currant fruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dyckerhoff 2014 Petit Gris Rosé (Reuilly)

description: Created in 1819, this vineyard surrounds a Victorian château overlooking the Loire. This wine is fruity, fresh and soft. It has attractive acidity, a light texture and perfumed acidity set in the context of apple and lime fruits. Drink now.
title: Château de Thauvenay 2014  Sancerre

description: Light and bright, this slightly textured wine is full of crisp green and citrus fruits. A great tang of acidity and freshness flows through this attractive wine. Drink now.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2014 Cuvée Le Charnay  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This crisp wine has a creamy background that presents an attractive blend of fresh apples with honey and lemon. It's a light, perfumed wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Cady 2014 Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: This crisp wine has a creamy background that presents an attractive blend of fresh apples with honey and lemon. It's a light, perfumed wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Cady 2014 Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: Produced from Pinot Gris, this is so crisp and fresh. It has light red currant flavors that give an intensely fruity character to this attractive wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Denis Jamain 2014 Rosé (Reuilly)

description: Produced from Pinot Gris, this is so crisp and fresh. It has light red currant flavors that give an intensely fruity character to this attractive wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Denis Jamain 2014 Rosé (Reuilly)

description: Very crisp and packed with fruit, this is an attractive, lightly mineral wine. It is fresh, full of green apples and lime, with a juicy apricot aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Les Milets Sauvignon Blanc (Reuilly)

description: Very crisp and packed with fruit, this is an attractive, lightly mineral wine. It is fresh, full of green apples and lime, with a juicy apricot aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Les Milets Sauvignon Blanc (Reuilly)

description: Light, creamy and fruity, this fresh, lightly mineral wine has plenty of fresh apple and citrus flavors. There is no suggestion of wood, and the wine is all about fresh fruit. Drink now.
title: Jacques Bourguigon 2013  Chablis

description: A mineral-driven wine with typical herbaceous flavors, some pineapple and peach fruit and a tangy, lemon-zest aftertaste. It's crisp and fresh, ready to drink now and over the next 2–3 years.
title: Langlois-Chateau 2011 Château de Fontaine-Audon  (Sancerre)

description: A ripe, perfumed Chinon. Red cherry, dried fruit and light spice are balanced by attractive acidity. This is a fruity, ready-to-drink wine, just hinting at tannins at the end.
title: Pichard & Jourdan 2009  Chinon

description: A broad, spicy wine, ripe with plenty of sweet mango and peach fruits to go with the green fruit acidity. It is already delicious but will develop further over the next 2–3 years.
title: Château de Chamirey 2008 La Mission Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Very textured wine, with apple skin tautness, followed by acidity, a touch of wood, and final spice. Attractive wine that could age for 1–2 years.
title: Marcel Couturier 2008 Aux Scelles  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Rich wine, full in the mouth, bringing wood and ripe apple flavors well together. Delicious.
title: Manuel Seguin 2008  Viré-Clessé

description: A smoothly textured wine, full and ripe, with great pear flavors, giving rich acidity as well as a texture that shows apricot skins and green plums.
title: Manuel Seguin 2008  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: A gorgeous and decadent Syrah with aromas and flavors of black raspberry, black cherry, fudge brownie and coffee ice cream. The lush and creamy mouth is full but not overdone, with a fantastic evolution on the palate from fresh dark fruit to sweet chocolaty flavors and finally pepper-flecked spice on the long finish. Balanced and read to drink now, though you could hold for another couple of years to mellow.
title: Laurent Miquel 2007 Nord Sud Syrah (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Rich, smooth, ripe flavors of wood with some pear and peach juice. Soft, but with good depth of flavor.
title: Jean Rijckaert 2008 Epinet  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Full in the mouth, well–structured, ripe wine, showing great bright white fruits, a vibrant acidity, layered with wood. Delicious.
title: Jean-Claude du Roure 2008  Mâcon-Fuissé

description: A concentrated and ripe wine, dominated by spicy wood and pineapple with creamed peach flavors. The texture is full, dense, very rich.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2008 Terra Incognita  (Saint-Véran)

description: Fine and fresh, brightened by grapefruit, lemon zest and bright acidity, this is a delicious wine, ready for seafood, finishing so clean and crisp.
title: Gilles Morat 2008 La Roche  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: 84-86 Barrel sample. With its gentle tannins and juicy fruit, this is on the fresh side, the jelly and blackcurrant flavors a hint.
title: Château Puy-Blanquet 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 84-86 Barrel sample. Definitely in the earthy style of Listrac, very tannin dominated, the fruit way behind that dry structure. It seems to have been over-extracted.
title: Château Fourcas Hosten 2008 Barrel sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: Brisk red-apple flavors govern nose and the crisp palate. A lemon backbone of freshness brightens everything. The finish is clean and appetizing.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2014 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Brisk red-apple flavors govern nose and the crisp palate. A lemon backbone of freshness brightens everything. The finish is clean and appetizing.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2014 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Green pear and soft citrus are the chief charms of this wine. The palate is clean, dry and easy to drink. It's a good all-rounder for a party.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2014 Vieilles Vignes Pinot Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: Light and fruity, the wine comes from the sandy soils of the Camargue Rhône-delta region, known for its rugged, indigenous horses. The wine is crisp with acidity and has a bright touch of red currants. The wine is dry, refreshing for an apéritif.
title: Domaine Royal de Jarras 2015 Pink Flamingo Rosé (Sable de Camargue)

description: Earthy notes of pear peel promise texture and the very crisp, bright palate delivers, but with edges of bitterness. The finish is wonderfully brisk. This wine will do so much better with food.
title: Domaine Pfister 2013 Cuvée 8 White (Alsace)

description: This is an attractive fruity wine with citrus fruits and a tangy, zesty texture. The lightest hint of wood gives the wine extra richness. It is already drinkable.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014  Montagny

description: This wine has ripe red fruits, a touch of caramel and some spice. A definite mineral and tannic structure gives the wine a textured character. It needs food to show at its best.
title: Château Cantelaudette 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine has ripe red fruits, a touch of caramel and some spice. A definite mineral and tannic structure gives the wine a textured character. It needs food to show at its best.
title: Château Cantelaudette 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is structured and tight with minerality and zesty lemon flavors. It has a definite texture and a nervy character that needs to round out.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2014 Le Clos  (Marsannay)

description: This wine is structured and tight with minerality and zesty lemon flavors. It has a definite texture and a nervy character that needs to round out.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2014 Le Clos  (Marsannay)

description: This is a juicy, fruity wine with intense acidity. It has spice, berry fruit and some smoky tannins. The aftertaste is tangy, hinting at orange as well as red-currant fruits.
title: Domaine Collotte 2014 Combereau  (Marsannay)

description: A fresh, friendly and fruity apple scent on the nose is far more subdued on the fresh, clean palate. This is dry, lively and refreshing.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2014 Fraicheur Gourmande Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: A fresh, friendly and fruity apple scent on the nose is far more subdued on the fresh, clean palate. This is dry, lively and refreshing.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2014 Fraicheur Gourmande Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: A very soft, ripe and open wine that lacks structure. The best aspects are the finely judged wood element and the light acidity that floats at the end.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2007  Meursault

description: A soft, firm wine with a nice touch of citrus. The character is fresh, light, with a fine burst of final acidity to mark an easy, bright wine.
title: Pierre Morey 2007 Bourgogne Chardonnay  (Bourgogne)

description: Done in a clean and fresh style, this Pinot Gris has nice depth of flavor, with plenty of apricot and pear interest in the mouth. The fruit here is very healthy and the impression totally dry. Hazelnuts and just a touch of minerality linger on the finish.
designation: Domaines du Château de Riquewihr Les Maquisards
title: Dopff & Irion 2005 Domaines du Château de Riquewihr Les Maquisards Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Softly rich, a rounded wine that brings out ripe plums and sweet strawberry jam. The acidity only kicks in towards the end, as the tannins and final rich character offer contrast.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2006 Gravières Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Softly rich, a rounded wine that brings out ripe plums and sweet strawberry jam. The acidity only kicks in towards the end, as the tannins and final rich character offer contrast.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2006 Gravières Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: The crispest Aligoté, all grapefruit and bright green fruits. The wine is fresh, clean and lively. There is a final light element of wood.
title: Pierre Morey 2007 Bourgogne Aligoté  (Bourgogne)

description: With 30% Grenache Gris, 40% Bourboulenc and 30% Rolle (or Vermentino), here's a ripe, lush white blend from the South of France. Aromas of peach, roasted red apple, jasmine and a kiss of honey fill the bouquet, while the round, full mouthfeel shows more toasty cedar notes. A big, developed wine that has lots to offer.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2007 Château L'Hospitalet Reserve La Clape White (Languedoc)

description: The price makes this a relative bargain for a cuvée sourced from 100-year-old vines within Le Crau, one of the appellation's most renowned lieux-dits. Notions of leather, cedar and cocoa accent bright red-plum fruit in this full-bodied wine, adding a hint of cracked pepper on the richly textured finish.
title: Domaine la Boutinière 2013 Grande Réserve Vieilles Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: The price makes this a relative bargain for a cuvée sourced from 100-year-old vines within Le Crau, one of the appellation's most renowned lieux-dits. Notions of leather, cedar and cocoa accent bright red-plum fruit in this full-bodied wine, adding a hint of cracked pepper on the richly textured finish.
title: Domaine la Boutinière 2013 Grande Réserve Vieilles Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Produced from 40-year-old vines on a 15-acre vineyard, the wine is almost entirely Merlot. It has dense, dark tannins and signs of wood aging that will integrate with time. It is a very fine, rich wine with black-plum fruit flavors. The aftertaste brings out the acidity and black currant fruits.
title: Clos Beauregard 2014  Pomerol

description: Produced from 40-year-old vines on a 15-acre vineyard, the wine is almost entirely Merlot. It has dense, dark tannins and signs of wood aging that will integrate with time. It is a very fine, rich wine with black-plum fruit flavors. The aftertaste brings out the acidity and black currant fruits.
title: Clos Beauregard 2014  Pomerol

description: Produced on a small family-run estate that is surrounded by Bordeaux first growths, this wine is structured and firm. It has dark tannins and black currant fruit, together giving a ripe, smoky wine. The 40-year-old vines add to the concentration of this wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Gaudin 2012  Pauillac

description: Produced on a small family-run estate that is surrounded by Bordeaux first growths, this wine is structured and firm. It has dark tannins and black currant fruit, together giving a ripe, smoky wine. The 40-year-old vines add to the concentration of this wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Gaudin 2012  Pauillac

description: Still with its youthful structure and tannins, this is going to be a classically ripe Médoc, all black currant fruits and dry tannins. But to give it weight, there is a rich streak of black plum skin, followed by a tight, dark finish.
title: Château les Ormes Sorbet 2006  Médoc

description: Made by the winemaking team at Cos d'Estournel, this is a very soft, generous wine that burst with fruit in the mouth. The structure is easy, gently tannic but not more. The pleasure is from the sweet fruit.
title: Goulée 2006  Médoc

description: Dense and complex, with plum and black licorice notes upfront, followed by cherry and peat moss in the mouth. Gripping tannins and intense mineral notes are cut a bit short by warm alcohol on the finish. Nevertheless, an impressive effort. Drink now to 2010.
title: Domaine de Saint-Antoine 2006 Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft and balanced, this seems to have missed the potential when tasted as a barrel sample. It is maturing quickly, the tannins are soft, delicate. It is turning into an easy wine for drinking soon.
title: Château Monbrison 2006  Margaux

description: A beautifully crisp wine, very mineral, with its citrus and green apple flavors given a fine texture of bright acidity. It is still so young, with just a hint of toast to show some maturity. The finish is shockingly fresh.
title: Billecart-Salmon 1999 Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A beautifully crisp wine, very mineral, with its citrus and green apple flavors given a fine texture of bright acidity. It is still so young, with just a hint of toast to show some maturity. The finish is shockingly fresh.
title: Billecart-Salmon 1999 Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is an intense rosé, pushing forward the pink fruit flavors, the rich texture and red berry fruits. Dry, still youthful, it has considerable acidity and a complex and concentrated mélange of flavors. Age for 3–5 years.
title: Louis Roederer 2006 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This ultrarich, opulent wine has such purity of fruit. With its pepper and spice flavors layered over mango and ripe nectarine, it is a straight line of pure flavor, rich and complex.
designation: Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Hints of smokiness combine with a perfumed character in this wonderful wine. It has richness, with lychee and spice flavors, while adding the extra complexity of a touch of toast and green tea. Wonderful now, but will age for five years and more.
designation: Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Very pure Chardonnay from the heart of the Côte de Blancs. It has all the minerality of the vintage while also boasting tropical fruit flavors. It's already a delicious wine, with its tight edge of acidity, but could certainly age.
title: Jacquesson et Fils 2002 Avize Champ Gain Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Initially, the acidity shoots through this wine. Then it reveals equally intense honey and spice flavors. The wine is complex, with yellow fruits laced with nutmeg and finished with a tender, crisp aftertaste. It is never too sweet, a beautifully balanced wine in which all the elements play their part.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Turckheim Clos Jebsal Vendanges Tardive Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Initially, the acidity shoots through this wine. Then it reveals equally intense honey and spice flavors. The wine is complex, with yellow fruits laced with nutmeg and finished with a tender, crisp aftertaste. It is never too sweet, a beautifully balanced wine in which all the elements play their part.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Turckheim Clos Jebsal Vendanges Tardive Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: From one of the few Chardonnay vineyards in Dizy, this is a tight wine, with a steely character, very crisp and citric. Even at nine years age, it tastes young, structured, demanding aging.
title: Jacquesson et Fils 2002 Dizy Corne Bautray Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A small plot of old Pinot Noir produces this superb wine. It has all the richness of wines from Aÿ, with its red fruits and hint of sweetness. But it is the structure, the complexity that sets it apart, the grapes ripe and concentrated from a great year. Age for at least another five years.
title: Jacquesson et Fils 2002 Aÿ Vauzelle Terre Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Yeasty aromas lead to a wine that is bright with crisp apples and soft lemon-juice flavors. There is a hint of white bread roll, which rounds it out.
title: Grandial NV Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: The natural honeyed character of Chenin Blanc shines through this simple, fruity wine. It has bright acidity and a creamed pear character that finishes with lime acidity. Screwcap.
title: Château Gaudrelle 2011 Le Petit Chenin No 11 Chenin Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Classic, medium sweet rosé from Anjou, bottled cherry flavors and lemon acidity. Screwcap.
title: Bougrier 2011  Rosé d'Anjou

description: Light, fruity and sweet, this is classic Rosé d'Anjou. Bright strawberry fruits are softly linked with a crisp texture and acidity to finish.
title: Barton & Guestier 2011  Rosé d'Anjou

description: Bone dry, but soft, this is a complete, rounded Champagne. It has plenty of the Chardonnay mineral character, with fine citrus zest and tight acidity. It is nowhere near mature, so keep for another two years. Impressive.
designation: Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pascal Doquet 1998 Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Thirteen years on, this is still not remotely mature. It is a major wine, with its still-tight, vibrant acidity and wonderful piercing grapefruit flavors. The acidity of the vintage is all there, but the strength of this Champagne is that the acidity is finely balanced with minerality and fruit.
designation: Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pascal Doquet 1996 Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Thirteen years on, this is still not remotely mature. It is a major wine, with its still-tight, vibrant acidity and wonderful piercing grapefruit flavors. The acidity of the vintage is all there, but the strength of this Champagne is that the acidity is finely balanced with minerality and fruit.
designation: Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pascal Doquet 1996 Le Mesnil sur Oger Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Rich and creamy, this wine has weight as well as the hallmark freshness of 2007. The yellow fruits and spicy pear flavors are smoothed out with spice, with some herbaceous elements and a fine waft of apple skin structure. Worth aging for 3–4 years. Screwcap.
title: Château la Louvière 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is rich, but the balance of the wine is excellent, the wood very much underneath the smooth, opulent apricot and pear fruits. There is spice, which adds a fine piquancy to the texture. The finish is vivid, still young, needing at least five years to age.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: Finely balanced, this has plenty of weight, which shines with the fresh lemon, pear and sweet grapefruit flavors. There is some wood there, but just a hint to give texture. A big success from a fine white wine vintage, and worth aging for 3–4 years.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: A ripe, dry wine with delicious mature fruit, touched by wood from barrel fermentation. Grapefruit, almonds, some yeastiness all give complexity, as does the acidity that follows this intense wine right through to the finish.
title: Alfred Gratien NV Cuvée Paradis Brut  (Champagne)

description: This takes the color rosé to an extreme. Almost white, with only the palest hint of color, it comes from 80-year-old Grenache vines. That creates what little concentration this light and delicate wine has. There is an attractive spicy herbal character that lies at the back of this fruity wine.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2016 VieVité Extraordinaire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fallen from the sky is the name of this wine, alongside a child's drawing of a spaceship. The wine itself is more earthbound, soft and with forward ripe fruitiness. Red berries and plums are right up there alongside plenty of acidity. Drink this easy wine now.
title: L'Enclos des Braves 2016 Tombé du Ciel Red (Gaillac)

description: Fallen from the sky is the name of this wine, alongside a child's drawing of a spaceship. The wine itself is more earthbound, soft and with forward ripe fruitiness. Red berries and plums are right up there alongside plenty of acidity. Drink this easy wine now.
title: L'Enclos des Braves 2016 Tombé du Ciel Red (Gaillac)

description: This wine is dominated by Grenache, which makes up 80% of the blend. That gives the spice and pepper edge as well as bringing out delicious red-berry fruits and crisp acidity. The wine, with its bright aftertaste,is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine des Mapliers 2016 Préferences Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a warm rounded wine, very approachable with raspberry and damson flavors and crisp acidity. Well balanced, with a lively fruity aftertaste, it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2016 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a warm rounded wine, very approachable with raspberry and damson flavors and crisp acidity. Well balanced, with a lively fruity aftertaste, it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2016 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Delicious jammy red fruits are the hallmark of this ripe wine. It is still young although it has great fruitiness and a juicy black-currant character. The wine is open, generous and likely to be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaine de Cause 2014 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a tangy, fruity wine, with orange and spice flavors. It is rich and full of citrusy acidity, with a tight structure. The wine needs a few more months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Chevalier de Lafoux Sainte Anne 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A blend of 50% Grenache and 50% Cinsault from the 50-year-old Pointe de Diable vineyard, this is a soft and ripe wine. It has light acidity and rich red-berry fruits. It's a wine for apéritif drinking—gentle and fruity at the end (the road to the property is called “End of the World”). Drink now.
title: Château Malherbe 2016 Pointe du Diable Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pierres Blanches (white stones) constitute the soil of this parcel. That gives a strongly textured, mineral character, as well as allowing room for the ripe apple and citrus flavors. The wine is rich, rounded and will age. Drink from 2016.
designation: Les Pierres Blanches Gneiss Sur Lie
title: Domaine Luneau-Papin 2013 Les Pierres Blanches Gneiss Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Pierres Blanches (white stones) constitute the soil of this parcel. That gives a strongly textured, mineral character, as well as allowing room for the ripe apple and citrus flavors. The wine is rich, rounded and will age. Drink from 2016.
designation: Les Pierres Blanches Gneiss Sur Lie
title: Domaine Luneau-Papin 2013 Les Pierres Blanches Gneiss Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A freshly herbaceous wine, a reminder of how crisp, grassy and refreshing white Bordeaux can be. This has a lively green and white fruit character, all vibrant acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Bel Air Perponcher 2006  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A freshly herbaceous wine, a reminder of how crisp, grassy and refreshing white Bordeaux can be. This has a lively green and white fruit character, all vibrant acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Bel Air Perponcher 2006  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Finesse is a wine created to exhibit elegance, showing restrained fruits, poised tannins and plenty of the trademark 2004 fresh acidity.
title: Château de Portets 2004 Finesse de Portets  (Graves)

description: A blend from Puligny-Montrachet and Meursault, this is a soft rounded wine with white fruit acidity, almond flavors and a gentle lemon zest texture. Drink in the next two years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2009 Les Sétilles  (Bourgogne)

description: Mint flavors reflect the new wood aging in this smooth, ripe wine. It has a fine structure, ample acidity and blackberry fruit. This textured, structured wine is ready for 4–6 years of aging.
title: Château la Croix de Roche 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine shows extraction, new wood and firm tannins. What it also has is the fruit weight to sustain all this. Given 4–5 years, the wine's richness and smoky flavors will come together with the black currant fruit.
title: Château Darzac 2011 Heritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Big, dense and complex, this is still young. It has the weight of tannin as well as dark fruits offering a rich and ageworthy structure. As it opens, the wine is packed with dried fruits, licorice and dark coffee. This is a wine for keeping at least four more years.
title: Château le Raz 2006  Montravel

description: Some Banyuls can be pruny, but this version from the Rhône-based firm of Chapoutier is remarkably fresh. The wine's sweet, plummy fruit features herbal touches on the nose, but also enough cocoa-like flavors to pair with chocolate and a softly dusty texture to the finish.
title: M. Chapoutier 2003 Vin Doux Naturel  (Banyuls)

description: A big, smooth, ripe wine, with rich raspberry-jam flavors and just gently dry tannins. This blend of Merlot with some Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon comes from vineyards 1,500 feet in the Limoux hills, yet it has the richness of a wine from warmer climate. Wood and spices add interest and richness.
title: Château d'Antugnac 2005 Aux Bons Hommes Red (Limoux)

description: This is the second wine of Clerc Milon from an exceptional year. With the soft richness of the vintage, its tannins are velvety and ripe. Blackberry fruits and mint shine through the smoky edge of tannins to give a wine that has both generous fruits and a tight end that brings in bright acidity. It is just ready to drink, although it will be better from 2017.
title: Château Clerc Milon 2009 Pastourelle de Clerc Milon  (Pauillac)

description: This is a structured wine that shows class and finesse. It has rich juicy blackberry flavors that are supported by some firm tannins and a dense texture. The wine is ready to drink for its fruitiness, although it will be better from 2019.
title: Maison Malet Roquefort 2012 Les Hauts de la Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This is a structured wine that shows class and finesse. It has rich juicy blackberry flavors that are supported by some firm tannins and a dense texture. The wine is ready to drink for its fruitiness, although it will be better from 2019.
title: Maison Malet Roquefort 2012 Les Hauts de la Gaffelière  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Young and fruity, this is fresh, with some tangy lemon flavors from aging on the lees. It has a good depth of apple and green plum flavors. This is a delicious wine to drink now.
designation: Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2014 Domaine de la Tourmaline Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: For the vintage, which generally provided rather ripe fruit, this is a bit tight and stiffly tannic. The cherry cobbler aromas and flavors are certainly pleasurable, but finish crisp and firm. Give it a few years in the cellar, and drink 2017–2023.
title: Louis Bernard 2012 Les Carbonnières  (Gigondas)

description: For the vintage, which generally provided rather ripe fruit, this is a bit tight and stiffly tannic. The cherry cobbler aromas and flavors are certainly pleasurable, but finish crisp and firm. Give it a few years in the cellar, and drink 2017–2023.
title: Louis Bernard 2012 Les Carbonnières  (Gigondas)

description: This wine is ripe, full in the mouth and rich. With grapefruit tanginess and crisp apple richness, it is generous with its fruits and texture. Like many wines from this appellation, it needs to age, so drink from 2016.
title: Hubert Veneau 2014  Pouilly-Fumé

description: This wine is ripe, full in the mouth and rich. With grapefruit tanginess and crisp apple richness, it is generous with its fruits and texture. Like many wines from this appellation, it needs to age, so drink from 2016.
title: Hubert Veneau 2014  Pouilly-Fumé

description: A pretty shallot-skin pink, this fruity, crisp wine has red cherry freshness and a bright level of acidity. With its light mineral texture, it is obviously a food rosé.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul Balland 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Light and fresh, this is an apple-crisp wine with delicious acidity and a refreshing lemon tang. A finely textured character gives shape to the wine and supports the crunchy fruit. Drink this wine now.
title: Domaine du Haut Bourg 2014 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: This ripe, wood-aged wine has fragrant red-cherry flavors and good acidity. It's still young, so it does have some bitterness, although the rich fruits and structure all point to a good future. Drink from 2017.
title: Chavet Fils 2013 Cuvée Exception  (Menetou-Salon)

description: With ripe berry fruits, this smooth wine has a layer of balanced tannins. It is structured, jammy in character, full of black currant flavors and final acidity. Drink from 2016. The château's history goes back to the 14th century and became a ruin after the 1789 Revolution. It was completely restored after World War II.
title: Château Timberlay 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wood aging shows in this wine, giving a smoky, spicy character. It has softened the crisp fruits and allowed the wine to broaden out with ripe berry fruits. Solid and dense, it will need to age so drink from 2017.
title: Château Peuy Saincrit 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This white blend—an assemblage of Clairette (40%), Bourboulenc (30%), Grenache Blanc (20%) and Ugni Blanc (10%)—is geared toward maximum freshness. It's flinty up front, with fruity notes reminiscent of citrus and fennel fronds that are bright, clean and zippy on the finish.
title: Château Pégau 2014 Cuvée Lône White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This white blend—an assemblage of Clairette (40%), Bourboulenc (30%), Grenache Blanc (20%) and Ugni Blanc (10%)—is geared toward maximum freshness. It's flinty up front, with fruity notes reminiscent of citrus and fennel fronds that are bright, clean and zippy on the finish.
title: Château Pégau 2014 Cuvée Lône White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: There is a mineral texture to this wine with its blend of almost equal Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon. It is tight, structured and needs to age with its crisp acidity and warmer tropical fruits. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Galès 2014  Graves

description: There is a mineral texture to this wine with its blend of almost equal Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon. It is tight, structured and needs to age with its crisp acidity and warmer tropical fruits. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Galès 2014  Graves

description: There is a ripe and smoky character to this wine aged 12 months in French oak. A rich background of plums and berry fruits steadies the tannins. The wine is balanced and will be ready to drink from 2017. The Gonfrier brothers' 94 acres are certified “Haute Valeur Environmentale” (High Environmental Value).
title: Château de Marsan 2013  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: With fine tannins, ripe berry fruits and a good cut of acidity, this is an attractive wine that deserves some aging. It has weight along with its strawberry and red currant flavors. Drink from 2016. Made by UNIVITIS Producers.
title: Château Bellevue 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A firmly structured wine, this has a dry character that's underscored by red fruit and balancing acidity. It needs to age for a few years to be at its best.
title: Moillard 2010 Clos du Meix Trouhans  (Fixin)

description: Round and soft, this warm wine from the southern end of the Côte de Beaune feels rich and generous. It has caramel and yellow fruit flavors, and its crisp acidity will ensure that it will remain fresh and fruity.
title: Jaffelin 2010 Passetemps Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Round and soft, this warm wine from the southern end of the Côte de Beaune feels rich and generous. It has caramel and yellow fruit flavors, and its crisp acidity will ensure that it will remain fresh and fruity.
title: Jaffelin 2010 Passetemps Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: This is a lightweight Chambolle that's dominated by red fruit and acidity. There is a bitter edge that comes from the wood and the firm structure of the vintage. However, with its attractive, juicy finish, it is already soft enough to drink.
title: Jaffelin 2010  Chambolle-Musigny

description: This wine is solid, concentrated and tannic, and it has a dark chocolate flavor from having aged in wood. It's likely to develop into a chunky wine over the next few years.
title: Jaffelin 2009  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: This wine is solid, concentrated and tannic, and it has a dark chocolate flavor from having aged in wood. It's likely to develop into a chunky wine over the next few years.
title: Jaffelin 2009  Nuits-St.-Georges

description: There is just pure fruitiness here, a Chardonnay that is light and fresh although with some creamy richness behind it. It's softly textured, a warm wine with a vanilla hint at the end.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2012 Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: There is just pure fruitiness here, a Chardonnay that is light and fresh although with some creamy richness behind it. It's softly textured, a warm wine with a vanilla hint at the end.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2012 Chardonnay (Val de Loire)
