description: This ripe wine offers yellow fruit and a generous texture. A touch of pepper accompanies the acidity, fruits and full-bodied structure. Drink this rich wine from 2017.
title: Domaine d'Alzipratu 2015 Pumonte White

description: This ripe wine offers yellow fruit and a generous texture. A touch of pepper accompanies the acidity, fruits and full-bodied structure. Drink this rich wine from 2017.
title: Domaine d'Alzipratu 2015 Pumonte White

description: The wine is completely mature. With soft strawberry flavors that have melded into the rounded texture, this is a wine that has only the lightest tannins. Acidity and an attractive ripe fruit character make this a wine to enjoy now.
title: Domaine Julie Belland 2011 Beauregard Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: The wine is completely mature. With soft strawberry flavors that have melded into the rounded texture, this is a wine that has only the lightest tannins. Acidity and an attractive ripe fruit character make this a wine to enjoy now.
title: Domaine Julie Belland 2011 Beauregard Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Nicely mature, this is a ripe red-fruit and spice-flavored wine. Soft tannins merge with the fruit to give a wine that is balanced with a fragrant, juicy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2010 Cuvée La Grange Dimière  (Sancerre)

description: Medium-pink in color, this looks immediately vibrant and fruity. Scents of mealy plum, berry and watermelon fill the bouquet, while the palate offers more austere flavors of red currant and sour pomegranate. Tart and sharp in acidity, the finish is short and brisk.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2013 Rosé (Languedoc)

description: Calling on the inspiration or mysticism of the figure 7, grower Didier Pelvillain has introduced this version, one in a range of three. This wine is balanced between juicy acidity and firm, dark tannins. The black plum fruit flavors are still in the background as it develops. Give this wine time to fill out and start drinking from 2018.
title: Pelvillain Frères 2014 Inspiration 7.5 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Firm and stalky, this wine has intense black currant fruitiness. A dry tannic core is balanced by the fresh fruits and acidity. It's almost too fruity at the moment and needs to soften, so wait until 2016.
title: Château La Mothe du Barry 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: While the wine certainly has structure, its main character, from the dominant Merlot, is the juicy, stalky fruit and jammy, ripe black plums. It does have an edge of bitter chocolate and a layer of wood. When that softens, it will be a ripe, broad wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Roquebrune 2011 Cuvée Reine  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: While the wine certainly has structure, its main character, from the dominant Merlot, is the juicy, stalky fruit and jammy, ripe black plums. It does have an edge of bitter chocolate and a layer of wood. When that softens, it will be a ripe, broad wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Roquebrune 2011 Cuvée Reine  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: The wine is full and ripe, generous both in its black fruits and its tannins. It's rich, juicy and packed with berry fruits, a touch of wood and a mineral texture showing at the end. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Bordes-Quancard 2011  Bordeaux

description: Totally herbaceous and crisp, this is a rich, citrus-flavored wine. Grapefruit flavors dominate with a twist of lemon on top, giving a zesty texture that shows a young wine. For it to calm down and broaden out, wait until the end of 2015.
title: Château Bertinerie 2013 Grande Cuvée  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This lively wine revels in its red fruits. It is tight, tangy and packed with fresh flavors, with just the right amount of weight and dryness to put it firmly on the table with food.
title: Château Boisson 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A blend of Grenache, Cinsault and Carignan, this offering is very citrusy upfront, filled with grapefruit aromas. It's light to medium in weight, with flavors reminiscent of tangerines and hints of strawberries and something vaguely vegetal on the finish.
title: Jules 2007 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This ripe and rounded wine features soft tannins and generous fruitiness. Cherries dominate along with juicy plums, all cut by acidity. An edge of tannins give weight and a concentrated feel. Drink now, but even better wait until 2015.
title: Lucien Lardy 2013 Vignes de 1951  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This wine is so well balanced. It has all the right fruitiness that's filled out by a rich texture, apricot acidity and some spice. Wait a few months to really enjoy this ripe and full-bodied wine.
title: Lucien Lardy 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: From the slopes of Côte de Py, this is a solid, powerful wine with dark tannins and a firm, still young structure. Cherry and plum fruits give weight. It's still developing, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2013 Le Py  (Morgon)

description: This is a blend mainly of the local Loin de l'Oeil with a touch of Sauvignon. Together they give a rich, while balanced wine, allowing acidity to keep the luscious peach, pear and honey flavors crisp and fragrant. Drink now, but the wine will age well.
title: Domaine Rotier 2011 Les Gravels White (Gaillac Doux)

description: An impressive, balanced wine that brings out the ripeness of Malbec and then keeps it in check with judicious wood aging and layers of acidity. It's concentrated while elegant, and will develop delicious black fruits as it ages. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Cèdre 2011 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Moët & Chandon's new prestige cuvée is a remarkable blend of three different styles of wine: young and fresh, wood aged and bottle aged. The oldest wine in this blend dates from 1993. It's superb—more wine than bubbles—with a patina of maturity that is also so fresh. Toast and crisp apples make a wonderful pair of flavors. It is complex, ripe and unforgettable.
title: Moët & Chandon NV MC III Brut  (Champagne)

description: Faint aromas of melon rind, yellow flower and honeycomb lead into the ripe palate of yellow apple and mealy peach. Pithy citrus notes unfold on the surprisingly bitter finish.
title: Paul Bouchard & Cie NV White (Vin de France)

description: Sweet oak aromas of vanilla extract, pencil shaving and cocoa butter flood the nose, overshadowing any pure fruit character. Soft and broad in texture, it has plum spice and sweet wood flavors that fade fast on the close.
title: Le Val 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: Initial medicinal notes of cherry cough syrup partner with scents of cherry Jolly Rancher and red rope licorice. The smooth, slick palate feels overdone, offering more of those sweet red-fruit flavors, but it finishes fast.
title: L'original French Kiss NV Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: Initial medicinal notes of cherry cough syrup partner with scents of cherry Jolly Rancher and red rope licorice. The smooth, slick palate feels overdone, offering more of those sweet red-fruit flavors, but it finishes fast.
title: L'original French Kiss NV Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: An assertive medicinal character dominates the bouquet of this wine, with secondary notes of overripe red berries and strawberry. A fruit leather and Jolly Rancher-like quality overwhelms the palate, while the finish is surprisingly sharp and short.
title: Pierre Moulin NV Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: A good value in the world of Zind-Humbrecht wines, this off-dry Gewürztraminer is super-concentrated, with a silky texture and flavors of lychees and cling peaches. A nice white cherry accent kicks in on the medium finish. Try with Thai fare.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2007 Turckheim Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A good value in the world of Zind-Humbrecht wines, this off-dry Gewürztraminer is super-concentrated, with a silky texture and flavors of lychees and cling peaches. A nice white cherry accent kicks in on the medium finish. Try with Thai fare.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2007 Turckheim Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This striking Provence white opens with intense aromatics of mixed nuts and peach that set the stage for a powerful expression of crushed flowers and grass in the mouth. This is a refreshing wine, but weighty and warm; try with veal or light pork dishes. Drink now to 2011.
title: Château Paradis 2008 Terre des Anges White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This single-vineyard wine is ripe, toasty and already delicious. With a honeyed aroma, wood-aging spice and rich apricot and almond flavors, it is full of character. The acidity and mineral texture show it will age. Drink from late 2018.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Les Chaniots Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: This single-vineyard wine is ripe, toasty and already delicious. With a honeyed aroma, wood-aging spice and rich apricot and almond flavors, it is full of character. The acidity and mineral texture show it will age. Drink from late 2018.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Les Chaniots Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: Full and rich, this single-estate wine is generous and ripe. Spice and yellow-fruit flavors are right up front, giving the wine generosity. Good balancing acidity offers the lift the wine needs. Drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine Beranger  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wine comes from the most northerly of the Beaujolais cru villages as it merges gently in Burgundy's Mâcon region. The wine is structured and firm, but with bright red-cherry fruit and acidity. It will age and be best from 2018.
title: Florent Descombe 2015  Saint-Amour

description: This wine comes from the most northerly of the Beaujolais cru villages as it merges gently in Burgundy's Mâcon region. The wine is structured and firm, but with bright red-cherry fruit and acidity. It will age and be best from 2018.
title: Florent Descombe 2015  Saint-Amour

description: This ripe and fruity wine has just the right amount of mineral texture to give it a zesty character. It offers hints of toast, attractive juicy acidity and a lively, bright aftertaste. The wine needs to lose the slight earthy flavor from bottling that should soon blow away.
title: Domaine Antonin Guyon 2015 Les Charmes Dessus Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: The Gosset style of dry Champagnes is well expressed in their nonvintage cuvée. It is crisp with a steely acidity that is balanced by apple and tight citrus fruit flavors. The wine is fresh while also showing a touch of bottle aging.
title: Gosset NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: A ripe and smoothly rich single-estate wine, this has structure and a dense fabric of spice, toast as well as fruit. It's solid and chunky, with rich black fruits and layers of balancing acidity. Give this dense wine until 2017 before drinking.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Belairissime Domaine des Ailes  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: A ripe and smoothly rich single-estate wine, this has structure and a dense fabric of spice, toast as well as fruit. It's solid and chunky, with rich black fruits and layers of balancing acidity. Give this dense wine until 2017 before drinking.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Belairissime Domaine des Ailes  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Slight notes of oatmeal and bread play above the ripe apple tones and create a harmonious wine that balances fruit and yeast notes. The palate is fresh, with zesty citrus and a creamy, frothy, persistent foam. This is a rounded and elegant crémant that finishes with the richness of baked apple.
title: Joseph Cattin NV Pinot Blanc (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Green pear and Granny Smith apple notes signal lightness and easy refreshment. The frothy mousse swirls the almost weightless body and brings out all the freshness. This is easy and uncomplicated, but superclean and invigorating.
title: Hubert Meyer NV Pinot Blanc (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Although the wine is labeled as a nonvintage, it is predominantly from 2012, hence the name of the cuvée. Without any dosage, it is bone dry, relying on the ripeness of the fruit for its rich, mineral and lemon-zest character. The bottle could do with some more aging, so drink from 2016.
title: Lallier NV R.012N Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: This attractive wine, fresh with crisp apple as well as red fruit flavors, seems drier than in the past. That gives a tight, bright character that allows room for some tannins. The wine is fruity, attractively textured and ready to drink.
title: Perrier Jouët NV Blason Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Produced from old Pinot Noir vines, this wine shows attractive age as well as balanced fresher fruitiness. This well-made cooperative wine is ripe while also crisp and fresh. Apples and white currants come together with a steely texture to give a wine that could age in bottle.
title: Chassenay d'Arce NV Confidences Brut  (Champagne)

description: A ripe wine that shows some bottle age, this has flavors of toast and yeasty bread as well as textured acidity and lemon-flavored fruit. Well balanced and with a sense of depth, it is balanced between freshness and maturity, ready to drink.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Cuvée Premium Brut  (Champagne)

description: A ripe wine that shows some bottle age, this has flavors of toast and yeasty bread as well as textured acidity and lemon-flavored fruit. Well balanced and with a sense of depth, it is balanced between freshness and maturity, ready to drink.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Cuvée Premium Brut  (Champagne)

description: Beautifully understated, this offers fruit that's well integrated with the tight texture, giving a seamless, dry while also fruity wine. Just a hint of bottle maturity adds complexity.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Beautifully understated, this offers fruit that's well integrated with the tight texture, giving a seamless, dry while also fruity wine. Just a hint of bottle maturity adds complexity.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Still very young, this is a crisply fresh wine, all lemon zest and apple skin flavors. There is a young, green element here that needs to soften over the next few months. Screwcap.
title: Château d'Haurets 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Lightly crisp and herbaceous, this is an attractively youthful and fruity wine. Lemon and crisp pear flavors dominate. Bright and aromatic, it's ready to drink.
title: Château de Lagarde 2012 Les Hauts de Lagarde  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: That this wine is all Merlot is the reason both for its jammy richness and its high alcohol. It gives a wine that is out of balance, with pepper, spice and wood dominating the super-ripe black cherry fruits. It's unlikely to age for long.
title: Château de Brondeau 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Just what the label says, this is fresh, fruity, simple and attractive Sauvignon Blanc. Lemon, crisp apple peel and fragrant acidity all meld easily together. Screwcap.
title: Calvet 2011 Limited Release  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Fresh and fruity, light and fragrant, a wine with citrus flavors over red currants, spoilt by a metallic aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh and fruity, light and fragrant, a wine with citrus flavors over red currants, spoilt by a metallic aftertaste.
title: Barton & Guestier 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Anne Néel and her children, Maria and Damien Chombart, manage the clay-limestone family property, The result is a fresh, bright and crisp wine that is ready to drink. It has zingy orange and pink-grapefruit flavors that are already well integrated into the bright, tight, mineral texture.
title: Château Lamothe de Haux 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A tangy, bright and crisp wine, this is fresh, fruity with green fruits and lime flavors and full of zesty orange and lime. It is a wine that is all fruit, lively and showing a refreshing aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château la Moulinière 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A tangy, bright and crisp wine, this is fresh, fruity with green fruits and lime flavors and full of zesty orange and lime. It is a wine that is all fruit, lively and showing a refreshing aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château la Moulinière 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The tannins of the vintage are very apparent in this dry wine. That gives it a dry structure that was enhanced by wood aging. It needs to develop longer and become a wine that is balanced while always austere. Drink from 2017.
title: Chateau Faure Beauséjour 2011  Fronsac

description: The tannins of the vintage are very apparent in this dry wine. That gives it a dry structure that was enhanced by wood aging. It needs to develop longer and become a wine that is balanced while always austere. Drink from 2017.
title: Chateau Faure Beauséjour 2011  Fronsac

description: Winemaker Jérémy Ducourt brings attractive grassy, herbal aromas that are followed by a crisp wine. It has tropical fruits as well as lime and lemon flavors. The texture is tight, perfumed and elegant. Drink now.
title: Château Briot 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Lightly aromatic, this is a soft wine with attractive acidity and sliced green apple fruit. It is just lightly mineral with a fresh, bright aftertaste. Drink now.
designation: Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie
title: Domaine Martin 2015 Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This ripe wine from the Siozard family has a smooth texture. It has some spice, rich apple and apricot fruits and touches of more tropical fruits. While the wine is full in the mouth, it still guards some attractive freshness. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Claouset 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This ripe wine from the Siozard family has a smooth texture. It has some spice, rich apple and apricot fruits and touches of more tropical fruits. While the wine is full in the mouth, it still guards some attractive freshness. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Claouset 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A blend with 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a wine that has juicy fruit, red-berry flavors and only the lightest tannin. It is rounded, soft and generous. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Cheval Quancard 2014 Réserve Merlot-Cabernet Sauvignon  (Bordeaux)

description: A blend with 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a wine that has juicy fruit, red-berry flavors and only the lightest tannin. It is rounded, soft and generous. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Cheval Quancard 2014 Réserve Merlot-Cabernet Sauvignon  (Bordeaux)

description: The second wine of Ramage la Batisse, this wine had six months in wood. It is a ripe, early developing wine that is now ready. Spice from the wood mingles easily with the smoky tannins and black currant fruit. Drink now and until 2022.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2009 L'Enclos de Ramage  (Haut-Médoc)

description: The second wine of Ramage la Batisse, this wine had six months in wood. It is a ripe, early developing wine that is now ready. Spice from the wood mingles easily with the smoky tannins and black currant fruit. Drink now and until 2022.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2009 L'Enclos de Ramage  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Attractive structured tannins and red fruits give this wine a good start in life. With the acidity, the dusty structure and the perfumed aftertaste, the wine will develop well. Drink from 2017.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2015  Bordeaux

description: This wine is on the pale side for this vintage. There is a yeasty character that comes across as bitterness. By contrast, the acidity and the crisp fruits are fine, light and delicate. Drink now.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Fleur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an attractive, herbal wine. It has light spice and touches of cilantro as well as crisp red fruits. The wine is bright and ready to drink.
title: Château Coussin 2016 La Croix du Prieur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an attractive, herbal wine. It has light spice and touches of cilantro as well as crisp red fruits. The wine is bright and ready to drink.
title: Château Coussin 2016 La Croix du Prieur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This pure Merlot wine suffers from excessive wood aging giving an extra-dry character. To compensate, the red fruit is perfumed and rich. Another year will help the softening process although probably not enough.
title: Domaine Guillaman 2014 Les Hauts de Guillaman Merlot (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This pure Merlot wine suffers from excessive wood aging giving an extra-dry character. To compensate, the red fruit is perfumed and rich. Another year will help the softening process although probably not enough.
title: Domaine Guillaman 2014 Les Hauts de Guillaman Merlot (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a soft simple wine, full of ripe red fruit. It has a lightly structured edge from the Syrah in the blend while keeping plenty of bright acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Virant 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A light and fruity wine that has attractive herbal flavors as well as touches of riper yellow fruits. The blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon is crisp and bright, ready to drink now.
title: Château Laulerie 2016 White (Bergerac Sec)

description: This wine is so soft, rounded and fat. It has hints of red fruits and acidity with a herbal edge. But with the soft texture of the wine, it is misses out on fruit and acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Lauzade 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An earthy aroma comes from this vivid dark red wine. It is gently soft, not quite dry and with black-plum fruits. The aftertaste is soft, very fruity and ready to drink.
title: Vinovalie 2016 Tarani Malbec

description: An earthy aroma comes from this vivid dark red wine. It is gently soft, not quite dry and with black-plum fruits. The aftertaste is soft, very fruity and ready to drink.
title: Vinovalie 2016 Tarani Malbec

description: This is a stalky light wine. With black-currant fruit and layers of intense acidity, it is fruity with a cool crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Pellehaut 2016 Harmonie de Gascogne Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a soft pretty wine with a light fruity character. It is gently fruity, finishing with a peppery edge and crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Cuvée des Princes Rosé (Var)

description: This is a lightly fruity wine with attractive acidity and citrus and apricot flavors. It is light and lively, fresh and crisp. There is a just a touch of spice and pepper at the end. Drink now.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Brigue Vin de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is light, fruity and just off dry. It has bright red fruits and crisp acidity, softened by a gentle aftertaste. The wine, pure Gamay, is ready to drink.
title: Vinovalie 2016 Tarani Gamay Rosé

description: Completely different in style from the estate's Coin Caché rouge, this is primarily Mourvèdre, and primarily aged in new oak. Despite the oak, the fruit shines through, offering up ripe, mouthfilling flavors of blackberry, cola, coffee and spice. Firmly structured, this could repay 5–7 years of cellaring.
title: Mas de la Dame 2005 Le Vallon des Amants Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Rich and ripe—nearly over the top in ripeness—this is a luscious blend of 90% Grenache and 10% Syrah matured in old foudres. Without any appreciable oak, what shines are the superripe Grenache flavors of black cherries and cola and the soft, plush tannins. A concentrated, long finish.
title: Mas de la Dame 2004 Coin Caché Rouge Grenache (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Richer and deeper than the 2004 version, this shows an abundance of black cherry fruit, but also layers of spicy, savory complexity. Dominated by old-vine Grenache, it could easily be mistaken for a Lirac or Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Drink now–2015.
title: Domaine d'Eole 2003 Cuvée Lea Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This full-bodied, richly textured rosé is wonderfully aromatic and floral, with dried spices, plums and cherries all mingling on the nose. Made from 80% Mourvèdre, it behaves almost like a good red wine, but with extra zest and freshness. You could sip it on its own, with white meats or even burgers or steaks.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2007 Réserve Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In contrast to many of the other wines, this one starts off tight, with only faint lime and mineral notes on the nose. But it blossoms with air, stubbornly yielding up taut citrus flavors that flow over the palate with an almost gritty, powdered-rock texture.
title: Louis Latour 2000 Chateau De Blagny Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A bit tighter than some of the other wines, even showing some sulfur aromas that gradually ease up. Toasty wood notes accent pear and lime fruit, developing into dried spice nuances on the long, minerally finish.
title: Louis Latour 2000 Sous Le Puits  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: The catch-all nose offers grass, grapefruit, flint, vanilla and baking spices. What follows is a tasty blend of citrus, green herbs, Granny Smith apples and a welcome chalkiness. Round yet structured, this bottling offers most of what's great about Loire Valley white wine.
title: Lucien Crochet 2000 La Croix du Roy  (Sancerre)

description: The catch-all nose offers grass, grapefruit, flint, vanilla and baking spices. What follows is a tasty blend of citrus, green herbs, Granny Smith apples and a welcome chalkiness. Round yet structured, this bottling offers most of what's great about Loire Valley white wine.
title: Lucien Crochet 2000 La Croix du Roy  (Sancerre)

description: The tight bouquet tosses off a touch of mustard seed, lemon and lees. The mouth is full and round, bordering on plump. There is pineapple and mango to the sweet-fruit finish, and it goes down easily. It's the quintessential ready-to-drink Loire white.
title: Pascal & Nicolas Reverdy 2000  Sancerre

description: The tight bouquet tosses off a touch of mustard seed, lemon and lees. The mouth is full and round, bordering on plump. There is pineapple and mango to the sweet-fruit finish, and it goes down easily. It's the quintessential ready-to-drink Loire white.
title: Pascal & Nicolas Reverdy 2000  Sancerre

description: Among the range of Jolivet's 2000 Sancerres, Les Cailottes is the winner, hands down. It's zesty, with chalk and mineral qualities. The nose is clean, stony and pungent, while the flavors that come next are pure and ripe citrus and melon, with just a nip of honey. It closes out firm, round and full, and with elegance.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2000 Les Caillottes  (Sancerre)

description: This is made from 80% Cinsault, 10% Grenache and 10% Carignan. It has a deep pink hue and smells more like a red wine than many rosés, with hints of smoked meat, bold notes of garrigue and just a bit of berry-like fruit. It's full bodied, complex and savory—a fine rosé to serve with grilled meats.
title: Laurence Féraud 2016 Pink Pégau Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This is made from 80% Cinsault, 10% Grenache and 10% Carignan. It has a deep pink hue and smells more like a red wine than many rosés, with hints of smoked meat, bold notes of garrigue and just a bit of berry-like fruit. It's full bodied, complex and savory—a fine rosé to serve with grilled meats.
title: Laurence Féraud 2016 Pink Pégau Rosé (Vin de France)

description: A smooth and rounded wine that is full of ripe fruits. It has a hint of steely texture and minerality but the white fruit is the immediately attractive aspect of the wine. Drink this wine now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Domaine de Terres Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: A smooth and rounded wine that is full of ripe fruits. It has a hint of steely texture and minerality but the white fruit is the immediately attractive aspect of the wine. Drink this wine now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Domaine de Terres Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: A new cuvée from this producer, it is brightly fruity and with fine tight acidity. There is an earthy edge that gives it a funky character lifted by the freshness and crisp texture. Drink this lively fruity wine from early 2018.
title: Domaine Laporte 2016 Les Grandmontains  (Sancerre)

description: The 147-acre vineyard on a high chalk plateau in the east of Cahors was first planted in the Middle Ages. It has produced a structured, mineral wine, very textured and with firm, dusty tannins. Underneath the black currant fruits are developing and will give a fine juicy wine from 2019. Grands Vins de Seigneur is a group of growers who approve each other's wines.
designation: Château de Haute-Serre Grand Vin de Seigneur
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Château de Haute-Serre Grand Vin de Seigneur Malbec (Cahors)

description: The 147-acre vineyard on a high chalk plateau in the east of Cahors was first planted in the Middle Ages. It has produced a structured, mineral wine, very textured and with firm, dusty tannins. Underneath the black currant fruits are developing and will give a fine juicy wine from 2019. Grands Vins de Seigneur is a group of growers who approve each other's wines.
designation: Château de Haute-Serre Grand Vin de Seigneur
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Château de Haute-Serre Grand Vin de Seigneur Malbec (Cahors)

description: Now prizes for guessing C de B stands for Côte de Brouilly. Now perfectly mature, this is a soft, black cherry fruited wine. It is ripe, with a fine, dense texture that is lifted by the acidity and the light tannic structure. The wine is so deliciously ready to drink.
title: Domaine Dumas 2011 C de B  (Côte de Brouilly)

description: Still firm and structured, this pure Malbec wine is rich and tannic. At the same time, it has layers of ripe black fruits that are coming through strongly. The smoky, textured character of this wine comes from the wood aging that has added an extra layer. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lamartine 2013 Prestige du Malbec (Cahors)

description: Still firm and structured, this pure Malbec wine is rich and tannic. At the same time, it has layers of ripe black fruits that are coming through strongly. The smoky, textured character of this wine comes from the wood aging that has added an extra layer. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lamartine 2013 Prestige du Malbec (Cahors)

description: An attractively fresh rosé, full of red fruits laced with enticing acidity. The wine is light, fresh, a dry rosé great for food.
title: Château Laulerie 2010 Rosé (Bergerac)

description: Delicately fresh wine, its fruit directed towards a crisp, bright character. It is soft, with red berry flavors and tight final acidity. Screwcap.
title: François Lurton 2010 Fumées Blanches Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: As fresh as possible, this herb- and orange-flavored wine is crisp, driven by its fruit and acidity, finishing with a burst of fruit juice. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine la Salette 2010 White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This wine is still tight and closed. Hints of the lemon and fresh pear fruits are sustained by a crisp, mineral texture. This is a wine to age for a few months, so drink from 2016.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2013 Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This wine is still tight and closed. Hints of the lemon and fresh pear fruits are sustained by a crisp, mineral texture. This is a wine to age for a few months, so drink from 2016.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2013 Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Very perfumed, this lightly sweet and poised wine is a blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Gros Manseng. It has cool acidity as well as wonderfully fragrant fruitiness. The texture gives the wine the potential to age, so drink now and until 2017.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2013 Villa Chambre d'Amour White (Vin de France)

description: Although this is a relatively light wine due to the 2013 vintage, it does manage to achieve many of the firm tannins of Morgon. It also has red berry fruits that are allied to fresh acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2013  Morgon

description: This is a wine that's not just lively and fruity. It has weight and structure as well, keeping its instant drinkability along with a good sense of balance.
title: Domaine de la Madone 2014 Nouveau  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Not many Grand Cru wines are made into a Sec style of Champagne. This wine is more soft than sweet, with plenty of acidity as well as a touch of honey. Soft and round at the end, the wine is balanced and ready to drink.
title: Jean Milan NV Tendresse Grand Cru Sec  (Champagne)

description: From one of the villages that lies behind the primary Chardonnay vineyards of the Côte de Beaune, this is already smooth, fruity and perfumed. It has attractive acidity and a rich, baked apple character that is pointed up by the layer of toastiness. Drink now, although the wine will be better from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Sous le Château  (Saint-Romain)

description: From one of the villages that lies behind the primary Chardonnay vineyards of the Côte de Beaune, this is already smooth, fruity and perfumed. It has attractive acidity and a rich, baked apple character that is pointed up by the layer of toastiness. Drink now, although the wine will be better from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Sous le Château  (Saint-Romain)

description: Aromas of dried cloves and adhesive bandages will be a bit offputting to some tasters, but the bones of this wine are solid, offering supple tannins and blackberry, hickory and black cherry flavors. Turns a touch metallic on the finish. The 2006 seems much cleaner.
title: Château des Annibals 2005 Fesse-Mathieux Red (Coteaux Varois)

description: Aromas of dried cloves and adhesive bandages will be a bit offputting to some tasters, but the bones of this wine are solid, offering supple tannins and blackberry, hickory and black cherry flavors. Turns a touch metallic on the finish. The 2006 seems much cleaner.
title: Château des Annibals 2005 Fesse-Mathieux Red (Coteaux Varois)

description: The fruity, perfumed character shows instant red berry aromas, but the old-wood flavor doesn't quite chime with the fruit, giving a slightly muddled feel to the wine.
title: Château Tour Saint-Germain 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Heavy toast aromas follow through to a wine that is packed with new wood and some fruit. It has a biting burnt edge that may soften.
title: Château Bourbon 2010 Clos Bourbon  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Mint aromas speak of the wood used in aging this wine. With some burnt tannin character, it's perhaps not a wine that will show great fruit.
title: Château Haut Canteloup 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Mint aromas speak of the wood used in aging this wine. With some burnt tannin character, it's perhaps not a wine that will show great fruit.
title: Château Haut Canteloup 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A confected wine that shows polished wood and mint flavors but little fruit. It puts on a great show, but without depth.
title: Château Brethous 2010 Prélude  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A confected wine that shows polished wood and mint flavors but little fruit. It puts on a great show, but without depth.
title: Château Brethous 2010 Prélude  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Lean and tough, this is all hard edges. The wine has an austere character that's likely to be off-putting even in the future.
title: Château Biac 2010 Félix de Biac  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine has an unusual candy-flavored character. Its tannins are fine, and there is structure, but the final character is unbalanced.
title: Château Tour Saint-Germain 2010 Elegance  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A firm and tannic wine, with a hard-edge feel to it. The structure is dry and tough, leaving little room for the fruit, even in the future.
title: Château Saint-Urbain 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A firm and tannic wine, with a hard-edge feel to it. The structure is dry and tough, leaving little room for the fruit, even in the future.
title: Château Saint-Urbain 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A new-wood-dominated wine, this is very toasty and extracted, and it is losing some of its fruit in the process. It has a fine structure that will fill out when the black currant flavor gets a chance to shine. Keep for 4–5 years.
title: Château Saint-Pierre 2010  Saint-Julien

description: Chocolate and licorice flavors dominate this solid, foursquare yet austere wine. Its offers firm fruit, with a dense texture of black currant and red plum. Acidity and a spice note set off the finish.
title: Château Rahoul 2008  Graves

description: This fruity wine has attractive acidity and a lively black-currant note. The brightness on the surface masks the wine's firmly tannic structure, although it's the fruitiness and forward nature of the wine that will provide the most pleasure.
title: Château Maucamps 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: This fruity, wood-aged wine has plenty of potential. Its stone fruit flavors are full and rich, a contrast to the herbaceous edge. A smooth texture is just showing through. Keep for 2–3 years.
title: Château Haut Selve 2011  Graves

description: This ripe wine is full of tropical and citrus fruits, with some extra weight from the hint of wood. Fine and balanced, it reveals the smooth richness of 100% Sémillon.
title: Château Haut Guillebot 2011 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This solid, chunky wine expresses dry tannins as much as ripe fruit. The structure is present, but the black currant note is still waiting for its chance to shine. Give it 4–5 years.
title: Château de Goëlane 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This solid, chunky wine expresses dry tannins as much as ripe fruit. The structure is present, but the black currant note is still waiting for its chance to shine. Give it 4–5 years.
title: Château de Goëlane 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: While the wine has some richness, it is also firmly structured, with a minerally severity from its tight tannins. Under the surface, there is a fruity character that's dominated by a juicy black-currant flavor.
title: Château Bel-Air 2009  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: While the wine has some richness, it is also firmly structured, with a minerally severity from its tight tannins. Under the surface, there is a fruity character that's dominated by a juicy black-currant flavor.
title: Château Bel-Air 2009  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: Remember when all Châteauneufs were priced like this? Now this is entry-level pricing, yet the wine is very good, delivering a complex, harmonious blend of leather, earth, spice and plum notes. It's soft enough to drink now and over the next few years.
title: Louis Bernard 2009 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A blend of 13 different grape varieties, some rare, this is a delicious, honeyed wine, with rich baked apple flavor and crisp acidity, topped with a creamed spice note. Its pure line of citrus provides a lively finish.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2010 White (Alsace)

description: A blend of 13 different grape varieties, some rare, this is a delicious, honeyed wine, with rich baked apple flavor and crisp acidity, topped with a creamed spice note. Its pure line of citrus provides a lively finish.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2010 White (Alsace)

description: This is a brooding selection, with layers of dark fruits (think blackberry, plum and cherry), chewing tobacco and bay leaf alongside a hint of vanilla bean. The palate is rich and dense, with a texture like crushed satin. Tight and flavorful now, this would benefit from a bit more time in the cellar; try after 2015.
title: Domaine de la Coume du Roy 2008 Grenache (Maury)
winery: Domaine de la Coume du Roy

description: This is a structured wine, showing the firm tannins of a 2010 Beaujolais. Under the dry surface, the rich, juicy fruit is there, balanced with acidity, red fruit and a dense texture. Age for at least another year.
title: Domaine Chasselay 2010 La Chapelle des Bois  (Fleurie)

description: This is an exceptionally rich wine, its fruit exploding from the glass. The richness gives a spicy, peppery edge to the ripe white fruit, and its acidity is almost an afterthought in this mélange of full-bodied fruit and texture.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2010 Rosenberg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This is an exceptionally rich wine, its fruit exploding from the glass. The richness gives a spicy, peppery edge to the ripe white fruit, and its acidity is almost an afterthought in this mélange of full-bodied fruit and texture.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2010 Rosenberg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Here's a wine that is fine and fresh as well as structured. Apple skin and citrus juice flavors are cut through with mature toast flavors. The result is rich, its mouthfeel full and its aftertaste tight and tangy.
designation: Dessus le Mont Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Dessus le Mont Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Here's a wine that is fine and fresh as well as structured. Apple skin and citrus juice flavors are cut through with mature toast flavors. The result is rich, its mouthfeel full and its aftertaste tight and tangy.
designation: Dessus le Mont Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Dessus le Mont Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: For a wine without a reputation for aging, this is surprisingly good. It's very lush and honeyed, with a viscous texture and a long, sweet finish. Try it with desserts rather than as an apéritif.
title: Vignobles La Coterie 2006 Balma Venitia  (Muscat de Beaumes de Venise)

title: Vignobles La Coterie 2006 Balma Venitia  (Muscat de Beaumes de Venise)

description: A blend of the two Pinots used in Champagne—Noir and Meunier—this rich yet soft wine from a lesser vintage is rounded, smooth and ripe. It is well balanced, crisp, rich and full of attractive red-currant and orange zest fruitiness.
designation: Cuvée Louis Eugène Vintage Blanc de Noirs Brut
title: Pannier 2006 Cuvée Louis Eugène Vintage Blanc de Noirs Brut  (Champagne)

description: A blend of the two Pinots used in Champagne—Noir and Meunier—this rich yet soft wine from a lesser vintage is rounded, smooth and ripe. It is well balanced, crisp, rich and full of attractive red-currant and orange zest fruitiness.
designation: Cuvée Louis Eugène Vintage Blanc de Noirs Brut
title: Pannier 2006 Cuvée Louis Eugène Vintage Blanc de Noirs Brut  (Champagne)

description: Oak aging remains a hallmark of the Tardieu-Laurent style, but it seems to fit with the 2010s from Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Toasted coconut, vanilla and plum pudding notes work together to give almost the impression of dessert in a glass, despite the wine's dry nature. It's full bodied, richly textured and slightly warm on the finish yet surprisingly elegant. Drink now–2020.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2010 Vieilles Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: The gold color and honeyed aromas are a great invitation to this ripe, sweet wine. Wood aging has a given just a hint of toastiness to the opulent honey and lemon flavors. It's hard to resist now, but the wine will be even better from 2017.
title: Domaine Rotier 2011 Renaissance Vendanges Tardives Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac Doux)

description: This Beaujolais comes from a dense granite vineyard that has produced an equally powerful wine. It's mineral in texture, with aromatic black fruits that have been given a taste of wood from 12 months barrel aging. The acidity at the end as well as the tannins promise aging, so drink from 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Clos de Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This Beaujolais comes from a dense granite vineyard that has produced an equally powerful wine. It's mineral in texture, with aromatic black fruits that have been given a taste of wood from 12 months barrel aging. The acidity at the end as well as the tannins promise aging, so drink from 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Clos de Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: At the moment, the 2010 Réservée is intense but moody, showing a smoky, gamy, feral side. The fruit is subdued but concentrated, picking up multiple earthy, spicy nuances including iodine and licorice. It's a big wine, with chewy tannins that leave the impression of fine suede behind on the long finish.Give it another five years in the cellar.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2010 Cuvée Réservée Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This is a mineral-driven wine, austere at first then showing great black fruits that are sustained by acidity. It's a wood-aged and complex wine that is likely to develop into something powerful and impressive. Drink from 2019.
title: Château la Reyne 2011 L'Excellence Malbec (Cahors)

description: This wine is rich, smooth, perfumed and opulent. It shows the power of Malbec without completely losing its elegance. With generous black fruits that are round and dense, it's almost sweet in its ripeness. Conveying a dark, brooding character, this is a wine for serious aging, wait until 2018.
title: Château Eugénie 2011 Cuvée Réserve de l'Aïeul Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: This wine is rich, smooth, perfumed and opulent. It shows the power of Malbec without completely losing its elegance. With generous black fruits that are round and dense, it's almost sweet in its ripeness. Conveying a dark, brooding character, this is a wine for serious aging, wait until 2018.
title: Château Eugénie 2011 Cuvée Réserve de l'Aïeul Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: Based in the cru villages of Chénas, Pierre-André Dumas also has vines in Brouilly. This is a soft fruity wine with attractive red cherry flavors and a minimum of tannins. It is fresh and light, ready to drink now for its fruitiness, although ready to age at least until 2019.
title: Domaine Dumas 2013  Brouilly

description: This wine comes from the highest terrace above the Lot River, giving it a cool, fresh feel. Gravel and chalk soil give both lightness and minerality. Black fruits, integrated tannins and juicy final acidity mean this is a wine that will be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Port 2014 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: This wine comes from the highest terrace above the Lot River, giving it a cool, fresh feel. Gravel and chalk soil give both lightness and minerality. Black fruits, integrated tannins and juicy final acidity mean this is a wine that will be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Port 2014 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Such an elegant wine, with its attractive crisp apple skin and ripe pear juice flavors. It has a fine perfumed character, laced intensely with acidity. Drink now.
title: Wolfberger 2010 Signature Riesling (Alsace)

description: Such an elegant wine, with its attractive crisp apple skin and ripe pear juice flavors. It has a fine perfumed character, laced intensely with acidity. Drink now.
title: Wolfberger 2010 Signature Riesling (Alsace)

description: A rich style of Pinot Blanc, bringing out a more spicy character of baked apples and nutmeg. The wine has richness, feeling full in the mouth, rounded and soft.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Very floral and aromatic, a smooth and confected wine, rounded in texture. It has a fine varietal character, rich and with a bite of pepper.
title: Domaine Specht 2009 Gewürztraminer (Alsace)

description: Very floral and aromatic, a smooth and confected wine, rounded in texture. It has a fine varietal character, rich and with a bite of pepper.
title: Domaine Specht 2009 Gewürztraminer (Alsace)

description: The wine shows interesting oxidation and toast from the Savagnin grape in the blend. It has creamed apple and zesty bitter orange flavors as well as tight, nervy acidity.
title: Stephane Tissot NV Sparkling (Crémant de Jura)

description: The wine shows interesting oxidation and toast from the Savagnin grape in the blend. It has creamed apple and zesty bitter orange flavors as well as tight, nervy acidity.
title: Stephane Tissot NV Sparkling (Crémant de Jura)

description: Toast and nut aromas set the scene for a wine that has a rich character with vanilla and smoky flavors. The wine is strongly driven by wood acidity, a touch of oxidation and a final crisp texture.
title: Frédéric Lornet 2010 Nature Savagnin (Arbois)

description: Toast and nut aromas set the scene for a wine that has a rich character with vanilla and smoky flavors. The wine is strongly driven by wood acidity, a touch of oxidation and a final crisp texture.
title: Frédéric Lornet 2010 Nature Savagnin (Arbois)

description: Cool and crisp, this tightly herbaceous wine has a concentrated, juicy, green fruit character along with a tangy texture. The fruits are complemented by the tight, acidic aftertaste. Drink from 2014.
title: François Millet 2012 Empreinte Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: Cool and crisp, this tightly herbaceous wine has a concentrated, juicy, green fruit character along with a tangy texture. The fruits are complemented by the tight, acidic aftertaste. Drink from 2014.
title: François Millet 2012 Empreinte Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: An attractively balanced wine, it comes across as soft and creamy while also having spice and an almond bite. With its tight lime acidity, it is just passing its first flush of youth and needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de la Perruche 2011 Les Rotissants  (Saumur)

description: A firm wine that has solid tannins and layers of spice and juicy red fruits. The wine is structured, dry at the center followed by fine acidity and a toast and smoke character. The fresh fruits show at the end, giving the wine a final lift.
title: Domaine de la Lande 2011 Cuvée Domaine Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Very fresh and crisp initially, this wine then develops a richer, denser character. Lime and lemon acidity cuts through the rich pear and white plum fruits, giving texture and structure. Drink now.
title: Rijckaert 2011 Chardonnay (Arbois)

description: Very fresh and crisp initially, this wine then develops a richer, denser character. Lime and lemon acidity cuts through the rich pear and white plum fruits, giving texture and structure. Drink now.
title: Rijckaert 2011 Chardonnay (Arbois)

description: This wine—made using fruit from 60-year-old Marsanne vines—is full bodied but crisp and reined in at the same time. Hints of toast accent citrus and melon notes that turn more lemony and lean on the finish. Could improve with 3–5 years of cellaring.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2009 Domaine de Roure Marsanne (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: This is an intense crisp and red-fruited wine. Clean and clear, this is delicious to drink now with its lively freshness on the finish. Screwcap.
title: Joseph Mellot 2011 Le Rabault Rosé (Sancerre)

description: A light, bright, herbaceous wine, this is the epitome of easy-drinking Sauvignon Blanc. Crisp apple and grapefruit flavors dominate the lemon zest texture. Drink now. Screwcap.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc (Val de Loire)

description: A light, bright, herbaceous wine, this is the epitome of easy-drinking Sauvignon Blanc. Crisp apple and grapefruit flavors dominate the lemon zest texture. Drink now. Screwcap.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc (Val de Loire)

description: Truly herbaceous and aromatic, this is a crisp, clean, easy-drinking wine, with a fresh, bright line of acidity. Ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Laporte 2011 Le Bouquet Sauvignon Blanc (Val de Loire)

description: This is an attractive herbaceous wine that's light and tangy. Its gooseberry character dominates, lending acidity and a lively, crisp finish. The wine's blue bottle is memorable.
title: Château Tuilerie Pagès 2011  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: Made from Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a soft, rounded rosé, with red fruits right to the fore. With its attractive acidity, it is dry and very food friendly. Ready to drink.
title: Château Thieuley 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Made from Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a soft, rounded rosé, with red fruits right to the fore. With its attractive acidity, it is dry and very food friendly. Ready to drink.
title: Château Thieuley 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is an attractive mint- and pear-flavored wine with citrus acidity. There is a delicious refreshing orange character to this soft, light and very fresh wine.
title: Domaine du Salvard 2010 Chardonnay-Sauvignon (Cheverny)

description: Ripe tropical fruits dominate this warm, soft Sauvignon Blanc. The wine has a herbaceous element reinforced with acidity and a peach flavor. Ready to drink, but it could age for another year.
title: Château des Tourtes 2009  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a full and rounded Blanc de Blancs with Chardonnay fruitiness tempered by both bottle aging and the steely structure that lies in the background. An intense mineral character on the palate is balanced by apricot and brisk, fresh acidity. The bottle is ready to drink now but could improve with age as well.
title: Esterlin NV Cléo Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A dark and dense wine, this offers richness and a good depth of flavor. Along with its concentrated black plum and damson fruits, it is also strongly structured, ripe and dense. It needs aging, so don't drink before 2018.
title: Château Cossieu-Coutelin 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: Lamiable is a small house in Tours-sur-Marne at the eastern end of the Montagne de Reims. This Champagne is sourced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards. Yellow-fruit, citrus and green plum aromas introduce a wine that is crisp and elegant, but with significant weight behind it. It's ready to drink now.
title: Lamiable NV Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Lamiable is a small house in Tours-sur-Marne at the eastern end of the Montagne de Reims. This Champagne is sourced exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards. Yellow-fruit, citrus and green plum aromas introduce a wine that is crisp and elegant, but with significant weight behind it. It's ready to drink now.
title: Lamiable NV Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a full in the mouth, forward and fruity rosé, that is all fresh acidity and lively, crisp flavors. It has a light, zesty texture and the merest hint of toastiness. Drink now or give it a year's bottle aging.
title: Dampierre NV Cuvée des Ambassadeurs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This wine shows mint aromas and big black-fruit flavors. With high toast wood aging, it feels extracted, with bitter chocolate paralleling the blackberry fruits. It has considerable power and density and needs aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2011  Pomerol

description: This wine shows mint aromas and big black-fruit flavors. With high toast wood aging, it feels extracted, with bitter chocolate paralleling the blackberry fruits. It has considerable power and density and needs aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2011  Pomerol

description: The estate is a small enclave within the Château Tour des Termes which is owned by the same family. Half-and-half Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, the wine has a smoky character from the wood aging. That balances with the rich black fruits and intense fruity acidity. It is likely to be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Saint-Corbian 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: Unusually complex for a rosé, this medium- to full-bodied wine offers a mix of red berries and melon, hints of cinnamon and clove, richness reminiscent of white chocolate and even a tinge of mocha on the lengthy finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Château la Genestière 2016  Tavel

description: Unusually full-bodied and rich for a 2014, this is a big, muscular wine. The superripe plummy fruit is wrapped in a luxurious coat of chocolate-vanilla oak, yet finishes with drive to match its dusty tannins. Drink now–2025.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2014 La Reine Des Bois Red (Lirac)

description: A luxury white cuvée of pure Roussanne fermented in wood, this is full bodied, with an ripe, honeyed feel. Notes of toast and baking spices add complexity to the pear and pineapple flavors, lingering elegantly on the finish. Drink now–2021.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Domaine Grand Veneur La Fontaine Roussanne (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: It's hard to believe it's possible to buy this quality rosé for so little money. Mouthwatering scents of raspberry, stone fruit and crushed stone emerge from the glass, followed by rich, ripe fruit flavors balanced by just-enough citrusy acidity. It's full-bodied and plush, yet vibrant and long on the finish.
title: Domaine des Carteresses 2016  Tavel

description: This wine has an attractive crisp edge refreshes and balances the ripe fruit and the generous texture. Toast flavors from the wood aging underline the richness. Drink now.
title: Pascal Rollet 2015 Les Grands Climats  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: The wine has delicious acidity as well as lively fruitiness. An attractive mineral texture offers a tangy view of a ripe vintage. Drink this crisp wine now.
title: Union Beaujolaise 2015 Domaine des Trois Tilleuls  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A core of sweetness shows through this wine. It has juicy acidity shining prominently—it shows its fresh side immediately. Bélair-Monange is still a work in progress, although this will always be a delicious wine.
title: Château Bélair-Monange 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Densely fruity wine, all sweetness and richness without too much weight. It does have power, a dark core, but it is the sweet balance that is so attractive. There is a layer of acidity as well, giving freshness to the final character of the wine.
title: Château Providence 2009  Pomerol

description: A seductive wine, deliciously ripe with the softest, juiciest fruit over smoky new wood. The wine shows intense fruit as well as a soft Merlot core. The tannins are beautifully integrated in this ripely sweet wine.
title: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2009  Pauillac
winery: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande

description: A seductive wine, deliciously ripe with the softest, juiciest fruit over smoky new wood. The wine shows intense fruit as well as a soft Merlot core. The tannins are beautifully integrated in this ripely sweet wine.
title: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2009  Pauillac
winery: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande

description: Mint aromas hint at the wood, but more important is the massive Merlot fruit that is an essential element in the blend. The result is a wine that blends richness and power with an initially severe character. Slowly it opens to reveal opulent blackberry jam flavors, immensely ripe.
title: Château Latour 2009 Les Forts de Latour  (Pauillac)

description: Mint aromas hint at the wood, but more important is the massive Merlot fruit that is an essential element in the blend. The result is a wine that blends richness and power with an initially severe character. Slowly it opens to reveal opulent blackberry jam flavors, immensely ripe.
title: Château Latour 2009 Les Forts de Latour  (Pauillac)

description: Impressively weighty wine, with a fine combination of tannins, full fruit and a solid, chunky core. The wine is rich, but it also has a sweet acidity. Powerful ageworthy wine, never losing sight of elegance.
title: Château Hosanna 2009  Pomerol

description: Dark and structured, this is a firm wine. It has a smoky wood character, powerful tannins over intensely ripe fruit. Acidity and sweetness balance to give a dense wine, powered with richness and destined to age for many years.
title: Château Giscours 2009  Margaux

description: Dark and structured, this is a firm wine. It has a smoky wood character, powerful tannins over intensely ripe fruit. Acidity and sweetness balance to give a dense wine, powered with richness and destined to age for many years.
title: Château Giscours 2009  Margaux

description: With its superripe, jammy fruit, this is lush and opulent. It does have a fine structure as well as bitter chocolate and dark tannins. A hugely powerful wine.
title: Château Pavie 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A gorgeously perfumed wine, dominated by the ripest Cabernet Franc, combining richness and an intense structure. With its tannins, it will age well over many years. The fruit is finely textured, deliciously juicy, showing the most complex series of flavors.
title: Le Dôme 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Elegant as well as rich, this is a beautiful wine. It has great depth of flavor, the sweetest fruit, deliciously ripe. At the same time, the tannins are an underlying sustenance to the impressive ageworthiness.
title: Clos Fourtet 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Elegant as well as rich, this is a beautiful wine. It has great depth of flavor, the sweetest fruit, deliciously ripe. At the same time, the tannins are an underlying sustenance to the impressive ageworthiness.
title: Clos Fourtet 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A rich and opulent wine, very ripe, packed with luscious blackberry and damson fruit as well as sweet tannins. It is a fruit salad of fruit flavors given structure by a core of dryness. Already a gorgeous wine, but one that will also age.
title: Château Rauzan-Ségla 2009  Margaux

description: This pretty wine, with its pale pink color, is soft and fruity. Strawberry flavors give it a ripe character that's reflected in the light acidity on the finish. Drink now.
title: Château l'Orangerie 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This pretty wine, with its pale pink color, is soft and fruity. Strawberry flavors give it a ripe character that's reflected in the light acidity on the finish. Drink now.
title: Château l'Orangerie 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This ripe and fruity wine from vineyards in the east of the Entre-deux-Mers region has apple, citrus and lightly herbal characteristics. Its crisp texture is refreshing. Drink now.
title: Château Haut Maurin 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Although this wine has structure and acidity, it's lean, and the fruit seems to be missing. Spice and a smoky character give some pleasure. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Berthenon 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This blend of Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay is immediately attractive. With its balanced acidity and lightly crisp texture, it finishes with a lively sliced apple flavor. Drink now.
title: Bouvet-Ladubay NV Signature Brut Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Vin Mousseux)

description: This crisply herbal wine also introduces some richer apricot flavors. A joint venture between négociant Schröder & Schÿler and the Barton family of Léoville and Langoa Barton, it's attractive, fruity and full in the mouth. Drink now.
title: Schröder & Schÿler 2016 La Croix Barton  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Strawberry aromas follow through to the soft, red berry fruit flavors of this wine. The blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon gives both richness and structure. Drink now.
title: Rosé de Guiet 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Strawberry aromas follow through to the soft, red berry fruit flavors of this wine. The blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon gives both richness and structure. Drink now.
title: Rosé de Guiet 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Chardonnay from three grand cru villages in the Côte des Blancs, this tense mineral wine is bone dry with citrus and apple crispness. It is tight and nervy, still young and needing to age further. This will be ready to drink from late 2018.
designation: Lilyale Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Zéro Dosage
title: Waris Hubert NV Lilyale Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Zéro Dosage Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Made with skins to add color, this dark-orange-pink wine has fine red-berry aromas. It is dry and crisp with lively acidity as well as red-currant flavors. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Vollereaux NV Brut Rosé de Saignée  (Champagne)

description: A blend of 90% Chardonnay with 10% Pinot Blanc makes this a Blanc de Blancs (not indicated on the label). The wine itself is fruity, soft and with creamed-apple acidity to give it a lift. The light mousse gives a gentle aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Gyéjacquot Frères NV Collection Blanche  (Champagne)

description: A very creamy nose almost has hints of butter. The same creamy richness appears on the palate where it is countered by frothy foam and a light body. There is just a hint of citrus but it makes its freshness felt on the dry finish.
title: Domaine Zinck NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The piles of rocks taken from the vineyard and heaped around the edge are what give the bizarre name of this vineyard. To taste, the wine is soft, sweetly ripe with an attractive, ripe creamy character, lifted by toast.
designation: Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru
title: Maison Champy 2008 Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: The piles of rocks taken from the vineyard and heaped around the edge are what give the bizarre name of this vineyard. To taste, the wine is soft, sweetly ripe with an attractive, ripe creamy character, lifted by toast.
designation: Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru
title: Maison Champy 2008 Les Murgers des Dents de Chien Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Pure Sauvignon Blanc, this is herbal while also crisp, very fruity, bright and lively. Gooseberry juice dominates this intense wine.
title: Domaine des Pierrettes 2009 Element Terre Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Pure Sauvignon Blanc, this is herbal while also crisp, very fruity, bright and lively. Gooseberry juice dominates this intense wine.
title: Domaine des Pierrettes 2009 Element Terre Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Lightly laced with wood, this attractive ripe wine shows pear and peach flavors and vivid acidity. It is well textured, with a streak of apple and pear skins. Fine grained wine, with attractive final acidity.
title: Xavier Flouret 2008 Marly Domaine Hamelin  (Chablis)

description: Lightly laced with wood, this attractive ripe wine shows pear and peach flavors and vivid acidity. It is well textured, with a streak of apple and pear skins. Fine grained wine, with attractive final acidity.
title: Xavier Flouret 2008 Marly Domaine Hamelin  (Chablis)

description: Delicious, fruity rosé, and as befits the vintage, with some weight and richness as well. The red berry flavors are overlaid with caramel and cinnamon. Great final acidity.
title: Roger et Didier Raimbault 2009 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Rich and toasty, with tiny bubbles. The bouquet is laced with honey and vanilla scents. The palate suggests nuts and toast, without any noteworthy sweetness despite the demi-sec label. There’s good concentration and a ripe, toasty, slightly oxidized, nutty finish. This would work perfectly with the usual Champagne food suspects: foie gras, triple-cream cheeses and pâté, though it’s probably not the best choice for oysters.
title: Jacquart NV Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Rich and toasty, with tiny bubbles. The bouquet is laced with honey and vanilla scents. The palate suggests nuts and toast, without any noteworthy sweetness despite the demi-sec label. There’s good concentration and a ripe, toasty, slightly oxidized, nutty finish. This would work perfectly with the usual Champagne food suspects: foie gras, triple-cream cheeses and pâté, though it’s probably not the best choice for oysters.
title: Jacquart NV Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Shows some older notes: a bouquet of toasted white bread, cinnamon, brown sugar and smoky yeast, with just the slightest hint of white pepper. Really rich and complex, with supple lime flavors offsetting the earthy impression. Very dry, with an overall excellent palate impression. Should continue to age and grow finer.
title: Jacquart 1992 Blanc de Blancs Brut Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Offers an intriguing nose with ginger, lime and floral elements. The mouthfeel is ephemeral—almost too light—but there’s a good case to be made for this style when bubbles are involved. Green apple, an almost lilac note, and lime on the palate. Finishes nicely, too.
title: H.Germain NV Cuvée Prestige  (Champagne)

description: This classy example opens with a very floral nose and almost flower-shop aromas. But it’s not at all sweet on the palate, as tangy lime quickly moves to the fore. Impressively light and elegant, it displays some unusual elements and has a fine bead as well as a supple, herb-tinged finish.
title: H.Germain NV Cuvée President  (Champagne)

description: Really fine for a low-acid vintage, there's an intriguing nose here with white pepper, sandalwood and pine-nut elements. There are mature notes to the apple, toast and pepper flavors, good backbone, and the texture is just lovely. This well-developed example still has youthful elements, and closes with a grapefruit-mineral finish that is both relaxed and complex.
title: Heidsieck & Co Monopole 1989 Diamant Bleu  (Champagne)

description: Jacquart makes a full-bodied, ripe style of Champagne, with tiny, effusive bubbles. Flavors of slightly overripe apples lead into a mature palate with hints of oxidation. Sherry, nuts, olive oil, vanilla and other less identifiable nuances meld into a rich, ripe, satisfying and complex whole.
title: Jacquart 1992 Cuvée Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Jacquart makes a full-bodied, ripe style of Champagne, with tiny, effusive bubbles. Flavors of slightly overripe apples lead into a mature palate with hints of oxidation. Sherry, nuts, olive oil, vanilla and other less identifiable nuances meld into a rich, ripe, satisfying and complex whole.
title: Jacquart 1992 Cuvée Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Light and elegant, this spicy, lively wine is a gentle joy. There is a precision and refinement evident here that makes other Champagnes seem almost clumsy. The delicate flavors of fresh apple, pear and citrus are further enhanced with pretty cinnamon spice.
title: Jacquart NV Brut Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Light and elegant, this spicy, lively wine is a gentle joy. There is a precision and refinement evident here that makes other Champagnes seem almost clumsy. The delicate flavors of fresh apple, pear and citrus are further enhanced with pretty cinnamon spice.
title: Jacquart NV Brut Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Inky and rustic, yet in a refined manner. This is knock-out juice if you like ’em big and flavorful. The full bouquet of grape, raisin, oak, licorice and herb aromas pulls you in and the follow-up palate of dense blackberry flavors with herb and smoke shadings fulfills the promise the nose makes. Loads of oak here, but there’s great depth of fruit for it to play against. A definite keeper; hold for three or four years at least.
title: Le Vieux Donjon 1998 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: The nose is dominated by the attractive scents of new French oak, with some hints of pipe tobacco and just a whiff of volatile acidity. It is tight and tannic, a bit "lifted" with the VA, and at this point not showing much fruit or complexity, given the price.
title: Daniel Rion 1999 Les Charmes  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: The nose is dominated by the attractive scents of new French oak, with some hints of pipe tobacco and just a whiff of volatile acidity. It is tight and tannic, a bit "lifted" with the VA, and at this point not showing much fruit or complexity, given the price.
title: Daniel Rion 1999 Les Charmes  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This needs a good bit of breathing time, then it begins to reveal some cherry lifesaver fruit and a balanced structure with firm acids and medium tannins. A bit chalky in the finish, it's a relatively light style that is pleasant and pretty once it has opened up.
title: Michel Gros 1999 Les Chaliots  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Scents of graham cracker and malted milk chocolate tickle the nose, while the tart fruit slowly unwinds to reveal cherry and beetroot scents and flavors. Tannic and hard, without immediately showing much sweetness, it seems to put the emphasis on mineral and soil, root and leaf, but may evolve into a very interesting wine.
title: Michel Gros 1999  Chambolle-Musigny

description: This is a lovely, fragrant Burgundy, with a smoky/cherry scented nose leading into a rather tight, hard young wine. Hints of rosewater, graham cracker and tobacco are there, along with some green tannins. Medium body and texture; needs more time to show its best stuff.
title: Daniel Rion 1999 Clos dea Argillieres  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Another premier cru from Michel Gros, this one not as elegant and fruity as the Réas. Instead it goes for more ripeness, more tannic weight, and a lot more roasted scents from the barrels. Big, rawboned but undeniably appealing, it has a lot of rough-hewn flavor, dominated by toast, tannin and tobacco.
title: Michel Gros 1999 Aux Brulees  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Rion holds back on the new oak, letting the pure, supple fruit speak for itself. This is a muscular Vosne, young and firm, showing excellent focus and structure. Already the finish lingers beautifully, with layers of texture and tightly wrapped fruit. Should cellar well for a decade or more.
title: Daniel Rion 1999 Les Beaux-Monts  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This lovely wine, a Monopole, is already showing complex, forward fruit with flavors of plum, cherry and cranberry. Soft and fulsome, it shows a light hand with the oak, allowing nuances of tobacco and leather to emerge. Good weight and texture, it seems bound for early glory.
title: Michel Gros 1999 Clos des Reas  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This blend of 75% Grenache and 25% Syrah is a well-made rosé at a realistic price. Scents of crushed stone and bubble gum emerge from the glass, followed by medium-bodied strawberry and cherry flavors and a faintly chalky finish.
title: Saveurs du Temps 2014 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This blend of 75% Grenache and 25% Syrah is a well-made rosé at a realistic price. Scents of crushed stone and bubble gum emerge from the glass, followed by medium-bodied strawberry and cherry flavors and a faintly chalky finish.
title: Saveurs du Temps 2014 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Solid tannins still dominate this potentially ripe and full-bodied wine. It has the richness and structure of the vintage, giving ripe red fruits from the Merlot as well as tight tannins that need to soften. Drink from 2016.
title: Dourthe 2010 Réserve du Château  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Attractively pink in color, this has a touch of caramel as well as ripe strawberry fruit flavors. It has a rich side, but is bright and fruity with lively acidity at the end. It will be great as an apéritif.
title: Château Vircoulon 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This totally refreshing wine is crisp, lively and packed with acidity as well as red currant fruits. It's a delicious wine and a fine apéritif from the Doublet family in Entre-deux-Mers.
title: Château Vignol 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Attractively juicy fruit is fresh and full of black currant flavors. This wine still has firm tannins although they are beginning to fill out with fresh fruitiness and smoky acidity. It should still age, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Vieux Ligat 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: Still young, this wine is showing intense herbaceous characteristics that need to soften. Plenty of fruit between the texture needs to fill out. Hints of apples, pears and quince are all there. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Still young, this wine is showing intense herbaceous characteristics that need to soften. Plenty of fruit between the texture needs to fill out. Hints of apples, pears and quince are all there. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a spicy wine, but it is more about ripe fruits, apricot and peach as well as a twist of lemon. The aftertaste is fresh and fruity. The Queyren family's 100 years in the wine business makes good use of its Entre-Deux-Mers' vineyard of 80% Sauvignon Blanc and 20% Sémillon.
title: Château Pilet 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This very fresh wine from the Ducourt family is all crisp, crushed berry fruits and tight acidity. The 100% Cabernet Sauvignon is tangy, very dry and steely in character, with equal parts acidity and fruit. The aftertaste is lively, poised and refreshing.
title: Château Larroque 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is fresh, crisp and still young. Crisp acidity dominates the strongly citrus character and gives a tight aftertaste of lime and pink grapefruit. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc was aged on the lees for six months to enhance aroma. Wait to drink until early 2016.
title: Dourthe 2014 La Grande Cuvée  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This wine is fresh, crisp and still young. Crisp acidity dominates the strongly citrus character and gives a tight aftertaste of lime and pink grapefruit. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc was aged on the lees for six months to enhance aroma. Wait to drink until early 2016.
title: Dourthe 2014 La Grande Cuvée  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is as soft as a cushion. Yes, 1999 is a soft, full-bodied vintage, but this expression of the year is too much. What is here is very ripe fruit, with flavors of peaches and apricots, the acidity a suggestion behind the fruit. Drink now.
title: Pommery 1999 Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Only lightly spicy, it has a smooth texture and a fruity peach character. It is off dry, but tastes drier because of the light spice. The acidity helps give freshness.
title: Pierre Sparr 2012 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Slender and lemony, this is a dry, zesty Riesling. Grapefruit rind forms the central theme, supported by green apple and mandarin peel, leading straight into a linear, taut finish. This is very clean and beautifully streamlined.
title: Lucien Albrecht 2014 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Candy floss and mandarin on the nose suggest a fun, easy wine and the palate keeps the promise. This is a soft, easy, dry Gewurztraminer with a wonderfully slick mouthfeel and some phenolic grip. It's rich but presents a tight body.
title: Leon Beyer 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Pure and friendly tart apple and sweet pear fruit are very appetizing. The palate emphasises fruity sweetness but is kept in check and balance. Residual sweetness will make this shine in certain food contexts while the backbone of bright, citric acidity provides a great counterpoint.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2014 Altenburg Pinot Gris (Alsace)
