title: Henriet-Bazin NV Blanc de Noirs Extra Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: A rich wine, this has a mineral as well as a fruity character. With a high proportion of Chardonnay in the blend, it is full of orange peel, apple and pink grapefruit flavors that are refreshing, with a crisp kick at the end. The wine is finely textured and tangy, with soft acidity as the aftertaste.
title: Taittinger NV Folies de la Marquetterie Brut  (Champagne)

description: With some bottle age, this nonvintage wine is beautifully integrated. Crispness accompanies a rounder, riper character, with green plum and lemon flavors cut by sliced apple and acidity. The blend brings together the three Champagne grapes in equal measure and reflects that in its well-balanced aftertaste.
title: Pol Roger NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine has tight fruit, crisp cherry flavors and acidity. The structure comes from the fruit skins rather than tannins. It is ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Château de Nevers  (Brouilly)

description: Earth dominates the citrus fruit notes on the nose. On the equally lemony palate there is a touch of bitterness and some earthy notes, but the finish is clean, fresh and invigorating.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2012 Prestige Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Earth dominates the citrus fruit notes on the nose. On the equally lemony palate there is a touch of bitterness and some earthy notes, but the finish is clean, fresh and invigorating.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2012 Prestige Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Based in Fleurie in northern Beaujolais, this domaine also has a few acres of old vines in Saint-Jean d'Ardières in the Beaujolais appellation. This wine with its cherry flavor has a tangy, mineral character while relying on fresh fruit and crisp acidity for its lively, bright effect. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Marrans 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: Ripe and jammy, this is a soft, rounded wine with rich berry fruits. The generous texture comes over more vividly than the acidity. The wine is fruity, ready to drink.
title: Château des Tours 2014  Brouilly

description: This light, crisp and fresh wine is dominated by attractive red currant and raspberry fruit flavors. A tangy texture adds interest and brightens up the aftertaste.
title: Jacquart NV Rosé Mosaïque Brut  (Champagne)

description: Candy-pink in color, this soft, fruity wine has ripe strawberry flavors that are lifted by acidity. The aftertaste, rounded and perfumed, is fresh although not crisp.
title: Comtes de Dampierre NV Cuvée des Ambassadeurs Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With a demi-sec, off-dry wine, balance is the key to success. This wine is balanced between the bright fruit and the softness from the high dosage. Pear and yellow-fruit flavors are smoothed out by the sweetness of the wine. Drink now.
title: Collet NV Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: With dry tannins, this 100% Gamay also has plenty of fruit that will give acidity and red-cherry flavors. For the next few months, it needs to soften and round out. Drink from 2016.
title: Pardon et Fils 2014 Cuvée de l'Ermitage  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This is as close as Malbec gets to a Port-style wine. It is rich, lightly nutty and well balanced between sweet black fruits and acidity, with firmer tannins that promise aging. Drink at the end of a meal, like a vintage Port.
title: Château du Cèdre 2011 Le Cèdre Vintage Malbec (Vin de Liqueur)

description: Ripe and round, this soft, juicy wine shows just a hint of a more serious tannic structure. It has plenty of acidity to go with its warm, red cherry flavors. Drink now, or better from 2015.
title: Vincent 2012 Domaine de la Conseillère  (Juliénas)

description: Ripe and round, this soft, juicy wine shows just a hint of a more serious tannic structure. It has plenty of acidity to go with its warm, red cherry flavors. Drink now, or better from 2015.
title: Vincent 2012 Domaine de la Conseillère  (Juliénas)

description: It was inevitable that a producer would play on the name of the appellation Saint-Amour when naming his wine. Luckily, the wine itself is delicious and charming. With just the right tannic structure to sustain the berry fruits, it's rounded, ripe and fruity. That structure will allow it to age, but it is ready to drink now.
title: Pascal Berthier 2013 Esprit de Séduction  (Saint-Amour)

description: This mouthwatering rosé is a traditional blend of 50% Grenache, 40% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre. It's medium-bodied, boasting notes of fresh herbs, cherries and white chocolate, balanced by a hints of sea spray. Drink it over the next year.
title: Mas Carlot 2014 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This mouthwatering rosé is a traditional blend of 50% Grenache, 40% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre. It's medium-bodied, boasting notes of fresh herbs, cherries and white chocolate, balanced by a hints of sea spray. Drink it over the next year.
title: Mas Carlot 2014 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a Pinot Noir-dominated wine, with intense acidity as well as attractive, rich white fruits. There is a touch of maturity, of ripeness that gives the wine a full-bodied character. Add in some toastiness and this is a well-integrated wine that's ready to drink.
title: Jean Josselin NV Cordon Royal Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: A fruity wine, refreshing and crisp with just the right balance between acidity and citrus flavors and a youthful mineral texture. The wine is certainly crisp, although it is the fruitiness and the tangy character that comes through most strongly. Drink now.
title: Marie Copinet NV Alexandrine Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Unusually for a Champagne from the Montagne de Reims, better known for its Pinot Noir, this is a 100% Chardonnay. It is ripe and fruity—a warm wine with apricot and spice as well as crisper citrus. Drink this smooth wine now.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut
title: Henriet-Bazin NV Blanc de Blancs Premier Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Touches of yellow apple and sponge cake entice on the nose. The palate adds ripe, friendly and appetizing notes of yellow plum and lemon alongside creamy fizz set against a softly autolytic background. This presents a lovely union of fruit, freshness and development. Full of flavor, is has a dry, lemony finish.
title: Gustave Lorentz NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A notion of apple peel clings to the aromas of peach and mirabelle that swirl on nose and palate. The medium-sweet body has a lightness and ease about it, but also a very earthy grounding edge. The richness is countered by some lemon freshness and a phenolic element. The finish is warm and intense.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2015 Seppi Landmann Zinnkoepfle Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Beautifully fruity notes of fresh and baked apples create an inviting nose. The palate fizzes away with creamy mousse and a lovely yeasty autolytic edge reminiscent of fresh rye bread. The apple fruit brightens the entire palate and creates a rounded, harmonious and very balanced dry finish.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2014 Plaisir Perlant Extra Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: There is something lifted on the nose that translates as white currant and dried lemon peel on the palate. A distinct notion of autolysis provides a canvas for the fruity but restrained lemon notes. The fine mousse supports this beautiful balance, while the dry finish shines with lasting lemon flavors.
designation: Anne de K Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Bestheim NV Anne de K Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: There is something lifted on the nose that translates as white currant and dried lemon peel on the palate. A distinct notion of autolysis provides a canvas for the fruity but restrained lemon notes. The fine mousse supports this beautiful balance, while the dry finish shines with lasting lemon flavors.
designation: Anne de K Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Bestheim NV Anne de K Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Honeyed ripe pear fruit fills the nose. The palate amplifies this rich notion even more with a generous touch of residual sweetness that bathes the pear fruit in caramel richness. There is a glint of pleasant phenolic bitterness here and there but the pear fruit conquers all. This is rich but fresh with a medium-sweet finish ideal for blue cheese.
designation: Anne de K Schlossberg Grand Cru
title: Bestheim 2015 Anne de K Schlossberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A floral freshness is the first impression on the nose, followed citrus and green apple. There is levity and exuberance here, with a palate that has light-bodied, brightness and a frothy but softly foaming mousse, enlivened by a dry, fresh feel.
title: Arthur Metz NV Perle d'Alsace Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Lovely and fresh notes of red apple are joined by a livelier tangier citrus note on the nose. The dry palate is very light, almost weightless and fizzes away with a very fine mousse. There is real depth of fruit and a knowingly light touch. It is lovely as an elegant apéritif but sophisticated enough to be served alongside food. The finish is tart, lasting and grown-up.
title: Allimant-Laugner NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a liquorous wine, still with its youthful yellow-fruit and honey flavors that are cut with the dry botrytis core. The wine is rich and with a fine balance between the opulence and acidity. This is a wine to savor now, although it will also age further, certainly until 2023.
title: Moulin Touchais 2005 Chenin Blanc (Coteaux du Layon)

description: It's the old vines that are behind the concentration of this wine. It is rich, tight and dry with a really crisp texture and strong minerality. The acidity and the great lemon and grapefruit flavors are delicious and refreshing. Give this wine another few months for the best effect and drink from 2018.
designation: Les Quatre Chanteaux Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2016 Les Quatre Chanteaux Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Totally fresh, this offers attractive, young citrus flavors that are given a broader brush by the creamed apple texture that rounds out the wine. Crisp, it could be drunk now and will be better from 2016.
title: Domaine de la Potardière 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Gentle friendly notes of yellow mirabelle plum play on the nose. The palate is equally fruity and appetizing, chock-full of fruit and freshness. Drink soon.
title: Dopff & Irion 2015 Cuvée René Dopff Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Hints of earth are the only aromas on the nose, which seems devoid of fruit. The palate has a similar leafy earthiness and slight berry aromas. There are bitter edges on the very slender, soft and easy body. This has a picnic-style rusticity about it and a very clean and dry finish.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2015 Tradition Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Hints of earth are the only aromas on the nose, which seems devoid of fruit. The palate has a similar leafy earthiness and slight berry aromas. There are bitter edges on the very slender, soft and easy body. This has a picnic-style rusticity about it and a very clean and dry finish.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2015 Tradition Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Gentle but lovely hints of yellow mirabelle plum are just perceptible on the nose. The palate is light and lithe and meets the scented fruit of the nose with an earthier roundness.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Gentle but lovely hints of yellow mirabelle plum are just perceptible on the nose. The palate is light and lithe and meets the scented fruit of the nose with an earthier roundness.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: The vineyards of this estate are on a ridge overlooking the Garonne river. The wine is packed with black fruits and rich tannins. Still with its dry tannins, it has a ripe future of fruit and tense acidity. Produced by a group of 12 investors, six from Bordeaux and six from Burgundy, it is a serious wine, ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Réaut 2012  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Produced from vines an average of 24-years-old, the wine comes from an 86-acre vineyard to the south of Bordeaux. It is firm with tannins and with ripe, textured Merlot. There is a juicy character from the black-currant fruitiness. The wine with wood flavors needs to age. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Rahoul 2014  Graves

description: This second wine, from Château Monbousquet, is spicy and ripe with a touch of pepper. It has fruits as well, giving a rich character to the wine. Great acidity gives the much-needed a lift at the end. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Monbousquet 2014 Angélique de Monbousquet  (Saint-Émilion)

description: One of the properties owned by Jean-Michel Lapalu, the wine comes from the far north of the Haut-Médoc appellation. It is tight with firm tannins and a dry core that will need time to soften. The fruit is going to become more generous as the wine fills out. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Lieujean 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: One of the properties owned by Jean-Michel Lapalu, the wine comes from the far north of the Haut-Médoc appellation. It is tight with firm tannins and a dry core that will need time to soften. The fruit is going to become more generous as the wine fills out. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Lieujean 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: A ripe, soft and rich wine that will be ready to drink soon. It has black plum and berry fruits, ripe soft tannins and light acidity. The wine has a crisper cooler aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Leboscq 2014  Médoc

description: A ripe, soft and rich wine that will be ready to drink soon. It has black plum and berry fruits, ripe soft tannins and light acidity. The wine has a crisper cooler aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Leboscq 2014  Médoc

description: Under the same family ownership as Château Lamothe-Cissac, this estate has produced a broa rich wine, dominated by its 60% Cabernet Sauvignon. It is rounded already with juicy blackberry fruits and dark tannins. Drink this already fruity wine from 2019.
title: Château la Tonnelle 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: The wine is soft and ripe. Generous blackberry fruits and a smooth texture from wood aging give this wine its richness and open character. Hints of vanilla and spice add to the perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Amour 2014  Médoc

description: Something of the structure of Morey is here in this wine. However it is surprisingly ready to drink, with the tannins in the background leaving the foreground to juicy red-berry fruits and fresh acidity. It is attractive and balanced; drink now.
title: Louis Chevallier 2014  Morey-Saint-Denis

description: The soft, open character of Menetou-Salon is very apparent in this gentle, fruity wine. With fresh acidity and bright citrus and apricot flavors, it's a wine to savor young. Light perfumes add interest to this wine that is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Les Thureaux  (Menetou-Salon)

description: The soft, open character of Menetou-Salon is very apparent in this gentle, fruity wine. With fresh acidity and bright citrus and apricot flavors, it's a wine to savor young. Light perfumes add interest to this wine that is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Les Thureaux  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This wine has an initial strong tannic element that submerges the red fruits. As it opens, the wine reveals more juiciness, berry flavors and fresh acidity. It's still young and needs to be aged. Drink from 2018.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Domaine des Emois  (Sancerre)

description: This is a perfumed, fragrant wine. Its acidity is offset by the red berry and currant fruits that add freshness to the dry, crisp character. It's a full wine, with good fruit depth and ripe flavors, and will be better with food. Drink now.
title: Jean Reverdy et Fils 2014 Les Villots Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This is a perfumed, fragrant wine. Its acidity is offset by the red berry and currant fruits that add freshness to the dry, crisp character. It's a full wine, with good fruit depth and ripe flavors, and will be better with food. Drink now.
title: Jean Reverdy et Fils 2014 Les Villots Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Smooth and soft, this has light, fresh red-berry fruits laced with acidity and perfumed by red cherries. The structure is gentle and with the bright fruits, this succulent wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaines Tatin 2014 Les Demoiselles Tatin Pinot Noir (Reuilly)

description: While the aromas speak of wood aging, the fruit comes through on the palate. It is firm, full and dry, and the fruity acidity and fresh black currant flavor backs up the structure.
title: Barton & Guestier 2008 Thomas Barton Réserve Privé  (Médoc)

description: Ripe, round, soft and juicy, this is already attractive and drinkable. It has firm tannins, yet these are cushioned by the sweet black fruits and the lift from the acids. Drink now, or hold this for another year.
title: Abbaye de Saint-Ferme 2009 Vieilles Vignes  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Juicy and ripe, this has soft tannins and a red berry flavor. Alongside all of the fruit is a more stalky, spicy character to give complexity. The wine is ready to drink, but it could age for 2–3 years.
title: Musset-Roullier 2009 Les Neuf Vingt Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: This is fresh, light and very crisp. Citrus fruits dominate the grassy, herbaceous texture. There is perfumed white-currant acidity on the finish.
title: Michel Redde et Fils 2011 Petit Fumé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Attractive and smoky, this has a light red-currant perfume. The wine is soft, with bright acidity to go with the more serious tannins and dry finish. Drink now, or age for two years.
title: Joseph Mellot 2009 Le Boisclair  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: Attractive and smoky, this has a light red-currant perfume. The wine is soft, with bright acidity to go with the more serious tannins and dry finish. Drink now, or age for two years.
title: Joseph Mellot 2009 Le Boisclair  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: The nose seems closed. There is just a hint of earthiness. The slender palate has edges of mocha and smoke that frame its fresh crisp tart red-cherry fruit. The body is light but held within a very fine-boned structure that leads to a dry clean finish.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2014 Saint Gregoire Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The nose just hints at earth and autumnal oak leaf. The palate comes with slight grip, very fine tannins and more earthy leafy aromas. Red-cherry fruit is just hinted at. This is slender and bone dry and will come into its own when served with subtle mushroom or game dishes.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2015 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The nose just hints at earth and autumnal oak leaf. The palate comes with slight grip, very fine tannins and more earthy leafy aromas. Red-cherry fruit is just hinted at. This is slender and bone dry and will come into its own when served with subtle mushroom or game dishes.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2015 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Soft appetizing pear peel entices the nose. The palate almost has a kind of apple freshness and a wonderfully fruity, attractive if very light-bodied nature. The finish is clean and moreish.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2015 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: This is a new wine in this ever-expanding series. It reflects the structure and solid tannins of the appellation. It also brings out the juicy black-currant fruit of the vintage that will allow it to mature relatively quickly. Drink this attractive wine from 2019.
title: Kirkland Signature 2014  Pauillac

description: Packed with ripe Merlot fruit, this is a dense wine. It has impressive structure and great acidity to cut through the dark fruit. Rich and full in the mouth, this will be a solid fine wine from 2020.
title: Domaine des Sabines 2014  Lalande de Pomerol

description: This is a bold and rich wine, a blend totally dominated by 90% Merlot. It is fruity, structured and with fine juicy black fruits and acidity. The 12 months of wood aging have given the wine an edge of spice that is attractive now. Final tannins will allow it to age. Drink from 2021
title: Château Reysson 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: Making a vintage only from Chardonnay, the Gimmonet family is able to bring out the best of the year. This wine retains its crispness, minerality, almost chalky texture and fresh pear flavors. Its freshness promises aging potential.
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2000 Spécial Club Premier Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Making a vintage only from Chardonnay, the Gimmonet family is able to bring out the best of the year. This wine retains its crispness, minerality, almost chalky texture and fresh pear flavors. Its freshness promises aging potential.
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2000 Spécial Club Premier Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A pure, fresh line runs through this delicate rosé. It shows more white fruits than red, just hinting at red currants, but more of fresh white berries. There is just some hint of sweetness, more from the fruit of 2003 than from any extra dosage.
title: Louis Roederer 2003 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A pure, fresh line runs through this delicate rosé. It shows more white fruits than red, just hinting at red currants, but more of fresh white berries. There is just some hint of sweetness, more from the fruit of 2003 than from any extra dosage.
title: Louis Roederer 2003 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Vintage 2002 is turning out to be a great year in Champagne, and this wine is a reflection of that. Made from the heart of the pressing, it starts crisp and creamy. But then the power of the year shows through with its depth of flavor, yeast and apples, and a fine mineral structure, offering aging potential.
designation: Aubry de Humbert Premier Cru Brut
title: Aubry 2002 Aubry de Humbert Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: A Champagne that is very much wine. The structure and the richness are just right for a food wine, showing ripe acidity, flavors of plums and apricots, and balancing these primary fruits with a dense, complex structure that takes in yeast, maturity and a tight apple skin finish.
designation: Cuvée Victor Mandois Vieilles Vignes Brut
title: Mandois 2000 Cuvée Victor Mandois Vieilles Vignes Brut  (Champagne)

description: The beautiful orange pink sunrise color sets the scene for a dry style of wine, very much in the Laurent-Perrier tradition. Flavors of crisp red apples, red berry fruits and white currants come together with an edge of toast. A great wine, and a real food Champagne.
designation: Grand Siècle Cuvée Alexandra Rosé Brut
title: Laurent-Perrier 1998 Grand Siècle Cuvée Alexandra Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A rich, rounded Champagne, ripe and fruity without being simplistic. The complexity comes from the toast, the vanilla and the spicy edge combining with the quince, pear and white peach flavors. The acidity is finely balanced. Expect to age this for 5–7 years.
designation: Cuvée Symphorine Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Jean Milan 2002 Cuvée Symphorine Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A powerful wine that is very ripe and soft. What makes it work so well is the toast, the acidity from a high proportion of Pinot Noir, and the dense, full structure. This is, without question, a food wine. It should also age over 4–5 years at least.
title: Philipponnat 2000 Cuvée 1522 Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Showing surprising age for such a young vintage, this is a wine that's ready. It is of course, like all Charles Heidsieck Champagnes, beautifully crafted, with its toast and spice element integrated deftly into the crisp fruits. A top quality Champagne, needing food for its full appreciation.
title: Charles Heidsieck 2000 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: Showing surprising age for such a young vintage, this is a wine that's ready. It is of course, like all Charles Heidsieck Champagnes, beautifully crafted, with its toast and spice element integrated deftly into the crisp fruits. A top quality Champagne, needing food for its full appreciation.
title: Charles Heidsieck 2000 Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: Bright red fruit aromas are followed by flavors of fresh berries and caramel. This is a light, crisp, soft rosé refreshed by intense finishing acidity.
title: Domaine du Grand Bouqueteau 2007 Rosé Cabernet Franc (Chinon)

description: The year is a fine one for white Bordeaux, and this vintage of white Mouton-Cadet takes good advantage of the fresh, herbaceous character, with an added citrus tang, and spiced up with some aromatic Muscadelle.
title: Mouton-Cadet 2007  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is all fruit and no structure. The fruit shows a superripe character, which suggests this is a wine for short-term aging.
title: Château Cluzan 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine veers between firm tannins from old wood and red fruit acidity, without finding balance. It's very dry, with a hard edge.
title: Château Toumilon 2009  Graves

description: This lightweight wine is dominated by juicy red fruit. Fresh in character, it has bright acids and soft tannins. Not a wine for aging.
title: Château des Combes 2010  Bordeaux

description: Soft and somewhat dilute, this wine is attractively crisp but does not show great character. It's a fine apéritif wine, light and gently fruity.
title: Château de Parenchère 2011  Bordeaux Blanc

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Juicy and fruity, this wine has brisk acidity and fresh fruit flavors, along with a bitter edge of dark chocolate.
title: Château Clarke 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. Very open, ripe and soft, this wine has spice, fruity plum-juice flavors and just a touch of warm tannin.
title: Château d'Angludet 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This chateau has been newly acquired by the Barton family of Léoville Barton. It's an attractive, fruity wine with warm tannins. The palate is fine and juicy, and finishes softly at the end.
title: Château Mauvesin Barton 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This is a perfumed wine with new-wood aromas that lend a strongly woody character. The wood buries much of the fruit at the moment, resulting in a hard and dry aftertaste.
title: Château Fourcas Hosten 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. Structured and firm, this solid, dense wine is lightened by fresh acidity that is already well integrated into the tannins. A big and fruity finish gives the wine added attraction.
title: Château Fonréaud 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. There is a severe character to this wine, with its bold acidity and firm tannins. At the same time, the fruitiness is attractive, as is the final perfume.
title: Château Potensac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This wine is attractive with light tannins, black-currant fruits and lively acidity. It has a rustic edge, allowing the dominant Merlot flavors to shine through.
title: Château Fourcas-Borie 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. In its ninth harvest as the Médoc bottling from Château Cos d'Estournel, Goulée is coming into its own as the vineyard matures. The palate is nicely concentrated with chocolate and black-currant fruits, followed by an herbal hint on the finish.
title: Goulée 2012 Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. Firmly tannic and dry, the wine has density, a dry core and complex structure. With a firm character, not yet hinting at fruit.
title: Château Prieuré-Lichine 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This juicy wine is attractively perfumed. It's a wine that will develop relatively quickly with lively acidity and balanced tannins.
title: Château Paveil de Luze 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 89–90. Barrel sample. This is a polished, new-wood flavored wine that has hints of mint as well as an herbal character. It's juicy and soft with black currant fruits lending an attractive aftertaste.
title: Chateau Desmirail 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This concentrated wine brings out all the qualities of 2012 vintage—fruitiness, juicy black fruit and great swathes of fresh acidity. It's a finely balanced wine.
title: Château Malescot Saint-Exupery 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a solid and dense wine with hints of bitter chocolate along with super-ripe blackberry fruits. The wine has concentration, richness and a fine ageing potential.
title: Château Maucaillou 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a solid and dense wine with hints of bitter chocolate along with super-ripe blackberry fruits. The wine has concentration, richness and a fine ageing potential.
title: Château Maucaillou 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This rich, opulent wine is packed with ripe black fruits and red berries. It's a warm wine with a generous character that's balanced with a firm core of tannins.
title: Château Branas Grand Poujeaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a solid and dense wine with hints of bitter chocolate along with super-ripe blackberry fruits. The wine has concentration, richness and a fine ageing potential.
title: Château Pontac-Lynch 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This wine has very dark, extracted tannins. It is densely structured, and at present tasting tough, although with plenty of wonderful ripe fruit, there's a refreshing acidity on the finish.
title: Château Ferrière 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. There's a big amount of acidity that flows from the black-currant flavors on this wine. Brisk fruitiness contrasts with a dry, dense structure, while a richer center is missing.
title: Chateau Dauzac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. There's a big amount of acidity that flows from the black-currant flavors on this wine. Brisk fruitiness contrasts with a dry, dense structure, while a richer center is missing.
title: Chateau Dauzac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. Firm and tannic, this is a structured wine that also supports delicious black fruits. It brings together both fruitiness and ripeness.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. Firm and tannic, this is a structured wine that also supports delicious black fruits. It brings together both fruitiness and ripeness.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A ripe and fruity wine with some chocolate extract as well as black-currant fruitiness. This is a soft wine with attractive final acidity.
title: Château d'Issan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. A ripe and fruity wine with some chocolate extract as well as black-currant fruitiness. This is a soft wine with attractive final acidity.
title: Château d'Issan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a complex wine that's dry at the heart and powered with dark tannins. Slowly the juicy fruit shows through on the mid palate, yielding a wine that offers the potential of solid fruits and excellent acidity.
title: Château Poujeaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a big and fruity wine with solid tannins and dense structure. It's ripe and rich—packed with black plum—and yet modern and polished.
title: Château d'Arsac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Very structured with enough ripe fruit to yield a wine that is firm and balanced. This is a fine, complex wine with good aging character.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Very structured with enough ripe fruit to yield a wine that is firm and balanced. This is a fine, complex wine with good aging character.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2012 Barrel Sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Rich and soft, this wine has fine acidity and sweet black fruits. It has a good depth of rich flavor, and a palate that's rounded and smooth. The tannins show a velvet character.
title: Château Marquis de Terme 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. Rich and soft, this wine has fine acidity and sweet black fruits. It has a good depth of rich flavor, and a palate that's rounded and smooth. The tannins show a velvet character.
title: Château Marquis de Terme 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a full-bodied wine that shows signs of bitter extraction. It has weight, certainly, along with signs of dark-plum fruits to go with the firm tannins. A complex aftertaste promises well.
title: Château Lascombes 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a full-bodied wine that shows signs of bitter extraction. It has weight, certainly, along with signs of dark-plum fruits to go with the firm tannins. A complex aftertaste promises well.
title: Château Lascombes 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This is a dense, complex wine that's full of dark tannins piled atop ripe black-plum fruits. The wine has richness as well as lively acidity.
title: Château du Tertre 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91–93. Barrel sample. This wine is rich, with delicious fruitiness, as well as ripe black fruits. With all this opulence, however, there is also great freshness and crispness that comes from the Cabernet in the blend.
designation: Alter Ego de Château Palmer Barrel Sample
title: Château Palmer 2012 Alter Ego de Château Palmer Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. This is a spicy, fruity wine that has excellent acidity and a rounded, fruity character. It has some extraction, giving a bitter edge, while the final effect is a rich, juicy Merlot.
title: Marojallia 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. With marked acidity as well as black fruits, this is a wine with weight and richness. It has a dark core of firm tannins, although the aftertaste maintains the juiciness.
title: Château Brane-Cantenac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. With marked acidity as well as black fruits, this is a wine with weight and richness. It has a dark core of firm tannins, although the aftertaste maintains the juiciness.
title: Château Brane-Cantenac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. An austere wine that has distinct acidity and a black-currant character. The texture is tannic and dry, but it's fragrant with a light green note that comes through at the end.
designation: Pavillon Rouge de Château Margaux Barrel Sample
title: Château Margaux 2012 Pavillon Rouge de Château Margaux Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. An austere wine that has distinct acidity and a black-currant character. The texture is tannic and dry, but it's fragrant with a light green note that comes through at the end.
designation: Pavillon Rouge de Château Margaux Barrel Sample
title: Château Margaux 2012 Pavillon Rouge de Château Margaux Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: A rich wine, it adds a finely textured dimension to the red fruitiness and fresh acidity. With complex fruits, structure as well as the attractive crispness, it's a dry wine, best drunk with food.
title: Château de Calavon 2013 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: A rich wine, it adds a finely textured dimension to the red fruitiness and fresh acidity. With complex fruits, structure as well as the attractive crispness, it's a dry wine, best drunk with food.
title: Château de Calavon 2013 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: A crisp, very textured wine that has red fruits and a salty edge from the closeness of the vines to the sea. It has a mineral texture, grapefruit and raspberry flavors, intense and bone dry. The wine needs food to be at its best.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: With its blend that includes perfumed Mourvèdre, this is a solidly tannic while also aromatic wine. It tastes of the garrigue and wild plants that surround the vineyards, giving both tannin and rich dark plum fruit flavors. It needs to age, so drink from 2016.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2011 Cuvée G Red (Bandol)

description: Domaine Houchart is one of the top estates in Sainte-Victoire. This ripe while deliciously fruity and fresh wine is full of raspberries, ripe red currants and a refreshing line of acidity.
title: Domaine Houchart 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This is a delicious fruity wine with a fine line of acidity that cuts right through the orange and red-currant fruits. It is bright with acidity and just a light mineral edge to give a textured and fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Jas d'Esclans 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a delicious fruity wine with a fine line of acidity that cuts right through the orange and red-currant fruits. It is bright with acidity and just a light mineral edge to give a textured and fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Jas d'Esclans 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a really fruity, attractive wine from a fine estate. It is crisp with delicious acidity and a lively texture that gives the wine a refreshing tang. The wine is up front, full of fruitiness and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Houchart 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a really fruity, attractive wine from a fine estate. It is crisp with delicious acidity and a lively texture that gives the wine a refreshing tang. The wine is up front, full of fruitiness and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Houchart 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Gavoty family has been at this estate since 1806. This is their top rosé, a rich wine that is powered by ripe red-cherry and spice flavors. The wine is food friendly with a mineral texture and dry firm aftertaste. Don't hesitate to drink this wine from late 2017.
title: Domaine Gavoty 2016 Cuvée Clarendon Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of 80% Grenache and 20% Cinsault comes from a 100-acre property in the center of the Côtes de Provence. The wine is ripe and with great fruit. There is a touch of spice and pepper that gives the wine an attractive edge. It is all about delicious red-currant and orange-zest fruit. Drink now.
title: Domaine de l'Amaurigue 2016 Fleur de l'Amaurigue Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of 80% Grenache and 20% Cinsault comes from a 100-acre property in the center of the Côtes de Provence. The wine is ripe and with great fruit. There is a touch of spice and pepper that gives the wine an attractive edge. It is all about delicious red-currant and orange-zest fruit. Drink now.
title: Domaine de l'Amaurigue 2016 Fleur de l'Amaurigue Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the top wine from the Sainte Roseline estate. With a perfect salmon-pink color, the wine is ripe and full of red fruits that are softly integrated with the acidity. It is a food-style of wine, lit by spice and finished with a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
designation: Cuvée la Chapelle de Sainte Roseline
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2016 Cuvée la Chapelle de Sainte Roseline Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Under the same ownership as Château Roubine, this estate has old vines, some up to 60-years-old. The wine is rich and with concentration as well as a crisper edge. It is full of red-berry fruits, sharpened with red-currant acidity. This is a ripe wine that will be better from late 2017.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Instant B Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This estate wine is packed with attractive fruit. With grapefruit and orange-zest flavors, it is tightly crisp. Set against that are the ripe red-currant and berry fruitiness, layers of acidity and a pinch of pepper. Drink this refreshing wine now.
title: Château les Valentines 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This soft, finely structured and salmon-hued wine has an explosive mousse. Its attractive strawberry fruit is balanced by rich acidity. Ripe, mouth-filling and softly creamy, it's ready to drink now and has a rounded aftertaste.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This soft, finely structured and salmon-hued wine has an explosive mousse. Its attractive strawberry fruit is balanced by rich acidity. Ripe, mouth-filling and softly creamy, it's ready to drink now and has a rounded aftertaste.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This delicious wine offers subtle barrel nuances, with ripe plum and strawberry fruits. Along with this is a stylish crispness, just touched by spice and toast. This is a serious wine, intended for food.
title: Château d'Esclans 2010 Garrus Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Soft and creamy, this is a bright, apple and pear fruity wine. It's light and very fresh, layering acidity and a citrus burst at the end. Drink now.
title: Sacha Lichine 2013 SLS Blend No. 5 White (Vin de France)

description: This is fresh and juicy, relishing its cherry and light spice flavors as well as its aromatic acidity. It's balanced, with some depth of flavor that gives weight to the fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château de Lacarelle 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This is fresh and juicy, relishing its cherry and light spice flavors as well as its aromatic acidity. It's balanced, with some depth of flavor that gives weight to the fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château de Lacarelle 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Bone-dry, this blend of Negrette, Malbec and Gamay is rich, packed with strawberry fruits and spice. A touch of vanilla makes the acidity ripe and soft. Drink this attractive rosé now.
title: Château Bouissel 2013 Rosenc Rosé (Fronton)

description: This traditional Southern Rhône blend features some attractive floral and herbal aromas some might call garrigue, but also an intrusive cruciferous note. It's a crisp, medium-bodied wine with bright, red-plum fruit flavors and a hint of cabbage. Drink it now–2016.
title: Louis Bernard 2011 Domaine des Causses Red (Lirac)

description: The wine is full of acidity as well as bright raspberry and red currant fruits. It has a light, fresh feel that's given added weight by firmer fruit tannins and a concentrated dry aftertaste. Drink from 2016.
title: Henry Fessy 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: An off-dry, full-bodied Chenin Blanc, this wine brings together bitter almond and white-fruit flavors, cut with acidity and topped off with a creamy pear texture. Ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Vaugondy 2011 Demi-sec  (Vouvray)

description: Light, fruity wine, hinting at strawberries, along with a vanilla touch from the Merlot in the blend. It's crisp and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Lartigue 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Light, fruity wine, hinting at strawberries, along with a vanilla touch from the Merlot in the blend. It's crisp and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Lartigue 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The entry wine of Château Lagrezette lives up to its name in the color. With its soft tannins, touch of smokiness and blackberry-juice fruit flavors, it's a fine showpiece for the more open side of Malbec.
title: Château Lagrézette 2011 Purple Malbec (Cahors)

description: A ripe and opulent Champagne with intense white and yellow fruit flavors. The wine is full bodied, with just a touch of toast to show approaching maturity. This is a wonderfully open and generous wine.
title: Pierre Péters 2005 Les Chétillons Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: No longer a second wine of Ducru-Beaucaillou, but a wine from its own separate vineyard, Croix de Beaucaillou is impressive. Firm while also rich, it is firmly tannic, superripe and packed with great dark plum and berry fruits. Fruit and structure well balanced together.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2010  Saint-Julien

description: Montrose's second wine has something of the same gravity as the top wine from the estate. It shows firm tannins as well as black currant fruits. These flavors are followed by spice, leather and drying tannins. It does have a sense of elegance that promises well for its mid-term aging,
title: Château Montrose 2010 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: The attractive half bottle means this vintage wine can age more quickly than the same wine in a full bottle. It's already hinting at maturity with touches of cookie and toast flavors. There is still a fresh apple and citrus streak that gives a steel, mineral thrust at the end.
designation: Femme de Champagne Grand Cru Brut
title: Duval-Leroy 2004 Femme de Champagne Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: A strong caramel aroma and flavor spoils the suggestions of fruit. They give a ripe, almost sweet character that doesn't match with the red-currant fruit flavors.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine has a herbal character that doesn't mesh with the lightly tannic and tangy structure. The effect is of a wine that comes from grapes that were too green.
title: VIgnobles Ducourt 2015 Château Larroque Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine has a herbal character that doesn't mesh with the lightly tannic and tangy structure. The effect is of a wine that comes from grapes that were too green.
title: VIgnobles Ducourt 2015 Château Larroque Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is an off-dry wine with sweet raspberry fruit flavors that have a rustic edge to them. Drunk with ice, its fruitiness goes in favor of fresh acidity. Drink now.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Ice Rosé Demi-Sec Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: Herbal and spicy, this wine has bitter vegetal flavors that don't accord with the acidity or texture.
title: Château Gandoy Perrinat 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a fresh, aromatic wine with off-dry white fruit flavors. Made to be drunk with ice, it is less fruity and more softly textured with a light tang and considerable acidity. Drink now.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Ice Demi-Sec Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This is a fresh, aromatic wine with off-dry white fruit flavors. Made to be drunk with ice, it is less fruity and more softly textured with a light tang and considerable acidity. Drink now.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Ice Demi-Sec Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This wine has an attractive salmon-pink color followed by ripe caramel and spice flavors. The fruit and acidity don't feature as strongly, so the end result is a wine that is fat.
title: Château de Cornemps 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Two thirds Syrah and one-third Mourvèdre, this highly aromatic rosé features hints of passion fruit alongside confected, bubblegum flavors balanced by a squirt of lime on the finish. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2015 Cape Bleue Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Two thirds Syrah and one-third Mourvèdre, this highly aromatic rosé features hints of passion fruit alongside confected, bubblegum flavors balanced by a squirt of lime on the finish. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2015 Cape Bleue Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Rich wine, full of yellow fruits, apricots and peaches that give ripeness. It has weight, a solidity that is balanced by the totally refreshing acidity. Hints of the wood aging give spice as well as adding to the rich effect. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2010 Les Chaniots Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: Rich wine, full of yellow fruits, apricots and peaches that give ripeness. It has weight, a solidity that is balanced by the totally refreshing acidity. Hints of the wood aging give spice as well as adding to the rich effect. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2010 Les Chaniots Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: A rich, ripe wine, striated with yellow fruits, acidity and spice from wood. It is warm and generous, while not losing sight of its origins in the streak of minerality. A fine, attractive wine that could do with another year's aging.
title: Evening Land 2011  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: A soft wine, generously proportioned and with ripe peach and apricot fruits. Floral, perfumed, picking up in its texture the chalk soil of the vineyard, it has a fine structure as well as rich fruits and cutting acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 En Pierrelet  (Mercurey)

description: A soft wine, generously proportioned and with ripe peach and apricot fruits. Floral, perfumed, picking up in its texture the chalk soil of the vineyard, it has a fine structure as well as rich fruits and cutting acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 En Pierrelet  (Mercurey)

description: White Rully is one of the unsung values of Burgundy. This soft, attractive ripe wine is a pleasure to drink. It has a buttery, toast character along with crisp acidity, delicious apricot fruit and a mouthwatering aftertaste.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2007  Rully

description: A soft and deliciously jammy wine. It has immediately attractive ripe plum and berry fruits, layered with balancing acidity. The tannins sit well in the plump cushion of the wine. Not for aging.
title: Manuel Olivier 2008  Aloxe-Corton

description: Light and very fresh for a Gewurztraminer, this is a wine with as much crisp apple as spice. It's off dry, laced with acidity and very ready to drink.
title: Klipfel 2011 Cuvée Particulière Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Light and very fresh for a Gewurztraminer, this is a wine with as much crisp apple as spice. It's off dry, laced with acidity and very ready to drink.
title: Klipfel 2011 Cuvée Particulière Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A fine and creamy mousse gives this wine a palate that's smooth and full of fruit and spice flavors. It has some freshness, but it is the richness that is most obvious.
title: Willm NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a fruity, light wine. It has apple flavors, enlivened by acidity and zesty citrus character. On the finish, the wine is fresh while also creamy.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2012 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Just off dry, this is a smooth, attractively fruity wine that has a light touch of perfume. The acidity keeps the freshness level up, producing a wine that's easy to drink now. Screwcap.
title: Wolfberger 2011 Edelzwicker White (Alsace)

description: Made from 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, there's a delicate earthy character to the nose of this wine, lending interest to the ripe red-cherry and -plum fruit. The palate is soft and accessible, with juicy fruit flavors that finish clean but a touch short.
title: Domaine de Cambis 2014 Les Jardins Suspendus Red (Saint-Chinian)

description: Made from 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, there's a delicate earthy character to the nose of this wine, lending interest to the ripe red-cherry and -plum fruit. The palate is soft and accessible, with juicy fruit flavors that finish clean but a touch short.
title: Domaine de Cambis 2014 Les Jardins Suspendus Red (Saint-Chinian)

description: This pours an extremely pale-pink color, with dainty aromas of white cranberry, cherry and orange blossom in the bouquet. The lightweight palate is bright and lively, with good verve and tart berry and citrus flavors that finish quick yet clean. Drink now.
title: Domaine de la Métairie d'Alon 2016 Le Village Pinot Noir Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: The wine is spicy with strong wood flavors. That contrasts with the blackberry fruitiness and fine acidity. It should be well integrated and ready to drink from early 2018.
title: Château Tour de Bigorre 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a fruity wine, full of both red-berry and cherry flavors and some dry tannins that will certainly soften and integrate. It has the potential to be balanced, full and deliciously fruity. Wait until 2019.
title: Château Tayet 2015 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This blend of 50% Grenache, 25% Syrah and 25% Mourvèdre is reasonably light in body. The notes of crushed stone, berries, citrus and spice pick up a hint of brine on the palate, then finish tart and cleansing.
title: Château Roustan 2016 Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Citrus peel and raw, fresh herbs dance in the nose of this delicate pale-pink rosé, with supporting tones of white cherry and apple blossom. It's clean and bright on the palate, showing beautiful harmony and acidic verve that carries through to the refreshing finish.
designation: Vin Biodynamique Rosé de Nymphe Emue
title: Château Maris 2016 Vin Biodynamique Rosé de Nymphe Emue Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Produced from biodynamically grown grapes, the wine is structured with firm tannins and an austere character. The sixth generation of the Hubert family at the estate has made a wine that will need time for the acidity and the structure to soften. From 2019, it will have richness and a more full-bodied character.
title: Château la Grolet 2014 Tête de Cuvée  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: This Dulon wine is full of wood flavors that are currently dominating the fruit. That will change as the blackberry fruitiness emerges from the background. So give this wine until 2019 to bring out its inherent juiciness.
title: Château Grand Jean 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A strong wood component at the moment doesn't mask the juicy ripe fruits. They give the wine its ripe character and potential. As it matures, it will be an attractive, ripe wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Floreal Laguens 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A ripe, balanced and structured wine, this is dense and full of blackberry and damson fruits. It has spice from the wood aging, along with a dry core of tannins. With its potential, it will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château d'Haurets 2015  Bordeaux

description: Ripe fruit, firm tannins and acidity are showing the potential of this wine. With its blackberry flavors and attractive light tannins, this one should be ready to drink soon, certainly by early 2018.
title: Château de Lisennes 2015  Bordeaux

description: The wine is crisp with black currants and plenty of acidity. There is a smoky character to this wine that is still young and stalky. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Garros 2015 L'Excellium de Château de Garros  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: The wine is crisp with black currants and plenty of acidity. There is a smoky character to this wine that is still young and stalky. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Garros 2015 L'Excellium de Château de Garros  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This ripe fruity wine has soft tannins and generous berry fruit flavors. It is perfumed with mint and spice aromas that fill the glass. It's an attractive wine, juicy at the end and ready to drink.
title: Château de Bel 2015 Echappée Bel  (Bordeaux)

description: This ripe fruity wine has soft tannins and generous berry fruit flavors. It is perfumed with mint and spice aromas that fill the glass. It's an attractive wine, juicy at the end and ready to drink.
title: Château de Bel 2015 Echappée Bel  (Bordeaux)

description: This fruity wine is full of cherry and blackberry flavors. It has a soft texture, lightly spiced and with an attractive balance of acidity and firmer tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Barreyre 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This easy-drinking white wine is broad on the palate, with just enough acidity to provide a clean, refreshing finish. Ripe melon notes mingle easily with citrus in this mix of Viognier, Roussanne and Clairette.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2016 Réserve Grand Veneur White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A pale pink color, this clean, refreshing rosé offers nuanced notes of strawberry hull, white melon rind and just-ripe peach on the nose and mouth. The bright, juicy palate is zippy and refreshing, with lively acidity and citrus-driven flavors that carry through to the mouthwatering finish.
title: Les Jamelles 2016 Clair de Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A light wine that shows extreme freshness, rather than any depth. The acidity comes from red currant fruits, showing the freshness that is the wine's dominant character. The finish is short and fruity, a wine to be drunk within two years.
title: Château Potensac 2006 Chapelle de Potensac  (Médoc)

description: Light, lean wine that has some firm structure. The fruit, though, is really not there, just hints of black currant floating past.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2006  Pauillac

description: Light, lean wine that has some firm structure. The fruit, though, is really not there, just hints of black currant floating past.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2006  Pauillac

description: Dry, certainly not softened by the rich 2003 vintage, but showing fresh fruit, black currants and dry tannins. It's restrained, finely balanced, drinkable now, leaving a soft final impression.
title: Château Guillotin 2003  Puisseguin Saint-Émilion

description: Aromas of smoky new wood and blackberries set the scene for a wine that brings out a soft, supple texture, followed by fresh black fruits and light structure. The second wine of Château Corbin Michotte is attractively fresh, smoky and ready to drink.
title: Château Corbin Michotte 2006 Les Abeilles  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A solid, structured Bordeaux. It shows black berry fruit flavors, lifted by acidity and rounded with dark plum, dry spice and firm tannins. There's a fine, juicy richness to the finish, which leaves fruit and dry tannins firmly in place.
title: Barton & Guestier 2006 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: Fresh and with a herbaceous background, this is a tight, taut and mineral wine. It presents a definite tang of lemon zest, steeliness and a crisp aftertaste. It can be drunk now, although it will be better from 2016.
title: Domaine Matthias et Emile Roblin 2013 Origine Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: Fresh and with a herbaceous background, this is a tight, taut and mineral wine. It presents a definite tang of lemon zest, steeliness and a crisp aftertaste. It can be drunk now, although it will be better from 2016.
title: Domaine Matthias et Emile Roblin 2013 Origine Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: Almonds and green plum flavors give this a bright, perfumed character. Produced with organically grown grapes, it is fruity, touched by minerality and layered with intense, juicy acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Petit Coteau 2014 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: With light vanilla aromas, this is a ripe style of wine despite its low alcohol. An attractive creamy texture gives it a round character, fresh with yellow fruits and orange peel. Drink now.
designation: Le Clos de la Butte Sur Lie
title: Domaine de l'Aujardière 2013 Le Clos de la Butte Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: With light vanilla aromas, this is a ripe style of wine despite its low alcohol. An attractive creamy texture gives it a round character, fresh with yellow fruits and orange peel. Drink now.
designation: Le Clos de la Butte Sur Lie
title: Domaine de l'Aujardière 2013 Le Clos de la Butte Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: This is a crisp, bone-dry wine from vines on the plateau above Vouvray. It has a strongly tangy texture, with lemon zest and tight acidity adding to minerality. It needs to calm down from its in-your-face freshness, so drink from 2017.
title: Clos du Gaimont 2013  Vouvray

description: This pale rosé, made from Cabernet Franc and Chenin Blanc, is attractively fresh, with balanced acidity and fruitiness. The wine offers a tang of plum skins as well as a bite of raspberry. Drink now.
title: Château Moncontour NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Full bodied and silky, like so many of the 2007s from the Southern Rhône, this has already reached maturity. Notes of dried cherry, cinnamon, clove and chocolate all come together in a very drinkable package.
title: Domaine la Mereuille 2007 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: By Médoc standards, this 7-acre vineyard is small, with a production of 1,150 cases. The powerful blackberry flavor is sweetened by dark plum and licorice notes, structured with new wood influence and firm tannins. There is a juicy finish, and the tannins promise long-term aging.
title: Clos la Bohème 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: New-wood flavors abound in this firmly structured, dry wine. With its tannins at the fore, plus its heavy toast and sweet-tasting black-fruit flavors, it has weight and density. This is likely to age well over 3–4 years.
title: Château Tanesse 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: New-wood flavors abound in this firmly structured, dry wine. With its tannins at the fore, plus its heavy toast and sweet-tasting black-fruit flavors, it has weight and density. This is likely to age well over 3–4 years.
title: Château Tanesse 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is rich and smooth, and the power of its tannins are already integrated into the complex plum and blackberry flavors. It has a solid structure, with weight and an open feel.
title: Château Pey la Tour 2009  Bordeaux

description: This is a ripe, fruity wine, with a black currant flavor, layered tannins and refreshing acidity. It's a wine of power yet also of pleasure for drinking now.
title: Château Lynsolence 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: One of the largest Médoc properties, this chateau always produces a reliable wine that is ready to drink soon. Soft and already approachable, the 2010 is no exception. Ripe tannins and a blackberry flavor meld into a round finish
title: Château Larose-Trintaudon 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: A solid and dense wine, this is full of firm tannins, plus black currant and berry flavors. It is well structured and concentrated, a benefit from using fruit sourced from low-yield old vines. With its dark, dense texture, it will age for several years.
title: Château La Mothe du Barry 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Ripe, juicy and fragrant, this has a delicious red berry flavor that is ready to give pleasure. Maybe it's not a wine for long-term aging, but keep it for at least for 4–5 years.
title: Château de Pressac 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Rich and fruity initially, this shows spice and new wood flavors as well as black plum and red berry touches. It has weight without being too concentrated. For medium-term aging.
title: Château Altimar 2009  Pomerol

description: The 20% Malbec in the blend helps to produce the spicy tannins and dark color of this wine. The other grapes in the blend add richness and firm structure, plus a blackberry-driven juiciness. With its bright acidity added to the mix, this is a serious wine with good aging potential.
title: Bernard Magrez 2010 Château Guerry  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: A terrific value, Borlais's white is subtle and floral on the nose, then full bodied, broad and weighty on the palate, with flavors of melon, pineapple and a dry, stony note that lingers on the finish. Drink now.
title: Philippe Borlais 2010 Tête du Rhône White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Beychevelle's style privileges elegance over weight, and such is the case with the 2010. It's a pure-fruited, ripe and lightly tannic wine, emphasizing a blackberry note. This will evolve relatively quickly, reaching a peak in approximately eight years.
title: Château Beychevelle 2010  Saint-Julien

description: Beychevelle's style privileges elegance over weight, and such is the case with the 2010. It's a pure-fruited, ripe and lightly tannic wine, emphasizing a blackberry note. This will evolve relatively quickly, reaching a peak in approximately eight years.
title: Château Beychevelle 2010  Saint-Julien

description: Big, floral, ripe and juicy, this epitomizes the richness of the 2009 vintage. It offers firm tannins and generous, forward fruits.
title: Château Valandraud 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This powerful, rich wine is densely packed with sweetness and citrus flavors. Honey and lemon notes combine with a dry core of botrytis, offering intensity and a complex sweet-and-sour finish.
title: Château Lafaurie-Peyraguey 2009  Sauternes

description: This is a smoky, rich wine that shows evident wood aging. This feature adds weight, though the sweetness is currently muted. It is a wine with potential intensity; the fruit and acidity will emerge in several years.
title: Château Guiraud 2009  Sauternes

description: Superbly ripe, this wine shows upfront botrytis and honey flavors. At its core, it bears opulence, with depth and concentration. The open character of the wine is shot through with lemon and orange zest flavors.
title: Château de Malle 2009  Sauternes

description: Dense and rich, this wine has concentrated flavors of botrytis and floral honey. The wine gives the impression of sweetness, with balancing acidity and a core of dryness. Weighty and dense, it's likely to age.
title: Château Coutet 2009  Barsac

description: Dense and rich, this wine has concentrated flavors of botrytis and floral honey. The wine gives the impression of sweetness, with balancing acidity and a core of dryness. Weighty and dense, it's likely to age.
title: Château Coutet 2009  Barsac

description: With advice from consultant and Bordeaux University professor Denis Dubourdieu, Batailley has improved immensely in the past few years. This 2010 reinforces that trend, revealing a wine that is structured with Cabernet Sauvignon and is attractive with black currant fruitiness. Age for the medium-term.
title: Château Batailley 2010  Pauillac

description: Prices for this estate's wines have skyrocketed, but there is no doubting the quality in the bottle. The 2009 Cuvée Réservée is a huge wine, overflowing with intense black cherry and plum flavors to the point of seeming a bit sweet. Yet it's all framed by strong yet softly dusty tannins that should see it age well for at least 15 years.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2009 Cuvée Réservée Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: In this concentrated wine, an opulent botrytis character dominates. Notes of yellow and citrus fruits combine with a lemon-flavored honey accent to produce a wine that has both richness and intense acidity. It needs to age.
title: Château Nairac 2009  Barsac

description: Obviously wood-aged, with a smoky toast flavor, this is a wine that shows the power of Saint-Estèphe tannins in full force. At the same time, there is a blackberry character that adds richness and juiciness, which cuts through the dry core. Age for at least 7–8 years.
title: Château Lilian Ladouys 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: This full, fruity wine is packed with acidity as well as ripeness. It has a fresh black-currant character, and the structure underneath is strong. It will develop relatively quickly, but then could hold at its peak for many years.
title: Château Kirwan 2010  Margaux

description: This full, fruity wine is packed with acidity as well as ripeness. It has a fresh black-currant character, and the structure underneath is strong. It will develop relatively quickly, but then could hold at its peak for many years.
title: Château Kirwan 2010  Margaux

description: One of the Lurton properties in Margaux, Brane Cantenac is showing the richness of its finely placed vineyard in this 2010. Smoky wood and ripe blackberry are among the flavors of a wine that is complex, complete and concentrated. It will certainly age well.
title: Château Brane-Cantenac 2010  Margaux

description: It was powerful and dense at en primeur, and it hasn't changed since. This is firm, concentrated and very structured, perhaps extracted, showing the full force of blackberry and sweet wood flavors and dark tannins.  Long-term aging needed.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2010  Margaux

description: A lemon zest flavor cuts through this delicate wine. It has lively sweetness and flavors of lemon curd and bitter orange that lace the note of honey. There is much more concentration to come in the future.
title: Château de Rayne Vigneau 2009  Sauternes

description: Closed at this stage, this promises a huge, ripe future. Toast and spice notes are balanced around a black plum flavor. The dense, dark tannins create a brooding character, which is balanced by freshness on the finish. Give this wine at least 10 years.
title: Château Angélus 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Closed at this stage, this promises a huge, ripe future. Toast and spice notes are balanced around a black plum flavor. The dense, dark tannins create a brooding character, which is balanced by freshness on the finish. Give this wine at least 10 years.
title: Château Angélus 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This is rich, exuding delicious sweetness, with a core of dense botrytis. An opulent, ripe apricot flavor accompanies the bittersweet orange and mirabelle fruit notes. The acidity, sweetness and concentration promise a great future for this wine.
title: Château la Tour Blanche 2009  Sauternes

description: One of the finest wines to come from Cantenac Brown for many years, this is powerful and dense, dominated by Cabernet Franc tannins and fruits. The structure has a smooth, polished character that locates it firmly in Margaux, giving elegance and discreet fruitiness. Age this fine wine for many years.
title: Château Cantenac Brown 2010  Margaux

description: There's an attractive richness to the ripe stone and tropical fruit core of this wine, laced with hints of citrus peel and saline that shine on the finish. The medium-weight body is balanced by ample acidity, helping to preserve the wine's fresh and lively feel. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2015  Picpoul de Pinet

description: This is a fresh, open and very accessible wine. Crisp acidity cuts through the green apple flavors and tangy, mineral texture. With juicy fruitiness, it is a light wine that is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Gérard Duplessis 2014  Chablis

description: A rich wine with some tropical fruit character fixed firmly in a very mineral context. Very firm and rich, there is a grapefruit character to the texture. A fresh finish rounds it off.
title: Domaine Laporte 2008 Les Duchesses  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This wine has soft fruit, a creamy texture and light acidity. It is balanced, fruity with apple and spice flavors. The aftertaste introduces a drier, woody character that is less attractive.
title: Domaine de la Denante 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This wine offers attractive citrus and yellow-fruit flavors. It is fresh, with a richer backdrop of perfumed fruit. The texture brings out the ripeness.
title: Christophe Cordier 2014  Mâcon

description: This 50-50 blend of Marselan and Merlot opens with aromas of raspberry-cran-apple juice and underripe cherry. The light palate offers lithe tannins and a tart, fruit-skin astringency that lingers through the close.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2014 La Remise Red (Vin de France)

description: Crisp aromas of lemon, melon rind and underripe pear are not overly intense but at the center of the bouquet. The palate is light weight and accessible, with similarly easy flavors that carry through to the clean and mouthwatering finish.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2015 White (Vin de France)

description: Soft and round, this has gentle fruitiness and a touch of spice. It is an easy, open wine that is ready to drink.
title: Manciat-Poncet 2014 Les Crays  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Light scents of lime, white melon rind, green gooseberry and fresh-cut grass dance on the nose of this dainty white, followed by flavors of underripe pear and tart currant on the light-weight palate. It's fresh and lively, finishing short but clean. Drink up.
title: Kiwi Cuvée 2015 Bin 086 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Light scents of lime, white melon rind, green gooseberry and fresh-cut grass dance on the nose of this dainty white, followed by flavors of underripe pear and tart currant on the light-weight palate. It's fresh and lively, finishing short but clean. Drink up.
title: Kiwi Cuvée 2015 Bin 086 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This soft wine has ripe melon and pear flavors only lightly cut with citrus acidity. It is easy to drink and ready now.
title: Jean-Paul Paquet 2014 Domaine des Vieux Murs  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This soft wine has ripe melon and pear flavors only lightly cut with citrus acidity. It is easy to drink and ready now.
title: Jean-Paul Paquet 2014 Domaine des Vieux Murs  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is a solid and balanced wine, with lively aromas and flavors of red cherry, strawberry and banana. Light weight and easy drinking, the softly tannic structure transitions seamlessly into the clean, fruity finish.
title: J.P. Chenet 2015 Reserve Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: The nonvintage blend from this venerable producer is as balanced as all its Champagnes. It steers a fine course between acidity and crispness and a softer riper dosage. Blended with equal parts of all three main Champagne grapes, it is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Perrier NV Cuvée Royale Brut  (Champagne)

description: The nonvintage blend from this venerable producer is as balanced as all its Champagnes. It steers a fine course between acidity and crispness and a softer riper dosage. Blended with equal parts of all three main Champagne grapes, it is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Perrier NV Cuvée Royale Brut  (Champagne)

description: Tropical fruit aromas show up on the ripe fruity palate of this wine. With pineapple and mango, it is in the tropical spectrum of Sauvignon Blanc. The acidity is just right to keep the crisp texture in place. Drink now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2016 La Java des Grandes Esperances Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This wine is marked as sec (dry) and it is certainly that. The acidity is intense, cutting through the apple fruits and almond flavors. The wine obviously needs to soften and mature for a few months, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Moncontour 2016 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: While this is certainly a young fruity wine, it also has a soft texture to go with the juicy black fruits to make it ready to drink now. It is smoky, lightly tannic and packed full of ripe fruits.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier 2016 Le Grand Bouqueteau  (Chinon)

description: The standard nonvintage blend from this producer is soft with a good touch of bottle age as well as a relatively high dosage. It is fruity, easy and with its final acidity, crisp and refreshing to drink.
title: Esterlin NV Brut Eclat  (Champagne)

description: From vines around the village of Epfig (“E”), this is a wonderfully pure wine that's fragrant and crisp. It has apple and citrus flavors lightly blessed by honey. Acidity cuts right through the fruitiness, giving the wine a tight and steely aftertaste.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2011 Vignoble d'E Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a sweet, very perfumed wine with pleasant candy flavors. Rich rosewater and spice notes add complexity, and chalk soils lend a crisp edge that cuts into the opulent character of the wine. It could age, not for long, so drink until 2018.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2011 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A serious wine that needs aging, this is full and ripe while also having a steely edge to it. Very perfumed, floral and strongly textured, this is an impressive wine that does need extended aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2011 Praelatenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: While the wine is a touch gamy, it also has a ripe, fruity character. There is a touch of wood, underlining the acidity and juicy red fruits. The finish brings out the richness of the vintage.
title: Chateau de Pibarnon 2009 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a rich and perfumed wine that is solid with dusty tannins and ripe fruit. Bold acidity adds balance and promises good aging. It is quite dry with fruit hiding behind all the structure, but it will soften, so drink from 2016.
title: Château de Calavon 2010 Tradition Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a deliciously ripe, full-bodied wine with all the red berry fruits, orange zest and acidity that you could want. It's finely made with a creamy mousse and a fresh and fruity aftertaste.
title: Willm NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Very fruity and soft, this wine blends tropical pineapple aromas with a crisper, lemon zest palate. It's a gentle wine, its acidity tamed by the ripe fruits. Screwcap,
title: Tortoise Creek 2012 Cuvée Jeanne Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Very fruity and soft, this wine blends tropical pineapple aromas with a crisper, lemon zest palate. It's a gentle wine, its acidity tamed by the ripe fruits. Screwcap,
title: Tortoise Creek 2012 Cuvée Jeanne Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This wine's richness is masked by acidity and given a mineral texture. Apples mingle with green plums and a herbal character. The powerful acidity is very dominant and needs to integrate.
designation: Le Peu de la Moriette Demi-Sec
title: Domaine Pichot 2012 Le Peu de la Moriette Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This wine's richness is masked by acidity and given a mineral texture. Apples mingle with green plums and a herbal character. The powerful acidity is very dominant and needs to integrate.
designation: Le Peu de la Moriette Demi-Sec
title: Domaine Pichot 2012 Le Peu de la Moriette Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Soft and fruity, this is an attractive, light and perfumed rosé. It has delicious vanilla flavors, red and white fruits all laced with a good citrus element and a bright aftertaste. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Guillaman 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A crisp, fruity, unoaked Chardonnay. It has bright apple and fresh squeezed lime. This is very light and finishes with great acidity. Screwcap
title: Bernier 2012 Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: A mature, toasty wine, perhaps too toasty. There are still hints of ripe strawberries as well as the more mature flavors. The wine shows a full-bodied character and an attractive onion skin color.
title: Vranken 1998 Diamant Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is packed with crisp red currant fruit and plenty of acidity. Firm with tannins now, it will bring out more fruitiness as it develops. Ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château la Brande 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Lively, ripe fruit, with appetizing acidity, dominated by pink grapefruit and vibrant citrus. Just a touch of yeast, from a fresh mousse.
