If you're after a treat with washed-rind cheeses, choose this medium-sweet gem.
title: Louis Sipp 2010 Osterberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Rounded and rich, this single-vineyard wine is concentrated without losing a touch of its beautiful fruit. It has a fine balance between fruit and acidity as well as a tense line of minerality and tight texture. Drink this impressive wine from 2024.
title: Le Carré 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: Full and rich, this is ripe with red berry-fruit flavors. Orange-pink in color, the wine, despite its acidity, seems heavy. The aftertaste is soft and rounded, with strawberry flavors.
title: Luc Mérat NV La Diva Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This strawberry and caramel-flavored wine has bright acidity and a crisp, clean aftertaste. The fruit right up front gives a refreshing summer-afternoon feel. Drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: This wine has red-currant fruits, along with acidity and light tannins. The wine is crisp and fruity, maybe not expressing the full power of a Morgon but can be enjoyed now for its fruitiness.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014  Morgon

description: For fruity, red-cherry-flavored Beaujolais, look no further. This Gamay wine has it all: soft tannins, intensely juicy red fruits and crisp, tangy acidity at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dupeuble Père et Fils 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: For fruity, red-cherry-flavored Beaujolais, look no further. This Gamay wine has it all: soft tannins, intensely juicy red fruits and crisp, tangy acidity at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dupeuble Père et Fils 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: A soft Chardonnay from limestone soil vineyards, this has attractive apple and citrus fruits. It is round, smooth and with a creamy aftertaste that allows room for refreshing acidity. Jean-Paul Brun has been making wine since 1979. He uses natural yeasts.
title: Domaine des Terres Dorées 2014 Classic  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Production from 41 acres of land donated over more than a century to the Hospices of Lyon produces an attractive and aromatic wine. It is full of light, juicy fruit and fresh red cherries. Drink this refreshing wine now.
title: Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon 2014  Beaujolais-Villages
winery: Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon

description: There is a danger that the otherwise fine wines of Daniel Fournié are becoming excessively alcoholic. That's the feeling here. So although the black fruit is ripe, opulent and packed with tannins, there is a nagging burn and pepper character. A degree less alcohol and this would be a fabulous wine.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2008 Pur Plaisir Malbec (Cahors)

description: An impressively structured wine, this great blend of Négrette, Syrah and Malbec shows intense tannins underlying powerful juicy black fruit flavors. Aromatic, spicy and driven by its dry texture, it should age for several years.
title: Château Bouissel 2008 Le Bouissel Red (Fronton)

description: Burnt toast aromas show the youth of this wine. Their tannins dominate, giving a bitter chocolate and coffee character. The fruit is still lost here and needs 3–4 years to come out. An impressive wine for the future.
title: Mas del Périé 2008 Les Acacias Malbec (Cahors)

description: Burnt toast aromas show the youth of this wine. Their tannins dominate, giving a bitter chocolate and coffee character. The fruit is still lost here and needs 3–4 years to come out. An impressive wine for the future.
title: Mas del Périé 2008 Les Acacias Malbec (Cahors)

description: Perfumed, minty wine, very solidly structured, while also showing delicious red berry fruits. The tannins have a distinct mineral character, chewy although well integrated with the fruit.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2006 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Perfumed, minty wine, very solidly structured, while also showing delicious red berry fruits. The tannins have a distinct mineral character, chewy although well integrated with the fruit.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2006 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: An elegant expression of Tannat, with plum skin spice and a delicious juiciness showing well. The acidity, the wood and a smoky flavor add complexity. Age this balanced wine for another 2–3 years.
title: Château d'Aydie 2008 Ode d'Aydie Tannat (Madiran)

description: A dense wine, very much in the line of powerful wines from Haut-Bailly. Flavors of bitter chocolate, sweet berry fruits and richness are dominant, the acidity a fine balancing act to give a burst of freshness.
title: Château Haut-Bailly 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: Definite tannins here, a wine that shows ripe fruits, richness and a solid core. It is not huge, but does have structure, bitter chocolate, sweetness. It's worth aging this wine 3–4 years.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2007 Clos du Marquis  (Saint-Julien)

description: With a high proportion of Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a structured wine, the freshness coming from intense blackberries. Spice and bitter coffee flavors mingle with the tannins, promising some good aging for the vintage.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2007  Saint-Julien

description: Meffre's wines can be a bit variable, but this Condrieu is top shelf, starting from its seductive aromas of honey, apricot and truffle to its lingering, elegant finish. In between, it's lush and mouthcoating without being overblown. Drink now-2012.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2007 Laurus  (Condrieu)

description: Meffre's wines can be a bit variable, but this Condrieu is top shelf, starting from its seductive aromas of honey, apricot and truffle to its lingering, elegant finish. In between, it's lush and mouthcoating without being overblown. Drink now-2012.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2007 Laurus  (Condrieu)

description: A great success, with its concentration, solid tannins and black, bitter cherry fruit flavors. The wine has spice, licorice and some layers of wood. Certainly, this would be worth aging for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: A great success, with its concentration, solid tannins and black, bitter cherry fruit flavors. The wine has spice, licorice and some layers of wood. Certainly, this would be worth aging for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: The wood that dominated during the futures tastings in 2008 has calmed down, merging more easily into the rich fruits. There is an attractive smoky character, focused berry flavors and delicious spice. It should age well over 3–5 years.
title: Château du Tertre 2007  Margaux

description: The wood that dominated during the futures tastings in 2008 has calmed down, merging more easily into the rich fruits. There is an attractive smoky character, focused berry flavors and delicious spice. It should age well over 3–5 years.
title: Château du Tertre 2007  Margaux

description: This is a delicious wine already, not powerful, but charming and elegant. The acidity and fruit are easy and bright, the tannins light but properly in balance. That suggests this is not for aging. It's already a pleasure to drink now.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2007  Saint-Julien

description: Dusty tannins push to the front, resulting in a firm, wood-aged wine that shows smokiness, ripe blackberry flavors and a firm core. This should be at its best in 2–3 years.
title: Château Maison Neuve 2010 Clotilde  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Full bodied, structured and tannic while also fruity, this is fine example of the 2010 vintage. It's all structure at this stage, but it's going to be a full and ripe wine, although the alcohol does show through at the end in a pepper-driven moment.
title: Château la Brande 2010  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is beautifully structured, packed with black fruits, ripe tannins and balanced acidity. It's still young, showing the black fruit side of Malbec, but the tannins are already integrating well into the structure. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: The blend is 70% Syrah, 20% Grenache and 10% Carignan, and in 2009 the grapes were as ripe as they could be. Mocha and chocolate notes pick up a touch of prune. With its superripe fruit, ample weight, lush texture and warm finish, there are valid concerns about its ageability, but this offers hedonistic drinking for an affordable price.
region: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Guillaume Gros 2009 El Niño Loco Red (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: More than half of the blend is Viognier, which no doubt accounts for its dramatic aromas and flavors of exotic tropical fruit, only just reined in by more citrusy notes. It's full bodied and round in the mouth without being at all flabby, with a crisp, clean, lingering finish. Drink it over the next year.
title: E. Guigal 2010 White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: More than half of the blend is Viognier, which no doubt accounts for its dramatic aromas and flavors of exotic tropical fruit, only just reined in by more citrusy notes. It's full bodied and round in the mouth without being at all flabby, with a crisp, clean, lingering finish. Drink it over the next year.
title: E. Guigal 2010 White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This blend of 60% Grenache, 20% Syrah and 20% Mourvèdre delivers juicy, almost gulpable fruit, supported by a loose spine of soft tannins. Purple raspberry and black cherry flavors linger on the supple finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Les Trois Couronnes 2010 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This wine starts off with vanilla, cinnamon and dark cherry notes on the nose, with the oak-derived elements marrying nicely with the Grenache fruit. It's full bodied, liquorous and lush, with a long, velvety finish. Probably best over the next 4–5 years.
title: LePlan-Vermeersch 2009 GT-G Grand Terroir Grenache (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Dense and almost black in color, this is concentrated, with intense tannins and black plum fruit. It bursts with the rich fruit and acidity, finishing on a smoky, juicy note.
title: Mas del Périé 2010 La Roque Malbec (Cahors)

description: Dense and almost black in color, this is concentrated, with intense tannins and black plum fruit. It bursts with the rich fruit and acidity, finishing on a smoky, juicy note.
title: Mas del Périé 2010 La Roque Malbec (Cahors)

description: An attractive, pale rosé, this is fruity and just lightly textured. Packed with red fruits, its soft character comes from the dosage that puts the wine on the sweeter side of Brut. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Authentic Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A subtle touch of tannin in this otherwise fruity wine gives a dry edge that contrasts with the bright red-berry fruits and refreshing acidity. Drink now, although this wine will be even better in 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Automne Gourmand  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This broad, ripe wine has plenty of ripe red fruits but the minimum of structure. It is soft, generous and ready to drink. Much of the hand-picked production is from old vines on a 45-degree slope.
title: Henry Fessy 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This broad, ripe wine has plenty of ripe red fruits but the minimum of structure. It is soft, generous and ready to drink. Much of the hand-picked production is from old vines on a 45-degree slope.
title: Henry Fessy 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Light and fruity, this gently textured wine is more about red fruits than structure. It is perfumed with red-berry flavors, crisp acidity and a tangy, orange-flavored aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A high-toned nose makes earthy yeast notes seem more heady than they are. The palate is frothy and almost austere, with a slightly bitter edge softened by dosage.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé NV Giersberger Cacher Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: With its lively mousse and crisp acidity, this red-currant-flavored wine is fresh and tight. The fruitiness is still right up front. Another few months in bottle will soften and round it out very well. Drink from 2016.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is a light and fresh wine with soft tannins and appealing red berry fruits. It offers attractive acidity at the end, a balanced wine that is ready to drink.
title: Gérard Charvet 2014 La Réserve d'Amélie  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This structured wine has a great weight of fruit behind its firm tannins. Juicy acidity gives a delicious, fragrant and ripe character. Drink this wine from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Clos des 4 Vents La Madone  (Fleurie)

description: From vineyards close to Juliénas, this is a bright wine full of cherry juice and fresh acidity. It does have a sense of structure with a background of tannins and minerality that will allow it to age, although it is delicious now.
title: Domaine des Mouilles 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Mainly Cabernet Sauvignon, this shows off Cabernet's cedary, leafy qualities to advantage, using them to accent its cassis fruit. It's a nicely balanced, medium-bodied Cab, with a smooth texture and chocolate and cedar accents on the finish. Ready to drink now, but it should hold for at least another few years.
title: Jules 2004 Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon (Côtes de Provence)

description: Mainly Cabernet Sauvignon, this shows off Cabernet's cedary, leafy qualities to advantage, using them to accent its cassis fruit. It's a nicely balanced, medium-bodied Cab, with a smooth texture and chocolate and cedar accents on the finish. Ready to drink now, but it should hold for at least another few years.
title: Jules 2004 Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon (Côtes de Provence)

description: Less fruit-driven than most Provence rosés, this is a refined, elegant style that provides complexity in the form of spice, mineral and hints of green herbs. Long on the finish.
title: Château des Gavelles 2007 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: A 50-50 blend of Cinsault and Grenache, this is a medium-bodied, plump, succulent rosé, hinting at grapefruit and underripe peaches. It's nicely balanced, with a long, slightly minerally finish. Drink now.
title: Château Margüi 2007 Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: While this wine does not age in wood, it does age on its lees, giving it a rich, creamy texture. It's smooth, full and soft, its apricot and peach flavors showing ripeness and openness. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2015 Ancestral  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A fine blend with 60% Tannat that has been softened and filled out by Cabernets Franc and Sauvignon. It still does have a firm tannic core although this is surrounded by ripe black fruits and acidity. It has all its bright fruit and so could age further, although it is now ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Moulié 2011 Red (Madiran)

description: One of a pair of wines that are named after the soils on which the vines grow, this comes from clay and chalk earth on the terraces of the Lot river. It is structured and still dense, needing several years to mature. Packed tannins still lie over the generous ripe fruits. Drink from 2019.
title: Rigal 2013 Les Pierres Blanches Malbec (Cahors)

description: This warm, rounded Champagne is full of strawberry flavors. It is ripe and soft, perhaps too soft with a suggestion of sweetness as well as the natural acidity of the wine. Drink now.
title: Gremillet NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The wine is soft, gently herbaceous and fresh. Grapefruit and gooseberry flavors are bright, steely and fruity in this clean wine that's ready to drink.
title: Sauvion 2013  Sancerre

description: This second wine of Lafite Rothschild is packed with acidity, nervy black currant fruits and extreme freshness. It's a light wine, all fruit and only hints of tannin and structure.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2013 Les Carruades de Lafite  (Pauillac)

description: With 70% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a structured wine, firm with tannins that contrast with the black-currant fruits. Still full of young tannins, it will develop well over the next few years. Wait to drink until 2019.
title: Château Laffitte Carcasset 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: This full and structured wine offers good acidity, firm tannins and layers of black-currant flavors. It has good potential with richness, weight and balance. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut-Vigneau 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Black-currant fruit and attractive acidity are layered with ripe, dark tannins and concentration. The potential is there, although it is likely be over the short term. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2013  Saint-Julien

description: This structured wine has acidity and a broad base of black fruits. It is concentrated and firm, but with the fruitiness of the vintage. Drink this already-attractive wine from 2018.
title: Château Lalande-Borie 2013  Saint-Julien

description: This is a ripe, spicy wine with attractive acidity and pear and crisp apple flavors. It is all fruit, fresh while also having a riper side to it. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut Nouchet 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: From a small parcel of chalky soil in the Fourcas Dupré estate, this ripe, wood-aged wine offers toast and herbal flavors along with ripe apricot and quince fruitiness. The acidity and the mineral edge of the wine promise aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Fourcas Dupré 2014 Grand Vin Blanc Sec  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: The skill of Michel Rolland's wine-consulting team shows in this sophisticated, rich wine. The 90% Merlot dominates, but the ripeness is tempered by solid tannins, stylish black-currant flavors and a firm, ageworthy aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Courlat 2011  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: This is the dry white wine made from the Sauternes estate of Rayne Vigneau. Grapefruit and other citrus flavors are prominent, cutting through the taut texture, along with with a light touch of honey that gives richness. The wine needs to age a little longer, so drink from late 2016.
title: Château de Rayne Vigneau 2013 Le Sec de Rayne Vigneau  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is the dry white wine made from the Sauternes estate of Rayne Vigneau. Grapefruit and other citrus flavors are prominent, cutting through the taut texture, along with with a light touch of honey that gives richness. The wine needs to age a little longer, so drink from late 2016.
title: Château de Rayne Vigneau 2013 Le Sec de Rayne Vigneau  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Fruit and more mature flavors are coming together, giving a structured wine with black-currant flavors balanced with mint, spice and a rounded texture. This stylish wine is almost ready to drink; just wait until summer 2016.
title: Château de l'Annonciation 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: This wine is a vineyard selection, aged in wood for 12 months. A structured blend of Fer Servadou and Cabernet Sauvignon, it has black fruits, firm tannins and acidity, all in balance. The wood aging is only a hint of smoothness with the rich fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laurens 2013 Cuvée de Flars  (Marcillac)

description: Coming mainly from the villages of Ladoix and Chorey-lès-Beaune, this wine is a delicious example of the juicy, ripe fruit that comes from the Côte de Beaune. It's soft and open, with a generous character that makes it ready to drink soon, from 2018.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Côte de Beaune-Villages

description: From midway between Bordeaux and Toulouse, the small area of Buzet produces wines in the likeness of Bordeaux. This blend has the tannins of Cabernet Sauvignon prominent in the mix, giving the wine structure and density. Drink the wine from 2018.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 Merlot-Cabernet Sauvignon (Buzet)

description: Blending the three red grapes of Gaillac (Duras, Braucol and Syrah), this is an impressively rich wine, with signs of its wood aging just integrating with the ripe black-currant fruit and firm tannins. It has an exhilarating aftertaste of acidity and young fruits. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Rotier 2015 Les Gravels Red (Gaillac)

description: Vineyards close to the sea produce a beautiful crisp wine, with red fruits, a touch of saltiness and tangy acidity. Cool fermentation has kept so much delicious flavorsome fruit. Drink now.
title: Château Minuty 2016 Rosé et Or Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine comes from a single, high-elevation vineyard owned by Château Lagrézette. Wood aged, it smooths out the naturally creamy Viognier to give a broad generous wine. Spice and apricot fruits are balanced by green-fruit acidity. The opulent wine is just about ready to drink although it will be better from 2018.
title: Château Lagrézette 2015 Le Pigeonnier White Vision Viognier (Côtes du Lot)

description: This young wine has great potential. With powerful tannins and a dense texture, it is rich in black fruits and acidity. Concentrated and with a firm structure, the wine will age well. Produced from a blend that puts Bordeaux grapes with a small proportion of the local Abouriou, it will be ready in 2020.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2014 Château Bazin Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: With concentration and a sense of structure, this is a solid wine with great potential. It has firm tannins under the attractive raspberry fruits. The wine is dense and certainly needs aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Roche de Bellene 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: A family estate just outside Aix-en-Provence has produced a textured and dense wine. It has great fruitiness along with a spice and pepper character that brings out a more complex side. It's definitely for food.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine la Rabiotte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is an attractive pink-colored wine that is beautifully fresh while also having some rich strawberry fruit cut with acidity. There is a touch of pepper that gives a dry and lightly tannic core. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine Houchart 2014 Tête de Cuvée Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is an attractive pink-colored wine that is beautifully fresh while also having some rich strawberry fruit cut with acidity. There is a touch of pepper that gives a dry and lightly tannic core. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine Houchart 2014 Tête de Cuvée Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of four varieties boasts notes of almond skin, orange zest and honeydew melon in a full-bodied, slightly warm wine. The long finish shows ample concentration and a hint of bitterness.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2013 Cuvée Réservée White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Kept in tank for 10 years, this rich, full wine proves that Muscadet can age. It has preserved all its freshness and added ripe yellow fruits and a surprisingly opulent character. The wine still has a tang and lemon crispness, full of flavor. It is a wine for food with its final mineral aftertaste.
title: Domaine du Haut Bourg 2005 Origine du Haut Bourg  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: Lightly off dry, this rich, smooth wine has acidity to balance the honey and ripe pineapple flavors. With some aging, it will show a delicious, ripe balance of fruit and creamy texture, with some zest to add liveliness. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de la Gaverie 2014 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Certainly tannic but at the same time richly black fruited. This is solid, chunky, with plum and sweet fig fruits, lining a bitter chocolate and dark tannin outer shell. For aging over several years.
title: Château Peyros 2007 Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: Dry, firmly tannic wine, dominated by mint and coffee flavors along with wood. The fruit underneath has a suggestion of ripe blackberry flavors but will need at least 3 years to come out. It is a powerful, complex wine for aging.
title: Château du Port 2009 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Dense and complex wine, packed with the ripest fruit. It has powerful tannins, although they are easily balanced by the rich plum and damson flavors. The wine is solid, chunky, based on a dry and firm core, ready for aging over 4 years.
title: Château du Cèdre 2008 Malbec (Cahors)

description: With the richness of the vintage in mind, this wine makes a powerfully extravagant statement. There is nothing subdued about the concentrated tannins or the intensely rich black fruits. Even with 3–4 years aging, this will still be a bold wine.
title: Mas del Périé 2009 La Roque Malbec (Cahors)

description: With the richness of the vintage in mind, this wine makes a powerfully extravagant statement. There is nothing subdued about the concentrated tannins or the intensely rich black fruits. Even with 3–4 years aging, this will still be a bold wine.
title: Mas del Périé 2009 La Roque Malbec (Cahors)

description: Lemon-scented Mirabelle notes hover on the nose and turn into fully fledged, ripe plum on the palate where the seam of fresh, enlivening and brightening acidity sets a lively theme. The body is light, the finish is dry and the overall impression is one of light-footed playfulness and ease. You might almost forget to notice the more textured, structured core which underlies all this and will allow it to age beautifully. Drink now through 2025.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2013 Fronholz Riesling (Alsace)

description: Lemon-scented Mirabelle notes hover on the nose and turn into fully fledged, ripe plum on the palate where the seam of fresh, enlivening and brightening acidity sets a lively theme. The body is light, the finish is dry and the overall impression is one of light-footed playfulness and ease. You might almost forget to notice the more textured, structured core which underlies all this and will allow it to age beautifully. Drink now through 2025.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2013 Fronholz Riesling (Alsace)

description: Subtle but luscious notes of Mirabelle plum, ripe greengage and peach lend a seductive touch to this taut, structured and beautifully textured wine whose palate is reminiscent of bot fresh apple peel and grapefruit zest. Covers of fruit are tautly spread across spokes of acidity, creating a wonderful tension that keeps you wanting more. Authentic in its appeal, it's delicious now but will drink well until at least 2025.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2013 Clos Mathis Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tender notes of citrus appear at first through a veil of yeast. Their zestiness then fills out with subtle, earthy spice. On the light, dry palate, the true subtlety hits: wafts of lemon, aromatic wild thyme, Seville orange zest, fresh apple peel and wet stone. The delicacy of the concentrated body is astonishing, with a central vein of lemony freshness that provides a focal point. So subtle, so layered and alive: with every new sip new nuances occur.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Clos Windsbuhl Riesling (Alsace)

description: This conveys the purest, most evocative scent of ripe Sicilian blood orange, embedded in a sea of rose petals. Floral notes and aromatic citrus freshness lead a dance on the slender palate that has the slightest edge of smoke and stone. The finish is dry, imbued with a haunting, elemental quality that makes this light but profound wine irresistible.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2014 Fronholz Muscat (Alsace)

description: This wine already has great balance, with its dry structure setting off the concentrated cherry and red-berry fruits. The acidity, tense while also fragrant, gives a background of freshness to the wine. It is still young, firm tannins still prominent. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Méo-Camuzet 2013 Aux Murgers Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A generous wine, this features intense dark fruits, ripe strawberry and an almost -weet character. It's packed with spice, richness and beautiful concentration. Great acidity gives a wine that is developing freshness and weight. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Les Boucherottes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Wonderful spice and ripe red fruits shoot through this rich while structured wine. Dark cherries, strawberries and a ripe texture have given a wine that will be beautiful, smooth and generous. The acidity and the core of tannins will allow it to age well. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Ripe and juicy, this is a well-structured wine with both delicious red fruits and a core of serious tannins. The wine has weigh, richness and a opulence that comes from great fruits. The result is a wine with beautiful character that will develop well. Drink from 2019.
title: Henri de Villamont 2012  Mazis-Chambertin

description: From one of the rare south-facing vineyards in Beaune, this warm, rich and ripe wine is generous with its spice, smokiness and rounded red fruits. Acidity cuts through, bringing raspberry in its wake. The sense of structure really gives this wine its power and density. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Clos des Couchereaux Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This is a gentle wine that has some weight and richness. Its fruit is soft, ripe and warm.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2011 Cep d'Or Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is full, soft and a little heavy. It's condensed with sweetness from the rich fruit and misses some crispness.
title: Château Pas du Cerf 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a simple, clean wine, with light fruit and approachable acidity. The finish is soft and easy.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2011 Domaine Fontanyul Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a simple, clean wine, with light fruit and approachable acidity. The finish is soft and easy.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2011 Domaine Fontanyul Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Flavors of red fruit, tangerine and a touch of spice all contribute to this open, warm effortthat has light acidity.
title: Noble Terroir 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Sylvaner's essential spice and pepper quality is well brought out in this stylish wine. The pear and quince flavors come through strongly, finishing with acidity.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2009 Trois Châteaux Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: Already showing some maturity, this almond- and yeast-flavored wine still has plenty of soft white fruits and balancing acidity. The wine finishes with a warm, rounded feel.
title: Joseph Cattin 2007 Grande Cuvée Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Ripe and creamy wine, with a good edge of age to soften and broaden the fruitiness. It has a texture of plum skins with acidity not far behind. With its fresh aftertaste, this is a success.
title: Jean Albrecht NV Brut Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Ripe and creamy wine, with a good edge of age to soften and broaden the fruitiness. It has a texture of plum skins with acidity not far behind. With its fresh aftertaste, this is a success.
title: Jean Albrecht NV Brut Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: At the south end of Chassagne-Montrachet, Morgeots Premier Cru is close to abbey ruins. This young, toasty wine is ripe, smooth and creamy. Rich apple and green plum flavors are balanced by acidity and touched by honey. The wood aging is still prominent and needs to tone down, so drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Les Morgeots Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Produced from old vines on the Bourgeois estate, this wood-aged wine certainly shows its toastiness although it also has plenty of red-berry flavors as a balance. It is richly concentrated, a good example of the richer, more serious style of Pinot Noir that is coming from Sancerre. It is structured and can age, so drink from 2017.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 La Bourgeoise  (Sancerre)

description: This has a strong steely, mineral character. It offers plenty of citrus and green plum but, at this young stage, the wine is more about crisp texture. The aftertaste hints at the future, ripe and warm. Drink from 2017.
title: Doudet Naudin 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This wine is closed and still very young. For the moment, acidity dominates, although plenty of ripe apples and peaches are waiting to come out. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2014 En Brûle  (Saint-Véran)

description: Smooth and ripe, this offers good acidity as well as apple and citrus flavors. With a crisp texture and touches of minerality, it is ready to drink,
title: Louis Latour 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Smooth and ripe, this offers good acidity as well as apple and citrus flavors. With a crisp texture and touches of minerality, it is ready to drink,
title: Louis Latour 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Packed with red fruits, this is a ripe while fresh wine. Acidity that cuts into the ripe flavors with a crisp edge in this otherwise jammy, rounded wine. The aftertaste is bright and lively with red currants. Drink from 2018.
title: Henri de Villamont 2014 Le Village  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A spicy new wood flavored wine, offering attractive jammy fruits. The wine is fresh, fruity, not particularly dense, but balancing well.
title: Château d'Agassac 2008 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Ripe, but firm wine, its blackcurrant freshness tucked into stark tannins. Black plum juice gives both acidity and sweetness. The final is a balanced wine, lifted by spice.
title: Château Batailley 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Ripe, but firm wine, its blackcurrant freshness tucked into stark tannins. Black plum juice gives both acidity and sweetness. The final is a balanced wine, lifted by spice.
title: Château Batailley 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. The second wine of Valandraud, a wine that goes more for tannins than its big brother. The fruit is less obvious, less attractive.
title: Clos Badon 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

title: Clos Badon 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. An intensely spicy wine, full of exotic flavors, dried prunes, figs and a powerful layer of cinammon. The wine certainly has character.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. An intensely spicy wine, full of exotic flavors, dried prunes, figs and a powerful layer of cinammon. The wine certainly has character.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Very sweet fruit, deliciously approachable. Chocolate and ripe black fruit. The layer of tannin is important to keep all this opulence together.
title: Château la Pointe 2008 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Dry firm tannins with a lively sweet layer of blackcurrant fruits. Both tannins and fruit are ripe.
title: Château de Pez 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Good, with dense tannins, a powerful wine that shows a rich structure. It has obvious acidity, but that fits into a fresh profile.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2008 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Good, with dense tannins, a powerful wine that shows a rich structure. It has obvious acidity, but that fits into a fresh profile.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2008 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: This light-bodied Merlot rosé is a summer delight. Hints of strawberry blossom and citrus mark the nose, while the palate features berry shadings set against a backdrop of citrus, something like a dry, adult version of pink lemonade.
title: Marrenon 2014 Classique Merlot Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: While the wine is toasty, burnt almost, the freshness of the fruit is very present, giving a light, lively touch to the weight. Give it six months to finally integrate.
title: Pierre Vessigaud 2008 Vers Agnières  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A piercingly citrus wine, the fruit as fresh as can be, rounded by the wood aging. There is a really bright character here that is appetizing and fresh.
title: Jean Manciat 2008  Saint-Véran

description: Some fine wood and fruit aromas are followed by fresh grapefruit, pear and bright lemon flavors. The whole is held together by a fine touch of honeyed wood.
title: Domaine de la Garenne 2008  Mâcon-Azé

description: Fine fresh fruits, bright with good acidity and a lively fresh character. There is a strong apple skin and grapefruit texture, finishing fresh and full.
title: Gilles Morat 2008  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Pale and crisp, this has yeast and herb flavors, with a creamy character from the mousse. Light and just off-dry, this would make for a fine apéritif.
title: Veuve du Vernay NV Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: With some structure to go with the blackberry fruit, this is fruity and still light-bodied. With soft tannins and acidity, it is ready to drink.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: Herbaceous and aromatic, this is a crisp, green-fruit- and citrus-flavored wine. Grapefruit and green apple dominate the texture with its zesty character. Not for aging.
title: Château du Barrailh 2010 Cuvée Collection Prestige  (Graves)

description: With red berry fruitiness, this is an attractive wine. It has a light texture, some juicy acidity and it's ready to drink.
title: Château Bellegrave du Poujeau 2007  Haut-Médoc

description: A chunky wine, this has flavors of dark plum skin and blackberry that merge with the firm tannic core. It has a bell pepper character and a juicy, fruity aftertaste.
title: Kirkland Signature 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Fresh and bright, this is a light, fruity and easy rosé. It is aromatic, soft and ready to drink. Screwcap.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Petit Bourgeois Rosé (Val de Loire)

description: Fresh and bright, this is a light, fruity and easy rosé. It is aromatic, soft and ready to drink. Screwcap.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Petit Bourgeois Rosé (Val de Loire)

description: In a style that is reminiscent of neighboring Jurançon, Pacherenc produces fruity, fragrant and fresh sweet wines. There is a touch of honey and tropical fruit that balances the acidity and the crispness. A wine for pâtés as well as desserts.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2010 Château Arricau-Bordes  (Pacherenc du Vic Bilh)

description: This is a really fruity rosé with refreshing red currant and raspberry fruit flavors. They are blended with a crisp, dusty texture that offers both an herbaceous and a fuller character. The extra richness makes this a food rosé.
title: Patient Cottat 2011 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Given a year's aging, this Chenin Blanc has lost its initial fruitiness while gaining a more nutty, complex series of flavors. It is rich, full and packed with both acidity and baked-apple fruit flavors. The wine has potential for aging over 2–3 years.
title: Marc Bredif 2010 Classic  (Vouvray)

description: This may be dry Chenin Blanc, but there is this tantalizing touch of honey that goes with the crisp apple and fresh quince fruits. The wine has delicious, refreshingly crisp acidity that counterbalances its natural richness.
title: Château la Varière 2009 Clos de la Division Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: This may be dry Chenin Blanc, but there is this tantalizing touch of honey that goes with the crisp apple and fresh quince fruits. The wine has delicious, refreshingly crisp acidity that counterbalances its natural richness.
title: Château la Varière 2009 Clos de la Division Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: A nice nose of black and blue berries with a hint of leather opens this value Syrah. Well built, it shows a bit of chocolate and decent length. There’s just a touch of green herb in there and it closes dry with fairly full tannins.
title: Calvet 1998 Syrah (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A nice nose of black and blue berries with a hint of leather opens this value Syrah. Well built, it shows a bit of chocolate and decent length. There’s just a touch of green herb in there and it closes dry with fairly full tannins.
title: Calvet 1998 Syrah (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A stylish nonvintage brut, offering the right mix of character and functionality. Aromas are the standard green apple and bread dough. It’s maybe a little neutral, but the appley palate is clean, and it finishes with length and power.
title: De Saint Gall NV Bouzy Brut  (Champagne)

description: It’s tart and earthy, with heavy fruit flavors and some spice in the finish. Nothing elegant here, but it’s a good mouthful of fruit with concentration and a crisp, appley flavor extending through the satisfying finish.
title: Charles Lafitte NV Grande Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a light wine, and the fruit is dominated by acidity. It has a tart red-currant flavor, with a hint of banana.
title: Domaine Dupré 2011 Terre Noire Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: Light and fruity, this has a red cherry flavor that's filled with refreshing acidity. The banana flavor from the fermentation is a little too prominent, but this is still a bright, ready-to-drink selection.
title: Trenel Fils 2011 Cuvée Rochebonne  (Beaujolais)

description: Baked vanilla entirely dominates the nose, underneath lurks a citric, lemony freshness that pervades a rich, vanilla-scented and almost unctuous palate. This is an unusual blend of Pinot Gris and Riesling—perfuming the roundness of the former with the freshness of the latter.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2014 Steinert Grand Cru White (Alsace)

description: Notes of yellow mirabelle plum compote make for a fruit-laden opening. The purity of that ripe, soft mirabelle fruit pervades the entire palate and also providesthe natural, enlivening freshness that illuminates a more citric edge. This is full of joyous fruit and just off-dry.
designation: Clos Zisser Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru
title: Klipfel 2013 Clos Zisser Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The sweet peach fruit on nose and palate almost borders on over-ripeness, so fleshy, so decadent is its richness. It is on the palate that orange zest provides some offset and more perfume. Decadent in its truest sense.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2009 Furstentum Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The tannins here are fine, dusty almost, giving the wine a softer core than is normal for this vineyard. Around the tannins, the jammy blackberry fruits give a sweet side to the flavors. Rich and soft.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Les Porrets Saint-Georges Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: The tannins here are fine, dusty almost, giving the wine a softer core than is normal for this vineyard. Around the tannins, the jammy blackberry fruits give a sweet side to the flavors. Rich and soft.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Les Porrets Saint-Georges Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A ripe, sweet and enticing wine, with elegant structure and spice from new wood. It's the fruit that is so delicious here, the tannins subdued behind the strawberry flavors and fresh acidity.
title: Domaine des Perdrix 2008  Vosne-Romanée

description: Initially mineral and austere, but after a moment, the richer sweet berry fruits come through. The wine has spice from new wood as well as a solid core of dry tannins. The aftertaste reveals the dense texture, and the aging potential.
title: Château Belle-Vue 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: A perfumed wine, only just hinting at Pommard chunkiness and tannic structure. This is more polished and smooth, with a strong toasty wood element, while still delivering a fine, jammy, sweet aftertaste.
title: Maison Champy 2008 Les Grands Epenots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A perfumed wine, only just hinting at Pommard chunkiness and tannic structure. This is more polished and smooth, with a strong toasty wood element, while still delivering a fine, jammy, sweet aftertaste.
title: Maison Champy 2008 Les Grands Epenots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A finely balanced wine, its tannins showing the influence of Cabernet Sauvignon along with its signature black currant flavors. There is also weight and an attractive plumper character that broadens the wine, surrounding the tannins with sweet berry fruits.
title: Mähler-Besse 2008 Château d'Arche  (Haut-Médoc)

description: There is considerable power in this rich wine. With its dark plum and chocolate flavors it is dense and extracted. The alcohol shows in the pepper edge. It is probably too ripe and bitter for its own good.
title: Château de Tigné 2011 L'Isensé Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou)

description: Pierre Lurton runs Cheval Blanc and d'Yquem and this winery, his home château. This is a smooth wine, full-bodied and with a soft texture. It is ripe with apricot and pear flavors, cut with sliced apple. A touch of spice adds interest. With its ripe, full aftertaste the wine shows the plumper side of the vintage. It is ready to drink.
title: Château Marjosse 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Dominated by its 86% Merlot, this is a fruity wine that is surprisingly light for the vintage. It comes from the plain between Saint-Émilion and the Dordogne River, giving a soft style with just a touch of tannin. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Joly 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: Small production from five acres with biodynamic techniques, the wine is perfumed, full of candied flavors. It has acidity and a zesty texture with a juicy, green plum character. The aftertaste is ripe and full-bodied. Stéphane Derenoncourt consults for owner Pascal Collotte.
title: Château Jean Faux 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: There are ripe yellow fruits here in this generous, full wine. Touches of spice add to the general feeling of richness. There is enough concentration to give a wine that is dense and with a pepper aftertaste.
title: Château Gantonnet 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: There are ripe yellow fruits here in this generous, full wine. Touches of spice add to the general feeling of richness. There is enough concentration to give a wine that is dense and with a pepper aftertaste.
title: Château Gantonnet 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A soft, ripe and rounded wine that is full of fruit. It has a generous feel to it that is balanced by a more tangy citrus edge. Apricots show as the wine opens up to reveal its ripe side. Drink now.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A soft, ripe and rounded wine that is full of fruit. It has a generous feel to it that is balanced by a more tangy citrus edge. Apricots show as the wine opens up to reveal its ripe side. Drink now.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A light and fruity wine that has bright black fruits and an edge of tannins. The black currant and acidity give the wine its fruity character, typical of the vintage. Drink now.
title: Château Bellevue 2014  Bordeaux

description: A soft, almost off dry wine that is full in the mouth. It has caramel and spice flavors as well as light acidity. The wine feels weighty and definitely needs food.
title: Cellier des Dauphins 2015 Réserve Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Made from a blend of Gamay and Grolleau, this is a bright and fresh wine. There's no wood aging here, just fruit that is full of red-berry flavors and only a touch of tannin. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Clos de l'Elu 2013 Indigène Red (Val de Loire)

description: The classic Bordeaux white blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon has produced a light and fruity wine. It has some attractive green plum and currant flavors that are lined with clean, pure acidity. Drink the wine now.
title: Clos des Menuts 2014 Menuts Fruité  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: The wine relies entirely on its ripe fruit without any oak aging. That gives a fresh and fruity character, typical of the vintage, with red-fruit flavors and a fine line of acidity cutting through the gentle tannins. Drink now.
title: Cheval Quancard 2014 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: This is classic wine drunk in the bars of Nantes with oysters. It is so crisp, light with an almost shocking amount of acidity. It is very fresh, with strong citrus fruit and just a light prickle on the tongue. Drink now.
title: Lieubeau 2015 La Fruitière Folle Blanche Folle Blanche

description: This is a soft wine that has some attractive acidity and fresh apple flavors. It is a style of wine that is open, ripe and ready to drink.
title: Ollivier Frères 2015 Domaine de l'Olivier Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A small parcel of vines produces this crisp, fragrant and very fruity wine. With its apple fruits and lightly oaked character, it's a bright wine, it's more taut texture showing some aging potential. Drink from 2015.
title: Romain Bouchard 2011 Le Grand Bois  (Chablis)

description: A very perfumed, fragrant and refreshing wine. It is full in the mouth, ripe, smelling of hedgerow blossoms and having a touch of spring in its fruits. Ready to drink, but also keep until 2016.
title: Pierre and Charles Sparr 2011 Cuvée Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: A very perfumed, fragrant and refreshing wine. It is full in the mouth, ripe, smelling of hedgerow blossoms and having a touch of spring in its fruits. Ready to drink, but also keep until 2016.
title: Pierre and Charles Sparr 2011 Cuvée Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a soft, silky-textured version of Crozes-Hermitage. Hints of cedar accent black cherry and licorice aromas, while the flavors are super ripe, verging on jammy. It's already approachable, and should drink well through 2020.
title: Duvernay 2010  Crozes-Hermitage

description: The wine has firm, smoky tannins as well as ripe berry fruits and acidity. Put the elements together and it adds up to a satisfying, full wine with a good sense of structure and a medium-term future. Drink from the end of 2014.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Red fruits and a soft tannic profile give a ready-to-drink feel. It's generous, balanced, the black fruits giving a sweet, jammy feel. Pepper and spice at the end are paired with juicy acidity.
title: Domaine de Cause 2011 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Campuget has been a reliable source of rosé for at least a decade, and the 2013 is even better than usual. It's now made in a pale copper hue, light, crisp and lean, with aromas and flavors of wet stone, citrus and underripe peach highlighted by a long, lime-driven finish.
title: Château de Campuget 2013 Tradition de Campuget Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Rich Bordeaux, with concentrated blackberry fruits and dry tannins. There is a dry core and intense acidity. The wine is ready to drink, but could mature for 1–2 years.
title: Abbaye de Saint-Ferme 2006 Les Vignes du Soir  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Rich Bordeaux, with concentrated blackberry fruits and dry tannins. There is a dry core and intense acidity. The wine is ready to drink, but could mature for 1–2 years.
title: Abbaye de Saint-Ferme 2006 Les Vignes du Soir  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: With a hint of minerality, this wine has structure to go with its soft, generous fruit. There are almonds, toast, peaches and an attractive rounded texture.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: With a hint of minerality, this wine has structure to go with its soft, generous fruit. There are almonds, toast, peaches and an attractive rounded texture.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Petit Chablis is planted on the plateau above the Serein river valley, the heart of Chablis. This attractively fruity wine offers white fruits and crisp acidity. Light and refreshing, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2014  Petit Chablis

description: This is a warm and rich wine from the southern Mâcon region. It is ripe with yellow fruits, crisp apples and a touch of minerality that gives the tangy texture. Packed with fruit as well as structured, this wine can be drunk now, although better from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013  Pouilly-Vinzelles

description: An intense, mineral-driven wine, this is tight and very textured. Its dryness is mitigated by hints of riper mango and apricot that fill out the palate. The structure and the tense acidity show this wine is still young. Drink from 2017.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2014 Les Baronnes  (Sancerre)

description: Top of the range from Eugénie, this pure Malbec is huge, firm and very concentrated. Wood aging has added spice and emphasized the dryness that comes from the fruit and wood tannins. But the fruit is all there, a juicy background that will come out as the wine ages.Drink this impressive wine from 2020.
title: Château Eugénie 2012 Haute Collection Malbec (Cahors)

description: Top of the range from Eugénie, this pure Malbec is huge, firm and very concentrated. Wood aging has added spice and emphasized the dryness that comes from the fruit and wood tannins. But the fruit is all there, a juicy background that will come out as the wine ages.Drink this impressive wine from 2020.
title: Château Eugénie 2012 Haute Collection Malbec (Cahors)

description: A beautiful wine, this has fresh acidity, crisp fruits and zesty mineral texture. Apples, citrus and hints of apricots are all there along with an intense tangy character that bursts in the mouth. It's still so young and needs to age; drink from 2018 at the earliest. The Special Club is a group of growers who rate and taste each other's wines before release.
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2008 Special Club de Collection Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Spice and sweet fruits, a delicious wine, already soft and approachable. Only a hint of tough tannin suggests aging.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Spice and sweet fruits, a delicious wine, already soft and approachable. Only a hint of tough tannin suggests aging.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Solidly packed tannins, very firm and structured, a feeling of considerable extract as well as a high toast content.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2009 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Surprisingly lightweight wine, its freshness the dominant character. It shows bright black fruits and some toast, the tannins a sweet element.
title: Château Tour de Pez 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Caramel aromas, a wine that seems over-extracted, tough. The fruit has a juicy element, but misses out on elegance.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Caramel aromas, a wine that seems over-extracted, tough. The fruit has a juicy element, but misses out on elegance.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A big wine, with intense dark tannins and great concentration. This is a wine of power, somewhat rough around the edges. To finish, great juiciness.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A big wine, with intense dark tannins and great concentration. This is a wine of power, somewhat rough around the edges. To finish, great juiciness.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2009 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. Juicy, the fruit showing some awkward super-maturity. Power, but the structure is missing.
title: Château Grand-Puy Ducasse 2009 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 89-91 Barrel sample. A rounded wine, packed with rich fruits, feeling generous. The plum and damson juice flavors are dominant, ripe and powerful.
title: Château d'Angludet 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Packed with ripe fruits, caramel flavors, lots of wood, solid and well balanced. Good final acidity.
title: Château Rahoul 2009 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Under new ownership after the sale by Alain Raynaud, this is now a lighter style of wine. But it does have great acidity, really fresh, with smoky tannins.
title: Château Quinault L'Enclos 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. A finely structured wine, its tannins firm but generous. It has some dark characters, black plums and a solid texture, but it is also fired with super-rich fruit.
title: Château Moulin de la Rose 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. A finely structured wine, its tannins firm but generous. It has some dark characters, black plums and a solid texture, but it is also fired with super-rich fruit.
title: Château Moulin de la Rose 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. The juicy blackcurrant flavors of the year show through here, the wine a firm balance between juicy fruit and the driest of tannins.
title: Château les Ormes de Pez 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Tough tannins over juicy fruit. The wine has great ripeness as well as freshness. The intensity of the blackcurrant is considerable.
title: Château Cos Labory 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. From a vineyard right on the edge of the city of Saint-Emilion, this is a rounded wine, packed with ripe and generous fruit, black cherries and velvet tannins. The finish is very juicy.
title: Le Carré 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. From a vineyard right on the edge of the city of Saint-Emilion, this is a rounded wine, packed with ripe and generous fruit, black cherries and velvet tannins. The finish is very juicy.
title: Le Carré 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Firm tannins, but also ripe, sweet fruits, with a fine balance. While the wine is on the light, fresh side, it does have a good, final structure.
title: Château Coufran 2009 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Firm tannins, but also ripe, sweet fruits, with a fine balance. While the wine is on the light, fresh side, it does have a good, final structure.
title: Château Coufran 2009 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. A bright, shiny wine, spiced with blackcurrants and sweet plums, very fruity, dancing with liveliness.
title: Château Brillette 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. It takes a while for this wine to show. Then it has solid tannins, topped by ripe berry flavors, rich plums and an edge of juiciness.
title: Château Bouscaut 2009 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Soft, fleshy and fruity, with tannins that are very ripe. The fruit has blackberry juice, sweet with an edge of licorice.
title: Goulée 2009 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Dense, smoky tannins over ripe fruit with layers of powerful structure. It is extracted but also well-made.
title: Clos Magdelaine 2009 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Ripe, sweet fruit, lots of smooth tannins, caramel and toast. The fruit is rich, lightly structured with firm tannins showing through.
title: Clos des Jacobins 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. The ripest fruit, with plenty of sweet flavors, packed with spice, the ripe wood giving structure.
title: Clos Badon 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Good balance between richness and great freshness. The acidity is almost sweet, giving a wine that is spicy, but with a great green aftertaste.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2009 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Firmly dry wine, solid with many firm, wood-derived tannins. It gives bitter coffee and cranberry juice flavors, but also manages to retain freshness.
title: Chateau La Tour Carnet 2009 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. A very smoky character, with an attractive lightness. The fruit is bright, even though there is richness. The tannins give a dark, dry aftertaste.
title: Château Fontenil 2009 Barrel sample  (Fronsac)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Owned by Château Angélus, a soft and gentle wine, wearing its fruit on its sleeve, the tannins light, followed by a juicy texture.
title: Château Daugay 2009 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Dense tannins over delicious blackberry juicy fruit. A finely structured wine, good freshness and sweet aftertaste.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Dense tannins over delicious blackberry juicy fruit. A finely structured wine, good freshness and sweet aftertaste.
title: Château Chasse-Spleen 2009 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: A noteworthy effort made in widely available commercial quantities, Guigal's '07 CdR Blanc offers scents of pineapple and pear, flavors that include hints of white chocolate, a reasonably rich mouthfeel and a long, dry, concentrated finish with just a hint of honey.
title: E. Guigal 2007 White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A smooth, polished wine, with acidity, sweet fruit and a range of dusty tannins, with acidity. This is an accomplished, delicious wine that is developing fast, and seems only for medium-term aging.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: A subtly wood aged wine, the white fruit flavor giving an extra dimension with a touch of honey. It has all the direct, delicious fruit of 2007, the wine then rounded out with nutmeg and soft acidity.
title: Château Magneau 2007 Cuvée Julien  (Graves)

description: A subtly wood aged wine, the white fruit flavor giving an extra dimension with a touch of honey. It has all the direct, delicious fruit of 2007, the wine then rounded out with nutmeg and soft acidity.
title: Château Magneau 2007 Cuvée Julien  (Graves)

description: An impressively intense wine, concentrated and solid. The fruits are firm and tannic, with a new wood element that seems well in balance. A good success for the year.
title: Château Grand Mayne 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: Aged in a combination of one- and two-year-old oak and stainless steel, Guigal's 2007 Saint-Joseph is round in the mouth yet minerally at the same time, with graphite notes supporting the voluminous pear and melon fruit, right through the lengthy finish.
title: E. Guigal 2007  Saint-Joseph

description: Aged in a combination of one- and two-year-old oak and stainless steel, Guigal's 2007 Saint-Joseph is round in the mouth yet minerally at the same time, with graphite notes supporting the voluminous pear and melon fruit, right through the lengthy finish.
title: E. Guigal 2007  Saint-Joseph

description: There is good density here, with impressive tannins and very dry core of structure. The wine has weight, with cranberry and red berry flavors shining through. Always, the freshness is right up front.
title: Château Potensac 2007  Médoc

description: There is good density here, with impressive tannins and very dry core of structure. The wine has weight, with cranberry and red berry flavors shining through. Always, the freshness is right up front.
title: Château Potensac 2007  Médoc

description: The wine has developed well, with plenty of weight, but the fruit seems a little diffuse, soft, open in character. It's masking the tannin core, a wine that opens slowly and carefully.
title: Château Pavie Macquin 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine has developed well, with plenty of weight, but the fruit seems a little diffuse, soft, open in character. It's masking the tannin core, a wine that opens slowly and carefully.
title: Château Pavie Macquin 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: Elegant as so often from this estate, the wine rounded, relatively soft and fruity. Red berry fruits dominate, with just the right amount of fine extraction. For medium-term aging.
title: Château La Tour Figeac 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: This intriguing wine displays an almost fumé-style smoky minerality on the nose, followed by flavors of pear and toast. It's a focused, medium-bodied blend of 50% Marsanne and 50% Roussanne, with a finish that won't quit.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2007 Vieilles Vignes White (Saint-Péray)

description: Krug prefers to call this wine multivintage rather than nonvintage, but that doesn’t change what it is. Deep yeast, butter and cider aromas lead into full caramel and apple flavors on the weighty palate; it turns a bit sweet-tart on the finish. Perhaps made with juice from some weaker vintages of the early 1990s, it’s nonetheless very good.
title: Krug NV Grande Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Krug prefers to call this wine multivintage rather than nonvintage, but that doesn’t change what it is. Deep yeast, butter and cider aromas lead into full caramel and apple flavors on the weighty palate; it turns a bit sweet-tart on the finish. Perhaps made with juice from some weaker vintages of the early 1990s, it’s nonetheless very good.
title: Krug NV Grande Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Blueberries and blackberries are the dominant themes here, with some smoky notes playing a supporting role. Bright, tart and fruity, this doesn’t appear to have the depth for aging. But it is an immensely attractive wine for early quaffing. There are some slightly drying tannins on the finish, so try it with rich or fatty foods for best effect.
title: Domaine des Entrefaux 1999  Crozes-Hermitage

description: There's a lot of richness in this wine, which has a pale pink color. You can smell fresh strawberries as well as a yeasty note and something earthy and mulchy. It drinks quite dry and crisp, with a real bite of acidity and some pretty raspberry flavors. It turns rich and complex on the finish.
title: Pannier NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A very Grenache-like wine, with red berries, rhubarb, meat and spices on the nose. Earth and anise notes in the mouth add interest, and there is a fine fruit-acid balance here. Sweet berries, a strong mineral component and fine tannic structure shine on the solid finish. Tight now, it will show better in two or three years.
title: Domaine Gramenon 1998 Les Laurentides Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A very Grenache-like wine, with red berries, rhubarb, meat and spices on the nose. Earth and anise notes in the mouth add interest, and there is a fine fruit-acid balance here. Sweet berries, a strong mineral component and fine tannic structure shine on the solid finish. Tight now, it will show better in two or three years.
title: Domaine Gramenon 1998 Les Laurentides Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A reserve selection that’s seen some barrel aging, but not too much. The toasty, chocolaty oak is hardly noticeable under a firm wallop of cherry-berry fruit that turns velvety on the palate. Some softly bitter tannins creep in on the finish, letting you know that the best is yet to come. Pick up a few bottles and drink them over the next couple of years.
title: Château Mas Neuf 1998 Prestige des Gibelins Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: A rich nose of honey, marmalade and yeast opens to full apple and lemon-custard flavors. There’s fullness, but also a less-than-sparkling quality that’s a little disappointing considering the Krug pedigree. Medium-weight, it finishes with buttery, oaky complexity but not the length you’d expect.
title: Krug 1988 Brut  (Champagne)

description: A rich nose of honey, marmalade and yeast opens to full apple and lemon-custard flavors. There’s fullness, but also a less-than-sparkling quality that’s a little disappointing considering the Krug pedigree. Medium-weight, it finishes with buttery, oaky complexity but not the length you’d expect.
title: Krug 1988 Brut  (Champagne)

description: This full-flavored blend is 65% Grenache and the balance is mostly Syrah, with a little Mourvèdre. It opens with a rustic nose and full earthy, horsey flavors. There’s a very typical Rhône-ish brambly quality to the dark-berry fruit, and the finish is long and flavorful. Quite approachable right now; it should drink well for the next 4 to 8 years, maybe longer.
title: Domaine de la Solitude 1998 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This stylish bottling offers a silky nose with hay, pound cake and herb notes. Lean and clean, it sports grapefruit and green-apple flavors, and a good feel and finish, with mineral and spice elements. A trim, well-toned contender.
title: Piper-Heidsieck 1995 Brut  (Champagne)

description: The nose here is rich and dense, with biscuit and mushroom elements. The big, layered palate displays apple and chalk notes, but is surprisingly soft, with a rather faint bead. There's an element of sweetness some tasters found tacky and perfumey for a wine of this stature. Others, however, found it complex and exciting, with yeasty, toasty notes.
designation: Comtes de Champagne Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Taittinger 1994 Comtes de Champagne Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Champagne)

description: Opening with a toasty, sourdough-like leesy nose, the focus here moves to apple, pear and melon flavors on the palate. The texture is full, but also soft, and the bead is not as lively as some Champagnes.
title: Pannier 1995 Egérie Brut  (Champagne)

description: Opening with a toasty, sourdough-like leesy nose, the focus here moves to apple, pear and melon flavors on the palate. The texture is full, but also soft, and the bead is not as lively as some Champagnes.
title: Pannier 1995 Egérie Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is an interesting bottling that opened up considerably while tasting. The nose displays biscuit, grape and lime notes, and there’s plenty of green apple and sweet-tart citrus in the mouth. It has a nice texture on the palate and closes with a grapefruit tang and chalky notes.
title: Pannier NV Brut Sélection  (Champagne)

description: Earthy and truffley in an attractive and complex way, this fairly mature offering has a full mouthfeel and rich apple and plum flavors. The long finish brings tart plums. This has the stuffing to be used as a dining Champagne, and the reserved elegance required for drinking alone or with hors d’oeuvres.
title: Gosset NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Earthy and truffley in an attractive and complex way, this fairly mature offering has a full mouthfeel and rich apple and plum flavors. The long finish brings tart plums. This has the stuffing to be used as a dining Champagne, and the reserved elegance required for drinking alone or with hors d’oeuvres.
title: Gosset NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Spicy ginger and liqueur-like vanilla notes on the nose announce this engaging, medium-weight Champagne. There’s nice tension here between the bright, youthful lemon and green-apple flavors and the fuller, fairly mature earthy notes. It finishes long and nicely complex, and comes in a unique pineapple-like bottle, too.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 1992 Cuvée Palmes d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: Interesting aromas and flavors abound with biscuit, toast, lemon and ginger. The texture is full and mature, but the wine still has very good acidity to support its apple, lime and spice flavors. It has an appealing mix of heavy and light elements, and it finishes long, with apple and mint notes.
title: Jacquart 1988 La Cuvée Nominée  (Champagne)

description: Interesting aromas and flavors abound with biscuit, toast, lemon and ginger. The texture is full and mature, but the wine still has very good acidity to support its apple, lime and spice flavors. It has an appealing mix of heavy and light elements, and it finishes long, with apple and mint notes.
title: Jacquart 1988 La Cuvée Nominée  (Champagne)

description: A perfect salmon shade, with scents of peaches, cherries and toast. It hits the palate with big, ripe, fresh fruit: crisp apples, peaches, cherries and citrus. Concentrated and full, with a tart, fresh back end that lingers into a cherry-vanilla finish.
title: Gosset NV Grand Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Close to the Côtes de Blaye vineyards in the northwest of Bordeaux, Loumelat offers a crisp, fruity 2012. There is a smoky edge from the wood aging as well as black currant fruit that is still young. Acidity cuts through the aftertaste. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Loumelat 2012 Cuvée J-J Lesgourgues  (Bordeaux)

description: Rich, juicy and structured, this firm wine has great power and concentration along with a dark, dry core. It's almost too much of a good thing, very flamboyant and ripe. It still needs to age to be fully balanced.
title: Château le Reysse 2010  Médoc

description: Rich, juicy and structured, this firm wine has great power and concentration along with a dark, dry core. It's almost too much of a good thing, very flamboyant and ripe. It still needs to age to be fully balanced.
title: Château le Reysse 2010  Médoc

description: Under the same ownership as Château la Dominique in Saint-Émilion, Clément-Pichon has produced a richly juicy 2012. Firm structure underlies the generous fruits, while the acidity and the dry core of tannins promise good aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Clément-Pichon 2012  Haut-Médoc

description: The initial impression of this wine is almost dry. That comes from the dense structure as well as the complex interplay between botrytis and acidity. Yellow fruits and bitter oranges show well, giving both acidity and final sweetness. Drink from 2018
title: Château Caillou 2011  Barsac

description: There is just a hint of a pale blush in the color of this wine, and the delicate flavors follow the same light, fresh style. It is not dry, however, and red berries do give softness. To finish, a touch of caramel adds ripeness to the acidity.
title: Pommery NV Springtime Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With its deep pink color, this wine enjoys a fresh strawberry flavor, with some sweetness and a fruit candy freshness. In the mouth, it is full, the mousse is tight and the acidity is not completely balanced with the fruit, which will almost certainly need more time to blend together.
title: Beaumont des Crayères 2003 Fleur de Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Clove, bay leaf and black cherry aromas burst from the glass, followed by flavors of dark cherry and cocoa. The tannins are supple, the mouthfeel ample, and the finish ends with a refreshing lift of acidity. Drink now–2018.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2013 Les Abeilles de  Colombo Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This is a ripe, perfumed wine with smooth, generous texture and broad black fruits. An earthy, leathery edge gives extra character, and the suggestion of maturity comes from the wood aging and the ripe berry fruits. Drink now.
title: Château de Cénac 2012 Cuvée Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Produced from a selection of small parcels, this perfumed wood-aged wine is big and concentrated while also keeping style and balance. It is dark, firm in the center with tannins that are surrounded by juicy acidity and black currant fruits. Keep for a few more months and drink from 2016.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2012 Confidential Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Produced by the Château de Bligny close to Beaune, this soft, perfumed wine has stalky red fruits, laced with a dry core of tannin and fragrant acidity. It could age for another year.
title: Evening Land 2011 Rouge  (Bourgogne)

description: Ripe, rich and fruity, this is Gamay from old vines that give extra concentration. The wine is full of bitter cherries, tight acidity and a light texture. Drink now.
title: Signé Vigneron 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: A small wine region close to the city of Lyon, Coteaux du Lyonnais produces the wine for the city's bars. This is soft, rounded, a delicious cherry flavored wine. It has a light structure and attractive final acidity.
title: Signé Vigneron 2011 Fleurieux  (Coteaux du Lyonnais)

description: Light, fresh and fruity, this is an immediately attractive wine. Apple and citrus dominate with a tang of orange zest to add an extra refreshing character. Not for aging, ready to drink now.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Saint-Véran)

description: Herbal garrigue notes take centerstage in this blend of 50% Syrah, 25% Marselan and 25% Mourvèdre. The palate is lifted and bright, with flavors of tart blackberry and plum. Not an ager, so enjoy it now.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes Catalanes
title: Caspen 2011 Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes Catalanes)

description: A light and fruity wine with attractive red fruits and acidity. There is just a touch of tannin to hold the friendly fruitiness together.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2011  Côte Chalonnaise

description: Boysenberry, blueberry and black cherry aromas lead on the nose of this wine, with a touch of warmth and chocolaty sensation following behind. The palate veers more towards red-fruit flavors, with a thin midpalate and an astringent close.
title: Château de Corneilla 2009 Pur Sang Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: This is a bright friendly open wine. With its light crisp fruitiness, layers of acidity and a twist of lemon, it is bone dry with a lively fresh aftertaste. Drink now and call it your Valentine's Day.
title: Château les Valentines 2016 La Caprice de Clementine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In an effort to persuade us that rosé is not just for the summer, this is a wine ostensibly for winter. In fact, name aside, it could be consumed this summer as well. It is fruity, with a touch of minerality and is ready to drink now.
designation: Grain de Glace Le Rosé d'Hiver
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Grain de Glace Le Rosé d'Hiver Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Bringing together in its name two important aspects of Provence, flower (lavender is a major local crop) and the sea, this wine is soft and fruity, with just the right balance of acidity and ripe fruit flavors. It is refreshing, open and ready to drink.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Fleur de Mer Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: A fine, ripe and soft blend of Duras and Braucol, this is a wine that's made to drink young for its fruit. There is a dry background to the fruitiness although it is the red-fruit flavors and balanced acidity that shine. Drink from early 2018.
title: L'Enclos des Braves 2015 Les Gourmands Rouge Red (Gaillac)

description: An elegant wine that has some maturity, even though the tannins are still firm. It shows considerable fresh acidity, giving a fresh feel to the black currant fruits. Light spiciness adds extra interest. It's ready to drink now and until 2022.
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2008  Pomerol

description: A finely made wine, full of firm tannins and rich fruit. Structured and dark, it has weight, black fruit and great potential. With wood aging smoothing the bold fruit, it can be drunk soon, but will age well. Drink from 2014.
