description: To celebrate the family's 150th anniversary (founded in 1864), the Milans have released two Champagnes, half fermented in wood the other half in tank. The result for this Blanc de Blancs is a full wine, with a future that will bring out richness as well as a tight, mineral structure with just a hint of toast.
designation: Duo 150 Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Jean Milan NV Duo 150 Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Spécial Club is a grouping of growers who taste each other's wines and approve them for Club status. This is certainly an impressive wine, seamlessly moving from freshness to richness via a steely texture. It is still impressively young and fruity, a bright, crisp wine that will age for several more years. Drink from 2016.
designation: Spécial Club Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2006 Spécial Club Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Ultra Brut, the original no-dosage Champagne, is the name and that's just how this bone-dry wine tastes. It's totally crisp, fruity, structured and fresh. Acidity from tight citrus combines with apples and pears to produce a wine that offers both fruitiness and dryness. Like many super-dry Champagnes, it will benefit from some bottle aging, so drink at least six months after purchase.
title: Laurent-Perrier NV Ultra Brut  (Champagne)

description: With just the right amount of bottle aging, this almost bone-dry Champagne is tight, steely while also hinting at the beginnings of toastiness. It is also full of crisp apple, lemon and pink grapefruit fruitiness, well integrated into the taut texture. Drink now for freshness, age for even more toastiness.
title: Jacquesson et Fils NV Cuvée No 736 Brut  (Champagne)

description: With just the right amount of bottle aging, this almost bone-dry Champagne is tight, steely while also hinting at the beginnings of toastiness. It is also full of crisp apple, lemon and pink grapefruit fruitiness, well integrated into the taut texture. Drink now for freshness, age for even more toastiness.
title: Jacquesson et Fils NV Cuvée No 736 Brut  (Champagne)

description: Dense and rich, this shows structure as well as powerful fruits. It comes from a parcel of chalk soil at the southern end of Pouilly Fuissé. The wine is firm, concentrated, packed with yellow fruits as well as layers of acidity and toast structure. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Fuissé 2012 Les Combettes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Complex and rich, this is full of tangy fruits, with a dense structure that brings out weight, minerality and a chewy core of zesty citrus. It very crisp and fruity at this stage and needs to develop its many other flavors. Drink from 2017.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is very floral and fruity--almost to the point of being candied and artificial--with prominent flavors of cherries and bubble gum, yet finishing dry. A decent summertime quaff.
title: Domaine Houchart 2008 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A fresh white currant-flavored wine, attractive with its acidity and fresh berry character. Dominated by Sauvignon Blanc, it has a grassy element, but there is also good intensity of sweet flavors.
title: Barrière Frères 2007 Grand Bâteau  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This wine, while so fresh and fruity, also has some weight behind it, giving ripe plum and black-cherry flavors. A tannic texture behind the wine balances with the final acidity.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2014 Les Griottes  (Beaujolais)

description: This is a ripe and juicy wine with fine tannins and a swathe of black currant and cherry fruits. It bursts from the glass, fruity and with bright acidity. It is classic, ready-to-drink Beaujolais.
title: Domaine de Colette 2014 Coteaux de Colette  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: With a light layer of tannin, this structured wine comes from the heart of the Beaujolais Villages area. It has black cherry and red-fruit flavors balanced by the right amount of acidity. Drink now. The Colonge family has been growing grapes in Beaujolais since 1789.
title: Domaine André Colonge 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: With a light layer of tannin, this structured wine comes from the heart of the Beaujolais Villages area. It has black cherry and red-fruit flavors balanced by the right amount of acidity. Drink now. The Colonge family has been growing grapes in Beaujolais since 1789.
title: Domaine André Colonge 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: From the village of Lantignié, rosé from this 1,300-foot elevation vineyard is fresh and light-hearted. Full of ripe strawberry flavors, the wine also has great acidity, giving a direct and fruity wine that is ready to drink.
title: Château de Basty 2014 Lantignié Rosé (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Ripe and jammy, this is an immediately attractive wine. Warm crushed-strawberry flavors have enough tannin and acidity to keep freshness. This wine can be drunk now, although it will be better, with softer tannins, from 2016.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2014 Eté Indien  (Brouilly)

description: Juicy and soft with just a touch of tannin, this is all about red cherry fruits. A rounded texture makes the wine ready to drink.
title: Trenel Fils 2014  Côte de Brouilly

description: This is a soft, rounded and immediately accessible wine. Ripe apple and crisp green-plum flavors are balanced with a softness from the dosage. Ready to drink, the wine is freshly fruity with a lively mousse and creamy aftertaste.
title: Georges Lacombe NV Grand Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: This richly colored, rich-tasting wine has a lively mousse and ripe strawberry flavors. The palate is all about fruitiness, smooth and with just a light tang of orange zest at the end.
title: Jean Laurent NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Sec is less dry than Brut in Champagne doublespeak, and so this is a soft wine that brings out perfumed red fruits and attractive acidity without great crispness. That makes for an attractive apéritif style, with a ripe aftertaste.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne Rosé Sec  (Champagne)

description: Vines on the southern slopes of the Montagne de Reims have given this wine a soft character and ripe fruitiness. Fresh baked apples and bright acidity are right out front to produce a refreshing, accessible wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Autréau de Champillon NV Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: An intense wine, its spice finely integrated with a more fruity character. It has the classic Gewürztraminer lychee flavor but this is balanced with acidity, ripe baked apple and mineral structure.
title: Pierre Sparr 2010 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: An intense wine, its spice finely integrated with a more fruity character. It has the classic Gewürztraminer lychee flavor but this is balanced with acidity, ripe baked apple and mineral structure.
title: Pierre Sparr 2010 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A solid wine, with plum skin and dry tannin textures. It does have the ripe fruit of 2009, attractive red fruits and juicy acidity. But it needs aging over at least three years to show its fruitiness.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009  Pommard

description: A solid wine, with plum skin and dry tannin textures. It does have the ripe fruit of 2009, attractive red fruits and juicy acidity. But it needs aging over at least three years to show its fruitiness.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009  Pommard

description: Sweet new wood goes with rich plum skins in a wine that has a firm structure. The richness of the wine revolves around sweet cherries and juicy acidity. With the wood still dominant, it needs at least five years to settle down.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2009 Les Rugiens Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: This structured, mineral wine offers tight acidity and strikingly fresh fruits. It's full of wood, juicy apple skins and lime juice giving a fresh, taut character. Still young, it needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012 Chatenière Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Grape growers since the end of the 18th century, the Dautel and Cadot families are based in the Aube area of Champagne. The family began making their own Champagne in 1971; now Sylvain Dautel works the vineyard by hand and makes the wine for this small maison. Full-bodied, this has touches of toast from the five years bottle age. The rich fruit also allows plenty of tight acidity into the mix. Drink this mature, well-balanced wine now.
title: Dautel-Cadot NV Cuvée Prestige Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine has all the right crispness and steeliness of a Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay. It also has warmth, yellow fruits along with a touch of apple. That makes a wine that is full-bodied while not missing out on a tight, very fresh aftertaste.
title: Tendil & Lombardi NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fresh and crisp, this is bright with acidity as well as warmer fruitiness. It brings out the dry Laurent-Perrier style, balanced by soft creamed apples and fragrant acidity. Light and fruity at the end, it is ready to drink.
title: Laurent-Perrier NV LP Brut  (Champagne)

description: This dark-colored rosé comes from a single vineyard in the village of Dizy. It is certainly dry as its Extra Brut description indicates, but it offers so much ripe red fruitiness that it is also rich and concentrated. There is bright acidity at the end. Drink now.
designation: Dizy Terres Rouges Extra Brut Rosé
title: Jacquesson et Fils 2008 Dizy Terres Rouges Extra Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This delicately colored rosé is made by adding red wine to Chardonnay, allowed in the Champagne region, and hence the name Rosé des Blancs. It's a new venture for Gimonnet, under the current direction of Didier Gimonnet, and is a great success. Fruity, crisp and steely. it is light and bright; a fine apéritif style.
designation: Rosé des Blancs Premier Cru Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils NV Rosé des Blancs Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: This delicately colored rosé is made by adding red wine to Chardonnay, allowed in the Champagne region, and hence the name Rosé des Blancs. It's a new venture for Gimonnet, under the current direction of Didier Gimonnet, and is a great success. Fruity, crisp and steely. it is light and bright; a fine apéritif style.
designation: Rosé des Blancs Premier Cru Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils NV Rosé des Blancs Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: While this is crisp and fresh, it also has an attractive, round vanilla flavor that provides a smooth, creamy texture. It's refreshing with apple and pear flavors, with appealing acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine Patrick Javillier 2010 Cuvée des Forges  (Bourgogne)

description: Light and almost herbaceous, this is the simplest Chablis in the Laroche portfolio. It has pure, clean white-fruit and red apple flavors, tautened by acidity, ending with a crisp, green finish. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Laroche 2011  Petit Chablis

description: While the texture is rich and full-bodied, there is an edge of sharp acidity that takes away from the generous ripeness. Tannins and juicy red fruits are present, but the acidity is a little jarring.
title: Domaine Guy & Yvan Dufouleur 2009 Clos du Chapitre Premier Cru  (Fixin)

description: While the texture is rich and full-bodied, there is an edge of sharp acidity that takes away from the generous ripeness. Tannins and juicy red fruits are present, but the acidity is a little jarring.
title: Domaine Guy & Yvan Dufouleur 2009 Clos du Chapitre Premier Cru  (Fixin)

description: Intense acidity precedes the ripe yellow fruits of this bright wine. It has a rich texture that's very minerally and steely, pairing with a vanilla note from its wood aging. It's a wine to be consumed young, over the next 2–3 years.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Les Vieilles Vignes  (Chablis)

description: Warm, ripe and round, this red-fruited wine has a fine feeling of richness. It is soft and fruity, with just the right amount of acidity to balance. Ready to drink.
title: Manuel Olivier 2009  Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: Tropical fruit and new wood flavors thread this opulent, seductive Chardonnay. It has surface glamor, with its flavors of ripe mango, peach and toast. Under the surface, the flavors are simple, softly textured.
title: Maison Jessiaume 2010  Bourgogne

description: Open, soft, creamy, along with a candied fruit character. There is freshness here, with the acidity dominant on the finish.
title: Signé Vigneron 2008  Mâcon-Villages

description: Soft and broad, a little unfocused, the fruit showing pear juice and green apple skins. It feels light, juicy, missing concentration, and there's a caramel toast aftertaste.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2008 Buissonnier Côte Chalonnaise Chardonnay  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: A simple but easy-to-drink Chardonnay with soft aromas and flavors of ripe red apple and pear. Medium weight with a solid, clean finish.
title: Barton & Guestier 2007 Bistro Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A solidly structured rosé with a bit of weight and great ripeness in the mouth. Strawberry and somewhat medicinal cherry fill the bouquet and palate, with a touch of herbaceousness on the finish.
title: Gayda 2008 Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Certainly light, but also deliciously fruity, with raspberries a dominant flavor in the juicy acidity and the softest, velvet tannins. Drink now.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2007 Bourgogne Pinot Noir  (Burgundy)

description: A blend of Merlot and Duras, the red grape of Gaillac. The combination creates a meaty and chewy wine, with pepper and red-currant flavors. While the Merlot supplies the warmth, the Duras offers acidity and fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2008 Red (Côtes du Tarn)

description: Though not terribly complex or exciting, this is a well-made Minervois with soft red fruit and kirsch aromas backed by hints of spice and light floral characters. Approachable tannins and light acidity followed by a short, clean finish make this an easy-to-drink and enjoyable selection.
title: Domaine Montaude 2007 Red (Minervois)

description: Damaged by hail in 2013, the vineyards yielded low quantities. The grapes harvested produced a wine with crisp red fruits and bright berry acidity. The fresh, tight aftertaste suggests the wine will age. Drink from 2019.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013 Dominode Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Damaged by hail in 2013, the vineyards yielded low quantities. The grapes harvested produced a wine with crisp red fruits and bright berry acidity. The fresh, tight aftertaste suggests the wine will age. Drink from 2019.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013 Dominode Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: The softest hint of apricot can be discerned on the nose. The palate reinforces this flavor with more soft stone fruit and just a touch of off-dry sweetness. The result is a very expressive, gently but deeply fruited, slender palate that will sing with spicy Asian dishes or soft cheeses. It offers wonderfully lasting flavor.
title: Paul Blanck 2014 Vieilles Vignes Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: This wine comes from one of the best vineyard sites in Savigny-lès-Beaune, on the slope closest to Beaune. It is a smooth, perfumed and ripe wine that has a balanced structure under the bright red-cherry flavor. Still bursting with young fruit, the wine will age, so wait to drink until 2019.
title: Nicolas Potel 2014 Les Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Lemon freshness encounters some honeyed richness. There's a hint of pleasant bitterness of honeycomb on the flavor, while the palate is streamlined with zesty lemon freshness. These create an intriguing and successful counterpoint on the dry, slender but expressive body.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2014 Vieilles Vignes Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: Lemon freshness encounters some honeyed richness. There's a hint of pleasant bitterness of honeycomb on the flavor, while the palate is streamlined with zesty lemon freshness. These create an intriguing and successful counterpoint on the dry, slender but expressive body.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2014 Vieilles Vignes Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: This lush wine will be too oaky for purists, but there is no denying the superb quality of the underlying fruit. It's full-bodied, soft and succulent in texture, with cassis fruit framed by ample cedar and vanilla. A blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah. Drink now–2018.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2008 Guy Louis Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A rich, fat wine, with the weight of concentrated red fruits laced with pear and a touch of spice. There is a vanilla layer that adds extra complexity.
title: Domaines Ott 2010 Château de Selle Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Hints of ripe peach creep in with the yellow plum notes on the nose. The palate adds a generous if frothy creaminess to these flavors, making them fizz and fill the mouth with their fruity freshness. Behind all this lurks a grown-up backdrop of biscuity richness that allows for a restrained dosage and a very dry finish. Lovely now, will benefit from bottle age. Drink 2016–2019.
title: Joseph Cattin 2010 Grande Cuvée Brut Millesimé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Hints of ripe peach creep in with the yellow plum notes on the nose. The palate adds a generous if frothy creaminess to these flavors, making them fizz and fill the mouth with their fruity freshness. Behind all this lurks a grown-up backdrop of biscuity richness that allows for a restrained dosage and a very dry finish. Lovely now, will benefit from bottle age. Drink 2016–2019.
title: Joseph Cattin 2010 Grande Cuvée Brut Millesimé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: From organic and biodynamic vineyards, this wine is full of ripe berry fruits backed up by firm tannins, this is a wine that is full of potential. It has structure, a fine form of rich fruit and acidity. With its dense texture this is a wine to age. So just wait until 2019.
title: Château Brethous 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: From organic and biodynamic vineyards, this wine is full of ripe berry fruits backed up by firm tannins, this is a wine that is full of potential. It has structure, a fine form of rich fruit and acidity. With its dense texture this is a wine to age. So just wait until 2019.
title: Château Brethous 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is the driest of the wines in this producer's range. A high proportion of Pinot Meunier gives it fruitiness to balance the dryness. It is light and poised with white fruits and good acidity. The mineral texture makes this balanced Champagne a match with many salty foods.
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Light, fruity and medium sweet, this is a pleasant, strawberry-flavored sparkling wine that lacks some acidity. It's best as an apéritif.
title: Marquis de la Tour NV Rosé Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This is a lightly wood-aged wine, with crisp acidity and just a hint of toast. The fruit is upfront, showing a crisp, tight lemon character that's tangy and refreshing. Drink now.
title: La Chablisienne 2014 La Pierrelée  (Chablis)

description: This is a pale-colored wine with a soft texture and gentle strawberry fruits. The texture comes through slowly to give a firmer edge to what is a wine for medium-term aging. This is stylish and smooth. It should be drunk from 2018.
designation: Quentin Jeannot La Fussière Premier Cru
title: Philippe Jeannot 2015 Quentin Jeannot La Fussière Premier Cru  (Maranges)

description: Pineau d'Aunis vines planted in 1920 by the grandfather of the estate's current owner have produced a smooth, ripe and spicy wine. It has some red fruits and acidity, but the edge of tannins in the texture gives the wine its real character. Drink now.
title: Domaine Patrice Colin 2015 Gris Bodin Rosé (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: Run by a mother and daughter team, this estate has produced a fruity, very accessible Chablis. It has the crisp apple fruitiness of the vintage along with a fine shot of fresh citrus. The wine has a lightly mineral character, finishing with refreshing acidity. Drink this wine now.
title: Domaine Bègue-Mathiot 2014  Chablis

description: For a sort of kitchen sink blend composed of Grenache Blanc, Chenin Blanc, Mauzac, Sauvignon Blanc, Vermentino and Chasan, this wine is surprisingly pleasing and easy to drink with flavors of lively melon, stone fruit and accents of lime citrus. Versatile for food pairing, easy to drink and a terrific value.
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2009 ClaudeVal Blanc White (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: This shows the fruity side of Cabernet Franc. No wood aging, just red fruits, spice and stalky tannins, with a hint of smokiness and a light structure. Drink from 2015.
title: Château de la Roulerie 2013 Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: An herbal wine, this has fruit flavors that suggest peach and crisp apple. Round, textured and fragrant, this is for drinking now.
title: Mont Gravet 2011 Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: An herbal wine, this has fruit flavors that suggest peach and crisp apple. Round, textured and fragrant, this is for drinking now.
title: Mont Gravet 2011 Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A classic and fun Nouveau, this has an extra side of firm tannin that adds weight to an otherwise bold, fruity and food-friendly wine.
title: Thorin 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais)

description: Brilliantly fresh, this wine is tight with acidity and textured with zingy citrus. Layers of apple and toast are already integrated in this bright wine. It's tangy, lively and likely to be ready to drink from 2017. The wine comes from the highest vineyard in Chassagne.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2013 En Pimont  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Brilliantly fresh, this wine is tight with acidity and textured with zingy citrus. Layers of apple and toast are already integrated in this bright wine. It's tangy, lively and likely to be ready to drink from 2017. The wine comes from the highest vineyard in Chassagne.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2013 En Pimont  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Dark in color and in flavor profile, this medium-bodied Cornas boasts aromas and flavors reminiscent of chocolate fudge, espresso and plummy fruit, all framed by soft, dusty tannins. Drink now–2025.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2012 Coteaux  (Cornas)

description: Delicious while also young and textured, this wine comes from biodynamically grown grapes. It has a strong sense of minerality as well as intense citrus and green fruits. It's tight at the moment and needs to round out, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Vacheron 2014 Le Pavé  (Sancerre)

description: Produced from three vineyards in the north of the Sancerre appellation, this is a crisp, ripe wine. It offers a blend of green plum and lime with a touch of white peach. The acidity, still young, will soften over the next few months when the wine will be even better. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Rome 2014  Sancerre

description: Produced from three vineyards in the north of the Sancerre appellation, this is a crisp, ripe wine. It offers a blend of green plum and lime with a touch of white peach. The acidity, still young, will soften over the next few months when the wine will be even better. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Rome 2014  Sancerre

description: Sourced from 50+ year-old vines in the commune of Sorgues, this aromatic blend of 60% Grenache, 20% Syrah and 20% Mourvèdre boasts hints of rosemary, bay leaf and clove. It's reasonably full bodied, with a long, drying finish that demands another year or two in the cellar or (preferably) some rare beef or lamb.
title: Château Pégau 2013 Cuvée Setier Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This wine is packed with ripe fruit, fresh acidity and crisply textured minerality. Finely wrought, it's structured and made to age, with a strong steely backbone to the otherwise fresh lemon and lime flavors. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Favray 2014  Pouilly-Fumé

description: Produced from two parcels in Aloxe Corton, this structured wine has red-plum fruitiness that is still masked by a dry tannic coating. It has concentration and good potential. Drink this textured, firm wine from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2013 Les Brunettes et Planchots  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: Firm, but balanced, this is a wine with many of the virtues of the vintage. It has weight and richness, but also fresh, juicy, fruity acidity all packaged nicely in tannins. Drink this wine from 2015.
title: Château Trocard Monrepos 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Beautifully ripe and aromatic notions of juicy pear and red apples play on the nose. The palate is more advanced and full of lanolin and chalk notes with a rich texture but absolutely dry. This has a rich but taut, almost balm-like body with concentration. The backbone of lemony freshness pull a tight focus. Ready now, but will develop and drink well until 2020.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2012 Kessler Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Beautifully ripe and aromatic notions of juicy pear and red apples play on the nose. The palate is more advanced and full of lanolin and chalk notes with a rich texture but absolutely dry. This has a rich but taut, almost balm-like body with concentration. The backbone of lemony freshness pull a tight focus. Ready now, but will develop and drink well until 2020.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2012 Kessler Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Lifted, fresh notes of peach on nose and palate somehow manage to pull off a wine of utter freshness that is soft, mellow and rounded at the same time. The peachy fruit pervades the entire palate which has just a smidgeon of residual sweetness and a helpful, balancing edge of pleasant bitterness.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2013 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Tight and structured, this has a strongly crisp character. It is fresh, fruity and touched by spicy toast. There is a great line in attractive acidity here, along with a tight, mineral aftertaste.
title: Maison Matisco 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Tight and structured, this has a strongly crisp character. It is fresh, fruity and touched by spicy toast. There is a great line in attractive acidity here, along with a tight, mineral aftertaste.
title: Maison Matisco 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Dainty aromas of wild strawberry, red cherry and peach pit lead the nose of this playful rosé. The palate is light and lively, with flavors of citrus peel and white melon rind that carry through to the mouthwatering finish. Drink now.
title: M. Chapoutier 2014 Bila Haut Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Dainty aromas of wild strawberry, red cherry and peach pit lead the nose of this playful rosé. The palate is light and lively, with flavors of citrus peel and white melon rind that carry through to the mouthwatering finish. Drink now.
title: M. Chapoutier 2014 Bila Haut Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This wine is fruity, with crisp, fresh lemon flavors. It is lightly textured and smooth, with green fruit acidity and a creamy aftertaste. Drink from 2016.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Mâcon-Villages

description: This soft, smooth and creamy wine has attractive spice and vanilla from the wood aging, along with light citrus and peach flavors. Ripe and full in the mouth, it has a touch of minerality at the end to give a fine texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Louis Jadot 2012  Bourgogne

description: This soft, smooth and creamy wine has attractive spice and vanilla from the wood aging, along with light citrus and peach flavors. Ripe and full in the mouth, it has a touch of minerality at the end to give a fine texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Louis Jadot 2012  Bourgogne

description: A hint of menthol infiltrates the red cherry and raspberry fruit core, smelling almost like a cherry Halls. Hints of cherry pit and mineral add intrigue, while lively acidity lends a refreshing feel to the palate and carries through to the mouthwatering finish. Enjoy now.
title: Le Cirque 2014 Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: A hint of menthol infiltrates the red cherry and raspberry fruit core, smelling almost like a cherry Halls. Hints of cherry pit and mineral add intrigue, while lively acidity lends a refreshing feel to the palate and carries through to the mouthwatering finish. Enjoy now.
title: Le Cirque 2014 Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: This crisp wine is packed with acidity and fruitiness. It is tangy, tight, full of attractive acidity as well as lively citrus and white fruits. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Guillot-Broux 2013 Les Gennievrières  (Mâcon-Cruzille)

description: There's a definite ripeness to the bouquet of this wine, with rich scents of mealy melon, peach, strawberry and banana. The palate, however, shows more restraint in flavors of crisp watermelon, firm cherry and citrus peel. Medium acidity lends lift and freshness to the mouthfeel and finish. Drink up.
title: Calmel & Joseph 2014 Villa Blanche Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Like a freshly picked cherry, all juicy fruit with sweet perfumes and a jammy, ripe character. The wine is soft, open and already accessible.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2009 Bearegard  (Santenay)

description: Produced from young vines, this fresh, fruity wine offers immediate pleasure, with red berries and sweet fruit flavors over a spicy layer of wood and a soft, generous texture.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2009 Santenots  (Volnay)

description: Produced from young vines, this fresh, fruity wine offers immediate pleasure, with red berries and sweet fruit flavors over a spicy layer of wood and a soft, generous texture.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2009 Santenots  (Volnay)

description: Gently soft and ripe, full of creamed pear and red apple flavors. There is a touch of structure as well to give an edge to it, leaving a warm glow of rich fruit on the finish.
title: Domaine de la Croix Senaillet 2009 Les Buis  (Saint-Véran)

description: Ripe and powerfully structured, this is dense with bold blackberry flavors and dark tannins that give a firm structure. However, as so often with 2013, it's the fruit that shines in this rich wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Le Carré 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: The acidity and alcohol are a bit pronounced on the nose, but otherwise this is a drinkable and clean rosé with tart but lively notes of white cherry, rhubarb and cranberry.
title: The Frenchhouse 2010 Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A soft wine, with some herbal, pear and kiwi flavors. It has just an edge of sweetness that gives it a soft aftertaste. For drinking now.
title: Jean-Michel Cazes 2010  Bordeaux Blanc

description: There's a strong funkiness to this wine, which can be called barnyard or even bordering on Band-Aid, that almost overwhelms the nose and mouth. Black plum and berry flavors struggle for dominance, while spicy oak controls the close.
title: Walden 2008 Rouge Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: Packed with exotic, tropical fruits, this is the essence of Gewurztraminer. It's perfumed, ripe, over the top and spicy. Lychee juice and peppered pears dominate this ready-to-drink wine.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2012 Clos St Sébastien Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A blend of the local Niellucciu and Sciaccarello grapes, this is a robust wine, with rustic tannins, blackberry acidity and a firm dry core. A great barbecue wine, finishing very fresh with a layer of wood.
title: Clos Teddi 2006 Rouge Red (Patrimonio)

description: A blend of the local Niellucciu and Sciaccarello grapes, this is a robust wine, with rustic tannins, blackberry acidity and a firm dry core. A great barbecue wine, finishing very fresh with a layer of wood.
title: Clos Teddi 2006 Rouge Red (Patrimonio)

description: Soft, creamy, rounded wine, which seems initially unfocused. But there are some good pear and kiwi flavors. The end, though, is dilute.
title: Sauvion 2006 Cardinal Richard  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: There is an important element of wood here, along with a ripe, creamy texture. By contrast, the structure is mineral, lifted with grapefruit flavors. The wood supports this fruit, giving a complete, mouth filling wine.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Les Perrières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Great swathes of yellow fruits here, a wine that has weight, richness and delicious texture. Final spice shows through from the wood.
designation: Domaine des Deux Roches Vieilles Vignes
title: Collovray et Terrier 2008 Domaine des Deux Roches Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: There is an explosion of ripe yellow fruit here, giving a ripe, tropical feel. Spice, mango, it's quite a powerhouse of flavors. This is a gorgeous, opulent wine.
title: Louis Latour 2008  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: From what is always the Grand Cru that develops most quickly, this is a gorgeous, already very drinkable, ripe wine, certainly fresh. Maybe there is a more mineral character than usual, allied to higher acidity.
title: William Fèvre 2008 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Caramel and vanilla aromas, the palate rounded, poised, with pear and green plum flavors, along with lively acidity, filled out with toast.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2007 Perrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Caramel and vanilla aromas, the palate rounded, poised, with pear and green plum flavors, along with lively acidity, filled out with toast.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2007 Perrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: The dry, hard tannins are very Saint-Estèphe, but the wine bears its weight well, giving good black plum and berry fruits and a dense texture. It has a solid, chunky feel to it, dark and firm. The finish is more fresh and juicy.
title: Château Meyney 2007  Saint-Estèphe

description: Now owned by Château Labégorce-Margaux, this classed growth is beginning to come back to life. With this vintage, perhaps the wood flavor is too much, but the fruit has weight, dark spicy character and solid tannins. Age for 5–6 years for the wood to soften.
title: Château Marquis d'Alesme 2007  Margaux

description: Now owned by Château Labégorce-Margaux, this classed growth is beginning to come back to life. With this vintage, perhaps the wood flavor is too much, but the fruit has weight, dark spicy character and solid tannins. Age for 5–6 years for the wood to soften.
title: Château Marquis d'Alesme 2007  Margaux

description: While not strictly part of the Haut-Médoc Château Cambon la Pelouse, this small parcel in Margaux is under the same ownership and vinification. The wine has weight, some solid fruit, with the wood adding polish but not dominating. A well-structured wine for medium-term aging.
title: Château Cambon la Pelouse 2007 L'Aura de Cambon  (Margaux)

description: Just an edge of butter gives this wine roundness and extra richness. Along with this character comes ripe peach fruit, lifted with acidity. Ready to drink. Screwcap.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2010 Kimmeridgien  (Bourgogne)

description: Expect ripe and open fruit from this Faiveley owned vineyard in Mercurey. The wine tastes soft, the tannins well integrated into the ripe cherry and berry fruits. It could age, but it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2009 Clos des Myglands Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Soft, sweet rosé, with a caramel and sugared strawberry character. A light wine for those who want less alcohol than is found in a white Zinfandel.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009 Rosé  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a ripe, wonderful wine that's full of spice, pineapple and apricot with a green tang of herbaceous character. It's simply beautiful, with great style and a deceptively simple use of wood.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a ripe, wonderful wine that's full of spice, pineapple and apricot with a green tang of herbaceous character. It's simply beautiful, with great style and a deceptively simple use of wood.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 96–98. Barrel sample. A beautifully ripe wine that's very dense in its character. The wine is generous and rich, while also structured. It already has delicious black plum fruit and velvet tannins. A wonderful, opulent wine that's packed with full-throated Merlot.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 85–87. Barrel sample. This is a soft, simple wine. It has attractive, gentle fruits and some ripe tannins. Likely to age quickly.
title: Château d'Arcins 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 85–87. Barrel sample. This is a soft, simple wine. It has attractive, gentle fruits and some ripe tannins. Likely to age quickly.
title: Château d'Arcins 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 86–88. Barrel sample. On the dry, extracted side, this is a wine with some firm tannins and solid structure. The aftertaste is dark, mineral and austere.
title: Château Lestage Simon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This is a warm, open wine that's gently tannic, and likely to age quickly. It has some spice, ripe black plums, and aftertaste that reveals some of its dry structure.
title: Château Caronne Ste Gemme 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. Jammy in character—perhaps attributable to the 26% of Petit Verdot in the blend—this wine is soft and smooth, but already developing well.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2012 Tronquoy de Sainte-Anne Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This is a firm, extracted wine that's hard-edged and needing some signs of fruit. Very dry and austere, chocolate and bitter-coffee notes dominate.
title: Château Tour de Pez 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. Dry, firm, extracted tannins are alleviated by the fruity background on this wine. There's a bitter chocolate character along with black currant and brisk acidity on the finish.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. Dry, firm, extracted tannins are alleviated by the fruity background on this wine. There's a bitter chocolate character along with black currant and brisk acidity on the finish.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This is a fruity, lightweight wine that is very juicy and soft. It's attractively bright and fresh with an open character.
title: Château Cantemerle 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This is a fruity, lightweight wine that is very juicy and soft. It's attractively bright and fresh with an open character.
title: Château Cantemerle 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Juicy and fruity, this wine is a classic example of the vintage. Along with a forward fruit character, there is a spicy element from new wood. The wine finishes with layered acidity.
title: Château Reysson 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Signs of very ripe fruit are everywhere on this wine with soft tannins and a rich, sweet plum character. The palate is forward and likely to age fast.
title: Château de Villegeorge 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Signs of very ripe fruit are everywhere on this wine with soft tannins and a rich, sweet plum character. The palate is forward and likely to age fast.
title: Château de Villegeorge 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Ripe, almost Porty in character, the wine boasts very black fruit that shines through the tannins. The palate has a dry edge to it, revealing dark concentration and a firm aftertaste.
title: Château Batailley 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. This dry wine is balanced by a dark concentration of juicy fruit. It has enough density of both black fruit and dry tannins to promise good aging.
title: Château Coufran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. This dry wine is balanced by a dark concentration of juicy fruit. It has enough density of both black fruit and dry tannins to promise good aging.
title: Château Coufran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Layered new-wood flavors dominate this ripe wine. It has a concentrated structure while also being full and fruity. There is a touch of bitter extraction at the end.
title: Château Cos Labory 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Layered new-wood flavors dominate this ripe wine. It has a concentrated structure while also being full and fruity. There is a touch of bitter extraction at the end.
title: Château Cos Labory 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. This is a ripe, full wine that's very soft in the tannin department. Its pleasure comes from the warm plum fruits and open, generous character.
title: Château Clément-Pichon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. One of the largest vineyards in the Médoc, Larose Trintaudon has produced a reliable, attactively fruity wine with soft tannins, blackberry-juice flavors and a crisp acidity at the end.
title: Château Larose-Trintaudon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. One of the largest vineyards in the Médoc, Larose Trintaudon has produced a reliable, attactively fruity wine with soft tannins, blackberry-juice flavors and a crisp acidity at the end.
title: Château Larose-Trintaudon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and fruity wine with delicious, already-accessible black-currant fruit. Attractive and very forward.
title: Château Pibran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and fruity wine with delicious, already-accessible black-currant fruit. Attractive and very forward.
title: Château Pibran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This wine is marked by new-wood spice and strong structure that showcases a sense of weight and spicy ripeness. The palate is powerful, while also maintaining a bold, juicy character.
title: Château Meyney 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This wine is marked by new-wood spice and strong structure that showcases a sense of weight and spicy ripeness. The palate is powerful, while also maintaining a bold, juicy character.
title: Château Meyney 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89–91. Barrel sample. This is a concentrated wine that's very full in the mouth and shows its structure right up front. It has acidity and some juiciness, but the fruit is still very suppressed by the dryness.
title: Château Camensac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This ripe and chocolatey wine is soft and pleasantly characteristic of Merlot. Full-bodied and rich, the palate is touched by spice and topped with attractive acidity. There's a rich feel to it all around.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This ripe and chocolatey wine is soft and pleasantly characteristic of Merlot. Full-bodied and rich, the palate is touched by spice and topped with attractive acidity. There's a rich feel to it all around.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and spicy wine that showcases flavors of new wood and rich, sweet black fruits. The wine is attractive and fruity, but with enough structure to promise some good aging.
title: Château Cambon la Pelouse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a ripe and spicy wine that showcases flavors of new wood and rich, sweet black fruits. The wine is attractive and fruity, but with enough structure to promise some good aging.
title: Château Cambon la Pelouse 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. This is a full and ripe wine that slowly reveals its rich, full-bodied character. On the mid palate, dry Saint-Estèphe tannins come through to show the immense concentration of the wine.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. Solid and structured, while also a fruity wine, this has weight, richness and generous black-fruit flavors. It's quite a success, and showcases the pleasurable side of the vintage.
title: Château d'Hanteillan 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. Packed with new wood, blackberry fruits and soft tannins, this wine sums up the fruitiness of the vintage. Great swathes of juicy acidity linger at the end.
title: Château d'Agassac 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90–92. Barrel sample. Richly textured and weighty, this dark, dense, black-plum flavored wine is accented by black-coffee notes along with fragrant acidity.
title: Château Citran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Big, fresh and juicy, this is a bright and forward wine. Attractive smoky tannins are layered with fresh acidity and black currant flavors. The wine is already attractive, although there are enough tannins for it to age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Gazin Rocquencourt 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Strongly aromatic, this wood-aged wine is perfumed with both toast and smokiness. The palate has fruit, but the acidity both from that fruit and the wood dominates, suggesting the wine needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Portets 2013  Graves

description: A soft, apple-fruited wine that has fine, flinty acidity to go with its lively grapefruit freshness. An extra year of aging has given it roundness while retaining the seafood-friendly nature of Muscadet.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2010 Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The Hospices de Saumur is a charitable foundation, with the Clos Cristal one of the donations of vineyards. This young, fruity 2011 shows some rough, rustic edges while also giving full, red berry fruits and some tight tannins. For aging over the next 2–3 years when it will smooth out.
title: Hospices de Saumur 2011 Clos Cristal  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: The Hospices de Saumur is a charitable foundation, with the Clos Cristal one of the donations of vineyards. This young, fruity 2011 shows some rough, rustic edges while also giving full, red berry fruits and some tight tannins. For aging over the next 2–3 years when it will smooth out.
title: Hospices de Saumur 2011 Clos Cristal  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: This is on the fullish side, lacking crispness and refreshment factor. Fortunately, the ripe apple and pear flavors are charming enough to pull it through.
designation: Marquis de Perlade Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Sparr NV Marquis de Perlade Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: No doubt this is meant to be a slightly more serious attempt at sparkling wine, but it merely succeeds in being pleasant. Obvious citrus and earth aromas add hints of ginger on the palate. It's slightly creamy in texture, finishing clean and fresh.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2004 Brut Chardonnay (Vin Mousseux)

description: No doubt this is meant to be a slightly more serious attempt at sparkling wine, but it merely succeeds in being pleasant. Obvious citrus and earth aromas add hints of ginger on the palate. It's slightly creamy in texture, finishing clean and fresh.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2004 Brut Chardonnay (Vin Mousseux)

description: This is a soft, rounded and ripe wine. Attractive raspberry fruits are filled out with a light tannic character. The freshness and acidity do cut the full texture although perhaps not enough. Drink now.
title: Jean-Paul Brun 2014 Rosé d' Folie Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: With intense banana aromas, this is a tight wine with high acidity. It has crisp red-currant fruits that are not quite ripe. Tangy and shot through with banana flavors, the wine will be better from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine des Darroux  (Chénas)

description: Both citrus and apple notes are dulled by very earthy notes. The slender palate frothes softly but does not provide more fruit, either. This is dry and muted, but fresh.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Both citrus and apple notes are dulled by very earthy notes. The slender palate frothes softly but does not provide more fruit, either. This is dry and muted, but fresh.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This young, fruity wine is soft and fresh with acidity. It is light, rounded and, with its red-cherry flavors right to the fore, ready to drink. Pierre Ferraud created the wine in 1986 to show that a simple red Beaujolais is not just nouveau.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2014 Cuvée des Montagnards  (Beaujolais)

description: This young, fruity wine is soft and fresh with acidity. It is light, rounded and, with its red-cherry flavors right to the fore, ready to drink. Pierre Ferraud created the wine in 1986 to show that a simple red Beaujolais is not just nouveau.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2014 Cuvée des Montagnards  (Beaujolais)

description: With its bright pink color and fruity acidity, this is a candy-flavored, crisp wine. It is as bright in its flavors as it is in its color. It is light and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Dupeuble Père et Fils 2014 Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: This wine is lean, based more on acidity and structure than on fruit. It has hints of red-cherry flavors although they ought to be more developed. It leaves a smoky aftertaste.
title: Domaine du Clos du Fief 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This Chardonnay from Marcel Grillet's horse-plowed biodynamic vineyard called Pizay is still very young, showing a candy, confected flavor that needs to calm down. It has the potential for attractive fruit from 2016.
title: Domaine de la Bonne Tonne 2014  Beaujolais Blanc

description: This is a soft wine, light and fresh. It has a citrus character, lemon squeezed over apples that give crispness. Some minerality to the texture adds interest and puts the wine in the food-friendly category. Drink now.
title: Château de Pizay 2014  Beaujolais Blanc

description: Red fruits and banana aromas lead to a wine that has a lightly tannic touch over bright cherry fruits. Intense acidity and a herbaceous character come from grapes that are barely ripe. Drink now.
title: Château de Chatelard 2014 Cuvée les Chalandières  (Beaujolais)

description: Red fruits and banana aromas lead to a wine that has a lightly tannic touch over bright cherry fruits. Intense acidity and a herbaceous character come from grapes that are barely ripe. Drink now.
title: Château de Chatelard 2014 Cuvée les Chalandières  (Beaujolais)

description: This tight and steely wine is fresh with crisp fruits and a strongly herbaceous character. It offers gooseberry, grapefruit and intense, youthful acidity that needs to calm down. Give this very young wine until the end of 2016.
title: François Millet 2014 Empreinte Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: This tight and steely wine is fresh with crisp fruits and a strongly herbaceous character. It offers gooseberry, grapefruit and intense, youthful acidity that needs to calm down. Give this very young wine until the end of 2016.
title: François Millet 2014 Empreinte Blanc  (Sancerre)

description: This unoaked Chardonnay offers bright aromas of red apple and white peach, laced with the faintest hint of hay and yellow flower. It's light and zippy on the palate, with a lemon-lime freshness and a green plum flavor that results in a tart and refreshing finish.
region: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: Laroque 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: This unoaked Chardonnay offers bright aromas of red apple and white peach, laced with the faintest hint of hay and yellow flower. It's light and zippy on the palate, with a lemon-lime freshness and a green plum flavor that results in a tart and refreshing finish.
region: Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne
title: Laroque 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays Cité de Carcassonne)

description: Made from 30% Cinsault, 30% Grenache, 20% mourvèdre and 20% Syrah, this offers direct cherry, watermelon, peach and citrus notes on the nose and mouth. Light weight and balanced, it's a refreshing and easygoing quaff that finishes briskly.
title: S. Delafont 2015 Rosé (Languedoc)

description: This is a bright, cherry-flavored wine. It has an attractive tannic edge to the ready-to-drink fruitiness. The acidity at the end gives the wine a good lift.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014  Beaujolais

description: This is a bright, cherry-flavored wine. It has an attractive tannic edge to the ready-to-drink fruitiness. The acidity at the end gives the wine a good lift.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014  Beaujolais

description: Herbal and citrus, this is a crisp, immediately drinkable wine. With its light texture and zing of orange peel, the wine is fruity—so fresh and bright.
title: Mont Gravet 2015 Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: From the Ferraud family's estate in Vaux en Beaujolais, this wine is ripe and full bodied. It has a touch of pepper as well as raspberry and red-currant flavors. Lively and full of fruitiness, it is ready to drink.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2015 Les Merrains  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: From the Ferraud family's estate in Vaux en Beaujolais, this wine is ripe and full bodied. It has a touch of pepper as well as raspberry and red-currant flavors. Lively and full of fruitiness, it is ready to drink.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2015 Les Merrains  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: The wine is bright and fruity. It has crisp acidity and a light touch of citrus to go with the lively acidity. Its blend brings out the herbal flavor of Colombard with just a touch of honey from Gros Manseng. Drink now.
title: Domaine la Taste 2015 Colombard-Ugni Blanc-Gros Manseng-Sauvignon White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Very crisp and very fresh, this thrives on its bright sliced apple flavors. A tight texture gives a lemon tang. It's still young and should be given until late 2015.
title: Veuve Doussot NV Grande Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: Very crisp and very fresh, this thrives on its bright sliced apple flavors. A tight texture gives a lemon tang. It's still young and should be given until late 2015.
title: Veuve Doussot NV Grande Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a very dry and crisp Champagne. With fresh acidity and sliced apple, lemon and green plum-skin fruitiness, it's still in its young and steely stage. There is plenty of fruit and texture to allow it to age.
title: Duval-Leroy NV Finesse Absolue Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fresh, citrus-dominated wine, with really crisp, lively fruit. The floral aromas are followed by a zingy character and a white fruit aftertaste. Screwcap.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2006  Graves

description: This is definitely a wine in the new ripe Bordeaux style, with rich black fruits and spicy tannins. Impressively dense, dusty fruit tannins are alongside smooth, polished new wood flavors. The acidity and black currants are the reminder that this is still Bordeaux, not New World.
title: Château Balestard 2004  Bordeaux

description: Friendly appetizing hints of Golden Delicious apple and pear make for an inviting but subtle nose. The palate is fresh and balanced, with a backbone of gentle but firm texture. The finish is clean and aromatic on this very successful blend of Riesling and Pinot Gris.
title: Willm 2015 Cuvée Méli-Mélo White (Alsace)

description: A soft, bright and fruity wine that has red currant and berry fruits. It is fresh with soft tannins and a damson skin texture that just gives shape to the fruit and acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Clos de l'Elu 2013 L'Aiglerie Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: This is so fruity with its blend of Grolleau and Cabernet Franc. It is off dry, full of strawberry flavors and laced with acidity. It is a fine summer rosé.
title: Chereau Carré 2015 Domaine des Nouelles  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: This is so fruity with its blend of Grolleau and Cabernet Franc. It is off dry, full of strawberry flavors and laced with acidity. It is a fine summer rosé.
title: Chereau Carré 2015 Domaine des Nouelles  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: This wine has soft apple and ripe pear flavors. It has a smooth texture that means it is ready to drink. The aftertaste, with its crisper acidity, suggests a wine that will be a good apéritif.
title: Château Fonfroide 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The Sèze family's white vineyard is enclosed by their Fronsec red vines. This wine is soft, ripe and rounded. It has gentle acidity along with a tangy edge of orange zest. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a softly fruity wine that has attractive, easy apple and melon flavors. It is floral and ready to drink.
title: Bougrier 2015 Château du Jaunay Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Slightly confected in style, with bubble-gum and cotton-candy notes accenting pear and guava fruit. It's medium bodied, with an abbreviated finish.
title: Jean Berteau 2014 Prestige White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The wine has caramel flavors and a tannic structure to give a dry, bitter character. It is firm and tight and needs a few more months. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château de Parenchère 2015 Red (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: This wine is soft, with touches of honey and orange marmalade. It's made from late harvest grapes that have concentration and natural sweetness. Drink now.
title: Château de Lardiley 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A light wine that seems rather dilute. It has simple, green and citrus fruit flavors that are gentle and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Michel Lynch 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A light wine that seems rather dilute. It has simple, green and citrus fruit flavors that are gentle and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Michel Lynch 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: An homage to the classic French mustache (rarely see now), this is an amusing label interpretation of simple, fruity Bordeaux. It has plenty of black-currant fruits and a lightly stalky texture that balances the crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Falgueyret Leglise 2014 Monsieur Moustache  (Bordeaux)

description: This blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault comes across as slightly confected. Bubble gum and cotton candy hint at sweetness, although this medium-bodied wine is technically dry. Serve well chilled.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2015 Saint-Vincent Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The wine has the lightness of the vintage. It has spice, red-currant fruits and hints of not-quite-ripe grapes. The wine is developing fast and will be ready from 2017.
title: Château Tour de Cazelle 2013  Côtes de Bourg

description: The wine has ripe yellow fruit flavors that are soft and full. Spice and a generous texture give a rounded wine that is full bodied and ready to drink.
title: Château Suau 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A gentle wine, soft and with attractive green fruits. It is light and tangy although the flavors are muted at the moment. Give it a few months for an easy apéritif style.
title: Château L'Oiseau 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine is smoky, with black currant-fruits and a core of dry tannins. Those tannins are probably not going anywhere much, so while the fruit and acidity will soften, the wine will always be dry.
title: Château La Fleur Poitou 2013  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: From a producer in the Layon valley, this is an off-dry wine with considerable acidity as well as red-fruit flavors. It is light with the yeasty character of a young, fruity wine. Drink now.
title: Château de Montguéret 2015  Rosé d'Anjou

description: This is a light, earthy wine from the limestone soil of Saumur-Champigny. It is soft, lightly smoky and with some attractive tannins and berry fruits in the background. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Besombes Moc Baril 2014 Domaine des Closiers  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: This is a light, earthy wine from the limestone soil of Saumur-Champigny. It is soft, lightly smoky and with some attractive tannins and berry fruits in the background. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Besombes Moc Baril 2014 Domaine des Closiers  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: This is a straightfoward, plummy, grapy red wine. It's medium in body but rather simple, ending on a slightly astringent, chalky note. Ecocert.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 Nature Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Bruno Mottet's 2013 purchase of Right Bank Château Seguin now delivers a ripe, smooth and soft wine. There is plenty of fruitiness, citrus, green plum and apple, all integrated into the rich texture and final acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Seguin 2015 Sauvignon de Seguin  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: It's the smoky flavors and acidity that dominate this fresh wine. It has hints of black-currant flavors that may develop although the wine is light and shows more dry tannins than fruit at this stage. Think about waiting until 2018.
title: Château Recougne 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Very ripe pear fruit is dangerously close to tipping over into cloying richness, almost hinting at cream soda. The palate is less overwhelming. As always, that special streak of Alsace acid saves the day.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Produced from vineyards in the mountains away from the coast, this cool wine still gives free rein to the richness of Vermentino. There is an herbal touch, some spice and ripe apricot flavors. Balanced and fruity now, it will be better from 2016.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2014 Vermentino (Côtes de Provence)

description: For a 2011, the wine has surprising maturity that makes it ready to drink now. Rounded berry fruits merge into the soft tannins, leaving an attractive, juicy aftertaste. Drink until 2018.
title: Château Roquevieille 2011  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is still austere, with dry toastiness. Black fruits emerge from the structure, showing a severe character although one with potential. It will develop into a powerful wine, solid and firm.
title: Château Puygueraud 2012  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Yes, the wine is perfumed, but the aromas are restrained, stylish and never in your face. That gives this Gewurztraminer a place at the table, fragrant while cut with acidity. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Zinck 2012 Portrait Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Yes, the wine is perfumed, but the aromas are restrained, stylish and never in your face. That gives this Gewurztraminer a place at the table, fragrant while cut with acidity. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Zinck 2012 Portrait Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This fruity, light and fresh wine offers easy tannins and red berry fruits. It's rounded and juicy, smoothed by wood aging that gives it a ripe aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Prestige de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: Soft and round, this young wine is all about fruit and a light tannic structure. Fresh berry fruits abound along with acidity and a drier core. It's not for long aging and will be ready to drink in 2015.
title: Château Siaurac 2012 Plaisir de Siaurac  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Soft and round, this young wine is all about fruit and a light tannic structure. Fresh berry fruits abound along with acidity and a drier core. It's not for long aging and will be ready to drink in 2015.
title: Château Siaurac 2012 Plaisir de Siaurac  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: This dense, wood-laden wine has ripe spice and dark tannins. It's heavy with wood as well as black currant fruits and acidity. It is young and needs time to integrate, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Château Roc de Ségur 2013  Bordeaux

description: For a young Sauvignon Blanc, this is surprisingly rich. A concentrated character supports the yellow fruits and light vanilla flavor. Drink now and until 2018.
title: Château Queyssard 2013 Cuvée Dorianne  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: For a young Sauvignon Blanc, this is surprisingly rich. A concentrated character supports the yellow fruits and light vanilla flavor. Drink now and until 2018.
title: Château Queyssard 2013 Cuvée Dorianne  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: The wine has a hard extracted edge, with bitter tannins that are dominating the fruitiness. It needs to soften and bring out the berry fruits, although the wine will always have a tough character.
title: Château Haut Bertinerie 2012 Elegance  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is ready to drink with its ripe black fruits and soft structure. A tannic edge keeps the berry fruits in order, allowing the juicy acidity also to shine. At the end, the wood aging shows along with the black currant fruit.
title: Château des Combes 2011  Bordeaux

description: The browning color shows that this wine has age. It has weight still, as well as considerable acidity, but the wine is beginning to dry out and certainly should not be kept for much longer.
title: Château le Raz 2003  Montravel

description: A solid wine, full of dried fruits, dense plums and firm tannins. It has fresh acidity, bright juiciness that will come through more strongly over the next few months.
title: Château le Mayne Turon 2011  Bordeaux

description: This smoky wine shows an herbal character. Juicy fruitiness reveals fresh red-berry fruit along with some bitterness that needs a couple of years to soften.
title: Château Ségonzac 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Despite a dry base, the wine is full of fruity acidity, lively tannins and solid potential. Give this wine 2–4 years and it will be well balanced.
title: Château Roc de Minvielle 2011  Bordeaux

description: A jolly, jammy wine, packed with wood flavors and a soft and rounded character. It has spice, vanilla and red berry flavors. It should develop quickly and be ready to drink by 2016.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2011 Le Petit Mouton  (Pauillac)

description: This single vineyard wine has delicious white fruit and lime flavors. Tangy with acidity and a touch of crisp minerality, it's ready for summer drinking.
title: Bernard et Christophe Richel 2016 Domaine la Combelle Apremont Jacquère (Vin de Savoie)

description: This single vineyard wine has delicious white fruit and lime flavors. Tangy with acidity and a touch of crisp minerality, it's ready for summer drinking.
title: Bernard et Christophe Richel 2016 Domaine la Combelle Apremont Jacquère (Vin de Savoie)

description: This estate obviously believes in experiments, presenting here an apéritif-style blend of Syrah and Muscat. It's not hard to taste the strongly perfumed Muscat character, which dominates the palate. Ripe with more spice than fruit, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2016 Mireille Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Dominated by Merlot and Cabernet Franc, typical of this region to the east of Saint-Emilion, this is a ripe, smooth wine, its tannins spread through the fresh red fruit flavors. There's lively acidity here as well, a wine whose tannins promise aging.
title: Château Robin 2004  Côtes de Castillon

description: Dominated by Merlot and Cabernet Franc, typical of this region to the east of Saint-Emilion, this is a ripe, smooth wine, its tannins spread through the fresh red fruit flavors. There's lively acidity here as well, a wine whose tannins promise aging.
title: Château Robin 2004  Côtes de Castillon

description: An earthy hint comes with the bright lemon flavors of this dry, tart wine. The palate reveals a glimpse of riper fruit but lime freshness rules. It finishes totally clean.
title: Vieil Armand 2015 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: An earthy hint comes with the bright lemon flavors of this dry, tart wine. The palate reveals a glimpse of riper fruit but lime freshness rules. It finishes totally clean.
title: Vieil Armand 2015 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Ripe, almost overripe notes of yellow pear signal a generouswine. Full of fruit, the palate is juicy, mellow and easy. Drink soon to make most of all these pear notes.
title: Helfrich 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Only a small portion of this vineyard is planted with Chardonnay, and it has produced a minerally wine that's both crisp and ripe. The acidity is dominant at this stage, which lends the palate a juicy, peach- and citrus-like character. This wood-aged selection needs time.
designation: Clos de la Croix de Pierre
title: Louis Jadot 2010 Clos de la Croix de Pierre  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: This wine is concentrated and full in the mouth, and it bears a minerally texture and intense acidity. It's packed with flavors of sweet peach, lime, ripe Rocha pear and spice from the wood maturation. This promises to age for several years.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2010  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: This wine is concentrated and full in the mouth, and it bears a minerally texture and intense acidity. It's packed with flavors of sweet peach, lime, ripe Rocha pear and spice from the wood maturation. This promises to age for several years.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2010  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: Fruity and rounded, this has attractive, citrus-like acidity that cuts through the caramel and apricot flavors. There is a delicious, forward orange-juice flavor that adds to the fresh feel of the wine. It's ready to drink, although it will also age.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Sentier du Clou Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Rugiens,  which is named after its red soil, is located in the south of Pommard. Dense, structured and powerful, this is a brooding wine that has concentrated tannins and fruit that is offset by a tight line of acidity. This is a wine that demands aging.
designation: Domaine du Pavillon Rugiens Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Domaine du Pavillon Rugiens Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Rich and full, this wine shows some sense of structure. It has considerable acidity and flavors of cherry and red currant. With the dry tannins coming through on the finish, it will need some years to soften.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2010 Brouillards Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Rich and full, this wine shows some sense of structure. It has considerable acidity and flavors of cherry and red currant. With the dry tannins coming through on the finish, it will need some years to soften.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2010 Brouillards Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Les Fourneaux is one of the smallest premier crus. Rich and balanced, this wine is full of pear and apricot flavors. It combines a minerally edge with a generous structure and fruitiness. Delicious now, but keep it for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Charly Nicolle 2011 Les Fourneaux Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a superrich, smooth wine. The acidity is what keeps the ripe yellow-fruit flavors in order, and it has a lemon-like edge to the tropical mouthfeel. Age this for 3–4 years.
designation: Sous le Dos d'Ane Premier Cru
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Sous le Dos d'Ane Premier Cru  (Meursault-Blagny)

description: This is a superrich, smooth wine. The acidity is what keeps the ripe yellow-fruit flavors in order, and it has a lemon-like edge to the tropical mouthfeel. Age this for 3–4 years.
designation: Sous le Dos d'Ane Premier Cru
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010 Sous le Dos d'Ane Premier Cru  (Meursault-Blagny)

description: The high altitude vineyards of Luberon can yield some thirst-quenching rosés, of which this is a very good example. Hints of crushed stone and barely-ripe peaches finish on a refreshing note of fresh lime juice. Drink now.
title: Marrenon 2015 Petula Rosé (Luberon)

description: From tiny production of 2.5 acres, there is a spicy, lightly toasty wine that brings out a richness in the Sauvignon Blanc and gives the apricot and pear fruit roundness. The wine is ripe, full in the mouth, tangy and zesty with a more refreshing herbal aftertaste. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château Maison Noble 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a spicy, perfumed wine that has a fine balance between acidity and red fruits. It comes from 40-year-old vines in this estate owned by French actor Gérard Depardieu. The wine is ripe and crisp with acidity at the end. Drink now.
title: Château de Tigné 2010 Vieilles Vignes Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou)

description: In the south of the Layon Valley, this producer has made a soft, fruity wine that is packed with red fruits. It is rounded, smooth with only a dusting of light tannins. The fruit is right up-front, exuberant and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Château de Montguéret 2013 Le Petit Saint Louis Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou)

description: Fine, new wood flavors mingle with acidity and ripe blackberry fruits to give a balanced wine. It has a fine texture, spice and juicy acidity that brings out the fruit of the vintage. It will be ready to drink soon, certainly by 2017.
title: Château de Cranne 2014  Bordeaux

description: Fine, new wood flavors mingle with acidity and ripe blackberry fruits to give a balanced wine. It has a fine texture, spice and juicy acidity that brings out the fruit of the vintage. It will be ready to drink soon, certainly by 2017.
title: Château de Cranne 2014  Bordeaux

description: Bonnet was this family's winery in 1744. André Lurton took over in 1953 and in 2015, the third warmest year since 1900, his team created a wine with tropical fruits, mango and pineapple. This give this wine its ripe, perfumed character. It does have a crisp side as well, fresh with apple and citrus. The balance is just right, giving a refreshing, ready-to-drink wine.
title: Château Bonnet 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Initially ripe and creamy, the wine tightens up with herbaceous, lemongrass flavors, only hinting at the richness. It needs another six months in bottle before drinking.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2007  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A white currant-flavored wine with soft but fresh acidity, layered with just a touch of spice. The wine is fruity, juicy, an easy drink as an aperitif or with fish.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Ballade 2007 Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This deliciously fruity wine shows some good depth of apple, apricot and orange zest flavors. The wine is light, crisp and finished with white currants. Easy and refreshing. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Cox 2007 Colombard (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is an attractive fruity wine, with a good touch of steely acidity as well as ripe yellow and white fruits. Sliced apples and fresh grapefruit give freshness. Crisp and clean, it is refreshingly ready to drink.
title: Louis Latour 2013 En Paradis  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: Crisp and fresh, this is a tangy, lemon and orange zest flavored wine. Lively acidity bursts through the richer white fruits, green plums and quince spiciness. Both fresh and ripe, it's well balanced. Drink now.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Pouilly-Vinzelles

description: This seems prematurely evolved with its lifted, kerosene-like whiff on the nose, but is no less pleasant for that. Ripe stone fruit melds into a slick, oily palate guided by a seam of bright, lemony freshness. The finish is dry and bright, and flavors fill the mouth long after the last sip.
title: Antoine Moltès & Fils 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: This seems prematurely evolved with its lifted, kerosene-like whiff on the nose, but is no less pleasant for that. Ripe stone fruit melds into a slick, oily palate guided by a seam of bright, lemony freshness. The finish is dry and bright, and flavors fill the mouth long after the last sip.
title: Antoine Moltès & Fils 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: With a good sense of structure, this bottling, formerly called Vieilles Vignes, comes from 55-year-old vines. It is textured, with some firm tannins as well as ripe plum flavors and acidity. The wine is still developing and will be better from 2016.
title: Alex Gambal 2013 Les Picotins  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: With a good sense of structure, this bottling, formerly called Vieilles Vignes, comes from 55-year-old vines. It is textured, with some firm tannins as well as ripe plum flavors and acidity. The wine is still developing and will be better from 2016.
title: Alex Gambal 2013 Les Picotins  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Ripe, jammy fruit aromas and flavors of black berry, cherry and plum abound in this attractive wine, with a secondary hint of fudgy brownie adding additional decadence. The palate is smooth and medium bodied, with approachable tannins and ample acidity providing just enough structure. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2013 Syrah-Carignan (Minervois)

description: Ripe, jammy fruit aromas and flavors of black berry, cherry and plum abound in this attractive wine, with a secondary hint of fudgy brownie adding additional decadence. The palate is smooth and medium bodied, with approachable tannins and ample acidity providing just enough structure. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2013 Syrah-Carignan (Minervois)

description: Apple peel and citrus shyly greet the nose, but the palate is rounder, zestier and full of red-apple goodness. This is crunchy, fruity, lively and refreshing. The dry finish is moreish and the textured midpalate is a bonus.
title: Domaine Zinck 2014 Portrait Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A blend of 80% Syrah and 20% Grenache, this seductive wine opens with rich aromas of chocolate covered cherry, raspberry, mocha and black licorice. High acidity lifts the rich black-fruit flavors on the palate, while fine tannins lend a subtly gripping texture. Drink now.
title: La Croix 2011 Grand Vin Syrah-Grenache (Minervois La Liviniere)

description: Freshly cut apple peel and apple fruit create a very welcoming and lively palate. The fruit is clean and very invigorating, while the dry finish provides cool refreshment.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2014 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Slightly floral notes combine the creaminess of jasmine with the fresh scent of mandarin peel. Despite the typical varietal broadness of Pinot Gris, this wine offers an appealing slenderness and a tender balance. Subtle and almost delicate, it conveys a touching edge of florality and lovely seam of acidity.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2014 Cuvée Particulière Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Orange and mandarin peel illuminate the sunny, pear-fruited character of this rounded and full wine. The fruit flavors have an additional boost from residual sugar, but this is balanced beautifully. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2013 Cuvée Engel Pinot Gris (Alsace)
