description: A crisp, fresh and creamy wine, it has grapefruit acidity and a firm sense of mineral structure. The wine is developing well, but to bring out its balance between fruit and texture, it needs until 2015 in bottle.
title: Vignobles Berthier 2012 Cuvée Jean-Marie Berthier  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A blend of 40% Bourboulenc, 30% Grenache Blanc and 30% Vermentino, this is a bright and floral wine, offering upfront scents of orange rind, melon, apple flesh, green fig and garrigue herbs. Flavors of red apple and stone fruits continue on the medium-weight palate, with ample acidity to provide good cut and freshness to the finish. A toasted-walnut flavor whispers softly on the medium-length finish. Drink now–2016.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Château L'Hospitalet La Reserve White (La Clape)

description: Made from 40% Syrah, 40% Grenache and 20% Mourvèdre, this rosé leads with herbal scents of garrigue herbs and peppercorn that dance atop fruity tones of ripe red cherry and plum skin. The soft, round palate offers richer tones of watermelon candy and peach preserves, while ample acidity lifts the finish and provides a clean close.
title: Domaine de Nizas 2016 Les Pierres Blanches Rosé (Languedoc)

description: The wine is ripe with rounded black-plum fruits over the toasty flavor. It has structure certainly, although this is already integrated into the juicy character of this attractive wine. Drink now.
title: Château Petit-Freylon 2015 Cuvée Michael  (Bordeaux)

description: There is a toughness to this young wine that will take time to soften. On the other hand, there is plenty going for it with the smoky black fruits and acidity and the warm aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Majureau Sercillan 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Crisp and full of red fruits, this is a balanced wine. With its tannins well tamed and integrated with the fruit, this is going to be a fruity easy wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Le Bocage 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Still showing its wood aging, the wine is rich with spice and blackberry fruit. It is structured and with swathes of juicy fruitiness. The acidity at the end gives this wine its final lift.
title: Château des Judes 2016  Bordeaux

description: Still showing its wood aging, the wine is rich with spice and blackberry fruit. It is structured and with swathes of juicy fruitiness. The acidity at the end gives this wine its final lift.
title: Château des Judes 2016  Bordeaux

description: There is plenty of fruit to find in this generous wine. Its tannins and dense structure are just part of its ripe future. The berry fruits and acidity promise a delicious wine from 2018.
title: Château de Parenchère 2015 Cuvée Raphaël  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Made from 50% Syrah, 40% Grenache and 10% Cinsault, this opens with ripe peach and red-berry aromas that are framed by mentholated herbal tones. The medium-weight palate offers a round mouthfeel and soft acidity, followed by a lightly pithy finish.
region: Coteaux du Languedoc Pic Saint Loup
title: Château de Lancyre 2016 Le Rosé (Coteaux du Languedoc Pic Saint Loup)

description: Ripe both with the generous tannins and the juicy fruit, this is a wine with good potential. There is plenty of acidity to bring out the crisp character of this attractive wine. It will be ready from 2019.
title: Château de Garros 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Dense and well structured, this is going to be an attractive wine. It has blackberry fruit, plenty of crisp acidity and a structured aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Costis 2015  Bordeaux

description: Tight, young and tangy, this wine will be delicious when it all comes together. The elements are all there, with the quince and pear fruits, intense acidity and the crisp texture that is so refreshing. Drink this ageworthy wine from 2017.
title: Domaine de la Gaverie 2014 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This is the second wine of Château Pibran, whose vineyard is situated close to those of the the first growths of Mouton and Lafite. Structured and dense, this is a solid, powerful wine, packed with juicy black currant fruits and generous tannins. Give this wine until 2018 before drinking.
title: Château Pibran 2012 Château Tour Pibran  (Pauillac)

description: This is the second wine of Château Pibran, whose vineyard is situated close to those of the the first growths of Mouton and Lafite. Structured and dense, this is a solid, powerful wine, packed with juicy black currant fruits and generous tannins. Give this wine until 2018 before drinking.
title: Château Pibran 2012 Château Tour Pibran  (Pauillac)

description: Vines with an average age of 30 years give this wine good intensity that balances the firm, dark tannins. It's a powerful, concentrated Merlot-based wine, big and generous. Ripe plums and berries show strongly through the tannic structure. Give this wine until 2017 before drinking.
title: Château des Arnauds 2012 Cuvée des Capucins  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: This Demeter-certified biodynamic wine is made in an immediately enjoyable, drink-now style. Brandied black cherries and sun-baked earth mark the nose, while the palate is full, creamy and plush. It's warm, ripe and welcoming from start to finish.
title: Domaine de Beaurenard 2012 Boisrenard Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This Demeter-certified biodynamic wine is made in an immediately enjoyable, drink-now style. Brandied black cherries and sun-baked earth mark the nose, while the palate is full, creamy and plush. It's warm, ripe and welcoming from start to finish.
title: Domaine de Beaurenard 2012 Boisrenard Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Certified organic by Ecocert, this estate straddles the communes of Sablet, Plan de Dieu and Gigondas. This entry-level blend of 75% Grenache and 25% Syrah is beautifully floral and herbal, yet backed by appealing red and purple fruit. Medium to full in body, it's firm but ripe, framed by dusty tannins. Drink now–2020.
title: Domaine des Pasquiers 2013 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Certified organic by Ecocert, this estate straddles the communes of Sablet, Plan de Dieu and Gigondas. This entry-level blend of 75% Grenache and 25% Syrah is beautifully floral and herbal, yet backed by appealing red and purple fruit. Medium to full in body, it's firm but ripe, framed by dusty tannins. Drink now–2020.
title: Domaine des Pasquiers 2013 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A blend of Cabernet Franc, Gamay and Côt (aka Malbec), this smooth, dense and barrel-aged wine has impressive richness. Spice along with acidity and red berry fruits give a fresh aspect. The light tannins are dry and offer a balanced structure. It's ready to drink.
title: Vincent Roussely 2011 Clos Roussely Anthologie du Clos Red (Touraine)

description: Creamy, almost powdery pear flavors dominate, but the palate is illuminated by bright, sprightly lemon acidity. There is an innate balance that can be summed up as creamy lemon on a dry, yeasty background. This is moreish, appetizing and has a lasting, fruity finish.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: With a high proportion of Pinot Noir in the blend, this ripe wine has a sense of structure as well as fruitiness. Rich pear and apricot flavors are balanced by the fresh, crisp aftertaste. The wine is rounded and ready to drink.
title: Louis de Sacy NV Brut Originel  (Champagne)

description: With a high proportion of Pinot Noir in the blend, this ripe wine has a sense of structure as well as fruitiness. Rich pear and apricot flavors are balanced by the fresh, crisp aftertaste. The wine is rounded and ready to drink.
title: Louis de Sacy NV Brut Originel  (Champagne)

description: Raspberry aromas lift from the glass with this attractive and fruity wine. It is on the dry side, giving a crisp edge that is immediately refreshing. The aftertaste is creamy and soft, bright and perfumed.
title: Boizel NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: All juicy fruit, this is a bright, dry wine with delicious acidity that gives freshness. It also has a mineral edge, giving the red berry fruits a firm texture. The wine is ready to drink, although it will be better from 2016.
title: Fabien Collonge 2014 L'Aurore des Côtes  (Chiroubles)

description: Granit is the sandy granite hillside soil of northern Beaujolais. The vineyard is a neighbor to the Fleurie appellation. This textured wine is rich with cherry and red-currant flavors that are rounded out and have just hint of tannins. The wine could soften even more so wait until early 2016.
title: Domaine de Colonat 2014 Perle de Granit  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This estate wine from Château Moulin-à-Vent comes from a selection of different vineyards. It has a very direct, structured character, firm with tannins and ripe with delicious berry fruits. It is developing well, still structured and needing some time. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Moulin-à-Vent 2012  Moulin-à-Vent

description: This estate wine from Château Moulin-à-Vent comes from a selection of different vineyards. It has a very direct, structured character, firm with tannins and ripe with delicious berry fruits. It is developing well, still structured and needing some time. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Moulin-à-Vent 2012  Moulin-à-Vent

description: The autumnal bounty of aromatic red and and yellow apple is out in full force. The frothy, dry and slender palate is a beautiful foil for this richness and highlights the fruit with pure, lemony freshness. Yeasty autolysis adds welcome body and more counterbalance. Very refreshing and poised.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé NV Giersberger Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: With over 50% Pinot Noir in the blend, this rich, dry wine is ripe at the same time. Apples and bitter oranges fill out the fruitiness, giving a crisp, taut while ripe aftertaste. This is the standard nonvintage Champagne from Boizel.
title: Boizel NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: This is a structured wine, solid with tannins as well as ripe red berry and dark cherry fruits. The combination gives a wine that has concentration from old vines on sandy soil as well as the potential to age. Drink from 2016. The handsome château was an important fortified structure when the Lords of Beaujeu were defending themselves in the 12th century.
title: Loron et Fils 2014 Cheateau de la Pierre  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Light in color, this crisp and fruity wine has a balance between its red fruit flavors and the tight, bright acidity. It is softer and fruitier than some of the Gosset wines, making it immediately accessible and a fine apéritif style.
title: Gosset NV Grand Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Based in the village of Cramant, Voirin-Jumel has access to Grand Cru Chardonnay vineyards. This crisp and tight wine is packed with acidity, fresh citrus and a taut, steely texture. It is still young and fruity, and could do with some bottle age.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Voirin-Jumel NV Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Based in the village of Cramant, Voirin-Jumel has access to Grand Cru Chardonnay vineyards. This crisp and tight wine is packed with acidity, fresh citrus and a taut, steely texture. It is still young and fruity, and could do with some bottle age.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Voirin-Jumel NV Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Opulent and ripe, full bodied and rich, this has notes of toast and spice as well as apricot and pear flavors. With its balanced character, it can be consumed now, but it will also age for another year.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Domaine Beranger  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Opulent and ripe, full bodied and rich, this has notes of toast and spice as well as apricot and pear flavors. With its balanced character, it can be consumed now, but it will also age for another year.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Domaine Beranger  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Ripe and full bodied, this is a wine that reflects the softness of the vintage. Aged in wood, it has a rounded texture, with spice, apricot and pineapple flavors, finishing with a touch of acidity.
title: Michel Picard 2009 Le Charmois Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Ripe and full bodied, this is a wine that reflects the softness of the vintage. Aged in wood, it has a rounded texture, with spice, apricot and pineapple flavors, finishing with a touch of acidity.
title: Michel Picard 2009 Le Charmois Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Juicy and fruity, this has apple and lemon flavors that combine with a steely edge. It's refreshing and crisp, with a bright, lively character, and a tang on the finish.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: Juicy and fruity, this has apple and lemon flavors that combine with a steely edge. It's refreshing and crisp, with a bright, lively character, and a tang on the finish.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: Lively, fresh and crisp, brightened with citrus flavors. White currant fruits burst out of the wine, leaving an aftertaste of crisp steeliness.
title: Louis Latour 2006 En Paradis  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: Full-on style of wine, packed with apricot and peach flavors, spiced up with cinnamon, layered with toast and finishing with delicious, open acidity. A wine that shows why St-Aubin is a village that is worth paying attention to.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2006 La Chatenière Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Full-on style of wine, packed with apricot and peach flavors, spiced up with cinnamon, layered with toast and finishing with delicious, open acidity. A wine that shows why St-Aubin is a village that is worth paying attention to.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2006 La Chatenière Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Tannic and hard around the edges, it has a woody character. The black currant fruit is there but spoiled by the rest of the flavors.
title: Château Darzac 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The light color of this wine continues to the light palate, which just hints at strawberry fruits. Soft, finishing with fresh acidity, this lightweight wine should be drunk now.
title: Domaine Chêne 2011  Bourgogne

description: A juicy wine, it has soft tannins and gently stalky fruit textures. Black currant fruits accompany fresh, tangy acidity. Not for aging, so drink now.
title: Château Belle-Garde 2012  Bordeaux

description: A fruity wine, it has fresh citrus and pear flavors. It is very light with just hints of texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine L. Chatelain 2012  Petit Chablis

description: Typically young and fruity, this wine is packed with fresh cherry fruits and plenty of acidity. It's almost crisp and should be drunk now.
title: Château de Pizay 2013  Beaujolais

description: This single-vineyard wine is structured and dense. Powerful tannins come both from fruit and from wood aging. Underneath the black cherry fruit and fresh acidity are developing. Drink this complex wine from 2016.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 La Roche  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This powerful, single-vineyard wine is both fruity and structured. Dense tannins and dark cherry fruits are beautifully balanced with the wood aging. Wait to drink this wine until 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Clos du Grand Carquelin  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This powerful, single-vineyard wine is both fruity and structured. Dense tannins and dark cherry fruits are beautifully balanced with the wood aging. Wait to drink this wine until 2017.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Clos du Grand Carquelin  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This is the second wine from the Château Grenouilles vineyard, very fresh, but at the same time weighty and concentrated, with wood, caramel and generous fruits. Age for 5 years.
designation: Les Fiefs de Grenouilles Grand Cru
title: La Chablisienne 2005 Les Fiefs de Grenouilles Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Generous in style, with great freshness. The flavors are rich, touched by caramel, ripe white currants and some spice. A fine, red apple skin structure comes through to finish.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2005 Montmains Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Generous in style, with great freshness. The flavors are rich, touched by caramel, ripe white currants and some spice. A fine, red apple skin structure comes through to finish.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2005 Montmains Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Steeliness exemplified in wine. This is crisp and structured, complex with its green fruits, structured acidity and touch of caramel and kiwi. It's the acidity that shows at the moment; needs 4–5 years.
title: La Chablisienne 2005 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Very concentrated and closed up, like a coil. The intense green fruit is followed by plum skins. Crispness, dry but fresh, comes alongside a powerful explosion of flavors.
title: Albert Bichot 2005 Domaine Long-Depaquit Vaudésirs Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Very concentrated and closed up, like a coil. The intense green fruit is followed by plum skins. Crispness, dry but fresh, comes alongside a powerful explosion of flavors.
title: Albert Bichot 2005 Domaine Long-Depaquit Vaudésirs Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: A blend that is dominated by Chenin Blanc has produced a beautiful lightly honeyed wine. Its apple fruitiness and brilliant acidity give it great crispness along with an added touch of spice. Drink this delicious wine now.
title: Domaine Amirault 2016 Amirault Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Exquisite lightness and weightless charm are the two obvious hallmarks of this wine. The merest touch of citrus appears on the nose. The palate has the same restraint and lemony fruit, pitched against a light froth of tiny bubbles. It's lithe and bright, with a dry, brisk finish.
title: Arthur Metz NV 1904 Cuvée Spéciale Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Exquisite lightness and weightless charm are the two obvious hallmarks of this wine. The merest touch of citrus appears on the nose. The palate has the same restraint and lemony fruit, pitched against a light froth of tiny bubbles. It's lithe and bright, with a dry, brisk finish.
title: Arthur Metz NV 1904 Cuvée Spéciale Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: From Verzenay on the Montagne de Reims this wine is rich, structured and concentrated. It has a rich texture plus spice as well as zesty orange and red-currant fruits. The wine retains some of the tannins of the red grapes although goes much more for a mineral texture. Drink now.
designation: Blanc de Noirs Grand Cru Brut
title: Henriet-Bazin NV Blanc de Noirs Grand Cru Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: A touch of vanilla can be discerned in the sweet peachy juiciness of this wine which is already apparent on the nose. The palate is fluid, almost plump and rich with these flavors, especially peach and rose, come to the fore. A pleasantly bitter phenolic edge saves this from becoming too rich. Alcoholic warmth is apparent on the rich sweet finish.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2015 Brand Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A touch of vanilla can be discerned in the sweet peachy juiciness of this wine which is already apparent on the nose. The palate is fluid, almost plump and rich with these flavors, especially peach and rose, come to the fore. A pleasantly bitter phenolic edge saves this from becoming too rich. Alcoholic warmth is apparent on the rich sweet finish.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2015 Brand Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Yellow-apple notes are clearly expressed on the nose. They also appear with lovely purity on the balanced dry palate which has a rich backdrop of autolysis with hints of rye bread. The mousse is fine and creamy, the finish is dry and lasting.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2014 Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Yellow-apple notes are clearly expressed on the nose. They also appear with lovely purity on the balanced dry palate which has a rich backdrop of autolysis with hints of rye bread. The mousse is fine and creamy, the finish is dry and lasting.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2014 Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A style that brings in raspberry acidity to crispen the soft fruit. A texture of red apple skins gives an edge to the wine, balanced by some final soft sweetness.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A soft style, indicating a higher dosage, that produces simple fruits but also a level of bitterness. The wine is a disappointment from such a famous name.
title: Taittinger NV Prestige Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A soft style, indicating a higher dosage, that produces simple fruits but also a level of bitterness. The wine is a disappointment from such a famous name.
title: Taittinger NV Prestige Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A wine with some weight, showing simple fruit and acidity, the texture open and with a high dosage. It is easy, soft and balanced.
title: J. de Telmont NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Light, stalky wine with attractive classic black currant flavors and acidity. Light in character.
title: Château Simard 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: Light, stalky wine with attractive classic black currant flavors and acidity. Light in character.
title: Château Simard 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: The fruit here is attractive, pears and white currants on top of pink grapefruit and orange zest. It shows its structure and its tense minerality only slowly, allowing the acidity to give it a lift and vibrancy. This is a wine that is still young, still smoothing out its hard edges.
designation: Domaine Long-Depaquit Les Vaucopins Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine Long-Depaquit Les Vaucopins Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The fruit here is attractive, pears and white currants on top of pink grapefruit and orange zest. It shows its structure and its tense minerality only slowly, allowing the acidity to give it a lift and vibrancy. This is a wine that is still young, still smoothing out its hard edges.
designation: Domaine Long-Depaquit Les Vaucopins Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine Long-Depaquit Les Vaucopins Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Ripe and full, this is an apricot-and melon-flavored wine. With this ripeness comes a soft texture that offers some warm acidity and a perfumed aftertaste. From 50+-year-old vines, the wine is attractive now and ready to drink.
title: Jean-Paul Paquet 2014 Domaine des Granges  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Light and fruity, this is an easy, immediately accessible wine. Soft apple and creamed-pear flavors are balanced with acidity and a ripe aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2015  Mâcon-Villages

description: This citrus-laden wine shows its fresh fruits right up front. It is bright, crisp and full of lime and lemon flavors. Spiciness adds extra interest. Drink now.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2014 Terroirs  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This citrus-laden wine shows its fresh fruits right up front. It is bright, crisp and full of lime and lemon flavors. Spiciness adds extra interest. Drink now.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2014 Terroirs  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wine is light and fruity with citrus and red apples. It misses out on crispness, giving a more rounded character. It should be kept for a few months and drunk from 2017.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2015  Mâcon-Charnay

description: From a Chablis producer, this rosé is cool, crisp and fresh. It has plenty of red fruits and a tight mineral texture. A smooth caramel flavor balanced by juicy acidity keeps the wine deliciously refreshing.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2015  Bourgogne

description: From a Chablis producer, this rosé is cool, crisp and fresh. It has plenty of red fruits and a tight mineral texture. A smooth caramel flavor balanced by juicy acidity keeps the wine deliciously refreshing.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2015  Bourgogne

description: This blend of 45% Cinsault, 45% Carignan and 10% Syrah offers vanilla-kissed aromas of blackberry, raspberry and plum, as well as a touch of menthol. The slightly creamy, full-flavored palate boasts ripe black-fruit flavors and a touch of milk chocolate, all of which linger through to the medium-length finish.
title: Cuvée Lion d'Or 2015 Red (Vin de France)

description: A simple, straightforward wine, this has an attractive mineral, tangy texture to go with the bright citrus fruit. Crisp and refreshing, it is ready to drink.
title: Château de Santenay 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne)

description: With Chardonnay from Provence the dominant partner in this blend with Burgundian Chardonnay, this wine is soft and unoaked, with melon and yellow fruit flavors. It has light acidity, enough to give the wine freshness. It is ready to drink.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2014 100 Series Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This is a rich, full-bodied Champagne showing hints of bottle age but mostly crisp, fresh apple and apricot flavors. It's a ripe, fruity wine, from the southern vineyards in the Aube, but with a apple-skin astringency and brisk texture. Drink now–2019.
title: Veuve Doussot 2009 Cuvée Ernestine Brut  (Champagne)

description: Serious amounts of new wood dominate this still young wine. It has weight and there is great juicy black currant fruit underneath the dry wood character. Once it opens up again, this is going to be a delicious, structured wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Grand Bertin de Saint Clair 2010  Médoc
winery: Château Grand Bertin de Saint Clair

description: This lean, firmly tannic wine is more about structure than fruit. There is a burnt, chocolate- and bitter-coffee flavor that gives edge to the palate, while firm tannins enrobe black-cherry fruit. Drink from 2016.
designation: Cuvée Signature Les Charmots Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Les Charmots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: This is a rich demi-sec without being too sweet. It has a good balance of ripe creamed-pear and baked-apple flavors along with a bright layer of acidity. It's an harmonious whole, and ready to drink now.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin NV White Label Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: An intensely fruity Champagne, made for the Tsars of Russia, this is crisp with apple and citrus flavors. It has some depth, with a tight, steely texture and grapefruit acidity. There is some softness on the finish.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Only just off dry, this is a crisp Champagne with a cookie-pastry flavor that balances fresh lemon and orange-zest flavors. While fine with food, this would be an excellent apéritif.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Délice Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Although there is a wood-aged character to the wine, the main feeling is of stalky red fruits, tight tannins and acids. It has a smoky character from the Cabernet Franc that adds complexity.
designation: Château de la Mulonnière Rouge Baiser
title: Guy Saget 2009 Château de la Mulonnière Rouge Baiser Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages)

description: Although there is a wood-aged character to the wine, the main feeling is of stalky red fruits, tight tannins and acids. It has a smoky character from the Cabernet Franc that adds complexity.
designation: Château de la Mulonnière Rouge Baiser
title: Guy Saget 2009 Château de la Mulonnière Rouge Baiser Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages)

description: Rich red fruits along with a stalky element give this wine weight and structure. It's on the dry side, with the fruit tannins and wood notes still dominant. Good acidity offers a bright aftertaste.
title: Château la Jorine 2010  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: Made by the top Muscadet producer Christophe Gadais, this is beautifully clean and crisp. It has fragrant fruit flavors of citrus and apple, with a light, dancing character.
title: Domaine de la Tourmaline 2010 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Big and densely tannic, this wine's fruit is still firmly buried in the structure. It has wood, spice and ripe plum notes. With its concentrated texture, it is still capable of aging.
title: Château Tourans 2006 Cuvée Terre Blanche  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Some wood aging gives this Merlot-dominated wine a full structure, with attractive tannins and juicy black fruits. It is ripe, full-bodied and very approachable now.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Some wood aging gives this Merlot-dominated wine a full structure, with attractive tannins and juicy black fruits. It is ripe, full-bodied and very approachable now.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Still very young, this ripe Merlot-dominated wine is packed with dark plum and rich damson fruit flavors. They balance the serious amount of wood influence that gives it its spice and ageability. Drink from 2023.
title: Château Tour Grand Faurie 2015  Saint-Émilion

description: New wood aromas set the scene for this ripe, fuity and toasty wine. It has plenty of black plum fruit, rich tannins and a dry core that will soften. The texture is polished and ripe. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Ricaud 2015 Quartet  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is ripe and juicy, with delicious damson and berry fruit. Being rich and full bodied, it's also densely textured, with smoky touches of wood from barrel aging. Drink from 2020.
title: Château L'Escadre 2015 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The sweetness of this wine is well contained by acidity, with spice, lemon and honey flavors. It has fine fruit, a crisp texture and a feeling of lightness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Doisy-Védrines 2014 Petit Védrines  (Barsac)

description: This ripe wine is full of the fruit that's typical of the vintage, with its bursts of red berry flavor and layers of wood. It has a crisp edge from plenty of acidity and a good concentration that gives it the weight it needs. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de l'Annonciation 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: This second wine of classed growth Château Dassault is still young. It has tannins and a dense texture that comes from its rich fruit and high alcohol. However, it's balanced and jammy, with ripe blackberry flavors and a sense of restrained power. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Dassault 2015 D de Dassault  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This second wine of classed growth Château Dassault is still young. It has tannins and a dense texture that comes from its rich fruit and high alcohol. However, it's balanced and jammy, with ripe blackberry flavors and a sense of restrained power. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Dassault 2015 D de Dassault  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Fruit and tannins play well together in this wine. The blackberry flavors are crisp and juicy while having some richness ready to develop as the wine matures. Behind that, firm, mineral tannins give a strong sense of structure. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos Poggiale 2014 Red (Corse)

description: The wine is from a tiny parcel (around an acre) of vines that are over 30-years-old. It is concentrated both with fine fruit and sweet acidity. Yellow fruits are cut with lime and green plums. A touch of vanilla gives the wine a full final aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Fabrice Larochette 2015 La Grande Bruyère  (Mâcon-Fuissé)

description: From a selection of old vines in four parcels, the wine has rich fruits, concentrated blackberry flavors and fully integrated tannins. It is ripe, juicy with fine acidity and a good potential. Drink this fine and fruity wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: From a selection of old vines in four parcels, the wine has rich fruits, concentrated blackberry flavors and fully integrated tannins. It is ripe, juicy with fine acidity and a good potential. Drink this fine and fruity wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Although labeled as Sec (dry), this wine has hallmarks of the sweeter wines from this estate. Through its crisp, dry texture come honey, almonds and a light hint of botrytis. It makes for a delicious wine that is likely to age well, although hard to resist now. Drink ideally from 2018.
title: Château Moncontour 2015 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. A solid effort, this is a wine with great fruit and firm structure to support it. Ripe and full in the mouth, it's a firm and complex wine with a delicious juicy aftertaste.
title: Château Cantenac Brown 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a chocolate-inflected wine with a full mouth feel, and a very dark character. The palate is concentrated in tannins and a powerful, extracted feel. The aftertaste brings out more black-currant fruitiness.
title: Château Rauzan-Ségla 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a chocolate-inflected wine with a full mouth feel, and a very dark character. The palate is concentrated in tannins and a powerful, extracted feel. The aftertaste brings out more black-currant fruitiness.
title: Château Rauzan-Ségla 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This firm, dry wine is solidly rich and full in the mouth. With fine acidity and black currant fruit that show through the tannins, it is a wine with considerable potential.
title: Château Giscours 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a beautifully crafted wine with red fruits, a touch of black currant, great acidity and dense structure. A blend of half-and-half Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, it shows both weight and a great lift.
title: Château Palmer 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. A surprisingly fresh Margaux considering that it's dominated by 87% Cabernet Sauvignon. Dense tannins, black fruits and tight acidity combine to present a wine that shows, for a Château Margaux, medium-term potential.
title: Château Margaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. A surprisingly fresh Margaux considering that it's dominated by 87% Cabernet Sauvignon. Dense tannins, black fruits and tight acidity combine to present a wine that shows, for a Château Margaux, medium-term potential.
title: Château Margaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: Aromas and flavors of rhubarb and red pepper dominate, resulting in a wine that is sharp and unbalanced.
title: Château Dubraud 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A diffuse wine without focus. The tannins and the fruit are some way apart, while the final flavor is dry and tough.
title: Château la Petite Roque 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Bell peppers and green herbs as well as dark tannins are the main characters of this very dry, bitter wine.
title: Château des Tourtes 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is the first vintage of this property under the ownership of Château Ausone. The wine has a solid structure and firm tannins that offer rich fruit. It is balanced, full of tannins and with fine acidity as well as bold red fruits. Drink from 2023.
title: Château la Clotte 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: This 240-acre property has produced a ripe, smooth and fruity wine. With layers of tannins under the juicy blackberry flavors, it is already balanced and likely to be approachable soon. There is a lively edge of acidity to keep everything crisp. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Blaignan 2014  Médoc

description: A coniferous lift weaves through tart red-cherry notes. The slender, translucent and crunchy palate is pervaded by the same aromas and a lot of freshness. This is a light-bodied aromatic red wine that is ideal for lunch, for picnics or for serving chilled.
title: Joseph Cattin 2015 Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This wine shows hints of tar or rubber when first poured, so decant it for best effect. Once past those, berry and citrus aromas and flavors emerge, lingering on the long, mocha-tinged finish.
title: Les Vignerons de Tavel 2016 Les Lauzeraies  (Tavel)

description: Jammy fruits—wild strawberry and boysenberry—are complemented by scents of violet and sweet spice. The medium-weight palate is plush and velvety in texture, with dense fruit flavors that are countered by a lingering grip on the finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Terre de Loups 2014 Les Terrasses Royales Carignan-Syrah

description: Plush and velvety in texture, this is a reasonably mouthcoating and rich wine made from organic grapes. Blackberries, plums and dark chocolate mingle easily on the palate, lingering on the finish. Drink now–2020.
designation: Domaine le Garrigon Cuvée des Vieux Truffiers
title: Louis Bernard 2015 Domaine le Garrigon Cuvée des Vieux Truffiers Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Plush and velvety in texture, this is a reasonably mouthcoating and rich wine made from organic grapes. Blackberries, plums and dark chocolate mingle easily on the palate, lingering on the finish. Drink now–2020.
designation: Domaine le Garrigon Cuvée des Vieux Truffiers
title: Louis Bernard 2015 Domaine le Garrigon Cuvée des Vieux Truffiers Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Made from 80% Syrah and 20% Grenache, this starts off a touch closed and quiet, but with time reveals notes of black plum, blackberry, licorice, chicory, black pepper and leather. It is strongly textured, with firm tannins and black fruit-skin flavors that linger through the finish. Drink 2018–2021.
title: Laurent Miquel 2013 L'Artisan Syrah-Grenache (Saint-Chinian)

description: This wine, from selected vineyards owned by the Carrille family, is rich and now mature. Its tannins are merging with the secondary flavors of the fruit as it softens and develops a spice and tobacco character. Drink this wine now.
title: Poupille 2011  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this blend of 30% Syrah, 30% Mourvèdre, 30% Grenache and 10% Carignan boasts a pleasant balance of ripe black-fruit tones and earthy, herbal hints of garrigue. Hints of violet and lightly toasted oak add depth and interest throughout, with a lush, fruity finish of blackberry and boysenberry.
title: Château Bousquette 2013 Tradition Red (Saint-Chinian)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this blend of 30% Syrah, 30% Mourvèdre, 30% Grenache and 10% Carignan boasts a pleasant balance of ripe black-fruit tones and earthy, herbal hints of garrigue. Hints of violet and lightly toasted oak add depth and interest throughout, with a lush, fruity finish of blackberry and boysenberry.
title: Château Bousquette 2013 Tradition Red (Saint-Chinian)

description: Coming from flint soil, this is a structured, mineral wine. Tight texture, tangy acidity and an almost chewy character show that this young wine is still developing. It will reveal citrus and apple flavors in a year, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Reverdy-Ducroux 2014 Les Vignes Silex  (Sancerre)

description: This wine comes from one parcel that has particularly flinty soil. With a strongly mineral character, it is tight and nervy, needing some time to calm down. The fruit is all there, fresh citrus, apples and green plums, all ready to burst out over the next few months. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Paul Thomas 2014 Silex  (Sancerre)

description: Ripe tropical-fruit flavors give this wine a rich, rounded character. The attractive apricot and peach fruits are cut by citrus acidity to keep the freshness right up front. An opulent, full-bodied wine, it's ready to drink now.
title: Domaine le Virolys 2014  Viré-Clessé

description: The 15% Viognier in the blend exerts outsize influence on the bouquet of this wine, which exudes notes of honey, apricot and spice. On the palate, this is a big mouthful of ripe tropical fruit, framed on the mouthwatering finish by hints of toasted oak.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2013 Guy Louis White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Made in a similar fashion to Sherry with a solera that is topped up, this was aged outside for a year to concentrate the wine and its flavors. A sweet wine, it has a richly nutty, peppery character to balance the ripe plum fruits. Softly textured, just hinting at the alcohol used for fortification, this is a rare, fascinating and very drinkable wine.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2010 Estela Solera Malbec-Merlot (Vin de Liqueur)

description: From a small, 15-acre property, this wine is ripe, rich and full of yellow fruits along with crisp apples, with a tight texture that needs to develop. It is crisply structured, zesty and mineral in character. Give this juicy, delicious wine until 2017 before drinking.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Domaine des Emois  (Sancerre)

description: Just beginning its secondary phase, the wine has weight, dark tannins and complex dried fruit, licorice and spice. A stylish, elegant wine with some of the freshness of the vintage still in place.
title: Château le Raz 2008  Montravel

description: Dense and concentrated and still very young, the wine has ripe blackberry flavors, a sense of ripeness and a dry wood-and-tannin core. Give the wine at least 4–5 years.
title: Château Tanesse 2011  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Sweet fruit dominates this attractive, spicy wine. It has ample acidity, giving a fine, fresh black-currant character and tannins that are already melding into the wine. For medium-term aging of 3–5 years.
title: Château Lamothe-Cissac 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Sweet fruit dominates this attractive, spicy wine. It has ample acidity, giving a fine, fresh black-currant character and tannins that are already melding into the wine. For medium-term aging of 3–5 years.
title: Château Lamothe-Cissac 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: This rather closed wine has layers of sulfur that have suppressed the fruit. It's cool, neutral and dull.
title: Joseph Burrier 2012 Château de Beauregard  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: The wine seems soapy and out of focus. It's soft while missing fruit. The acidity and freshness at the end are the best parts.
title: Pierre Cornu Camus 2011  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: The Mourvèdre in this blend gives this wine a distinctive perfumed, structured character. Soft and rich yellow and tropical-fruit flavors are spiced with the edge of tannins and youthful red-fruit flavors. It is intensely ripe and also crisp with acidity. Drink from late 2016.
title: Domaines Ott 2015 Château Romassan Rosé (Bandol)

description: Made from low-yielding, 70-year-old vines, this is a dense wine with an almost-dark structure and ripe red-plum flavors. Powerful, it obviously will be better with food and could even benefit from decanting before drinking. Age this concentrated wine until late 2016.
title: Domaine du Clos Gautier 2015 Clos du Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the top rosé from the estate, one of the Côtes de Provence crus classés. The wine is smooth and ripe, although it never loses a fresher edge crisp with lemon-zest flavors. The wine has intensity, concentration and a warm aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Croix 2015 Organdi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the top rosé from the estate, one of the Côtes de Provence crus classés. The wine is smooth and ripe, although it never loses a fresher edge crisp with lemon-zest flavors. The wine has intensity, concentration and a warm aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Croix 2015 Organdi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Structured, tight and mineral, this wine comes from a selection of old vines in a northwest-facing vineyard on the Rimauresq estate. It offers a tang, along with a firm structure and concentration. A fruitier aftertaste will show through more strongly by late 2016.
title: Château Rimauresq 2015 R de Rimauresq Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Structured, tight and mineral, this wine comes from a selection of old vines in a northwest-facing vineyard on the Rimauresq estate. It offers a tang, along with a firm structure and concentration. A fruitier aftertaste will show through more strongly by late 2016.
title: Château Rimauresq 2015 R de Rimauresq Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With its striking (and heavy) square white bottle, this wine will certainly make a statement on any table. The wine itself, with Hubert de Bouärd (whose family owns Château Angélus) as consultant, is impressively ripe and concentrated, but still retains its crisp, fresh poise. The acidity at the end is intense and tight.
title: Château de Berne 2015 Pur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This young, fruity Champagne has delicious red-berry flavors balanced by lemon-zest acidity. It conveys a cool texture with its blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs. The aftertaste is mineral-tight.
title: Gauthier-Christophe NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Fresh but ripe citrus and both green and yellow apple make for a refreshing nose. The palate has an equally bracing, juicy and utterly refreshing aspect. The finish is dry and lip-smacking, rounded with fine fizz, and echoing with mellow apple notes.
title: Dopff Au Moulin NV Cuvée Julien Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fresh but ripe citrus and both green and yellow apple make for a refreshing nose. The palate has an equally bracing, juicy and utterly refreshing aspect. The finish is dry and lip-smacking, rounded with fine fizz, and echoing with mellow apple notes.
title: Dopff Au Moulin NV Cuvée Julien Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Notes of creamy apple on the nose also pervade the palate where they are joined by a more bitter element that lends both structure and pleasant backbone. In spirit, this is sprightly and pure and brings lots and lots of honest, frothy refreshment.
title: Domaine Pfister 2012 Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Notes of creamy apple on the nose also pervade the palate where they are joined by a more bitter element that lends both structure and pleasant backbone. In spirit, this is sprightly and pure and brings lots and lots of honest, frothy refreshment.
title: Domaine Pfister 2012 Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A faint nose of tart red currant turns into a subtly flavored palate rich with cranberry notes and gentle herbal notes of hay flowers. This subtlety is also expressed in the fine mousse and the long dry but very full-fruited finish.
title: Domaine François Schmitt NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This 16th century chateau with towers is in the northern Médoc. The wine is spicy with the wood aging still showing. At the same time, the ripe black-currant fruit is developing well and as it ages further, the wine will become finely balanced. With 60% Cabernet in the blend, this is a wine for the long term. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2014  Médoc

description: This 16th century chateau with towers is in the northern Médoc. The wine is spicy with the wood aging still showing. At the same time, the ripe black-currant fruit is developing well and as it ages further, the wine will become finely balanced. With 60% Cabernet in the blend, this is a wine for the long term. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2014  Médoc

description: This is a spicy ripe wine. Its berry flavors are shot through with acidity and generous tannins. It is still dry and still young although its future is assured. This estate is Bordeaux producer and négociant Nicolas Thienpont's family home. Drink this fine wine from 2019.
title: Château Puygueraud 2014  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a spicy ripe wine. Its berry flavors are shot through with acidity and generous tannins. It is still dry and still young although its future is assured. This estate is Bordeaux producer and négociant Nicolas Thienpont's family home. Drink this fine wine from 2019.
title: Château Puygueraud 2014  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Full bodied, softly tannic and immediately appealing, this offering from Alain Jaume's négociant business is attractively priced. It's not the biggest or most complex Châteauneuf-du-Pape, but the ripe black-cherry and chocolate flavors and finely dusty texture are undeniably satisfying. Drink now–2018.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2009 Vieux Terron Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Earthy in character, this is powerful and rich, yet somewhat rustic. It has concentrated ripe fruit, dark and dense, best at the end with its juiciness.
title: Goulée 2010  Médoc

description: With polished, new-wood aromas and flavors, this is a smooth wine. Hints of mint go with the black plum notes and the firmer, bitter chocolate flavors. In a modern style, this is likely to age quickly.
title: Château Reynon 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Dense and tannic, a firmly wood- and stalky-fruit based wine. Black currant fruits and dry tannins are the prominent characteristics. On the finish, the fruit shows a juicier feel.
title: Château Lamothe 2010 Première Cuvée  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Dense and tannic, a firmly wood- and stalky-fruit based wine. Black currant fruits and dry tannins are the prominent characteristics. On the finish, the fruit shows a juicier feel.
title: Château Lamothe 2010 Première Cuvée  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A rich but structured wine, this shows dark fruits and a strong tannic core. There is fine acidity and a taut, mineral texture.
title: Château Franc-Cardinal 2010  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Firm and structured, this is a textured wine, its tannins currently showing strongly. The blueberry fruit flavors offer a juicy, friendly contrast, resulting in a balanced wine that will benefit from a year or two of aging.
title: Château Arnaud Jouan 2010 Cuvée Prestige  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A juicy, fruity wine with attractive, bright red-berry fruit flavors. The wine is fresh, touched nicely by some wood and tannins.
title: Pezat 2010  Bordeaux

description: Biodynamically run, Château Tour des Gendres is at the top of the tree in Bergerac. This beautifully fruity wine shows freshness as well as depth of tannins, complex berry and bitter chocolate flavors. It is firm, but as a sign of the vintage, has a light character with final freshness.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2007 La Gloire de Mon Père Red (Bergerac)

description: Biodynamically run, Château Tour des Gendres is at the top of the tree in Bergerac. This beautifully fruity wine shows freshness as well as depth of tannins, complex berry and bitter chocolate flavors. It is firm, but as a sign of the vintage, has a light character with final freshness.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2007 La Gloire de Mon Père Red (Bergerac)

description: While there is some botrytis here, this wine is not heavily into that style. Rather it shows freshness, with its white currant and grapefruit acidity and delicate perfume. There is a fine core of sweet apple skin tannins to finish.
title: Château Jolys 2008  Jurançon

description: Unctuous texture is the telltale sign of quality  in a rich, sweet, botrytized wine. This wine has traded the spice of a Gewurztraminer with a palate full of honey and delicate lemon acidity. It is a fine, complex wine that is developing well. Drink until 2020.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg 2009 Sélection de Grains Nobles Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: While this wine does have sweetness, its great character comes from its structure and spiciness. It is rich, full in the mouth, ripe and concentrated. Even at four years old, it is youthful and closed still, and needs some time in the cellar. Drink from 2015.
title: Bott Frères 2009 Gloeckelberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Old vines and a Grand Cru vineyard have produced an impressive wine. It is bone dry and very crisp, but also has swathes of dense fruit and texture. It's very mineral and steely in style with youthful acidity and pink grapefruit flavors, but this is a wine to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2011 Kaefferkopf Grand Cru Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Old vines and a Grand Cru vineyard have produced an impressive wine. It is bone dry and very crisp, but also has swathes of dense fruit and texture. It's very mineral and steely in style with youthful acidity and pink grapefruit flavors, but this is a wine to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2011 Kaefferkopf Grand Cru Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: This spicy wine is fruity while also complex with its combination of red berries and a pepper edge. It is full and ripe with a light crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Jérôme Gueneau 2016 Le Clos Chartier Rosé (Sancerre)

description: The wine is velvet soft with smooth red berries and gentle tannins. It has a line in acidity along with spice and a rounded texture. Drink this lightly wood-aged wine now.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2014 Les Baronnes  (Sancerre)

description: Made from Caladoc, a grape variety created in 1958 by crossing Grenache and Malbec, this medium-bodied rosé is restrained in style, with ginger and citrus notes accenting strawberry fruit. It's dry and refreshing on the finish. Drink now.
title: Franck & Olivier Mousset 2016 Tendance Caladoc Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: The wine is dry and firm with a serious amount of new wood and spice. That seems to have swamped the fruit at this stage. There is enough fruit weight there to develop as the wine matures. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Monbrison 2014  Margaux

description: This is the second wine of Listrac's Chateau Fonréaud. A blend of half-and-half Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, it is rich and juicy. Blackberry fruits are shot through with acidity and balanced with generous tannins that are softening well. With its juicy acidity and fruity aftertaste, it will be ready to drink from late 2017.
title: Château Fonréaud 2014 La Légende  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This is a ripe wine that also has a light touch. That gives black-currant fruit and tannins along with a poised structure and attractive crisp acidity. The Cabernet Sauvignon fruit dominates while also giving the wine a dry core. Drink this stylish wine from 2019.
title: Château Escot 2012  Médoc

description: The northernmost Beaujolais cru of Saint-Amour is also the smallest, giving wines that are structured like this. It is a firm wine, made from 55-year-old vines (his youngest vines, says the producer) and with density as well as smooth red-fruit flavors. The wine will be ready to drink from late 2017.
title: Patrick Tranchand 2015 Coeur de Gamay  (Saint-Amour)

description: Cherry and wild strawberry flavors dominate this fruity wine. It is very fresh with intense acidity and a crisp aftertaste. A few months more in bottle would help it soften.
title: Hubert Meyer NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a wine with that's crisp and delicately fruity with flavors of red apples and pear skins. It's a fresh, bright wine with a soft aftertaste for enjoying now. Screwcap.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2012 Réserve Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Dopff au Moulin is something of a specialist for sparkling Crémant d'Alsace. This wine has some bottle age that gives the palate a touch of toast and nuts over fragrant fruit. There is a crisp, refreshing character to this wine, making it best as an apéritif.
title: Dopff Au Moulin NV Cuvée Julien Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a gamy wine that shows ripe fruit with a barnyard accent. It's quite full and forward with red berry flavors, bright acidity and a sense of structure.
title: Domaine le Galantin 2010 Red (Bandol)

description: The wine is very fresh and fruity with lively red-berry flavors balanced delicately with light tannins and acidity. It's refreshing with a red currant aftertaste.
title: Domaine de Sulauze 2012 Liane Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Very mature and soft in structure, this is a wine that needs to be drunk now. It has some richness, a dry edge and some attractive acidity, but it is not a wine that will improve.
title: Domaine de la Grande Séouve 2006 Saint-Aix Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Very mature and soft in structure, this is a wine that needs to be drunk now. It has some richness, a dry edge and some attractive acidity, but it is not a wine that will improve.
title: Domaine de la Grande Séouve 2006 Saint-Aix Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a blend of Pinot Gris and Riesling that melds the spice of the former with the steeliness of the latter. The result is a wine with lively acidity, touches of pepper and a crisp, light-hearted aftertaste. Screwcap.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2012 Black Tie White (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: This crisp, lively blend of Niellucciu (Sangiovese) and Grenache is deliciously refreshing. Its acidity and orange fruitiness are lifted by its tight texture and bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Domaine Casa Rossa Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: This crisp, lively blend of Niellucciu (Sangiovese) and Grenache is deliciously refreshing. Its acidity and orange fruitiness are lifted by its tight texture and bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Domaine Casa Rossa Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: This is Malbec in a South American style: soft, with ripe and gentle berry fruit. It has a light structure and plenty of acidity on the finish.
title: Les Domaines Auriol 2016 Le Réveil Malbec (Vin de France)

description: The Saumur-based merchant has produced this ripe soft wine from a single vineyard. It is an easy simple wine with attractive acidity and some tangy citrus fruits. Drink now.
title: Langlois-Chateau 2015 Château de Fontaine-Audon  (Sancerre)

description: The Saumur-based merchant has produced this ripe soft wine from a single vineyard. It is an easy simple wine with attractive acidity and some tangy citrus fruits. Drink now.
title: Langlois-Chateau 2015 Château de Fontaine-Audon  (Sancerre)

description: This is a refreshing crisp wine. Made from Pinot Gris, it has a light color, red-currant fruits and lively acidity. With a delicate perfume, it is a bright wine to drink now.
title: Jean-Michel Sorbe 2016 Rosé (Reuilly)

description: This is an easy, fruity wine made from Grenache. It has a clean, bright character, reflecting its red currant fruitiness and crispness.
title: Vinadeis 2016 Le Val Grenache Rosé (Vin de France)

description: The wine is soft with a flinty edge that gives it structure. There is a juicy character to this clean crisp wine that reveals itself in the apple, lime and grapefruit flavors. The wine is young, although very ready to drink.
title: François Millet 2016 Domaine des Côtes Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: The wine is soft with a flinty edge that gives it structure. There is a juicy character to this clean crisp wine that reveals itself in the apple, lime and grapefruit flavors. The wine is young, although very ready to drink.
title: François Millet 2016 Domaine des Côtes Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: This blackberry-flavored young wine is structured with tannins. The acidity and the ripe fruitiness are developing well, so drink from 2019 when it will have softened and filled out.
title: Domaine des Béguineries 2015 Réserve de Satis  (Chinon)

description: A soft, fat, caramel-flavored wine, showing strawberry fruits and a creamy texture. It lacks acidity, leaving a wine that needs to be drunk soon.
title: Dopff & Irion 2009 Rosé (Alsace)

description: A soft, fat, caramel-flavored wine, showing strawberry fruits and a creamy texture. It lacks acidity, leaving a wine that needs to be drunk soon.
title: Dopff & Irion 2009 Rosé (Alsace)

description: A soft, off-dry wine, full of lightweight currant fruits. It is gentle, in a fruity, apéritif style.
title: Dopff & Irion 2009 Gentil White (Alsace)

description: This lightly structured wine is all fruit. Its red berry flavors are already well integrated with the smoky tannins that form its core. It will, however, age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Côte Montpezat 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This lightly structured wine is all fruit. Its red berry flavors are already well integrated with the smoky tannins that form its core. It will, however, age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Côte Montpezat 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: There have been 19 (dix-neuf) generations of Mellots making wine in Sancerre; at least one of them in each generation has been named Alphonse. This wine celebrates the history and the great quality of the family's wines today. It is richly endowed with both the beautifully ripe fruit and with a sophisticated acidity and texture. Drink this very fine wine now, although, like the Mellots, it will also age.
title: Alphonse Mellot 2014 Génération Dix-Neuf  (Sancerre)

description: Matured in large wooden vats, this is a wine that is so ripe and rich. With great fruit allied to an opulent texture, it is both spicy and full of tropical fruit flavors. At the moment, it is just bursting with fruit and will need time to calm down, so wait to drink until 2019.
title: Domaine Vacheron 2015 Chambrates  (Sancerre)

description: Matured in large wooden vats, this is a wine that is so ripe and rich. With great fruit allied to an opulent texture, it is both spicy and full of tropical fruit flavors. At the moment, it is just bursting with fruit and will need time to calm down, so wait to drink until 2019.
title: Domaine Vacheron 2015 Chambrates  (Sancerre)

description: This is a tropical-fruit-flavored wine with only a hint of more herbal flavors. It is ripe and juicy with sweeping fruitiness as well as acidity. The texture, mineral in character, comes from the chalk of the vineyard—one of the top sites in Sancerre. Drink this beautiful wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Roger & Christophe Moreux 2015 Les Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: Soft and fruity, it's bone dry, very crisp and totally fresh. Red currants dominate this wine that has intense acidity and light zesty aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2013 Cuvée Spéciale Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh, aromatic and fruity, it has ripe citrus and pear flavors layered with a more mineral, salty texture. It's tangy, full bodied and cut with tight acidity at the end.
title: Château la Gordonne 2013 Verité du Terroir Rolle (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fresh, aromatic and fruity, it has ripe citrus and pear flavors layered with a more mineral, salty texture. It's tangy, full bodied and cut with tight acidity at the end.
title: Château la Gordonne 2013 Verité du Terroir Rolle (Côtes de Provence)

description: In Provence, heavy bottle seems to equal high alcohol. It's true here, with a wine that, while it has the right pale grey pink color, is almost too rich for its own good. It does have fruit and acidity but they are just a part of a powerful and ripe wine. Age it until the end of 2014 for best results.
title: Château Hermitage Saint-Martin 2013 Ikon Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In Provence, heavy bottle seems to equal high alcohol. It's true here, with a wine that, while it has the right pale grey pink color, is almost too rich for its own good. It does have fruit and acidity but they are just a part of a powerful and ripe wine. Age it until the end of 2014 for best results.
title: Château Hermitage Saint-Martin 2013 Ikon Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Old vines give extra concentration to this rich wine. With fruitiness, a tight texture and the need to age, it has structure and density. Drink from 2015.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2012 Vieilles Vignes Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Old vines give extra concentration to this rich wine. With fruitiness, a tight texture and the need to age, it has structure and density. Drink from 2015.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2012 Vieilles Vignes Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: From the coastal region around Bandol, this is a crisp, salty wine. It has the brightest lemon fruits and some herbaceousness. The tangy texture needs to soften, so wait until the end of 2014 to drink.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Cuvée G White (Côtes de Provence)

description: A wine that is full in the mouth, offering some wood flavors, also some tight acidity and a final, crisp edge.
title: Château de Fuissé 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: While there is a somewhat meaty edge to this wine, it also has good rich texture. It probably needs time to bring out the full potential of its ripe yellow fruits.
title: Bret Brothers 2008 En Carementrant  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Really toasty, honey and lemon style of Chardonnay, tight and crisp. There are plenty of green plum and grapefruit flavors. Deliciously crisp, while also ripe.
title: Bret Brothers 2008 Domaine la Soufrandière  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: Mouth-watering in its bright, pear juice freshness, this is a crisp and lemony wine, touched by cream with a tight texture layered by wood. The acidity is crisp, dominant.
title: Albert Bichot 2008  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: A soft, fruity wine, touched with vanilla and citrus. It is full, ripe, some tropical fruits and showing a final fresh acidity.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2008  Saint-Véran

description: Soft, green fruited wine, an attractive mix of crisp fruits and weighty texture. There is a good bite of pepper and apple skin that develops as the wine opens up.
title: Domaine de la Croix Senaillet 2008 La Grande Bruyère  (Saint-Véran)

description: Soft, green fruited wine, an attractive mix of crisp fruits and weighty texture. There is a good bite of pepper and apple skin that develops as the wine opens up.
title: Domaine de la Croix Senaillet 2008 La Grande Bruyère  (Saint-Véran)

description: Ripe, rounded wine, wood balancing with rich fruits. Flavors of honeyed toast go with ripe red apple juice and a soft aftertaste.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2008 Domaine Delaye les Clochettes  (Mâcon-Prissé)

description: Rich and creamy, rounded by toast and honey with some spiced fruits. The texture is more wood than fruit, needing time to evolve.
title: Jean Rijckaert 2008 Les Chailloux  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Structured and firm, this is a solid, chunky wine. With its black fruit flavors merging with a more dry and tannic core, it is both dense and ageworthy. Acidity leavens its rich character. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2010 Red (Bergerac)

description: Structured and firm, this is a solid, chunky wine. With its black fruit flavors merging with a more dry and tannic core, it is both dense and ageworthy. Acidity leavens its rich character. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2010 Red (Bergerac)

description: Full bodied and thickly textured, this Southern Rhône Syrah combines cedar and vanilla notes from oak aging with notes of brandied cherries and a bit of asphalt. It's long on the finish, with a plush feel, then ends on a slightly bitter note.
title: LePlan-Vermeersch 2009 GT-S Grand Terroir Syrah (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is atypically medium bodied for the warm 2009 vintage, with an admirable degree of lightness and drinkability. Tart berry fruit is accented by rose hips and orange zest, then finishes crisp and lingering. Drink it over the next several years.
title: La Font du Vent 2009 Notre Passion Signargues Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is atypically medium bodied for the warm 2009 vintage, with an admirable degree of lightness and drinkability. Tart berry fruit is accented by rose hips and orange zest, then finishes crisp and lingering. Drink it over the next several years.
title: La Font du Vent 2009 Notre Passion Signargues Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is has flavors of apple and red currant, with a dry, light touch. The acidity cuts through the palate, giving it an attractive freshness, with a touch of spice and a crisp finish.
title: Triennes 2011 Rosé (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Cabernet Sauvignon in Provence seems to evoke the herbal wild-thyme character of the countryside. This wine has weight to its black fruit flavors, with an edge from its tannins and acidity. It could age for 2–3 years. Screwcap.
title: Château Routas 2009 Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Cabernet Sauvignon in Provence seems to evoke the herbal wild-thyme character of the countryside. This wine has weight to its black fruit flavors, with an edge from its tannins and acidity. It could age for 2–3 years. Screwcap.
title: Château Routas 2009 Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Light colored wine with a touch of smokiness and soft, ripe fruits. It lacks definition, giving an open feeling without much structure. Wood aging gives a burnt character at the end.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2011  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: A warm, fruity rosé, softly textured and full of strawberry fruits. There's a fine touch of acidity to balance and a dry aftertaste. Ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Pigmentum Rosé (Vin de Pays du Lot)

description: A warm, fruity rosé, softly textured and full of strawberry fruits. There's a fine touch of acidity to balance and a dry aftertaste. Ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Pigmentum Rosé (Vin de Pays du Lot)

description: There is an earthy, rustic quality about this wine. The dry tannins are initially hard with chocolate flavors overshadowing the fruit. That gives a wine that needs time to open up and will always be on the dry, firm side. Drink from 2015.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château Leret Réserve Malbec (Cahors)

description: A warm and fruity wine, it is softly textured, ripe peach and apricot flavors. The acidity gives just enough freshness to a wine that is ripe, rounded and ready to drink.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2012 Solaire  (Mâcon-Vinzelles)

description: Soft fruit and lightly spicy, the wine has a touch of acidity, lychee and ripe apple flavors. It is ready to drink, a full and gently rich wine.
title: Cave de Cleebourg 2011 Prestige Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Red-berry fruits dominate this crisp, clear wine with its direct line of acidity and light aftertaste. It's aromatic and full of life.
title: Moncigale 2015 Frais et Délicat Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: An attractive and ripely fruited Cab, this opens with lush aromas of blackberry, raspberry preserves and black plum that are complemented by spicy notes of bittersweet chocolate, toasted oak, pepper and cigar-box spice. The plush mouthfeel offers medium tannins and dense black-fruit flavors that linger on the spicy finish.
title: Michel Gassier 2014 Les Piliers Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: On an estate about 10 miles north of Aix-en-Provence, this 32-acre vineyard has produced a pretty, fruity wine. Light and crisp, it is cut by citrus acidity, giving a lift to the lively raspberry fruits.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine Bel Eouve Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: On an estate about 10 miles north of Aix-en-Provence, this 32-acre vineyard has produced a pretty, fruity wine. Light and crisp, it is cut by citrus acidity, giving a lift to the lively raspberry fruits.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine Bel Eouve Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Structured and dense, this has a solid feel to it that still preserves its attractive, fragrant character. Black plum notes provide a twist of acidity as well as a perfumed finish.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Sélection  (Juliénas)

description: This wine is ripe and full, with a soft, creamy character that is warm and smooth. A light brushing of toast brings out spice. This attractive, rounded wine is ready to drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Clos Reyssie  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Crisp apple flavors show strongly in this wine that offers good acidity and a tight, lively aftertaste. The brightness pushes the citrus character forward, leaving a lively, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: With big holdings in the appellation, the Château de Santenay produces a range of wines. This single-vineyard bottling is typically rich and rounded. It cushions the tannins with ripe fruit and gentle acidity. Developing well, the wine will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château de Santenay 2014 Le Bois de Lalier  (Mercurey)

description: The magnificently named vineyard, the seat of God, is set in the hills next to Saint-Aubin. This wine is crisp while also having a warm, rich backdrop of yellow fruit. The chalk soil gives the wine its tight minerality and texture. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château de Santenay 2014 Clos de la Chaise Dieu  (Hautes Cotes de Beaune)

description: The magnificently named vineyard, the seat of God, is set in the hills next to Saint-Aubin. This wine is crisp while also having a warm, rich backdrop of yellow fruit. The chalk soil gives the wine its tight minerality and texture. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château de Santenay 2014 Clos de la Chaise Dieu  (Hautes Cotes de Beaune)

description: This wine shows some maturity, with toast flavors coming through the creamy mousse. White stone fruit and streaks of citrus give a fresher end to this well-balanced wine.
title: Cave de Viré NV Bruto  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Vines in deep red-iron soil on this tiny biodynamic family parcel (1.3 acres) are just coming into their own. This ripe wine balances rich yellow fruit with a tight shot of acidity and citrus. Fresh and crisp with touches of spice and butter., it is ready to drink.
designation: Domaine La Soufrandière Climat les Longeays
title: Bret Brothers 2014 Domaine La Soufrandière Climat les Longeays  (Pouilly-Vinzelles)

description: Made from 65- to 80-year-old vines, this wine offers wood spice as well as apple and citrus fruit flavors. An underlying richness balances the acidity and crisp texture. The wine is ready to drink, although it will be better from 2017.
title: Bret Brothers 2014 Climat Sous les Plantes  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Made from 65- to 80-year-old vines, this wine offers wood spice as well as apple and citrus fruit flavors. An underlying richness balances the acidity and crisp texture. The wine is ready to drink, although it will be better from 2017.
title: Bret Brothers 2014 Climat Sous les Plantes  (Viré-Clessé)

description: This ripe, yellow-fruit-flavored wine has a smooth, rich texture. Full and flavorsome, it conveys a ripe, nutty character. The wine with its warm fruitiness is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2015  Mâcon Solutré

description: This is solid, rich and with great fruit flavors to complement its structure. Red cherry fruitiness is lifted by intense acidity and broadened by the dark tannins and concentration. This is a wine to age for a few years, so drink after 2015.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2012 Grand Cras  Vieilles Vignes  (Morgon)

description: A lovely wine that brings out ripe fruits, peach and pineapple flavors and a flavor of lemongrass. It is a full, rounded wine, feeling rich while always balanced with its crisp acidity. It does need to age for a year or two, so drink from 2015.
title: Château Jolys 2011 Cuvée Pauline  (Jurançon Sec)

description: Dominated by wood and spice, this is still a wine in progress. It has the weight of black fruit, dark tannins and licorice, while chocolate flavors promise a wine that will age over the long-term. For now, wait and don't drink this powerful wine before 2017.
title: Château de Gaudou 2011 Renaissance Malbec (Cahors)

description: This medium-bodied, silky-textured rosé features modestly confected aromas of bubble gum and cotton candy, which give way on the palate to vinous notes of cherry and wet stone. Drink up.
title: Mas des Bressades 2011 Cuvée Tradition Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This medium-bodied, silky-textured rosé features modestly confected aromas of bubble gum and cotton candy, which give way on the palate to vinous notes of cherry and wet stone. Drink up.
title: Mas des Bressades 2011 Cuvée Tradition Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a fruity effort, with a blackberry note that is laced with attractive tannins and acids. With its smooth, ripe texture and full mouthfeel, this is already approachable.
title: Cheval Quancard 2009 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: This is a fruity effort, with a blackberry note that is laced with attractive tannins and acids. With its smooth, ripe texture and full mouthfeel, this is already approachable.
title: Cheval Quancard 2009 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: Smoky, ripe and juicy, this wine's weight and tannins are secondary to the plum note and balancing acidity. The wine is open, generous and delicious already.
title: Château Pey la Tour 2009 Réserve du Château  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: With its forward acidity, this shows its fresh side before revealing its ripe red-berry flavors. Tannins form a firm, solid base that dominates the finish.
title: Château Moulin de Mallet 2010  Bordeaux

description: Very herbaceous and fruity, this has gooseberry, lime and pink grapefruit flavors. It's a light, bright and attractive, and it will be ready to drink in a few months.
title: Château La Mothe du Barry 2011  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: Very herbaceous and fruity, this has gooseberry, lime and pink grapefruit flavors. It's a light, bright and attractive, and it will be ready to drink in a few months.
title: Château La Mothe du Barry 2011  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: Ripe red fruits give this wine a juicy feel. The fruit is balanced, with new wood and caramel flavors offering a smooth contrast to each other. The smoky aftertaste is warm and ripe.
title: Château Haut-Mongeat 2009 Cuvée Isabelle  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Both the aromas and the flavors show considerable wood-aging notes that need time to integrate. The wine will begin to show its fruity black-currant and red plum flavors in a year. It has the richness and ripeness for aging over several years.
title: Château de Macard 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a fruity wine, and its black currant flavor emerging right away. Next comes the bright acidity, while the tannins form a solid, dark and dry contrast. The wine needs at least two years to soften into something rich.
title: Château de la Bouyère 2010  Bordeaux

description: Tight, crisp and mineral driven, this wine has citrus fruits and a steely texture, demonstrating that it needs to age for a year.
title: Château de Bonhoste 2011  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Tight, crisp and mineral driven, this wine has citrus fruits and a steely texture, demonstrating that it needs to age for a year.
title: Château de Bonhoste 2011  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Sweet rosé, soft crushed strawberries with crisp, clean balanced acidity. The wine is fruity, fresh and great as an aperitif or with a fruit dessert.
title: Château la Varière 2010 Rosé (Anjou)
