description: This blend of 60% Syrah, 20% Carignan and 20% Grenache opens with pleasant but soft scents of herbed cherry, plum and violet. The palate is light and easy, with soft tannins and juicy red-fruit flavors that finish clean and bright. Drink now.
title: L'Ostal Cazes 2012 Estibals Red (Minervois)

description: Softly ripe notes of pear mingle with earthier elements on nose and palate of this dryish Riesling. The spine of acidity provides structure and fills the palate with lemony, bright freshness that lingers pleasantly.
title: Emile Beyer 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Softly ripe notes of pear mingle with earthier elements on nose and palate of this dryish Riesling. The spine of acidity provides structure and fills the palate with lemony, bright freshness that lingers pleasantly.
title: Emile Beyer 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: While ample flavors of apricot and rose are made even richer by residual sweetness, the components are abundant but slightly out of focus. Opulent and round, this might find its match in a mature wedge of oozing Munster cheese.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2014 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A rich wine, perfumed and intense. The tannins are a major element, although they ride with the sweet fruit and concentrated, complex wood and acidity. The wine is firm, impressively fruity and still likely to age further.
title: Henri Milan 2007 Le Vallon Red (Vin de Table Francais)

description: A rich wine, perfumed and intense. The tannins are a major element, although they ride with the sweet fruit and concentrated, complex wood and acidity. The wine is firm, impressively fruity and still likely to age further.
title: Henri Milan 2007 Le Vallon Red (Vin de Table Francais)

description: A very fine wine with some bottle age that has given the dense tannins a chance to integrate beautifully into its sweet fruit. There is a bitter chocolate edge that comes from the wood aging. It has a dark and very structured aftertaste.
title: Domaine le Bout du Lieu 2007 Orbe Noir Malbec (Cahors)

description: A powerful wine that has integrated its dense tannins with its equally impressive fruit. Blackberry jelly and spice mingle around a firm, dry core mingle in this concentrated, ageworthy wine. Drink now or keep for 4–5 years.
title: Château Saint-Didier-Parnac 2009 Prieuré de Cénac Mission Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: A wine that shows its wood aging from the mint aromas and dark, dry texture. At this young stage, the 18-month barrel aging weighs heavily on the fruit, but this should certainly soften after 3–4 years. An impressive wine showing the richness of 2009.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2009 K-Lys Malbec (Cahors)

description: A wine that shows its wood aging from the mint aromas and dark, dry texture. At this young stage, the 18-month barrel aging weighs heavily on the fruit, but this should certainly soften after 3–4 years. An impressive wine showing the richness of 2009.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2009 K-Lys Malbec (Cahors)

description: A beautifully perfumed wine. It shows an elegant side to Cahors, offering intense and juicy blackberry fruit that override the dark tannins. The wine has weight and power and remains finely proportioned. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Château de Chambert 2009 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: The aroma is earthy, while on the palate this wine shows a full-bodied structure and rich, chewy black fruits. There is minerality here, a very textured wine offering spice as well as blackberry and plum-skin flavors.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2007 Collection Plaimont Red (Madiran)

description: Landron's complex wine comes from organic grapes that add a line of purity to the bright white and citrus fruits. A textured wine, this needs to age for a few months to round out the fragrant fruitiness and open up the structure. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaines Landron 2013 Les Houx Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Landron's complex wine comes from organic grapes that add a line of purity to the bright white and citrus fruits. A textured wine, this needs to age for a few months to round out the fragrant fruitiness and open up the structure. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaines Landron 2013 Les Houx Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Nuits Saint-Georges based Liger-Belair has produced a very Burgundian Beaujolais. It is full, structured and rich, now reaching its peak. Great cherry fruits allied to intense acidity are balanced by mature tannins and a firm, dense texture. The wine is ready to drink, although it could still mature further.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2009 Les Rouchaux  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: A fresh, lightweight Chardonnay, hinting at citrus and almonds. There is a taut, tannic edge to the yellow fruits, the acidity turning to a firm texture. Final acidity is fresh and crisp.
title: Cave de Lugny 2008 Les Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: A fresh, lightweight Chardonnay, hinting at citrus and almonds. There is a taut, tannic edge to the yellow fruits, the acidity turning to a firm texture. Final acidity is fresh and crisp.
title: Cave de Lugny 2008 Les Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: A lovely Sauv Blanc nose with pretty floral notes dancing among aromas and flavors of ripe tropical fruit, peach and tangerine oil. Light weight with good acidity and a clean finish. Fresh and inviting; not terribly complex, but a great example of the varietal.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2008 Réserve Spéciale Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Serious mineral tones take precedence over the fruit here, with hay aromas giving way to flavors of stones and just a hint of apricot on the palate. Some strawberry fruit graces the medium finish. This wine is fairly dry, a flexible partner for a variety of classically prepared fish poultry.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2007 Saering Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A darkly tannic wine, showing a dry side of Pinot Noir but still offering some good berry fruits and raspberry sweetness. The acidity needs to soften, though.
title: Domaine Jayer-Gilles 2007  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: Ripe, creamy wine with a good toast element. It is smooth, elegant, the flavors showing almonds, vanilla, baked apple and pear enlivened by fresh acidity. Attractive, ready to drink.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2008 Buissonnier Montagny  (Montagny)

description: In the trilogy of wines made at Ponzac, this is the one to drink young. It comes from chalky soil that gives soft tannins and ripe blackberry fruits. It is fruity and soft with just an edge of structure and with plenty of acidity to finish. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Ponzac 2014 Maintenant Malbec (Cahors)

description: Produced from vineyard around the 13th-century castle, the wine has concentration, rich tannins and ripe berry fruit. Pepper and spice bring out the texture of the wine that is freshened by acidity.
title: Château de la Terrière 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Fresh, ripe notes of yellow peach are joined by creamy richness. On the palate a streak of lemony freshness pulls the broad palate into focus. It's a wine of full-blown, peachy abundance. Drink soon.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2015 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This blend of Chenin Blanc, Chardonnay and Cabernet Franc is ripe and yeasty. It has perfumed fruit, although the fruit is ensconced in a bitter, nutty character. The acidity is intense, giving freshness at the end.
designation: La Folie des Loups Rosé Brut
title: Domaine de Nerleux NV La Folie des Loups Rosé Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Still fresh, even at two-years-old, this is a crisp, apple-scented wine. It has bright acidity that gives the wine a fine tang and mineral edge. Drink now.
title: Domaine de la Quilla 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a ripe, fruity wine with a herbal character alongside richer yellow and apple fruits. It is fresh and crisp, ready to drink and with a rounded, full aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Lacheteau 2014  Pouilly-Fumé

description: This blend of Sciaccarellu and Niellucciu is delicious and light—full of refreshing red currant flavors and crisp acidity. It's bright, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Poli 2016 Sciaccarellu-Niellucciu Rosé (Ile de Beauté)

description: Spice and damson flavors give this wine a fruity character. Add its smoky tannins and toasty layers, and it is a wine that needs to age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Tour Saint Germain 2015 Cuvée Moulin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Named after the grandfather of the estate's present owners, this is a weird and wonderful blend that mixes the grapes of Bordeaux, Gaillac and places in between. Bottled without sulfur, it's fruity and juicy, with a strong edge of pepper and a touch of barnyard. Drink now.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2016 Vigne d'Albert Red (Bergerac)

description: This juicy, fruity wine has red berry fruit and gentle tannins. Although ripe, it's not rich but attractive and likely to age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Pilet 2015 Alt. 120 Metres  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This juicy, fruity wine has red berry fruit and gentle tannins. Although ripe, it's not rich but attractive and likely to age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Pilet 2015 Alt. 120 Metres  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is dry and extracted, with firm, almost bitter tannins. Licorice and black chocolate flavors dominate. It will take several years for the fruit potential to show. Drink from 2021.
title: Château les Conseillans 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Produced from organically grown grapes, this Merlot-dominated wine is bright with red fruit and lined with tight tannins. It has the crisp edge of youth that will fill out with time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château les Aubiers 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: With its strong aromatic character, this wine layers firm tannins and intense acidity. Underneath all this, there is some fine fruit potential, evoking ripe blackberries. Drink from 2020.
title: Château le Doyenne 2015  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is packed with blackberry and damson flavors. The firm tannins at the back are balanced, giving an attractive character that will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Gigault 2015 Cuvée Viva  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is packed with blackberry and damson flavors. The firm tannins at the back are balanced, giving an attractive character that will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Gigault 2015 Cuvée Viva  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This second wine of Château du Cèdre is floral, with plenty of tannic structure and ripe, juicy black fruit. Drink from late 2018.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Chatons du Cèdre Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This second wine of Château du Cèdre is floral, with plenty of tannic structure and ripe, juicy black fruit. Drink from late 2018.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Chatons du Cèdre Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Baked apple aromas and crisp green fruit flavors set up this bright, fruity wine. With its lively character and juicy citrus notes, it could age a few more months. Save it for summer 2018.
title: Château des Tourtes 2016 Cuvée Classique  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Named after the Bay of Biscay near Gascony, this wine is light, fruity and crisp. It has an herbal character, refreshing green fruit and lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Biscaye Baie 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: An aromatic nose of ripe red and yellow apple promises fruit-forward fizz. On the palate, these notes are intensified by the very vivid frothy bubbles as they burst. There is apple crispness and lots of fruit on the light dry palate. It's an ideal and invigorating apéritif.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A lovely note of mirabelle plum and sponge cake appears on the nose. The palate is fresh and vivid, light-bodied and dry, enlivened by frothy fizz that highlights fresh citrus accents. The finish is very clean, dry and appetizing—ideal apéritif material.
title: Bott Frères NV Blanc de Noirs Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The nonvintage blend from this producer reveals the house style with its crisp character, tangy citrus fruits and great acidity. It is floral, fruity while also sitting on the dry side of Brut. Drink this finely balanced wine now.
title: Boizel NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: The nonvintage blend from this producer reveals the house style with its crisp character, tangy citrus fruits and great acidity. It is floral, fruity while also sitting on the dry side of Brut. Drink this finely balanced wine now.
title: Boizel NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: A touch of reduction clings to the nose, masking the fruit. On the palate, however, lemon and crisp green apple freshness prevail, carried by a soft lively mousse. This is dry, light and has a lovely backdrop of yeasty autolytic notes and a very clean finish.
title: Boeckel 2015 Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The wine is all fruit: red berries and red currants bursting from the glass. The red wine used to give color has added an edge of tannic texture to the ripe fruitiness. In the house style of this producer, the wine is dry and crisp at the end. Drink now.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Le Rosé Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: The wine is all fruit: red berries and red currants bursting from the glass. The red wine used to give color has added an edge of tannic texture to the ripe fruitiness. In the house style of this producer, the wine is dry and crisp at the end. Drink now.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Le Rosé Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: The vivid, deeply pink shade of this sparkler promises freshness. Both the nose and palate are chock-full of fruit: Tart red apple, strawberry and a touch of peach fill the head. The mousse is lively and frothy, the finish is dry, fresh and very moreish.
title: Gustave Lorentz NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Rounded ripe Chardonnay is the backbone of this accessible wine. Yes, it is crisp with an edge of steeliness, but its acidity is tempered by the rich lime and apricot flavors. The wine is ripe, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Gallimard Père et Fils NV Cuvée Grande Réserve Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is an unusual 100% Pinot Meunier Champagne. Its stark dryness is balanced by the natural softness of the grapes to give a rounded wine full of spicy apple balanced by fine textured acidity. Ready to drink now.
title: Eric Taillet NV Bansionensi Extra Brut Pinot Meunier (Champagne)

description: The enticing tartness of red and green apples dominates the appetizing nose. These crisp notes are heightened by a very lively frothing mousse on a light dry palate that shows both autolysis and freshness. The finish is lip-smacking and very refreshing and has a lasting hint of yeast.
title: Domaine Specht NV Blanc Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A lovely blend of tart berry and red-apple notes creates an inviting nose. The palate brings these lovely, almost autumnal berry notes even further as they are amplified by the lively frothy mousse. This is totally fruit driven, very appetizing and refreshing with an almost cleansing but lasting finish.
title: Domaine Specht 2015 Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fruity and fragrant, this wine shows just a touch of toast suggesting it is approaching maturity. Crisp on the palate with a light twist of lemon, it boasts tight acidity and a mineral character. It's an solidly structured wine, with a fruitiness that lingers on the finish.
title: Philippe Fontaine 2007 Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: This richly textured wine boasts incredible freshness, as well as complexity of flavor. Apple and citrus flavors show hints of development— secondary notes of toast and cookies. The acidity is still very present—a crisp reminder of its age worthiness. Drink through 2022
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2006 Brut Millesimé  (Champagne)

description: This Blanc de Blancs is crisp, and minerally with a textured, chalky character. Despite hints of maturity, it still tastes youthful, fruity and fresh. Dry and elegantly structured, it finishes with a hint of toast.  Drink now–2019.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2005 Millesimé Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Soft and rounded with ripe apple and pear flavors, this wine expresses the richness of the vintage. Hints of toast and cookie are changing the fruit character, making this a wine that's ready to drink while still fresh, yet starting to show good aging as well.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 2002 Palmes d'Or Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: While earthy on the nose, the palate bursts with huge berry flavors on this powerful wine. Bold, ripe fruit is cushioned by tannins and penetrating acidity, lending a dark feel to its structure. Drink from 2015.
region: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Château Routas 2009 Cyrano Syrah (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: Showing the freshness of the year as much as the structure, this is a ripe wine that's full of fragrant black currants and some tight acidity. It is smooth and soft, the tannins are already integrating, so drink from 2015.
title: Château le Prieuré 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: With strong new wood aromas, this concentrated wine shows vanilla as well as black-fruit flavors. Acidity cuts the richness, giving shape to wine and focusing on the balance. With firm tannins in the background, it needs several years. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Haut Selve 2010  Graves

description: Very ripe, powerful and extracted, the wine has a bitter edge, a dark and tannic structure and a dense texture. With its edge of cocoa and layers of wood over the blackberry fruits, it's a wine that will need a while before drinking. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Franc Pipeau 2010 Descombes  (Saint-Émilion)

description: French philosopher and writer Charles-Louis de Montesquieu once lived at the moated Château de la Brède, hence the name of this wine. It is a ripe, finely perfumed wine, with new wood and eucalyptus aromas, rich red fruits and a soft, open series of tannins. It is almost ready to drink, but the chocolate edge suggests it should be kept until 2017.
title: Château de la Brède 2011 Cuvée Montesquieu  (Graves)

description: An elegant wine that is given weight by its rich black fruits and style by the balance between tannins and acidity. There is a fresh character to this bright and fruity wine at this stage. Give it 4–5 years and it will begin to develop secondary aromas. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Chantelune 2011  Margaux

description: This is a richer style of Blanc de Blancs that has the weight of a high dosage behind it. There's a baked-apple character that's rich and rounded, but laced with minerality as well. It's soft on the palate, but with a reverberating freshness.
designation: Cuvée Stanislas Blanc de Blancs Brut Millesimé
title: Thiénot 2005 Cuvée Stanislas Blanc de Blancs Brut Millesimé Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The steely, mineral character of a Blanc de Blancs is resoundingly evident here. It's fresh on the palate with a crisp texture and vivacious acidity. It's so fruity, it's certainly ready to drink now, but wait a year, and it will show wonderful signs of maturity as well.
designation: Cuvée Gustave Belon Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Charles Clément NV Cuvée Gustave Belon Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe, wood-aged wine that shows the richer side of Meursault. It's generous with ripe yellow fruits, but balanced and complemented by crisp acidity and hints of toastiness. A fine wine with impeccable structure, it will age well, so drink from 2015.
designation: Cuvée Signature Le Porusot Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Le Porusot Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: This is a ripe, wood-aged wine that shows the richer side of Meursault. It's generous with ripe yellow fruits, but balanced and complemented by crisp acidity and hints of toastiness. A fine wine with impeccable structure, it will age well, so drink from 2015.
designation: Cuvée Signature Le Porusot Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Le Porusot Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A rich wine with crisp apple and grapefruit flavors as well as a touch of sweetness, Lanson's non-vintage Brut always has fine acidity with just a hint of toast indicating some bottle age. It's bottled ready to drink.
title: Lanson NV Black Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: A rich wine with crisp apple and grapefruit flavors as well as a touch of sweetness, Lanson's non-vintage Brut always has fine acidity with just a hint of toast indicating some bottle age. It's bottled ready to drink.
title: Lanson NV Black Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: Extra brut means that this Champagne is drier than most brut wines, while not totally dry as in brut zéro. This Extra Brut shows remarkable crispness, but also some ripeness with its apple and grapefruit flavors. It's one of those Champagnes that needs time to breathe, so open 30 minutes before you want to drink it—the bubbles won't disappear.
title: Lamiable NV Grand Cru Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Full of both fruit and structure, this richly perfumed and spicy wine is impressive with solid tannins that are coming into balance with the rich black fruits. It still needs aging, so drink from 2018. The property is owned by a dedicated wine family that over the years tended the few remaining Malbec vines that survived phylloxera of late 1800s, were founders of the union to protect Cahors wines in the 1930s and helped revive the Confrérie des vins de Cahors. Alain Gayraud is the family's current owner.
title: Château Lamartine 2011 Cuvée Particulière Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: Full of both fruit and structure, this richly perfumed and spicy wine is impressive with solid tannins that are coming into balance with the rich black fruits. It still needs aging, so drink from 2018. The property is owned by a dedicated wine family that over the years tended the few remaining Malbec vines that survived phylloxera of late 1800s, were founders of the union to protect Cahors wines in the 1930s and helped revive the Confrérie des vins de Cahors. Alain Gayraud is the family's current owner.
title: Château Lamartine 2011 Cuvée Particulière Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: Rotier's top wine is an impressive, wood-aged example of how good red Gaillac can be. This spicy, black-fruited wine is packed with dark cherries, plums and dusty tannins. It needs to age even more, so drink this solid, long-lasting wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Rotier 2011 Renaissance Red (Gaillac)

description: Rotier's top wine is an impressive, wood-aged example of how good red Gaillac can be. This spicy, black-fruited wine is packed with dark cherries, plums and dusty tannins. It needs to age even more, so drink this solid, long-lasting wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Rotier 2011 Renaissance Red (Gaillac)

description: Powerful tannins are the dominant theme of this still-young wine that is dark, brooding, very firm and young. Big and muscular, this is a wine for long-term aging. Even the black currant fruits need time to soften the intensity of their tannins. Drink from 2019.
title: Château d'Aydie 2012 Odé d'Aydie Tannat (Madiran)

description: Powerful tannins are the dominant theme of this still-young wine that is dark, brooding, very firm and young. Big and muscular, this is a wine for long-term aging. Even the black currant fruits need time to soften the intensity of their tannins. Drink from 2019.
title: Château d'Aydie 2012 Odé d'Aydie Tannat (Madiran)

description: Aged 100% in new wood, this is a wine produced as a joint venture between California vintner Paul Hobbs and Cahors producer Bertrand Vigouroux. It is a major, powerful statement, rich and dense. The texture smoothes out the natural structure of Cahors Malbec to give a silky wine, the tannins in suspension in the black plum fruits. It will be better from 2017.
title: Paul Bertrand 2011 Crocus Grand Vin Malbec (Cahors)

description: This luxury bottling spends nine months in barrel, yet shows little overt oak. It's full, ripe and opulent without going over the top, boasting aromas and upfront flavors of honeydew, apricot and bergamot. Then the long, mouthwatering finish folds in hints of honey and pineapple without any hint of bitterness.
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2012 La Chambée  (Condrieu)

description: This sweet, honeyed wine has a rich, unctuous character. It is perfumed, full of sweet orange marmalade and spice. The acidity keeps it together and gives final freshness. This is a wine to drink by itself rather than with food.
title: Domaine Rotier 2012 Renaissance Vendanges Tardives White (Gaillac)

description: Produced from the old vines of one of Cahor's emblematic estates, this is a dark, dense and concentrated wine. Full of black plum skins that are balanced with acidity, it is rich with black cherry and a smoky character from the wood aging. This 100% Malbec does need aging and should be drunk from 2019.
title: Domaine de Cause 2012 La Lande Cavagnac Malbec (Cahors)

description: Named after the wife of the previous owner, this top cuvée from Château de Cénac is powered by its structure and dark tannins. The rich black berries and plums are still working through the dense texture. It's a complex wine, still showing its wood aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Cénac 2012 Eulalie Malbec (Cahors)

description: This celebration of Tannat is a balanced while severe and structured wine. Plenty of juicy fruit is ready to come out from behind the dry, tannic structure. There is power here as well in this wine that is firm and needs to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château d'Aydie 2013 Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: This celebration of Tannat is a balanced while severe and structured wine. Plenty of juicy fruit is ready to come out from behind the dry, tannic structure. There is power here as well in this wine that is firm and needs to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château d'Aydie 2013 Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: Produced by the Baron family, this nonvintage blend is soft and as balanced as the other wines in the range. It has a ripe feel to it, creamed apple and green plums giving the fruity element. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Claude Baron NV Cuvée Saphir Brut  (Champagne)

description: A sunny touch of peach adds a very fruity edge to the strawberry nose of this vivid, pale-pink sparkler. The frothy mousse is very lively and makes this utterly refreshing, highlighting notes of red apples. The finish is dry and clean-cut.
title: Cave de Cleebourg NV Clérostein Pinot Noir Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A sunny touch of peach adds a very fruity edge to the strawberry nose of this vivid, pale-pink sparkler. The frothy mousse is very lively and makes this utterly refreshing, highlighting notes of red apples. The finish is dry and clean-cut.
title: Cave de Cleebourg NV Clérostein Pinot Noir Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Balanced and fruity with its hints of red fruits, this is a light wine. The dominance of the two Pinot grapes gives it a slight texture and tannic edge although this is smoothed out by the soft finish from the relatively high dosage. Ready to drink now.
title: Boizel NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Mainly Pinot Meunier, as befits a producer in the Marne Valley, this Champagne is soft and creamy. With its edge of acidity, baked-apple flavor and zingy texture, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Emile Leclère NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Mainly Pinot Meunier, as befits a producer in the Marne Valley, this Champagne is soft and creamy. With its edge of acidity, baked-apple flavor and zingy texture, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Emile Leclère NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: A touch of spice comes from the wood aging. This has plenty of fruit as well, promising a good future. Ripe and rich, this should age well, so drink from 2016. The Maurice Robert family winery, in the heart of Entre-Deux-Mers, is now in its third generation. The Sauve Majeure Benedictine abbey in the village is on the UNESCO World Heritage pilgrim route.
title: Château Turcaud 2014 Cuvée Majeure  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A touch of spice comes from the wood aging. This has plenty of fruit as well, promising a good future. Ripe and rich, this should age well, so drink from 2016. The Maurice Robert family winery, in the heart of Entre-Deux-Mers, is now in its third generation. The Sauve Majeure Benedictine abbey in the village is on the UNESCO World Heritage pilgrim route.
title: Château Turcaud 2014 Cuvée Majeure  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a tangy wine, packed with fruit, orange and lemon zest and a background hint of herbaceousness. A tight, steely texture gives both acidity and the promise of aging. Drink from early 2016.
title: Château la Verrière 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: In its weight and richness allied to scents of garrigue and sun-warmed stones, this speaks of its Tavel terroir. The berry fruit is subdued, with spice, weight and warmth carrying the wine to a long finish.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Le Crétacé  (Tavel)

description: With almost zero dosage, this is dry but it doesn't feel at all unbalanced because of the ripe, fragrant fruitiness. The wine is full in the mouth, with lively acidity. It is ready to drink, particularly with food.
title: Vincent Couche NV Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: It hurts to say this, but $78 qualifies as a decent value in Côte Rôtie these days. This is delicately floral on the nose, while vibrant raspberry fruit carries through on the palate. A hint of creaminess marks the texture, turning to fine silk on the finish. Drink now–2023.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2010  Côte Rôtie

description: La Nerthe's Cuvée des Cadettes shows a bit of oak on the nose in its hints of vanilla and toasted coconut, but also copious amounts of raspberry fruit. It's full bodied and lush, with the fruit gently cosseted by oak, not at all overwhelmed, and the finish is long and plushly textured. While approachable even now, it should be at its best sometime after 2020.
title: Château La Nerthe 2010 Cuvée des Cadettes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This firm Malbec comes from old vines. It is concentrated and dense, while wearing its power easily and openly. Wood aging adds complexity as do the leather, dark chocolate and black fruits that are followed by juicy acidity. A wine with great potential, don't drink before 2018.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2010 Pur Plaisir Malbec (Cahors)

description: Dark and powerful, this is a complex and concentrated wood-aged wine. It's a blend of two local Gaillac grapes, Duras and Braucol, which gives richness, structure and a dense, herbal character. This wine, with its long term future, is still young, showing as much tannin as fruit, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Domaine Rotier 2010 L'Ame Red (Gaillac)

description: A toasty, smoky wine, with freshening acidity, crisp green and white fruits and an attractive edge of toasty oak. The wine is lively, fresh, delicious, very poised and vibrant.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2007 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A toasty, smoky wine, with freshening acidity, crisp green and white fruits and an attractive edge of toasty oak. The wine is lively, fresh, delicious, very poised and vibrant.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2007 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: “Les Faisses,” meaning “terraces” in Occitan, refers to the vineyards overlooking the Heurault from which this wine was sourced. 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, this is a vibrant, fruit-forward wine with ripe fruit characteristics of blueberry, raspberry and cherry along with accents of garrigue herbs and soft pepper. An easy-to-drink, ready-to-please wine at an attractive price.
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2007 Jean Claude Mas Les Faisses Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Blending Sémillon and Muscadelle, this is a rich, unctuous wine with a rich texture. Honey and apricot flavors are underlain with intense acidity that gives this superb wine a fine lift and elegance. It could certainly age, but is delicious now.
title: Domaine l'Ancienne Cure 2009 L'Abbaye  (Monbazillac)

description: Petit Manseng, just beginning to get its rightful recognition, produces superb sweet wines that avoid any sense of cloying, instead offering honey flavors in a fresh, fragrant context. Here it performs superbly with lively acidity and a bright, if sweet, aftertaste.
title: Château de Rousse 2010 Cuvée Prestige  (Jurançon)

description: A wine that keeps close to the dense path of Yannick Amirault's wines. Firm, dark and with strong elements of wood aging, this is solid and chunky. Perhaps there is a touch too much extraction, but this is mitigated by the rich black plum and berry fruits and final. lifted acidity. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Yannick Amirault 2009 Les Quartiers Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: One of the pair of top end wines from Fournier (the other is the Grande Cuvée from Pouilly-Fumé) this ripe and full wine is soft and rounded. The initial herbaceous character gets replaced by a more sophisticated, rich and ripe character, intense and a very good pairing for food.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2009 Grande Cuvée  (Sancerre)

description: A taut, steely, very mineral wine, showing a tense, textured character. Fruit flavors run from grapefruit to peach, with a delicious tang of zest along the way. With its acidity and structure, this is a wine for long-term aging.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2009 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: An intense, mineral-driven wine, tasting of the limestone soil as well as very ripe fruit. Great acidity keeps the richness in line, toast offering sweetness. The wine is full-bodied, the flavors going right through to the apple-skin-textured core.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2009 Clos Saint Marc Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: The tannins are very fine, with rich fruitcake and smoky flavors. Red berry and black plums give a fruity character, along with delicious acidity. The wine is structured while still remaining very approachable.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2009  Saint-Estèphe

description: The tannins are very fine, with rich fruitcake and smoky flavors. Red berry and black plums give a fruity character, along with delicious acidity. The wine is structured while still remaining very approachable.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2009  Saint-Estèphe

description: This rich wine is structured, with orange zest and apple skins given a boost of fragrant acidity. It's packed with yellow fruits and the freshest acidity. Drink this lightly tannic wine now, although it would be better to wait until 2017.
title: Les Héritiers du Comte Lafon 2013 Clos du Four  (Mâcon-Milly Lamartine)

description: The southern part of the Montmains vineyard has produced a smooth, rounded wine that is full of honey and apricots, with a warm texture. It's a fruity wine, soft and demanding to be drunk now, with citric freshness at the end.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2013 Butteaux Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The southern part of the Montmains vineyard has produced a smooth, rounded wine that is full of honey and apricots, with a warm texture. It's a fruity wine, soft and demanding to be drunk now, with citric freshness at the end.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2013 Butteaux Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: A ripe wine from vines close to Volnay, this is dense and very textured. It shows wood, although not too much, and a creamy character. Minerality gives a good sense of structure to this concentrated, balanced wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2013 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A ripe wine from vines close to Volnay, this is dense and very textured. It shows wood, although not too much, and a creamy character. Minerality gives a good sense of structure to this concentrated, balanced wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2013 Les Caillerets Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: The premier cru is right in the heart of the appellation, close to the village. This wine, with its intense fruits and strongly textured character, is still trying out its structure and density. The potential is there with apricot and apple fruits waiting to come thorough the tight structure. Drink this fine wine from 2018.
title: Alex Gambal 2013 Maltroie Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: The premier cru is right in the heart of the appellation, close to the village. This wine, with its intense fruits and strongly textured character, is still trying out its structure and density. The potential is there with apricot and apple fruits waiting to come thorough the tight structure. Drink this fine wine from 2018.
title: Alex Gambal 2013 Maltroie Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: 85-87 Barrel sample. High wood here, with spicy toast. The fruit is lean by comparison, hinting at freshness, but not giving much through the wood and tannin.
title: Château Lilian Ladouys 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 85-87 Barrel sample. Ripe, unfocussed fruit, simple blackberry jelly flavor, lacking the structure and the acidity.
title: Château Berliquet 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Late harvest rather than botrytized, although here the richness and the superripe fruit have something of the same effect. Honeyed with yellow fruits and dried apricots, it is a gorgeously ripe sweet wine that is balanced with the wonderful acidity. Drink this wine soon, say from 2018.
title: Domaine Rotier 2013 Renaissance Vendanges Tardives Loin de l'Oeil (Gaillac)

description: Smoky notes mix with the lifted yarrow and lemon-peel notes of this wine. The palate is soft, rounded and medium-sweet, revealing a rich vein of peach compote flavors edged with bitter grapefruit pith. A wine of astonishing balance, it offers lively citrus notes and immense concentration.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Smoky but very ripe notes of Comice pear mingle with the honeyed spice of gingerbread on the nose. of this wine. The palate counters this aromatic richness with a steely, concentrated core of fresh citrus with apple and quince notes. It offers a great play-off of richness and utter precision for a wonderful expression of 2014. This wine is sure to develop. Drink 2016–2025.
title: Josmeyer 2014 Fromenteau Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Smoky but very ripe notes of Comice pear mingle with the honeyed spice of gingerbread on the nose. of this wine. The palate counters this aromatic richness with a steely, concentrated core of fresh citrus with apple and quince notes. It offers a great play-off of richness and utter precision for a wonderful expression of 2014. This wine is sure to develop. Drink 2016–2025.
title: Josmeyer 2014 Fromenteau Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Lifted notes of Williams pear show hints of gingerbread and dried Bierewecke, a confection made of Christmas spices, nuts and dried pear. Fresh with lemon zest, the palate is appealingly off-dry: all the richness comes from flavor and mellow texture. Pair this beautifully balanced wine with runny, ripe cheese for a real taste of Alsace.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2013 Lieu-dit Schofweg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Lifted notes of Williams pear show hints of gingerbread and dried Bierewecke, a confection made of Christmas spices, nuts and dried pear. Fresh with lemon zest, the palate is appealingly off-dry: all the richness comes from flavor and mellow texture. Pair this beautifully balanced wine with runny, ripe cheese for a real taste of Alsace.
title: Gustave Lorentz 2013 Lieu-dit Schofweg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Don't let the age fool you—this beautiful Ambré still has plenty of vibrancy and life ahead of it. Rich aromas of candied orange, dried mango, apricot and creamy, honeyed melon are hit by toasted oak and wood spice accents. The attack is bright and powerful, with ample orange-like acidity that keeps the stone fruit, toasted nut and rancio flavors lifted through the long, lingering finish.
title: Arnaud de Villeneuve 1985 Ambré White (Rivesaltes)

description: Lifted citrus blossom and luscious peach notes rise from the glass. The palate follows this with sweetness, as though rose petals were dipped into blossom honey. The floral overtones are accentuated by a bitter caramel note, leaving a medium-sweet finish. Lovely now, the wine will still develop. Drink 2016–2022
title: Wunsch & Mann 2011 Grand Cru Hengst Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A fruity wine that's laced with wood, this is smooth and lightly tannic. The red and black berry fruits are at the fore, supported by a toast character and lifting acidity Age for 1–2 years, but the wine is drinkable now.
title: Château de la Jaubertie 2010 Red (Bergerac)

description: Rounded and soft, this has a touch of vanilla to go with the sweet strawberry fruit and crisp yet open acidity. Well balanced and dry, this would make for a good apéritif. Screwcap.
title: Bieler Père et Fils 2011 Sabine Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: A slightly chunky and inelegant Côtes du Rhône, this wine nevertheless delivers satisfying and assertive notes of black olive, espresso and dark chocolate. Drink it over the next few years.
title: André Brunel 2009 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This intriguing blend of 50% Grenache and 50% Carignan combines crisp red-fruit flavors and lush, creamy tannins. There's a slightly herbal tinge as well. Drink it over the next year or two.
title: Les Vignerons D'Estezargues 2010 Terre de Mistral Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Bel-Air is owned by the Cazes family of Château Lynch-Bages in Pauillac, and the pedigree of the winemaking shows. A rich, almost opulent wine, tempered with tannins. Flavors of dark black figs, herbs and wood come together harmoniously. It has a tense edge of tannin that promises aging.
title: Château Villa Bel Air 2003  Graves

description: A very fruity wine, boasting perfumed white fruit and some minerality. The acidity is tight, racy and crisp, and it's just beginning to fill out. Currently, this tastes like it's between youth and maturity.
designation: Domaine du Château de Riquewihr Les Murailles
title: Dopff & Irion 2008 Domaine du Château de Riquewihr Les Murailles Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a full, fruity wine. It's ripe and packed with currant, green plum and pink grapefruit flavors. There are hints of almond and delicate flower aromas. The soft finish has more ripe, delicious fruit.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2010 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Smooth, rich and silky, this is attractively lifted by yeast and almond flavors. It's rounded and full bodied, and it's developing fast. Drink this within the year.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2009 Brand Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A rounded, wood-aged wine, this is full of ripe red-berry and spice flavors, with a core of warm, smoky tannins. It is structured and should age over several years.
designation: Domaine de la Créa Les Grands Picotins
title: Louis Max 2010 Domaine de la Créa Les Grands Picotins  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: A rounded, wood-aged wine, this is full of ripe red-berry and spice flavors, with a core of warm, smoky tannins. It is structured and should age over several years.
designation: Domaine de la Créa Les Grands Picotins
title: Louis Max 2010 Domaine de la Créa Les Grands Picotins  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This is firm, showing a ripe plum-skin flavor and a severe line of tannin. There's some bitterness along with a good depth of fruit flavor, structure and acidity, all of which suggest aging potential.
title: Louis Max 2009 Clos des Chênes  (Volnay)

description: Pure, clean and fresh, this has bright lime and grapefruit flavors that are lined with acidity. The wine has a touch of perfume and is attractively balanced. This is developing quickly.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2011 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a gentle, fruity and open wine that's full of rounded spiced-fruit flavors. It is attractive, with a fine balance of acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Vignoble des 2 Lunes 2009 Amélie Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Crémant de Loire is the Loire-wide sparkling wine appellation. This wine, with its blend of Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay, shows a crisp character, its acidity given brightness by lemon and green-plum fruit flavors. There's an attractive edge of minerality to add some tautness to the wine.
title: Bouvet-Ladubay NV Brut Excellence Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: Made partly from ungrafted Chenin Blanc planted in 1979, this is an astonishingly opulent wine. It has spice, white currants and acidity, with a tight texture underlying the super-ripe fruit.
title: Henry Marionnet 2011 Domaine de la Charmoise Vinifera Chenin Blanc (Touraine)

description: Made partly from ungrafted Chenin Blanc planted in 1979, this is an astonishingly opulent wine. It has spice, white currants and acidity, with a tight texture underlying the super-ripe fruit.
title: Henry Marionnet 2011 Domaine de la Charmoise Vinifera Chenin Blanc (Touraine)

description: With hints of almond and touches of honey, this is a deliciously fruity wine. The palate is lightly textured with crisp acidity wrapped in rounded, ripe fruit. The aftertaste balances acidity and delicate fruit. Screwcap.
title: La Grille 2011  Vouvray

description: With hints of almond and touches of honey, this is a deliciously fruity wine. The palate is lightly textured with crisp acidity wrapped in rounded, ripe fruit. The aftertaste balances acidity and delicate fruit. Screwcap.
title: La Grille 2011  Vouvray

description: Very spicy, full-in-the-mouth wine. It has just the right amount of acidity to keep it fresh, but its main thrust is towards rich pepper and weight. At the end, a tighter mineral character appears. Keep for 2–3 years.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2012 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The Côte des Bar is the source of grapes for this Aube-based producer, now in the family's eighth generation. This dry rosé gets its richness from ripe red Pinot Noir cut with refreshing citrus acidity from the Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc. The Pinot Noir also adds texture. Drink now.
designation: Grains de Celles Rosé Extra Brut
title: Pierre Gerbais NV Grains de Celles Rosé Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Lifted notes of ripe, juicy apple are foremost on the nose. They also shine on the palate, where they are countered by a fine, gentle and creamy mousse and lovely freshness. This is beautifully composed, understated, fresh and elegant. The dry finish shines with lemon and echoes long.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Lifted notes of ripe, juicy apple are foremost on the nose. They also shine on the palate, where they are countered by a fine, gentle and creamy mousse and lovely freshness. This is beautifully composed, understated, fresh and elegant. The dry finish shines with lemon and echoes long.
title: Lucien Albrecht NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A full, spicy wine, with weight from wood and attractive fruits. There is a touch of stalkiness here, a sign of the vintage, but the wine is maturing well in a food-friendly way.
title: Château Haut Ballet 2007  Fronsac

description: From a tiny, seven-acre property in Saint-Estèphe, this is a Cabernet Sauvignon-dominated wine with black currant fruit and good, firm fruit tannins. There is a smoky wood element to balance the lively, youthful acidity.
title: Château Graves de Pez 2009  Saint-Estèphe

description: Tight acidity layers a wine that has freshness and a stalky character. Flavors of currants and acidity highlight its light fruitiness.
title: Château de Villeneuve 2009  Saumur-Champigny

description: Tight acidity layers a wine that has freshness and a stalky character. Flavors of currants and acidity highlight its light fruitiness.
title: Château de Villeneuve 2009  Saumur-Champigny

description: With good density, this is a success for the vintage. It has ripe, smooth fruit, flavors of black berry, the tannins well integrated. Age for a year.
title: Barton & Guestier 2007 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The crispness and acidity are very evident in this bright, fresh, strawberry-flavored wine. Drink soon for its delicious liveliness.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2009 Les Belles Vignes Rosé Pinot Noir (Sancerre)

description: A little rough around the edges, this wine still has some attractive black berry and damson flavors and shows acidity and a texture of dry tannins. For medium-term aging.
title: Château Fourcas Dupré 2007  Listrac-Médoc

description: Still very herbaceous, this Sauvignon Blanc-dominated wine is ripe, full of melon and peach flavors, with an attractive zesty character. There's enough structure for 2–3 years' aging.
title: Château Bertinerie 2008 Cru Réserve  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a ripe wine with tropical fruit flavors that are cut with fine green acidity. There is a good texture with some nerviness as well as lively acidity on the finish. It's a style of wine that needs food.
title: Château Tour d'Auron 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Herbaceous in character, this is a tight and tangy wine with crisp, grassy fruitiness. It has a rich palate, but maintains a tight and nervy feel to it. Best kept for a year before drinking.
title: Château Talbot 2012 Caillou Blanc  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a dense wine that has plenty of fresh fruit to support its weight. It's quite tannic though, so enjoy with food. It could also do with time, so wait two years.
title: Château Rivensan 2011  Bordeaux

description: This is an intense wine that is full of fresh fruits, rich green plum and apricot flavors, as well as a creamed apple character. It is weighty and generous, while at the end, the wine offers a more tangy, tight aftertaste.
title: Château Les Combes 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Freshness dominates this bright, fruity wine. There are apple, pear and apricot flavors with just the lightest touch of vanilla. At the end, the wine shows a great tangy character, full of lemon and grapefruit zest.
title: Château La Rame 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This light, fresh and creamy wine balances cool acidity and bright citrus and apple-peel flavors. It is poised, fruity with a crisp, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2014 Cruet Altesse (Vin de Savoie)

description: This light, fresh and creamy wine balances cool acidity and bright citrus and apple-peel flavors. It is poised, fruity with a crisp, refreshing aftertaste.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2014 Cruet Altesse (Vin de Savoie)

description: This tight, full-bodied wine has rich citrus and crisp apple flavors. It is textured, spicy and with a mineral background. With this sense of structure, the wine needs to age a few months, so drink from late 2015.
title: Domaine de la Vieille Cure 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This tight, full-bodied wine has rich citrus and crisp apple flavors. It is textured, spicy and with a mineral background. With this sense of structure, the wine needs to age a few months, so drink from late 2015.
title: Domaine de la Vieille Cure 2013 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a lightly textured wine with crisp acidity and a chalky, mineral feel. Concentration from the old vines will allow it to age for a few more months. Drink this fruity, tightly woven wine from 2016.
designation: Clos de la Fontaine Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie
title: Domaine de la Foliette 2013 Clos de la Fontaine Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a ripe, full-bodied wine with already rounded texture and fresh pear flavors. It is perfumed, richly textured, the acidity a balanced part of the fruitiness of the wine. It needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Moncontour 2014 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Steely, minerally and very textured, this has concentratio and taut layer of acidity to go with the lime fruit. Powered by its structure, it will age for 3–4 years.
title: Romain Bouchard 2010 Vau de Vey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Honey and wood aromas lead to a rich, generally rounded wine. Having aged in wood, the white fruits are full, soft and ripe. It's not all immediate pleasure; the wine has a more complex undertow of structure, sweet malolactic character and complex acidity on the finish.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2010 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a structured wine with rich, concentrated fruits. It has a strong mineral content along with a tense texture. Tropical fruit flavors come through on the rich, opulent finish.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is a taut wine, touched by yeast and warmed by ripe yellow fruit. Flavors of melon and spice from the new wood give it an open feel. It's ripe, already rounded and full bodied.
title: Louis Latour 2010 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: A beautifully perfumed wine from one of Volnay's top vineyards, this delights with its aromatic red fruits, ripe tannins and balancing acids. It is still settling down and will certainly round out over the next years when its more sumptuous side will come forward.
title: Joseph Faiveley 2010 Santenots Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: This blend of premier crus and some village Côte de Beaune shows generous red-cherry fruit and a touch of acidity. Its depth of richness and complexity highlight its fine origins.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2010  Côte de Beaune

description: This is a floral wine that combines structure, firm acidity and intensely ripe fruit. Flavors of green fruit, citrus, toast and some smoke give complexity to this concentrated, full-bodied effort.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Les Combettes Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This is a floral wine that combines structure, firm acidity and intensely ripe fruit. Flavors of green fruit, citrus, toast and some smoke give complexity to this concentrated, full-bodied effort.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Les Combettes Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Big and rounded, this will eventually develop into a ripe, complex wine. Spice and toast notes merge with the yellow fruits and structured nervosity.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 La Romanée Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Taut, and closed, this is very structured. The green fruits, mineral structure and flinty character offer a severe, complex wine. Layered with a caramel note, this is set to age over many years. Screwcap.
designation: Les Vaillons Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru
title: Domaine Laroche 2010 Les Vaillons Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is rich and ripe, with just a touch of wood influence. It has a tropical fruit and lime flavor, with lemon zest acidity. It is full, very structured and mineral, adding the complexity of ripe fruit. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is rich and ripe, with just a touch of wood influence. It has a tropical fruit and lime flavor, with lemon zest acidity. It is full, very structured and mineral, adding the complexity of ripe fruit. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2010 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a very drinkable Gigondas despite being very much in the savory-spicy style. Leather, garrigue, cinnamon and clove are the dominant notes, softened by silky tannins and modest cherry fruit. Drink now–2015.
title: Andrieux & Fils 2009  Gigondas

description: This is a food-friendly rosé that's full-bodied and rich. It has orange and apricot flavors, along with a note of red plum. The acidity keeps the wine fresh and crisp while the aftertaste has a fine tang of zest. Screwcap.
title: Château Riotor 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: If any rosé can be serious, it's this. It has structure as well as fruit, a sense of purpose, ripe red fruits and tight acidity. It could even age, so wait to drink it until late in summer 2014.
title: Château Deffends 2013 Cuvée Première Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From a parcel in the Osterberg Grand Cru vineyard, this is a blend of Riesling, Pinot Gris and Gewurztraminer. The spice dominates although it is cut through by Riesling acidity. It's not quite integrated, showing youthful exuberance that needs to settle down. Drink from 2016.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2010 Clos du Zahnacker White (Alsace)

description: This generous, almost opulent wine has both concentration and rounded fruits. It's open already, hinting at wood-aging while concentrating much more on the ripe fruits. Packed with fruit and tannins, it's densely textured. It will age, of course; don't start to drink before 2025.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2013  Pauillac

description: This is finely structured, a tense wine with great fruits and an intense texture. It's tight while bursting with fruit. The structure is complex, dense and very mineral in character. It is a wine that will need many years, so drink from 2022. The production is tiny, and what is not fit for this wine goes into the Dillon Clarté wine.
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is an impressive wine that transcends the problems of the vintage. It has rich fruit that is sustained by the tannic structure that rests on a bed of fresh blackberry fruits cut with fresh acidity. The wine will certainly age well. Don't think about drinking it before 2024.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: The production is tiny, yet the potential of this wine is enormous, with its tight, textured structure that is still so young. It is opulent and generous while still keeping a tight rein on its emotions. A steely core is surrounded by fruit that has hints of apricots as well as citrus. This will be a very fine wine but it needs many years, so wait until 2022.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: A delicate and elegant Riesling, light, fresh and perfumed. It has white fruits, a floral hedgerow character and a dry, more tight and nervy final character. Fruity while structured, it's ready to age a couple of years.
title: Domaine Moltès 2012 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Perfumed wine with some subtle overtones of spice, fresh fruits and acidity. It is a wine that has a rounded texture with just a final seasoning of pepper.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2011 Cuvée Engel Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Perfumed wine with some subtle overtones of spice, fresh fruits and acidity. It is a wine that has a rounded texture with just a final seasoning of pepper.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2011 Cuvée Engel Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Ripe, complex, wood-aged wine. It has weight in its structure and mineral texture. Along with this, there is rich fruitiness, yellow fruits laced with lime. Concentrated and dense, this is a powerful wine, showing great potential for the future. Keep for at least four years.
title: Château Fuissé 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Always one of the most impressive of the Grand Crus, Les Clos reveals itself slowly. This dense, wood aged wine is still firm, very mineral in texture, chewy and dense, Age this wine and don't drink before 2018.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2011 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: From the area known as Pierres Dorées because of the gold-colored stone used in buildings, this wine is soft and fruity. It carries a touch of tannin along with red-cherry crispness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons des Pierres Dorées 2015 Salamandre d'Or  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: From the area known as Pierres Dorées because of the gold-colored stone used in buildings, this wine is soft and fruity. It carries a touch of tannin along with red-cherry crispness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons des Pierres Dorées 2015 Salamandre d'Or  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This wine is crisp and fruity. It has attractive acidity, a nice touch of spice and a backbone of minerality. The juiciness leaves a bright, crisp aftertaste.
title: Domaine Ferret 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Ripe and fruity, this wine offers crisp apples and pear-juice flavors. It has a strongly tangy element that is refreshing and delicious now.
title: Louis Max 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: From outlying vineyards in the Côte d'Or, the heartland of Burgundy, this wood-aged wine is full of red currants and attractive, easy acidity. With a touch of spice and a juicy aftertaste, it is ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Bourgogne

description: From outlying vineyards in the Côte d'Or, the heartland of Burgundy, this wood-aged wine is full of red currants and attractive, easy acidity. With a touch of spice and a juicy aftertaste, it is ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Bourgogne

description: This wine is still young and developing. It is beginning to show its richer lemon and apple flavors, but it still needs more time. Wait until 2017.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This crisp, tangy wine is packed with citrus flavors. Brightly textured with a mineral edge, it is fruity, hinting at spice along with a floral, fresh character.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine des Chenevières  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: With its classic mineral edge, dusty tannins and firm, dry structure, the wine has a core that weighs well with the severe texture. As a contrast, the fruit underneath is ripe and juicy. A wine for several years' aging.
title: Les Astéries 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: With its classic mineral edge, dusty tannins and firm, dry structure, the wine has a core that weighs well with the severe texture. As a contrast, the fruit underneath is ripe and juicy. A wine for several years' aging.
title: Les Astéries 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: A powerful, chocolate- and berry fruit-flavored wine, powered by ripe tannins and juicy acidity. It has a solid foundation of tannins, on which is built a rich edifice of fruit.
title: Château la Fleur-Pétrus 2008  Pomerol

description: This formal, upright wine has solid, dense tannins and is well structured: with acidity and firm fruit, it shows its more opulent side slowly, leading to a smoky finish.
title: Château Beau-Séjour Bécot 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: Treated now as a separate wine, rather than a second wine, with its own vineyard, Clos du Marquis has developed a dense, concentrated style. It is firm, chewy, the tannins in suspension in the rich fruit. Good aging potential.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2008 Clos du Marquis  (Saint-Julien)

description: While at this young stage there may be toasty aromas, there is also intense, perfumed fruit. This complex, distinguished wine is polished, with plenty of bright fruits and acidity.
title: Château Haut-Bailly 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: The wine shows both rich density and structure. It gives weight while remaining stylish. The delicious black berry fruits on the finish characterize a wine that is classic, balancing fruit and tannins.
title: Château Canon la Gaffelière 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine has a lively mousse along with crisp acidity. Unusually for a rosé, the blend is 90% Chardonnay, the color coming from the addition of red wine (normal in Champagne). It shows some maturity with a hint of toastiness as well as a soft aftertaste on the sweet side of Brut. Drink now.
title: Petit & Bajan NV Nymphéa Brut Rosé Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: Only recently disgorged in July 2017, this bottling is still young. It is structured with a hint of tannin as well as a steely tight texture. It is going to develop into a fine wine, rich and with a blend of apple and ripe pear flavors. Drink this bottling from late 2018.
designation: Brut Nature Premier Cru Blanc de Noirs
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Nature Premier Cru Blanc de Noirs Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Beautifully aromatic notes of ripe apple make for a most appetizing nose. The soft fizz on the palate underlines both the fruity apple purity and the bready backdrop of autolysis. A very harmonious refreshing wine that is dry, utterly light and moreish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Les Natures Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Beautifully aromatic notes of ripe apple make for a most appetizing nose. The soft fizz on the palate underlines both the fruity apple purity and the bready backdrop of autolysis. A very harmonious refreshing wine that is dry, utterly light and moreish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Les Natures Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Soft, almost sweet, with considerable caramel and sweet strawberry flavors. There is an awkward final bitterness.
title: Château Bélingard 2008 Rosé (Bergerac)

description: Simple, clean, fresh, raspberry-flavored wine, with light acidity. There is an edge of apple and caramel, the aftertaste just off dry.
title: Yvon Mau 2008 Seigneurs de Bergerac Rosé (Bergerac)

description: A wonderfully aromatic nose of blossom and Conference pear is very appetizing. The palate comes in with pear-fruited generosity and an almost oily mouthfeel that speaks of the power of this concentrated wine. There is a pleasant edge of pithy bitterness that acts as a counterpoint to the inherent richness and ripeness of the fruit alongside fresh acidity. This is balanced and rounded and just off dry with a lovely, fresh structure that echoes long. There is great aging potential here. Drink 2017–2030.
designation: Clos Saint Landelin Vorbourg Grand Cru
title: René Muré 2015 Clos Saint Landelin Vorbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A wonderfully aromatic nose of blossom and Conference pear is very appetizing. The palate comes in with pear-fruited generosity and an almost oily mouthfeel that speaks of the power of this concentrated wine. There is a pleasant edge of pithy bitterness that acts as a counterpoint to the inherent richness and ripeness of the fruit alongside fresh acidity. This is balanced and rounded and just off dry with a lovely, fresh structure that echoes long. There is great aging potential here. Drink 2017–2030.
designation: Clos Saint Landelin Vorbourg Grand Cru
title: René Muré 2015 Clos Saint Landelin Vorbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: From one of the top of the new generation of Vouvray estates, this wine is a delicious medley of fruit flavors. With a touch of honey to go with the apple, and citrus to give extra freshness, this is a beautiful wine. It is very drinkable although still so young. Drink now if you can't wait, but it's better to hold on until 2021.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2015 Le Peu Morier  (Vouvray)

description: This wine comes from a parcel that is planted at a superhigh density of nearly 7,000 plants per acre. This gives the plants greater competition between each other and encourages concentration of the wine. That is true in this rich wine with its impeccable balance between white fruit and mineral texture from the chalk soil. The wine will age, so drink from 2020.
title: Château de Tracy 2014 Haute Densité  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Delicately sparkling, this creamy Champagne is crisp, fruity and on the dry side of Brut. It has citrus as well as pear flavors giving a fruity edge to the lively texture. This delicious wine should age a little longer, so drink from 2019.
designation: Nuit Blanche Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Petit & Bajan 2011 Nuit Blanche Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Delicately sparkling, this creamy Champagne is crisp, fruity and on the dry side of Brut. It has citrus as well as pear flavors giving a fruity edge to the lively texture. This delicious wine should age a little longer, so drink from 2019.
designation: Nuit Blanche Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Petit & Bajan 2011 Nuit Blanche Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: With some age, this bone-dry wine has softened and filled out. There's still a lemon aroma as well as crisp acidity on the palate, but they are less tight now, rounded and with a fine balance between fruit and acidity. It is still a year off maturity, so wait until 2018.
title: Lombard et Cie 2008 Brut Nature Grand Cru Millésime  (Champagne)

description: A rich floral notion of dandelion precedes the rich aroma of ripe peaches on the nose. The palate opens into a kind of vast peach mellowness, edged with a touch of citrus zest and a grounding, earthy element. A gentle sweetness boosts the peachy roundedness but does not dominate. This is gentle on the surface but very concentrated at the core. It is on the off-dry finish that the lemon zest comes though triumphantly. Drink 2017–2027.
title: Domaine Michel Fonne 2012 Marckrain Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A mellow touch of ripe Red Delicious apple hovers on the nose. The palate brims with rich fruit, showing candied pear and dried apple. This richness is countered by a pleasantly bitter phenolic edge and a pure streak of fresh zestiness. A touch of sandalwood and cinnamon adds spice around the edges. While this is attractive now, it will reward cellaring as far more interesting notes of spice and fruit are sure to develop. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2015 Frankstein Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This blend of equal parts of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay is impressive. On the dry side of Brut, it is crisp, tight with intense acidity and a nervy texture that will soften. It's a perfumed, structured wine full of potential with its citrus and spice flavors. Drink this bottling from 2019.
title: Chanoine NV Tzarina No 1 Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fine blend of equal parts of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, this ripe wine is crisp with acidity and a nervy mineral texture. It is still young, still tight and structured. But it will be a fine wine as it matures. Drink from 2019.
title: Chanoine 2012 Tsarine Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fine blend of equal parts of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, this ripe wine is crisp with acidity and a nervy mineral texture. It is still young, still tight and structured. But it will be a fine wine as it matures. Drink from 2019.
title: Chanoine 2012 Tsarine Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: Made exclusively from Pinot Noir, this is a rich and highly textured wine. Red fruit aromas yield a ripe impression on the palate, while at the same time, it is dry and crisp in tangy acidity, with a zesty lemon flourish. This food-friendly wine is ready to drink.
designation: Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Noirs
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Noirs Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Made exclusively from Pinot Noir, this is a rich and highly textured wine. Red fruit aromas yield a ripe impression on the palate, while at the same time, it is dry and crisp in tangy acidity, with a zesty lemon flourish. This food-friendly wine is ready to drink.
designation: Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Noirs
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Grand Cru Brut Blanc de Noirs Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This perfumed and floral wine is concentrated and dense. Its ripe black-plum and spice flavors are impressive with their intensity. Produced from biodynamically grown grapes, the wine is showing considerable aging potential. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Domaine Amirault 2014 Le Fondis  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: This fruity wine is full of juicy red berries that are laced with acidity. Hints of wood aging stay in the background of this essentially fresh and bright wine.
title: Château les Mottes Pradier 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: This young, fruity wine is almost ready to drink. Attractive black currant acidity and light tannins t bring a bite to the natural smoothness of the wine. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Chai Neuf 2012  Bordeaux

description: This young, fruity wine is almost ready to drink. Attractive black currant acidity and light tannins t bring a bite to the natural smoothness of the wine. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Chai Neuf 2012  Bordeaux

description: The wine is attractively fruity, its crispness balanced by round apple and pear flavors that give richness. It has a creamy texture, concentrated acidity and a finish that brings out lemon and lime.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine is attractively fruity, its crispness balanced by round apple and pear flavors that give richness. It has a creamy texture, concentrated acidity and a finish that brings out lemon and lime.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: For the vintage, this is a surprisingly lean wine. Some juicy fruit is still struggling out of the very dry tannic shell. Acidity is a dominant character of this firm, dry wine.
title: Château Blanchereau 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: Steely and crisp, this tight, very fresh wine is full of lemon zest and grapefruit flavors. It's bright, light, and taut as a wire.
title: Les Vignerons des Terroirs de la Noëlle 2013 Domaine de l'Aurière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)
winery: Les Vignerons des Terroirs de la Noëlle

description: It still tastes very young with its aggressive acidity and herbaceous character. It's mineral, tight, with zesty lemon, lime and strong gooseberry flavors. It needs until 2015 to calm down.
title: Les Vignerons des Coteaux Romanais 2013 Château de Pont Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: A yeasty character masks the fresh fruitiness. Underneath the bready notes, grapefruit and other attractive citrus flavors are waiting to get out. Wait until 2015 to see if the wine improves.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2012 Cuvée Les Caillottes  (Sancerre)

description: This soft and rounded wine has attractive lemon, peach and almond flavors. It's crisp while showing touches of honey that give a riper feel. It's ready to drink
title: Domaine du Petit Coteau 2013 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Still young and dry, it has an austere, lean side that is still a way from being mature. Some juiciness gives a fresher potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Métairie Neuve 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: Fruity, and crisp, it has citrus flavors balanced by an intense herbal character. It's fresh and juicy; the acidity gives a bright, lively aftertaste.
title: Château de Parenchère 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This attractively soft wine is as gentle as the Gascony countryside, made with grapes from this region. It brings together many citrus flavors along with hints of pineapple and richer fruits. Drink now.
title: Famille Laplace 2016 Aramis Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This spicy, fruity wine, which includes the rare spicy Egiodola grape, is crisp with acidity and red currant fruit. With its touch of caramel, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is Gascony's classic grape blend in a wine that's both herbal and juicily fruity. Soft and light, with citrus and white currant flavors, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2016 Colombard-Ugni Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Soft and bright with red berry fruit, this is a warm, open and easy wine. It has a gentle texture and just enough tannins to give it shape. Drink now.
title: Château Saint-Florian 2016  Bordeaux

description: All tangy fruit, this simple wine is light, with citrus and crisp pear flavors. A touch of honey adds a soft side while keeping its zesty fruit right in place. Drink now.
title: Château l'Orangerie 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: An attractive, creamy textured wine with apple as well as citrus fruits. It is soft, smooth although with plenty of acidity to keep it lively. Drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2016 Cedrus le Blanc Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Red fruit and wood are both prominent in this wine. A juicy red-currant character shows through the high-toast flavor. Attractive and fruity, it is likely to develop quickly. Drink this soft wine from 2018.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014 Gravières Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: The wine is just off dry, with a soft tropical-fruit character. It has pineapple as well as lemon fruit, crisp acidity and dried apricot flavors. The wine is crisp at the end, and ready to drink.
title: Famille Laplace 2015 Aramis Petit Manseng-Sauvignon White (Vin de France)

description: This open, soft wine brings out some of the ripe fruit flavors of the vintage. It has attractive melon and apricot fruit along with a tight streak of mineral acidity. It's ready to drink now, although it will be better from 2017.
title: Domaine Perraud 2015 L'Oeuvre de Perraud  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Toasty and ripe, this is a smooth, lightly textured wine full of yellow fruits lifted by crisp apple and lime juice. Rich while also fresh, it's a warm wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Valanges 2014 Paquet Mathieu  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is a ripe and structured wine with great fruit and still some firm tannins. It has layers of black-currant acidity along with the dry core that signal the potential to age further. The blend of 50-50 Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon gives the wine firmness while allowing plenty of expression for the exuberant fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Bernard Magrez 2011 Château du Galan  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Although the wood aging shows strongly at this stage, this is a wine that will develop well. Already its blackberry fruits show ripe juicy character that blends well with the generous tannins and acidity. It should be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Rousset-Caillau 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is the second wine of Laroze, a property situated on the plateau to the west of Saint-Émilion. This is a softly ripe and perfumed wine with 40% Cabernet Franc in the blend. It is rich, smooth and dense with black fruits and balanced acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Laroze 2012 Lady Laroze  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This is the second wine of Laroze, a property situated on the plateau to the west of Saint-Émilion. This is a softly ripe and perfumed wine with 40% Cabernet Franc in the blend. It is rich, smooth and dense with black fruits and balanced acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Laroze 2012 Lady Laroze  (Saint-Émilion)
