description: This structured wine with big, bold red fruits offers ripe acidity, a dense texture and considerable concentration. It also has the hallmark freshness of the vintage that balances the strong aging potential. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: This structured wine with big, bold red fruits offers ripe acidity, a dense texture and considerable concentration. It also has the hallmark freshness of the vintage that balances the strong aging potential. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Lovely cassis and jam scents are hampered by some slight musty aromas, which eventually give way to a blast of black licorice. Burnt sugar and cassis dominate the soft, sweetish palate that offers just a bit of grip. The short finish is reminiscent of a raspberry cordial. Drink up.
title: Les Jamelles 2006 Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Juicy but crisp, textbook Syrah aromas of meat and game mix with plum and floral aromas on the nose, while the palate shows a pleasant core of cherry, which persists on the medium finish. Try with barbecued meat.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2006 La Violette Syrah (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: This structured wine has ripe black fruits followed by red berries. There is a good depth of flavor, the tannins giving the bright fruit weight and a mouthfilling character.
title: Château Sainte Barbe 2006 Merlot  (Bordeaux)

description: Charming and straightforward, barnyard, charred meat and manure notes on the nose lead to a palate perfumed with mixed berry compote. Shows the faintest grip on the shortish finish. Try with baby lamb chops.
title: Montpezat 2007 Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Starts off with a bit of a sweaty funk that soon blows off and allows more pleasant notes of bay leaves, thyme, red currant and rhubarb to come through. A touch sanguine and mulchy in the mouth with lighter body and acidity.
title: Lorgeril 2005 La Combe Des Oliviers Red (Corbières)

description: Starts off with a bit of a sweaty funk that soon blows off and allows more pleasant notes of bay leaves, thyme, red currant and rhubarb to come through. A touch sanguine and mulchy in the mouth with lighter body and acidity.
title: Lorgeril 2005 La Combe Des Oliviers Red (Corbières)

description: Both the gorgeous purple color and the nose of fresh grapes make this wine a dead ringer for Beaujolais. The soft palate shows notes of sweet strawberries but has sufficient acidity to leave a refreshing impression in the mouth. Drink now.
title: Les Jamelles 2007 Pinot Noir (Vin de Pays de L'Aude)

description: Crisp acidity marks this mouthwatering white. Intense aromas of lemon and grass make for an intriguing nose. The palate is a bit dull, although the acidity gives the minerally finish a bit of staying power and makes it a good foil for fresh seafood.
title: Domaine Begude 2007 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A wine that tries too hard. The extract is strong, giving some bitterness. And, although the berry fruits are sweet and rich, the tannins edge the fruit with hardness. On the finish, some smokiness enhances the black currant juice, but that astringency just won't go away.
title: Barton & Guestier 2006 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Margaux)

description: Dark in style, as is often the case here, with a hard, tough edge. It is austere, the fruit a mere hint in the background. It does have potential, although this will come slowly.
title: Château Haut Bages Libéral 2008  Pauillac

description: This wine is on the austere, lean side, with firm tannins and fruit that is still only just showing and therefore lacking depth of flavor. The finish has attractive red berry fruits.
title: Château Durfort-Vivens 2008  Margaux

description: Beautiful and appetizing notes of Cox Orange Pippin apples shine. The palate is zesty, sprightly and textured, and shows pure fruit—a combination that spells ideal refreshment. The lemony fillip on the finish is lip-smacking.
title: Dopff & Irion 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tender, freshly cut yellow pears and yellow plums play on a rounded, rich and almost oily palate that remains dry but expresses richness in terms of texture and mouthfeel, edged with earthy and nutty notes. This finishes exquisitely clean.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2012 Les Élements Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Saint-Maur's vines are planted close to Saint-Tropez in one of the warmest sectors of the Provence coast. This wine is firm and tannic, with signs of bitter coffee from extraction that are balanced by the ripe black-currant flavors. It will develop well; drink after 2017.
title: Château Saint-Maur 2013 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: So pale, this wine is almost white. The fruit and the red-berry flavors are definitely those of a rosé, a fruity, full wine with a touch of spice as well as a tight, mineral texture. Weight and ripeness are balanced by a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaines Ott 2014 Château de Selle Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This impressively concentrated wine focuses on the brilliant red fruits that shine through the generous texture. It is ripe, with a streak of fresh acidity at the end to give the essential refreshing aftertaste.
title: Domaine Gavoty 2014 Cuvée Clarendon Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Rolle, or Vermentino, has produced a warm, herbal, southern sun-touched wine. It is full of rich yellow fruits and laced with acidity. A light touch of honey from the ripe fruits gives a deliciously smooth aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2014 L'Esprit de Provence Rolle (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Rolle, or Vermentino, has produced a warm, herbal, southern sun-touched wine. It is full of rich yellow fruits and laced with acidity. A light touch of honey from the ripe fruits gives a deliciously smooth aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2014 L'Esprit de Provence Rolle (Côtes de Provence)

description: Earthy notes and yeasty richness swing along the aromatic lemon bouquet. On the very slight, slender palate these flavors appear linear and leave a feeling of near weightlessness. Savory tones of yeast make themselves felt on the long, gossamer finish.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2013 Les Éléments Riesling (Alsace)

description: This blend of 40% Syrah, 30% Grenache and 30% Carignan opens with attractive aromas of fudgy brownie, mocha latte, dried cherry and raspberry sauce. Medium weight and plush, it's rich and attractive, but not overly done, with flavors of blackberry and cherry that lead into a spicy finish of black pepper and roasted cocoa nib.
title: Château Tourril 2011 Philippe Red (Minervois)

description: A blend of 80% Syrah and 20% Grenache, this boasts assertive aromas and flavors of ripe black cherry, raspberry, bramble and licorice root, with accents of black pepper and cocoa powder. The velvety tannins frame the dark fruit core on the palate, with lingering notes of dried fig and charred pepper on the close.
title: Château Tourril 2010 Panatella Syrah-Grenache (Minervois)

description: Pale in color, this ripe, full-bodied wine has a rich core of red fruits and spicy acidity. The wine is concentrated while still keeping elegance and fresh fruitiness. The aftertaste is full and smooth.
title: Château les Crostes 2014 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pale in color, this ripe, full-bodied wine has a rich core of red fruits and spicy acidity. The wine is concentrated while still keeping elegance and fresh fruitiness. The aftertaste is full and smooth.
title: Château les Crostes 2014 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rounded red apple with an edge of peppery spice and a whole lot of grapefruit zest makes for a lively, textured and vivid palate. This is fresh, pure and totally appetizing. The finish similarly leaves the impression of peppery red apples.
title: François Baur 2014 Herrenweg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Rounded red apple with an edge of peppery spice and a whole lot of grapefruit zest makes for a lively, textured and vivid palate. This is fresh, pure and totally appetizing. The finish similarly leaves the impression of peppery red apples.
title: François Baur 2014 Herrenweg Riesling (Alsace)

description: The lifted, lemony scent promises purity and poise, while the palate delivers what nature provided: pure, crunchy fruit and the flavor of stone. This is dry and clean-cut in its traditional style, with potential to develop.
title: Boeckel 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: The lifted, lemony scent promises purity and poise, while the palate delivers what nature provided: pure, crunchy fruit and the flavor of stone. This is dry and clean-cut in its traditional style, with potential to develop.
title: Boeckel 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: One of many excellent values to be found among the 2012 Southern Rhône wines, this is supple in style, with ripe cherry and chocolate accented by vanilla and sandalwood. Drink now–2016.
title: Brotte 2012 Esprít Barville Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Burgundy- and California-based Boisset's Rhône outpost has turned out an excellent value in this medium-bodied, firmly structured 2012. Black cherry and leather notes predominate, but pick up welcome hints of espresso, black olive and clove. Drink now–2017.
title: Louis Bernard 2012 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The two signature white grapes of Côtes de Gascogne give a wine flavored with tropical fruit and honey. It is delicate, ripe and just off dry. The wine is ready to drink although it will be better at the end of 2015.
title: Domaine Uby 2014 No. 4 Gros & Petit Manseng White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The varieties in the blend include Grenache Blanc, Roussanne and Viognier. They come together to offer hints of pineapple, pear and citrus. There's a silky texture on the palate, then a clean, crisp finish.
title: Laudun Chusclan 2013 Luna White (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: The varieties in the blend include Grenache Blanc, Roussanne and Viognier. They come together to offer hints of pineapple, pear and citrus. There's a silky texture on the palate, then a clean, crisp finish.
title: Laudun Chusclan 2013 Luna White (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: A full and ripe wine, it is richly layered with black fruits, soft tannins and a juicy, warm aftertaste. The acidity at the end adds a little freshness. It's made to be drunk now.
title: Kirkland Signature 2011  Médoc

description: With considerable spicy, smoky wood, this is a rich, while extracted, wine. It does have some juicy fruit that shows potential so it should soften and become less bitter. Drink from 2017.
title: Château l'Argenteyre 2011  Médoc

description: A light and rather stalky wine from the flat plain close to the Dordogne river. It has some black currant flavors that are firmed out by dry tannins. The aftertaste is fresh and juicy.
title: Château Joly 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Weight and dense tannins go with the firm black fruits and acidity, producing a wine that is spicy, fruity and likely to age quickly. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Ducla 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Light and fruity, this is a fresh, rounded wine with attractive berry fruits. It is already smooth, although the tannins are in the background. It's fragrant with a medium-term potential. Drink from 2015.
title: Château d'Arcins 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Smooth and rich, this is full of ripe apricot and peach flavors that warmly embrace the palate. A vanilla flavor adds softness. On the finish, juicy acidity cuts in to give a crisper feel.
title: Pierre André 2010  Chablis

description: This is deliciously crisp and steely, with an apple flavor and the weight of citrus and grapefruit. It has a minerally, chalky feel, and then the wine rounds out, with crisp fruit on the finish.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2010 Drouhin-Vaudun Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Full, soft and rich, this has flavors of ripe yellow fruit and red apple, with a textured edge. The wine is round and layered with delicious acidity. While its already to drink now, it will age for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is rich and rounded, with ripe apple and peach flavors. It has a good depth of flavor that comes from the complex play between toast and sweet fruit notes. It has weight, and it can age over the next two years.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2010  Chablis

description: In the range of what Clos Troteligotte calls micro-parcels, this is in the middle. It's full of generous black fruits and attendant acidity. At the same time, it is young and still coming together. The future promises great concentration and depth of flavor. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2012 K Malbec (Cahors)

description: A dark and dense wine that has solid tannins and tight, juicy acidity. Its texture is very mineral, firm, complex and still needing to age. From a single vineyard in Morgon, it offers the powerful side of a Beaujolais cru, powered both by fruit and by structure. Drink now.
title: Château de Bellevue 2009 Le Clos  (Morgon)

description: This is true Tannat, black colored, powerful and firm. It also has fruit weight, potentially delicious black plums, damsons and dark berries that give aging potential. For now, it has tannins, a dark, brooding character and concentration. Age at least until 2018.
title: Château d'Aydie 2011 Tannat (Madiran)

description: This is true Tannat, black colored, powerful and firm. It also has fruit weight, potentially delicious black plums, damsons and dark berries that give aging potential. For now, it has tannins, a dark, brooding character and concentration. Age at least until 2018.
title: Château d'Aydie 2011 Tannat (Madiran)

description: A pure gold color, this gorgeous, rich wine also has a fresh lightness that allows it to dance out of the glass. Yellow fruits and honey dominate, while there is a good acidity at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Château d'Aydie 2011  Pacherenc du Vic Bilh

description: The power and complexity of wines from the slope of the Côte de Py is very evident in this wine. Densely argued, it is a solid wine with red fruits and a strong minerality from the volcanic soil. The acidity and tannic structure promise aging, and the wine will be best drunk from 2016.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: The power and complexity of wines from the slope of the Côte de Py is very evident in this wine. Densely argued, it is a solid wine with red fruits and a strong minerality from the volcanic soil. The acidity and tannic structure promise aging, and the wine will be best drunk from 2016.
title: Château des Jacques 2012 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: For a wine meant to be consumed now, this is almost too tannic. It has bright fruit and a flavor of black currant skin, plus a dry, tannic core.
title: Albert Bichot 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Light, fruity and herbaceous, this has a crisp grapefruit flavor, laced with lemon. Soft and fresh, this is ready to drink now.
title: Château Laulerie 2011 White (Bergerac Sec)

description: The wood influence in this wine is almost too much for the fruit, even in the future. It has a severe, burnt character that shows an herb flavor and a tight texture.
title: Château La Grange de Bessan 2010  Médoc

description: This is classic and fun, bold and fruity, with weight coming from the firm tannins. Pair this with food.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais)

description: Similar in style to a Côtes de Gascogne, this is a fruity, ripe and attractively light wine. The crisp, refreshing palate dances along.
title: Baron d'Arignac 2011 White (Gers)

description: Flavors of banana and red berry come with some tannin. This exudes vibrant, in-your-face fruit that's crisp and juicy.
title: Mommessin 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais)

description: Flavors of banana and red berry come with some tannin. This exudes vibrant, in-your-face fruit that's crisp and juicy.
title: Mommessin 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais)

description: This wine is mostly comprised of Merlot that was sourced from 30 different parcels. It is smooth and ripe, with red berry fruits, soft tannins and attractive acids. From the hands of top consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt, this simple Bordeaux has character and style.
title: Les Parcelles de Stéphane Derenoncourt 2011  Bordeaux

description: Fresh, juicy black berry fruits and a dominant layer of acidity cover the wood spice and toast in this wine. It is fruity more than hugely structured, despite its dry tannins. The acidity continues right through, leaving a vivid, mouthwatering aftertaste.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2005 K Price Malbec (Cahors)

description: Fresh, juicy black berry fruits and a dominant layer of acidity cover the wood spice and toast in this wine. It is fruity more than hugely structured, despite its dry tannins. The acidity continues right through, leaving a vivid, mouthwatering aftertaste.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2005 K Price Malbec (Cahors)

description: The original “black wine” of Cahors is obviously alive and well—and living in the Loire valley, to judge by the color of this wine. Made from ungrafted Malbec, this is rich, unoaked, a ripe but stalky textured wine that gives great perfumes and a firm, juicy and tannic aftertaste.
title: Henry Marionnet 2007 Vinifera Malbec (Touraine)

description: In the strange world of Champagne, Sec (dry) on the label means a wine that is less dry than Brut. It is more to do with fullness and weight than sugar. This wine bears ripe fruit, flavors of peaches, creamy pears and light nougat and spice character. Pair this with richly sauced foods.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne Sec  (Champagne)

description: With just the right amount of bottle age, this is a vintage to drink now. It has light, sweet pastry flavors, some toast and yellow peach and strawberry flavors. Delicious, but not for keeping.
title: Moët & Chandon 2000 Grand Vintage Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Full and ripe, this wine has the ease of the 2000 vintage but has integrated textured acidity and some powerful green and white fruit flavors. There is an attractive yeast element to add complexity.
title: De Venoge 2000 Brut Millésimé  (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe, soft and warmly fruity wine. It has red cherry and strawberry flavors that lend a feeling of richness and roundness in texture. The acidity provides structure to this wine, but it is developing fast and will be ready to drink in 2015.
designation: Cuvée Signature Clos du Roi Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Clos du Roi Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This is a ripe, soft and warmly fruity wine. It has red cherry and strawberry flavors that lend a feeling of richness and roundness in texture. The acidity provides structure to this wine, but it is developing fast and will be ready to drink in 2015.
designation: Cuvée Signature Clos du Roi Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Clos du Roi Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: There is some toasty maturity that adds richness to the crisp apple-skin and tight, tense acidity on the palate of this NV Montaudon. It's a very brisk, clean, light wine with a dry, bright finish.
title: Montaudon NV Réserve Première Brut  (Champagne)

description: A pretty onion-skin colored wine, this has soft texture, light acidity and a warm, rounded character. Tart red currants provide freshness and crispness to a palate that's weighty and concentrated with flavor. A finely balanced wine that can be drunk now.
title: JCB NV No 69 Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Aged in new wood, this wine is warm and rich with spicy vanilla and apricot notes. It has green plum, yellow cherry and citrus flavors that are nicely rolled into a balanced package. It can be drunk now, but would be better to wait a year.
title: Henri de Villamont 2010 Millénaire  (Bourgogne)

description: This big and ripe wine is abundant in red and yellow fruit notes. It has a warm feel, with piercing acidity throughout. This full-bodied wine is perfect to be paired with food.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2012 Le Pont Rosé (Bandol)

description: A firm wine that has solid, dry tannins as well as rich fruit. It shows minerality, structure and a firm character that suggests potential for aging. The wine also has rich fruit that balances the density well, its acidity cutting through. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Myon de l'Enclos 2010  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: A firm wine that has solid, dry tannins as well as rich fruit. It shows minerality, structure and a firm character that suggests potential for aging. The wine also has rich fruit that balances the density well, its acidity cutting through. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Myon de l'Enclos 2010  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: The blend of Cabernet Franc and Tannat allows this wine to be released young and for the tannins to be accessible. It's young and fresh, Nouveau in its style, going for bright berry fruits and lively acidity.
title: Château Peyros 2008 Magenta Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: The blend of Cabernet Franc and Tannat allows this wine to be released young and for the tannins to be accessible. It's young and fresh, Nouveau in its style, going for bright berry fruits and lively acidity.
title: Château Peyros 2008 Magenta Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: Tart, fresh and a bit chunky and rustic, this blend of 60% Syrah, 20% Grenache and 20% Cinsaut features bold lime notes, scouring acidity and hints of crushed stone. Drink now.
title: Château de Pourcieux 2009 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A creamy style of Sauvignon Blanc, showing soft pear juice and flora flavors, fresh with a feeling of richness. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2009 Sauvignon Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A touch of fresh bay leaf, wet earth and musk rose combine to make a very enticing intriguing nose. The resolutely dry palate carries these lovely aromatics with zesty freshness and lovely zesty texture that is reminiscent of grapefruit peel. It is its abiding freshness that makes this stand out.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2015 Turckheim Muscat (Alsace)

description: A touch of fresh bay leaf, wet earth and musk rose combine to make a very enticing intriguing nose. The resolutely dry palate carries these lovely aromatics with zesty freshness and lovely zesty texture that is reminiscent of grapefruit peel. It is its abiding freshness that makes this stand out.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2015 Turckheim Muscat (Alsace)

description: Sumptuous peach comes across as almost overripe. There certainly is opulence on the rich almost oily palate. Flavors are very concentrated and have edges of caramel and barley sugar, but these are balanced by freshness and a pithy welcomed bitterness. This finishes medium sweet with lingering flavors of both zest and peach.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2012 Frankstein Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Maturity gives a bruised apple aroma to the generous mellowness of ripe pear on the nose. The palate is more taut than the nose leads you to expect, but there is concentration and richness and more bruised apple skin texture. Fruit, evolved flavors and freshness make for an intriguing wine. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2011 Frankstein Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Maturity gives a bruised apple aroma to the generous mellowness of ripe pear on the nose. The palate is more taut than the nose leads you to expect, but there is concentration and richness and more bruised apple skin texture. Fruit, evolved flavors and freshness make for an intriguing wine. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2011 Frankstein Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The home chateau of the group of properties owned by the Guyon family, this estate has produced a solid very ageworthy wine. It has dark tannins and rich juicy black fruits. With its structure and bright berry and plum flavors, it will not be ready to drink before 2020.
title: Château Rollan de By 2014  Médoc

description: The home chateau of the group of properties owned by the Guyon family, this estate has produced a solid very ageworthy wine. It has dark tannins and rich juicy black fruits. With its structure and bright berry and plum flavors, it will not be ready to drink before 2020.
title: Château Rollan de By 2014  Médoc

description: Ripe Merlot gives this wine its richness and concentration. It is filled with black fruits, hints of the wood aging and with tannins cushioned by the fruit. Acidity shows strongly at the end, leaving a bright aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Quintus 2014 Le Dragon de Quintus  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This a finely perfumed wine with its 32% Cabernet Franc, unusual for this estate. It gives a wine with great structure and concentration as well as layers of ripe black fruits. The wine needs to age so drink from 2023.
title: Château Nenin 2014  Pomerol

description: This a finely perfumed wine with its 32% Cabernet Franc, unusual for this estate. It gives a wine with great structure and concentration as well as layers of ripe black fruits. The wine needs to age so drink from 2023.
title: Château Nenin 2014  Pomerol

description: Ripe tropical fruits along with intense sweet lemon give this wine its fine acidity and ripe character. It is pure, clear and clean with lively acidity and a tangy zingy aftertaste that also brings in some minerality. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2014 Aigle d'Argent  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a fine wood-aged blend of 57% Cabernet Sauvignon with Merlot and Petit Verdot. It is darkly colored, dense and with great ripe tannins. One of several Bordeaux properties owned by the Thiénot family, this estate occupies a fine, gravel outcrop in the Pessac-Léognan region, just south of Bordeaux. Drink from 2024.
title: Château la Garde 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a fine wood-aged blend of 57% Cabernet Sauvignon with Merlot and Petit Verdot. It is darkly colored, dense and with great ripe tannins. One of several Bordeaux properties owned by the Thiénot family, this estate occupies a fine, gravel outcrop in the Pessac-Léognan region, just south of Bordeaux. Drink from 2024.
title: Château la Garde 2014  Pessac-Léognan

description: Owned by the Cruse family, part of the old Bordeaux elite, the estate is in the southern Médoc. The wine, with its firm character and rounded fruit, has weight and considerable richness. It will develop into a plush full-bodied wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Château du Taillan 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: The wine has weight, tannins and a firm structure. At the same time, its ripe black fruits are developing to fill out the structure and give an impressive wine. Hints of dark chocolate go with the juicy acidity to leave a wine that has several years to develop. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Branas Grand Poujeaux 2014  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: The great dominance of Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend has given this wine both a fine structure and crisp swathes of black-currant fruit. It is a firm wine at this stage, although the fine fruitiness will become an important part of the taste. The estate is named after one of Napoleon's generals who became King of Sweden. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Bernadotte 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: A touch of wet stone and wet earth accompanies the scent of ripe pear on the nose. The palate, therefore, surprises with luscious, off-dry peachiness and ample fruit: ripe pears and juicy peaches abound with expressive flavor. Their generosity is met with lemony freshness. This is utterly moreish and seductive with a lemony, just off-dry finish that makes you want to sip again.
title: Antoine Moltès & Fils 2015 Steinert Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A ripe, pure wine of red fruit around a core of toast, dominated by vital acidity and an edge of dry tannins. The wine is linear, finely balanced, fruity and exuberant.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2008 Champs Pimont  (Beaune)

description: This normally rich Meursault has gone into overdrive in 2009, producing a superopulent wine. It does, however, balance that with fine acidity and a mineral edge. It opens slowly to give its apple and peach fruits.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2009 Clos des Poruzots Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A charming and rich wine, with tannins that nestle within the soft texture. It is approachable, packed with ripe red fruits in an attractive juicy texture. The finish has enticing acidity.
title: Louis Latour 2009 Les Chatelots  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: A charming and rich wine, with tannins that nestle within the soft texture. It is approachable, packed with ripe red fruits in an attractive juicy texture. The finish has enticing acidity.
title: Louis Latour 2009 Les Chatelots  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This is a fresh while also rich wine. Yellow fruits are laced with appealing acidity and a crisp lemon zest texture. Lively, fruity and mineral, it is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012 Domaine Drouhin-Vaudon  (Chablis)

description: This ripe and full-bodied wine has a wonderful balance between pure acidity and ripe yellow fruits. From chalk and clay soils, it's both mineral and rich, both fresh and warm. It could be drunk now, although it will be much better from 2016.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2013 Authentique  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This ripe and soft wine has a great balance between the rich red berry fruits, bright cherries and acidity. The structure is full, generous and gives the wine a comfortable feel. Acidity at the end lends a fresher aspect. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Parigot 2013 Les Peuillets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: The pale, pink-gray color indicates how light this wine is. It does have attractive red fruits, crisp acidity and a refreshing shot of green apples, all packaged in a dancing, buoyant body. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Caseneuve 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: While Savigny is better known for its red wines, its whites have a rich, soft character that makes them accessible when young. This wine, from 40-year-old vines and aged lightly in wood, is structured, mineral and full of crisp green and white fruits. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2012  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: This is a nonvintage with bottle age, giving richness along with toast. The primary fruits are melting into a full, almond and yeast wine that fills the mouth with its concentration and citrus hints. This is a style for those who like rich but dry Champagne.
title: Perrier Jouët NV Grand Brut  (Champagne)

description: Shot through with minerality, almost flinty, this wine shows its vintage well. The red fruit element is now only a small part of what is now a fully mature wine. But the steely edge and tannic structure show that it will age, probably 10 years or more.
title: Ruinart 1996 Dom Ruinart Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A complex Champagne, with its apricot, green plum and pink grapefruit flavors, mixed with a rich, creamy texture and soft acidity. The final tastes are of lychees, with some toastiness.
title: Chartogne-Taillet NV Tête de Cuvée Fiacre Brut  (Champagne)

description: A complex Champagne, with its apricot, green plum and pink grapefruit flavors, mixed with a rich, creamy texture and soft acidity. The final tastes are of lychees, with some toastiness.
title: Chartogne-Taillet NV Tête de Cuvée Fiacre Brut  (Champagne)

description: This young vintage is outside the usual Grande Année range of vintages. Bollinger sees the unique heat of 2003 as a reason to make a special vintage for release early. The wine is rich, but being Bollinger, the richness has translated into the full character of the house style. It is relatively dry, packed with white fruits. Not for aging. Drink now.
title: Bollinger 2003 2003 by Bollinger Brut  (Champagne)

description: A full, ripe creamy wine with a fine balance between fresh red berries and pink grapefruit crispness. There is spice, followed by a mouthful of complex berries, red plums and a firm texture. This is already delicious, but could certainly age over several years.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin 2002 Vintage Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: With extra aging on the lees, this creamy wine shows delicious green apple and pink grapefruit flavors and a layer of yeasty ripeness. It's certainly crisp at the same time, but the extra age rounds out the concentrated fruitiness.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Réserve
title: Jean Milan NV Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Réserve Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a solid, firm and ripe wine. With its dry structure and still youthful tannins, it has weight and the potential to age. The smoky aromas and fragrant berry fruits are bursting out of the glass, giving a ripe wine that should be drunk after 2016.
title: Domaine les Pins 2012 Cuvée les Rochettes Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: This is a solid, firm and ripe wine. With its dry structure and still youthful tannins, it has weight and the potential to age. The smoky aromas and fragrant berry fruits are bursting out of the glass, giving a ripe wine that should be drunk after 2016.
title: Domaine les Pins 2012 Cuvée les Rochettes Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Braucol, hardly found outside Gaillac, produces a deep, dark-colored wine. This powerful wine is rich, smooth and still very young. It is packed to the limits with dark tannins and flavors of its wood aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine du Moulin 2012 Florentin Braucol (Gaillac)

description: Putting two naturally tannic grapes together seems to soften them both. The blend gives this rich wine structure, as well as rich plum and damson, leather and smokiness. The wine finishes on a high note of acidity. Age and drink from 2016.
title: Château Peyros 2010 Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: Black fruit and soft tannins yield a wine that is rounded with some attractive texture. Its ripe black currant fruitiness is lifted by its crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2015 Merlot (Vin de France)

description: Open, friendly and lively fruit dominate this crisp clean wine. It comes from one of three estates owned by the Gueneau family. Spice and lively acidity finish this immediately drinkable wine.
title: Jérôme Gueneau 2016 Domaine des Grandes Perrières  (Sancerre)

description: Ripe tropical fruit flavors give this wine from Sancerre producer Eric Louis its warm character. It has enough acidity to cut through the richness and give it a fruity aftertaste. It's ready to drink.
designation: Alphonse Dolly Les Doigts d'Or de Dolly
title: Eric Louis 2016 Alphonse Dolly Les Doigts d'Or de Dolly Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: The wine has a lean texture, presenting fruit that is shot through with tight acidity. Cherry flavors are firmly balanced with tannins and a dry core. Definitely cool-climate Pinot Noir.
title: Domaine Matthias et Emile Roblin 2015 Grande Côte de la Vallée  (Sancerre)

description: The wine is tight with acidity and red-currant fruitiness. Made from Cabernet Franc, it is crisp, cut through with a lively, mineral texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine les Pins 2016 Cuvée les Rochettes Rosé (Bourgueil)

description: The wine is tight with acidity and red-currant fruitiness. Made from Cabernet Franc, it is crisp, cut through with a lively, mineral texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine les Pins 2016 Cuvée les Rochettes Rosé (Bourgueil)

description: This accessible ripe wine is full of fruit. The aromas are intensely herbal, a character that is repeated in the grassy palate that is lifted by juicy green fruits and citrus. Drink now.
title: Domaine de la Villaudière 2015  Sancerre

description: This ripe, cherry-flavored wine has touches of toasty spice from wood aging. It's smooth and soft, with juicy acidity that offsets its rounded texture.
title: Barton & Guestier 2016 Bistro Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This 100% Pinot Noir rosé is ripe and full of red fruit, with a touch of caramel. It shows an attractive streak of acidity on the finish.
title: Saget la Perrière 2016 La Petite Perrière Pinot Noir Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Made from 100% Gamay, this is a crisp wine with attractive acidity, red currant fruit and a spicy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Philippe Viallet 2016 Savoie Rosé (Vin de Savoie)

description: This is a stylish attractive wine. It has an herbal touch although it is more about delicious bright fruit. Citrus and crisp apples dominate, laced with acidity. This refreshing wine is ready to drink now.
title: Paris-Simoneau 2016 Antoine Simoneau Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This tangy wine is crisp while also fruity. With its hints of herbal flavors along with green plum and apples, it is a juicy wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Paris-Simoneau 2016 Antoine Simoneau Cuvée AS Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Wonderfully aromatic, this sure-to-be legendary wine offers richness, ripeness, and pure yellow fruits, peaches and apricots, all alongside a structured strain of chalky minerality. It is a wine for long aging, the wood spice just becoming integrated, the fruit still in its first vibrancy. But even now, it fills the mouth with generous fruits, and a great finish of citrus.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: If you are looking for wild flavors, then this wine is for you. It is dry, but smells sweet, with lychee, green candy and aromatic spices. It's a wine with a terrific character, needing cheeses and rich fish dishes to bring out its full potential.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2006 Terre Originelle White (Gaillac)

description: Plenty of dark Malbec tannins here, giving a tight, mineral wine with a core of dryness. Around the core are black plum and fig fruits, and an edge of the crispest black currants. Firmly extracted, with fine wood toast flavors.
title: Château Lamartine 2007 Cuvée Particulière Malbec (Cahors)

description: Plenty of dark Malbec tannins here, giving a tight, mineral wine with a core of dryness. Around the core are black plum and fig fruits, and an edge of the crispest black currants. Firmly extracted, with fine wood toast flavors.
title: Château Lamartine 2007 Cuvée Particulière Malbec (Cahors)

description: Sweet fruits dominate this wine. It still has all the right black tannins and berry fruits, but it also has great ripeness, the wine spiced with vanilla and all-spice. It finishes with mouthfilling juiciness.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2005 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: Sweet fruits dominate this wine. It still has all the right black tannins and berry fruits, but it also has great ripeness, the wine spiced with vanilla and all-spice. It finishes with mouthfilling juiciness.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2005 Prestige Malbec (Cahors)

description: With its rich chocolate and spice flavors, this rolls around the mouth like velvet, its fruit so well-integrated with the wood and the vanilla that it is seamless. A delicious wine that deserves 3–4 years aging.
title: Château l'Enclos 2005  Pomerol

description: Under the watchful eye of consultant Michel Rolland, Candale has produced an intense, powerful expression of super-ripe Merlot. The tannins are dense, powering through the dark berry fruit, rounded by the wood. It could do with 4–5 years aging.
title: Château de Candale 2005  Saint-Émilion

description: Under the watchful eye of consultant Michel Rolland, Candale has produced an intense, powerful expression of super-ripe Merlot. The tannins are dense, powering through the dark berry fruit, rounded by the wood. It could do with 4–5 years aging.
title: Château de Candale 2005  Saint-Émilion

description: Big, rich and elegant, this wine has fine, lifted black fruits layered over dry new wood and fruit tannins. It is certainly firm, and needs at least 4–5 years' aging, but it will develop into a sophisticated, balanced wine.
title: Château Laroque 2005  Saint-Émilion

description: Big, rich and elegant, this wine has fine, lifted black fruits layered over dry new wood and fruit tannins. It is certainly firm, and needs at least 4–5 years' aging, but it will develop into a sophisticated, balanced wine.
title: Château Laroque 2005  Saint-Émilion

description: Great wafts of sweet fruit and ripe tannins show this wine well. Its fruit is balanced, the power behind it well judged alongside the fresh juicy black currant flavors and acidity. The texture is certainly dense, and the wine needs time. Give it 4–5 years.
title: Château Fonplégade 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: This women-owned château above Cadillac produced a crisp wine, tight and nervy. With lively acidity, it focuses on the citrus side of life, finishing with a mineral edge. It will drink best from the end of 2017.
title: Château Peneau 2016 II Sauvignons  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This women-owned château above Cadillac produced a crisp wine, tight and nervy. With lively acidity, it focuses on the citrus side of life, finishing with a mineral edge. It will drink best from the end of 2017.
title: Château Peneau 2016 II Sauvignons  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Véronique Barthe is the first woman to manage the estate that has been in the Barthe family since 1789. She delivered a light and bright wine, poised and stylish with its crisp fruit and tangy acidity. A delicious burst of citrus at the end continues the theme of this fruity wine.
title: Château la Freynelle 2016 La Freynelle Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Strongly herbal, this Sauvignon Blanc-dominated wine is fruity and crisp, with a good depth of flavor. Refreshing acidity adds a tight edge to this young wine. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château l' Oiseau 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This full-bodied wine is rounded and soft. With generous red fruits, balanced acidity and a bright aftertaste, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Goudichaud 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This full-bodied wine is rounded and soft. With generous red fruits, balanced acidity and a bright aftertaste, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Goudichaud 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This stylish wine is tight, crisp and with fine intense acidity. Its apple fruitiness is bright, delicious and refreshing. With its lively aftertaste, this is ready to drink now.
title: Château Gaudrelle NV Vigneau Brut  (Vouvray)

description: This off-dry character is a hard style to work well. This wine succeeds because it has kept a dry background as well as strong minerality, so the almond-perfumed character of the wine is beautifully restrained and delicate. Drink the wine from 2019.
title: Château de Montfort 2015 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This off-dry character is a hard style to work well. This wine succeeds because it has kept a dry background as well as strong minerality, so the almond-perfumed character of the wine is beautifully restrained and delicate. Drink the wine from 2019.
title: Château de Montfort 2015 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Showing plenty of the concentration this village can produce, this wine from a small parcel is structured to age. It's rich while keeping the acidity and crispness of the year in mind. Drink from 2021.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2014 Les Sionnières  (Morey-Saint-Denis)

description: The fruit and structure of this monopole bottling from Nuiton-Beanoy are already well integrated. With a smoky character from wood aging and a core of firm tannins and acidity, it manages to feel ripe and crisp at the same time. Drink from 2020.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2014 Clos du Chapitre Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This dry version of Jurançon can't go far from its sweeter partner. It is rich and dry with considerable acidity, but underneath there is honey, spice and a wonderful ripe apricot fruits. It is full, tangy, a wine for food. Drink from 2018.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 Cami Salié  (Jurançon Sec)

description: Ripe, full and showing the richness of the vintage, this comes from one of the premier crus vineyards on the south bank of the Serein river. It's crisp with strong minerality, while also having plenty of ripe citrus and apple fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2015 Vaillon Premier Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This wine comes from the furthest west of the Chablis Premier Cru vineyards, and furthest from the Serein river. The coolness of its chalk soil reflects in its crisp, appley and tight mineral character. The fruit is bright, in accordance with the 2014 vintage. Drink now, or, better yet, from 2018.
title: Nicolas Potel 2014 Vau Ligneau Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This pale rosé is showing its maturity at seven years of age, its fruitiness transforming into extra richness, with touches of toast. It's a very fine wine, ripe and ready to drink.
title: Deutz 2010 Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Based in the Côte des Blancs Grand Cru village of Oger, this producer draws on some very fine vines. That superior fruit gives this vintage wine its texture, minerality and intensity. Crisp with acidity and a flinty texture, it still needs further time to develop. Drink from 2019.
designation: Neyrot Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
title: Demière-Ansiot 2010 Neyrot Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Aged at the estate for five years before release, this wine shows fine toasty character paired with youthful mineral texture. It's dry and crisp with apple fruit, edged with a more mature yeasty note. This fine Champagne is ready to drink.
title: Boude Baudin NV Brut Cuvée de Réserve Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A finely balanced wine with toast and ginger flavors peeking through the ripe peach and apricot fruits. It is striated with minerality giving an intense ageworthy texture. The acidity shows through strongly at the end.
title: Chartron et Trébuchet 2009 Les Embazées Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: An almost creamy wave of pear fruit hits the nose. The palate is equally soft and full fruited, boosted by residual sweetness that makes the fruit fluid and rounded. This is countered by ample zesty freshness that has a pithy slightly bitter edge. The finish is just off dry and clean.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2016 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: An almost creamy wave of pear fruit hits the nose. The palate is equally soft and full fruited, boosted by residual sweetness that makes the fruit fluid and rounded. This is countered by ample zesty freshness that has a pithy slightly bitter edge. The finish is just off dry and clean.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2016 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Pure bright smoky fruits give this wine its edge of tannin and great red plum and spice flavors. Its youth adds a dry character to the fruitiness and acidity. Drink this from 2018.
title: Domaine du Petit Clocher 2015 Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: This lively wine comes from the Clarence Dillon group (Château Haut-Brion). It offers good balance between the considerable acidity and the red-berry fruit. With its spicy background, the wine is delicious to drink now.
title: Clarendelle 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a crisp wine, full of acidity. It holds the potential of crisp green and citrus fruits that are developing. A nutty edge contrasts with the tense acidity. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château Terres Douces 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a real food wine, with its tangy texture, touch of spice and attractive acidity. Light fruitiness and a dry core give a structured character. Drink now.
title: Château Reynon 2016 Le Rosé de Floridène Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Olivier Doujon made only 7,000 bottles of this 100% Merlot at the family estate in Fronsac. Rounded and ripe, this is a full-bodied wine with great fruitiness and attractive acidity. Well balanced, it offers red-cherry flavors with an edge of pepper. Drink the wine now.
title: Château Magondeau 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: There is a great burst of appealing acidity in this wine, accompanied by refreshing red fruits. This balanced wine is lively, crisp and with plenty of flavor. Drink now.
title: Château Les Hauts de Palette 2016 Château Haut Mondain Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is tight and closed at this stage, although it has great potential. The fruit is lively and crisp, just waiting to burst out with citrus and sliced apple fruitiness. Wait until late 2017.
title: Château de Lussac 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is already ripe and rounded. It has good balance between the rich apple and pear fruits and acidity, along with an attractive mineral texture. Drink this fruity wine now.
title: Château de la Rivière 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is an attractive, ripe wine from the André Lurton group. It is smoothly rich, with balanced perfumed fruits and acidity. Full bodied and creamy, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Bonnet 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Ripe orange and plump stone fruits rise from the glass while subtle rose scents hover. The palate is fresh. There is enough acidity and a slightly bitter phenolic edge to frame the peach and orange fruit that is augmented by a little residual sweetness. The finish is off dry. Drink while flavors are fresh.
title: Cave du Roi Dagobert 2016 Découverte Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Soft and rounded, this has caramel and strawberry flavors, but it misses some crispness.
title: Les Vignerons de Grimaud 2011 Cuvée du Golfe de Saint-Tropez Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Soft and rounded, this has caramel and strawberry flavors, but it misses some crispness.
title: Les Vignerons de Grimaud 2011 Cuvée du Golfe de Saint-Tropez Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fashionably pale in color, this light, bright and very poised wine is made from old-vine Mourvèdre, Grenache and Cinsault. With its acidity and fresh red currant and raspberry fruits, it is still crisp and could age a few more months, although why wait?
title: Maison Angelvin 2014 Grande Réserve Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With 70% Mourvèdre, this rich, concentarted wine is packed with dark, tarry tannins and juicy black-plum fruits. A strong, spicy, character goes with the powerful tannins that still need to soften. Drink from 2018.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Cuvée G Red (Bandol)

description: Fruity and crisp, this is a ripe, refreshing wine. Lively acidity sets off the full strawberry and red-currant fruits. The aftertaste continues the fruity theme with tangy orange-zest flavors.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2015 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The 123-acre estate has been in the Rabarin family for 150 years, yielding both wine and market-garden produce. This is a delicious, crisp wine full of red-currant freshness with a tight, mineral character. It is concentrated with pepper overtones and a nervy, bright aftertaste.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine la Rabiotte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Full bodied and concentrated, with a long, chewy finish, this wine gets points for being complex as well. It's plummy yet savory, with touches of braised beef, coffee and black olive. Drink 2013–2023.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2007 Cuvée Spéciale Grenache (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Already showing well, Guigal's 2007 white Hermitage displays hints of truffle and peach on the nose and in the mouth. This blend of 95% Marsanne and 5% Roussanne is full bodied and mouthcoating, with a long, citrusy finish. Drink this beauty now, or hold 10 or more years.
title: E. Guigal 2007 White (Hermitage)

description: Already showing well, Guigal's 2007 white Hermitage displays hints of truffle and peach on the nose and in the mouth. This blend of 95% Marsanne and 5% Roussanne is full bodied and mouthcoating, with a long, citrusy finish. Drink this beauty now, or hold 10 or more years.
title: E. Guigal 2007 White (Hermitage)

description: A fine example of white Hermitage, Chapoutier's 2007 Chante-Alouette boasts attractive aromas of crushed stone, honey and pineapple, while in the mouth the wine goes down easily, flowing along like a gentle, honeyed stream. Harmonious. Drink now–2014, or after 2019 if you prefer aged Hermitage.
title: M. Chapoutier 2007 Chante-Alouette Marsanne (Hermitage)

description: A hard, too-toasty wine that is completely dominated by smoky wood flavors. Whatever fruit is there is swamped, only a juicy hint through the wine's weight.
title: Château Cossieu-Coutelin 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: The wine is fruity, crisp and herbaceous. Everything is in place for an attractive, ready-to-drink wine, all fruit and with only a light texture.
title: Schröder & Schÿler 2013 La Croix Barton  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Heavily dominated by wood aging, this wine should be showing its fruit by now, but isn't. It has bitterness, layers of spice and smoky wood. Only the aftertaste brings some freshness and acidity.
title: Château Haut-Gelineau 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: Fruity and fresh, it's full of grapefruit, lime and green apple flavors. It is crisp and ready to drink.
title: Château Lamothe de Haux 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine does have fruit, but it is masked by strong burnt tannins from the wood aging. The acidity shows the possibility of red berry fruits appearing later.
title: Château Haut-Gelineau 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: There is an earthy, barnyard character to this Sauvignon Blanc, with a tightly herbaceous flavor overshadowed by a more rustic style. It's ready to drink, but does need food to balance that earthiness.
title: Domaine de l'Hermitage 2012  Menetou-Salon

description: There is an earthy, barnyard character to this Sauvignon Blanc, with a tightly herbaceous flavor overshadowed by a more rustic style. It's ready to drink, but does need food to balance that earthiness.
title: Domaine de l'Hermitage 2012  Menetou-Salon

description: This is a wine that's on the lean side. That gives it structure without enough fruit to balance. It is dry, tight and shows black currant acidity at the end.
title: Château La Fleur Beaumont 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a wine that's on the lean side. That gives it structure without enough fruit to balance. It is dry, tight and shows black currant acidity at the end.
title: Château La Fleur Beaumont 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine is all about fruitiness, its crisp texture merely an aid to the lively acidity and herbaceous character. Cool and fresh, it delivers a bright aftertaste of lime juiciness.
title: Château Fayau 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This offers black currant flavors and firm, stalky tannins. It has acidity, a good juicy character and a dry aftertaste. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Cagnas 2012  Bordeaux

description: Very firm tannins coming from ripe black fruits give this structured wine, produced by the winemaking team from Château Montrose, a solid, dense feel. The core of dryness is surrounded by rich fruits and bright acidity. The wine presents the possibility of good aging; drink from 2018.
title: Château Tronquoy-Lalande 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: Duhart-Milon continues to get better and more sophisticated. This 2011 vintage shows that trend well with its elegant spice, black currant fruits and firm tannins. The fruitiness is well focused, with typical Cabernet acidity bringing out the fresher side of the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2011  Pauillac

description: Duhart-Milon continues to get better and more sophisticated. This 2011 vintage shows that trend well with its elegant spice, black currant fruits and firm tannins. The fruitiness is well focused, with typical Cabernet acidity bringing out the fresher side of the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2011  Pauillac

description: This small merchant house is best known for its great Vendanges Tardives. But at the simpler level, this Riesling Collection is dry and fresh, with a great floral character, deceptively light acidity and a subtly spicy aftertaste.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2000 Collection Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very light, this wine disappoints with a lack of power, of steely acidity. Instead it is soft, broad, a touch of green fruit, leaving a light, bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine Specht 2008 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very light, this wine disappoints with a lack of power, of steely acidity. Instead it is soft, broad, a touch of green fruit, leaving a light, bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine Specht 2008 Riesling (Alsace)

description: A slight vanilla accent glimmers through the fresh fruit aromas of pear and apple flesh. Round and ripe on the palate, the finish takes a seductive tropical-fruit turn before finally landing on a clean, clementine citrus note.
title: Cap Cette 2010 Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: A blend of fruit from across the southwest yields a very fresh wine. It is crisp, textured, full of white fruit with an herbal edge. Drink now.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2010 Villa Grand Cap White (Vin de France)

description: Concentrated aromas of blackberry, cherry and mashed fig abound, while flavors of black plum skins dominate the palate and coat the mouth with a firm texture. Medium tannins linger on the finish alongside a hint of roasted cocoa nib.
title: La Noble 2009 Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Concentrated aromas of blackberry, cherry and mashed fig abound, while flavors of black plum skins dominate the palate and coat the mouth with a firm texture. Medium tannins linger on the finish alongside a hint of roasted cocoa nib.
title: La Noble 2009 Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Deep yellow in color. This has a somewhat closed nose with hints of hay, yellow fruit and honey. The fairly low acidity magnifies the full body, round midpalate and creamy texture. A well-integrated note of buttered toast nods to the use of some new oak. This wine is for hearty poultry and polenta dishes.
title: Domaine Begude 2008 L'Etoile de Begude Chardonnay (Limoux)

description: Deep yellow in color. This has a somewhat closed nose with hints of hay, yellow fruit and honey. The fairly low acidity magnifies the full body, round midpalate and creamy texture. A well-integrated note of buttered toast nods to the use of some new oak. This wine is for hearty poultry and polenta dishes.
title: Domaine Begude 2008 L'Etoile de Begude Chardonnay (Limoux)

description: Spiced with cinnamon, this is an exotic wine. The fruit takes second place to the structure, toastiness and weight of this wine. It could age well, but will always be an unusual wine, with its own, ?unique attractiveness.
title: Château de Monrecueil 2011  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Mint aromas dominate notes of new wood aging on this wine. Toast notes are there, but blend harmoniously with berry flavors and acidity. Taken as a whole, this wine has weight and potential. Drink from 2015.
title: Château de Lisennes 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a firm wine that will take time to show its best. When it does, it should reveals a solid texture, juicy fruitiness and attractive acidity. Wait until 2015.
title: Château de Goëlane 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a lime- and lemon- flavored wine that is fruity and refreshing. It is delicate, bright and light, and attractive to drink now as an apéritif.
title: Château de Bellevue 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a lime- and lemon- flavored wine that is fruity and refreshing. It is delicate, bright and light, and attractive to drink now as an apéritif.
title: Château de Bellevue 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A wine that is both creamy and has a tight, steely core. It will be fine with food, with its crisp apple acidity and a squeeze of lemon. Drink now.
title: Wolfberger 2013 Signature Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A wine that is both creamy and has a tight, steely core. It will be fine with food, with its crisp apple acidity and a squeeze of lemon. Drink now.
title: Wolfberger 2013 Signature Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Old vines give some extra concentration and allow ripe spice to show strongly. It makes for a rich wine that is packed with lychee and mangos. The wine doesn't allow much room for acidity but makes up for that with a lightly dry, textured aftertaste.
designation: Anne de K Altenbourg Old Vines
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg 2012 Anne de K Altenbourg Old Vines Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a forward, fruity and spicy wine. It is sweet and soft, with the lightest hint of acidity to give some freshness at the finish. Lychees and mangos combine easily with the attractive pinch of pepper at the end.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2013 Steinert Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a forward, fruity and spicy wine. It is sweet and soft, with the lightest hint of acidity to give some freshness at the finish. Lychees and mangos combine easily with the attractive pinch of pepper at the end.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2013 Steinert Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: With just the right amount of wood aging, this is soft, rich and smooth. Tannins are already well integrated into the blackberry fruits, giving a wine that is fruity, juicy and good for medium-term aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Terrefort Bibonne 2012  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: With just the right amount of wood aging, this is soft, rich and smooth. Tannins are already well integrated into the blackberry fruits, giving a wine that is fruity, juicy and good for medium-term aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Terrefort Bibonne 2012  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Firm and complex, it manages both acidity and concentrated tannins and brings out really black fruits.
title: Cap Royal 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has weight and the potential for ripe black fruits. At this stage, it is closed up, full of suggestions without realization. Wait until 2017 for the rich character to be fully revealed.
title: Château de Potiron 2012 Cuvée Privilége  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A rounded and soft wine that has juicy red fruits and gentle tannins. It just hints at a dry structure that will allow it to age for several months. Drink this attractive cru wine from late 2017.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Saint-Amour

description: An attractive, lightly structured cru wine that has juicy cherry fruits. It is balanced, ripe with acidity and gentle tannins in equal measure. Drink from late 2017.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Morgon

description: A solidly structured wine with fine tannins and ripe red-berry fruits. The acidity adds a piquancy to the fruitiness giving the wine a lift. The wine comes from Henry Fesse vines. Drink from late 2017.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Chiroubles

description: From the smallest of the Beaujolais crus, this wine is structured, layering tannins with black fruits and acidity. It is a wine to age at least for a couple of years. Drink from 2018.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Chénas

description: Fronholz is from a single vineyard, a heady, perfumed wine with ripe, smooth undertones. While there is plenty of acidity, it's the opulent, ripe texture that comes right up front. A light touch of honey and melon roundness give a creamy aftertaste. Drink now, but better from 2017.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2012 Fronholz Riesling (Alsace)

description: Fronholz is from a single vineyard, a heady, perfumed wine with ripe, smooth undertones. While there is plenty of acidity, it's the opulent, ripe texture that comes right up front. A light touch of honey and melon roundness give a creamy aftertaste. Drink now, but better from 2017.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2012 Fronholz Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is the second wine of Château Labégorce. It has much of the elegance of the top wine with firm tannins and generous fruits kept in stylish proportion. Black currant and berry fruits lie under the dark, dry exterior. The wine is dense, needing several years' aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2010 Zédé de Labégorce  (Margaux)

description: A truly aromatic Riesling that has a wonderful series of fruit and spice perfumes. It's ripe and full in the mouth, offering a strongly mineral edge as well as rich apple and citrus. Textured and still very tangy, the complex wine needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2012 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A truly aromatic Riesling that has a wonderful series of fruit and spice perfumes. It's ripe and full in the mouth, offering a strongly mineral edge as well as rich apple and citrus. Textured and still very tangy, the complex wine needs to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2012 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Opulent yet so elegant, this wine has already achieved great balance. It comes from the soft richness of the generous fruit, the spice from both the wood and the fruit, and the roundness of the texture, which envelops you in its warmth and ripeness. And, at the end, just to give a great lift, along comes the acidity.
title: Louis Jadot 2005 Les Baudes Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: Domaine de l'Arlot owns just over one acre of this grand cru vineyard in Vosne-Romanée. This 2005 shows intense, complex fruits and tannins, both finely intertwined. There is power, but the strawberry flavors are just as important, flattering the palate.
title: Domaine de l'Arlot 2005  Romanée-St.-Vivant

description: Beautiful, aromatic wine, with raspberry fruit floating above the spice and toast. This is shot through with acidity and some dense tannins, but above all it is the piercing fruit that dominates. One of Jadot's signature wines, it is wonderful, with considerable aging potential.
title: Louis Jadot 2005 Clos Saint Jacques Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: A supremely integrated wine, its richness and beautiful fruit just part of a story that starts with intense aromas and segues on the palate into a balance of tannins, dark red fruits, enveloping acidity and a beautifully orchestrated finale of berries, spice and aching freshness.
title: Louis Jadot 2005  Corton-Pougets

description: This is a powerhouse of a wine. It is driven forward by immense tannins as well as by superrich fruit that still keeps itself in check by a velvet texture. There is spice, acidity, some toast and vanilla, and finally a sunburst of warmth.
title: Louis Jadot 2005  Clos de la Roche

description: A beautiful wine, smooth, polished, with rounded corners. Its intense fruit is balanced and harmonizes well with the sweet tannins, the layers of wood and the red berry flavors. Certainly powerful, it impresses equally with the pleasure it will give in 7–10 years.
title: Clos de Tart 2005  Clos de Tart

description: A complete wine. As it starts in the mouth, there is a feeling of everything in its place. The tannins are initially soft, dusty rather than dry; then the dark plums, red berries and so-sweet strawberries come into play. And finally, they all come together in a climax of richness and freshness.
title: Louis Jadot 2005  Charmes-Chambertin

description: A beautiful, pure wine that  combines freshness and intense richness. It seems to float while still giving a huge mouthful of plums, coffee and sweet, juicy tannins. A straight line of pure flavor all the way to the finish.
title: Domaine des Lambrays 2005  Clos de Lambrays

description: The wine is neither very fruity nor fresh. It is clean with a crisp aftertaste although the character or the interest are not there.
title: Clos Floridène 2014 Le Rosé de Floridène Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Bubblegum aromas send this wine in a candied direction. It is soft, not quite dry, with ripe strawberry flavors. It tastes confected although the acidity at the end does keep it fresh.
title: Château de Lardiley 2014 Prestige Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Bubblegum aromas send this wine in a candied direction. It is soft, not quite dry, with ripe strawberry flavors. It tastes confected although the acidity at the end does keep it fresh.
title: Château de Lardiley 2014 Prestige Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine's fruitiness comes from stalky black currant flavors that have a green edge. It shows tannins, bitter chocolate and considerable acidity.
title: Maison Bouey 2013 Château Maison Blanche  (Médoc)

description: This wine smells yeasty, a character that follows through on the palate. It is soft and round, conveying ripe red fruits without freshness. It reveals bitter acidity at the end.
title: Château Recougne 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine smells yeasty, a character that follows through on the palate. It is soft and round, conveying ripe red fruits without freshness. It reveals bitter acidity at the end.
title: Château Recougne 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light in color, this is a wine with flavors that seem to have been stripped away. It is crisp and only lightly fruity, with some bitter acidity at the end.
title: Château Goudichaud 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A soft, simple wine without great character, this is soft, gently fruity and ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Bessac 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A soft, simple wine without great character, this is soft, gently fruity and ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Bessac 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Juicy fruit aromas lead to a palate conveying tangy flavors and mandarin zest. This is a fruity wine that is not quite balanced, and likely to remain with fruit and texture out of kilter.
title: Château de Lardiley 2014 Prestige  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A disappointing effort from a normally reliable producer, this wine shows entirely too many rubbery, chemical aromas and flavors. Some decent strawberry and citrus fruit peeks through on the finish, so it may be worth decanting and seeing if that helps.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Réserve Grand Veneur Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This wine is soft, watery and misses out on character. It is gentle, but with a bitter almond aftertaste.
title: Château du Cros 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is soft, watery and misses out on character. It is gentle, but with a bitter almond aftertaste.
title: Château du Cros 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a perfumed crisp wine, attractively fruity and with delicious acidity. Its fruit is effusive and needs to calm down and fill out, so just wait until 2018 for it richness to be fully apparent.
title: Bouchié-Chatellier 2015 La Renardière  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This rare white wine from a vineyard in Saint-Emilion is produced by Gérard Perse of Château Pavie. Now mature, this ripe, bitter-almond and spice flavored wine shows a touch of scorched wood. As a contrast, there is a rich, almost buttery character that gives the wine a full texture. Ready to drink.
title: Château Monbousquet 2004  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This rare white wine from a vineyard in Saint-Emilion is produced by Gérard Perse of Château Pavie. Now mature, this ripe, bitter-almond and spice flavored wine shows a touch of scorched wood. As a contrast, there is a rich, almost buttery character that gives the wine a full texture. Ready to drink.
title: Château Monbousquet 2004  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This impressive wine is full of potential. Powerful wood flavors are currently masking the fruitiness of the wine. However the weight of fruit and the rich texture promise good long-term aging.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This impressive wine is full of potential. Powerful wood flavors are currently masking the fruitiness of the wine. However the weight of fruit and the rich texture promise good long-term aging.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is an impressive performance from an estate that has been improving over the past 10 years. The wine is dense with fine tannins, fresh acidity and layers of black-currant fruitiness. It will develop over the medium term, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2013  Margaux

description: This is an impressive performance from an estate that has been improving over the past 10 years. The wine is dense with fine tannins, fresh acidity and layers of black-currant fruitiness. It will develop over the medium term, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2013  Margaux

description: This wine shows the continuing evolution of this property even in a difficult year. Structured, balanced tannins are already integrated with the fresh black-currant fruits. With a balance between Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, the wine is fruity and still young. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Light and fruity, this wine has attractive acidity and layers of red berry fruits. The silky tannins are present, although light and dominated by the fruitiness of the wine. It's fresh, packed with acidity and likely to be ready soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Palmer 2013 Alter Ego de Château Palmer  (Margaux)

description: Showing how Saint-Émilion came out well in 2013, this wine has ripe and juicy Merlot fruits topped with perfumed Cabernet Franc. Rich and structured, it's a wine for aging over the medium-term with its layers of tannins under the fruit. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Canon 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: This wine is full of juicy Merlot, ripe with sweet tannins and jammy fruit. It is soft, with the freshness of the year as well as having hints of structure. It is ripe, beautifully fruity and will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2013 Le Marquis de Calon Ségur  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: One of two wines produced as a joint venture between California vintner Paul Hobbs and Cahors producer Bertrand Vigouroux, Crocus is aged 50% in new wood. It is ripe, smooth and powerful, a dense wine with dusty tannins and dark black plum flavors. It is just about ready to drink.
title: Paul Bertrand 2011 Crocus Malbec (Cahors)

description: An excellent value, this comes from vines that average 40 years of age. It's unusually complex for the price, offering hints of cracked pepper, clove, leather, plum and mint, all delivered with ample weight and a rich, supple texture. Drink now–2020.
title: André Brunel 2012 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Light, fresh, raspberry-flavored wine, with a hint of spice and great lines of acidity. The wine is fruity, delicious.
title: Château Beauregard-Ducourt 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light, fresh, raspberry-flavored wine, with a hint of spice and great lines of acidity. The wine is fruity, delicious.
title: Château Beauregard-Ducourt 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: From two different domaines on the Côte de Py slope, this is a dense, firm wine, very solid and powerful. The wine has opulence under its structure, with rich plum and sweet jelly flavors. Worth aging for another year.
title: Paul Beaudet 2009 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: From two different domaines on the Côte de Py slope, this is a dense, firm wine, very solid and powerful. The wine has opulence under its structure, with rich plum and sweet jelly flavors. Worth aging for another year.
title: Paul Beaudet 2009 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: The 2009 vintage of this wine was one of the stars from Georges Duboeuf, and this 2010 fits the same pattern. It has great richness, spice, black cherry fruits, the acidity offering the fruity side of the wine. Ready for aging two years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Domaine de la Chaponne  (Morgon)

description: The rare ripeness of the 2009 vintage is shown in the high alcohol, for Beaujolais at least, of this wine. Not that it shows, except in weight. The acidity is right there along with ripe plums. An ageworthy, finely concentrated wine.
title: Paul Beaudet 2009 Clos de la Brosse  (Saint-Amour)

description: The only question with this wine is whether it might be too much of a good thing. It's full bodieed and densely concentrated, with oaky notes of toasted almond and vanilla layered over plummy fruit, finishing warm and lush. Hedonistic to the max. Drink now.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2008 Vieilles Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Dark-hued wine, dominated by acidity as well as firm tannins. It shows solid, chunky structure, ripe fruit and plenty of sweetness. Of course, there is acidity as well, the charm of Gamay coming through in the fresh cherry flavors. Age 2–3 years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2010 Domaine Montchavy  (Morgon)

description: Very Pommard, very structured, this is a dense and dark wine that shows big black fruits over dry tannins. It's big, firm, muscular, a powerhouse of firmness and richness.
designation: Clos de la Commaraine Premier Cru
title: Corton André 2005 Clos de la Commaraine Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Firm and hard, this shows density rather than fruit, tannin rather than freshness. It goes for the dark side of Clos Vougeot. There is some bitterness from the extraction, but the wine needs many years before it comes into balance—the juicy red fruit finish promises richness later.
title: Louis Latour 2005  Clos de Vougeot

description: Firm and hard, this shows density rather than fruit, tannin rather than freshness. It goes for the dark side of Clos Vougeot. There is some bitterness from the extraction, but the wine needs many years before it comes into balance—the juicy red fruit finish promises richness later.
title: Louis Latour 2005  Clos de Vougeot

description: An opulent style, where the tannins are subservient to the ripeness of the red cherry flavor. The acidity enhances the sweetness of the rich fruit, and the lively, vibrant texture comes sweeping right through to finish.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2005  Monthélie

description: Proper Nuits-St.-Georges, all dry tannins powering through the dark cherry fruit flavors, and balanced with tasty acidity. There's great potential here, the ripe fruits just showing their intensity, but for the moment, the tannins are the core.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Les Chaboeufs Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Proper Nuits-St.-Georges, all dry tannins powering through the dark cherry fruit flavors, and balanced with tasty acidity. There's great potential here, the ripe fruits just showing their intensity, but for the moment, the tannins are the core.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Les Chaboeufs Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A refreshing wine with its fresh lemon and sliced apple flavors. It is light and fruity with a mineral texture at the end that leaves a tang in the mouth. Drink now.
title: Lacheteau 2014 Réserve des Cléons Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: On the herbaceous side, this is a full bodied but grassy wine with hints of green undergrowth and a cat-like character. It has a modern, forward fruitiness that's very new world in style. Drink now.
