description: While the wine is dominated by youthful acidity, it's red fruits and light structure promise an attractive future. It's fresh and very fruity, with spice and smokiness at the end.
title: Domaine de Colonat 2013 Perle de Granit  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: With its intense acidity, this wine is still too young to drink. It has plenty of fruit, a cool texture and a crisp, berry fruitiness. Give it until mid-2015 to round out and be less acidic.
title: Jean-Marc Burgaud 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: With its intense acidity, this wine is still too young to drink. It has plenty of fruit, a cool texture and a crisp, berry fruitiness. Give it until mid-2015 to round out and be less acidic.
title: Jean-Marc Burgaud 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Sauvignon Blanc, yes, but it's a round, tropical fruit style of Sauvignon. It gives a rich texture and and a warm feel to the wine, reinforced by its soft aftertaste. It's ready to drink now.
title: Tortoise Creek 2013 Cuvée Jeanne Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Sauvignon Blanc, yes, but it's a round, tropical fruit style of Sauvignon. It gives a rich texture and and a warm feel to the wine, reinforced by its soft aftertaste. It's ready to drink now.
title: Tortoise Creek 2013 Cuvée Jeanne Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: An impressively rich Sancerre red, showing plenty of red berry fruits, tight tannins and balanced acidity. Yes, it is not Burgundy, but in 2005 Sancerre could really justify its red wines, and this example, with delicacy and elegance, works well.
title: Château de Sancerre 2005  Sancerre

description: Light, fresh style, demanding shellfish, with crisp, green acidity and just a hint of creamy baked apple. Just what a Muscadet should be, enjoyable now and for the rest of the year.
title: Château de l'Hyvernière 2007 Réserve  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is firm, rich and closed, with the fruit showing potential richness under the tight exterior. Packed with notes of wood, spice and a taut texture, this is a wine to enjoy several years down the road. Age for at least five years.
title: Henri de Villamont 2009 Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Opulent and ripe, this is full of sweet red fruit, with tannins that have absorbed into the fruit. The wood aging acts as support to the rich texture. It is developing well, but could certainly age for four years or more.
designation: Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2009 Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Opulent and ripe, this is full of sweet red fruit, with tannins that have absorbed into the fruit. The wood aging acts as support to the rich texture. It is developing well, but could certainly age for four years or more.
designation: Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2009 Château de Chamirey Les Cinq Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Using grapes sourced from 102-year-old vines, this is superripe and concentrated. Yet despite its richness, it has tight acidity that meshes with plum and damson fruits. Age for at least five years.
title: Domaine Perrot-Minot 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: Full and rounded, this has ripe apple and peach fruits that are contrasted with the taut, minerally line of citrusy acidity. It has weight and structure from the flavors of apple skin and orange zest. It needs to age at least four years. Screwcap.
title: Domaine Laroche 2010 Les Vaudevey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The toast character lends a firm structure to this solid, rich wine. A spice note pairs well with the white plum and apricot fruit, and there is a sense that this needs to age for several years in order to bring out its richness and full potential.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2010 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: The toast character lends a firm structure to this solid, rich wine. A spice note pairs well with the white plum and apricot fruit, and there is a sense that this needs to age for several years in order to bring out its richness and full potential.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2010 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: This exudes notes of ripe yellow fruits while keeping an edge of structure. It's fragrant, with a fine dense texture that brings out acidity and a caramel flavor. It has aging potential, so keep it for over three years.
title: La Chablisienne 2010 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Stone, earth and hay are about to merge into notions of lanolin and chamomile: clearly this is a maturing wine at an early point of its evolution. The palate is fluid and has the texture of drenched chalky, stone. The fruit is hiding in the wings, only to appear as orange oil here or as apple scent there. The dryness shows every nuance of this earthy, wine from a historic, co-planed vineyard of Riesling, Pinot Gris and Gewurztraminer. What a triumph. Drink 2016–2026.
designation: Osterberg Grand Cru Clos du Zahnacker
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2009 Osterberg Grand Cru Clos du Zahnacker White (Alsace)

description: Stone, earth and hay are about to merge into notions of lanolin and chamomile: clearly this is a maturing wine at an early point of its evolution. The palate is fluid and has the texture of drenched chalky, stone. The fruit is hiding in the wings, only to appear as orange oil here or as apple scent there. The dryness shows every nuance of this earthy, wine from a historic, co-planed vineyard of Riesling, Pinot Gris and Gewurztraminer. What a triumph. Drink 2016–2026.
designation: Osterberg Grand Cru Clos du Zahnacker
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2009 Osterberg Grand Cru Clos du Zahnacker White (Alsace)

description: Soft, gentle fruit of stewed apple shimmers on the nose but on the palate is contained by immense, lemony zestiness. There is real muscle and elegance. The body is dry, slender but concentrated and beautifully clean with inflections of stone. This is a beacon of clarity and clean fruit, shining with a pristine, citrus-kissed purity. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Boeckel 2013 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Soft, gentle fruit of stewed apple shimmers on the nose but on the palate is contained by immense, lemony zestiness. There is real muscle and elegance. The body is dry, slender but concentrated and beautifully clean with inflections of stone. This is a beacon of clarity and clean fruit, shining with a pristine, citrus-kissed purity. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Boeckel 2013 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very pure notes of red apple and Bosc pear on the nose relax into a juicy, delicious mix on the dry, poised palate. The abundance of fruit cannot conceal the absolute purity and concentration at the core of this dry, structured wine. This strikes a wonderful balance and finishes dry and long.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2013 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very pure notes of red apple and Bosc pear on the nose relax into a juicy, delicious mix on the dry, poised palate. The abundance of fruit cannot conceal the absolute purity and concentration at the core of this dry, structured wine. This strikes a wonderful balance and finishes dry and long.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2013 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose is still closed, there is an almost smoky aspect and a promise of far more perfume in the future. The palate comes with great concentration of still tightly coiled lemon zest notes but the aftertaste is almost salty. This is dry, linear, muscular and toned, affording glimpses of future grandeur through dense lemon and lime zestiness. Give this some time in bottle. Drink 2018–2030.
designation: Clos Saint-Théobald Schistes Rangen Grand Cru
title: Domaine Schoffit 2013 Clos Saint-Théobald Schistes Rangen Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a full-bodied wine that exudes yellow fruits and a smooth structure. It is ripe, packed with citrus acidity to keep it fresh while the mineral texture is so well-cushioned by the rich fruitiness. It is delicious now with the exuberance of young fruit although it will certainly age and will be even better from 2017.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014 Maxime Cuvée Silex  (Sancerre)

description: Fulsome notes of ripe, juicy pear lead straight to a fluid, concentrated palate that holds a whole world of ripe pear flavors. This is still deep in its shell, ringing with primary fruit but burying many layers of spiced joy: think marzipan and gingerbread. This is one for laying down that will reward patient drinkers. The deep core of fruit, the concentration on the midpalate and the ultraclean finish all suggest a great future. Drink 2018–2028.
designation: Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Clos Saint Urbain Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine brings out the structure inherent in this vineyard. Tensely textured with young fruits that have a touch of bitterness, the wine offers kiwi and green plum flavors given a more exotic character with some mango. It's a deeply structured wine that needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Pinson 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This wine brings out the structure inherent in this vineyard. Tensely textured with young fruits that have a touch of bitterness, the wine offers kiwi and green plum flavors given a more exotic character with some mango. It's a deeply structured wine that needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Pinson 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This wine has weight, structure and richness. Spice comes from wood aging while the texture is concentrated and dense. It's powerful, full of apple and crisp pear flavors that are tight and firm. There is a dusty, almost tannic character to this powerful wine that is still young. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laroche 2012 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: From a vineyard that once belonged to the charitable Hospices de Chablis, this is a superrich wine for a Chablis, powered both by acidity and by beautiful ripe fruits. It is bright and tight in character, although it is the richness and the density of the wine that shows most strongly. Drink this powerful wine from 2020.
designation: Les Clos Grand Cru Cuvée Clos des Hospices
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru Cuvée Clos des Hospices  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: From a vineyard that once belonged to the charitable Hospices de Chablis, this is a superrich wine for a Chablis, powered both by acidity and by beautiful ripe fruits. It is bright and tight in character, although it is the richness and the density of the wine that shows most strongly. Drink this powerful wine from 2020.
designation: Les Clos Grand Cru Cuvée Clos des Hospices
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru Cuvée Clos des Hospices  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This wine has weight, richness and an intense texture and structure that brings tannins and a firm background to the generous yellow fruits, ripe apples and crisp green plums. The wine is still very young, needing several years. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2013 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: All the Fèvre vines are at the top of this vineyard, giving very structured, long-lived wines. This is certainly an age-worthy wine, tightly coiled and nervy, with a strong mineral note at its heart. Lemon and quince flavors are caught up in the complex structure. Drink from 2020.
title: William Fèvre 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Extra rich, ripe and round , this offers a full fruitiness that explodes in the mouth. Tannins and structure are all there, although the main thrust of this wine is the balance between this tension and the generous fruits that are developing. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2013 Valmur Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: With its great richness, the wine is opulent, generous and full of powerful fruits. The wood aging and the toastiness have done nothing to diminish the yellow fruit and crisp apple flavors. It's an impressive and concentrated wine that will age for many years. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Jadot 2013  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: This is a beautiful wine with elegant fruits that reflect a strong sense of minerality. It is crisp, although that is just a surface quality to a wine that has such depth. Toast flavors round out the intense fruits, giving a light spice and butter to this powerful wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Jadot 2013 Les Demoiselles  (Chevalier-Montrachet)

description: Fermented and aged in six-year old wood for 24 months, this is a richly spicy wine. The wood is there to smell and taste, but it is the rich fruit that speaks. Yellow fruits are given weight by the mineral backdrop, while layers of acidity instill freshness. Drink this complex wine from 2018.
designation: Cuvée Authentique Les Clos Grand Cru
title: Domaine Pinson 2012 Cuvée Authentique Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This young wine is all magnificent structure. It is intense, with fruit and acidity given richness by the powerful texture and tense tannins. The dense symphony of ripe fruits is kept in check by the structure. This wine needs many years; drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Brambles and undergrowth aromas give this wine a curious character reflected in the wild strawberry flavors that are not linked to the tannins. This seven-acre Thienpont family property is run by Jan, who has several wine projects, and Florian, who came to wine as a chef.
title: Château La Marotte 2013  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: All dry tannin and bramble aromas, this wine is a tough proposition. François Maurin and son Raphael handle the organic vineyards and wine fermented in stainless steel.
title: Château la Croix Blanche 2013  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: All dry tannin and bramble aromas, this wine is a tough proposition. François Maurin and son Raphael handle the organic vineyards and wine fermented in stainless steel.
title: Château la Croix Blanche 2013  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine has been too heavily extracted, giving a series of tough tannins and a hard edge without the fruit to balance things out. It is a blend of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon and 25/25 Merlot and Cabernet Franc.
title: Château de Seguin 2013 La Vieille Cour de Seguin  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine has been too heavily extracted, giving a series of tough tannins and a hard edge without the fruit to balance things out. It is a blend of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon and 25/25 Merlot and Cabernet Franc.
title: Château de Seguin 2013 La Vieille Cour de Seguin  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine has too much extraction to allow the fruit to develop. It will soften out, although not enough. It is an 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon blend.
title: Château de Marsan 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This old-vine wine shows signs of rotten fruit, certainly aromatically. On the palate, it is tight with dark tannins and a hard, extracted edge. It is hard to tell if it could soften. This property liess in both the Castillon and Franc appellations. Wine is vinified plot by plot.
title: Château Terrasson 2013 Cuvée Prevenche  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is soft and smooth, with acidity and a creamy character. The flavors are reminiscent of ripe pear and spice. Very ready to drink.
title: Bott Frères 2010 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This has a silky texture, with weight and richness. Soft and ripe, this has a hint of spice that's attractively balanced by tangy acidity.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2008 Herrenreben Riesling (Alsace)

description: Floral and aromatic, this wine is the opposite of the typical tannic Nuits-St.-Georges. It is lively, with vibrant red fruits, great rich black cherry flavors, with a light layer of tannin providing structure.
title: Corton André 2005 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Powerful, ripe wine, plump and structured. There are fresh black cherries and plums and structure that promises some aging.
title: Corton André 2005  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: Densely tannic and firm, this wine has fresh acidity and red-plum-skin flavors. It is a solid, chunky wine, likely to age well, with a vibrant, juicy freshness in the aftertaste.
title: Louis Latour 2005  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: From one of the good value communes at the northern end of the Côte de Beaune, this Chorey is soft, juicy with strawberry flavors and framed by tannins. The acidity is there, but the effect is of a ripe, easy wine, ready to drink now.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2005  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: There is some good depth of flavor to this wine, the strawberry flavors going right through until they meet the tannic core. The acidity balances well, pushing the fruit through the dryness, leaving freshness and juicy fruits.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Clos du Roi Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: From the Villamont domaine, this is a soft, rounded, quite generous wine that is dominated by enjoyable bright red fruits. It's fresh, ripe, just lightly touched by tannins, and with a juicy, friendly aftertaste.
title: Henri de Villamont 2005 Le Village  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This wine has the ripe fruitiness of the vintage, fresh and crisp although with a rich background of apple and pear flavors. Not aged in wood, the wine is all fruit with lively final acidity.
title: Château Lapinesse 2014  Graves

description: This light wine has red berry flavors and lots of acidity. With only the lightest texture, it's all about fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château Lapinesse 2013 Les Terrasses de Colas  (Graves)

description: This light wine has red berry flavors and lots of acidity. With only the lightest texture, it's all about fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château Lapinesse 2013 Les Terrasses de Colas  (Graves)

description: Still not in balance, this wine shows blackberry flavors and acidity pushed up against dark, lean tannins. It may fill out although that is not certain. The Castaing family has farmed crops and grazing animals since 1800s. The 13-acre vineyard, 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Merlot, was added in 1995.
title: Château Jaulien 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Produced in the Entre-deux-Mers region, this light, fresh wine has young tannins and stalky black-currant flavors. It is crisp with lively acidity and a juicy aftertaste. Give it another few months and drink from late 2016.
title: Château Blouin 2014  Bordeaux

description: It's a shame that the producer used too much wood in this difficult vintage. The fruit is delicate, with the black-currant flavors and acidity smothered by a burnt, toasty character that's hard to taste through. It will soften, although the wood will always be there. Vignobles Roux bought this Cru Bourgeois in 2013. The blend is 50-50 Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château Taffard de Blaignan 2013 Cru Bourgeois  (Médoc)

description: It's a shame that the producer used too much wood in this difficult vintage. The fruit is delicate, with the black-currant flavors and acidity smothered by a burnt, toasty character that's hard to taste through. It will soften, although the wood will always be there. Vignobles Roux bought this Cru Bourgeois in 2013. The blend is 50-50 Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château Taffard de Blaignan 2013 Cru Bourgeois  (Médoc)

description: This wine is firm and structured, on the dry side with more sinews than flesh. That tough, stalky edge to the wine will remain always.
title: Château Haut Nouchet 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine has the alcohol of the vintage along with the tannins and some of the juicy black-currant fruitiness. Lightly perfumed, it's still dry with its firm texture. It will develop although it is ready to drink.
title: Château de l'Abbaye de Saint-Ferme 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has the alcohol of the vintage along with the tannins and some of the juicy black-currant fruitiness. Lightly perfumed, it's still dry with its firm texture. It will develop although it is ready to drink.
title: Château de l'Abbaye de Saint-Ferme 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: With 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc, this is an unusual blend for a Haut-Médoc wine. The result is a wine that's light and already soft. Fresh red-berry flavors are lightly underlined by tannins. It will develop fast, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Reysson 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: Soft and fresh, this fruity wine comes from sandy soil that gives it lightness, especially in this vintage. Fresh fruits and soft tannins make this wine ready to drink now.
title: Château la Croix du Casse 2013  Pomerol

description: From vineyards in the Entre-deux-Mers region of Bordeaux, this Fontana family wine has a dry core surrounded by ripe, fresh fruit. It is still young and should age, certainly until 2017.
title: Château Haut Clairbes 2014 Grande Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: From vineyards in the Entre-deux-Mers region of Bordeaux, this Fontana family wine has a dry core surrounded by ripe, fresh fruit. It is still young and should age, certainly until 2017.
title: Château Haut Clairbes 2014 Grande Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: This stalky and fruity wine has fresh red-currant flavors that are backed up by dry tannins. It is a light wine, as much fruit as texture, and is likely to age quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Hauchat 2013  Fronsac

description: This is a stalky wine, full of black-currant fruits and with just enough weight to balance tannins and the dry structure. It has the potential to become an attractive, fruity wine, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Grivière 2013  Médoc

description: This ripe and fruity wine has an edge of tannins to give it structure. It's full of juicy black fruits, rich berry flavors and fresh acidity. The wine will age as the tannins round out further, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Fortin Plaisance 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: This attractively crisp wine packed with red berry fruits is light and lively. It offers plenty of acidity along with a touch of pepper and cinnamon. Drink now.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This attractively crisp wine packed with red berry fruits is light and lively. It offers plenty of acidity along with a touch of pepper and cinnamon. Drink now.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Pear drop and strawberry make for a fresh inviting nose. The palate is slightly dilute but very fresh and lively with some residual carbon dioxide. This is light and dry. Drink while aromas are fresh.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2016 Pinot Noir Rosé (Alsace)

description: In a ripe Bordeaux year, Sauvignon Blanc goes towards tropical and yellow fruits, making it ripe while also light and crisp. This refreshing, rounded wine is ready to drink.
title: Les Vignerons de Tutiac 2015 Château les Jouberts Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This ripe fruity wine is bursting with young red fruits. It has a fine structure that gives a core of dryness. It also has a crisp edge that brings out the fruit and the liveliness of this attractive wine. Ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Sauvat 2016 Demoiselles Gamay

description: Fresh earthy notes join the subtle peach fruit on the nose. The palate counters with slightly bitter notes that seem slightly out of joint. Drink this while aromas are fresh.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2016 Glintzberg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: From vineyards on the slope above Cadillac, this is a tight, mineral-textured wine. With crisp lemon flavors, it is brightly lit with acidity and clean fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Suau 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: From vineyards on the slope above Cadillac, this is a tight, mineral-textured wine. With crisp lemon flavors, it is brightly lit with acidity and clean fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Suau 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Pascal Sirat named this wine for his father and his son. Bright and fruity, it is already deliciously light, refreshing and bright. Acidity jumps out of the glass, giving a crisp, fresh character. The aftertaste is more taut and tense. Drink now.
title: Château Panchille 2016 Blanc de Fernand  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Light and bright, this is a perfumed wine. Its very present acidity is underpinned by spice, red-currant fruits and a tangy, tangerine aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château le Grand Verdus 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Light and bright, this is a perfumed wine. Its very present acidity is underpinned by spice, red-currant fruits and a tangy, tangerine aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château le Grand Verdus 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine from Maison Ginestet is all crisp, green fruit. Light and bright, it bursts with acidity and perfumed fruitiness. Drink now.
designation: Le Bordeaux de Larrivet Haut-Brion Blanc
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2016 Le Bordeaux de Larrivet Haut-Brion Blanc  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a warm wine, ripe and with hints of yellow fruits as well as crisper acidity. Poised between herbal and riper flavors, it's ready to drink now.
title: Château La Rame 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is spicy, fruity and packed with herbal and lemon flavors. It will soon be a refreshing wine, lively and with swathes of acidity. Drink from late summer 2017.
title: Château de Bonhoste 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This candy-pink-colored wine offers candy-pink-colored flavors. It conveys caramel as much as fruit, although with acidity and a tangy aftertaste.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A light and bright wine, this offers plenty of herbal fruit that is lifted by crisp acidity. The wine is refreshing, lively and ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Mondain 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Bunan's 18th-century castle is called Belle Raisin—Bélouvé in the old Provençal dialect (beautiful grapes in English). With a range of varieties in the blend, it is an attractively integrated wine that has red cherry, raspberry and crisp apple flavors. It is lively and full of ripe fruits, with just a touch of pepper at the end.
title: Domaines Bunan 2015 Bélouvé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Owned by the Quiot family of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, this is one of a pair of wines produced from the region of Sainte-Victoire. It is a full and fruity wine, rich with raspberries and freshened by final grapefruit acidity.
title: Domaine Houchart 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Owned by the Quiot family of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, this is one of a pair of wines produced from the region of Sainte-Victoire. It is a full and fruity wine, rich with raspberries and freshened by final grapefruit acidity.
title: Domaine Houchart 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This rich, full-bodied wine has ripe green and white fruits along with a touch of minerality. It is a sophisticated wine that adds acidity to its complex array of flavors. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Confidence 2015 Indiscreet Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This attractive, citrus-driven blend of Vermentino and Sauvignon Blanc comes from an estate created by the Knights Templar in the 13th century. It owes a lot to the Sauvignon in its tight herbal character. Lemon and grapefruit fruits are filled out with more exotic pineapple and mango flavors. The wine is a little young to drink now so try waiting until late 2016.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2015 White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a delicious, perfumed and fruity wine. It is crisp and clean, bright with acidity and ripe in raspberry flavors. This wine is a perfect summer quaffing rosé.
title: Château Valcolombe 2015 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: With its floral rose motif, the bottle is attractive in itself. The rosé inside comes to life with crisp red fruits and lively acidity. This wine has a real freshness with a tangy texture, spice and a perfumed aftertaste.
title: Château Roubine 2015 La Vie en Rose Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of Rolle and Ugni Blanc, typical of Provence whites, is smooth, ripe and only lightly textured. The Rolle (Vermentino) that dominates gives an attractive perfumed character as well as a mineral texture and acidity. Drink now.
title: Château d'Ollières 2015 Prestige White (Coteaux Varois)

description: This blend of Rolle and Ugni Blanc, typical of Provence whites, is smooth, ripe and only lightly textured. The Rolle (Vermentino) that dominates gives an attractive perfumed character as well as a mineral texture and acidity. Drink now.
title: Château d'Ollières 2015 Prestige White (Coteaux Varois)

description: A warm blend mainly of Grenache with Carignan and Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine is typically pale in color, with just a touch of tannin from the Cabernet. A spicy undertone balances with the deliciously crisp and fresh red-fruit character.
title: Château de Beaupré 2015 Baron Maxime Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a superbly rich wine that is packed with generous black fruits and balanced acidity. It has structure and concentrated plum and damson fruits. The wood aging still shows in what is young wine, although this will go. Drink this impressive wine from 2019.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: This naturally cool vineyard fared well in warm 2015, giving wine that has retained minerality and a crisp texture. It is fruity, while having a tight edge as well as layers of acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Henri de Villamont 2015 Sous le Puits Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Packed with tannins, this dark-hued wine is concentrated, demanding aging. It has spice and layers of wood as well as black plums and acidity. It is a powerful wine, full of dark chocolate as well as fruit and tannins. Drink from 2023.
title: Henri de Villamont 2015 Châtelots Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This is one of the higher elevation premier crus in Puligny. In this warm vintage it has managed to give a wine that is crisp and mineral. To contrast with this, the wine also has a creamy, toasty character from the wood aging. Drink from 2021.
title: Louis Latour 2015 Sous le Puits Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Translated, the name of this vineyard means fogs, maybe a reference to a predisposition to get misty in the morning. Adjacent to Pommard, the wine has some of the structure of that village allied to the rounder character of Volnay. Together, these elements make for a wine that is likely to age well. Drink this ripe and smoky wine from 2023.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2015 Les Brouillards Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: This is a very fine expression of this always richly structured appellation. It is still young, dominated by firm tannins as well as dark black fruits and the spice of wood aging. The acidity, the black cherry flavors and the density of the wine all suggest its great potential. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaines Dominique Piron 2015 Grand Cras  (Morgon)

description: Bold and ripe, this is a rich wine. It has great red-cherry and berry fruits that are filled out by the dry core of tannins. It comes from a vineyard that is close to the premier crus of Beaune and it has something of the extra structure and texture of that appellation. That means it will need to age. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine Arnoux Père et Fils 2015 Les Peuillets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: There is a fine perfumed character with this wine. It floats above the ripe cherry and berry fruits and the firm structure of rich tannins. The vineyard, centrally located in Nuits-Saint-Georges, has given a firm wine with the great potential to be generous. Drink from 2021.
title: Château de Santenay 2015 Les Pruliers Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A beautiful orange pink-colored wine. Young and fresh, it has great depth of raspberry and red fruit flavors as well as a delicious summer fruit brightness and liveliness. A beautiful Champagne, that will repay some bottle aging.
title: Louis Roederer 2004 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A wonderfully toasty, yeasty wine, with creamed apple fruits, flavors that show some softness but never deviate from a crisp, steely character. Although this wine is ready to drink, consider keeping for 3–4 years.
title: Taittinger 2004 Brut Millesimé  (Champagne)

description: A wonderfully toasty, yeasty wine, with creamed apple fruits, flavors that show some softness but never deviate from a crisp, steely character. Although this wine is ready to drink, consider keeping for 3–4 years.
title: Taittinger 2004 Brut Millesimé  (Champagne)

description: Dominated by rich Pinot Noir, this is still impressively youthful. It has a sense of power and concentration, with intense white fruit, yeast and just a hint of honey. It could age, but is ready to drink.
title: Gosset 1998 Celebris Vintage Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This fruity wine is still developing. It hasn't achieved the full ripe fruit experience, still showing structure and a mineral, terroir character. Drink this textured wine from 2016.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: This fruity wine is still developing. It hasn't achieved the full ripe fruit experience, still showing structure and a mineral, terroir character. Drink this textured wine from 2016.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: This structured wine also has bright red fruits and juicy acidity. It's an attractive bottle now, the tannins showing through while leaving room for an elegant, leisurely aftertaste. Drink from 2015.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2011  Vosne-Romanée

description: This rich and full-bodied wine brings out the structure of a Chassagne premier cru. It has generous fruits and a toasty structure. Drink from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2011 Les Morgeots Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is a crisp and fruity style of Champagne, lightweight and attractively fresh. It comes from the original of the three Champagne producers with Heidsieck in their name, and this nonvintage seems to be finding its form after several fallow years. Drink this apple-fruited wine now.
title: Heidsieck & Co Monopole NV Blue Top Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is tight, mineral and on the dry side of Brut. The 100% Chardonnay taste signals chalky soil—crisp and fresh. A pure line of acidity cuts through the texture, giving a balanced, always dry wine that could do with more bottle aging to soften the piercing acidity at the end.
designation: Cuvée des Moines Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is tight, mineral and on the dry side of Brut. The 100% Chardonnay taste signals chalky soil—crisp and fresh. A pure line of acidity cuts through the texture, giving a balanced, always dry wine that could do with more bottle aging to soften the piercing acidity at the end.
designation: Cuvée des Moines Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: While this wine certainly has a tannic background, it is already showing fruitiness and ripe berry and red plum flavors. That makes for a warm, rounded wine that will age relatively quickly. Drink from 2016.
title: Manuel Olivier 2011 Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Dry and crisp, this bright, tight Champagne has citrus, red fruits and a strong steely character at its heart. The bottling tastes young, fresh and would benefit from some bottle age. Hold it until mid-2015.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Le Rosé Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: On the light side, this is an attractive wine, but missing the intensity of some other wines from Saint-Julien. It's balanced, fresh and elegant.
title: Château Talbot 2008  Saint-Julien

description: Good smoky wood aromas augur a medium-weight wine with attractive black fruits and light tannins. It's attractive, with fresh acidity on the finish.
title: Château Siran 2008  Margaux

description: Smoke, chocolate, toffee, spice and caramel. It's ripe, very open, full-bodied, with a rich Merlot character.
title: Château Nenin 2008 Fugue de Nenin  (Pomerol)

description: Stalky, firm wine, powered by tannins, although not weighty, and showing black berry flavors and acidity. Not a wine for the long term.
title: Château de Fieuzal 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: A soft, ripe wine, its fruit rounded by an oily Sémillon texture. There is weight here, wih spice, wood and a creamy aftertaste. For medium-term aging.
title: Château Olivier 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: Soft, very round, already approachable, the wine is flavored with spice, black berry flavors and sweet tannins. Juicy, ripe Merlot for medium-term aging.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a full-bodied, ripe and rich example of Tavel. Flourishes of dried flowers and spices dress up ripe melons and berries, finishing long and warming. It's a rosé tailor made for cool end-of-summer evenings.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2016 La Dame Rousse  (Tavel)

description: In 1999, Stéphane and Paola Gabard resurrected winemaking at an estate that has belonged to the family since the 18th century. Ripe, rich and still retaining its youthful structure, this concentrated wine will need time. With its dense texture and layers of black-currant fruit, it has a fine future. Drink from 2019.
title: Château La Gabarre 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Made by the same team as neighboring Château Chasse-Spleen, the wine from this 17-acre estate is fruity, with the potential for a smooth texture and rich fruit. The wine has spice, juicy black currants and a delicious aftertaste. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Gressier Grand Poujeaux 2015  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: Made by the same team as neighboring Château Chasse-Spleen, the wine from this 17-acre estate is fruity, with the potential for a smooth texture and rich fruit. The wine has spice, juicy black currants and a delicious aftertaste. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Gressier Grand Poujeaux 2015  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: Still with intense tannins, this Merlot-dominated blend is young. The fruitiness is all there with ripe smoky fruit and blackberry flavors. It just needs a while for the tannins to soften into ripe generous fruitiness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Cormeil-Figeac 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine has ripe fruit, tannins that have now softened and signs of maturity. It is still juicy with attractive acidity as well as a touch of spice. Finely balanced, the wine from this Cru Bourgeois estate is elegant and ready to drink.
title: Château Castera 2011  Médoc

description: The wine has ripe fruit, tannins that have now softened and signs of maturity. It is still juicy with attractive acidity as well as a touch of spice. Finely balanced, the wine from this Cru Bourgeois estate is elegant and ready to drink.
title: Château Castera 2011  Médoc

description: Among top-flight Northern Rhône, this has to be considered a solid value. Hints of melon and gingery spice mark the nose, while the palate is filled out by pear and melon notes. It's full bodied and silky in texture, finishing with echoes of melon and marshmallow. Drink now.
title: M. Chapoutier 2014 Les Meysonniers White (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: This ripe and rich wine balances its wood-aging flavors with its ripe tropical fruits. Pineapple, apricots and delicious acidity are all present. It will be a rich and delicious wine, but needs time, so drink from 2020. The first harvest at this château was in 1252. The property is now owned by Bernard Magrez, a wine, art, culture and gastronomy patron.
title: Château Pape Clément 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Ripe and showing the typical generosity of this château, this bold, round wine is powered by rich berry and damson fruit flavors. It is juicy and perfumed, while the tannic structure and wood flavors are enveloped by the fruits. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Lynch-Bages 2013  Pauillac

description: An impressive, solidly tannic wine, this also manages to capture fresh fruits and acidity in a balanced package. The wine is firm, dark and designed for serious aging. It is packed with fruit tannins, structure and black currant fruitiness. Drink from 2022.
title: Château la Gaffelière 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: The tannin structure of this wine is firm and dense considering the vintage, giving impressive concentration that contrasts with the ripe black berry and plum fruits that are beginning to show through. The wine is already balanced, the hints of wood smoothing the fresh, bright black-currant flavors. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Ducru Beaucaillou 2013  Saint-Julien

description: In an opulent style, this wine is full of ripe fruits and generous tannins. Juicy acidity gives it a fresh lift typical of the year, although this wine has a depth of flavor that promises well for its development. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Léoville Poyferré 2013  Saint-Julien

description: This wine is rich while at the same time having a stalky character that gives smokiness, texture and acidity. These combine with black-currant flavors that finish the wine with great freshness. It's a light vintage for this estate, fruity and certainly for the medium-term. Drink from 2020. The estate has been in the Dillon family since 1985.
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: With ripe, spicy fruit, this is a concentrated, dense wine. It has young, firm tannins that are beginning to integrate with the juicy black fruits and fine, perfumed acidity. This is a serious wine, showing how well this estate is developing even in a difficult year. Drink this from 2022.
title: Château Bélair-Monange 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Structured and dense, this wine revels in its tension and tight texture. While there are plenty of black fruits, the dry core of tannins and the rich, perfumed character show this wine's best quality. It is well balanced and ripe while guarding all the freshness of the vintage. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Angélus 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Structured and dense, this wine revels in its tension and tight texture. While there are plenty of black fruits, the dry core of tannins and the rich, perfumed character show this wine's best quality. It is well balanced and ripe while guarding all the freshness of the vintage. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Angélus 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: With a higher proportion of Merlot (92%) than usual, this is a round, ripe wine released at just 20% of normal production. The generous texture and tannins are well integrated into the rich fruit. It's juicy, broad and showing the typical acidity of the vintage. With its tannic structure, the wine will age well. Drink from 2020.
title: Vieux Château Certan 2013  Pomerol

description: This wine is rich with jammy fruits and ripe acidity. Firm tannins are only just making a mark on the sweet, fleshy fruitiness. It revels in its concentrated fruit and in the dark tannins that are still at the back. This wine will certainly age, dense while always fresh and juicy at the end. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Valandraud 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: This wine has considerable potential, with rich tannins and firm fruits. It is solid, very dry at this stage although this is balanced by dark plum skin and blackberry flavors. The wine will develop slowly, so don't drink before 2022. The first harvest at this estate was in 1252. The property is now owned by Bernard Magrez, a wine, art, culture and gastronomy patron.
title: Château Pape Clément 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Very well balanced, this is already a beautiful wine that could almost be drunk now. Smooth tannins and oak are layered with red and black-currant fruits that are perfumed and fresh. The structure is all there, just light and fragrant. Drink now, although the wine will fill out from 2022.
title: Château Palmer 2013  Margaux

description: Very well balanced, this is already a beautiful wine that could almost be drunk now. Smooth tannins and oak are layered with red and black-currant fruits that are perfumed and fresh. The structure is all there, just light and fragrant. Drink now, although the wine will fill out from 2022.
title: Château Palmer 2013  Margaux

description: This wine is concentrated, dense and has superb acidity and fresh white fruits. Crisp apples, pears and spice from the wood aging are all there. Made with 90% Sauvignon Blanc and 10% Sémillon, this is a wine for the long haul, so, if you can, wait until 2020 before drinking. Bonnet family owners are in the mix; Michel Rolland consults.
title: Château Malartic-Lagravière 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Soft, fruity and with a ripe almond character, this is a bone dry Chenin. It has a delicious, juicy feel, crisp with tight acidity and minerality. Drink now for its freshness.
title: Vignoble Brisebarre 2012 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This opens with mealy aromas of watermelon and cherry that smell rich and full. The palate offers a bit more restraint, with focused flavors of tart cherry and berry that are framed by prickly acidity. The finish is short, but crisp and mouthwatering.
title: Bernard Magrez 2013 Bleu de Mer Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: The flint and chalk nature of the soil shows in this wine. From old vines well situated in the Premier Cru of Montmains, it has concentration and a tight, young texture that will need to develop. It is fresh and full of citrus now, although a riper, creamy character will be coming through as it matures. Drink from 2018.
designation: Les Vieilles Vignes Montmains Premier Cru
title: Domaine Pascal Bouchard 2014 Les Vieilles Vignes Montmains Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Named in honor of the Romans who first planted vines in Sancerre, this wine has its feet firmly in the chalk soil that gives it richness as well as minerality. Ripe with touches of yellow fruits as well as lime and other citrus flavors, it is structured, dense and likely to age well. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Vacheron 2014 Les Romains  (Sancerre)

description: La Nerthe's luxury white cuvée relies on Roussanne for richness and Clairette for freshness, with tiny amounts of Grenache Blanc and Bourboulenc rounding out the blend. The result is a rich but balanced wine, loaded with honey and toasted coconut but also boasting mouthwatering pineapple flavors and a tremendously long finish. Drink now–2025.
title: Château La Nerthe 2012 Clos de Beauvenir White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This intense, full-bodied wine is packed with ripe yellow fruits that are balanced with a powerful, concentrated texture. The wine is very young, with the toast and fruits full of energy and needing to round out. This complex wine will age. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Pascal Bouchard 2013 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is slowly developing into a beautiful wine. It dazzles with its combination of fresh acidity and generously ripe yellow-fruit flavors. The texture and structure give a steely edge to this impressive wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2012 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is slowly developing into a beautiful wine. It dazzles with its combination of fresh acidity and generously ripe yellow-fruit flavors. The texture and structure give a steely edge to this impressive wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2012 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: From a domaine located in Gigondas, this is a profound Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Yes, there's some toasty oak on the nose, but underneath is a big, sturdy core of dark cherries, bay leaf and garrigue. This is a structured wine that's built for the cellar. Drink 2018–2030.
title: Domaine Santa Duc 2012 Habemus Papam Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Considered by many as the finest of the Grand Crus, Les Clos is steep, south-facing and impressive just to look at. Like many wines from this vineyard, this wine has immense power and concentration. It is rich, dense and full of tight but rich yellow and green fruits shot through with intense acidity. It is still very young and needs to be aged. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Pascal Bouchard 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Considered by many as the finest of the Grand Crus, Les Clos is steep, south-facing and impressive just to look at. Like many wines from this vineyard, this wine has immense power and concentration. It is rich, dense and full of tight but rich yellow and green fruits shot through with intense acidity. It is still very young and needs to be aged. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Pascal Bouchard 2013 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Winemaker Julie Voirin has vines in Cramant on the Côte des Blancs. This wine, perfumed with wild flowers and freshly picked almonds, is ripe and fruity while having a crisp, mineral texture. It is well balanced, soft and ripe at the end, and ready to drink.
title: Dalÿs NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This estate in the Aube region has produced a pink-colored rose that is soft. It is full of ripe strawberry fruits that are rounded out with fresh acidity and with a full aftertaste. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Bligny NV Grand Réserve Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: While this wine does have structure, it also offers some lean fruitiness. Plum skins, banana and tight black-currant flavors dominate, cut through with acidity. The wine has structure and some potential. Drink from late 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine de la Roche Noire  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: While this wine does have structure, it also offers some lean fruitiness. Plum skins, banana and tight black-currant flavors dominate, cut through with acidity. The wine has structure and some potential. Drink from late 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine de la Roche Noire  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: More tannic structure than fruit at this stage, this is a firm, mineral-textured wine. A smoky, spicy character gives complexity, but also is still masks the red-currant fruits. Drink from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Château des Déduits  (Fleurie)

description: More tannic structure than fruit at this stage, this is a firm, mineral-textured wine. A smoky, spicy character gives complexity, but also is still masks the red-currant fruits. Drink from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Château des Déduits  (Fleurie)

description: This wine is rich and gently textured with acidity under the red-berry fruits. Hints of fruit tannins balance the essentially juicy character of the wine. Drink from the end of 2015. Most of the Les Merrains grapes come from the Ferraud family estate in Vaux en Beaujolais.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2014 Les Merrains  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Friendly notes of red and yellow apple dominate nose and palate. On the mouth a little bitterness creeps in, but overall the palate remains balanced, clean and fresh.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann NV Bonheur Festif Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: From vines around the village of Lancié (near Moulin-à-Vent and Fleurie), this ripe, warm rosé is full of red-berry fruits that have raspberry and tangy bitter orange flavors. It's rich, spicy and a rosé for food.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2014 Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: While this Chardonnay is rich, it is also well balanced. It offers light spice, rounded yellow fruits and just a touch of minerality to give texture, plus toastiness to add interest. The end brings out the acidity.
title: Domaine des Marrans 2014  Beaujolais Blanc

description: While this Chardonnay is rich, it is also well balanced. It offers light spice, rounded yellow fruits and just a touch of minerality to give texture, plus toastiness to add interest. The end brings out the acidity.
title: Domaine des Marrans 2014  Beaujolais Blanc

description: Ripe and soft, this 100% Gamay puts its fruitiness right on display. It is fully packed with red currants that are sustained by light, mineral-textured tannins. It is ready to drink. Consider giving it a light chill in the summer. Thomas Collange, the eighth generation, has joined dad Bernard in running the winery.
title: Domaine de Colonat 2014 Tradition  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A subdued nose of ripe, scented yellow Reine Claude and mirabelle plums suggests a sun-kissed wine. The palate reinforces this stone-fruited richness with elements of apricot and peach compote. This is off-dry but delicately balanced, rich but not opulent. Soft and gentle harmoniousness pervades from start to long finish.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2014 Furstentum Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A blend of Syrah and Cinsault gives this wine that has some structure as well plenty of perfumed fruit. Lively and fruity, it revels in its crisp, open red-currant flavors. The wine will make a fine apéritif.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A blend of Syrah and Cinsault gives this wine that has some structure as well plenty of perfumed fruit. Lively and fruity, it revels in its crisp, open red-currant flavors. The wine will make a fine apéritif.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From 50 year old vines, this fruity wine is both crisp and clean and also full of warmer flavors. Citrus, pear and apricot notes all mingle in this delicious, concentrated wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2016 Cruet Vieille Vigne d'Idylle Jacquère (Savoie)

description: Apricot and peach aromas lead the way in this still-tight, mineral wine. Its richness is drawn up at this stage, showing crisp acidity as well as honey and pineapple flavors. It's likely to age well, so drink from 2019.
title: Clos Dady 2014  Sauternes

description: This young wine with its edge of dry botrytis is just starting out. Apricot aromas are a sign of what is to come, as its fine balance between honey and fruit comes into play. Acidity keeps everything crisp. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Tanesse 2015  Cadillac

description: Big, bold tannins set this wine up with fine potential. It has structure and good concentration. Richly endowed with black fruit, it will age well. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Pillebois 2015 Tradition  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This dense wine is now beginning to mature. It has the bold black fruit of the vintage, which is overlaid by dark chocolate notes and some bitterness. Still firm, it will probably need to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Pailhas 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: This dense wine is now beginning to mature. It has the bold black fruit of the vintage, which is overlaid by dark chocolate notes and some bitterness. Still firm, it will probably need to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Pailhas 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: This perfumed wine is firm with tannins that gives a spicy character. It has a dry core, a juicy aftertaste and rich blackberry fruit that will certainly develop as it matures. Give it some time and drink from 2021.
title: Château Labrousse 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This perfumed wine is firm with tannins that gives a spicy character. It has a dry core, a juicy aftertaste and rich blackberry fruit that will certainly develop as it matures. Give it some time and drink from 2021.
title: Château Labrousse 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Fresh apple and honey aromas give this fruity wine a great start. With its acidity, spice, touch of honey and crisp white fruit, it's delicious, perfumed and ripe. A full-bodied wine that's a pleasure to drink now, with food.
title: Château Jolys 2015  Jurançon Sec

description: This wine's jammy black fruit aromas lead to a soft, full and ripe palate. Black plum flavors, rich tannins and layers of toast from wood aging signal both youth and solid, firm character. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Hervé-Laroque 2015  Fronsac

description: This wine is firm and structured. It also has fine black fruit and balanced acidity. Full bodied, fruity and backed by solid tannins. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Cranne 2015 6ème Génération  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A tightly wrought, crisp texture gives the typical cool character of this appellation. This wine is full of white fruits layered with juicy acidity. Full in the mouth, it is delicious to drink although it will be better from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Pernand-Vergelesses

description: Lightly mineral in texture, this wine is perfumed and ripe, with both acidity and refreshing citrus fruits. These contrast with hints of yellow fruits that will show well as this develops into a bright and crisp wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This village wine comes from a parcel of low-yielding 70-year-old vines. It is firm and concentrated with a strong layer of tannins over black fruits. Blackberry and black plum are balanced by the acidity. Together with the tannins, they promise aging. Drink from 2018.
designation: Château d'Antigny La Rue du Port
title: Maison Stéphane Brocard 2014 Château d'Antigny La Rue du Port  (Pommard)

description: In the prestigious village of Vosne-Romanée, there is little room for anything but Grand and Premier Cru vineyards. This wine, from the flatter ground at the bottom of the slope, shows something of the structure that makes the great wines. To balance that it also has bright fruit and plenty of acidity. It will be ready to drink from early 2018.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2013 Collection  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Smoky aromas and wood flavors are still dominant in this wine even after five years. It does have some concentration and red-berry fruits, although the structure and the tannins are still firm. The wine should age further to allow the fruit to mature and shine. Drink from 2019.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010 Collection  (Clos de Vougeot)

description: This single-vineyard wine has great aging potential. The minerality and tension in this wine with its apple fruit and texture is still resolving itself. Wait at least until 2019 before drinking.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2014 Le Clos  (Vouvray)

description: While this domaine is based in Chaintré it also has vines in Pouilly-Fuissé. This wine comes from a 2.4-acre vineyard on the clay and chalk soil that marks this appellation. It is rich, full in the mouth with a mineral texture and lively acidity. It is still young and will be better from late 2017.
title: Domaine Fabrice Larochette 2014 Les Robées  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is really mature Muscadet, yet it's certainly not too old. It is toasty, with almond, spice and vanilla flavors plus the concentration that comes from old vines. It is a fascinating wine, ripe and with considerable depths. The wine is, of course, ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Cognettes 2005 Tentation Sélection Vieilles Vignes  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Produced from 65-year-old vines, this is a rich and perfumed wine from the estate of Nicolas Potel. It is structured, balancing the red fruits and acidity with a solid framework of tannins. Spice from the wood aging shows lightly, while the wine finishes with crisp red-currant acidity.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: At the southern end of Nuits Saint-Georges, this vineyard produces a ripe and full style of wine. This wine has those characters along with the tannins and the acidity of the vintage to produced a juicy wine that will age well. The aftertaste keeps that crunchy, crisp character. Drink it from 2019.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014 Les Porêts Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: From the Mâcon appellation that is dominated by the formidable rock of Solutré, this is a ripe, full-bodied wine. It offers juicy acidity, fresh sliced apple flavors and a touch of spice. The wine is ready, although it will be better from late 2016.
title: Domaine Trouillet 2014  Mâcon Solutré

description: This aromatic, herbal wine is crisp and lively, with bright acidity and green fruits. Citrus and gooseberry flavors bring out an even fresher side. It finishes light and fruity. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Villalin 2014  Quincy

description: Based in Humbligny, midway between Menetou-Salon and Sancerre, this producer has vines in both appellations. A delicate, perfumed wine, this enjoys a good balance between acidity and apple and white peach flavors. It's rounded, full in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Champarlan 2014  Sancerre

description: This wine is superripe and fruit-forward, loaded with black cherry and plum fruit. It might even be a bit warm on the palate, but ends on a supple, silky note. Drink now–2020.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Réserve Grand Veneur Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This wine is superripe and fruit-forward, loaded with black cherry and plum fruit. It might even be a bit warm on the palate, but ends on a supple, silky note. Drink now–2020.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Réserve Grand Veneur Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This soft, ripe wine is full of ready-to-drink fruits. Fresh apple and smooth puréed pear flavors are nicely lifted by the acidity. It's a clean, fruity wine, finishing freshly.
title: Florian Roblin 2014 Champ Gibault Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: This perfumed wine has a rustic edge that should blow away as the wine matures. For the fruit, it is red-berry time: bright, soft and lifted by gentle tannins and lively acidity. The wine will improve for a few more months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Florian Roblin 2014 Champ Gibault Pinot Noir (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: This perfumed wine has a rustic edge that should blow away as the wine matures. For the fruit, it is red-berry time: bright, soft and lifted by gentle tannins and lively acidity. The wine will improve for a few more months, so drink from late 2017.
title: Florian Roblin 2014 Champ Gibault Pinot Noir (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: This is firm and tannic, reflecting the challenges of the vintage, yet it does show classic garrigue aromas and flavors of black olives and dark cherries. Drink it now with grilled meats, or hold it a year or two in the hopes of it softening a little.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: Very herbal and green, this is an intensely grassy wine, with a catty character. It's crisp, fresh and ready to drink.
title: Eric Louis 2014 Les Celliers de la Pauline  (Sancerre)

description: From vines nearly 30 years in age, this is Pinard's immediately attractive, drink-now wine. Fresh lemon and grapefruit flavors are lightly herbal in character. Juicy, lively and crisp, it's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vincent Pinard 2014 Florès  (Sancerre)

description: Intensely herbal, this is a crisp, cool wine. Layers of citrus, grapefruit and gooseberry mingle with grassy, herbal flavors. Green, fresh and drinkable now, this is a fine apéritif style.
title: Domaine Philippe Portier 2014 Cuvée des Victoires  (Quincy)

description: Grown on different parcels of chalk and clay soil, this soft, ripe wine is attractive to drink now. The smooth texture is nicely lifted by acidity and fresh citrus flavors. The aftertaste is fresh, crisp and fruity.
title: Domaine Pellé 2014 Les Bornés  (Menetou-Salon)

description: Produced from young vines, this is a fresh, fruity, and crisp wine. It has attractive apple and pear flavors, brightened further by citrus overtones. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Domaine Fouassier 2014 Sur le Fort  (Sancerre)

description: Very herbal and grassy, this crisp wine emphasizes fruit rather than texture. It is ripe, fruity with citrus and gooseberry flavors that are heightened by the acidity. It's a wine to drink now.
title: Domaine Dyckerhoff 2014 Sauvignon Blanc (Reuilly)

description: Grown on gravel terraces that rise up from the Loire, this wine is both structuredand fruity. Fresh juicy black currant flavors bring acidity along with them, leaving a light tannic structure at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Damien Lorieux 2014 Graviers Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: With its bitter cherry flavors and light, smoky tannins, this perfumed wine has a richer juicy element in the background. Lightly textured, it's more about fruit that is up front and refreshing. Drink now, although the wine will be better from 2017.
title: Denis Jamain 2014 Pinot Noir (Reuilly)

description: The color is light on this wine, which is really only just beginning to show richness. The botrytis dominates, with a fat, oily texture needing many years of aging. There is a lovely ripe orange marmalade flavor on the finish.
title: Château Doisy-Daëne 2007  Barsac

description: An astonishing nose of peach and bramble with refreshing accents of lemon zest. The intense, off-dry palate of pistachio, pecan and apricot lead to a long, minerally finish. Carries its hefty 15.5% alcohol well. Best now to 2016.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2007 Herrenweg De Turckheim Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Intensely rich in character, touched lightly by new wood, the acidity crispening the ripe orange and sweet peach skin texture. This is a gorgeous, opulent wine.
title: Château Doisy-Védrines 2007  Barsac

description: A family-owned vineyard on this famous slope in Morgon supplies the grapes to Duboeuf for the wine. It is structured and dense, full of black plum and berry flavors. Acidity cuts through the tannins, resulting in a wine that will age well. Drink from 2019.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: A family-owned vineyard on this famous slope in Morgon supplies the grapes to Duboeuf for the wine. It is structured and dense, full of black plum and berry flavors. Acidity cuts through the tannins, resulting in a wine that will age well. Drink from 2019.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: Made from the Domaine's oldest vines, this is a generous concentrated wine. With its ripe black fruits and firm tannins it is also a wine to age. It has perfumed black-cherry flavors that are enhanced and lifted by the acidity. Drink this wine from late 2017.
title: Domaine les Capréoles 2015 Diaclase  (Régnié)

description: Full-bodied, concentrated and richly textured, this is a succulent wine with refreshingly balanced oak. A floral note on the nose gives way to apricot and ginger-like spice, then finishes with a flourish of mouthwatering acidity. Drink now.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2014  Condrieu

description: This is a ripe, somewhat creamy style of Côte Rôtie, with potent mocha notes complementing hints of clove, olive and plum. The tannins are silky-supple on the finish, so don't hesitate to pop a cork soon. Drink now–2021.
title: Olivier Ravoire 2011  Côte Rôtie

description: This soft and lightly herbal wine has a smooth texture that brings out its ripe red fruit and plays down its acidity. That makes it easy to drink, rich and generous on the finish.
title: Château Ferry Lacombe 2016 Mira Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: Eight months of oak aging gives this wine its spicy, lightly toasty character. Ripe red apple and grapefruit flavors add to its richness. Finely balanced, it's ready to drink now.
title: Charlier & Fils NV Brut Carte Noire  (Champagne)

description: A blend of local grapes with Syrah, this fruity wine enfolds a core of tannins. Stalky, smoky flavors balance with a red plum-skin texture and crisp acidity. It is young, the fruit still developing, so drink from 2017.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2013 Domaine Vetriccie Red (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: A blend of local grapes with Syrah, this fruity wine enfolds a core of tannins. Stalky, smoky flavors balance with a red plum-skin texture and crisp acidity. It is young, the fruit still developing, so drink from 2017.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2013 Domaine Vetriccie Red (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: Exquisitely fresh and fruity, this delicious rosé has crisp red currant fruits that are tangy, bright and tight. It is very refreshing now, although in a few months the almost shocking acidity will soften. Drink from mid-2016.
title: Patient Cottat 2014 Anciennes Vignes Rosé (Sancerre)

description: With its massively concentrated blackberry fruit framed in ample new oak, this bears a bit of resemblance to some Australian Shirazes. It's mouthfilling but supple, with nuances of Christmas spices like cinnamon, clove and anise that linger on the long finish. Drink 2014–2023.
title: Cave de Tain 2009 Gambert de Loche  (Hermitage)

description: This seems awfully civilized for Cornas, with bold, clean blueberry fruit front and center, anchored by a framework of cedar and vanilla. This full-bodied, lush, creamy expression of Northern Rhône Syrah should drink well through 2025. Imported by DHI Selections, T. Edward Wines Ltd
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2009 Les Barcillants  (Cornas)

description: A full-bodied, rich wine, with tannins either supremely smoooth or just concealed under masses of plummy fruit. Yet despite the enormous ripeness, it's not lacking nuance, boasting savory notes of espresso and leather. Drinkable now, but should age through 2023, at least.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2009 La Louvée  (Cornas)

description: Made from grape must that is heated before fermentation, this is powerful and concentrated, with a rich and very dense character. Prune, dried fruit and fresh plum notes combine with an intense background of acidity. Age for at least five years.
designation: Clos Triguedina The New Black Wine
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Clos Triguedina The New Black Wine Malbec (Cahors)

description: Open and primal on nose, this has notes of game, roasted meat, lead pencil, green bell pepper and blackberry. It offers succulent fruit on the midpalate, accompanied by generous viscosity and oak. The wine sits broadly across the palate with significant heft, chewy tannins and moderate acidity. The harmony of flavors and structure lingers onto the lengthy finish.
title: Prieuré St. Jean de Bébian 2008 Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: From a vineyard just at the edge of the Bandol appellation, this fresh and fruity wine has a lively, light touch that contrasts with its richer texture. The aftertaste, packed with acidity and orange freshness, is delicious.
title: Domaines Bunan 2014 Bélouvé Rosé (Bandol)

description: Soft and rounded, this is a warm, ripe wine. With its yellow fruits and light texture, it's fruity, already open for drinking. Crisp lemon gives an appealing edge to the bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2013  Chablis

description: Delicious and tangy, this wine is tensely textured. With its pale orange-pink color it is fruity and packed with acidity and red currants, finished with a twist of spice.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2014 Cuvée Paparazzi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organically grown grapes, this razor-sharp wine is fresh with caramel and red berry flavors. It's a lively wine enhanced by a zingy orange zest character. Drink now, although the wine will be better at the end of 2015.
title: Domaine d'Eole 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The palest salmon-pink color sets the scene for a lightly fruity wine. It has caramel, raspberry and crisp pear flavors. Pure fruitiness makes it refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Coteaux Varois is a small region that gives lively, gentle wine such as this delicious rosé. It's pink in color, ripe, touched by caramel and with a rounded, soft aftertaste.
title: Château Routas 2014 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Very pale in color, this soft and gently fruity wine is almost ethereal in its lightness. It's fresh with attractive acidity, a touch of red currant and orange and refreshing at the end.
title: Chateau Peyrassol 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the epitome of Provence rosé, made for balmy oceanside drinking. It is fruity and tangy, with an attractive bite of acidity to lift the fresh while rounded character.
title: Château du Rouët 2014 Cuvée 1840 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This pale orange-pink colored wine offers ripe fruits, spice and a tangy orange and pepper character. The Grenache, Cinsault and Rolle blend is full-bodied and rounded, offering a good opportunity to be paired with food.
title: Château du Puget 2014 Cuvée Tradition Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This pale orange-pink colored wine offers ripe fruits, spice and a tangy orange and pepper character. The Grenache, Cinsault and Rolle blend is full-bodied and rounded, offering a good opportunity to be paired with food.
title: Château du Puget 2014 Cuvée Tradition Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Owned by Champagne producer Bruno Paillard, this estate produces a deliciously fresh and crisp wine. Red fruits dominate along with steely acidity and the freshest aftertaste.
title: Château des Sarrins 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is distinctive in its Dutch gin bottle. It's full of fruit and crisp acidity, while an unusual herbal layer gives extra freshness. Tangy and aromatic, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2014 VieVité Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Like so many Provence wines, this is made from organically grown grapes: Grenache and Cinsault. It is fresh and light, with a crisp, poised texture that gives an attractive tang and lifts the red fruits. It is fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Saint Roman d'Esclans 2014 Bain de Soleil Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Aromatic and richly fruity, this has surprising weight that gives the palate a round and smooth quality. The acidity is there, although it is covered by the superrich fruit.
title: Domaine de Moulin-Pouzy 2011 White (Bergerac Sec)

description: This is a smooth, rounded rosé made mainly from Négrette. Along with its youthful crispness, it also has a more creamy side and a crushed strawberry flavor, all lightened by balancing acidity.
title: Château Plaisance 2011 Rosé (Fronton)

description: Smooth and rounded, this has light acidity, with citrus and pear flavors and a crisp finish. It needs to age for a year longer to allow its textured character a chance to smooth out even more.
title: Château Bélingard 2011 White (Bergerac Sec)

description: Smooth and rounded, this has light acidity, with citrus and pear flavors and a crisp finish. It needs to age for a year longer to allow its textured character a chance to smooth out even more.
title: Château Bélingard 2011 White (Bergerac Sec)

description: A lively, spicy wine that shows ginger and nutmeg character, followed by ripe white pears. Beneath this vivid character, the texture is smooth, honeyed, deliciously ripe.
title: Château Doisy-Daëne 2006  Barsac

description: The second wine of Château Ausone is an impressive younger brother. It has the same density and suavity, but the fruits are fresher, lighter. Those fruits go right through the firm tannins, leaving spice and delicious, juicy flavors. It is a complete wine, showing all the exuberant freshness of 2006.
title: Chapelle d'Ausone 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: Christian Moueix's new property is already showing its potential. In the second vintage under his control, it is producing a huge, dense wine, with black cherry juice, blackberry and bitter cocoa flavors. The wine's structure is firm and solid, but with the potential over the next 4–5 years of revealing a more generous side.
title: Château Providence 2006  Pomerol

description: Christian Moueix's new property is already showing its potential. In the second vintage under his control, it is producing a huge, dense wine, with black cherry juice, blackberry and bitter cocoa flavors. The wine's structure is firm and solid, but with the potential over the next 4–5 years of revealing a more generous side.
title: Château Providence 2006  Pomerol

description: A lovely, fresh, juicy wine that has a delightful lilt to its fruit. Red and black berries intermingle easily with a core of firm tannins. New wood is a major part of the firm texture, but never too dominant. This is a finely structured wine, already well developed.
title: Château Pavie Macquin 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: A beautifully dense wine, concentrated and ripe. With its opulent style, packed with sweetness, this is dominated by its smooth, velvet texture, the botrytis packed behind. An impressive wine that is good to drink now, but should age well.
title: Château de Malle 2006  Sauternes

description: Taking advantage of the delicious fruit of 2006, this Branaire-Ducru shows a charming side. It brings out ripe, spicy black plums and black cherry spice to go with the lively, fresh tannins. That's not to say that there isn't structure, but today it is the fruit that dominates.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2006  Saint-Julien

description: As a contrast to Jonathan Maltus's Le Carré, this single-vineyard wine, from vines situated only 100 yards away, has a taut, mineral flavor, with an initial austere character which then opens out to give dark bitter chocolate and plum skin flavors. It is potentially a richer, more impressive wine, but it needs aging for 4–5 years.
title: Les Astéries 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: From a small, single-vineyard plot of 3.5 acres, this shows intense fruit, very aromatic in character. Its concentration is immense, dark black fruits vying with spice, tar and sweet plum pudding flavors. The Cabernet Franc shows through well here, giving a perfumed finish.
title: Le Carré 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: From a small, single-vineyard plot of 3.5 acres, this shows intense fruit, very aromatic in character. Its concentration is immense, dark black fruits vying with spice, tar and sweet plum pudding flavors. The Cabernet Franc shows through well here, giving a perfumed finish.
title: Le Carré 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: Licorice, chocolate and black plums all show immediately in this rich, dense wine. Sweet tannins combine with fresh tobacco smokiness over jammy, ripe fruit. This array of flavors is kept in check by the over-arching acidity.
title: Château Latour à Pomerol 2006  Pomerol

description: Licorice, chocolate and black plums all show immediately in this rich, dense wine. Sweet tannins combine with fresh tobacco smokiness over jammy, ripe fruit. This array of flavors is kept in check by the over-arching acidity.
title: Château Latour à Pomerol 2006  Pomerol
