description: Leathery, earthy and spicy, with dried fruit flavors framed by soft tannins. This full-bodied offering from the new négociant venture between Nicolas Jaboulet and the Perrin family is reasonably complex and mouthwatering on the finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2007 Ermitage  (Hermitage)

description: This joint venture between Nicolas Jaboulet and the Perrin family is turning out some good examples from the Northern Rhône, like this Côte Rôtie, which is plummy, yet at the same time loaded with savory notes of cured meat and smoke, even a hint of bacon fat. Silky tannins frame the finish. Drink now–2017.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2007  Côte Rôtie

description: Hints of smoky bacon and wood are now giving this wine some maturity. It has firm tannins still, but also a rich texture, with some red berries still present.
title: Château de la Terrière 2008 Cuvée de la Lure  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Hints of smoky bacon and wood are now giving this wine some maturity. It has firm tannins still, but also a rich texture, with some red berries still present.
title: Château de la Terrière 2008 Cuvée de la Lure  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This is a tight, mineral single-vineyard wine coming from layered granite soil. Produced from organic grapes, it is crisp, tangy with lemon zest and light spice flavors and a strongly aromatic aftertaste. Drink this concentrated wine from 2017.
title: Bonnet-Huteau 2015 Les Dabinières Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Produced in one of the newly designated Muscadet crus, this mature wine has spice, almond and toast flavors while still retaining a strong mineral character. It is a far cry from typical Muscadet with its rich, soft texture. Drink this unusual wine now.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2007 Mouzillon-Tillières  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a delicious, ripe wine that is packed with apricot, apple and pear fruits. It is tangy and freshly fruity. The bright, rich fruit continues right through this wine that is ready to drink now.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2015 Made From Organically Grown Grapes  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A wine that is hard right through, missing out on the fruit. It has a bitter extracted taste that brings out dark chocolate flavors. It's unlikely to soften much.
title: Château L'Argilus du Roi 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: A wine that is hard right through, missing out on the fruit. It has a bitter extracted taste that brings out dark chocolate flavors. It's unlikely to soften much.
title: Château L'Argilus du Roi 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: Muddled blackberry, black cherry and boysenberry are the initial aromas on the nose of this wine, with supporting notes of sweet spice, toasted oak, crushed lavender and bay leaf. The palate is plush and juicy, with ripe fruit flavors that are framed by accents of licorice, toasted peppercorn and mocha. Drink now–2018.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Grenache-Carignan (Fitou)

description: Muddled blackberry, black cherry and boysenberry are the initial aromas on the nose of this wine, with supporting notes of sweet spice, toasted oak, crushed lavender and bay leaf. The palate is plush and juicy, with ripe fruit flavors that are framed by accents of licorice, toasted peppercorn and mocha. Drink now–2018.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Grenache-Carignan (Fitou)

description: Concentrated and powerfully structured now, this will benefit from some time to integrate and harmonize. Currently, all of the elements are assertively upfront, with strong oaky sensations, dense and ripe black-fruit notes and firm tannins all vying for your attention. Hints of leather, bramble, licorice root and roasted cocoa nib hang in the background, waiting for their moment to shine. Try after 2016, and through 2020.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Château de Villemajou Grand Vin Red (Corbières-Boutenac)

description: Concentrated and powerfully structured now, this will benefit from some time to integrate and harmonize. Currently, all of the elements are assertively upfront, with strong oaky sensations, dense and ripe black-fruit notes and firm tannins all vying for your attention. Hints of leather, bramble, licorice root and roasted cocoa nib hang in the background, waiting for their moment to shine. Try after 2016, and through 2020.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Château de Villemajou Grand Vin Red (Corbières-Boutenac)

description: This wine presents an intriguing blend of ripe tomato, dried herbs and Dutch cocoa on the nose, then follows that up with plenty of weight and richness on the palate. It's a savory rather than fruity version of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, with a long, finely textured finish. Ready to drink now.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 Les Sinards Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This wine presents an intriguing blend of ripe tomato, dried herbs and Dutch cocoa on the nose, then follows that up with plenty of weight and richness on the palate. It's a savory rather than fruity version of Châteauneuf-du-Pape, with a long, finely textured finish. Ready to drink now.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 Les Sinards Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: With the extra years of aging, this wine has smoothed itself out. It has lost that instant freshness of a young Muscadet and gained riper yellow and spice flavors that give it a full, rich character. There's just the right amount of acidity at the end to finish on a crisp note. Drink now.
title: Domaines Vinet 2012 Clos de la Houssaie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Still young, this is going to be a ripe wine with a fine structure and rich fruitiness. It has a mineral edge and concentration from the old vines. The berry fruits have been smoothed by the wood aging to give a rich wine that will age further. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier  2014 Le Grand Bouqueteau Réserve  (Chinon)

description: Still young, this is going to be a ripe wine with a fine structure and rich fruitiness. It has a mineral edge and concentration from the old vines. The berry fruits have been smoothed by the wood aging to give a rich wine that will age further. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier  2014 Le Grand Bouqueteau Réserve  (Chinon)

description: Another tiny cuvée from Amoureuses (80 cases produced), this one blends 40% Syrah, 35% Grenache and 25% Merlot. Toasted-coconut oak scents lead the way, followed by oodles of black plums and cherries, a splash of vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon. It's full bodied and velvety textured; rich, like dessert without sugar. Drink now–2025.
title: Chateau Les Amoureuses 2012 Terres des Amoureuses Sublime Red (Ardèche)

description: Packed with fruit and crisp acidity, this is a bright, light and perfumed wine. Red-berry flavors are lifted by red currants and a light spice. Drink now for total freshness.
title: Bernard Reverdy et Fils 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Fresh with apple and citrus, this is a perfumed, immediately attractive wine. It has bright acidity, a lightly mineral texture and a tangy, zesty aftertaste. It's young and will age although it is delicious now.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2013 Le Charmois Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: This is 100% Grenache from a vineyard planted in 1895, so genuinely old vines. That said, 2013 was a challenging vintage, and this wine shows the firmness that marks so many of the wines. It's taut, dusty and herbal, with drying tannins on the finish.
title: Château Maucoil 2013 1895 Grenache (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: A light approach to Chablis, this brings out crisp fruitiness, attractive acidity, apple flavors and a touch of steeliness. With its creamy, ripe aftertaste, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Louis Moreau 2014  Chablis

description: From a great dessert wine year, this is packed with botrytis, unctuous in texture, rich and liquor-like. It is not for aging, but is delicious now.
title: Château la Rayre 2005  Monbazillac

description: A blend of 60% Syrah and 40% Grenache, this wine offers both beefy and herbal notes among the more standard black raspberry and plum fruit flavors. Medium-full on the palate with a hint of sanguine character, this comes off a bit brighter and more balanced than one might anticipated from the bouquet.
title: Domaine Sainte Léocadie 2007 Fernand Averoux Red (Minervois)

description: This mineral-dominated Malbec is dry, packed with tannins as well as black currants and wild berries. It is on the austere side, finishing with intense acidity.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2005 Château Nozières Malbec (Cahors)

description: A broad, ripe wine, with peach and apricot flavors to go with a fine citrus tang. Full in the mouth, very fruity and attractively textured with green plum skin juiciness.
title: Clos d'Yvigne 2008 Princesse de Cleves White (Bergerac Sec)

description: While there is a mineral austerity to this wine, it has the potential for richness. It offers dark berries and sweet plums under the dense layer of tannins. Give it 2–3 years at least.
title: Château Suau 2006  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: While there is a mineral austerity to this wine, it has the potential for richness. It offers dark berries and sweet plums under the dense layer of tannins. Give it 2–3 years at least.
title: Château Suau 2006  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Sweet red peach flavors combine with honey in this soft, accessible wine. It has a layer of botrytis and just a hint of dryness. Drink now and over the next few years.
title: Château Suau 2005  Cadillac

description: Good density for a young wine. There is weight here, dry tannins that integrate well with the berry fruits and the wood. Firm, still developing; keep for 2 years.
title: Château Cabredon 2008  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Good density for a young wine. There is weight here, dry tannins that integrate well with the berry fruits and the wood. Firm, still developing; keep for 2 years.
title: Château Cabredon 2008  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: With some wood aging, this limited-production wine comes from 45-year-old vines. It balances the lightly spicy wood flavors with crisp citrus fruits. The wine is still young, still fully integrating and will be much better from 2017.
title: Pierre Morin 2014 Le Chant de l'Orme  (Sancerre)

description: Soft and rounded, this rich wine brings out the smoother side of Sauvignon Blanc. With its apple and pear flavors, it has ripeness that is cut by lime acidity. Drink this wine from 2017.
title: Alain Girard et Fils 2014  Sancerre

description: Commemorating the small boats that once plied the Loire river, this wine is fresh with a ripe yellow-fruit character that contrasts with the salty, tangy flavors to give the wine its texture and tight, steely structure. The wine will be best kept for a few months; drink from 2017.
title: Joseph Mellot 2014 Domaine des Mariniers  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Creamy wood aromas are prominent in this ripe, yellow-fruit-flavored wine. A rich, textured character hints at minerality while bringing out fresh fruit and acidity. It is ready to drink, although some of the bursting acidity will calm down by late 2016.
title: Château de Santenay 2013  Mercurey

description: This is a soft, ripe wine, with juicy acidity to keep it fresh. Flavors of lemon, tangy spice and baked apples are balanced by the taut texture of this still-young wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Santenay 2013 Clos de la Chaise Dieu  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune)

description: With grapes from 40-year-old vines, this is a dense and concentrated wine. Yellow fruit as well as crisper citrus flavors give a balance between richness and freshness. It has high alcohol that shows in the light pepper edge although this doesn't detract from the fruitiness of the aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Cédrick Bardin 2014 Les Bernadats  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Coming from a single vineyard, this rich wine has concentration as well as ripe yellow and green fruits. It's a wine to age for a few more months to bring out all its complexity. Drink from 2017.
title: Claude Riffault 2014 Les Denisottes  (Sancerre)

description: This is an attractively herbal rendering of Côtes du Rhône Villages, offering hints of flowering thyme, sage and rosemary that are rounded out by flavors of just-ripe cherries. It's a medium-bodied wine, with a long on the finish.
title: Domaine Saint-Nabor 2013 Domaine des Santonilles Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: An attractively light-textured wine, this has a red currant flavor backed by juicy acidity. It is forward and fruity; with its gentle tannins, this is ready to drink.
title: Vignoble des 2 Lunes 2009 Périgée Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Light, fruity and rounded, this wood-aged wine has white fruit, spice and apricot flavors. It could age a year, but it is delicious now.
title: Cave de Lugny 2010 Les Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: Lively, fresh and very clean, this has bright acidity and an attractive touch of strawberry. It's dry, with a crispness that balances the rich fruit.
title: Bott Frères NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a steely wine wrapped with white and green fruit flavors. It is clean, bright and full of pear and crisp apple notes. The tangy after taste is floral. Ready to drink in six months.
title: Boeckel 2010 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Tannins and a red berry flavor combine in this soft wine. It has the structure of the vintage, with a firm core; the fruit and acidity developing slowly. Keep for 2–3 years.
title: Louis Max 2010 Clos la Marche  (Mercurey)

description: Now at its drinking peak, this has attractive acidity balanced by mature flavors. It has weight, richness and a dry, steely core Enjoy this with food or by itself.
title: Hugel 2007 Jubilée Riesling (Alsace)

description: Soft and ripe, this has flavors of almond, pink grapefruit and attractive, crisp acidity. With its warm character that's embellished with toast, it is ready to drink now.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2010  Mâcon-Villages

description: A bright, slightly confected rosé blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Grenache and Cinsault, this is flavorful but a bit short.
title: Le Saint-André 2007 Rosé (Vin de Pays Var)

description: A bright, slightly confected rosé blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Grenache and Cinsault, this is flavorful but a bit short.
title: Le Saint-André 2007 Rosé (Vin de Pays Var)

description: This is a rich style of rosé, full-bodied and packed with ripe strawberry fruit. As a happy contrast to this richness, it also has a spice and orange zest element that adds both piquancy and final crispness.
title: Château les Valentines 2011 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pink fruited and light, with an attractive herbal character. The crisp acidity cuts right through the rich mouthfeel.Bright and lively, the finish has a grapefruit note that lends lift.
title: Château de l'Escarelle 2011 Les Belles Bastilles Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: A light, perfumed wine with soft tannins and bitter cherry fruits. There is an earthy edge here, and while the wine has brisk acidity, there's an easy texture. It's ready to drink.
title: Mommessin 2011 Le Clé Saint-Pierre  (Bourgogne)

description: A light, perfumed wine with soft tannins and bitter cherry fruits. There is an earthy edge here, and while the wine has brisk acidity, there's an easy texture. It's ready to drink.
title: Mommessin 2011 Le Clé Saint-Pierre  (Bourgogne)

description: Based in Nuits-Saint-Georges, Manuel Olivier has made a specialty of the wines from the Hautes Côtes in the hills behind the city. This is a light and fruity wine with freshness and some firm, dry tannins, although it's ready to drink now.
title: Manuel Olivier 2010  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: Based in Nuits-Saint-Georges, Manuel Olivier has made a specialty of the wines from the Hautes Côtes in the hills behind the city. This is a light and fruity wine with freshness and some firm, dry tannins, although it's ready to drink now.
title: Manuel Olivier 2010  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: This is a bit tarry at first, but gradually opens up to reveal slightly herbal fruit notes of cassis and hints of olive and tomato—very Provençal. It's silky on the finish, so it's easy to drink now and over the next 5–6 years.
title: Domaine La Consonnière 2010 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: With pink hints from the skins of the Pinot Gris this wine has honey and canned apricot syrup flavors. The spice and acidity complement each other at the end of this attractive wine.
title: Lucien Albrecht 2012 Cuvée Romanus Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Ripe yellow and white fruits are the dominant factor in this smooth, rich wine. It has good weight, along with a juicy, lemon and zest texture. Not for aging, unlike some Pouilly Fumé, so drink over the next few months. Screwcap.
title: Joseph Mellot 2012 Le Troncsec  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Rich and full in character, the wine, from a small walled vineyard, has red and black berry fruits along with some good flavor depth and well integrated tannins. The wine is solid, while also offering ready-to-drink fruitiness. Screwcap.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2009 Clos de la Folie Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a classic Pinot Blanc, rounded, soft and ripe. It has just a touch of spiced pear along with red apples, and a fine, fragrant layer of acidity.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2012 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a classic Pinot Blanc, rounded, soft and ripe. It has just a touch of spiced pear along with red apples, and a fine, fragrant layer of acidity.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2012 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Tasting of white grapes, this is fruity, lightly spicy and fragrant. It's a rare grape in Alsace which is a shame because its delicate, attractive fruitiness makes it a great apéritif wine.
title: Domaine Moltès 2012 Réserve Muscat (Alsace)

description: Very perfumed Riesling, full of white flowers, hedgerow fruits and fragrant acidity. There is a good granular texture to balance this fruitiness giving a ripe wine that can be drunk now.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2011 Cuvée Engel Riesling (Alsace)

description: Lively, fruity wine that is fragrant and fresh. Having no sugar and bone dry, it is as crisp as an apple. A bright mousse offers a fine fruity texture and a light, citrus aftertaste.
title: Zusslin NV Brut Zéro Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Lively, fruity wine that is fragrant and fresh. Having no sugar and bone dry, it is as crisp as an apple. A bright mousse offers a fine fruity texture and a light, citrus aftertaste.
title: Zusslin NV Brut Zéro Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This intensely fruity wine revels in its red berry fruits, crisp acidity and general enjoyment of being a summer rosé. It's lively with acidity and a light tang to freshen the aftertaste.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2014 Simone Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This intensely fruity wine revels in its red berry fruits, crisp acidity and general enjoyment of being a summer rosé. It's lively with acidity and a light tang to freshen the aftertaste.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2014 Simone Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This lively, crisp wine gives both intense acidity and great fruitiness. It's bright, with a line of fresh red currant flavors that are delicious and drinkable right now.
title: Domaine Houchart 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Petit Manseng grape gives a honeyed, ripe and fragrant wine. Made from late-harvest fruit, this shows notes of pineapple and creamed apple. It should age well over many years.
title: Domaine Cauhapé 2010 Noblesse du Temps  (Jurançon)

description: This top cuvée made by the Pelvillain family shows typical black Malbec color, and it has an opulent texture that's packed with notes of rich spice, black plum and balanced wood. While the tannins are present, the fruit offers a full, rich character. With its concentration, this will benefit from several years of aging.
title: Château de Cénac 2010 Eulalie Malbec (Cahors)

description: Powerful and structured, with a dense texture, this is packed with dark, brooding tannins. It's intense and concentrated with damson fruit. Ready for long aging.
title: Alain Brumont 2008 Château Montus Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: A smooth, wood-matured wine, this shows all of the richness of Braucol and Duras. Named “the spirit,” it is a true evocation of the rugged nature of Gaillac, with a mineral streak and a big black-fruit flavor. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Rotier 2009 L'Ame Red (Gaillac)

description: A smooth, wood-matured wine, this shows all of the richness of Braucol and Duras. Named “the spirit,” it is a true evocation of the rugged nature of Gaillac, with a mineral streak and a big black-fruit flavor. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Rotier 2009 L'Ame Red (Gaillac)

description: This rare unclassified growth from Saint-Julien has all of the elegance you would expect, and it balances firm tannins with a classic black-currant flavor. It has dark, structured tannins, with layers of wood and acidity on the fragrant finish. Keep this for many years.
title: Château Moulin de la Rose 2010  Saint-Julien

description: This rare unclassified growth from Saint-Julien has all of the elegance you would expect, and it balances firm tannins with a classic black-currant flavor. It has dark, structured tannins, with layers of wood and acidity on the fragrant finish. Keep this for many years.
title: Château Moulin de la Rose 2010  Saint-Julien

description: A ripe, wood-aged wine, this has a wood element that's intensely spicy and toasty. The weight of the sweet plum fruit and tannins are equally powerful and concentrated. A selection of the best of Château Leret Monpezat, this will need at least five years of aging before it should be touched.
designation: Cuvée Icône du Château Leret Monpezat
title: Georges Vigouroux 2009 Cuvée Icône du Château Leret Monpezat Malbec (Cahors)

description: Vanilla and caramel flavors dominate this wine after 12 months in French oak. That means that the fruit is really not allowed to shine. It is firm, very dry and all about spice. A pepper flavor from the alcohol leaves a burn in the mouth.
title: Château Haut Prieur 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: An intensely youthful herbaceous character is at work here. The wine is full of gooseberry, lemon and pink grapefruit flavors, laced with some orange zest. It's very fresh and probably too young, so wait until late 2015.
title: Château La Rose du Pin 2013  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: The over-exuberance of wood aging spoils this wine. With strong spice and equally tannic elements, it's all about the skeleton and not about the flesh of the fruit.
title: Château Mayne Guyon 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The over-exuberance of wood aging spoils this wine. With strong spice and equally tannic elements, it's all about the skeleton and not about the flesh of the fruit.
title: Château Mayne Guyon 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wood aging dominates this toasty, burnt-flavored wine. The light stalky fruit barely shows. Maybe when the tannins soften in 2015, it will be more approachable.
title: Hubert Meyer 2012 Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Ripe and juicy, this smooth, simple wine is ready to drink. Juicy black currant fruits are polished by the wood aging.
title: Château de Beauregard-Ducourt 2011  Bordeaux

description: The wine is ripe and soft with a body of tannin that sits uneasily within this jammy character. The blend (Merlot 75%, Cabernet Franc 25%, Malbec 5%) was aged 30% in barrel and 70% in stainless steel tanks. It is unbalanced and likely to remain so.
title: Château Le Grand Moulin 2012 Grande Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A late Merlot harvest (October 19) from 22 acres, the wine was stored for 12–16 months in cement vats. Dry and extracted with a hard edge that dulls the fruit, the wine will likely stay that way.
title: Château La Claverie 2012  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Juicy and spicy flavors give a wine that layers fruit and ginger. Blackberries are the dominant fruit while the spice adds a bite that is almost exotic.
title: Château Crusquet Sabourin 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Spicy and fruity, this is a bright, fresh wine with a light touch of sweetness. Gentil is a category that blends any number of the Alsace varieties together. It's aromatic, crisp at the end while keeping softness. Drink now.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2012 Pfaff Gentil White (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: The wine is ripe, soft and spicy. It has a rustic feel, disclosing earthy aromas and almond and spice flavors. Light acidity keeps the wine fresh, although already it is showing signs of maturity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Loew 2011 Vérité Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: Tightly herbaceous, this light and crisp wine is all citrus and gooseberries, with a tangy lemon zest texture. Drink now.
title: Château Rousset-Caillau 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: There is a toasty aroma in this wine that comes from a premier cru next door to Chassagne-Montrachet. This toastiness continues into a spicy, toasty note. A good sense of fruitiness gives the wine a ripe and rich character that will allow it to mature well. Drink from 2017.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2012 Pitangerets Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Ripe and creamy, this has rich pear and apple fruits lightly cut by more lemon flavors. The wine is fruity, textured with minerality and still young. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Tinel-Blondelet 2014 L'Arret Buffatte  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: The name of the wine (land of the angels) is inspired by the fact that monks first planted the slope. More prosaically, it is a delightful wine, fresh and crisp with tight acidity that promises to soften to bring out the citrus and ripe pear flavors. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Laporte 2014 La Terre des Anges  (Sancerre)

description: What Baumard describes as a “secret blend” from its vineyards, this wine is both sweet and fresh. Honey and intense acidity are filled out with baked apple and lemon-marmalade flavors. It is ready to drink in all its fresh glory.
title: Domaine des Baumard NV Le Petit Paon White (Vin de France)

description: With its light color and cool feel, this well-balanced wine comes from a parcel of 30-year-old vines. The smoky tannins and intense acidity give a wine that will develop well and slowly. It's still young with its red-berry fruits and fresh aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Clement et Florian Berthier 2014 L'Inédit Pinot Noir (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: With its light color and cool feel, this well-balanced wine comes from a parcel of 30-year-old vines. The smoky tannins and intense acidity give a wine that will develop well and slowly. It's still young with its red-berry fruits and fresh aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Clement et Florian Berthier 2014 L'Inédit Pinot Noir (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: Blended from grapes from a range of different soils, this open, generous wine has richness and a structure that comes from the ripe apple and gooseberry fruits. The wine is textured and deserves to age. Drink from 2017.
title: Jean Pabiot et Fils 2014 Domaine des Fines Caillottes  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Rich and full in the mouth, this dense wine is focused on ripe white and yellow fruits that are lifted by acidity. The wine is concentrated and tangy, cut with a steely aftertaste. Drink from2017.
title: Pierre Prieur et Fils 2014 Domaine de Saint-Pierre  (Sancerre)

description: This cool, mineral-textured wine has crisp fruit. It is refreshing while still tight, with a firm structure. It likely will remain nervy, taut and dominated by citrus. Drink from 2017.
title: Camille Paquet 2014 Les Crays  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This cool, mineral-textured wine has crisp fruit. It is refreshing while still tight, with a firm structure. It likely will remain nervy, taut and dominated by citrus. Drink from 2017.
title: Camille Paquet 2014 Les Crays  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This soft wine features attractive citrus and creamed-apple flavors. It is round, full, lightly spicy and presents an easy, immediately drinkable character.
title: Vignerons des Pierres Dorées 2015 Salamandre d'Or  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: Vinified in new 500-liter oak barrels, this wine is fresh, fruity and crisp. It has attractive acidity, a strong streak of minerality and lively lemon fruit. With a taut, nervy edge, the wine has a bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Round and smooth, this rich wine has the right acidity for the ripe pear, green plum and thrust of citrus. A backbone of minerality gives structure, while a spicy nutmeg note complements the subtle nutty character. Drink now.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Though the vineyard sits at 1,100 feet, hints of tropical fruits give this wine a ripe feel. Pineapple and mango mingle with crisper citrus flavors, yielding a wine that is both fresh and ripe. Drink now.
title: Pierre Merguey 2014 Vielles Vignes  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Soft red fruits dominate this only lightly structured wine. It is more about juicy Pinot Noir, fruity with raspberry and red-currant flavors. Dryness at the core of the wine adds shape. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014  Bourgogne

description: Soft red fruits dominate this only lightly structured wine. It is more about juicy Pinot Noir, fruity with raspberry and red-currant flavors. Dryness at the core of the wine adds shape. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014  Bourgogne

description: The wine is smooth, soft and bland. The fruitiness and light acidity give it a crisp edge to what is otherwise a lightly textured wine. The strawberry fruits bring out a gentle aftertaste.
title: Château des Bertrands 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine balances honeyed sweetness with intense acidity to give a wine that would be best as an apéritif. It is light and poised, finishing crisp with orange-marmalade flavors.
title: Domaine Guillaman 2015 Frisson d'Automne White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: In Cahors terms, a wine labeled Tradition is the entry-level wine of an estate, often unoaked as it is here. The wine successfully relies on the bold blackberry fruits and balanced acidity. With tannins forming a fine background, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Cause 2013 Tradition Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a soft wine. Its rounded fruits and texture are gentle and smooth with a touch of caramel. The blend, dominated by Cinsault, gives a light spicy character as well as an attractive crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Sainte Roseline 2016 Le Cloître Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a crisp fruity wine with delicious red currants. It has fine acidity as well, with a burst of freshness in the midst of the spicy, ripe wine. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Cuvée du Lion Rosé (Var)

description: This is a rich wine, just beginning to mature. With berry fruits, some firm tannins and acidity, the wine is ripe, still showing some stalkiness and with a dry firm aftertaste. Drink starting from 2018.
title: Château de Berne 2013 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Organic grapes go into this light and fruity wine with its unexpected animal name. It is soft with bright red-berry fruits that are cut with acidity. The wine is dry with strong citrus flavors at the end. Drink now.
title: Château Barbanau 2016 La Girafe Verte Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a smooth wine with rounded fruit and light acidity. It has refreshing red-berry fruits that give softness while also finishing with a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Aimé Roquesante 2016 Cuvée Selectionée Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Attractively onion-skin pink in color, this wine is lightly textured and delicate in flavor. It does have a dry peppery edge that brings out some structure. The wine's crisp fruit is restrained. Drink from late 2017.
title: Les Vins Bréban 2016 Bo Rivage Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: The wine is unexpectedly perfumed by the addition of Muscat. That gives the wine a full character, including touches of spice and acidity. The wine is unbalanced, the fruit and the spice at odds.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2016 Jas des Vignes Rosé

description: This wine is soft, smooth and bland. It has gentle fruit without the crisp edge necessary to give it a lift. Drink as an apéritif.
title: Maison Denuzière 2016 Champs de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Red fruits dominate this rich wine. It has great balance and a smooth texture, with red plum, loganberry and caramel flavors. With its structure, it could even age a year.
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2010 Grande Réserve Cru Classé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A delicious wine, very ripe while having great style. It packs concentrated red berry fruits into a textured package that shows acidity, vanilla and final spice.
title: Château Léoube 2010 Secret de Léoube Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The acidity dominates this super-fresh wine. The red currant juice flavor is mixed with candied lemon and a soft texture.
title: J. de Telmont NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This offers notes of white strawberry, cherry and melon rind on the nose and mouth. Medium-minus in weight, flavors of lime peel and tart cherry skin lend astringent grip to the close.
title: Fortant 2016 Coast Select Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This offers notes of white strawberry, cherry and melon rind on the nose and mouth. Medium-minus in weight, flavors of lime peel and tart cherry skin lend astringent grip to the close.
title: Fortant 2016 Coast Select Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This broad wine is soft, indistinct and suffers from overripe fruit. It needs a shot of acidity to give it life and interest.
title: Mommessin 2015 Grandes Mises  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This broad wine is soft, indistinct and suffers from overripe fruit. It needs a shot of acidity to give it life and interest.
title: Mommessin 2015 Grandes Mises  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Baby powder and carnation grace the ummy peach and strawberry fruit tones in this wine. It's a touch sharp through the close, while mealy fruit dominates the palate.
title: Château Guilhem 2015 Pot de Vin Syrah Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A soft, dilute wine, this is gently fruity. Acidity gives a lift at the end. Drink now.
title: Pierre-Yves et Olivier Fichet 2016 La Crepillionne  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: While this wine is full, it has an indistinct character. A soft texture and only light fruitiness leave a dull impression.
title: Gerald Talmard 2016  Mâcon-Chardonnay

description: While this wine is full, it has an indistinct character. A soft texture and only light fruitiness leave a dull impression.
title: Gerald Talmard 2016  Mâcon-Chardonnay

description: Bright and fruity, this wine is light, crisp and shot through with acidity. Lively and tangy, it's ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Perraud 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: This soft wine is full of citrus and spice flavors. A lightly zesty edge brings out the acidity. Fruity and easy to drink, it is ready now.
title: Maison Stéphane Brocard 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: This is a soft, rounded wine, with ripe fruit that seems unfocused. The fruit and the acidity are reticent, not giving the wine much shape. A simple, ripe wine, it can be drunk now.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Buissonnier  (Montagny)

description: This wine opens with delicate scents of red currant, spiced cherry and tart currant. Light tannins and slightly astringent red-cherry flavors unfold on the palate, finishing short but clean.
title: Vignobles Jeanjean 2016 Secret de Lunès Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: This wine opens with delicate scents of red currant, spiced cherry and tart currant. Light tannins and slightly astringent red-cherry flavors unfold on the palate, finishing short but clean.
title: Vignobles Jeanjean 2016 Secret de Lunès Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: Sourced from vines that are just outside the Meursault appellation, this is a light, bright wine flavored with citrus and apple. Floral aromas are followed by touches of spice, balanced acidity and a juicy finish. Drink now–2020
title: Patrick Javillier 2011 Cuvée des Forgets  (Bourgogne)

description: This is a soft, almost off-dry Champagne with bright raspberry flavor and a gentle structure. It is balanced with fruitiness laced with good levels of acidity. To be drunk now while it is still young and crisp.
title: Drappier NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This finely balanced, juicy wine is full of red-fruit aromas and brisk acidity. Juicy and bright with strawberry flavors and refreshing acidity, it's a value wine with great potential. Drink from 2015.
title: Derey Frères 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Fixin)

description: Black currant flavors dominates this wine. The palate is dense with flavor, with firm tannins allied with tense acidity and spicy licorice flavors. It's a ripe wine that shows potential for aging. Drink from 2014. Screwcap.
title: Château Routas 2011 Wild Boar Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays Var)

description: This is a crisp, floral wine with apple and pear aromas that are unabashedly forward. It has lively acidity and a texture that's crisp, fresh and intensely minerally. Just a touch of creamy vanilla helps to fill the wine out. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2011 Clos Philippe-le-Hardi  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune)

description: A concentrated, ripe wine, full of toasty new wood flavors as well as dark berry tannins and acidity. It is dense, full in the mouth and packed with ripe fruit. Drink from 2016.
title: Château le Prieuré 2011 Délice du Prieuré  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A concentrated, ripe wine, full of toasty new wood flavors as well as dark berry tannins and acidity. It is dense, full in the mouth and packed with ripe fruit. Drink from 2016.
title: Château le Prieuré 2011 Délice du Prieuré  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Here's a wood-aged wine, with peach and pineapple flavors and a rich, round mouthfeel. It has a lighter side, with ample, crisp acidity and the poise of the white wines of 2012. You could drink it now, but better to wait until 2014.
title: Château Haut Selve 2012  Graves

description: This is a solid and structured wine that is lightened by its juicy acidity. Black currant fruits dominate, giving a fresh character to the wine. The tannins that show through do promise medium-term aging. Drink from 2014.
title: Château Haut Mazerolles 2011 Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Fresh as well as ripe, with layers of toast, creamy pear and red apple flavors. Attractively spicy, ready to drink.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Light red cherry-flavored wine from a fine year for Beaujolais. The wine is all juicy fruit, rounded tannins and light, smoky acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Beaujolais

description: Light red cherry-flavored wine from a fine year for Beaujolais. The wine is all juicy fruit, rounded tannins and light, smoky acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Beaujolais

description: Ample Bordeaux, with the tannins softened and rounded. Flavors are of black plums, with some stalkiness and light acidity. Drink soon
title: Château Roc de Minvielle 2009  Bordeaux

description: Attractive, fruity wine, with good tannins as well as stalky black currant fruit flavors. Its ripeness is a sign of the warm vintage.
title: Charles Joguet 2009 Cuvée Terroir  (Chinon)

description: Fresh and soft, with bright strawberry flavors and a delicious texture of red currants. Lively acidity gives the wine a great send-off.
title: Domaine de Granajolo 2009 Rosé (Corse Porto Vecchio)

description: Spices, a hint of honey, a texture of pears and white plums—this is a rich, soft wine with a good intensity of taste and ripeness.
title: Domaine de Granajolo 2009 Blanc Vermentino (Corse Porto Vecchio)

description: Made, unusually, by skin contact rather than adding red wine, this rosé is dark in color, with tannins as well as fruit. That gives it a rich character, full in the mouth and certainly putting it in the food-friendly category. It's an acquired taste because it is different.
title: Soutiran NV Premier Cru Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This fruity fizz majors on the aroma of freshly cut Golden Delicious apples, while the body is very light, slightly tart and pleasantly dry. The mousse is rather frothy but if refreshment is what you are after, this is your ticket.
title: Willm NV Prestige Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Demi-Sec is essentially an off-dry Champagne. This wine is soft, hinting at some sweetness while preserving crisp citrus and apple flavors. It has some richness as well, and its soft character makes it a good partner with cold meats or pâtés.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin NV Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Very fresh, fruity and drinkable, this is a soft, red-cherry-flavored wine. Attractive acidity bursts out of the glass with a perfumed, tangy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Robert Perroud 2014 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: Very fresh, fruity and drinkable, this is a soft, red-cherry-flavored wine. Attractive acidity bursts out of the glass with a perfumed, tangy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Robert Perroud 2014 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: Pale in color, this crisp, light wine has attractive red berry fruits well integrated into the lively texture and bright acidity. The wine is balanced, fruity and ready to drink.
title: J. M. Gobillard et Fils NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Fresh strawberry flavors fizz lightly and easily on a fruit-driven, dry and light-bodied palate. This is a fruity haze of fizzy, pale-pink fun, ideal for parties and light-hearted gatherings.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fresh strawberry flavors fizz lightly and easily on a fruit-driven, dry and light-bodied palate. This is a fruity haze of fizzy, pale-pink fun, ideal for parties and light-hearted gatherings.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: With a little bottle age, this dry Champagne is balanced and ripe. It has attractive apple and lemon flavors cut by minerality, acidity and a crisp edge of grapefruit. It's a fruity wine backed up by its texture. This bottling is ready to drink.
title: Vollereaux NV Extra Brut Naturelle  (Champagne)

description: An equal blend of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, this is the producer's nonvintage cuvée, soft and ripe. Balanced and crisp, it has attractive acidity under the light texture and tangy lemon-zest flavor. The bottling is ready to drink.
title: Vollereaux NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Big, rich, dusty tannins and black plum fruits are built on a firm layer of wood. There is a fresh mint character as well, giving the wine a polished and spicy feel. With the wood and the acidity, this needs aging: 3–4 years and more.
title: Château Haut Selve 2006 Réserve  (Graves)

description: There is a strong layer of new wood here, serving to give structure to the rich berry fruits. Plum juice and black coffee round out the dryness, but the texture is still young, needing four years aging.
title: Château le Prieuré 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: A rustic wine, with definite barnyard flavors. The fruit has some smoky extract, but the tannins and old wood tastes intrude too much.
title: Château les Tonnelles 2005 Prestige  (Fronsac)

description: This well known négociant has turned in a sold effort. The nose is slightly herbal, but with attractive black-pepper shadings, while the fruit flavors favor dark-skinned plum. Drink this medium-bodied, supple wine over the next few years.
title: Louis Bernard 2013  Crozes-Hermitage

description: This well known négociant has turned in a sold effort. The nose is slightly herbal, but with attractive black-pepper shadings, while the fruit flavors favor dark-skinned plum. Drink this medium-bodied, supple wine over the next few years.
title: Louis Bernard 2013  Crozes-Hermitage

description: Now developing into a delicious wine, this is ripe, full and perfumed. It is rich with yellow fruits, spice and red apple flavors. The wine still has hints of the intense youthful steeliness although it is now balanced, full in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2013 Les Deux Cailloux  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Now developing into a delicious wine, this is ripe, full and perfumed. It is rich with yellow fruits, spice and red apple flavors. The wine still has hints of the intense youthful steeliness although it is now balanced, full in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2013 Les Deux Cailloux  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This crisp, simply fruity wine is light, bright and bursting with lemon and crisp apple flavors. It is direct, full of juicy acidity and ready to drink.
title: Les Frères Couillaud 2016 Bernier Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: Although the label says Brut, in fact this is a very dry rosé. It has a bitter edge that is off-putting and it seems to have lost the fruit along with way. The wine also has weight with a tannic aftertaste—a strange beast.
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Rosé Premier Cru  (Champagne)

description: Exuberant wine, almost exotic in its flavors, with ripe currant and a lining of honey. Full in the mouth, intense and concentrated.
title: Domaine Huët 2008 Le Haut-Lieu Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Exuberant wine, almost exotic in its flavors, with ripe currant and a lining of honey. Full in the mouth, intense and concentrated.
title: Domaine Huët 2008 Le Haut-Lieu Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Very rich style of wine from 50-year-old vines. It is smooth, opulent almost, packed with pure pink grapefruit along with an herbal, grassy character. Concentration is the hallmark of this fine wine.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2008 Jadis  (Sancerre)

description: Very rich style of wine from 50-year-old vines. It is smooth, opulent almost, packed with pure pink grapefruit along with an herbal, grassy character. Concentration is the hallmark of this fine wine.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2008 Jadis  (Sancerre)

description: Première Trie means a wine from the first selection of grapes during harvest. This wine, now firmly closed up, as is expected with Chenin Blanc, is headed towards an opulent future, even though the fruit is kept firmly in check by the long-term aging potential.
designation: Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux
title: Domaine Huët 2006 Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: With so much intensity, botrytis and concentration, this is going to be impressive. It is still very young, at a closed stage, but the ripe currant as well as the honey dominate. Great wine.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2008  Quarts de Chaume

description: A wine that just hints at its enormous future. It is opulent, rich, rounded, full of quince, spice, layers of honey and apricots. It is gorgeous without losing any freshness. Keep for seven years.
title: Domaine Huët 2009 Clos du Bourg Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: A majestic, magisterial wine, powered by superripe fruit as well as honey and a gorgeous ripeness. With years ahead of it, this will be superb.
designation: Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux
title: Domaine Huët 2009 Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: A majestic, magisterial wine, powered by superripe fruit as well as honey and a gorgeous ripeness. With years ahead of it, this will be superb.
designation: Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux
title: Domaine Huët 2009 Clos du Bourg Première Trie Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: This will be a wonderful wine. Already, it is fine, with lovely acidity, bright and richly sweet at the same time. Yellow fruits mingle with honey, pear, almonds and the intense sweetness of botrytis.
title: Domaine Huët 2010 Le Mont Première Trie Moelleux  (Vouvray)

description: Even more concentrated than Huët's superb 2009 Première Trie, this is outstanding. It has both great concentration and elegance. The wine is touched by botrytis, while retaining freshness. Made from ripe, just shrivelling grapes, this is sweet Vouvray at its magnificent best.
title: Domaine Huët 2009 Cuvée Constance 500ml  (Vouvray)

description: The fruity, fresh aroma continues into the palate. Ripe yellow fruits are spiced and then cut with pear acidity and freshness. It's already balanced, although it will be even better from 2016.
title: Emile Beyer 2013 L'Hostellerie Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This surprisingly dry wine has more to do with spice than richness. That gives it a food friendly character full of ripe fruit, a spicy, peppery edge and baked apple flavors. Acidity cuts through providing balance. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Amazing candy-shop aromas set the scene for a totally perfumed wine. This is ripe, full in the mouth and a great example of the character of Gewurztraminer. Drink this wine now for all its exuberance.
title: Domaine Jean-Luc Mader 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This wine is ripe with yellow fruits and rich pears. It has a rounded character, with a creamy texture shot through with acidity. The aftertaste has touches of grapefruit and a minerality that gives good texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2014 Clos de Mazeray  (Meursault)

description: This wine is smoky, ripe and packed with tannins. The fruit gives the wine weight although it is not yet fully developed. There is a toasty background to this rich wine with its juicy red-berry fruits and acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Huguenot 2014 Champ Perdrix  (Marsannay)

description: With attractive wood flavors, this is a wine with spice, toast and citrus flavors. Orange and yellow fruits come through the lime acidity and zesty texture. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: With attractive wood flavors, this is a wine with spice, toast and citrus flavors. Orange and yellow fruits come through the lime acidity and zesty texture. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: Some flinty notes precede earthier, ripe apple notes that also spread across the palate. There is a textured mouthfeel, while a clean seam of lemon crispness counters the earthy fruit. Texture and freshness linger pleasantly.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2014 Rosenberg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Ripe notes of juicy yellow-pear waft from the glass The palate is equally full-fruited but comes with a dry, crisp and refreshing palate and a clean finish.
title: Wolfberger 2015 W3 White (Alsace)

description: Ripe notes of juicy yellow-pear waft from the glass The palate is equally full-fruited but comes with a dry, crisp and refreshing palate and a clean finish.
title: Wolfberger 2015 W3 White (Alsace)

description: This soft, rounded wine has attractive ripe white-stone-fruit flavor. It also has a rich, spicy side, with light hints of wood that give it a mellow character. The wine is developing well and will be ready from 2017.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine Adélie Les Champs-Michaux  (Mercurey)

description: Vines from high up in the vineyard produce this cool, fresh wine. It has bright acidity along with intense grapefruit and lemon fruits. The wine is tangy with a strong texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Château Gris Les Terrasses  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Peach skin and orange peel appear on the nose, the palate is off-dry but fresh and vivid with floral impressions that are more present on the tongue than the nose. There is ripe, fresh peach and honeysuckle and a balanced poise. The aromatic subtlety causes you to pause and wonder, even after the last echo.
designation: Clos Zisser Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru
title: Klipfel 2010 Clos Zisser Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: With a nutty flavor fresh apples and pears and a touch of honey, this is a delicious wine. It is full of ripe fruit that has not lost its crisp, cool character. The wine has a mineral edge that gives it a fine tang as well as a tight texture. It's fresh although there are indications of bottle age which means it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2013 L'Ancestrale Brut  (Vouvray)

description: With a nutty flavor fresh apples and pears and a touch of honey, this is a delicious wine. It is full of ripe fruit that has not lost its crisp, cool character. The wine has a mineral edge that gives it a fine tang as well as a tight texture. It's fresh although there are indications of bottle age which means it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2013 L'Ancestrale Brut  (Vouvray)

description: There is some good structure here, as befits a Saint-Estèphe, along with intense fruits and ripe blackberry flavors. That makes the wine both very drinkable now and gives it aging for the next two years. The aftertaste with its juicy acidity is already attractive.
title: Producta Vignobles 2011 Château Grand Chemin Monplaisir  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: Like most Saint-Joseph whites, this blend of Marsanne and Roussanne is only modestly aromatic. What it does deliver is a world of weight and texture on the palate, along with notions of toasted nuts and grilled fruit (melon and pineapple). Ready to drink now.
title: Gilles Flacher 2011 Cuvée Loess  (Saint-Joseph)

description: Like most Saint-Joseph whites, this blend of Marsanne and Roussanne is only modestly aromatic. What it does deliver is a world of weight and texture on the palate, along with notions of toasted nuts and grilled fruit (melon and pineapple). Ready to drink now.
title: Gilles Flacher 2011 Cuvée Loess  (Saint-Joseph)

description: This ripe, concentrated wine has rounded tannins plus a structure that gives weight as well as richness. It comes from vines close to Morey Saint-Denis. The richness promises good aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2011 Les Fuées Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This luxury cuvée rides close to the edge of being too ripe for its own good. It's full bodied and rich, boasting flavors of prune, chocolate and espresso framed by hints of toast and vanilla. The texture is supple, turning velvety on the finish, which makes it accessible now. Drink it over the next few years.
title: Domaine du Vieux Lazaret 2007 Nolandra Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Rounded, rich and warm, it has excellent acidity along with touches of wood and very pure citrus flavors. Peach fruits give a riper feel. Drink now, but better to wait until 2015.
title: Benjamin Leroux 2011  Auxey-Duresses

description: Although this wine has a strong toasty character, it offers enough fruit, acidity and ripe tropical flavors to make it work. Attractive acidity gives a delicious, fresh aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Joseph Faiveley 2011 Champ Gain Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This open, generous wine is already completely in its stride. Ripe yellow fruits are given freshness by flavors of orange zest and citrus. The wood aging shows, but gently, rounding out the fruits and adding a note of spice. It's a full wine, ready to drink in 2015.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Les Morgeots Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Although this wine starts off a bit stern in texture, by the long finish those tannins have turned velvety and plush, nicely framing intense black olive, espresso, cherry and plum flavors. Drink now–2018.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Gigondas)

description: Although this wine starts off a bit stern in texture, by the long finish those tannins have turned velvety and plush, nicely framing intense black olive, espresso, cherry and plum flavors. Drink now–2018.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Gigondas)

description: Full bodied yet still fresh and vibrant, this is a blend of 30% each Bourboulenc, Marsanne and Viognier, plus 10% Clairette. Hints of lemon curd impart a lovely texture, while the aromas and flavors lean toward pineapple, melon and citrus. Drink now.
title: Famille Perrin 2011 Coudoulet de Beaucastel White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This well-proportioned wine has ripe fruits along with generous texture and acidity. A touch of wood gives extra weight. It's ready to drink, but will be even better by the end of 2014.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2012 Au Brûlé  (Saint-Véran)

description: This well-proportioned wine has ripe fruits along with generous texture and acidity. A touch of wood gives extra weight. It's ready to drink, but will be even better by the end of 2014.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2012 Au Brûlé  (Saint-Véran)

description: With really ripe fruit and juicy black flavors, this is a rounded, warm wine. It tastes of sun, although there is also something more seriously structured about it. Acidity gives freshness, while the tannic structure suggests further aging. Drink now, but better in 2015.
title: Domaine Houchart 2011 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine comes from the Alpilles mountains, made famous by Van Gogh's paintings. It has a tight, steely character that comes from the wild terroir while keeping delicious freshness and acidity. It could age until late 2014.
title: Domaine de Valdition 2013 Vallon des  Anges Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The bouquet of this rosé is soft and delicate, with subtle notes of strawberry hull, watermelon rind and white-plum flesh. The mouthfeel is light, but with a slight roundness to the midpalate, with a lightly bitter-lime flavor that adds zip to the finish.
designation: Domaine Saint Nabor Gris de Nabor
title: Château Saint-Nabor 2012 Domaine Saint Nabor Gris de Nabor Rosé (Gard)

description: This wine displays weight, richness and intense fruits. It also has structure and a texture that offers a tangy, steely character. It's still young and needs to age, so drink from 2015.
title: Joseph Mellot 2013 Le Troncsec  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Smooth and rounded, it also has a more mineral character from the gravel soil. It is tangy, full of yellow fruits, touches of citrus and lively final acidity. Give it until the end of 2014 to drink.
title: Joseph Mellot 2013 La Gravelière  (Sancerre)

description: Smooth and rounded, it also has a more mineral character from the gravel soil. It is tangy, full of yellow fruits, touches of citrus and lively final acidity. Give it until the end of 2014 to drink.
title: Joseph Mellot 2013 La Gravelière  (Sancerre)

description: As the label says, the wine is off dry, but with its great, refreshing acidity, it is also crisp and fruity. Baked apples and citrus flavors mingle with a lightly mineral texture to give a lively, fragrant wine. Drink now.
title: Château Moncontour 2012 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: This Grenache-based rosé, with 4% Syrah, opens with a mélange of fruity aromas that carry through to the palate. Notes of peach, guava, cherry, banana and melon are accented by a hint of garrigue. It's medium weight, with ample acidity to lift the ripe fruit flavors.
title: Penya 2013 Grenache-Syrah (Côtes Catalanes)

description: A fine, mineral-textured wine, crisp with lemon juice acidity and well integrated with green apple flavors. It has developed attractively, with weight in the right places.
title: De Venoge 2000 Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Extra Brut on the label indicates that the Champagne is very dry, and this wine is certainly that. But it also benefits from bottle age to soften the vivid acidity. The flavors are moving into a secondary phase, bringing almonds and yeast to the forefront, keeping creamy apple behind. It is ripe and full, definitely for food.
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Ripe, mature, easy Champagne, maintaining the Clicquot style of bottle maturity, with toast, sweet pastry and a rich, full-in-the-mouth character of white fruits. The finish is relatively soft.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin NV Yellow Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: A moussy, creamy, fresh and light Champagne, with velvet apples and cream character. There is a touch of citrus, but this so-fruity wine is lively and instantly delicious.
title: Duval-Leroy NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: It takes a while to get beyond the dry structure of this wine. But underneath that initially forbidding exterior, there is a solid core of ripe, sweet black fruits and an elegant balance with the acidity coming through to finish well. A wine for some aging—maybe 3–4 years.
title: Château du Seuil 2006  Graves

description: It takes a while to get beyond the dry structure of this wine. But underneath that initially forbidding exterior, there is a solid core of ripe, sweet black fruits and an elegant balance with the acidity coming through to finish well. A wine for some aging—maybe 3–4 years.
title: Château du Seuil 2006  Graves

description: A very lively mousse bursting in the mouth opens the way for this bone-dry Champagne. It has a hint of toast that helps tame the grapefruit acidity, and it is tightly structure.
title: Boizel NV Brut Ultime Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Dark and intense, with notes of roasted meat, plum and black olive that give way to an espresso note and chalky tannins on the finish. Pretty stern stuff, which just means you'll want to give it another year or two before drinking it over the next 5–6 years.
title: André Brunel 2009 Cuvée Sabrine Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is a wine that is almost mature. With generous black fruits and tannins that are integrated into the texture, the wine is ripe and fruity. The acidity is still there, giving a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Laubès 2010  Bordeaux

description: This is an ancient 13th-century fortified castle with an impressive keep. The wine is more in a modern style, full of crisp fruits and with attractive balanced tannins. There is a smoky edge from the wood aging and intense black-currant acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Fontesteau 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: Considering the relatively light nature of the vintage, this wine has been overmanipulated. Hard tannins and a bitter chocolate flavor are all too much for the fruit. A gentler approach would have been better.
title: Château du Parc 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine is firm and still structured. With wood, dense tannins and just the hint of juicy black-currant fruit, it needs time. From 2019, it should be a richer fruitier wine, always with a tannic core.
title: Château Cayla 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is firm and still structured. With wood, dense tannins and just the hint of juicy black-currant fruit, it needs time. From 2019, it should be a richer fruitier wine, always with a tannic core.
title: Château Cayla 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A strangely tart notion persists on the nose. The palate rings with the same strange but faintly red-currant-like aroma. The body is light, fresh and dry and has a clean finish. Drink soon.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2014 Les Natures Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Ripe berry aromas set the scene for this balanced, juicy wine. Full of black currant and berry flavors, it's already delicious with its fruitiness. The tannins, though, need to calm down somewhat, and the wine will be better from 2019.
title: Château Haut Peyrefaure 2016  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Richly structured, this is a wine with style and balance. It has plenty of firm tannins to contrasted with its juicy blackberry fruit. It needs some time to fill out. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut la Pointe 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: Richly structured, this is a wine with style and balance. It has plenty of firm tannins to contrasted with its juicy blackberry fruit. It needs some time to fill out. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut la Pointe 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: This wine is aromatic, spicy and likely to develop quickly. That shows in the fragrant black currant fruit and generous tannins. Its acidity should be fully integrated with the fruit and the wine ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut Grelot 2015 Coteaux du Methez  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is firm with powerful surface tannins. Underneath, its blackberry-like fruit is developing, bringing out spice, acidity and plenty of weight. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Bertinerie 2015 Grand Vin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is firm with powerful surface tannins. Underneath, its blackberry-like fruit is developing, bringing out spice, acidity and plenty of weight. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Bertinerie 2015 Grand Vin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine is ripe and smooth, with rich if still dry tannins. Its juicy black fruit and acidity are balanced with a structure that will allow it to age further. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Ducros 2015 Clos Bourbon  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This opens with crisp and attractive spice and almond flavors. They go with the acidity, lemon and apple notes to give a balanced, complex wine. Drink from mid-2018.
title: Château Dubraud 2016  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Structured and firm, with dense, dry tannins, this wine also has plenty of fruit. Black cherry flavors envelop its dry core, feeling rich and ready to drink from 2021.
title: Château du Cros 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Produced from organically grown grapes and bottled without added sulfur, this wine is full of life. With its juicy fruit and jammy texture, bursts with blackberry and black plum flavors. It's likely to age quickly, so drink from 2018.
title: Château du Cèdre 2016 Extra Libre Malbec (Cahors)

description: Although this seems initially austere, it has some fruit weight. Its tannins are dry and firm but will soften with time, showing potential for long, slow aging. Drink from 2020.
title: Château des Mille Anges 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Although this seems initially austere, it has some fruit weight. Its tannins are dry and firm but will soften with time, showing potential for long, slow aging. Drink from 2020.
title: Château des Mille Anges 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is young—full of acidity and rich yellow fruit. A blend of Petit and Gros Manseng, it has the typical honeyed edge yet is bone dry. It will take time for its intense acidity to calm down, so drink from late 2018.
title: Château de Jurque 2016 Fantaisie  (Jurançon Sec)

description: This wine is young—full of acidity and rich yellow fruit. A blend of Petit and Gros Manseng, it has the typical honeyed edge yet is bone dry. It will take time for its intense acidity to calm down, so drink from late 2018.
title: Château de Jurque 2016 Fantaisie  (Jurançon Sec)

description: Minty aromas reflect the new wood that was used to age this wine. Its red berry fruitiness recalls the vintage while its firm tannins will allow it to age for several years. It comes from the western end of the Entre-deux-Mers region. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Bel 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Ripe and fruity, with delicious red berry flavors, this wine is attractive now. It also has some firm tannins built for aging, giving structure to the juicy fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Crusquet Sabourin 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This blend of Niellucciu, Sciaccerellu and Syrah is both rich and stalky. That gives acidity, black currant fruit and a youthful texture. It's balanced with rich tannins which will allow it to age further. Drink from late 2018.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2015 Domaine Vetriccie Red (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: This blend of Niellucciu, Sciaccerellu and Syrah is both rich and stalky. That gives acidity, black currant fruit and a youthful texture. It's balanced with rich tannins which will allow it to age further. Drink from late 2018.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2015 Domaine Vetriccie Red (Corse)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: “Old vines” means different things to different people. In this case, the fruit comes from vines that average 25–30 years old in the Côtes du Bourg and the Côtes du Blaye. The wine is fruit-focused (black cherries and cassis) but relatively light-bodied, finishing with lemony acids.
title: Malesan 1999 Vielles Vignes  (Bordeaux)

description: Black cherries and chocolate combine on the palate, but there's also a certain weediness to the aromas. This blend of approximately 60% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon finishes strong, with tart fruit and a dose of chocolate.
title: Malesan 1999 Reserve de Malesan  (Bordeaux)

description: This ripe wine has good acidity that thrusts through the rich yellow fruits. It is ready to drink, with its tangy acidity and warm apricot and peach flavors.
title: Doudet Naudin 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This bright, lemony wine is lightly mineral as well as fruity. A crisp apple character gains even more tightness from a shot of lime juice. The wine is ready to drink, light and refreshing with a buttery aftertaste.
title: Domaine Michel Goubard 2014 Mont-Avril  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: In the same family since 1835, this estate in Pouilly-Fuissé also makes wines in other surrounding appellations. This wine, with its soft and full white fruit, gentle structure and just enough acidity, is developing fast and will be ready from late 2016.
title: Château Vitallis 2015 En Paradis  (Mâcon-Vinzelles)

description: In the style of a Côtes de Gascogne white blend, this is a crisp, herbal and citrusy wine. It has considerable acidity along with pink grapefruit and lime flavors. Drink this light, bright wine now.
title: Famille Laplace 2015 Aramis Colombard-Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Tangy and juicy, this is a bright, still tight wine. A strong mineral character dominates the texture and suggests the wine needs time to allow the crisp citrus and acidity to come through. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Domaine de la Garenne  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Tangy and juicy, this is a bright, still tight wine. A strong mineral character dominates the texture and suggests the wine needs time to allow the crisp citrus and acidity to come through. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Domaine de la Garenne  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Bright red berry and cherry fruits are well up front in this wine that has crisp acidity as well as a more rounded background that will develop well. Juicy and fruity, the wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laleure-Piot 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: Bright red berry and cherry fruits are well up front in this wine that has crisp acidity as well as a more rounded background that will develop well. Juicy and fruity, the wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Laleure-Piot 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: This wine is surprisingly soft for a Pommard. Juicy red fruits have been spiced by the wood aging. It is light, gently crisp and ready to drink.
title: Domaine A. Machard de Gramont 2014 Clos Blanc Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Still young, this crisp wine is at the beginning of its development. Time will bring out the ripe apple fruit and the touches of spice that are just hints now. Drink from 2017.
title: Tramier et Fils 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This wine is initially tight and austere. The red-cherry fruit will develop slowly and with bright acidity to sustain it. Drouhin vineyards are biodynamic; this blend comes from its own and partner vineyards. Drink from 2018.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: Soft and creamy, this wine has an attractive burst of freshness with apple and citrus flavors. Lightly textured and fruity, it is ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Bourgogne

description: Soft and creamy, this wine has an attractive burst of freshness with apple and citrus flavors. Lightly textured and fruity, it is ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014  Bourgogne

description: Incredibly pure notes of freshly cut Cox's Orange Pippin assail the nose. The palate has the same purity and a linear, taut, rich but toned body that is yet to reveal all of its secrets. The purity and luminoisty of the fruit is astonishing. We have not seen the best of this yet. For now the purest apple fruit delights. This is deliciously concentrated and very youthful. Drink 2016–2030.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2012 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Ripe Mirabelle plums and tart, red apples mix to give a very fruity, appetizing aspect which on the palate is joined by ripe, lemony freshness. This has the balance and drama everyone wishes for in dry Riesling: both generous fruit and ample freshness. Lovely now but with the balance and concentration to last. Lovely Mirabelle finish of immense length. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Ripe Mirabelle plums and tart, red apples mix to give a very fruity, appetizing aspect which on the palate is joined by ripe, lemony freshness. This has the balance and drama everyone wishes for in dry Riesling: both generous fruit and ample freshness. Lovely now but with the balance and concentration to last. Lovely Mirabelle finish of immense length. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Soft perfume susbsumes citrus, apple and peach. All three are referenced in equal measure on the dry, clean palate. This has a soft aspect but is nonetheless fresh, taut, concentrated and linear. It comes with huge charm and clarity and finishes with pure, zesty dryness and pure, pervasive and lasting apple notes. Still young, oozing potential. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Boeckel 2013 Wiebelsberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Earthy notes of pear mix with the generous sweetness of a late harvest wine. The palate is concentrated and lushly sweet, but full of rich flavors, tinged with pear and orange, caramel and lemon oil, acacia honey and candied lemon peel. Lovely, bright and still totally fresh. Drink 2016–2030.
designation: Rangen Grand Cru Clos Saint Théobald Vendanges Tardives
title: Domaine Schoffit 2007 Rangen Grand Cru Clos Saint Théobald Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The Monts Damnés, the cursed hill because its steepness makes it so difficult to work, faces south-east and gives the ripest grapes. This rich wine exemplifies the richness of the wines from this vineyard. It is finely rounded, stylish and full of opulent fruitiness. All this is tempered by a tight, mineral texture that gives the wine a fine final bite. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014 Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: The Monts Damnés, the cursed hill because its steepness makes it so difficult to work, faces south-east and gives the ripest grapes. This rich wine exemplifies the richness of the wines from this vineyard. It is finely rounded, stylish and full of opulent fruitiness. All this is tempered by a tight, mineral texture that gives the wine a fine final bite. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014 Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: The aromatics take time to come to the fore but they are definitely there: notes of lifted Poire William and ripe, golden-cheeked apricots are hinted at. The medium-sweet palate brings them out in full force, glowing with a ripe opulence tempered by freshness and a slight phenolic grip. There is a luminous quality to this wine, shining its way ahead into the future, guided by a seam of freshness and focus on the midpalate, echoing with bitter almond and more fruit. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Hengst Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The aromatics take time to come to the fore but they are definitely there: notes of lifted Poire William and ripe, golden-cheeked apricots are hinted at. The medium-sweet palate brings them out in full force, glowing with a ripe opulence tempered by freshness and a slight phenolic grip. There is a luminous quality to this wine, shining its way ahead into the future, guided by a seam of freshness and focus on the midpalate, echoing with bitter almond and more fruit. Drink 2016–2026.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Hengst Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Subtle notions of ripe peach circle above a compact, bundled palate of peach and spice: perhaps vanilla, perhaps pepper. The distinct but subtle sweetness on the palate is countered by a firm, focussed freshness which in turn contrasts with pleasant warmth. The dramatic palate draws you so far into its quicksand-like depth that you almost forget to notice the more ethereal, scented clouds of peach. Pure joy.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Goldert Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Rich and rounded, the wine has classic power. Wood flavors show strongly at this stage in its development, but it is full, ripe, full of yellow fruits, pineapple and apple skins. The wine has great weight, but offers a fresh, straight and crisp aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2011  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This iconic wine is rich and perfumed. It's powerful and concentrated, with layers of wood contrasted by explosive, ripe fruits. Ripe red-fruit flavors are brightened by ample acidity, resulting in a sumptuous wine that also has enough tannins to age. Drink from 2018.
designation: Vigne de l'Enfant Jésus Grèves Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Vigne de l'Enfant Jésus Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: At this stage, this wine is closed, tight and mineral in character. As befits a great Perrières, it will be a serious, structured wine, textured and full of nervy, steely feeling, softening later into mature spice and toast. Drink from 2016.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Perrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: From vines just below the line of Grand Cru vineyards, this is a big and powerful expression of Pinot Noir. It is dense with firm tannins that are embedded in the ripe black fruits. It's a complex wine, serious while still fruity, and needing to age. Drink from  2018.
title: Domaine Rossignol-Trapet 2011 Petite Chapelle Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)
