This is a beautifully crafted wine, with vanilla and polished violet perfumes. To taste, the ripeness of the tannins and the richness of the fruit give both complexity and elegance. It should age for at least 15 years.
title: Delas Frères 1999 La Landonne  (Côte Rôtie)

description: Produced by consultant Pascal Chatonnet, this is basic Saint-Emilion with attitude. Spicy new wood, rich, bitter chocolate flavors and superripe berry fruits are kept in order by the acidity and the dense core of dry tannins.
title: Château l'Archange 2004  Saint-Émilion

description: With its distinctive flower bottle, this is an immediately recognizable Champagne, both in its looks and its distinctive Perrier-Jouët elegance. Lively white fruits play with acidity and a tangy backbone of apple skins. Age this for 4–5 years and maybe more.
title: Perrier Jouët 2002 Fleur de Champagne Brut  (Champagne)

description: With its distinctive flower bottle, this is an immediately recognizable Champagne, both in its looks and its distinctive Perrier-Jouët elegance. Lively white fruits play with acidity and a tangy backbone of apple skins. Age this for 4–5 years and maybe more.
title: Perrier Jouët 2002 Fleur de Champagne Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is tight and austere. It still shows the smoky wood aging that has left a bitter chocolate character in the wine. It should soften, although it will likely end up lean. The blend is 75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château Taussin 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: If pink could have a taste, this is the wine. From hand-picked 100% Cabernet Franc, it is all about bright fruit and red berries. Soft with touches of caramel, it delivers good acidity at the end.
title: Château Roquefort 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is herbaceous, crisp and lively. Tangy acidity envelops the citrus and green apple flavors, while the aftertaste is all about the tight, steely acidity.
title: Château des Antonins 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This totally acidic wine is crisp and shockingly tart. Fruit has been overtaken by acidity that gives the wine a very fresh, very tangy character.
title: Château de Lardiley 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine has a dark chocolate character that shows how it has been extracted, masking the juicy fruits and giving dark, dry tannins. It should soften, although a wine like this should be more about fruit than structure.
title: Maison Bouey 2012 Lestruelle  (Bordeaux)

description: A ripe wine that is almost off dry, this has a ripe cherry character, rich in the mouth and with a full texture. The aftertaste brings out spice and tannins. Bordeaux Clairet lies between rosé and red in color and in taste.
title: Château Timberlay 2014  Bordeaux Clairet

description: Crisp and very fruity, this offers bright and intense acidity. There is a light, tangy texture and a bright, poised aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Timberlay 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Crisp and tangy, this is all about acidity, red currant and a refreshing, bright aftertaste. It's lively on the palate, a wine that will be just right with summer food.
title: Château Pilet 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Crisp and tangy, this is all about acidity, red currant and a refreshing, bright aftertaste. It's lively on the palate, a wine that will be just right with summer food.
title: Château Pilet 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: With its little seasoning of Muscadelle in the blend, this is an attractively perfumed wine. It has bright acidity, plenty of herbaceous flavors and a final pear and crisp apple aftertaste. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château Maison Noble 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: With its little seasoning of Muscadelle in the blend, this is an attractively perfumed wine. It has bright acidity, plenty of herbaceous flavors and a final pear and crisp apple aftertaste. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château Maison Noble 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This bold, smoky wine has great fruitiness to match the dense, dry structure. It is firm with wood flavors still strongly present. The acidity and the black currant fruits give promise of a well-integrated future.
title: Château Bel Air 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Tight and packed with acidity, this is a very fruity wine dominated by herbaceous Sauvignon flavors that need to soften. It seems one-dimensional, just herbaceous and citrus.
title: Producta Vignobles 2014 Mission Saint-Vincent  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Chapoutier's flamingo-pink rosé is a blend of Grenache, Syrah and Cinsault that's features strawberry bubble-gum aromas and flavors, some melon fruit and a slightly chalky finish. Drink up.
title: M. Chapoutier 2014 Belleruche Rosé (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Producers, aware of the Tannat grape's reputation for tough tannins, have set about reinventing Madiran, emphasizing fruit rather than structure. Here is a good example, with its softness, juicy red fruits and almost Beaujolais-like freshness.
title: Vignobles Laplace 2005 Autour du Fruit Tannat (Madiran)

description: Structured, ripe and with great fruit, this is a bold warm wine. It has plenty of rich berry fruits, ripe tannins and layers of spice and toast. With its concentration, this is going to be a rich wine. Drink from 2022.
title: Maison Champy 2015 Les Vergelesses Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Big, bold and rounded, this is a rich wine from a single vineyard. Red-plum fruits go with a plush texture that masks the firm tannins and dry core. The acidity and structure both promise long-term aging. The wine is still young, needing time. Drink this from 2022.
designation: Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Very toasty aromas mark this wine. While the toast is present on the palate, it also offers plenty of fruit flavors, conveying apricot and white peach along with a citrus edge that brings out the freshness. Drink this wine from 2022.
title: Domaine Buisson Battault 2015 Porusot Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Very toasty aromas mark this wine. While the toast is present on the palate, it also offers plenty of fruit flavors, conveying apricot and white peach along with a citrus edge that brings out the freshness. Drink this wine from 2022.
title: Domaine Buisson Battault 2015 Porusot Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: This wine is crisp and fruity. With acidity as well as a light toast character, it is already balanced, bringing yellow and melon fruit flavors into the mineral texture. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine Buisson Battault 2015 Genevrières Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: This crisp, fruity wine is packed with acidity as well as citrus flavors. It has a cool feel, beautifully fresh and with a strong mineral element. Drink this structured, textured wine from 2019.
title: Domaine Antonin Guyon 2015 Sous Frétille Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: This crisp, fruity wine is packed with acidity as well as citrus flavors. It has a cool feel, beautifully fresh and with a strong mineral element. Drink this structured, textured wine from 2019.
title: Domaine Antonin Guyon 2015 Sous Frétille Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: Red-berry fruits dominate this already delicious wine. Allied with the acidity and the toasty wood aging, it is balanced while, of course, still young. It has potential, rich with tannins and with fine fruits. The wine is structured, needing time. Drink from 2025.
title: Bouchard Aîné et Fils 2015 Clos du Roi Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Firm and tannic, this is a dense wine. Its weight and richness promise a good future. It is juicy, full of red-cherry flavors and with plenty of perfumed acidity. The wine will be ready to drink from 2023.
title: Albert Bichot 2015 Aux Clous Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Firm and tannic, this is a dense wine. Its weight and richness promise a good future. It is juicy, full of red-cherry flavors and with plenty of perfumed acidity. The wine will be ready to drink from 2023.
title: Albert Bichot 2015 Aux Clous Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: There is high acidity on this black currant-flavored wine. It is light and fruity, with a cool feel and taut texture.
title: Château Lamothe 2010  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Bright and juicy, this is a fresh, red-fruited wine, ripe and fragrant. The tannic element is almost an afterthought.
title: Château de Ricaud 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Bright and juicy, this is a fresh, red-fruited wine, ripe and fragrant. The tannic element is almost an afterthought.
title: Château de Ricaud 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Get beyond the yeasty aromas to reveal a fruity, creamy textured wine. It has ripe yellow fruits, an herbaceous element and a smooth, full mouthfeel.
title: Château des Tourtes 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Structure goes with red berry fruits in this light, crisp wine. It has a tendency to a tight texture and lean tannins. Ready to drink.
title: Domaines Devillard 2009 Le Renard  (Bourgogne)

description: A very perfumed wine, with a thin texture. It has pure apple-juice flavors that lend a creamy feel, with a soft, rounded finish.
title: Frey-Sohler 2011 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Winemaker Jacques Grange produces relatively small quantities of this blend of 70% Grenache and 10% each of Bourboulenc, Clairette and Viognier. It's moderately weighty, but also refreshing, with bright notes of pineapple, star anise and balsam fir. Drink it over the next six months.
title: Delas Frères 2010 Saint-Esprit White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Big and powerful tannins give this wine a dry, dense and extracted feel. Black fruits power through the structure, offering a rich experience. No shy violet, this is a wine with considerable concentration and aging potential.
title: Vignobles Chaigne et Fils 2010 Château Ballan-Larquette  (Bordeaux)

description: Full, rich, quite heavy in style, this is only just brut, with its crushed strawberry flavor and low acidity. It works, as a fine wine for a red-fruit dessert, the balance remaining right up to the very soft aftertaste.
title: Perrier Jouët NV Blason Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a blend from seven of Pascal Agrapart's less important vineyards. It tastes as young as many of the vines are crisp with some citrus and fennel, but there is some softness. Not for aging.
designation: Les Sept Crus Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Agrapart & Fils NV Les Sept Crus Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Malbec from Marmande, between Cahors and Bordeaux, is softer and smoother than Cahors. It has the same ripe, juicy black fruits, with tannins that are already well integrated into the wine. The finish brings out spice and light acidity.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2011 Château Terrebert Malbec (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Malbec from Marmande, between Cahors and Bordeaux, is softer and smoother than Cahors. It has the same ripe, juicy black fruits, with tannins that are already well integrated into the wine. The finish brings out spice and light acidity.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2011 Château Terrebert Malbec (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: The wine is full of fresh fruits and crisp acidity. Alongside that, ripe plum skins and a mineral texture promise short-term aging. The old vines give concentration that adds a firm structure at the end.
title: Les Frères Perroud 2013 Vieilles Vignes  (Brouilly)

description: A fresh and ripe blend that brings the richness of Chardonnay and the perfumed Viognier well into focus. It is rich, full of apricot and green plum fruits that are cut by acidity. The name Vin de Lune (moon wine) is a reminder of the time when grapes were harvested at night to avoid detection by the local lord and so escape taxes.
designation: Clos Triguedina Blanc Sec Vin de Lune
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2014 Clos Triguedina Blanc Sec Vin de Lune Viognier-Chardonnay

description: From a selection of parcels, this is a ripe and fruity wine. Vines aged on average 55 years have produced a ripe concentrated wine with opulent yellow fruits that are balanced by citrus acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Tourterelles 2015 Les Epinets  (Viré-Clessé)

description: From a selection of parcels, this is a ripe and fruity wine. Vines aged on average 55 years have produced a ripe concentrated wine with opulent yellow fruits that are balanced by citrus acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Tourterelles 2015 Les Epinets  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Produced from vines grown on the plateau above the Loire east of the town of Saumur, this wine is beautifully ripe and honeyed while still dry. Acidity cuts through the fruitiness and creamy texture to give a crisp aftertaste. This wine is young and drinkable, although it will be so much better from 2018.
title: Domaine Chancelle 2015  Saumur

description: Produced from vines grown on the plateau above the Loire east of the town of Saumur, this wine is beautifully ripe and honeyed while still dry. Acidity cuts through the fruitiness and creamy texture to give a crisp aftertaste. This wine is young and drinkable, although it will be so much better from 2018.
title: Domaine Chancelle 2015  Saumur

description: Light and bright, this wine is fruity with a soft, smooth texture that brings out pear and green-plum flavors. A refreshing wine, it's tangy, zesty and ready to drink.
title: Jean Perrier et Fils 2015 Apremont Cuvée Gastronomie Jacquère (Savoie)

description: Perfume partners with great acidity in this wine. The two work in harmony, resulting in a wine that has a soft texture, rich, jammy berry fruits and a backbone of tannins that will allow for aging. Drink from 2017.
designation: Clos de la Mousse Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Clos de la Mousse Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Rich and sweetly fruity, this wine wields intense power. Red fruits are initially opulent and pleasurable, but then the wine begins to show solid structure and concentration. The final texture, with its tannins and fruit in harmony, is impressive. Drink from 2018.
title: Louis Latour 2011 Cuvée Héritiers Latour  (Chambertin)

description: From the village of Blagny, considered part of Meursault, this full, rounded wine has a generous character, full of ripe fruit. It is given a crisper side by good acidity, and shows both freshness and weight at the end.
title: Louis Latour 2011 Château de Blagny Premier Cru  (Meursault-Blagny)

description: Roughly equal parts Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre, this is probably Lirac's top wine at the moment. It's big and rich in the mouth, leaving behind a coating of dark fruit, hints of meaty savoriness, baking spices and softly layered wood.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2010 La Reine des Bois Red (Lirac)

description: This wine takes white Châteauneuf-du-Pape to rare heights. Mouthwatering aromas of toasted nuts and pineapple set the stage for a full-bodied, rich, succulent wine experience whose finish lingers. Yet despite the wine's undeniable heft, it never seems overly weighty. Drink this blend of 80% Roussanne and 20% Grenache Blanc over the next couple of years.
title: Famille Perrin 2011 Château de Beaucastel White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This wine takes white Châteauneuf-du-Pape to rare heights. Mouthwatering aromas of toasted nuts and pineapple set the stage for a full-bodied, rich, succulent wine experience whose finish lingers. Yet despite the wine's undeniable heft, it never seems overly weighty. Drink this blend of 80% Roussanne and 20% Grenache Blanc over the next couple of years.
title: Famille Perrin 2011 Château de Beaucastel White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: With three acres out of 36 in this Grand Cru, Faiveley is one of the larger proprietors. The wine is firm and structured with solid tannins, while black fruits give acidity and freshness to this massive wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2011  Chambertin Clos de Bèze

description: Chanson owns four acres, a quarter of this premier cru. This 2011 is smooth, rich and very elegant. Fruitiness is striated by a mineral, tight texture that gives a touch of steeliness. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Les Chenevottes Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Chanson owns four acres, a quarter of this premier cru. This 2011 is smooth, rich and very elegant. Fruitiness is striated by a mineral, tight texture that gives a touch of steeliness. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Les Chenevottes Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This is a blend from ten different parcels of the Grèves vineyard. It's beautifully smooth, hiding its structure behind generous red fruits as well as a fresh, crisp texture. It's complex, warm, very perfumed and elegant. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This is a blend from ten different parcels of the Grèves vineyard. It's beautifully smooth, hiding its structure behind generous red fruits as well as a fresh, crisp texture. It's complex, warm, very perfumed and elegant. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: From the famous Chablis Grand Cru, this wine lives up to the vineyard's reputation. Steely in character, packed with a firm structure and tightly textured, it shows a citrus side that will be refreshing and attractive as the wine ages. But it does need time, so wait to enjoy until 2017.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2011 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: The wine has the right weight and power. It comes from a blend of different parcels, bringing out the complexity of the vineyards. Black fruits are soft and generous, supported by tannins as well as licorice and wood flavors. At the end, fresher red fruits show.
title: Louis Latour 2011  Clos de Vougeot

description: This is a soft wine on the surface, but under that generosity lies a firm core that gives the promise of aging. This powerful wine comes from stony soil which explains the tannic structure while the richness comes from ripe berry fruits. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Rossignol-Trapet 2011 Les Teurons Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: In this rich, dense wine, firm tannins have already been smoothed by 50% new wood. It is solid, dark and tannic, a powerful wine that is ripe now and will reveal great fruitiness as it ages. From vines close to Volnay, it has hints of the voluptuousness of that village. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chantal Lescure 2011 Les Bertins Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: In this rich, dense wine, firm tannins have already been smoothed by 50% new wood. It is solid, dark and tannic, a powerful wine that is ripe now and will reveal great fruitiness as it ages. From vines close to Volnay, it has hints of the voluptuousness of that village. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Chantal Lescure 2011 Les Bertins Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Ripe and rich, this full-bodied wine retains minerality as well as attractive acidity. Crisp lemon flavor is rounded out with peach and apple skin fruits. The wood, already integrated, gives richness and smoothness. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Ripe and rich, this full-bodied wine retains minerality as well as attractive acidity. Crisp lemon flavor is rounded out with peach and apple skin fruits. The wood, already integrated, gives richness and smoothness. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Chanson 2011 Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: A terrific effort, the 2010 Terre Ferme is a full-bodied, velvety-textured wine with a long, multidimensional finish. It's pungent and savory upfront in its aromas of clove and allspice, but raspberry undertones add another layer of interest and those grace notes are all underscored by the powerful bass duo of black olive and espresso. Drink now–2025.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 Domaine de Terre Ferme Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Jaboulet's Condrieu program takes a huge step forward with this release, which artfully combines barrel fermentation and aging with just-ripe Viognier into a compelling and cohesive whole. The toast and baking-spice elements provide the right amount of restraint to the tropical fruit notes, which then finish with tremendous, mouthwatering length. Drink now–2020.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 Domaine de Grands Amandiers  (Condrieu)

description: This powerful wine features wood and the ripest fruit. It also has the solid structure of a Nuits Saint-Georges, creating a wine that is dark and impressively concentrated. It offers richness while preserving the fresh fruitiness of the vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Benjamin Leroux 2011 Aux Thorey Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This powerful wine features wood and the ripest fruit. It also has the solid structure of a Nuits Saint-Georges, creating a wine that is dark and impressively concentrated. It offers richness while preserving the fresh fruitiness of the vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Benjamin Leroux 2011 Aux Thorey Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A terrific effort, this wine highlights the features that make Condrieu special. First is the incredible perfume, like honeyed stone fruit and mango. Second is the richness and texture of the wine, imparting great palate presence. Third is the vibrance of the finish, providing the counterweight to the wine's ripeness and weight. Drink it over the next few years.
designation: Les Vieilles Vignes de Jacques Vernay
title: Michel & Stéphane Ogier 2011 Les Vieilles Vignes de Jacques Vernay  (Condrieu)

description: Tannic and dry, this wine is beginning to show its age. It still has some juicy red fruits but they are covered by the firm structure and dusty character of the wine. It needs to be drunk now.
title: Château Franc le Maine 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: A soft, juicy wine, it is fresh with attractive red berry fruits. It has a crisp, light feel, with the tannins giving the possibility of medium-term aging.
title: Château de Villambis 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Oak influence shows strongly on this wine, giving a smooth texture and soft tannins. It has a light texture, fresh with black currant fruitiness attractively balanced with acidity. For the medium term, the wine should be drunk from 2015.
title: Château de Côme 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a soft wine, with rounded tannins that emerge from the ripe black plum fruitiness. The structure is well integrated into the fruit, giving a wine that is for short-term aging. Drink now.
title: Château Vieux Robin 2011  Médoc

description: This is a fruity wine, full of acidity, ripe tannins and just touches of new wood. With the structural weight, it has some potential, leaving a fruity, fresher aftertaste.
title: Château Tour Saint-Fort 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: A light, fruity and fresh wine, it shows attractive black currant fruits. With just a touch of Cabernet Franc to give perfume, it is well balanced with tannins underlying the juicy fruit and acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Tour Canon 2011  Canon-Fronsac

description: A light, fruity and fresh wine, it shows attractive black currant fruits. With just a touch of Cabernet Franc to give perfume, it is well balanced with tannins underlying the juicy fruit and acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Tour Canon 2011  Canon-Fronsac

description: A solid wine that shows both juicy black fruits and some more bitter, licorice flavors. That suggests toasty wood used in the aging that does need time to soften and will always leave a dry character to the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Labadie 2011  Médoc

description: A solid wine that shows both juicy black fruits and some more bitter, licorice flavors. That suggests toasty wood used in the aging that does need time to soften and will always leave a dry character to the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Labadie 2011  Médoc

description: Rich and dense, revealing ripe fruit, touches of wood and firm flavors, and a delicious juicy interior which bursts through. It revels in this fruit, all red berries and fresh acidity. To finish, there is some toasty wood.
title: Morey-Blanc 2005 Clos du Chapitre Premier Cru  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: Rich and dense, revealing ripe fruit, touches of wood and firm flavors, and a delicious juicy interior which bursts through. It revels in this fruit, all red berries and fresh acidity. To finish, there is some toasty wood.
title: Morey-Blanc 2005 Clos du Chapitre Premier Cru  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: The wine is named after a raspberry plantation, and that's what it tastes like. Small wild fruit, with their extra taste of ripe flesh, are in the glass along with delicious acidity. The tannins and the wood are all at the service of the fruit.
title: Faiveley 2005 La Framboisière  (Mercurey)

description: This is a stylish wine, fruity with red currants and herbs. It has a delicious crisp character as well as a salty tang, maybe from the nearby sea. The aftertaste is bright, packed with fruit. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Léoube 2016 Rosé de Léoube Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a ripe rounded wine. It has generous apricot and red-berry fruits that are lifted by spice. The schist soil gives a mineral edge to the wine while the acidity in the background is just right to give this wine its crisp aftertaste. Drink this balanced wine now.
title: Château du Carrubier 2016 Cuvée Ingénue Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In color, this could be a white wine with just the faintest hint of pink when seen against a white surface. Luckily, the fruit is still there, offering flavors of tangy orange and red currant. It has pepper and spice as well as final refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Château des Bertrands 2016 L'Elégance Réserve des Bertrands Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of Sémillon and Rolle is ripe and fat. It has a rich character that is crispened by a herbal edge. Now that it is mature, it's well balanced while keeping plenty of fruit. There is a nutty soft aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de Berne 2013 White (Côtes de Provence)

description: The vineyard is on the slopes of the Massif des Maures, on the way to Saint-Tropez. This special cuvée is ripe and full in the mouth. It has a bone-dry texture, balancing fruit and spice. This serious wine will be ready from late 2017.
title: Château Barbeiranne 2016 Réserve Robert Pascal Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The vineyard is on the slopes of the Massif des Maures, on the way to Saint-Tropez. This special cuvée is ripe and full in the mouth. It has a bone-dry texture, balancing fruit and spice. This serious wine will be ready from late 2017.
title: Château Barbeiranne 2016 Réserve Robert Pascal Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Protected by the Massif de Sainte-Baume, kept dry and sunny with the Mistral winds that blow down the Rhône Valley, this vineyard can produce ripe wines like this. It has a crisp cool feel to it, bright with acidity as well as red currant and tangy orange. This is a delicious wine, with a fruity aftertaste.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2016 Domaine Champelle Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a small production wine blended by French sommeliers. The result is a soft, rich wine, deliciously ripe and perfumed. There are touches of honey as well as yellow fruits and mango juice. The acidity gives the wine a lift and makes a contrast to the richness of the wine. Drink now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2014 Le Faîte  (Saint-Mont)

description: This is a more serious style of rosé. It is structured with an edge of tannins that lead to richness as well as piles of delicious red-berry fruits and considerable balanced acidity. Owned by the Fabre family, this vineyard dates back to 1910. The estate produces the wine, although it is bottled by the Saint-Tropez cooperative. Drink now.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2016 Domaine Aureillan Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This estate lies in a valley one set of ridges behind the Mediterranean. The sheltered location gives a warm style of wine, properly pale in color but also with delicious ripe red fruits touched by caramel. Drink the wine now.
title: Domaine Saint Roman d'Esclans 2016 Bain de Soleil Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is light and fruity—properly crisp with attractive acidity. The red fruits shine through the light texture and touch of spice creates a bright wine full of final fruitiness.
title: Domaine Jacourette 2016 L'Ange et Luce Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a rich blend of Duras and Braucol. It is densely textured with ripe black-plum and berry fruits and some still young tannins. The wine will age well to show ripe fruits and a generous texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2015 Rouge Red (Gaillac)

description: This is a rich blend of Duras and Braucol. It is densely textured with ripe black-plum and berry fruits and some still young tannins. The wine will age well to show ripe fruits and a generous texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2015 Rouge Red (Gaillac)

description: Light in color and bright in taste, this is a lightly fruity wine. It's the epitome of the French Riviera—hinting at red currants and with plenty of acidity. It is an immediately drinkable wine with a refreshing crisp aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2016 La Riviera Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A ripe wine from a fine Bergerac vintage, this is balanced without being weighty. It is a blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, giving both a fine tannic structure and plenty of black-currant juiciness. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Château les Peyroulets 2015 Red (Bergerac)

description: This 100% Malbec rosé brings out a charming side to this sometimes tough grape. The bone-dry wine is fruity, deliciously crisp and with intense red fruitiness. Named after the owner's daughter, Julie Perrin, it comes from young vines. The wine is very ready to drink.
title: Château Lagrézette 2016 Le Rosé de Julie Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: This 100% Malbec rosé brings out a charming side to this sometimes tough grape. The bone-dry wine is fruity, deliciously crisp and with intense red fruitiness. Named after the owner's daughter, Julie Perrin, it comes from young vines. The wine is very ready to drink.
title: Château Lagrézette 2016 Le Rosé de Julie Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: Organically grown grapes have resulted in a soft, crisp and clean wine. It has bright pure fruits with white-peach and red-currant flavors along with stylish acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Vaucouleurs 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Organically grown grapes have resulted in a soft, crisp and clean wine. It has bright pure fruits with white-peach and red-currant flavors along with stylish acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Vaucouleurs 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: While it does have a light texture, this wine is also rich. With intense red-currant fruit, totally crisp acidity and a fine citrus lift, the wine is both fruity and zesty. It will be best drunk from 2018.
title: Château de Brigue 2016 Baroque Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. Dark, balanced, but concentrated, a powerhouse of fruit and ripe spices. The tannins are in the same league, a wave of solid structure, giving support to the freshness of the final acidity.
title: Château Lynch-Bages 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. The ripe fruits go straight to the heart of this powerful, orange peel and citrus wine. There are yellow fruits, balanced with fresh acidity. The ensemble is rich, but balanced.
title: Château Doisy-Védrines 2008 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. Definite new wood aromas here, the wine impressively dense, structured. Then there is velvet, caramel wood layer that sneaks in to give a wine that has freshness, but great elegance.
title: Château Troplong Mondot 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. A solid, almost chunky wine, but well balanced, the tannins fine and tight. The overall effect is of a wine that is warm and ripe, but there is also a tension there.
title: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)
winery: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande

description: 93—95 Barrel sample. Domaine de Chevalier's white has a reputation for long aging, and that's the case with 2006. It is the structure that does it, very firm, almost tannic. But the fruit is also a star, ripe, dense, with green plum flavors and touches of spice. Give this at least 10 years.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 93—95 Barrel sample. Domaine de Chevalier's white has a reputation for long aging, and that's the case with 2006. It is the structure that does it, very firm, almost tannic. But the fruit is also a star, ripe, dense, with green plum flavors and touches of spice. Give this at least 10 years.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 93-85 Barrel sample. Mint and eucalyptus aromas are the hallmark of this tensely tannic wine, which relies on finely polished new wood as well as blackcurrant flavors. It is very dry, with a hard edge, but the potential balance is there.
title: Château Beau-Séjour Bécot 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. Now in the mainstream of top Saint-Emilion wines, the former garage wine is packed with rich, juicy fruit. The acidity is a waft over the firm tannins. There is certainly plenty of new wood, but the opulent fruit balances well.
title: Château Valandraud 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93—95 Barrel sample. A beautiful wine, full of white fruits, citric character and concentrated structured fruit. Great green fruits give a freshness to the wine, which is fleshed out with spice from the wood.
title: Château Laville Haut-Brion 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 94-96 Barrel sample. A dense wine, but without huge power. It goes for the elegant side of Margaux, soft, beautiful. The black cherry fruits are lively, juicy, with extra fresh acidity. Not big, but definitely elegant.
title: Château Margaux 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 94-96 Barrel sample. A beautiful wine, with its fresh wood, lively blackcurrant juice flavors, and subtle tannins. It has a lift and liveliness to it, which sits easily over the firm structure.
title: Château Léoville Poyferré 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: The oak influence has been trimmed back at Jaboulet in recent vintages, and this wine shows only traces of menthol and cedar. Cracked peppercorns and red cherries form the core aromas and flavors of this medium-bodied but long and mouthwatering wine. Approachable now, but it should age well for at least 10 years.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2010 Domaine de Saint Pierre  (Cornas)

description: Warm and ripe, it offers bitter cherry fruits, sweet berries and a layer of firm tannins. It's already balanced and delicious with weight and structure. At the end, it is all bright fruitiness.
title: Domaine Chantal Lescure 2011 Les Mombies  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This is a warm wine with a rounded feel, making it soft and full of red fruits. It features strawberry sweetness as well as a tighter, more tannic character. It could well age, so wait until 2016.
title: David Moreau 2011  Côte de Beaune-Villages

description: Fully fruity right up front, this rounded wine has a crisp element that cuts through the richness. Peach and pear flavors contrast with orange zest and lively final acidity.
title: Collovray et Terrier 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Weighty, warm and welcoming, this is an easy-to-like wine with surprisingly delicate aromas of citrus blossom, tangerine and pineapple. Citrus and honey flavors form the bulk of the rich palate, lingering on the finish.
title: Château Mont-Redon 2011 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Strong wood aromas and flavors dominate the wine at this young stage. Good fruit and a steely texture lie behind the toast. As those yellow fruits develop, it will become a delicious, while always structured wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château des Rontets 2012 Clos Varambon  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Strong wood aromas and flavors dominate the wine at this young stage. Good fruit and a steely texture lie behind the toast. As those yellow fruits develop, it will become a delicious, while always structured wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château des Rontets 2012 Clos Varambon  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Firm, tough, mineral and austere, this is a dense wine that grabs you with its structure and dark fruits. The acidity is lean, needing more time to develop as the wine fleshes out.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2005 Pigmentum Malbec (Cahors)

description: Firm, tough, mineral and austere, this is a dense wine that grabs you with its structure and dark fruits. The acidity is lean, needing more time to develop as the wine fleshes out.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2005 Pigmentum Malbec (Cahors)

description: Evocatively tender notes of Conference pear appear on the nose. The palate is ample with juicy pear and has a generous dollop of residual sweetness. Nonetheless, this is balanced by vigorous lively freshness, leaving a harmonious, rounded, light-footed and elegant wine with a moreish finish.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Yellow peach, honeysuckle and russet pear combine in a very inviting nose. The palate amalgamates these flavors even more, bathing them in tangy but sightly sweet orange notes. The result is a bullet of flavor and freshness, balanced, friendly and very moreish. The finish is off dry and wonderfully clean and spicy.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2015 Les Princes Abbés Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Yellow peach, honeysuckle and russet pear combine in a very inviting nose. The palate amalgamates these flavors even more, bathing them in tangy but sightly sweet orange notes. The result is a bullet of flavor and freshness, balanced, friendly and very moreish. The finish is off dry and wonderfully clean and spicy.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2015 Les Princes Abbés Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A lovely fresh blast of citrus foliage rises from the glass. The palate carries the same fragrant freshness but holds warmth and strength at its core, despite the dry taut body. This is the sunshine and the richness of 2015 captured with a light touch. The finish is dry and refreshing.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2015 Vignoble d'E Riesling (Alsace)

description: A lovely fresh blast of citrus foliage rises from the glass. The palate carries the same fragrant freshness but holds warmth and strength at its core, despite the dry taut body. This is the sunshine and the richness of 2015 captured with a light touch. The finish is dry and refreshing.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2015 Vignoble d'E Riesling (Alsace)

description: Appetizing and warmly generous pear notes characterize the nose. The palate has the same, friendly fruit, boosted by some residual sugar. The plump fruit is countered by ample lemony freshness that creates an inherent balance. The finish is just off dry, but very refreshing.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2014 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Subdued earth notes precede the ripe freshness of red apple and mirabelle. A touch of residual sweetness boosts ripe fruit flavors of pear and orange, red apple and mirabelle plum. Lemon freshness brightens the palate and makes for an appetizing, zingy and refreshing finish.
title: Domaine Gresser 2015 Duttenberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Fresh Granny Smith apple and lemon notes are announced on the nose. On the palate they become fully fledged and weave their refreshing, uncompromisingly dry way across a slender dry body. This is very refreshing and totally invigorating: light yet full of flavor. The finish is long and dry.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2016 Victoriasberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Wood aging has given this wine richness as well as a smooth texture. It is a ripe full-bodied wine, finely poised between fruit and more mature secondary flavors. The single vineyard wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Chaintres 2011 Clos des Oratoriens  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: The name means cornerstone and that is what Maison Bouey delivers in this ripe, structured wine. It has good balance between the wood aging and the rich yellow fruits. A touch of toast gives concentration and density. This full-bodied wine will age. Drink from 2018.
title: Maison Bouey 2016 Pierre Angulaire  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: The name means cornerstone and that is what Maison Bouey delivers in this ripe, structured wine. It has good balance between the wood aging and the rich yellow fruits. A touch of toast gives concentration and density. This full-bodied wine will age. Drink from 2018.
title: Maison Bouey 2016 Pierre Angulaire  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Fresh peel of Russet pear appears on the nose with its implication of pleasant bitterness and juicy fruit. The palate is slender and bone dry, showing the purity of the fruit even more. While this is powerful and concentrated, the finish echoes with gentle delicate pears and lemony freshness.
title: Josmeyer 2015 Fromenteau Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Ripe and delicious, this is full of fruit along with balanced structure. It is lively, with some youthful acidity as well as rich red berry flavors. It's ready to drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2012 Château du Grand Vernay  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This is a bright, fruity wine made delicious by red berry flavors that come with a touch of spice and smoke. It has a good future, fresh and juicy while showing some structure. Drink now, but it will be better in 2015.
title: Domaine Dubost 2013 Tracot  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Smooth, creamy and round, this offers mango, peach and fresher grapefruit flavors, well integrated into its full-bodied texture. With its delicious rich feel, it has weight as well as final acidity.
title: Domaine des Terres Dorées 2013  Beaujolais Blanc

description: A wine that is so fresh, with its blend of aromatic Gros and Petit Manseng and good acidity. Honey and a light hand on wood are added to peach and mango flavors to give a sweet, delicate, ready-to-drink wine.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2010 Victoire White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A wine that is so fresh, with its blend of aromatic Gros and Petit Manseng and good acidity. Honey and a light hand on wood are added to peach and mango flavors to give a sweet, delicate, ready-to-drink wine.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2010 Victoire White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This structured wine discloses dark tannins and a firm, dense character. The granite soil comes through strongly in the cool minerality and tight texture. It has weight and potential richness, but it does need to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Henry Fessy 2012  Chiroubles

description: This is an exceptionally young wine, still tight, textured and mineral. The potential shows in the white fruits, lemon crispness and rich background. It's full of both fruit and a firm, steely structure. Drink from 2017.
title: Wolfberger 2013 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This soft wine shows a rounded character. It's balanced, with acidity giving a supporting freshness and texture to the full, rich creaminess. Full in the mouth and dense, it could age further. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2012 Vieilles Vignes White (Alsace)

description: A blend dominated by Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay produces a crisp, herbal wine that has the background of a more creamy texture. From 20-year-old vines planted on granite soil, it has a tight, mineral edge as well as concentrated apple, citrus and fresh melon fruits. Drink now.
title: Lieubeau 2015 La Fruitière Vignes Blanches White (Val de Loire)

description: Complex and rich, this is an impressive, concentrated wine. It has great acidity that balances flavors of ripe white fruits and apple skins, and lends a tight, taut texture. The wine should be aged for at least six months before drinking.
title: Chateau Haut Rian 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is closed at this stage, offering just hints to its potential. At the core, there are ripe stone fruits, dark plums as well as blackberries. Fine and stylish tannins add balance. This is a fine wine with a future. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Cagnas 2011  Bordeaux

description: With 35% Sauvignon Gris in the blend, this wine is attractive to drink now. Perfumed white fruits with hints of apricots—it's lively and light.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2014 La Fleur Ribeyrolles  (Entre-Deux-Mers)

description: This wine has a fresh, herbal character with grassy aromas and crisp acidity. Apples and quince blend with a more citric element to give a tangy texture that needs a few more months to come together. The blend is 45% Sauvignon Blanc, 35% Sémillion and 20% Sauvignon Gris. Drink from summer 2016.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: From vines in the Entre-deux-Mers, this is a cool wine although with fresh black-currant fruits and balanced tannins. Dominated by Merlot blended with Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc, it has a juicy character that leaves a fresh taste as well as lively acidity. Drink from the end of 2016.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2013 La Fleur de Ribeyrolles  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This young, fruity and ripe wine blends 75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Sauvignon. The generous tannic structure goes with the red fruits and the light acidity. A juicy texture will allow it to age quickly. Drink from 2017. The Gondreau family is a member of Alliance Bourg.
title: Château Lansac La Richarde 2014  Côtes de Bourg

description: This wine is packed with tannins, less packed with fruit. That gives it a tough character, very dry and not fruity enough. The estate is owned by the Perrin family of Château Carbonnieux.
title: Château Lafont Menaut 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This young, purple-colored wine has young fruit to match. It offers stalky red plum and blueberry flavors, light acidity and a fresh character. It is ready to drink.
title: Château la Rose de Vitrac 2014  Bordeaux

description: This young, purple-colored wine has young fruit to match. It offers stalky red plum and blueberry flavors, light acidity and a fresh character. It is ready to drink.
title: Château la Rose de Vitrac 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a tight, structured and stalky wine. Smoky black-currant flavors are freshened by acidity in the 79% Merlot and 21% Cabernet Sauvignon blend from 15 acres. A firm character keeps the wine tough. Drink from 2016. A member of Alliance Bourg.
title: Château Grand Bourgeau 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: Owned by members of the Cruse family, one of the ancient merchants families in Bordeaux, this estate has produced a fruity wine that is juicy with blackberry flavors and considerable acidity. It will need time for the dry core to fill out and balance. Drink from 2018.
title: Château du Taillan 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This is turning into a ripe and fruity wine. The tannins are integrating easily into the black currant flavors. Soon the dry core will open out, supporting the fruit taste. The blend is 50% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc. Drink from late 2016.
title: VIgnobles Roux 2014 Château les Tuilleries  (Bordeaux)

description: A Merlot-dominated wine, this is light in texture, with fresh black currants and a stalky background. It is ready to drink.
title: Exem 2013  Bordeaux

description: This wine has some structure, with enough tannins to sustain the red-berry fruits. It's juicy, with stalky acidity and an attractive texture that will allow it to age a few months. Drink from early 2017.
title: Château Mézain 2013  Bordeaux

description: This wine has some structure, with enough tannins to sustain the red-berry fruits. It's juicy, with stalky acidity and an attractive texture that will allow it to age a few months. Drink from early 2017.
title: Château Mézain 2013  Bordeaux

description: Chloé is a good representation of Vincent Couche's style of wine. With ripe fruit coming from the Aube, it offers well-balanced dryness, giving a rich wine that has an orange tang as well as a steely aftertaste. It is ready to drink, although it will benefit for keeping in bottle until the end of 2015.
title: Vincent Couche NV Chloé Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: From a small village in the Côte Chalonnaise that specializes in Aligoté, this is a bright wine with delicious acidity and refreshing lightness. It's made to be drunk young and is ready now.
title: Louis Jadot 2014

description: This is a juicy fruity wine with tannins that are already subdued by the acidity and fruit. There is a dry core just set to support the black-currant fruit. With a bright crisp aftertaste, the wine will mature quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château du Caillau 2014 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Soft and full in the mouth, with spice adding an extra dimension to the broad berry fruits. The wine is ready to drink, its acidity melding well into the richness. The final taste is solid and dense.
title: Château la Croix Melin 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: A tightly tannic wine, with a firm feeling of wood, balanced by stalky black currant fruit and a layer of acidity. It is still young, with the tannins likely to soften.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2006 Château de Sabazan  (Saint-Mont)

description: A tightly tannic wine, with a firm feeling of wood, balanced by stalky black currant fruit and a layer of acidity. It is still young, with the tannins likely to soften.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2006 Château de Sabazan  (Saint-Mont)

description: The Buzet co-op's top brand, this is big, powerful and rich. It is dominated by blackberry jelly and sweet plums, as well as firm tannins. The palate is weighty, solid, maybe missing freshness but certainly giving good intensity.
title: Vignerons de Buzet 2005 Baron d'Ardeuil Vieilles Vignes Red (Buzet)

description: A soft, apple-y, ripe wine, this is a broad, fruity and instantly attractive wine. A fine example of cool, unoaked Chardonnay, it's lightly fragrant and crisp on the finish. Screwcap.
title: Domaine de Bernier 2011 Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: A classic Gaillac blend of Duras, Gamay, Merlot and Syrah, this is a bright, fruity wine, the lighter of the two wines produced at Château Lecusse. Red berries dominate, allied to crisp acidity.
title: Château Lecusse 2009 Grappes d'Or Red (Gaillac)

description: A classic Gaillac blend of Duras, Gamay, Merlot and Syrah, this is a bright, fruity wine, the lighter of the two wines produced at Château Lecusse. Red berries dominate, allied to crisp acidity.
title: Château Lecusse 2009 Grappes d'Or Red (Gaillac)

description: Complex tannins lend this wine weight and structure. It has a good sense of freshness, and its black currant flavor underscores the dark, dry core.
title: Château la Bienfaisance 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: This wine starts with a shock of acidity, followed by a ripe blackberry note. It is upright, structured and still young, and its sweetness is just beginning to show through the tannins and acidity. Give it 3–4 years.
title: Château Grand Barrail Lamarzelle Figeac 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: This ripe wine's delicious sweetness comes from the delicious honey, ripe apricot and mango flavors. Delicate acidity is balanced against these notes, giving the palate a citrusy edge.
title: Château Filhot 2009  Sauternes

description: Located north of Margaux village, Deyrem Valentin is a small, family-owned property of 32 acres that represents one of the values of Margaux. This wine is smooth, polished and concentrated, with flavors of wood and a sweet-tasting blackberry. The acidity and tannins demonstrate a fine balancing act. This shows good aging potential.
title: Château Deyrem Valentin 2010  Margaux

description: This fine, rich, fruity wine is from a chateau controlled by the Lurton family. It is solid, concentrated and dense, packed with blackberry flavor. Deliciously juicy now, it has the tannins and acidity that suggest it is capable of aging for many years.
title: Château de Villegeorge 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Le Châtaignier is a luxury cuvée of the domaine's oldest vines, approximately 96% Grenache and 4% Mourvèdre. Bright red fruit flavors of raspberry and cherry are complemented by coffee and chocolate notes (the wine spends four months in oak). For a 2009, it's crisp and on the firm side, so give it until next year, and then drink it through 2025.
title: Domaine de Nalys 2009 Le Châtaignier Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Lush and mouth-filling, this is a plummy rendering of Châteauneuf-du-Pape that's ready to drink. Hints of green peppercorn and mocha add nuance, while the finish is long and voluptuous.
title: Louis Bernard 2009 Domaine La Crau des Papes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: From one of the few Saint-Julien properties that are not cru classé, this nevertheless shows all the class of the appellation. It has ripe black-currant and berry flavors, laced with acidity and dry, dense tannins. Its richness  is still developing. This has considerable aging potential.
title: Château les Ormes 2010  Saint-Julien

description: This powerful effort is holding back on its richness now, but it has great potential. It has concentration, firm tannins and round fruit that will soften over the next several years.
title: Château Edmus 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: From the Poujeaux section of Moulis, Dutruch Grand Poujeaux is still family-owned and -inhabited. This is deliciously fruity and the juicy black-currant flavor is firmly balanced by ripe, generous tannins. A concentrated wine that will certainly age well.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2010  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: T-L has three cuvées of Châteauneuf, and while this is the least expensive, it's also the most enjoyable now. A hint of sweaty horse blanket may put off some tasters, but this full-bodied, lushly textured wine features ample raspberry and cherry flavors, copious spices and a long, softly dusty finish. Drink it over the next 5–8 years.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2009 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: T-L has three cuvées of Châteauneuf, and while this is the least expensive, it's also the most enjoyable now. A hint of sweaty horse blanket may put off some tasters, but this full-bodied, lushly textured wine features ample raspberry and cherry flavors, copious spices and a long, softly dusty finish. Drink it over the next 5–8 years.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2009 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Crisp and fruity, this bright and fruity wine has attractive acidity as well as spice and a lightly tangy texture. It's still very fresh and needs time to deepen and become richer. Drink from 2016.
title: Emile Beyer 2013 Lieu dit Hohrain Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Situated in Eguisheim, the Emile Beyer winery is based in a former inn, hence the name L'Hostellerie. This wine is rich and very spicy, with a good cut of acidity. Yellow fruits are balanced with citrus to give a ripe, full-bodied wine. Drink now.
title: Emile Beyer 2012 L'Hostellerie Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Situated in Eguisheim, the Emile Beyer winery is based in a former inn, hence the name L'Hostellerie. This wine is rich and very spicy, with a good cut of acidity. Yellow fruits are balanced with citrus to give a ripe, full-bodied wine. Drink now.
title: Emile Beyer 2012 L'Hostellerie Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This bone-dry wine has a soft, ripe touch. It is crisp at the start and at the end, with attractive fresh sliced apple and pineapple fruit flavors. It can be drunk now.
title: Domaine Rieflé-Landmann 2013 Seppi Landmann Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a tremendous example of Côte-Rôtie from an irregular vintage. After 20 months in new oak, the wine is a seamless amalgam of roasted meat and charred fruit. The tannins are supple, the extraction and ripeness judged expertly to provide richness without excessive weight. The finish does firm up a bit, so drink it from 2018–2028, and possibly beyond.
title: Domaine Jean-Michel Gerin 2013 La Landonne  (Côte Rôtie)

description: The wine, with its firm tannins and solid structure, is still young. The hints of black-plum fruits are way behind the structure. That's all good, because this wine will come together well, to give a rich full wine with spice, juicy black fruits and acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Vignobles K 2014 Badine de la Patache  (Pomerol)

description: From the family's own premier cru vines, this is a Chardonnay-dominated wine. That gives it a distinctive chalky texture and a steely edge despite the relatively high dosage. Ripe with white and citrus fruits and acidity, it is ready to drink.
designation: Les Pêcherines Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru Brut
title: Duménil NV Les Pêcherines Vieilles Vignes Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Tart apple scents on the nose become fully fledged on the frothy palate. Granny Smith flavors are met with some creamy autolysis notes of shortbread but the zingy tartness remains. The finish is dry, sprightly and clean-cut.
title: Clément Klur NV Cuvée Manekineko Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Vanilla aromas give this wine its warm wood character. The ripe fruits that are underneath are full of red berries, touches of spice and acidity. This is a full-bodied wine, likely to be ready from 2017.
title: Château Thieuley 2014  Bordeaux

description: The wine is tight and tangy with a strong mineral edge. It has a ripe feel to it, full of spice and rich pears. It is concentrated and will be better from 2017.
title: Château Lacaussade Saint-Martin 2015 Trois Moulins  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine is tight and tangy with a strong mineral edge. It has a ripe feel to it, full of spice and rich pears. It is concentrated and will be better from 2017.
title: Château Lacaussade Saint-Martin 2015 Trois Moulins  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Jacques Chardat, who also owns Labrousse, has a wine that has the potential to be a ripe and juicy. Fine tannins and plenty of acidity will let it develop well. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Lacaussade Saint-Martin 2014 Trois Moulins  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Stephane Heurlier makes a generous yet structured wine that's full of fruit. It has plenty of spice and black currant layered with a touch of chocolate and coffee. Let the wine mature and drink from 2019.
title: Château la Bretonnière 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a fruity wine with contrasting wood-aging spice and high toastiness. It is still young with the acidity still prominent, so the two elements should blend well over the next few years to give a ripe, fruity wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Pezat 2014 Prélude du Château Haut-Pezat  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Owned by the same family since 1850, this estate has produced a ripe Merlot-dominated wine. It is densely structured and full of black-currant fruits. The crisp fruitiness of the year shows strongly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Tabuteau 2014  Lussac Saint-Émilion

description: The strains of a certain song about summer wine just seem to pop up as you smell this fruity fizz. This is a generously fruited, berry-tastic wine whose flavors are accentuated by a generous dosage and freely foaming effervescence. This embodies the ease and joy of summer. Drink soon and enjoy.
title: Charles Sparr NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The strains of a certain song about summer wine just seem to pop up as you smell this fruity fizz. This is a generously fruited, berry-tastic wine whose flavors are accentuated by a generous dosage and freely foaming effervescence. This embodies the ease and joy of summer. Drink soon and enjoy.
title: Charles Sparr NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Producer Michel Gonet has made this 50-50 blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, using this label exclusively for the American market. It is a soft, ripe wine, well balanced and attractive with white fruits and a touch of citrus. The texture is crisp, leaving a bright, tight aftertaste.
title: Charles-Gilbert de Vindé NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Producer Michel Gonet has made this 50-50 blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, using this label exclusively for the American market. It is a soft, ripe wine, well balanced and attractive with white fruits and a touch of citrus. The texture is crisp, leaving a bright, tight aftertaste.
title: Charles-Gilbert de Vindé NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: This is a young and fruity Champagne, bursting with red fruits and the lightest of tannins. With its salmon-pink color, it is tangy and crisp, moving towards dry in its style. The aftertaste is fruity with a zing of acidity.
title: Taittinger NV Prestige Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This cool-climate wine is crisp, steely and full of fruit. Its acidity and touch of saltiness add to its refreshing nature.
title: Auguste Bonhomme 2016 La Forcine Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This cool-climate wine is crisp, steely and full of fruit. Its acidity and touch of saltiness add to its refreshing nature.
title: Auguste Bonhomme 2016 La Forcine Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This blend of Grolleau and Gamay has an attractive onion-skin-pink color. Fruity and with red-currant flavors, it is soft and lively. There is a nutty character that adds to the pleasure of this easygoing ready-to-drink wine.
title: Paris-Simoneau NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Touraine)

description: This is a beautifully ripe wine, full of melon and apricot fruits as well as fine crisp acidity. There is a little touch of pepper to give the wine piquancy. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Ollivier Frères 2016 Domaine de l'Olivier Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The wine is light and crisp with lemon acidity and with a zesty bright texture. There is a touch of minerality and a clean lively aftertaste. Drink now.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2016 Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Definitely mature, this is a ripe wine with rich tropical flavors that give balance to the beginnings of toastiness. An attractive tang of acidity contrasts with the soft, ripe aftertaste. The wine will age further, although it is ready to drink now and until 2018.
title: Bertrand-Delespierre 2006 Millésimé Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Definitely mature, this is a ripe wine with rich tropical flavors that give balance to the beginnings of toastiness. An attractive tang of acidity contrasts with the soft, ripe aftertaste. The wine will age further, although it is ready to drink now and until 2018.
title: Bertrand-Delespierre 2006 Millésimé Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Bone dry and crisp, this is also has fruitiness from the ripeness of the grapes, giving impressively rich apple and pear flavors. Of course, these are cut by tight acidity and intense citrus, leaving a tight, steely aftertaste.
title: A.R. Lenoble  NV Dosage Zéro Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: Freshly cut Granny Smith vies with Golden Delicious on the fruit-driven nose and palate. The palate has a tart edge but the flavors are fresh, citric and clean—autolysis is barely perceptible while the fizz is rather frothy yet easily dissipates. If you don't like aggressive mousse, this is a softer choice.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Les Natures Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The creamy notes of autolysis are only slightly present but there is a roundness of red fruit and apple flavors on the palate. This is balanced and beautifully dry, with a lasting finish.
title: Hubert Meyer NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Citric tartness dominates nose and palate, making for a spritzy, lime-flavored fizz with frothy bubbles. The dry palate is light yet fruity, making this fun, easy-drinking and refreshing.
title: Gustave Lorentz NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Fresh strawberry and red-cheeked apple unite on the appetizing nose of this pretty pink fizz. The same, rich, rounded and fruity flavors play on the creamy palate. There is a bit of body here, pulled into focus by bright, lemony freshness.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé NV Giersberger Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Tannins and structure bring out the character of the 2010 vintage in this open, generally soft wine. It is already attractive, drinkable and fresh. Black currants dominate the natural fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Fleur de Roc  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A branded Bordeaux, this shows the structure of the vintage while also being accessible and ready to drink now. It is dominated by Merlot which gives ripe berry fruits and a full, soft structure. Drink now and until 2018. Screwcap.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: A branded Bordeaux, this shows the structure of the vintage while also being accessible and ready to drink now. It is dominated by Merlot which gives ripe berry fruits and a full, soft structure. Drink now and until 2018. Screwcap.
title: Cheval Quancard 2010 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: A ripe, very smooth second wine of Château Siaurac, rich while still full of fresh fruit that already shows elegance and a light touch. The wine is likely to age well and soon, so drink from 2015.
title: Château Siaurac 2011 Plaisir de Siaurac  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: A bright, citrus flavored wine thart is very crisp and fruity. There is a wonderful shock of acidity that brings out freshness and the herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc flavors. Drink now.
title: Château Carignan 2012 L'Orangerie de Carignan  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A bright, citrus flavored wine thart is very crisp and fruity. There is a wonderful shock of acidity that brings out freshness and the herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc flavors. Drink now.
title: Château Carignan 2012 L'Orangerie de Carignan  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Dark and weighty, this is a dense wine, very firm in its tannins as well as bringing out rich blackberry fruits. The wood shows through strongly, while there is a pepper edge from the high alcohol.
title: Château Carignan 2011 L'Orangerie de Carignan  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Dark and weighty, this is a dense wine, very firm in its tannins as well as bringing out rich blackberry fruits. The wood shows through strongly, while there is a pepper edge from the high alcohol.
title: Château Carignan 2011 L'Orangerie de Carignan  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Ripe and creamy, this is an attractive wine that has forward apple, lemon and green-plum flavors. It's a lightly textured, vanilla-touched wine that can be drunk now.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2012 Grande QV  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: Ripe and creamy, this is an attractive wine that has forward apple, lemon and green-plum flavors. It's a lightly textured, vanilla-touched wine that can be drunk now.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2012 Grande QV  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This wine is soft and ripe with a generous palate of wild-strawberry flavor, but a balancing act of acidity lends elegance. It's fruity but finishes crisp and dry.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 Passion Légère Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is soft and ripe with a generous palate of wild-strawberry flavor, but a balancing act of acidity lends elegance. It's fruity but finishes crisp and dry.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 Passion Légère Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A soft, fragrant red-cherry flavor dominates this fruity, open and easy wine. Very ready to drink, it has attractive acidity and a light spice to the finish.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Château du Prieuré  (Brouilly)

description: This is a very spicy, candy-flavored wine. A simple Gewürztraminer, it has lychee, almond and rosewater notes.
title: Vignerons Réunis de Kientzheim 2010 The Furst Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: There is some of the structure characteristic of 2010 Beaujolais in this wine, but it is mainly dominated by a red cherry flavor and fresh acidity. It's ripe, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Jaffelin 2010  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Crisp, attractive fruit flavors produce a wine that is bright, light, open. There's a good tang of lemon zest accompanying the acidity that comes from the green fruit flavor. Ready to drink.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2011 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: There is a touch of minerality from the textured apple-skin flavor. The wine has a bright, lively feel to it, with green plum and grapefruit notes providing a fruity finish.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2010 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This ripe, honeyed wine is very rich and smooth. Apricot and mango flavors dominate. Balance comes with the final tang of lemon zest acidity.
title: Domaine François Schmitt 2010 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This gold-colored, mature wine shows deliciously rich spice as well as a dense texture. It's full bodied and definitely ready to drink.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2008 Herrenweg Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This medium-sweet wine is attractively perfumed, with a good balance between exotic spice and fragrant acidity. The wine is soft and immediately drinkable. Screwcap.
title: Cave de Beblenheim 2010 Baron de Hoen Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This wine is textured, with a firm backdrop to the ripe white fruits. Acidity cuts through everything, giving a fragrant character. Drink this developing wine from 2018.
title: Louis Latour 2014  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This wine is textured, with a firm backdrop to the ripe white fruits. Acidity cuts through everything, giving a fragrant character. Drink this developing wine from 2018.
title: Louis Latour 2014  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Here's true “old vine” wine—from vines 75 years old on average—and it is ripe and toasty, with flavors of almonds, spice and baked bread. Fresh, crisp apples and green plums are lifted by a citrus aftertaste. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Pierre Merguey 2014 Vielles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This spicy wine is ripe, fresh and richly fruity. Plenty of toast contrasts with the yellow fruit and grapefruit. This full-bodied wine is ripe, generous and ready to drink.
title: Mommessin 2014 Deux Terroirs Grande Exception  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This south-facing vineyard has produced a well-balanced wine. The tannins are gentle, enveloped by the juicy red-fruit flavor and the mineral acidity. It is ripe, full of fruit with a crisp, tight aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Suremain 2014 Les Crêts Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: The wine is pure fruit, deliciously perfumed and with a rounded ripe character. It has acidity and structure although these are just supports for the bright fruits. The acidity at the end will allow it to age further, so drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Michel Dupré 2014 Le Griottier  (Morgon)

description: The wine is pure fruit, deliciously perfumed and with a rounded ripe character. It has acidity and structure although these are just supports for the bright fruits. The acidity at the end will allow it to age further, so drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Michel Dupré 2014 Le Griottier  (Morgon)

description: A ripe bold wine with generous black fruits, it is a blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc. Dark and concentrated, it brings together rich fruitiness and firm tannins that will allow it to age. Drink from 2018. The wine comes from a vineyard that is currently in biodynamic conversion.
title: Château le Prieuré 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Sometimes seen as the junior estate in the Mouton-Rothschild stable, this property is now showing its own fine character. The wine is juicy with crisp fruit and soft tannins. It is in a rounded generous style that will allow it to be drinkable relatively soon. Drink starting from 2020.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2014  Pauillac

description: Sometimes seen as the junior estate in the Mouton-Rothschild stable, this property is now showing its own fine character. The wine is juicy with crisp fruit and soft tannins. It is in a rounded generous style that will allow it to be drinkable relatively soon. Drink starting from 2020.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2014  Pauillac

description: Very structured and dark, this is a wine for the long haul. It is concentrated and balanced, still very young and only just hinting at the black fruits that show the rich potential of this wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Prieuré-Lichine 2012  Margaux

description: Very structured and dark, this is a wine for the long haul. It is concentrated and balanced, still very young and only just hinting at the black fruits that show the rich potential of this wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Prieuré-Lichine 2012  Margaux

description: The main estate of the Bunan family is a citadel from the 18th century. This wine is perfumed, rich with pepper as well as ripe red fruits. Structure from the dominant Mourvèdre in the blend gives some tannins and a sense of power. Drink from early 2017.
title: Domaines Bunan 2015 Château la Rouvière Rosé (Bandol)

description: The main estate of the Bunan family is a citadel from the 18th century. This wine is perfumed, rich with pepper as well as ripe red fruits. Structure from the dominant Mourvèdre in the blend gives some tannins and a sense of power. Drink from early 2017.
title: Domaines Bunan 2015 Château la Rouvière Rosé (Bandol)

description: A blend of Grenache and Cinsault, this wine comes from old vines in an estate revived in 1997 by Gilles Pons and Pascale Massenot. It's all about aromatic fruit, with grapefruit, pineapple and red currants playing in the flavors. A rich element contrasts pleasurably with the tight, crisp acidity. The wine will benefit from a few more months aging, so wait until the end of 2016.
title: Château les Valentines 2015 Les Valentines Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine comes from a small parcel of 41-year-old vines in the Muraires vineyard. It has concentration, richness and a structured character that suggests aging potential. Of course, this impressive wine is ready to drink now for its freshness.
title: Bernard Magrez 2015 L'Excellence des Muraires Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Something different, the fruit for this wine comes off 80-year-old Carignan vines. The result is an intensely concentrated wine that mixes raspberry and blueberry fruit with delicate herbal shadings. It's full-bodied, but supple and easy to drink, ending on a note of dark chocolate. Drink now–2018.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2012 Qu'es aQuo Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Something different, the fruit for this wine comes off 80-year-old Carignan vines. The result is an intensely concentrated wine that mixes raspberry and blueberry fruit with delicate herbal shadings. It's full-bodied, but supple and easy to drink, ending on a note of dark chocolate. Drink now–2018.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2012 Qu'es aQuo Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a full-bodied blend of Syrah and Carignan, aged a year in oak. It's dense and velvety, with an almost chocolate-fudge texture and notes of plum, leather and spice. Drink now–2018.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2010 Trassegum Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: The blend includes Bordeaux grapes along with the local Abouriou. Richly structured, it has the ripe black fruits to match. It shows power, although it also keeps an elegant balance between tannins and fruit. Hold until 2016.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2010 Richard 1er Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: The blend includes Bordeaux grapes along with the local Abouriou. Richly structured, it has the ripe black fruits to match. It shows power, although it also keeps an elegant balance between tannins and fruit. Hold until 2016.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2010 Richard 1er Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Ready to drink now, this blend of 50% Grenache, 25% Syrah and 25% Mourvèdre displays hints of roasted fruit and game on the nose. It's full in body, supple in texture and velvety on the finish, making it a solid choice for roasts or braises this winter.
title: Pierre Henri Morel 2011 Signargues G-S-M (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: The Tain cooperative's luxury cuvée of Crozes-Hermitage is marked by touches of vanilla and cedar, yet retains some sinewy herbal notes and ample black cherry fruit. It's medium-bodied, well structured and firm, even a bit crisp, on the finish. It's modern and oak-influenced, but well done.
title: Cave de Tain 2010 Les Hauts du Fief  (Crozes-Hermitage)

description: Black fruits and rich tannins bring out the fruitiness. A strongly mineral character gives structure, while still allowing room for the red cherry and raspberry fruit flavors. It will age, so drink from 2016.
title: Fabien Collonge 2013 L'Aurore des Côtes  (Chiroubles)

description: This blend of Muscat and Gewurztraminer is all spiciness. It has peach freshness as well with just a touch of honey. It's immediately attractive.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2011 Andante White (Alsace)

description: The wine is soft and rounded, with red fruits that are lightly sweet and balancing acidity. A rich wine, it's ready to drink.
title: Bailli de Provence 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is soft and rounded, with red fruits that are lightly sweet and balancing acidity. A rich wine, it's ready to drink.
title: Bailli de Provence 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is aromatic and fresh, although its herbal character doesn't quite fit with the rest of this crisp and fruity wine. It may improve, but at the moment it is not balanced or together.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2013 Le Pont Rosé (Bandol)

description: The balance between ripeness and acidity that is the hallmark of this fine vintage is expressed well in this impressive wine. Tangy, with a strong streak of minerality, it is crisp and rich at the same time. For its fruitiness, it is ready to drink; for more maturity, it will need to age until 2018.
title: Taittinger 2008 Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The balance between ripeness and acidity that is the hallmark of this fine vintage is expressed well in this impressive wine. Tangy, with a strong streak of minerality, it is crisp and rich at the same time. For its fruitiness, it is ready to drink; for more maturity, it will need to age until 2018.
title: Taittinger 2008 Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)
