description: Egarade means a “mysterious evening stroll,” according to the producer. Perhaps the idea is that you lose track of time in this wine. A blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, it is rich and full-bodied with a good weight of white and green fruits and a final nervy texture and acidity.
title: Bailly-Lapierre 2005 Egarade Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Aromas of currants and tropical fruits are followed by ripe nectarine and star fruit flavors with the acidity coming from a fresh pineapple character. It's an intense wine, with delicious, full concentration of flavors.
title: Roger et Didier Raimbault 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: A strangely bitter note mingles with unusually high-toned leafy red-fruit notes. The palate is slightly bitter but dry and fresh. The body is very light. Drink soon.
title: Robert Karcher et Fils 2014 Cuvée du Commandeur Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This exuberant wine has pineapple, pepper and perfumed toast. It is open, generous, kept in check with some crisp acidity, but essentially rich, lively and buttery. This is a down-to-earth wine, fat, prosperous and friendly.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2006 En Remilly Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Big, ripe, generous, this wine is on the rich side of the 2006 vintage. At this stage, it offers peach and apricot, with honeyed yeast flavors. The minerality crispens the texture, while black pepper and firm tannins suggest aging ability.
designation: Le Fief de Grenouilles Grand Cru
title: La Chablisienne 2006 Le Fief de Grenouilles Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Big, ripe, generous, this wine is on the rich side of the 2006 vintage. At this stage, it offers peach and apricot, with honeyed yeast flavors. The minerality crispens the texture, while black pepper and firm tannins suggest aging ability.
designation: Le Fief de Grenouilles Grand Cru
title: La Chablisienne 2006 Le Fief de Grenouilles Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: Subdued but promising apple-ripeness on the nose leads to a rounded, fully mature palate that rings with fresh and dried apple. There are hints of hay and and a wonderfully, clean core of lemon freshness that is supremely well cushioned on these rich, intense flavors. Drink 2016–2019.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2010 Rosacker Grand Cru Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: The wine is young and still firm with dry tannins. It has really fresh red-berry fruits that are going to need time to broaden out. For now, the wine shows the fruitiness of the vintage and with a solid texture for aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014  Sancerre

description: The wine is young and still firm with dry tannins. It has really fresh red-berry fruits that are going to need time to broaden out. For now, the wine shows the fruitiness of the vintage and with a solid texture for aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014  Sancerre

description: The appetizing perfume is a perfect fusion of lemon zest and tart apple. The palate also pitches that same, ripe freshness against zingy tang. The palate is dry, textured and juicy and thus very moreish. This is very alive and appetizing with a super-clean, lip-smacking finish.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2014 Frankstein Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The promise of aromatic, ripe stone fruit is immediately evident: vine-ripened peach and baked apple are lush and perfumed. The palate is equally fruitful, but tempered by dryness and a stony, taut and structured background. This is clean and poised and is ready now but will develop beautifully until 2020.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2012 Kirchberg de Ribeauvillé Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very gentle, perfumed honeysuckle notes are distinct and enticing on the nose. The palate follows this with a perfumed, opulent medium-sweetness that is reminiscent of sugar-plums and candied fruit pastilles: there are peach and plum and unbridled richness with a slight phenolic grip.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2011 Sonnenglanz Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A closed nose shows the faintest notes of quince. The palate is dry and fresh with lots of lemony zestiness. It's slender and clean with a wonderful, straightlaced backbone. Freshness and tautness signal a purposeful, lively wine, full of apple fruit and aromatic overtones of quince.
title: Willm 2013 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Once the sulfur note blows off this young wine, the tart berry and cherry aromas and flavors wear cocoa and tobacco accents. On the tongue an even palate-feel and smooth texture please, and decent acidity supports the fruit.
title: Abarbanel 1999 Estate Bottled Merlot (Languedoc)

description: A perennial favorite, it's reassuring to see that the quality continues to remain high even from Guigal's least expensive cuvée. Red fruits—cherries and raspberries—marry easily with hints of clove, cracked pepper, black olive and espresso. It's round on the midpalate, showing more focus and ample length on the finish.
title: E. Guigal 2011 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: It's basically one-third each Grenache Blanc, Roussanne and Viognier, but the Viognier speaks loudest in the finished wine. Apricot and peppery-gingery spice notes mark the nose, while the texture is bolstered by Viognier's phenolic content without becoming bitter. Drink now through 2015.
title: Domaine de la Mordorée 2013 La Reine des Bois White (Lirac)

description: Spicy, ripe and fruity, this wine has enough structure to give shape to the broad black fruits that are the stars. A smoky element comes from just the right amount of wood aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Recougne 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Big and bold, this is going to be an impressive Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon blend from a 2.5-acre plot on the Queyrens family estate. It has great red fruits and generous acidity, both of which are given a strong sense of structure by the tannins. At the moment, it is about potential, so wait until 2017.
title: Château Pilet 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Developing well, this rich and intense wine has all the pleasures of 2005. The tannins are a firm hint along with the sweet, smoky berry fruits and ripe acidity. It is structured, dense and elegant, a great success for this château.
title: Château Marquis de Terme 2005  Margaux

description: With a density of nearly 7,000 vines per acre, and consequent low yields, it is not surprising this is a concentrated, intense wine. It has quintessential herbaceous flavors, rounded out with a creamed apple element and a tight, steely texture. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château de Tracy 2008 Haute Densité  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: With a density of nearly 7,000 vines per acre, and consequent low yields, it is not surprising this is a concentrated, intense wine. It has quintessential herbaceous flavors, rounded out with a creamed apple element and a tight, steely texture. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château de Tracy 2008 Haute Densité  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This bottling from the large négociant Ogier features attractive aromas of black olives and ripe cherries. It's full bodied and creamy in texture, with flavors of mocha, olive and dark earth that finish warm and long. Drink now–2020.
title: Clos de L'Oratoire des Papes 2012 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: It's almost worth buying this bottling just for the extravagant medieval label design. Luckily the wine is lives up to the heraldic billing. It is rich while also well structured. Juicy berry fruits and fresh black currant acidity show well against a still-tannic structure. The wine comes from the Moreaud family. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Cormeil-Figeac 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Rich, ripe and full-bodied, this is a Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon/Malbec blend. Juicy acidity and berry fruits are integrated into the firm structure. A smoky, dry wood-laden background gives the wine good texture. Drink from 2016. Xavier Carreau, Alain Jourdan and Cyril Jourdan, the latest generation, run the family's five estates.
title: Château Barbé 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Rich, ripe and full-bodied, this is a Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon/Malbec blend. Juicy acidity and berry fruits are integrated into the firm structure. A smoky, dry wood-laden background gives the wine good texture. Drink from 2016. Xavier Carreau, Alain Jourdan and Cyril Jourdan, the latest generation, run the family's five estates.
title: Château Barbé 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is rich, full of ripe red berry fruits and sliced with firm, still-young tannins. Produced from old vines, it has concentration and juicy acidity that lifts the full, fruity character. The structure will allow the wine to age further, so drink from 2017.
title: Vignoble de la Jarnoterie 2012 Concerto  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: Attractively ripe, this second wine from Château Léoville las Cases is initially fruity. The structure comes through only slowly to reveal itself.The wine is ripe yet shot through with acidity. Likely to develop quickly.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2010 Le Petit Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: Attractively ripe, this second wine from Château Léoville las Cases is initially fruity. The structure comes through only slowly to reveal itself.The wine is ripe yet shot through with acidity. Likely to develop quickly.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2010 Le Petit Lion  (Saint-Julien)

description: An attractively ripe and mature wine with a great balance between the orangy citrus fruits and a tight, taut, mineral texture. The wine is rich in its dosage and fruitiness while showing signs of maturer toast and almond flavors. However, it could still age.
title: Duval-Leroy 2005 Clos des Bouveries Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The wine is soft with a fine touch of tannin and some stalkiness. It has black currants that are ripe while remaining crisp. The wine is easy, accessible and ready to drink.
title: Cheval Quancard 2015 Chai de Bordes  (Bordeaux)

description: The wine is tight and dominated by very crisp black currants and considerable acidity. Assuming it can soften and open up, it will be a fruity wine with just a light structure.
title: Château Roquefort 2015  Bordeaux

description: The wine has structure along with juicy generous fruits. Bright fruitiness brings acidity from black-currant flavors. Drink this ripe wine from 2018.
title: Château Roc de Minvielle 2015 Cuvée Les Tourelles  (Bordeaux)

description: The wine has structure along with juicy generous fruits. Bright fruitiness brings acidity from black-currant flavors. Drink this ripe wine from 2018.
title: Château Roc de Minvielle 2015 Cuvée Les Tourelles  (Bordeaux)

description: While this wine shows its wood aging strongly, it is likely that the fruit will be able to push through the spice and heavy toast as it matures. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Peuy Saincrit 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a structured wine, firm with tannins. Behind the structure, the attractive black-plum fruits are still developing. The wine is dense and solid and will be ready from 2018.
title: Château l'Eglise Saget 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a fruity wine, packed with acidity, red fruits and a soft texture. With its crisp open character it is not a wine for long aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Lacombe Cadiot 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a fruity wine, packed with acidity, red fruits and a soft texture. With its crisp open character it is not a wine for long aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Lacombe Cadiot 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This light- to medium-bodied wine comes across as playful for its aromas of cotton candy and bubble gum. On the palate, it's still a bit confected, but is clean, dry and refreshing.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2016 Château Grand Escalion Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: A blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, this medium-bodied wine is slightly confected and bubble-gum-like at first. With a bit of air, it takes on simple, fruity and direct flavors of cherries and berries, but finishes clean and dry. Drink now.
title: Domaine La Tour de Gâtigne 2016 Rosé (Cévennes)

description: Balanced and fruity, this is a crisp wine that has soft tannins. With its bright black-currant fruit, acidity, and touch of spice, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2015  Bordeaux

description: Balanced and fruity, this is a crisp wine that has soft tannins. With its bright black-currant fruit, acidity, and touch of spice, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Mouleyre 2015  Bordeaux

description: The wine is structured with both wood and tannin flavors. It has a juicy core that will develop, so give this wine until 2019.
title: Château des Moines Menodin 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a dry wine, ruled by tannins. It is firm, the juicy fruit underneath needs time. It will have a juicy future, so wait until late 2018.
title: Château Terres Douces 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a dry wine, ruled by tannins. It is firm, the juicy fruit underneath needs time. It will have a juicy future, so wait until late 2018.
title: Château Terres Douces 2015  Bordeaux

description: Full, fat and fleshy, this wine has some weight, ripe fruit and green plum acidity. There's a light structure of fruit skins, giving a crisp aftertaste. Thirst-quenching acidity to finish.
title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild 2006 Mouton Cadet Réserve  (Graves)

description: On the nose this is earthy, with grassy aromas touched by flint. The palate offers herbal flavors and fleshy green plums, still with an earthy edge. Ready to drink, the structure just gives finishing weight.
title: Yvon Mau 2006 Premius Sauvignon Blanc  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: and fruity, this packs good, ripe flavors of blackberries, leather, herbs and sweet acidity. The tannins remain firmly dry, structured, leaving fine, black fruits and acidity.
title: Château le Grand Paroissien 2003  Haut-Médoc

description: This is the second wine of Château Balestard, and there are suggestions of high extraction and very ripe fruit. It does have balance, however, the black fruits need time to calm down. The acidity is all here, offering freshness to this rich wine.
title: Château Lalande Balestard 2003  Bordeaux

description: A ripe, spicy wine, with a good blend of black fruits, spice and tannins from wood aging, and a layer of dry plum skins. It has plenty of Merlot tobacco aromas and dark fruit cake flavors.
title: Caves Fleury 2001 Grand-Portail Cuvée Réservée  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A ripe, spicy wine, with a good blend of black fruits, spice and tannins from wood aging, and a layer of dry plum skins. It has plenty of Merlot tobacco aromas and dark fruit cake flavors.
title: Caves Fleury 2001 Grand-Portail Cuvée Réservée  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A ripe and creamy wine that has also managed to retain a strongly mineral character. It's a rich wine from the heart of Champagne's Côte des Blancs Chardonnay vineyards. Apples, spice and tight lime and lemon flavors give a crisp aftertaste. It is ready to drink.
designation: Millénaire Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Jean Milan NV Millénaire Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a steely wine, crisp and very textured. Lemon zest and acidity are given structure by the mineral character and by the touches of wood. It's a wine with a future, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2012 Vaillon Premier Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This is a ripe, softly fruity wine that has acidity within a smooth texture. It is dry without being too tight or nervy. Citrus fruits dominate, giving a crisp aftertaste. Drink with food.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Domaine Aureillan Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Simple and fruity, this is ready for summer drinking. It is very fresh, crisp, lightly textured and with fragrant, refreshing acidity. A touch of pepper gives the aftertaste attractive spice.
title: Château Barbanau 2014 La Girafe Verte Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This soft, ripe wine is still developing its rich white fruitiness. For now, it's poised between acidity and a mineral structure. The creamier aspect of this wine is still to come, so keep until 2016.
title: Domaine Carrette 2013 Les Mûres  (Saint-Véran)

description: This soft, ripe wine is still developing its rich white fruitiness. For now, it's poised between acidity and a mineral structure. The creamier aspect of this wine is still to come, so keep until 2016.
title: Domaine Carrette 2013 Les Mûres  (Saint-Véran)

description: Named after the river that flows past Chablis, this is a ripe, fruity wine, with yellow fruit flavors and good ripeness. Unoaked, it has good concentration as well as richness.
title: La Chablisienne 2005 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: From a vineyard run on biodynamic principles, this wine boasts good, fresh fruit, with great green, crisp acidity and green plum intensity. It's very lively and fresh, but full-bodied.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2005 Domaine de la Boissoneuse  (Chablis)

description: Attractively colored wine with red berry fruits and an edge of bitter cherries, almonds and perfumed acidity. The wine is structured, spicy, full-bodied in character.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2010 Le Pont Rosé (Bandol)

description: Benefiting from the ripe 2009 vintage, the wine shows more ripe fruit than is usual from the Hautes-Côtes. It has rich strawberry flavor along with acidity. The soft tannins add a light sense of structure.
title: Pierre André 2009 Les Forges  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune)

description: There's a wild, natural streak to this wine of garrigue herbs and game matched with fruit notes of dark cherry and plum guts. The medium-weight mouth is juicy but offers nice structre with dusty tannins and a fudgy finish. Drink now.
title: Mourrel Azurat 2009 Red (Fitou)

description: Warm and rounded wine, with almond flavor and the ripe red fruits to go with the intense and balancing acidity. The wine is rich, while also well textured, giving fine final acidity.
designation: Perle de Nuit Blanc de Noirs Brut
title: Louis Bouillot NV Perle de Nuit Blanc de Noirs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Warm and rounded wine, with almond flavor and the ripe red fruits to go with the intense and balancing acidity. The wine is rich, while also well textured, giving fine final acidity.
designation: Perle de Nuit Blanc de Noirs Brut
title: Louis Bouillot NV Perle de Nuit Blanc de Noirs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: With its strawberry flavor and tight acidity, this is an attractive, clean sparkling wine. It has just the right balance between acidity and bright fruit, leaving a textured aftertaste.
title: Louis Bouillot NV Perle d'Aurore Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: With its strawberry flavor and tight acidity, this is an attractive, clean sparkling wine. It has just the right balance between acidity and bright fruit, leaving a textured aftertaste.
title: Louis Bouillot NV Perle d'Aurore Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Fresh, simple, apple-flavored wine, with an edge of citrus and soft vanilla flavors. The wine is attractive and clean with elegance coupled to ripe fruit.
title: Labouré-Roi 2009 St Amand  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Now at its peak, this rich, rounded wine is full of spice and tropical fruits, and is full in the mouth. The explosion of ripe fruits is only lightly restrained by some final acidity. This joyous wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2012 Les Éléments Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Now at its peak, this rich, rounded wine is full of spice and tropical fruits, and is full in the mouth. The explosion of ripe fruits is only lightly restrained by some final acidity. This joyous wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2012 Les Éléments Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Full and ripe, the wine has smooth flavors of apricots, ripe apples and pears and a structure that includes wood tastes. It's a rich wine, hinting at spice and showing fresh, juicy acidity at the end. Drink until 2019.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2010 Grande Fumé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Full and ripe, the wine has smooth flavors of apricots, ripe apples and pears and a structure that includes wood tastes. It's a rich wine, hinting at spice and showing fresh, juicy acidity at the end. Drink until 2019.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2010 Grande Fumé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Dark in color, this powerful and concentrated wine is still very young. There is possibly too much extraction here that shows in bitterness, but the wine also has the potential for aging with its rich underlying fruitiness. Don't drink before 2015.
title: Château la Varière 2011 La Chevalerie Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: Dark in color, this powerful and concentrated wine is still very young. There is possibly too much extraction here that shows in bitterness, but the wine also has the potential for aging with its rich underlying fruitiness. Don't drink before 2015.
title: Château la Varière 2011 La Chevalerie Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: With age, this 2002 has become fascinating, still showing sweetness while also offering dried fruits, prunes, figs and spice. A nutty character suggests the wine can still age for many years.
title: Château d'Arlay 2002 Vin de Paille White (Côtes du Jura)

description: A lean wine with some austerity. It has a firmly tannic character while missing the fruit for the future.
title: Château Brethous 2010  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is stalky with tight tannins and just a touch of spicy wood. It has acidity, bitter cherry fruits and structure. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2014 Les Belles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: The wine is stalky with tight tannins and just a touch of spicy wood. It has acidity, bitter cherry fruits and structure. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2014 Les Belles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: This rosé is warm and soft, with an attractive perfume and lively acidity to balance. Its red berry fruit is finished with a touch of spice that gives a final lift to the smooth vanilla-inflected aftertaste.
title: Florent Descombe NV Syrah Rosé (Vin de France)

description: In a very Corsican style, this is a totally crisp blend of Nieillucciu, Sciaccarellu and Grenache. The first grape lends intense acidity while adding red currant and orange fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Petroni 2016 Rosé (Corse)

description: In a very Corsican style, this is a totally crisp blend of Nieillucciu, Sciaccarellu and Grenache. The first grape lends intense acidity while adding red currant and orange fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Petroni 2016 Rosé (Corse)

description: This family-owned producer has made a distinctly crisp herbal wine. With gooseberry and aromatic green fruit, the wine is light while packed with acidity and lively fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Joël Delaunay 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: The wine comes from vineyards on the plateau above the village of Vouvray. It is a ripe, lemon and honey-flavored wine with balanced acidity that creates a clean, crisp, perfumed and fruity aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Clos Chapon 2016  Vouvray

description: This is a rich, aromatic and deliciously herbal wine full of structured black fruits and dense tannins that promise aging. Blackberry and plum flavors dominate, giving freshness and ripeness to this full wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2012 Cuvée G Red (Bandol)

description: Drouhin has significant holdings in a number of top Chambolle vineyards. This wine is a blend from other Premier Crus in the same village. It has the typical generous character along with a more serious structured backbone that gives a dry and solid density that's worth aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012 Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: With the right intensity for a premier cru, this is a rich, lightly toasty wine. It has layers of chalky, mineral texture along with dense fruits and a sense of structure and potential. Drink from 2017.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012 Domaine Drouhin-Vaudon Sécher Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: The Merlot gives richness, with sweet fruit and a good core of appetizing tannins, freshened with acidity.
title: Château Nenin 2007 Fugue de Nenin  (Pomerol)

description: A densely tannic wine, from organic grapes, that is dominated by wood and a very dry texture. The fruit under this is cool, slightly green, with acidity. The wine needs another year's aging.
title: Château de Lagarde 2007 L de Lagarde  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: An unusual blend of 80% Clairette and 20% Bourboulenc, this medium-bodied wine is crisp and citrusy, marked by pineapple and hints of underripe peach and pear. It's light enough to be paired with more delicate seafood dishes over the summer months.
title: Bourgeois Family 2008 In Fine White (Côtes-du-Ventoux)

description: An unusual blend of 80% Clairette and 20% Bourboulenc, this medium-bodied wine is crisp and citrusy, marked by pineapple and hints of underripe peach and pear. It's light enough to be paired with more delicate seafood dishes over the summer months.
title: Bourgeois Family 2008 In Fine White (Côtes-du-Ventoux)

description: Olive and espresso notes are backed by bright cherry fruit in this medium-bodied Syrah. It's a pleasant quaff that turns slightly dry on the finish; try it after 2011.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2005 Le Grand Pompée  (Saint-Joseph)

description: This is a fresh, medium-bodied white with a touch of honeysuckle on the nose and straightforward flavors that hints of orange and peach. A touch of spice adds interest to the modest finish. Drink now.
title: Château de Beaucastel 2006 Coudoulet de Beaucastel White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: While Colombo's Les Abeilles is a more traditional Rhône blend, this offering marries 70% Viognier with 30% Roussanne. The result is a medium-bodied wine hinting at honeyed peaches and tinged with anise that seems to be on a fast-developing course. Drink it over the next several months.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2008 La Redonne White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Light, bright and fruity, this has soft tannins, plenty of red fruits and balancing acidity. Just dry to finish, it is ready to drink now.
title: Domaines Devillard 2010 Le Renard  (Givry)

description: A typically soft wine, with attractive fruit, bright acidity and a touch of almond. The almond note, with a hint of bitterness, has the last word.
title: Joseph Cattin 2010 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A fruity, lemon-scented wine, this is attractively crisp, with the bright acidity of the vintage. Drinkable now, or age for a year.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2010  Bourgogne

description: With strong wood flavors giving structure to this otherwise fruity wine, this is a work in progress. It has delicious juicy peach and melon fruit, a full and rounded character and tight, refreshing final acidity. But wait until 2016 for the wine to be ready.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2012 En Remilly Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: Soft and fruity, this accessible Champagne has an attractive tang of lemon zest acidity that lifts the ripe apple flavors. The balance between softness and a crisp texture is just right. Lively and ready to drink.
title: Moët & Chandon NV Impérial Brut  (Champagne)

description: Made from Pinot Blanc, allowed although rarely seen in Champagne, this is a crisp, stylish wine that has some bottle age. Baked apple and lemon flavors accompany tight acidity. The aftertaste is crisp and dry.
title: Dautel-Cadot NV Cuvée Elégance Brut Pinot Blanc (Champagne)

description: Nearly a year in bottle after disgorgement has given this a toasty character. The acidity and the citrus fruits are still there, but they have been seamlessly integrated into the mature flavors. It's a light style, delicate and elegant.
title: Bruno Paillard NV Première Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: A ripe wine, this is full in the mouth and full of fruit. Apricots and lemons go well together for a rich while crisp mouthful. The wood aging over 18 months only shows fleetingly, leaving fruit as the main thrust. It finishes with plenty of fresh acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012  Meursault

description: A ripe and full-bodied wine, this has good depth of flavor from its lees and wood aging. A creamy texture comes along with a tangy cool fruitiness that has lemon and bitter orange flavors. It could be drunk now, but with its still crisp acidity, it will be better from the end of 2015.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: Retaining a good sense of structure, this is also a relatively light and fresh Gevrey-Chambertin. It has plenty of raspberry and red plum flavors and lively acidity at the end. Drink from 2015.
title: Manuel Olivier 2011  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: Retaining a good sense of structure, this is also a relatively light and fresh Gevrey-Chambertin. It has plenty of raspberry and red plum flavors and lively acidity at the end. Drink from 2015.
title: Manuel Olivier 2011  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: Simple, fruity wine, crisp, clean, laden with red fruits and touched by vanilla. The wine is light, fragrant and totally ready to drink.
title: Gassier 2012 Sables d'Azur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rich, sweet and soft, with a strawberry jam character, and just the right balance of acidity.
title: Alex Gambal 2009 Bourgogne Pinot Noir  (Bourgogne)

description: Rich, sweet and soft, with a strawberry jam character, and just the right balance of acidity.
title: Alex Gambal 2009 Bourgogne Pinot Noir  (Bourgogne)

description: A simple, fruity Chardonnay, ripe with pear flavors and a lacing of lime. It is round, warm, soft, ready to drink in a few months.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2010 Les Murelles  (Bourgogne)

description: A simple, fruity Chardonnay, ripe with pear flavors and a lacing of lime. It is round, warm, soft, ready to drink in a few months.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2010 Les Murelles  (Bourgogne)

description: Made solely from old-vine Grenache, this stands out as a horse of a different color in a flight of traditional Châteauneuf-du-Papes. It does boast a lovely suppleness and silky texture, but the aromas and flavors are strange—a sort of medicinal cherry meets boiled vegetables.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2008 Cuvée Spéciale Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: A medium-bodied, easy-drinking Côtes du Rhône, with modestly concentrated cherry fruit and some earthy elements. Drink now.
title: Père Anselme 2009 La Grivelière Tete de Cuvee Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Produced from young vines at Château Phélan-Ségur, this is a rich, spicy and open wine. It is bursting with fruitiness, packed with blackberries and with a rounded texture. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2011 La Croix Bonis  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: A year's barrel aging has given this firm and very rich wine a spicy character. That marries with the licorice and bitter chocolate to give a ripe, extracted and dense wine. It needs a few years to bring out more of the juicy plum fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Manon la Lagune 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A year's barrel aging has given this firm and very rich wine a spicy character. That marries with the licorice and bitter chocolate to give a ripe, extracted and dense wine. It needs a few years to bring out more of the juicy plum fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Manon la Lagune 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This rich and rounded wine comes from the flat lands of Saint-Émilion, giving it a soft and gentle feel. Acidity and ripe black fruits dominate the light structure. It's a wine for medium-term aging, ripe and ready to drink from 2016.
title: Château Jacques Noir 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This is a crisp and inviting sparkling wine, with bright notes of citrus and apple that are accented by hints of toast. An approachable and wallet-friendly quaff, perfect for holiday entertaining.
title: Saint-Hilaire 2011 Brut Estate Bottled Sparkling (Blanquette de Limoux)

description: This soft, ripe Pinot Noir manages to balance the fragrant red fruits with a gentle massage of wood aging. A firm layer of tannins gives structure and it is ready to drink.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Trois Châteaux Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The wine is all fruit initially and then the firmer tannins kick in. It has a strongly tannic core that leaves the wine dry and tough after 12 months in barrel. The fruit weight should broaden the wine out, giving black fruitiness in the future. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Roquevieille 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Spicy wood gives this wine a smooth character. It also adds lift, allowing the rich black fruits to speak out. Acidity is well integrated into the tannins and balanced character of the wine. It's one of seven Bordeaux properties in the Yung family since 1962. Drink from 2016.
title: Château les Hauts de Palette 2012  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Structured and balanced, this wine has great fruits that go with the tannins and rich texture. There is an unusually low amount of Merlot (60%) with 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Cabernet Franc for the area, yet there is a strongly juicy feel to the wine that gives a generous side. It is developing well; drink from 2016.
title: Château Godard Bellevue 2012  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Structured and balanced, this wine has great fruits that go with the tannins and rich texture. There is an unusually low amount of Merlot (60%) with 25% Cabernet Sauvignon and 15% Cabernet Franc for the area, yet there is a strongly juicy feel to the wine that gives a generous side. It is developing well; drink from 2016.
title: Château Godard Bellevue 2012  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Dark tannins dominate in this wine that has an austere side. The fruit under this dark structure is full of juicy black fruit flavors. The combination of the powerful texture and the ripe fruit has produced one of the best vintages from this chateau for many years. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Trottevieille 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Dark, dense and packed with wood flavors, the wine is hard at this stage. But it is also laden with fruits to give a dramatically powerful potential for this second wine. Blackberry fruits go with the smoky flavors and promise a fresh view as the wine ages. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Margaux 2011 Pavillon Rouge de Margaux  (Margaux)

description: This is a new wine from these enterprising négociants. Fruity, crisp and light, it has a tangy orange zest texture that gives extra brightness. Very fresh and ready to drink.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Smooth, caramel aromas and flavors give this wine a soft character. It is rich and rounded, missing some freshness but making up for it with the ripe, yellow fruits and generous texture. Drink this wine now.
title: Domaine Sophie Cinier 2013 A la Côte  (Saint-Véran)

description: This wine is ripe, textured with an attractive touch of oxidation giving richness and concentration. Good acidity at the same time is balanced with quince and a touch of spice.
title: Domaine Pinson 2013  Chablis

description: This wine is ripe, textured with an attractive touch of oxidation giving richness and concentration. Good acidity at the same time is balanced with quince and a touch of spice.
title: Domaine Pinson 2013  Chablis

description: Tight and structured, this mineral, nervy wine tastes of stony vineyards and tenacious grapes. It is cool in character, with lemon and green stone-fruit flavors that leave a crisp impression. Drink from 2017.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2013  Saint-Véran

description: Dry and crisp, this is a delicious rosé that has both ripe fruit and a tight line of acidity. Its red fruits are laced with fresh citrus character and an underlying touch of toast. This is a bottling that can improve with age, but is great now.
title: Lanson NV Rose Label Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Vert de l'Or is a play on words for Verdelho, grown in Anjou since 1810. It is a richly textured wine, ripe with apple, but with a spicy, steely character. Black currants linger in the background of this dry, fragrant wine. Screwcap.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2012 Vert de l'Or Verdelho (Vin de Table Francais)

description: Vert de l'Or is a play on words for Verdelho, grown in Anjou since 1810. It is a richly textured wine, ripe with apple, but with a spicy, steely character. Black currants linger in the background of this dry, fragrant wine. Screwcap.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2012 Vert de l'Or Verdelho (Vin de Table Francais)

description: A special cuvée of Château Siaurac, this is dark, dense, seriously young at this stage, but destined for a powerful, rich, black fruit and tannin future. It has weight and concentration, layered with new wood and acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Siaurac 2011 Baronne de Siaurac  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Initially austere in the mouth, this is a serious and complex wine. It has firm tannins, layers of blackberry fruits and acidity along with a strong feeling of wood aging. Powerful and with good depth, it's a wine that needs age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château les Roches de Ferrand 2010  Fronsac

description: Initially austere in the mouth, this is a serious and complex wine. It has firm tannins, layers of blackberry fruits and acidity along with a strong feeling of wood aging. Powerful and with good depth, it's a wine that needs age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château les Roches de Ferrand 2010  Fronsac

description: A rich and bold wine, structured and concentrated. This is packed with black plum fruits, ripe damsons and sweet tannins. There's a great juicy element, that brings in the acidity as well as some spice from wood aging.
title: Château Haut-Francarney 2010 No 2 et No 5  (Fronsac)

description: Honeyed, tropical fruit aromas are showing strongly in this smooth, lightly toasty dry wine. Rich and rounded, it shows both the fresh fruit of the vintage and also the concentration of the white wines. It should be aged, but can be drunk now. Drink until 2020.
title: Château de la Brède 2011 Cuvée Montesquieu  (Graves)

description: This Jadot is a combo of long-term contract vineyards and its Régnié Cru, demonstrating that knowing the terroir makes a difference. The blend shows well in this rich, full wine. It reveals ripeness—round and full of strawberry flavors from the 100% Gamay, with a tight layer of mineral acidity at the end.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Although not labelled as a Blanc de Blancs, this pure Chardonnay wine is exactly that. It is a floral wine with roundness that comes from the wood vinification. Crisp citrus and green apples push the wine forward along with the acidity and fresh, mineral aftertaste.
title: Jeeper NV Brut Grand Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Soutiran regards this as its hallmark wine—its signature. It reveals the producer's preference for drier styles of Champagne, bringing out crisp fruitiness. It is packed with apple and orange zest flavors that are young although ready to drink.
title: Soutiran NV Signature Brut Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: The wine is only just off dry, giving a wine that is deliciously crisp and fruity. Ripe apple and creamed pear flavors are lifted by balanced acidity. The fruitiness and the just off-dry character make this a wine that would be just as good as an apéritif as with food.
title: Louis Roederer NV Carte Blanche Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: With 60% of the Chardonnay in this wine coming from the vineyards of the Montagne de Reims, it is no surprise that it is rich and full in the mouth. The wine has weight along with a crisp minerality. Taut and tense, the aftertaste suggests that the wine will improve in bottle for a few months.
title: Lallier NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Red and yellow apples are the fruity markers of this crémant—their fruity flavor pervades the light-footed palate that fizzes with gentle froth. There is a bitter edge on the palate but also some autolytic, yeasty backbone, lending a bit more substance. Have this full-fruited yet light-bodied sparkler with food and it will come into its own.
title: Domaine Zinck NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Aged four years before disgorgement, this ripe and generously soft wine has both mature toasty flavors and great acidity. Rich in apricot as well as white fruit flavors, it is well balanced, with layers of acidity smoothed by the yeasty aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Collet NV Brut Art Deco  (Champagne)

description: A blend of 50-50 Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this is a rich wine from Grand Cru vineyards on the Montagne de Reims. It also structured, with a strongly mineral texture that is tight and concentrated. The wine, with its light tannins from the red wine in the blend, is ready to drink.
title: Henriet-Bazin NV Grand Cru Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Produced from grapes from the island of Corsica, this soft, open Pinot Noir has some pleasing fresh berry fruits, hints of strawberries and soft tannins. Ready to drink now.
region: Vin de Pays de l'Ile de Beauté
title: Les Vins Skalli 2006 Robert Skalli South of France Pinot Noir (Vin de Pays de l'Ile de Beauté)

description: Produced from grapes from the island of Corsica, this soft, open Pinot Noir has some pleasing fresh berry fruits, hints of strawberries and soft tannins. Ready to drink now.
region: Vin de Pays de l'Ile de Beauté
title: Les Vins Skalli 2006 Robert Skalli South of France Pinot Noir (Vin de Pays de l'Ile de Beauté)

description: This is described as a natural wine with zero sulphite. It has a perfumed character with an earthy edge that comes from the carbonic maceration (whole bunch fermentation). With cherry fruits and bright acidity, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Javernand 2014 Indigène  (Chiroubles)

description: Smoky aromas introduce a wine that is structured and concentrated, with intense fruit and acidity. Firm tannins, a subtle touch of wood and fine richness all combine mellifluously.
title: Alex Gambal 2009 Vieilles Vignes  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Pure, generous, red cherry fruit scintillates over a structured wine that has dense tannins and texture. The whole is pierced with the dominant acidity of 2008.
title: Domaine Bertagna 2008 Les Beaux-Monts  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: For a Gevrey, this wine emphasizes softness rather than structure. It does have good depth of flavor and is full of acidity and red berry fruits. The wine offers pleasure now, while having medium-term aging potential.
title: Camille Giroud 2008 Les Crais  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: For a Gevrey, this wine emphasizes softness rather than structure. It does have good depth of flavor and is full of acidity and red berry fruits. The wine offers pleasure now, while having medium-term aging potential.
title: Camille Giroud 2008 Les Crais  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Smooth and textured, this wine is rich, floral, perfumed and full of ripe yellow and crisper green fruits. With a fine tang and shot of acidity, it is developing well, but needs more time. Drink from 2017.
title: Hubert Veneau 2014 Domaine les Froids  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Smooth and textured, this wine is rich, floral, perfumed and full of ripe yellow and crisper green fruits. With a fine tang and shot of acidity, it is developing well, but needs more time. Drink from 2017.
title: Hubert Veneau 2014 Domaine les Froids  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: With dusty white flower aromas, this is a perfumed wine with a tight texture and fruit. Still too young to drink, it does have a lively, fresh character that comes from the bright green fruits. As it softens, it will be better balanced, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Jean-Pierre Vacher et Fils 2014  Sancerre

description: This wine is produced from the best parcels of the estate, located an hour east of the Atlantic Ocean. The result gives an intense, concentrated character with crisp, tight lemon and pink grapefruit flavors. Still developing, the texture is mineral and nervy. The wine will benefit from a bit more time in the bottle so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2014 Essentielle  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This wine is produced from the best parcels of the estate, located an hour east of the Atlantic Ocean. The result gives an intense, concentrated character with crisp, tight lemon and pink grapefruit flavors. Still developing, the texture is mineral and nervy. The wine will benefit from a bit more time in the bottle so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2014 Essentielle  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A great swathe of red fruits gives this wine a full while fresh character. It has totally refreshing acidity, a burst of life and crispness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Grandes Perrières 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Dominated by Sauvignon Blanc, this wine has a still young, crisp, tight character. As it ages, the yellow fruits and ripe plum flavors will come through, balancing the acidity and giving a ripe, full and generous wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château les Clauzots 2014  Graves

description: A blend of Mauzac and Loin de l'Oeil, commonly found in Gaillac, this bright, fruity and herbaceous wine is crisp and citrus-driven. A strong mineral edge to the texture adds bite to the aftertaste. Drink from 2015.
title: Château la Colombière 2014 Les Jacquaires White (Vin de France)

description: Touched with spicy wood, this is a classic smoky wine from Cabernet Franc, ripe while still held in tension by the acidity and dry tannins. It's dry with red plum and black currant freshness. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Brézé 2012 Clos Mazurique  (Saumur)

description: This ripe wine is firm, with a core of dry tannins. Over this are delicious, juicy red-berry fruit flavors and acidity. The wine is still softening out, with fruit coming forward. It will be ready to drink from 2017. The property has been in the family for six generations; Robert Filliatreau is the current owner. Wine is vinified by Châteaux Solidaires co-operative.
title: Château Beaumont les Pierrières 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Very fresh and crisp, this is a wine to drink soon. It has great acidity, bright and lively with green fruit flavors and some mandarin zest to give softness at the end.
title: Château du Claouset 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A ripe, red-fruited wine with a rich character, this offers vanilla as well as citrus and berry fruit flavors. It is just off dry, fresh and brightly fruity. It makes for a delicious, crisp summer rosé.
title: Château de Sours 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a crisp, intensely fruity wine. Full of red berries and fresh acidity, it is dry with a tangy orange-peel character, light minerality and a touch of caramel. It is ready to drink.
title: Château de Sours 2014 La Fleur d'Amélie Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a crisp, intensely fruity wine. Full of red berries and fresh acidity, it is dry with a tangy orange-peel character, light minerality and a touch of caramel. It is ready to drink.
title: Château de Sours 2014 La Fleur d'Amélie Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Firmly tannic, this is still a young wine. It has a dry structure with a black currant-skin stalkiness. Acidity and structure are still developing, so wait until 2016.
title: Château de Piote 2010  Bordeaux

description: This is a heavily wood-aged wine with a bitter character redeemed by the ripe blackberry fruits from a blend of 65% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Cabernet Franc. It is structured, with firm tannins over the fresh and juicy fruitiness. Give the wine another year and the two will come into balance. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Bordes-Quancard 2012  Bordeaux

description: With no oak aging, this wine offers black currants and stalky tannins. Juicy fruitiness and a ripe character reflect the vintage. The aftertaste, with acidity, is fresh and always fruity. Drink from 2016.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2014 Château Campot Lafont  (Bordeaux)

description: Bright pink in color, this rosé is full in the mouth with red berry flavors and intense acidity. A touch of bitterness gives a sharp aftertaste.
title: Jean Josselin NV Audace Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: With a sense of tannic structure and a dry background, this is a firm wine. It has some weight, although the texture and the black currant fruits are light and stylish rather than dense. Drink from 2016.
title: Château les Ancres 2011  Bordeaux

description: Smoky and obviously wood-aged, this toasty, spicy wine has extracted black-coffee flavors that mask the black currant fruits. That leaves a wine that seems austere and with a bitter aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château la Roque de By 2011  Médoc

description: Smoky and obviously wood-aged, this toasty, spicy wine has extracted black-coffee flavors that mask the black currant fruits. That leaves a wine that seems austere and with a bitter aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château la Roque de By 2011  Médoc

description: This wine has some bitter extraction giving it a hard edge. The fruit is lost in the dry, tannic structure. That hard edge will be tough to shift. Try drinking from 2017.
title: Château Garreau 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This soft, ripe wine by the Blaye sister-brother team of Marie-Pierre et Pierre-Charles Dartier has caramel flavors integrated into the red fruits. A crisp side comes from red currant flavors, while a smooth aftertaste keeps it rich while not losing the acidity.
title: Château Cailleteau Bergeron 2014 Villa Cailleteau Bergeron Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Bright, lightly-smoked red currant and berry fruits dominate this juicy, fresh wine. A plum-skin texture leads on to some firm tannins. The aftertaste is fruity and light.
title: Cave de Rauzan 2014 Augey  (Bordeaux)

description: This blend of two-thirds Syrah and one-third Mourvèdre is fresh and aromatic, showing some peppery-gingery spice to go with watermelon and strawberry notes. It's medium in body, with an abbreviated finish.
region: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2013 Cape Bleue Rosé (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: This blend of two-thirds Syrah and one-third Mourvèdre is fresh and aromatic, showing some peppery-gingery spice to go with watermelon and strawberry notes. It's medium in body, with an abbreviated finish.
region: Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2013 Cape Bleue Rosé (Vin de Pays de la Méditerranée)

description: This delicious, fruity wine is full of acidity and crisp fruit. Light, bright and dominated by green and citrus fruits, it is ready to drink now.
title: Château Vircoulon 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This delicious, fruity wine is full of acidity and crisp fruit. Light, bright and dominated by green and citrus fruits, it is ready to drink now.
title: Château Vircoulon 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Pale orange-pink in color, this is fruity and light. It coveys a bright, fresh character that is both refreshing and very crisp. Drink now.
title: Château la France 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Pale orange-pink in color, this is fruity and light. It coveys a bright, fresh character that is both refreshing and very crisp. Drink now.
title: Château la France 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A solid, ripe wine, very much a nouveau for food, with some rich cherry fruit and an underlying smoky tannin layer. The fruit is ripe and full.
title: Mommessin 2011 Nouveau  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Soft and rounded wine, with rich peach and pineapple flavors. The wine is smooth, the wood aging adding a subtle touch of spice. The long, creamy aftertaste suggests a wine that is ready to drink.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2009  Montagny

description: A creamy wine, its apple fruit flavors smoothed by touches of butter and spice. There is a fine citrus aftertaste that gives the rich wine a delicious, refreshing lift.
title: Henri Perrusset 2010  Mâcon-Villages

description: This is a soft, open wine, full of ripe berry fruits and red cherries. There is only the lightest tannin, along with bright acidity, a wine that is so ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Sélection  (Brouilly)

description: This is a soft, open wine, full of ripe berry fruits and red cherries. There is only the lightest tannin, along with bright acidity, a wine that is so ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Sélection  (Brouilly)

description: Packed with juicy red cherries, this is a fresh, fruity Beaujolais to drink this winter. There is just a touch of tannin as well as refreshing acidity.
title: Domaine Pral 2009 Cuvée Terroir  (Beaujolais)

description: Fixin, the northernmost red wines on the Côte de Nuits, generally produces light wines. This is no exception; the wine is bright, very fresh, with hints of berry fruits.
title: Derey Frères 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Fixin)

description: A wine that relishes its juicy fruit and acidity. The tannins, by contrast, are light. Close to Macau, south of Margaux, Gironville is in a fresh, black currant-fruit style, not for aging.
title: Château de Gironville 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: Ripe and also tannic, this is structured wine, its berry fruits pushing through a dry plum skin texture. It is solid and chunky while remaining fresh and fruity.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Château des Vierres  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Packed with strawberry aromas and red berry fruits, this is a ripe, fruit-forward wine only lightly disturbed by tannins. There is a great juicy quality here.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Château des Bachelards  (Fleurie)

description: A very herbaceous Sauvignon aroma, crisp and fresh with pink grapefruit and lemon grass flavors on top of a bright squeeze of lime. There is a final touch of pear juice acidity.
title: Château La Rose du Pin 2009  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This is a harmonious mix of firm, extracted tannins and dense fruit. It has a dark, hard edge at this youthful stage, suggesting this is always going to be a wine that is tough. At the same time, it has weight and richness to support the structure.
title: Château Puygueraud 2010  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a soft wine, dense and ripe. Any tannins are covered by sweet blackberry fruit flavors. This has attractive spice, final juiciness and bright acidity. A wine for early drinking.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2010 Le Petit Mouton  (Pauillac)

description: There is tough concentration here that suggests a wine that needs aging; there's also fruit that hints at richness to come. A wine that has a good future.
title: Château Monbadon 2010  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A packed wine, its ripe fruits are a warm pleasure. It has all the structure of the year but in fine measure, lending density and richness to the palate. It's a wine for aging; give it at least five years.
title: Château Gauthier 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A packed wine, its ripe fruits are a warm pleasure. It has all the structure of the year but in fine measure, lending density and richness to the palate. It's a wine for aging; give it at least five years.
title: Château Gauthier 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A little earthiness on the nose blows off to reveal a very concentrated and sweepingly apple-flavored palate which pitches generous, ripe fruit against welcome, tart freshness. This is open and and very joyous, fresh and utterly fruit-driven with a lasting, very moreish finish.
title: Emile Beyer 2014 Eichberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Structured and firm with balancing red berry fruit, this is a solid, chunky wine that reflects the concentration of the vintage. It has weight, solid tannins and hints of pepper and spice. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Château Tertre de Viaud 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: With soft tannins, this wine has a full, fleshy character that's laced with acidity. Black currant fruits and only hints of dryness suggest it is ready to drink.
title: Château du Prieur 2010 Cuvée Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: With soft tannins, this wine has a full, fleshy character that's laced with acidity. Black currant fruits and only hints of dryness suggest it is ready to drink.
title: Château du Prieur 2010 Cuvée Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: This is an attractive pink-colored wine, with soft crushed strawberry fruit flavors. The acidity is light, giving preference to the fruit and ripe flavor. The aftertaste veers on the sweet side, but it's well balanced.
title: Duval-Leroy NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A soft and rounded style of Champagne, this leans toward the pineapple and baked apple flavor spectrum. At the same time, it has a pure streak of acidity, finishing with a crisp, tight note.
title: Veuve Doussot NV Tradition Brut  (Champagne)

description: A blend of wines from different vineyards in Pouilly, this powerful wine is concentrated, with tight minerality that demands further aging. Rich and packed with apples and green plums, it is a beautiful wine that will age well. Drink from 2018 at the earliest.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Indigène  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Coming from arguably the grandest of the Chablis Grand Crus, this is an impressive, rich and structured wine. It is concentrated, intense with minerality, pure acidity and great fruitiness. The wine has depth and power, a ripe wine that captures the full strength of the fine vineyard. Drink from 2020.
designation: Les Vieilles Vignes Les Clos Grand Cru
title: Pascal Bouchard 2014 Les Vieilles Vignes Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: The wine comes from a small strip of a half acre in the center of this famed grand cru, part of the Olivier Leflaive family domaine. It is laden with toast flavors from the wood fermentation as well as intense fruit, green plums and crisp apples which are given extra richness by apricots. Concentrated and densely textured the wine will develop so well. Drink from 2022.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Chevalier-Montrachet

description: Produced from two parcels totaling 2.8 acres, this is a properly powerful wine. It has a concentrated texture and firm tannins. They are balanced with the black fruits and strongly mineral texture of this impressive wine. Like any wine of this quality, this needs to age for a considerable period. Drink from 2024.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Domaine des Perdrix  (Echézeaux)

description: Properly rich and majestic, this wine also has impressive amounts of crisp acidity to balance its concentration. The wine has layers of peach and apricot along with beautiful acidity and a taut texture that will allow it to age. It is generous and will become opulent and full bodied as it develops. Drink this powerful wine from 2022.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This Grand Cru is the smallest in the village of Morey Saint-Denis, located north of the village. This wine, produced from a tiny parcel, is immensely concentrated while also having the generous fruits that are typical of the village. It is full of juicy black fruits, fine tannins and a dark, firm aftertaste. Drink from 2023.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Clos Saint-Denis

description: Produced from less than half an acre of the Grand Cru vineyard, the wine has power and dark concentration. It is a rich wine with black fruit and solid tannins that promise long-term aging. The wood aging has given the wine an even richer character, bringing out spice and licorice flavors. The wine should not be drunk before 2023.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Echézeaux

description: Produced from biodynamically grown grapes (as are all the Olivier Leflaive family grand and premier crus), this is a gorgeous, opulent wine. It has richness and great intensity as well as fine acidity and crisp apple fruits. Toast and vanilla come from the wood aging. The wine is so generous and packed with fruit as well as a strong mineral texture. Drink from 2022.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: Produced from biodynamically grown grapes (as are all the Olivier Leflaive family grand and premier crus), this is a gorgeous, opulent wine. It has richness and great intensity as well as fine acidity and crisp apple fruits. Toast and vanilla come from the wood aging. The wine is so generous and packed with fruit as well as a strong mineral texture. Drink from 2022.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: Named after the ruined abbey which the vineyard surrounds, this is a smooth, generous and beautifully opulent wine. The vines, owned by the Leflaive family, give a bold, spicy wine, rich in white stone fruits, intense acidity and a firm mineral texture. There is just enough toasty flavor to give the wine extra complexity. Drink this impressive wine from 2021.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014 Abbaye de Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: While the color of this wine is light, the intensity and the structure are not. It comes from 30-year-old vines, planted densely that gives the wine huge concentration. It is firm full of tannins that lie over the ripe fruit. As it develops, this wine will be sumptuous, ripe and impressive. Wait until 2023.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Corton

description: The match for the red wine under the same name, this wine comes from organically grown vines in the village of Champtin. It is rich, full of white currant as well as crisp apple. The tight texture and intense minerality mark it out as a wine to age, while its elegance underlines its fine future. Drink from 2018.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Sauvage  (Sancerre)

description: The match for the red wine under the same name, this wine comes from organically grown vines in the village of Champtin. It is rich, full of white currant as well as crisp apple. The tight texture and intense minerality mark it out as a wine to age, while its elegance underlines its fine future. Drink from 2018.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Sauvage  (Sancerre)

description: Produced from a parcel of less than a third of an acre, this wine comes from 30-year-old vines. It is properly dark and dense, with great tannins and rich black fruits. The 18 months in wood show in the spice and the complex texture. This serious wine will age for many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Charmes-Chambertin

description: Produced from a parcel of less than a third of an acre, this wine comes from 30-year-old vines. It is properly dark and dense, with great tannins and rich black fruits. The 18 months in wood show in the spice and the complex texture. This serious wine will age for many years. Drink from 2024.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Charmes-Chambertin

description: This wine comes from the vineyard that sits at the pinnacle of Chardonnay in Burgundy. It is majestic and opulent, a powerful wine full of deeply concentrated fruit as well as the ineffable acidity of the vintage. It is structured, tensely mineral and demands long aging. Drink this beautiful wine from 2023.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2014  Montrachet

description: In this warm and ripe effort, the flavors of red currants and plums work with the underlying tannins and acidity. This has just the right weight, making for a wine that has attractive fruitiness and light tannins.
title: Château Roquefort 2009  Bordeaux

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is balanced, with tannins and red fruits in harmony. It has weight and richness without being overpowerful. Ready to drink in six months.
title: Château Montlau 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Rich and fruity, this wine is balanced, with tannins and red fruits in harmony. It has weight and richness without being overpowerful. Ready to drink in six months.
title: Château Montlau 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Dark and brooding, this is characterized by a plum skin note, plus firm tannins and a solid structure. It's concentrated and dense, a wine that is serious and needs to age for 4–5 years. The finish has a firm feel.
title: Château Montet 2009 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This mineral-driven and white-currant-flavored wine shows as much texture as fruitiness. In the future, it will show ripe yellow and pear notes, so age for a year.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2011  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Powerful and rich, this wine tastes of black and red berries. The ripeness of the vintage is evident, with a dense character that lends weight and concentration, while adding fresh black-currant-like acidity.
title: Château La Maroutine 2009  Bordeaux

description: Crisp, clean and fruity, this refreshing wine has an herb note that's restrained by ripe orange and green apple flavors. Bright and ready to drink.
title: Château de Fontenille 2011  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This is a dark, concentrated effort that shows its wood strongly. The tannins are firm and almost heavy, producing a wine that is intensely dry and will need many years to age.
title: Château Cissac 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: For such a young wine, this is surprisingly mature. Its tannins have softened and rounded, becoming well integrated with the black currant flavor and bright acidity. It's an attractive choice to drink now or over the next few years, but not for long-term aging.
title: Château Bel Enclos 2010 Cuvée Evidence  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Bitter tannins and heavy toast influence suggest a wine that has been heavily extracted. Rich and sweet-tasting, it has power and a solid, tannic presence.
title: Château Barde Haut 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Fresh and fruity with creamy green and white fruits, this is a soft, ready to drink Chardonnay. Attractively fruity, the acidity finely cuts through the wine.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2011 Bourricot Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: Notes of crushed leaves, leather and tobacco leaves on the overt nose indicate the first signs of evolution, with aromas of mulberry, black cherry and black raspberry also evident. Full bodied with balanced alcohol and lightly dusty tannins, the wine overcompensates in structure with its lightly tart acidity. Already evolving, this will drink now and up to 2–3 years longer.
title: G. Moulinier 2007 Les Sigillaires Red (Saint-Chinian)

description: This is a pleasantly quaffable Viognier, with restrained apricot and melon aromas and flavors. It's medium bodied, without much texture, but a clean, refreshing finish.
region: Vin de Pays des Portes de Méditerranée
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2009 Secret de Famille Viognier (Vin de Pays des Portes de Méditerranée)

description: This is tastes stalky, with a red fruit flavor. It has acidity along with a vegetal, herbal character. With taut acidity and a dry, tannic finish, this is a real barbecue wine.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2010 Cuvée Spéciale Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Tight and fruity, this is a crisp wine with considerable acidity. It has a fresh, crisp background, cut with a mineral texture and a stony, steely character. This wine, with its structure, needs to age; drink from 2017.
title: Jacques Simonin 2013 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Smooth, creamy and round, this ripe wine features appealing spice, toast and delicious fruitiness. It has an attractive layer of tannin along with firm minerality, adding structure, hints of wood and a finely textured character. Bright and fruity at the end, it will be ready from 2016.
title: Henri de Villamont 2013 Premier Cru  (Montagny)

description: Round and ripe, full of yellow fruits as well as crisp pear flavors, this wine has density as well as lively acidity. A strong line of minerality keeps the wine on a straight line of fragrant acidity and great freshness. Drink from 2016.
title: Henri de Villamont 2013 Clos du Cromin  (Meursault)

description: This wine is full in the mouth, with swathes of ripe apricot and mango fruit flavors. It has weight, a touch of spice and great acidity that emphasizes the general richness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Michel 2013  Viré-Clessé

description: Crisp, textured and with great acidity, this wine is still developing. It is packed with fresh citrus and apple fruits cut with strong minerality. Drink this structured wine from 2017.
title: Domaine de la Croix Senaillet 2014  Saint-Véran

description: In this ripe wine, yellow fruits, cinnamon and ripe herbs are melded into a harmonious whole. Great acidity offers a juicy core to this well-balanced wine. Drink now for its great refreshing character.
title: Christophe Cordier 2013 Clos du Four  (Mâcon-Milly Lamartine)

description: A perfumed wine, this is full of black fruits that are shot through with acidity. It is bright, soft and only hinting at tannins. This second wine of Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande will develop quickly and become an attractive, fruity wine from 2018.
title: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2013 Réserve de la Comtesse  (Pauillac)
winery: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande

description: Rich and ripe, this wine full of blackberry fruits and balanced tannins has improved since it was reviewed from barrel. It has good concentration for the vintage, dominated by black fruit that offers good acidity at the end. Drink from 2022. Olivier is a large medieval hunting estate that has belonged to the Bethmann family since the 19th century.
title: Château Olivier 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Named Espérance (hope) by the South African owner, the château has produced a firm, structured wine from this exceptional vintage. It is still young, full of black-currant fruit and fresh acidity that contrast with the dark tannins that extend throughout the wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château l'Espérance 2010 Espérance  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The second wine of Château du Tertre, this is produced by the winemaking team of the associated Château Giscours. It delivers the same elegance and sophistication with a more approachable fruitiness. Generous red and blackberry fruits are accompanied by concentration and some firm, smoky tannins. Drink this wine from 2017.
title: Château du Tertre 2012 Les Hauts du Tertre  (Margaux)

description: The second wine of Château du Tertre, this is produced by the winemaking team of the associated Château Giscours. It delivers the same elegance and sophistication with a more approachable fruitiness. Generous red and blackberry fruits are accompanied by concentration and some firm, smoky tannins. Drink this wine from 2017.
title: Château du Tertre 2012 Les Hauts du Tertre  (Margaux)

description: Baked apple aromas lead to a palate that has ripe fruit, and caramel over acidity. The wine is perfumed, full, with suggestions of some oxidation.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte NV Blue Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fresh, crisp wine, full of raspberry and red currant fruits, benefiting from a firm presence of acidity, a light touch of caramel and spice. A proper summer rosé.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2008 Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Relatively lightweight, showing freshness rather than density, this is a fruity, red currant- and red plum-flavored wine that is lifted by a good use of wood aging, spice, and enclosed by vibrant acidity.
title: Château Roquetaillade la Grange 2007  Graves

description: This delicious wine, on the dry side of brut, is fresh and fruity while also finely textured. Initially, it seems light and then more complex minerality and steely acidity come through to give a structure that promises aging. Drink this impressive wine from 2017.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2008 O' de Mailly Milésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: This delicious wine, on the dry side of brut, is fresh and fruity while also finely textured. Initially, it seems light and then more complex minerality and steely acidity come through to give a structure that promises aging. Drink this impressive wine from 2017.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2008 O' de Mailly Milésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: Rich and structured, this complex wine comes from grand cru vines on the northern slopes of the Montagne de Reims. It is tense as well as packed with ripe apple and pineapple fruit flavors. The tension develops from a fine vintage that will allow it to age. Drink until 2022.
title: Henriet-Bazin 2008 Millésime Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Fresh yellow apple aromas broaden out into notes of ripe, baked apple. The palate is creamy and beautifully textured by autolysis and shows off rounded flavors of freshly baked shortcrust and pastry. The overall effect is one of poised freshness and harmonious balance. This is dry and taut but generous with ample substance that highlights both fruit and structure—all achieved without dosage and addition of sulfur dioxide.
title: Zusslin NV Brut Zero Sans Soufre Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a beautifully made wine from a great vintage. It is still young and very fresh, although its flavors are now deepening and filling out. Ripe apple, white fruits and a tangy edge of lime zest are balanced by a complex texture along with good acidity. Drink the wine now and until 2020.
title: Joseph Perrier 2004 Brut Vintage  (Champagne)

description: This vintage, disgorged in 2013, is now at its peak. It is well balanced between fresh fruit and secondary, toast and almond flavors. There is a tangy character and a tight mineral underlay to this well-made wine that is now ready to drink.
title: Nicolas Maillart 2007 Millésime Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a pale-colored wine with a finely wrought texture and great fruit. It is tight and mineral on the one hand, but balanced with the crispest red-currant flavors that offer a bright line in acidity. Delicious hints of age round out the final fresh aftertaste.
title: Charles Heidsieck 2006 Millésime Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a pale-colored wine with a finely wrought texture and great fruit. It is tight and mineral on the one hand, but balanced with the crispest red-currant flavors that offer a bright line in acidity. Delicious hints of age round out the final fresh aftertaste.
title: Charles Heidsieck 2006 Millésime Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Chalky, stony notes come to the forefront on this austere, restrained, non-dosed vintage crémant. The taut texture carries green apple and citrus tones, with a satisfying, savory soy sauce backdrop. This is poised and precise, fresh and refreshing, clean and structured—a testament to the nobility of Chardonnay.
title: Boeckel 2011 Extra Brut Chardonnay (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: With 60% Merlot in the blend, this wine is packed with red fruits and crisp acidity as well as richer fruitcake flavors. It has some structure as well as its red-berry flavors. It is ready to drink.
title: La Fleur Ribeyrolles 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: With 60% Merlot in the blend, this wine is packed with red fruits and crisp acidity as well as richer fruitcake flavors. It has some structure as well as its red-berry flavors. It is ready to drink.
title: La Fleur Ribeyrolles 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine showcases the fruit of the vintage—ripe black currants and plums with a juicy, generous character. It is full bodied and rich, with good structure plus acidity to give the right freshness. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Pichon Longueville 2013  Pauillac

description: Almost entirely Cabernet Sauvignon (98%), this structured and dense wine is packed with concentrated dark fruits that are firm, showing intense acidity and freshness under the dark tannins. It's classic Bordeaux, with fruit and tannins in equal measure and needing time. Drink from 2024.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2013  Pauillac

description: This wine is a success for the vintage with its ripe Cabernet flavors and dark, dense tannins. It is fruity certainly, with a juicy, perfumed background. However, the structure and texture show best—firm and dry, indicating a good potential. This concentrated wine will not be ready to drink before 2024.
title: Château Figeac 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Powered by its structure and texture, this complex wine is dense, structured and firm. Plenty of dry and taut tannins dominate at this stage, but it is also full of fruit. The wine will age over many years while not being one of those vintages that will mature forever: the fruitiness will see to that. Drink this impressive wine from 2025.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: This wine has a lot of class and elegance, along with firm tannins that show how well it will age. It is dark and concentrated, the black fruits still developing under the solid structure. This wine will age slowly, so wait until 2022.
title: Château Trotanoy 2013  Pomerol

description: Sophisticated and full of fruit, this wine combines the freshness of the year with great tension and structure. The juicy underlay will develop well over the next few years. It's complex and worth aging. Drink from 2024.
title: Vieux Château Mazerat 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Sophisticated and full of fruit, this wine combines the freshness of the year with great tension and structure. The juicy underlay will develop well over the next few years. It's complex and worth aging. Drink from 2024.
title: Vieux Château Mazerat 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Initially closed, this wine just hints at its richness and perfumed character. As it opens it shows still-young tannins and intense black plums and blueberries that will develop as the wine ages. It is likely to mature well over the medium to long term, and will not be ready to drink before 2022.
title: Le Dôme 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: For Bordeaux, this is a plump, cushioned wine that brings out rich fruit, chocolate sauce and ample spice. The structure is there, with tannins and a dry core, but it's the soft, generous fruit that is more prominent.
title: Château de Parenchère 2010 Cuvée Raphaël  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: For Bordeaux, this is a plump, cushioned wine that brings out rich fruit, chocolate sauce and ample spice. The structure is there, with tannins and a dry core, but it's the soft, generous fruit that is more prominent.
title: Château de Parenchère 2010 Cuvée Raphaël  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A rich, sweetly fruity wine, its ripe black plum fruit balanced by fine acidity and layered with wood. It is a solid and dense wine, firm and with great juiciness. Likely to age well for 4–5 years.
title: Jean-Michel Cazes 2011 Réserve  (Médoc)
