title: Aubry 2000 Ivoire & Ebène Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is dense, ripe and full of rich apricot and peach flavors, with a line of crisp lemon and a background of toast. Full in the mouth, this generous wine will be ready to drink from 2017. It comes Louis Max domaine vineyards in and around Mercurey.
title: Louis Max 2014 Les Rochelles  (Mercurey)

description: Named after the winemaker, Amélie Couillard, this soft, rounded wine is smooth with creamed apple flavors while also having a proper tangy of acidity. That tight and tangy edge makes the wine refreshing now while also allowing it to age for a few more months. Drink now or from late 2016.
title: Château de la Ragotiere 2014 Cuvée Amélie Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Named after the winemaker, Amélie Couillard, this soft, rounded wine is smooth with creamed apple flavors while also having a proper tangy of acidity. That tight and tangy edge makes the wine refreshing now while also allowing it to age for a few more months. Drink now or from late 2016.
title: Château de la Ragotiere 2014 Cuvée Amélie Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This blend of Bordeaux grapes with Syrah is rich and spicy. It is made to be drunk young, with touches of toast and a dense texture that brings out the perfumed character of Syrah balanced with Bordeaux structure. The wine is ready to drink, although it will be better from late 2016.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2014 La Croix d'Argon Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This dense and dark wine offers spice and toast flavors. It has a big, generous feel, leaving room both for the dry, still-young tannins and for aromatic blackberry fruits. It does need to age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Eugénie 2012 Tradition Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: A smooth wine, rich for the vintage, with black currant and bright fruits and a strong underlay of wood. The acidity, though, is quite striking, with the freshest fruit and tight tannins.
title: Château Ausone 2007 La Chapelle d'Ausone  (Saint-Émilion)

description: A smooth wine, rich for the vintage, with black currant and bright fruits and a strong underlay of wood. The acidity, though, is quite striking, with the freshest fruit and tight tannins.
title: Château Ausone 2007 La Chapelle d'Ausone  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The blended white from Beaucastel is every bit as enjoyable right now as the more expensive Vieilles Vignes bottling, offering more generous notes of honeyed oranges, a rich, weighty mouthfeel and a long, harmonious finish. Drink now.
title: Château de Beaucastel 2006 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Peachy and spicy, floral yet mineral, this clean, pure expression of Viognier fruit and Condrieu terroir is a delicious marriage. Drink now.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2008  Condrieu

description: This is the top cuvée from Pouilly-Fuissé's most famous estate. It is a big, round wine, its curves opulent and generous. There are yellow fruits, particularly apricots, and the wine is given some sinew by its acidity and by the light spice aftertaste.
title: Château de Fuissé 2006 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Big, ripe and juicy, this wears its rich black fruits right up front. A strong and firmly tannic structure serves as a background to the fruit. The wine is rich, complex and full of potential. Spice, ginger and nutmeg come through at the end along with the fruit. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Malartic-Lagravière 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Sumptuous, ripe and very full on the palate, this wine is dense and packed with notes of botrytis that give a strong sense of structure. This well-balanced wine shows potential to age, offering rich acacia honey and beautiful final acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Rayne Vigneau 2011  Sauternes

description: This marks an impressive step forward for this wine that's so often been in the shadows of other wines in the Lafite-Rothschild stable. It's dense and structured as well as deliciously fruity. The wine is straight down the line, starting with perfumed acidity and finishing with blackberry fruit. Intense and tannic, it's likely to age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2012  Pauillac

description: This marks an impressive step forward for this wine that's so often been in the shadows of other wines in the Lafite-Rothschild stable. It's dense and structured as well as deliciously fruity. The wine is straight down the line, starting with perfumed acidity and finishing with blackberry fruit. Intense and tannic, it's likely to age. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Duhart-Milon 2012  Pauillac

description: Now firmly in its new cellars, Clerc-Milon's wine is performing at the top of its form. This is a dense wine with juicy acidity as well as sweet tannins and ripe blackberry fruits. They give a ripe wine that is finely structured. The juicy aftertaste, typical of this vintage, is appealing although it does not detract from its power and longevity. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Clerc Milon 2012  Pauillac

description: Deliciously fresh, this off-dry wine emphasizes the apple flavors of Chenin, its lively acidity balancing the crisp fruit backed by a mineral character. This is likely to age but drinkable now.
title: Domaine Philippe Delesvaux 2006 Chenin Blanc (Coteaux du Layon Saint Aubin)

description: A tannic, structured wine, full of rich stone fruit flavors, with the acid hints of red berry fruits. It is fragrant and ripe with some depth and intensity.
title: Domaine du Clos du Fief 2006 Cuvée Tradition  (Juliénas)

description: This demi-sec (off dry) means there is some initial roundness that makes it more attractive young. But the underlying acidity and the green plum flavor, along with an edge of tannin, all suggest some aging ability. Drink now–2012.
title: Château Moncontour 2006 Demi-sec  (Vouvray)

description: An intense, rounded wine, with fresh pear and apple flavors that offer freshness but also richness. Dry, but gives a softer side of Chenin, attractive now, but worth aging for 2–3 years.
title: Château Moncontour 2006 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Smooth and spicy, this is an attractive, rounded and ripe wine. It has weight and richness from wood and black plum and currant fruits. The acidity is a fine counterpoint. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2011  Bordeaux

description: Smooth and spicy, this is an attractive, rounded and ripe wine. It has weight and richness from wood and black plum and currant fruits. The acidity is a fine counterpoint. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roquefort 2011  Bordeaux

description: This is a dense and rich wine full of black plum fruits, rich tannins and a dark structure. It has great potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Queyssard 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: With a medicinal hint, this is a wine that is all potential. At the moment, it is firm, dry and darkly tannic. The weight gives the promise, offering rich fruitiness in the future. Drink this impressive, concentrated wine from 2016.
title: Château La Croix Lartigue 2011  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is an open, juicy wine with attractive fruit framed by firm but tamed tannins. The wine has a feeling of lightness, with black currant flavors that are lifted and fresh. This is a wine for medium-term aging. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Gloria 2011  Saint-Julien

description: This is an open, juicy wine with attractive fruit framed by firm but tamed tannins. The wine has a feeling of lightness, with black currant flavors that are lifted and fresh. This is a wine for medium-term aging. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Gloria 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Solid and dense, this is a concentrated wine. It has black plum flavors and a feeling of ripeness and ease. Sweet acidity shows strongly on the finish. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Feret Lambert 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Swathes of botrytis reveal themselves seductively on this sweet wine. It is rich in flavors, but still vibrant with acidity. Fine balance and intense flavors of apricots, honey and spice give it potential to age well. Drink from 2015.
title: Château du Seuil 2012  Cérons

description: Swathes of botrytis reveal themselves seductively on this sweet wine. It is rich in flavors, but still vibrant with acidity. Fine balance and intense flavors of apricots, honey and spice give it potential to age well. Drink from 2015.
title: Château du Seuil 2012  Cérons

description: This is a wine with potential. It has weight and ripe berry fruits balanced with solid tannins and a dense texture. Behind the structure, the fruit and acidity promise good things. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Camelot la Chapelle 2011  Bordeaux

description: This is a blend of local grapes including Jacquère and Altesse. It is a ripe style of wine that is full of pear, melon and sweet orange fruit. It is ready to drink, fruity and deliciously bright.
title: Philippe Viallet 2015 White (Savoie)

description: Produced from Niellucciu, this wine is ripe, perfumed and also packed with crisp acidity. Fresh raspberry, citrus and a touch of caramel are brought comfortably together by the acidity and zesty aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Clos Alivu 2015 Rosé (Patrimonio)

description: This is a grassy, herbal wine with attractive acidity and the crispest hint of apricots and some distinctive spice. It is fruity, ready to drink now.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 Semillon-Sauvignon Blanc (Bergerac Sec)

description: This smooth and creamy wine has ripe fruit and only light acidity. It's full-bodied and on the heavy side, showing its weight. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015  Meursault

description: Produced by two members of one of Burgundy's grand families, this wine is fruity and soft. With a lightly toasty flavors, it's smooth and creamy, lit by lime-like acidity. Although young, it's likely to develop quickly. Drink from mid 2017.
title: Domaine Guy & Yan Dufouleur 2015 La Vacherotte  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: Rock Angel is the new name for the estate wine of Château d'Esclans. It is a ripe and full wine, yet so well balanced that it seems light and refreshing. A crisp element balances the full red fruits and offers elegance and poise. This is a style of rosé that could age, although it is delicious now.
title: Château d'Esclans 2014 Rock Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Still firm, this wine is dominated by tannin and dark fruit, with a dry core typical of this Pommard vineyard. The red and dark plum-fruit flavors are developing slowly and the wine needs time to balance. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2013 Les Rugiens Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Pear laced with subtle notes of smoke hints at a taut palate. The dryness and discipline of the poised flavors nonetheless allow the ripe, luscious pear fruit to glow and shine. Mouthfeel and texture are reminiscent of pear peel and bitter almond, and echo long after the last sip.
title: Trimbach 2013 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Pear laced with subtle notes of smoke hints at a taut palate. The dryness and discipline of the poised flavors nonetheless allow the ripe, luscious pear fruit to glow and shine. Mouthfeel and texture are reminiscent of pear peel and bitter almond, and echo long after the last sip.
title: Trimbach 2013 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Soft, open wine, with some attractive perfumed character as well as light acidity. It is somewhat unfocused, missing structure. Screwcap.
title: Château Suau 2010  Bordeaux Blanc

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. While certainly powered by tannins, this wine does have a rich, fruity character as well. The finish brings juicy flavors that cut right through the tannins.
designation: La Chapelle de la Mission Haut-Brion Barrel Sample
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2011 La Chapelle de la Mission Haut-Brion Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. Dense and concentrated, this is a massive wine that's packed with tannins.
title: Château la Dominique 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A powerhouse of dark tannins, this wine is black in color and dark in taste. It has bitter chocolate flavors, with notes of new wood and intense spice.
title: Château la Couspaude 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A powerhouse of dark tannins, this wine is black in color and dark in taste. It has bitter chocolate flavors, with notes of new wood and intense spice.
title: Château la Couspaude 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. Ripe, rich and soft, this wine has open, juicy fruit and attractive red plum flavors; it already shows its fruity character.
title: Château Giscours 2011 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. There are some reductive, meaty aromas on this barrel sample, but the palate still shows the fine potential of this wine. It has all the weight and richness of the vintage, with underlying crisp acidity.
title: Château Filhot 2011 Barrel Sample  (Sauternes)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. Rich and ripe, the wine has delicious Cabernet flavors. It offers ripe and rounded fruits with juiciness rather than great density.
title: Château Coufran 2011 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A rounded rich wine, showing the juicy fruit of the year along with rich tannins. It is spicy, lively and impressive.
title: Château Citran 2011 Barrel Sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A herbaceous, fruity wine, with its acidity well integrated into the ripe, bright fruits. The wine is light, fresh and crisp, with an attractive lemon-curd note.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A herbaceous, fruity wine, with its acidity well integrated into the ripe, bright fruits. The wine is light, fresh and crisp, with an attractive lemon-curd note.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. This wine is laden with tannins yet shows juicy, crisp red-berry flavors. It finishes with great structure.
title: Château Latour à Pomerol 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. With all the freshness of the year, the wine is ripe and soft. It has acidity and juicy black currant fruits. The wine is spiced; well integrated with ripe tannins.
designation: Les Pagodes de Cos Barrel Sample
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2011 Les Pagodes de Cos Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. A juicy and forward wine, with attractive spice and sweet tannins. It's soft and gentle on the palate.
title: Château Canon la Gaffelière 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92. Barrel sample. Aromas of new wood mark this wine. On the palate, the tannins are gentle, with flavors of ripe black plum, nutmeg and milk chocolate.
title: Château Beauregard 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. This has an herbal character along with spice. It's juicy, with intense acidity.
title: Château Providence 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. A smooth, rounded wine, this shows opulence with its rich blackberry fruit.
title: Château le Bon Pasteur 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pomerol)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. Big, bold and fruity, this shows plenty of rich blackberry-juice flavor and fine tannins. The fruit and tannins are well balanced, with a juicy character on the finish.
title: Château Lascombes 2011 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. An attractive and fruity wine that offers soft, cushioned tannins, along with ripe, easy fruit.
title: Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. This wine's concentrated tannins match the sweet fruit and ripe acidity. It shows structure and density, with its blackberry flavor already showing well.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. This wine's concentrated tannins match the sweet fruit and ripe acidity. It shows structure and density, with its blackberry flavor already showing well.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. This is big and solid wine, with firm tannins and juicy fruit. It shows spice and intense acidity followed by black-currant freshness.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. This is big and solid wine, with firm tannins and juicy fruit. It shows spice and intense acidity followed by black-currant freshness.
title: Croix de Beaucaillou 2011 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 91-93. Barrel sample. Initially this is just a seductive effort; but then its intensity and structure emerge, creating a wine of great complexity. Its botrytis character adds considerable weight.
title: Château Suau 2011 Barrel Sample  (Barsac)

description: This is a hugely rich wine, very concentrated, yet with a light touch of acidity that gives it some crispness. It is on the dry side, though with some sweetness that comes through on the soft, rounded finish.
title: André Kientzler 2010 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Finely balanced, this has attractively honeyed aromas that lead to apricot, honey, lemon and light spice flavors. The wine is warm, yet with just the right acidity to keep it fresh.
title: André Blanck et ses Fils 2010 Clos Schwendi Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Here's a wine that is rich and full bodied, tending toward dryness while still retaining all the ripe, spicy Pinot Gris character. It has apple, lychee and mango flavors, nicely mingling together, leaving a fresh, crisp finish.
title: Emile Beyer 2010 L'Hostellerie Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This medium-dry wine is rich and rounded. It has concentrated flavors of spice, mango, crisp lime and ripe apple. Full-bodied and rounded, it has a good shot of acidity.
title: Meyer-Fonné 2011 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Notes of burnt caramel, dried date, mocha and fresh savory herb like thyme and bay leaf complement the umami and rancio accents of mushroom and nut, creating a fantastic complexity to the nose and mouth of this aged Rivesaltes. Thick and viscous, it has a heavy character that's marked by prune, caramel sauce and roasted spice on the close.
title: Laurent de Bescombes Singla 2003 Héritage du Temps White (Rivesaltes)

description: This is a ripe and spicy wine, with great touches of lemon and acidity that partner with the rich quince and mango flavors. The wine is ripe and full bodied, a fine expression of a more complex side of Pinot Blanc.
title: André Blanck et ses Fils 2011 Rosenburg Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This big, ripe, fruity wine balances its fruit with a core of firm tannins. It's dense, with a dusty texture, a sweet blackberry-jam flavor and final acidity.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine Jean Descombes  (Morgon)

description: This tight wine has intense acidity, smoky tannins, a light texture and an attractive strawberry-jelly-flavored finish.
title: Frey-Sohler 2009 Fleur de Granit Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This tight wine has intense acidity, smoky tannins, a light texture and an attractive strawberry-jelly-flavored finish.
title: Frey-Sohler 2009 Fleur de Granit Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Even though this is a dry wine, it has such richness that it almost tastes sweet. The balance comes from the hint of acidity and the intense spice and pepper flavors. It's ready to drink, yet could age for another year.
title: Domaine Sipp-Mack 2009 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Initially fruity, this attractive, pink-colored rosé subsequently shows a definite texture. There is a bite of lemon juice and a sharp, edgy acidity that give the wine an mouthwatering freshness. Age this for a few months.
title: Charles Ellner NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Flavors of pear peel and tart citrus zest on the nose lead to a slightly spicy palate. Floral notes hover above everything, and mouthwatering freshness and appetizing bitterness around the edges gets all juices flowing. While there is texture there is no heaviness. It's a very appetizing, just off-dry wine with gentle subtlety.
title: Domaine Michel Fonne 2014 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The slightest notes of vanilla accent the pear-fruited nose that also carries hints of saffron. The palate is defined but balanced. Fruit concentration partners with gentle richness and spice, with the necessary counterbalance of citrus pith and zest. Lovely now, this elegant wine will develop. Drink 2016–2024.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2015 Cuvée Ste. Catherine Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Named after the grandfather (Aïeul in the local patois) of the current owner, the wine is concentrated and powerful. It is rich wine with a smooth character that belies the dense tannins behind it. Blackberry fruit and tight acidity give this wine aging potential. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Eugénie 2014 Cuvée Réservée de l'Aïeul Malbec-Tannat (Cahors)

description: Still young, this is a structured wine with the dark botrytis flavors giving as much richness as sweetness at this stage. Yellow fruits are integrated into a tight, mineral texture that will open up over the next few months. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Jurque 2014 Tendresse  (Jurançon)

description: Gentle, restrained notes of blossom and peach on the nose lead to a medium-sweet palate flavored with the gentle roundness of clear blossom honey. Grapefruit pithiness balances that slight sweetness, leaving a harmonious, restrained and very elegant wine. The finish echoes with honeysuckle.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2013 Cuvée Saint Rémi Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Black-cherry fruit and a soft tannic structure give this wine its fruity but firm character. It has plenty of ripe generous fruitiness that is sustained by the acidity and by the solid core of the wine. Drink starting from 2017.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine de Rochegès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Black-cherry fruit and a soft tannic structure give this wine its fruity but firm character. It has plenty of ripe generous fruitiness that is sustained by the acidity and by the solid core of the wine. Drink starting from 2017.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine de Rochegès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This bright wine has red fruit and just the hint of structure. It is still young, still bursting with energy. The tannins will develop quickly to give a crisp, fruity wine. Drink from mid-2017.
title: Domaine des Marrans 2015 Corcelette  (Morgon)

description: This high-end bottling features fruit from 90+-year-old vines, aged for 12 months in oak. It's medium to full in body, with supple tannins and crisp acids. Notes of barrel char and cherries finish dry, with a rustic edge.
title: Marrenon 2014 Orca Vieilles Vignes Grenache (Ventoux)

description: This high-end bottling features fruit from 90+-year-old vines, aged for 12 months in oak. It's medium to full in body, with supple tannins and crisp acids. Notes of barrel char and cherries finish dry, with a rustic edge.
title: Marrenon 2014 Orca Vieilles Vignes Grenache (Ventoux)

description: Produced from Henry Fessy's own cru vineyards, the wine is fruity and very accessible to drink young. Generous berry fruits and soft tannins make this an attractive wine. The aftertaste brings in light acidity. Drink now.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Brouilly

description: Produced from Henry Fessy's own cru vineyards, the wine is fruity and very accessible to drink young. Generous berry fruits and soft tannins make this an attractive wine. The aftertaste brings in light acidity. Drink now.
title: Henry Fessy 2015  Brouilly

description: A blend of Syrah, Grenache and Carignan, this medium- to full-bodied red features bright aromas of cherry, herb, chocolate and espresso, but turns dry and dusty-textured on the finish. Drink now.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Domaine De Yves Red (Ventoux)

description: Ripe and fruity, this is a soft cru wine full of cherry and red-berry flavors. It has an acid core firmed up by a smattering of tannins. Mainly though it is a lively, crisp wine that is ready to drink.
title: Maison des Bulliats 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Régnié)

description: The wine comes from vineyards surrounding a stylish 19th-century chateau. With its bright red-berry fruit, the wine is crisp and only lightly structured. It is a cru wine to drink soon to appreciate its fruitiness.
title: Jean Loron 2015 Château de Bellevue  (Brouilly)

description: Organically grown grapes go into this very fine wine. Its structure and balance confirm that it's still young, bursting with juicy ripe berry fruit and with firm background tannins. Its great fruitiness is contrasted with the strength of those tannins and with its concentration. Drink from 2020.
title: Château du Cèdre 2014 Le Cèdre Malbec (Cahors)

description: From a Barsac-based producer who prefers to use the Sauternes appellation, this rich, intense wine has weight, opulence and layers of honey and botrytis flavors. While still young, it shows impressive apricot and liquorous flavors. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Caillou 2014  Sauternes

description: This rich and generous Grand Cru Classé is full of dark fruit and tannins and is ready to drink. It has weight, juicy acidity and black plum and berry flavors. Ripe, with the perfume of Cabernet Franc, it's entering maturity now and should very drinkable until at least 2025.
title: Château Destieux 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: From selected parcels of Château Bélingard, this is a great success for the cool 2007 vintage. There is black berry richness to balance the severe tannins, while the element of freshness is well integrated into the final stalky acidity. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2007 Ortus Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: From selected parcels of Château Bélingard, this is a great success for the cool 2007 vintage. There is black berry richness to balance the severe tannins, while the element of freshness is well integrated into the final stalky acidity. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Bélingard 2007 Ortus Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: With its aromas of tropical fruits, this is a rich wine. There is also a fine streak of minerality, spiked with lemon juice and textured with green plum skins. It is fresh, full and very dry.
title: Vincent Pinard 2008 Cuvée Florès  (Sancerre)

description: A zesty, lemon wine, with an intriguing series of herbal and animal flavors, this is not a wine to go unnoticed. It has weight, with spice and nut flavors adding to the fruit. Drink with shellfish or sharp cheese.
title: Domaine Bellegarde 2008 La Pierre Blanche  (Jurançon Sec)

description: A smooth-textured wine that shows some ripe Merlot, firm fruit tannins and soft spice. There is an edge of wood, but the fruit is bright enough to cope. It should develop well into a rich wine.
title: Château Roylland 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: A smooth-textured wine that shows some ripe Merlot, firm fruit tannins and soft spice. There is an edge of wood, but the fruit is bright enough to cope. It should develop well into a rich wine.
title: Château Roylland 2007  Saint-Émilion

description: Big, broad and ripe, with an opulent texture, flavors of black plums. along with soft tannins and a smooth surface. The wine is developing well, offering rich fruit that will deepen in a couple of years.
title: Château l'Enclos 2007  Pomerol

description: A lightly perfumed wine, this is soft with warm strawberry flavors. The acidity and texture play a supporting role in this ripe, light-bodied wine.
title: Manuel Olivier 2010  Bourgogne

description: There's a kick of dry tannin behind this otherwise ripe wine. Raspberry flavors, red plum skins and a some bitterness add fruit and structure. It needs a year to soften out.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2011  Bourgogne

description: Perfumed dry rosé with a touch of smokiness to go with the full and ripe red berry fruit. It is well balanced, with attractive acidity and a light final touch of caramel.
title: Cave de Saumur 2010 Réserve des Vignerons Rosé (Saumur)

description: Perfumed raspberry flavors dominate this soft wine. It has an edge of crisp citrus, with orange zest to go with the acidity. The wine's main character is gentle, fresh and light.
title: Beaumont des Crayères NV Grand Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Tight acidity, fresh fruit, with lightness and poise. It shows flavors of apple, lemon and herbs with a crisp seafood-friendly aftertaste.
title: Guy Saget 2010 Les Clissages d'Or Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: There is some weight on this young tasting wine. The tannins are beginning to allow the red berry and damson fruits to open up. Touches of wood round it out for aging.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2009 La Brigardière Vieilles Vignes  (Mercurey)

description: Ladoix is a forgotten Burgundy village that can offer good value. This wine with its strawberry fruits and gentle tannins fits the bill. There is a fine, ripe feel to it, and a dry edge that sets off the fruitiness.
title: Pierre André 2007 Clos de Chagnots  (Ladoix)

description: Ladoix is a forgotten Burgundy village that can offer good value. This wine with its strawberry fruits and gentle tannins fits the bill. There is a fine, ripe feel to it, and a dry edge that sets off the fruitiness.
title: Pierre André 2007 Clos de Chagnots  (Ladoix)

description: Opulent richness combines with an aromatic delicacy, with honey, orange and acacia. The freshness and acid-sweetness balance of Castelnau are already accessible.
title: Château Suduiraut 2003 Castelnau de Suduiraut  (Sauternes)

description: Cocoa and cedar aromas dominate the bouquet, but then some dark fruit emerges on the palate. It's dense, rich and flavorful, but lacks the elegance and finesse to score higher.
title: Château de Campuget 1998 Cuvée Prestige Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Sure it's oaky, but it tastes good, with the subtle menthol and bold vanilla flavors serving to highlight bright cherries. The silky texture is a highlight, then the finish shows off juicy fruit and fine tannins.
title: Le Rouge de Saint-Louis 1998 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: The dark color tells you right away this is no ordinary vin de pays. Then you sniff it and get cedar, black currants and blackberries. The finish has juicy acidity and dusty tannins, suggesting a couple years' cellaring may be warranted. Impressive.
title: Mas de Guiot 1999 Cabernet Sauvignon-Syrah (Vin de Pays du Gard)

description: A delightful blend of cracked black pepper, blackberries and hung game aromas lead into a surprisingly plush mouthfeel that's laden with cherry and berry fruit. The finish blends in some dark coffee flavors for extra complexity.
title: Domaine Andre Brunel 1999 Cuvée Sommelongue Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This grand cru bottling comes from vines owned by Louis Jadot. It's firmly structured, as befits a wine from this village, and shows a predominance of red fruit and acidity. However, with its dry core and concentration, it will need to age. Drink from 2025.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Chapelle-Chambertin

description: Next door to the top grand cru of Chambertin, this vineyard, with its east-facing exposure, is one of the stars of Gevrey-Chambertin. This vintage is hugely rich—ripe with voluminous fruit and smoky hints from the wood aging. It has density and the potential for long aging. Drink from 2025.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Chambertin Clos de Bèze

description: From one of the larger of the great grands crus of Vosne-Romanée and Flagey-Echézeaux, this is a dark, structured wine. It has power and juicy acidity that drive its black plum and berry fruit flavors. A dry core of tannins promises many years of maturing. Drink from 2026.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Echézeaux

description: From vines inside the Les Clos Grand Cru purchased in 1904 from the Hospices de Chablis, this is a richly structured wine. It's dense with layers of flavor and great aging potential. Wood and smoky flavors are still calming down to give a wine that will be impressive and long-lived. Drink from 2023.
designation: Les Clos Grand Cru Clos des Hospices
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2014 Les Clos Grand Cru Clos des Hospices  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This wine produced from vines on the Corton hill is dense and dark, with great power and concentration. Its rich, dark fruit is paired with intense, juicy acidity, ensuring slow development over many years. Drink from 2025.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Corton-Pougets

description: The largest of the four grands crus in Morey-Saint-Denis, this vineyard gives the most structured wines. This bottling, with its tannins and power, is no exception. While it shows plenty of rich black, perfumed fruit, it also has an immense structure of tight tannins are balanced by juicy acidity. Drink from 2027.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Clos de la Roche

description: The largest of the four grands crus in Morey-Saint-Denis, this vineyard gives the most structured wines. This bottling, with its tannins and power, is no exception. While it shows plenty of rich black, perfumed fruit, it also has an immense structure of tight tannins are balanced by juicy acidity. Drink from 2027.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Clos de la Roche

description: This is a powerhouse of a wine—structured and dense yet still developing and closed at this young stage. There's already a sense of both fruit richness and mineral texture, underpinned by oak spice, yet it will grow more powerful with time. Drink from 2023.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This is a powerhouse of a wine—structured and dense yet still developing and closed at this young stage. There's already a sense of both fruit richness and mineral texture, underpinned by oak spice, yet it will grow more powerful with time. Drink from 2023.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Corton-Charlemagne

description: This is a major wine from a great white wine vintage that's naturally impressive and intense. Ripe white and yellow fruit dominates the palate, sustained by wood aging flavors and tight, nervy texture. Bâtard-Montrachet is largest of the five white Grand Crus in Puligny and Chassagne Montrachet. Drink from 2024.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: The essence of the appellation smokes out from the glass, offering hints of cracked pepper, bacon, clove and leather. It's reasonably full-bodied for Côte Rôtie, with feral, smoked-meat flavors, ample spice and plenty of the concentrated plummy fruit. Tannins are silky, making this approachable now, but likely capable of aging well for at least 10–15 years.
title: E. Guigal 2011 Château d'Ampuis  (Côte Rôtie)

description: This is a finely structured wine that will age well. With black-plum fruits, layers of dark young tannins and balanced acidity, it is both juicy and full of great ripe swathes of fruit. From the cru estate that is owned by Louis Jadot in Beaune, it is impressive and worth aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château des Jacques 2015  Morgon

description: The vines of Saint-Tropez are often within sight of the sea in the hills above the famous resort. This single-estate wine from a property managed by the Saint-Tropez cooperative contrasts fresh fruit and acidity with a generous ripe texture. It is soft, fruity and ready to drink now.
title: Vignobles de Saint-Tropez 2016 Château la Moutte Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The vines of Saint-Tropez are often within sight of the sea in the hills above the famous resort. This single-estate wine from a property managed by the Saint-Tropez cooperative contrasts fresh fruit and acidity with a generous ripe texture. It is soft, fruity and ready to drink now.
title: Vignobles de Saint-Tropez 2016 Château la Moutte Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a ripe fruity wine. It has weight and richness as well as intense acidity that cuts the ripe berry flavors. This is a food friendly rosé, full of fruit, produced from organically grown grapes.
title: Château Trians 2016 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: The Dubard family has produced a fine and ripe wine. Perfumed and with tropical fruit flavors it is a rich wine, packed with fruit and also finely textured. It has weight, yellow fruits and fine acidity. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château Laulerie 2015 Comtesse de Ségur  (Montravel)

description: The Dubard family has produced a fine and ripe wine. Perfumed and with tropical fruit flavors it is a rich wine, packed with fruit and also finely textured. It has weight, yellow fruits and fine acidity. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château Laulerie 2015 Comtesse de Ségur  (Montravel)

description: The medium-intense nose of this solid and easy-to-like Cab offers scents of blackberry, cassis and plum, all laced by hints of cocoa and cigar box. The medium-weight mouth offers a pleasant texture, thanks to moderate tannins and ample acidity, with solid black-fruit flavors at the core.
title: Romantic 2014 Authentic & Chic Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: The medium-intense nose of this solid and easy-to-like Cab offers scents of blackberry, cassis and plum, all laced by hints of cocoa and cigar box. The medium-weight mouth offers a pleasant texture, thanks to moderate tannins and ample acidity, with solid black-fruit flavors at the core.
title: Romantic 2014 Authentic & Chic Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: Anyone with a yen for the flappers of the 1920s should get this wine, with its label showing a vision of the French Riviera in that era. The wine itself is modern, clean and crisp with an attractive lightness. Ripe strawberries come through strongly in the aftertaste.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Retrofollies Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Subtle peach, apricot and yellow melon dance in the bouquet of this medium-bodied wine. The palate is pithy and tart, leaner than the nose suggests, with nice vibrancy and a subtle spicy accent on the close. Enjoy now.
title: Michel Gassier 2014 Les Piliers Viognier (Vin de France)

description: Subtle peach, apricot and yellow melon dance in the bouquet of this medium-bodied wine. The palate is pithy and tart, leaner than the nose suggests, with nice vibrancy and a subtle spicy accent on the close. Enjoy now.
title: Michel Gassier 2014 Les Piliers Viognier (Vin de France)

description: With a caramel character and light, bright acidity, this is a soft, not-quite-dry wine. It has a warm, open and accessible feel to it, light and fruity on the finish.
title: Sables d'Azur 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced in vineyards close to Mont Saint-Victoire in the west of the Provence vineyards, this perfumed, floral wine has crisp acidity along with orange and citrus flavors. The wine is light, very fruity and bright at the end.
title: Gassier 2015 Esprit Gassier Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The Négrette wines come mainly from a small area northwest of Toulouse although they are also found in pockets elsewhere in the southwest. This is a light and deliciously fruity wine, full of rosewater aromas and a bright aftertaste.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 La Vie en Rose Negrette (Vin de France)

description: The Négrette wines come mainly from a small area northwest of Toulouse although they are also found in pockets elsewhere in the southwest. This is a light and deliciously fruity wine, full of rosewater aromas and a bright aftertaste.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2015 La Vie en Rose Negrette (Vin de France)

description: The classic skittle bottle shape, familiar from restaurant tables throughout Provence, reflects this wine's character. Lightly peppery and spicy, it has attractive and perfumed acidity.
title: Château du Rouët 2015 Cuvée Réservée Tradition Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is full of red-berry flavors, fresh with acidity and a juicy texture. Lively and bright with a dancing, crisp character, it's a great apéritif-style wine.
title: Barton & Guestier 2015 Passeport Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is full of red-berry flavors, fresh with acidity and a juicy texture. Lively and bright with a dancing, crisp character, it's a great apéritif-style wine.
title: Barton & Guestier 2015 Passeport Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Finely textured, with great minerality as well as ripe fruit. Flavors range from peach to lime, a reflection of the warm vintage and the chalk soil. Acidity is important, giving a contrast to the richness.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2009 Montée de Tonnerre  (Chablis)

description: A rich, buttery wine, with classic mineral and citrus characters. Very taut and tight, while layering fresh fruit flavors. Crisp and rounded at the same time.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Puligny-Montrachet

description: A big, ripe wine that also keeps an edgy character, typical of the year. It has a fine contrast between full apple and pear fruits and a zesty tang of acidity and texture. It does need a few months' aging.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: A big, ripe wine that also keeps an edgy character, typical of the year. It has a fine contrast between full apple and pear fruits and a zesty tang of acidity and texture. It does need a few months' aging.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Dry and serious, this firm wine is classic Bordeaux. It has weight, a core of tannins and black currant fruitiness that needs time to fully integrate with the dense structure. Give this exemplary wine another five years.
title: Château Landat 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Mint aromas and new wood flavors mark this smoothly ripe, polished wine. It has a good amount of black fruit, a dry but open texture and a rich, smoky character. The tannins and generous fruit power the wine forward.
title: Château la Tonnelle 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Ripe fruit, new wood flavors and a rounded character give this structured and textured wine a fine sense of shape. It has weight, richness and a well balanced texture. Age it for four years.
title: Château La Rame 2011 La Charrulle  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A fruity wine, made to be drunk young, ripe and forward. It has bold tannins as well as ripe berry fruits and soft acidity. Certainly drink now, but better age for 2–3 years.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2011 Triguedina Petit Clos Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Light, fruity, packed with strawberries, this is an attractive Pinot Noir. The only spoiler is the over-excited use of wood which is masking the fruit and will always be an important factor.
title: René Muré 2011 Clos Saint Landelain Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Firm and structured, this is a solid wine, laced with mineral acidity and tight tannins. It has a juicy, blackberry fruit component cutting through the texture. Drink this still young wine from 2014.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Les Comtes Cahors Malbec (Cahors)

description: Firm and structured, this is a solid wine, laced with mineral acidity and tight tannins. It has a juicy, blackberry fruit component cutting through the texture. Drink this still young wine from 2014.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Les Comtes Cahors Malbec (Cahors)

description: A rounded, smooth and fruity wine, the latest addition to the range from Vigouroux's Château Pech de Jammes. It is an easy drinking wine, plenty of black fruits, soft tannins and light acidity at the end.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Petit Jammes Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a bright and approachable wine, with forward notes of blueberry, plum and wild strawberry accented by hints of garrigue and vanilla. Swaths of mocha and sweet spice add richness to the palate and linger on the medium-length finish.
title: Domaine Grier 2009 Odyssea Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: This is a bright and approachable wine, with forward notes of blueberry, plum and wild strawberry accented by hints of garrigue and vanilla. Swaths of mocha and sweet spice add richness to the palate and linger on the medium-length finish.
title: Domaine Grier 2009 Odyssea Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: A simple, rounded wine, soft and fruity. Pear and apricot flavors dominate along with a crisper, grapefruit edge. The wine is aging quickly, and will be ready in a few months.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2011  Saint-Véran

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this is a new wine from Barton & Guestier, a fresh, very herbaceous Sauvignon Blanc. It is bright with pear and green fruits to go with a big twist of lemon. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays du Val de Loire
title: Barton & Guestier 2008 Originel Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays du Val de Loire)

description: Produced in one of new crus villages of Muscadet, this is a deliciously ripe rounded wine. Those four years of aging have filled the wine out, given its ripe tropical fruit a chance to come forward. The spice and pepper at the back add complexity to this fine wine. Drink now.
title: Véronique Günther-Chereau 2013 Château de la Gravelle Gorges  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Gorges is one of the recently created village crus or village appellations in Muscadet. The wine has richness and a dense character not always found in Muscadets. While it has some age, which has softened the intense fruit, it is still crisp, fruity and ripe with apple, lime and spice. Drink now.
title: Véronique Günther-Chereau 2012 Gorges  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: White peach aromas and powerful fruitiness give this wine great intensity. It is bone dry while rich, full of quince, pear and peach fruits. There is an extra richness from the edge of wood aging. The wine is still young and should not be drunk before 2020.
title: Domaine Vincent Carême 2015 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: From one of the most famous vineyard slopes in Sancerre, the wine is tight, structured and still young. It has great potential with rich citrus, herbs and green fruit flavors. Along with the tense, mineral texture, the wine has both concentration and aging ability. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Roger & Christophe Moreux 2016 Les Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: From one of the most famous vineyard slopes in Sancerre, the wine is tight, structured and still young. It has great potential with rich citrus, herbs and green fruit flavors. Along with the tense, mineral texture, the wine has both concentration and aging ability. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Roger & Christophe Moreux 2016 Les Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: There is something sonorous but restrained about the pure ripe pear notes on the nose of this wine. The palate falls into step: Lovely, pure and resonant pear fruit gently fills nose, mouth and mind. The finish is medium sweet and sustained—a very grown up wine that treads a very fine line between Pinot Gris' inherent generosity and freshness. Totally moreish. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2015 Ehrhart Brand Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Ripe pear is bathed in honey on the nose and palate of this wine. There is a touch of pleasant bitterness reminiscent of fir honey. All this is countered by lemon zest freshness that brightens and lightens and brings beautiful balance and poise. The finish is moreish and refreshing. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2013 Hengst Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The nose already promises both texture and ripeness with its combined aroma of russet pear peel and juicy pear flesh. The palate only adds to the juicy richness with a good dollop of residual sweetness, boosting all of the pear fruit. This is countered by wonderful lemon drop freshness. The plump but shapely palate is utterly concentrated and aromas of candle wax and honeycomb show that this has just begun to evolve. While the finish has distinct sweetness, it is balanced by 2010's glorious freshness. Lovely now, especially alongside cheese or hot Asian spice, but sure to develop further. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2010 Gloeckelberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This impressive wine comes from the northernmost of the Grand Cru villages of the Côte des Blancs, where the chalk soil contains more clay. This gives a wine with weight and fine fruitiness. The hints of toast are just showing through the citrus fruits indicating that the wine is just ready to drink.
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Nature Chouilly Grand Cru Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The latest vintage release from this producer based in Châlons-en-Champagne is very much in the house style with its crisp acidity and tight texture. It is towards the dry end of Brut with apple and citrus flavors and little sign yet of aging. Although this textured wine is ready to drink, it will be better from 2018.
title: Joseph Perrier 2008 Cuvée Royale Brut Vintage  (Champagne)

description: The latest vintage release from this producer based in Châlons-en-Champagne is very much in the house style with its crisp acidity and tight texture. It is towards the dry end of Brut with apple and citrus flavors and little sign yet of aging. Although this textured wine is ready to drink, it will be better from 2018.
title: Joseph Perrier 2008 Cuvée Royale Brut Vintage  (Champagne)

description: The merest touch of lemon appears on the nose. The palate is equally reticent, only gradually revealing a touch of orange blossom and apple peel around a very lemony, bright, linear core. This has concentration but no heaviness, there is depth and toned muscle. The finish is dry and alluring, focusing on that lemon purity with a lovely earthy edge of apple peel. Drink 2019–2030.
title: Jean Biecher & Fils 2016 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The scent of fresh fragrant orange peel has a totally honeyed edge on the nose. The palate, however, has a wonderfully clear and clean-cut green pear and lemon note that simply sings. There is concentration and poise but also a feeling that this might be far better with a few years of cellar age. The beautifully dry palate is concentrated and has impact but is not heavy; the finish is lip-smacking and vivid. It's lovely now but better later. Drink 2017–2030.
title: Wolfberger 2014 Rangen Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: It is lemon that constitutes the beginning, middle and end of this alluring wine. The first bright freshness flashes on the nose. The absolutely dry palate then becomes enveloped in the incisive, bright and invigorating fruit and zest of ripe lemon, providing direction and litheness. The finish is moreish and lip-smacking with the zesty freshness. You simply want more. Drink 2017–2027.
title: Willm 2014 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: With almost five years of aging on its lees, this is now a rich mature wine. It has a toasty, spicy character to balance the still-vibrant white-fruit flavors. The acidity is a foil to the richness of the wine, cutting through and giving a crisp, always mature aftertaste.
title: Petit & Bajan 2011 Ambrosie Brut Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: A blend of equal Chardonnay and Pinot Noir exclusively from Grand Cru vineyards. It is a rich wine, tightly textured with citrus and tangy acidity. There is a tense core of crispness, with intense fruit and a dry aftertaste. This is a fine bottling that should age further, so drink from 2018.
title: Taittinger NV Prélude Brut Grands Crus  (Champagne)

description: There is no mistaking the purple chequered bottle of this wine. In its just off-dry character, it retains a light crispness, fresh apples and a soft, fruity feel. An attractive tang at the end makes it a good apéritif.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne Sec  (Champagne)

description: With its honeyed aromas, this is a warm and rich wine. It has some ripe, buttery flavors alongside more fruity apples and pears. It is smoothly textured, feeling ripe and ready to drink by 2015.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: With its honeyed aromas, this is a warm and rich wine. It has some ripe, buttery flavors alongside more fruity apples and pears. It is smoothly textured, feeling ripe and ready to drink by 2015.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is the third wine of classed growth Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste, a charming offspring of the more serious grand vin. It shows lively black fruits, touches of wood and balanced acidity. It's a wine to drink young and fruity, so open from 2016.
title: Domaine de Saint-Guirons 2010  Pauillac

description: This is the third wine of classed growth Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste, a charming offspring of the more serious grand vin. It shows lively black fruits, touches of wood and balanced acidity. It's a wine to drink young and fruity, so open from 2016.
title: Domaine de Saint-Guirons 2010  Pauillac

description: A structured wine, it has the weight and the firm tannins to give it aging potential. Black cherries, dark fruits and juicy acidity are paired with the drier tannic structure, amking for a smooth and rich wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine A. Machard de Gramont 2011 Clos Blanc Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: A structured wine, it has the weight and the firm tannins to give it aging potential. Black cherries, dark fruits and juicy acidity are paired with the drier tannic structure, amking for a smooth and rich wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine A. Machard de Gramont 2011 Clos Blanc Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Close to Gaillac, this vineyard has a Mediterranean feel to it, making it good for Syrah. The wine is rich, softly textured, aromatic and smooth. Wood aging gives a rich texture that partners the full black fruits. It will age relatively quickly, so drink from 2016.
title: Château Lagrézette 2012 Mas des Merveilles Syrah (Côtes du Lot)

description: A classic vinification in tank and barrel has produced a ripe, full-bodied wine. It has ripe cherry and dark plum fruits; layers of wood-aging flavors give a complete, dense and concentrated wine. It will age, drink until 2020.
designation: Château de Bellevue Climat les Charmes
title: Loron et Fils 2011 Château de Bellevue Climat les Charmes  (Morgon)

description: A classic vinification in tank and barrel has produced a ripe, full-bodied wine. It has ripe cherry and dark plum fruits; layers of wood-aging flavors give a complete, dense and concentrated wine. It will age, drink until 2020.
designation: Château de Bellevue Climat les Charmes
title: Loron et Fils 2011 Château de Bellevue Climat les Charmes  (Morgon)

description: Well balanced, ripe and fresh, it reveals raspberry fruits, an attractive mineral texture and citrus acidity. The style, definitely dry, needs food.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Les Papilles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From the large Beaulieu estate near Aix-en-Provence, this wine shows great fruitiness as well as a mineral texture and good depth. Ripe raspberry and red currant fruits are laced with acidity. It's very much a food rosé.
title: Château Beaulieu 2013 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: From Bandol producer Sorin, this is a rich wine with just a light saltiness from the vineyard's proximity to the sea. It has pure fruit, an attractive citrus tang and lively line of final acidity.
title: Domaine Sorin 2013 Terra Amata Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From Bandol producer Sorin, this is a rich wine with just a light saltiness from the vineyard's proximity to the sea. It has pure fruit, an attractive citrus tang and lively line of final acidity.
title: Domaine Sorin 2013 Terra Amata Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There is plenty of fruit here, but there is also some richness, caramel flavors and a rounded texture that gives a sense of weight. Acidity at the end adds freshness.
title: Domaine de Caseneuve 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There is plenty of fruit here, but there is also some richness, caramel flavors and a rounded texture that gives a sense of weight. Acidity at the end adds freshness.
title: Domaine de Caseneuve 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Although the wine has some richness and yellow fruits, the crisp acidity and lemon zest dominate. Fragrant and very fruity, it has some extra structure to allow it to age. Drink from the end of 2014.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2013 Cuvée Marina White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Although the wine has some richness and yellow fruits, the crisp acidity and lemon zest dominate. Fragrant and very fruity, it has some extra structure to allow it to age. Drink from the end of 2014.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2013 Cuvée Marina White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Soft and lightly fruity, it has flavors of bitter almonds as well as red fruits. This gives the wine a firm character with some tannins and a mineral texture. Wait until late 2014 before drinking.
title: Château du Galoupet 2013 Le Galoupet Rosé (Côtes de Provence La Londe)

description: Soft and lightly fruity, it has flavors of bitter almonds as well as red fruits. This gives the wine a firm character with some tannins and a mineral texture. Wait until late 2014 before drinking.
title: Château du Galoupet 2013 Le Galoupet Rosé (Côtes de Provence La Londe)

description: This is a lovely effort from a challenging vintage, offering up tarry notes that turn plummy and round with air. It's full-bodied without going over the top, with a long, concentrated finish framed by silky tannins. Drink now–2018.
title: La Bastide Saint Dominique 2008 Chloris Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Textured, dry rosé that reveals its rich character slowly. The Sumeire family, making wine at Coussin for 200 years, has mastered the production of a serious, food-friendly style of rosé.
title: Château Coussin 2010 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Full of yellow fruits, this is a ripe and lightly wood-aged wine. Great acidity and plenty of rich but lively fruitiness play well together, leading into a crisp aftertaste. It needs to age a bit more, so drink from 2018.
title: Vins Auvigue 2014 Solutré  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Full of yellow fruits, this is a ripe and lightly wood-aged wine. Great acidity and plenty of rich but lively fruitiness play well together, leading into a crisp aftertaste. It needs to age a bit more, so drink from 2018.
title: Vins Auvigue 2014 Solutré  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: While this wine is rich, its tight texture brings out the minerality. Yellow fruits and toast are balanced with zingy acidity for a wine that will need time to broaden out. Drink from 2021.
designation: Les Murgers des Denys de Chien Premier Cru
title: Roux Père et Fils 2015 Les Murgers des Denys de Chien Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: This wine is soft, with a light fruitiness and earthy flavors typical of some Pinot Noir. The tannic element gives a dry core to this simple, fruity wine. Drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012  Bourgogne

description: Well-balanced wine, ripe fruit, touches of wood, light spice, ginger and sweet apples. Structured, held well together by wood.
title: Jean Manciat 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Mâcon-Charnay)

description: Well-balanced wine, ripe fruit, touches of wood, light spice, ginger and sweet apples. Structured, held well together by wood.
title: Jean Manciat 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Mâcon-Charnay)

description: This 16–acre estate is run biodynamically, producing intensely flavored, honeyed, ripe wines. This is succulent from ripe fruit, with the acidity bright and vivid, finishing with sweet pineapple and apricot flavors.
title: Domaine Guillemot-Michel 2008 Quintaine  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Ripe fruit in the mouth, with a fine layer of green plums, apricots and balancing acidity. An open wine, generous in texture and weight, ready to drink in the next few months.
title: Domaine des Comtes Lafon 2008 Mâcon Buissières Le Monsard  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Spice and fresh fruit give flavors of baked apples, a creamy texture and bright acidity. Well balanced, the aftertaste shows toast and honey flavors.
title: Domaine Denis Jeandeau 2008 Sécret Minéral  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Flavors are followed by intense crisp citrus fruit. This is a lively style, very fresh with a delicious tang of orange zest, light caramel and vibrant acidity.
title: Domaine de la Chapelle 2008 Madame Noly  (Saint-Véran)

description: Well structured wine with plenty of ripe fruit. The freshness of fruit is replaced by spice and peach flavors.
title: Château de Fuissé 2008 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Well structured wine with plenty of ripe fruit. The freshness of fruit is replaced by spice and peach flavors.
title: Château de Fuissé 2008 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Structured wine, with firm tannins as well as a light touch of wood aging. It's a fruity wine, raspberry fruit cut with taut acidity. It can be drunk now for its fruitiness, but would be better allowing the tannins to soften. So drink from 2015.
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Domaine des Perdrix  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: It's the extra weight that gives this wine its Réserve title. With ripe white fruits, rich acidity and just a touch of spiciness, this is a full-bodied wine, its creamed pear bringing an extra full character.
title: Boeckel 2012 Réserve Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A blend of 70% Syrah, 20% Grenache and 10% Carignan, this opens with skin-driven, black-fruit aromas and accents of savory herbs and forest floor. The medium-weight mouth offers gripping yet fine tannins and a decadent richness to the black cherry core.
title: Les Vignerons de Tautavel Vingrau 2011 Syrousse Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages)

description: A fine vintage of this always delicious Chablis. The wine has weight, a sense of warmth from its yellow fruits and depth of flavor. Full and ripe in the mouth, it will age for a year, although it is drinkable already.
title: La Chablisienne 2011 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: The wine has weight, and dense tannins at this stage. What does give it a hint of Volnay's generosity is the warm, full fruit that is behind the structure. It's obviously going to need at least three years to soften out into a more rounded wine.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2011  Volnay

description: Old vines always add some concentration to a wine, and this firm and dark wine is no exception. It's also juicy and fruity with a full character that is already attractive but should age well over 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Volnay)

description: A blend of Syrah, Carignan, Mourvèdre and Grenache, all in even proportion, this is a lush and dense selection that offers upfront notes of wild blackberry, boysenberry, licorice and sweet spice. The palate is lush and the texture creamy, with medium tannins and lovely chocolate and toasted-oak accents that linger long on the finish.
title: Domaine Cazes 2009 Le Credo Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages)

description: This simple, fruity and rounded wine has light acidity, apricot and pear flavors and a tang of orange zest. It is full, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Laroche 2014 Saint-Martin  (Chablis)

description: This is a soft and creamy wine, ripe with baked apple and crisp pear flavors. Balanced and full in the mouth, it attractive and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Chenevières 2014  Chablis

description: Why, at the northern limits of Burgundy, there should be a small village producing Sauvignon Blanc is a curiosity, as the name of the wine suggests. This ripe, tropical fruit and crisp green plum-flavored wine is tightly textured and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2014 Curiosité de Bourgogne  (Saint-Bris)

description: This is a soft, open wine, lightly flavored with red fruits and with attractive acidity. A bright, lively mousse gives a lift to the palate, finishing with an orange-zest tang.
title: Baron-Fuenté NV Rosé Dolores Brut  (Champagne)

description: With a high proportion of Pinot Meunier in the blend, this is ripe, warm and accessible. Fresh apple and ripe pear flavors are cut by grapefruit acidity. The texture is soft, ripe and very ready to drink.
title: Baron-Fuenté NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a well-balanced wine with honeyed ripeness contrasted with attractive, crisp acidity. Pineapple and baked-apple flavors are given a texture by the zing of the honey. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine d'Arton 2012 Les Deux Cèdres Gros Manseng (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Almost woody in character, this wine has not succeeded in aging gracefully. It is beginning to dry out and lose its fruit. The wine is interesting, not more.
title: Domaine Claude Branger 2009 Monnières-Saint-Fiacre  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: So light, it's almost intangible, this fresh, crisp wine has little character. Drink now.
title: Lacheteau 2013 Réserve du Cléons Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A light, fresh wine, with flavors of crushed strawberries. There is sweetness, softness, and a rounded aftertaste. Screwcap.
title: Michel Picard 2006  Bourgogne

description: This wine has distinct acidity, probably too much. Red currant fruits dominate, giving the wine elegance, but also showing some unripe fruit flavors and a texture that is too light and unfocused.
title: Maison Champy 2006 Les Champs Pimont Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This vineyard is widely regarded for its quality worthy of grand cru status, and this wine, from vines owned by Louis Jadot, is a fine example. It is both structured and richly fruity—dense with ripe red fruit flavors cut with acidity. A dry core of tannins will allow this impressive wine to age. Drink from 2024.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Clos Saint-Jacques Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This vineyard is at the southern end of Meursault next to Puligny-Montrachet, lending the wine Puligny-like structure and texture and beautiful Meursault-like fruit. Yellow fruit flavors, layers of wood spice and juicy acidity all contribute to this very fine wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Meursault Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A dense and seriously concentrated wine, this comes from a small parcel of vines that are densely planted with 6,666 vines per hectare (2,600 per acre). Black fruits dominate the powerful dusty tannins while licorice and dark chocolate flavors come from behind. It is a wine to age for many years. Drink from 2022.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Château de Mercuès Cuvée 6666 Malbec (Cahors)

description: A dense and seriously concentrated wine, this comes from a small parcel of vines that are densely planted with 6,666 vines per hectare (2,600 per acre). Black fruits dominate the powerful dusty tannins while licorice and dark chocolate flavors come from behind. It is a wine to age for many years. Drink from 2022.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Château de Mercuès Cuvée 6666 Malbec (Cahors)

description: Part of this Grand Cru vineyard is in the village of Pernand-Vergelesses, the home of this producer. The wine is rich, with a cool hint that gives it texture. With concentrated yellow and white fruit, it's dense and ripe, balancing lemon and apricot flavors on the finish. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine Laleure-Piot 2015  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Part of this Grand Cru vineyard is in the village of Pernand-Vergelesses, the home of this producer. The wine is rich, with a cool hint that gives it texture. With concentrated yellow and white fruit, it's dense and ripe, balancing lemon and apricot flavors on the finish. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine Laleure-Piot 2015  Corton-Charlemagne

description: Fifty-year-old vines on the two opposing slopes of this Grand Cru vineyard come together in this balanced wine. It has a cool mineral character that contrasts with its ripe yellow and pear fruit. Acidity and a tight texture hold the wine together beautifully. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2014 Valmur Grand Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: This is so crisp and fruity. It is refreshing, lively and with fine acidity that lifts the wine so attractively. The red currants and lemons present an extra tang at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dragon 2016 Vignoble Dragon La Belle Hélène Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is so crisp and fruity. It is refreshing, lively and with fine acidity that lifts the wine so attractively. The red currants and lemons present an extra tang at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dragon 2016 Vignoble Dragon La Belle Hélène Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organically grown fruit, this is a delicious refreshing wine. Its red fruits and crisp lemon zest are balanced with the intense acidity and touch of herbs. It is great for summer drinking or as an apéritif.
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2016 L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organically grown fruit, this is a delicious refreshing wine. Its red fruits and crisp lemon zest are balanced with the intense acidity and touch of herbs. It is great for summer drinking or as an apéritif.
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2016 L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine comes from the Madiran vineyard of the Lesgourgues family, who are also producers of Armagnac and Bordeaux. It is just beginning to mature, with the rich tannins integrating with the powerful structure and intense black-plum and currant fruits. The dry edge gives the wine concentration, while the finish brings out black-currant acidity. Drink this fine wine from 2018.
title: Château Peyros 2013 Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: The wine is soft and gently fruity. With wild strawberry flavors and balanced acidity, this is a wine that floats easily. The aftertaste is lightly perfumed, with herbal hints. Drink now.
title: Château Minuty 2016 M de Minuty Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: From a vineyard at the western end of the Côtes de Provence, this is a smooth, caramel and spice-flavored wine. It has a tangy herbal character that brings a contrast to the bright red fruits. Drink now.
title: Château Fontaine 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is ripe with its stalky black-currant fruit filled out and given a rich character by the warm red-plum juiciness. It is still young and its youthful tannins still prominent. Give this until 2019 before drinking.
title: Château de Berne 2015 Terres de Berne Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: With just a touch of bitterness and structure, this is a finely textured wine. It has plenty of fresh red and white fruit flavors, a lively, busy mousse and a tight acidity on the finish.
title: Willm NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This light pink wine is warm, ripe and red-fruit flavored. It is soft and creamy with just the right amount of acidity. There's a refreshing, light aftertaste.
title: Cave de Hunawihr NV Calixte Rosé Brut Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The 18 months' barrel aging has given a strong toasty wood taste that smothers the black plum fruits. Six months could see better integration, but the juiciness is missing in the bone-dry tannins.
title: Mas del Périé 2007 La Roque Malbec (Cahors)

description: A blend of Syrah and Braucol from the slopes above Gaillac, this fruity, friendly wine has notes of spice and red berry. It's attractively juicy, with soft tannins, and it's ready to drink now.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2008 Château Baron Red (Gaillac)

description: Marcillac is one of the more remote French regions located in the hills of the Massif Central. Mansois is the local red grape, and here it has produced a perfumed wine, with red berry fruit that's lined with herb and lavender notes. It has a tense streak of acidity that cuts through the palate, leaving a balance of fruit and dry tannin.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2010  Marcillac

description: A ripe red-fruit note offers a perfumed character to this fruity wine. A touch of banana is the only quibble with what is otherwise a bright selection.
title: Pardon et Fils 2011 Domaine Pardon  (Fleurie)

description: There is a curious imbalance here between Muscat's natural honey and very insistent acidity. The result is a wine that wants to be fresh, sweet and fruity, but doesn't fully succeed.
title: Royal Muscato NV White Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This lush, concentrated Viognier combines cool-weather weight with summertime echoes of apricots and honey. Hints of toasty oak provide an ample frame for this full-bodied wine that avoids any sense of oiliness or heaviness while remaining bold, rich and long. Drink now–2020.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2014 Domaine des Grands Amandiers  (Condrieu)

description: This 24-acre estate has produced an intensely toasty wine. With burnt oak that totally killed the fruit, it has hard to see this wine becoming attractive to drink.
title: Château la Gravette Lacombe 2014  Médoc

description: This 24-acre estate has produced an intensely toasty wine. With burnt oak that totally killed the fruit, it has hard to see this wine becoming attractive to drink.
title: Château la Gravette Lacombe 2014  Médoc

description: Based for three generations in Chouilly on the Côte des Blancs, this producer offers a nonvintage Champagne that is attractively fruity, soft and creamily textured. Bright acidity is balanced by pear and white-peach flavors. This fruity wine is ready to drink.
title: Gauthier-Christophe NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Dry while also fruity, this is crisply textured and crisp to taste. Red-currant and orange-zest flavors blend well with a mineral texture to leave a clean, deliciously fruity aftertaste.
title: Devaux NV Cuvée Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A crisp, red-currant flavored wine, this offers bright acidity and an attractive tangy texture. In its hallmark De Venoge carafe bottle, it is pure Pinot Noir with the addition of red wine from Pinot Noir to give its pale salmon-pink color. Drink now.
title: De Venoge NV Princes Rosé Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Bottled in a replica of a 19th-century crystal carafe, this wine is a blend of crus from the Montagne de Reims. On the dry side of brut, it has a lively sliced apple and citrus character as well as refreshing, lively acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: De Venoge NV Princes Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Big, bold and very fruity, this is a black-currant-dominated wine. It's full of broad brush strokes of acidity and spice from wood aging. Still young, it needs to be aged. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Leboscq 2011  Médoc

description: With its tough tannins, this solid wine also shows dark fruits and black plum skins, finishing with fresher acidity.
title: Château Coutelin Merville 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: A rich style of rosé that has some wood aging and a full-bodied texture. Strawberry fruit flavors dominate. Drink now.
title: Château Brown 2012 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: A rich style of rosé that has some wood aging and a full-bodied texture. Strawberry fruit flavors dominate. Drink now.
title: Château Brown 2012 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Strong wood aromas lead to a wine that is still very young. The smoky wood character dominates the red berry fruits and typical acidity of the vintage. It does have the weight to develop well, so give this structured wine until 2017.
title: Château Bessan Ségur 2011  Médoc

description: This is a dry, structured wine, with dry tannins and stalky fruit characteristics. However, it will develop into a fruity wine without great depth but with attractive berry flavors and acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Barreyres 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Here's a very rich and full-bodied wine. It does have structure, giving firm tannins to balance the ripe red berry fruits. With this solid character, the wine will age and should be drunk from 2016.
title: Château Barrail Chevrol 2011  Fronsac

description: Here's a very rich and full-bodied wine. It does have structure, giving firm tannins to balance the ripe red berry fruits. With this solid character, the wine will age and should be drunk from 2016.
title: Château Barrail Chevrol 2011  Fronsac

description: Citrus and apple flavors bring out freshness. A dry white, it conveys a smooth texture, lively acidity and a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Schröder & Schÿler 2012 Chartron la Fleur  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Different parcels of old vines in the south of the appellation produce a smooth and well-balanced wine. With touches of toast as well as crisp lemon and ripe melon fruits, it is rich and intense with lively, juicy acidity. A generous wine, it is ready to drink.
designation: Les Terres du Sud Viellies Vignes
title: Rijckaert 2014 Les Terres du Sud Viellies Vignes  (Saint-Véran)

description: Rather lean and austere, this is a tight, structured wine. Its future lies in the firm tannins and the juicy red-currant fruit. Wait for this wine and don't drink before 2020.
title: Michel et Joana Ecard 2014 Aux Serpentières Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Rather lean and austere, this is a tight, structured wine. Its future lies in the firm tannins and the juicy red-currant fruit. Wait for this wine and don't drink before 2020.
title: Michel et Joana Ecard 2014 Aux Serpentières Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This structured, tight wine has complex almond and spice flavors that partner with crisp acidity and tangy lemon zest and grapefruit accents. The texture with its minerality and tight aftertaste promises aging. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine L. Chatelain 2014 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This structured, tight wine has complex almond and spice flavors that partner with crisp acidity and tangy lemon zest and grapefruit accents. The texture with its minerality and tight aftertaste promises aging. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine L. Chatelain 2014 Les Clos Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This wine balances intense fruit with a steely core of minerality. It is packed with apple, crisp pear and kiwi fruits, contrasted with this tight texture and hints of wood aging. Well balanced, the wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2014  Puligny-Montrachet

description: This warm, rounded and ripe wine offers balanced fruit and acidity. A crisp edge to the rich pear and spicy flavor is lifted by an attractive touch of cinnamon. The final acidity is steely, bringing in a mineral element. Drink now.
title: Domaine Gilles Morat 2014 Domaine Chataigneraie-Laborier Terroirs de Vergisson  (Pouilly-Fuissé)
