description: From the coolest of the Premier Cru vineyards, this is a crisp wine, packed with minerality as well as tight green fruits. The aftertaste with its flinty edge is spicy as well as deliciously fruity. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Fourrey 2014 Côte de Lechet Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Crisp and fruity, this bright, textured wine has a tangy character that is juicy and refreshing. Lively and rich, it is ready to drink although it will be better from 2017.
title: Domaine des Valanges 2014 Hors Classe  (Saint-Véran)

description: This wine is soft, with attractive, aromatic red fruits. It has the round, ripe feel typical of the village, with just a tannic touch to keep it together. At the moment, the wine is all fruit and acidity, and it needs to develop further to bring out its secondary flavors. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Coquard Loisson-Fleurot 2014  Chambolle-Musigny

description: This is one of the coolest premier crus, meaning that the wine can often age well. In the warm 2015 vintage, the wine shows both beautifully ripe fruit and a tight mineral streak that will keep it on the straight and narrow. It does need to age and the wine will be best from 2018.
title: Domaine Chenevières 2015 Côte de Lechet Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: A silky ripe wine that has great yellow and white stone fruits. That is contrasted with a strongly mineral character, touches of honey and intense acidity. The wine is still young but it has a delicious future. Drink starting from 2019.
title: Château de Lavernette 2014 Vers Châne  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A silky ripe wine that has great yellow and white stone fruits. That is contrasted with a strongly mineral character, touches of honey and intense acidity. The wine is still young but it has a delicious future. Drink starting from 2019.
title: Château de Lavernette 2014 Vers Châne  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wine comes from the historic walled vineyard around the Château des Bachelards in Fleurie. It is floral, dense and spicy, rich with pepper, concentrated spice and tannins. With its dark character and still-firm tannins, the wine needs more time, so drink from 2017.
title: Château des Bachelards 2014 Le Clos Gamay

description: This comes from one of the Premier Crus that line the lower slopes of the hill of Corton. It has weight, richness and a densely tannic character that promises aging. Its packed red fruits are cut with juicy acidity as well as a firmer structure and dark-berry flavors. This finely perfumed wine needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Capitain-Gagnerot 2013 Les Moutottes Premier Cru  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: This premier cru is on the cooler left bank of the Serein river, making this vintage a crisply mineral wine that's tight with zesty lemon and fine crisp acidity. The hints of yellow fruits are still to develop. The wine is structured and needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2015 Vau de Vey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This premier cru is on the cooler left bank of the Serein river, making this vintage a crisply mineral wine that's tight with zesty lemon and fine crisp acidity. The hints of yellow fruits are still to develop. The wine is structured and needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2015 Vau de Vey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is an attractive, fruity, concentrated wine. It has a salty, mineral character that adds a tang to the ripe apple and lime fruits. With its lift of acidity, it is crisp and refreshing at the end.
designation: Clos de Beauregard Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie
title: Guilbaud Frères 2015 Clos de Beauregard Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: From old vines and only produced in the best years, this is a wine that is mature while preserving a crisp, tight character. It has some toastiness as well as melon and apple fruits. Concentrated and with fine acidity, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Haut Bourg 2012 Signature du Haut Bourg  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: Dourthe's 100% Sauvignon Blanc is lively and crisp—a light, bright wine. With its strong citrus flavors, lemon and tangerine, touched by spice, it is balanced and fruity. The texture gives a herbal edge that is attractive and refreshing.
title: Dourthe 2015 La Grande Cuvée  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a perfumed, refreshing wine. It has abundant apple and citrus fruits, crisp acidity and a light, bright character. The wine has some weight from the lees aging. It is ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Quilla Sur Lie
title: Domaines Vinet 2015 Domaine de la Quilla Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Soft and fruity, this is an attractive red-fruit flavored wine. It has touches of spice over the bright acidity and red-currant fruit. The tannins are still young although not enough to subdue the spirits of the lively fruit. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Mabileau-Rezé 2015 Quintessence  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: Soft and fruity, this is an attractive red-fruit flavored wine. It has touches of spice over the bright acidity and red-currant fruit. The tannins are still young although not enough to subdue the spirits of the lively fruit. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Mabileau-Rezé 2015 Quintessence  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: The wine has ripe Merlot with red-berry fruit flavors and balanced tannins. It's fresh with the acidity of the year. Here it is contrasted with spice, a smooth surface texture and a ripe cherry aftertaste. This is an attractive wine to drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour Bayard 2013  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: The wine has ripe Merlot with red-berry fruit flavors and balanced tannins. It's fresh with the acidity of the year. Here it is contrasted with spice, a smooth surface texture and a ripe cherry aftertaste. This is an attractive wine to drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour Bayard 2013  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: Dating back to the 16th century, this estate's 52-acre vineyard faces the Gironde estuary. The wine is dark, firm and concentrated. The tannins are firm, and hard edged. The acidity and the smoky character of the wine make a fine balance with its tough, young side. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Peyredoulle 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The vines around the showpiece castle of Cléray have produced a crisp, lemon-scented wine that has a tight mineral edge to point up the ripe apple and lime fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Sauvion 2015 Château du Cléray Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Soft, sensuous, this is a wine that appeals straight away to the senses. The red fruits float over a soft texture of sweet tannins, leaving a juicy, succulent texture. While it is not a powerful wine, it offers all the delicious characters of Pinot Noir.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2006 Bressandes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Soft, sensuous, this is a wine that appeals straight away to the senses. The red fruits float over a soft texture of sweet tannins, leaving a juicy, succulent texture. While it is not a powerful wine, it offers all the delicious characters of Pinot Noir.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2006 Bressandes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Exhibiting all the ripeness and richness of an Aloxe-Corton, this wine revels in delicious raspberry fruits, topped with red currant acidity. The wine rolls around the mouth, with a velvet texture on top of some firm tannins. There is a complex sweet and sour aftertaste, as the ripe fruit combines with fresh acidity.
designation: Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Maréchaudes Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Maréchaudes Premier Cru  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: The instant appeal of seductive Pinot Noir is here, with its ripe fruits that are poised between sweetness and a pure line of acidity. The fruit is juicy, but always fresh, with wild strawberry flavors and just some spice from wood.
designation: Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Malconsorts Premier Cru
title: Albert Bichot 2006 Domaine du Clos Frantin Les Malconsorts Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Reasonably priced for a Châteauneuf-du-Pape, the 2005 Vieux Lazaret displays lovely kirsch aromas balanced by subtle spice, remarkably pure fruit flavors and a rich, creamy texture. This full-bodied effort is drinking well now, and should continue to do so for at least 10 years.
title: Domaine du Vieux Lazaret 2005 Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Light in color, this rejoices in its perfumed character as much as its fruit. There is a heady smoky aroma, while the palate shows a leaner character. The fruit flavors of red berries are given an extra dimension by the smoky wood and the meaty edge.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2006 Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: With its sweet wood, dense fruit and jammy character, this is a rich wine. It has some solid tannins, but they are almost lost in the welter of soft strawberry, nutmeg and juicy red berries. Typically with 2005, this is a wine whose opulence appeals now, but those tannins do suggest some good aging.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: With its sweet wood, dense fruit and jammy character, this is a rich wine. It has some solid tannins, but they are almost lost in the welter of soft strawberry, nutmeg and juicy red berries. Typically with 2005, this is a wine whose opulence appeals now, but those tannins do suggest some good aging.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2005 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: The relatively unknown Pezerolles Vineyard is at the far northern end of Pommard, touching Beaune above Les Epenots. It produces wine that seems softer than many Pommards, with rich fruit, the tannins firm but definitely playing second fiddle. It is the smoky plum fruit with just a dash of acidity that makes this immensely pleasing.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006 Les Pezerolles Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: The relatively unknown Pezerolles Vineyard is at the far northern end of Pommard, touching Beaune above Les Epenots. It produces wine that seems softer than many Pommards, with rich fruit, the tannins firm but definitely playing second fiddle. It is the smoky plum fruit with just a dash of acidity that makes this immensely pleasing.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006 Les Pezerolles Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Perhaps less intense than some wines from this appellation, this is still a sweet, honeyed wine that is shot through with lemon acidity. It is poised and very stylish with yellow fruits and orange marmalade that are caught in a web of botrytis. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Vignobles Laffourcade 2014 Château de l'Echarderie  (Quarts de Chaume)

description: Perhaps less intense than some wines from this appellation, this is still a sweet, honeyed wine that is shot through with lemon acidity. It is poised and very stylish with yellow fruits and orange marmalade that are caught in a web of botrytis. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Vignobles Laffourcade 2014 Château de l'Echarderie  (Quarts de Chaume)

description: Syrah-based, this is the Amoureuses cuvée most likely to be found on store shelves. It's full bodied and supple, with ample black cherry fruit and a savory side of cola and coffee. Long and smoothly textured on the finish, it's ready to drink now–2023.
title: Chateau Les Amoureuses 2012 Terres des Amoureuses Passionnée Syrah-Grenache (Ardèche)

description: This is an impressively rich and ripe within the light, poised character of classic Muscadet. It balances floral apple and pear fruit with a tight, mineral texture that gives the wine a young character. The extended lees aging has added notes of almonds and spice to this ripe wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2015 Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is an impressively rich and ripe within the light, poised character of classic Muscadet. It balances floral apple and pear fruit with a tight, mineral texture that gives the wine a young character. The extended lees aging has added notes of almonds and spice to this ripe wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Gadais Père et Fils 2015 Vieilles Vignes Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Unlike many vintages of Coudoulet, this one is medium-bodied and fruit-forward, offering hints of cherries, mulberries and wild Provençal herbs. Those garrigue notes linger on the softly dusty finish. Drink now–2023.
title: Famille Perrin 2013 Coudoulet de Beaucastel Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: Full of black currant and perfumed apple fruits, this is a wine that has filled out as it has matured while not losing its tight mineral character. It is a complex wine, tasting of the terroir, structured and fruity at the same time. Drink this impressive wine now.
title: Domaine Landrat-Guyollot 2012 Des Cuvées Exquises Gemme Océane  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: From a parcel of vines at Château de l'Aulnaye in the Château-Thébaud area, this is now a mature, ripe and smooth wine, It has a flinty edge along with richer yellow fruits and mint. This concentrated wine is ready to drink.
title: Lieubeau 2012 Château de l'Aulnaye Cru Château-Thébaud  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Still very closed up, this austere wine has distinct aging potential, with its taut character, apple skin texture and hints of wood. It will need 3–4 years to show its best.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2009 Les Chaumes  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: With crushed strawberry and caramel flavors, this is relatively light wine, though elegant and pierced with acidity. Milk chocolate and soft tannins complete an attractive ensemble.
title: Camille Giroud 2008 Aux Cras  (Beaune)

description: This is Chardonnay from the same region as Muscadet giving it a crisp salty character that has been filled out with some oak aging. The wine is ripe, spicy with a mineral character that comes from the granite soil. Drink now.
title: Lieubeau 2015 La Fruitière Chardonnay (Val de Loire)

description: A blend created for Schröder & Schÿler, a Bordeaux wine merchant founded in 1739, this is soft, ripe with plenty of red berry fruits. It has some firm tannins still although these are rounded out with the juicy fruits and final acidity. It's an attractive wine to drink now.
title: Schröder & Schÿler 2012 Private Réserve  (Médoc)

description: The wine is all green fruit, crisp and with a strong citrus element. Its light tangy texture lifts it easily and gives a bright character to an attractive wine. Drink now. This is one of 15 Bordeaux chateaus by Crus and Domaines de France.
title: Château Laubès 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A spectacular B&B château is the backdrop for this 100% Sauvignon (Blanc and Gris). The wine has a strongly herbal character with its tense acidity and citrus flavors. It is still developing its even more fruity side, bringing out apple and green-plum flavors. Drink from late 2016. Owned by Groupe Bolian since 2013.
title: Château de la Rivière 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine from Vignobles Chatelier is ripe, smooth and well balanced. With its green fruits balanced by apricot, it is a wine that has both tangy acidity and a soft, rounded texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Château d'Arveyres 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Fresh, fruity and fragrant, this wine has a pure line of acidity and crisp citrus alongside its tangy texture. The tightness shows its aging potential; drink from 2020. Founded in the 13th century by Benedictine monks, Château Carbonnieux is one of the oldest estates in the Bordeaux region. In 1956, Marc Perrin purchased the château and began vineyard and winery renovations that were continued by son Antony. The property is now run by grandsons Eric and Philibert.
title: Château Carbonnieux 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: With fine, dusty tannins, this rich and juicy wine wears its fruit on its sleeve, all black plums and blackberry flavors. The acidity of the year is almost sweet with the fresh ripeness of the fruit. It is developing well, showing a medium-term future. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Capbern 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: With fine, dusty tannins, this rich and juicy wine wears its fruit on its sleeve, all black plums and blackberry flavors. The acidity of the year is almost sweet with the fresh ripeness of the fruit. It is developing well, showing a medium-term future. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Capbern 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: This wine has attractive acidity as well as ripe tannins. It is perfumed and offers structure as well as fresh black-currant fruit. It's still young, with layers of wood still very obvious. This medium-weight wine will need time to develop. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Beychevelle 2013  Saint-Julien

description: The wine comes from the Côte de Py, regarded as the finest site in Morgon. It has produced a rich mineral-textured wine. The structure is balanced by fine acidity and generous fruitiness. Red berries and cherry flavors are sustained by the firm tannins that will allow the wine to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Lucien Lardy 2015 Côte de Py  (Morgon)

description: Produced with advice from the late Denis Dubourdieu who was instrumental in revolutionizing Bordeaux white wines, this is impressive. The wood aging is just right, giving toast and allowing the ripe fruits to blossom and smooth out. The wine will age well, so don't drink before 2020.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2015  Pessac-Léognan

description: Produced with advice from the late Denis Dubourdieu who was instrumental in revolutionizing Bordeaux white wines, this is impressive. The wood aging is just right, giving toast and allowing the ripe fruits to blossom and smooth out. The wine will age well, so don't drink before 2020.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2015  Pessac-Léognan

description: Cool and crisp, this is an attractively fruity wine. It certainly has plenty of acidity but it also has an equal quantity of red berry fruits that are lively, bright and make the wine ready to drink.
title: Cave de Saumur NV De Chanceny Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Cool and crisp, this is an attractively fruity wine. It certainly has plenty of acidity but it also has an equal quantity of red berry fruits that are lively, bright and make the wine ready to drink.
title: Cave de Saumur NV De Chanceny Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: There is a touch of toastiness to this otherwise fruity wine, produced by Jean-René Matignon of Château Pichon Baron in Pauillac. It has class as well as attractive tangy acidity and a refreshing citrus backdrop. Drink now.
title: Cap Royal 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: There is a touch of toastiness to this otherwise fruity wine, produced by Jean-René Matignon of Château Pichon Baron in Pauillac. It has class as well as attractive tangy acidity and a refreshing citrus backdrop. Drink now.
title: Cap Royal 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This textured wine offers tangy, zesty minerality and a dry, nutty edge, making it a wine for food. With its structure and a perfumed aftertaste, it is ready to drink.
title: Maison Bouey 2016 La Vache Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This crisp, balanced wine has lively citrus fruits, light spiciness and some tight, mineral acidity. Drink now.
title: Les Parcelles de Stéphane Derenoncourt 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The nose is very shy but the palate holds creamy candy-like strawberry notes. This is dry and fresh, light and easy. A touch of residual carbon dioxide makes for extra liveliness. Drink this soon.
title: Willm 2016 Rosé (Alsace)

description: Still young, this round and textured Champagne has great apple and citrus flavors. It is tightly drawn with a great line of acidity, some toast and the purest light final touch of fruit. Age for 4–5 years and more.
title: Vollereaux 2005 Brut Cuvée Tradition  (Champagne)

description: Dry Riesling from vineyards in Turckheim. It has a great steely core, and layers of perfume and intense acidity. It is crisp, concentrated while remaining poised and elegant.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Terroir d'Alsace Riesling (Alsace)

description: Wild strawberry flavors dominate this ultrafresh rosé. The wine, based on 90% Chardonnay and added Pinot Noir, is so fruity and ripe, while keeping a strict line in acidity.
title: De Sousa & Fils NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: While it obviously has a relatively high dosage (added sweetness), this is still a fresh and balanced wine, with a mineral edge to go with the green apple flavors. The finish is ripe and soft.
title: Château de Bligny NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: One-quarter of the Clos des Maréchaudes is classified Grand Cru, as the soil and the slope change. This shows in the power of the wine with its smoky tannins and dark character. Black fruits and a dense texture signify a wine with power and longevity. Drink from 2022.
designation: Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Maréchaudes
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Maréchaudes  (Corton)

description: This is a rich wine from several parcels of vines in the Clos de Vougeot. It has great intensity, powered both by tannins and by the dark black fruits. Serious and concentrated, the wine will age magnificently. Drink from 2024.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine du Clos Frantin  (Clos de Vougeot)

description: This is a rich wine from several parcels of vines in the Clos de Vougeot. It has great intensity, powered both by tannins and by the dark black fruits. Serious and concentrated, the wine will age magnificently. Drink from 2024.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Domaine du Clos Frantin  (Clos de Vougeot)

description: Steely and tight, this is a mineral-driven wine. With its vibrant acidity and tense texture, it is a classic Chardonnay that will fill out slowly and evolve favorably with time. Beneath the tension and forward acidity is a rich wine, though it needs time to show it. Drink from 2020.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: This wine is already well balanced. Ripe strawberries and red cherries are shot through with the acidity of the vintage. The tannins are present, complementing the already attractive fruits. The aftertaste shows the considerable potential with its tannins. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014 Les Cazetiers Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Ripe and generous, this floral wine is dense with fruit as much as tannins. It is full of blackberry and plum flavors, ripe while also cut with acidity. The spice that comes from the wood aging shows well, adding a further element. Drink the wine from 2022.
title: Albert Bichot 2014 Les Amoureuses Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: This wine comes from a vineyard surrounded by Grand Crus. It delivers a huge, smoky palate that is firm with tannins and dense with structure and fruit. The wine is rich, still shot through with the freshness of the vintage. Black fruits are balanced by the dry core of the wine. It will age well, and should not be drunk before 2022.
title: Nicolas Potel 2014 Aux Combottes Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Big, juicy and smoky, this powerful wine comes from vines in the center of the vineyard. Black fruits and firm tannins dominate the richness of the wine with its dark structure and concentration. A touch of chocolate and licorice partners with the generous fruits. Drink from 2024.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2014  Clos de Vougeot

description: This is a beautiful, ripe and floral wine. It does have structure although the main focus is on the rich, juicy fruit. Berries and red plums push through the rounded tannins. It will age magnificently, with great richness.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014  Latricières-Chambertin

description: This is a beautiful, ripe and floral wine. It does have structure although the main focus is on the rich, juicy fruit. Berries and red plums push through the rounded tannins. It will age magnificently, with great richness.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014  Latricières-Chambertin

description: Initially rough around the edges, this wine opens up to give warm red berry fruits, firm tannins and a solid structure. Underlying tannins give a dry core. A more juicy, fresh aftertaste means this wine needs some aging. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Saransot-Dupré 2011  Listrac-Médoc

description: A ripe, smooth and fruity wine that is already delicious in its ripe berry and plum flavors. Touches of new wood show how it is still developing, a burst of vanilla followed by fruity acidity. It will be a full, ripe wine, but give it until 2016.
title: Château Peyredon Lagravette 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: It's certainly tannic and tough at the moment, the wine also has so much fruit. That will allow it to round out, bringing out the black currant fruitiness and resulting in a full, rich and perfumed wine. Wait until 2018.
title: Château Lamothe-Bergeron 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: The most taut and steely of the wines made by Guillaume Vrignaud from Fourchaume fruit, this offers a tight, minerally texture, lively acidity and an apple- and grapefruit-like crispness. With its structure, this has the potential to age for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2011 Les Champréaux Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: An old-vine wine, this is powerful, concentrated and impressively dense for a Marsannay. It is full of red plum and berry flavors, plus firm tannins that suggest this could age for several years.
title: Domaine Sylvain Pataille 2010 L'Ancestrale  (Marsannay)

description: This is a smooth and polished wine, with herb and new wood aromas. It has juicy red-berry flavors, and the tannins push forward. Structured, with intense acidity, this is ready to age for at least 5–6 years.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2010 Gravières Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: With its upfront, ripe apple and pear flavors, this wine is immediately attractive. Behind the fruitiness, there is a firm, structured character of minerality and a steely edge, which makes this a Chardonnay to age for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Charly Nicolle 2011 Mont de Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: With its upfront, ripe apple and pear flavors, this wine is immediately attractive. Behind the fruitiness, there is a firm, structured character of minerality and a steely edge, which makes this a Chardonnay to age for 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Charly Nicolle 2011 Mont de Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Located on a high slope in Marsannay, the Vaudenelles Vineyard creates structured wines. This selection has a beautiful perfumed character, and it offers delicious red-berry flavors and lively acids that are striated by minerality.
title: Domaine Bruno Clair 2010 Vaudenelles  (Marsannay)

description: Savigny-lès-Beaune often shows the softer side of Pinot Noir. This wine has juicy red-cherry and raspberry flavors that balance the gentle, dry tannins. The low-yielding old vines from which the fruit was sourced give this selection extra concentration. This will benefit from medium-term aging.
title: Roche de Bellene 2010 Vieilles Vignes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This structured wine is firm with tannins while also having plenty of room for ripe blackberry fruits. It will develop well, giving a rounded wine that will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château de Tourteyron 2013  Médoc

description: Set in the southern half of the Pauillac appellation, this estate still is not expressing the quality of its vineyard location. The wine is firm, lean with tight acidity and dry tannins. It will soften, although not by much.
title: Château Croizet-Bages 2013  Pauillac

description: This is a creamy wine that has attractive fresh apple as well as citrus flavors. It has a tang of lemon zest to give a crisper edge. The aftertaste is fruity, ripe and refreshing.
title: Domaine du Claouset 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This structured wine also has attractive layers of ripe fruits. Black-currant freshness balances with a dry tannic core and a rich juicy texture. It's going to be ready to drink soon, so only wait until 2017.
title: Château Pomeys 2013  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: This wine just avoids an excessive amount of wood. Instead the wood flavors enhance the black-plum and berry fruits. It is a dry wine, dense and firm. It does need time, so wait until 2018.
title: Château Pierre de Montignac 2013  Médoc

description: This wine just avoids an excessive amount of wood. Instead the wood flavors enhance the black-plum and berry fruits. It is a dry wine, dense and firm. It does need time, so wait until 2018.
title: Château Pierre de Montignac 2013  Médoc

description: Vines on steep slopes leading down to the Gironde estuary give this estate a good exposure. This wine is structured and laced with firm tannins. It has a balanced character that will allow it to age further, although the black-currant flavors are beginning to shine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château Moulin Eyquem 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: Vines on steep slopes leading down to the Gironde estuary give this estate a good exposure. This wine is structured and laced with firm tannins. It has a balanced character that will allow it to age further, although the black-currant flavors are beginning to shine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château Moulin Eyquem 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: This wine is dry, dominated by the new-wood flavors and toasty character that hide any fruit. The lean structure will probably remain. The property is owned by the Kressmann family.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Smoky wood aromas are repeated on the palate. Although prominent, they do not suppress the juicy blackberry flavors and crisp acidity. Already balanced, the wine is likely to mature quickly. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Charmail 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: There are edges of cocoa, pepper and curing spice to the dense red plum and cherry core of this attractive Syrah. Just a touch of gamy character throughout adds depth and intrigue. The rich fruit flavors continue on to the palate, with a texture like crushed satin and lingering notes of coffee, bittersweet chocolate and sweet spice.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2014 Syrah (Vin de France)

description: Pepper and spice come through strongly in this lemon and red-fruit-flavored wine. It has a creamy texture cut through with tangy orange and red currants. The aftertaste is full while always fruity.
title: Fabre en Provence 2015 Château de la Clapière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced in an estate created in the 1980s, this wine is soft, gentle and warm. The 5% of white grapes in the blend adds extra lightness to the wine. A mineral edge along with pepper brings another dimension to the red fruits. Bone-dry, it is more of a food than apéritif wine.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine Fleur Passion Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This 25-acre, family-owned estate has produced a fruity, lighthearted wine. With crisp red-currant flavors and poised acidity, the wine is lively and bright. A light touch of spice adds a twist to the aftertaste.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Domaine des Martyrs Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine lives up to its name in the pure, perfumed flavors that are an enticement for sipping. An edge of tannin and lemon zest liven the wine even more. The tight, bright acidity at the end is mouthwatering.
title: Mirabeau 2015 Pure Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine lives up to its name in the pure, perfumed flavors that are an enticement for sipping. An edge of tannin and lemon zest liven the wine even more. The tight, bright acidity at the end is mouthwatering.
title: Mirabeau 2015 Pure Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There is enticing new wood here, a wine that shows richness to boost the ripe, creamy apple and pear fruits. It has a generous character, to contrast with its core of steely acidity. The finish is more earthy, suggesting the wine still needs time in the bottle.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2007 Vaillons Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Vibrant and juicy with red cherry and blueberry playing well alongside notes of thyme and soft pepper spice. Medium weight in the mouth with soft grain tannins, solid acidity, and a finish that leaves a delicious raspberry syrup flavor lingering until the next sip. Drink now or hold for a year.
title: Mas Belles Eaux 2006 Les Coteaux Red (Languedoc)

description: Vibrant and juicy with red cherry and blueberry playing well alongside notes of thyme and soft pepper spice. Medium weight in the mouth with soft grain tannins, solid acidity, and a finish that leaves a delicious raspberry syrup flavor lingering until the next sip. Drink now or hold for a year.
title: Mas Belles Eaux 2006 Les Coteaux Red (Languedoc)

description: This wine has simple fruit with fresh acidity, touches of lemon and a crisp, tangy texture. Still young, it offers a flinty edge and a steely aftertaste, both of which will merge into the apple and grapefruit flavors over the next few months. Drink from 2016.
title: William Fèvre 2014  Chablis

description: Round, smooth and rich, this full-bodied wine has ripe fruit and a balanced acidity. It is more about yellow fruits, less about citrus, conveying a generous character. It is likely to age quickly, so drink from late 2015.
title: Domaine Saumaize-Michelin 2013 Clos sur la Roche  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wine is toasty, with an attractive vanilla and honey character. It's full in the mouth, with rich yellow fruits and a generous texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine Guillot-Broux 2013 Les Perrières  (Mâcon-Cruzille)

description: Soft and ripe with an attractive kick of juicy acidity, this is a perfumed wine with yellow and white fruit flavors. It has all the freshness a ripe wine needs, showing a tangy, bitter orange and lime aftertaste.
title: Domaine des Valanges 2013 Hors Classe  (Saint-Véran)

description: Soft and ripe with an attractive kick of juicy acidity, this is a perfumed wine with yellow and white fruit flavors. It has all the freshness a ripe wine needs, showing a tangy, bitter orange and lime aftertaste.
title: Domaine des Valanges 2013 Hors Classe  (Saint-Véran)

description: Woody, toasty aromas are dominant here giving a full-bodied, spicy character to the wine. It is rich, but with plenty of acidity to give it good freshness. Bright while toasty, it will age. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine des Deux Roches 2013 Les Cras  (Saint-Véran)

description: Smooth and creamy, this is round, ripe and attractively cut with acidity. It has white fruit flavors, pears and red apples giving ripeness. A light touch of toastiness adds further interest. Drink now.
title: Domaine Perraud 2013  Mâcon La Roche Vineuse

description: This wine offers tropical fruit against a background of intense acidity. That makes it fruity, ripe with a tight structure that gives delicious lift and freshness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Méo-Camuzet 2013  Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: One-quarter of the wine is aged in wood that leaves the merest touch of toast on the palate. The wine is ripe, hinting at yellow fruits along with an abundance of acidity. The end is crisp and tight, and the wine needs further aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Laroche 2014 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: One-quarter of the wine is aged in wood that leaves the merest touch of toast on the palate. The wine is ripe, hinting at yellow fruits along with an abundance of acidity. The end is crisp and tight, and the wine needs further aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Laroche 2014 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: This wine is fresh, crisply fruity and toasty without missing the apple and pear flavors that give juiciness behind the texture. It's ripe and is developing well. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Ferret 2013 Les Perrières Tête de Cru  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This wine is full of rich fruit. With apricots, mangos and a layer of caramel, this is a generous wine with enough acidity to sustain its richness. The aftertaste brings in spice, vanilla and a squeeze of lemon.
title: Domaine André Bonhomme 2013 Cuvée Spéciale  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Delivers strawberries, resin and golden raisins upfront while exotic spices dominate the palate. Petroleum notes on the finish indicate that it has already reached maturity though the fresh acidity will allow it to improve for a few more years in bottle.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2004 Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: This wine is concentrated with both tannins and fruit. With acidity and a fresh aftertaste the fruit is full of black-currant flavors. At the same time, the tannins assure a fine future. Drink from 2019.
title: Vignobles Carreau Selection 2014 Château Les Petits Arnauds Excellence  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Full of bright black-currant fruit, this wine shows its young fruitiness, backed by a dry core of tannins and ample acidity. With its structure and spicy wood flavors, it will develop into a complex, dense wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tour Bayard 2014  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This is a firm wine, dry and with tight tannins. The fruit weight is still developing and the wine needs time to fully realize its potential. Given time, the fruit will become rich and full. Denis Noël and his kids run the estate, which has been in the family since 1800. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Noël Les Charmes 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Full of red fruits as well as spicy wood flavors, this is a rich wine that has a fine concentrated texture. It is firm at the moment, showing layers of toast and wood from a year in oak barrels. Allow the ripe fruit to come through and drink from 2019.
title: Château La Caussade 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: All the elements are present in this young wine. It has plenty of red fruit, touches of plum and spice. The tannins are firm while leaving plenty of room for the fruit. A wine that will be comfortably drinkable from 2018.
title: Château de Parenchère 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: All the elements are present in this young wine. It has plenty of red fruit, touches of plum and spice. The tannins are firm while leaving plenty of room for the fruit. A wine that will be comfortably drinkable from 2018.
title: Château de Parenchère 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wine shows the firm tannins of the vintage. They give a dry core that will probably remain. However, there is also a fine layer of fresh black-currant fruit that gives a fine lift to the wine at the end. It will be ready soon, drink from 2017.
title: Château de Lescours 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine shows the firm tannins of the vintage. They give a dry core that will probably remain. However, there is also a fine layer of fresh black-currant fruit that gives a fine lift to the wine at the end. It will be ready soon, drink from 2017.
title: Château de Lescours 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: While the wood flavors are prominent, they don't mask the ripe berry fruits in this Merlot-dominant blend. Blaye sister-brother team of Marie-Pierre et Pierre-Charles Dartier produced a wine with a rich character. It is full of wood spice, hints of mint and acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Cailleteau Bergeron 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: While the wood flavors are prominent, they don't mask the ripe berry fruits in this Merlot-dominant blend. Blaye sister-brother team of Marie-Pierre et Pierre-Charles Dartier produced a wine with a rich character. It is full of wood spice, hints of mint and acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Cailleteau Bergeron 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Creamy notes of Red Delicious apple are tinged with hints of shortbread on the nose. These become more forward on the creamy palate as the frothy mousse amplifies them. This is dry, restrained and elegant with a wonderfully refreshing finish.
title: Bott Frères NV Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Very faint notes of red berry are supported by floral overtones on the nose. The palate has pleasantly bitter elements that enhance the yeasty notes of bread crust. The body remains light while the finish is dry and balanced.
title: Boeckel 2014 Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Very faint notes of red berry are supported by floral overtones on the nose. The palate has pleasantly bitter elements that enhance the yeasty notes of bread crust. The body remains light while the finish is dry and balanced.
title: Boeckel 2014 Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A rich hint of apple crumble precedes tart notes of lemon freshness. The palate fizzes with frothy bubbles and gives the impression of lightness and ease. A very clean-cut, sprightly and refreshing finish almost hides the more serious autolytic backdrop of this elegant, fine-fruited Crémant.
title: Boeckel 2014 Blanc de Blancs Brut Auxerrois (Alsace)

description: Known for its pink-metallic bottle cover and signature “Ace of Spades” logo, this fresh-faced wine is crisp and zesty. The wine, with a pale salmon-pink color and lively mousse, is light and full of red-currant fruit that keeps it bright. Dry, young and fruity, it's made by the Cattier house for entrepreneur and rapper Jay Z. Drink now.
title: Armand de Brignac NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Known for its pink-metallic bottle cover and signature “Ace of Spades” logo, this fresh-faced wine is crisp and zesty. The wine, with a pale salmon-pink color and lively mousse, is light and full of red-currant fruit that keeps it bright. Dry, young and fruity, it's made by the Cattier house for entrepreneur and rapper Jay Z. Drink now.
title: Armand de Brignac NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A rounded, toast-rich wine, with the full creaminess of malolactic acidity very evident. This richness works, giving a sensuous, opulent style, just kept in check by the acidity, but very ready to let all its ripeness rip.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2006 Les Cortons Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: A spicy, full, fat wine, with a good citrus touch, this is made lively by the green fruit flavors, the edge of honey and the rounding toast.
title: Louis Jadot 2006 Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A finely structured, delicate, elegant wine, this has a pure white fruit and mineral character that lies easily on the palate. The aftertaste is soft but there is still a steely edge to the wine, which promises long aging. Give it at least 5 years.
title: Louis Roederer 2000 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This has a minerally, tense structure as well as green fruit and citrus flavors. As the texture is quite dominant, let this age for two years to allow  the opulent fruit to surface.
title: Domaine Luquet 2011 Bois Seguin  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A fruity wine, this has exuberant red-berry flavors that suggest this wine can be consumed now. Gentle tannins balance the fine acidity and rich, warm texture.
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Les Charmes  (Santenay)

description: In the past, there was much more red wine than white wine produced in Chassagne-Montrachet. This firm, tannic wine, with its austere fruit, shows a similarity to Pommard. This is a wine that needs to age for over several years in order for it to soften and become round, and for the red berry fruit to surface.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: With only 100 acres of Chardonnay, Auxey-Duresses, which is located behind Meursault, is a small player in white Burgundy production. Yet the village creates distinctive wines that are rich and taut. This 2010 is structured and firm, and it has a fruity, crisp apple-skin flavor. It could age well for 1–2 years.
title: Olivier Leflaive 2010  Auxey-Duresses

description: From vines in the heart of the Entre-deux-Mers, the wine is fresh, fruity and light. It has red-currant flavors that are bright and crisp. It's perfumed by the Cabernet Franc that dominates the blend. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Roustaing 2015 Réserve Vieilles Vignes  (Bordeaux)

description: This Merlot/Cabernet Franc blend is a tight closed wine showing tannins rather than fruit. It will remain this way.
title: Château les Grands  Maréchaux 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This Merlot/Cabernet Franc blend is a tight closed wine showing tannins rather than fruit. It will remain this way.
title: Château les Grands  Maréchaux 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This Alliance Bourg wine is dry and firm with its concentrated tannins. Too much extraction has left a bitter character. It will remain a wine that is tough.
title: Château Haut Millet 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine has very ripe fruit that leaves a jammy character. Merlot sweetness dominates and the wine seems unbalanced maybe the result of recent bottling.
title: Château Ad Francos 2014 Château le Priolat  (Francs Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a soft wine. It is lightly fruity while tasting dilute and unfocussed. Drink now.
title: Château la Bretonnière 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Shooting for wine that will age for at least 15 years, this has too much wood for its own good. Dark and spicy with tough toast, it will likely remain that way. Somebody tried too hard.
title: Château Berthenon 2014 Cuvée Chloé  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: There is some ripe melon fruitiness that gives the wine richness. By contrast, there is little structure or crisp acidity to give it life.
designation: Château la Croix Saint-Pierre Blanc de la Croix Saint-Pierre
title: Vignobles Carreau Selection 2015 Château la Croix Saint-Pierre Blanc de la Croix Saint-Pierre  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Structured and lean this is wine that seems to have lost its fruit. It will likely remain dry because of the tough extraction.
title: Château les Bertrands 2014 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Structured and lean this is wine that seems to have lost its fruit. It will likely remain dry because of the tough extraction.
title: Château les Bertrands 2014 Cuvée Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: From a 17-acre Merlot-dominated vineyard, this is a dry wine, where the tannins dominate the fruit. The wine has a bitter edge from too much extraction. The hints of fruit are not quite enough.
title: Château des Tourtes 2014 Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a dry wine, firm with tannins and perhaps missing the fruit element. It has a dry core along with acidity. The future will leave it still on the dry side.
title: Château Chatard 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a lean wine, all tannins and missing fruit. It is dry and showing considerable hard extraction. It will soften, but not much.
title: Château les Berthets 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is dry, firm and with too many tannins for its own good. It does have hints of fruit along with spice and acidity. Shame about the over extraction that gives it a bitter aftertaste.
title: Château le Sèpe 2014  Bordeaux

description: Strawberry fruit flavors dominate this soft wine. It is unfocussed and misses out on clarity and shape.
title: Château la Mothe du Barry 2014 Cuvée Design  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Initially a little rustic, the wine does open out. It is smoky, fruity with the acidity of the vintage.
title: Château Briot 2014  Bordeaux

description: A silky, medium-bodied selection, this features elegant notes of cherries, fine leather and baking spices. It's a soft, easy-to-drink wine for immediate consumption.
title: Skalli 2009 Les Rabassières Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A silky, medium-bodied selection, this features elegant notes of cherries, fine leather and baking spices. It's a soft, easy-to-drink wine for immediate consumption.
title: Skalli 2009 Les Rabassières Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A solid, medium-bodied effort, this Saint Gervais boasts fine complexity on the nose, where it mixes berries with smoke and olive before turning darker on the palate, finally ending with hints of bitter chocolate and espresso.
designation: La Réserve du Crouzau St. Gervais
title: Les Vignobles Foncalieu 2009 La Réserve du Crouzau St. Gervais Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This full-bodied blend of Viognier, Clairette and Grenache Blanc is a pretty typical white from the Southern Rhône. It's largely neutral in aroma and flavor save for a modest melon note, with a weighty mouthfeel. Drink soon.
title: Andrieux & Fils 2010 Cuvée Marie Vieilles Vignes White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This ripe, rich wine is full of fruit. Sweet tannins have merged with the blackberry fruits, making it structured and dense. Spice, balancing acidity and a dark, firm aftertaste all promise further aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Clos Venturi 2014 Red (Corse)

description: This ripe, rich wine is full of fruit. Sweet tannins have merged with the blackberry fruits, making it structured and dense. Spice, balancing acidity and a dark, firm aftertaste all promise further aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Clos Venturi 2014 Red (Corse)

description: This is a ripe, smoky and generous wine. It has spice and wood flavors that are balanced with the red berry and cherry fruits and the crisp acidity of the vintage. With its rich character, it will age gently over the next few years and be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Huguenot 2014 Petits Crais  (Fixin)

description: Fermented and aged in tank, the wine is nothing but simply attractive pure ripe fruit. It has density and concentration that come from the generous apple and yellow-fruit flavors. At the same time, the wine is cut by delicious acidity and minerality. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Bègue-Mathiot 2014 Vaillons Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Fermented and aged in tank, the wine is nothing but simply attractive pure ripe fruit. It has density and concentration that come from the generous apple and yellow-fruit flavors. At the same time, the wine is cut by delicious acidity and minerality. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Bègue-Mathiot 2014 Vaillons Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a rich, smoky red-fruit-flavored wine. One of three wines produced by the estate that was created by the late Anne-Claude Leflaive of Domaine Leflaive in Burgundy, it is made from biodynamically grown grapes. Wood aged, it shows spice as well as the cool fruitiness that gives the wine both its crispness and aging potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Clau de Nell 2014 Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: This is structured young Bourgueil, with its stalky dry fruits and spicy character. The fruit is ripe with good potential for aging as the cedar character subsides and the generous fruit takes over. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine les Pins 2015 Cuvée Les Rochettes Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Les Cailloux is a traditional-style Châteauneuf-du-Pape, with only the small Syrah component being aged in barrel. The 80% Grenache speaks the loudest, bursting with cherry fruit, dried spice and crushed stone notes that come to a refined, silky finish. Drink now–2025.
title: André Brunel 2011 Les Cailloux Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Les Cailloux is a traditional-style Châteauneuf-du-Pape, with only the small Syrah component being aged in barrel. The 80% Grenache speaks the loudest, bursting with cherry fruit, dried spice and crushed stone notes that come to a refined, silky finish. Drink now–2025.
title: André Brunel 2011 Les Cailloux Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: An attractive salmon color introduces this crisp and fruity wine. Lively and full bodied, it has bright acidity, as well as fresh strawberry flavor. It's dry, dominated by youthful acidity. It will benefit from a few more months in bottle.
title: Jacquart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Named after the Lyre style of vine training, this wine comes from the far north of Burgundy, close to Chablis. It is soft, smooth and creamy, with a light minerality and perfumed acidity. It is just right to drink now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2014 Quintessence de Lyre

description: Tight and structured, this wine has minerality as well as tangy lemon character. It has a crisp side, with citrus fruits and attractive acidity. The aftertaste is bright with freshness.
title: Louis Max 2014  Mâcon-Villages

description: This wine offers an attractive mix of mango and kiwi fruit, with a light structure. A fresh, fruity tang makes it full while also refreshing. Drink now.
title: Jean-Marie Chaland 2014 En Thurissey  (Viré-Clessé)

description: This tight wine has acidity with a crisp texture and hints of the fruit to come. A potential for richness comes from the ripe yellow fruits that are developing. Drink from 2017.
title: Jean Curial 2014  Saint-Véran

description: With its attractive red-fruit flavors, this is a light, perfumed wine. It has spice, fine acidity and a smooth texture that is just lifted by tannins. Drink now.
title: Château de Tigné 2014 Gerard Depardieu Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This wine comes from less than an acre in Mâcon's smallest appellation. The result is a tight wine with a steely edge. Strong citrus and crisp apple flavors are lifted by the nervy acidity and finished with a shot of lemon juice. Let this wine calm down and drink from 2017.
title: Bret Brothers 2014 Climat La Colonge  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: The wine is rounded and soft with attractive berry fruits and wood aging. It's fruity with juicy acidity, black currant freshness and a dry core that will allow it to age 2017–2018.
title: Château La Rose du Pin 2011  Bordeaux

description: Fresh and citrus crisp, this is a Sauvignon-dominated herbaceous wine. It has a light structure and a texture that brings out vivid lemon zest. Not for aging, drink now.
title: Château de Beauregard-Ducourt 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A red wine that relies on its fruitiness to succeed. Red berries and plums show strongly, aided by acidity. The texture has a stalky character with a bitter green herb aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2012 Tradition Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Lightly spicy, this soft wine has a broad feel, with a rounded texture, ripe apples and attractive, bright acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Moltès 2013 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Definitely wood-aged, this seriously toasty wine seems to have lost its fruit along the way. It gives a hard and tough character that is partly redeemed by juicy acidity at the end.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2012 Domaine Saint-Rémy Barrique Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Definitely wood-aged, this seriously toasty wine seems to have lost its fruit along the way. It gives a hard and tough character that is partly redeemed by juicy acidity at the end.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2012 Domaine Saint-Rémy Barrique Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Perfumed and rich, this wine gives a ripe fruit feel. Hints of green fruits marry with spice and touches of apricot, even honey. The end is crisp, clean and full.
title: Château Routas 2013 Routas Viognier (Vin de Pays Var)

description: Perfumed and rich, this wine gives a ripe fruit feel. Hints of green fruits marry with spice and touches of apricot, even honey. The end is crisp, clean and full.
title: Château Routas 2013 Routas Viognier (Vin de Pays Var)

description: As often in Alsace Pinot Noir, the wine has too much wood for its fruit. What fruitiness it has—bitter cherries and red berries—is smothered by high toast giving a dry, edgy aftertaste.
title: Domaine Loew 2013 Westhoffen Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Hugel has always made a benchmark Pinot Noir. This has weight and richness. It does have a strong wood content that provides some bitterness, though it is rounded out by the note of ripe red plum, lifted by final acidity.
title: Hugel 2009 Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This taut, structured wine achieves a balance between red berry flavors and dry, firm tannins. It has a herbal edge and a solid, dense texture. It powers through with intense acidity on the finish.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 La Madone  (Fleurie)

description: This is a firmly structured wine, but its black cherry flavor is marred by banana sweetness. Otherwise the wine is solid and tannic, with light acidity on the finish. Age for a year.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine Javernière  (Morgon)

description: This rich, juicy wine is bursting with red fruits that are ready to drink. This is a ripe, full-bodied, friendly wine with just an edge of tannin and acidity to hold it all together.
title: Domaine Chasselay 2010 L'Héronde  (Côte de Brouilly)

description: Full-bodied, velvety and rich, this is a big Hermitage for a big occasion. Espresso and dark chocolate notes lead the way, buoyed by baking spices, vanilla and plum. It's approachable now, but certain to go another decade in a cool cellar.
title: Ferraton Pere et Fils 2013 Les Dionnières  (Hermitage)

description: Full-bodied, velvety and rich, this is a big Hermitage for a big occasion. Espresso and dark chocolate notes lead the way, buoyed by baking spices, vanilla and plum. It's approachable now, but certain to go another decade in a cool cellar.
title: Ferraton Pere et Fils 2013 Les Dionnières  (Hermitage)

description: In this case, Tardieu-Laurent's distinctive oak signature is amply supported by layers of black cherry and raspberry fruit. Hickory smoke and dusty tannins frame the long, mouthwatering finish. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2013 Vieilles Vignes  (Gigondas)

description: My favorite 2014 Cornas from Jean-Luc Colombo, this boasts an intoxicating perfume of peppery spice, anise and blackberry-plum liqueur. It's elegant on the palate despite the ripe fruit, with silky tannins that belie the wine's intensity and length. Drink now–2030.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2014 La Louvée  (Cornas)

description: This premier cru, surrounded by grand cru vineyards, has produced a luscious, ripe wine. It's generous in both black fruit flavor and structure, showing great potential for aging. Drink from 2021.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: This premier cru, surrounded by grand cru vineyards, has produced a luscious, ripe wine. It's generous in both black fruit flavor and structure, showing great potential for aging. Drink from 2021.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Les Suchots Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Produced in one of the great sweet wine regions of France, this rich honeyed wine is intense while always preserving acidity and a crisp apple character. Honey and flavors of botrytis are balanced with the acidity and apricot flavors the give the wine its freshness. Drink this beautiful wine from 2018.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2012 Foehn  (Jurançon)

description: The wine is rich, honeyed and full of ripe marmalade and apricot jelly flavors. At the same time, it has the fine shot of acidity and crispness that gives Jurançon its elegance and individuality. This is delicious to drink now, although it would be much better to wait and drink it from 2019.
title: Domaine Nigri 2015 Toute une Histoire  (Jurançon)

description: The wine is rich, honeyed and full of ripe marmalade and apricot jelly flavors. At the same time, it has the fine shot of acidity and crispness that gives Jurançon its elegance and individuality. This is delicious to drink now, although it would be much better to wait and drink it from 2019.
title: Domaine Nigri 2015 Toute une Histoire  (Jurançon)

description: Pegau's Cuvée Laurence is aged in wood for longer than the Cuvée Resérvée, but is otherwise nearly identical. The 2012 version is full-bodied, dense and richly textured, redolent of liniment, horse tack and garrigue, yet backed by ample cherry and plum fruit. Drink now–2025.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2012 Cuvée Laurence Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Pegau's Cuvée Laurence is aged in wood for longer than the Cuvée Resérvée, but is otherwise nearly identical. The 2012 version is full-bodied, dense and richly textured, redolent of liniment, horse tack and garrigue, yet backed by ample cherry and plum fruit. Drink now–2025.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2012 Cuvée Laurence Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Young vines give this wine a bright, fruity character, while wood aging brings out complexity and ripe yellow and citrus fruits. It's juicy and lively, with just the right minerality and tight texture to allow it to age. Drink from 2021.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2014 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: Young vines give this wine a bright, fruity character, while wood aging brings out complexity and ripe yellow and citrus fruits. It's juicy and lively, with just the right minerality and tight texture to allow it to age. Drink from 2021.
title: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils 2014 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)
winery: Domaine Christian Moreau Père et Fils

description: Montée de Tonnerre is considered one of the richest premier crus in Chablis, and this wine lives up to that reputation. It's ripe and full of yellow fruit, while maintaining its acidity and tight texture. Still young, its intense fruit and crispness will allow it to age for many years. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Billaud-Simon 2014 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This fresh wine is all about fruit. Soft tannins and attractive strawberry flavors are lightly cut with acidity. Coming from vines between 50 and 60 years of age, it has some extra concentration. Drink this fragrant wine now.
title: Roche de Bellene 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne)

description: With a typical Coteaux d'Aix blend that includes Cabernet Sauvignon, this is fruity while also textured and aromatic. It has a good concentration, minerality and a rich, red-fruited aftertaste.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2014 Château Saint Hippolyte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This pale-colored wine tastes as light as its color. It's fresh and crisp, with attractive acidity and fragrant orange and apple fruits. Soft, it's ready to drink.
title: Château Hermitage Saint-Martin 2014 Grande Cuvée Enzo Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: As pale as a rosé can be, this is a smooth and rounded wine. Ripe, perfumed red fruits offer a tang from a squeeze of lemon. The acidity gives the right amount of freshness to this attractive, drink-it-now wine.
title: Barton & Guestier 2013 La Villa Barton Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: As pale as a rosé can be, this is a smooth and rounded wine. Ripe, perfumed red fruits offer a tang from a squeeze of lemon. The acidity gives the right amount of freshness to this attractive, drink-it-now wine.
title: Barton & Guestier 2013 La Villa Barton Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Shining bright fruits give this wine a freshly polished character that glows with red berries and acidity. It's a textured wine, full of minerality as well as a steely edge. The aftertaste is lively and bright.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2014 Cuvée G Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The wine is textured, tight and with a strongly mineral character. That gives it a food-friendly character, emphasized by the orange zest over the raspberry fruits and the tangy acidity at the end.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Château Gabriel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is a lush, rich and toasty Chardonnay, with upfront scents of grilled apple, brioche, orange custard and sweet spice. The medium-weight palate is balanced by ample acidity, lending a freshness to the finish that closes on notes of honeydew melon and toasted hazelnut. Drink now–2018.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2011 Aigle Royal Chardonnay (Limoux)

description: Soft, fruity wine, very smooth, its pear and green plum flavors integrated into acidity along with a light touch of sweetness. Ready to drink.
title: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) 2010 Réserve Spéciale  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Peach aromas open a smooth wine. It has acidity certainly but also some good melon and pear ripeness. There is an herbaceous edge that cuts through the finish.
title: Château Dame Jane 2010  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Low intensity fruit and floral aromas are hidden in the bouquet, with minor suggestions of strawberry hull and crushed carnation to be found only upon deep nosing. Light and easy in the mouth with a short but clean finish.
title: Les Jamelles 2010 Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Simply fruity Bordeaux. It has signs of wood and black currant fruit along with acidity and a light layer of tannin. Drink now.
title: De Mour 2008 Prince Rubis  (Bordeaux)

description: Lean, with severe tannins and fruit, dark and firm and laden with acidity. It is hard to take much pleasure from this austere wine.
title: Château la Bassonnerie 2008  Pomerol

description: Attractively balanced wine, with refreshing acidity cutting through the apple and pear flavors. It has some tangy minerality as well as a really fresh but rich aftertaste. Screwcap.
title: Pierre Sparr 2010 Réserve Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Soft and ripe, this is a broad wine. Its tannins are enveloped by the rich plum and damson fruit flavors. It combines the richness of the vintage with the softness of a Savigny in an already delicious whole.
title: Maurice Ecard 2009 Les Serpentières Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This exhibits stalky fruit, with some weight behind it. A black currant flavor dominates, with a ripe, jammy feel. For short-term aging.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2011  Bordeaux

description: This exhibits stalky fruit, with some weight behind it. A black currant flavor dominates, with a ripe, jammy feel. For short-term aging.
title: Les Hauts de Lagarde 2011  Bordeaux

description: A very herbaceous character makes this wine seem rather thin. It's soft and lightweight, and the lemon zest character is mildly attractive. Ready to drink.
title: Château de Virecourt 2011  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Dark and structured, dense and tannic this has considerable structure, but it's unlikely to age.
title: Château Bel Air Moulard 2009  Bordeaux

description: A textured wine, this has ripe fruit that still shows a green, herbal character. It has weight and a ripe black-currant flavor, plus juicy acidity and soft tannins. Ready to drink.
title: Bernard Magrez 2010 Maison Magrez  (Bordeaux)

description: A textured wine, this has ripe fruit that still shows a green, herbal character. It has weight and a ripe black-currant flavor, plus juicy acidity and soft tannins. Ready to drink.
title: Bernard Magrez 2010 Maison Magrez  (Bordeaux)

description: Young and fruity, this wine can be enjoyed now for its fruitiness or aged over 2–3 years. The attractive black-currant flavor is pleasant now.
title: Augey 2011  Bordeaux

description: Young and fruity, this wine can be enjoyed now for its fruitiness or aged over 2–3 years. The attractive black-currant flavor is pleasant now.
title: Augey 2011  Bordeaux

description: A creamier notion of ripe apples with custard pervades both nose and palate of this soft wine. The acidity is bright and pure but cushioned by creaminess that gives this a very approachable, very friendly and fruity aspect.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2014 Sommerberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A creamier notion of ripe apples with custard pervades both nose and palate of this soft wine. The acidity is bright and pure but cushioned by creaminess that gives this a very approachable, very friendly and fruity aspect.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2014 Sommerberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Softly scented notes of apricot compote entice the nose. The palate is honeyed and pliable, with layers of sweetness and richness. Fresh lemon oil acidity holds against that but overall accentuates the honeyed apricot notes that are the chief theme of this luscious wine.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2009 Eichberg Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Softly scented notes of apricot compote entice the nose. The palate is honeyed and pliable, with layers of sweetness and richness. Fresh lemon oil acidity holds against that but overall accentuates the honeyed apricot notes that are the chief theme of this luscious wine.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2009 Eichberg Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Earth and smoke join fruity, fresh apples on the nose. The palate is equally apple-fruited and very appetizing, full of freshness and friendly fruit on a dry, slender body. The juicy, poised cleanliness lingers beautifully.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2013 Geisberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Notions of ripe fresh pears and pear compote on the nose segue into the more pliable fruitiness of ripe mirabelle plums. This is off-dry but offset by a little phenolic grip and a lively streak of freshness. Nose, palate and finish all speak of golden mirabelles.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2013 Mambourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Notions of ripe fresh pears and pear compote on the nose segue into the more pliable fruitiness of ripe mirabelle plums. This is off-dry but offset by a little phenolic grip and a lively streak of freshness. Nose, palate and finish all speak of golden mirabelles.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2013 Mambourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Ripe, velvety notions of juicy pear and pear peel perfume the subtle nose. The palate has the same, bright, friendly but utterly balanced juiciness that is immensely appetizing. The palate is dry and lithe and has a fine acidic backbone of lemony freshness.
title: Hubert Meyer 2014 Winzenberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This soft wine offers ripe yellow fruits and a gentle texture. Bright with acidity, it also has peach and melon roundness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Michel 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: With its small proportion of Aligoté in the blend, this crisp, fruity wine is lively with acidity. Citrus flavors are given an extra fillip by a zingy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Collection  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This ripe and creamy wine offers yellow fruits and a soft texture. The acidity is just right for all the rich fruit, giving a lift of citrus to the smooth texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2015 Bel-Air  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: This ripe and creamy wine offers yellow fruits and a soft texture. The acidity is just right for all the rich fruit, giving a lift of citrus to the smooth texture. It is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2015 Bel-Air  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Bright, soft and attractively fruity, this is an easy, open wine. An edge of acidity and minerality give the wine a good, crisp texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Deux Roches 2015 Rives de Longsault  (Saint-Véran)

description: Bright, soft and attractively fruity, this is an easy, open wine. An edge of acidity and minerality give the wine a good, crisp texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Deux Roches 2015 Rives de Longsault  (Saint-Véran)

description: This bright and fruity wine is made from Gamay, bringing out a cherry character as well as crisp acidity. The wine is lively, perfumed and ready to drink.
title: Château de Pizay 2016 Rosé de Soirée Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: This is a ripe and sunny wine full of tropical fruit and ripe apple flavors. Smooth and open, it has just enough crisp acidity at the end. Drink from 2018.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2016  Mâcon-Vinzelles

description: This is a ripe and sunny wine full of tropical fruit and ripe apple flavors. Smooth and open, it has just enough crisp acidity at the end. Drink from 2018.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2016  Mâcon-Vinzelles

description: This ripe wine has rich white stone fruit and only light acidity. The warmth of the wine comes from the ripeness and the smooth texture that will allow it to age quickly. Drink now.
title: Pierre-Yves et Olivier Fichet 2016 Les Trois Terroirs

description: Pretty, delicate and soft, initial scents of redcherry and strawberry carry through to the lightweight easygoing plate. It's fresh and easy to like, with good zip to the finish.
title: Les Vignobles Foncalieu 2016 Le Versant Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Pretty, delicate and soft, initial scents of redcherry and strawberry carry through to the lightweight easygoing plate. It's fresh and easy to like, with good zip to the finish.
title: Les Vignobles Foncalieu 2016 Le Versant Grenache Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A blend with 85% Gamay, this wine comes from the Beaujolais region. It has delicious red-cherry fruit and attractive acidity. The wine with its layer of tannins is ready to drink— fruity and bright.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: Mango aromas bring out the tropical character of this superripe wine. It is soft and creamy, maybe too much so, since it lacks a crisper edge. It is ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine de la Batie  (Saint-Véran)

description: This typical, fruity wine from Gascony offers lemon and herbal flavors and a crisply tangy texture. It's a light, breezy wine, full of fruit and tight with acidity. Drink this refreshing wine now.
title: Domaine de Millet 2016  Coteaux Bourguignons

description: The name, Mineral, says everything you need to know about the texture of this wine. It is also rich, generous and ripe with apricot and melon flavors. This easygoing wine has a soft aftertaste that makes it drinkable now.
title: Cave des Grands Crus Blancs 2016 Minéral  (Mâcon-Loché)

description: From sand and granite soil, this firmly structured wine has dark tannins as well as the more familiar red-cherry flavors of Beaujolais. As it develops, it will become rich and fruity, juicy with good acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Bertrand 2015 Les Déduits  (Fleurie)

description: A ripe and full wine, packed with fruit. It has a toasty character, spice and bright red-berry fruits that give the wine its crisp acidity and balance the riper smooth texture that is developing. Give this wine until 2022.
title: Denis Père et Fils 2015  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: The year 1610 was the year the estate was created, so it does have some history. The wine is smooth, rich and with a dense character that gives it an almost inky black color. Solid and concentrated, it is a powerful wine, with dense berry fruits and acidity. It will be ready from 2019.
title: Château Grand Boise 2015 Cuvée 1610 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a ripe wine, soft on the normal tannins of this appellation and big on the black-cherry and berry fruits. It does have a firm core, cushioned by the generous fruitiness. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Château de Santenay 2015  Pommard

description: Dense and structured, this bottling is made from selection of wines aged in large wood barrels for 12 months. Black cherry and plum fruits are balanced by firm tannins and backed by acidity. It is ready to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Pizay 2015 Les Sybarites  (Morgon)

description: A part of this estate's vineyards are in the Sainte-Victoire subappellation close to the landmark mountain of that name. This is a dense wine with serious tannins at this stage. It also has generous potential, along with the tight black-currant and blackberry fruits. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Château Grand Boise 2015 Red (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: rich, fruity wood-aged wine, this offers ripe white fruits and plenty of smoky toast flavors. Acidity and minerality give the wine its distinctive tangy texture. These elements result in a ripe wine that will age further. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Santenay 2015 Abbaye de Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: From the famed slope of the Côtes de Py, this wine sums up both the great terroir and a great vintage. It has structure, with dry tannins permeating the ripe, rounded fruit. Its potential is considerable, anchored in great fruitiness and finishing acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Pizay 2015 Cuvée du Py  (Morgon)

description: The wine is dense with fine concentration and a solid dry tannin character at the back. It is full of black fruits and balanced acidity. Its richness reflects the quality of the vintage and its aging potential. Drink from 2022.
title: Louis Latour 2015 Les Chaillots Premier Cru  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: Firm and structured, this wine has strong wood-aging spice and ripe tannins. The fruit is suppressed by the toasty wood flavors, but it holds hints of black currant fruitiness for the future. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Fleur la Forge 2012 Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: Bordeaux wine should not have high alcohol; it detracts from the play between fruit and tannins, as in this wine. It is powered by its extracted structure, with flavors of bitter chocolate that leave the fruit behind.
title: Château des Landes 2009 Cuvée Prestige  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: Tobacco aromas are followed by a palate that is classic smoky, cool Cabernet Franc. With tannins, juicy acidity and light red berry flavors, it's a fruity wine with a bright aftertaste.
title: Cave de Saumur 2013 Les Pouches  (Saumur)

description: The wine is soft, showing ripe apple fruits, pears and apricots, with fresh acidity. It's light, but has a strong sense of texture and minerality. It's ready to drink but will be better early in 2015.
designation: Château de La Haudinière Sur Lie
title: Les Vignerons des Terroirs de la Noëlle 2013 Château de La Haudinière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)
winery: Les Vignerons des Terroirs de la Noëlle

description: A light orange-colored rosé, it's equally light on the palate. It has lost its freshness while broadening out into a softly fruity, orange peel and strawberry flavored wine. It needs food.
title: Henry Natter 2012 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This second wine from the estate offers spice and mushroom aromas that indicate it's now mature. Ripe and smooth, with attractive secondary flavors, it's spicy, meaty and ready to drink.
title: Château Valade 2012 L'Etendard de Château Valade  (Saint-Émilion)

description: From a château that has vineyards in both Blaye and Bourg, this wine is redolent of black currant, both on the nose and on the palate. The wood and tannins lend support, giving plenty of space for the ripe fruitiness and juicy acidity. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Métairie Neuve 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is the second wine of Vieille Cure, one of the leading Fronsac estates. It is aging well, moving from fruit to mature, secondary flavors, softening in the process. Wood aging has balanced the blackberry fruit with spice and made it ready to drink.
title: Château la Vieille Cure 2012 Sacristie de la Vieille Cure  (Fronsac)
