description: An attractive, fruity wine that is soft and smooth. It does have a crisp edge although the wine is also full of yellow fruits, ripe apricot and melon. The wine is ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2015 Domaine de la Grenaudière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The wine is crisp, tight, full of attractive acidity and citrus flavors. There is a mineral element to the wine that gives the texture a fine bite. It is fruity, bright with acidity and ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2015 Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The wine is crisp, tight, full of attractive acidity and citrus flavors. There is a mineral element to the wine that gives the texture a fine bite. It is fruity, bright with acidity and ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2015 Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a vibrantly rich wine that is brimming with delicious red fruit notes and bright acidity. Full and concentrated, it has weight without being heavy. It is a finely made wine, with a crisp finish.
title: Château Vignelaure 2011 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The near-vertical slope of the Monts Damnés produces wines that have great elegance, style and impressive richness. This 2011 is still young, needing another year to start to bring out all the complex texture and aromatics. Drink until 2020.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 La Côte de Monts Damnés  (Sancerre)

description: Silex is a flint and sand soil that suits Sauvignon Blanc well. This wine, with tight, nervy texture and crisp lemon character, is still fresh, full of primary citrus and gooseberry flavors. It needs until 2015 to fully integrate and show rich concentration.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2011 Sancerre d'Antan  (Sancerre)

description: The Château-Chalon appellation can only make vin jaune and this exceptional example shows why this type of wine is unique. Balanced acids and fragrant fruitiness underpin the yeast, almond flavors and freshness. It is ready to drink in all its glory but will age for many, many years.
title: Domaine Berthet-Bondet 2006 Vin Jaune Savagnin (Château-Chalon)

description: 88-90 Dense and dry, a firmly structured wine, packed with tannins and a solid texture. The acidity powers through everything.
title: Château Ferrande 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 88-90 Spicy, toasty fresh citrus wine. It's light, crisp, with bright final acidity.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 88-90 Solid, chunky wine, firmly tannic and tough. The weight of fruit is there to give promise for the future.
title: Château Cissac 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Great acidity runs through what is also a richly concentrated wine. It has weight, density, always with this bright acidity.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88-90 Spicy, smoky character, with ripe fruit and good acidity. Black plums, and very rich. There is a touch of pepper from the alcohol.
title: Château Bertineau Saint-Vincent 2010 Barrel sample  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: 88-90 The wine seems to have over-ripe fruit, giving it an unbalanced feel. It does have weight, the tannins offering some structure, while it's the acidity that really gives the wine shape.
title: Château Berliquet 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 88-90 A definite mineral character here, with a wine that boasts a taut structure, pushing beyond the metallic edge of the fruit.
title: Château Romer 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 88-90 Big, extracted wine, with hard tannins, very firm, tough.
title: Château Peyrabon 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Big, extracted wine, with hard tannins, very firm, tough.
title: Château Peyrabon 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 88-90 Acidity and fresh fruit are out of balance with smoky wood. The wine will need to integrate in the coming months, although all the elements are there.
title: Château Maucaillou 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 89-91 The wine is all tannins, very severe feeling. The toughness masks the fruit, although there is just a hint of juiciness to finish.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 89-91 Soft, open style of wine from one of the largest estates in the Médoc. The wine has fresh berry fruits, tingling acidity, very fresh.
title: Château Larose-Trintaudon 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Firmly structured, while also boosted with sweet, smoky fruits and ripe tannins. The wine has style more than power, and the juicy berry fruits give it acidity and a fresh aftertaste.
title: Château Larcis Ducasse 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Attractively perfumed, with great acidity and delicious dusty tannins. It is fresh, hinting at wood, spice and blackberry flavors.
title: Château Haut-Simard 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Smoky, firm tannins, with black currant fruits, firmly dark, dry and tannic, with a solid structure.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2010 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 89-91 Ripe, soft fruit, the tannin right within the sweetness. It has density without weight, an opulent, ripe wine.
title: Château Citran 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Ripe, soft fruit, the tannin right within the sweetness. It has density without weight, an opulent, ripe wine.
title: Château Citran 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Smooth, opulent with tannins firmly buried in the sweet acidity. Black plum juice flavors go with the ripe fruits and just a touch of spice.
title: Château Teyssier 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 89-91 Solid, chunky wine, with a fine juicy element showing through in the aftertaste. It has weight, structure, a dense texture, and balance.
title: Château Poujeaux 2010 Barrel sample  (Moulis-en-Médoc)

description: 89-91 A firm wine, with tight tannins, very structured, showing a mineral edge.
title: Château La Grave à Pomerol 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 A firm wine, with tight tannins, very structured, showing a mineral edge.
title: Château La Grave à Pomerol 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Fine tannins, with plenty of juicy fruit. The wine has wonderful sweetness to go with the acidity.
title: Château Bellegrave 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 89-91 Firm and structured, plenty of bitter chocolate as well as sweet fruit. The wine is very dense, wearing its tannins on the surface. Power here, dark and firm.
title: Château Belgrave 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Herbaceous and fresh, the wine has a grassy character with a citrus edge, spice and grapefruit. It is lively and refreshing.
title: Le Nardian 2010 Barrel sample  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: 89-91 Tought initially, although the weight of fruit is all there. The dry core spreads outwards, giving a rich, textured feel. Very firm aftertaste.
title: Château Villegeorge 2010 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 89-91 Rich and spicy, the wine has ripe balanced fruit, lots of juiciness. A very Merlot, jammy character.
title: Château Siaurac 2010 Barrel sample  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: 89-91 Rich and spicy, the wine has ripe balanced fruit, lots of juiciness. A very Merlot, jammy character.
title: Château Siaurac 2010 Barrel sample  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Attractive crisp citrus and pear fruits mark out this creamy wine. It is light, fruity and lightly salty at the end, a great seafood partner. Drink now.
title: Bougrier 2015 Alain de la Treille  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Petit Chablis comes from the plateau above the main Chablis vineyards. As here, it offers a light fruity style with only the lightest minerality and much more in the way of apple and citrus flavors. Drink the wine from early 2017.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2015 Blancs Cailloux  (Petit Chablis)

description: Named after the parcel from which this wine originally came, it is delicate and soft. The apple and citrus fruit is light, cut easily with some acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2014 Collection Tiserny  (Bourgogne)

description: This is a crisp and fruity wine that has fine acidity and a tangy orange-zest texture. The wine is full of green plums and with a salty, bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Le Renard  (Bourgogne)

description: This is a light wine—fruity and with a soft texture. It has citrus and creamed pear flavors that are balanced with acidity. It's a wine to be drunk now while its fruitiness is still at its peak.
title: Domaine Chevillon-Chezeaux 2014  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: The producer is following the Provence fashion and packaging its range of Pure Loire in square bottles. This rosé is dry with red fruit and spice from the Cabernet Franc in the blend. Tangy and crisp, it is ready to drink,
title: Bougrier 2015 Pure Loire  (Rosé de Loire)

description: Inspired by Sancerre, but with grapes from other parts of the Loire, this soft, herbal and green-fruit flavored wine is refreshing and lightly textured. Drink now.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Val de Loire)

description: A ripe, crisp, yellow- and white-fruit-flavored wine. It shows taut minerality, the flintiness you find in Chablis. The structure is dominant in what is still a young wine, but the fruit is all there. Worth aging for a year.
title: Bailly-Lapierre 2005 Pur Chardonnay  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: The familiar Cordon Rouge, in an impressively restyled bottle, is soft, fruity and eminently drinkable. Its balance comes from the ripe apple fruit and the underlying softness of the creamy mousse. Acidity ties it all together. Drink this bottling now.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Grand Cordon  (Champagne)

description: This is a crisp and dry Champagne. Its attractive red fruits are linked to the acidity and tight texture to give a linear wine that is refreshing and has a bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Tendre Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a crisp and dry Champagne. Its attractive red fruits are linked to the acidity and tight texture to give a linear wine that is refreshing and has a bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Tendre Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Based in the small Sézanne vineyard region south of Epernay, this producer's nonvintage cuvée is dominated by Chardonnay. It reflects the house style: crisp, steely with a good balance between acidity and citrus and apple fruitiness. Drink this refreshing Champagne now.
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Grande Sélection Brut  (Champagne)

description: This ripe creamy wine has sliced apple aromas and a smooth rich palate. The wine has apple and pear flavors, generous fruit along with a tang of acidity. A full mousse adds to the general feeling of richness. Drink now.
title: Jean Laurent NV Blanc de Blancs Réserve Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A touch of ripe pear plays into the Golden Delicious notes of the nose. The palate displays the same fruit flavors on its very light and easy fruit-driven palate, supported by freshness and fizzing froth. The lemony finish is dry and refreshing.
title: Willm NV Prestige Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Soft and creamy, this floral wine also has an attractive touch of toastiness suggesting it has bottle age. Its green-plum and citrus flavors contribute to the crispness of this balanced wine. Drink now.
title: Vollereaux NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Only just off dry, this finely balanced wine is tangy, zesty and rich. Its white-fruit flavors and touch of zingy lime are infectious and immediately attractive. Enjoy this stylish wine with Asian food.
title: Taittinger NV Nocturne City Lights Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: A creamy, apple-flavored wine that is crisp and fruity. It has lively acidity that is fresh and cool. A tight, mineral texture gives the wine a fine tangy edge. The aftertaste with its fresh pineapple acidity is so refreshing.
title: Monmousseau NV Cuvée J.M. Brut Sparkling (Touraine)

description: A creamy, apple-flavored wine that is crisp and fruity. It has lively acidity that is fresh and cool. A tight, mineral texture gives the wine a fine tangy edge. The aftertaste with its fresh pineapple acidity is so refreshing.
title: Monmousseau NV Cuvée J.M. Brut Sparkling (Touraine)

description: Notes of Turkish delight and peach immediately signal opulence. The palate follows up with distinct sweetness that underlines the rich rose and peach flavors even more. There is an edge of freshness, but only just. Yet the palate is intense and pervaded by peach. Whether this is about intensity or sweetness will depend entirely on the food it is paired with.
title: Martin Schaetzel 2013 Eichberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: There is an almost tropical touch to the apple and lemon fruit: this is almost like vanilla-spiced apple tart with lemon zest. Very appetizing with that unusual vanilla-edge and more of that tropical lychee. Overall, this is balanced and very fruit-driven.
title: Domaine Moltès 2014 Steinert Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very aromatic, gentle, almost floral notes of Cox's Orange Pippin appear with the first whiff. They get their full due on the off-dry palate which boosts the fruit flavors and paints them in a golden light. There is grip and backbone and ample fruit. Drink while the fruit is at its height: 2016–2018. Finishes off dry.
title: Domaine de la Tour Blanche 2012 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Rather perfumed, lifted notes of honeysuckle and the full force of lemon-drizzled honeydew melon make for a striking opening. The palate is bright and brings ample fruit: citrus-tempered apple, plums, apricots and peaches. This is joyous in its exuberance, even without much complexity. Drink soon.
title: Robert Klingenfus 2013 Bruderthal Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Ripe and fruity, this is still so fresh. Along with its crisp citrus flavors and touch of minerality, it has a pure, clean line of acidity. It is bright, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Delaporte 2014  Sancerre

description: Made with Chardonnay vinified in wood and old-vine Pinot Noir, this strongly flavored rosé has a tannic edge as well as red fruits. It is full bodied and rich, ready to drink.
title: Jeeper NV Grand Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This attractive wine is fresh and fruity, with raspberry flavors and a red cherry-skin edge of tannins. It is full and creamy, with a soft, ripe aftertaste. The bottling is ready to drink.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: With ripe fruits and balanced tannins, this wine is developing well. It has generous berry flavors, ripe black currants and refreshing acidity. The tannins are still prominent and need to soften. Drink from late 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine des Pontheux  (Chiroubles)

description: Creaminess, almost akin to cream soda, emanates from the glass and subdues the soft strawberry fruit. The palate has some of that creaminess, too, but is fresh and pleasingly taut, with bright freshness and a light, dry body. The fizz is frothy and altogether results in an immensely drinkable, easy-to-enjoy crémant.
title: Zusslin NV Brut Zéro Sans Soufre Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: In this balanced off-dry wine, all the elements of ripe fruit, a high dosage and crisp acidity come together. It is perfumed with white-flower aromas while the palate is soft with a ripe baked-apple flavor. The bottling is ready to drink.
title: Vollereaux NV Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: This nonvintage cuvée from Gobillard is crisp and fruity, with delicate apple and fresh pear flavors. It is a well-balanced, light wine, poised and stylish, showing fruit that contrasts the mineral-textured finish.
title: J. M. Gobillard et Fils NV Tradition Brut  (Champagne)

description: The nose gives little away but the palate holds red, rounded fruit diffused by frothy, lively fizz. The foamy bubbles spell exuberance and easy-drinking enjoyment. Dry, light and rounded, this is a perfect party wine in a most appealing shade of coppery pink.
title: Ruhlmann NV Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: A fruity, structured wine, dense and dark-hued, its black currant fruits giving a sense of lighter acidity. It's just coming into balance, so it will likely age well over the medium term.
title: Château de Ricaud 2010 Réserve des Coteaux  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: While there is a strong element of new wood in this wine, it also has plenty of ripe black fruits. So it makes a wine that is powerful, potentially complex in 4–5 years with richness and a solid, serious final character.
title: Château Hyot 2010  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Big, bold and juicy, with ripe black fruits that dominate the rich tannins. The power and concentration both promise a good future for this solid, full-bodied wine, so keep for 4–5 years.
title: Château Haut la Pointe 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Firmly tannic yet with enough sense of juicy fruit to act as a balance, this is a fine, rich wine, showing power and concentration with a solid, ripe structure. Give this wine at least five years to soften and round out.
title: Château Gigault 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Without any sweetening dosage, this is a bone-dry wine, so crisp and laden with a citrus and mineral texture. With its intense acidity and clean feel, it brings out all the feeling of the soil of Champagne (hence the name of the cuvée, the mother rock). Drink with food.
title: Yann Alexandre NV Roche Mère Brut  Nature  (Champagne)

description: Without any sweetening dosage, this is a bone-dry wine, so crisp and laden with a citrus and mineral texture. With its intense acidity and clean feel, it brings out all the feeling of the soil of Champagne (hence the name of the cuvée, the mother rock). Drink with food.
title: Yann Alexandre NV Roche Mère Brut  Nature  (Champagne)

description: This wine is soft and creamy with baked apple and pear flavors. A line of acidity gives freshness and a mineral edge, offering a texture that will allow the wine to age. Fruity and soft, it will be ready to drink from early 2016.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: This is a smooth and rounded wine with ripe yellow fruits as well as a crisp, sliced apple character. It is fruity and warm with its ripe, full flavors. Drink this generous wine now.
title: Jacques Charlet 2013 La Crochette  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This is a smooth and rounded wine with ripe yellow fruits as well as a crisp, sliced apple character. It is fruity and warm with its ripe, full flavors. Drink this generous wine now.
title: Jacques Charlet 2013 La Crochette  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This wine has structure and tannins. With ripe apples and quince flavors, it is tight, tense while also full in the mouth. A strong background of acidity gives concentration and considerable freshness at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This wine has structure and tannins. With ripe apples and quince flavors, it is tight, tense while also full in the mouth. A strong background of acidity gives concentration and considerable freshness at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Louis Latour 2013  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: This pale salmon rosé is fresh and clean. It opens with bright aromas of strawberry hull, watermelon rind and citrus peel that carry through to the linear yet vibrant palate. The palate boasts excellent verve and refreshment, making this a perfect choice for warm-weather enjoyment. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2014 Gris Blanc Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: This blend of Malbec, Merlot and Tannat is lean and austere—probably the effect of the vintage. That gives powerful tannins and less in the way of fruit. It's firm, hinting at more juicy fruit but likely to remain dry and structured. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2013 Clos Triguedina Red (Cahors)

description: Soft, ripe, red fruit-flavored Merlot gives a round character to this rich wine. It has plenty of spice, juicy acidity and gentle tannins that make it drinkable young.
title: Grand Bateau 2016 Sécret de Grand Bateau  (Bordeaux)

description: Soft, ripe, red fruit-flavored Merlot gives a round character to this rich wine. It has plenty of spice, juicy acidity and gentle tannins that make it drinkable young.
title: Grand Bateau 2016 Sécret de Grand Bateau  (Bordeaux)

description: Fortified Tannat makes for a rich while also tannic wine. Its sweet, jammy fruit and the opulence that comes from the addition of spirit are tempered by firm tannins. It should be aged for another year or two and will be best from 2019.
title: Famille Laplace 2013 Maydie Tannat Vintage Tannat (Madiran)

description: With vines close to the Garonne river south of Bordeaux, this small vineyard has produced a light and fruity wine with red berry flavors. It's soft, just lightly tannic and ready to drink now.
title: Clos des Justices 2014  Bordeaux

description: This wine is firm, dense and packed with tannins. Juicy acidity lends a crisp character to its dominant black currant fruit. It will take time to soften, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Terre Blanque 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This ripe wine is attractively fruity. It has generous tannins that are balanced by black fruit. While not very powerful or dense, it's easy and will be ready to open from 2019.
title: Château Pillebois 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is juicy, with ripe black fruit and tannins. It's dry and structured, with spicy pepper and nutmeg notes. With its pure fruitiness and lack of wood aging, it's likely to age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Nozières 2015 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: This fine estate has produced a ripe, fruity wine in 2014. It has spice from wood aging as well as juicy black currant fruit flavors. Generously textured, it's ready to drink.
title: Château Landereau 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Bright and fruity, this wine is attractive in black currant flavors. With its juicy balance of acidity and open fruit, it is developing quickly and will be ready from 2019.
title: Château Lacaussade Saint-Martin 2015 Trois Moulins  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a rich wine that has flavors of spice, apricot and almond, along with a touch of honey. Rich and full on the palate, it's a meal in itself, but finely balanced with intense fruitiness and light acidity. Drink now.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Trois Châteaux Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: As a Gewurztraminer becomes sweeter, it loses some of its spice. What it gains, as here, is a more intense, honeyed and fragrant character that also allows space for acidity. There is some dryness on the finish, as well as a pleasant astringency. Drink until 2019.
title: Joseph Cattin 2009 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a fully mature wine with an attractive mix of fresh acidity and intense perfumes. Bright and crisp on the palate, this textured wine finishes with white currant flavor. This is ready to drink now.
title: Trimbach 2010 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a fully mature wine with an attractive mix of fresh acidity and intense perfumes. Bright and crisp on the palate, this textured wine finishes with white currant flavor. This is ready to drink now.
title: Trimbach 2010 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This rich, boldy alcoholic wine has a pepper character that dominates fragrant fruit and spice notes. It should age well, so drink until 2020.
title: Rieflé 2011 Côte de Rouffach Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Petrol aromas lead to a wine that has ripe fruits balanced by intense acidity and delicious freshness. The palate is marked with flavors of almonds and red fruits with a crisp, bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Vallongue 2012 La Garrigues Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Petrol aromas lead to a wine that has ripe fruits balanced by intense acidity and delicious freshness. The palate is marked with flavors of almonds and red fruits with a crisp, bright aftertaste.
title: Domaine de la Vallongue 2012 La Garrigues Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: This is a ripe, full-bodied wine, packed with black berries, sweet tannins and a generous acidity. The wine has weight along with an open character that is already appealing. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine de Frégate 2009 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a ripe, full-bodied wine, packed with black berries, sweet tannins and a generous acidity. The wine has weight along with an open character that is already appealing. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine de Frégate 2009 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a dense wine, full of blackberries and ripe tannins. Juiciness gives the wine the fruitiness that's typical of the best of the vintage. Acidity at the end emphasizes the freshness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Trois Moulins 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This wine is perfumed with a high proportion of Cabernet Franc, giving structure and tannins as well as blackberry fruits. Like all the wines of the vintage, it is fruity although it balances that characteristic with the tight final texture. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Nenin 2013  Pomerol

description: This wine is perfumed with a high proportion of Cabernet Franc, giving structure and tannins as well as blackberry fruits. Like all the wines of the vintage, it is fruity although it balances that characteristic with the tight final texture. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Nenin 2013  Pomerol

description: While this wine has wood aromas, the palate also shows plenty of fruit. That combination gives it weight, spice and red-currant flavors along with juiciness. The wine has plenty of development ahead. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2013 Le Petit Mouton  (Pauillac)

description: After the promise of the wine at its initial barrel tasting, this bottled wine is less exciting. Berry fruits are muted by the extracted tannins. It's likely the wine will develop quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2013  Pauillac

description: While showing too much wood at the moment, this wine has potential. The red berries and black currants promise a fruity future with good tannins in support. Give the wine a few years and drink from 2019.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: While the tannins are still firm, this has the potential to be a fruity wine with attractive acidity. A juicy character will allow the wine to develop quickly. Sylviane Garcin-Cathiard also owns Clos L'Église in Pomerol, Château Barde-Haut in Saint-Émilion and Château Branon in Pessac Léognan.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine is full of bright fruit and attractive acidity. It's been made to take advantage of the fruitiness of the year and is likely to develop quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Ferrière 2013  Margaux

description: This wine is full of bright fruit and attractive acidity. It's been made to take advantage of the fruitiness of the year and is likely to develop quickly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Ferrière 2013  Margaux

description: The enthusiastic use of wood for this wine gives a dark, spicy character that masks any fruit. Less new wood would have helped highlight the natural fruitiness of the wine. Leave it until 2020 and the fruit may fill out. Winemaker Stephan Carrier returned from Napa to take over winemaking after Irish businessman Lochlann Quinn bought the property in 2001.
title: Château de Fieuzal 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: With an equal blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this firm wine has a juicy background, nurtured by consultant Hubert de Boüard (of Château Angelus). Chocolate and spice notes mix with the dry wood-aging character, while black currant flavors develop in the background. Give this wine until 2017.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2011  Graves

description: Situated close to the city of Bordeaux, this estate has produced a Cabernet-dominated wine that has some firm tannins and a dry core. The black-currant fruit shows well, with fresh acidity giving a juicy character. It will soften quickly, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Bellegrave du Poujeau 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: For a Lalande de Pomerol this wine has a high proportion (30%) of Cabernet Franc, giving a structure that shapes the ripe Merlot. It's juicy with black plums and has a core of dry tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Tournefeuille 2013  Lalande de Pomerol

description: This two-acre premier cru situated north of Beaune city gives smooth and rich wines. This bottling shows the acidity of the vintage while also having a full, round character, ripe with strawberries and crisp with acidity. The wine needs more time, so drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Arnoux Père et Fils 2014 En Genêt Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: There is a fine touch of spice in this wine. Bright and tangy, it is also full with white fruits, ripe acidity and a warm while zesty character. Still young and zesty, the wine will soften over the next few months into something more rounded. Drink from 2017.
title: Christophe Cordier 2014 En Faux  (Saint-Véran)

description: From vines aged between 40 and 80 years, this is a lightly wood-aged wine, with yellow fruits that go with the spicy toast. Full, ripe, and nicely cut with acidity, it has a creamy, smooth texture. Drink now.
title: Château Vitallis 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Crisp, tight and mineral, this classic wine has citrus and apple fruits filled out with creamed pear. The zingy texture is still young and vibrant. With intense acidity at the end, the wine could still develop, so drink from early 2017.
title: Château Vitallis 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: From one of the most familiar of the Meursault Premier Crus, this wine is crisp and mineral in character. It has tight acidity with apple and green-plum fruit that is laced by a light amount of wood aging. The wine is still young and will be better from 2018.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2014 Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: Ripe and juicy, this is a delicious, red-fruit wine. Its tannic structure lies well behind the generous fruitiness. With a dense texture and good acidity, the wine will be full and rich. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine de la Vougeraie 2014 Les Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Ripe and juicy, this is a delicious, red-fruit wine. Its tannic structure lies well behind the generous fruitiness. With a dense texture and good acidity, the wine will be full and rich. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine de la Vougeraie 2014 Les Marconnets Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This fresh, fruity wine also has a core of smoky tannins. It is both structured and offers plenty of bright red fruits. The wine is crisp, ripe with a dry core. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine de la Vougeraie 2014 Les Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: The softness of the 2000 vintage is reflected in this delicious, gentle, ripe wine. It is full of soft red fruits, lifted easily by the fresh red currant acidity and cranberry texture. It is showing signs of maturity, but still has several years to develop.
title: Pol Roger 2000 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The discrete Henriot labeling is echoed in this elegant wine. Like so many Henriot Champagnes it has good bottle age, shows toast as well as light red fruits. There is a depth of flavor here, the texture of yeasty mousse and apple skins going right through the taste. Ready to drink, but worth aging.
title: Henriot NV Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is great Champagne, in the bottle-aged Henriot style. It's a classic Chardonnay, ripe, creamy, packed with yellow fruits, and finely balanced with a great waft of toast. A high percentage of older vintages in the blend gives this wine richness, maturity, without ever losing its crisp edge.
title: Henriot NV Blanc Souverain Pur Chardonnay Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A great wine, much more than only a Champagne, this is impressively rich and ripe, with crisp yellow fruits, spices and layers of toast. It's in an opulent style that is round but also very focused on tight layers of fruit, minerality and final vivid acidity.
title: Charles Heidsieck NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: Lightweight wine that seems somewhat dilute with flavors of green plums, bright acidity and a very soft texture.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2008  Petit Chablis

description: Lightweight wine that seems somewhat dilute with flavors of green plums, bright acidity and a very soft texture.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2008  Petit Chablis

description: Light pink in the glass with soft aromas and flavors of strawberry and blueberry. Delicate and refreshing; a great choice for hot summer days.
title: Mas Belles Eaux 2008 Rosé (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Pleasant, soft wine, easy to drink, its fruits round and somewhat dilute. It doesn't resonate, but is certainly fresh and crisp.
title: Domaine Jayer-Gilles 2007  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune

description: Pleasant, soft wine, easy to drink, its fruits round and somewhat dilute. It doesn't resonate, but is certainly fresh and crisp.
title: Domaine Jayer-Gilles 2007  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune

description: An interesting Chard that offers quite sweet notes of stewed peaches, orange marmalade and overripe honeydew. Big and a bit clumsy in the mouth, more vibrancy and freshness is needed to keep things in better balance. However, if you like 'em sweeter, this one's for you.
title: Domaine de Guiot 2008 Les Jumeaux Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Blending Pinot Noir and Gamay, this wine comes from a new Burgundy-wide appellation that can include fruit from Beaujolais. It's a style of wine that needs to be drunk young and fruity, with black cherry flavors and refreshing acidity. Drink this lively wine now.
title: Louis Max 2014  Coteaux Bourguignons

description: This fresh, fruity wine is full of red cherry and berry flavors. A light touch of tannin holds the fruit and acidity together. It's a fine, simple Burgundy, ready to be drunk now.
title: Louis Max 2013 Beaucharme  (Bourgogne)

description: Both nose and palate need waking up. It is only with intense swishing that some apple freshness emerges on the rather broad palate. A streak of tart apple acidity rescues this.
title: Joseph Cattin 2014 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a soft and fruity wine, ripe with red-berry fruits and perfumed acidity. A light touch of caramel and tannin give the right structure, and the aftertaste is bright and fruity.
title: Le Cercle des Vignerons Saint-Louis 2014 Lumière de Provence Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Lovely notes of ripe apple with an orange peel touch play on the nose. They also appear on the dry, juicy and very fruit-driven palate. All is driven and slender, fresh but ripe. The fruit is so burgeoning that this is still juicy, even on the apple-scented finish.
title: Joseph Cattin 2015 Hatschbourg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose is shy and does not give much away. On the palate, beautifully pure red currant and tart red-cherry notes come through. The slender body is pervaded by freshness and has lovely overtones of conifer and oak leaf. It is later on that the fine but firm structure comes to bear. This is light but has depth and the potential to develop.
title: René Muré 2015 Signature Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The nose is shy and does not give much away. On the palate, beautifully pure red currant and tart red-cherry notes come through. The slender body is pervaded by freshness and has lovely overtones of conifer and oak leaf. It is later on that the fine but firm structure comes to bear. This is light but has depth and the potential to develop.
title: René Muré 2015 Signature Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A really taut wine, this is very nervy. It brings out the ageworthy qualities of fine Alsace Riesling, offering white fruits and fragrant acidity. Crisp and fruity on the surface, it is steely right at its core. Keep for 3–5 years.
title: Zusslin 2010 Clos Liebenberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: A very aromatic, wood aged wine. It shows great richness and spice from the wood, along with white fruits. The wine also has freshness, in the form of lime and plums. There is a taut, lively aftertaste. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Saget la Perrière 2010 Domaine des Grandes Esperances Aurora Chenin Blanc (Touraine Amboise)

description: A very aromatic, wood aged wine. It shows great richness and spice from the wood, along with white fruits. The wine also has freshness, in the form of lime and plums. There is a taut, lively aftertaste. Age for 4–5 years.
title: Saget la Perrière 2010 Domaine des Grandes Esperances Aurora Chenin Blanc (Touraine Amboise)

description: Full, fragrant and very perfumed, this is a beautiful ripe wine that is already showing signs of maturity. Its fragrant white fruit flavors are touched by minerality and texture. It could still be aged for another 2–3 years. The name recalls the local legend of the dragon who  fought the sun.
title: Josmeyer 2011 Le Dragon Riesling (Alsace)

description: The ultra-steep Kirchberg de Barr vineyards can give ripe wines such as this from its great exposure. The wine has a ripe character, the yellow fruits cut through with lively acidity, a perfumed character. Fruity, likely to age over the next 3–5 years.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2011 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: So elegant, a wine with just a fine balance. It has creamy apple fruit flavors, hedgerow fruits, with a line of crisp acidity to cut through the fruitiness and give a more mineral edge. It will be worth aging this wine for 2–3 years. Drink after 2014.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2012 Glintzberg Riesling (Alsace)

description: Just off dry, this is a rounded soft wine that takes its name after the sun god Apollo from the sunny exposure of the vineyard. It has a rounded, generous feel as a foil to its more steely, crisp character. A wine that certainly needs aging for 3–4 years.
title: Cave Freudenreich 2011 Terre d'Apollon Riesling (Alsace)

description: Even at four years of age, this shows great purity of fruit. Black cherries laced with garrigue mark the nose, while the cherries expand to coat the palate, adding hints of leather and baking spices. Ready to drink now, but it should easily last through 2020.
title: E. Guigal 2009  Gigondas

description: A structured wine with tannins from wood aging, as well as rich blackberry fruit. The wine has fruit and structural intensity, layering spice and juiciness atop a dry core. Keep for 3–5 years.
title: Domaine les Pins 2011 Le Clos Cabernet Franc (Bourgueil)

description: Laurence Féraud, the stylish power behind Domaine de Pégaü in Châteauneuf-du-Pape, also produces her own négociant line of wines. This Gigondas is a top example, boasting intriguing scents of sweaty leather and peppery, clove-like spice, plenty of weight and structure on the palate and a long, firm finish. Drink now–2024.
title: Sélection Laurence Féraud 2009  Gigondas

description: Celebrating 500 years as grape growers, the Mellot family offers this top Sancerre. It is rounded and spicy with a touch of wood to add to its rich character. Apricots and pineapple are a delicious addition to the citrus acidity that cuts right through the wine. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Joseph Mellot 2010 La Grande Châtelaine  (Sancerre)

description: Subtitled Vin de Lune, moon wine, because the grapes were harvested at night. That has allowed the wine to preserve its freshness with lively acidity and fresh red currant flavors.
designation: Clos Triguedina Le Rosé du Clos
region: Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2007 Clos Triguedina Le Rosé du Clos Malbec (Vin de Pays du Comté Tolosan)

description: This is powerful and rich, allowing just a note of freshness to creep into the firm structure. Dark tannins, black fruits and smoky wood flavors combine harmoniously, lending a sense of great power and long-term aging potential. Drink from 2019.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Le Corton  (Corton)

description: This is powerful and rich, allowing just a note of freshness to creep into the firm structure. Dark tannins, black fruits and smoky wood flavors combine harmoniously, lending a sense of great power and long-term aging potential. Drink from 2019.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011 Le Corton  (Corton)

description: Initially, this is a richly ripe wine with tropical fruit flavors. It also has an immense sense of structure that supports the fruit impressively. It's dense, concentrated, exuding power and solidity, while always keeping a sense of elegance. Drink from 2018.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2011  Chevalier-Montrachet

description: This is full of fruit and weighty tannins. Coming from one of the finest vineyards in Burgundy, it is going to have great power and an opulent nature. This wine also has elegance, its black fruits controlled and with a mineral edge. That doesn't take away the power, it enhances the stylishness of this grand wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Domaine Rossignol-Trapet 2011  Chambertin

description: In this unbalanced, medium-dry wine, the fruit, the acidity and the sweetness don't seem to want to hang together. At the end, the acidity wins, while the rest of the wine is left behind.
title: Bougrier 2013 V Douce France  (Vouvray)

description: Cut with sulfur, this is a wine whose bitterness hides the potential of the strawberry fruits and acidity. Off-dry, it's unbalanced.
title: Bougrier 2013  Rosé d'Anjou

description: The bouquet of this wine is quite forward and floral, with strong scents of carnation, violet and lavender. The fruit appears secondary to the herbal backbone, with a touch of blueberry and cocoa making an appearance on the mouthwatering close. Drink now.
title: Domaine Saint Antonin 2009 Red (Faugères)

description: This is rounded, rich, missing some acidity but with the compensation of ripe yellow fruits layered with pineapple and spice from wood. With all its sweetness, it is not for aging.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2009 Clos Rochette  (Mercurey)

description: The off-dry version of Vaugondy's Vouvray brings out ripe apple as well as pineapple and lemon flavors. It is still crisp, packed with acidity, rounded out with finishing sweetness.
title: Domaine de Vaugondy 2010 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: The off-dry version of Vaugondy's Vouvray brings out ripe apple as well as pineapple and lemon flavors. It is still crisp, packed with acidity, rounded out with finishing sweetness.
title: Domaine de Vaugondy 2010 Demi-Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Lean cherry, strawberry and red plum aromas start off the nose of this wine, and gradually subside to reveal a stony, flinty streak augmented with soft garrigue herbs. Soft spice and ripe fruit continue in the medium-weight mouth, the fine grain tannins coating your palate and staying through the slightly chewy and fudgy close. Mature now, so drink up.
title: Cuvée Valentin Duc 2007 Red (Faugères)

description: Lean cherry, strawberry and red plum aromas start off the nose of this wine, and gradually subside to reveal a stony, flinty streak augmented with soft garrigue herbs. Soft spice and ripe fruit continue in the medium-weight mouth, the fine grain tannins coating your palate and staying through the slightly chewy and fudgy close. Mature now, so drink up.
title: Cuvée Valentin Duc 2007 Red (Faugères)

description: Mainly Grenache (80%, the balance is Syrah) aged entirely in tank, this wine features loads of superripe dark cherries and plums, yet with a savory, olive-and meat-tinged aspect as well. Full-bodied, with a velvety texture and a long finish, it should drink well through at least 2016.
title: Vindemio 2009 Amadeus Red (Ventoux)

description: Mainly Grenache (80%, the balance is Syrah) aged entirely in tank, this wine features loads of superripe dark cherries and plums, yet with a savory, olive-and meat-tinged aspect as well. Full-bodied, with a velvety texture and a long finish, it should drink well through at least 2016.
title: Vindemio 2009 Amadeus Red (Ventoux)

description: Spicy, with wood there as well as tannins, this is a dark, extracted wine. There is stalkiness, balanced with dense berry fruits and final acidity.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2008  Pessac-Léognan

description: A finely structured wine, well spiced with ripe berry fruits and intense but balanced acidity. This is stylish, attractive and is worth aging for 3-4 years.
title: Château Labat 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: Foursquare, solid wine, its tannins tight and severe. There is good weight, with red berry fruits under the formidable exterior. To watch as it softens and opens.
title: Chateau Dauzac 2008  Margaux

description: This is very black currant in character, with crisp fresh fruits to go with the bright acidity. There are tannins certainly, lightened by the fruity character of the wine.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2008  Pauillac

description: A wine that seems lean, even angular at first. It does, though, have a good depth of black plum skin fruits. The finish continues the tough theme, showing that it needs several years of softening up.
title: Château Croizet-Bages 2008  Pauillac

description: This crisp, lively rosé is balanced between ripe red fruits and the tight, mineral texture. A high proportion of Pinot Meunier in the blend adds extra fruitiness. With tangy acidity as well as richness, it's ready to drink now.
title: Liebart-Régnier NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The wine has good ripe red fruits as well as layers of tannin. It has some concentration and weight behind juicy acidity. It will develop well and should be ready from 2017.
title: Domaine de Courteillac 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a fruity wine, full of red-berry flavors and with some smoky tannins in the background. It is balanced between the wood aging and the berry and red-cherry fruitiness. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Terres Douces 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a wine with fine tannins and plenty of ripe fruit. It has good potential with fruit and structure working well together. Spice and a rich aftertaste suggest a wine that will be fine from 2018.
title: Château Montlau 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a wine with fine tannins and plenty of ripe fruit. It has good potential with fruit and structure working well together. Spice and a rich aftertaste suggest a wine that will be fine from 2018.
title: Château Montlau 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has a dual nature, displaying both herbal and citrus characteristics. A crisp texture and some spiciness indicate its youth. It will be better with some age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château les Clauzots 2015  Graves

description: A bright juicy wine, this has acidity, red-berry fruits and a touch of black currants. This is an attractive wine already, just needing a few months to settle down. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lauduc 2014 Classic  (Bordeaux)

description: Jean Lissague's blend of 90% Sauvignon Blanc and 10% Muscadelle is soft and full in the mouth with just enough acidity to keep it crisp. Melon and spiced-lemon create a tangy touch that gives the wine an edginess. Drink now.
title: Château Grand Secret 2015 Petit Secret  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Moulin's gravelly four-acre Merlot plot offered up plenty of fruit for a ripe and smooth wine. It has tannins that are under the red-berry fruits. Hints of wood aging and ripe fruitiness combine to give a wine with good potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Grand Moulin 2014 Prélude du Grand Moulin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Moulin's gravelly four-acre Merlot plot offered up plenty of fruit for a ripe and smooth wine. It has tannins that are under the red-berry fruits. Hints of wood aging and ripe fruitiness combine to give a wine with good potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Grand Moulin 2014 Prélude du Grand Moulin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Fresh with fine acidity, this is a crisp wine. Red-currant fruit flavors are the dominant character, supported by some firm tannins. It is juicy and perfumed. Drink this Michel Boyer wine from 2018.
title: Château du Cros 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a rich juicy wine. It has red berry fruits and jammy acidity that integrates well with the soft tannic structure. It's a wine to drink soon, so just wait until early 2017.
title: Château des Antonins 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a perfumed wine with mint flavors from the wood aging. It has black-currant fruitiness that brings out acidity as well as tannins. The aftertaste is still young and fruity and the wine needs to age until 2017.
title: Château Carignan 2013  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a perfumed wine with mint flavors from the wood aging. It has black-currant fruitiness that brings out acidity as well as tannins. The aftertaste is still young and fruity and the wine needs to age until 2017.
title: Château Carignan 2013  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This creamy wine offers attractive red fruits and balanced acidity. It is on the sweeter side of brut, giving a soft, ripe fruit character to this easy, ready-to-drink wine.
title: Heidsieck & Co Monopole NV Rose Top Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Ripe while also juicy, this is a fruity wine that is full of red fruits and a spicy texture from wood aging. Drink from 2019.
title: Vignobles Arno 2014 Château Godard Bellevue  (Francs Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: From schist soil, this tight and mineral-driven wine has crisp acidity enmeshed in the taut texture. This complex, young-tasting wine, with its structure, needs to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Bonnet-Huteau 2013 Les Dabinières Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: The Grandlieu lake, to the west of the Sèvre et Maine Muscadet vineyards, produces softer wines, like this. This wine is ripe, with hints of toast and vanilla as well as fresh and crisp apple acidity. It's a full-bodied, rounded wine that is just ready to drink and will be better from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'Aujardière 2013 La Noë Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: This is so pale in color, it's almost a white wine in looks and in flavor. It has crisp white fruits with the merest touch of raspberry, backed by minerality and finishing with delicious juicy acidity.
title: Bernard Magrez 2014 Château des Muraires Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Light, fresh and fruity, this is a lime and lemon flavored wine. It has a tangy, textured character that blends easily with the acidity. From a blend led by Grenache and Cinsault, it's a lively wine that will be a great apéritif.
title: Domaine Val d'Astier 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Still young with attractive fresh fruits, this wine needs to age. With its bright acidity and white fruits, it's just beginning to hint at the mineral structure behind. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Ellevin 2013 Vaucoupin Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: A blend of Syrah and Grenache from organic vineyards gives a herbal, very southern taste to this ripe wine. It is still young and showing both acidity and a firm structure. As it develops further, it will get a rich, full and plummy character. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine des Aspras 2013 Les Trois Frères Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from the organic vineyards of Les Baux, this wine is pale in color but full of fruity flavor. The blend is Grenache (50%), Cinsault (30%) and Syrah (20%). It has a crisp, mineral texture that's tangy and fragrant with white flowers and red currants, giving it delicious apéritif style.
title: Domaine de la Vallongue 2014 Garrigues Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: A beautifully pale rosé from the north slopes of the Montagne de Reims, this is fruity while also having a crisp texture. It's a raspberry, red currant flavored wine that is shot through with grapefruit acidity. Perfumed and ready to drink.
designation: Face Nord Rosé Grand Cru Brut
title: Pehu-Simonet NV Face Nord Rosé Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: A beautifully pale rosé from the north slopes of the Montagne de Reims, this is fruity while also having a crisp texture. It's a raspberry, red currant flavored wine that is shot through with grapefruit acidity. Perfumed and ready to drink.
designation: Face Nord Rosé Grand Cru Brut
title: Pehu-Simonet NV Face Nord Rosé Grand Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: In the dry style of Blin Champagnes, this is a fruity and very crisp wine. Sliced apples and crisp pears are cut with pink grapefruit and other citrus flavors. It is fresh with acidity that balances the fruit. The texture at the end is soft, lightly mineral.
title: H. Blin NV Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: Santa Duc's small parcel of Châteauneuf-du-Pape is planted to a mix of 95% Grenache and 5% Mourvèdre. It's a peppery, briary wine that's savory and spicy, with blackberry fruit providing support rather than leading. The tannins are soft, but still provide ample structure for aging through 2020.
title: Domaine Santa Duc 2010 Habemus Papam Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Santa Duc's small parcel of Châteauneuf-du-Pape is planted to a mix of 95% Grenache and 5% Mourvèdre. It's a peppery, briary wine that's savory and spicy, with blackberry fruit providing support rather than leading. The tannins are soft, but still provide ample structure for aging through 2020.
title: Domaine Santa Duc 2010 Habemus Papam Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Textbook Jamet, with flamboyant swirls of cracked pepper, grilled meat, plum, berry, black olive and espresso finishing long and silky. It's not the biggest or baddest Côte Rôtie, but it remains a benchmark for elegance and balance. Drink now–2027.
title: Domaine Jamet 2009  Côte Rôtie

description: Textbook Jamet, with flamboyant swirls of cracked pepper, grilled meat, plum, berry, black olive and espresso finishing long and silky. It's not the biggest or baddest Côte Rôtie, but it remains a benchmark for elegance and balance. Drink now–2027.
title: Domaine Jamet 2009  Côte Rôtie

description: This is a rich, ripe Condrieu that manages to avoid seeming excessively weighty or oily. The suggestion of grilled apricot and pineapple slices is balanced by mouthwatering acidity and a slightly peppery, textural grip on the long finish. Drink by 2016.
title: Michel & Stéphane Ogier 2011 La Combe de Malleval  (Condrieu)

description: This is a rich, perfumed wine, with spice from new wood, a rich texture and dense red berry fruit. Its structure and concentration suggest it will age further, so wait until late 2018 to drink.
title: Domaine Vico 2015 Red (Corse)

description: Pale in color, this oak-aged wine is soft, with juicy red fruit. It offers cinnamon and nutmeg flavors, as well as a smoky character from the wood. It finishes with intense, juicy acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Dugois 2016 La Sombarde Poulsard (Arbois)

description: Pale in color, this oak-aged wine is soft, with juicy red fruit. It offers cinnamon and nutmeg flavors, as well as a smoky character from the wood. It finishes with intense, juicy acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Dugois 2016 La Sombarde Poulsard (Arbois)

description: This wine is smooth, floral and lightly honeyed. With tangy acidity that balances its creamy texture, it's also full, rich and stylish. Produced from the Vermentino grape (Vermentinu in the local dialect), it's generous and ready to drink.
title: Clos Alivu 2016 Vermentino (Patrimonio)

description: This wine has intense acidity and a tight texture that will obviously need time to open up, but ripe apricot and honey flavors are present now. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Rabaud-Promis 2014 Raymond Louis  (Sauternes)

description: Smooth with polished new wood flavors and fine black fruit, this wine has good potential. Subtle tannins back up its black currant and berry fruit. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Magdeleine Bouhou 2015 Grand Vin  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This finely structured wine is ripe and full of blackberry flavors, with a soft, rich texture. That suggests it will age relatively quickly and be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château La Roche Bazin 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This honeyed white wine made from late-harvest grapes is both intensely rich and so fresh and crisp. Its acidity cuts through the ripe apricot and candied orange flavors, creating a balance that will allow it to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Jolys 2015  Jurançon

description: This is a powerful wood-aged wine. Spice and toast aromas give it a firm character that will need to soften. Its black plum and berry fruit is upfront, with a juicy element that will fill out. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Haut Sociondo 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is closed at this young stage but hints at an underlying richness. That leaves acidity and fragrant lemongrass-like crispness at the fore. It needs time to fill out, so drink from 2021.
title: Château Guiraud 2014 Petit Guiraud  (Sauternes)

description: Big, bold and spicy, this wine is ripe with black fruit. Tannins and a rich texture confirm its upfront style. Likely to take its time to develop, it will be ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château Glorit 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is soft and ripe, with juicy black fruit and fresh acidity over a background of firm tannins. A smoky edge adds to its attractiveness.
title: Château Berthenon 2015 Cuvée Henri  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a rich style of Sauvignon Blanc, the natural acidity rounded out by warmer fruits, currants, spice and a sense of structure. It is young, like many Pouilly Fumés at this stage, and will be best in 2015.
title: Sauvion 2012 Loire Valley  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Just beginning to mature, this generous wine has fine red berry fruits, a smoky character, touches of wood aging and further potential. It shows acidity with a juicy red cherry aftertaste. Drink now and until 2019.
title: Vignoble de la Jarnoterie 2011 Les Terres Noires  (Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil)

description: A full-bodied, slightly oxidative wine that wears its character well. There is a toastiness here along with some apple and apricot fruits, giving a rich feel to the wine. It's ready to drink but can also continue to age until 2017–2018.
title: Andre et Mireille Tissot 2011 Les Graviers Chardonnay (Arbois)

description: A wine that already shows some of the typical oxidative character of Savagnin. It creates a wine that has great style, richness and wonderful tangy, smoky character. It could age further, although it's ready to drink now.
title: Andre et Mireille Tissot 2010 Savagnin (Arbois)

description: From the home vineyards of the Saget family, this a warm and generous wine. While endowed with many green Sauvignon Blanc characteristics, the tropical fruit style makes it feel rich. As it ages, it will offer even more complex flavors. Drink from 2015.
title: Saget la Perrière 2012 Le Domaine  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Still young, this intense wine is packed with tropical and citrus fruits. It is also structured, textured with a chalky, mineral feel. This is a wine that feels rich and that needs several years aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 La Demoiselle de Bourgeois  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: The largest appellation in the Côte Chalonnaise produces here a foursquare, solid wine. It has red fruits, although the structure is what is dominant at this stage. There is a dry, smoky, meaty flavor that marches with the final acidity.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2011 Buissonnier  (Mercurey)

description: A wine with some structure, firm tannins and attractive black cherry and spice flavors. The wine has good weight and a dense texture that promises medium-term aging.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine de Lafayette  (Brouilly)

description: Tight acidity with a strong minerality, apple and apricot flavors just touched by vanilla. This is fruity, while also textured and structured. Worth aging, so drink from 2015.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2011 Broc de Biques  (Chablis)

description: Tight acidity with a strong minerality, apple and apricot flavors just touched by vanilla. This is fruity, while also textured and structured. Worth aging, so drink from 2015.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2011 Broc de Biques  (Chablis)

description: The fruity characteristics are the star of this wine, with heady notes of forest berry, red plum and cherry that flood the nose and mouth. Accents of chocolate, menthol and sweet smoke add depth, but play a delicate supporting role to the fleshy fruit core. Medium weight, with fine tannins and a fairly easygoing structure.
title: Domaine du Clos des Fées 2010 Les Sorcières Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: The fruity characteristics are the star of this wine, with heady notes of forest berry, red plum and cherry that flood the nose and mouth. Accents of chocolate, menthol and sweet smoke add depth, but play a delicate supporting role to the fleshy fruit core. Medium weight, with fine tannins and a fairly easygoing structure.
title: Domaine du Clos des Fées 2010 Les Sorcières Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: Soft and rich, a wine that shows the warmth of the vintage in this southern Burgundy appellation. It's full of yellow fruits with just a hint of pineapple along with a good line in acidity. A sense of minerality and texture appears at the end.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2010  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Hints of earthy spice and bark add interest to the somewhat muted blackberry and black plum aromas. The wine opens up more on the palate, revealing a lush and creamy texture, with dense blackberry flavors and a sweet oak and vanilla spice that lingers through the finish.
title: Domaine Cabirau 2011 Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: This is a structured, fruity wine, with red cherry flavors that go well with the drier edge of tannin. It has a layer of acidity that cuts through the ripe fruit showing a more ageworthy character. Keep this wine for 2–3 years, although with its fruitiness it can be drunk now.
title: Château des Jean-Loron 2010 Les Gandelins  (Chénas)

description: This Syrah-dominant blend, with 25% Carignan and 5% Grenache, leads with oak-driven aromas of charred cedar, sweet smoke and vanilla bean that envelop the ripe blackberry and cherry fruit tones. The palate is lush and full, with a creamy roundness that's partially lifted by generous spicy notes of garrigue, licorice root and black pepper on the close.
title: Bernard Magrez 2010 Passion d'une Vie Red (Côtes du Roussillon)

description: Celebrating the founding in 1875 of Antonin Rodet, this ripe, perfumed wine has red fruits that are opulent, gloriously drinkable already. It's ripe, softly textured, layered with delicate acidity.
title: Antonin Rodet 2010 Héritage Rodet  (Mercurey)

description: Celebrating the founding in 1875 of Antonin Rodet, this ripe, perfumed wine has red fruits that are opulent, gloriously drinkable already. It's ripe, softly textured, layered with delicate acidity.
title: Antonin Rodet 2010 Héritage Rodet  (Mercurey)

description: The region's most widely available wine remains a solid benchmark. Exotic aromas of citrus blossom and tropical fruit make a bold impression, followed up on the palate by ample weight and a touch of oiliness. Drink now–2016.
title: E. Guigal 2011  Condrieu

description: Blueberry, blackberry and boysenberry all abound on the nose and palate of this easy-pleasing and accessible wine. Fine tannins and medium acidity create an approachable structure, while hints of crushed violet and chocolate add richness to the finish.
title: Laurent Miquel 2010 Père et Fils Syrah-Grenache Syrah-Grenache (Pays d'Oc)

description: This dry, full-bodied selection benefits from the rich Pinot in the blend. It has a tight, minerally texture, its acidity cutting the flavors of lime juice and orange zest.
title: Aubry NV Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: From the lesser-quality 2006 vintage, this is a gentle and tangy selection. It has lemon zest and steely acidity, with light touches of grapefruit and crisp apple. Not for aging, this is an attractive wine to drink now.
title: Michel Moritz 2006 Noblesse d'Or Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: This intensely crisp selection shows its red-currant-driven acidity immediately. It is a fragrant, refreshing wine, very food-oriented with its dry character. It has touch of toast and a taut, minerally finish.
title: Tendil & Lombardi NV Rosé de Saignée Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: The wine has simple red-berry flavors and a light layer of tannins. The acidity is probably too intense—a product of the vintage. But it is an attractive wine to drink now, finishing with its crisp aftertaste.
title: Château de Chambrun 2013  Lalande de Pomerol

description: The wine has simple red-berry flavors and a light layer of tannins. The acidity is probably too intense—a product of the vintage. But it is an attractive wine to drink now, finishing with its crisp aftertaste.
title: Château de Chambrun 2013  Lalande de Pomerol

description: A Sauvignon Blanc-dominated wine that is crisp while also having some weight and fatness from the Sémillon in the blend. It is full of fruit, with lemon and crisp apple flavors. The aftertaste is tight and tangy with lemon zest.
title: Exem 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The high elevation of Chiroubles has produced a crisp, cool and stylish wine. It has juicy cherry fruit and bright acidity. The wine is developing quickly and will be ready to drink from early 2017.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2015 Chatenay  (Chiroubles)

description: Sémillon, so adept at producing botrytized grapes for sweet wines gives its richness and fine apricot flavors to this ripe wine. Sweet while kept from cloying by its acidity, it is an opulent wine, with honey and fine almond and marzipan flavors at the end. Drink from early 2017.
title: Cheval Quancard 2015  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The wine is full of bright fruit and acidity. It does still have a dry tannic core that gives it a firm character. The juicy acidity and crisp texture show it is still young. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château Tour Chapoux 2014  Bordeaux

description: The fact that there is 60% Cabernet Franc in this blend gives the wine a real perfumed attractiveness. It is fruity and light, with a crisp lively character. Red berries and plenty of acidity leave a fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château Landereau 2015 La Vie en Rose Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a mature, wood-aged wine. It is rich in yellow fruits and toast flavors. It does retain a crisper, citrus side that keeps it fruity. The wines are vegan (no animal products in production). It is ready to drink.
title: Chateau Haut Rian 2013 Excellence  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: As always, this attractive non-vintage Champagne is light, fruity and fragrant. It has crisp apple, pear and green-plum flavors and a refreshing citrus acidity. It is full in the mouth, but finishes with a reverberating softness.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a full-bodied rosé, with rich fruit and spice notes. Its ripe apricot and strawberry flavors are lifted by balanced acidity. Drink now.
title: La Bastide Blanche 2012 Rosé (Bandol)

description: Crisp with brisk acidity, yet bright with citrus and yellow fruit, this wine shows structure as well as warmth. It's a textured wine that can age over the medium term. Drink now–2018.
designation: Cuvée Signature Les Macherelles Premier Cru
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2011 Cuvée Signature Les Macherelles Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Vincent Couche has a specialty with very dry Champagne. This wine, with some bottle age, is rich, warm and generous, yet quite dry. A touch of toast adds complexity to ripe apple fruits.
title: Vincent Couche NV Perle de Nacre Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Ripe and creamy, this wine is full of rich apricot, peach and mango flavors. The wood aging shows through in the form of exotic vanilla. Brisk with acidity, the palate is light and crisp, finishing with refreshing minerality. It's ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2011 Ancestral  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: The Deutz style, with its lilting, dancing mouthfeel, is well illustrated by this non-vintage cuvée. It is bright and fruity, with crisp apple and pear fruits and tight acidity. but showing some signs of good bottle aging as well.
title: Deutz NV Brut Classic  (Champagne)

description: With a good depth of flavor, this is a rich wine, showing a touch of toast to go with its grapefruit flavor and apple skin texture. It's a wine that tends towards dry, with a bright acidity and a lively burst of mousse on the finish.
title: Cheurlein-Panfilo NV Le Medaillon Cuvée Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: A fruity style, not powerful but bright, with some rich strawberry jam flavors. It has an edge of tannins as well as spice, dried fruits and a cool, soft aftertaste.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2008 Domaine Mont Chavy  (Morgon)

description: Made from Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs, this intensely crisp and fresh wine is maturing well, although it's nowhere near ready to drink. It is a fine wine: tight, steely, mineral in character with citrus acidity balanced by warmer apricot and crisp apples. Drink from 2018. The Special Club is a group of growers who rate and taste each other's wines before release.
designation: Special Club Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2009 Special Club Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Made from Chardonnay from the Côte des Blancs, this intensely crisp and fresh wine is maturing well, although it's nowhere near ready to drink. It is a fine wine: tight, steely, mineral in character with citrus acidity balanced by warmer apricot and crisp apples. Drink from 2018. The Special Club is a group of growers who rate and taste each other's wines before release.
designation: Special Club Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2009 Special Club Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Named after the Roman emperor who allowed planting of vines in Cahors (and elsewhere in France), this wine is a fine expression of rich, concentrated Malbec. It is powered by its tannins and young black fruits at this stage and needs several years to present its full, rich and concentrated potential. From 2019, this will be a serious wine.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2013 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: Despite the age, the color of this wine is still impressively vibrant and the ripe fruit and dense structure both speak of a wine that is still developing even nine years later. Such is longevity of a great Malbec. Blackberry fruit flavors charge through this wine that's reached the point of balance with the tannins. Drink now, although the wine will still be developing in 2018.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2007 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: Despite the age, the color of this wine is still impressively vibrant and the ripe fruit and dense structure both speak of a wine that is still developing even nine years later. Such is longevity of a great Malbec. Blackberry fruit flavors charge through this wine that's reached the point of balance with the tannins. Drink now, although the wine will still be developing in 2018.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2007 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is an over-soft wine, without real bite or crispness. It is pleasantly creamy, with almond flavors and a full mousse, but the soft character continues right through to the finish.
title: Louis Barthélémy NV Brut Améthyste  (Champagne)

description: This is an over-soft wine, without real bite or crispness. It is pleasantly creamy, with almond flavors and a full mousse, but the soft character continues right through to the finish.
title: Louis Barthélémy NV Brut Améthyste  (Champagne)

description: Based in the Aube in southern Champagne, Fluteau's vineyards are in the Seine valley. This crisp, tight and dry wine is balanced although still young. Textured crisp apple and lemon flavors have a taut, nervy character. It needs to age for a few more months, so drink from 2016.
title: Fluteau 2006 Cuvée Symbiose  (Champagne)

description: Rich, this offers both bright crisp citrus fruits and ripe peach and pear flavors. It is still young, still textured and tight, needing to broaden to bring out more of the attractive fruitiness. Drink from 2016.
title: Bruno Cormerais 2012 Chambaudière Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: With its wood aging and rich, concentrated black cherry fruits, this is an impressive wine. Aged for 18 months in wood, it is a special selection that brings out rich fruits, a ripe structure and some aging potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2011 Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup  (Fleurie)

description: The granite soil and ocean climate of Château-Thébaud—plus two years aging in tank—give this wine good richness while also retaining the crisper aspects of Muscadet. A delicate salty character lies over the final delicious apple and citrus flavors.
title: Domaine Clair Moreau 2010 Château-Thébaud  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Bulky, chunky lemony aromas come with a touch of green hay, or is it alfalfa? The mouth is entirely grapefruit and orange, making it citrus all the way. A stony, gravelly quality to the finish could be interpreted as mineral. The weight is on the heavy side, which costs the wine some style points.
title: Domaine Denis Gaudry 2000 Pouilly-Fumé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This Bordeaux white is heavily oaked, and it's therefore overloaded with coconut aromas, creamy custard and pear flavors, and a taste of banana on the finish. At every point along the way the wood towers over the fruit, which ultimately makes the wine duller than it could be.
title: Château de Rochemorin 2000 White  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Richly textured wine, full of ripe and spicy fruit, the acidity just a hint behind the dried honey and watermelon flavors. It is full-bodied, ripe, packed with intense fruit flavors. A wine for aging over 3–4 years.
title: Joseph Cattin 2009 Hatschbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Pure sweetness, the wine has a rich texture with just a hint of botrytis but plenty of opulent spice, very rounded and unctuous. It is just beginning to show maturity, but could easily age further, the sweetness so well integrated into the orange zest finish.
title: Joseph Cattin 2007 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Just released, this latest non-vintage from Jacquesson is very steely, austere, cool and elegant with apple and citrus acidity. It has freshness and balance. Still young, but very complete.
title: Jacquesson et Fils NV Cuvée 735 Brut  (Champagne)

description: Just released, this latest non-vintage from Jacquesson is very steely, austere, cool and elegant with apple and citrus acidity. It has freshness and balance. Still young, but very complete.
title: Jacquesson et Fils NV Cuvée 735 Brut  (Champagne)

description: This intense wine has great ripe fruit and sweetness to go with the pear and honey flavors. There is great acidity and beautiful fruit character in a gorgeous wine that still keeps its style and freshness.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Brand Grand Cru Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: Bringing out all the minerality of the chalk soils, this rounded wine is also packed with rich fruits. The wine is just approaching its peak, showing wonderful lemon and white stone fruits.
title: Pol Roger 2000 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: From the great 2002 vintage, this is a beautifully structured wine, packed with a fine texture of red berries, intense acidity as well as richness. Intense, complex wine that could well age.
title: Pol Roger 2001 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Richness, concentration, great weight and balance. Despite the ripeness, the crispness of the house style dominates. The apple flavors and the minerality need several years to really mature. From mainly grand cru vineyards.
designation: Special Club Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2004 Special Club Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Refreshingly dry Champagne. With its tight strawberry flavors, it is forward and fruity. It has a fine burst of lime acidity to complement the red fruits. Not for aging, delicious now.
title: Deutz 2000 Cuvée William Deutz Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A blend of 13 vintages, beautifully ripe and round, even with some maturity. Fresh citric fruit cuts through the richness and flavors of pineapple. There is a tang in the texture, an almost chewy structure. Age this wine for a year or two.
designation: Cuvée des Caudalies Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: De Sousa & Fils NV Cuvée des Caudalies Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A blend of 13 vintages, beautifully ripe and round, even with some maturity. Fresh citric fruit cuts through the richness and flavors of pineapple. There is a tang in the texture, an almost chewy structure. Age this wine for a year or two.
designation: Cuvée des Caudalies Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: De Sousa & Fils NV Cuvée des Caudalies Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Toasty aromas abound, and the acidity is well integrated with the fruit and biscuit flavors. Pure brioche and ripeness. Ready to drink.
title: Perrier Jouët 1998 Belle Epoque Brut  (Champagne)

description: Toasty aromas abound, and the acidity is well integrated with the fruit and biscuit flavors. Pure brioche and ripeness. Ready to drink.
title: Perrier Jouët 1998 Belle Epoque Brut  (Champagne)

description: This very structured wine is dry, in the Laurent-Perrier house style. Crunchy green apples are supported by richness and a complex texture. With nine years in the cellar, it has already gained some maturity, but needs aging.
title: Laurent-Perrier 2002 Millésimé Brut  (Champagne)

description: The Clos Windsbuhl produces an opulently rich and sweet wine, gorgeously ripe and packed with tropical fruits. It is dense and powerfully concentrated, intense and very ageworthy.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2009 Clos Windsbuhl Hunawihr Pinot Gris (Alsace)
