With the extra year of aging, it has lost some initial freshness but has gained complexity and structure. The wine is full-bodied while remaining very stylish. Drink now.
title: Château d'Esclans 2012 Les Clans Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This estate wine has rich fruits that are totally balanced with the acidity and the ripe red fruit flavors. A crisp texture offers acidity and a full body. It will be even better by the end of 2014.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This estate wine has rich fruits that are totally balanced with the acidity and the ripe red fruit flavors. A crisp texture offers acidity and a full body. It will be even better by the end of 2014.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Light pink/gold in color, this is an exotic ripe wine with melon and tropical fruit flavors underlined by toast. It is big, rich and mouthfilling.
title: Domaine de la Sauveuse 2009 Cuvée Carolle White (Côtes de Provence)

description: A wine that is both fruity and almost approachable now, it is packed with the great structure of Pauillac Cabernet Sauvignon. It's rich and firmly tannic, layering plums and blackberries within a dark texture. This should be aged for at least five years.
title: Château Béhèré Courtin 2010  Pauillac

description: The Romans made it to Sancerre, hence the name of this wine. The flavors are rich, with a mineral edge to the notes of green fruits, plums and greengages and a serious citrus core. With its structure, the wine needs to age for 2–3 years.
title: Domaine Fouassier 2010 Les Romains  (Sancerre)

description: Impressive dusty tannins offer a structured counterpoint to the deliciously ripe fruits and sweet berry flavors that stand out in this wine. It has great concentration as well, a powerhouse of firm structure and gorgeous fruit.
title: Château Bouscaut 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: A rich, yeasty wine, this is a ripe expression of Sauvignon Blanc, with balanced and concentrated mineral intensity and taut lemon and grapefruit flavors. There is a strong sense of structure and texture, and the wine needs to age at least two years.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2010 Sauvage  (Sancerre)

description: The flint and sand soil of this vineyard brings out the minerally, steely character of this taut, tight wine. While it is herbaceous and flavors of pineapple and white fruit, the structure dominates. Give this impressive wine another year or two.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2010 La Chapelle des Augustins  (Sancerre)

description: Old vines have produced a superconcentrated and ripe wine. It has notes of toast, spice and yellow fruit as well as bright acidity. With its structure, depth of flavor and density, it should age well over 3–4 years.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2009 La Bourgeoise  (Sancerre)

description: This is full and rounded initially, then the more textured notes of green fruit skin and wood spice come through. It has an attractively ripe feel while remaining structured. At the same time, the wine is developing fast and will be ready to drink in 3–4 years.
title: Château Carbonnieux 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: A ripe, spicy wine, this balances its rich tropical fruits with tense acidity and wood toast. It's full and rounded yet finely tangy and taut. With this structure, the wine should age over many years.
title: Château Bouscaut 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: A ripe, spicy wine, this balances its rich tropical fruits with tense acidity and wood toast. It's full and rounded yet finely tangy and taut. With this structure, the wine should age over many years.
title: Château Bouscaut 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: A touch of wood aging gives this wine richness, aided by the ripe fruit of the vintage. The wine is full with citrus, crisp apple and ripe pear. With its nervy texture and acidity, it needs to age a bit more. Drink from 2018.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Buissonnier  (Bourgogne)

description: A pale pink color, this starts with dainty, delicate aromas of white cherry and strawberry hull. The palate is similarly light in intensity, with a clean, mouthwatering finish that's immensely refreshing. Drink now.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2016 Gris Blanc Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: White peach, cherry and cranberry fruits are coupled with attractive scents of white tea, talc and peony on the nose of this wine. There's a subtle texture to the lightweight palate, thanks to notes of lime pith and bitter melon rind. It's well balanced and easy to like.
title: Famille Fabre 2016 Grande Courtade L'Instant Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: From vines in the vineyards behind the Côtes de Nuits, this wine is warm, smooth and ripe. It offers yellow fruits as well as rich apple and enough acidity to give a crisp edge. It's attractive and will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine des Perdrix  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: Bright and fruity, this delicious wine is crisp, clean and refreshing. With yellow fruits followed by zesty acidity, it's both open and textured. Drink now.
title: Domaine Touzot 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: This fruity wine is full of bright acidity. Crisp and clean, it shows yellow fruits and a shot of citrus. The aftertaste is lively and bright. Drink now.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2016 Clos de la Bressande  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: The wine is juicy with intense acidity. Its red-currant flavor is consistent with this acidity. Tannins are firm and will soften. The juicy aftertaste gives the wine crispness.
title: Domaine Pierre Guillemot 2015 Aux Serpentières Premier Cru  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: The ripe fruit of this vintage is right up front in this strawberry and spice-flavored wine. With a texture that adds a touch of tannin to the fruitiness, it is smooth and round. Drink this aromatic wine from 2018.
title: Château des Loges 2015 Sélection  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: The ripe fruit of this vintage is right up front in this strawberry and spice-flavored wine. With a texture that adds a touch of tannin to the fruitiness, it is smooth and round. Drink this aromatic wine from 2018.
title: Château des Loges 2015 Sélection  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Beaujolais Blanc is effectively Burgundy-type Chardonnay but from the southern neighbor Beaujolais region. This wine, with its ripe and creamy texture, has the same rich character as a Mâcon wine. It is smooth and soft from a warm vintage for white wines. Drink this wine now.
title: Château de Lavernette 2015 Les Vignes de la Roche  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: Beaujolais Blanc is effectively Burgundy-type Chardonnay but from the southern neighbor Beaujolais region. This wine, with its ripe and creamy texture, has the same rich character as a Mâcon wine. It is smooth and soft from a warm vintage for white wines. Drink this wine now.
title: Château de Lavernette 2015 Les Vignes de la Roche  (Beaujolais Blanc)

description: This soft, ripe wine has good apricot and peach flavors alongside the crisper citrus acidity. It is spicy, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Château de Beauregard 2015 Vignes Blances  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: One in a range of wines under the Xavier Flouret brand, this wine is made by Domaine Hamelin in Chablis. It is deliciously refreshing, with just the right edge of crispness to give it a lift. At the same time, its ripe, creamy texture blends with spiced-apple fruitiness. Drink the wine now.
title: Xavier Flouret 2015 Marly  (Chablis)

description: This is an open delicious wine, full of red-cherry and red-currant fruit with a touch of minerality to add texture. Some wood aging has smoothed out the crisp fruit and added vanilla to the mix. Drink this ripe wine from 2018.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2015 Buissonnier  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: This is a rich and luscious wine dominated by Petit Manseng, a small berry/small-yield grape from Gascony, the home of unusual grapes. It's aromatic, ripe and honeyed with ripe peach cut by the pineapple freshness. It's a gorgeous wine now but it really should be aged so drink from 2020.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Foehn  (Jurançon)

description: From vines that surround the castle of Mercuès that crowns a rock above the River Lot, this wine is richly structured, packed with juicy black fruits as well as a firm dry core. It's a dense wine, dark with intense tannins. It is serious as well as opulently fruity. Drink this wine from 2020.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2012 Château de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: Based in the village of Beaujeu, this producer has made a dense wine that needs time for the fruits to develop. It is juicy with acidity that is beginning to show through the tannins. Give this cru wine time and drink starting from 2018.
title: Pardon et Fils 2015 Domaine Pardon Vieilles Vignes  (Fleurie)

description: With its hint of acidity along with the textured fruit, this is a fruity wine that is balanced between richness and crispness. It has a light tannic structure that gives the wine its shape and ability to age for a few more months before drinking. Drink from mid-2017.
title: Trenel Fils 2015  Côte de Brouilly

description: A beautifully balanced non-vintage, in the lighter style that is Ayala's hallmark. It is fresh, but shows a good amount of blend with older wines to give weight and complexity. The green fruit flavors are well balanced with secondary aromas of almonds, green berries and lively, but not dominant acidity.
title: Ayala NV Brut Majeur  (Champagne)

description: A beautifully balanced non-vintage, in the lighter style that is Ayala's hallmark. It is fresh, but shows a good amount of blend with older wines to give weight and complexity. The green fruit flavors are well balanced with secondary aromas of almonds, green berries and lively, but not dominant acidity.
title: Ayala NV Brut Majeur  (Champagne)

description: The name indicates that this Champagne gets its delicate onion skin pink from the grape skins and not the addition of red wine, as with most rosé Champagnes. Does this make it any better? It's certainly a well integrated wine, the berry fruits very much part of the overall richness and, the acidity in a great supporting role.
title: Duval-Leroy NV Rose de Saignée Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Mainly from grand cru vineyards in Cramant, this is a ripe, smooth, creamy wine whose minerality is subordinated to rich white fruits and a pure, dense structure. Despite its relative youth, the richness means this wine is ready to drink now.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Colin 2001 Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: On the dry side, showing crisp white currants, grapefruit and a chalky structured texture. A delicious wine, firmly in the refreshing apéritif Champagne camp, floating its fruit with considerable delicacy.
designation: Blanc de Blancs Réserve Privée Brut
title: Bruno Paillard NV Blanc de Blancs Réserve Privée Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Yeasty, fresh-baked bread aromas, followed by an impressively fresh wine full of white fruits; white currants and pink grapefruit follow on the palate. It's well rounded with a soft aftertaste and well-balanced acidity, but there's no sign of maturity yet.
title: Nicolas Feuillatte 1997 Palmes d'Or  (Champagne)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. On the austere side initially, but then ripe fruit comes through, giving a wine that has potential power. There is a suspicion of super-ripe Merlot, a plump cushion. But the tannins will keep it together.
title: Château Canon 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Dry botrytis is the theme here, with richness rather than sweetness. Somewhere under all that dryness is acidity and flavors of sweet pears, but these are a long way off.
title: Château Suau 2006 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Vibrantly fruity wine that shows freshness. It has lift, fresh blackcurrants, layers of acidity, while the tannins hide in the background.
title: Château Les Carmes Haut-Brion 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Go to this wine for freshness, crispness. It tastes like a Loire Sauvignon Blanc in its freshness, but adds to that with some toast.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Fresh, rich, with attractive acidity and crisp, green apple and cream flavors. Well balanced, this wine shows excellent botrytis and sweetness properly together.
title: Château de Myrat 2006 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Austere and mineral, this is a tight wine, held by bonds of tannin. The structure is based upon dark plum skins, as well as potentially rich fruit.
title: Clos Fourtet 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Austere and mineral, this is a tight wine, held by bonds of tannin. The structure is based upon dark plum skins, as well as potentially rich fruit.
title: Clos Fourtet 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Great density here, this wine is big and powerful, but all held together by rich fruit. It is concentrated, the dry tannins a part of a richer whole.
title: Clos des Jacobins 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Great density here, this wine is big and powerful, but all held together by rich fruit. It is concentrated, the dry tannins a part of a richer whole.
title: Clos des Jacobins 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Along with the new wood flavors, the wine has rich fruit, spiced with dried figs, dark berries and a rounded, fruitcake character. There's a good touch of perfume to lift the finish.
title: Château Siran 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. As often, Magdelaine is a wine that is on the austere side, emphasizing minerality, not showing much at this stage. The acidity is tight, opening slowly to blackcurrant flavors.
title: Château Magdelaine 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Named after the limestone, Astéries, which dominates this small vineyard. The wine is mineral, tannic, somewhat austere at this stage, with dry tannins.
title: Les Astéries 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90—92 Barrel sample. Named after the limestone, Astéries, which dominates this small vineyard. The wine is mineral, tannic, somewhat austere at this stage, with dry tannins.
title: Les Astéries 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Big, ripe fruits, spiced with new wood, a big-hearted blackberry wine, sweet tannins, potentially generous.
title: Château Larcis Ducasse 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Very jammy fruit, where the sweetness seems to dominate. It is accessible, the tannins open, opulent, with a ripe structure. It works though, as a rich wine.
title: Château Fonplégade 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Balanced, open wine, full of ripe blackcurrant fruits. It has a fine, rich density which shows well alongside the acidity of a young wine. It finishes with delicious black fruits.
title: Château d'Armailhac 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Tight tannins set the scene for a wine that is firm, but with delicious blackcurrant fruit flavors. The tannins are dry under this freshness. Very vivid aftertaste.
title: Château Carbonnieux 2008 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Fruity, attractively balanced wine, the spice and caramel wood flavors fitting well into the sweet, berry fruits.
title: Château Cantemerle 2008 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. Fruity, attractively balanced wine, the spice and caramel wood flavors fitting well into the sweet, berry fruits.
title: Château Cantemerle 2008 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 90-92 Barrel sample. There is attractive spicy wood here, piled with acidity, great blackcurrant characters. The wine is balanced, fresh and fruity.
title: Château Bourgneuf 2008 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: Spiced-apple aromas lead to a soft, perfumed wine that has a crisp, fruity edge. The apple and green-plum flavors give attractive acidity. Drink now.
title: Marcel Couturier 2015 La Cour des Bois  (Saint-Véran)

description: This wine is crisp and refreshingly fruity. A lively texture gives brightness, and a light touch of acidity finishes the wine on a citrus note. Drink now.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: A bright wine, this offers attractive fruit and a crisp texture.The tangy, zesty edge is refreshing, giving the wine a delicious lift at the end. Drink now.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2015  Saint-Véran

description: A deliciously rich wine, this is full of ripe fruit and rich wood and spice flavors. It is generous, layering peach and pear fruitiness cut with acidity. A tangy edge gives the wine an attractive bite. Drink now.
title: Domaines Devillard 2015 Domaine de la Garenne  (Mâcon-Azé)

description: This bright, fruity wine has attractive acidity plus crisp sliced apple and green plum fruitiness. It is open, soft and ready to drink.
title: Maison Champy 2015  Mâcon-Villages

description: Soft and fruity, this young wine is full of red fruits and attractive acidity. It has a core of tannins that will soften over the next few months. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne)

description: Vines in the hills west of Nuits Saint-Georges are the source for this crisp red-currant-flavored wine. It has a juicy character, bright with red fruits. The wine will be ready from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Belle Canaille  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: The palest salmon pink color, this refreshing rosé is fresh, with red berry fruits mingling with the acidity. A perfect apéritif style.
designation: L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Cru Classé
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2010 L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Cru Classé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The palest salmon pink color, this refreshing rosé is fresh, with red berry fruits mingling with the acidity. A perfect apéritif style.
designation: L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Cru Classé
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2010 L'Esprit de Sainte Marguerite Cru Classé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Slightly herbal in character—not surprising given that it's 70% Cabernet Franc, an unusual variety for the Gard. Those leafy notes persist from start to finish, balanced out hints of peach and raspberry. Easy to drink.
title: Domaine des Cantarelles 2010 Rosé de Fayel Rosé (Vin de Pays du Gard)

description: Marcillac is a tiny appellation tucked away in the France's elevated Massif Central region. Made from the local grape Mansois (also known as Fer Servadou or Braucol in neighboring Gaillac), this wine is finely perfumed and ripe with berry fruits. With a cool, tannic structure, the wine is firm while fruity. It is not going to take long to be ready to drink, so just wait until the end of 2016.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2014  Marcillac

description: The producer has the largest nursery of old grape varieties in southwest France and from it has plucked the Manseng Noir to blend with Merlot. The result is a rich wine with ripe Merlot red fruits that are given a more tannic character with the Manseng. There is a fresh juicy aftertaste that allows it to be drunk now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2014 Moonseng Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The producer has the largest nursery of old grape varieties in southwest France and from it has plucked the Manseng Noir to blend with Merlot. The result is a rich wine with ripe Merlot red fruits that are given a more tannic character with the Manseng. There is a fresh juicy aftertaste that allows it to be drunk now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2014 Moonseng Red (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a typical blend in Gaillac, combining the broad character of the Loin de l'Oeil with the crisper Sauvignon. It's a fine, ripe wine that is perfumed with white stone fruit and touches of apricot. The wine's full in the mouth although lightly textured. Drink now.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Gouleyant White (Gaillac)

description: A fresh wine with red cherry fruits giving a bright character, the tannins soft and with attractive acidity. It is lightly textured and should be ready to drink in 1–2 years.
title: Domaine Moillard 2009  Côte de Nuits-Villages

description: Spice and cream combine in a rounded, soft, very ripe wine. It has intense flavors of lychee and white peach with a refreshing amount of acidity. The wine is dry, but rich from the ginger and with a peppery final bite.
title: Pierre Sparr 2010 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A beautifully perfumed wine that shows some of the structure of a Gevrey but combines this with dark rich fruits and sweet tannins. There is a smoky flavor that balances the ripe red fruits and final acidity.
title: Domaine Thierry Mortet 2009  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: While it does have the structure of a Pommard, this is also a ripe, rounded wine. Its sweet red fruits surround the firm tannins offering richness. A wine that will offer sold pleasure in 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Moillard 2009 Rugiens Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: While it does have the structure of a Pommard, this is also a ripe, rounded wine. Its sweet red fruits surround the firm tannins offering richness. A wine that will offer sold pleasure in 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Moillard 2009 Rugiens Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: The nose is very shy: a mere hint of earthiness emanates. The slender palate shows very clean fruit of yellow apple residing on a slender lemony palate. This is fresh and sprightly with a dry finish. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: 92-94 Sweetly juicy wine, the new wood giving high toast to the black currant flavors. It is on the elegant side, although the new wood needs to be tamed to let the fruit come through.
title: Château Giscours 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Spice and mint aromas with blackberry fruit, new wood and a polished character. The acidity is delicious, refreshing.
title: Château Faugères 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 Hugely aromatic, a wine that manages to combine freshness, lightness and density. It is deliciously fresh, then offering a fine, ripe dried fruit aftertaste.
title: Château de Myrat 2010 Barrel sample  (Barsac)

description: 92-94 Great acidity here, the wine has freshness as well as dried apricot and peach flavors, very honeyed. Excellent acidity to finish.
title: Château de Malle 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92-94 Great dusty tannins, almost too powerful, very solid in character. The wine is chunky, allowing juicy fruits to show. It is a dry wine, certainly not hard.
title: Château Cheval Blanc 2010 Barrel sample Le Petit Cheval  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 With huge tannins, very dark fruits, powerful and concentrated. The wine is ripe, juicy and firmly tannic.
title: Château Certan de May de Certan 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)
winery: Château Certan de May de Certan

description: 92-94 With huge tannins, very dark fruits, powerful and concentrated. The wine is ripe, juicy and firmly tannic.
title: Château Certan de May de Certan 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)
winery: Château Certan de May de Certan

description: 92-94 This is rounded, ripe, a densely tannic mineral wine, very intense. It is tense, structured, firm, promising long aging.
title: Les Astéries 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 This is rounded, ripe, a densely tannic mineral wine, very intense. It is tense, structured, firm, promising long aging.
title: Les Astéries 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 A luxurious wine, acidity and sweet plum fruits rolling together into a fine, beautiful structure. It has toughness, to be sure, while it is the glamorous surface that is immediately attractive.
title: Château Talbot 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92-94 Spice, smoky fruit, with great acidity, a wine that offers richness, structure, powerful tannins and already some delicious blackberry fruits.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 92-94 Spice, smoky fruit, with great acidity, a wine that offers richness, structure, powerful tannins and already some delicious blackberry fruits.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 92-94 Very structured wine, its fruit tannins dominant. It has power and extreme concentration. Dark and dense.
title: Château Siran 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Very structured wine, its fruit tannins dominant. It has power and extreme concentration. Dark and dense.
title: Château Siran 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Ripe blackcurrants, powerful fruit, with great acidity and enticing dusty tannins. The wine brings out juicy Merlot flavors, with a more concentrated element.
designation: Barrel sample Alter Ego de Château Palmer
title: Château Palmer 2010 Barrel sample Alter Ego de Château Palmer  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Ripe blackcurrants, powerful fruit, with great acidity and enticing dusty tannins. The wine brings out juicy Merlot flavors, with a more concentrated element.
designation: Barrel sample Alter Ego de Château Palmer
title: Château Palmer 2010 Barrel sample Alter Ego de Château Palmer  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 A rich and firm wine, packed with dark tannins, wood flavors, very concentrated and dense. The sweet, smoky character comes through to give opulent black fruits.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92-94 Dark, dry wine initially with austerity. Then the bright berry fruits come from behind the severe façade to give a structured, still luscious wine.
title: Château Lagrange 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 92-94 Big, firm, with dense tannins that underly the ripe, dark berry and plum skin fruit flavors. Very powerful, the almost shocking acidity a cutting edge of freshness. Hugely juicy aftertaste.
title: Château la Pointe 2010 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 92-94 A hugely fruity wine, very rich, concentrated and dense. It has great power and richness, the berry fruits racing with ripeness.
title: Château Fonbadet 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92-94 There is power and richness here, the wine has weight, delicious ripe fruits and a smooth texture. Under that surface is the powerful, dense texture.
title: Château Ferrière 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Packed with tannins, new wood and a dense character, this is going to be a wine for the long-term. It has all the power, although with a softer side in the final fruitiness.
title: Château d'Arsac 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Packed with tannins, new wood and a dense character, this is going to be a wine for the long-term. It has all the power, although with a softer side in the final fruitiness.
title: Château d'Arsac 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Powerful tannins here, spiced with a considerable amount of new wood. The wine has richness, black chocolate burnt toast flavors along with intense sweet plum fruits.
designation: Barrel sample Les Pagodes de Cos
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2010 Barrel sample Les Pagodes de Cos  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 92-94 Smoky wine, dominated by its dry tannins, seemingly extracted. The wine certainly has weight and power, but the dryness is a major element at this stage. It will need serious aging time.
title: Château Bélair-Monange 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 A closed up wine, although all the elements are there, promising great final balance, richness and power.
title: Château Guiraud 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92-94 Herbaceous style of wine, a Bordeaux white wine classic style, with crisp grassy Sauvignon Blanc flavors, elegant, not heavy.
title: Château de France 2010 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 92-94 Juicy black fruits, very ripe berries, powered by the darkest tannins. The wine has richness, weight and immense structure.
title: Château Croizet-Bages 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92-94 New, polished wood aromas lead to a wine that has a smooth balance between toast, sweet fruits and a velvet-textured acidity. Delicious.
title: Château Brane-Cantenac 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Powerful, very juicy in style, with toasty new wood flavors mingling with the the very ripe fruits. The wine has a bitter, extracted edge that will probably soften with further wood aging.
title: Château Beausejour-Duffau-Lagarrosse 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 Sweet and juicy, a wine that has the potential to be delicious. The tannins are certainly prominent, although with good sweetness. Finally very structured.
title: Château Malescot Saint-Exupery 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 92-94 Big and tannic, very firm and tough. Yet all the fruit is there, offering great potential. There is a ripe, juicy aftertaste. Under the same ownership as Château Léoville-Poyferré in Saint-Julien.
title: Château Le Crock 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 92-94 Ripe, juicy aromas, a wine that then offers sweet fruit, great flavors, a ripe wine with blackberry flavors and balanced tannins.
title: Château la Dominique 2010 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 92-94 Concentrated tannins, very rich, very firm, very dry at this stage. There is a more juicy character underneath, offering the potential of rich berry fruits. There's a new wood, smoky aftertaste.
title: Château Haut Bages Libéral 2010 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 92-94 Very rich in character. The sweetness is there, but masked by the firm structure, the almost tannic texture. Great concentration.
title: Château Rabaud-Promis 2010 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 92-94 Dark tannins and structure go with the most powerful fruit. Full of ripe berries, this has all the structure and density. The acidity helps it on its way.
title: Château Pontac-Lynch 2010 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: Pure fruitiness holds the balance of this wine between crisp acidity and a tightly mineral texture. It comes from the producer's Bué vineyards, one of the top villages of Sancerre. The wine is crisp, made to be drunk young and fruity.
title: François Millet 2015 Domaine des Côtes Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: Deliciously light and herbal, this smooth, creamy wine is bright, poised with black-currant fruits and ripe gooseberry flavors. Drink this wine young, for its great fruit.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2015 Côtes de Morogues  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This is a fresh, fruity and apple-crisp wine that is light, buoyant with acidity and shot with citrus. It is lightly mineral, textured and with attractive crispness at the end. The Devillard family bottles this wine on behalf the estate's owners. Drink now.
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Domaine de la Garenne  (Mâcon-Azé)

description: The Sacy is a rare variety found only in a corner of the Yonne Valley west of Chablis and in the small Loire appellation of Saint-Pourçain where it is known as Tressallier. This is a spicy wine with plenty of acidity and a crisp texture. It is fruity with green plum and a brilliant, fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Gueguen 2015 Cuvée Confidentielle  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: The wine is soft and creamy. Made from fruit grown in the Mâcon region, it is ripe and with a good balance between citrus and melon flavors. The acidity and the attractive fruitiness have produced a wine that is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Denante 2015  Bourgogne

description: A blend of Gamay and Pinot Noir, this wine has qualities from both grapes. It has the bright cherry flavors of the Gamay and the rich, red-berry fruits of the Pinot Noir. They are finely integrated into this soft ripe wine that is ready to drink.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014 Cuvée Terroir  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: Produced from vineyards in the hills above the Côte de Nuits, this wine benefits from the ripe vintage of 2015. It has open red fruit and soft tannins that are both lifted by the acidity. Made to be drunk young, this is ready to enjoy now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: Produced from vineyards in the hills above the Côte de Nuits, this wine benefits from the ripe vintage of 2015. It has open red fruit and soft tannins that are both lifted by the acidity. Made to be drunk young, this is ready to enjoy now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: Named after the church which is next to the Brocard winery, this crisp fruity wine is lively with acidity, lemon and apple fruits and a light tangy texture. The wine becomes more ripe as it opens up showing peach and apricot flavors at the end. Drink now.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2015 Sainte-Claire  (Chablis)

description: Château de Mercuès has had its own vineyard since the 13th century. This latest vintage is a powerful wine, pure tannic and rich Malbec, structured and with huge black fruits. The wine has weight, solid tannins and an excellent potential. Drink from 2017–2018.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: Big, bold and rich wine, solidly tannic, firm and ripe. Vivid black plum flavors scroll across the palate giving a full, firm, right up front feel. The wine has great texture, weight and density. It also has an impressive future, so drink from 2017.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2011 Clos Triguedina Probus Malbec (Cahors)

description: A perfumed wine from new wood aging, powerful extraction and dark tannins. The wine is dense and black in color, heavy on the ripe berry and plum fruits with very firm structure. With its power and youthful fruit, it will age well. Don't drink before 2018.
designation: Cuvée Icône du Château Leret Monpezat
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Cuvée Icône du Château Leret Monpezat Malbec (Cahors)

description: On the sweet side, this is a rich, almost honeyed wine. It has deliciously ripe fruit, lychees and fragrant lemon. Full and generous, the wine still manages to keep some good freshness. It is young, so drink from 2017.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2011 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is the softest of the three single vineyard wines from Château de Fuissé. It has a warm, rich character, generous and full in the mouth. Yellow fruits are partnered with citrus acidity and an attractive layer of wood. The wine ends with the freshness of the vintage.
title: Château Fuissé 2011 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: While this is almost ready to drink, with its fruity pear and apple flavors, beneath the surface, the wine is much more serious. It has a rich feel to it, touched by toast and a hint of honey, it has a firm wood aging character, a firm structure and considerable potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Pascal Bouchard 2011 Vaudésir Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: There is a lightness about this vintage of Mouton Rothschild. It doesn't take away from its quality but does give the wine poise and an attractive lift. The wine is based on solid tannins, then the ripe fruit builds layers of fruitiness and freshness. It is not likely to be one of the longest-aging Moutons, but it will be delicious. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2011  Pauillac

description: There is a lightness about this vintage of Mouton Rothschild. It doesn't take away from its quality but does give the wine poise and an attractive lift. The wine is based on solid tannins, then the ripe fruit builds layers of fruitiness and freshness. It is not likely to be one of the longest-aging Moutons, but it will be delicious. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2011  Pauillac

description: This wine has so many of the structural elements of a Saint-Estèphe, but also is enveloped by ripe fruitiness. Black in color and dense in character, it has sweetness from the plum juice fruits and great acidity. But it is also firm, powerfully projecting a serious potential. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: A solidly structured wine, it is both elegant and intensely powerful. It is disclosing its fruitiness slowly, at the moment dense and concentrated. A restrained edge provides complexity and balance. It will need aging, so don't drink before 2022.
title: Château Margaux 2011  Margaux

description: A solidly structured wine, it is both elegant and intensely powerful. It is disclosing its fruitiness slowly, at the moment dense and concentrated. A restrained edge provides complexity and balance. It will need aging, so don't drink before 2022.
title: Château Margaux 2011  Margaux

description: Huge structure, huge potential, a wine that will bring out all the fruit and density of the vintage while remaining very fresh. Black plums are already showing strongly along with the dry core that promises aging. It's serious while alive and bright. Drink this major wine from 2022.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2011  Saint-Julien

description: So smooth, this is a rich, grandiose wine. Although it is full of black currant fruits and spice flavors, the texture is most impressive. Dusty tannins are integrated with juicy fruits seamlessly. The purest fruit flavors are allied to linear tannins in a precise yet generous way. The wine is evolving beautifully, but do not drink before 2020.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2011  Pauillac

description: The wine shows the power typical of a Lafite but within the context of the fruity 2011 vintage. The immensely dense tannic structure gives the wine a solid feel that is lifted by so much ripe black currant and berry fruits. At the back, the wine has a more brooding, dark character that suggests great aging potential. Drink this wine from 2019.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2011  Pauillac

description: Made at Provence classed growth Château Rimauresq, this soft and full rosé has attractive red and citrus fruits, a hint of pepper and herbs. It's warm and ready to drink.
title: Xavier Flouret 2012 Nationale 7 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Just bottled when tasted, this is a wine that needs a few months to come together. Its ripe pear and apricot fruit and dense flavor will offer a full, rounded wine that goes more for a tropical Sauvignon Blanc character.
title: Calvet 2012 Réserve  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Fruity, light-hearted wine that pushes forward its red fruits, its crisp acidity and its bright texture. There is a dancing character to this delicious, refreshing wine.
title: Gassier 2012 Miradou en Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is on the soft side for rosés, a warm wine with a sense of Mediterranean herbs and sun. It has light red fruits, spice and great final acidity.  Screwcap.
title: Estandon 2012 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Austere and firm, this is still many years from being ready to drink. For now, its potential is apparent in the juicy black fruits, dark tannins and solid structure. It has much of the structure of the vintage, well clothed in fuller fruits.
title: Château Lavergne-Dulong 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Austere and firm, this is still many years from being ready to drink. For now, its potential is apparent in the juicy black fruits, dark tannins and solid structure. It has much of the structure of the vintage, well clothed in fuller fruits.
title: Château Lavergne-Dulong 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A full and ripe rosé from the Sumeire family which owns a number of Provence estates. This wine has freshness along with its rich character, strawberry fruit and acidity well in balance.
title: Château la Tour de l'Evêque 2012 Pétale de Rosé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Full in style, this is a lemon-scented, peach-flavored wine. It has some richness to it both from the ripe fruit and the textured acidity that gives a tight tang to the aftertaste. The needs to age for a year. Screwcap.
title: Château La Rose du Pin 2012  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This is a thin wine with way too much acidity for the fruit. The rest of the wine is dry tannin that could soften into a more juicy character. It's always going to be a light wine.
title: Léo de la Gaffelière 2012  Bordeaux

description: This is a thin wine with way too much acidity for the fruit. The rest of the wine is dry tannin that could soften into a more juicy character. It's always going to be a light wine.
title: Léo de la Gaffelière 2012  Bordeaux

description: This tough wine seems light on fruit. It is hard and shows considerable extraction.
title: Chateau le Grand Verdus 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is hard and tough, all tannins and extraction.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: A light and fruity wine that is ready to drink. From the heart of the Entre-deux-Mers region, it has red berry fruits and juicy acidity. A greener, herbal character in the background suggests grapes that weren't totally ripe at harvest.
title: Château de Crain 2012  Bordeaux

description: A light and fruity wine that is ready to drink. From the heart of the Entre-deux-Mers region, it has red berry fruits and juicy acidity. A greener, herbal character in the background suggests grapes that weren't totally ripe at harvest.
title: Château de Crain 2012  Bordeaux

description: The wine is extracted and hard. It has a tough character along with some bitterness.
title: Château Penin 2012 Les Cailloux  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: The wine is extracted and hard. It has a tough character along with some bitterness.
title: Château Penin 2012 Les Cailloux  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Herbal aromas give a crisp character. The fruit is not entirely ripe, so the wine relies on its tannins and acidity to get balance.
title: Château Briot 2012  Bordeaux

description: Strong wood flavors have smothered the fruit, leaving vanilla, spice and milk chocolate as the main flavors. Gérard Laurent blends 65% Cabernet Franc and 35% Malbec from biodynamic and organic vineyards in egg-shaped Apollo flexitanks where the wine matures for a year.
title: Château l'Escart 2012 Cuvée Puits du Roy  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Strong wood flavors have smothered the fruit, leaving vanilla, spice and milk chocolate as the main flavors. Gérard Laurent blends 65% Cabernet Franc and 35% Malbec from biodynamic and organic vineyards in egg-shaped Apollo flexitanks where the wine matures for a year.
title: Château l'Escart 2012 Cuvée Puits du Roy  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Bread and yeasty aromas lead to a wine that has tannins and wood aging, leaving the fruitiness behind.
title: Château Larteau 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The fruit is extremely extracted, making for a wine that is tough, very firm and hard without the juicy character needed to see it through.
title: Château Damase 2012  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a hard-edged wine with a chemical character. It's tough both in tannins and extracted fruits.
title: Château Belrose 2012 Cuvée Maucaillou  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: With an attractive pink color and soft acidity, the wine is fruity with red berry flavors and a soft, caramel texture. It's ready to drink while it is still so fresh.
title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild 2013 Le Rosé de Mouton Cadet Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Mealy apple and orange custard aromas set the stage for this ripe, fleshy white. There's a roundness to the mouthfeel, as those notes continue through to the palate, though the finish offers a pithy citrus astringency that helps to enliven the experience.
title: Domaine Saint-Nabor 2016 Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: Mealy apple and orange custard aromas set the stage for this ripe, fleshy white. There's a roundness to the mouthfeel, as those notes continue through to the palate, though the finish offers a pithy citrus astringency that helps to enliven the experience.
title: Domaine Saint-Nabor 2016 Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: This rounded, creamy wine is attractive, with rich apricots and balanced zesty acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine des Verchères 2016  Mâcon-Villages

description: This light and fruity wine, produced by a Burgundy negotiant, is full of bitter cherry crispness. It is ready to drink, offering acidity and a tight, bright aftertaste.
title: Maison Jean-Baptiste Béjot 2014 La Perlière  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This wine is very soft and only lightly fruity. Some spice and touches of acidity give a crisp edge to the otherwise dull wine.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Mercurey)

description: This blend of Gamay and Pinot Noir, mainly from Beaujolais, is fruity with soft cherry flavors. Its attractive fruitiness and balanced acidity are immediately accessible and ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Léon  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This blend of Gamay and Pinot Noir, mainly from Beaujolais, is fruity with soft cherry flavors. Its attractive fruitiness and balanced acidity are immediately accessible and ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Léon  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This is a Mâcon region-wide blend, simple and fruity with an attractively crisp texture. It has a citrus character, slightly salty as well as tangy with orange zest. Drink now.
title: Florent Descombe 2014  Moulin-à-Vent

description: Sweet oak tones frame the black cherry and currant fruit in this wine, with notes of mocha and raspberry sauce atop. The velvety texture offers good tannic grip, while ample acidity helps to keep the palate fresh and the finish lifted. Drink now.
title: Les Jamelles 2015 Cabernet Sauvignon (Pays d'Oc)

description: Sweet oak tones frame the black cherry and currant fruit in this wine, with notes of mocha and raspberry sauce atop. The velvety texture offers good tannic grip, while ample acidity helps to keep the palate fresh and the finish lifted. Drink now.
title: Les Jamelles 2015 Cabernet Sauvignon (Pays d'Oc)

description: Pretty pink-flower tones lead the nose of this white blend, framed by fruity notes of white peach, lychee and musky grape. The palate is surprisingly light in feel, with ripe fruit flavors and good acidity to keep the finish fresh.
title: Les Domaines Auriol 2015 La Villa de Maison Vialade White (Pays d'Oc)

description: This is a tight wine, firm with tannins and with a bitter edge. Jammy cherry fruits lie behind this structure, along with acidity. The wine will soften and be ready to drink from 2018.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Collection  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Light and crisp, this wine has citrus and green-plum flavors. It is still developing, with plenty of acidity as well a perfumed character. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Petit Vallons  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Light and crisp, this wine has citrus and green-plum flavors. It is still developing, with plenty of acidity as well a perfumed character. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Petit Vallons  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Produced from old vines in the Aegerter Domaine, this wine is dominated by red fruits and spice from wood aging. It is fruity, perfumed and likely to be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne)

description: This 100% Pinot Noir rosé, produced in the northern Burgundy village of Saint-Bris, is packed with fruit. It shows a light touch of red cherry fruit and plenty of bright acidity. Along with the citrus aftertaste, this is a refreshing apéritif wine.
title: Robert Goulley 2016  Bourgogne

description: There are some pleasant gamy tones to the plum and cherry fruit on the nose of this wine, with decadent touches of white chocolate and peach pit. Zippy acidity picks up the palate, finishing fresh and easy.
title: Gayda 2016 Flying Solo Grenache Cinsault Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Bold with tannins, this spicy wine is dense and dark. It's all structure and dryness at the moment. And, although the fruit is there, it looks as though the tannins will remain.
title: Xavier Flouret 2015 Château Haut-Meneau Quai Lumière  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The rarely used Atlantique appellation covers much the same region as Bordeaux, with less stringent rules. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc wine is fruity, easy, soft and full of citrus flavors. Drink now.
title: Terre de Vignerons 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Atlantique)

description: The rarely used Atlantique appellation covers much the same region as Bordeaux, with less stringent rules. This 100% Sauvignon Blanc wine is fruity, easy, soft and full of citrus flavors. Drink now.
title: Terre de Vignerons 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Atlantique)

description: This wine is light and fruity, poised between rich tropical and herbal-laced green fruits. It has a perfumed touch from the Sauvignon Gris in the blend and a crisp texture. Drink from early 2018.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2016  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This wine is light and fruity, poised between rich tropical and herbal-laced green fruits. It has a perfumed touch from the Sauvignon Gris in the blend and a crisp texture. Drink from early 2018.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2016  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This wine is dry and smoky, with serious tannins. It is concentrated, with bitter chocolate flavors from the wood aging.
title: Château Sainte-Marie 2015 Alios  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is dry and smoky, with serious tannins. It is concentrated, with bitter chocolate flavors from the wood aging.
title: Château Sainte-Marie 2015 Alios  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: It is fascinating how some wines from this vintage have gone from youth to old age without passing maturity. That's the case here: this wine is showing age, with tannins that have become dry, leaving the secondary flavors, let alone the fruit, behind.
title: Château Montlisse 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This soft and fruity wine may be young, but with its bright red fruits, it's ready to drink. Its juicy red berry flavors are filled with spice and a minty character from wood aging. It finishes with ripe fruitiness.
title: Château Lussan 2016  Bordeaux

description: An unusual find of an old vintage currently available, this is certainly a mature wine. In fact, it is beginning to dry out—focused on old tannins rather than on the wonderful secondary flavors of a well-aged Bordeaux. For lovers of older wines, this is a bargain curiosity.
title: Château Hervé-Laroque 2006  Fronsac

description: This young wine is full of black currant fruit and balanced tannins. It has the richness of high alcohol, which brings out a touch of pepper. But juicy fruit dominates. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Grand Meynau 2016  Bordeaux

description: Bitter chocolate aromas and woody flavors are the hallmarks of this smoky, burnt toast-inflected wine. That bitter quality probably won't go away, leaving the fruit behind.
title: Château de Fontenille 2015  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This firm, structured wine is lean and austere. Spice and toast notes dominate, leaving little room for fruit. It's a tough wine to like.
title: Château de Cranne 2015 Château Jeandebout  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This example shows a bit more character than many Pays d'Oc Chardonnays. Pretty scents of lemon and honeysuckle lead to a palate with above-average concentration and lovely lemon meringue pie flavors. Tangy acidity renders this a good choice for salmon.
title: Robert Skalli 2005 South of France Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A solid, straightforward red that is immediately approachable and extremely drinkable. It's satiny in texture, with red fruit aromas and flavors of cherry, raspberry and rhubarb supported by hints of cocoa and eucalyptus. Mild tannins and a lighter weight followed by a clean, shorter finish make this easy-drinking wine an excellent choice for rich duck or heavily spiced lamb dishes.
title: Château Les Palais 2004 Cuvée Merville Red (Corbières)

description: A simple fruity Bordeaux, attractively layering black currants, firm and dry tannins and fresh, juicy acidity. It's light, already drinkable. Screwcap.
title: Château la Moulinière 2006  Bordeaux

description: A firm, smoky wine, with tannins that verge on too dry. The fruit is not totally ripe, giving awkward astringency.
title: Château Beauregard 2006  Pomerol

description: This impressive value from Bordeaux house Yvon Mau shows that Languedoc-Roussillon is capable of turning out serious Syrah/Shiraz at a reasonable price. Seared meat, black pepper and raspberry scents make for a nice opening while cherry and white pepper flavors permeate the moderately intense palate. Short finish; drink up.
title: Yvon Mau 2005 Shiraz (Vin de Pays de L'Aude)

description: A beautiful nose full of classic garrigue-infused herbaceousness is supported by notes of raspberry-sage preserves and sweet spiced baked fruit. The mouth lacks a certain vibrancy, though, with a lighter than expected weight and acidity. The finish falls a little short, with a somewhat jarring sweet sharpness.
title: Château de Lancyre 2005 La Coste d'Aleyrac Pic Saint-Loup Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Simple earthy notes interspersed with faint cherry aromas open this pleasant, good-value Pinot Noir from the south of France. The blueberry-flavored palate shows riper fruit than is typical for Burgundy and may appeal to those who find California Pinots to be a bit overwhelming. Tannins are in abundance here but are fine enough not to interfere with tuna or swordfish in a delicate sauce.
title: Gala Rouge 2006 Pinot Noir (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: A complex wine with firm acidity and ripe black currant notes. The fruit is juicy, and the palate finely structured. The small property, owned by André Lurton, is improving with every vintage.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: A complex wine with firm acidity and ripe black currant notes. The fruit is juicy, and the palate finely structured. The small property, owned by André Lurton, is improving with every vintage.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: Although it's not indicated on the label, this is a Blanc de Blancs from Chardonnay. It is warm and ripe, with a soft texture allied to fresh acidity. Orange and lemon zest give a great lift to this rounded wine.
title: Larmandier-Bernier NV Latitude Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A wine that is deliciously perfumed from the 25% Cabernet Franc in the blend. The wine has very ripe black fruits, with contrasting intense acidity, toast and dark chocolate. It's powerful and concentrated, with good aging potential.
title: Château Nenin 2010  Pomerol

description: A wine that is deliciously perfumed from the 25% Cabernet Franc in the blend. The wine has very ripe black fruits, with contrasting intense acidity, toast and dark chocolate. It's powerful and concentrated, with good aging potential.
title: Château Nenin 2010  Pomerol

description: There's good dense fruit here, with a blackberry jam quality to the ripe fruit. The wine misses some richness, but makes up for it with its lively smooth tannins and acidity, and ripe, juicy aftertaste.
title: Clos de Gamot 2005 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This fresh and fruity sparkling wine is crisp with apple skin and apricot flavors. Ripe and full in the mouth , it has a lightly creamy mousse. The blend of Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay gives delicious fruitiness and tight final acidity.
title: Musset-Roullier NV Noctambule Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: Mint and sage aromas give an instant herbal character. That's balanced by citrus fruits that cut through the texture to give great freshness and intense acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Roquefort 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Mint and sage aromas give an instant herbal character. That's balanced by citrus fruits that cut through the texture to give great freshness and intense acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Château Roquefort 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Jadot's take on Burgundy Chardonnay is fruity and creamy. Juicy, intense acidity comes from the crisp apple and white peach fruits. A touch of wood aging softens the fruit and broadens the character of the wine. Drink now.
title: Louis Jadot 2013  Bourgogne

description: Jadot's take on Burgundy Chardonnay is fruity and creamy. Juicy, intense acidity comes from the crisp apple and white peach fruits. A touch of wood aging softens the fruit and broadens the character of the wine. Drink now.
title: Louis Jadot 2013  Bourgogne

description: Light and fruity, this soft Champagne has red berry fruits, noticeable sweetness and fresh acidity to match. It's attractive for those who like their Champagne soft and easygoing.
title: Vranken NV Diamant Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Earthy aromas and a soft red fruit ripeness are dominated by wood and smoky spice. They give an unbalanced feel to the wine, not allowing much room for the potential of the fruitiness and acidity.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2012 Epineuil  (Bourgogne)

description: The 50-50 blend of Chardonnay and Aligoté gives a tangy, zesty lemon-flavored wine. It has a textured character, crisp and full of the freshest acidity. It could benefit from a few months in bottle, so when you buy, wait a little.
title: Cave de Bissey NV Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is an attractive and fruity, creamy wine. Flavors of ripe apples and pear juice are boosted by the nutty suggestion of bottle age and by a tight, crisp acidity at the end.
title: Jaffelin NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Structured, mineral and tense, this is a classic Pouilly Fuissé. It has lemon and crisp sliced white fruits, very linear in character with a bright, tight texture. The wine is young and could age until 2016.
title: Jaffelin 2013  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Structured, mineral and tense, this is a classic Pouilly Fuissé. It has lemon and crisp sliced white fruits, very linear in character with a bright, tight texture. The wine is young and could age until 2016.
title: Jaffelin 2013  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: The wine is soft, round and full in the mouth, with balance between fresh citrus and ripe melon and pear fruits. The acidity gives a great lift, adding to the steely texture and final burst of fruit.
title: Dopff & Irion NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Bright and fruity, it's full of fresh acidity and has a strongly mineral texture. Green fruits, apples and pears partner with a strong citrus element. Wait until 2015.
title: Bret Brothers 2012 La Roche  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: While the wine is structured, it does also have plenty of ripe, juicy fruitiness that is already delicious. It's an open wine, rounded and rich in fruit flavor. The tannins are likely to smooth out soon, so drink from 2016.
title: Antonin Rodet 2011 Château de Mercey  (Santenay)

description: While the wine is structured, it does also have plenty of ripe, juicy fruitiness that is already delicious. It's an open wine, rounded and rich in fruit flavor. The tannins are likely to smooth out soon, so drink from 2016.
title: Antonin Rodet 2011 Château de Mercey  (Santenay)

description: This attractive village wine has ripe fruits as well as a more steely texture. Wood flavors give smoothness that rounds out the wine and enhances the yellow fruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Louis Latour 2011  Puligny-Montrachet

description: A structured, cool wine that is poised and elegant, it has a lightly creamy texture cut by apple and pear flavors. Definitely mineral, it is textured with fruit skins and flavored with the oak aging. It needs to be aged, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Réserve Personelle  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: This full-bodied wine just lacks that bit of freshness that would've taken it to the next level. Stewed plums, black olives and espresso notes are rich and complex, ending on a long silky note. Drink now and over the next few years.
title: Dauvergne & Ranvier 2010 Vin Rare  (Gigondas)

description: Lively, bright and very textured, it discloses fresh apple and pear flavors along with a more nuanced, honey character. The wine is developing well, giving great acidity while also promising fruitiness. Drink from 2015.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2012 L'Entreroches  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Lively, bright and very textured, it discloses fresh apple and pear flavors along with a more nuanced, honey character. The wine is developing well, giving great acidity while also promising fruitiness. Drink from 2015.
title: Ferraud et Fils 2012 L'Entreroches  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A very buttery wine, it is soft, smooth and creamy in texture. Contrasting citrus flavors add a crisp touch. The acidity winds through the ripe fruit to give a bright edge.
title: Domaine Sophie Cinier 2012  Saint-Véran

description: While Marsannay is mainly planted with Pinot Noir, there are small vineyards of Chardonnay, like this six-acre parcel. It has produced a fruity, ripe wine with a touch of minerality, along with wood and crisp acidity. Light, fruity and ready to drink soon.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2011 Le Clos  (Marsannay)

description: Jammy and ripe, from gravel soils in the valley plain of Saint-Emilion, this is already a very drinkable wine. It has intense, concentrated red and black berry fruits surrounding a core of seriously dry tannins from fruit and wood. Solid but rich, this is developing well.
title: Château Laforge 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: A wonderfully firm wine, which balances extraction with pure sweet fruit. It moves comfortably within its tannic structure, the ripe Merlot allowed plenty of play to show off its black jelly and plum flavors.
title: Château La Conseillante 2006  Pomerol

description: Currently a hard-edged wine that has tight structure and lacks sweetness. All the elements are there, the botrytis dryness, a racy vivid acidity, richness and balance. But they have yet to come together. Wait at least two years.
title: Château Sigalas Rabaud 2006  Sauternes

description: A beautifully perfumed, dark-colored wine, bursting with black plums and violet perfumes. It is, on the surface, delicious, but taste beneath that and it becomes complex and dark, with immense but velvet tannins, suggesting considerable potential.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2006 Clos du Marquis  (Saint-Julien)

description: This is a great success. Youthful tannins exude power and vitality, combining with great fruit concentration, the elements coming together with sweet chocolate and cocoa as added richness. A tasty wine that is developing well.
title: Château Ferrière 2006  Margaux

description: This wine continues the improvements at this classed growth chateau at the far southern end of the Margaux appellation. It is firmly structured, but the fruit is rich, showing juiciness from ripe, black fruits. The concentration and intensity offer excellent aging potential.
title: Chateau Dauzac 2006  Margaux

description: A powerhouse of rich Merlot, big, ripe, with black plums, sweet figs and only light acidity. A wine for lovers of big Merlots, this rolls generously around the mouth. Because of this immediate richness, it seems likely to age quickly.
title: Château Clinet 2006  Pomerol

description: This is a dark wine, perhaps more elegant than powerful. The currant fruit flavors drive through with prominent acidity, trailing tight tannins and smoky wood. More weight would have been welcome.
title: Château Belair 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: At this early stage in its development, this wine shows more structure than richness. The tannins are fully developed, dark and dense. The complexity is there, but the fruit and the elegance are still to come—and that suggests good aging potential.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2006  Pauillac

description: A big, rich chocolaty wine with delicious spice and ripe tannins. The fruit is sumptuously rich, blackberry juice flavors balancing the power and concentration of the texture. In all this richness, there is just enough freshness to lift the finish.
title: Château l'Évangile 2006  Pomerol

description: A big, rich chocolaty wine with delicious spice and ripe tannins. The fruit is sumptuously rich, blackberry juice flavors balancing the power and concentration of the texture. In all this richness, there is just enough freshness to lift the finish.
title: Château l'Évangile 2006  Pomerol

description: Very elegant, very classy, this wine shows, discreetly, its sweet juicy fruit, great ripe black currant flavor and fine tannins. Nothing is overstated; this is for lovers of stylish wines.
title: Château Lagrange 2006  Saint-Julien

description: Very elegant, very classy, this wine shows, discreetly, its sweet juicy fruit, great ripe black currant flavor and fine tannins. Nothing is overstated; this is for lovers of stylish wines.
title: Château Lagrange 2006  Saint-Julien

description: Fruity and fresh, this is a delicate apéritif style of Crémant. It has light acidity along with touches of almonds and a light spiciness. They go well with the ripe red-apple and orange zest flavors.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Open and ripe, the wine has red fruits and warm tannins. Caramel and vanilla flavors lend a richness to the wine.
title: Mas Sainte Berthe 2012 Passe-Rose Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Open and ripe, the wine has red fruits and warm tannins. Caramel and vanilla flavors lend a richness to the wine.
title: Mas Sainte Berthe 2012 Passe-Rose Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: A fruity, fragrant wine, this has good acidity and bright flavors of raspberries, plums and loganberries. It is more fruity than structured and should be drunk now.
title: Mas Sainte Berthe 2009 Louis David Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: With lees aging to give extra richness, the wine is fruity with a fine mineral texture. Apricot and raspberry fruits are right up front along with the intense acidity. Drink this attractive ripe wine now.
title: Vignobles de Saint-Tropez 2016 La Bravade Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With lees aging to give extra richness, the wine is fruity with a fine mineral texture. Apricot and raspberry fruits are right up front along with the intense acidity. Drink this attractive ripe wine now.
title: Vignobles de Saint-Tropez 2016 La Bravade Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is the little brother of Brumont's estate wines such as Montus and Bouscassé. It is all fruit, the 80% Tannat tamed easily, leaving a modicum of tannins to support the juicy black fruit. It is a ripe wine that is very ready to drink.
title: Vignobles Brumont 2012 Petit Torus Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: This wine comes from Gascony, where the Gascon and his famous beret are inseparable. This blend of mainly Gros Manseng has some herbal character but it also has yellow fruits, and a ripe edge of honey that softens and fills out the crisp green-fruit flavors. Drink now.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2015 Beret Blanc  (Saint-Mont)

description: The wine is light but it also has very fine fruitiness and great balanced acidity. With a creamy texture and touches of yellow fruit as well as citrus, the wine is refreshingly fruity with great final acidity in a ripe rounded context. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2016 Chardonnay (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The name is a reference to the youngest member of the family, obviously a lively kid. The wine is pretty lively as well with plenty of bright acidity, crisp red fruits and just a touch of caramel. Drink now.
title: Domaine des Diables 2016 Le Petit Diable Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: It's an evocative name and that's what Provence rosé is about. The wine works well to fulfill that dream with its bright fruit and easy quaffable character. It has just a touch of spice to add an edge to the bright fruits. Drink now.
title: Château Sainte-Béatrice 2016 Summer Dreams Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This soft wine is a blend of 80% Malbec and 20% Merlot. With ripe red fruits, it is a smooth wine, now mature, with a light texture. Not for aging, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Château Saint-Sernin 2012 Chateau Quattre Malbec (Cahors)

description: The wine shows the richness that the Merlot attained in this vintage. Happily, it also has acidity and red fruits to balance the pepper and wood-aging flavors. It will always be a superripe wine although it will develop a smoother mature side. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Laulerie 2015 Merlot (Bergerac)

description: Selected from a portion of the family vineyard, this soft wine, named after the owner of the estate, is gently ripe but with the potential to bring out even more fruitiness. The aftertaste is crisp and ripe.
title: Château Hermitage Saint-Martin 2016 Enzo Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a soft and perfumed wine that is crisp yet ripely fruited. With its bright red fruits, orange-peel accent and gentle texture, it is a full-bodied style that will be great for food. Drink now.
title: Aimé Roquesante 2015 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Dumangin's nonvintage blend, is smooth, creamy and soft. It is on the dry side, with some good bottle age, showing in toast and a very textured fruit character.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Brut 17  (Champagne)

description: Dumangin's nonvintage blend, is smooth, creamy and soft. It is on the dry side, with some good bottle age, showing in toast and a very textured fruit character.
title: J. Dumangin Fils NV Brut 17  (Champagne)

description: One of the successes from Pessac-Léognan, this refined, structured wine is singing already with its fruitiness. Ripe and forward, it is developing into a medium-bodied, perfumed wine that will be ready to drink relatively quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine de Chevalier 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Spice and wood aromas show on this still-structured wine. It has fresh acidity, red berries and tight tannins that are still developing. The wine is light and fruity while also having enough structure to allow it to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Margaux 2013 Pavillon Rouge du Château Margaux  (Margaux)

description: This Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot dominated wine is dense with tannins, although with enough fruit richness to balance. It has a dark texture and shows plenty of wood flavors at this stage. Its weight will allow it to age well, so wait until 2022. The Bonnet family has renovated vineyards and installed a gravity-fed winery. They also own a winery in Argentina and nearby Gazin Rocquencourt.
title: Château Malartic-Lagravière 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: From one of the properties owned by Bernard Magrez, this wine exhibits the opulent character he seems to like. Rich and full of black-plum flavors, it offers all the fruit of the vintage with the right amount of tannins to support it. Drink from 2018.
title: Château les Grands Chênes 2013  Médoc

description: Made in a firm, solid style, this wine shows considerable potential. Pure berry flavors are prominent along with the dense tannins. It is a good wine for the difficult vintage and will be ready to drink from 2020. The estate is in the process of converting to biodynamic methods.
title: Château Durfort-Vivens 2013  Margaux

description: This wood-aged wine, one of the château's top white cuvées, needs to age. With its toast and ripe yellow and white fruits, it is rich and full, a reflection of good whites in a drab red Bordeaux vintage. After a bitter smoky edge from the toastiness softens, it will be a very fine wine. Drink from 2017. This Lévèque family estate is a member of the Union des Grands Crus de Bordeaux.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2013 Cuvée Caroline  (Graves)

description: This is a fruity wine with juicy acids and fresh black-currant and berry flavors. The tannins are present, but they are well integrated into the fruit and acidity. It's bright and ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château Lafleur de Haute-Serre Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a fruity wine with juicy acids and fresh black-currant and berry flavors. The tannins are present, but they are well integrated into the fruit and acidity. It's bright and ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château Lafleur de Haute-Serre Malbec (Cahors)

description: A black-fruited wine with a strong sense of structure and wood, it has spice and black-plum flavors that are held together by tannins. This can age for a few years.
title: Domaine du Moulin 2010 Red (Gaillac)

description: This is a mint- and licorice-flavored wine, with its wood aging prominent at this stage. Full bodied, rich and concentrated, it shows strong signs of extraction that give it a bitter finish. Age this tannic wine for 2–3 years or more.
title: Château Lestruelle 2010  Médoc

description: A creamed apple aroma is followed by a creamy palate. It has tight acidity that lends brightness and freshness, with a crisp, fruity finish.
title: Château Jolys 2011  Jurançon Sec

description: A creamed apple aroma is followed by a creamy palate. It has tight acidity that lends brightness and freshness, with a crisp, fruity finish.
title: Château Jolys 2011  Jurançon Sec

description: This is a juicy black-currant flavored wine that's ripe in tannin and in fruitiness. It has a hint of bitter extraction and an edge of dark wood aging, which need to soften and become round, so age it for at least five years.
title: Château Carcanieux 2010  Médoc

description: With a rich, dense texture, this is an opulent, generous and ready-to-drink wine packed with black fruits. Tannins are now well integrated into the fruit and a touch of wood aging smoothes it all out. It's a bountiful wine, ready to drink now.
title: Alain Brumont 2010 Torus Tannat-Cabernet (Madiran)

description: This is a soft, easygoing style from the Millets, now in their third generation in Sancerre. With attractive white stone fruits and a citrus streak, the wine has delicious refreshing acidity and a light bright aftertaste. Drink now.
title: François Millet 2016  Sancerre

description: This spicy, strongly perfumed wine is full of fruit and juicy acidity. It's dry and structured, with a firm backdrop of tannins. It will be great for the winter.
title: Florent Descombe NV Syrah (Vin de France)

description: This is a smooth, ripe and generous wine befitting southern Merlot. It has just the right amount of acidity, black currant fruitiness and a smoky aftertaste.
title: Florent Descombe NV Merlot (Vin de France)

description: This is a smooth, ripe and generous wine befitting southern Merlot. It has just the right amount of acidity, black currant fruitiness and a smoky aftertaste.
title: Florent Descombe NV Merlot (Vin de France)

description: This cool-climate Pinot Noir is soft and gentle. Its ripe tannins and cherry flavors are both lightly structured and juicy. Although still young, it's ready to drink.
designation: Alphonse Dolly Les Doigts d'Or de Dolly
title: Eric Louis 2016 Alphonse Dolly Les Doigts d'Or de Dolly Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: From the Sancerre vineyard of this Pouilly-Fumé producer, this is a ripe wine. Packed with apple and rich peppered-pear flavors, it is spicy, shot through with acidity and lightly mineral at the end. The wine is ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Croix-Canat La Vendangette
title: Domaine Tinel-Blondelet 2015 Domaine de la Croix-Canat La Vendangette  (Sancerre)

description: From the Sancerre vineyard of this Pouilly-Fumé producer, this is a ripe wine. Packed with apple and rich peppered-pear flavors, it is spicy, shot through with acidity and lightly mineral at the end. The wine is ready to drink.
designation: Domaine de la Croix-Canat La Vendangette
title: Domaine Tinel-Blondelet 2015 Domaine de la Croix-Canat La Vendangette  (Sancerre)

description: This oddly named Cabernet Sauvignon is fine. It has light tannins, a juicy, stalky character, upfront black currant fruit and balanced acidity. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Romantic Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: Light, bright and packed with crisp fruit, this is a refreshing wine. Produced from Pinot Noir, it has red-cherry flavors along with a mineral texture and bright fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Joseph Mellot 2016 Le Rabault Rosé (Sancerre)

description: A soft style, this is ripe with attractive apple and crisp pear fruits. The wine is refreshing with its acidity lacing through the flinty texture. The wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Jérôme Gueneau 2016 Le Clos Chartier  (Sancerre)

description: This producer has a number of estates in Sancerre. This estate, bearing his own name, has produced a delicate, crisp and fruity wine. Its acidity and tight texture make this wine really food friendly.
title: Jérôme Gueneau 2016 Domaine J. Gueneau Rosé (Sancerre)

description: This producer has a number of estates in Sancerre. This estate, bearing his own name, has produced a delicate, crisp and fruity wine. Its acidity and tight texture make this wine really food friendly.
title: Jérôme Gueneau 2016 Domaine J. Gueneau Rosé (Sancerre)

description: The Chardonnay in this blend with Vermentino creates a smooth, unctuous texture. Acidity and richness combine to bring out citrus and apricot flavors. The end delivers a zesty, mineral tang. Drink now.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2016 Domaine Vetriccie White (Ile de Beauté)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: Crisp and full of green apple and squeezed lemon juice, this is a fruity wine that has a tight edge of steely texture as a contrast. It is a fine, refreshing and tangy wine, hinting at minerality and ready to drink.
title: Thibault 2015 Fernand & Sons Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: From a small appellation north of the Pouilly-Fumé region, this wine is lightly fruity. It has creamy acidity and a perfumed character that comes from the lemon and honey fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2015 Domaine de Terres Blanches Alchimie Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: This is rounded, soft and textured with spice and pepper. Acidity gives freshness while leaving the wine full in the mouth and generous in character. It's for drinking now.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This off-dry wine presents a great balance between the spicy flavors and the tropical fruits. It's a lightly textured wine, already accessible, with a touch of pepper at the end along with just enough acidity.
