title: Domaine Jean-Luc Mader 2013 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: If you want spicy, lychee-flavored Gewurztraminer, look no further. The wine is laced with bergamot, with a medium-dry fruit character and balanced freshness at the end. It's ready to drink.
title: Charles Sparr 2013 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: With good acidity, this is a crisp, dry style of Pinot Gris. Plenty of spice and tropical fruits give richness to this fresh wine.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2013 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: With good acidity, this is a crisp, dry style of Pinot Gris. Plenty of spice and tropical fruits give richness to this fresh wine.
title: Cave de Turckheim 2013 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Well on the way to sweet, this soft, spicy wine has light acidity and a gentle feel, with just a tangy, mineral edge to suggest some potential. Drink now.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2012 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Well on the way to sweet, this soft, spicy wine has light acidity and a gentle feel, with just a tangy, mineral edge to suggest some potential. Drink now.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2012 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This can be a somewhat edgy wine, but the warmth of 2009 has softened it, imparting a rich, velvety texture and flavors of dried cherries, leather, cinnamon and clove. The long finish features a chocolaty note. Drink now–2025.
title: Perrin & Fils 2009 Les Christins Red (Vacqueyras)

description: This can be a somewhat edgy wine, but the warmth of 2009 has softened it, imparting a rich, velvety texture and flavors of dried cherries, leather, cinnamon and clove. The long finish features a chocolaty note. Drink now–2025.
title: Perrin & Fils 2009 Les Christins Red (Vacqueyras)

description: Showing signs of maturity, this is a delicious, rich and ripe wine, full of citrus, mineral and perfumed white fruits. Though rich, it is also bone dry, with tight texture and powerful acidity.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2009 Osterberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This ripe, fruity and perfumed wine is delicious. Juicy red and black fruits ooze from every part of its smoky structure. It comes from vines on a small plateau called Pisse-Vieille in Brouilly. The wine is ready to drink for its fruity pleasure.
title: Domaine Bertrand 2015 Pisse-Vieille  (Brouilly)

description: This perfumed wine comes from the home vineyard of the producer. With soft tannins and juicy red-berry fruit, the wine is straightforward, delicious and very much in the style of the vintage. It has a crisp end of acidity that gives it just the right lift. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Arnoux Père et Fils 2015 Les Beaumonts  (Chorey-lès-Beaune)

description: The lightest touch of wood gives this wine a full, rich character. Weight and density are balanced by the intense acidity. Melon, apricots and citrus are all blended in this ripe wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2015  Meursault

description: Ripe tannins and rich red-plum fruits give this wine a generous rounded character. Bringing out the generosity of this vintage, the wine is a balance between the broad fruits and acidity. In the background, the tannins give the wine extra weight. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Santenay 2015 Les Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Ripe tannins and rich red-plum fruits give this wine a generous rounded character. Bringing out the generosity of this vintage, the wine is a balance between the broad fruits and acidity. In the background, the tannins give the wine extra weight. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Santenay 2015 Les Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Rich and structured, this firm wine has concentration from dense white and yellow fruits plus richness from the wood aging. This intense wine is still developing, so drink from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2015  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Rich and structured, this firm wine has concentration from dense white and yellow fruits plus richness from the wood aging. This intense wine is still developing, so drink from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2015  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: Produced from vines that are up to 40 years old, this is a firmly structured wine. Concentration and dry tannins come from some firm extraction. The fruit though is ripe and juicy, showing red-berry flavors along with spice from the wood aging. Drink the wine from 2019.
title: Château de Chénas 2015  Moulin-à-Vent

description: Produced from vines that are up to 40 years old, this is a firmly structured wine. Concentration and dry tannins come from some firm extraction. The fruit though is ripe and juicy, showing red-berry flavors along with spice from the wood aging. Drink the wine from 2019.
title: Château de Chénas 2015  Moulin-à-Vent

description: This wine is full of acidity, with a crisp edge that's a delicious part of the riper fruit. The wood-aging spiciness is well judged to give a balanced wine that is generous and ready to drink.
title: Château de Beauregard 2015 Vers Cras  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A rounded, ripe wine, this is packed with yellow fruits and touched with melon softness. It has toast as well as a mineral texture that give strong backing to the ripe fruitiness. This is likely to develop quickly, drink from 2019.
title: Jaffelin 2015 Passetemps Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Made from organically grown grapes, this wine is structured and still firm, with ripe berry fruits buried in the structure. As it matures, this rich wine will open out generously. Drink from 2019.
title: Vignobles Bulliat 2016 Nature  (Morgon)

description: With its spice and wood flavors, this wine is rich and deliciously concentrated. It has a bold yellow fruit and spice character that is warm and rounded. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Marcel Couturier 2015 Le Bourg  (Pouilly-Loché)

description: The wine has a good structure with sophisticated tannins and perfumed acidity. Black cherry and spice from the wood are balanced by the freshness of the acidity and the rounded aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Latour 2015 Domaine Latour  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: This crisp wine is packed with delicious fruit and balanced acidity. It shows some of the richness of the vintage, but goes more in a tangy, mineral direction. With lively acidity, it is refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2015  Pouilly-Vinzelles

description: This crisp wine is packed with delicious fruit and balanced acidity. It shows some of the richness of the vintage, but goes more in a tangy, mineral direction. With lively acidity, it is refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2015  Pouilly-Vinzelles

description: This ripe, wood-aged wine is generous and smooth. Spice and toastiness are balanced by the apricot and citrus fruits. One gives richness, the other crispness. It is a wine with a future. Drink from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Les Reversées Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This ripe, wood-aged wine is generous and smooth. Spice and toastiness are balanced by the apricot and citrus fruits. One gives richness, the other crispness. It is a wine with a future. Drink from 2020.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Les Reversées Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This rich and structured wine is packed with both ripe black fruits and concentrated tannins. It is a big wine, a fine representation of this appellation with its dense flavors and aging potential. The wine should be ready from 2021.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: A light and fruity wine with a slight tincture of tannin and acidity. Red-cherry and banana flavors dominate this readily drinkable wine.
title: Barton & Guestier 2015 Les Violettes  (Beaujolais)

description: Finely structured, this is a fruity wine with bright cherry fruit and acidity. It has a drier edge that gives it texture and shape. The fresher aftertaste gives the wine a fruity lift. Drink now.
title: Vignerons des Pierres Dorées 2015 La Rose Pourpre Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: Aromas of white clover, carnation and lime leaf lead the nose of this crisp and easy white. Fruity tones of underripe peach and melon rind unfold on the palate, coupled with zippy lime-like acidity and a saline streak that lifts the close. Drink up.
title: Saint-Jean des Sources 2015 Picpoul (Languedoc)

description: This is a fruity, perfumed wine with just enough structure to keep it all together. Fresh and with red fruit flavors, it is already drinkable.
title: Rigal 2014 Oltesse Malbec (Cahors)

description: From organic grapes and bottled without added sulfur, this is a fruity juicy wine with a strangely perfumed, geranium character. It has soft tannins, and hints of red fruits behind the perfume. The aftertaste is the only firm part of this fresh wine, which can be drunk young.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2015 K-Pot' Malbec (Cahors)

description: Light and fruity, this wine has blackberry flavors to balance its soft texture and dusty tannins. The wine has an earthy edge to go with its simple fruit and lively acidity. Drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Cedrus Malbec

description: A blend of Ugni Blanc and Colombard from Gascony, the wine has crisp herbaceous flavors and a tight zesty texture. It is light, refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Cedrus le Blanc White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A blend of Ugni Blanc and Colombard from Gascony, the wine has crisp herbaceous flavors and a tight zesty texture. It is light, refreshing and ready to drink.
title: Château du Cèdre 2015 Cedrus le Blanc White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Flowery and fresh, this is a classic cool-climate white. Fragrant acidity is balanced by the citrus and pear flavors. Fruity and crisp, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Uby 2014 No. 1 Sauvignon Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This green, intensely herbaceous wine comes from Sauvignon Blanc and Colombard vines growing on sandy soil. It is full of lemon and grapefruit flavors that give the wine a tight, almost steely texture. It should be drunk from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine de Ballade 2014 Ballade Blanc White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This green, intensely herbaceous wine comes from Sauvignon Blanc and Colombard vines growing on sandy soil. It is full of lemon and grapefruit flavors that give the wine a tight, almost steely texture. It should be drunk from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine de Ballade 2014 Ballade Blanc White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This entry-level wine from Lagrézette is certainly purple in color. With touches of wood under the juicy red fruit flavors, and soft tannins, it cries out for a barbecue.
title: Château Lagrézette 2009 The Original Purple Malbec (Cahors)

description: This crisp, dry rosé is very fresh with delicious acidity. It has a bright character, lively and full of raspberry flavors. Drink now.
title: Château la Colombière 2014 Vinum Rosé (Fronton)

description: This soft and fruity wine has only the lightest of tannic structures. Black currants and stalky berries dominate along with bright acidity. It can be drunk now.
title: Domaine Seailles 2012 Cubik Merlot (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This soft and fruity wine has only the lightest of tannic structures. Black currants and stalky berries dominate along with bright acidity. It can be drunk now.
title: Domaine Seailles 2012 Cubik Merlot (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Red currants dominate this textured rosé that has a mineral element along with its fresh fruit and tight acidity. The aftertaste is brilliant with crispness.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2014 Terrisses Rosé (Gaillac)

description: Grapefruit flavor is the key to this attractive, fruity wine. Crisp and lightly herbaceous, it is fresh while also having a rounder background. Drink now, but better to wait until early 2016.
title: Domaine D'en Ségur 2014 Sauvignon Blanc (Côtes du Tarn)

description: Green apples and citrus flavors dominate this fresh, fruity wine with its finishing acidity. It's light, bright and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Millet 2014 Colombard-Ugni Blanc (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Crisp and full of raspberry and red currant fruit flavors, this is an attractive, ready-to-drink wine. A pure line of acidity lifts the fruitiness and gives the wine a bright, very fresh aftertaste.
title: Château Bouissel 2014 Rosenc Rosé (Fronton)

description: One of the most commonly seen French rosés in the U.S., La Vieille Ferme's 2013 delivers a mouthful of bold red fruit, plenty of weight on the palate and a pleasant but quick finish. Drink up.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2013 Rosé (Ventoux)

description: One of the most commonly seen French rosés in the U.S., La Vieille Ferme's 2013 delivers a mouthful of bold red fruit, plenty of weight on the palate and a pleasant but quick finish. Drink up.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2013 Rosé (Ventoux)

description: This fruity, aromatic wine is fresh and crisp. It has a strongly herbaceous, citrus character and an intensely perfumed backdrop. Drink now.
title: Vignerons de Buzet 2013 Baron d'Ardeuil Vieilles Vignes White (Buzet)

description: There are hints of oak aging in old barrels in this wine. That gives a rich texture to the bright red fruits and perfumed acidity. It is ready to drink now, although with some aging its fruit will mellow and it will broaden out. For that, wait until 2018.
title: Domaine du Clos de l'Elu 2013 Magellan Cabernet Franc (Anjou Villages)

description: This is a fine, ripe wine with a good balance between crisp, mineral acidity and tangy lemon fruit. It has a peppery edge that gives a bite to the young fruit. It is ready to drink although it will be better from 2017.
title: Domaine des Tilleuls 2015 Essentielle Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A fully ripe wine, that has black-currant and blueberry fruit, fine acidity and balanced tannins. It is juicy, fruity although with a good structure that will allow it to age longer. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos des Justices 2012  Bordeaux

description: From the family estate of Bordeaux wine gurus Denis and Florence Dubourdieu, this is a crisp, refreshing Sauvignon Blanc/Sémillon blend that appeals immediately. Bright acidity, freshly squeezed lemon and a herbal, green edge all make for a wine that is drinkable now as an apéritif as well as with food.
title: Château Reynon 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine is dry and firm with solid tannins as well as blackberry fruit. It is structured, balanced by juicy acidity and oak-aging flavors. The wine comes from the slopes of the Côtes de Bordeaux about the small town of Cadillac.
title: Chateau de Sadran 2012 Prestige  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: The wine is dry and firm with solid tannins as well as blackberry fruit. It is structured, balanced by juicy acidity and oak-aging flavors. The wine comes from the slopes of the Côtes de Bordeaux about the small town of Cadillac.
title: Chateau de Sadran 2012 Prestige  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Vincent Lataste's organic wine is light, bright and immediately refreshing. This is a wine that shows a strongly herbal side. It has citrus and green apple flavors that are crisp and tight. With perfumed acidity at the end, the wine is delicious to drink now. It won 2016 Best of Wine Tourism award for B&B in giant wine barrels.
title: Château de Lardiley 2015 Sauvignon  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This bone-dry, fresh wine is crisp with citrus and apple flavors. There are touches of wood aging that adds spice to the tangy acidity and touches of honey. Perfumed and bright at the end, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Fesles 2014 La Chapelle Vieilles Vignes Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: This bone-dry, fresh wine is crisp with citrus and apple flavors. There are touches of wood aging that adds spice to the tangy acidity and touches of honey. Perfumed and bright at the end, the wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Fesles 2014 La Chapelle Vieilles Vignes Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: Fresh and stalky, this is a wine that brings out the smokiness of Cabernet Franc and puts it along with crisp red-berry fruits and acidity. A wine to be drunk young, although with enough concentration to age, it will be ready in late 2016.
title: Château de Fesles 2014 La Chapelle Vieilles Vignes Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: In 2001, Aliénor and Alexandre de Malet Roquefort bought this property which is 15 minutes southeast of their Château La Gaffelière. From 8.5 acres of Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Muscadelle, this is a rounded, soft wine that promises well. It is going towards the tropical fruit area with its apricot and pineapple flavors. Behind, the acidity is tangy and crisp with a tight, nervy aftertaste.
title: Château Chapelle d'Aliénor 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: With a high proportion (60%) of Merlot, this is a ripe wine while also being structured. It has a dense character that comes from the still young, firm tannins. Behind these are the ripest black-currant fruits, crisp and juicy, packed with flavor as well as acidity. Drink this wine from 2019.
title: Château Bardins 2011  Pessac-Léognan

description: Bordeaux has always had Malbec in its vineyards although it is rare. This unusual wine shows how, in a fruity year, the grape can work well. The tannins are soft, giving a juicy black-fruited wine that is forward and delicious to drink now for its succulent fruit.
title: Vignobles Raymond 2014 En Mémoire du  (Bordeaux)

description: Bordeaux has always had Malbec in its vineyards although it is rare. This unusual wine shows how, in a fruity year, the grape can work well. The tannins are soft, giving a juicy black-fruited wine that is forward and delicious to drink now for its succulent fruit.
title: Vignobles Raymond 2014 En Mémoire du  (Bordeaux)

description: Crisp and fruity, this is an immediately attractive win from the fourth generation of the Bonhur family. It has bright acidity, a herbal edge and perfumed apple and lemon flavors. The wine is totally ready to drink.
title: Vignobles Bonhur 2015 Château Terres Douces  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Fresh and fruity, this wine is also lightly herbal and shows touches of wood. It is crisp, tangy with its yellow-fruit flavors mingling with the citrus acidity. The wine will be ready to drink from late 2016.
title: Le Nardian 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is round, smooth and rich. The palate brings a tangy, herbal texture, but this is balanced by the ripe apricot and white peach flavors. The aftertaste reveals a more spicy flavor.
title: Château Gazin Rocquencourt 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a concentrated wine, full of blackberry fruits with acidity and spice. The wood-aging character is balancing out well, giving structure without dominating the fruit. Drink from 2020. Grapes are vinified by variety and plot from the 60-acre vineyard of Cabernet Sauvignon (55%), Merlot (40%) and Petit Verdot (5%). The property was purchased by Jean-Christophe Mau in 2004.
title: Château Brown 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Tight and stalky, this wine has considerable acidity. Firm tannins in the background give some promise of aging. At this stage, the wine is more about structure than fruit and thus is very early in its development. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Brane-Cantenac 2013  Margaux

description: From an estate that claims to date back to Roman times and has been revived by the current owners, this attractive wine features dusty tannins and ripe, juicy blackberry-flavored Merlot. A touch of perfume and plenty of acidity at the end keep it fresh. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Saint-André Corbin 2013  Saint-Georges-Saint-Émilion

description: Young, fruity and with potential, this is a perfumed while also structured wine. It has plenty of black-currant flavors as well as delicious acidity. The dry core keeps the fruitiness together. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Roche-Lalande 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This well-made, ripe and fruity wine has soft tannins that are already well integrated with the red-berry fruits. Acidity keeps it all fresh and suggests the wine could age over the medium-term. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lestage 2013  Listrac-Médoc

description: This well-made, ripe and fruity wine has soft tannins that are already well integrated with the red-berry fruits. Acidity keeps it all fresh and suggests the wine could age over the medium-term. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Lestage 2013  Listrac-Médoc

description: Rich and concentrated, this blend is mainly Merlot, with a little Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec. The alcohol shows in the weight of the wine, but the freshness is still very present. Powerful, dark and still young, the wine will be best from 2017.
title: Château l'Espérance 2010 Cuvée Trois Frères  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Rich and concentrated, this blend is mainly Merlot, with a little Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec. The alcohol shows in the weight of the wine, but the freshness is still very present. Powerful, dark and still young, the wine will be best from 2017.
title: Château l'Espérance 2010 Cuvée Trois Frères  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: What is so good about this wine is its balance. The producer has accentuated the fruit of the vintage, leaving aside any big tannic structure. The result is a black-currant wine that is juicy, fresh and developing well. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Le Boscq 2013  Saint-Estèphe

description: All about freshness, this wine has crisp red-currant flavors and bright acidity. The tannins are just a background to the juicy, fruity front. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Latour à Pomerol 2013  Pomerol

description: This ripe, juicy and fruity wine has plenty of tannins, although they have easily integrated into the black fruits and fresh acidity. The wine is already surprisingly balanced, so although it will improve with age, it can be enjoyed now.
title: Château Laroque 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: This Graves estate has vines in nearby Sauternes where it has produced this honey and orange-flavored wine. It is light and fresh while still having a wonderful sweet and dry character. The acidity at the end is delicious. Drink now for its fruit, although the wine will age at least until 2025.
title: Château Lapinesse 2013  Sauternes

description: Already balanced, this is a rich wine, packed with jammy fruit and tannins. The concentration contrasts with the intense, fresh acidity. Good depth of flavor comes with a dense texture and a final shot of pure acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Laforge 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Already balanced, this is a rich wine, packed with jammy fruit and tannins. The concentration contrasts with the intense, fresh acidity. Good depth of flavor comes with a dense texture and a final shot of pure acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Laforge 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: Dry and firm, this wine just escapes being too toasty. Instead there is room for the fruit to begin to show, with black-currant flavors and fresh acidity. It's not a wine for aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2013  Margaux

description: Dry and firm, this wine just escapes being too toasty. Instead there is room for the fruit to begin to show, with black-currant flavors and fresh acidity. It's not a wine for aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2013  Margaux

description: This wine is medium sweet in style with a rich, complex character. It has notes of spice and honey that accent ripe peach and apricot flavors. The richness of the wine comes from it's dense texture. It is ready to drink now, but will also age well.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2010 Kessler Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is medium sweet in style with a rich, complex character. It has notes of spice and honey that accent ripe peach and apricot flavors. The richness of the wine comes from it's dense texture. It is ready to drink now, but will also age well.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2010 Kessler Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a perfumed, structured wine that is showing both tannins and fruit well. While ripe and full of black fruits, it's also bright with acidity. It is just beginning to develop, with a dark, tarry texture that lingers on the finish.
title: Domaine la Bastide Blanche 2010 Red (Bandol)

description: The sand and granite soil of the Brand vineyard gives an intensely structured wine that's tight and steely. It's rich with apricot and pear flavors made crisp with refreshing acidity. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2010 Brand Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: With its ripe acidity, this is a wine that is ready to drink. It shows strong Cabernet Sauvignon ripeness, with a structure that is now soft and generous, along with cushioned tannins and an opulent feel. This is a wine to savor.
title: Château Vignelaure 2007 Cabernet-Syrah (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Solid, ripe, perfumed and tannic, this is a concentrated, dark wine. Hints of mint and wood frame rich black fruits on the palate. It is a powerful wine with a good future, so drink from 2015.
title: Château de Calavon 2009 La Réserve Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Solid, ripe, perfumed and tannic, this is a concentrated, dark wine. Hints of mint and wood frame rich black fruits on the palate. It is a powerful wine with a good future, so drink from 2015.
title: Château de Calavon 2009 La Réserve Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a very fine wine with sweetness tempered with a great sense of structure and concentration. Lychees dominate the fruit profile but are supplemented with pineapple and pomelo flavors that are sprinkled with pepper. It is rich and full in the mouth. It needs some more time to age, so drink from 2016.
title: René Muré 2011 Clos Saint-Landelin Vorbourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a deliciously rich Riesling that's so ripe and full in the mouth, but dry in style. It has swathes of fruitiness, a sense of power and intense acidity. For such a complex wine it is surprisingly ready to drink. But waiting would be better, so hold out until 2016.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a deliciously rich Riesling that's so ripe and full in the mouth, but dry in style. It has swathes of fruitiness, a sense of power and intense acidity. For such a complex wine it is surprisingly ready to drink. But waiting would be better, so hold out until 2016.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A wine that is structured and dominated at this stage by its tannins. The potential is there, showing in the rich, supporting fruit and berry flavors that come through as the wine opens up. Drink this wine with its good potential from 2017.
title: Domaine la Bastide Blanche 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: A wine that is structured and dominated at this stage by its tannins. The potential is there, showing in the rich, supporting fruit and berry flavors that come through as the wine opens up. Drink this wine with its good potential from 2017.
title: Domaine la Bastide Blanche 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: While still young and fruity, this has the potential to be a complex, long-lived wine. It boasts stone fruit and white flower aromas, a tight structure and a hint of sweetness. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Albert Mann 2011 Furstentum Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is an impressive, rich, smooth wine. Generous and opulent in style, it has weight and firm tannins along with concentrated black fruits. Brisk acidity and a dry finishing touch lend elegance. Drink from 2016.
title: Mas de la Dame 2011 Réserve du Mas Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: This is a beautifully perfumed wine, that, while rich with fruit, maintains a crisp, steely and tight youthfulness. It's juicy character floods the palate. It's clearly a wine to age, so don't drink before 2016.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2011 Cuvée Ste Catherine Riesling (Alsace)

description: This wine is made from a mix of 13 different grape varieties in a field blend. It's a totally terroir driven wine, full of mineral and gritty textures in its youth. Behind this structure is a wild range of flavors—spice, apples, pears and apricots—waiting to show through. It needs to age, so drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2011 White (Alsace)

description: Developing a golden color, this is already a beautifully mature wine with some sweetness and ripe flavors of yellow fruits and lemon. There's also a touch of honey and spice to this blend of Pinot Gris and Riesling. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Marcel Deiss 2007 Rotenberg White (Alsace)

description: A fruity blend of Pinot Noir and Pinot Blanc, this is soft, creamy and balanced with acidity. The relatively high dosage gives the wine a gentle aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Gyéjacquot Frères NV Collection Brut  (Champagne)

description: There are hints of cream and butter on the nose. They also appear on the palate but are counteracted by very lively frothy lemony fizz. The palate is light and easy with big lively bubbles and a dry, slightly bitter finish.
title: Cave de Hunawihr NV Calixte Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Gros Plant (also known as Folle Blanche) is the second grape of the Pays Nantais region, better know for Muscadet. The grape produces a wine with intense acidity that is crisp, very light and traditionally drunk with oysters. It is vibrantly all fruit and ready to drink.
title: Lieubeau 2016 La Fruitière Folle Blanche Gros Plant

description: This light crisp wine with its yeasty citrus aromas is juicy, fruity and with fine acidity. Its citrus fruits and touch of pepper have been filled out with the lees aging. The wine is ripe and ready now.
designation: Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie
title: Domaine Martin 2016 Le Perd son Pain Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a structured wine, displaying black currant and spice notes. Still young, with grippy tannins and a dusty texture, this will develop quickly into a round and fruity wine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Grand Marchand  (Bordeaux)

description: Ripe and juicy, this full-bodied wine has black plum and berry fruits that are well integrated into the juicy acidity and ripe tannins. The wine will develop quickly, so drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Arnaucosse  (Bordeaux)

description: A lively, open, crisp wine, ready to drink, with a fresh apple and cream flavor complementing its flavors of pineapple and herbaceous edge. Delicious, easy Sauvignon Blanc.
title: Château de Tracy 2006 Mademoiselle de T  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A lively, open, crisp wine, ready to drink, with a fresh apple and cream flavor complementing its flavors of pineapple and herbaceous edge. Delicious, easy Sauvignon Blanc.
title: Château de Tracy 2006 Mademoiselle de T  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: This rich wine is ripe with red-berry fruits, mango and peach. Full in the mouth, it has a touch of spice from the Mourvèdre in the blend. Crisp and lively, the wine could age until 2018, although it will be best from late 2016.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: This rich wine is ripe with red-berry fruits, mango and peach. Full in the mouth, it has a touch of spice from the Mourvèdre in the blend. Crisp and lively, the wine could age until 2018, although it will be best from late 2016.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2015 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: This wine comes from vines south of the Mont Sainte-Victoire and close to the edge of the Aix-en-Provence region. The cool vineyard site helps the wine keep extreme freshness. Plenty of wild strawberry flavors are lifted by acidity and a refreshing citrus edge.
title: Provence Wine Maker 2015 Rose Infinie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A rich Pouilly Fuissé, concentrating on ripe tropical fruits and a rounded structure. The wine has weight, richness and a good density. With all these complex characters, it's a wine that needs to age over at least three years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Clos Reyssié  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A rich Pouilly Fuissé, concentrating on ripe tropical fruits and a rounded structure. The wine has weight, richness and a good density. With all these complex characters, it's a wine that needs to age over at least three years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Clos Reyssié  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Big, bold and tannic, this is powerful Gamay from La Tour du Bief vineyard in Juliénas. It has weight, and a concentrated texture that bodes well for the wine's future. Along with this structure are the fragrant black and red currant fruits, already delicious to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Clef du Bief  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This wine has great strawberry flavors with soft tannins and sweet fruits. It's fragrant, delicate, and very pure in style, with just a hint of structure and likely to age over the medium term.
title: François Bertheau 2011  Chambolle-Musigny

description: A structured wine, packed with red fruits and delightful acidity. There is a core of dark tannin and a solid structure as well as the bright freshness at the end. Because it has this structure, it's worth aging for 4–5 years.
title: Domaine des Croix 2011  Beaune

description: Firm in tannins, but bright with cherry fruits, this has lovely youthful acidity. Firmer tannins promise good aging over the next 4–5 years.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2011 La Colombière  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: Already harmonious, this is a potentially opulent wine with a dry core surrounded by ripe red cherry and berry fruit. At the end, the spice adds a fuller note.
title: Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair 2011 Aux Cras Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This is an elegant, smooth wine that draws out the freshness of the vintage as much as the fruitiness. It has ripe, soft tannins, juicy red-fruit flavors and an intriguing smokiness. With acidity holding the wine in check, it should age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2011 Montrevenots Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This is an elegant, smooth wine that draws out the freshness of the vintage as much as the fruitiness. It has ripe, soft tannins, juicy red-fruit flavors and an intriguing smokiness. With acidity holding the wine in check, it should age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Jean Monnier et Fils 2011 Montrevenots Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: A ripe, soft, generous wine, laden with blackberry fruits as well as spice from wood aging. Rich and full-bodied, it has power and concentration from dark tannins as well as the ripe, opulent black fruits of the vintage. Drink from 2014.
title: Château Siaurac 2009  Lalande de Pomerol

description: A ripe, soft, generous wine, laden with blackberry fruits as well as spice from wood aging. Rich and full-bodied, it has power and concentration from dark tannins as well as the ripe, opulent black fruits of the vintage. Drink from 2014.
title: Château Siaurac 2009  Lalande de Pomerol

description: Still dominated by its new wood aromas, this is a fine, structured wine that is only just setting out. It has fine weight, rich blackberry fruits and dark tannins. The spicy wood still needs to integrate, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Bel-Air Ortet 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a successful off-dry Champagne emphasizing fruitiness balanced comfortably with acidity. It showscases rich creamed apple and pear alongside a deep citrus element. A great accompaniment for salads, soft cheeses and seafood.
title: Chanoine NV Tsarine Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: Ripe and soft with rich apple flavor, there's a fullness to this wine. While elegant with a touch of maturity from bottle ageing, the palate is freshened a crispness and levity characteristic of the house style. It has enough weight to accompany food and is ready to drink now.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: Ripe and soft with rich apple flavor, there's a fullness to this wine. While elegant with a touch of maturity from bottle ageing, the palate is freshened a crispness and levity characteristic of the house style. It has enough weight to accompany food and is ready to drink now.
title: Canard-Duchêne NV Cuvée Léonie Brut  (Champagne)

description: One of the most familiar of Champagnes, the Yellow Label is finely made—a fruity while structured wine. It has both fresh and fragrant fruit as well as richness, a soft, creamy texture and bright acidity. There is no sense in bottle aging here—drink this wine because of its crispness.
title: Veuve Clicquot Ponsardin NV Yellow Label Brut  (Champagne)

description: This crisp, delicate Blanc de Blancs is full of white fruit, but steely and citrusy on the palate. Taut, tight and complex with a layered acidity, this is a nervy, textured wine. Although it is ready to drink now, a few more months in the bottle will make it even better.
title: Jean-Noël Haton NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A rare Champagne made only from red grapes, this dry wine is marked by an intense acidity that needs time to soften. At the moment, lemon flavor dominates, but with time, the crispness of fruit should round out. It's a wine that should age for many years. Drink from 2015.
designation: Cuvée Garance Blanc de Rouges Brut Millesimé
title: Thiénot 2006 Cuvée Garance Blanc de Rouges Brut Millesimé  (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe, full and fruity wine that is typical Savigny with its warm red fruits and gentle tannins. It's a rounded, already attractive wine that's full of strawberry and bilberry flavors. It can be drunk now– 2019.
title: Patrick Javillier 2011 Patrick Javillier  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: This copper colored rosé is a touch flat, with notes of mushy red berries and melon rind that are hit with a minty accent. The palate is zippy and lifted by ample acidity, though there's a noticeable sweetness to the ripe-fruit flavors.
title: WYSIWYG 2015 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: The nose gives almost nothing away, while the palate discloses only a little pear fruit, boosted by some residual sweetness that makes this wine off dry. It has a gentle, easy charm. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Affenberg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Delicate scents of white flowers and fresh herbs frame the core notes of green apple and lime zest. Refreshing and easy drinking, ample acidity lifts the melon pith and citrus peel flavors that flesh out the medium-weight palate, finishing clean yet short.
designation: Paul Mas Estate Single Vineyard Collection
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2015 Paul Mas Estate Single Vineyard Collection  (Picpoul de Pinet)

description: This banana-flavored wine is soft and gently fruity. It has crisp acidity as well as a light tangy texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Thulon 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This banana-flavored wine is soft and gently fruity. It has crisp acidity as well as a light tangy texture. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Thulon 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This light-weight, easygoing wine offers subtle notes of red cherry, plum and currant on the nose and mouth. A hint of fresh mint adds a touch of interest to the nose. Drink now.
title: Château de Jonquieres 2015 Cuvée Cersius Rosé (Languedoc)

description: This light-weight, easygoing wine offers subtle notes of red cherry, plum and currant on the nose and mouth. A hint of fresh mint adds a touch of interest to the nose. Drink now.
title: Château de Jonquieres 2015 Cuvée Cersius Rosé (Languedoc)

description: This is a wine that has tannins as well as crisp red-currant fruit. It is lightly textured with a bright shot of acidity. The aftertaste is fresh and lively.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2015 Special Selection  (Beaujolais)

description: There are some fine, dry tannins in this wine along the dark cherry fruit and acidity. It comes from a single vineyard part of the 61-acre estate of Jean-Paul Dubost. There is a ripe feeling here; drink this balanced wine now.
title: Domaine Dubost 2015 Climat le Tracot  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: There are some fine, dry tannins in this wine along the dark cherry fruit and acidity. It comes from a single vineyard part of the 61-acre estate of Jean-Paul Dubost. There is a ripe feeling here; drink this balanced wine now.
title: Domaine Dubost 2015 Climat le Tracot  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A structured and concentrated wine that is packed with tannins. It does have some black fruit under this dry structure although the wine misses out on richness. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
designation: Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2013 Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange  (Morgon)

description: A structured and concentrated wine that is packed with tannins. It does have some black fruit under this dry structure although the wine misses out on richness. It will be ready to drink from 2017.
designation: Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2013 Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup Le Regard de l'Ange  (Morgon)

description: This is an impressively rich wine for a simple Beaujolais. It has plenty of fruit, while it also has a good depth with ripe red-berry fruits and some well-integrated tannins.
title: Collin-Bourisset 2015  Beaujolais

description: Produced in clay amphoras from organically grown grapes, this is an almost honeyed wine even though it's dry. It is richly textured and ripe, with floral and bitter spice tones. Enjoy from 2017.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2014 K-Libre 1040 Chenin Blanc (Côtes du Lot)

description: This is a rich dense wine, full of blackberry fruits. With its firm tannins behind ripe fruitiness, it has fresh acidity and layers of wood to give extra density. The wine is still maturing and should be ready from 2018.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2015 Tour des Gendres Red (Bergerac)

description: Soft notes of honeysuckle adorn mandarin and clementine fruit. The off-dry palate is richer than the nose suggests and its residual sweetness boosts the full-fruited, peachy nature of the wine. It finishes warm, but zesty and citrus-flavored.
title: Wolfberger 2015 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Notes of freshly peeled red apples are inviting and continue on the soft, rounded and generous palate. It has a lovely midpalate mouthfeel and drinks just off dry, with an accent of vanilla and the merest touch of cinnamon.
title: W. Gisselbrecht 2015 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Lemony freshness meets earthy, textured glints on this slender Riesling characterized by its brightness and slender body. Underneath it all, plenty of tart, refreshing apple fruit leads to a clean, lively finish.
title: Vieil Armand 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Oaky aromas of baked apple and toasted wood are upfront on the nose of this wine, but are grounded by ample ripe peach, apple flesh and orange. The medium-weight palate is lushly textured and slightly round in feel, though ample acidity helps to keep the flavors fresh and vibrant through the spicy finish.
title: La Forge Estate 2015 Chardonnay (Pays d'Oc)

description: Upfront, ripe pear fruit plays on nose and palate. These fruit notes are boosted by slight residual sweetness that makes this wine off dry, counterbalanced by a pleasantly bitter pith note. Enjoy this with ripe, runny cheese for a successful combination.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Earthier aspects mix with the fleshy yellow-plum notes on nose and palate. The medium-sweetness puts the ripeness of the fruit center stage, countered by hints of pith and freshness. Drink soon.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2015 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Soft, full and very rounded, this has yellow fruit flavors that are ripe and open, with its acidity emerging slowly. The finish is more focused and fresh.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2010  Mercurey

description: Exhibiting the roundness of the vintage, this is rich and soft. With notes of almond, yeast and yellow fruit, this is already maturing into a bold, open wine. Ready to drink.
title: Château Philippe-le-Hardi 2009 En Vesvau  (Saint-Aubin)

description: A fruity wine from the lesser known Fixin appellation, this has strawberry fruit, soft tannins and a warm, rich texture. The acidity brings out a bright side to this approachable offering.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2009 Cuvée Signature La Mazière  (Fixin)

description: A fruity wine from the lesser known Fixin appellation, this has strawberry fruit, soft tannins and a warm, rich texture. The acidity brings out a bright side to this approachable offering.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2009 Cuvée Signature La Mazière  (Fixin)

description: Savory, juicy, refreshing and textured, this has a crisp green-fruit feel, and is full of bright fruit flavors. The finish continues to express the lively, tight character of the wine.
title: Bernard Defaix 2010  Chablis

description: Savory, juicy, refreshing and textured, this has a crisp green-fruit feel, and is full of bright fruit flavors. The finish continues to express the lively, tight character of the wine.
title: Bernard Defaix 2010  Chablis

description: This is an attractively structured wine, with ripe strawberry and smoky wood flavors. The fruit continues through to the soft finish, which is laced with acidity and a firm tannic core.
title: André Guichot 2010 La Maladière Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Rich, deliciously fruity and ripe, this combines warmth with a more mineral undertow that cuts through the palate, creating a wine that is refreshing and mouth-filling. It would be worth aging for two years or more.
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Domaine Long-Depaquit  (Chablis)

description: Rich, deliciously fruity and ripe, this combines warmth with a more mineral undertow that cuts through the palate, creating a wine that is refreshing and mouth-filling. It would be worth aging for two years or more.
title: Albert Bichot 2010 Domaine Long-Depaquit  (Chablis)

description: This wine comes from a single vineyard on the south bank of the Vienne river. It is ripe, perfumed and generously rich with concentrated blackberry fruit and balanced tannins. Some wood aging has broadened the wine rather than adding flavor. The wine could age another year with noticeable benefit, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Dozon 2015 Clos du Saut au Loup  (Chinon)

description: Prunelard (or Prunelart) is a Gaillac grape that had almost disappeared. Revived by a few enterprising producers, it produces a distinctly fruity, aromatic wine. This bottling's firm edge of tannins and juicy acidity contribute structure and intense fruitiness. Still bursting with youth, it should be aged for another year. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2015 Le Monde en Parle Prunelard (Vin de France)

description: This is one of the entry-level ranges from this top producer. The wine is sophisticated. It has a strong mineral texture and fine ripe citrus and pear fruits shot through with acidity. With its finishing fruitiness, this is already an attractive wine, although it will be better from 2018.
title: Alphonse Mellot 2016 La Moussière  (Sancerre)

description: Ostentatiously ripe, this full-bodied wine hardly hides its richness. It's generous and packed with fruitiness. The acidity and the tighter texture are backdrops to this great burst of fruit. Drink now.
title: Gitton Père et Fils 2015 Les Montachins  (Sancerre)

description: Rich, full of citrus and ripe apple flavors, this is a sophisticated wine. The mineral texture and the dense fruit flavors offer a delicious take on Sauvignon Blanc, giving complexity and ripeness. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Laporte 2016 La Terre des Anges  (Sancerre)

description: This perfumed and wood-aged wine is so stylish. It is smooth in texture, paced with acidity and shows well-balanced red fruits. The wine finishes with fine acidity and delicious fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Bernard Fleuriet et Fils 2015 Tradition  (Sancerre)

description: Soft and creamy, this wine has a line of acidity that gives it great lift. Lime and ripe apples go with green plums to give both freshness and a tangy character. It's a wine to age a few months; drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Perraud 2013  Saint-Véran

description: Soft and creamy, this wine has a line of acidity that gives it great lift. Lime and ripe apples go with green plums to give both freshness and a tangy character. It's a wine to age a few months; drink from 2016.
title: Domaine Perraud 2013  Saint-Véran

description: Ripe and juicy, this wine comes mainly from vines in the Mâcon region. Attractive yellow fruit flavors are filled out with spice and almond, accented by refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Château de Pizay 2014  Bourgogne

description: Soft, dainty scents of pressed sweet pea, white raspberry and cherry dance in the bouquet, while pithy citrus and cherry-skin flavors unfold on the palate. The midpalate shows a touch of roundness, but brisk acidity and a slight bitterness lifts the close. Drink now.
title: Villa des Anges 2014 Old Vines Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft, dainty scents of pressed sweet pea, white raspberry and cherry dance in the bouquet, while pithy citrus and cherry-skin flavors unfold on the palate. The midpalate shows a touch of roundness, but brisk acidity and a slight bitterness lifts the close. Drink now.
title: Villa des Anges 2014 Old Vines Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: Tight, crisp and fruity, this is a refreshing and bright wine. Lively acidity cuts right through the lightly mineral texture. Full of fruit, fresh and lively, this should be drunk now.
title: Jean-Claude Debeaune 2013 Domaine Lenoir  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This soft, ripe perfumed wine has a fine, clean texture of apple skins. Orange zest and a citrus acidity come through strongly in this wine that is bright and fresh at the end. Drink now.
title: Domaine Jean-Paul et Benoît Droin 2013  Petit Chablis

description: From a property that is just below the Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru vineyard, the 30-year-old vines give a round, easygoing wine. The tight texture is really lost in the fresh pear and apple flavors and general ripeness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Billaud-Simon 2013 Tête d'Or  (Chablis)

description: This grassy, very herbaceous wine is all crisp green fruits. Touched by a creamy texture under a layer of freshness, it shows some good weight and structure. There is light wood that rounds it all out.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2006 Héritage  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This grassy, very herbaceous wine is all crisp green fruits. Touched by a creamy texture under a layer of freshness, it shows some good weight and structure. There is light wood that rounds it all out.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2006 Héritage  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A rich wine that shows plenty of berry fruits, supported by some dry but dusty tannins. This is a wine that is going to develop with its firm powerhouse of ripe fruit that is emerging from a tight period in its development.
title: Château Haut Selve 2003  Graves

description: Fine, fresh white Bordeaux from this Entre-deux-Mers property. A blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, just touched by wood, with spice and melon flavors brightened by citrus.
title: Château Thieuley 2008  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Fine, fresh white Bordeaux from this Entre-deux-Mers property. A blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, just touched by wood, with spice and melon flavors brightened by citrus.
title: Château Thieuley 2008  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Lively, crisp wine from an estate founded by the Knights Templar in the 13th century. It is full of delicious red fruits, light acidity and a nervy, mineral aftertaste.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2012 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Complex and powerful, this wood-aged red has both elegance and density. Its black plum and blackberry fruits are spiced with an herbal character that gives an edge to the acidity in the aftertaste. Keep for 4–5 years.
title: Château Léoube 2010 Les Forts de Léoube Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Complex and powerful, this wood-aged red has both elegance and density. Its black plum and blackberry fruits are spiced with an herbal character that gives an edge to the acidity in the aftertaste. Keep for 4–5 years.
title: Château Léoube 2010 Les Forts de Léoube Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rich and smooth, this is a good example of the sumptuous 2009 vintage. It is soft, ripe with blackberry and red plum fruits. It is already developing well. It's a medium-term wine, already juicy and drinkable.
title: Château le Temple 2009  Médoc

description: Produced at Château Haut-Bailly, this concentrated red show the attractive fruit of 2011. It's tannins are relatively gentle, a fine counter-point to the red berry and currant fruits. It's a wine for medium-term aging over the next 4–6 years.
title: Château le Pape 2011  Pessac-Léognan

description: Produced by the winemaking team of Château Giscours in Margaux, this is impressive for a simple Bordeaux. It has weight, rich blackberry fruits, structure and concentration. It could even age.
title: Petite Sirène 2010  Bordeaux

description: Extra fruity, packed with strawberry and crisp red currants flavors, this is all freshness, richness and clean acidity. It has some weight but this just emphasizes the fruitiness.
title: Gassier 2012 Château Beaulieu Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rich, concentrated wine, with generous fruits and soft tannins. It has super-ripe black plums, a touch of chocolate and spice from wood aging. Powerful, juicy, fruity, likely to age well over the medium-term, over the next 3–4 years.
title: Clos Larcis 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Mint and eucalypt aromas set the scene for a modern, polished wine, packed with wood tannins as well as ripe black fruits. Currently, the tannins are winning giving a wine that is dark, structured and dry. So give it at least five years.
title: Château Faizeau 2010 Sélection Vieilles Vignes  (Montagne-Saint-Émilion)

description: This intense, extracted wine shows some bitter tannins along with loganberry and cranberry fruits. There are some spice and herbal flavors in addition to the juicy aftertaste.
title: Domaine Philippe Delesvaux 2005 Cabernet Franc (Anjou)

description: Crisp, red hedgerow fruits and wild strawberries add to the acidity in this wine. There is an edge of greenness, but there is also some weight. Certainly not a powerful wine.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2007 Domaine de Boischampt  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Crisp, red hedgerow fruits and wild strawberries add to the acidity in this wine. There is an edge of greenness, but there is also some weight. Certainly not a powerful wine.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2007 Domaine de Boischampt  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This is ripe, structured and fragrant, with a touch of wood. It shows fine concentration and crisp, fresh citrus on the finish.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2010  Saint-Romain

description: This is ripe, structured and fragrant, with a touch of wood. It shows fine concentration and crisp, fresh citrus on the finish.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2010  Saint-Romain

description: Firm red currant and raspberry fruits dominate this smooth wine. The tannins, which lie underneath, give this round Pinot Noir essential firmness. This needs to age for 2–3 years.
title: Vincent Sauvestre 2010 Les Santenots Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: The wine is ripe, weighty and full of fruit. Its tannins are already softening into the blackberry flavors. The sole question about this wine is the excessive wood aging that has given a burnt edge. Hopefully, this blend of 50-50 Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot will assert its natural fruitiness. Don't drink before 2020.
title: Château Ramafort 2014  Médoc

description: The wine is ripe, weighty and full of fruit. Its tannins are already softening into the blackberry flavors. The sole question about this wine is the excessive wood aging that has given a burnt edge. Hopefully, this blend of 50-50 Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot will assert its natural fruitiness. Don't drink before 2020.
title: Château Ramafort 2014  Médoc

description: This wine with its tight black-currant character, is still also firm with tannins. It has a juicy edge that will develop well as the wine matures. With crisp acidity and structure, it should age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Méric 2014  Médoc

description: This wine with its tight black-currant character, is still also firm with tannins. It has a juicy edge that will develop well as the wine matures. With crisp acidity and structure, it should age. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Méric 2014  Médoc

description: The top of the range wine from this estate is ripe and full of vivid black currant fruits. It does have tannins although these are subordinate to the juicy jammy fruit. The wine is almost ready to drink. Just wait until mid-2017.
title: Château Haut-Mouleyre 2014 Grand Réserve  (Bordeaux)

description: The 65% of Merlot in the blend gives a wine that is soft and rounded. With its acidity and fine tannins, it is fresh and fruity. Black currants and berries dominate a wine that will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut Beyzac 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: The nose is very shy: The wines still needs waking up and only comes alive slowly with a little air. The flavors on the palate seem subdued but there is customary Riesling freshness. The finish is dry.
title: Boeckel 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose is very shy: The wines still needs waking up and only comes alive slowly with a little air. The flavors on the palate seem subdued but there is customary Riesling freshness. The finish is dry.
title: Boeckel 2014 Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a bright, ripe and fruity wine. With its red fruits, gentle tannins and juicy acidity, everything is in place for an early drinking and food friendly wine. Ready from late 2017.
title: Petite Sirène 2015  Bordeaux

description: As so often results from this vineyard, this is a lovely wine, the fruit ripe and showing considerable sweetness as well as richness. The structure is soft, open and elegant, surrounding the core of sweet tannins. Not for long-term aging, but worth waiting 4–5 years.
title: Albert Bichot 2008 Les Amoureuses Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: Full of fruit, this rich wine packs plums and cherries into a style that is sumptuous, with great ripeness. The tannins are soft, sweet and roll well into the rounded structure.
title: Domaine des Comtes Lafon 2007 Santenots Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Relatively light and fruity with tight tannins. The wine has fresh acidity that still dominates the texture. There is a delicious spicy element that edges around the tannic core. It seems firm, not yet ready to soften into middle age.
title: Louis Jadot 2004 Clos Saint-Jacques Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: A powerful wine, offering a dark, textured view of Clos de Vougeot. It is muscular, packed with ripe fruit and a layer of spice and wood. Black plums and prunes provide extra, delicious flavors.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007  Clos de Vougeot

description: Soft and ripe, with a sprinkling of pepper and spice, this is a rich, gentle wine. The tannins are open, lying under the lively black and red berry fruits. It will age over the next few years, but is not for the long-term.
title: Domaine Parent 2007 Les Epenots Premier Cru  (Pommard)

description: Firm and solid, this is a wine marked by blackberries, solid and dense tannins. The concentration will bring all the elements together to give an important wine, while never losing the 2008 acidity.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2008 Les Porrets St.-Georges Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Foursquare, almost chunky, the tannins dominate black fruits, dark chocolate and spice flavors. There is considerable concentration here, along with initial high acidity. Straight from bottling, the fruit is subdued. The weight of the wine, though, confirms that this is going to be a powerhouse.
title: Louis Latour 2008  Echézeaux

description: A powerful wine, packed with solid tannins, giving rich fruit over the hard, youthful structure. Black tannins and complex bitter chocolate and acidity suggest this is a wine that still needs time to knit together. The final is big and generous.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007  Grands-Echezeaux

description: This is a soft, unfocused wine that only hints at fruitiness. It is rounded and full bodied, with a touch of pepper as well as lemon zest acidity at the end.
designation: Brut d'Argent Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: La Cheteau NV Brut d'Argent Brut Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: This is a soft, unfocused wine that only hints at fruitiness. It is rounded and full bodied, with a touch of pepper as well as lemon zest acidity at the end.
designation: Brut d'Argent Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: La Cheteau NV Brut d'Argent Brut Blanc de Blancs Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: The blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah mixes notes of black cherries with hints of red raspberries to create a delicious tension. Dried spices and mocha add nuance, while the tannins are firm at first, fading to the texture of cocoa powder on the long finish. Drink now–2022.
title: Domaine le Renard 2015 Plan De Dieu Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: The blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah mixes notes of black cherries with hints of red raspberries to create a delicious tension. Dried spices and mocha add nuance, while the tannins are firm at first, fading to the texture of cocoa powder on the long finish. Drink now–2022.
title: Domaine le Renard 2015 Plan De Dieu Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: A blend of 50% Syrah and 50% Grenache, this is an attractive and enticing rosé, with delicate aromas of pressed pink flowers, white raspberry, melon rind and underripe guava. The light-plus body lends a slight opulence to the mouthfeel, with flavors of red raspberry and tangerine that end slightly pithy. Drink now.
title: L'Ostal Cazes 2016 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: A blend of 50% Syrah and 50% Grenache, this is an attractive and enticing rosé, with delicate aromas of pressed pink flowers, white raspberry, melon rind and underripe guava. The light-plus body lends a slight opulence to the mouthfeel, with flavors of red raspberry and tangerine that end slightly pithy. Drink now.
title: L'Ostal Cazes 2016 Rosé (Pays d'Oc)

description: The wine is initially light and fruity. It then opens up to give a much richer character that involves ripe white stone fruit and intense acidity. It is dense, with a tangy edge that adds minerality to the complex mix. This is part of a series of wines named after the subsoil in which the vines are planted. The fine wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de l'Ecu 2014 Gneiss  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a yellow fruit and spice flavored wine. It is rich, just cut with acidity and with rounded fruit flavors and a generous texture. It is an impressive development from a young, crisp Muscadet and shows how well some wines from the region can age. Drink now.
title: Ollivier Frères 2010 Cuvée Charbonnière Excellence Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Perfumed and juicy, this is already an attractive wine. Fine tannins and plenty of red fruits give a fresh and structured character. With a firmer background, it will develop well. Drink from 2020.
title: Seguin-Manuel 2014 Les Bressandes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: There are dark tannins here, although they are embedded in the ripe black fruits. This wine is solid and firm, the acidity giving the essential freshness. The fruitiness and the plush texture are taking their time to show. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Latour 2014 En Chevret Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: There are dark tannins here, although they are embedded in the ripe black fruits. This wine is solid and firm, the acidity giving the essential freshness. The fruitiness and the plush texture are taking their time to show. Drink from 2020.
title: Louis Latour 2014 En Chevret Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Bright and fruity with touches of wood, this is a complex wine with good acidity, a crisp texture and a strong mineral strain. It is rich and will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Ferret 2014 Hors Classe Les Ménétrières  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A big, burly rich wine, dominated by Syrah and by wood tannins. It is fruity, full of black plums and boysenberries, low in acidity, but structured with some good tannins. It's a wine to drink now.
title: Hecht & Bannier 2004 Red (Minervois)

description: Honey and fresh orange zest aromas and flavors drive this nicely balanced fortified Muscat. There's a pleasing weightiness to it on the palate, and a slightly creamy texture to go with the pristine flavors. Try with blue cheeses or foie gras.
title: Ey 2003 Vigne Lo Clavell  (Muscat de Rivesaltes)

description: This is a simple fruity wine that is just right for the summer. Light citrus and orange-zest flavors give the wine its lift and brightness. Drink now.
title: Bougrier 2016  Muscadet

description: This warm style of Sauvignon Blanc has easygoing acidity and gooseberry fruit flavors. It's lightly tangy, with a bright, crisp texture.
title: Vinadeis 2016 Le Val Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: From a Loire Valley-based producer, this wine is crisp and cool. It has herbal touches and lively, citrusy acidity. Drink now.
title: Villebois 2016 Loupart Le Petit Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine is fruity and soft, with hints of citrus and herbal flavors. Its acidity is bright and attractive. Drink now.
title: M. & J-F Bertrand 2016 Fleur de Carbonnel Sauvignon Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine is fruity and soft, with hints of citrus and herbal flavors. Its acidity is bright and attractive. Drink now.
title: M. & J-F Bertrand 2016 Fleur de Carbonnel Sauvignon Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: Syrah-like aromas make this an attractive, soft wine. Its red berry fruit and balanced acidity are well in place for warm-weather drinking.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2016 La Châsse Syrah Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Syrah-like aromas make this an attractive, soft wine. Its red berry fruit and balanced acidity are well in place for warm-weather drinking.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2016 La Châsse Syrah Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This crisp red-currant-flavored wine is packed with acidity. It is tense and juicy with a light brushstroke of vanilla. But it is the intense acidity that sets the tone for this wine. Make this a food—not an apéritif—wine.
title: François Millet 2016 Domaine des Côtes Blanches Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Soft, fruity and lightly crisp, this is a wine to drink young to keep its freshness. It has perfumed acidity and a lightly zesty lemon aftertaste.
designation: Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie
title: Ollivier Frères 2016 Domaine de la Grenaudière La Grenouille Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a pale, light-bodied rosé with aromas and flavors reminiscent of underripe peach and melon. It's clean, dry and even a bit austere on the finish, making it a fine apéritif.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2016 Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This light, fruity wine is a perfect summer apéritif. With a crisp texture and attractive red fruit, it's lively and refreshing. Drink now.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2016 Terra Santa Rosé (Ile de Beauté)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: Sourced from vineyards on the east coast of Corsica, this attractive, fruity wine is made from 100% Sciaccarellu. Its lively, light and crisp red currant and lemon flavors make it ready to drink.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2016 Marestango Rosé (Ile de Beauté)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: This fruity red wine has firm tannins and juicy acidity. Its soft, rounded aftertaste makes it easy and warm.
title: Tussock Jumper 2015 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This fruity red wine has firm tannins and juicy acidity. Its soft, rounded aftertaste makes it easy and warm.
title: Tussock Jumper 2015 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: Produced from Languedoc grapes by the Château d'Esclans team in Provence, this is an easy, open wine with both red berry richness and delicious acidity Drink now.
title: Sacha Lichine 2016 Single Blend Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Produced from Languedoc grapes by the Château d'Esclans team in Provence, this is an easy, open wine with both red berry richness and delicious acidity Drink now.
title: Sacha Lichine 2016 Single Blend Rosé (Vin de France)

description: Rose gold in color, this rosé smells fresh and inviting, with pleasant underripe strawberry, mango and citrus zest scents. The palate is similarly light-footed, yet ripe tropical fruit tones lend some substance and richness.
title: Domaine la Colombette 2016 Notorious Pink Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This is an earthy, rustic wine with tannins that set its black fruit firmly in place. Juicy acidity and black currant flavor give it a lift on the finish. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Brigue NV Rouge Héritage Red (Vin de France)

description: The wine is soft and open. It has some bright citrus and creamed-apple flavors that give it a ripe character. The wine is juicy, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Bougrier 2016 Domaine Guenault Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: While this wine shows some of the softness and richness of 2003, it keeps a light touch and the acidity and black fruits remain fresh. There is an edge of astringency that leaves a hard aftertaste.
title: Château Toumilon 2003  Graves

description: Lightweight, with more dryness than richness, this wine is lightly sweet, hinting at botrytis, with apple and cream flavors touched by honey.
title: Chais de Méribel 2003  Sauternes

description: Lightweight, with more dryness than richness, this wine is lightly sweet, hinting at botrytis, with apple and cream flavors touched by honey.
title: Chais de Méribel 2003  Sauternes

description: Finely balanced, simple Sauternes with light apricot and honey flavors. With just a touch of botrytis dryness, the aftertaste is more sweet.
title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild 2004 Mouton Cadet Réserve  (Sauternes)

description: An attractive and slightly hedonistic wine. The intense black fruit core of boysenberry, blueberry and raspberry fruit preserves are spiked with spicy notes of garrigue, violet, faint pepper and soft sweet smoke. Rich and thick on the palate, the creamy mouthfeel is balaned by medium tannins and a long, gripping finish.
region: Coteaux du Languedoc Pic Saint Loup
title: Gérard Bertrand 2009 Grand Terroir Syrah-Grenache-Mourvèdre G-S-M (Coteaux du Languedoc Pic Saint Loup)

description: From old Cabernet vines, this rich and full-bodied wine was made from a magnificent vintage. It has rich, ripe and powerful fruits that burst with energy and structure. It was bottled without added sulfur.
title: Clos des Terrasses 2009 Cuvée le Clos Red (Côtes de Bergerac)

description: A stunning white with superb balance and layer upon layer of aromas and flavors. An expressive white-flower note accents the solid backbone of ripe red apple and firm nectarine fruit. The medium-weight palate is slightly creamy but not overdone, with hints of toast, sweet spice and almond-flavored nuttiness that unfold on the finish.
title: Château Rives-Blanques 2010 Odyssée Chardonnay (Limoux)

description: Marmalade, raisin and a hint of tropical fruit are balanced by the dry botrytis of this rich wine, which is based on the same grape varieties as Sauternes. It is elegant and ageworthy, but is also ready to drink now.
title: Château K 2009 White (Saussignac)

description: There is an excellent depth of flavor in this ripe and fruity wine. It is more about rich fruits than it is about structure, giving a full and rounded character to the plum-jelly, spice and mint flavors. Ready to drink in a year.
title: Château de Corbiac 2009 Cyrano de Bergerac  (Pécharmant)

description: There is an excellent depth of flavor in this ripe and fruity wine. It is more about rich fruits than it is about structure, giving a full and rounded character to the plum-jelly, spice and mint flavors. Ready to drink in a year.
title: Château de Corbiac 2009 Cyrano de Bergerac  (Pécharmant)

description: Tannat, with its high tannins, seems to lend itself as well to sweet fortified wines as do the Douro grapes of Port country. This is sweet, but firmly, solidly tannic, packed with wild berries and an edge of spice.
title: Domaine Berthoumieu 2007 Tannatis Tannat (Vin de Liqueur)

description: Ripe, smooth, rich fruits, juicy strawberry flavor and fresh acidity. The texture is solid and dense, with an obvious potential for aging.
title: Château La Rame 2006 La Charmille  (Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Ripe, smooth, rich fruits, juicy strawberry flavor and fresh acidity. The texture is solid and dense, with an obvious potential for aging.
title: Château La Rame 2006 La Charmille  (Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: A powerful, dense and still youthful wine. It balances a fresh blackberry fruit character with smoky tannins and delicious, bright and juicy acidity.
title: Château Haut-Peyrous 2008 Retour des Palombières  (Graves)

description: A solid, foursquare wine, flaunting its tannins but not forgetting the rich weight of fruit underneath. Mint flavors go with the chocolate and dark plums.
title: Château de la Grave 2006 Caractère  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: This 100% Carignan is a great expression of what the grape can do all by itself without any blending buddies. Red cherry and plum mingle with garrigue herbs and a touch of vanilla on the nose. Soft tannins and vibrant acidity lay out the approachable structure, with a lingering finish accented by sweet spice.
region: Vin de Pays du Val de Cesse
title: Château Cabezac 2007 Cariñu Carignan (Vin de Pays du Val de Cesse)

description: Aromatic, herbal wine, with evocative lavender, a core of dry tannins, fresh red plum juice fruit and flavors of wild thyme. The six years' aging has given the wine just the right amount of maturity to drink now.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2004 Jules Réserve Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Although this is marked nonvintage, the fruit all comes from 2004. It is made from old vines, giving richness and ripeness, and a generous white fruit character which fully compensates for the very dry nature of the wine. It's delicious, a complex wine of intense character.
title: Larmandier-Bernier NV Terre de Vertus Premier Cru Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Based mainly on vines in Le Mesnil-sur-Oger, this impressive wine is superbly rich with just the merest hint of age. With its lively mousse, secondary aromas of mocha and flavors of green apples, it is a wine that should develop magnificently over the next 4–5 years.
designation: Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Pascal Doquet NV Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: While the Larmandier's main vineyard is in Vertus, they also have a parcel in the grand cru vineyard of Cramant. It is full of beautifully ripe fruit, beginning to round out as it ages. Green fruits and white pears, as well as yeast are still dominant; drink 2010.
designation: Vieilles Vignes de Cramant Grand Cru
title: Larmandier-Bernier NV Vieilles Vignes de Cramant Grand Cru Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The latest release from Salon, this just explodes in the mouth with mineral, steel and flint. The tiny mousse has flavors of yeast and just a touch of toast. It is rich, but so austere and structured. Like many Salon Champagnes, this will age for 20 years or more.
title: Salon 1996 Le Mesnil Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The latest release from Salon, this just explodes in the mouth with mineral, steel and flint. The tiny mousse has flavors of yeast and just a touch of toast. It is rich, but so austere and structured. Like many Salon Champagnes, this will age for 20 years or more.
title: Salon 1996 Le Mesnil Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Creamy rose and peach puree notes create a very sensuous and seductive scent. The light-footed creaminess continues fluidly on the slender palate, helped along by a touch of flavor-boosting sweetness. But this is pervaded by freshness to finish off dry. Drink soon while flavors are at their peak.
title: Robert Klingenfus 2015 Clos des Chartreux Muscat (Alsace)

description: The rosy floral overtones of Muscat are very evident on the fragrant nose. The palate, on the other hand, gives us the texture of Pinot Gris and the freshness of Riesling while floral nuances hover and swirl. This is a lovely blend of all that Alsace does well. Friendly and fresh with a dry finish.
title: Pierre Sparr 2015 One White (Alsace)

description: A clean-cut nose of green pear leads onto an equally clean-cut palate of fresh pear. There is freshness and lots of lemony brightness on the light but precise palate. This is appetizing and moreish.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: It is the freshness of mandarin peel and jasmine that draws you in, as well as the lifted scent. The palate is light and dry with rose petal and tangerine making a charming twin appearance. Lovely and light, it's very attractive.
title: Joseph Cattin 2015 Muscat (Alsace)

description: Very ripe pear plays on the enticing nose. The palate has the same refreshing and appetizing fruitiness. Lemony brightness pervades the light-bodied palate and makes for a very moreish finish.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2015 Bouquet de Printemps Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Oxidative in character, this ripe wine has melon, spice and almond flavors. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Marengo 2014 Appolonia Vermentino (Patrimonio)

description: This pale-colored soft wine has attractive fruitiness. Red fruits and a touch of spice are linked with gentle tannins. The wine is already gaining maturity and should be drunk now.
title: Cave de Bissey 2014 Le Clos d'Augustin  (Bourgogne)

description: This is a typical sweet rosé from Anjou. A light and fruity blend of Groslot and Gamay, it is sugary but has attractive acidity to balance the sweet wild-strawberry flavors. Drink now.
title: Sauvion 2015 Loire Valley  (Rosé d'Anjou)

description: This is a typical sweet rosé from Anjou. A light and fruity blend of Groslot and Gamay, it is sugary but has attractive acidity to balance the sweet wild-strawberry flavors. Drink now.
title: Sauvion 2015 Loire Valley  (Rosé d'Anjou)
