description: Notes of dried dark berry, leathery spice, sweet tobacco and chocolate-covered cherry fill the nose of this wine. The satiny texture pairs well with the dusty tannins, and additional flavors of prune, sweet smoke and fresh caramel linger through the medium-length finish.
title: Les Clos de Paulilles 2009 Rimage  (Banyuls)

description: Fine, soft and round, this is a simple Pinot Blanc that's fruity and creamy. Apples and pears dominate the fruit flavors, with a texture that is open and ready to drink.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2010 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This overtly spicy wine is very intense, with a slight burn on the palate from the pepper flavor. Exotic white fruit and a hint of pomegranate are the flavors. It has a hard, final edge from its alcohol.
title: Jean Becker 2010 Sonnenglanz Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Lush, ripe and a touch heady, this is a rich selection that's brimming with notes of white peach, quince, melon and red apple. Thankfully, hints of ginger, nectarine pit and citrus rind add lift to the palate and remain through the medium-length finish.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée NV Resplandy  (Muscat de Saint-Jean de Minervois)

description: Very perfumed in character, the wine has a bright red cherry flavor, with some weight and structure. There are good tannins and a warm, soft finish. The wine could age for another year.
designation: Château la Tour de Bief Claude de la Tour
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Château la Tour de Bief Claude de la Tour  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Very perfumed in character, the wine has a bright red cherry flavor, with some weight and structure. There are good tannins and a warm, soft finish. The wine could age for another year.
designation: Château la Tour de Bief Claude de la Tour
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2010 Château la Tour de Bief Claude de la Tour  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Soft and ripe, smooth and creamy, this has a spicy element here the Pinot Gris in the blend, giving a piquancy to the white fruit flavor. It is warm, rounded and fragrant. Screwcap.
title: Clément Klur 2011 Gentil de Katz White (Alsace)

description: Soft and ripe, smooth and creamy, this has a spicy element here the Pinot Gris in the blend, giving a piquancy to the white fruit flavor. It is warm, rounded and fragrant. Screwcap.
title: Clément Klur 2011 Gentil de Katz White (Alsace)

description: This is full of ripe raspberry flavor that is cut with lively acidity. It is a delicious, fruity, apéritif-style rosé with just a touch of zesty texture to tighten it up.
title: Chapuy NV Tradition Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is full of ripe raspberry flavor that is cut with lively acidity. It is a delicious, fruity, apéritif-style rosé with just a touch of zesty texture to tighten it up.
title: Chapuy NV Tradition Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Intense, complex and full-bodied, this is a powerful Pinot Gris. It has weight and richness, providing both fruitiness and a ripe texture. Ready to drink, with the acidity lifting the finish.
title: Rieflé 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a deliciously balanced, elegant wine. Its ample spice character is matched by the crisp white-fruit note and acidity. It is floral, perfumed and stylish.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2009 Holder Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a soft, rounded wine that has ripe tropical fruit, lychee and mango notes, accompanied by just enough acidity. While it is fruity, a more mature character is beginning to show.
title: Helfrich 2008 Steinklotz Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a ripe wine, full of apple and apricot fruit with a strong citrus line. A touch of minerality adds tangy texture and gives this rich wine plenty of life and freshness. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Vincent Girardin 2011 Les Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Recognized for its good value, Saint-Romain is particularly strong on white wines. This wine, from old vines, shows some concentration and rich fruits that are balanced by toast flavors. It is a ripe wine with a strongly refreshing feel at the end.
title: Domaine de Bellene 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Saint-Romain)

description: With attractive mint aromas, this polished wine balances structure and fruit. New wood shows through but it doesn't dominate the black fruits that give weight and ripeness. It shows the typical juiciness of the vintage. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Moya 2011  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Big, ripe and fruity, this wine balances its rich fruits with firm tannins. A dry core gives shape to the blackberry fruit flavors, offering aging potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2011 Héritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Big, ripe and fruity, this wine balances its rich fruits with firm tannins. A dry core gives shape to the blackberry fruit flavors, offering aging potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2011 Héritage  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A fine, smooth, wood-aged wine that already shows good balance between creamy toast and fresh, citrus and white fruits. It is cut-through with youthful acidity and a crisp structure, promising aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Chartron et Trébuchet 2012 Le Gresigny Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: A fine, smooth, wood-aged wine that already shows good balance between creamy toast and fresh, citrus and white fruits. It is cut-through with youthful acidity and a crisp structure, promising aging. Drink from 2016.
title: Chartron et Trébuchet 2012 Le Gresigny Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: Gentle hints of tangerine and lemon zest rise from the glass. These continue to charm on the broad palate. There is an earthy, pithy dimension to the midpalate flavors and ample freshness. The dry finish has a slightly bitter tang.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2014 Réserve Spéciale Riesling (Alsace)

description: Gentle hints of tangerine and lemon zest rise from the glass. These continue to charm on the broad palate. There is an earthy, pithy dimension to the midpalate flavors and ample freshness. The dry finish has a slightly bitter tang.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2014 Réserve Spéciale Riesling (Alsace)

description: Pure notes of russet pear rise from the glass with their wonderful combination of juicy ripeness and moreish freshness. The palate does these aromas justice and follows with fruit-driven full freshness of pear and lemon. The body is slender and zippy, the finish is clean and dry.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2015 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Pure notes of russet pear rise from the glass with their wonderful combination of juicy ripeness and moreish freshness. The palate does these aromas justice and follows with fruit-driven full freshness of pear and lemon. The body is slender and zippy, the finish is clean and dry.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2015 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: Honey, honeysuckle and peach on the nose create a most inviting aroma. These flavors are even more clearly apparent on the medium-dry palate where they are brightened and intensified by lemon freshness. This is intense and fluid, rounded and soft, and yet it manages to remain fresh and appetizing. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2015 Cuvée Carole Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Honey, honeysuckle and peach on the nose create a most inviting aroma. These flavors are even more clearly apparent on the medium-dry palate where they are brightened and intensified by lemon freshness. This is intense and fluid, rounded and soft, and yet it manages to remain fresh and appetizing. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2015 Cuvée Carole Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A touch of narcissus precedes the full-fruited notes of peach on the nose. The palate has the same generous peach but also a slightly bitter tangy edge that gives structure to the rich wine. This is intense, rich and medium sweet, with a lasting rich finish.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2014 Cuvée Mégane Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: A touch of narcissus precedes the full-fruited notes of peach on the nose. The palate has the same generous peach but also a slightly bitter tangy edge that gives structure to the rich wine. This is intense, rich and medium sweet, with a lasting rich finish.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2014 Cuvée Mégane Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Lovely red apple, ripe pear and mirabelle plum create an appetizing nose. These fruit notes are even more intense on the palate, boosted by a dollop of residual sweetness and framed by tangy textured phenolics. This is refreshing, intense and moreish.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2015 Cuvée Engel Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose gives little away. The palate, however, is full-fruited and zesty: yellow mirabelle plum and juicy peach are intensified by lemon freshness. A touch of residual sweetness makes the flavors even juicier and fuller. This is off dry, intensely fruity but very balanced and refreshing.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2015 Bergheim Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose gives little away. The palate, however, is full-fruited and zesty: yellow mirabelle plum and juicy peach are intensified by lemon freshness. A touch of residual sweetness makes the flavors even juicier and fuller. This is off dry, intensely fruity but very balanced and refreshing.
title: Domaine Fernand Engel 2015 Bergheim Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose is shy but the palate is full of generous ripe pear fruit that's wonderfully countered by equally ample freshness. This interplay between opposite poles creates a friendly and appetizing wine. The finish is clean and just off dry.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2015 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Still very young, this is a Maison Bouey wine with good potential. It offers hints of the ripe yellow fruits and richness that will come as it develops. The touch of perfumed spice means it is also a wine to savor as an apéritif.
title: Château Lestruelle 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A smooth, perfumed wine, with an initial barnyard character that then softens into red fruits and soft tannins. Relatively light, going more for juiciness than weight.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007 Beaune du Château Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: An intensely wooded wine that is dominated by dark tannins. The red berry fruit is buried under the dry spice and toast character, although at the end there is a more juicy element.
designation: Les Molesmes Château de Rully Premier Cru
title: Antonin Rodet 2007 Les Molesmes Château de Rully Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: An intensely wooded wine that is dominated by dark tannins. The red berry fruit is buried under the dry spice and toast character, although at the end there is a more juicy element.
designation: Les Molesmes Château de Rully Premier Cru
title: Antonin Rodet 2007 Les Molesmes Château de Rully Premier Cru  (Rully)

description: This is an expressive wine and quite powerful for a rosé. There are lovely peach and apple notes upfront while the earthy palate is enlivened by refreshing notes of orange zest. Woodsy notes on the finish suggest this wine is best drunk up before 2011.
title: E. Guigal 2007  Tavel

description: A wine that reflects the relative lightness of the reds in this vintage. It has a layer of tannins, but they don't suggest aging; they are more a base for the attractive raspberry and red plum flavor, freshened by the acidity.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2007 Marconnets Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Fine, solidly textured wine that has some depth of red fruit flavors as well as some sweetness. The tannin edge is on the dry side, with some obvious toast character, giving a wine that needs 2–3 years aging.
designation: Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Ursulines
title: Albert Bichot 2007 Domaine du Pavillon Clos des Ursulines  (Pommard)

description: There is plenty of wood here, quite a dominant feature. The fruit comes behind, showing bright ripe white fruits and a hint of apricot. The wood spice, though, has the last word.
title: Morey-Blanc 2007  Auxey-Duresses

description: Ripe, soft and creamy, with yellow fruits, fresh acidity and a hint of toast. The wine is full, textured with pear skins, with a strong citrus element.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2007 La Chatenière Premier Cru  (Saint-Aubin)

description: There is a firm structure here underpinning the sweet, ripe strawberry flavors. The wine offers freshness from its berry acidity along with a final tight core of tannins. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2006 Beauregard Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: A lively, impressively fresh Aligoté, packed with green and citrus fruits, bubbling with bright vivacity.
title: Manuel Olivier 2007 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne Aligoté)

description: A fascinating nose, with grapefruit, kiwi, citrus, orange rind and hay that fold in to a peach/pear structure in the mouth. Very light and almost austere on the finish, this is a Riesling that would be at home at a raw bar. Drink now to 2012.
title: Lucien Albrecht 2007 Cuvée Henri Riesling (Alsace)

description: This wine is fruity although it also has weight and a rich strand of spice and red plum-skin tannins. This 100% Gamay could age at least until early 2016, although one can just drink it now.
title: Louis Jadot 2014  Beaujolais

description: Light and freshly crisp, this has a good mix of red fruits and tangy acidity. It's so light both in color and flavor, bright at the end and delicious.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2014 Domaine Romy Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Light and freshly crisp, this has a good mix of red fruits and tangy acidity. It's so light both in color and flavor, bright at the end and delicious.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2014 Domaine Romy Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: While there is a good structure here, this wine is spoiled by banana flavors that dominate the otherwise attractive red berry fruits. Acidity and a dry tannic core suggest some aging, so maybe the wine will round out.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine Mont Chavy  (Morgon)

description: This wine has structure and freshness although the fruit is on the lean side, offering black cherries and swathes of crisp acidity. The aftertaste is juicy, fresh and mineral.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine dit Baron  (Brouilly)

description: Aromas of bananas follow through to the palate of this wine, spoiling the structured black plums and tannins. The wine is fresh and juicy, with some dry structure at the background. Drink from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine des Rosiers  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: An organic, low-sulphur wine, this is all about soft fruitiness. Red fruits shine along with the texture that has just an edge of dryness. Acidity penetrates right through this fresh, light wine. A member of Terroirs Originels, Victor Sornin is a ninth-generation winemaker.
title: Domaine Victor Sornin 2014 Nature  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Light in color, this wine seems already mature. It has a leathery character, the fruit subdued to the structure. It's attractive to drink as a mature wine that is ready now.
title: Domaine de la Bonne Tonne 2013 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: Light in color, this wine seems already mature. It has a leathery character, the fruit subdued to the structure. It's attractive to drink as a mature wine that is ready now.
title: Domaine de la Bonne Tonne 2013 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: This crisp, dry Champagne has citrus fruits and a light, bright texture. Acidity makes its presence felt, giving a tight aftertaste of lemon zest.
title: Luc Mérat NV La Diva Brut  (Champagne)

description: This wine is soft and fruity, with just an edge of dryness at the center. It is more about red berry and cherry brightness, with an attractive twist of pepper. Drink now.
title: Domaine Dupré 2014 Terre Noire Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais)

description: Still young, this wine is showing structure and a dense texture as well as tight fruitiness. It's a blend of one-third of each of Champagne's principal grapes, giving good balance and intense acidity. The low dosage has made the wine dry without losing a ripe, full character. Drink from 2017.
title: Lelarge-Pugeot 2005 Millésime Premier Cru Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This single-parcel, partially barrel-fermented Champagne is in effect a Blanc de Noirs. If all that sounds complicated (and so does the name of the wine), the wine itself is much easier to appreciate. It is certainly rich, with a touch of tannin and mineral texture. Full of ripe white fruits, it offers good acidity at the end. It could age longer; drink from 2017.
designation: Fins Lieux No 1 Millésimé Grand Cru Brut
title: Pehu-Simonet 2010 Fins Lieux No 1 Millésimé Grand Cru Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This medium-bodied blend features aromas and flavors reminiscent of bubble gum and cantaloupe. It's mainly Grenache and Cinsault, which impart ample weight, balanced by some slightly bitter, pithy notes on the finish.
title: My Essential 2014 French Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: This certainly has maturity, giving it toasty flavors and a touch of oxidation. But it balances that with ripe yellow fruit, ripe acidity and a firm texture. It's rich and complex, balancing ripe fruit and more a rounded finish. Don't age it, though—enjoy it with food now.
title: Pannier 2002 Egérie Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This certainly has maturity, giving it toasty flavors and a touch of oxidation. But it balances that with ripe yellow fruit, ripe acidity and a firm texture. It's rich and complex, balancing ripe fruit and more a rounded finish. Don't age it, though—enjoy it with food now.
title: Pannier 2002 Egérie Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Ripe yet crisp, this is a fine reflection of the excellent 2004 vintage in Champagne. It has a rich texture with concentrated apple, pineapple and toast notes, along with a tangy orange-zest character. Ready to drink now, but it will certainly age.
title: J. Dumangin Fils 2004 Vintage Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: Darker in color than a rosé, this Clairet is fruity with ripe strawberry fruit. But it does seem heavily laced with caramel as well as some tannins and spice.
title: Château de Fontenille 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: Taut, stalky wine, very structured. There is fruit but it is herbal, green, missing ripeness. The tannins have the same character.
title: Château Grand Jean 2010  Bordeaux

description: A thin wine that is all dry tannins and not enough fruit. It is lightweight with just a hint of juiciness.
title: Château du Vallier 2007  Premieres Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Soft, lightweight wine, with gentle tannins and a thin fruit character. There is plenty of acidity to give freshness. Drink now.
title: Château Dame Jane 2010  Bordeaux

description: Produced by the largest Bordeaux cooperative, this is a freshly fruity wine, with simple red fruit flavors and soft tannins. There is a smoky edge and pink raspberry acidity.
title: Univitis 2009 Chevalier de Saint-André  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine comes from a vineyard, created in 1894, in which the vines are planted against walls to get the maximum reflected heat. It is a majestic wine—a smooth wave, opulent and rich with intense acidity and just a hint of spice. The wine is just ready to drink, although it will be even more impressive from 2018.
title: Château de Parnay 2011 Clos d'Entre les Murs  (Saumur)

description: Lemon-jelly aromas give this a strange character. The fruit reflects the same artificial flavor. It is hard to see where it is going.
title: Pierre Chardigny 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Saint-Véran)

description: This wine comes from a single vineyard, planted on flint soil. It has a definite steely character that has been softened by the year in bottle. That gives a pure wine shot through with citrus and apples, showing power and concentration from the intense fruit. Drink the wine now.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Le Roc  (Sancerre)

description: One of Jolivet's single-vineyard wines, this comes from a south-facing parcel in the heartland of Sancerre. It is a classic fruity wine, but is developing an opulent character that brings in spice as well as wonderfully ripe flavors. The wine is very drinkable now, although still young and with a great future. Drink ideally from 2018.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Le Grand Chemarin  (Sancerre)

description: One of Jolivet's single-vineyard wines, this comes from a south-facing parcel in the heartland of Sancerre. It is a classic fruity wine, but is developing an opulent character that brings in spice as well as wonderfully ripe flavors. The wine is very drinkable now, although still young and with a great future. Drink ideally from 2018.
title: Pascal Jolivet 2014 Le Grand Chemarin  (Sancerre)

description: This is a young, beautifully fruity wine. Lemon and lime chase ripe yellow fruits and pears that are all lifted by spice and acidity. It is perfumed, rich and concentrated from the old vines. The aftertaste is mineral and tight. Drink from 2020.
designation: Les Vieilles Vignes Fourchaume Premier Cru
title: Pascal Bouchard 2015 Les Vieilles Vignes Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This is a small Premier Cru of two acres higher up the slope from the main line of Premier Cru vineyards. That gives it a cool mineral character as well as crisp red fruits. The tannins are solid, concentrated and are still driving the fruits. The wine needs to fill out, so don't drink before 2022.
designation: Domaine des Perdrix Les Terres Blanches Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Domaine des Perdrix Les Terres Blanches Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: In an impressive line up of Premier Crus from Mercurey, this is the most structured. With dark dry tannins and a firm structure it has considerable potential for aging. The rich black fruits are still developing, filling the wine with fine perfumes and juicy acidity. The wine needs to wait, drink from 2020.
designation: Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: In an impressive line up of Premier Crus from Mercurey, this is the most structured. With dark dry tannins and a firm structure it has considerable potential for aging. The rich black fruits are still developing, filling the wine with fine perfumes and juicy acidity. The wine needs to wait, drink from 2020.
designation: Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru
title: Domaines Devillard 2014 Château de Chamirey Champs Martin Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Daughter of Roger Belland, Julie has taken over and changed the name of this estate. Based in Santenay, they also have vines in other appellations. This wine, for instance, is rich and structured with just the right amount of wood aging. It has vanilla, spice and great acidity from the citrus and apple fruits. The wine is still young and will be best from 2018.
title: Domaine Julie Belland 2014 Morgeot Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: The wine comes from a parcel that is less than an acre. Vines aged for 45 years on average have created a structured, concentrated wine with powerful tannins and dark, black fruits. It is a wine for serious aging, It's unlikely to be ready before 2020.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014 Champeaux Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: While the wine is structured and firm at the moment, it also has a solid character with plenty of berry fruits that are waiting to come through. It is smoky, fruity and likely to be ready to drink from 2016.
title: Le Bord'eau du Clos des Moiselles 2012  Bordeaux
winery: Le Bord'eau du Clos des Moiselles

description: The Jaume family continues to turn out reliable, well priced wines from the Southern Rhône. This is filled with effusive cherry fruit and marries that to a soft, plush texture. It's a simple, yet highly satisfying glass of red wine to drink over the next few years.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2012 Grand Veneur Réserve Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The Jaume family continues to turn out reliable, well priced wines from the Southern Rhône. This is filled with effusive cherry fruit and marries that to a soft, plush texture. It's a simple, yet highly satisfying glass of red wine to drink over the next few years.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2012 Grand Veneur Réserve Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The bouquet is mildly intense, with soft pear and delicate apple skin as the only distinguishable elements. More apple and bitter citrus appear in the mouth, with almost a hoppy character developing on the finish. Drink now.
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2009 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: The bouquet is mildly intense, with soft pear and delicate apple skin as the only distinguishable elements. More apple and bitter citrus appear in the mouth, with almost a hoppy character developing on the finish. Drink now.
title: Domaines Paul Mas 2009 Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: There is a depth of flavor and concentration from low-yield old vines. The style gives raspberry flavors and acidity, with a light tannic character.
title: Manuel Olivier 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: There is a depth of flavor and concentration from low-yield old vines. The style gives raspberry flavors and acidity, with a light tannic character.
title: Manuel Olivier 2008 Vieilles Vignes  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: Ripe and rich without being overdone, this is a well-balanced Viognier with stone fruit and Anjou pear flavors lifted by accents of peony and orange rind. Vibrant acidity keeps things lively in the mouth, with a refreshingly crisp finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2009 Réserve Spéciale Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Ripe and rich without being overdone, this is a well-balanced Viognier with stone fruit and Anjou pear flavors lifted by accents of peony and orange rind. Vibrant acidity keeps things lively in the mouth, with a refreshingly crisp finish.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2009 Réserve Spéciale Viognier (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Ripe and juicy, this wine is soft, generous and full of rich, while very fresh fruits. It has black-currant acidity, a touch of spice and a perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Goulée 2013  Médoc

description: Ripe and juicy, this wine is soft, generous and full of rich, while very fresh fruits. It has black-currant acidity, a touch of spice and a perfumed aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Goulée 2013  Médoc

description: Perfumed wood dominates this wine, giving it structure and tannins. Juicy red fruits are still submerged beneath this welter of dryness. The wine needs time to integrate. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Mongravey 2013  Margaux

description: Plenty of tannins give this wine a firm and dense structure, but it also shows the potential of black-currant fruit flavors and perfumed acidity. Give this wine time and drink from 2019. Spring and fall weather in 2013 forced Marie-José (Perrin) Lerichecut to reduce production to 20% of an average year.
title: Château le Sartre 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This small, seven-acre property has an unusually high (20%) proportion of Petit Verdot in its wine, giving it big color and structure. Ripe black currant fruits balance the tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Garricq 2013  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: Solid and firm tannins give this wine its structure. The fruits are masked by this density although the weight suggests they are there. It is concentrated and firm, and needs plenty of time. Drink from 2022. Founded in the 13th century by Benedictine monks, Château Carbonnieux is one of the oldest estates in the Bordeaux region. In 1956, Marc Perrin purchased the château and began vineyard and winery renovations, continued by son Antony. The property is now run by grandsons Eric and Philibert.
title: Château Carbonnieux 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: The almost 100-acre vineyard of Brillette is situated at one of the highest points in Moulis. Ripe and generously structured, this concentrated wine has layers of blackberry fruits and solid tannins. It will age well, with its fresh acidity and dry core. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Brillette 2013  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: From one of a pair of châteaux, both with Braude in the name and both owned by Château Mongravey in Margaux, this perfumed and fruity wine has ripe fruits that are now becoming mature. Soft tannins and juicy berry fruits are still fresh. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Braude Fellonneau 2012  Haut-Médoc

description: From one of a pair of châteaux, both with Braude in the name and both owned by Château Mongravey in Margaux, this perfumed and fruity wine has ripe fruits that are now becoming mature. Soft tannins and juicy berry fruits are still fresh. Drink now and until 2020.
title: Château Braude Fellonneau 2012  Haut-Médoc

description: An animal, yeasty character in this wine masks the fruit. It offers toast, spice, citrus and yellow fruits, but that earthy character needs to blow away before the wine is fully ready to drink. Wait until 2018. Lucien Lurton took over Bouscaut in 1979. Since 1992, it has been in the hands of daughter Sophie Lurton and her husband Laurent Cogombles. Improvements include vineyard renovation, the barrel cellar in 2010 and a B&B added in 2013.
title: Château Bouscaut 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This structured wine has a severe aspect, with dry wood and fruit tannins. The fruit is there, smoky and with considerable acidity. It's a wine that will remain serious as it ages. Wait to drink until 2018.
title: Château Beauséjour 2013  Fronsac

description: Anglophiles will enjoy this wine with its royal coat of arms on the label. The wine itself is less grand, although attractive with its black-currant fruits. At the moment, dry tannins are also a strong presence, and they will soften over the next few years. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Victoria 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: Anglophiles will enjoy this wine with its royal coat of arms on the label. The wine itself is less grand, although attractive with its black-currant fruits. At the moment, dry tannins are also a strong presence, and they will soften over the next few years. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Victoria 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This wine is all fruity, juicy Merlot. It's soft, rounded and ripe with flavors of berries and dark plums to give richness. Drink soon, from 2018.
title: Château Petit Village 2013  Pomerol

description: This perfumed wine is rich, full in the mouth while keeping plenty of fresh, crisp citrus and pear flavors. It is ready to drink, but will be better in 2015.
title: Domaine Houchart 2013 White (Côtes de Provence)

description: Strong caramel aromas lead to a wine that is rich, vanilla-flavored with some attractive ripe strawberry flavors. It's soft and full in the mouth, revealing its acidity only at the end.
title: Domaine d'Eole 2013 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The simplest wine from La Sanglière is as attractive as the rest of the range. It has a tangy, bright texture, very crisp with raspberry fruits and bone-dry acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A warmly perfumed wine, it has all the aromatic characters of Pinot Gris, rounded and soft with only a few hints of acidity. Off-dry, it is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Albert Mann 2011 Rosenberg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A simple, intensely perfume wine, over-the-top in its spice and lychee flavors. It conveys a wallop of fruit and a rounded structure. Drink this generous wine now.
title: Domaine Albert Mann 2011 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Warm while also fresh, this rounded wine is full of red fruits, lit up by a touch of spice and freshened with acidity. Clean and crisp, it's just bursting with fruit at the end.
title: Château Montaud 2013 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This bright wine has red fruits, citrus and a light minerality, finishing crisply. Wait until late 2014 for it to open up.
title: Château les Valentines 2013 Le Caprice de Clémentine Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Fruity and with plenty of acidity, this is a crisp wine, still exposing the tight mineral texture. The red-currant and raspberry fruits are prominent, shot through with acidity. Drink from 2023.
title: Domaine Rossignol-Février Père et Fils 2015 Les Angles Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: Fresh fruit aromas are a delicious part of this crisp, fruity wine. It is well balanced, with lively acidity sharing the stage with the ripe pear and pineapple flavors. It's ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Ferret 2015  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Ripe tropical fruits star in this opulent, bold wine. The acidity is there, just enough to give this rich wine the support it needs. It is a complete wine—ripe and spicy, just give it some more time. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Ferret 2015 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Ripe tropical fruits star in this opulent, bold wine. The acidity is there, just enough to give this rich wine the support it needs. It is a complete wine—ripe and spicy, just give it some more time. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Ferret 2015 Le Clos  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This beautifully perfumed wine is ripe, structured and well on the way to being delicious. Tannins and spice flavors have melded into rich black-cherry fruits cut with acidity. The wine could age for another few months, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2014 Réserve Louis Leyre-Loup  (Morgon)

description: This wine is pure apricot fruitiness, giving it acidity as well as the warmth that comes from the year. It also delivers balance and a delicious, refreshing character. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château des Rontets 2015 Clos Varambon  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This is a generous wine with fine potential. Its rich red fruits and acidity are contrasted with dense tannins and spice from the wood aging. It will be slow but sure to develop into a delicious wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château de Santenay 2015  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: Produced from 100-year-old vines, this wine has been aged for nearly three years and has lost its intense fruitiness. Wood and spice flavors are present along with a perfumed intensity and toastiness. Drink this wine now.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2014 Aux Bouthières  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A blend from different parts of the Fleurie appellation, this wine is elegant and floral. Crisp red fruits are sustained by acidity and by a juicy character. As often with this appellation, it is a wine to age and will be better from 2018.
title: Domaines Dominique Piron 2015 La Chanaise  (Morgon)

description: The Suremain family winery in the main street of Mercurey has cellars going back to the 17th century. This wood-aged wine will have been kept here, where it has developed into a structured and firm wine, full of dry tannins as well as ripe red-berry fruits. Drink from 2023.
title: Domaine de Suremain 2015 Les Crêts Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: From selected parcels of the Ollières estate, this wine is impressive. It has weight but that is balanced by the acidity and the generous black fruits and acidity. This is certainly a wine that has been well aged, although it would pay to wait another year before drinking. So drink this very fine wine from 2018.
title: Château d'Ollières 2013 Haut de l'Hermitage Red (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Structured and dense with tannins, this is a big wine with a big future. Its black fruits, acidity and solid texture all point to its weight and richness. It is going to be a rich fruity wine. But wait until 2023.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2015  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: Crisp and creamy, with red apple flavors. The wine is lifted by its crisp, green acidity, lightly coating the apple skin structure and tautness.
title: Domaine de la Grenaudière 2007  Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

description: Pommery's prestige Champagne is named after one of the great Champagne widows of the 19th century who took over when her husband, Alexandre Pommery, died. It is a rich, mature wine, with toast and almond flavors as much as fruit. Full of mineral Chardonnay (60% of the blend), this ripe wine is very ready to drink.
title: Pommery 2004 Cuvée Louise Brut  (Champagne)

description: This latest Blanc de Blancs vintage from Roederer is well poised and balanced, already offering a hint of toast, while the minerality is prominent. It is in a dry style, relying on the ripe fruit to soften the impact of the acidity. A beautiful wine, ready to drink.
title: Louis Roederer 2010 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This family-owned Champagne house has sourced grapes from one of the finest villages in the Côte des Blancs. The zero dosage is balanced by the ripeness of the fruit and the rich texture. Mineral and flinty, this totally crisp Champagne deserves some bottle age. Drink this bottling disgorged in March 2016 from 2017.
designation: Brut Nature Le Mesnil sur Oger Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru
title: Lombard et Cie NV Brut Nature Le Mesnil sur Oger Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: A blend of grapes from Cumières in the Marne Valley and the Côte des Blancs, this is a rich, well-balanced and very young brut rosé. It is ripe, while keeping an almost austere texture and acidity that will soften and broaden out as it ages. Drink now for the lively red fruits, but better to wait until 2019.
title: Louis Roederer 2011 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A blend of grapes from Cumières in the Marne Valley and the Côte des Blancs, this is a rich, well-balanced and very young brut rosé. It is ripe, while keeping an almost austere texture and acidity that will soften and broaden out as it ages. Drink now for the lively red fruits, but better to wait until 2019.
title: Louis Roederer 2011 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: Produced from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, this balances ripe red berry and citrus fruits with more mature spice and vanilla. With this development has come depth, concentration and richness. It is a wine to drink with food, ripe and finishing with crisp, dry acidity.
title: Billecart-Salmon 2006 Cuvée Elisabeth Salmon Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is a blend of fruit from the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs. The result is a wine that is now showing maturity while not completely losing the apricot and pineapple-flavored fruits. A taut mineral texture lies behind the richness, suggesting that this wine will age further. Ideally drink from 2018.
title: Mailly Grand Cru 2004 Exception Blanche Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is an onion-skin-colored wine, ripe and showing some maturity as well as rich red and citrus fruits. It is beautifully balanced, the pure, crisp fruit elegantly integrated into the lightly mineral texture. This stylish bottling is ready to drink.
title: Krug NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: This is an onion-skin-colored wine, ripe and showing some maturity as well as rich red and citrus fruits. It is beautifully balanced, the pure, crisp fruit elegantly integrated into the lightly mineral texture. This stylish bottling is ready to drink.
title: Krug NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: The 60% Cabernet in the blend gives a dark fruit character. At this young stage, the wood aging still dominates with its burnt toast and chocolate character. For the future, while the wine will be dry, it also has plenty of fresh fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Taffard de Blaignan 2012  Médoc

description: Juicy and fruity with acidity and black currant fruits, this wine comes from a vineyard on slopes at the entrance to Saint-Émilion. It's bright and fresh with lively, easy fruits and soft tannins. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Simard 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Juicy and fruity with acidity and black currant fruits, this wine comes from a vineyard on slopes at the entrance to Saint-Émilion. It's bright and fresh with lively, easy fruits and soft tannins. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Simard 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: One of Bordeaux's more memorable labels (orange nymphs supporting a picture of the chateau), Saransot-Dupré is one of a number of chateaus in Listrac with the Dupré suffix. This is a solid wine, chunky in a typical way for the appellation with plenty of black fruits and balanced tannins. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Saransot-Dupré 2012  Listrac-Médoc

description: This smoky wine has firm tannins and a tough core. The juicy fruit is taking its time to develop, although it will give the wine density and ripe berries in time. The vineyard, created in the early 1980s is now at peak maturity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lacombe Noaillac 2012  Médoc

description: The smoky aroma and toasty wood character smothers the fruit. It is a tough wine at this stage although it does hint at some of the 2012 juicy fruit flavors. Drink this firm, solid wine from 2018.
title: Château la Haye 2012  Saint-Estèphe

description: The smoky aroma and toasty wood character smothers the fruit. It is a tough wine at this stage although it does hint at some of the 2012 juicy fruit flavors. Drink this firm, solid wine from 2018.
title: Château la Haye 2012  Saint-Estèphe

description: One of the many chateaus with vines on the wide valley floor of the Dordogne, this estate has made a lightly extracted wine that has chocolate as well as blackberry stalkiness. There's freshness as well, with fruit acidity that cuts through the mineral texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Chapelle Despagnet 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: One of the many chateaus with vines on the wide valley floor of the Dordogne, this estate has made a lightly extracted wine that has chocolate as well as blackberry stalkiness. There's freshness as well, with fruit acidity that cuts through the mineral texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Château la Chapelle Despagnet 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: Quince and lychee fruit flavors dominate this ripe, off-dry wine. It has a spicy character, allowing for a dry core of pepper while also giving a rich aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Robert Karcher et Fils 2012 Harth Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The wine is all spice and sweet fruits. It has a honeyed character that gives the wine softness while also showing a dry core. The wine is rounded now and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Loew 2012 Cormier Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Now fully developed, this rich wine boasts spice and generous lychee and mango fruits. Its acidity is light, a reflection of the wine's ripe texture. It's totally ready to drink.
title: Domaine Jean-Luc Mader 2012 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Well balanced, this wine has acidity and a crisp character complemented by spice and a ripe, round texture. It's ready to drink, fresh as well as peppery.
title: Domaine Allimant-Laugner 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a rounded wine, soft and spicy. It has a velvet texture, spice and lychees all attractively balanced. With a touch of dryness as well as a more medium-dry character, this is now ready to drink.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2012 Saint-Rémy Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Properly light in color, this is crisp, fruity and deliciously fresh. Some weight comes from ripe strawberry fruits as well as touches of vanilla. The acidity at the end brings refreshment.
title: Les Quatre Tours 2013 Classique Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Smooth, ripe and rounded, it's ready to drink with its light perfume and spice. Rich pear and quince fruits add freshness to the fullness. Drink now.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2011 Val Saint Grégoire Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: While this wine is dry, the spice and creamy, ripe texture give a warm, rich feel. It has weight, baked apple fruit and a touch of spice. Ready to drink.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2011 Les Princes Abbés Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Close to Saint-Tropez the vineyards of the Massif des Maures have produced an attractively fruity wine that has an unusual blending including the rare Caladoc grape. Raspberry fruits are right up front, giving a bright, ripe character.
title: Domaine d'Astros 2013 Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Vin de Pays des Maures)

description: While rich, this blend of Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon is also quite herbal in character. Maybe it gets its nature from the wild garrigue countryside of Provence, but its tannins are firm and the fruit is laced with licorice. It should age another year.
title: Château Margüi 2011 Titien de Margüi Red (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Rich in style, this full-bodied rosé boasts ripe red fruits and a rounded, smooth character. The lift from acidity gives essential freshness at the end.
title: Château de la Galinière 2013 Le Cengle Vieilles Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Hydropathe means someone who reacts against water, presumably preferring wine. From hard against the slopes of Mount Sainte-Vicoire, this is a structured, rich and fruity wine. It reveals a strong citrus element as well as red fruits and a strongly mineral texture.
title: Domaine Sainte Lucie 2012 L'Hydropathe Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Hydropathe means someone who reacts against water, presumably preferring wine. From hard against the slopes of Mount Sainte-Vicoire, this is a structured, rich and fruity wine. It reveals a strong citrus element as well as red fruits and a strongly mineral texture.
title: Domaine Sainte Lucie 2012 L'Hydropathe Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: The heavy bottle indicates the importance attached to this wine by its producer. Structured and full bodied, it bursts with crisp fruits, mineral acidity and a touch of herbaceousness. Keep it until late 2014 to broaden out.
title: Domaine Saint-André de Figuière 2013 Première de Figuière Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Quat' Saisons, meaning four seasons, suggests that this wine isn't just for summer. It is certainly a food wine with its dry, full-bodied character and ripe caramel and red plum flavors. Lively and fresh at the end, it's ready to drink.
title: Château la Mascaronne 2013 Quat' Saisons Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Quat' Saisons, meaning four seasons, suggests that this wine isn't just for summer. It is certainly a food wine with its dry, full-bodied character and ripe caramel and red plum flavors. Lively and fresh at the end, it's ready to drink.
title: Château la Mascaronne 2013 Quat' Saisons Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In its tall square bottle, this makes a striking presentation. The wine inside has the same sense of presence, with a ripe, full-bodied structure that's full of red fruits with only light acidity. Fruitiness makes it delicious as an apéritif.
title: Château de Berne 2013 Terres de Berne Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: In its tall square bottle, this makes a striking presentation. The wine inside has the same sense of presence, with a ripe, full-bodied structure that's full of red fruits with only light acidity. Fruitiness makes it delicious as an apéritif.
title: Château de Berne 2013 Terres de Berne Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: The nose is subdued. Even the palate only gives up its secrets slowly. Right now, there is a creamy richness informed by peach and mirabelle plum. It is framed by zesty lemon freshness that counters the palpable warmth. The body is concentrated and lip smacking, harmonious and moreish with an earthy, clean, textured and off-dry finish.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2015 Roche Calcaire Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Ripe luscious pear fruit almost has a touch of maple syrup on the nose. The palate, which still has ample carbon dioxide from the fermentation for a little fizz, is light and fresh, lemony and bouncy, alive with a kind of earthy goodness. It is the lemon that lasts longest on the dry refreshing palate and makes for a lip-smacking finish.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2015 Heimbourg Riesling (Alsace)

description: A vivid freshness rises from the glass, recalling the wet stones of a cool brook. The palate has a rounder aspect of ripe citrus and is imbued with the tantalizing bitterness of grapefruit and tangerine peel. The body is smooth and concentrated, anchored in freshness and that animating pith. Very moreish, but in an advanced adult way. The finish is whistle clean, lip-smacking, dry and moreish.
title: Domaine Schoffit 2015 Lieu-Dit Harth Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose is a mere promise compared to the full-on experience that follows. The dry palate is a lovely synthesis of ripe, textured and tart elements: of russet-pear peel and flesh, of grapefruit zestiness and spice, of ripe and aromatic tangerine. This is concentrated and full of flavor, animated and full of impact. This seems like energizing fuel. Mouthwatering freshness creates a long fruit-rich driven finish.
title: Domaine Pfister 2015 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: The nose is reticent but reveals glimpses of passion fruit and peach. These are intensified by honeyed richness on the concentrated palate. Flavors are luscious and round but tangy notes of grapefruit zest give tension and ease to this richness. The finish is all about freshness despite being medium sweet. The peach lasts and lasts.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2015 Fronholz Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Sun-warmed ripe mirabelle notes beckon on the nose. The palate edges them with wonderful lemon zestiness. All is bright and luminous with citrus while more rounded peach and apricot notes appear on the slender, concentrated but absolutely full-fruited palate. The finish is whistle clean and lasting with pure lemon.
title: Domaine Jean Sipp 2015 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: Very ripe aspects inform the nose: ripe honeyed peach and pear dominate. The palate, on the other hand, is a picture of citric slenderness and steely concentration of freshness. Its absolute dryness highlights the brisk, clean and lemon-driven style perfectly. This is wonderfully bracing and cleansing and so very refreshing. Lovely now but sure to develope. Drink now through 2025.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2015 Collection Riesling (Alsace)

description: A touch of flint flashes up briefly before fruity notes of ripe juicy apricot and peach take over. On the palate they are joined by a flash of lemon freshness that brightens and heightens the slender but concentrated palate. Lemon and peach, tangerine and mirabelle fill mouth and mind while the freshness blows away any sensory cobwebs. This is deeply satisfying, lovely now but sure to improve. Drink now through 2030.
title: Josmeyer 2015 Le Dragon Riesling (Alsace)

description: The faintest hint of zesty lemon appears on the nose. The dry palate is of a concentrated slenderness, showing intense notes of ripe lemon zest but hinting at richer notions of ripe pear and candied citron. There is real impact, guided by rapier-like freshness and utter precision. This has an almost cleansing quality but is nonetheless imbued with the fruitful generosity of 2015. Lovely now, but sure to develop. Drink now through 2027.
title: Trimbach 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: A lifted, ethereal note of bitter almond suggests the beginnings of evolution. The palate, on the other hand, still seems closed but displays a streamlined concentrated core of flawless dryness and precise bundled freshness. This is taut, precise and sure to develop. The finish is lasting, refreshing and clean. Drink now through 2030.
title: Trimbach 2014 Réserve Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This small production wine has a crisp crackly character with great fruitiness, as well as a tight mineral texture from the chalk soil. Its citrus and herbal flavor is balanced with taut acidity. The wine, one of two from this producer reflecting different soil types, is young. Drink from 2019.
title: Michel Vattan 2015 Cuvée Calcaire  (Sancerre)

description: Golden pear and citrus fruit shimmer in the glass. The palate is ripe and fresh, made taut by citrus but glowing with ripe juicy pear and red apple. There is a lovely textured midpalate that is reminiscent of chalk, shot through with freshness that underlines the ripe fruit of 2015 even more. This is tangy and refreshing, concentrated and dry with a lovely long and whistle-clean aftertaste.
title: René Muré 2015 Cote de Rouffach Riesling (Alsace)

description: Rounded, but with just the right amount of herbaceousness to give a vivid fruity character. The wine is rich, sun-soaked while still retaining its sense of balance and elegance.
title: Château Olivier 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Full in the mouth, this is a rich wine with its yellow fruit and buried acidity. It is laden with wood and ripe fruit, and is dense and cushioned. A nutmeg flavor shows through slowly to add to the exotic, opulent aftertaste.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is a ripe and full-bodied; it benefitted from the warm vintage, offering rich yellow-fruit flavors to go with its touches of toast and sweet herb. On the finish, acidity and minerality come forward to suggest its aging potential.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2009 Sancerre d'Antan  (Sancerre)

description: This is a taut, tight, dry Champagne, needing a few more years of bottle age. It has fine acidity, with a crisp lemon flavor and a lively mousse. With further maturity, it will develop into an intense, toasty Champagne of great quality.
title: Veuve Doussot NV Cuvée L  (Champagne)

description: Maturing well, this is a rich Champagne. Its fruit flavors have gained a golden glow of toast and almond flavors, while retaining a taut, textured acidity. Ready to drink now.
title: Veuve Doussot 2002 Cuvée Guy Joly Mémory Brut  (Champagne)

description: The idea that Sauvignon Blanc cannot age is emphatically disproved by this impressive, mature wine. It is rich and concentrated, full of almonds, herbs and a great sense of length and ripeness. This is now perfectly ready to drink.
title: Domaine Laporte 2006 Le Grand Rochoy  (Sancerre)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Fruity and spicy, this is a fine, attractively fruity wine. While it doesn't have great weight, it has a core of dry tannins and a dark structure that suggests good aging for the future.
title: Château de Pez 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 92–94. Barrel sample. Fruity and spicy, this is a fine, attractively fruity wine. While it doesn't have great weight, it has a core of dry tannins and a dark structure that suggests good aging for the future.
title: Château de Pez 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. The wine is very dry, layered tannins giving a major sense of structure. It will always have this dry, dense character, very firm, solid and powerful.
title: Château Lynch-Bages 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This finely fruity wine is packed with black fruits accented by spice and wood flavors. Solid tannins and bright layers of acidity make this wine so typical of the vintage.
title: Château Croizet-Bages 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a smooth, rich wine that's intensely concentrated and packed with great black-currant fruits. The wine has weight and a sense of structure to support the great fruitiness.
title: Château Beychevelle 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This powerful wine is dense with rich tannins and black fruits that are balanced. Full and concentrated, it's a wine with great potential.
title: Château Ormes de Pez 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Full of ripe Cabernet tannins, this is a structured wine that's chunky in character. It elegantly balances fruit and structure, resulting in a wine that's sure to be impressive.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. This is a solid effort that showcases both great blackberry fruit and sweet tannins right at the forefront. There is also fine acidity and a layer of wood that gives a dry, firm, age-worthy aftertaste.
title: Château Saint-Pierre 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Comprised of 80% Cabernet Sauvignon, this is a densely ripe wine, full of black fruits, smoky wood and generous tannins. Given its structure, the wine will obviously age well, even if it is drinkable in the medium term.
title: Château Pichon Longueville 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Already a beautiful wine, this is showing fine, sweet fruits along with a solid structure. The palate is juicy and fruity with new wood flavors showing through. The aftertaste is full of the fresh aspect of the vintage.
title: Château Lagrange 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. Concentration is the name of the game with this dark and intense wine. It has power and a structure that is finely tannic and dusty, with bright fruits suspended within. The aftertaste shows fine, bright acidity.
title: Château Haut Bages Libéral 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 93–95. Barrel sample. While fully ripe on the palate, this wine also boasts acidity and a black-currant freshness. It shows the quality of Cabernet from Pauillac in 2012.
title: Château Clerc Milon 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This very ripe, full-bodied wine is powered by sweet blackberries and solid tannins. It is a full, concentrated and complex wine that has a great future.
title: Château Léoville Poyferré 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. Intense black currant fruitiness makes this wine unabashedly forward. The palate bears weighty tannins behind that fruit, resulting in a wine that is already quite balanced and structured.
title: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)
winery: Château Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. Firmly tannic in character, this wine is dry and extracted. There's potential for this powerful, impressive wine to bear the wine's very dry character with the weight of its fruit.
title: Château Léoville Barton 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a big, powerful, fruity wine that has restraint from its dense tannins. It's foursquare, chunky in character, already balanced, the tannins merging with the acidity. There is great aging potential.
title: Château Montrose 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. This is a glamorous wine with acidity and structure surrounded by a ripe fruit character. The palate is powerful, and already quite complex, with both great fruitiness and a solid feel.
title: Château Ducru Beaucaillou 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. Big and rich with lots of chocolate and ripe black-plum fruits, this is a very structured wine, showing some extraction but also spice and sweet tannins. Powerful, but with a finish that is like a cool breeze.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. Big and rich with lots of chocolate and ripe black-plum fruits, this is a very structured wine, showing some extraction but also spice and sweet tannins. Powerful, but with a finish that is like a cool breeze.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 94–96. Barrel sample. Big and ripe, this is a powerful wine with 78% Cabernet Sauvignon, giving the wine a solid, dusty structure but also delicious fruit. Finishes with a touch of chocolate at the end.
title: Château Calon Ségur 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: 95–97. Barrel sample. Full and powerfully concentrated, this wine has dense acidity, sweet black fruits and very fine tannins. The concentration is enormous but it expresses itself through the prism of smooth, velvet-textured tannins.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 95–97. Barrel sample. This is a very solid wine with tannins that are very firm and dense. There is power without excessive alcohol, lending a classic feel, and a pure line from fruit, acidity and tannin. The result is as much about fruit as structure.
title: Château Léoville Las Cases 2012 Barrel Sample  (Saint-Julien)

description: 96–98. Barrel sample. This is a structured, ripe wine that also has a great sense of freshness—vibrant blackberry flavor and lively acidity. The finish retains the same delicious freshness and brightness of this vintage.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 96–98. Barrel sample. This powerful, impressive wine is comprised of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon. It's seriously structured, with loads of black currants and dark tannin, and revels on the finish with the juicy, fresh acidity of this vintage. A fine Mouton, this is the first vintage produced in the chateau's new cellar.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 96–98. Barrel sample. This powerful, impressive wine is comprised of 90% Cabernet Sauvignon. It's seriously structured, with loads of black currants and dark tannin, and revels on the finish with the juicy, fresh acidity of this vintage. A fine Mouton, this is the first vintage produced in the chateau's new cellar.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2012 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 86–88. Barrel sample. A hard-edged wine, the palate is very dry, and without the fruit to support it. It has edgy wood tannins, and only a hint of juiciness.
title: Château la Tour de By 2012 Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 86–88. Barrel sample. A hard-edged wine, the palate is very dry, and without the fruit to support it. It has edgy wood tannins, and only a hint of juiciness.
title: Château la Tour de By 2012 Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 86–88. Barrel sample. This is a very ripe wine, that's perhaps overripe in its soft, fruity character. It is very full in the mouth with gentle tannins.
title: Château Mongravey 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 86–88. Barrel sample. This is a very ripe wine, that's perhaps overripe in its soft, fruity character. It is very full in the mouth with gentle tannins.
title: Château Mongravey 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This wine is solid and dark with bitter tannins that offer a hard edge to the riper blackberry fruits. A dense wine that has a very dry core.
title: Château Fourcas Dupré 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. This wine is solid and dark with bitter tannins that offer a hard edge to the riper blackberry fruits. A dense wine that has a very dry core.
title: Château Fourcas Dupré 2012 Barrel Sample  (Listrac-Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. Spicy wood comes through strongly, giving this wine a bitterness that's contrasted with intense acidity and tart black-currant flavors.
title: Château Monbrison 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. With firm tannins along with acidity and freshness, this is a lively, smoky wine, finishing with intense juicy acidity.
designation: La Chapelle de Potensac Barrel Sample
title: Château Potensac 2012 La Chapelle de Potensac Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. With firm tannins along with acidity and freshness, this is a lively, smoky wine, finishing with intense juicy acidity.
designation: La Chapelle de Potensac Barrel Sample
title: Château Potensac 2012 La Chapelle de Potensac Barrel Sample  (Médoc)

description: 87–89. Barrel sample. Big, ripe and fruity, this wine has attractive acidity and a soft texture. The palate is full bodied with a lingering fruity aftertaste.
title: Château Siran 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Juicy and ripe, this wine has rich fruitiness without the balancing structure. It profits from ripe Merlot flavors in the blend, yielding a fruity wine that will develop fast.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Juicy and ripe, this wine has rich fruitiness without the balancing structure. It profits from ripe Merlot flavors in the blend, yielding a fruity wine that will develop fast.
title: Château Labégorce Margaux 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: 88–90. Barrel sample. Packed with dark tannins, this wine is concentrated and dry with considerable extraction, giving the palate a bitter coffee character. It could stay severe in style.
title: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2012 Barrel Sample  (Margaux)

description: Darker in color than normal rosé, Bordeaux Clairet also has more richness. This wine is concentrated with vanilla and sweet strawberry flavors, although with a lack of freshness. Treat this as a red wine.
title: Château de Parenchère 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: Darker in color than normal rosé, Bordeaux Clairet also has more richness. This wine is concentrated with vanilla and sweet strawberry flavors, although with a lack of freshness. Treat this as a red wine.
title: Château de Parenchère 2010 Rosé (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: The Chartrons is the neighborhood of Bordeaux where the wine merchants traditionally worked. This branded Bordeaux is softly ripe, with an attractive density along with a dry core of tannins. Ready to drink now.
title: Maison Duhard 2009 Baron des Chartrons  (Bordeaux)

description: This is a ripe juicy wine with fine red fruits and acidity. The smoky tannins are a fine support to the berry flavors. It is developing well and should be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Légende 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a perfumed wine. Although the tannins are still firm from 14 months in new oak, it does have fine, fragrant red-fruit and acidity. The texture is dense, still young, and will be fine from 2019.
title: Château Tertre de Belves 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is going to be a fine fruity wine once its firm tannins have calmed down. It has enough black-fruit flavors and acidity to ensure that it will be perfumed, ripe and fresh at the same time. Drink starting from 2017.
title: Château Tassin 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is going to be a fine fruity wine once its firm tannins have calmed down. It has enough black-fruit flavors and acidity to ensure that it will be perfumed, ripe and fresh at the same time. Drink starting from 2017.
title: Château Tassin 2014  Bordeaux

description: This is a firmly tannic wine although with ripe potential. It has a dense character that is good, allowing the fruit to develop. For now, it is dry so give that fruit plenty of time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tanesse 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a firmly tannic wine although with ripe potential. It has a dense character that is good, allowing the fruit to develop. For now, it is dry so give that fruit plenty of time. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Tanesse 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a ripe toasty wine. With its red-berry fruits and acidity along with some dry, smoky tannins it is a wine in progress. Drink this concentrated wine from 2018.
title: Château Roc Meynard 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a ripe and perfumed wine from Vignobles Marcel Petit. It has good aging potential—full of tannins and also of bold black fruits. Structure and fruitiness are a good sign. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Pillebois 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A perfumed fruity wine, this has a light structure along with its forward red fruits. Acidity and juicy fruitiness complete this attractive, ready to drink wine.
title: Château l'Escadre 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Big tannins dominate this still young wine. It has spice and a dry toast character that will need to soften. With acidity and hints of red fruits that should happen, so drink this wine from 2019 when its potential should be realized.
title: Château Les Hauts de Palette 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Big tannins dominate this still young wine. It has spice and a dry toast character that will need to soften. With acidity and hints of red fruits that should happen, so drink this wine from 2019 when its potential should be realized.
title: Château Les Hauts de Palette 2014  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Situated on the Côte des Bar, this estate has produced a soft, full blend of half and half Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. It treads a fine line of a balanced dosage with the white fruits and final citrus acidity. Drink now.
title: Château de Bligny NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: The blend in this cuvée is 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah, aged in second-use oak. The oak provides hints of baking spices on the nose and some cedary notes on the palate, nicely accenting the bright black-cherry fruit in this medium-bodied wine. Soft tannins combine with mouthwatering acids on the finish. Drink now–2016.
title: Domaine Fond Croze 2009 Cuvée Romanaise Grenache-Syrah (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: This is a round, silky Châteauneuf-du-Pape that's an appealing, early-drinking rendering. Cherry and leather notes aren't particularly complex beyond a certain horsiness, but the wine fills the mouth and the flavors do linger.
title: Domaine de Châteaumar 2009 Secret de Nos Vignes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Full-bodied, broad and a bit oily in texture, this concentrated old-vine Marsanne seems a bit evolved, with open aromas of honeyed fruit and truffle backed by citrusy fruit and a hint of anise. Long and intense on the finish. Drink now.
title: Cave de Tain 2009 Au Coeur des Siècles Marsanne (Hermitage)

description: The Jaume family's négociant business is thriving because of wines like this that faithfully represent their terroirs while offering solid value. This raspberry- and garrigue-scented wine features ample weight framed by supple tannins that firm up on the finish. Drink now–2018.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2009 Les Valats Red (Rasteau)

description: This classic blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from Savoie has resulted in the palest rosé that rivals only Provence in color. It has a touch of tannin, plenty of red-fruit acidity and a soft, creamy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Les Rocailles NV Brut Rosé  (Vin de France)

description: Red berry aromas and spicy fruit give a wine that is ripe and smooth, with just the lightest of tannins. It's all fruit—juicy and open. Drink now.
title: Famille Laplace 2016 Aramis Tannat-Syrah (Vin de France)

description: Still very firm, this wine shows the tannic structure of the vintage. Because it's beginning to mature, it also shows it's not likely to open up much more. Big and hard to like.
title: Château Tour Grand Faurie 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This simple, fruity wine has both crisp, citrusy acidity and riper apricot and pear flavors. It's soft and finishes with attractive tangy acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Saint-Florian 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This estate in the east of the Entre-deux-Mers region has produced a ripe white blend that balances its white fruit with a crisp herbal element. With acidity and a touch of spice, it's crisp and ready to drink.
title: Château Haut Peyruguet 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This blend includes 70% Merlot and a small (2%) amount of Malbec. Ripe blackberry fruit dominates, but it also has structure. It's likely to develop quickly and be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Fleur de Plaisance 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This blend includes 70% Merlot and a small (2%) amount of Malbec. Ripe blackberry fruit dominates, but it also has structure. It's likely to develop quickly and be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Fleur de Plaisance 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This ripe organic wine has benefited from the fine 2016 vintage to give rich black fruit and plenty of firm tannins. At its heart are berry flavors and acidity. It will age well over the next few years. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Lagarde 2016 Les Hauts de Lagarde  (Bordeaux)

description: Smoky, toasty aromas set the scene for a wine that has obviously seen plenty of wood aging. At this stage, it's all spice and wood, which will probably inhibit its development. Wait until 2020.
title: Château Cailleteau Bergeron 2015 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Crisp with bright fruit recalling sliced apples, this wine is fruity and fresh. Acidity cuts easily through it and lends an herbal edge. Drink now.
title: Château Barbé 2016  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: From vines on the slopes above the River Cher, this steely wine has a tight texture that is restraining the natural fruitiness. It will open up, with its ripe yellow and green fruit flavors. Drink from 2016.
title: Paul Buisse 2014 Domaine Paul Buisse Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This wine is laced with wood and spice. It is ripe and fruity, also having a strong pepper and toast character and a light sprinkling of tannin. Juicy cherries give a lift at the end. Drink now.
title: Patient Cottat 2013 Le Grand Caillou Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This wine is laced with wood and spice. It is ripe and fruity, also having a strong pepper and toast character and a light sprinkling of tannin. Juicy cherries give a lift at the end. Drink now.
title: Patient Cottat 2013 Le Grand Caillou Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This light, fruity and fragrant white has a strong herbaceous character that is recognizably Sauvignon Blanc. It is crisp, clean, fresh and ready to drink.
title: Château Nicot 2014  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: This wine is bright and fruity, with acidity and some fresh red berry fruits. The background tannins do have a dryness but will soften over the next few months. Drink from 2017. This property, east of Saint-Émilion, is run by Florent Dubard.
title: Château Nardou 2013 Bois Meyney du Château Nardou  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This wine is bright and fruity, with acidity and some fresh red berry fruits. The background tannins do have a dryness but will soften over the next few months. Drink from 2017. This property, east of Saint-Émilion, is run by Florent Dubard.
title: Château Nardou 2013 Bois Meyney du Château Nardou  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Juicy red berry fruits and bright acidity are the hallmarks of this wine, from an 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc blend. The tannic background is still there and does need to soften, so give the wine until 2017. This estate, one of six, has been in the Aubert family since before the French Revolution.
title: Château Labesse 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Juicy red berry fruits and bright acidity are the hallmarks of this wine, from an 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc blend. The tannic background is still there and does need to soften, so give the wine until 2017. This estate, one of six, has been in the Aubert family since before the French Revolution.
title: Château Labesse 2012  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: While the tannins here are dry, this wine has enough fruit to show its potential. Blackberry flavors are ripe, cut with acidity and a juicy texture. The wine needs time, so drink from 2017. Enologist Sebastien and vineyard manager Nicolas are the latest generation managing the Carreau family estates.
title: Château la Croix Saint-Pierre 2012 Grand Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: There is a good balance between fruit and structure in this blend of 71% Merlot and 29% Cabernet Franc. It is not weighty, although it does offer attractive berry fruits and touches of red currants. Acidity is a powerful element in this wine that needs to soften. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Donjon de Bruignac 2013  Bordeaux

description: Juicy black currant acidity dominates this light, bright wine that's 100% Merlot. It has a fresh feel and is structured with light tannins. Drink now.
title: Château de Seguin 2013 Cuvée Carpe Diem  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Red currant and red berry fruits show strongly in this wine from Virginie Aubrion's biodynamic vineyards. The tannins are strong, although leaving space for the fruitiness. It needs to develop, with good acidity likely to come through. Drink from 2016.
title: Château de Piote 2013 Cuvée Prestige  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This juicy wine conveys a ripe black cherry and lightly spicy character. It's all about the fruit, right up front and with a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de Gaudou 2014 Gaudou Exception Malbec (Vin de France)

description: This juicy wine conveys a ripe black cherry and lightly spicy character. It's all about the fruit, right up front and with a fresh, crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de Gaudou 2014 Gaudou Exception Malbec (Vin de France)

description: This second wine of Château de Belcier has a good texture, jammy ripe strawberry fruits and light tannins. A wine with acidity and a character, it will be ready to drink soon. Drink from mid-2016. MACIF, a mutual insurance company, bought the estate in the 1980s and restored the vineyards and château that was built by François de Belcier, a counter-revolutionary who was guillotined in 1794.
title: Château de Belcier 2013 Château de Monrecueil  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This second wine of Château de Belcier has a good texture, jammy ripe strawberry fruits and light tannins. A wine with acidity and a character, it will be ready to drink soon. Drink from mid-2016. MACIF, a mutual insurance company, bought the estate in the 1980s and restored the vineyards and château that was built by François de Belcier, a counter-revolutionary who was guillotined in 1794.
title: Château de Belcier 2013 Château de Monrecueil  (Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: From one of the small outliers in the Loire valley, this crisp wine made from Pineau d'Aunis is bright and lively. It has fresh acidity, red currant flavors and a light, tight aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Cave Cooperative du Vendômois 2014 Lieu-dit Cocagne Rosé (Coteaux du Vendômois)

description: This is a medium-sweet wine, very fresh while also with some richness. A creamed-apple texture is given a more exotic touch with white peach flavors and freshened with bright acidity. It would be good with Asian food. Drink now.
title: Barton & Guestier 2014 Passeport  (Vouvray)

description: This is a medium-sweet wine, very fresh while also with some richness. A creamed-apple texture is given a more exotic touch with white peach flavors and freshened with bright acidity. It would be good with Asian food. Drink now.
title: Barton & Guestier 2014 Passeport  (Vouvray)
