title: Bernard Magrez 2016 Château des Muraires Séduction Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: With 45% Mourvèdre and 35% Cinsault this has turned into a highly flavored and aromatic wine. It has great fruits and a rich texture that has a herbal edge. It is certainly a food rosé and with its up-front fruit, it could do with a few months to calm down. Drink from late 2017.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2016 Cuvée G Rosé (Bandol)

description: With crisp black berry fruits, this is pure juice in a glass. It has fresh acidity, a light layer of tannin and a sweet underlay to the attractive fruitiness.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Sélection  (Juliénas)

description: With crisp black berry fruits, this is pure juice in a glass. It has fresh acidity, a light layer of tannin and a sweet underlay to the attractive fruitiness.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Sélection  (Juliénas)

description: This is a pale-colored wine—lightly fruity and with a crisp clean texture. It is balanced with acidity and orange-zest flavor, giving the wine a refreshing lift at the end. This is an apéritif style, ready to drink now.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2016 Les Jolies Flles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a refreshingly fruity wine with a fine balance between acidity and ripe red-currant and raspberry fruits. The wine is crisp, clean and full of fruitiness with a bright fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Estandon 2016 Lumière de Provence Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a refreshingly fruity wine with a fine balance between acidity and ripe red-currant and raspberry fruits. The wine is crisp, clean and full of fruitiness with a bright fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Estandon 2016 Lumière de Provence Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: Produced close to the sea at Bandol, this wine has a good proportion (20%) of Mourvèdre in the blend. That adds to the richness and brings out a fine aromatic floral character. Wild strawberries flavors give a rich ready-to-drink aftertaste.
title: Le Charmel 2016 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Vines more than 40 years old are the backbone of this ripe, concentrated wine. With bergamot and intense spices, it's a rich wine that's already beguiling. Vines from Katzenthal give the mineral edge to this pepper and spice wine that is only just moving towards sweet.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2012 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The granite soil of the Holder vineyard lends itself to Pinot Gris, allowing the grapes to keep freshness while adding a rich undertow. This wine is full in the mouth, medium sweet in style and generous. It will age over the short-term, so drink from 2016.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2012 Holder Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Riesling that is just becoming mature is the foundation of this perfumed, white fruit and complex wine. Dried apricot and spice cake flavors give the wine richness and balance the fruitiness that is now maturing. Drink this fine wine now.
title: Vieil Armand 2009 Château Ollwiller Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Produced from a small parcel of old vines, this is a crisp and fresh wine. With red-cherry fruit and acidity, it is a bright wine, up-front with its fruitiness and lively aftertaste.
title: Jean-Michel Dupré 2015 Terre Noire Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Some earthy tones cling to the ripe pear and peach of this wine. A hint of bitterness on the palate is leavened by a bright, pure streak of lemon on a dry and slender body.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2015 Les Natures Riesling (Alsace)

description: The wine is built with a tannic structure that gives density. Red fruits vie with the dry tannins and acidity to produce a firm wine that could still age another few months. Drink starting from 2017.
title: Mommessin 2013 Domaine de la Presle  (Fleurie)

description: Earth and apple notes unite to make this juicy, fresh and sprightly Riesling. The style is dry, helped by a slight phenolic grip and that characteristic, lime-lemon acidity that brightens everything.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2014 Muhlforst Riesling (Alsace)

description: Earth and apple notes unite to make this juicy, fresh and sprightly Riesling. The style is dry, helped by a slight phenolic grip and that characteristic, lime-lemon acidity that brightens everything.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2014 Muhlforst Riesling (Alsace)

description: Gentle notes of creaminess and ripe pears signal a soft, creamy wine with lots of texture and body. The rounded body carries some weight and is edged with a bitter marzipan note. All this is countered by fresh acidity, more creamy, nutty notes and a vanilla finish.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2014 Im Berg Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Floral overtones join ripe pear notes on the nose. The palate comes in with even more generous, juicy pear fruit, the rounded flavors boosted by a little residual sweetness that makes the wine finish off dry.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Vieilles Vignes Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Based in Fleurie, this producer has made a wine rich in fruit and tannins. It has a smoky spicy character as well as intense red fruits. It is warm, concentrated and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Berrod 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: A blend of Loin de l'Oeil and Sauvignon Blanc has produced a ripe and soft but balanced wine from a vineyard owned by the Wine Museum of Paris. It has refreshing melon and white-plum fruits, and an aromatic character that is rich and full bodied. Drink now.
title: Château Labastidié 2014 White (Gaillac)

description: A blend of Loin de l'Oeil and Sauvignon Blanc has produced a ripe and soft but balanced wine from a vineyard owned by the Wine Museum of Paris. It has refreshing melon and white-plum fruits, and an aromatic character that is rich and full bodied. Drink now.
title: Château Labastidié 2014 White (Gaillac)

description: This wine, with its black fruits and still-firm tannins, is crisp with intense acidity as well as black-currant fruitiness. Its ripe structure suggests the ability to age a little longer, and the wine will be best from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Monplaisir 2014 Malbec (Cahors)

description: In Cahors Tradition means a wine that doesn't go into barrels for aging. That keeps the fruit vibrant and crisp, as it is here. The wine is ripe, full in the mouth with fruit tannins and black-currant acidity. It is a year away from maturity, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Eugénie 2014 Tradition Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: In Cahors Tradition means a wine that doesn't go into barrels for aging. That keeps the fruit vibrant and crisp, as it is here. The wine is ripe, full in the mouth with fruit tannins and black-currant acidity. It is a year away from maturity, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Eugénie 2014 Tradition Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Produced from old vines on the Chatelard estate, this wine is smooth, ripe and full of vibrant red fruits. There is a good balance between acidity and rich fruit with just a light core of tannins in the background. Drink now.
title: Château du Châtelard 2015 Cuvée les Vieilles Vignes  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: The wine is ripe and bone dry. It has a tight structure, mineral texture and intense acidity. There is a bitter edge in this young wine that will blow away as the ripe white fruit asserts itself. At the end, there is a touch of honey.
title: Château de Jurque 2014 Fantaisie  (Jurançon Sec)

description: The Mourvèdre in this ripe wine lends a wonderful spice and herbal character. While the wine is full and rich, it also has a fine refreshing line of raspberry fruit. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château d'Azur 2015 Tradition Rosé (Bandol)

description: Bright and perfumed while also rich, this is a full-bodied wine. It has spice and pepper that come from its alcohol although everything is kept fresh by the red-currant fruitiness. Drink now.
title: Château d'Azur 2015 Jardin du Soleil Cuvée Prestige Rosé (Bandol)

description: A ripe, rounded wine, with just some wood. It is soft, with flavors of apricots followed by a fresh acidity and a final waft of tropical fruits and spice.
title: Henri de Villamont 2007  Rully

description: Delicious and inviting with notes of eucalyptus, chocolate-covered cherries and wild raspberries on the nose. The palate exhibits darker flavors by way of black cherry and plum, fleshing out the solidly structured medium weight mouth. A moderate, evolving finish closes nicely with a kiss of sweet oak.
title: Les Vignerons de la Méditerranée 2006 La Cuvée Mythique Red (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Showing some maturity in its dried fruit notes, this is neverhtheless an attractive heavyweight for near-term drinking. Chocolate fudge and prune notes pick up hints of cinnamon and dried herbs, then end long and softly dusty. Drink now–2020.
title: Sélection Laurence Féraud 2011  Gigondas

description: Honey, peach and honeysuckle create a very rich aromatic nose. The medium-sweet palate amplifies them all and presents them on an almost oily, rich and fluid body. A bitter phenolic edge provides backbone. The finish is full of peach, zest and freshness.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2016 Les Natures Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Honey, peach and honeysuckle create a very rich aromatic nose. The medium-sweet palate amplifies them all and presents them on an almost oily, rich and fluid body. A bitter phenolic edge provides backbone. The finish is full of peach, zest and freshness.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2016 Les Natures Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Generous, appetizing and juicy pear fruit dominates nose and palate. Flavors of ripe yellow Comice pear dance freshly, freely and fully expressed. The palate is compact, dry and juicy. The utterly inviting pear notes last and linger.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2015 Les Natures Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Lime and lemon zest are joined by aromatic citrus foliage on the nose. The palate replays these sprightly refreshing notes and lets them ripple across the slender palate. This is light, dry and will put a spring in your step with its citrus liveliness.
title: Wolfberger 2016 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Lime and lemon zest are joined by aromatic citrus foliage on the nose. The palate replays these sprightly refreshing notes and lets them ripple across the slender palate. This is light, dry and will put a spring in your step with its citrus liveliness.
title: Wolfberger 2016 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Friendly inviting notes of ripe juicy pear appear immediately on the nose and are also amply present on the palate. The body is concentrated and has warmth and texture that are amply countered by zesty citrus freshness. The finish is clean, medium sweet and lasting.
title: Ruhlmann 2015 Tête de Cuvée Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The nose is a subdued but evocative blend of rose petal, peach, lemon and mirabelle. The palate shows a similarly easy interplay of flavors on a concentrated, harmonious and off-dry body. This is fresh and fruity, lively and enticing.
title: Domaine G. Metz 2015 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose is rather subdued. The palate comes in with the ripe freshness of orange flesh and peel. There is a lovely zesty pleasantly bitter frame that lends structure and acts as a counterweight to the slight fruit sweetness. The off-dry palate is poised and balanced, with an almost dry finish. This is restrained and elegant.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2016 Collection Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose is rather subdued. The palate comes in with the ripe freshness of orange flesh and peel. There is a lovely zesty pleasantly bitter frame that lends structure and acts as a counterweight to the slight fruit sweetness. The off-dry palate is poised and balanced, with an almost dry finish. This is restrained and elegant.
title: Cave de Ribeauvillé 2016 Collection Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: From the heart of the Marne Valley, this 100% Pinot Meunier bottling is ripe and yeasty. It has a rich, soft character and hints of toast from the 30% reserve wine in the blend. Balanced dosage gives a soft, smooth aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Gérard Loriot NV Tradition Brut Pinot Meunier (Champagne)

description: From the heart of the Marne Valley, this 100% Pinot Meunier bottling is ripe and yeasty. It has a rich, soft character and hints of toast from the 30% reserve wine in the blend. Balanced dosage gives a soft, smooth aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Gérard Loriot NV Tradition Brut Pinot Meunier (Champagne)

description: This blend of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier combines richness with tight, crisp acidity. It has a softer side, recalling ripe apples, with a Pinot Noir-like structure and taut, mineral edge. A great Champagne for food.
title: Liebart-Régnier NV Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a rich style of Chablis that has the crispness of 2014 while showing a more creamy, yellow fruit character. Part wood-aged and part matured in tank, it's balanced and ready to drink.
title: La Chablisienne 2014 La Sereine  (Chablis)

description: This wine is tight, textured and still young. With crisp, mineral acidity and bright citrus and white stone fruits, it needs to age to show its full, rich potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2015  Mâcon La Roche Vineuse

description: One of a range of single-vineyard wines, this is a selection from the producer's oldest vines. It has great white fruit, and is generously textured and ripe. Hints of yellow fruit in the background add richness. It has a soft aftertaste, suggesting it is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2015 Croix de Montceau  (Saint-Véran)

description: One of a range of single-vineyard wines, this is a selection from the producer's oldest vines. It has great white fruit, and is generously textured and ripe. Hints of yellow fruit in the background add richness. It has a soft aftertaste, suggesting it is ready to drink.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2015 Croix de Montceau  (Saint-Véran)

description: The cooler northern part of Burgundy is not far from southern Champagne, so it's unsurprising that this is the source of much sparkling Burgundy. This pale colored rosé is soft and fruity, with a hint of red cherry and plenty of fine, crisp acidity. Drink now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre NV Brut Rosé  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This big, concentrated effort is currently closed, but it's already hinting at ripe black fruits, solid tannins and a long future. On the finish, acidity and a black currant note give the wine a final lift. Keep this for at least five years.
title: Château Paloumey 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Wood-driven tannins dominate at this stage, creating a wine that is structured and dense. The tannins are layered with the weight of the black currant and plum fruits. Lascombes is still finding its style, but is definitely on the upward slope.
title: Château Lascombes 2010  Margaux

description: This is weighty, closed, dark and dense, and the tannins dominate. For the time being, the ripe, juicy fruits are overwhelmed by the firm structure. This needs time.
title: Château la Bienfaisance 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This is an impressive, concentrated wine that gives pride of place to the ripe berry flavors and the balancing acidity. Underneath, the tannins are built up, showing that the wine will age. With its weight and depth, this needs to be aged the tannins to fully soften.
title: Château Hourtin-Ducasse 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: From the cave cooperative located in nearby Vacqueyras, this is a full-bodied, plushly textured wine that manages to avoid being too soft. Black cherry and garrigue notes are joined by hints of licorice and mocha on the long, layered finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Vignerons de Caractère 2009 Roque Colombe G-S-M (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Boasting notes of dried flowers and herbs in its bouquet, this is a silky, elegant rendition of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. There's a sense of wet-stone minerality, along with notes of dried black fruit and dark chocolate. Licorice comes through on the lengthy finish.
title: Domaine du Pegau 2008 Cuvée Laurence Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Ripe and fruity, this has ripe tannin and rich red-berry flavors. It has a solid, firm background of dark tannins that promise good aging.
title: Clos l'Eglise 2009  Pomerol

description: This firmly tannic wine, characteristic of Saint-Estèphe, is very dry. Underneath the dryness, there is a delicious, opulent juiciness that brings out black currant and plum flavors. It's obviously a wine for the long haul; keep for at least six years.
title: Château Sérilhan 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: This rounded wine is dense, with firm tannins that are well molded into its sweet-tasting structure. Packed with ripe fruit, this will age relatively quickly, giving pleasure in 5–6 years.
title: Château Rouget 2009  Pomerol

description: This rounded wine is dense, with firm tannins that are well molded into its sweet-tasting structure. Packed with ripe fruit, this will age relatively quickly, giving pleasure in 5–6 years.
title: Château Rouget 2009  Pomerol

description: Crisp and fresh, a well-balanced wine that shows vivid fruit, acidity as well as weight. The crispness at the end gives a delicious final burst.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2009 La Cave de Saint-Roch-les-Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Crisp and fresh, a well-balanced wine that shows vivid fruit, acidity as well as weight. The crispness at the end gives a delicious final burst.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2009 La Cave de Saint-Roch-les-Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: One of the trio of great white wine villages in the Côte de Beaune, Puligny-Montrachet makes the most classical wines. This village wine has the best of all worlds with its generous fruit and beautifully taut texture. It's ready to drink but will also age well. Drink now and until 2022.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012  Puligny-Montrachet

description: This attractive sunset-pink colored wine has light acidity along with its rich, structured fruit. This is as serious as rosé gets, with red plum and berry fruits supported by a concentrated texture and acidity. It could age, so drink towards the end of 2015.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: This attractive sunset-pink colored wine has light acidity along with its rich, structured fruit. This is as serious as rosé gets, with red plum and berry fruits supported by a concentrated texture and acidity. It could age, so drink towards the end of 2015.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Vaulorent is often grouped with others as Fourchaume Premier Cru. Here Brocard has bottled it separately to bring out its ripe fruits and warm character. The wine is toasty, smooth although not losing its more mineral texture. It offers a delicious, rounded vanilla aftertaste.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2012 Vaulorent Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: 92-94 Barrel sample. A solid, wood and fruit balanced wine, foursquare and chunky. It has a firm backbone of tannins, and the dark plum and fig fruits match well with final lift of acidity.
title: Château Giscours 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 93—95 Barrel sample. What a fine wine, elegant, structured, impressively balanced, full of spice, blackcurrants, vibrant acidity. A great year at Trotanoy.
title: Château Trotanoy 2006 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 93—95 Barrel sample. A very intense, ripe wine, packed with botrytis. It has great ripe flavors, plenty of apricots and dense, full fruit. At the top.
title: Château la Tour Blanche 2006 Barrel sample  (Sauternes)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. A small property on one of the best sites in Saint-Emilion, newly released under its own name. It is powerful, dense compact, with dark tannins, an impressive richness. It is full, firm and solid.
title: Vieux Château Mazerat 2008 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: 93-95 Barrel sample. With an higher proportion of Merlot than is usual even at Palmer, this wine, goes for lovely fresh, soft fruits. There is a touch of spice, juicy red berries, finally getting to a depth of dusty, chewy tannins.
title: Château Palmer 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: Some smoke and crushed boysenberry play on nose and palate. The pleasant smokiness reaches into all corners of this soft but fresh wine. It has a lovely rounded balance despite the relatively light body where earthiness is as present as fruit.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2012 H Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Some smoke and crushed boysenberry play on nose and palate. The pleasant smokiness reaches into all corners of this soft but fresh wine. It has a lovely rounded balance despite the relatively light body where earthiness is as present as fruit.
title: Domaine Saint-Rémy 2012 H Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The nose is secretive but the palate shows structure and poise. There is freshness and brisk, tart redcurrant fruit with some concentration, plesantly unexpected grip and lovely firmness. It's a light but impressive Pinot.
title: Domaine Charles Frey 2013 Quintessence Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: The nose is subdued but the palate shows the effortless, weightless charm of Sylvaner, with hints of green pear and lime as well as notes of stone and earth. It offers expressive slenderness.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2013 Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: The nose is subdued but the palate shows the effortless, weightless charm of Sylvaner, with hints of green pear and lime as well as notes of stone and earth. It offers expressive slenderness.
title: Domaine Charles Baur 2013 Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: This is a fresh but also full and rich wine with ripe pear and raspberry fruits. The wine is balanced and ready to drink.
title: Château Fonfroide 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is firm and structured, with complex tannins and dark black-fruit flavors. Under the tannins, juicy fruit with considerable acidity gives signs of great potential. The aftertaste again comes back to the structure. Drink from 2019.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: This simple wine has some attractive citrus fruit. It is light, bright with plenty of acidity to keep it all fresh. It should be drunk now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2013 Domaine des Chènevières  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Light and bright, this fruity wine has a more bitter element that gives a sharper character that will hopefully round out. At the back, plenty of acidity leaves a crisp aftertaste.
title: Domaine Saumaize-Michelin 2013  Mâcon-Villages

description: Made from 50% Syrah and 50% Mourvèdre, this rosé offers direct notes of red cherry, currant and raspberry on the nose and mouth. Hints of savory herbs and underbrush add depth to the palate, finishing short and slightly bitter. Drink up.
title: Domaine Cazes 2014 Le Canon du Marechal Rosé (Côtes Catalanes)

description: Crisp and light, this is a bright wine with attractive acidity and fresh fruitiness. It's not a wine for the long-term, with its simple caramel and spice flavors. Drink now.
title: Domaine Paquet et Fils 2013 Château de Chaintré  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Toast and a yeast character gives an edge of bitterness to the fruit. There are hints of smooth melon and acidity, although the lightly burnt character masks the fruitiness.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013  Viré-Clessé

description: This fresh, soft and simple wine has attractive acidity. Fruity and aromatic, it is totally ready to drink.
title: Cave de Lugny 2013 Coeur de Charmes  (Mâcon-Lugny)

description: Honeyed and caramel aromas are followed on the palate by a ripe, rich creamy texture. Yellow fruits are further smoothed by buttery flavors. This is a rounded wine, ready to drink.
title: Louis Max 2013  Mâcon-Villages

description: Mainly Pinot Noir with a touch of Gamay, this is a crisp red-currant flavored wine. It comes from northern Burgundy giving a cool character to this fruity wine. The acidity and the orange zest at the end are really refreshing.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Full and perfumed, this wine has a rich character, with ripe apples, green plums and lively acidity. With its wildflower aromas and touch of pepper, it is both delicious and evocative.
title: Domaine Vico 2015 Vermentino (Corse)

description: This wine is rich while also crisp. Refreshing red fruits are laced with a touch of orange peel and spice. A blend of the local Nieullucciu and Sciaccarellu, it is fruity and very ready to drink.
title: Domaine Vico 2015 Rosé (Corse)

description: This wine has bright black-currant fruit and some firm tannins. Crisp, it's packed with acidity giving a fresh feel. It will be better lightly chilled.
title: Domaine de l'Idylle 2015 Arbin Mondeuse (Savoie)

description: This is a soft wine, fruity without great definition. A ripe, red fruit character contrasts with a bitter acidity. It is ready to drink. The blend is 50/50 Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château Taussin 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: There is a rosé here struggling to get out. This wine has strawberry fruits combined with tannins in a way that does not work. Bordeaux Clairet lies between rosé and red in color and in taste.
title: Château de Marsan 2014  Bordeaux Clairet

description: Light, ripe and fruity, this wine is bursting with black currant fruits supported by a firm base of dry fruit tannins. It can be drunk now in its youth, but will be better from 2016.
title: Château Grand Jean 2014  Bordeaux

description: Deep pink in color, this gently fruity wine has too much caramel flavor. It offers red currant fruit at the end and attractive acidity.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2014 La Rosée de Ramage Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Deep pink in color, this gently fruity wine has too much caramel flavor. It offers red currant fruit at the end and attractive acidity.
title: Château Ramage la Batisse 2014 La Rosée de Ramage Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This caramel-flavored, lightly pink wine is soft and full in the mouth, with a light touch of tannin in the background. Drink now.
title: Château Maison Noble 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Still dominated by wood and toast aromas, this wine is certainly too young to drink. The wood needs to smooth out and allow room for the fruit. It will age, with its fresh fruits and acidity, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Jean de Bel Air 2014  Bordeaux

description: Pure fruitiness, this wine is full of black currant flavors and a stalky, dusty texture. Without wood aging, it has acidity, fruitiness and some dry tannins. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Château Haut Vieux Chêne 2014  Bordeaux

description: A bold pink color suggests the richness of this vanilla-flavored wine that misses out on a truly refreshing character. It is full and soft, with a touch of bitter acidity at the end.
title: Château des Antonins 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Touches of red fruits give this soft and creamy wine attractive acidity. Pepper and spice lead to a bitter aftertaste.
title: Château de Piote 2010 Perles Rosé  (Crémant de Bordeaux)

description: Very fruity, this is a crisp, lemon-scented and flavored wine, with grassy, herbaceous character from the green Sauvignon Blanc in the blend. The aftertaste is tight with some bitterness.
title: Château de Parenchère 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wine is bone dry, very crisp and fruity. It presents a bright and lively character plus orange peel tang. The acidity at the end is very fresh, with just a touch of caramel.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Tannat and Pinenc, both native to this region of Southwest France, give a ripe, juicy wine, packed with red-fruit flavors surrounding a more dense tannic core. It has a smoky flavor that gives an edge to the great fruit flavors. Drink in 3–4 years.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2010 L'Empreinte de Saint-Mont  (Saint-Mont)

description: The flagship wine from Fournier is rich, showing maturing Sauvignon Blanc along with smooth, creamy plum and apricot flavors. It is full and intense—a complex wine that will repay another 2–3 years of aging.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2009 Grand Fumé  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A wonderfully fruity, dry wine, it is exuberantly Chenin Blanc, with its ripe honey and pear flavors. It tastes of almonds, rounded with a rich texture and finished with acidity. The wine is both impressive and delicious.
title: Domaine des Roches Neuves 2011 L'Insolite  (Saumur)

description: A wonderfully fruity, dry wine, it is exuberantly Chenin Blanc, with its ripe honey and pear flavors. It tastes of almonds, rounded with a rich texture and finished with acidity. The wine is both impressive and delicious.
title: Domaine des Roches Neuves 2011 L'Insolite  (Saumur)

description: Still young, this rich and full-bodied wine is densely packed with red currant and bitter-orange fruit. Along with the fruit, there is a flinty, crisp edge that comes from the bright acidity. It needs at least two years to come together.
title: Domaine des Berthiers 2010 Saint-Andelain  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Gone far away are the days when a Chinon normally clocked in at 12.5% alcohol. Now, as with this Clos de l'Echo, there is more power. Here, the power is put to good use, giving both a bold wine and one that has a sophisticated balance of firm, dry tannins and elegant black plum fruits. Age this wine for at least four years.
title: Couly-Dutheil 2010 Clos de l'Echo  (Chinon)

description: A luscious sweet wine, very honeyed and liquorous. As a complete contrast, the wine has that intense acidity that is the hallmark of Loire sweet wines. The combination is a fragrant nectar that will benefit from aging.
title: Château Gaudrelle 2009 Réserve Personelle  (Vouvray)

description: With its silver embossed label and wax capsule this is a luxury cuvée from the Plaimont cooperative. The wine is firm, and still quite youthful after four years, integrating its tannins with the concentrated fruit. Wait for at least five more years for this impressive wine to show its best.
title: Producteurs Plaimont 2009 Plénitude Tannat (Madiran)

description: From the plateau that lies between the Loire and Vienne rivers, this is a firm, mineral structured wine. It has power and juicy red fruits that also show dark, dry tannins. It's a concentrated and dense wine for medium-term aging.
title: Jean-Maurice Raffault 2010 Les Picasses  (Chinon)

description: From the plateau that lies between the Loire and Vienne rivers, this is a firm, mineral structured wine. It has power and juicy red fruits that also show dark, dry tannins. It's a concentrated and dense wine for medium-term aging.
title: Jean-Maurice Raffault 2010 Les Picasses  (Chinon)

description: Bright pink in color, this is a soft, ripe and fruity wine. It has a light texture that supports the raspberry flavors. A delicate cut of acidity comes through at the end. Drink now.
title: Pelvillain Frères 2014 Zee Original Rosé (Côtes du Lot)

description: This is a soft, fruity wine with a lively creamy mousse. Red fruits are cut with acidity that is still young. The wine really needs more time in bottle before it is drunk to allow the super-fresh character and final bitterness to soften. Palmer is the brand name for a grouping of seven growers.
title: Palmer & Co NV Rosé Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: This classic blend from the Gascony region is crisply fresh and light, the sort of wine that just dances in the glass. It has a herbal character that is balanced by lemon and grapefruit fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Pigmentum Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This classic blend from the Gascony region is crisply fresh and light, the sort of wine that just dances in the glass. It has a herbal character that is balanced by lemon and grapefruit fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Pigmentum Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: From the Conti family, one of the best-known producers in Bergerac, this wine is a ripe blend of organic Merlot and Malbec. It is succulent with red berry fruits and acidity that are lightly spiced with some wood aging. The wine is fresh at the end yet still needs to age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2014 Red (Bergerac)

description: From the Conti family, one of the best-known producers in Bergerac, this wine is a ripe blend of organic Merlot and Malbec. It is succulent with red berry fruits and acidity that are lightly spiced with some wood aging. The wine is fresh at the end yet still needs to age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2014 Red (Bergerac)

description: A lively wine, layering wild strawberry and vanilla flavors with a light spritz and sweetshop candy. The acidity is crisp, apple skin fresh.
title: Château Cahuzac 2008 Rosé Red (Fronton)

description: The nose of this translucent red is very shy. The palate is exquisitely light with an aromatic touch of conifer on fresh tart red currants. The palate is very dry and light. Try chilling this as you would a rosé. While there is not a lot of body, there is lots of charm. Drink soon.
title: Ruhlmann 2015 Cuvée Mosaique Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A restrained nose has hints of fresh pear and lovely wet earth. The pear and earth roundness also continues on the palate where it is met with bright lemony freshness. This results in a balanced, appetizing body. The finish is dry and fresh with a slightly bitter tang.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2016 Cuvée Particulière Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A restrained nose has hints of fresh pear and lovely wet earth. The pear and earth roundness also continues on the palate where it is met with bright lemony freshness. This results in a balanced, appetizing body. The finish is dry and fresh with a slightly bitter tang.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2016 Cuvée Particulière Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Peach and honeysuckle send very subtle evocative aromas on the nose. On the palate, real spice becomes apparent: pepper as well as grapefruit. The full fruit approach on the medium-sweet palate fully benefits from that grapefruit edge: this is balanced, refreshing and moreish. Drink while aromas are at their peak.
title: Willm 2016 Réserve Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The nose is restrained but has zesty lemon hints. The palate also presents ample lemon and orange zest. This counters the fruity richness of the peach. A bitter phenolic streak prevents this from becoming too rich and balances the ample fruit on the off-dry finish.
title: Willm 2016 Cuvée Emile Willm Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Plump, sweet and plush peach flavors fill nose and palate. This is medium sweet and intense with a wonderful vein of freshness that brightens the stone fruit with zesty tang and gives glimpses of grapefruit peel. There is a wonderful spiciness reminiscent of tangelo peel on the clean finish.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2014 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Plump, sweet and plush peach flavors fill nose and palate. This is medium sweet and intense with a wonderful vein of freshness that brightens the stone fruit with zesty tang and gives glimpses of grapefruit peel. There is a wonderful spiciness reminiscent of tangelo peel on the clean finish.
title: Domaine Vincent Stoeffler 2014 Kirchberg de Barr Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Faint hints of aromatic tart cherry try to burst through the closed nose. The fruit is present on the fresh palate with astonishing purity. There is real concentration and a richer, almost plush texture at the core despite the svelte nature of this wine. A real triumph that expresses pure aromatic red cherry with real elegance. This has beauty, charm, length and authenticity.
title: Domaine Pfister 2013 Rahn Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A gentle lift of crushed black cherry rises from the glass. There also is an edge of medicinal herb. The body is light and juicy, fresh and highly aromatic. There is concentration without weight, luxuriant fruit without plumpness. This is fresh and pure, lifted and profound. An utterly honest and uplifting rendition of Pinot Noir.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2015 Fronholz Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A gentle lift of crushed black cherry rises from the glass. There also is an edge of medicinal herb. The body is light and juicy, fresh and highly aromatic. There is concentration without weight, luxuriant fruit without plumpness. This is fresh and pure, lifted and profound. An utterly honest and uplifting rendition of Pinot Noir.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2015 Fronholz Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A subtle note of caramel adds richness to the baked apple aromas on the nose. On the palate, hints of chamomile tisane add to the baked apple flavors. The body is taut and linear. Rounded hints of baked apple persist even on the dry, clean and fresh finish.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2014 Kaefferkopf Grand Cru Vieilles Vignes Riesling (Alsace)

description: With 40% new wood aging, this is a polished wine. Along with its smooth texture and juicy black fruits, it has a core of dry smoky tannins. The 53% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives a fine fruity, black-currant aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Vieux Robin 2014  Médoc

description: With 40% new wood aging, this is a polished wine. Along with its smooth texture and juicy black fruits, it has a core of dry smoky tannins. The 53% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives a fine fruity, black-currant aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Vieux Robin 2014  Médoc

description: With great green plum, gooseberry and pink grapefruit flavors, this is a delicious fruit salad of a wine. It has lively acidity, a bright texture and an attractive tangy feel. It's ready for drinking now.
title: Maison Sichel 2012 Les Hauts de Bel-Air  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Very fruity and fragrant, this is an attractive wine that shows potential. It has good acidity, firm tannins and fresh black-currant flavor. Drink this wine after two more years.
title: Château Saint-Sulpice 2011  Bordeaux

description: Ripe and full in the mouth, this is a forward, fruity wine. It has fragrant tobacco and spice notes followed by flavors of luscious blackberries. Softly tannic in structure, it will age, so drink now and until 2019.
title: Château l'Escart 2011 Cuvée Eden  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Tight and herbaceous, this is a very Sauvignon-oriented wine. It has the classic, intensely grassy feel, a tangy lemon texture and green acidity. It is very intense and concentrated.
title: Château Gréteau Médeville 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Big, fruity and juicy, this is a wine for drinking soon. It has lively acidity, a strong black-currant fruit character and light tannins. Already well integrated, it's a wine that accentuates freshness.
title: Château Cantinot 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Big, fruity and juicy, this is a wine for drinking soon. It has lively acidity, a strong black-currant fruit character and light tannins. Already well integrated, it's a wine that accentuates freshness.
title: Château Cantinot 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is properly fresh and fruity, with delicious herb and ripe apricot notes. Light, refreshing and crisp, this is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Pigmentum Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is properly fresh and fruity, with delicious herb and ripe apricot notes. Light, refreshing and crisp, this is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Pigmentum Ugni Blanc-Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This is a classic, bold, fruity Nouveau, with firm tannins that add weight to the palate. Pair this with food.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Dry, bright and aromatic, this has notes of fresh apple and crisp pear, plus a touch of herb. The méthode ancestrale involves finishing the first fermentation in the bottle rather than, as with méthode Champenois, having a second fermentation.
title: Domaine du Moulin NV Methode Ancestrale Brut Mauzac (Gaillac)

description: Light and fruity, this is full of refreshing red berry fruits, making this a clean, forward apéritif. It has fragrant acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2011 Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Light and fruity, this is full of refreshing red berry fruits, making this a clean, forward apéritif. It has fragrant acidity on the finish.
title: Domaine des Nugues 2011 Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Nervy and tangy, this is laced with flavors of ripe apricot, lemon and lime zest as well as notes of basil and green apple skin. With its exotic, juicy character and tense acidity, this is a wine for food.
title: Domaine Bru-Baché 2010  Jurançon Sec

description: Produced by the major négociant Castel, this juicy, fruity wine is proving to be drinkable already. Soft, with a black currant flavor, it has fine acids and spicy, toasty touches on the finish.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2010  Médoc

description: Produced by the major négociant Castel, this juicy, fruity wine is proving to be drinkable already. Soft, with a black currant flavor, it has fine acids and spicy, toasty touches on the finish.
title: Château Tour Prignac 2010  Médoc

description: Swathes of ripe fruit dominate this full wine that verges on being too alcoholic. While the acidity gives it freshness and the perfumed Cabernet Franc in the blend lends lift, the wine seems weighed down by its own richness.
title: Château Lanbersac 2010  Puisseguin Saint-Émilion

description: This wine has a smoky character and a subtle touch of wood, along with firm tannins and red fruits. Age this for 1–2 years.
title: Les Parcelles de Stéphane Derenoncourt 2011  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Exhibiting all the richness of the vintage, this is a round, ripe, spicy wine. It has a full, warm, creamy feel, with notes of almonds and ripe peaches. Only on the finish does the suggestion of white Bergerac's characteristic herbaceousness show.
title: Château Thénac 2009 Fleur du Périgord White (Bergerac Sec)

description: While this shows its youthful tannins, it also bears blackberry fruit and juicy acidity. The chateau has produced a stylish wine that's rich while still keeping plenty of freshness and acidity. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Maison Blanche 2010  Médoc

description: A full-bodied, extracted wine, this has a flavor of dark cherry and a hint of chocolate. It's a big, in-your-face style, with firm tannins and a solid, chunky structure.
title: Château Bouissel 2010 Le Syrah de Bouissel Syrah

description: This is a crisp, Syrah-based rosé, with some passion fruit on the nose, but then ripe berry flavors on the palate. It's plump and medium-bodied, yet finishes with a zing of refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Beaubois 2010 Expression Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is a crisp, Syrah-based rosé, with some passion fruit on the nose, but then ripe berry flavors on the palate. It's plump and medium-bodied, yet finishes with a zing of refreshing acidity. Drink now.
title: Château Beaubois 2010 Expression Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: A lovely example of mature Ventoux, revealing the sunny nature of the 2007 vintage in its velvety tannins and hints of chocolate and warmth. Raspberry and plum fruit carry a faintly peppery-herbal edge. Drink now–2016.
title: Mas du Fadan 2007 Les Fées Red (Côtes-du-Ventoux)

description: Big, yet creamy in texture and refined, with plenty of silky tannins to frame the superripe black cherry fruit. Just lacks a little complexity, but still a very good, juicy mouthful of fruit and oak. Drink now–2013.
title: Marrenon 2009 Grand Marrenon Red (Luberon)

description: The wine balances acidity and full fruitiness. These show in the lively, fresh character as well as the rich apple and pear flavors. The end shows more youthful texture, offering the chance to hold this wine until 2015.
title: Producta Vignobles 2013 Mission St Vincent  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This is a fragrant, floral wine, with a smooth touch of vanilla. It has a fruity, ripe feel, and it shows fresh, crisp, apple-like acidity. This is a ready-to-drink, balanced Chardonnay.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2010  Bourgogne

description: This is a fragrant, floral wine, with a smooth touch of vanilla. It has a fruity, ripe feel, and it shows fresh, crisp, apple-like acidity. This is a ready-to-drink, balanced Chardonnay.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2010  Bourgogne

description: A fresh, lemon-scented wine, this has fine minerality and youthful acidity that needs some months to become round.
title: Domaine Sangouard-Guyot 2011 Clos de la Bressande  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: With yellow fruit flavors and soft acidity, it's rich and fragrant. The wood aging shows at the end, along with some ripe pear flavors. Drink now.
title: Pierre André 2012  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: With yellow fruit flavors and soft acidity, it's rich and fragrant. The wood aging shows at the end, along with some ripe pear flavors. Drink now.
title: Pierre André 2012  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Bright and fruity, it has good acidity and a crisp exterior. Inside, lemon and pear fruit flavors are touched with pineapple. It will be ready soon, so drink 2014.
title: Domaine Sophie Cinier 2012 Les Amandiers  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Epineuil is a region between Burgundy and Chablis, producing light, fruity Pinot Noir. This perfumed and dusty wine does show some firm tannins. It is bright with red currant and raspberry fruits, with a fresh aftertaste.
title: Domaine Dominique Gruhier 2011 Côte de Grisey  (Bourgogne Epineuil)

description: Epineuil is a region between Burgundy and Chablis, producing light, fruity Pinot Noir. This perfumed and dusty wine does show some firm tannins. It is bright with red currant and raspberry fruits, with a fresh aftertaste.
title: Domaine Dominique Gruhier 2011 Côte de Grisey  (Bourgogne Epineuil)

description: Ripe and soft, this is a smooth, dense wine. Yes, it has plenty of tannins, but they're smothered by the concentrated black fruit that gives it its generous, rich character. It's likely to age well, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Moulin de Guiet 2015  Côtes de Bourg

description: This juicy, fruity wine has a great backup of tannins. It has a smoky character, along with black currant fruit, lending an attractive balance. That fruit that will develop well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château L'Escadre 2015 Grande Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Initially firmly tannic, this opens to reveal fine blackberry fruit and fresh acidity. It's a generous wine, the wood aging giving tannins and spice while the delicious fruit offers a rounder, smoother side. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Les Grands Maréchaux 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This is a ripe, smoky wine with fine tannins and rich black fruit. Dense with black chocolate and damson flavors, it gives concentration and richness and will age well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château La Rame 2015 La Charmille  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is a ripe, smoky wine with fine tannins and rich black fruit. Dense with black chocolate and damson flavors, it gives concentration and richness and will age well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château La Rame 2015 La Charmille  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Ripe and structured, this wood-aged wine is still developing. It has a dark structure, dense blackberry fruit and powerful concentration. A peppery touch of alcohol gives it a bitter finish, which should dissipate as it ages. Drink from 2022
title: Château des Landes 2015 Cuvée Prestige  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: The wine has bold tannins, generous fruit and an excellent future. With its concentration and density, it needs time to soften. For now, the black fruit flavors are developing well, balanced with acidity and ripe tannins. Drink from 2021.
title: Château de Birot 2015 Vintage  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This ripe, juicy wine is already attractive and perfumed. Its tannins and wood-aging flavors give weight to its fruit. Spicy and full of black cherry and berry flavors, it's bold and will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Cône-Taillasson Sabourin 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The second label of classed growth Château Chauvin, this wine is structured yet bears all the fruit that is characteristic of the vintage. Finely balanced, its acidity and black fruit flavors work together to create a wine that needs to age further. Best from 2020.
title: Château Chauvin 2014 Folie de Chauvin  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Rich and dense, this generous wine has considerable botrytis as well as perfumed apricot and bitter orange flavors. It's ripe and full of fruit and honey. Drink from 2020.
title: Clos Haut-Peyraguey 2014 Symphonie  (Sauternes)

description: Rich and dense, this generous wine has considerable botrytis as well as perfumed apricot and bitter orange flavors. It's ripe and full of fruit and honey. Drink from 2020.
title: Clos Haut-Peyraguey 2014 Symphonie  (Sauternes)

description: Maturity comes slowly to a Sauternes, but this wine is almost there. Its fine sweetness is balanced by a lemon curd-like acidity while its rich botrytis is finely integrated with the opulent texture. Drink now.
title: Château Simon 2010 Cuvée Exceptionelle  (Sauternes)

description: A mineral texture gives this ripe wine an edge while its full, red berry fruit offers some solid tannins and concentration. It's smoky and full-bodied and will be ready to drink from 2019.
title: Château Joanin Bécot 2015  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: The second wine from the Saint-Julien estate, this is every bit as elegant as the grand vin, its black currant fruit developing to envelop the fine tannins. There is fine fruit, plenty of acidity and a rich texture. It needs time, so drink from 2020.
title: Château Beychevelle 2015 L'Amiral de Beychevelle  (Saint-Julien)

description: A crisp, clean, fruity wine, tangy and lemony. This is a really attractive wine, a classic of its kind. Screwcap.
title: Château Bonnet 2008  Bordeaux Blanc

description: With its layers of wood, the wine has weight. Herbaceous characters are mixed with ripe pear flavors. There is a good, tight final texture.
title: Barton & Guestier 2010 Thomas Barton Réserve  (Graves)

description: Well balanced between fruitiness and spice, this is a young, crisp wine. Its apricot and pear flavors are lighted by fragrant acidity and considerable freshness for a Pinot Gris. It is ready to drink, but will be better in 1–2 years.
title: Dopff & Irion 2012 Cuvée René Dopff Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Very floral, fragrant wine, its acidity a foil for the ripe tropical and white fruits. There is a definite mineral texture here, with just a hint of sweetness that will make this wine great with Asian food. Screwcap.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2012 Côté Chardonnay-Sauvignon (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Very floral, fragrant wine, its acidity a foil for the ripe tropical and white fruits. There is a definite mineral texture here, with just a hint of sweetness that will make this wine great with Asian food. Screwcap.
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2012 Côté Chardonnay-Sauvignon (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Meaty aromas lead on the nose of this wine, with additional supporting notes of red cherry, black pepper and curing spice. It's easy on the palate, with medium yet fleeting tannins and balanced alcohol. The finish is fully loaded with spice, ending quite peppery.
title: Les Vignerons de Tautavel Vingrau 2010 Roc Gris Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages)

description: A forward and expressive wine, this blend of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 10% Mourvèdre leads with attractively jammy black-fruit flavors and hints of vanilla and licorice root. The lush yet approachable structure and medium-length finish make this an easy choice for enjoying now.
designation: Le Pas de la Mule Mas Janeil
title: François Lurton 2008 Le Pas de la Mule Mas Janeil Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages)

description: In the foothills of the Massif Central, the small appellation of Marcillac produces wines that have a feel both of the Mediterranean and the Atlantic. Stalky on the one hand and ripe and warm on the other, this is a wine to drink easily and soon.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2012  Marcillac

description: In the foothills of the Massif Central, the small appellation of Marcillac produces wines that have a feel both of the Mediterranean and the Atlantic. Stalky on the one hand and ripe and warm on the other, this is a wine to drink easily and soon.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2012  Marcillac

description: This is a soft and fruity wine, showing bright currant fruits in a perfumed context. Tangy, nervy, showing plenty of minerality to boost the acidity and fruitiness.
title: Leon Beyer 2011 Riesling (Alsace)

description: Medium-intense scents of dark berries and black plum unfold in the bouquet of this wine, with soft hints of vanilla, toast and garrigue in the background. The mouthfeel is robust and gripping, with skin-driven fruit flavors and solid tannins that stay through the finish.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes Catalanes
title: Le Cirque 2011 Rouge Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes Catalanes)

description: A light and fruity wine, gently tannic while showing firmness at the edges. Red berry fruits dominate to give good acidity and an attractive fresh aftertaste.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2011 Château Labrande Malbec (Cahors)

description: This creamy, light and soft wine offers attractive acidity and a touch of citrus. It is fruity and brings a bright aftertaste. The wine with its light buttery character is ready to drink.
title: Alex Gambal 2014  Bourgogne

description: With touches of the typical minerality of the appellation, this is a young, tight wine. Crisp apple, lemon and spice add interest to this perfumed wine. It will be better to drink from 2017.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2015  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Soft and buttery, this wine is smooth and creamy with hints of citrus and a tangy backdrop. With a lightly toasty edge, the wine finishes more tightly than it starts. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2013 Fourchaume Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: From the Aegerter domaine, this wine is full of spicy red fruits. It comes from a vineyard in the hills above Nuits Saint-Georges, and the cooler elevation shows in the acidity and fresh fruitiness. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2014 Les Dames Huguettes Vieilles Vignes  (Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: This is a generous wine, full of red-berry fruitiness and acidity with firm tannins. It is almost ready to drink. Wait until 2017.
title: Jaffelin 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: The wine has a toasty character showing that it has considerable bottle age. The fruit has moved into the realm of secondary flavors with almonds, fresh bread and spice flavors. It is a delicious wine for those who like more mature Champagnes.
designation: Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blancs Brut
title: Ruinart 2004 Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Lovely notes of Golden Pearmain apple perfume the nose, with hints of soy sauce. The body and palate are luminous showing green apple freshness that come across as light, graceful and authentic. There is something honest and fresh-faced about this wine that is rather disarming. This is a very beautiful, classy crémant made from a blend of Riesling and Auxerrois.
title: Zusslin 2012 Clos Liebenberg Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Produced from vines up to 80 years old, this is a powerful, wood-aged wine. Tannins are mixed with toast, spice and dark plum flavors. Acidity gives freshness and finishes the wine with very fine fruits as well as structure. Age this impressive wine and drink from 2018.
title: Richard Rottiers 2014  Moulin-à-Vent

description: Wonderfully balanced notes of green, yellow and red apples are subsumed beautifully into a taut, yeasty, autolytic strucutre. Dryness lets the fruit speak while the fizz dances woftly. This is immensely refreshing and has real grace—thanks to 95% Chardonnay and 5% Pinot Noir.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam NV Emotion Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: The great 2008 vintage has produced a textured wine that is still young. With its crisp citrus and green fruits, it is tight, mineral and tense. The wine is balanced with its texture and fresh fruits, but it needs to age. Drink from 2018.
title: Soutiran 2008 Grand Cru Millésimeé  (Champagne)

description: This is a beautiful wine, so crisp, taut and refreshing. It brings out the fragrance and freshness of the chalk vineyards of the Côte de Blancs, fruity with apples and citrus. Still young although already balanced, the wine will age for several years and will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Louis Roederer 2009 Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Disgorged in October 2014, this smooth, now mature, wine has flavors of yeasty toastiness and a tight, mineral structure. Sliced apple and lemon zest still give freshness. Behind the fruit, crisp texture and a steely edge await. It is beautifully balanced, rich while dry and ready to drink.
title: Boizel 2007 Grand Vintage Brut  (Champagne)

description: Already balanced, this is a rich, firm and elegant wine. Its fruitiness comes from plum skins and black cherries as well as the acidity. It also has a solid core of tannin.
title: Domaine Antonin Guyon 2011 Les Goudelettes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: Full-bodied wine, rich and rounded. It has its edge of tannins underlying the ripe cherry fruits. There is a jammy character that seems to diminish any acidity, making this a wine for drinking soon.
title: Manuel Olivier 2008  Vosne-Romanée

description: This crisp wine has bright fruits, lively acidity and a vibrant mineral character. It could develop for another 1–2 years.
title: Domaine du Chalet Pouilly 2008  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: There is a good mineral character here, a steely edge to the ripe apricot and yellow plum flavors. The wine has enough acidity to maintain its fresh side, and a fine lift on the finish.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2009 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Aged in acacia wood barrels, which give less wood flavor than oak, this is an attractive, lightly oxidized wine with a toasty edge, very dry with almond and honeyed fruit flavors.
title: Château de Fesles 2009 Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: A finely balanced wine, preserving the mineral edge and keeping fine acidity while displaying  ripe white and yellow fruits.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2008 Monte de Milieu Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: A delicious Volnay, all warm fruits and sweet tannins. The wine is soft as well as juicy, enjoying ripe cherry and red plum juice flavors. The tannins and acidity give a gentle boost. Drink now, or age for 3–4 years.
title: Maison Jessiaume 2008  Volnay

description: The nose is closed but the palate is fresh and lithe, arriving light, citrus-scented, and surrounded by a chorus of freshness that leaves mouth and soul utterly refreshed.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2015 Réserve Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: This wine is quite firm, but with plenty of black fruits under the severe exterior. Heavy losses from hail don't seem to have affected the ripeness and the structure of what will develop into a very fine wine. It offers spice and a touch of chocolate at the end.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2014 Santenots Premier Cru  (Volnay)

description: This attractive, delicate wine features gentle tannins and immediately accessible red-berry fruits. The structure is well integrated into the fruitiness of the wine. Acidity and a jammy strawberry aftertaste suggests this wine will be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013 La Perrière Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This attractive, delicate wine features gentle tannins and immediately accessible red-berry fruits. The structure is well integrated into the fruitiness of the wine. Acidity and a jammy strawberry aftertaste suggests this wine will be ready to drink soon. Drink from 2018.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2013 La Perrière Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: Fresh, light and fruity this is attractive young Chablis. It is soft, dwelling on the fruit rather than any texture. Crisp and with citrus and green apple flavors, it will be ready to drink easily by mid-2016.
title: Louis Max 2014  Chablis

description: Produced just outside the Chablis region, the wine has the same minerality and steely character. It also offers ripe yellow fruits and intense acidity. The combination of these elements suggests the wine needs to age another year, so wait until 2017.
title: Bailly-Lapierre 2014 Côtes d'Auxerre  (Bourgogne)

description: Crisp and textured, this is a ripe wine with a core of tight structure. Fruity with its lemon and apple flavors, it has a lightly herbal edge that adds a green, fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Trenel Fils 2014  Saint-Véran

description: Crisp and textured, this is a ripe wine with a core of tight structure. Fruity with its lemon and apple flavors, it has a lightly herbal edge that adds a green, fresh aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Trenel Fils 2014  Saint-Véran

description: There are only a handful of acres of this Vitis vinifera vine left and wines like this are consequently rare, so much so that the Gueguens claim to be the only producers of 100% Sacy. This light, crisp, fruity wine is low in alcohol and bright to taste. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Céline et Frédéric Gueguen 2014 Cépage Confidentiel  (Coteaux Bourguignons)

description: This blend of Sémillon and Sauvignon Gris is medium dry in character, with fruity acidity and a floral character from the Sauvignon Gris. A crisp, light fruitiness makes it an attractive apéritif wine.
title: Château Bélingard 2014 Bélingard Moelleux White (Bergerac)

description: Fatter than any Loire Sauvignon Blanc, this has some rich fruit, flavors of currants, an oily texture and intriguing candy flavors. There is a structure of green apple skins, but the wine is essentially light, fresh and instantly pleasing.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2006 Sauvignon de Saint-Bris  (Saint-Bris)

description: This wine has a juicy, fruity character that comes from the 60% of Cabernets in the blend. It is just touched by wood and, like a true Bordeaux second wine, it is showing plenty of perfumed fruitiness already. With fresh acidity and a bright character, the wine will be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Figeac 2013 Petit Figeac  (Saint-Émilion)

description: André Lurton bought de Rochemorin in 1973, an estate with vines since the 16th century. This is an aromatic wine, perfumed with blackberry tones. It has plenty of fresh fruit, soft tannins and ample acidity. The structure plays a supporting role—dry while also showing some richness. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Rochemorin 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Dating to the Middle Ages, this estate has produced a Merlot-dominated wine packed with dark tannins and a dusty texture that is becoming more elegant as it ages. The wine is still young and full of its concentrated structure. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Ambe Tour Pourret 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Still very young, this is an off-dry wine with bright acidity. The wine is not in balance with the sweetness clashing with the fruit. It could come together in a year, but that is somewhat doubtful.
title: Sauvion 2013  Vouvray

description: Still very young, this is an off-dry wine with bright acidity. The wine is not in balance with the sweetness clashing with the fruit. It could come together in a year, but that is somewhat doubtful.
title: Sauvion 2013  Vouvray

description: A blend of Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Viognier (to add some southern spice), this is a soft, fruity wine with rich white fruits and attractive acidity. It's a wine that can be drunk soon, although it should age several years.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2012 C.Sb.V. White (Vin de Pays du Lot)

description: Rich and fruity, this wine shows black currant fruit along with a firm, dry and tannic core. This youthful balance is finished with a polish of new wood and fine acidity.
title: Château Lacombe Noaillac 2011  Médoc

description: Big, rich and bold, this is a finely concentrated wine that's marked by the freshness of the year. It's likely to develop quickly and be ready next year.
title: Château Haut Bages Libéral 2011 Haut-Médoc de Haut Bages Libéral  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Big, rich and bold, this is a finely concentrated wine that's marked by the freshness of the year. It's likely to develop quickly and be ready next year.
title: Château Haut Bages Libéral 2011 Haut-Médoc de Haut Bages Libéral  (Haut-Médoc)

description: A strongly wood-aged wine, firm, spicy and with a burnt edge. Chocolate and black plum-skin fruit combine in this strongly tannic wine. There is, though, a smooth element from the ripe Merlot in the blend, giving potential richness in 2–3 years.
title: Château de Parenchère 2011 Cuvée Raphaël  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This bold, fruity wine is all red berries and ripe cherry flavors. It has good juiciness, soft tannins and it will be ready to drink soon. A bright wine, with great acidity at the end.
title: Château de Lisennes 2011 Cuvée Tradition  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A simple, big and fruity Malbec, softer than many although with all the right richness. This is a wine for drinking now, with its mature plum flavors and leather aroma. The French number for the department (county) of Cahors is 46.
title: Vignobles 46N118 2008 Noir 46 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a delicate, deliciously fragrant Riesling with just the freshest of fruits. Lemon and bright zest notes leave the palate totally refreshed.
title: Domaine Pfister 2011 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: The Réserve Personnelle line from Bott Frères decidedly greater intensity than the Tradition range. This Riesling exhibits great fruitiness allied with a very mineral structure and tight acidity. The wine has a future, so drink now and until 2019.
title: Bott Frères 2009 Réserve Personnelle Riesling (Alsace)

description: This is a perfumed wine with Syrah's delicious acidity as well as firm tannins. It is concentrated with ripe black fruits, but ready to drink now and until 2018.
title: Domaine d'Eole 2008 Léa Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Delicate tannins accent this complex and rich wine. It has fine acidity along with a juicy black-fruit element. It's a wine with weight and firm structure that should be enjoyed from 2017.
title: Domaine de Frégate 2010 Red (Bandol)

description: There is a good balance of tropical and citrus flavors on this warm, ripe wine. The fruit easily covers the more mineral core that gives structure. Rich and full-bodied, it can age through 2015.
title: Domaine Chatelain 2012 Les Vignes de Saint-Laurent l'Abbaye  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Generously ripe and creamy, it has layers of wood giving way to a beautiful, smooth texture. It's dense and complex, although a crisper citrus element gives a fresher side to this broad, rich wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Generously ripe and creamy, it has layers of wood giving way to a beautiful, smooth texture. It's dense and complex, although a crisper citrus element gives a fresher side to this broad, rich wine. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Creamy, soft, but pricked with high acidity, this dry sparkling wine from Montlouis is made from Chenin Blanc. In the mouth, there's an herbal element, vivid acidity and a crisp aftertaste.
title: Domaine les Loges de la Folie NV Brut  (Montlouis-sur-Loire)
winery: Domaine les Loges de la Folie

description: The Lurtons get their fruit for this wine from the Carcassonne region, the coolest part of the Languedoc. That explains the simple freshness of the red fruits, the acidity and the supple but dry tannins. Screwcap.
title: J. & F. Lurton 2006 Les Bateaux Merlot Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: The Lurtons get their fruit for this wine from the Carcassonne region, the coolest part of the Languedoc. That explains the simple freshness of the red fruits, the acidity and the supple but dry tannins. Screwcap.
title: J. & F. Lurton 2006 Les Bateaux Merlot Merlot (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Shy but very pure notes of ripe juicy pear and fresh ripe mirabelle plum appear on the nose. They continue seamlessly on the full-bodied palate where they find a fitting counterpoint in its phenolic texture, which has a pleasantly bitter edge. This is bone dry but unusually full-bodied for a Sylvaner, highlighting the ripeness of the 2015 vintage. The finish is long and underlines the quiet power of this wine.
title: Boeckel 2015 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: Shy but very pure notes of ripe juicy pear and fresh ripe mirabelle plum appear on the nose. They continue seamlessly on the full-bodied palate where they find a fitting counterpoint in its phenolic texture, which has a pleasantly bitter edge. This is bone dry but unusually full-bodied for a Sylvaner, highlighting the ripeness of the 2015 vintage. The finish is long and underlines the quiet power of this wine.
title: Boeckel 2015 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: Beautifully pure and creamy notes of golden apple dominate the nose. The palate has a similarly gentle apple note that harmonizes perfectly with the light, dry body and the fine bubbles. This elegant pink sparkler will give lots of pleasure before and during a meal.
title: Bestheim NV Anne de K Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is a crisp, 90% Pinot Noir-based wine with a light tannic edge from the red wine used to give color. It also has ripe red-berry fruits as well as acidity giving it dryness. It is fruity, steely and ready to drink.
designation: Lady de N. Cuvée Rosé Brut
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Lady de N. Cuvée Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: With five years' bottle aging, this Champagne is just beginning to show some attractive signs of maturity. The toasty aroma is followed through on the palate and this toastiness has softened the tight mineral texture of the wine. Drink this balanced wine now.
designation: Cuvée Royale Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: Joseph Perrier NV Cuvée Royale Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: There is an earthy, funky touch on the nose at first but freshly cut peach comes through quickly, edged by the tang of lemon balm. The palate is medium-sweet and the richness makes the peachy ripeness shine. This is full on, lavish but fresh with a long medium-sweet finish.
title: Pierre Sparr 2016 Mambourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: There is an earthy, funky touch on the nose at first but freshly cut peach comes through quickly, edged by the tang of lemon balm. The palate is medium-sweet and the richness makes the peachy ripeness shine. This is full on, lavish but fresh with a long medium-sweet finish.
title: Pierre Sparr 2016 Mambourg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This finely balanced wine is both crisp and packed with fruit. Its mineral texture is balanced by the sliced green apple and lively acidity. With its lightly toasty aroma, it is ready to drink.
title: Faniel et Fils NV Appogia Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This finely balanced wine is both crisp and packed with fruit. Its mineral texture is balanced by the sliced green apple and lively acidity. With its lightly toasty aroma, it is ready to drink.
title: Faniel et Fils NV Appogia Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Based in Epernay, this cooperative has produced a crisp balanced wine. A zesty, lightly mineral texture gives shape and precision to the citrus fruit and bright aftertaste. It is still young, so drink this vintage wine from 2019.
title: Esterlin 2009 Brut Nature  (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe mature wine. With acidity and pear and apple fruitiness, it is a rich blend that is dominated by Chardonnay. That gives an extra minerality to the tangy texture. This is a fine Champagne, ready to drink now.
title: Emile Leclère NV Cuvée du Bicentenaire Brut  (Champagne)

description: A lovely notion of ripe mirabelle and clean citrus makes for an appealing nose. The palate highlights the mirabelle with a honeyed rich sweetness that is juicy and appetizing. A touch of spice seems reminiscent of dark fir honey. The lemon brightens and invigorates this full-fruited richness. The finish is long and medium-sweet.
title: Domaine Mersiol 2016 Frankstein Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Beautifully pure notes of Golden Delicious apple fill the nose. The same expressive, ripe and appetizing fruitiness is also apparent on the palate which has a fine balance of ripe apple notes and crisp freshness, underpinned with a creamy bready mousse. Simply lovely and full of fruit.
title: Domaine G. Metz NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Beautifully pure notes of Golden Delicious apple fill the nose. The same expressive, ripe and appetizing fruitiness is also apparent on the palate which has a fine balance of ripe apple notes and crisp freshness, underpinned with a creamy bready mousse. Simply lovely and full of fruit.
title: Domaine G. Metz NV Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Producer Jean-Yves Bretaudeau enjoys showing how well Muscadet can age. In this cuvée, now five years old, all the signs of freshness are still there, just that they are given an edge of nuttiness as well as spice. The wine is impressive, crisp and also full of character. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2012 Mouzillon-Tillières  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Producer Jean-Yves Bretaudeau enjoys showing how well Muscadet can age. In this cuvée, now five years old, all the signs of freshness are still there, just that they are given an edge of nuttiness as well as spice. The wine is impressive, crisp and also full of character. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Colombier 2012 Mouzillon-Tillières  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a simple, soft wine which has some sweetness as well as easy fruit. There is some perfume and a spicy edge as well as rounded orange flavor. Drink now.
title: Dopff & Irion 2011 Gentil White (Alsace)

description: Light in color and with considerable acidity, this wine boasts cherry fruits along with a dry texture and spice. It is not for aging.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg 2010 Exception Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: Not quite dry, this is a creamy apple-flavored wine. It is fresh, fruity and immediately attractive, with a light, fragrant aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Willm 2012 Gentil White (Alsace)

description: Produced by the Cazes family of Château Lynch-Bages and Michel Lynch, this wine delivers quite a success from a difficult vintage. It is fresh and with plenty of acidity, balanced by the rounded red fruits and soft tannins. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Kirkland Signature 2013  Médoc

description: Produced by the Cazes family of Château Lynch-Bages and Michel Lynch, this wine delivers quite a success from a difficult vintage. It is fresh and with plenty of acidity, balanced by the rounded red fruits and soft tannins. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Kirkland Signature 2013  Médoc

description: Young and fruity, this is an attractive red- and black-currant-flavored wine. Its youthful stalky character will soften quickly to highlight the fruit. Drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Grand Billard  (Bordeaux)

description: Young and fruity, this is an attractive red- and black-currant-flavored wine. Its youthful stalky character will soften quickly to highlight the fruit. Drink from late 2016.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Grand Billard  (Bordeaux)

description: After a low period, Siran has come back in 2010 with this solid, tannic, firm and serious wine. There is plenty of blackberry flavor to flesh out the structure, resulting in a wine for medium-term aging.
title: Château Siran 2010  Margaux

description: The best wine from Phélan Ségur for several years, this shows less of the often-intrusive new wood and more of the fruit that had been missing in past vintages. It shows a subtle level of toast and a black currant flavor, plus great acidity and freshness on the finish.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2010  Saint-Estèphe

description: Listrac's naturally tannic character has benefited from the structure-driven 2010 vintage. Château Lestage shows this well, bearing powerful, complex tannins that are powered equally by the ripe blackberry flavor and fruity acidity. It has just the right build for medium-term aging.
title: Château Lestage 2010  Listrac-Médoc

description: This is ripe and dense, with great tannins; opulent, rich black fruit; and a fresh, juicy aftertaste. The structure and the solid texture both point to long-term aging.
title: Château d'Hanteillan 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Warm and fruity, this has the right amount of wood and sweetly ripe blackberry flavor. It is certainly structured, but the generous texture balances it, making it likely to age into a full, ripe character. Drink in 4–5 years.
title: Château Fonréaud 2010  Listrac-Médoc

description: A great success for this southern Médoc chateau, this is fine, elegant and perfumed. It bursts with a black fruit flavor, balanced by smooth tannins and acidity. It's a wine for medium-term aging over the next six years.
title: Château Cantemerle 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: A great success for this southern Médoc chateau, this is fine, elegant and perfumed. It bursts with a black fruit flavor, balanced by smooth tannins and acidity. It's a wine for medium-term aging over the next six years.
title: Château Cantemerle 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Château Brown continues its impressive push to quality with this fine 2010. It brings demonstrates the structure of the year with its firm, youthful tannins. But it also shows plentiful black-currant flavor, layered with acidity. Classic and serious, this is a wine for aging.
title: Château Brown 2010  Pessac-Léognan

description: Strong new-wood aromas lead to a palate that is layered with firm tannins, a polished toast character and a sufficient ripe blackberry flavor to balance. This 2010 bottling shows that this is a chateau to watch.
title: Château Bernadotte 2010  Haut-Médoc
