description: Soft, lightly creamy Chardonnay, pleasantly fruity, offering some apple and pear flavors along with gentle acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2009  Mâcon-Villages

description: Lightweight red from Gascony, with a touch of tannin, red berry fruits and crisp acidity. A red wine with an attractive bite.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Pellehaut 2008 Harmonie de Gascogne Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This wood-laden wine has light berry fruit and burnt toast flavors. The acidity cuts through, offering a glimpse of stalky black currant flavors.
title: Barton & Guestier 2008  Bordeaux

description: Firmly structured, this dark and dense wine packs a punch of tannins, giving a dry core. The judicious wood-aging supports the black-currant fruitiness that is developing well. It should be ready to drink from 2017.
title: Château Saint-Corbian 2012 Cuvée Tradition  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This wine is solid and dense with probably too much extracted tannins. There are only hints of fruitiness. It will soften although it's likely to remain stalky. This is the first vintage in which some of the vineyard was managed organically.
title: Château Marquis de Terme 2013  Margaux

description: Ripe and concentrated, this is a rich blackberry-flavored wine, with a dense texture lifted by acidity and a stalky edge. The wine, like many in this vintage, still has a firm side and could age. Drink from 2017.
title: Château le Calvaire 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a big and juicy wine full of blackberry and dark-plum flavors. The second wine of Larrivet Haut-Brion, it is fruity with dominant Merlot and round and perfumed Cabernet. It is developing rapidly into an accessible, ripe wine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2012 Les Hauts de Larrivet Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: This is a big and juicy wine full of blackberry and dark-plum flavors. The second wine of Larrivet Haut-Brion, it is fruity with dominant Merlot and round and perfumed Cabernet. It is developing rapidly into an accessible, ripe wine. Drink from late 2016.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2012 Les Hauts de Larrivet Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: Ripe berry fruits and gentle, dusty tannins give this wine a rich character. Acidity keeps it fresh, although a good structure lies behind that crisp surface. With its juicy fruit, it is ready to drink, but will be better from late 2016.
title: Château Lapinesse 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Graves)

description: This dense wine comes from a 50-acre estate, large by the region's norm. It's concentrated, showing signs of extraction although not enough to hide the black fruits and fruit tannins. Dominated by ripe Merlot, it will develop relatively fast. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lanbersac 2012  Puisseguin Saint-Émilion

description: Ripe, ready to drink and fruity, this is an attractive, balanced wine. Black-currant flavors are given structure by the tannins in this 94% Merlot and 6% Cabernet Franc blend from 15 acres. The fresh acidity of the vintage is still there, giving a lively juicy aftertaste. Drink now. An Alliance Bourg member.
title: Château Haut-Gelineau 2012  Côtes de Bourg

description: Ripe, ready to drink and fruity, this is an attractive, balanced wine. Black-currant flavors are given structure by the tannins in this 94% Merlot and 6% Cabernet Franc blend from 15 acres. The fresh acidity of the vintage is still there, giving a lively juicy aftertaste. Drink now. An Alliance Bourg member.
title: Château Haut-Gelineau 2012  Côtes de Bourg

description: This wine is toasty and spicy with black-currant fruits that are still developing. It is fresh although its firm structure needs time to soften. As it matures, it will develop a balance between fruit and tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut Breton Larigaudière 2013  Margaux

description: This wine is toasty and spicy with black-currant fruits that are still developing. It is fresh although its firm structure needs time to soften. As it matures, it will develop a balance between fruit and tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut Breton Larigaudière 2013  Margaux

description: Along with ripe fruit and structure, this wine has a core of tannins that form the base for fresh fruitiness. The acidity becomes intense as it opens, with the tannins remaining at the core. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Fourcas-Borie 2013  Listrac-Médoc

description: After four years, this wine is showing ripe, smooth Merlot fruitiness with red berries and attractive acidity. It is light in texture although well balanced with acidity, a tannin underlay and silky aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de la Cour 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This attractive, already smooth wine offers good acidity and dark tannins. Juicy black-currant flavors give the wine richness and the potential to age quickly and gracefully. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Cruzeau 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine has attractive black-currant fruits and fresh, light acidity. It's an early-developing wine with soft tannins and a stalky backdrop. Drink from 2018.
title: Chateau d'Angludet 2013  Margaux

description: A ripe, toasty wine, very buttery. It has rich, almost sweet yellow fruit balanced with a wonderful mineral texture. The wine, of course, is still very young, but shows its future as being rounded and opulent. The acidity that holds it all together shows in the finish.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2008  Chevalier-Montrachet

description: This beautiful wine is austere at this very young stage. But what pent-up power—the richness comes from glorious ripe fruit, tempered with a core of steel and wrapped with pure lemon, apricot and toast flavors. Age for 10 years at least.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2008  Bâtard-Montrachet

description: Made from fruit selected across this southern Burgundy appellation, this wine has a touch of minerality and more attractive white fruit. It's rich, soft, full-bodied and fruity. Drink now.
title: Florent Descombe 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Ripe with a warm character, this wine has both bright red berry fruit and a rich, generous structure. Its fruitiness shows that it's still young—its acidity very much upfront. It will fill out and develop richness with time in bottle. Drink from 2020.
title: Labouré-Roi 2015  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: Ripe with a warm character, this wine has both bright red berry fruit and a rich, generous structure. Its fruitiness shows that it's still young—its acidity very much upfront. It will fill out and develop richness with time in bottle. Drink from 2020.
title: Labouré-Roi 2015  Savigny-lès-Beaune

description: This is a classic mineral-driven wine with its intense acidity and bright lemon fruit. Textured and crisp with acidity, it's packed with great fruitiness. From a fine vintage for whites, it has a cool, stylish aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Vignerons des Terres Secrètes 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: From the Seysses family of Domaine Dujac in Burgundy, this wine hails from east of Aix-en-Provence. It's crisp and fruity with red currant brightness. Acidity and tangy citrus give it a fresh feel. Drink now.
title: Triennes 2016 Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: From the Seysses family of Domaine Dujac in Burgundy, this wine hails from east of Aix-en-Provence. It's crisp and fruity with red currant brightness. Acidity and tangy citrus give it a fresh feel. Drink now.
title: Triennes 2016 Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: The Baylet family has produced a rich wine in this vintage. With chocolate and spice flavors accenting its black plum fruit, it's ripe and smooth. The tannins are well integrated into the generous fruit. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Landereau 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Red fruit aromas show strongly in this wine. With its juicy acidity and soft tannins, it has fine fruitiness and will age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut-Rian 2015 Prestige  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This is attractive, smooth and well balanced between spice and ripe berry fruit. With its acidity and toasty concentration, it's going to be delicious from 2020.
title: Château Godard Bellevue 2015  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Almost as a challenge, owners Pascal et Jean-Marc Verhaeghe set out to prove that Malbec could produce a fine Port-style fortified wine. It works: its ripe sweetness and the balance between brandy and wine are just right. Jammy black cherry flavors and soft tannins give it a rich, velvety character. Drink now.
title: Château du Cèdre 2014 Le Cèdre Vintage Malbec (Vin de Liqueur)

description: This wood-aged wine is smooth, with berry fruit flavors, solid tannins and a touch of mint. It should age well for the next few years, so drink from 2019.
title: Château de Lagarde 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This perfumed wine has firm tannins, a dry core and plenty of acidity. Its black currant fruit shows fine potential to give richness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Cranne 2015 Dompter la Bête  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This perfumed wine has firm tannins, a dry core and plenty of acidity. Its black currant fruit shows fine potential to give richness. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Cranne 2015 Dompter la Bête  (Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This dusty wine has weight and concentration. Fruit lies behind its firm facade, giving the potential for juiciness. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Cranne 2015 7ème Génération  (Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: This smoky wine is full of wood and spice notes. Ripe fruit is also there, with some solid tannins to back it up. It will develop well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Bourdieu 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This smoky wine is full of wood and spice notes. Ripe fruit is also there, with some solid tannins to back it up. It will develop well. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Bourdieu 2015  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Very light and fresh, this offers crisp red berry flavors. It's not quite dry, favoring fruitiness and acidity with a touch of sweetness to soften the crisp aftertaste.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg NV Anne de K Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Very light and fresh, this offers crisp red berry flavors. It's not quite dry, favoring fruitiness and acidity with a touch of sweetness to soften the crisp aftertaste.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg NV Anne de K Brut Rosé Pinot Noir (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This light-colored, soft and supple wine has a palate filled with red fruits. It's immediately drinkable, already showing signs of maturity.
title: Manuel Olivier 2011  Bourgogne

description: A simple, fruity wine, this offers attractive citrus flavors and a ripe texture. Yellow fruits add richness while the acidity shoots through at the end.
title: Domaine Chatelain 2013  Petit Chablis

description: Soft and full of red fruits, this is a simple, forward and immediately drinkable wine, with gentle tannins and light acidity. There are no complications here, just fruitiness.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2012 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: Soft and full of red fruits, this is a simple, forward and immediately drinkable wine, with gentle tannins and light acidity. There are no complications here, just fruitiness.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2012 Réserve  (Bourgogne)

description: This light, gently fruity wine has a soft, candied pear and apple flavor that is open, immediately accessible. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: Hints of menthol and cherry cough drop are upfront on the nose. Flavors of red currant, rhubarb and sour raspberry appear on the crisp, tart palate, finishing clean yet short.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: There's an initial astringency to the bouquet of this wine, presented in scents of red-cherry skin, apple and raspberry leaf. The palate offers more of the same, with bitter tannins and fruit-skin flavors that lead into a finish reminiscent of oversteeped black tea.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2014 Marquis de Brim Grande Réserve Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: Lightly spicy, this soft wine has a zesty tang of orange and bright strawberries that are ripe and gently fruity. The wine is open, ready to drink.
title: Château de Saint Martin 2015 No 2 de Saint-Martin Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Carignan is smooth and easy to drink, with friendly aromas and flavors of red cherry and raspberry that are kissed by a hint of mentholated character. The tannins and low and the finish is short; drink up.
title: Belle Made For You NV Red (Vin de France)

description: This blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Carignan is smooth and easy to drink, with friendly aromas and flavors of red cherry and raspberry that are kissed by a hint of mentholated character. The tannins and low and the finish is short; drink up.
title: Belle Made For You NV Red (Vin de France)

description: This rosé is an extremely pale-pink color, with similarly light aromas of red cherry and currant on the nose. The palate is surprisingly round and somewhat flabby, with ripe red-fruit flavors and a touch of white chocolate on the finish.
title: Café du Midi 2015 Grenache Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This rosé is an extremely pale-pink color, with similarly light aromas of red cherry and currant on the nose. The palate is surprisingly round and somewhat flabby, with ripe red-fruit flavors and a touch of white chocolate on the finish.
title: Café du Midi 2015 Grenache Rosé (Vin de France)

description: This offers assertive aromas and flavors of banana, strawberry bubblegum, watermelon and blueberry. The palate is lightweight and fruity, with a sharp acidic edge and a short, fleeting finish.
title: Romantic 2015 Authentic & Chic Merlot (Vin de France)

description: This offers assertive aromas and flavors of banana, strawberry bubblegum, watermelon and blueberry. The palate is lightweight and fruity, with a sharp acidic edge and a short, fleeting finish.
title: Romantic 2015 Authentic & Chic Merlot (Vin de France)

description: Mouthwatering acidity combines with a sweet aftertaste to give a wine that could be unbalanced but, surprisingly, has an attractive soft texture and easygoing fruitiness. Drink immediately.
title: Le Pépin 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: An easy-drinking and non-offensive white, this offers light yet direct notes of citrus peel, melon rind and apple, with a bitter edge to the palate and a short but refreshing finish.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2014 White (Vin de France)

description: An easy-drinking and non-offensive white, this offers light yet direct notes of citrus peel, melon rind and apple, with a bitter edge to the palate and a short but refreshing finish.
title: La Vieille Ferme 2014 White (Vin de France)

description: This is a jammy and fruit-forward selection, with direct aromas and flavors of red cherry, berry and plum that are lifted by a hint of menthol. The smooth, easygoing palate offers light tannins and fleshy fruit flavors, followed by a clean but fleeting finish.
title: Belle Made For You NV Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: There's a wild character to the nose of this lean, tart Pinot. It offers aromas and flavors of game, sour cherry, tart raspberry and red currant, framed by soft tannins and a fleeting finish.
title: Maison de la Villette 2015 Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This wine is a soft, lean selection, with closed aromas and tight flavors of black currant and cherry that struggle to appear fully. The palate is clean but fleeting, with little texture and a short finish.
title: Voiturette 2015 Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de France)

description: This wine has an herbal aroma that leads on to the palate. It goes with the almost jammy raspberry flavor, making for a wine that is fruity while not yet balanced.
title: Château Saint Baillon 2015 Réserve du Château Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is soft, unfocused and gently fruity. Hints of herbal and citrus flavors give a green-fruit character to the wine, which has a tight, nervy aftertaste.
title: Café du Midi 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This is soft, unfocused and gently fruity. Hints of herbal and citrus flavors give a green-fruit character to the wine, which has a tight, nervy aftertaste.
title: Café du Midi 2015 Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de France)

description: This wine is textured, tight and seems to be missing out on fruit. It has pepper, spice and just a few hints of green plums. There is a bitter aftertaste.
title: L'original French Kiss 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This wine is textured, tight and seems to be missing out on fruit. It has pepper, spice and just a few hints of green plums. There is a bitter aftertaste.
title: L'original French Kiss 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: A soft, lightly fruity wine, this is light in texture and flavor, with the merest hints of citrus fruits, apples and tangy orange. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: A soft, lightly fruity wine, this is light in texture and flavor, with the merest hints of citrus fruits, apples and tangy orange. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: Ott specializes in rosés with weight and alcohol. Everything is so well integrated that they are only a part of a rich, fruity wine that has a dense texture, with spice and generous strawberry fruits. Full and definitely for food, the wine should be aged another few months, so drink from mid-2016.
title: Domaines Ott 2014 Clos Mireille Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Ott specializes in rosés with weight and alcohol. Everything is so well integrated that they are only a part of a rich, fruity wine that has a dense texture, with spice and generous strawberry fruits. Full and definitely for food, the wine should be aged another few months, so drink from mid-2016.
title: Domaines Ott 2014 Clos Mireille Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Flinty overtones of yeast reveal how very young this wine is. The verve that springs from the glass is undeniable. While the focus is on grapefruit and lemon zest in a tightly pulled focus, there are glimpses of honeycomb, popcorn, treacle, pollen and hints of tropicality, with a touch of pineapple. Hold this wine for a while longer and it will unfold itself graciously. Drink 2016–2020.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Terroir d'Alsace Riesling (Alsace)

description: Flinty reduction still dominates the nose but this is only a sign of youth in this nuanced wine. It discloses tentative pear blossom and fruit, plus notions of wet earth and candied lime. Above all, a zesty spine of acidity and freshness directs all the attention to a profound, stony core. There is life force here and you know this will continue to evolve.
title: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht 2013 Calcaire Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: There is a distinct phenolic edge on this earthy, lemon-dominated and taut Riesling. Fruit—apart from citrus—is subsumed into an earthy, tense and concentrated palate. This needs more time to relax into itself and should blossom with more bottle age. Drink 2017–2020.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2013 Leimental Riesling (Alsace)

description: Three barrels were made of this structured, tannic wine that offers a juicy balance between acidity and dark tannins. It is perfumed with acidity that cuts through the red berry and dry concentration. It is a dense wine, full of fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Louis Latour 2012 Les Beaux Monts Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: The 20% of Cabernet Sauvignon in this wine gives structure, although a perfumed character dominates. This refreshing wine has pine and rosemary flavors as well as red fruits. It is ripe and concentrated, with intense acidity at the end.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Château Saint Hippolyte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: The 20% of Cabernet Sauvignon in this wine gives structure, although a perfumed character dominates. This refreshing wine has pine and rosemary flavors as well as red fruits. It is ripe and concentrated, with intense acidity at the end.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2015 Château Saint Hippolyte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Set close to the sea (you can throw a stone into the water), this vineyard produces a fresh, almost salty wine, with a tight tang of citrus. It is perfumed, hinting at raspberries and pears. The aftertaste delivers a delicious, straight line of acidity.
title: Domaines Ott 2015 Clos Mireille Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organic grapes, this is a ripe, full and deliciously fruity wine. It has a good balance between wild strawberry fruits and tight, textured acidity that gives the wine shape. The aftertaste is bright and crisp.
title: Domaine de la Vallongue 2015 Cuvée Garrigues Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: With 60% Mourvèdre, this blend is rich and spicy. It has great acidity, still fresh and accented by red and citrus fruits. Minerality and an herbal element come from the garrigue that surrounds the vines. The wine has certainly benefited from a year's aging.
title: Domaine de la Bégude 2014 Rosé (Bandol)

description: With 60% Mourvèdre, this blend is rich and spicy. It has great acidity, still fresh and accented by red and citrus fruits. Minerality and an herbal element come from the garrigue that surrounds the vines. The wine has certainly benefited from a year's aging.
title: Domaine de la Bégude 2014 Rosé (Bandol)

description: Almost white in color, this wine takes the Provence fashion for light rosé to extremes. To taste, yes, it is a rosé with a light tannic edge and red-currant flavors. The aftertaste with lime and lemon freshness is bright, emphasizing the clean fruitiness of the wine.
title: Château de Brigue 2015 Brique Prestige Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This structured wine is the second wine of Château Montrose. It is balanced, the smooth, fresh fruits and plum-skin texture making it already accessible. With its juicy aftertaste, it will be ready to drink soon.
title: Château Montrose 2011 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: This structured wine is the second wine of Château Montrose. It is balanced, the smooth, fresh fruits and plum-skin texture making it already accessible. With its juicy aftertaste, it will be ready to drink soon.
title: Château Montrose 2011 La Dame de Montrose  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: Almost black in color, this is a solid, firm and ripe wine. It has a smooth wood character that is round and rich with black plum and berry fruit flavors. With its dark underlying texture, it will age, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Larose Perganson 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Firm and closed this is a dark and tannic wine, although black currant flavors are also very present. It feels austere with a mineral texture and concentrated final acidity. Drink Lafite's second wine from 2017.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2011 Carruades de Lafite  (Pauillac)

description: Spicy new wood flavors dominate this otherwise strongly fruity wine. The tension between the two promises a rich, full and ripe wine for the future. There is enough weight, acidity, blackberry fruit and richness to balance out the wood aging. Give this dense wine until 2018.
title: Château Fonréaud 2011  Listrac-Médoc

description: The estate is under the same ownership as Château la Dominique in Saint-Émilion. This dense wine balances acidity with intense fruitiness. The tannins are now softening, giving a rich structure plus a concentrated leather and spice character. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Clément-Pichon 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: The estate is under the same ownership as Château la Dominique in Saint-Émilion. This dense wine balances acidity with intense fruitiness. The tannins are now softening, giving a rich structure plus a concentrated leather and spice character. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Clément-Pichon 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: An impressive wine, it already shows signs of its potential. It is elegant, with ripe fruits and layers of dark tannins. As it opens, blackberry fruits come through strongly, balancing the firm structure. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Beaumont 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: Coming from the same stable as Léoville las Cases in Saint-Julien, the wine is finely structured with firm tannins and dark fruit. Rich plum flavors are counterbalanced by solid tannins. It needs to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Potensac 2011  Médoc

description: A soft wine that is full of strawberry fruits to go with a sweet citrus edge. The wine has good acidity, in a light apéritif style with pure final raspberry juice.
title: Mailly Grand Cru NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: Almonds and toasted bread combine with lemon and honey flavors in this well-balanced off-dry wine. The acidity reminds you this is Champagne, while keeping fruit and softness right up front.
title: Louis Barthélémy NV Opale Demi-Sec  (Champagne)

description: A surprising 30% of this wine is Clairette, a white grape variety. Perhaps that accounts for the wine's apparent freshness. Hints of crushed stone mark the nose, while the ripe flavors suggest peaches and berries, tailing away slowly on the finish. Drink this mouthfilling rosé over the rest of 2017.
title: Chateau de Manissy 2015 Cuvée de Lys  (Tavel)

description: From an small estate that also has vines in Chénas and Saint-Amour, this is a firmly tannic wine that also has attractive juicy red-berry fruits. The wine, still young, will repay aging allowing it to broaden out with rich fruit and a soft texture. Drink this cru from late 2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine de Roche Noire  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Richly structured this wine, from well-exposed vines (hence the land of light in the name) is fruity with black cherry and some firm tannins. It is going to develop into a serious, complex wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Chatelard 2015 Cuvée Terre de Lumière  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Meursault can manage big and bold, and this wine definitely lives up to that reputation. The spice and wood are perhaps too much at this stage. I would certainly like to see more of the ripe white fruits that are there in the background. A wine to return to in a year.
title: Roux Père et Fils 2006 Clos des Poruzots Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A wide-open, friendly wine, all delicious rich white fruits and tropical flavors. While it may not be ageworthy, it is a pleasure now, an opulent mouthful of Chardonnay.
title: Louis Latour 2006 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: A wide-open, friendly wine, all delicious rich white fruits and tropical flavors. While it may not be ageworthy, it is a pleasure now, an opulent mouthful of Chardonnay.
title: Louis Latour 2006 Les Folatières Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: With its tight minerality and vivid green fruits, this is a fine representative of the freshness and richness of 2006. While Bouchard Père is generous with the wood, it does not dominate because the fruit flavor texture and finishing freshness are so important.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2006  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: New wood overwhelms the aromas, and it also dominates the palate of this wine. It just keeps on the right side of drinkability because the spice merges into pear flavors to give an intriguing nutmeg character, while the aftertaste offers freshness. The wine needs at least a year to blend together.
title: Château de Fuissé 2006 Les Brulés  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Still very young with its tannins dominant, this will nevertheless be a richly fruity wine as it develops. The black fruits are all there, along with licorice and bitter chocolate. Final acidity brings a lift to the dense texture.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2009 Château de Flore Malbec (Cahors)

description: As pure an expression of a Malbec dominated blend as possible, this is ripe, juicy, packed with fine acidity and underpinned by solid, dry tannins. It balances the firm, dry character with delicious, forward, juicy fruit.
title: Jean-Luc Baldès 2008 Clos Triguedina Red (Cahors)

description: Big, spicy wine with its dark tannins and black fruit. Dark chocolate flavors go with the fruit, a rich and complex array of flavors that bring in herbs and spices as well as wood. Age for another 1–2 years.
title: Henri Milan 2006 Les Clos Red (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Almost black, this is a concentrated, black plum skin- and blackberry-driven wine, laced throughout with dense tannins. It has weight and concentration as well as the ripest juicy fruit. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Ponzac 2008 Patiement Malbec (Cahors)

description: Almost black, this is a concentrated, black plum skin- and blackberry-driven wine, laced throughout with dense tannins. It has weight and concentration as well as the ripest juicy fruit. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Ponzac 2008 Patiement Malbec (Cahors)

description: Honey flavored wine, packed with botrytis and also with intense acidity. That makes the wine light, dancing, while also showing richness. It is all so light, delicate, so delicious.
title: Château Jolys 2009 Cuvée Jean  (Jurançon)

description: Big-hearted wine, full of warm and rich fruit. It has a solid core of dusty tannins, black plum fruit flavors and a delicious, chewy, juicy texture. It does have power as well as intense fruitiness. Age for 3–4 years.
title: Château Eugénie 2008 Cuvée Pierre le Grand Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: The wine is all about firm structure and dense tannins. It is concentrated while hiding rich, generous fruits. It still needs to balance the structure with the fruit. For the future, it will be a rich wine full of power.
title: Clos du Marquis 2011  Saint-Julien

description: The wine is all about firm structure and dense tannins. It is concentrated while hiding rich, generous fruits. It still needs to balance the structure with the fruit. For the future, it will be a rich wine full of power.
title: Clos du Marquis 2011  Saint-Julien

description: While the wood is still very apparent in this wine, it does also have the rich fruit as a balance. The acidity, dark berry fruits and a fine juicy character go with the firm tannins and spicy wood character. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Lilian Ladouys 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is super-rich, but wears its high alcohol lightly. That gives great full fruit, blackberry flavors, a juicy ripe wine that balances the wood and acidity to give fine potential for a year's time.
title: Grands Terroirs de France 2010 Grand Cru  (Saint-Émilion)

description: Full and rounded, this is a soft wine, more suited to food than as an aperitif. The apple and red currant fruits are textured and spiced with lemon zest and mandarin orange flavors, finishing with some richness.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2012 Vie Vité Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Bright and crisp with just a touch of vanilla along with the more citrus character. The wine has red berry fruits, a light structure, fragrant, ready to drink.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2012 Breezette Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Solid and tannic with a stalky character both from young fruit and acidity. There is structure, black currant fruits and dense, dry tannins. The wine needs to age for at least 3–4 years.
title: Château Léoube 2011 Rouge de Léoube Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: A rounded wine, herbs, spice and yellow fruits bringing out a full and ripe feel. There is an attractive level of acidity that gives the wine a lively feel while not losing sight of a warm, Mediterranean feel.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2012 White (Côtes de Provence)

description: A rounded wine, herbs, spice and yellow fruits bringing out a full and ripe feel. There is an attractive level of acidity that gives the wine a lively feel while not losing sight of a warm, Mediterranean feel.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2012 White (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a soft, creamed apple wine, with touches of toast. It has a great lemon zest character that brings freshness as well as brilliant acidity. The finish is textured, very fresh.
designation: Cuvée des Moines Brut Blanc de Blancs
title: Besserat de Bellefon NV Cuvée des Moines Brut Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: An herbal, perfumed wine, showing concentrated tannins and firm black fruit flavors. The wine has a dense structure, filled with acidity as well as final richness. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2009 Le Pont Red (Bandol)

description: Peach and lemon combine in this superripe Chablis. Reflecting the warm vintage, the wine is soft, laced with lime juice acidity and hinting at vanilla and thyme. Round and warm, it is not typical Chablis, much more akin to a Meursault.
title: Labouré-Roi 2009 Premier Cru Réserve  (Chablis)

description: This wine is round and smooth, with attractive white-fruit flavors. The light acidity is more than compensated by the touch of toastiness and spice. With a juicy aftertaste, the wine is already very enjoyable.
title: Trenel Fils 2014  Mâcon-Villages

description: This wine is fruity and ripe with fresh red-berry fruits and layers of smoky tannins. Those tannins will open up to give a rich, juicy and spicy wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Edmond Cornu 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: This wine is buttery and has a creamy texture along with a fresh streak. Apple flavors are lifted with citrus while also filled out with that rounder character, making for an immediately attractive, ripe wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine Carrette 2014 Les Mûres  (Saint-Véran)

description: Made from a grape that probably hails from the Somontano region of Spain (where it is known as Parraleta) this is a tight, stalky wine that has acidity and black currant fruit in abundance. Its tannins are more restrained than the fruit, allowing a light structure to hold up the juicy acidity and crisp aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Clos Venturi 2015 1769 Carcajolu (Vin de France)

description: This wine, a blend from many Mâcon vineyards, is crisp and full of acidity, making it bright and tangy. Its freshness is up front with apple and citrus fruits. The mineral texture gives an attractive tautness, and the wine is drinkable now.
title: Bret Brothers 2014 Terroir du Mâconnais  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: This is a style of Pinot Noir that needs to be drunk chilled. It brings out the smoky, stalky character of the wine that dominates the bitter cherry fruits. It's still young and needs another year to come together.
title: Chavet Fils 2012 Tradition  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This is a style of Pinot Noir that needs to be drunk chilled. It brings out the smoky, stalky character of the wine that dominates the bitter cherry fruits. It's still young and needs another year to come together.
title: Chavet Fils 2012 Tradition  (Menetou-Salon)

description: Totally herbaceous, this is a lemon and mown-grass scented wine. Crisp, light and with gooseberry flavors, it shows a direct, bright, tight aftertaste. Ready to drink. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays du Val de Loire
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays du Val de Loire)

description: Totally herbaceous, this is a lemon and mown-grass scented wine. Crisp, light and with gooseberry flavors, it shows a direct, bright, tight aftertaste. Ready to drink. Screwcap.
region: Vin de Pays du Val de Loire
title: Henri Bourgeois 2012 Petit Bourgeois Sauvignon Blanc (Vin de Pays du Val de Loire)

description: This structured wine brings together rich red fruits with an almost tannic character that gives it concentration and dryness. The wine has acidity, light touches of lemon and lime and a red currant aftertaste.
title: Commanderie de Peyrassol 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A caramel- and lemon-flavored wine that's both fresh and soft. It has an attractive perfumed character and a warm and round texture. This is made from old vines, which lends it extra concentration.
title: Château Réal Martin 2011 Perle de Rosé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A caramel- and lemon-flavored wine that's both fresh and soft. It has an attractive perfumed character and a warm and round texture. This is made from old vines, which lends it extra concentration.
title: Château Réal Martin 2011 Perle de Rosé Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This has superrich fruit, spice and a touch of pepper, revealing a wine that is powerful for a Provence rosé. This is impressive and finely made.
title: Chateau La Calisse 2011 Patricia Ortelli Rosé (Coteaux Varois)

description: This is very fresh, with light acidity and a touch of caramel. Its round character is contrasted with tangerine crispness.
title: Château Gassier 2011 Sables d'Azur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is very fresh, with light acidity and a touch of caramel. Its round character is contrasted with tangerine crispness.
title: Château Gassier 2011 Sables d'Azur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a rich red-berry-fruited wine. It is balanced and full, with nutmeg and pepper as well as crisp fruit flavors. With its ripeness, it's certainly suitable for food.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2011 Domaine de la Rabiotte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a rich red-berry-fruited wine. It is balanced and full, with nutmeg and pepper as well as crisp fruit flavors. With its ripeness, it's certainly suitable for food.
title: Ravoire et Fils 2011 Domaine de la Rabiotte Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This is a fat, rich wine, with fruits that are sweet and ripe. With its weight and caramel flavor, it's a full-bodied effort suitable for food.
title: Ormilles 2011 Ormilles Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: An attractively balanced wine, this is ripe but fresh. The raspberry and orange fruits are vivid and well etched into the structure of the wine.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2011 Cave de Saint-Roch les Vignes Rosé (Côtes de Provence)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: Like many of the Perrin & Fils wines, this one is firmly structured, its cherry and cocoa flavors ending on a dusty, tannic note. But the fruit is attractive, and even boasts some complexity in the wisps of garrigue on the nose. Probably best from 2013–2017.
title: Perrin & Fils 2009 Red (Côtes du Rhône Villages)

description: With up-front spiciness, this is an attractive, light and fragrant wine. There is no complexity, just pleasant off-flavors of honey and lychees. Drink now.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2010 Cuvée Saint-Jacques Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: With up-front spiciness, this is an attractive, light and fragrant wine. There is no complexity, just pleasant off-flavors of honey and lychees. Drink now.
title: Frédéric Mallo 2010 Cuvée Saint-Jacques Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Very perfumed, this wine is exotic and rich with fruit, but also remarkably dry. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Sorin 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: Very perfumed, this wine is exotic and rich with fruit, but also remarkably dry. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine Sorin 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a light, fruity wine that's ripe with perfumed quince and tropical fruit flavors. The palate is satisfyingly balanced with tight, bright acidity. This is wine that is not for aging, and ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Pfister 2011 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a light, fruity wine that's ripe with perfumed quince and tropical fruit flavors. The palate is satisfyingly balanced with tight, bright acidity. This is wine that is not for aging, and ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Pfister 2011 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Aged in wood, this is an unusual style of Pinot Blanc for Alsace. The toast flavors are subtle, leaving plenty of room for fresh fruits, light acidity and creamy texture. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2011 Barriques Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Aged in wood, this is an unusual style of Pinot Blanc for Alsace. The toast flavors are subtle, leaving plenty of room for fresh fruits, light acidity and creamy texture. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2011 Barriques Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Intensely rich, this wine is packed with flavors of spice, gingerbread and lychees. It has a full, rounded character with an intense spiciness that is anchored to a more structured texture. Drink now and until 2018.
title: Trimbach 2010 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Intensely rich, this wine is packed with flavors of spice, gingerbread and lychees. It has a full, rounded character with an intense spiciness that is anchored to a more structured texture. Drink now and until 2018.
title: Trimbach 2010 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Made from superripe grapes from old vines that have aged on lees, this is a rich, concentrated wine. Full-bodied yellow fruit and ripe pear flavors are sustained by the tight, steely mineral texture and the tangy aftertaste. This dense wine deserves to age until 2018.
title: Isabelle et Pierre Clément 2014 La Dame de Châtenoy  (Menetou-Salon)

description: The two parcels that go into this wine have performed well in 2012. This solid, dense wine is firm with tannins and rich with red plum and berry fruits. It is perfumed, ripe and concentrated. With this structure and with the acidity, it will age, so drink from 2018.
title: Château de Santenay 2012 Les Brunettes et Planchots  (Aloxe-Corton)

description: From old vines planted in 1955, this dense, impressive wine offers both perfume apple and pear fruits and a creamy texture. Behind this generous front, the wine is tight, steely and needs to age. Give it until 2018.
title: Domaine Vrignaud 2013 Fourchaume Premier Cru Vieilles Vignes  (Chablis)

description: From a separate parcel of old vines, this rich wine is structured and dense. Citrus and herbal flavors meld easily with the mineral texture and ripe green-plum fruits. It's a wine to age, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Pellé 2014 Les Blanchais  (Menetou-Salon)

description: From vines with an average age of 25 years, this concentrated wine is fruity and stylishly textured. With lively acidity balanced by tense minerality, it shows intense citrus and concentration. It will benefit from some aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Matthias et Emile Roblin 2014 Enclos de Maimbray  (Sancerre)

description: From flinty soil, this wine shows a strongly mineral character and even a smoky edge. It is structured and tight, ripe with yellow fruits as well as citrus. A complex wine, it's impressive and ready to age a few months. Drink from 2017.
title: Clement et Florian Berthier 2014 Terre de Silex Sauvignon Blanc (Coteaux du Giennois)

description: The 2011s from Cornas show high levels of ripeness, and this négociant wine is no exception. It's almost pruny, with other notes of meat, clove and cinnamon, yet remains crisp and firm, picking up hints of black olive and espresso on the finish. Drink now–2025.
title: Maison Nicolas Perrin 2011  Cornas

description: This beautifully perfumed wine comes from one of the highest in elevation premier cru vineyards. The tannins have fully integrated with the red berry and cherry fruits to give a soft, jammy character that contrasts with acidity to give a great lift at the end. Drink this sophisticated wine from 2018.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2012 Les Chaumées Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: This beautifully perfumed wine comes from one of the highest in elevation premier cru vineyards. The tannins have fully integrated with the red berry and cherry fruits to give a soft, jammy character that contrasts with acidity to give a great lift at the end. Drink this sophisticated wine from 2018.
title: Au Pied du Mont Chauve 2012 Les Chaumées Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Still young and firm, this wine gives indications of potential fruitiness along with a structure that promises concentration. Layers of black fruits and acidity need time to integrate fully with the dark structure and dense texture. Wait to drink this wine for a few more years, at least until 2018.
title: Domaine Maillard 2011  Corton Les Renardes

description: Rich and full-bodied, this displays much of the complexity of a Grand Cru wine. It also has a strongly fruity character that bursts from the glass. Schoenenbourg is one of the vineyards surrounding the picture-book village of Riquewihr. Age the wine and drink from 2017.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2013 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Rich and full-bodied, this displays much of the complexity of a Grand Cru wine. It also has a strongly fruity character that bursts from the glass. Schoenenbourg is one of the vineyards surrounding the picture-book village of Riquewihr. Age the wine and drink from 2017.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2013 Schoenenbourg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A perfumed wine, it is big on spiced apricots and ripe fruitiness. It is rich, full in the mouth with a slight oxidative aftertaste of almonds and walnuts that gives a sense of maturity. Drink now.
title: Rijckaert 2009 Les Grands Elevages Savagnin (Arbois)

description: A full, fruity wine, it is ripe and finely textured. It also has a good chalky, mineral character, rich apple and grapefruit flavors and tight, dense acidity. It should be aged until 2015.
title: François Millet 2012 Domaine des Côtes Blanches  (Sancerre)

description: Full of tropical fruits, this ripe, textured wine is rich in aromas and depth. Abundant peach and apricot flavors give immediate pleasure and attractiveness. Drink this opulent wine now.
title: Domaine Pignier 2011 A la Percenette Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura)

description: Hazelnut, white pepper and dried apples come together in this oxidative wine with a yeast and toast edge. There is intense acidity in this wine that is bone dry, very crisp and tightly controlled.
title: Domaine Buronfosse 2011 Varron Savagnin (Côtes du Jura)

description: A fruity wine, it's packed with citrus, freshly peeled apples and white peaches. Acidity cuts through the ripeness, giving total freshness at this stage. It's a wine to be drunk for its fruitiness now, or aged until 2018 for more complex flavors.
title: Château Moncontour 2012 Sec  (Vouvray)

description: Bright and woodsy, this Syrah-dominant red is intriguing for its tapestry of earth and mushroom flavors interwoven with mixed berry fruit. There's enough acidity in the medium, yeast-scented finish to stand up to hearty red meats. Drink up.
title: Domaine Saint Andrieu 2007 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Bright and woodsy, this Syrah-dominant red is intriguing for its tapestry of earth and mushroom flavors interwoven with mixed berry fruit. There's enough acidity in the medium, yeast-scented finish to stand up to hearty red meats. Drink up.
title: Domaine Saint Andrieu 2007 Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Bright fruit freshness dominates this wine. The fruit is pure, vivid. light and crisp. The acidity is important here, driving the wine in a mineral direction.
title: Domaine Specht 2008 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Bright fruit freshness dominates this wine. The fruit is pure, vivid. light and crisp. The acidity is important here, driving the wine in a mineral direction.
title: Domaine Specht 2008 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This was the last vintage at Clos Fourtet under the ownership of the Lurtons. They made fine wine, but the potential of the property was never quite realized. The wine just fails to excite: it is rich and concentrated with ripe tannins and some sweetness, but at the same time, there is a layer of acidity and structure which gives the wine a firm, solid shape.
title: Clos Fourtet 2000  Saint-Émilion

description: This is a very modern style of wine, with generous new wood and super-ripe fruit flavors, balancing with polished solid tannins. Very international in style, it is good, but could come from anywhere.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2000  Pauillac

description: The northernmost of the Beaujolais cru villages can produce wines that are Burgundian in their structure. This wine fits that profile well with its dark tannins and rich concentration. Densely textured with both black-cherry fruit and a dry core, the wine is taking its time to develop. Drink from late 2017 or 2018.
title: Domaine des Chers 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Saint-Amour)

description: Owned by Beaune merchant Louis Jadot, this cru estate produces some impressive wines. While its alcohol is excessive for a Beaujolais, it wears its power well. The black plum fruit and tannins from wood aging that are still very present will soften over the next year to give a rich generous wine with a style that is Burgundian rather than traditional Beaujolais. Drink from 2018.
title: Château des Jacques 2015 Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: Named after the medieval rulers of the village, this cru wine is firm and structured in the solid style of the appellation. It has rich black cherry and black-plum fruits that come with juicy acidity. At the same time, the tannins and the dry core promise considerable aging. Drink from 2019.
title: Trenel Fils 2015 Les Capitans  (Juliénas)

description: Mint and eucalyptus flavors show strongly in this wood-aged, polished, smoky wine. The fruit suggests black plums, damsons and berries. Give the wine 3–4 years.
title: Jean-Michel Cazes 2011 Michel Lynch Bio  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine is heavily spiced from its wood aging. Fresher fruit flavors do come through to give black currants, bright acidity as well as firmer fruit structure. The wine still needs time, so drink from 2016.
title: Etienne de Tauriac 2010  Côtes de Bourg

description: It has attractive acidity and fragrant, juicy fruitiness. Underneath this fruit is a solid structure, fine tannins and fresh final acidity.
title: Château Simard 2011  Saint-Émilion

description: This herbaceous wine is fresh, steely and crisp. Bright acidity cuts strongly through the lively texture, giving apples, lemon and pink grapefruit. Developing fast, it is ready to drink.
title: Château Lafont Menaut 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: The wine is all juicy fruit, black cherries with just a modicum of tannin to hold it together. It's fresh, ripe and immediately attractive. Ready to drink now, but with those tannins it should also age 2016–2017.
title: Château du Coudray Montpensier 2013 Le Grand Bouqueteau  (Chinon)

description: The wine is soft, rounded, showing light acidity and fresh fruit. Melons and pears dominate the ripe flavors, with a touch of almonds and rich aftertaste.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2013  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A rich and medium sweet wine, full of spice, lychees and ripe fruits. There is a tangy texture, a strong sense of minerality as well as herb, yellow fruits and nutmeg flavors. It is still young and needs time. Drink from 2017.
title: Boeckel 2012 Zotzenberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Not overly sweet, this offers a spicy character on top of a touch of honey and fresh lemon flavors. It's surprisingly and attractively delicate for a Gewurztraminer, and ready to drink now.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2010 Kessler Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Hugely ripe, this is a dense and potentially intense wine. Its high alcohol brings out a disturbing pepper character that spoils the purity of the rich fruits and mineral texture. It shows the heat of the volcanic soil of Ragen de Thann Grand Cru in its rich fruits and ripe structure. It does need aging, so drink from 2017.
designation: Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald
title: Domaine Schoffit 2011 Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald Riesling (Alsace)

description: Impressively concentrated for a Pinot Blanc, it offers intense spice as well as crisp apple flavors. It's bright, with good acidity as well as a rich and rounded aftertaste.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2013 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: Made from young vines, this is the second wine of Suduiraut. It has young, honeyed character, with a ripe, opulent texture that lays bitter orange fruits over drier noble rot flavors. It is so delicious now, but will be better from 2017.
title: Château Suduiraut 2010 Castelnau de Suduiraut  (Sauternes)

description: A wine that is rich in both tannins and ripe fruit. The 45% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives the concentration of the wine, with spice and black berry fruits that are given an extra richness by the intense dark plums. The wine needs aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Logat 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: A wine that is rich in both tannins and ripe fruit. The 45% Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend gives the concentration of the wine, with spice and black berry fruits that are given an extra richness by the intense dark plums. The wine needs aging, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut-Logat 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: Very rich, this ripe and rounded wine is typical of the powerful 2010 vintage. It's dense and concentrated, packed with black plum and sweet berry fruits. It shows a dense structure along with juicy fruits. It could be over the top, but the acidity and tannins hold it back. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Ferrand 2010  Saint-Émilion

description: Ripe Merlot pushes through the tight tannins that are still evident in this wine. This dark, dry core dominates initially, and needs time to open up to show the vivid black currant flavors, touched with dried fruits and fresh finishing acidity.
title: Château Teyssier 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: Dry, lean and structured, here is a wine that initially seems to be missing its fruit. There are hints of black cherries and plum skins, but they are always going to be surrounded by a heavy tannic presence.
title: Château Cos Labory 2006  Saint-Estèphe

description: Dry, lean and structured, here is a wine that initially seems to be missing its fruit. There are hints of black cherries and plum skins, but they are always going to be surrounded by a heavy tannic presence.
title: Château Cos Labory 2006  Saint-Estèphe

description: Moderately intense menthol, black licorice and African violets aromas on the nose. The mouth, full of ripe plum and dark cherries accented by notes of cocoa and fresh mint leaves, has a lovely balance and silky texture. Ends on a somewhat simple yet clean finish.
title: Domaine Lignères 2003 La Baronne Red (Corbières)

description: Moderately intense menthol, black licorice and African violets aromas on the nose. The mouth, full of ripe plum and dark cherries accented by notes of cocoa and fresh mint leaves, has a lovely balance and silky texture. Ends on a somewhat simple yet clean finish.
title: Domaine Lignères 2003 La Baronne Red (Corbières)

description: A touch funky and green at first, that soon blows off to reveal a dark and wonderfully concentrated wine that shows some serious promise with age. Cassis, plum, black cherry, spice and tobacco fill the palate, with a long, smoky finish sealing the deal. Drink after 2010. Imported by The Portfolio Group.
title: Château Maris 2005 Old Vine Syrah (Minervois La Liviniere)

description: A wood-dominated wine that shows spice and high toast characters. It has probably seen too much wood in its aging, but there is fruit there, its black currant ripeness hiding in the background. Hopefully, the wood will soften and integrate.
title: Château Fonréaud 2006  Listrac-Médoc

description: Fresh black currant fruit gives this wine all the vivacity of the 2006 vintage. It is a beautiful, elegantly crafted wine, as you would expect from the same team as Château Ausone, and it has a lovely lightness of touch, with its final note one of delicious juiciness.
title: Château de Fonbel 2006  Saint-Émilion

description: Initially youthfully crisp and herbaceous, the wine then broadens into riper more yellow-fruit flavors. That gives it richness and weight that balance with the grapefruit and lemon-juice freshness. Give this fine wine a year to meld together
title: Domaine Seguin 2011  Pouilly-Fumé

description: Pécharmant produces some of the most dense reds of Bergerac, and this wine from Ancienne Cure shows some of the same character in a more fruity version. Black fruits and firm tannins are layered with forward acidity to give a wine that will be approachable this year.
title: Domaine l'Ancienne Cure 2011 Sélection Jour de Fruit  (Pécharmant)

description: Ripe black currant aromas set this wine on its full, warm path. It is intensely fruity with a rounded feel to it. The acidity cuts through the ripe character, giving tension and a piercing crisp aftertaste.
title: Patient Cottat 2010 Anciennes Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: Full-bodied, fruity wine that has wood aging flavors along with red plum and strawberry fruits. Smoky, perfumed, this is a wine that shows fresh fruit with a good depth of flavor. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Château la Varière 2010 Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: Full-bodied, fruity wine that has wood aging flavors along with red plum and strawberry fruits. Smoky, perfumed, this is a wine that shows fresh fruit with a good depth of flavor. Age for 2–3 years.
title: Château la Varière 2010 Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: Powerful and rich, this is a concentrated, wood-aged wine. It has toasted almonds as well as ripe pear and green-plum fruit. With a fine tension under the fruitiness, it will age over several years.
title: Château de la Roulerie 2011 Les Terrasses Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: Powerful and rich, this is a concentrated, wood-aged wine. It has toasted almonds as well as ripe pear and green-plum fruit. With a fine tension under the fruitiness, it will age over several years.
title: Château de la Roulerie 2011 Les Terrasses Chenin Blanc (Anjou)

description: With three years' aging, this has developed into an almond- and toast-flavored wine that has softened and rounded the fruit. It has turned into a serious wine, its rich structure allied to the acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Domaine Roblin 2010 Ammonites  (Sancerre)

description: With three years' aging, this has developed into an almond- and toast-flavored wine that has softened and rounded the fruit. It has turned into a serious wine, its rich structure allied to the acidity. Ready to drink.
title: Domaine Roblin 2010 Ammonites  (Sancerre)

description: With a few years in bottle, this is maturing well. It has ripeness, the tannins beginning to soften into rich spice and damson jelly flavors. The acidity is still very present as is the dry core.
title: Chateau de Launay 2005 Les Vignes de Julia  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This wine is ripe, packed with tropical fruit and rich acidity. A hint of vanilla has rounded the wine out, giving a full body to the delicious fruitiness. Opulent and generous, it is kept in order by final, aromatic acidity. Drink from 2016.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2013 Cuvée Claude Brosse  (Saint-Véran)

description: A ripe and rounded wine, this is touched by honey as well as rich yellow fruits, and is generous and full in the mouth. Apples and peaches shine here. As the wine opens up, it develops a fresher side, bringing in a touch of minerality and giving a really crisp aftertaste. Drink from 2016.
title: Jean-Marc Brocard 2013 Vau de Vey Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This comes from a complicated blend of Muscadelle, Loin de l'Oeil and Sauvignon Blanc: a touch from both the Mediterranean and the Atlantic. Grapefruit and peach flavors bring out the best of the grapes, giving a wine that is both fresh and ripe. It is bright and tangy at the end. Drink from late 2017.
title: Domaine d'Escausses 2014 L'Ombre Fraîche White (Gaillac)

description: Red fruits and a bold color emphasize the fruitiness of this wine. It's ripe with some tannins that do need to soften; however, the explosive fruits are the stars here. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Cause 2012 Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a perfumed wine that is soft, full of red cherry fruit and gentle tannins. It does have a dry core that gives the wine shape and there is plenty of juicy fruitiness at the end. The wine is made for the Hospices, a charity in Lyon.
designation: Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon
title: Collin-Bourisset 2014 Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This is a perfumed wine that is soft, full of red cherry fruit and gentle tannins. It does have a dry core that gives the wine shape and there is plenty of juicy fruitiness at the end. The wine is made for the Hospices, a charity in Lyon.
designation: Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon
title: Collin-Bourisset 2014 Domaine des Hospices Civils de Lyon  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Soft, light, frothy apéritif style, pleasantly balanced with pear flavors. The aftertaste is soft, but the balance remains. Attractive, uncomplicated.
title: Mansard NV Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: The main nonvintage Champagne from Drappier is open, fresh and very easy. The fruit shows pears and apricots, tightened up by some green apple skins. The general feel is softness. An enjoyable apéritif Champagne.
title: Drappier NV Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: The main nonvintage Champagne from Drappier is open, fresh and very easy. The fruit shows pears and apricots, tightened up by some green apple skins. The general feel is softness. An enjoyable apéritif Champagne.
title: Drappier NV Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: A firm, dense wine, it currently shows plenty of dry tannins along with potentially ripe fruits. Already showing balance, it is developing into a complex, rich wine that will be full of black fruits and smoother tannins. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Saint-Estèphe 2011  Saint-Estèphe

description: This is a delightfully perfumed wine, the second wine of Château L'Evangile. Smooth with ripe Merlot flavors, it's full and dense, conveying the sense that it will mature quickly. Drink from 2016.
title: Château l'Évangile 2011 Blason de l'Evangile  (Pomerol)

description: From an eight-acre vineyard, this is produced by the same team as Château Paloumey. Powerful and concentrated, it is also elegant, balancing its structure with good berry fruits and acidity. The tannins are still considerable, so drink from 2017.
title: Château La Garricq 2011  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: Made from Pinot Noir, this fresh and light rosé is packed with red berries and lively acidity. It is perfumed, dry and very fruity. Drink now.
title: Benoît Daridan 2014 Rosé (Cheverny)

description: Dominated by Pinot Noir, this is a tight and stalky wine. It is almost too light, with its acidity and tight tannins to the front. Probably as it softens it will round out, so wait until late 2016 to drink.
title: Benoît Daridan 2014 Pinot Noir-Gamay (Cheverny)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. With its minty aroma and high proportion of new wood, this is a wine which shows polish, a smooth, wood-laden texture offering a wine that will probably age quickly.
title: Château Ferrière 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. With its minty aroma and high proportion of new wood, this is a wine which shows polish, a smooth, wood-laden texture offering a wine that will probably age quickly.
title: Château Ferrière 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A ripe, fruity wine, showing delicious fresh berries, lively acidity over solid tannins. This is a wine on the charming side, maybe lacking intensity, but a pleasure to taste.
title: Château Croizet-Bages 2008 Barrel sample  (Pauillac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A light style, moving into delicate citrus and crisp fruits. It shows a lively palate, with a tight, dry core of botrytis.
title: Château Bastor-Lamontagne 2008 Barrel Sample  (Sauternes)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Sweet, soft, ripe, full of very soft fruit flavors. The ripeness of the year seems to have overtaken the wine.
title: Château Smith Haut Lafitte 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Spicy, rich, concentrated, with sweet vanilla flavors over the blackberry fruits. Soft and ripe, a wine that is made to charm.
title: Château Olivier 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Soft, open, the wood giving roundness to a spicy, rich wine. It will develop quickly.
title: Château de France 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Very sweet, ripe, rounded, with almost tropical richness, layered with lychees and spice.
title: Château Bouscaut 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Very sweet, ripe, rounded, with almost tropical richness, layered with lychees and spice.
title: Château Bouscaut 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Somewhat lean, more of solid tannin than fruit. But there is also some fresh acidity.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2006 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. Firm and dry, here is a wine that still offers plenty of ripe fruits. There are good blackcurrant flavors, along with the dry tannins that are as much wood as fruit driven.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2006 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. A wine with a high wood content, maybe too much – the question is over the fruit's ability to stand up to the blast of wood. The result is a wine that is super-spicy.
title: Château Bourgneuf-Vayron 2006 Barrel sample  (Pomerol)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. A dark hued wine, with its tense tannins giving a strong backbone to the dry, firm structure. The fruit hardly shows through all this dry, extracted character.
title: Château Latour-Martillac 2008 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Caramel new wood aromas are followed by spice and toast flavors. The fruit seems thin by comparison, hard to feel under all that polished toast.
title: Château Kirwan 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Caramel new wood aromas are followed by spice and toast flavors. The fruit seems thin by comparison, hard to feel under all that polished toast.
title: Château Kirwan 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Perfumed, light, hinting at minerality, the wine has a smooth veneer over the dusty tannins. The final effect is rich and polished.
title: Château Fontenil 2008 Barrel sample  (Fronsac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. Perfumed, light, hinting at minerality, the wine has a smooth veneer over the dusty tannins. The final effect is rich and polished.
title: Château Fontenil 2008 Barrel sample  (Fronsac)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. The second wine of Château Palmer is light, fresh and fruity, with accessible blackcurrant fruits. There is a light touch of wood, with delicious, easy juicy acidity.
title: Alter Ego de Palmer 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88-90 Barrel sample. The second wine of Château Palmer is light, fresh and fruity, with accessible blackcurrant fruits. There is a light touch of wood, with delicious, easy juicy acidity.
title: Alter Ego de Palmer 2008 Barrel sample  (Margaux)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. A spicy, wood laden wine, kept afloat with ripe blackberries and fresh tannins. Excellent acidity to keep the wine buoyant.
title: Château Rahoul 2006 Barrel sample  (Graves)

description: 88—90 Barrel sample. The man who makes Dassault aeroplanes, also owns this property. It's improving, as witnessed by this dense, dark wine, very solid, dark chocolate.
title: Château Dassault 2006 Barrel sample  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This wine has no added sulfur, giving crisp, clear and clean fruitiness. It also adds an light touch of oxidation that broadens the wine and makes the white stone fruit richer. Drink this impressively ripe wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Bernard Fleuriet et Fils 2015 Pur Jus  (Sancerre)

description: This is a limited production wine from small parcels of limestone soil. Aged in acacia barrels, it has subtle spice and toast flavors. They wood aging has had the effect of broadening the wine and giving it extra richness. It's an impressive wine, ready to drink from 2018.
title: Daniel Chotard 2015 Les Cris  (Sancerre)

description: This is a limited production wine from small parcels of limestone soil. Aged in acacia barrels, it has subtle spice and toast flavors. They wood aging has had the effect of broadening the wine and giving it extra richness. It's an impressive wine, ready to drink from 2018.
title: Daniel Chotard 2015 Les Cris  (Sancerre)

description: Named after an ancestor who pioneered using oak barrels for maturing Sauvignon Blanc, the wine is, of course, wood aged. It is also ripe with yellow fruits, spice and vanilla. Apricot is cut with more tangy orange zest and finished with acidity. This is a concentrated wine that is just ready to drink.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2014 Etienne Henri  (Sancerre)

description: From a sloping flinty vineyard, this is an impressive wine. It is powered by its tight tense texture to give a concentrated essence of Sauvignon Blanc. The wine, with its green and citrus fruits, is tangy, steely and needing to age. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Laporte 2016 Le Rochoy  (Sancerre)

description: From the family behind Bosquet des Papes in Châteauneuf, this is a solid Côtes du Rhône, with modest tannins but decent structure and typical notes of leather, dried cherries, chocolate and cinnamon. Drink it over the next few years.
title: Domaine Nicolas Boiron 2008 Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: A blend of 60% Grenache and 40% Syrah, this is another example of the fine values coming out of the Costières de Nîmes. It's a medium-bodied wine with a velvety texture and a fine balance between herbs and raspberry fruit on the one hand and dark berries and earth on the other. Drink it over the next 2–3 years.
title: Château Grande Cassagne 2008 Grenache-Syrah (Costières de Nîmes)

description: The Birot estate is in Cadillac, the fortress town on the banks of the Garonne. This classic Sauvignon and Sémillon blend is herbal, green and grassy. It is bright with acidity and lemon fruit and with a lightly tangy texture. Drink now.
title: Château de Birot 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The Birot estate is in Cadillac, the fortress town on the banks of the Garonne. This classic Sauvignon and Sémillon blend is herbal, green and grassy. It is bright with acidity and lemon fruit and with a lightly tangy texture. Drink now.
title: Château de Birot 2015  Bordeaux Blanc

description: The wine is rich and ready to drink. With red fruits and warm tannins, it is a ripe wine that has a light structure and balanced acidity. It is already an easy wine—fruity and soft at the end.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 Château Tuilerie Pagès  (Bordeaux)

description: Intensely acidic wine, its red fruits and caramel hidden behind a tart, over-lemoned flavor. For lovers of mouth-shockingly dry rosé. Screwcap.
title: Château Larroque 2012 Red (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Bordeaux Claret has a darker color than a rosé, suggesting more weight. This wine, though, also has a green herbal edge that is less attractive.
title: Château de Piote 2012 Red (Bordeaux Clairet)

description: From the appellation that is at a summit of Loire sweet wines, this golden wine balances intense acidity with intense botrytis and honey flavors. Ripe peaches and pineapples dominate the fruit profile of this concentrated, beautiful wine. It is just approaching its peak, so wait a little longer, until 2018.
title: Château de Fesles 2011 Vin Rare  (Bonnezeaux)

description: The Grand Cru of Quarts de Chaume juts out over the Layon Valley, with its autumn mists, resulting in the best conditions for noble rot. This luscious wine, gold in color, is so rich, so intense as to be almost overwhelming. It is so young still all rich fruit, peaches, apricots with a touch of ginger. The wine, with its background of considerable acidity, will develop slowly; drink from 2020.
title: Château Pierre-Bise 2011 Grand Cru  (Quarts de Chaume)

description: The mature vines in the name of the wine are 40-years-old. The result is a firm structured wine although one with plenty of soft red fruits in the background. They are developing well, bringing with them acidity and good potential. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Maison Stéphane Brocard 2014 Closerie des Alisiers Vieilles Vignes  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: This wine shows how well Sancerre can age. While the initial herbal fruitiness has calmed down, the citrus and green fruit is still vibrant and crisp. The fruit has been joined by a touch of spice, pepper and a hint of toast from the partial wood aging. Drink this wine now.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2013 Vieilles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: This wine comes from a four-acre parcel of 55-year-old vines. It has the concentration that is so special to old vines. That goes with the ripe red fruits and generous tannins that give the wine great richness. It is a young wine still even though so fruity and will be better to drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Henri Delagrange 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Volnay)

description: With lees aging, this wine has gained richness, balancing crisp acidity with ripe flavors. Aromatic and with a flinty texture and citrus flavors, the wine is concentrated. The finish shows more of the herbal Sauvignon character.
title: Domaine Girard 2015 Philippe Girard  (Sancerre)

description: With lees aging, this wine has gained richness, balancing crisp acidity with ripe flavors. Aromatic and with a flinty texture and citrus flavors, the wine is concentrated. The finish shows more of the herbal Sauvignon character.
title: Domaine Girard 2015 Philippe Girard  (Sancerre)

description: With an average age of 45 years, the Chevreau family's vines bestow intensity and richness. This is a generous wine, the green fruits lifted by good acidity and a taut mineral texture that comes from the chalk in the soil. This wine is young but very ready to drink.
title: Château de Crézancy 2015  Sancerre

description: A ripe and soft wine, this is impressively rich for a Pinot Noir grown so far north in Burgundy. It has hints of red fruits along with pear and tight citrus minerality. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Earthy aromas lead to a palate that is full bodied, with notes of yeast and spice to go with the white fruit. It has attractive acidity and a tangy citrusy finish. Screwcap.
title: Château Routas 2010 White (Vin de Pays Var)

description: With 30% of the local Abouriou grape in the blend, this is herbal and spicy. It has a round character that is beefed up by the weight and tannins imparted by the addition of Malbec. Red fruits dominate, making this ready to drink.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2009 La Vieille Eglise Réserve Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: With 30% of the local Abouriou grape in the blend, this is herbal and spicy. It has a round character that is beefed up by the weight and tannins imparted by the addition of Malbec. Red fruits dominate, making this ready to drink.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2009 La Vieille Eglise Réserve Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Round and silky, this is a medium-bodied Saint-Joseph intended for early enjoyment. Blackberry and dusty earth shadings mingle easily on the palate, fading just a bit quickly on the finish.
title: Les Vins de Vienne 2009  Saint-Joseph

description: With no wood aging, the fruit speaks in this wine. However, it does have tannins and a stalky, young character, along with generous black-cherry fruit and a touch of spice. The wine needs to age a few months more, so drink from 2018.
title: Florent Descombe 2015  Chénas

description: This is a tight, tangy wine, laced with attractive wood flavors. Plenty of crisp citrus and spicy flavors balance each other. It is already delicious, so drink now.
title: Domaine Sophie Cinier 2016  Mâcon-Verze

description: This wine is ripe, rounded with a smooth vanilla and spice texture that complements the yellow fruit and rich pear flavors. The wine is generous and likely to age quickly. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Pierre Guillemot 2015 Dessus des Golardes  (Savigny-lès-Beaune)

description: The wood-aging flavors show strongly in this ripe wine, balancing with the apple acidity and the touches of green-plum fruits. A streak of minerality adds to the complexity of this delicious wine. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2015 Les Ecussaux Premier Cru  (Auxey-Duresses)

description: This wine is tight and closed up. It does suggest plenty of fruit weight, hinting at toast and apple flavors that will come through over the next several years to give a rich wine. Drink from 2022.
title: Domaine Faiveley 2015 Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: This is a generous wine, finely balanced and with great fruit. It has a touch of spice to balance the lively acidity and green crisp fruits. A waft of Mediterranean herbs passes over this ripe, generous wine. Drink from late 2017.
title: Château d'Ollières 2016 Prestige White (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: The small Beaujolais cru of Chénas is next door to Moulin à Vent. As this wine shows, it has the same firm structure and ripe fruit. The wine from the cru's chateau is dense, smoky and has plenty of firm tannins. It is a wine to age, so drink from 2019.
title: Château de Chénas 2015  Chénas

description: The small Beaujolais cru of Chénas is next door to Moulin à Vent. As this wine shows, it has the same firm structure and ripe fruit. The wine from the cru's chateau is dense, smoky and has plenty of firm tannins. It is a wine to age, so drink from 2019.
title: Château de Chénas 2015  Chénas

description: This ripe wine is already delicious with its full, bold fruits and peach and mango flavors. It's full of rich fruits and touched lightly by spice. Drink this generous wine from 2018.
title: Rijckaert 2015  Saint-Véran

description: This smooth wine has a rounded, soft texture, but acidity and a citrus edge creep into the peach and pineapple fruits. Drink now.
title: Meurgey-Croses 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: Touches of wood, not new, give this wine spice and roundness. It is an attractive, citrus-flavored wine, with yellow fruits coming from behind as the wine opens up. Drink now.
title: Louis Latour 2015  Marsannay

description: Touches of wood, not new, give this wine spice and roundness. It is an attractive, citrus-flavored wine, with yellow fruits coming from behind as the wine opens up. Drink now.
title: Louis Latour 2015  Marsannay

description: This wine is structured and firm, its red fruits waiting behind the wood and tannin complexity. It shows plenty of potential through its good acidity and cherry fruitiness. Drink from late 2018.
