title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Collection  (Morgon)

description: The wine is ripe and warm with generous red-berry fruits and touches of spice. The wine is rounded, full of fruitiness with a layer of tannins that is nicely judged to give support and breadth to the fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: The wine is ripe and warm with generous red-berry fruits and touches of spice. The wine is rounded, full of fruitiness with a layer of tannins that is nicely judged to give support and breadth to the fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2015 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)

description: This mango-flavored wine is ripe, generous and fruity. Its richness and spice are right up front. It is a gorgeous wine, smooth, creamy and ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine du Bois Rosier  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This smooth and creamy wine is spicy with wood aging and rich with yellow fruits. It presents a generous character, rounded and open. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Clos Reyssie  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This rounded wine is soft and ripe. Along with its smooth, warm texture it offers generous pear and melon flavors. Acidity adds an attractive final crispness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Pascal et Mireille Renaud 2015  Saint-Véran

description: This aromatic wine is delicious Pinot Noir. With fine ripe red fruits that are shot through with tannins for aging and crisp acidity for refreshing drinking, this is a rich wine that should be drunk now.
title: Domaine Michel Goubard 2015 Mont-Avril  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: The red wine from this vineyard (which also produces a white) is firm with layers of toast from wood aging as well as the potential for ripe red fruits. It is going to need some time to lose that spicy flavor that currently dominates the wine. Give it until 2021.
title: Domaine Jessiaume 2015 Les Gravières Premier Cru  (Santenay)

description: Strong wood aromas show in the toasty edge of this spicy wine. Ripe yellow fruits are full in the mouth, with a crisp, bright aftertaste to give a final lift.
title: Domaine Carrette 2016  Mâcon-Milly Lamartine

description: This rich wine features ripe, jammy red-plum and cherry fruits. It is dense, with its tannins and a touch of pepper coming from the high alcohol. The wine is a blend from five parcels. Ripe and with a juicy aftertaste, it will be best from 2018.
title: Domaine Bertrand 2015 Vuril  (Brouilly)

description: Big and broad with fruit that is full and ripe, packed with golden apple flavors. It has great texture and sweetness, with a well-judged touch of vanilla from the wood.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Goutte d'Or Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A rounded wine, with a counterpoint of apple skin texture, the fruit flavors offering acidity as well as green plums. The texture is plush, velvet, delicious.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A rounded wine, with a counterpoint of apple skin texture, the fruit flavors offering acidity as well as green plums. The texture is plush, velvet, delicious.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Charmes Premier Cru  (Meursault)

description: A structured wine, the weight and severe mineral character showing through richness. White peaches balance the acidity and a smoky layer from wood. It is drinkable now, but really worth aging a year.
title: Domaine des Comtes Lafon 2008 Mâcon Milly-Lamartine Clos du Four  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: A structured wine, the weight and severe mineral character showing through richness. White peaches balance the acidity and a smoky layer from wood. It is drinkable now, but really worth aging a year.
title: Domaine des Comtes Lafon 2008 Mâcon Milly-Lamartine Clos du Four  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Full in the mouth, round and rich, the wine is finely structured, fresh and ripe at the same time. Delicious.
title: Daniel Barraud 2008 Alliance  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: A good contrast between weighty, rich fruit and a steely structure. White fruits and acidity offer freshness, while the more austere edge gives the wine a serious, solid character. For aging.
title: Domaine Michel Bouzereau 2008 Le Limosin  (Meursault)

description: A good contrast between weighty, rich fruit and a steely structure. White fruits and acidity offer freshness, while the more austere edge gives the wine a serious, solid character. For aging.
title: Domaine Michel Bouzereau 2008 Le Limosin  (Meursault)

description: A wine that is broad, feeling full-bodied, with weight, pear and quince fruit flavors. The wine is attractively plump, toast and acidity adding richness. It opens slowly to give a rich aftertaste.
designation: Domaine des Deux Roches Rives de Longsault
title: Collovray et Terrier 2007 Domaine des Deux Roches Rives de Longsault  (Saint-Véran)

description: A wine that is broad, feeling full-bodied, with weight, pear and quince fruit flavors. The wine is attractively plump, toast and acidity adding richness. It opens slowly to give a rich aftertaste.
designation: Domaine des Deux Roches Rives de Longsault
title: Collovray et Terrier 2007 Domaine des Deux Roches Rives de Longsault  (Saint-Véran)

description: Initially soft, this wine then reveals a firmer structure, and a salty and mineral texture. There is an element of toastiness, rounding out the crisp apple and citrus fruit flavors. A cool, elegant wine.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2007 Les Caradeux Premier Cru  (Pernand-Vergelesses)

description: A great swathe of rich, well–defined fruit and a complex texture of pear and apple skins along with the freshest grapefruit and citrus character. This is an intense wine, the fruit fully in focus.
designation: Domaine la Soufrandière Climat les Quarts
title: Bret Brothers 2008 Domaine la Soufrandière Climat les Quarts  (Saint-Véran)

description: Ripe and soft, with a texture that is well balanced, this wine has peach and apricot flavors marrying well with the layers of wood. There is a strong, fresh element to give the wine a final lift.
title: Roger Lassarat 2008 Clos de France  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: With low yields after a hail storm, the wine is concentrated and dense. It has a touch of wood aging as well as dark black fruits. The tannins are firm in a wine that will age well over the medium term. Drink from 2023.
title: Château Potensac 2014  Médoc

description: A superripe structured wine that has serious tannins and a smoky dark character. Right now, the tannins dominate the otherwise fruity wine, but with some time it will soften and balance out. Drink this powerful wine from 2024.
title: Château Monbousquet 2014  Saint-Émilion

description: With top consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt behind this one, the wine is fine and ripe with just the right balance between tannin and rich blackberry fruit. There is a juicy character that shines through the youthful structure. The wine will age well. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Lestruelle 2014  Médoc

description: With signs of its wood aging that are balanced with firm tannins and concentrated black fruits, this is a solid wine, packed with tannins. There is a touch of dark chocolate as well as the ripe fruit. It is a fine wine, ready to drink from 2020.
title: Château la Vieille Cure 2014  Fronsac

description: From one of a group of chateaus owned by the Guyon family of Rolland de By, this is an intensely fruity wine. It has finely balanced tannins and acidity along with smoky flavors and layers of delicious black currant fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château La Clare 2014  Médoc

description: From one of a group of chateaus owned by the Guyon family of Rolland de By, this is an intensely fruity wine. It has finely balanced tannins and acidity along with smoky flavors and layers of delicious black currant fruit. Drink from 2019.
title: Château La Clare 2014  Médoc

description: Owned by the Borie family, one of the grand families of Bordeaux, the vineyard forms part of Château Fourcas-Borie. The wine, with its dark tannins and dense texture, is powerful and concentrated. Layers of tannins show most strongly at this young stage, while the ripe juicy fruit will develop well. It is going to be a fine wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Ducluzeau 2014  Listrac-Médoc

description: Owned by the Borie family, one of the grand families of Bordeaux, the vineyard forms part of Château Fourcas-Borie. The wine, with its dark tannins and dense texture, is powerful and concentrated. Layers of tannins show most strongly at this young stage, while the ripe juicy fruit will develop well. It is going to be a fine wine. Drink from 2021.
title: Château Ducluzeau 2014  Listrac-Médoc

description: With an unusually high proportion (nearly 17%) of Petit Verdot in the blend, this is both darkly structured and dark in color. It is weight, intense youthful acidity and black-currant fruits. It's also rich, full of tannins and in need of several years. Drink from 2021.
title: Château du Retout 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: With an unusually high proportion (nearly 17%) of Petit Verdot in the blend, this is both darkly structured and dark in color. It is weight, intense youthful acidity and black-currant fruits. It's also rich, full of tannins and in need of several years. Drink from 2021.
title: Château du Retout 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: A rich wine from a ripe year. The flavors are full and open, edged with a mushroom character that suggests maturity. The fruits are going towards almonds, while the structure has softened.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2005 Grand Cuvée Fournier Vieilles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: There is such a surprising level of acidity in this wine that it seems unsure of where to go with its sweetness. The fruit flavors are lemon, peach and dry honey. While the wine is likely to age, it is already missing intensity.
title: Château Rabaud-Promis 2004  Sauternes

description: Great wafts of white currants come from this delicious—but definitely too young—wine. It is full of flavor, fruity and ripe. There's a good structure from green apple skins and tight acidity. Give it another year.
title: Domaine Seguin 2007  Pouilly-Fumé

description: Typically Nairac, this is elegant and delicate, with great freshness and acidity. While it is not hugely concentrated, it is beautifully ripe, an aperitif style rather than for dessert.
title: Château Nairac 2004  Barsac

description: Typically Nairac, this is elegant and delicate, with great freshness and acidity. While it is not hugely concentrated, it is beautifully ripe, an aperitif style rather than for dessert.
title: Château Nairac 2004  Barsac

description: Dense, dark wine, with good black plum, fig, coffee and sweet raisin flavors. The ripe tannins fit well into this fruit mélange, with definite richness from new wood. There is good, juicy power here, as the wine finishes well with both dry tannin and fresh acidity.
title: Château Barreyres 2006  Haut-Médoc

description: Fine minerality here, with a wine that brings out balanced grapefruit acidity along with some pear juice and green apple skins. The texture is soft, everything well in balance to give a fine apéritif style of wine.
title: Boizel NV Chardonnay Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Mumm's new generation of Cordon Rouge bottlings is a pleasure. The wine has depth and great full swathes of pear and red apple fruit flavors. It is well integrated, with initial softness tightened up with acidity and yeast flavors.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Cordon Rouge Brut  (Champagne)

description: Mumm's new generation of Cordon Rouge bottlings is a pleasure. The wine has depth and great full swathes of pear and red apple fruit flavors. It is well integrated, with initial softness tightened up with acidity and yeast flavors.
title: G. H. Mumm NV Cordon Rouge Brut  (Champagne)

description: Three years aging have softened the tight acidity of this wine and given it a rounded and creamy character. It still has great freshness and a light touch of apple and crisp grapefruit. Drink this attractive wine now.
title: Domaine de Beauregard 2012 Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: Aromas of wood dominate this 100% Merlot aged in oak for 12 months, which also shows on the palate. It is concentrated and firm with acidity although not much fruit yet. Give this wine until 2017. Franck Cot took over the family estate in 1996. The vineyard was certified sustainable in 2011.
title: Château Siffle Merle 2012 Cuvée Prestige  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Sweet and sparkling, this light, fresh wine is delicious on a hot day or as an apéritif. It is crisp with red berry fruits and a soft, sweet aftertaste that is cut with acidity.
title: Les Rocailles NV Caprice Gamay (Vin de France)

description: This wine is stalky with wild blackberry fruits and spicy acidity. It has a crisp edge, with a fresh character that comes through the herbal tannic flavors. It is all youth and fruit, so will be better from 2016. Chill lightly before drinking.
title: Les Rocailles 2014 Saint-Jean-de-la-Porte Mondeuse (Vin de Savoie)

description: This is an attractive, simple and, yes, an easy wine to drink. It has a pretty orange-pink color, crisp citrus fruit and the freshest final acidity.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Easy Rosé (Mediterranée)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This is an attractive, simple and, yes, an easy wine to drink. It has a pretty orange-pink color, crisp citrus fruit and the freshest final acidity.
title: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez 2014 Easy Rosé (Mediterranée)
winery: Les Maîtres Vignerons de la Presqu'île de Saint-Tropez

description: This medium-bodied white blend is simple, fruity and fresh, dominated by aromas and flavors of pear, pineapple and melon.
title: Louis Bernard 2014 White (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon/Malbec blend is balanced with attractive juicy acidity and red berry flavors, leaving a perfumed aftertaste. As a light wine to drink young, this Carreau family wine is attractive.
title: Château la Croix Saint-Pierre 2013  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: High in acidity, this Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc blend is a crisp, with red-fruit flavors. It is bright and fresh, with light tannins that give structure to the fruits. Drink now.
title: Château de la Bouyère 2013  Bordeaux

description: A strongly perfumed wine, this is soft and just off-dry in character with some sucrosity. Crisp, fresh berry fruits are laced with acidity and finished with orange zest.
title: Domaine Terre de Mistral 2014 Mireille Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: The wine is ripe with a fine mix of generous fruits and layers of toast. It is an opulent wine, full of fruitiness and with a crisper side from juicy acidity. Produced from 48-year-old vines, it has some fine concentration that gives the wine extra richness. Drink from 2017.
title: Roche de Bellene 2014  Saint-Aubin

description: While this could be considered the equivalent of a second wine for the Château Pech de Jammes estate, it is in a modern, fruity style, which sets it apart from the Château wine. Bold, ripe and generous fruits give blackberry flavors alongside a lively, perfumed character. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2015 Petit Jammes Malbec (Cahors)

description: From the hills to the west of Nuits-St.-Georges, this is a crisp, red berry-flavored wine. It has light tannins and juicy, perfumed fruit—all in balance and ready to drink soon, from 2018.
title: Pierre Gruber 2014  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits

description: Produced by the cooperative of the Hautes Côtes, this wine is bright and fruity. It has light tannins and warm, red cherry character. With its acidity and structure it could age, although not for long. Drink from 2018.
title: Nuiton-Beaunoy 2015  Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Beaune

description: This wine is soft and smooth, with just the right amount of acidity to ruffle the surface. An attractive floral character will remain as the wine ages. For now, the acidity and fresh white fruits are young and crisp. Drink from mid-2016.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2014 White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This wine is soft and smooth, with just the right amount of acidity to ruffle the surface. An attractive floral character will remain as the wine ages. For now, the acidity and fresh white fruits are young and crisp. Drink from mid-2016.
title: Commanderie de la Bargemone 2014 White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: From vineyards outside the main village appellations of the Côte de Nuits, this is a firm, almost austere wine. It has a dry extract character that is suppressing the red plum and berry fruit flavors. Give it time, although it is probably always going to be dry.
title: Louis Max 2013  Côtes de Nuits Villages

description: This is a structured, still young and extracted wine, with dark tannins and spice from the wood aging. In the background, the red-berry fruits are developing and filling out to give a balance to the wine. Drink from 2017.
title: Les Vignobles Gueissard 2013 Les Papilles Red (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pure Chardonnay from the Grand Cru village of Oger, this wine is creamy and ripe. It also has a chalky mineral mouthfeel that keeps it crisp and tight. With its grapefruit and white stone fruit flavors, it's both fruity and textured. Let it age a few months and drink from 2018.
title: José Dhondt NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Now approaching its peak, this vintage blend balances the three primary Champagne grapes in equal proportion. It's ripe, yet still crisp, with attractive hints of toast and a full, rich, creamy background. Full-bodied and beautiful, it's ready to drink.
title: Huré Frères 2008 Instantanée Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This normally cool Premier Cru has done particularly well in the 2015 vintage. This bottling is ripe and full of white fruit, while keeping a strong line of fine, tight acidity. It will be ready to drink soon, so only wait until 2018.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2015 Côte de Lechet Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: This ripe wine is full of minerality and rich white and yellow fruit. Still young, it's deliciously creamy and bright, showing great potential for aging into something serious. Drink from 2020.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2014 Preuses Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: This ripe wine is full of minerality and rich white and yellow fruit. Still young, it's deliciously creamy and bright, showing great potential for aging into something serious. Drink from 2020.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2014 Preuses Grand Cru  (Chablis)

description: In the crisp, balanced style of the producer, this nonvintage Champagne is light, poised and elegant. It is satisfyingly mature with good acidity and minerality. Lively and perfumed, it is ready to drink.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: In the crisp, balanced style of the producer, this nonvintage Champagne is light, poised and elegant. It is satisfyingly mature with good acidity and minerality. Lively and perfumed, it is ready to drink.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Brut Réserve  (Champagne)

description: This producer based in the small Côte de Sézanne has produced a bright, zesty and crisp style of blanc de blancs. It emphasizes fruitiness, lively with only a light touch of chalky minerality. It is full, ripe, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Le Brun de Neuville NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fruity and spicy, this is a finely wrought wine. Structured and concentrated, it will develop well, giving a solid wine with tannins as well as blackberry fruits. Drink this Sébastian and Nicolas Carreau wine from 2019.
title: Vignobles Carreau Selection 2014 Amiral  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Fruity and spicy, this is a finely wrought wine. Structured and concentrated, it will develop well, giving a solid wine with tannins as well as blackberry fruits. Drink this Sébastian and Nicolas Carreau wine from 2019.
title: Vignobles Carreau Selection 2014 Amiral  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Taking advantage of recent warm vintages, Boizel has joined other producers in taking its range drier. This extra brut is full of crisp apple and lemon flavors. It is dry, although the acidity is balanced by the ripe fruitiness and mineral aftertaste. Drink this bottling (disgorged January 2016) from 2018.
title: Boizel NV Ultime Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: Taking advantage of recent warm vintages, Boizel has joined other producers in taking its range drier. This extra brut is full of crisp apple and lemon flavors. It is dry, although the acidity is balanced by the ripe fruitiness and mineral aftertaste. Drink this bottling (disgorged January 2016) from 2018.
title: Boizel NV Ultime Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a rich wine made from a selection of Pinot Noirs, including some from grand cru vineyards. It is textured with hints of tannin as well as yeast and minerality, concentrated while also stylish. Ripe pear and apricot flavors are lively and ripe. A young bottling, it's worth aging until 2017.
title: Boizel NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This is the driest wine in an already-dry range of Champagnes. With no dosage, it is crisp, tight and mineral. The high proportion of Pinot Meunier in the blend brings out the the flavors of white fruits and the crisp texture. The bottling is still young and will be better from 2017.
title: Billecart-Salmon NV Extra Brut  (Champagne)

description: This bone-dry wine is made using Pinot Noir skins to give its salmon-pink color. It is dry and tightly crisp, compared with the brut nature cuvée also made from Pinot Noir. The ripe red fruits give a fruity character that balances the dryness. Like many really dry Champagnes, it needs to age to soften the intensity of the acidity, so drink this bottling from 2017.
title: Drappier NV Rosé Brut Nature Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: This well-balanced nonvintage Champagne from this major producer in the Aube region is dominated by Pinot Noir, giving rich character and structure. Red apple and ripe melon flavors mean everything is in place, making for a wine that is deliciously ready to drink.
title: Drappier NV Carte d'Or Brut  (Champagne)

description: From flint and clay soil, this full, ripe wine is tangy, packed with fruit and still young. It is elegant, with the tight mineral structure giving a bright edge to the rounded fruit. Drink this intense and generous wine from 2017.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2013 La Demoiselle de Bourgeois  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: From flint and clay soil, this full, ripe wine is tangy, packed with fruit and still young. It is elegant, with the tight mineral structure giving a bright edge to the rounded fruit. Drink this intense and generous wine from 2017.
title: Henri Bourgeois 2013 La Demoiselle de Bourgeois  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: Rich and fragrant, this is perfumed with white flowers and lemon blossom. Apples, crisp pears and lime give a fresh and tightly fruity taste. The aftertaste is bright, while also rich. Drink now.
title: Les Rocailles 2014  Roussette de Savoie

description: This young, fruity and spicy Cabernet Franc is perfumed and ready to drink. The wine is structured, tight and offers delicious red fruit. Drink the wine, lightly chilled, with salmon as well as meat dishes.
title: Domaine les Pins 2015  Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil

description: The wine comes from the highest point of the slope above Santenay, giving it an attractive cool and crisp character. With its delicious, refreshing acidity as well as ripe pear flavors it is balanced, minerally and with fine acidity. The aftertaste confirms that the wine is ready to drink.
title: Domaine Julie Belland 2014 Comme Dessus  (Santenay)

description: The wine is ripe, balanced and likely to be ready to drink soon. With its plump fruitiness and texture, it is a full wine. Rich red-berry fruits are gently balanced by acidity and supported with a light layer of tannins. It will be very drinkable from late 2017.
title: Domaine Julie Belland 2014 Charmes  (Santenay)

description: A blend of vines grown on granite and richer gabbro soils, this is a full wine, with creamy white fruits and acidity that is fully integrated into the smooth texture. Crispness comes through at the end to give a bright aftertaste with plenty of acidity.
title: Domaine des Cognettes 2014 Les 2 Terres Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A blend of half and half Chardonnay and Aligoté, this is a mineral textured wine that is shot through with acidity and green fruits. It is crisp, light and bright, and refreshingly ready to drink.
title: Cave de Bissey NV Blanc de Blancs Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Very salmon pink in color, this lively, crisp wine has some weight as well as refreshing fruit. It is full-bodied, with citrus and raspberry fruits, dry and very fresh at the end.
title: Château la Gordonne 2013 Verité du Terroir Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A fruity wine, it shows ripe red berries, red currants and refreshing acidity. So while the wine has weight, it is also totally fresh and crisp. It's a rosé for food, rich while balanced.
title: Château Henri Bonnaud 2013 Terre Promise Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Since the futures tasting in 2009, the wood element has been tamed. It is still an important factor, but the fruit has blossomed, showing a solid core of tannins, surrounded by dark plum and red fruit flavors. It will need many years, but everything is here now.
title: Château Lilian Ladouys 2008  Saint-Estèphe

description: With hints of mint, and a firm structure from wood as well as tannins, this is a flattering wine. The tannins are rich, layered within the jammy black berry fruits. This is a wine for aging, but is deceptively attractive now.
title: Château Cambon la Pelouse 2008  Haut-Médoc

description: Big, structured and solid, with powerful dense fruit, this is packed with plum juice flavors. The wine feels chunky, while the acidity keeps everything in proportion.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2007  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: There is a voluptuous edge to this generous wine. It has rich flavors, some strawberry and plum juice. The final extreme freshness shows through the layer of firm tannins. For aging over 4–5 years.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Les Damodes Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: A solid, dense wine, packed with tannins and with a dry core. The soft fruit has flavors of strawberry, hinting at richness to come. At this early stage, tannins and acidity are still forming. Hold for five years.
title: Louis Latour 2008 Les Beaumonts Premier Cru  (Vosne-Romanée)

description: There is great structure here, with dusty tannins percolating through the rich wine. It has power, concentration and density, with cocoa and cherry flavors well integrated. Think about aging for 1–2 years.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Sélection  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Dominated by its dry tannins, this is a tight black currant and dark plum skin-flavored wine, surrounded by a firm core of tannins, a firm and dark-hued wine.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2009 Clos des Garands  (Fleurie)

description: A fresh, citrus flavored wine with attractive fruitiness and a crisp texture. There is a yeasty edge that should vanish and leave just fruit. Because it is mainly made from Chenin Blanc, there is a nutty, honeyed aftertaste.
title: Louis de Grenelle NV Platine Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: A fresh, citrus flavored wine with attractive fruitiness and a crisp texture. There is a yeasty edge that should vanish and leave just fruit. Because it is mainly made from Chenin Blanc, there is a nutty, honeyed aftertaste.
title: Louis de Grenelle NV Platine Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: It's the delicious, clean, crisp fruit that's so good about this wine. It is bright with acidity and crisp apple flavors along with a lemon tang texture giving a fine bite. Stylish and fresh, it is a fine apéritif wine in style.
title: Sauvion NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: It's the delicious, clean, crisp fruit that's so good about this wine. It is bright with acidity and crisp apple flavors along with a lemon tang texture giving a fine bite. Stylish and fresh, it is a fine apéritif wine in style.
title: Sauvion NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Loire)

description: Showing pure tropical fruits with a squeeze of lemon, this is a ripe, tasty wine, maybe a little short on acidity, but bringing out ripe lychee and mango flavors.
title: Domaine Henry Pellé 2008 Les Bornés  (Menetou-Salon)

description: Somewhat hard-edged wine, showing the sharpness of young Chenin Blanc. It has a future, though, as this edge drops away, because there is some good weight as well as bright fresh final acidity. Keep for several months.
title: Château Moncontour NV Brut Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Crémant de Loire)

description: A finely crafted wine, its tight acidity generating a very fresh profile. There is an intensity of fruit as well as a mineral texture. For aging. Screwcap.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2007 Clos de Saint-Yves  (Savennières)

description: Classic. Beautiful acidity is balanced by just a touch of sweetness. The wine is bright with apple and lime flavors.
title: Domaine Huët 2010 Le Haut-Lieu Sec  (Vouvray)

description: A wine that combines the richness of the vintage with the extreme flinty texture of young, dry Chenin Blanc. Packed with ripe acidity, it is pure, very crisp, yet for aging.
title: Château d'Epire 2009 Cuvée Spéciale  (Savennières)

description: This is firmly, tannic, the product of oak cask fermentation as well as aging. The tannins promise long aging, while the ripe black jelly fruit character brings out the richness of the vintage.
title: Charles Joguet 2009 Clos du Chêne Vert  (Chinon)

description: Old vines, at least 60 years old, are the basis for this soft, wood-aged wine. The texture is smooth, with rounded tannins and density. Flavors include licorice, bittersweet chocolate and black cherries.
title: Bernard Baudry 2009 Les Grézeaux  (Chinon)

description: Old vines, at least 60 years old, are the basis for this soft, wood-aged wine. The texture is smooth, with rounded tannins and density. Flavors include licorice, bittersweet chocolate and black cherries.
title: Bernard Baudry 2009 Les Grézeaux  (Chinon)

description: Pale gold-colored wine from an exceptional vineyard. The warmth of the volcanic soil gives richness to the fruit while still keeping some feeling of dryness. It has weight, dried spice and pepper. Honeyed fruits show right at the end. Drink from 2014.
designation: Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald
title: Domaine Schoffit 2009 Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Pale gold-colored wine from an exceptional vineyard. The warmth of the volcanic soil gives richness to the fruit while still keeping some feeling of dryness. It has weight, dried spice and pepper. Honeyed fruits show right at the end. Drink from 2014.
designation: Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald
title: Domaine Schoffit 2009 Rangen de Thann Grand Cru Clos Saint-Théobald Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: An opulent feeling Riesling, full of peach and pineapple flavors. It's ripe, full in the mouth and textured, its richness masking the dryness of the fruit and the acidity. It could age a few more years—give it 2–4.
title: Joseph Fritsch 2010 Schlossberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: The name is an oblique reference to Shiraz, which forms the basis of this cuvée. It's inky in hue and rather reticent on the nose at first. But swirl it vigorously and be rewarded with layers of cassis, blackberry and black pepper. Full bodied, rich and tannic, its blueberry and cassis fruit lingers on the long, mouthwatering finish. Drink 2015–2025.
title: Domaine de Fondrèche 2009 Persia Red (Ventoux)

description: Mango aromas and flavors give a sense of the sweetness of the wine. It is rich and full bodied, with spice and pepper notes just hinting at acidity. Keep the wine for 3–5 years.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2010 Brand Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Mango aromas and flavors give a sense of the sweetness of the wine. It is rich and full bodied, with spice and pepper notes just hinting at acidity. Keep the wine for 3–5 years.
title: Domaine Ehrhart 2010 Brand Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is perfectly balanced dry Chenin. It has just the right amount of richness, aided by a touch of vanilla. The green and white fruits are blended with deceptively soft acidity to give a wine that feels full and ripe in the mouth. Good to drink now, but also worth aging for 3–4 years and more. Screwcap.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2010  Savennières

description: Mango aromas drive this rich wine, full of honey as well as spicy fruits. It is not so much weighty as intense, with a sense of warmth. Now mature and ready to drink, it still retains a youthful fruit character.
title: Louis Sipp 2008 Osterberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Sure, it starts out a bit toasty and cedary, but that wood will surely integrate with the potent plummy, meaty fruit given a few years' time. It's full bodied and a bit coarsely textured for the moment, but finishes long and will clearly benefit from cellaring. Drink 2018–2025.
title: Paul Jaboulet Aîné 2009 Domaine de Saint Pierre  (Cornas)

description: Firmly in the style of the vintage, this is dense, full-bodied Cornas, with plenty of fruit. Intense plum, coffee and black olive notes dominate, while the tannins are ripe and plush. Believe it or not, this is actually drinkable now, yet should age easily through at least 2025.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2009 Les Ruchets  (Cornas)

description: Now in golden maturity, this is a smooth, unctuous and ripe wine. Honey is the dominant character, a perfumed wild flower honey that is layered with intense acidity that lifts the wine in a beautiful way. A sweet wine yes, but one that is so balanced.
title: Domaine des Baumard 2003 Cuvée le Paon Chenin Blanc (Coteaux du Layon)

description: Dominated by ripe Sémillon, this is a rich wine. It has a touch of herbaceousness, but the yellow fruits, pears and stroke of lemon give a full-bodied, rounded feel. Wood aging adds further to the satisfying flavors.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2013 Cuvée des Conti White (Bergerac Sec)

description: Les Cimels is a solid, entry-level Costières de Nîmes blend of Syrah, Carignan and Grenache. Blackberry fruit dominates this full-bodied red, picking up intriguing tarry notes and glancing those with crisp, citrusy acids. Long and mouthwatering on the finish.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2012 Les Cimels Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Heavily wooded, the wine is essentially toast with a touch of fruit. Of course, it is young, and the rich black fruits behind all this smokiness will come through. Drink after 2019.
title: Château de Gaudou 2012 Renaissance Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is a generous, ripe wine, full of red fruits and soft acidity. It's already enjoyable, but will benefit from aging until 2015 to bring out the refreshing fruitiness even more.
title: Château de Corcelles 2012  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Some firm tannins give solid structure and smoky character to this wine, an exotic blend of Merlot, Abouriou and Malbec. The juicy berry fruits are round and full in the mouth. It's a ripe wine, with a solid structure that gives balance to the fruitiness.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2011 La Vieille Eglise Red (Côtes du Marmandais)

description: Typically spicy, this wine is all about intense perfumes. Very soft, ripe and rounded, it will be better as a sweet apéritif than with food.
title: Henri Schoenheitz 2012 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Lively and fresh, it is full of mousse and ripe peach and pear fruits. It has acidity, a light touch of sweetness and a hint of bottle age. Drink now as an apéritif, but it is better with food.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Brut Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Lively and fresh, it is full of mousse and ripe peach and pear fruits. It has acidity, a light touch of sweetness and a hint of bottle age. Drink now as an apéritif, but it is better with food.
title: Pierre Sparr NV Brut Réserve Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: As fresh and fruity as possible, this is a lively wine. Coming in a darkened bottle it looks stylish on a table, although its fragrant red fruits make it even better as an apéritif.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2013 Paparazzi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Some overripe fruit on the nose derives a little more shape from the lemon acidity of the dry palate. The body is slightly dilute but finishes clean.
title: Domaine Fritz Schmitt 2015 Riesling (Alsace)

description: There's a subtlety to the bouquet of this wine, showing dainty scents of yellow apple, just-dried hay and orange peel. The palate offers more intensity and verve, with notes of citrus pith, melon rind and saline that linger softly on the refreshing finish. Enjoy now.
title: Domaine Delsol 2015  Picpoul de Pinet

description: There is an earthy character to this wine. It gives a dry edge to the black fruits and crisp acidity. The wine has the tannins typical of the appellation although it also has a light herbal touch that is less attractive. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Leyre-Loup 2014  Morgon

description: Produced from 20- to 30-year-old vines on terraces above the Lot Valley, the wine is structured and still firm. It has ripe tannins that are contrasted with stylish red fruits shot through with acidity.
title: Château Nozières 2014 Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: With a vineyard planted in the traditional Beaujolais style of individual bushes rather than trained on wires, this is a light, soft and fruity wine. It has attractive tannins and fresh red fruits. Drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Château des Vierres  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This attractive, family-owned estate has produced a fruity, crisp and light wine. With its orange-zest acidity, citrus fruits and a tight, mineral character, it is a light wine—bone dry with just a touch of pepper at the end.
title: Domaine Sarragousse 2015 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Attractively aromatic, this is a crisp blend of Colombard and Sauvignon Blanc from the same area as many of the Armagnac vineyards. It is fruity with a zesty lemon texture and so light and perfumed. It is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2015 White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Attractively aromatic, this is a crisp blend of Colombard and Sauvignon Blanc from the same area as many of the Armagnac vineyards. It is fruity with a zesty lemon texture and so light and perfumed. It is ready to drink now.
title: Domaine de Ménard 2015 White (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Earthy aromas mingle with mandarin peel on the nose. The palate becomes broader with its earthy notes and grainy texture, with some definition from citrus pith. Drink soon.
title: Joseph Cattin 2015 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Fresh and lively, this opens with vibrant scents of crisp green apple, white melon and lime. The palate offers riper flavors of pear, guava and nectarine, while brisk acidity keeps the mouthfeel bright and the finish mouthwatering. Drink now.
title: Jadix 2015  Picpoul de Pinet

description: This entry-level wine from Laurou is spicy and fruity. With a layer of tannins as well as attractive acidity, it is a wine to be drunk young. The aftertaste with its hint of licorice continues the spicy character that comes from the Négrette grape in the blend.
title: Château Laurou 2015 Tradition Red (Fronton)

description: This entry-level wine from Laurou is spicy and fruity. With a layer of tannins as well as attractive acidity, it is a wine to be drunk young. The aftertaste with its hint of licorice continues the spicy character that comes from the Négrette grape in the blend.
title: Château Laurou 2015 Tradition Red (Fronton)

description: Aged in large wood barrels for seven months, the wine is ripe and structured. It also has fine fruitiness, rich tannins and soft acidity. The wine will be better from 2017.
title: Château Gaillard 2015  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Sweet-tasting flavors of black plums and wild strawberries give this wine its initial charm. The tannins provide a firm structure under the attractive surface. It's rich, ripe and already a pleasure.
title: Château Haut Bessac 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Sweet-tasting flavors of black plums and wild strawberries give this wine its initial charm. The tannins provide a firm structure under the attractive surface. It's rich, ripe and already a pleasure.
title: Château Haut Bessac 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Already deliciously fruity, this is a big, ripe, black-fruit-dominated wine. To balance the black currant flavor, there is a fine sense of structure, which offers a dry edge along with final acidity.
title: Château Belgrave 2009 Diane de Belgrave  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Ripe, rich and generous, this has tannins that show the basic structure of the wine, with chocolate and licorice flavors highlighting the wood infuence. At the same time, it has a delicious fruitiness.
title: Château Barde Haut 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: This is an elegant Champagne, with a burgeoning sense of maturity as well as fresh acidity. Flavors of ripe pear are cut with a light touch of lemon while the overall texture is soft and on the sweet side of Brut. It could age a few more years, so drink now and until 2019.
title: Veuve Doussot 2006 Memory Brut  (Champagne)

description: Blanc de Noirs, white Champagne only from red grapes, produces wines with some weight, as here. It makes for a rich, full-blooded Champagne, packed with red fruits while also cut through with intense acidity. The fruitiness gains shape from a zesty texture.
title: Tendil & Lombardi NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Champagne)

description: Already showing some toasty maturity, this blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir is delicate, yeasty and rounded. Coming from northern Burgundy, it has a cool climate feel, textured with orange zest and the crispest acidity. It is ready to drink, although another few years in bottle will improve it even more.
title: Bailly-Lapierre 2011 Egarade  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: This is an austere wine, packed with tannins and tight acidity. The red fruits are right at the back behind the firm structure. A mineral character supports the dusty texture and suggests long-term aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Albert Morot 2012 Cent-Vignes Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Soft and full-bodied, this offers bright apple and citrus fruits layered with toast from wood aging. Under the broad exterior, the wine is developing more tangy, zesty fruits and a tight texture. It needs to age to bring everything together. Drink from 2017.
title: La Chablisienne 2012 Vaillons Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Pale in color, this is dominated by its taut, nervy structure. Crisp red currant and red apple flavors give the fruitiness. A ripe, full-bodied mouthfeel brings out a softer, riper aftertaste.
title: Ruinart NV Brut Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A bright, creamy wine with light acidity and flavors of green fruits, pears and a strong streak of grapefruit.
title: Yvon Mau 2009 Seigneurs de Bergerac Blanc White (Bergerac Sec)

description: A fresh, high-acid wine, with flavors of raspberry and apple. It's crisp, with fruit that is barely ripe. Needs plenty of chilling.
title: Provence Rosé 2009 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: 95-97. Barrel sample. Showing new wood spice, this rich and full-bodied wine also has weighty fruit, with creamy and herbaceous qualities.
title: Château Pape Clément 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 95-97. Barrel sample. A powerful wine with dark and dry tannins. It has a great depth of fruit flavor, with immense and concentrated weight, and a structure that is for long-term aging.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 95-97. Barrel sample. A powerful wine with dark and dry tannins. It has a great depth of fruit flavor, with immense and concentrated weight, and a structure that is for long-term aging.
title: Château Lafite Rothschild 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: 96-98. Barrel sample. The fruit is very pure with a great depth of flavor. This wine has weight, and intense flavors of dark plum and sweet fruit. Impressive.
title: Château Pontet-Canet 2011 Barrel Sample  (Pauillac)

description: Delicate notes of wood-grilled apples, walnut skin and lightly toasted brioche take center stage on this sparkler. Balanced and creamy in the mouth, with a nice streak of ruby red grapefruit pith unfolding on the clean finish.
title: Sieur d'Arques 2007 Toques et Clochers Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Limoux)

description: A Syrah-dominant blend with 20% Grenache and 20% Cinsault, this wine exhibits some greenness to the skin-driven red fruit flavors. Herbal notes of rosemary and thyme sprigs add depth to the nose and mouth, while a touch of mocha graces the clean finish.
title: Le Mas de Bertrand 2008 Le Cinq Montpeyroux Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Balanced, ready-to-drink wine with attractive, ripe red fruits and good acidity. It is fresh, the tannins giving an enjoyable firmness to an otherwise fruity wine.
title: La Croix de Renaud 2009  Bordeaux

description: This intensely fruity wine has richness, yellow fruit flavors and a touch of spice and citrus zest. Its soft aftertaste that makes it immediately attractive.
title: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) 2010 Sélection Prestige  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Now reaching its maturity, this is a wine that shows tannins that have softened into spicy acidity, meaty flavors and a suggestion of wood. It is a dry wine, now ready to drink.
title: Château Tour Rozier 2007  Fronsac

description: Soft wine that is now maturing. It is attractive with its red fruits and light tannins. The end is easy and fresh. Not for aging.
title: Château le Pape 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: A good choice for those who like their rosés light and easy, this pretty wine offers subtle notes of pink peony, red cherry, hard banana and a touch of white chocolate creaminess in the mouth. Enjoy now.
title: Vignobles Jeanjean 2010 Mas Fenouillet Rosé (Faugères)

description: This is the entry-level wine of this estate. It shows a crisp side of Cabernet Franc while keeping all its perfumed character. The wine is structured with young tannins as well which are balanced with acidity and bright red-berry fruits. Drink from 2018.
designation: Le Clos du Château de Parnay
title: Château de Parnay 2014 Le Clos du Château de Parnay  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: Produced from biodynamically grown grapes, this is a ripe smooth wine. Its green fruits and acidity are well in balance with the generous texture. The wine's crispness comes through at the end with a tight lifted aftertaste. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Philippe Gilbert 2015  Menetou-Salon

description: The wine is full of fruit that's soft and smooth. It has a broad ripe texture that is subtly contrasted with the acidity and more zesty character. The wine is refreshing and fruity and ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Rome 2015  Sancerre

description: Aged for six months on its lees, this ripe smooth wine is both rich and crisply fruity. Balanced acidity partners the apricot and ripe pear. It is just ready to drink, although it will be better from 2018.
title: Domaine de l'Hermitage 2015 Première Lune  (Menetou-Salon)

description: The Medieval Sancerre castle (Joan of Arc slept here) was built on the site of an ancient Roman fortress. Now owned by the producers of Grand Marnier liqueur, the vineyard produces an attractive, open style of wine. It has just the right tangy acidity along with delicious ripe apple and citrus fruits. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château de Sancerre 2015  Sancerre

description: Firm and bold, this is a solid wine. Its tannins and ripe berry fruit are upfront, the acidity and fresh character of the vintage in the background. Powered by a dry core, this is a wine that could do with at least five years' aging.
title: Château Lamothe-Cissac 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Haut-Médoc)

description: Firm and bold, this is a solid wine. Its tannins and ripe berry fruit are upfront, the acidity and fresh character of the vintage in the background. Powered by a dry core, this is a wine that could do with at least five years' aging.
title: Château Lamothe-Cissac 2011 Vieilles Vignes  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This nonvintage cuvée is dominated by Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. That gives richness as well as a crisp lemon and tangy orange character. Ripe and full, it's balanced and ready to drink.
title: Collet NV Brut Art Déco  (Champagne)

description: This is a tightly wrought wine, the white fruit flavors given a nervy edge of minerality. Its fruit and acidity are coming into balance, needing further age to fully integrate. Drink from 2018.
title: Collet NV Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: From its cellar in Aÿ, this small négociant buys grapes from a range of villages. This signature wine is soft with a crisp background and delicate acidity. Rounded and full of white fruit on the finish, it's ready to drink.
title: Brimoncourt NV Brut Régence  (Champagne)

description: This is the producer's nonvintage cuvée—a crisp, apple-flavored wine dominated by the softness of Pinot Meunier. It's fruity with an attractive and zesty acidity. A great apéritif-style Champagne.
title: Baron-Fuenté NV Grande Réserve Brut  (Champagne)

description: A soft and fruity style of rosé from a small Aube producer, this is ripe with red berry fruit and bright with acidity and orange zest tang. Dominated by Chardonnay, its color coming from still Pinot Noir wine, it's ready to drink now.
title: Lété-Vautrain NV Brut Royal Rosé  (Champagne)

description: A wine that is so perfumed, consummate pleasure to drink. It is soft as well as rich, the spice packed into a rounded structure. Drink now.
title: Emile Beyer 2009 Tradition Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Rounded, spicy wine with only light acidity and more of the lychee and mango side. It is ripe and generous, hinting at a dry core of firmness.
title: Lucien Albrecht 2009 Cuvée Marie Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Attractive, soft, white-fruit wine, its pear flavors rounded and gentle. This is a perfect apéritif style, easy with light acidity to cut through the ripe fruit.
title: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim 2009 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)
winery: La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim

description: With light spiciness, this is a full-bodied wine, dominated by tropical fruits. It is rich, rounded, soft, with touches of honey.
title: Jean Albrecht 2010 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Relatively lightweight, the wine has soft, stalky tannins and flavors of hedgerow fruits to go with the well-judged layer of smoky wood. It is dry, firm and fresh.
title: Château Vray Croix de Gay 2007  Pomerol

description: A finely made wine, with elegant fruit and tannins, but definitely on the light side. The red berry fruits are soft and juicy, already a pleasure to drink, with only short-term aging.
title: Château Lynch-Moussas 2007  Pauillac

description: Good density here, with tannins that spring from bright berry fruits. The acidity is certainly present, but it has weight behind it, giving potential richness balanced by wood.
title: Château Lieujean 2007  Haut-Médoc

description: There is plenty of wood, both in aromas and to taste. What is worrying is the dominance of the wood over the relatively light fruit character. There are just hints of Cabernet black currants, but then the wood closes in. It needs 3–4 years to come together.
title: Château Fonréaud 2007  Listrac-Médoc

description: A dry, spicy wine, with some good dense tannins. There is some power here, the dark fruits hinting at sweetness, but this is followed by the high acidity typical of the vintage. It should all come together in a year to 18 months.
title: Château Couhins-Lurton 2007  Pessac-Léognan

description: This barrel-fermented blend of Grenache Blanc, Vermentino and Roussanne features hints of toasted hazelnuts, but also plenty of ripe pear flavors and touches of spice and acacia blossom. The texture is lush, the flavors bold, just fading a bit in intensity on the finish.
title: Marrenon 2008 Grand Cuvée White (Luberon)

description: It's said that Viognier is difficult to grow, but then how can bargains such as this continue to exist? For $10, you get truffled pear aromas rounded out by the addition of melon, decent concentration and a long, dusty-minerally finish. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Gournier 2008 Viognier (Vin de Pays des Cévennes)

description: A blend of two different vineyards, this ripe wine is now very mature. It has lost its primary fruitiness and developed toasty spice as well as a more funky, earthy character.
title: Domaine de la Pepière 2009 Cuvée 3  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: This is a beautifully perfumed wine, ripe with black fruits and generous with its tannins and acidity. It comes from a one-acre parcel called Le Vivier which has 70-year-old vines. It is concentrated, dense and with aging potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Yohan Lardy 2015 Le Vivier  (Fleurie)

description: This is a beautifully perfumed wine, ripe with black fruits and generous with its tannins and acidity. It comes from a one-acre parcel called Le Vivier which has 70-year-old vines. It is concentrated, dense and with aging potential. Drink from 2018.
title: Yohan Lardy 2015 Le Vivier  (Fleurie)

description: A vegetal wine that has acidity and rhubarb flavors. It is tight and full of acidity, with a very citrusy aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Joseph Burrier 2012 Château de Beauregard  (Saint-Véran)

description: This soft, open wine has a light fruit character with attractive acidity and a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Jean-Marie Challand 2012 Les Tilles  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Tight, acidic and very crisp, it's propelled forward by lemon zest and grapefruit flavors. It is bright, fruity and light in texture.
title: Pierre André 2012  Saint-Véran

description: Burnt caramel aromas give a wine that has weight, sweetness and packs in the vanilla. It misses out on real fruitiness, giving weight rather than freshness.
title: Domaine Sophie Cinier 2012  Mâcon-Fuissé

description: Tropical in character, this wine has soft acidity and an attractive texture. With ripe mango flavor, it's full in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marie Challand 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Viré-Clessé)

description: Tropical in character, this wine has soft acidity and an attractive texture. With ripe mango flavor, it's full in the mouth and ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marie Challand 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Viré-Clessé)

description: A firm wine that is mainly tannin without a great fruit element. It is dry, tight and hard-edged.
title: Demessey 2011 Les Hâtes  (Santenay)

description: The green fruit flavors dominate this very fresh, crisp wine. It has acidity as much as fruitiness, giving a steely, tight character. Drink now.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2012  Viré-Clessé

description: This tight wine has red fruit acidity without the richness. With its green edge, it's likely to remain full of acidity even as it matures.
title: Pierre André 2011  Ladoix

description: This blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah is a chunky, slightly rustic style of Côtes-du-Rhône. It starts off with tar and herb aromas, then turns plummy and chocolaty on the palate. Drink now–2017.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2012 Linteau Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This blend of 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah is a chunky, slightly rustic style of Côtes-du-Rhône. It starts off with tar and herb aromas, then turns plummy and chocolaty on the palate. Drink now–2017.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2012 Linteau Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: The wine is tight, green and herbal. It has some fruitiness, but that is suppressed by general underripeness. The tannins are hard at the end.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2011  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: This is a generous, rounded and very perfumed wine. Candy and bubble gum flavors give sweetness that contrasts with the acidity.
title: Demessey 2012 Château de Messey Les Crets  (Mâcon-Chardonnay)

description: This wine is missing great depth of flavor. It has bright acidity and hints of peach fruit flavors, but remains dull.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: At first taste, the tannins dominate. Then fresher fruit shows through. The wine is firmly dry, the texture linear, the fruit showing some black currant character.
title: Château Ramafort 2008  Médoc

description: This is a traditional style—emphasizing earthy tannins and spicy fruit and is rough around the edges—but is a wine that would relish being partnered with sausages, salamis and hard cheeses. There is plenty of weight, the acidity coming from minerality and wood.
title: Clos de Gamot 2002 Cuvée des Vignes Centenaires Malbec (Cahors)

description: Intense with acidity and young fruitiness, this wine needs some time. The potential of the white and citrus fruit is there, with an herbaceous character that needs to soften. Drink from late 2015.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Intense with acidity and young fruitiness, this wine needs some time. The potential of the white and citrus fruit is there, with an herbaceous character that needs to soften. Drink from late 2015.
title: Château Buisson-Redon 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Well-crafted and fruity, this has a fresh character that allows room for red berry flavors. It's a ripe wine, keeping freshness while bringing in a warmer, caramel character.
title: Quai de la Lune 2014 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Rounded, soft and smoothly creamy, this is a ripe wine dominated by Pinot Meunier. It's an open wine, fruity and ready to drink.
title: Piot-Sévillano NV Tradition Brut  (Champagne)

description: This crisp, fruity wine has delicious acidity. Gray-pink in color, it is ripe with red berries that also impart attractive freshness. The wine is crisp, tangy and textured at the end.
title: Maison Bouey 2014 Le Rosé Gourmand de Lestruelle Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: If only this wine wasn't extracted so much (which gives bitterness), it would be ripe and fruity. As it is, it's hard to get past the tight, dry tannins. There are hints of juiciness and black currant fruits. It might soften by 2016.
title: Maison Bouey 2012 Château Lestruelle  (Médoc)

description: If only this wine wasn't extracted so much (which gives bitterness), it would be ripe and fruity. As it is, it's hard to get past the tight, dry tannins. There are hints of juiciness and black currant fruits. It might soften by 2016.
title: Maison Bouey 2012 Château Lestruelle  (Médoc)

description: There are flavors of peanuts as well as the more usual white fruits in this wine that is rounded and soft, with gentle acidity. The wine, fresh at the end, is ready to drink.
title: Liebart-Régnier NV Brut  (Champagne)

description: Stalky wine, its black currant fruits tight and still developing. It has a juicy character that comes from the intense youthful acidity and that will blend over the next 4–5 years.
title: Château Dupeyrat Plouget 2010 Cru de Plouget  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: Stalky wine, its black currant fruits tight and still developing. It has a juicy character that comes from the intense youthful acidity and that will blend over the next 4–5 years.
title: Château Dupeyrat Plouget 2010 Cru de Plouget  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: A delightfully clean and fruity wine, the epitome of Provence rosé. It has fresh acidity, crisp lemon and red currant fruit and just a light sprinkling of spice.
title: Château d'Esclans 2012 Whispering Angel Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A solid, ripe, juicy black fruited wine, delicious already with its fragrant fruits. It has structure that supports the attractive surface, giving shape to this lightly textured wine. Keep for 4–5 years, but also drink now.
title: Château de la Croix 2009  Médoc

description: A four-acre parcel of old vines is the source of this dense and rich wine. It has jammy red berry and cherry fruits that are lifted by the mineral texture and acidity. The wine is balanced although it does need to age. Drink from the end of 2017.
title: Terroirs et Talents 2015 Clos de la Brosse  (Saint-Amour)

description: This blend of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 10% Cinsault would be a crowd favorite if more than 700 cases were available in the U.S. The black cherry fruit is punched up by hints of herbs and cracked pepper, there's ample weight but great freshness and zest, and the finish is long and complex, showing off hints of licorice, pepper and dusty earth. Drink now–2020.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Haut de Brun Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This blend of 60% Grenache, 30% Syrah and 10% Cinsault would be a crowd favorite if more than 700 cases were available in the U.S. The black cherry fruit is punched up by hints of herbs and cracked pepper, there's ample weight but great freshness and zest, and the finish is long and complex, showing off hints of licorice, pepper and dusty earth. Drink now–2020.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2014 Haut de Brun Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This wine seems broad across the palate, but not quite as deep as some Condrieus. The fruit is understated, resembling gently toasted marshmallow and maybe a touch of baked pineapple, rather than flamboyant apricot and spice. Plan on serving it with fish or chicken rather than something rich or extravagant.
title: Jean-Luc Colombo 2013 Amour de Dieu  (Condrieu)

description: Ripe perfumed black fruits dominate this cru wine. They float above the firm tannins and concentrated acidity to offer a wine that will become rich and generous as it develops. A touch of pepper and spice adds to the layers of fruit. Drink from 2018
title: Pardon et Fils 2015 Les Mouilles  (Juliénas)

description: Ripe perfumed black fruits dominate this cru wine. They float above the firm tannins and concentrated acidity to offer a wine that will become rich and generous as it develops. A touch of pepper and spice adds to the layers of fruit. Drink from 2018
title: Pardon et Fils 2015 Les Mouilles  (Juliénas)

description: Owned by the Darroze family, the cru wine from this estate is produced by Georges Duboeuf. It is a dense wine with balancing rich black fruits. Its spicy cherry-fruit flavor and rich tannins give a wine that should age further. Drink from 2018.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine des Quatres Vents  (Fleurie)

description: Owned by the Darroze family, the cru wine from this estate is produced by Georges Duboeuf. It is a dense wine with balancing rich black fruits. Its spicy cherry-fruit flavor and rich tannins give a wine that should age further. Drink from 2018.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine des Quatres Vents  (Fleurie)

description: From the south-east facing Côte du Py, this is a powerfully structured wine. It is as full of tannins as of ripe red fruits. The wine with its dense character it likely to age well over several years. Drink from 2018.
designation: Domaine de Javernière Côte du Py
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine de Javernière Côte du Py  (Morgon)

description: This cru estate is owned by the Duboeuf family. The wine has some wood aging that adds to the rich texture while not detracting from the ripe juicy red-cherry fruit. With its tannins, the wine could age, so drink from late 2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Château des Capitans  (Juliénas)

description: This is one of several estates in this cru appellation where Georges Duboeuf makes and markets the wine. It is lightly wood aged to smooth out the ebullient fruits. Rich and with some firm tannins that will develop, it has concentration and a dense texture. Drink from 2018.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Château de Juliénas  (Juliénas)

description: Orange and mandarin flavors mark this warm, full-bodied wine. It's forward and fruity, showing a sweeter character, with vanilla and spice tones. Drink soon.
title: Domaine Rieflé 2008 Steinert Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Spice and cream dominate this attractive wine. With its full flavors of spice and pear, there is a also a hint of flower. An attractive wine that is developing quickly.
title: Domaine Ostertag 2010 Vignoble d'Epfig Riesling (Alsace)

description: Fresh, with an attractive line of acidity that complements the spice and rich texture. It's dry on the finish, remaining crisp and ripe. This is a real food wine.
title: Dopff & Irion 2010 Tradition Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Attractive spicy wine with a lively, lightly spicy character. It is rich without being heavy, showing acidity while also having a smooth texture on the finish.
title: Bott Frères 2010 Cuvée Particulière Muscat (Alsace)

description: Typical Beaune in its round, soft character. If the tannins are not particularly powerful, it still shows a generous nature, with super-ripe fruits supported by some dryness. The finish is jammy, ripe, a salad of red berries.
title: Bouchard Aîné & Fils 2005 Les Marconnets Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This wine seems thin and rather tight. It has as much acidity as it does fruit, and a dry tannic structure. Not a wine for aging.
title: Château Gréteau Médeville 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Light, bright and fruity, this wine is full of citrus acidity and a ripe, herbaceous character. Lively and fresh, it is a Sauvignon-dominated wine.
title: Univitis 2012 Grand Théatre  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Light, bright and fruity, this wine is full of citrus acidity and a ripe, herbaceous character. Lively and fresh, it is a Sauvignon-dominated wine.
title: Univitis 2012 Grand Théatre  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: This wine has a lean side that takes away from the bright acidity and fruitiness. With its berry fruit flavors, it should be rich, but lacks a middle.
title: Château Haut Nadeau 2011 Réserve du Propriétaire  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This wine has a lean side that takes away from the bright acidity and fruitiness. With its berry fruit flavors, it should be rich, but lacks a middle.
title: Château Haut Nadeau 2011 Réserve du Propriétaire  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Structure keeps this firm, dry wine solidly closed. It is tightly wound at this stage, only hinting at a brighter, fruity future. Drink after 2015.
title: Château Pey la Tour 2011  Bordeaux

description: With light toast aromas, this is a wine that shows vanilla from wood aging more than its fruitiness. There is a barnyard edge to it that brings out rusticity. On the finish, acidity does bring some freshness.
designation: Le Grand Rossignol du Château Lamothe Vincent
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2011 Le Grand Rossignol du Château Lamothe Vincent  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: Rich and spicy, this is a fine, dry, peppery Pinot Gris. In the mouth there's weight and ripeness, as well as some fat, yellow fruits. There's a touch of lychee as well, giving an exotic edge to the finish.
title: Rieflé 2006 Pinot Gris Bonheur Convivial Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Rich and spicy, this is a fine, dry, peppery Pinot Gris. In the mouth there's weight and ripeness, as well as some fat, yellow fruits. There's a touch of lychee as well, giving an exotic edge to the finish.
title: Rieflé 2006 Pinot Gris Bonheur Convivial Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A mature, serious wine, showing toasty flavors that are rounding out the fruit. A definite food wine, its richness tempered with a bite of acidity and delicious final crispness.
title: Dopff & Irion NV Cuvée Prestige Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Classic, soft, easy and broad Pinot Blanc. There is an attractive buttery character to go with the peach and lime flavors. The wine is ripe, with pure fruit and a final tang of acidity.
title: Mittnacht Frères 2009 Terre d'Etoiles Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: The aromas of smoky new wood follow through to the wood flavors on the palate. However, it's the powerful sweet black cherry and red berry fruit flavors, layered with fruit tannins and acidity, that are driving this impressive wine. For aging at least six years.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008 Clos des Mouches Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: Beautiful lemon-scented wine, balancing rich butter and apricot flavors with intense, pure acidity. The wine at this stage is toast and fruit, still coalescing into its long-term future.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2008 Clavoillon Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: Very dense wine, its tannins solid and concentrated. The structure is the leader here, with the young fruit showing through as black plum skins and crushed strawberries. This is a firmly tannic wine, needing aging.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2008  Clos de Vougeot

description: Very dense wine, its tannins solid and concentrated. The structure is the leader here, with the young fruit showing through as black plum skins and crushed strawberries. This is a firmly tannic wine, needing aging.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2008  Clos de Vougeot

description: Big, full-bodied wine, the great tannins dominating the underlying red fruit. It's firmly concentrated, intense, a powerhouse of dense texture and obviously a wine that will need aging. Give it 5–6 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2008  Charmes-Chambertin

description: Big, full-bodied wine, the great tannins dominating the underlying red fruit. It's firmly concentrated, intense, a powerhouse of dense texture and obviously a wine that will need aging. Give it 5–6 years.
title: Chanson Père et Fils 2008  Charmes-Chambertin

description: Structured, concentrated, a wine that shows power from both fruit and tannins. The opulent strawberry flavors are paralleled by firm, dry tannins. As the combination comes together, this will become a glorious wine.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Charmes-Chambertin

description: Structured, concentrated, a wine that shows power from both fruit and tannins. The opulent strawberry flavors are paralleled by firm, dry tannins. As the combination comes together, this will become a glorious wine.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2008  Charmes-Chambertin

description: The wine is still young with its crisp red fruits and tense tannins. It is a structured wine, firm with a dry core and still developing its fruitiness. It will need to age a while yet, so drink from 2018.
title: Yohan Lardy 2015 Les Michelons  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Named after the steeply sloping vineyard, the wine is cool, crisp with tight cherry flavors. It is lined with acidity and some tannins. The wine will need another few months to soften out and become richer.
title: Robert Perroud 2015 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: This three-acre parcel has produced a beautiful fruity wine. With red cherry and spice flavors, the wine is perfumed and juicy. Crisp acidity shoots through the attractive fruit to give a wine that is only lightly tannic and ready to drink.
title: Pascal Aufranc 2015 En Rémont Vignes de 1939  (Chénas)

description: This ripe, full, almost toasty wine tastes of tropical fruit and spice, giving it an exotic feel. At the same time, the right amount of acidity acts as a fine balance. This concentrated wine, medium-sweet in style, should be aged for 2–3 years.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2010 Furstentum Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This retains so much freshness, with just a hint of toast showing at the back of a wine that otherwise projects minerality, a tight structure and intense citrus acidity. It should be aged for several more years.
title: Charles Ellner 2002 Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: This retains so much freshness, with just a hint of toast showing at the back of a wine that otherwise projects minerality, a tight structure and intense citrus acidity. It should be aged for several more years.
title: Charles Ellner 2002 Millésime Brut  (Champagne)

description: Showing as much freshness and acidity as the hallmark spice of a Gewürztraminer, this is a white-fruit-dominant wine, poised and elegant, with a touch of minerality. Keep for 2–3 years.
title: André Blanck et ses Fils 2010 Schlossberg Grand Cru Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a lush and satisfying Rivesaltes Ambré, made from 100% White Grenache and aged in oak for seven years. There's a gorgeous rancio quality to the wine with notes of almond and orange rind throughout, framed by aromas and flavors of quince paste, wood-grilled peach, fruit cake and carmelized date. The long finish shows good evolution, transitioning from notes of stone fruit to peach pit and finally ending on a sweet spice accent.
title: Domaine Cazes 1996 Ambré Grenache Blanc (Rivesaltes)

description: Notes of ripe yellow apple play enticingly on the nose. They expand to full force on the palate and fill the mouth with their mellow goodness, supported in this by rich notes of shortbread and wonderful lemon freshness. The bubbles are creamy and disperse the lovely flavors to great effect. This is classy and delicious.
title: Domaine Zinck NV Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: Although this is a nonvintage wine, it is a blend around 2012, hence the number in the name. Dominated by Pinot Noir, this ripe, full-bodied wine has a tangy texture boosted by acidity that contrasts with rich red apple and crisp pear flavors that give richness. Drink now.
title: Lallier NV R.012 Brut  (Champagne)

description: Although this is a nonvintage wine, it is a blend around 2012, hence the number in the name. Dominated by Pinot Noir, this ripe, full-bodied wine has a tangy texture boosted by acidity that contrasts with rich red apple and crisp pear flavors that give richness. Drink now.
title: Lallier NV R.012 Brut  (Champagne)

description: Intense notes of ripe red and baked apples make a strong impression. The palate is rich with the same baked apple along with a touch of honey and gingerbread. The yeasty flavors of autolysis provide an ideal backdrop for this structured, grown-up and classy wine. The finish is totally dry and wonderfully long.
title: Domaine François Schmitt NV Blanc de Noirs Brut Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: This Alliance Bourg co-op wine is packed with minty new-wood aromas, this has the potential to be a smooth, polished wine. The blend is 70% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc. Firm tannins at this stage do not mask the ripe blackberry fruits. Give this wine until 2019 before drinking.
title: Closerie du Bailli 2014 Grande Réserve  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Owner Thierry Valette has been around the Right Bank (the family owned Pavie and owns Troplong Mondot) and, as a consultant, the world. Here he offers a delicious juicy wine with fine tannins and ripe red fruits. It has mint and spice perfumes along with balanced acidity. Drink this attractive wine from 2018.
title: Clos Puy Arnaud 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This vineyard is at one of the highest Castillon points. Big in tannins and also fruit, this is a dense wine. It has a dry core as well as rich blackberry fruits. Concentrated and full, the wine will be seriously worth drinking from 2019.
title: Château Montlandrie 2014  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This Cru Bourgeois estate has produced a structured wine that is still showing strong wood-aging flavors. Toasty as well as ripely fruity, it has firm tannins and good aging potential. The aftertaste is fruity and spicy. Drink from 2019.
title: Château le Pey 2014  Médoc

description: This ripe and spicy wine from the Dop family's 27 acres offers layers of black fruits. It has a concentrated texture and a firm structure that is juicy while dense. With this richness, the wine will develop into a smooth and generous wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut Cabut 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: A ripe, crisp, very fresh Chablis bursting with green fruits, with a light layer of caramel and green herbs. Delicious now.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2006  Chablis

description: In a piece of French wine shorthand, the new appellation of Saint-Bris takes in the old Sauvignon de Saint-Bris wines. The style, though, hasn't changed: an attractive, if rustic type, with crisp gooseberry and grapefruit flavors and a fresh burst of acidity. Screwcap.
title: Simonnet-Febvre 2007 Sauvignon de Saint-Bris  (Saint-Bris)

description: From the recent appellation at the southern end of the Côte de Beaune, this is a light and very fruity wine with little discernible tannin or structure. Red cherries and fresh acidity dominate and the wine should be drunk young.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Clos des Rois Premier Cru  (Maranges)

description: From the recent appellation at the southern end of the Côte de Beaune, this is a light and very fruity wine with little discernible tannin or structure. Red cherries and fresh acidity dominate and the wine should be drunk young.
title: Jean-Luc and Paul Aegerter 2012 Clos des Rois Premier Cru  (Maranges)

description: One of the lesser-known of the many Mâcon appellations, Péronne is close to Clessé. The wine is smooth, ripe and fruity, with a creamed pear and lightly lemon flavor. With a hint of minerality, it could age until 2016.
title: Jaffelin 2013 Les Villages de Jaffelin  (Mâcon-Péronne)

description: Crisp and textured, this offers plenty of fresh apple and red fruit flavors. It's a light, bright wine that's poised and stylish, in a fine apéritif style.
title: Dopff & Irion NV Brut Rosé Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This is fresh, not quite dry and a fine apéritif wine. With its soft texture, apple fruits and light mousse, it's both fruity and crisp, with a rounded, fragrant aftertaste.
title: Ruhlmann NV Signature Brut Sparkling (Crémant d'Alsace)

description: This light-colored wine has a spicy character that points up the tannins as well as the red berry fruits. It has a light feeling, with refreshing acidity that shows strongly at the end. It's ready to drink.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2012 Buissonnier  (Mercurey)

description: This light-colored wine has a spicy character that points up the tannins as well as the red berry fruits. It has a light feeling, with refreshing acidity that shows strongly at the end. It's ready to drink.
title: Vignerons de Buxy 2012 Buissonnier  (Mercurey)

description: In this case, Vieilles Vignes (old vines) only means vines over 20 years. The wine is soft, rounded and full of red cherry fruitiness. Judicious wood aging has rounded the wine out while leaving all its fruit intact. It can be drunk now, but will be better from 2016.
title: Manuel Olivier 2012 Vieilles Vignes  (Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits)
