description: The top wine from Domaine de Cause, it's huge, very dense and concentrated. There is a sense of extraction, showcased by the licorice and dark chocolate flavors. This needs to calm down to give the rich fruits a chance to shine. Give this wine 6–7 years.
title: Domaine de Cause 2009 Notre Dame de Champs Malbec (Cahors)

description: A dark, brooding wine, packed with firm tannins and solid plum-skin and licorice flavors. The wine is dense and complex—a powerful evocation of Malbec—allowing the juicy fruits to merge with the young structure that needs agng for at least 4–5 years.
title: Château Saint-Didier-Parnac 2011 Prieuré de Cénac Malbec (Cahors)

description: This wine from Château Lagrézette is powerful and dense in its own right. It has black, juicy, tar-like flavors with tannins concentrated into a dry, dark core. Blended with a small proportion of Merlot, there is just a touch of softness which will allow the wine to mature in the next 2–3 years.
title: Château Lagrézette 2010 Château Chevaliers Lagrézette Malbec (Cahors)

description: A super-rich wine, almost over the top in its honeyed intensity. It is opulent, generous, packed with ripe yellow fruits, mango and pineapple. The wine is so rich that it is hard to find the acidity, but it is there in the orange marmalade flavor right at the end.
title: Château la Varière 2009 Les Melleresses  (Bonnezeaux)

description: A super-rich wine, almost over the top in its honeyed intensity. It is opulent, generous, packed with ripe yellow fruits, mango and pineapple. The wine is so rich that it is hard to find the acidity, but it is there in the orange marmalade flavor right at the end.
title: Château la Varière 2009 Les Melleresses  (Bonnezeaux)

description: Complex and concentrated, this blend of Cabernets Franc and Sauvignon has weight and richness. The red and black fruits are layered with firm, dry tannins that promise aging. It is rich, the Cabernet Franc showing its characteristic smoky perfumes. Keep for 3–4 years.
title: Château la Varière 2010 Vieilles Vignes Cabernet Franc-Cabernet Sauvignon (Anjou Villages Brissac)

description: While this is certainly herbaceous, it also carries richer fruit flavors like apricots and melon to go with the grapefruit acidity. That gives it a rounded texture, full in the mouth and with a touch of minerality. Age this impressive wine another 1–2 years.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2010 Cuvée Silex  (Sancerre)

description: A floral wine, full of ripe black-cherry fruit and with a firm structure that sustains the wine. This cru wine is rich, still developing, still with enough tannins and acidity to allow it to age further. Drink this attractive wine from mid-2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Flower Label  (Fleurie)

description: Full of crisp fruit, this cru wine is bright with red-berry flavors. It is light and with a cool character that comes from the high altitude of the vineyards. There is an edgy texture that keeps the wine together. Drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Flower Label  (Chiroubles)

description: This cru wine comes from a 44-acre vineyard with 50-year-old vines supplied by one of Duboeuf's regular growers. It is structured and dense, perhaps too dense with its heavy dry tannins. The wine will need time. Drink from 2019.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine Mont Chavy  (Morgon)

description: This cru wine comes from a 44-acre vineyard with 50-year-old vines supplied by one of Duboeuf's regular growers. It is structured and dense, perhaps too dense with its heavy dry tannins. The wine will need time. Drink from 2019.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine Mont Chavy  (Morgon)

description: This is a romantic conjunction of names. The cru wine is silky and smooth, with integrated tannins and red-cherry fruit. It is bright and crisply textured, ready to drink from mid-2017.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2015 Domaine du Paradis  (Saint-Amour)

description: From an estate enveloping a magnificent medieval castle, this is a lightly structured cru wine with red cherry and berry flavors. It has a backdrop of tannins and acidity that give it structure. The wine is ripe and fruity at the end and ready to drink.
title: Château de la Terrière 2015  Brouilly

description: From an estate enveloping a magnificent medieval castle, this is a lightly structured cru wine with red cherry and berry flavors. It has a backdrop of tannins and acidity that give it structure. The wine is ripe and fruity at the end and ready to drink.
title: Château de la Terrière 2015  Brouilly

description: Still toasty, this is a fruity, spicy wine. Firm tannins form the backdrop to the red berry fruits and fresh acidity. It will develop attractively over the next few years, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Maison Noble 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This blend of Sauvignon Blanc, Muscadelle and Sémillon is round, full and softly textured. White fruits, spice and fresh acidity are already well integrated. The end is tangy with lemon zest flavors. Drink now. The estate has been in the Forcato family since 1950.
title: Château Lary 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This blend of Sauvignon Blanc, Muscadelle and Sémillon is round, full and softly textured. White fruits, spice and fresh acidity are already well integrated. The end is tangy with lemon zest flavors. Drink now. The estate has been in the Forcato family since 1950.
title: Château Lary 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Very crisp and fruity, this is a light, bright and refreshing wine, with a tangy edge that gives texture. Apples and a strong citrus character promise a wine that will round out over the next few months. Drink from late 2015.
title: Château Guichot 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: With its dark pink color, this is more red than rosé. It has a tannic edge, along with red plum acidity and fruits. It's clean, allowing space for freshness while also being structured.
title: Château de Parenchère 2014  Bordeaux Clairet

description: This wine is smooth while keeping all of its fresh wits about it. Citrus, red apple and quince flavors give both spice and ripe fruits. With its lively, tangy aftertaste, it does need to broaden out, so drink from 2016.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A property owned by Château Bel Air, Ouvrard has produced a lightly fruity wine that has fresh red berry fruits and just the right amount of acidity. Light tannins act as a backbone to the general fruitiness of this wine.
title: Château Bel Air 2012 Château Ouvrard  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: A property owned by Château Bel Air, Ouvrard has produced a lightly fruity wine that has fresh red berry fruits and just the right amount of acidity. Light tannins act as a backbone to the general fruitiness of this wine.
title: Château Bel Air 2012 Château Ouvrard  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This steely, tangy wine has a strongly mineral character—tight, taut and crisp. Green fruits, citrus and a grassy character dominate. It is ready to drink. This is an unusual 75% Sémillion and 25% Sauvignon Blanc blend that tends to round out the taste.
title: Château Anniche 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: An exceptional value for a Bordeaux, this is ripe, full and fruity. Smoky tannins and juicy black currant flavors are bright and generous. It will be ready to drink from 2016.
title: Cave du Marmandais 2014 Murets de Mez  (Bordeaux)

description: This is a soft, gentle Pinot with a plum jelly flavor derived from a touch of sweetness in its fruit. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010 Bourricot Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This is a soft, gentle Pinot with a plum jelly flavor derived from a touch of sweetness in its fruit. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2010 Bourricot Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: Vanilla and toasted almond aromas evolve into a scent of tarte tatin. Full bodied, with warm alcohol, this shows medium fruit concentration. The acidity is borderline in its balance, leaning to flabiness. The tactile heat on the medium finish is distracting.
title: Vignobles Garrigae 2010 Seigneurie de Peyrat Tradition Chardonnay-Viognier (Pays d'Oc)

description: Soft and fruity with some sweetness, this red-fruit-flavored wine is rounded and warm, crispened by acidity.
title: Barton & Guestier 2011 Bistro Pinot Noir (Ile de Beauté)

description: With only the lightest texture, this wine almost tastes like a white wine. It has plenty of citrus character, partnered with apple and green-fruit flavors. At the end, look out for the bite of tannin that gives it a more rosé character.
title: Château Laubès 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a strawberry-pink-colored wine with candied flavors balanced by acidity. It is fruity, crisp and light in character.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is herbal and ripely fruited all at once, smelling like sweet pea, carnation and baby powder combined with tones of plum and cherry. The fruity notes continue through to the medium-weight palate, though they're short-lived.
title: Maison Nicolas 2015 Rosé (Gard)

description: This is herbal and ripely fruited all at once, smelling like sweet pea, carnation and baby powder combined with tones of plum and cherry. The fruity notes continue through to the medium-weight palate, though they're short-lived.
title: Maison Nicolas 2015 Rosé (Gard)

description: A light, easy and cheery selection, with direct aromas and flavors of sweet cherry, red raspberry and strawberry. The mouthfeel is soft and approachable, with virtually no tannins and a clean, short finish. Drink up.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Pinot Noir (Pays d'Oc)

description: A very drinkable, light and easy to like Merlot, this offers ripe notes of black plum, cherry and berry on the nose and mouth, with a faint hint of milk chocolate in the background. The soft mouthfeel and fruity palate finish short, but clean.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Merlot (Pays d'Oc)

description: The caramel character of this wine is less attractive than its background of red fruits. The two sides need to come into balance for it to work completely, so wait until late 2016.
title: Producta Vignobles 2015 Cabane aux Oiseaux Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This pale-colored wine has a light, perfumed character. A blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, it is an attractive, bone-dry rosé, ripe with strawberry fruits, that will be best with food.
title: Château Léon 2015 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Almost white in color, this wine is fruity and crisp with lemon and lime flavors. A light hint of a tannic structure also suggests minerality. The aftertaste is bright and packed with acidity.
title: Château Côte Montpezat 2015 Le Canon de Côte Montpezat Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This is a very simple, friendly, fresh and lively white—easy to drink and enjoy with its lemony freshness. It's ideal for a party.
title: Famille Hauller 2015 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A softly earthy tone is all the nose gives away. The palate is brisk, neutral and has both freshness and a slightly bitter edge. Drink soon.
title: Leon Beyer 2014 Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A pleasant mix of dark berries and fruit lead the bouquet of this friendly wine, with solid notes of black cherry, blackberry and boysenberry throughout. A hint of spice adds interest to the finish, with medium-light tannins and ample acidity resulting in good overall balance.
title: Le Petit Cochonnet 2015 Cabernet Sauvignon (Pays d'Oc)

description: This wine is tangy and textured with light tannins, a bite of citrus acidity and plenty of fruit. It's bright and has a juicy, lively aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Bonhur 2015 Château Terres Douces Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine is tangy and textured with light tannins, a bite of citrus acidity and plenty of fruit. It's bright and has a juicy, lively aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Vignobles Bonhur 2015 Château Terres Douces Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Made from the local Sciaccarellu grape, this is a delicious, light and perfumed wine. It has tight acidity to go with the red currant flavors and the crisp texture. The wine is poised and refreshing.
title: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté 2015 Rosé (Ile de Beauté)
winery: Union de Vignerons de l'Île de Beauté

description: Friendly apple fruit sits easily on nose and palate before a refreshing, clean finish. This is an easy, fruit-driven white ideal for a party.
title: Dopff & Irion 2014 Cuvée René Dopff Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: A complex wine, full of tight textures, apple skins and mineral acidity. This is a wine for aging, its wood character beautifully judged, rounding out the crisp final texture. Drink from 2016.
title: Damien et Romain Bouchard 2011 Montée de Tonnerre Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: Givry is one of the unsung values in Burgundy. This ripe and structured wine shows why. It has weight, a firm texture and red plum and strawberry fruit flavors. All these elements are held together by a dark sense of tannin and fine acidity.
title: Antonin Rodet 2010  Givry

description: Coming from the Basque country, this blend of Cabernet Franc and Tannat is both perfumed and firmly structured. It is a solid wine, showing its wood aging while bringing out great ripe berry fruits. Drink from 2014.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2011 Donibane Red (Irrouléguy)

description: This is vibrant and expressive, with upfront purple-flower fragrances of violet and iris mixed with fruity tones of boysenberry and raspberry sauce. The crushed-silk texture offers medium tannins, ample acidity and skin-driven fruit flavors. Roasted coffee bean and sweet smoke accents mark the lingering finish.
title: Les Villages de Terroir Catalan 2010 Red (Côtes du Roussillon Villages Caramany)

description: This is a concentrated, firm and tannic wine. It has a structured feel from Chiroubles, which are the highest vineyards in Beaujolais. With its black fruits, dark tannins and concentrated texture, it could certainly age for 2–3 years, although it is ready to drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine des Pontheux  (Chiroubles)

description: This is a concentrated, firm and tannic wine. It has a structured feel from Chiroubles, which are the highest vineyards in Beaujolais. With its black fruits, dark tannins and concentrated texture, it could certainly age for 2–3 years, although it is ready to drink now.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2011 Domaine des Pontheux  (Chiroubles)

description: Ripe, jammy black-fruit sensations dominate the nose and mouth of this wine, with lush, expressive notes of blackberry, black raspberry and boysenberry preserves. The texture is like crushed satin, with medium-plus yet fine tannins and a cocoa-kissed finish. Enjoyable now, but should develop additional complexities after 2016.
title: Domaine Cabirau 2011 Serge & Nicolas Red (Maury Sec)

description: Ripe, jammy black-fruit sensations dominate the nose and mouth of this wine, with lush, expressive notes of blackberry, black raspberry and boysenberry preserves. The texture is like crushed satin, with medium-plus yet fine tannins and a cocoa-kissed finish. Enjoyable now, but should develop additional complexities after 2016.
title: Domaine Cabirau 2011 Serge & Nicolas Red (Maury Sec)

description: Big, dense wine, with dusty tannins and ripe red plum fruits. The wine is concentrated, fruity while also structured. It is already balanced, the acidity giving freshness, the texture showing the delicious ripe character of the vintage.
title: Château Tour de Lagarde 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A wine from a château that is still finding its form . It is soft, open, with attractive juicy red fruits and black currants, ready to drink soon.
title: Château Soutard 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Dominated by Merlot, this is a fruity and rich wine, rounded, ripe and spicy. It has density and weight, layered with dusty rich tannins. With its spice, blackberry acidity and chunky feel, it is already drinkable, but will age over several years.
title: Château Laforge 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Dominated by Merlot, this is a fruity and rich wine, rounded, ripe and spicy. It has density and weight, layered with dusty rich tannins. With its spice, blackberry acidity and chunky feel, it is already drinkable, but will age over several years.
title: Château Laforge 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: The wine has weight, is warm and spicy, with bold fruit flavors. A fine wine from Angludet, it is ripe, the wood judiciously balanced, finishing with tight acidity.
title: Château d'Angludet 2009  Margaux

description: A wine that shows rich blackberry fruits, already rounded and soft. It has a tannic structure that is embedded in the fruit, along with spice, toast and a firm finish. An ageworthy wine.
title: Château Liversan 2009  Haut-Médoc

description: Dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon, the wine is packed with dusty tannins. Mint flavors show the wood aging while black currant boosts the fruit side of the wine. It is rich, its fruit very ripe yet also elegant.
title: Château Lieujean 2009  Haut-Médoc

description: Darkly tannic wine, packed with dryness. The result is firm at this stage, always likely to be full of tannins, but there is delicious fruit under this dryness.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2009  Pomerol

description: Darkly tannic wine, packed with dryness. The result is firm at this stage, always likely to be full of tannins, but there is delicious fruit under this dryness.
title: Château Lafleur-Gazin 2009  Pomerol

description: Ripe, full-bodied white Graves, its flavors coming from tropical fruit, rich and complex. Good wood underscores the yellow fruit flavors and ripeness. Ready to drink, but could also age 2–3 years.
title: Château Haut-Peyrous 2009  Graves

description: Ripe, full-bodied white Graves, its flavors coming from tropical fruit, rich and complex. Good wood underscores the yellow fruit flavors and ripeness. Ready to drink, but could also age 2–3 years.
title: Château Haut-Peyrous 2009  Graves

description: Spice and ripe fruit, with attractive tannins and a soft texture. This wine is open, generous, rich and packed with black currant fruitiness. Give this wine another 2–4 years, but it could well be drinkable sooner.
title: Château Mayne Vieil 2011 Cuvée Aliénor  (Fronsac)

description: The gravel soil on this Lévèque family property makes a great place to grow white grapes. A 50/50 blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, this fresh wine suggests the ability to age. It is fruity now, hinting at apricots as well as citrus. It can be drunk now for its freshness, although wait until late 2016 for it to develop greater depths.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2013  Graves

description: The gravel soil on this Lévèque family property makes a great place to grow white grapes. A 50/50 blend of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, this fresh wine suggests the ability to age. It is fruity now, hinting at apricots as well as citrus. It can be drunk now for its freshness, although wait until late 2016 for it to develop greater depths.
title: Château de Chantegrive 2013  Graves

description: Grown inland, away from the sea's influence, this wine has a full-bodied character. Acidity cuts through the ripe red fruits and caramel and spice flavor. The wine is rich and full in the mouth, soft at the end.
title: Bernard Magrez 2015 Les Muraires Douce Vie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Grown inland, away from the sea's influence, this wine has a full-bodied character. Acidity cuts through the ripe red fruits and caramel and spice flavor. The wine is rich and full in the mouth, soft at the end.
title: Bernard Magrez 2015 Les Muraires Douce Vie Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a medium-bodied, spicy rendering of Syrah. Cherries, herbs and spice all mingle easily, while the silky texture is its calling card. Drink now–2023.
title: Michel & Stéphane Ogier 2012 d'Ogier Syrah (Vin de France)

description: This organic wine, produced with a natural and biodynamic approach, is an interesting blend of 30% Syrah, 20% Grenache, 10% Mourvèdre, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, 10% Malbec and 10% Marselan. It offers pronounced earthy characteristics, as well as a citrusy kick (like tangerine oil) to the blueberry and blackberry fruit core. The mouthfeel is creamy and velvety, with plush tannins and lingering baking-spice flavors.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2014 Kosmos Organic Grapes Red (Vin de France)

description: Ripe pear on nose and palate is the central theme on this broad-shouldered and richly textured wine. A dollop of sweetness is countered with fresh lime acidity that concludes in ripe accord.
title: Domaine Zinck 2013 Terroir Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Ripe pear on nose and palate is the central theme on this broad-shouldered and richly textured wine. A dollop of sweetness is countered with fresh lime acidity that concludes in ripe accord.
title: Domaine Zinck 2013 Terroir Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is fresh, perfumed with a juicy red-fruit character. It offers red cherries, with a soft texture and acidity. The great fruitiness leads to a bright, crisp aftertaste.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: This wine is fresh, perfumed with a juicy red-fruit character. It offers red cherries, with a soft texture and acidity. The great fruitiness leads to a bright, crisp aftertaste.
title: Joseph Drouhin 2012  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: Rounded, almost luscious fruitiness is at the core of this easy wine. Lychee, lemon, peach and apricot scented with rose petals on a rich palate close with orange peel freshness.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2014 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Rounded, almost luscious fruitiness is at the core of this easy wine. Lychee, lemon, peach and apricot scented with rose petals on a rich palate close with orange peel freshness.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2014 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Lots of apple tones, some rounded, some tart, are coralled into a core of bright, lemony freshness on this simple, refreshing and dry Riesling. This is a lovely, easy and versatile wine with enlivening spikes of acidity.
title: Jean-Baptiste Adam 2013 Réserve Riesling (Alsace)

description: The small area of Pez is one of the top sites in Saint-Estèphe, with many highly rated chateaus. This is one. New wood aging shows strongly at this stage, although so does the fruit. That gives a structured wine, firm and also full of blackberry fruit flavors. The future is good for this wine, so drink from 2018.
title: Château Tour de Pez 2012  Saint-Estèphe

description: New wood shows strongly in this perfumed, Merlot-dominated wine. It is structured and still very tight and tannic at this stage. The chalk soil of the vineyard has given a strongly mineral character to the wine. That, along with the tannins, gives powerful support to the black currant fruits. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Teyssier 2012  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: New wood shows strongly in this perfumed, Merlot-dominated wine. It is structured and still very tight and tannic at this stage. The chalk soil of the vineyard has given a strongly mineral character to the wine. That, along with the tannins, gives powerful support to the black currant fruits. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Teyssier 2012  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: Big, firm tannins dominate this structured wine. New wood aging shows, giving a very dry feeling. It's also rich and full in the mouth, packed with ripe black plum and berry flavors. It's going to balance well and richly. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Rollan de By 2012  Médoc

description: Big structure underlies this wine, very firm and dark. It has layers of dry tannins, big fruit and concentrated structure. The dryness at the heart of the wine will allow it to age well with its powerful structure and juicy aftertaste. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Picque Caillou 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: From the northern end of the Haut-Médoc region, close to Saint-Estèphe, this dark-hued wine is still very structured. Smoky wood-aging flavors give complexity that balances the ripe black currant fruitiness. It's still developing, so don't drink before 2018.
title: Château Larrivaux 2011  Haut-Médoc

description: This very complete wine offers dark tannins, ripe berry fruits and a velvet texture. It's rich, relying on blackberry and black plum flavors and a dense structure. Mouth-filling, it delivers delicious fragrant acidity at the end. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Laforge 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: From vines owned by Château Giscours but outside the Margaux appellation, this ripe and structured wine is a great success. Its rich berry and black currant fruits are pushed forward by the firm tannins that are so perfectly judged. It's a wine to enjoy soon, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Giscours 2012 Le Haut-Médoc de Giscours  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This is an earthy effort that shows the tough soil of Cahors in its minerally, tight character. Dark in color, this is laced with intense acids and firm tannins.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2011 Pigmentum Malbec (Cahors)

description: This has surprisingly structured fruits and firm tannins for a Nouveau, and it still maintains a juicy cherry flavor and ripe acidity. The finish has a tangy, textured character.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2012 Nouveau  (Beaujolais)

description: A classically fruity Beaujolais from the south of the region, this is packed with bitter cherry and ripe raspberry flavors. The tannins are soft—plentiful enough to lend structure. It is delicious, juicy and ready to drink.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2011 Les Griottes  (Beaujolais)

description: From an estate in the Entre-Deux-Mers region, this wine is firm and concentrated, packed with ripe tannins and juicy blackberry fruit. Dense, with dusty tannins, it is smooth and polished in texture.
title: Château Marac 2010  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This tastes bone dry, with a caramel note that's followed by light, bright notes of red berry and apple. The finish is crisp and tight.
title: Château de Pizay 2011 Rosé d'Une Nuit Gamay (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Based in Burgundy, this producer understands Chardonnay. That's why this wine is so finely balanced, with a ripe and perfumed character and a warm, full aftertaste. Drink now.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2016 Tramier Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: Consistently the top showing wine from the Le Val range, this is ripe and rounded, with a creamy texture and a toasty, spicy touch from light wood aging. Drink now.
title: Vinadeis 2016 Le Val Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This is all light fruit and crisp acidity. Bright and light, brimming with citrus and apples, the wine is ready to drink. It comes from the western end of the Muscadet vineyards near the Lac de Grand-Lieu.
title: Domaine les Hautes Noëlles 2016 Les Parcelles Sur Lie  (Muscadet Côtes de Grandlieu)

description: This has a soft texture that just allows room for some crisp apple flavors. Otherwise, it is a smooth rounded wine. Its fruitiness and its acidity are part and parcel of this ripe wine. Drink now.
title: Domaine Girard 2016 Benoît Girard  (Sancerre)

description: This wine comes from a large family-owned estate on the island's east coast. It's loaded with bright fruit, crisp acidity and a rounded, ripe red berry-inflected aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine Campu Vecchiu 2016 Rosé (Corse)

description: Smooth and soft, this is a warm wine, showing richness as well as a lightly rustic character that will disappear as the wine ages. It has fine tannins, layered with crisp acidity and a stalky, spicy texture. Drink now or keep until 2016.
title: Lionel Osmin & Cie 2012 Red (Gaillac)

description: A delicate, crisp, very pure wine. It has perfumes of white flowers, which continue with the addition of ripe pear and lime. Crisp at the end, for drinking now, but also keep until 2017.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: A delicate, crisp, very pure wine. It has perfumes of white flowers, which continue with the addition of ripe pear and lime. Crisp at the end, for drinking now, but also keep until 2017.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2011 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: A rich wine, full of black fruits, ripe tannins and juicy acidity. It's powerful and structured, showing a mineral texture, bold acidity and ample fruitiness.
title: Signé Vigneron 2012 Domaine de la Croix Rouge  (Juliénas)

description: The small enclave of Buzet makes wines in a Bordeaux style, with black currant fruitiness and some firm tannins. This wine, now aging well, shows ripe juicy fruits, a solid dry core and refreshing, crisp acidity at the end.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château Tournelles Red (Buzet)

description: The small enclave of Buzet makes wines in a Bordeaux style, with black currant fruitiness and some firm tannins. This wine, now aging well, shows ripe juicy fruits, a solid dry core and refreshing, crisp acidity at the end.
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château Tournelles Red (Buzet)

description: Very dark, structured wine, with coffee as well as fruit flavors. The wood comes through firmly producing a solid, very dry character. The more juicy black currant fruits are still to show well. So wait to drink until 2015.
designation: Domaine de la Ferté Premier Cru Servoisine
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Domaine de la Ferté Premier Cru Servoisine  (Givry)

description: Very dark, structured wine, with coffee as well as fruit flavors. The wood comes through firmly producing a solid, very dry character. The more juicy black currant fruits are still to show well. So wait to drink until 2015.
designation: Domaine de la Ferté Premier Cru Servoisine
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Domaine de la Ferté Premier Cru Servoisine  (Givry)

description: A smooth and rounded wine, its ripe plum and blueberry flavors well integrated into the soft tannins and sweet acidity. Drinkable now, but worth waiting for two more years.
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Château de Chamirey  (Mercurey)

description: Full-bodied wine with ripe pear and red apple flavors, laced with delicate acidity. It's an elegant wine, a fine balance with a more mineral, tight texture as a counterpoint. Drink from 2014.
title: Domaines Devillard 2011 Château de Chamirey  (Mercurey)

description: Fresh red fruits are smoothed out with caramel and spice flavors that give a ripe feel to this wine. It's light and ready to drink.
title: Le Roi des Pierres 2014 Rosé (Sancerre)

description: Attractive, simply fruity Chenin Blanc, this is a wine for drinking now. It is full of nutty flavors and apple acidity, with just a touch of minerality to give the wine some tension.
title: Cave de Saumur 2014 Les Pouches  (Saumur)

description: Attractive, simply fruity Chenin Blanc, this is a wine for drinking now. It is full of nutty flavors and apple acidity, with just a touch of minerality to give the wine some tension.
title: Cave de Saumur 2014 Les Pouches  (Saumur)

description: This soft, gentle sparkling wine is fresh with raspberry fruits and acidity at the end. Drink as an apéritif.
title: Château Saint-Pierre NV Saint-Pierre Rosé Brut Sparkling (Vin Mousseux)

description: With plenty of weight to support the ripe fruits, this is a balanced, perfumed wine. It has structure and tannins, along with fresh black currant flavors in the 80/20 Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon blend. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roc Montalon 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: With plenty of weight to support the ripe fruits, this is a balanced, perfumed wine. It has structure and tannins, along with fresh black currant flavors in the 80/20 Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon blend. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Roc Montalon 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine is light and fruity, well balanced with plenty of red berry flavors and only light tannins. It will be fresh and ready to drink from late 2016. The 30-acre vineyard on one of the appellation's highest spots was bought in 2009 by Denis Durantou, the owner of Château l'Église Clinet in Pomerol.
title: Château Montlanderie 2013  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is structured although it does have plenty of ripe and full of berry fruits. Drink from 2017. The blend includes 50% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon and 10% Cabernet Franc.
title: Château Les Hauts de Palette 2012  Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine has ripe red fruit flavors, a dry core, balanced tannins and plenty of acidity at the end. Drink now. The Maurin family's organic vineyards have all permitted grapes in Bordeaux, which is a good thing In a difficult vintage. This blend is Merlot (60%), Carmenère (15%), Petit Verdot (15%) and Malbec (10%).
title: Château la Croix de Roche 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This wine has ripe red fruit flavors, a dry core, balanced tannins and plenty of acidity at the end. Drink now. The Maurin family's organic vineyards have all permitted grapes in Bordeaux, which is a good thing In a difficult vintage. This blend is Merlot (60%), Carmenère (15%), Petit Verdot (15%) and Malbec (10%).
title: Château la Croix de Roche 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Made 50/50 from Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvigon, this dry, orange-pink-colored wine has an appreciable amount of tannin as well as plenty of fruit. Acidity and ripe raspberries show strongly, as well as crisp final acidity. Drink now.
title: Château de la Roulerie 2014 La Camélias  (Rosé de Loire)

description: Ripe, elegant wine, balancing fresh currant and red plum fruits against a mineral, dry structure. The acidity, the pure fruits and the solid tannins all work harmoniously together.
title: Château Dutruch Grand Poujeaux 2005  Moulis-en-Médoc

description: Light in color, this is a fruity, softly tannic and lightweight wine. It brings out red fruits that are now maturing, giving spice and a touch of pepper with final acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine Robert Klingenfus 2010 Signature Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: 86-88 Barrel sample. Despite its initial edge of bitterness, this develops as a dense wine, packed with dark high toast and blackberry jelly flavors. The final bite of high extract spoils the finish.
title: Château Malescasse 2008 Barrel sample  (Haut-Médoc)

description: 86-88 Barrel sample. Firm, with a bitter, tight edge, this has high acidity, spice, and a tight layer of tannins. For a second wine, this is not that accessible.
title: La Chapelle de Potensac 2008 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 86-88 Barrel sample. Firm, with a bitter, tight edge, this has high acidity, spice, and a tight layer of tannins. For a second wine, this is not that accessible.
title: La Chapelle de Potensac 2008 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: 86-88 Barrel sample An aroma that is almost port-like in its sweetness. To taste, the structure is lost in a swathe of ripeness that covers the fruit.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2008 Barrel sample  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: 86-88 Barrel sample. Densely structured wine, all rich plums and berry fruit flavors. There is a strong amount of wood, but it is the juicy, just green, character of the wine which is most prominent.
title: Château la Tour de By 2008 Barrel sample  (Médoc)

description: This rich wine balances ripe yellow fruits with intense citrus acidity in a harmonious whole. Its structure is laden with minerality, toast and a smooth, delicious creamy aftertaste.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2009 Les Pucelles Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: While the aromas of this young wine reveal considerable toast, on the palate the wine brings forward the ripe apricot and mango flavors to go with that wood. As it matures, these elements will coalesce with the taut, tense mineral texture into an superb, ageworthy terroir-driven wine.
title: Domaine Leflaive 2009 Les Combettes Premier Cru  (Puligny-Montrachet)

description: At this stage, the wine is all dark structure and very firm. It will need time to develop its full potential as an intensely rich wine. Concentrated and firm, it is powered by tannins as well as sweet red fruits. So age for five years at least.
title: Louis Jadot 2009 Petite Chapelle Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: At this stage, the wine is all dark structure and very firm. It will need time to develop its full potential as an intensely rich wine. Concentrated and firm, it is powered by tannins as well as sweet red fruits. So age for five years at least.
title: Louis Jadot 2009 Petite Chapelle Premier Cru  (Gevrey-Chambertin)

description: The mellowness of baked apple envelops all other aromas. While the baked apple is also apparent on the palate, it is pulled into sharp focus by fresh, lively and bright lemon acidity.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Collection Riesling (Alsace)

description: With a good structure, this is a solid wine from a small vineyard. It is dense with tannins as well as dark berry fruits and fresh acidity at the end. The wine will age well over the next few years, so drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2012 Les Champs Claude  (Santenay)

description: With a good structure, this is a solid wine from a small vineyard. It is dense with tannins as well as dark berry fruits and fresh acidity at the end. The wine will age well over the next few years, so drink from 2017.
title: Henri de Villamont 2012 Les Champs Claude  (Santenay)

description: Rounded rose and honey notes with inflections of apple and Mirabelle are cut very pleasingly by the citric freshness of tangerine peel. This is easy drinking, medium bodied and aromatic.
title: Paul Blanck 2014 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Generous, sweet pear fruit tumbles out over palate and throat, held carefully in check by fresh zestiness. This is about easy fruit and simple pleasure, held in beautiful balance. Drink soon.
title: Lucien Albrecht 2014 Cuvée Romanus Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: While the nose gives little away here apart from the slightest lemon flavors, the palate is lightly textured and shows straitlaced lemon freshness with bright rays of zesty fruit. It's an ideal, refreshing apéritif for warm summer days.
title: Sipp Mack 2014 Tradition Riesling (Alsace)

description: A year older than the other rosés tasted for this report, this is mossy and developed, yet retains a hint of red berries. It's earthy, chocolaty and rich, with along, lingering, savory finish. Drink up.
title: E. Guigal 2015  Tavel

description: A year older than the other rosés tasted for this report, this is mossy and developed, yet retains a hint of red berries. It's earthy, chocolaty and rich, with along, lingering, savory finish. Drink up.
title: E. Guigal 2015  Tavel

description: A fruity wine with soft tannins that is ready to drink. It has banana, red cherry and light spice flavors, finished off with attractive acidity.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2014 Collection  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: A fruity wine with soft tannins that is ready to drink. It has banana, red cherry and light spice flavors, finished off with attractive acidity.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2014 Collection  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: Too alcoholic for its own good, the wine is full bodied and heavy. It has tannins, superripe black fruits while missing structure and acidity. It is developing fast and will be ready to drink from 2017.
title: L. Tramier & Fils 2015 Collection  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: The wine is lean for the vintage, tight and with an austere structure. Its tannins and juicy red fruits are in the background. The aftertaste is dry and firm.
title: Château Kalon Nodoz 2012 Carpe Diem  (Côtes de Bourg)

description: Smooth and rich, this has superripe Merlot. It has soft, jammy red-fruit flavors and tannins that are enveloped by the opulent texture. The tannins should allow the wine to age over 3–6 years.
title: Horeau-Beylot 2010 Château la Fleur Poitou  (Lussac Saint-Émilion)

description: One of the small Sauvignon Blanc areas close to Sancerre, Menetou-Salon produces a light, crisp and herbal style of wine. This fits that bill well, its freshness contained within the flavors of hedgerow fruits and tangy acids.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2010 Côtes de Morogues  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This shows the rich density of Merlot in 2009, giving a solid structure, with dried fruit and red berry flavors and a concentrated line of tannins. Big and dense, this is ready to age.
title: Château La Fleur Plaisance 2009  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This shows the rich density of Merlot in 2009, giving a solid structure, with dried fruit and red berry flavors and a concentrated line of tannins. Big and dense, this is ready to age.
title: Château La Fleur Plaisance 2009  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: This is structured and firm, with its dry tannins prominent along with blackberry and black cherry acidity. The wine does have density, a dusty texture and the chance to further age.
title: Château Haut-Goujon 2008 La Rose Saint-Vincent  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Now maturing, this retains its red fruits; its bright texture and acidity go with the firm tannins and dark structure. It is balanced and ready to drink.
title: Château Bellegrave du Poujeau 2006  Haut-Médoc

description: Packed with superripe Merlot, this is rich and round. It has wood flavors and sweet, juicy black-plum fruits that are balanced by firm tannins. The finish shows some bitterness from over-extraction.
title: Château au Pont de Guitres 2009  Lalande de Pomerol

description: This is a very rich wine with black fruit and bitter coffee flavors and dense tannins. Its weight is almost too much for the firm structure that is underneath.
title: Château Cap Léon Veyrin 2009  Listrac-Médoc

description: Ripe and juicy, this is packed with black currant fruit and lined with soft, open tannins. The wine has a dry core, yet this is surrounded by attractive smoky fruit and bright acidity. Ready to drink now.
title: Château Beauvillage 2009  Médoc

description: Here's an interesting rosé fans of obscure winegrapes will love. It's 90% Tibouren, an old variety indigenous to Provence that's known for its finesse but also for its difficulty in the vineyard. This wine also stays an entire year in tank resting on its lees, so it's not a fruit-forward rosé at all. Hints of apricot and peach are subtle, with the emphasis being on the wines crisp acids and dry finish.
title: Château du Galoupet 2005 Tibur Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: A blend of 70% Clairette, 15% Sémillon and 15% Rolle, this is a slightly nutty, almondy white with touches of honeyed richness and apricot. Turns a bit astringent on the finish.
title: Château Calissanne 2006 Clos Victoire White (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: If you want to taste ripe Pinot Noir in Champagne, this grand cru blend (with 40% Chardonnay, 60% Pinot Noir) from Soutiran is where to come. The wine has weight, delicious white fruits and kiwi, and a textured mouthfeel. It is concentrated, certainly in a food wine style.
title: Soutiran NV Brut Grand Cru  (Champagne)

description: Following the elegant Deutz tradition, this wine has a character that is light as a feather, but still anchored into vivid red fruits and tight acidity, leavened by a softness. The final taste is soft, but well integrated.
title: Deutz 2005 Rosé Brut  (Champagne)

description: A richly Merlot wine, soft, ripe, packed with black jelly flavors, sweet acidity and generous balanced tannins. The flavors come together in a balanced, rich way. An attractive wine, ready to drink now.
title: Château Pavillon Bel-Air 2006  Lalande de Pomerol

description: A 50/50 blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this shows big fruity flavors tempered with a dry core of tannins. There is a stalky element of black currant skins which adds to the sensation of dryness, but there is also a more mouthfilling character of black plum juice to give the wine a final roundness.
title: Vieux Château Gaubert 2005  Graves

description: A 50/50 blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, this shows big fruity flavors tempered with a dry core of tannins. There is a stalky element of black currant skins which adds to the sensation of dryness, but there is also a more mouthfilling character of black plum juice to give the wine a final roundness.
title: Vieux Château Gaubert 2005  Graves

description: From 100% grand cru Chardonnay vineyards in the Côte des Blancs, this is a rich but almost bone-dry wine. It has a great mineral character that offers freshness, apple skins and a flinty edge. The disgorgement date is indicated on the bottle. Impressive, this would benefit from six months' aging.
title: De Sousa & Fils NV Réserve Blanc de Blancs Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: This is a balanced wine, moving easily between rich fruit and a tight mineral and grapefruit texture. There is a hint of toast to give extra weight. Worth aging for several years.
title: Drappier 2002 Millésime Exception Brut  (Champagne)

description: With 14 years age, this Champagne shows plenty of beautifully mature fruit. At the same time, its petrol and toast aromas and flavors are balanced by soft richness, a rounded citric and pear flavor and a gentle, ripe aftertaste.
title: Drappier 1995 Carte d'Or Brut 1.5 liters  (Champagne)

description: A dense and rich, jammy Merlot that is full of black fruit and has an ultra-ripe feel. It is hardly Bordeaux, but it does hold attraction with its rich, full fruits and dense tannins. A smoke and bitter chocolate aftertaste suggests some firm extraction.
title: Château Magondeau 2010  Fronsac

description: With touches of vanilla and caramel as well as ripe yellow fruits, this is a warm, generous Chardonnay. It has freshness from the citrus edge and a soft texture. Straightforward, it is an open and ready-to-drink wine.
title: Louis Jadot 2012  Mâcon-Villages

description: Produced from a number of parcels around the village of Katzenthal, this is a fresh and fruity wine, easy to drink. It's bright with acidity, flavored with ripe quince and apple fruits. It's ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2013 Cuvée Particulière Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Produced from a number of parcels around the village of Katzenthal, this is a fresh and fruity wine, easy to drink. It's bright with acidity, flavored with ripe quince and apple fruits. It's ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2013 Cuvée Particulière Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is soft, rounded and smooth. With just enough acidity to give a fresh character, it is ripe with pear and quince flavors. It's ready to drink, light and fragrant.
title: Cave de Cleebourg 2013 Prestige Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is soft, rounded and smooth. With just enough acidity to give a fresh character, it is ripe with pear and quince flavors. It's ready to drink, light and fragrant.
title: Cave de Cleebourg 2013 Prestige Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is all about perfumes and spice. It's ripe, fruity and already drinkable. Bergamot and fruity candy dominate the light acidity and soft texture.
title: Arthur Metz 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: There's no mistaking the grape in this spiced and peppery wine. Candy-shop aromas and bergamot flavors go together with a light acidity to create a wine that's drinkable now.
title: Rieflé 2013 Bonheur Convivial Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is light, fruity and fresh for a Gewurztraminer. A crisp character brings out bitter orange and ripe pear flavors. Drink now.
title: Pierre Sparr 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The style is all perfume, recalling straightforward lychee and spice wine. It has a rounded texture, soft and medium sweet, and is ready to be enjoyed.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: The style is all perfume, recalling straightforward lychee and spice wine. It has a rounded texture, soft and medium sweet, and is ready to be enjoyed.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Soft, floral and fruity, this is a rounded wine with a gentle texture, yellow fruits and light acidity. There is a good touch of spice to fill the wine out right at the end.
title: Vieil Armand 2013 Tradition Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: This wine has a light, fresh character to go with the ripe spiced fruits. It's smooth with a tangy lime-zest flavor filled out with yellow fruits. Drink now.
title: Cave de Kientzheim-Kaysersberg 2013 Anne de K Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Towards the dry end of the Pinot Gris spectrum, this is a crisp, apple and pear flavored wine that has a light character. It's fruity, crisp and ready to drink.
title: Cave de Beblenheim 2013 Réserve Particulière Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A lightly fruity wine that has a soft texture, gentle acidity and a perfumed aftertaste. It is ready to drink with its steely backbone well enmeshed in the fruitiness.
title: Wunsch & Mann 2012 Roi Clovis Riesling (Alsace)

description: For a Morgon, this is relatively light, showing more fruit than structure, with freshness that's tempered by a firm edge and minerality. Keep for a year, or drink now.
title: Signé Vigneron 2011 Domaine de l'Oseraie  (Morgon)

description: This is the second wine of Château de Mercuès, and it has some of the same concentration and tannins as the first wine, without the huge and powerful structure. It will develop its black cherry and spice flavors relatively quickly, to yield a ready-to-drink wine in 2–3 years.
designation: Château de Mercuès Le Vassal de Mercuès
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château de Mercuès Le Vassal de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is the second wine of Château de Mercuès, and it has some of the same concentration and tannins as the first wine, without the huge and powerful structure. It will develop its black cherry and spice flavors relatively quickly, to yield a ready-to-drink wine in 2–3 years.
designation: Château de Mercuès Le Vassal de Mercuès
title: Georges Vigouroux 2010 Château de Mercuès Le Vassal de Mercuès Malbec (Cahors)

description: This is full of crisp, herbaceous flavors of apple, grapefruit and lime. It has weight and concentration, with some richness to its freshness. Acidity cuts through on the finish. Age this for 2–3 years.
title: Château Tour des Gendres 2011 Cuvée des Contis White (Bergerac Sec)

description: Showing a mineral-driven structure and firm tannins, this is a Beaujolais that needs to age. Rich and juicy, its perfumed red fruits currently cut through the dry tannins.
title: Château de Raousset 2011  Chiroubles

description: Showing a mineral-driven structure and firm tannins, this is a Beaujolais that needs to age. Rich and juicy, its perfumed red fruits currently cut through the dry tannins.
title: Château de Raousset 2011  Chiroubles

description: Tough tannins set the scene for this firm and extracted wine, giving it a smokiness and a touch of bitter fruit. However, the wine has the weight to support the tannins, and it hints at future juicy fruit. Keep this for at least five years.
title: Château de Panigon 2010  Médoc

description: Cherry and blackberry notes dominate this ripe, full wine. It has a smoky, toasty character that lends good balance and aging potential. The estate is planted with Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon.
title: Château de Bordes-Quancard 2010  Bordeaux

description: This has a firmly tannic structure and juicy fruit, suggesting its aging potential. It is rich and ripe, with black cherry and plum flavors that create a generous finish.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2011 Domaine de la Source  (Chiroubles)

description: This has a firmly tannic structure and juicy fruit, suggesting its aging potential. It is rich and ripe, with black cherry and plum flavors that create a generous finish.
title: Vignerons de Bel Air 2011 Domaine de la Source  (Chiroubles)

description: Bold and fruity, this is laden with bitter cherry and juicy plum flavors. The tannins are light and attractive, with juicy, refreshing acidity. Age this for a few more months.
title: Robert Perroud 2011 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: Bold and fruity, this is laden with bitter cherry and juicy plum flavors. The tannins are light and attractive, with juicy, refreshing acidity. Age this for a few more months.
title: Robert Perroud 2011 L'Enfer des Balloquets  (Brouilly)

description: A cool, very Sauvignon wine, with strong herbaceous and citrus flavors. It's crisp, showing a bright, tight, slightly mineral texture.
title: Pezat 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: A cool, very Sauvignon wine, with strong herbaceous and citrus flavors. It's crisp, showing a bright, tight, slightly mineral texture.
title: Pezat 2012  Bordeaux Blanc

description: Great value, simple and fruity, this is a ripe wine without wood aging, just bursting with black fruit flavors. It's rich, slightly stalky and ready to drink now.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2011 K-nom Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Great value, simple and fruity, this is a ripe wine without wood aging, just bursting with black fruit flavors. It's rich, slightly stalky and ready to drink now.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2011 K-nom Malbec-Merlot (Cahors)

description: Ripe fruit, sweet tannins and soft texture mark this wine. It's full, ripe and lightly structured. An attractive wine for its black fruit and forward character. Drink in 2–4 years.
title: Château Macquin 2011  Saint-Georges-Saint-Émilion

description: Ripe fruit, sweet tannins and soft texture mark this wine. It's full, ripe and lightly structured. An attractive wine for its black fruit and forward character. Drink in 2–4 years.
title: Château Macquin 2011  Saint-Georges-Saint-Émilion

description: Fine, rich black-fruit flavors give this wine a sense of ripeness, openness and generosity. The wood and fruit balance is already fine, showing that it will be ready to drink this year.
title: Château Grand Billard 2011  Bordeaux

description: Dense planting for this vineyard has resulted in a wine that has greater concentration than in the past. The wine has firm tannins, while showing already delicious black-currant fruit. For drinking over the next 2–4 years.
title: Pezat 2011  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Solid and tannic, very firm from the opening to the finish. It is based around a dark core of wood and spice as well as more juicy fruit flavors. The wine needs time to round out and bring more of the juiciness to the fore.
title: Château les Mottes Pradier 2011  Côtes de Bourg

description: Under the serious amount of wood, this wine feels rich and concentrated. Wood spice, a touch burnt, along with chocolate and black currant fruit show both extraction and the need for 2–3 years' aging.
title: Château de Lestiac 2011  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This solid, structured wine has black currant fruit, balanced acidity and firm tannins. The wine has a solid texture, a core of dryness and the potential to age 3–4 years.
title: Château Belrose 2011  Bordeaux

description: This solid, structured wine has black currant fruit, balanced acidity and firm tannins. The wine has a solid texture, a core of dryness and the potential to age 3–4 years.
title: Château Belrose 2011  Bordeaux

description: This is a cool cru, which shows even in this great year with its structure, austerity and steely character. It makes it old-style Chablis, with its green fruits and lively, poised freshness.
title: La Chablisienne 2005 Côte de Léchet Premier Cru  (Chablis)

description: From old vines, at least 50 years old, this shows good concentration, giving a dense, ripe, rounded wine full of green apple fruits, hints of vanilla and streaks of minerality.
title: La Chablisienne 2005 Les Vénérables  (Chablis)

description: From old vines, at least 50 years old, this shows good concentration, giving a dense, ripe, rounded wine full of green apple fruits, hints of vanilla and streaks of minerality.
title: La Chablisienne 2005 Les Vénérables  (Chablis)

description: Densely rich, very sweet wine. It has some smoky tannins that give structure, along with a dark core of dry raisin and wood flavors. It has concentration and an opaque texture.
title: Château La Conseillante 2009  Pomerol

description: A wine that continues the impressive rise of du Tertre. It is becoming one of the sure values of Margaux, and this 2009 is both ripe and finely balanced. The acidity boosts the rich fruits, sweet tannins and the warm finish.
title: Château du Tertre 2009  Margaux

description: A wine that continues the impressive rise of du Tertre. It is becoming one of the sure values of Margaux, and this 2009 is both ripe and finely balanced. The acidity boosts the rich fruits, sweet tannins and the warm finish.
title: Château du Tertre 2009  Margaux

description: It's sad that only 5,080 bottles of this wine were produced, as it's truly a stunner. Dark and developed, complex and concentrated, this wine exhibits such superb balance and finesse, with nuanced notes of minerality, scrubland, whole tobacco leaf, black pepper and licorice root all gracing the dark fruit core of the nose and mouth. It's lush and full on the palate, and medium tannins provide a solid structure, making the wine drinkable now or ready to age.
title: Gérard Bertrand 2008 L'Hospitalitas - La Clape Red (Coteaux du Languedoc)

description: Initially wood dominates, but this is a stage after bottling. Because then the ripe, smooth fruit comes in, pouring through with black fruits, very ripe and juicy. As this wine develops, this rich fruit will be its main character.
title: Château Gruaud Larose 2009  Saint-Julien

description: With layers of wood, this is a structured wine, driven as much by tannins as fruit. It will need time for the dark plum fruit flavors to come through—St.-Estèphe is always likely to be firmly textured.
title: Château de Pez 2009  Saint-Estèphe

description: There is dense, ripe fruit here, although with an austere, serious edge. The wine has firm yet juicy blackberry fruits along with concentrated tannins. It is firm, dark, with the potential for good red berry fruits.
title: Château Magdelaine 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This wine continues the upward progression of Clerc-Milon. It has weight and density while also showing sweetness and delicious acidity. A very complete wine.
title: Château Clerc Milon 2009  Pauillac

description: Fresh blackberry fruits give a smooth wine, rich and with an immediately attractive fresh acidity. It does have the density of fruit along with relatively soft tannins. At the back there is a more chocolate character.
title: Château Beausejour-Duffau-Lagarrosse 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: This is soft and lightly flavored. Fruit and some fresh acidity are there along with spice, but the wine seems muted.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is soft and lightly flavored. Fruit and some fresh acidity are there along with spice, but the wine seems muted.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2013 Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Light and fruity, this is an attractive off-dry wine. It has a delicate spice character along with yellow fruits that are seasoned with pepper and acidity. Drink now.
title: Kuehn 2013 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Light and fruity, this is an attractive off-dry wine. It has a delicate spice character along with yellow fruits that are seasoned with pepper and acidity. Drink now.
title: Kuehn 2013 Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is totally fresh, with crisp red currant and riper banana flavors—a bright wine that's all fruit and refreshing acidity. The family has been in the wine business since 1811 and today works with some 50 small-production growers.
title: Loron et Fils 2014 Beau!  (Beaujolais)

description: This wine is totally fresh, with crisp red currant and riper banana flavors—a bright wine that's all fruit and refreshing acidity. The family has been in the wine business since 1811 and today works with some 50 small-production growers.
title: Loron et Fils 2014 Beau!  (Beaujolais)

description: This structured wine has a tight, tannic, dry character. It is slow to develop, leaving the black cherry fruits still masked by the forward dryness. Drink from 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014 Domaine du Paradis  (Saint-Amour)

description: Structured and firm, this wine has more in the way of dry tannins than of fruit. It presents a fine skeleton without much flesh, leaving a wine that is tight and extracted. It needs plenty of time, so drink from late 2016.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2014  Chiroubles

description: Banana aromas don't intrude too strongly into the fruity palate of this wine that has a crisp character. Tart red-berry fruits and and bright acidity give the wine a fresh, totally fruity appeal with only a hint of tannin. Drink now.
title: Domaine Pral 2014 Les Pays de Pierres Dorées  (Beaujolais)

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a ripe, cherry-flavored wine (hence the name Griottes, a type of cherry). It is light with a straight line of acidity that cuts through the attractive fruitiness. Drink immediately.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2014 Les Griottes Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Fresh and fruity, this is a ripe, cherry-flavored wine (hence the name Griottes, a type of cherry). It is light with a straight line of acidity that cuts through the attractive fruitiness. Drink immediately.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2014 Les Griottes Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: This wine is tight, fresh with crisp red currant and red-cherry flavors. It is as bright as a button, fruity with layers of acidity that bring out a perfumed character at the end. The Colonge family has been growing grapes in Beaujolais since 1789.
title: Domaine André Colonge 2014  Beaujolais

description: This wine is tight, fresh with crisp red currant and red-cherry flavors. It is as bright as a button, fruity with layers of acidity that bring out a perfumed character at the end. The Colonge family has been growing grapes in Beaujolais since 1789.
title: Domaine André Colonge 2014  Beaujolais

description: Lanson suggests adding fruit to this wine or using it as the base for cocktails. It is off dry, ripe and fruity in itself. A touch of toast suggests this bottling is not young. The wine confuses between crisp acidity and a soft, neutral texture. It will probably be best when it is part of a mixed drink.
title: Lanson NV White Label Sec  (Champagne)

description: This wine is light, fruity and with only a slightly tannic character. Aromatic cherry flavors give freshness and bring out a jammy character. It's ready to drink.
title: Jean-Marc Burgaud 2014 Les Vignes de Thulon  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This light, fresh Chardonnay has lively pear and apple flavors. A crisp texture gives zing to the brightly fruity wine. Drink now.
title: Jean-Marc Burgaud 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This light, fresh Chardonnay has lively pear and apple flavors. A crisp texture gives zing to the brightly fruity wine. Drink now.
title: Jean-Marc Burgaud 2014  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Solid and powerful, it has a great mix of very ripe fruit with dense tannins. Blackberry fruits, laced with licorice and dark chocolate, contrast with a juicy, lightly herbal element. This mainly Merlot wine is destined for a fine future. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Roquebrune 2010 Cuvée Reine  (Lalande de Pomerol)

description: Smooth and rich while remaining structured, this wine performs the role of second wine very well. The tannins are already rounded and the black currant fruit remains fresh. It should be ready to drink in 2016.
title: Château Cos d'Estournel 2011 Les Pagodes de Cos  (Saint-Estèphe)

description: A strong Merlot element has produced a ripe, juicy wine, full of fruit balanced with a subtle use of wood. It's a powerful, concentrated wine that has impressive tannins, rich berry fruits and acidity. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Preuillac 2011  Médoc

description: Perfumed, ripe and packed with blackberry fruits, this wine displays a great sense of elegance. It is fresh while the solid structure provides a contrast of tannins. The end shows acidity and fruitiness.
title: Château Lalande-Borie 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Perfumed, ripe and packed with blackberry fruits, this wine displays a great sense of elegance. It is fresh while the solid structure provides a contrast of tannins. The end shows acidity and fruitiness.
title: Château Lalande-Borie 2011  Saint-Julien

description: Hugely tannic, this formidable wine has great weight, richness and a dark and dense structure. Juicy berry fruits, sweet plum flavors and a dry, concentrated backdrop promise aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut Bertinerie 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Hugely tannic, this formidable wine has great weight, richness and a dark and dense structure. Juicy berry fruits, sweet plum flavors and a dry, concentrated backdrop promise aging. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Haut Bertinerie 2010  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Firm but with juicy fruit, this 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Sauvignon blend is a solid, still young, wine. The aftertaste is tough and packed with acidity.
title: Château Haut Boilon 2013  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Perfumed strawberry aromas show well. On the palate, this wine is fruity, jammy in texture with good balancing acidity. The tannins still need to soften, so drink from 2017.
title: Château Godard 2013  Francs Côtes de Bordeaux

description: While there are firm tannins, this wine also has plenty of fresh black currant fruits. Acidity and a crisp texture give it a lift and brightness. Drink this 100% Merlot from 2016 when the tannins have softened.
title: Château Donjon de Bruignac 2013 Premium  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: While there are firm tannins, this wine also has plenty of fresh black currant fruits. Acidity and a crisp texture give it a lift and brightness. Drink this 100% Merlot from 2016 when the tannins have softened.
title: Château Donjon de Bruignac 2013 Premium  (Bordeaux Supérieur)

description: This wine is concentrated, with fruit that seems too ripe. Jammy berry flavors are mixed in with dry tannins and a firm backdrop. It's solid, although not quite balanced. The estate was founded in 1967 by Philippe Raguenot; daughters Emmanuelle and Marie-Pierre took over in 1997.
title: Château des Tourtes 2012  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Ripe and jammy with attractive soft fruits and acidity, this wine has crushed strawberry and light spice flavors. Drink from late 2016. MACIF, a mutual insurance company, bought the estate in the 1980s and restored the vineyards and beautiful château. The estate manager is Fredéric Dubois and consultant is Georges Pauli.
title: Château de Belcier 2013  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Soft, ripe and fruity, this spicy wine has attractive acidity. It offers a light texture, pepper and a bite of orange zest at the end.
title: Domaine de la Sanglière 2014 Juliette Rosé (Mediterranée)

description: From owner Jean-Pierre Palatin's vineyards at the highest elevation in this appellation, this mostly Merlot wine is soft and fruity, ripe but with little sense of structure. It is juicy and with some acidity. Light and perfumed, it is ready to drink. The winemaker is Thomas Guibert who also handles Ferrand, Palatin's Saint-Émilion grand cru.
title: Château Roquevieille 2013  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: From owner Jean-Pierre Palatin's vineyards at the highest elevation in this appellation, this mostly Merlot wine is soft and fruity, ripe but with little sense of structure. It is juicy and with some acidity. Light and perfumed, it is ready to drink. The winemaker is Thomas Guibert who also handles Ferrand, Palatin's Saint-Émilion grand cru.
title: Château Roquevieille 2013  Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This firm, smoky wine with fine tannins and ripe fruit is developing well, allowing the berry fruits to come through the structure. Give this wine until late 2016.
title: Château Laronde Désormes 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Too much extraction has given this wine a dry character. It does have juicy red fruits underneath and these should come out as the wine ages. It is likely, though, always to be a dry wine.
title: Château Barreyre 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This crisp, fruity wine is fresh with citrus, grapefruit and an attractive zesty texture. Aromatic and bright, it is ready to drink now, clean and fragrant.
title: Cap Royal 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This crisp, fruity wine is fresh with citrus, grapefruit and an attractive zesty texture. Aromatic and bright, it is ready to drink now, clean and fragrant.
title: Cap Royal 2014  Bordeaux Blanc

description: While this wine has a strong tannic structure, it also offers plenty of ripe fruit. Acidity is kept in its place, giving freshness allied to warm berries. Drink this attractive wine from 2016.
title: Producta Vignobles 2013 Mission St. Vincent  (Bordeaux)

description: While this wine has a strong tannic structure, it also offers plenty of ripe fruit. Acidity is kept in its place, giving freshness allied to warm berries. Drink this attractive wine from 2016.
title: Producta Vignobles 2013 Mission St. Vincent  (Bordeaux)

description: This is just recognizably Pinot Noir, full of tannins with a tight edge. Bitter cherry flavors and very fresh acidity give a mineral flavor that is only just showing juiciness. Drink from 2016.
title: Les Rocailles 2014 Pinot Noir (Vin de Savoie)

description: Lemon and spice make this a fruity while textured wine. It tastes like the chalk soil from which it comes, very mineral and flinty. This wine is all fruit now and will broaden out from 2016.
title: Domaine Beausejour 2014 Les Grenettes Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Jammy fruits conflict with a firm tannic structure. This wine is not yet balanced and needs a lighter touch. Producer is Jean Paul Barre.
title: Château Saint-Urban 2013  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Jammy fruits conflict with a firm tannic structure. This wine is not yet balanced and needs a lighter touch. Producer is Jean Paul Barre.
title: Château Saint-Urban 2013  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Forward red fruits give a good beginning to this light and fruity blend of Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. It is crisp with red currant flavors and layers of acidity. Drink now.
title: Univitis 2013 Château Les Vergnes  (Bordeaux)

description: As is often the case with Phélan Ségur, there is an excess of wood in this wine. Sometimes it works, as here, because the big, bold fruits are powerful enough to match the toastiness. That suggests a future as a ripe, black-fruited and structured wine with room for juicy acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Phélan-Ségur 2012  Saint-Estèphe

description: One of the few great values from Pauillac, this 10-acre estate has produced an attractive perfumed wine that expresses both ripe black fruit and great structure. It's not a wine for long aging with its already-fragrant acidity. It has sweet tannins, delicious fruitiness and a lengthy aftertaste. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Gaudin 2011  Pauillac

description: This wine has yeasty aromas and a light character that brings out springy acidity before the dry botrytis. It is still forming itself around the dry core, waiting to become generous and rich. Drink from 2019.
title: Château d'Arche 2011  Sauternes

description: New-wood spice dominates the aroma of this wine, given weight by the rich black plum fruits and concentrated acidity. With its big structure and equally big fruits, this is an impressive wine for long aging. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Couhins 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: New-wood spice dominates the aroma of this wine, given weight by the rich black plum fruits and concentrated acidity. With its big structure and equally big fruits, this is an impressive wine for long aging. Drink from 2022.
title: Château Couhins 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Meaty and spicy, this wine is in an early stage of development. It has dark tannins that have an extracted, tough character. However, the weight of ripe fruit is all there, promising a rich and concentrated wine for the future. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Bouscaut 2012  Pessac-Léognan

description: Rounded and rich, this generous, full-bodied wine comes from a single parcel in the heart of Saint-Émilion. Black fruits are structured with dense tannins and a firm tension between ripeness and dryness. The wine is powerful, finishing with pepper and spice. Drink from 2018.
title: Le Carré 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Rounded and rich, this generous, full-bodied wine comes from a single parcel in the heart of Saint-Émilion. Black fruits are structured with dense tannins and a firm tension between ripeness and dryness. The wine is powerful, finishing with pepper and spice. Drink from 2018.
title: Le Carré 2012  Saint-Émilion

description: Laced with acidity, this is a complex, structured wine with great freshness as well as a dry core of botrytis. It has a rich potential, closed at the moment but holding dense texture and balance between lemon and honey. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de Malle 2011  Sauternes

description: Rich and broad in the mouth, with notes of honeyed citrus reminiscent of tangerine and a tang of peppery spice. The finish is warm, spicy and long, with a hint of vanilla oak. Drink it now and over the next year or two for its undeniable richness.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2009 Vieilles Vignes White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Like many of the '07 Hermitages, this isn't a huge wine, but instead shows a nice sense of proportion, marrying hickory smoke with touches of cracked peppercorns, cedar and roasted beef. Drink now–2020.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2007  Hermitage

description: Like many of the '07 Hermitages, this isn't a huge wine, but instead shows a nice sense of proportion, marrying hickory smoke with touches of cracked peppercorns, cedar and roasted beef. Drink now–2020.
title: Tardieu-Laurent 2007  Hermitage

description: Not a big, overwhelming blockbuster, this harmonious blend of equal parts Grenache Blanc, Roussanne, Clairette and Bourboulenc features ripe citrus and pineapple flavors, with a hint of melon thrown in for good measure. It's pleasantly medium bodied and creamy in the mouth, with a reasonably long finish. Drink it over the next 12–18 months.
title: Réserve des Oliviers 2009 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Not a big, overwhelming blockbuster, this harmonious blend of equal parts Grenache Blanc, Roussanne, Clairette and Bourboulenc features ripe citrus and pineapple flavors, with a hint of melon thrown in for good measure. It's pleasantly medium bodied and creamy in the mouth, with a reasonably long finish. Drink it over the next 12–18 months.
title: Réserve des Oliviers 2009 White (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: This is a seriously wood-aged wine. Its burnt toast character doesn't chime with the light fruitiness of the vintage and so gives a wine that is bitter and extracted. Less overworking would have produced a better wine.
title: Château Pindefleurs 2013  Saint-Émilion

description: This is a light and fruity wine that is ready to drink. It has spice and a layer of dry tannins that are acting as a support to the red fruits and acidity.
title: Château Doms 2014  Graves

description: This is a crisp and fruity wine that's perfumed and full of citrus and green fruits. It has a lively character that is filled out with the ripe fruitiness of the vintage. The aftertaste, bright and fresh, suggests it will benefit from another few months. Drink from summer 2016.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2015  Entre-Deux-Mers

description: High-toast aromas are followed on the palate by flavors that are more about wood than fruit. That gives the wine a tough, extracted character that probably will not go away.
title: Château Troupian 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: This is a soft, ripe and fruity wine. It has gentle tannins and attractive red-berry fruits. There is just a touch of dryness that gives this easygoing wine its structure. Drink from early 2017.
title: Château Lanscade 2015  Bordeaux

description: This is a crisp cherry-flavored wine. Cool-climate Pinot Noir has a light texture that gives the wine a hint of tannins although it is much more about fruit and bright acidity. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Reuilly 2015 Pinot Noir (Reuilly)

description: The sunshine of the Languedoc comes through in this wine's warm, soft fruit. A touch of acidity and a backdrop of tannins give it contrast and a fine, ready-to-drink character.
title: Vinadeis 2016 Le Val Merlot (Vin de France)

description: This is an easy, open wine that is lightly herbal. There is a barnyard edge that masks the fruit, although there is bright crisp acidity to give it a lift. Drink now.
title: Jean-Max Roger 2015 Le Charnay  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This light, cool-climate Pinot Noir is crisp with red currant fruit and herbal-tinged acidity. It has a zesty character that keeps it lively and tight. Drink now.
title: Saget la Perrière 2016 La Petite Perrière Pinot Noir (Vin de France)

description: This is a light bright wine, full of forward fruitiness. The tangy edge of minerality gives the wine a pleasing texture. Citrus fruits support this texture with their zest and acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Paul Buisse 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: This is a light bright wine, full of forward fruitiness. The tangy edge of minerality gives the wine a pleasing texture. Citrus fruits support this texture with their zest and acidity. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Paul Buisse 2016 Sauvignon Blanc (Touraine)

description: Soft and fruity, this is an easy-to-drink wine. Its creamy texture and balanced acidity complement its apple flavors. It's ready to drink.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2016 La Châsse Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This typical blend from southwest France draws on the intensely herbal character of both grapes. It's crisp, perfumed and refreshingly fruity, making it a great apéritif.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2015 La Châsse Sauvignon-Colombard White (Vin de France)

description: This typical blend from southwest France draws on the intensely herbal character of both grapes. It's crisp, perfumed and refreshingly fruity, making it a great apéritif.
title: Gabriel Meffre 2015 La Châsse Sauvignon-Colombard White (Vin de France)

description: This is rich in spice, herbal characteristics and tangy acidity. It has a strongly mineral edge along with green fruits and tight lemon zest. Drink from 2017. André Lurton bought de Rochemorin in 1973; the estate has grown vines since the 16th century.
title: Château de Rochemorin 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This is rich in spice, herbal characteristics and tangy acidity. It has a strongly mineral edge along with green fruits and tight lemon zest. Drink from 2017. André Lurton bought de Rochemorin in 1973; the estate has grown vines since the 16th century.
title: Château de Rochemorin 2013  Pessac-Léognan
