description: Still lean and structured, this is a cool-feeling, young wine. It has dry tannins and a chewy texture that needs to soften. At the back, juicy black currant fruits show promise for the future. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Paillet-Quancard 2012  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Still lean and structured, this is a cool-feeling, young wine. It has dry tannins and a chewy texture that needs to soften. At the back, juicy black currant fruits show promise for the future. Drink from 2018.
title: Château de Paillet-Quancard 2012  Cadillac Côtes de Bordeaux

description: This wine is still closed, lean and firm with its fruitiness masked by a strong mineral structure. It needs plenty of time to develop, so drink from 2018.
title: Château de Cruzeau 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine is still closed, lean and firm with its fruitiness masked by a strong mineral structure. It needs plenty of time to develop, so drink from 2018.
title: Château de Cruzeau 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Under the same ownership as Château de Panigon, this property (which has a heart on its cork) has produced a wine offering layers of smoky wood as well as ripe fruit. That solid structure suggests the wine will need time to develop. The aftertaste boosts a more juicy fruitiness.
title: Château Amour 2013  Médoc

description: This stylish Merlot-based wine has juicy red-berry flavors that are sustained by acidity and firmed up by tannins. Still dry from its dense structure, it's developing well. Drink from 2018.
title: Clos Beauregard 2013  Pomerol

description: This second wine of Château Potensac is soft, fruity with a hint of firmer structure. Juicy Cabernet gives the wine its shape and freshness. It is already drinkable, fruity and fresh.
title: Château Potensac 2013 Chapelle de Potensac  (Médoc)

description: This second wine of Château Potensac is soft, fruity with a hint of firmer structure. Juicy Cabernet gives the wine its shape and freshness. It is already drinkable, fruity and fresh.
title: Château Potensac 2013 Chapelle de Potensac  (Médoc)

description: This small 10-acre property has produced an attractively fruity wine with soft tannins and juicy black-fruit flavors. It is lightly structured—displaying more fruit than tannin—and has a fresh, bright aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Peyredon Lagravette 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This small 10-acre property has produced an attractively fruity wine with soft tannins and juicy black-fruit flavors. It is lightly structured—displaying more fruit than tannin—and has a fresh, bright aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Peyredon Lagravette 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This wine is dry but rich enough with black-currant flavors to compensate. The juicy aftertaste suggests the wine will develop quickly. Drink from 2017. This wine is the latest result of renovations on the 15-generation and 400-year-old Trocard family estate.
title: Château Mancèdre 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This wine is dry but rich enough with black-currant flavors to compensate. The juicy aftertaste suggests the wine will develop quickly. Drink from 2017. This wine is the latest result of renovations on the 15-generation and 400-year-old Trocard family estate.
title: Château Mancèdre 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Bright and fruity, this is classic white Bordeaux with its citrus and lively acidity as well as a crisp texture. It has weight and shows some potential to fill out, so drink from 2017. Because of spring frost and summer rain, Marie-José (Perrin) Leriche reduced the (90%) Sauvignon Blanc and (10%) Sémillion harvest by a third.
title: Château le Sartre 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Herbal and fruity at this young stage, this wine is bright with acidity, citrus fruits and a tangy texture. It is still young and almost too crisp for its own good, although it will likely develop into an attractively fruity, ripe wine with a fine weight of flavor. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2014 Les Hauts de Larrivet Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: Herbal and fruity at this young stage, this wine is bright with acidity, citrus fruits and a tangy texture. It is still young and almost too crisp for its own good, although it will likely develop into an attractively fruity, ripe wine with a fine weight of flavor. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Larrivet Haut-Brion 2014 Les Hauts de Larrivet Haut-Brion  (Pessac-Léognan)

description: This fresh wine has attractive citrus and yellow fruit flavors and an orange tang. It needs more time; drink from 2017. The property includes five acres of white grapes and 65 acres of red. Sylviane Garcin-Cathiard also owns Clos L'Église in Pomerol, Château Barde-Haut in Saint-Émilion and Château Branon in Pessac-Léognan.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: This fresh wine has attractive citrus and yellow fruit flavors and an orange tang. It needs more time; drink from 2017. The property includes five acres of white grapes and 65 acres of red. Sylviane Garcin-Cathiard also owns Clos L'Église in Pomerol, Château Barde-Haut in Saint-Émilion and Château Branon in Pessac-Léognan.
title: Château Haut-Bergey 2013  Pessac-Léognan

description: Now managed organically, this estate has produced a light, fruity wine. Fresh red berries are sustained by a firm tannin edge that offers a solid base for the fruitiness and acidity. Drink from 2017.
title: Château des Annereaux 2011  Lalande de Pomerol

description: This wine enjoys the fruitiness of the vintage with its black-currant flavors and light tannic structure. The blend is 50% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Cabernet Franc. The Cabernets, with ripe berry flavors that dominate here, give a firm core to the wine while not losing the potential of the fruit. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Balac 2012 Cru Bourgeois  (Haut-Médoc)

description: This wine enjoys the fruitiness of the vintage with its black-currant flavors and light tannic structure. The blend is 50% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon and 20% Cabernet Franc. The Cabernets, with ripe berry flavors that dominate here, give a firm core to the wine while not losing the potential of the fruit. Drink from 2017.
title: Château Balac 2012 Cru Bourgeois  (Haut-Médoc)

description: One of the peculiarities of St.-Émilion's classification is that Canon la Gaffelière is not classed in the top rung. Because, as this wine shows, it produces superb wines. This is ripe while so elegant, with great intensity and sweet perfumes.
title: Château Canon la Gaffelière 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Hugely dense, foursquare wine with great fruit and the purest tannins. Chocolate and coffee predominate at the same time as sweet tannins and acidity. A wine that combines charm with great power.
title: Château Canon 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Very supple wine, with great richness and density. It is all so complete, a pleasure, powerful yet also with sweet opulent fruits layered with dark tannins. For long-term aging.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2009  Saint-Julien

description: Very supple wine, with great richness and density. It is all so complete, a pleasure, powerful yet also with sweet opulent fruits layered with dark tannins. For long-term aging.
title: Château Branaire-Ducru 2009  Saint-Julien

description: Minty new wood aromas on a wine that shows both great tannins and sweet wood. The fruit is still to show, but promises fresh plum flavors that will be delicious and juicy. This is a ripe, concentrated wine.
title: Château Beau-Séjour Bécot 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Beneath the surface tannins is great Merlot fruit, very ripe and full-bodied, a powerhouse of flavors. The depth and complexity of the wine is all there, along with a dark core of dryness. A wine for long-term aging.
title: Château Trotanoy 2009  Pomerol

description: The purest Cabernet Sauvignon fruit, with dark chocolate and intense dark berry flavors. The tannins are so enveloped by the fruit and yet they promise great aging. At this stage, wood shows through the fruit, but the texture is so rich and opulent that it should easily become integrated.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2009  Pauillac

description: The purest Cabernet Sauvignon fruit, with dark chocolate and intense dark berry flavors. The tannins are so enveloped by the fruit and yet they promise great aging. At this stage, wood shows through the fruit, but the texture is so rich and opulent that it should easily become integrated.
title: Château Mouton Rothschild 2009  Pauillac

description: A dense, immense, solidly powerful wine. The ripest fruit overflows, paralleling the dark, solid tannins. As so often, Lynch-Bages is a blockbuster, dark and concentrated, with immense aging potential.
title: Château Lynch-Bages 2009  Pauillac

description: Just across the road from Pétrus, la Fleur-Pétrus shares some of the same intensity. There is great fruit here, rounded and powerful with the ripest character. It is open, generous, ready to drink. The tannins lead into the purest acidity, letting the fruit sing.
title: Château la Fleur-Pétrus 2009  Pomerol

description: Just across the road from Pétrus, la Fleur-Pétrus shares some of the same intensity. There is great fruit here, rounded and powerful with the ripest character. It is open, generous, ready to drink. The tannins lead into the purest acidity, letting the fruit sing.
title: Château la Fleur-Pétrus 2009  Pomerol

description: Solid, very structured, packed with dense and dry tannins. There is a core of acidity and darkness that gives the wine a brooding, powerful character. At this stage, it seems austere although it does have the weight of fruit typical of the year.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: Solid, very structured, packed with dense and dry tannins. There is a core of acidity and darkness that gives the wine a brooding, powerful character. At this stage, it seems austere although it does have the weight of fruit typical of the year.
title: Château Haut-Brion 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: An immensely structured wine, packed with dark tannins promising aging potential. It is complex, powerful, layered with new wood and concentration, finishing with dark plum fruits and acidity.
title: Château Léoville Poyferré 2009  Saint-Julien

description: An immensely structured wine, packed with dark tannins promising aging potential. It is complex, powerful, layered with new wood and concentration, finishing with dark plum fruits and acidity.
title: Château Léoville Poyferré 2009  Saint-Julien

description: A ripe year like 2009 is kind to the Cabernet Sauvignon of Château Figeac. The wine is perfumed with new wood and sweet fruits, delicious black currant flavors giving both ripeness and freshness. The wine has weight and impressive density. A star of the vintage.
title: Château Figeac 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A ripe year like 2009 is kind to the Cabernet Sauvignon of Château Figeac. The wine is perfumed with new wood and sweet fruits, delicious black currant flavors giving both ripeness and freshness. The wine has weight and impressive density. A star of the vintage.
title: Château Figeac 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Such a generous and ripe wine, with a dark core of tannins surrounded by opulent fruit. Black fruits, coffee, very concentrated flavors, a powerhouse of structure and richness. The warmth of the wine is palpable, as is the aging potential.
title: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2009  Pessac-Léognan

description: A very concentrated wine with such a stylish feel. It balances ripe berry fruits with chocolate and wood flavors in the richest, ripest combination. The wine has power, without losing its poised character. It's ready for long aging.
title: Château Troplong Mondot 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A very concentrated wine with such a stylish feel. It balances ripe berry fruits with chocolate and wood flavors in the richest, ripest combination. The wine has power, without losing its poised character. It's ready for long aging.
title: Château Troplong Mondot 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: A beautiful wine, with the firmest tannins surrounded by perfumed fruit. It is dense, of course, but this density is balanced with great elegance, blackberry fruits, sweetness and final juicy acidity. The wine is structured, a powerhouse of concentration while preserving this complete style.
title: Château Palmer 2009  Margaux

description: A massive wine for Margaux, packed with tannins and ripe fruit. It has more Cabernet Sauvignon than usual, giving intense black currant flavors with enticing acidity balanced by the sweetness of the fruit. Ripe swathes of this opulent fruit are also elegant and structured.
title: Château Margaux 2009  Margaux

description: Light and fruity, this is a crisp wine with good acidity. a tangy character and a yeasty edge. Drink now.
title: Château Lauduc 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: This wine has a touch of caramel as well as spice. Both work well with the red fruits that shine through this ripe wine. It is ready to drink.
title: Château Lalande Méric 2016 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: The Mottet family bought this chateau in 2009 and has been in renovation mode: chateau, winery, vast vineyards and placement of a dramatic 40-foot steel rooster in the vineyard. This wine is refreshing, lively and crisp, with plenty of acidity. It reveals spice, apples and lime flavors along with a more mineral side. The wine is ready to drink.
title: Château la France 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: In the Boissonneau family since 1839, this southern Entre-Deux-Mers vineyard gives a crisp, herbal wine with light fruit and attractive acidity. It has lemon and grapefruit flavors, bright with a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: In the Boissonneau family since 1839, this southern Entre-Deux-Mers vineyard gives a crisp, herbal wine with light fruit and attractive acidity. It has lemon and grapefruit flavors, bright with a crisp aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Château de la Vieille Tour 2016  Bordeaux Blanc

description: This wood aged Chenin Blanc has a strongly oxidative character. It has lost its fruit in favor of grilled almonds, toast and intense acidity. Drink this mature wine now.
title: Château de Chaintres 2013 Clos des Oratoriens  (Saumur)

description: One of a pair of gorgeous Petit Manseng-based dessert wines by Claude Loustalot, this has richness but also lightness from the fresh acidity. This is fruity and fragrant, with a peach-like crispness, and it's worth keeping for another 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Bru-Baché 2008 La Quintessence  (Jurançon)

description: One of a pair of gorgeous Petit Manseng-based dessert wines by Claude Loustalot, this has richness but also lightness from the fresh acidity. This is fruity and fragrant, with a peach-like crispness, and it's worth keeping for another 3–4 years.
title: Domaine Bru-Baché 2008 La Quintessence  (Jurançon)

description: A powerful, wood-aged wine, this shows weighty black fruit and a toasty character. It is concentrated and solid, yet it has a soft and rich side as well.  The tarry, tannic character needs at least four years to soften.
title: Château de Gaudou 2010 Renaissance Malbec (Cahors)

description: A new-wood-dominated wine, this has a heavy toast character, with extracted licorice and dark chocolate flavors as well as a big black-plum note. Rich and weighty, with juicy acidity, this demands many years of aging.
title: Château d'Aydie 2009 Tannat (Madiran)

description: A new-wood-dominated wine, this has a heavy toast character, with extracted licorice and dark chocolate flavors as well as a big black-plum note. Rich and weighty, with juicy acidity, this demands many years of aging.
title: Château d'Aydie 2009 Tannat (Madiran)

description: Aromatic hints of new wood translate onto the smooth palate. It has smoke and black currant flavors, with tannins that are already well integrated. Attractive acidity gives this a final lift. Keep it for 5–6 years.
title: Château Blaignan 2010  Médoc

description: Aromatic hints of new wood translate onto the smooth palate. It has smoke and black currant flavors, with tannins that are already well integrated. Attractive acidity gives this a final lift. Keep it for 5–6 years.
title: Château Blaignan 2010  Médoc

description: Made using fruit that was sourced from vines planted in 1939, this wine shows the great concentration low yields and old vines can give. It has Gamay's natural freshness, with firm, dry tannins, a spice note and a fragrant finish. It's drinkable now, but it will be better in two years.
title: Pascal Aufranc 2011 Vignes de 1939  (Chénas)

description: This is rich, spicy and full of red cherry flavor. It also has a dark, firm structure from the granite-based soil. The acidity that cuts through the fruit lends balance. Age this for 2–3 years.
title: Château des Jacques 2011 Clos de Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: This is rich, spicy and full of red cherry flavor. It also has a dark, firm structure from the granite-based soil. The acidity that cuts through the fruit lends balance. Age this for 2–3 years.
title: Château des Jacques 2011 Clos de Rochegrès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Made using fruit sourced from a parcel of vines more than 60 years old, this is a dense, dark wine, with herb, dark fig and plum notes. Solid and concentrated, it has a firm texture, and the dusty tannins match well with the ripe fruit. Age for 7–8 years.
title: Château de Gaudou 2009 Réserve Caillou Malbec (Cahors)

description: A rich, full-bodied wine from one of the masters of Tannat, Pierre Laplace, this has ripe tannins and layers of toast, black plum and berry, with intense acidity on the finish.
title: Château d'Aydie 2010 Madiran Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: A rich, full-bodied wine from one of the masters of Tannat, Pierre Laplace, this has ripe tannins and layers of toast, black plum and berry, with intense acidity on the finish.
title: Château d'Aydie 2010 Madiran Laplace Tannat (Madiran)

description: A light wine, somewhat unfocused and lacking fruit intensity. But it is certainly pleasant, clean and fresh, with a definite green tinge and a citrus aftertaste.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2006 Fournier  (Menetou-Salon)

description: This wine comes from a vineyard owned by the Gagey situated in the northern part of Nuits-Saint-Georges, close to Vosne-Romanée. It has firm structure and a perfumed character that is already enticing. Richly fruity with juicy acidity, it will be impressive as it ages. Drink from 2023.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Les Boudots Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: This wine comes from a vineyard owned by the Gagey situated in the northern part of Nuits-Saint-Georges, close to Vosne-Romanée. It has firm structure and a perfumed character that is already enticing. Richly fruity with juicy acidity, it will be impressive as it ages. Drink from 2023.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Les Boudots Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Named after the 15th century owner of this estate, the wine comes from a selection of the best parcels. With impressive tannins, a dense structure and rich bold black fruits, this is a powerful wine. It is full of ripe fruit with a mineral texture and has a good future. Drink from 2021.
designation: Château de Haute-Serre Cuvée Géron Dadine de Haute-Serre
title: Georges Vigouroux 2014 Château de Haute-Serre Cuvée Géron Dadine de Haute-Serre Malbec (Cahors)

description: This dense and structured wine comes from a small walled vineyard within the larger Les Vignes Franches premier cru, partially owned by Louis Jadot. Robust tannins frame its rich, juicy black fruit, showing potential for long aging. Drink from 2024.
title: Louis Jadot 2014 Clos des Ursules Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This wine manages to combine firm structure with the finely perfumed fruit associated with Chambolle-Musigny. It's rich, fruity, lifted by acidity and held together by solid tannins. Impressive and full bodied, it's a wine to age. Drink from 2024.
title: David Duband 2014 Les Sentiers Premier Cru  (Chambolle-Musigny)

description: From one of the highest premier cru vineyards comes a wine that has a cool edge, generous fruit and firm tannins. Those elements come together with black cherry flavors and a dry core, promising a serious future. Drink from 2023.
title: David Duband 2014 Aux Thorey Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: From one of the highest premier cru vineyards comes a wine that has a cool edge, generous fruit and firm tannins. Those elements come together with black cherry flavors and a dry core, promising a serious future. Drink from 2023.
title: David Duband 2014 Aux Thorey Premier Cru  (Nuits-St.-Georges)

description: Purists will no doubt object to this wine's fine patina of sophisticated, cedary oak, but there's plenty of high-quality fruit to back it up. Incorporating unusual proportions of 44% Grenache, 33% Mourvèdre and 23% Syrah, the fruit is ripe and lush, velvety-supple and medium to full in weight, without any sense of heaviness. Drink 2020–2030.
title: Château La Nerthe 2013 Cuvée des Cadettes Red (Châteauneuf-du-Pape)

description: Crisp and packed with lively lemon-like acidity, this wine shows both minerality and intense fruitiness. Textured and tight, it has hints of yellow fruit in the background that will blossom as the wine develops. Drink from 2021.
title: Alex Gambal 2014 La Maltroie Premier Cru  (Chassagne-Montrachet)

description: Bouscassé is the home of Alain Brumont who also owns Château Montus in Madiran. This powerful wine with its blend of Tannat with the two Cabernets (Franc and Sauvignon) is dense and packed with firm tannins. It is also equally full of generous black-plum fruits and considerable acidity. This is still young—it's a concentrated wine that needs to age further. Drink from 2019.
title: Alain Brumont 2011 Château Bouscassé Red (Madiran)

description: Dense and structured, this is a wine with good potential. It has weight, concentrated tannins and ripe fruit, as well as a solid, full-bodied feel. The palate is marked with power, a fine mineral texture and great acidity on the finish. Drink from 2017.
title: Domaine de Val d'Arenc 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: Structured and firm, this is a tight wine with powerful, youthful acidity as well as a dense structure and dark tannins. It has weight as well, indicating a wine with excellent aging potential. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Salettes 2011 Red (Bandol)

description: Firm and tannic in structure, this is a wine for aging. Ripe, dark fruits add power and a density of texture. Drink from 2016.
title: Château Paradis 2010 Terre des Anges Red (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: Richly sweet, this is a wine that has traded primary fruitiness with deliciously balanced honey flavor and lively citrus acidity. It's a wine that has richness, intense flavor and the ability to age further.
title: Rieflé 2010 Zinnkoepflé Grand Cru Vendanges Tardives Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a textured wine with ripe and perfumed fruitiness. Honeyed in style and medium-sweet on the palate, it's a complex, rich wine that's ready to drink now, but could also improve with age.
title: Rieflé 2010 Steinert Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: Sweet and rich, this is a wine that combines honey with a touch of toast and smokiness. The mid palate is filled with apricot and fresh lemon flavors. There is a fine acidity on the finish that gives a delicious lift.
title: Trimbach 2007 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This is a medium-sweet wine that's warm and rich due to the ripening abilities of the Spiegel vineyard. It is spiced, concentrated and full of a smoky character that contrasts with its fruitiness. It's ready to drink now, although it will certainly age well. Drink until 2019.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2007 Spiegel Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a medium-sweet wine that's warm and rich due to the ripening abilities of the Spiegel vineyard. It is spiced, concentrated and full of a smoky character that contrasts with its fruitiness. It's ready to drink now, although it will certainly age well. Drink until 2019.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2007 Spiegel Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This is a remarkably spicy wine that is also finely balanced. It's sophisticated as well as rich, with spice and lychee flavors lifted by a crisp edge of acidity. It's complex in texture and should age well. Drink from 2015.
title: Domaine Weinbach 2011 Cuvée Théo Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Big, full bodied and concentrated, this is a ripe, rich wine. Ripe plum flavors are balanced with nervy acidity and dense tannins. This is a wine that will still need to age, so don't drink before 2017.
title: Domaine de l'Hermitage 2010 Red (Bandol)

description: This is a robust, dense wine, showing the hot character of the vintage in its aromas and flavors of fruitcake and spice and slightly rough texture. It's a blend of 60% Syrah and 40% Cabernet, matured in one-third new oak.
title: Mas de la Dame 2003 La Stèle Rouge Syrah-Cabernet (Les Baux de Provence)

description: Slightly confected on the nose, showing cotton candy and bubble gum aromas, but you'll also find plenty of strawberry-raspberry flavors. Very fruity and clean, with a fresh finish.
title: Mas de la Dame 2007 Rosé du Mas Rosé (Les Baux de Provence)

description: This is smoky and minerally upfront, influenced by barrel notes, but there's also some intense strawberry and raspberry fruit on the palate and a minerally reprise on the concentrated finish.
title: Château d'Esclans 2006 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: There's a slightly confected top-note of cotton candy or bubble gum to this wine, but also decent concentration of canteloupe and peach fruit aromas and flavors. It's plump and medium-bodied, with a touch of refreshing minerality on the finish.
title: Saint André de Figuière 2007 Magali Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Here's a solid, dark wine, with an old wood character. It has weight, a black plum flavor and dark tannins. This feels old and hard.
title: Château de Ferrand 2008  Saint-Émilion

description: Dry and firm, this is smothered with hard-edged tannins that give the wine a tough character. It will soften a little bit, but not completely.
title: Horeau-Beylot 2009 Château Grand Martinet  (Saint-Émilion)

description: An attractively fragrant rosé, this is very crisp and clean. It has lively raspberry and red currant flavors that are lightly touched by a herb note. A bright finish completes this refreshing wine.
title: Chateau le Grand Verdus 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: An attractively fragrant rosé, this is very crisp and clean. It has lively raspberry and red currant flavors that are lightly touched by a herb note. A bright finish completes this refreshing wine.
title: Chateau le Grand Verdus 2011 Rosé (Bordeaux Rosé)

description: Spicy, creamy new-wood aromas introduce a wine that is heavily dominated by woody tannins. The wine is very dry, its fruit a mere whisper in the background. Give this five years and the fruit may come forward, though that's not a guarantee.
title: Château du Moulin Rouge 2010  Haut-Médoc

description: New wood dominates this soft wine. The fruit is round and smoky, featuring notes of black cherries and red plums that fall behind a toasty caramel sweetness. It needs several months for the wood influence to integrate.
title: Château Bois Noir 2009  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Produced from organic grapes, the wine is ripe and packed with fruit. It has a delicious line of acidity, as well as weight and peach and red-fruit flavors. The acidity keeps the exuberance in check. Drink now.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2016 Paparazzi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced from organic grapes, the wine is ripe and packed with fruit. It has a delicious line of acidity, as well as weight and peach and red-fruit flavors. The acidity keeps the exuberance in check. Drink now.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2016 Paparazzi Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a ripe, full and fruity wine. It is packed with attractive red-berry fruits and a crisp dry backbone. The acidity and the bright aftertaste make it a fine food rosé. It comes from a small appellation surrounded by the large Côtes de Provence area.
title: Domaine Harmonie des Arpents 2016 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This is a ripe, full and fruity wine. It is packed with attractive red-berry fruits and a crisp dry backbone. The acidity and the bright aftertaste make it a fine food rosé. It comes from a small appellation surrounded by the large Côtes de Provence area.
title: Domaine Harmonie des Arpents 2016 Rosé (Coteaux Varois en Provence)

description: This blend of Cinsault, Grenache and Syrah is attractively fruity. It has a crisp texture that gives it a bright character, red-currant fruitiness and intense refreshing acidity. The aftertaste is elegant and fruity. The wine's name (meaning to dare) is an anagram of Rosé. Drink now.
title: Domaine Clos Gautier 2016 Oser Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Pascal Savoret is the only producer with vines actually in the village (as distinct from the appellation) of Madiran, a mere population of 430. He has produced a dense and tannic wine, packed with woody dark tannins. The black fruits and concentrated dusty texture promise further aging for this Tannat wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Clos Fardet 2013 Tannat (Madiran)

description: Pascal Savoret is the only producer with vines actually in the village (as distinct from the appellation) of Madiran, a mere population of 430. He has produced a dense and tannic wine, packed with woody dark tannins. The black fruits and concentrated dusty texture promise further aging for this Tannat wine. Drink from 2020.
title: Clos Fardet 2013 Tannat (Madiran)

description: This ripe wine from a very fine vintage in Bergerac, is fully structured while also having a fine black-currant fruitiness. Half-and-half Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it has a perfumed edge along with rich juicy acidity and fruits. Drink this fine wine from late 2017.
title: Château le Payral 2015 Red (Bergerac)

description: This ripe wine from a very fine vintage in Bergerac, is fully structured while also having a fine black-currant fruitiness. Half-and-half Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it has a perfumed edge along with rich juicy acidity and fruits. Drink this fine wine from late 2017.
title: Château le Payral 2015 Red (Bergerac)

description: From organically grown grapes, this firmly structured red wine is stalky while also rich with potential. It is young, dense with tannins as well as black-currant fruit. The wine will need to age, so drink from 2019.
title: Château Grand Boise 2015 Red (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: The estate wine of Coutinel is dominated by the local Négrette grape. With the addition of 15% Syrah and (unusual for this part of the world) 15% Gamay, the wine is structured while also juicy. Soft tannins and black fruits are shot through with an attractive perfumed character. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Coutinel 2015 Red (Fronton)

description: This is a ripe, fresh and fruity wine that's filled out with a tangy, mineral texture. Grapefruit and lime juice flavors give a zesty feel as well as intense acidity. It is ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Rome 2013  Sancerre

description: Lightly herbaceous, this is a ripe, lively wine. Grapefruit and lemon zest flavors are complemented by fuller apple and quince flavors. A tight minerality in the background will allow the wine to age. Drink from 2016.
title: Domaine de l'Ermitage 2013  Menetou-Salon

description: Ripe and fruity, this immediately attractive wine has a crisp texture, giving prominence to apple and grapefruit freshness. The light spritz from bottling from the lees adds bright lift to the aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaines Landron 2013 La Louvetrie Sur Lie  (Muscadet Sèvre et Maine)

description: A crisp, lemon-scented wine, then layering on butter, toast and ripe melon fruit flavors. It's immediately attractive, not needing any aging, with a soft, yet fresh, finish.
title: Cave de Lugny 2010 L'Aurore  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: A crisp, lemon-scented wine, then layering on butter, toast and ripe melon fruit flavors. It's immediately attractive, not needing any aging, with a soft, yet fresh, finish.
title: Cave de Lugny 2010 L'Aurore  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: Yes, it has 2003 ripeness, but there is also some restraint here. The tannins are still defiantly young, the fruit packed with black plum jelly flavors. It promises 2–3 years' aging.
title: Château la Grande Barthe 2003  Montagne-Saint-Émilion

description: A wine that aims to bring out the casual side of Bordeaux, this is friendly, accessible, without losing the essential dry tannins and fresh black currant flavors typical of the region. If only all branded Bordeaux was like this.
title: Barrière Frères 2006 Jacques Sans Souci  (Bordeaux)

description: A wine that aims to bring out the casual side of Bordeaux, this is friendly, accessible, without losing the essential dry tannins and fresh black currant flavors typical of the region. If only all branded Bordeaux was like this.
title: Barrière Frères 2006 Jacques Sans Souci  (Bordeaux)

description: This smooth, rich and fine wine is maturing well. It has a good balance of ripe fruit and acidity. Bitter coffee and spice notes add complexity while not detracting from the fruit. Drink from 2020.
title: Château Tour Grand Faurie 2009  Saint-Émilion

description: Fresh, crisp and fruity, this is an immediately drinkable wine. It has great freshness, lively acidity and perfumed apple fruitiness. The acidity cuts through brightly and leaves a vibrant, textured aftertaste.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Fresh, crisp and fruity, this is an immediately drinkable wine. It has great freshness, lively acidity and perfumed apple fruitiness. The acidity cuts through brightly and leaves a vibrant, textured aftertaste.
title: Bouchard Père & Fils 2014  Pouilly-Fuissé

description: Made to be drunk young, this is a soft, ripe and fruity wine. It has a juicy blackberry flavor, plenty of acidity and a soft, smooth aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Famille Laplace 2015 Aramis Rouge Tannat-Syrah Tannat-Syrah (Vin de France)

description: Made to be drunk young, this is a soft, ripe and fruity wine. It has a juicy blackberry flavor, plenty of acidity and a soft, smooth aftertaste. Drink from 2017.
title: Famille Laplace 2015 Aramis Rouge Tannat-Syrah Tannat-Syrah (Vin de France)

description: Spicy, fruity and attractive, this balanced wine has acidity, tight minerality, yellow fruits and a richer texture. Full bodied and generous, it will age well. Drink from 2017.
title: Christophe Cordier 2014 Vers Cras  (Pouilly-Fuissé)

description: This rich wine is full and has a good balance of acidity and fruit. The lightly mineral texture gives bite and crispness. It is still a young, tight wine needing another few months. Drink from 2017.
title: Château de Santenay 2014  Chassagne-Montrachet

description: From vines in the northern part of the appellation, this ripe wine conveys peaches and apricots laced with lime. A vibrant, mineral wine with swathes of fresh acidity, it can be drunk now.
title: Château de Fuissé 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This tangy wine has attractive acidity and a tightly coiled mineral texture. Apple and lemon flavors shoot right through the bright, crisp texture. Drink from 2017.
title: Cave des Vignerons de Buxy 2014  Mâcon-Villages

description: Packed with red fruits and crisp acidity, this lively wine has a tight mousse, while the red-currant fruitiness adds intense acidity. The wine is bright and ready to drink.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV La Burgondie Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Packed with red fruits and crisp acidity, this lively wine has a tight mousse, while the red-currant fruitiness adds intense acidity. The wine is bright and ready to drink.
title: Bailly-Lapierre NV La Burgondie Rosé Brut  (Crémant de Bourgogne)

description: Lean and tannic, this wine has chocolate and bitter coffee flavors from over-extraction. The fruit is suppressed at this stage, with a bitter aftertaste.
title: Château les Lattes 2013  Médoc

description: This fresh wine has plenty of acidity as well as some firm tannins. It is still young, waiting to fill out with riper fruit flavors. The aftertaste just repeats the acidity.
title: Les Vignerons Réunis de Monségur 2014 La Tour du Gouverneur  (Bordeaux)

description: This wine is structured and stalky without the fruit weight, reflecting the difficult vintage. A smoky character comes through the acidity to leave a dry aftertaste. Through 2016, it will soften a little, although always missing the fruit. The blend is 55% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Ssauvignon and 20% Cabernet Franc.
title: Château Vrai Caillou 2013  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Too enthusiastic use of wood has left this wine bereft of fruit and unbalanced.
title: Château Monfort Bellevue 2012  Médoc

description: Too enthusiastic use of wood has left this wine bereft of fruit and unbalanced.
title: Château Monfort Bellevue 2012  Médoc

description: This soft, jammy and fruity wine is ready to drink, with black-currant flavors that are ripe and rounded. Only the lightest tannins gives any structure to this wine that is immediately accessible.
title: Château les Joyeuses 2014  Bordeaux

description: This wine is lean with acidity playing over the red-currant fruits, leaving a character that's light and tight. While the wine will soften it's not likely to show any more weight or richness.
title: Château Méric 2013  Médoc

description: This wine is lean with acidity playing over the red-currant fruits, leaving a character that's light and tight. While the wine will soften it's not likely to show any more weight or richness.
title: Château Méric 2013  Médoc

description: The producer has probably used too much wood for the fruit and density of this wine. The toastiness does not allow any fruit to show through.
title: Château la Gravette Lacombe 2013  Médoc

description: Based in the heart of the Haut-Médoc, this property has produced a wine that shows a dry character, with bitter extraction and too much wood. There are just hints of juicy fruit that will need time to come through. It could well stay dry and firm always.
title: Château du Retout 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: Based in the heart of the Haut-Médoc, this property has produced a wine that shows a dry character, with bitter extraction and too much wood. There are just hints of juicy fruit that will need time to come through. It could well stay dry and firm always.
title: Château du Retout 2013  Haut-Médoc

description: This wine came out of the disaster of shriveled Duras grapes after an especially hot period. Rather than discarding them, Domaine Rotier made a wine. Wood aged, it has many of the characters of a late harvest with its rich, sweet, lightly tannic flavors and sufficient acidity to balance. A surprising success.
title: Domaine Rotier NV Noces de Feu Duras (Vin de Liqueur)

description: This wine came out of the disaster of shriveled Duras grapes after an especially hot period. Rather than discarding them, Domaine Rotier made a wine. Wood aged, it has many of the characters of a late harvest with its rich, sweet, lightly tannic flavors and sufficient acidity to balance. A surprising success.
title: Domaine Rotier NV Noces de Feu Duras (Vin de Liqueur)

description: Chardonay and Pinot Noir are both present in this apple and pear flavored wine. A lively mousse brings out the fruit and acidity, giving a tangy, bright wine that's ready to drink now.
title: Domaine Rolet Père et Fils 2008 Brut Sparkling (Crémant de Jura)

description: A blend of white Bordeaux and local Gers grapes, this is a smooth, medium sweet wine. With three years of aging, it has become mature, rich in smoky flavors as well as dried apricot and bitter oranges. Acidity keeps everything in line. It's ready to drink.
title: Domaine de Gensac 2011 Quadrille White (Gers)

description: Dense almost to the point of chewiness, this is a concentrated blend of Syrah, Carignan and Grenache. Earthy, plummy notes pick up hints of dark chocolate and licorice before ending rich and velvety.
title: Château d'Or et de Gueules 2010 Les Cimels Red (Costières de Nîmes)

description: This is as perfumed an example of Syrah as you'll find from the Southern Rhône. Hints of herbs, spice and violets accent blueberry fruit in this charming wine. It's medium in body—not that rich but or layered but supple, silky and easily accessible. Drink this through the end of 2015.
title: Michel Gassier 2012 Les Piliers Syrah (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Old-vine Pinot Noir has produced a rich structured wood-aged wine. With its opulent texture and ripe full-bodied cherries and red plums, the wine is poised and generous. Drink this impressive wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Bernard Fleuriet et Fils 2015 Anthocyane  (Sancerre)

description: The Meridian in the name is the zero-longitude Prime Meridian which passes through this vineyard. The wine, with its minty flavors from new-wood aging, is serious, concentrated and with an impressive structure. The dark firm character of this wine promises plenty more aging. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Parnay 2014 La Coulée du Méridien  (Saumur-Champigny)

description: From old vines planted in a single vineyard, this is a spectacular red. It has the crisp acidity of the cool-climate Sancerre, but it also has the weight and ripeness of a fine Burgundy. The wood aging has left a spicy toasty edge to the beautiful cherry fruits and acidity. It could age for another year to be at its best. Drink from 2019.
title: Alphonse Mellot 2014 En Grands Champs  (Sancerre)

description: From old vines planted in a single vineyard, this is a spectacular red. It has the crisp acidity of the cool-climate Sancerre, but it also has the weight and ripeness of a fine Burgundy. The wood aging has left a spicy toasty edge to the beautiful cherry fruits and acidity. It could age for another year to be at its best. Drink from 2019.
title: Alphonse Mellot 2014 En Grands Champs  (Sancerre)

description: For those with a classical bent, Clos Teddi is named after Thetis, sea goddess and mother of Achilles. This rosé, appropriately, summons up lunch by the ocean, with its crisp, fresh, dry strawberry and pink grapefruit flavors, just touched by caramel.
title: Clos Teddi 2007 Rosé Red (Patrimonio)

description: As in nearby Sauternes, 2005 produced some exceptionally rich botrytised wine in Monbazillac. This example from one of the leading Bergerac producers certainly shows plenty of richness, but it seems rather too sugary, showing toffee flavors and fatness. The acidity is missing.
title: Château Bélingard 2005  Monbazillac

description: Easy, creamy wine, with soft apple flavors and a touch of citrus. There is a light edge of toast to round out the soft, fleshy aftertaste.
title: Kedar's K'orus NV Chardonnay (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: Created by music industry businessman Kedar Massenburg (CEO Motown Records), the K'orus range is produced in the Languedoc. This Cabernet Sauvignon gives blackberry fruits, very juicy, lightly sweet to finish, but retaining attractive structure and acidity.
title: Kedar's K'orus NV Cabernet Sauvignon (Vin de Pays d'Oc)

description: With its few years of aging, this is now a ripe and broad wine rich in yellow fruits that are cut with pear juice. It has nutty overtones, and a bright, crisp aftertaste.
designation: Clos de la Tourelle Château Ollwiller
title: Vieil Armand 2010 Clos de la Tourelle Château Ollwiller Pinot Blanc (Alsace)

description: The Pfleck vineyard with its clay and limestone soil gives a rich style of Pinot Gris. This wine, with its intense spice and lychee flavors, is typical. It has a crisp edge but the ripe fruitiness and touch of pepper give weight and richness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2012 Pfleck Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: The Pfleck vineyard with its clay and limestone soil gives a rich style of Pinot Gris. This wine, with its intense spice and lychee flavors, is typical. It has a crisp edge but the ripe fruitiness and touch of pepper give weight and richness. Drink now.
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2012 Pfleck Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: This wine is still young, showing spice and not yet enough fruit. It has the right weight and potential richness as well as concentration from the old vines. Drink this ageworthy wine from 2016.
title: Ruhlmann 2013 Vieilles Vignes Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: Concentrated, with white fruits, a strong streak of herbaceousness, green apples and a rich texture. The wine shows intensity as well as youth. It really needs another year before drinking.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2006 Les Caillottes  (Pouilly-Fumé)

description: A full, soft Sauvignon from close to Sancerre. There is a light, yeasty character to this young wine, but the fruit is all there—fresh pink grapefruit, lime and green berries. The finish is acidic and crisp, but still mouth-filling.
title: Domaine Philippe Portier 2007  Quincy

description: A full, soft Sauvignon from close to Sancerre. There is a light, yeasty character to this young wine, but the fruit is all there—fresh pink grapefruit, lime and green berries. The finish is acidic and crisp, but still mouth-filling.
title: Domaine Philippe Portier 2007  Quincy

description: Full, firm white wine that gives good green fruit and pear flavors, lifted with spice from wood. The wine is round, while still retaining crispness from grassy acidity, and offers a good depth of plum skin structure and flavor.
title: Château Puy-Servain 2007 Marjolaine  (Montravel)

description: Full, firm white wine that gives good green fruit and pear flavors, lifted with spice from wood. The wine is round, while still retaining crispness from grassy acidity, and offers a good depth of plum skin structure and flavor.
title: Château Puy-Servain 2007 Marjolaine  (Montravel)

description: The richness of vintage 2003  shows in this wine's layers of dried fruits on top of sweet tannins and a dense concentration. There is some licorice flavor arriving as the wine matures.
title: Château Puy-Servain 2003 Vieilles Vignes  (Montravel)

description: The richness of vintage 2003  shows in this wine's layers of dried fruits on top of sweet tannins and a dense concentration. There is some licorice flavor arriving as the wine matures.
title: Château Puy-Servain 2003 Vieilles Vignes  (Montravel)

description: An enticingly perfumed wine, with its white flowers and apricot blossom. The palate is soft, rich, moving towards yellow fruits, ripe pink grapefruit and just an edge of mineral chalkiness.
title: Fournier Père et Fils 2006 Les Belles Vignes  (Sancerre)

description: A delicious wine, the Chenin Blanc giving both mineral and spice flavors, contrasting with the richer Chardonnay. Apricot and sweet melon flavors are supported by a fine, surprisingly complex structure. Fresh currants mark the refreshing finish.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine du Tariquet 2007 Chenin Blanc-Chardonnay (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: Made from Fer Servadou, Duras and Syrah, this is a wine with a truly local pedigree and a modern style, with prominent new wood. There are aromas that talk of wild heather and a dry landscape and palate notes of spice, ripe berries and prunes.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2006 Grande Tradition Red (Gaillac)

description: Made from Fer Servadou, Duras and Syrah, this is a wine with a truly local pedigree and a modern style, with prominent new wood. There are aromas that talk of wild heather and a dry landscape and palate notes of spice, ripe berries and prunes.
title: Domaine des Terrisses 2006 Grande Tradition Red (Gaillac)

description: A remarkably rich, spicy, attractive red. It obviously has new wood, but its use is judicious, leaving the mint, black berry and soft tannins of the fruit to come through well.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Mirail 2005 Les Mirlandes Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: A remarkably rich, spicy, attractive red. It obviously has new wood, but its use is judicious, leaving the mint, black berry and soft tannins of the fruit to come through well.
region: Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne
title: Domaine de Mirail 2005 Les Mirlandes Red (Vin de Pays des Côtes de Gascogne)

description: This totally fresh wine has benefited from the quality of whites in 2007 Bordeaux. It is lemony with pink grapefruit flavors giving an intense lift. There is some herbaceousness, with green herbs and juicy fruits. To drink now.
title: Yvon Mau 2007 Premius Bordeaux Sauvignon  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: A heavy dose of Sauvignon Blanc brings herbaceous, grassy, white currants and gooseberry flavors. It's young, and needs more time to coalesce. It is certainly fresh, fruity, right up front.
title: Château Lamothe-Vincent 2008 Sauvignon  (Bordeaux Blanc)

description: Although it is labeled “Extra Dry” (that is sweeter than Brut), this lively Champagne in its festive little pink bottle is very fresh, with delicious acidity. It finishes lightly, easily.
title: Pommery NV Pop Rosé Extra Dry  (Champagne)

description: From a large 177-acre estate in the southern Graves, this wine shows plenty of stalky, black currant fruits, fresh acidity and spice from wood. It has just the right characters for a food Bordeaux, dry core of tannins and vivid fruit around.
title: Château Pavillon de Boyrein 2006  Graves

description: A balanced wine, with softness that indicates a relatively high dosage. There is no complexity, but the wine is light, creamy, flavored with green plums and kiwi, just edged with bitterness.
title: Vranken NV Demoiselle Tête de Cuvée Brut  (Champagne)

description: This is a ripe wine and full of fruit. It has structure as well with its firm tannins and smoky backdrop. It will broaden out well and give a rich wine from 2018.
title: Château de Bel 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This is a fragrant, spicy wine that is shot through with red fruits and fine acidity. The 95% Merlot and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon blend is still firm with its tannins although the acidity and bright fruit are well in balance. Drink from 2018.
title: Château Cap Saint-Martin 2014  Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux

description: Partially from Grand Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims and the Côte des Blancs, this wine is soft, ripe and balanced, with a ripe dosage that contrasts with citrus acidity. It has a fine, cool texture.
title: Jacquart NV Brut Mosaïque  (Champagne)

description: Neatly divided between the three major grapes of Champagne, this full, ripe wine is packed with rich apple and pear fruits. It is crisp while showing a high dosage giving a softer, smoother aftertaste. Drink this bottling now.
title: Duménil NV Grande Réserve Premier Cru Brut  (Champagne)

description: From a estate in the Marmet family since 1990, the wine has ripe Merlot flavors that give a generous character. Big, bold fruitiness dominates this wine whose structure is firm while smooth. Drink starting from 2019.
title: Château Ségonzac 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Ripe fruit and balanced acidity allow this wine to make room for touches of wood aging. It has spice, a smoky character and attractive finishing freshness. Drink from 2017 when the wine will be fully balanced.
title: Château Saintongey 2014 Vieilles Vignes  (Bordeaux)

description: While the wine is firm and tannic at this early stage, it does have the potential to bring out a more fruity character. The red-berry fruits and acidity are there, promising a fresh wine from 2018.
title: Château Mougneaux 2014  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: The wood flavors are still prominent in this spicy wine. Heavily influenced by rich Merlot, the wine is lightly structured and more about juicy red fruits. Tannins in the back give enough shape, although it will be ready to drink from early 2017.
title: Château les Petits Arnauds 2014 Tradition  (Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux)

description: Juicy dark plum, cherry and boysenberry are upfront on the nose, with additional seductive hints of purple violet and vanilla. The palate is plush and fruit-forward, with ample acidity and medium tannins that lend pleasant structure. Accents of sweet spice grace the finish.
title: Frédéric Brouca 2013 Samsó Seulle Cinsault (Vin de France)

description: Juicy dark plum, cherry and boysenberry are upfront on the nose, with additional seductive hints of purple violet and vanilla. The palate is plush and fruit-forward, with ample acidity and medium tannins that lend pleasant structure. Accents of sweet spice grace the finish.
title: Frédéric Brouca 2013 Samsó Seulle Cinsault (Vin de France)

description: This Grenache-heavy blend (with 20% Syrah) offers a good amount of bittersweet cocoa powder and rich jammy black berries and all-fruit preserves on the nose and mouth. A hint of gaminess adds interest to the bouquet, while the crushed velvet texture and firm tannins transition into a long finish laced with earthy spice.
title: Loup Blanc 2007 La Mère Grand Red (Minervois)

description: A solid effort, with attractive, balanced black currant fruits and ripe acidity. The wine layers fruit and integrated tannins. It feels chunky and dense, finishing dry.
title: Château Ferrière 2009  Margaux

description: Full-bodied wine, spiced with nutmeg and toast and give richness by sweet blackberry juice flavors. It is densely structured, rich with great fruit character as well as a powerful drive of rich tannins. Age this wine at least four years and more.
title: Château Bel-Air Ortet 2009  Saint-Estèphe

description: Bruised apple and dandelion notes play spicily on the textured, slightly phenolic palate. The central streak of freshness brightens all aspects of the wine, which might gain complexity with a year or two more in bottle. For now it remains intriguingly poised between earthy richness and ethereal lift.
title: Domaine Roland Schmitt 2014 Grand A du Petit Léon Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: With intense acidity, this wine has both good structure and red currant and raspberry fruits. It is bright, fresh and almost crisp in character. In the background, the tannins show the dense texture of the wine. It will need to age, so don't drink before 2019.
title: Domaine René Bouvier 2014 Champ Salomon  (Marsannay)

description: Young vines, planted in 2007, give a fresh, fruity wine with attractive citrus and zingy orange flavors. It is ripe and deliciously perfumed with a touch of minerality and saltiness. Drink from 2019.
title: Domaine Jacques Prieur 2014 Grèves Premier Cru  (Beaune)

description: This is a blend from most parts of the village, with fruit from 14 different parcels. It is solid and firm while also having great swathes of raspberries and red plums laced together with acidity. The aftertaste is perfumed with a fresh lift. Drink from 2018
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: This is a blend from most parts of the village, with fruit from 14 different parcels. It is solid and firm while also having great swathes of raspberries and red plums laced together with acidity. The aftertaste is perfumed with a fresh lift. Drink from 2018
title: Domaine Faiveley 2014  Gevrey-Chambertin

description: With tannins and new-wood flavors, this rich wine is also structured. A smoky character from the wood is shot through by perfumed red fruits. The aftertaste shows more of the wood flavors that need to integrate. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Collotte 2014 Clos de Jeu  (Marsannay)

description: The Pinot-ness of this wine is undeniable: its structure is of velvet, and its aromas convey freshly turned earth, autumnal oak leaf and subdued red-cherry fruit. There is a depth that evokes deep forests. Have this with furred or feathered game.
title: Domaine Bott-Geyl 2012 Galets Oligocène Pinot Noir (Alsace)

description: A soft, stony scent of pebble and the faintest melon signals a fresh, clean wine. The palate plays these aromas out softly but also with precision. That stoniness lingers on the dry, gentle finish and the lasting flavor of fresh apple peel
title: Domaine Barmès-Buecher 2014 Rosenberg Sylvaner (Alsace)

description: While the wine has a crisp side, it's also full of red fruits and soft tannins. That makes for a wine that's fragrant, fruity, ready to drink and not likely to age much. Enjoy it now.
title: Manoir du Carra 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: This is a rich style of rosé, rounded and fruity with good texture, wild strawberry flavors and very crisp acidity at the end. It's an attractive wine and one that's worth keeping until 2015.
title: Laurent Gauthier 2013 Rosé (Beaujolais Rosé)

description: Attractive cherry flavors give a ripe, rounded feel that's balanced by the acidity and tannins. Black cherries burst easily from the glass, delivering a full aftertaste.
title: Georges Duboeuf 2013 Flower Label  (Beaujolais)

description: The wine is very fresh, with intense acidity and fragrant red fruits. Made from 100-year-old vines, it's tight, mineral and has a cool, light character with the merest hint of tannin. Drink now.
title: Domaine du Vissoux 2013 Coeur de Vendanges  (Beaujolais)

description: Some wood aging gives the fruitiness of the wine an added spice. Tannins support the bitter cherry flavors and add firmness to the juicy acidity. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine du Haut-Poncié 2013 Roche Grès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Some wood aging gives the fruitiness of the wine an added spice. Tannins support the bitter cherry flavors and add firmness to the juicy acidity. Drink from the end of 2015.
title: Domaine du Haut-Poncié 2013 Roche Grès  (Moulin-à-Vent)

description: Crisp while also fruity, it has bright acidity, lively citrus and apple flavors and a refreshing aftertaste. Drink now.
title: Domaine de Thulon 2013  Beaujolais-Villages

description: Chenin Blanc has found an unlikely new home in Cahors, to judge by the producers who are trying it out. It works well, giving a deliciously nutty character as well as intense citrus and minerality. Age this wine until 2015.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2013 K-libre Chenin Blanc (Côtes du Lot)

description: Chenin Blanc has found an unlikely new home in Cahors, to judge by the producers who are trying it out. It works well, giving a deliciously nutty character as well as intense citrus and minerality. Age this wine until 2015.
title: Clos Troteligotte 2013 K-libre Chenin Blanc (Côtes du Lot)

description: Soft, ripe and fruity, this is an immediately accessible, drinkable wine. It's soft with lemon and yellow fruits coming together to give a fresh, lively apéritif style of wine.
title: Mont Gravet 2013 Colombard (Côtes de Gascogne)

description: The wine is warm and round, full of ripe berry fruits and soft tannins. It's ready to drink now with its full structure, balanced acidity and juicy aftertaste.
title: Les Vins Aujoux 2013 Belle Grâce  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: The wine is warm and round, full of ripe berry fruits and soft tannins. It's ready to drink now with its full structure, balanced acidity and juicy aftertaste.
title: Les Vins Aujoux 2013 Belle Grâce  (Beaujolais-Villages)

description: This is a firm wine, balancing some solid tannins with ripe red fruits. Still young, it is packed with fruitiness and with acidity that are centered around a firm core. Drink this stylish wine from 2018.
title: Domaine Franck Besson 2014 Le Griottier  (Juliénas)

description: This 23-acre-estate is situated in the south of the Margaux appellation, close to classed growth Château Giscours. While not classified, it still has the ability to produce a fine ripe wine that also has great structure. Acidity and firm tannins are very present along with concentrated blackberry fruits. Drink this fine wine from 2019.
title: Château Mille-Roses 2012  Margaux

description: With ripe Merlot dominating this fine, blackberry flavored wine, it is fruity and rich. The acidity gives a crisper edge to the wine while the tannins come from a dry core. It is a wine in progress, full of potential and likely to be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Mayne Vieil 2014  Fronsac

description: Produced from 30-year-old vines, this 55% Cabernet Sauvignon wine is firm with tannins as well as black-currant fruit. It is balanced with the potential to become a fruity wine with a soft texture. The acidity will keep it crisp and on point. Drink from 2018.
title: Château La Branne 2014  Médoc

description: This is a perfumed wine, with mint flavors as well as blackberry fruits. There is still a dominant structure of tannins and the wood aging that will allow the wine to age well. The fruits give the wine weight while the aftertaste has great swathes of acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut-Logat 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: This is a perfumed wine, with mint flavors as well as blackberry fruits. There is still a dominant structure of tannins and the wood aging that will allow the wine to age well. The fruits give the wine weight while the aftertaste has great swathes of acidity. Drink from 2019.
title: Château Haut-Logat 2014  Haut-Médoc

description: This is the second wine from one of the group of chateaus with Corbin in their names. It is a tight wine, firm with tannins and with a concentrated texture and flavors of over-extraction. That said, the wine will probably develop over time into something serious with a dark, dense aftertaste.
title: Château Corbin 2014 Divin de Corbin  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This is the second wine from one of the group of chateaus with Corbin in their names. It is a tight wine, firm with tannins and with a concentrated texture and flavors of over-extraction. That said, the wine will probably develop over time into something serious with a dark, dense aftertaste.
title: Château Corbin 2014 Divin de Corbin  (Saint-Émilion)

description: The 45% Cabernet Sauvignon in this wine gives it structure and aging potential. It is a ripe wine that is also stylish with attractive acidity and plenty of black-currant fruitiness. The wine is developing well and it should be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 La Sérénité des Grands Chênes  (Médoc)

description: The 45% Cabernet Sauvignon in this wine gives it structure and aging potential. It is a ripe wine that is also stylish with attractive acidity and plenty of black-currant fruitiness. The wine is developing well and it should be ready to drink from 2018.
title: Bernard Magrez 2012 La Sérénité des Grands Chênes  (Médoc)

description: This is a powerful, almost concentrated, very dry selection. Its richness comes from the weight of its fruit flavors and the tight tang of its intense acidity. From a fine vintage, it could still age for several more years. Disgorged July 2011.
title: Bruno Paillard 2002 Assemblage Brut  (Champagne)

description: The extra age on this bone-dry wine has paid off, as the taut character of a young wine has been tempered with toast, creating a round feeling. It is perfectly in harmony now, beautiful and crisp.
designation: Oenophile Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2005 Oenophile Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: The extra age on this bone-dry wine has paid off, as the taut character of a young wine has been tempered with toast, creating a round feeling. It is perfectly in harmony now, beautiful and crisp.
designation: Oenophile Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
title: Pierre Gimonnet et Fils 2005 Oenophile Premier Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fight your way through the string and wax sealing that holds down the cork, and you'll discover a wine that is rich, full and opulent. The ripe peach character is balanced with the delicious toasty edge and final bright acidity. Ready to drink.
designation: Grande Réserve Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Jean Milan NV Grande Réserve Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Fight your way through the string and wax sealing that holds down the cork, and you'll discover a wine that is rich, full and opulent. The ripe peach character is balanced with the delicious toasty edge and final bright acidity. Ready to drink.
designation: Grande Réserve Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut
title: Jean Milan NV Grande Réserve Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Brut Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Now with its intensity and some bottle age, this wine—formerly known as Crémant de Cramant—is rich, with its apple flavor blending with an almond note and a soft, warm texture. The acidity shoots right through this ripe wine.
designation: Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs
title: G. H. Mumm NV Mumm de Cramant Blanc de Blancs Chardonnay (Champagne)

description: Blowsy, lychee aromas, a wine that is ripe, soft, open, with a light touch of acidity. Pepper and sweet spices fit well into this easy profile. Screwcap.
title: Dopff Au Moulin 2009 Gewürztraminer (Alsace)

description: A soft style of Riesling, with some attractive aromatic white flower character. The fruit is soft, just off dry, freshened by acidity. Screwcap.
title: Cave de Beblenheim 2009 Baron de Hoen Riesling (Alsace)

description: This wine has acidity and a good balance between the fresh, crisp character and the richer yellow fruits. It is ready to drink.
title: Paul Reitz 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This wine has acidity and a good balance between the fresh, crisp character and the richer yellow fruits. It is ready to drink.
title: Paul Reitz 2014  Saint-Véran

description: This light and fruity wine offers soft tannins and an earthy character. The wine comes mainly from Beaujolais with 15% of Pinot Noir from the Mâcon region. Drink now.
title: Patriarche Père et Fils 2014  Coteaux Bourguignons

description: This wine is extracted and tough. The acidity does come through to help out, although it still has a hard edge with some bitter toast. It will soften, leaving some perfumed fruit for the future.
title: Domaine Poulleau Père et Fils 2014  Chorey-lès-Beaune

description: This is a soft and jammy wine with attractive ripe strawberry fruit and only the lightest structure. It is gentle, rounded and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Michel Goubard 2014 Mont-Avril  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: This is a soft and jammy wine with attractive ripe strawberry fruit and only the lightest structure. It is gentle, rounded and ready to drink.
title: Domaine Michel Goubard 2014 Mont-Avril  (Côte Chalonnaise)

description: Here is a simple but tasty Chard, offering attractive notes of pear, spiced orange and toasted apple skin on the nose and mouth. It's light weight and well balanced, with ample acidity and a short but clean finish. Enjoy now.
title: Kiwi Cuvée 2014 Bin 068 Chardonnay (Vin de France)

description: This soft wine has a gentle texture and smooth white fruits. It is fruity and lightly perfumed. With its crisp edge of acidity, is totally ready to drink.
title: Cave de Viré 2015 Grande Réserve du Président  (Mâcon-Villages)

description: An addition to the worldwide JCB brand, produced by the Boisset family of Burgundy, this feels rich and sumptuous, full of ripe red fruits and juicy plums. It is also balanced and well structured. Drink this wine with food.
title: JCB 2014 No. 5 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This wine is full in the mouth with a taste between pepper and fruit. It's ripe, rounded and tangy with clementine zest as well crisp apples and red currants. It could benefit from a few months in bottle, so drink from late 2015.
title: Domaine Sainte-Marie 2014 VieVité Extraordinaire Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rounded and soft, this rich rosé is fruity while also perfumed. The blending of Syrah in the mix gives the wine a sense of power and concentration, making it an adquate partner at the dinner table.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2014 L'Esprit de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Rounded and soft, this rich rosé is fruity while also perfumed. The blending of Syrah in the mix gives the wine a sense of power and concentration, making it an adquate partner at the dinner table.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2014 L'Esprit de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Very fruity and fresh, this wine has crisp apples as well as red fruit giving it a bright, delicious feeling. The acidity goes right through the wine, giving a beautifully fresh feel that points up the fragrant raspberries. Vineyards are in the heart of the sandy soils of the Saint Tropez peninsula.
title: Domaine de la Bastide Blanche 2014 TwoB Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This rich and impressive wine has structure and a firm texture, partly from the Cabernet Sauvignon in the blend (45% Grenache, 35% Syrah, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon). It is dense and full of juicy red fruits, caramel and delicious spice. Production is only 2,500 cases. It would be worth aging for a few more months, so drink from late 2015.
title: Château Vignelaure 2014 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: While the wine is really pale in color, it does have a great range of flavors, offering red fruit notes balanced by beautiful acidity and citrus streaks. It's gently textured, giving a good bite to the fruitiness at the end.
title: Château Sainte Marguerite 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Produced by the owners of Châteauneuf-du-Pape estate Château Mont-Redon, this is a full and fruity wine. It has a good balance between acidity and red berry fruits that give a rich character. Packed with flavor, it's ready to drink.
title: Château Riotor 2014 Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Always released after a further year's aging, this rich and full-bodied wine is now at its peak. With a dense texture, layers of spice and vanilla as well as intense red fruits, this powerful wine expresses the more complex side of Provence rosé. Drink now.
title: Château d'Esclans 2013 Les Clans Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Always released after a further year's aging, this rich and full-bodied wine is now at its peak. With a dense texture, layers of spice and vanilla as well as intense red fruits, this powerful wine expresses the more complex side of Provence rosé. Drink now.
title: Château d'Esclans 2013 Les Clans Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: Freshly cut red, yellow and green apples make both nose and palate very fruity. The dry palate with its lemony freshness and open aspect lets all the apple flavors shine and inflects them here and there with baked and dried apple, too. Wonderfully fruity and pure.
title: Sipp Mack 2014 Rosacker Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Freshly cut red, yellow and green apples make both nose and palate very fruity. The dry palate with its lemony freshness and open aspect lets all the apple flavors shine and inflects them here and there with baked and dried apple, too. Wonderfully fruity and pure.
title: Sipp Mack 2014 Rosacker Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Subtle notes of clean, fresh lemon zest promise pleasure, the palate reveals a far riper aspect of fresh red apple and baked apples. The dry palate remains zingy and clean and provides ample textured freshness. The effect is that of fresh apple sorbet.
title: Kuentz-Bas 2014 Pfersigberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: There are mere hints of beeswax and marzipan on the nose. The palate opens into a structured, bright and well-lit space of pear peel, pear juice and a wonderfully bitter edge. This is off-dry and concentrated, definite but with a light touch. There is an intriguing hint of bitter orange peel that draws you in and pull this onto a higher plane.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2012 Kessler Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: There are mere hints of beeswax and marzipan on the nose. The palate opens into a structured, bright and well-lit space of pear peel, pear juice and a wonderfully bitter edge. This is off-dry and concentrated, definite but with a light touch. There is an intriguing hint of bitter orange peel that draws you in and pull this onto a higher plane.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2012 Kessler Grand Cru Pinot Gris (Alsace)

description: A very subdued nose suggests some dried orange peel but the palate is full of life: there is bracing, bright and lemon-scented acidity on the dry palate and drenched stone. There is concentration and a texture of the finest, purest citrus oil. This is wonderfully mature and ready now but has the stuffing to last. Drink 2016–2020.
title: Domaines Schlumberger 2010 Kitterlé Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: A rather perfumed nose hints at the Gewurztraminer that colors this Riesling with rose petal and honeysuckle notes. The co-planted varieties in this vineyard make a smashing duo since they are almost polar opposites: structured, straight-laced Riesling with its fine spine of acidity benefits from the playfulness and charm of aromatic, fleshy Gewurztraminer which in turn is lit up by Riesling's freshness. Really, this is a case where you can have the best of both worlds.
title: Biecher & Schaal 2014 Altenberg de Bergheim Grand Cru White (Alsace)

description: Ripe fragrant, yellow mirabelle plums constitute the chief perfume of this charming wine. The palate holds even more fruity nuance but is dry, concentrated and linear, being carried forward by zesty freshness and lemony overtones. This is clean, charming, taut and dry with a bracing nature and a clean, brisk finish.
title: Jean-Marc Bernhard 2013 Wineck-Schlossberg Grand Cru Riesling (Alsace)

description: Lifted notes of honey and rose petal play on the nose, the palate is altogether more lively than the nose suggests: sprightly and fresh, concentrated and caramel-tinged with lemon freshness. This strikes an appetizing, moreish palate and makes for joyful drinking.
title: Willm 2011 Vendanges Tardives Gewurztraminer (Alsace)

description: This medium-bodied blend of 50% Grenache and 50% Syrah is simple but satisfying. Ripe cherries and raspberries carry the load, dressed up by hints of vanilla and cinnamon. A soft dustiness marks the texture, turning silky on the finish. Drink now–2020.
title: Lavau 2015 La Decelle Red

description: A ripe perfumed wine with fine tannins as well as dense fruit. Blackberry flavors are up there along with the acidity and crisp aftertaste. It's a wine with a good future, ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Maison Noble Saint Martin 2015 Château Jean de Bel Air  (Bordeaux)

description: A ripe perfumed wine with fine tannins as well as dense fruit. Blackberry flavors are up there along with the acidity and crisp aftertaste. It's a wine with a good future, ready to drink from 2018.
title: Château Maison Noble Saint Martin 2015 Château Jean de Bel Air  (Bordeaux)

description: From a Grand Cru estate, this second wine shows the same rich fruit and generous structure as the winery's first wine. It's just softer with an approachable character and generous black fruits that will enable it to mature relatively quickly. Drink from 2020.
title: Château de Pressac 2014 Les Terrasses de Pressac  (Saint-Émilion)

description: This is a juicy wine with its red fruits and attractive acidity. The wood aging still shows, perhaps too strongly, but that fruit is already a major factor in the success of the wine. Drink from 2019.
title: Château de l'Aubrade 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: This bend of 70% Syrah and 30% Grenache is nevertheless very pale in hue. the nose hints at wet stone, thyme and bay leaf, while the medium-bodied palate delivers a harmonious blend of red berries and citrus. Long on the finish, with mouthwatering persistence.
title: Château de Campuget 2016 Tradition Rosé (Costières de Nîmes)

description: Fruity and ripe, the wine also has some solid structure to give it a core of dark tannins. The black-currant fruits are developing well, bringing their crispness to the party. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Château Bois Chantant 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Fruity and ripe, the wine also has some solid structure to give it a core of dark tannins. The black-currant fruits are developing well, bringing their crispness to the party. Drink this wine from 2018.
title: Château Bois Chantant 2015  Bordeaux Supérieur

description: Named after the Negrel family, owners of the estate, this is the top cuvée in their range. Aging in wood gives it a surprising series of flavors ranging from caramel to spice to buttery toast. While some of the fruit is lost along the way, the wine has a rounded, very complete character that is rich and made for food.
title: Mas de Cadenet 2015 Mas Negrel Cadenet Rosé (Côtes de Provence Sainte-Victoire)

description: Coming from a remote estate on the edge of the Lubéron mountains in the north of Provence, this wine is impressively rich. It gains great concentration and structure from the Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah in the blend. Full of ripe red fruits, it is dense at the end.
title: Château Vignelaure 2015 Rosé (Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence)

description: This producer shows its preference for dry Champagnes with this bone-dry, oak-fermented bottling. With its bottle age and the softening effect of wood, it's generous and gently textured, leaving plenty of room for its bright fruit and balanced acidity to show. Drink from 2018.
title: Jeaunaux-Robin NV Brut Zéro Sélection  (Champagne)

description: From a walled vineyard once owned by the local bishop, this wine is structured and firm while also having great red cherry and berry fruit. It's one of a number of Premier Crus from this producer—and certainly the most expressive with its generous fruit and balanced tannins. Drink from 2018.
title: Domaine Jeannin-Naltet 2014 Le Clos l'Evêque Premier Cru  (Mercurey)

description: Aged for an extra two years to soften its tense acidity, this Champagne is defiantly bone-dry yet not searing. Its ripe and rich fruitiness cushions the crisp acidity and taut, nervy citrus character. Drink now.
title: Boude Baudin NV B. Zéro Brut Dosage  (Champagne)

description: This potentially rich Champagne is still young. The Chardonnay and Pinot Noir that dominate the blend show tight acidity, minerality and a tangy, orange-like edge. Give it time to mature, and it will be splendid.
title: Boude Baudin 2010 Cuvée St Clément  (Champagne)

description: A simple but attractive Côtes du Rhône, with impressively pure cherry-berry fruit, medium body and a slightly chunky feel. Drink it over the next couple of years.
title: Alain Jaume et Fils 2009 Réserve Grand Veneur Red (Côtes du Rhône)

description: This is a big, spicy wine, with very ripe flavors of red berries. It''ss concentrated, with layers of pepper a tight lemon-zest acidity.
title: Domaine du Grand Cros 2011 L'Esprit de Provence Rosé (Côtes de Provence)

description: This is a big, spicy wine, with very ripe flavors of red berries. It''ss concentrated, with layers of pepper a tight lemon-zest acidity.
